prekṣāvatpravṛttaye vyākaraṇasya viṣayaṃ bhagavān bhāṣyakāraḥ prādarśayat ``atha śabdānuśāsanam iti| athaśabdaḥ prārambhasya dyotako na tu vācakaḥ, nipātatvāt upasargavat| na ca te'pi vācakā eveti vācyam, `upāsyate guruḥ' `anubhūyate sukham' ityādau dhātoḥ sakarmakakriyāparatvaṃ vinā karmaṇi lakārāyogena vācakatve sthite upasargāṇāṃ dyotakatvasyaiva yuktatvāt| nanūktayuttyā'stūpasargāṇāṃ dyotakatā nipātāntaraṃ tu vācakameviti cet ? na, sākṣātkriyate alaṃkriyate ūrīkriyate ityādau karmaṇi lakāreṇa karmībhūtasya gurvāderabhidhānasiddhaye dhātvarthaṃ prati karmatvasya vācyatvāt, upasargatvāpekṣayā nipātatvasyādhikavṛttitayā tadavacchedenaiva dyotakatākalpanācca| sāmānye pramāṇānāṃ pakṣapātāt| nipātatvaṃ cā'khaṇkaḍopādhirūpaṃ jātirūpaṃ śabdasvarūpameva ceti pakṣatraye'pi prādicādisādhāraṇameva| pratvādipratyekaparyavasannaṃ taditi pakṣe'pi vrādīnāṃ cādibhyo vailakṣaṇyānirukteḥ kevalānāmaprayogeṇa anyalabhyatā'pi tulyaiva| vijayate ityatra dhātorviśeṣṭajaya iva ghaṭaścetyatra samuccitaghaṭe ghaṭaśabdasyāpi lakṣaṇāyāḥ saṃbhavāt| kiñca cādīnāṃ vācakatve samānādhikaraṇaprātipadikārthayorabedānvaya iti vyutpattirnipātetaraviṣayakatayā vinā pramāṇaṃ saṃkocanīyā syāt, syācca samuccayādiśabdayoga iva cādiyoge'pi ghaṭādeḥ ṣaṣṭhī| kiñca samuccayādipadairupasthite yathā viśeṣaṇasambandhastathā cādibhirupasthite'pi syāt| dyotakatvapakṣe tu padārthaikadeśatvānna tatra viśeṣaṇānvayaḥ| api ca----
śarairusrairivodīcyānuddhāriṣyan rasāniva|
ityādau usrasadṛśaiḥ śaraiḥ rasasadṛśānudīcyānuddharipyannityādirarthaḥ| sa ca usrādiśabdānāṃ tatsadṛśaparatve ivaśabdasya ca tātparyagrāhakatve satyeva labhyate| anyathā pratyayānāṃ prakṛtyarthānvitasvārthabodhajanakatā'pi bhajyeta| ivaśabdāttu tṛtīyā durlabhā, asattvārthakatayā kārakavibhaktyayogāt| evamapyusrādibhyastṛtīyāyā'nanvayasyānuddhārācca| nanvevaṃ nañtatpuruṣasyottarapadārthādiprādhānyamityādisiddhāntā bhajyeranniti cet ? na, pūrvapadadyotyaṃ prati prādhānyamiti tadarthāt| dyotyārthenā(1)pyarthavatteti prātipadikatvasiddhi| ata eva yeṣāṃ dyotyo'pyartho nāsti ``tu hi ca sma ha vai pādapūraṇe ityamarakośāt ``kamīmidviti pādapūraṇārthāḥ iti nirūktācca, tadarthaṃ ``nipātasyānarthakasya iti vārtikārambha ityavadheyam| sphuṭañcedaṅkaiyaṭādigrantheṣu| ata evā''kṛtyādhikaraṇe bhaṭṭairuktam---
caturvidhe pade cātra dvividhasyārthanirṇayaḥ|
kriyate saṃśayotpatternopasarganipātayoḥ ||
tayorarthābhidhāne hi vyāpāro naiva vidyate|
yadarthadyotakau tau tu vācakaḥ sa vicāryate || iti ||
yattu arthavatsūtre `adhīte' ityādau dhātoranarthakatā upasargaviśiṣṭasya vācakateti kaiściduktaṃ, tadabhyuccayamātram| ``sarvasya dve iti sūtre kaiyaṭādigrantho'pyevameva| pūrvottaramīmāṃsayostatratatra natraḥ paryyudāse lakṣaṇeti granthā apyevameva, uktayukteḥ| astu vā matāntaraṃ nipātā vācakā iti, sarvathāpi prādayo dyotakāścādayastu vācakā ityevaṃrūpamarddhajaratīyaṃ naiyāyikābhyupagatamaprāmāṇikameveti dik |
anupṛrvakaḥ śāsirvivicya jñāpane dṛṣṭaḥ| tadyathā--``akṣetravitkṣetravidaṃ hyaprāṭ sa praiti kṣetravidānuśiṣṭaḥ| yathā vā--``saṃpūṣanviduṣā naya yo añjasā'nuśāsati| ya evedamiti vravat| atra hi guṇatrayopetena sadguruṇā'smān śikṣayeti pūṣā prārthyate| tatra añjaseti saighrayamuktam| anuśāsatīti vivicya bodhakaṃtvam| ``bahulañchandasi iti śapo na luk| idamityameveti yo brūyāditi prameyaniṣkarṣa uktaḥ| bravadityatra ``leṭoḍāṭau ityaṭ| tathāca anuśiṣyante vivitacya asādhubhyo vibhajya bodyante yeneti karaṇelyuṭ| tataśśabdānāmiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, tadantena samāsaḥ| na ca ``karmmaṇi ca iti sūtreṇa samāsāniṣedhaḥ śaṅkhyaḥ, tatra ca śa(1)bdārthatayā karmmaṇīti śabdavatā ``ubhaūyapraptau itisūtreṇa yā ṣaṣṭhī tadantaṃ na samasyate ityarthāt| `citraṃ gavāṃ doho'gopena' ityatra hi āścaryaṃ pratipādyaṃ, tacca yadyaśikṣito dogdhā durdohā gāvaśca dogdhavyāstadaiva nirvahati, na tvanyathā| ataḥ kartṛkarmaṇorviśiṣyopādānādastyubhayaprāptiḥ| iha tu śabdānāmidamanuśāsanaṃ na tvarthānāmityarthanivṛttiparaṃ vākyaṃ na tu karttṛviśeṣanivṛttiparamato nāstyubhayaprāptiḥ| astu vā athākathañcidubhayaprāptiḥ| tathāpi na kṣatiḥ, ``ubhayaprāptau itisūtre aviśepeṇa vibhāṣeti pakṣasyāpi vakṣ‌yamāṇatayā niyamāpravṛttipakṣe ācāryasya śabdānuśāsanamiti prayogasaṃbhāvat| śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī vā'stu| tasmādvaidikā laukikāśca śādhavaḥ| śabdā iha viṣaya iti sthitam| vede bhavā vaidikāḥ, adhyātmāditvāṭhṭhañ| evaṃ loke bhavā laukikāḥ| yadvā loke viditā laukikāḥ ``tatra vidita iti varttamāne ``lokasarvalokāṭṭhaña| prātiśakhyoṣviva na vaidikaikadeśamātramiha viṣayaḥ| na vā vyākaraṇāntareṣviva chāndasaparityāga iti sūcayitumubhayopādānam ||
|| iti viṣayanirūpaṇam ||
syādetattū, gaurityādiḥ śabda iha viṣayaḥ| tatra ca gakāra aukāro viśargaśca ghaṭakaḥ| vyutpādyate tu ḍopratyayasupratyayarvādeśādikam| na caitadgauriti bodhe bhāste| tathācārthāntaratā| gaurityanena pariniṣṭhitena saha ḍoprabhṛtīnāṃ sambandhaviśeṣastatpratipattyupayogitā cāstīti tadvyutpādanāmiti cet ? na, śabdāntaravyāvṛttasya sambandhasya upayogasya ca durvacatvāt dravyaguṇādipadārthānāmiha pyutpādyatāpatteśca| asti hi teṣāṃ gaurityanena vācyavācakabhāvādiḥ sambandhaḥ| ata eva śābdabodhe gavi samavāyena gotvamiva śaktyāśyasambandhena śabdo viśeṣaṇatayā bhāsate| cākṣuṣabodhe'pi vyaktayā smāritaḥ śabdo viśeṣaṇamityabhyupagamaḥ| āha ca---
na so'sti pratyayo loke yaḥ śabdānugamādṛte|
anuviddhamiva jñānāṃ sarvaṃ śabdena bhāsate ||
grāhyatvaṃ grāhakatvaṃ ca dve śaktī tejaso yathā|
tathaiva sarvaśabdānāmete pṛthagavasthite || iti ||
yatsaṃjñāsmaraṇaṃ tatra na padapyanyahetukam ||
piṇḍa eva hi dṛṣṭaḥ san saṃjñāṃ smārayituṃ kṣamaḥ ||
iti ca|
yuktaṃ caitat, gṛhītaśaktikaṃ prati śabdenārthasyeva arthena śabdasyāpi smaraṇe bādhakābhāvāt| ata eva gotvasyeva gośabdasyāpi vyaktiviśeṣaṇatvāviśeṣātsaṃsargo'pi tādātmyamevāstu| evaṃ goguṇādibhirapi tadabhinnābhinnasya tadabhedādityāśayena ``atha gaurityatra kaḥ śabdaḥ iti praghaṭṭake dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyaiḥ saha śabdasyābhedo bhāṣyakṛdbhirāśaṅkya nirākṛtaḥ| tatra nirākaraṇagranthasyāyamāśayaḥ--samasattākabhedābhedau viruddhāveva| anyathā tvaduktarītyā sattāguṇatvādyabhedātsukhaduḥkhasvarganarakāderapyabhedāpattau pravṛttinivṛttivyavasthā na syāt, na syācca bhedagrahād bhramanivṛttiḥ| jātivyaktyādisambandhastvatirikta eveti| evameva śabdenāpi sahāstyeva sambandho dravyādīnāmiti sthitam| asti ca dravyādivyutpādanasya prakṛte upayogo'pi| asminnarthe'yaṃ sādhurityarthāviśeṣaṃ puraskṛtyaiva sādhutvasya vaktavyatvāt| ata eva vājini daridre ca krameṇa aśrvaśabdau asvaśabdaśca sādhurvyutkrameṇa tvasādhuriti siddhāntaḥ|
nanu yathā vaiśeṣikādīnāmetacchāstrasiddhameva prakṛtipratyayavibhāgamupajīvya padārthavyutpādanāya pravṛttiḥ, prakṛtipratyayādivicārastu kvācitkaḥ prāsaṅgikastathehāpi lokaprasiddhaṃ darśanāntarasiddhaṃ ca padārthajātamupajīvya śabdamātravyutpādanaṃ na virudhyate iti cet ? astu tāvadevaṃ, tatāpi ḍoprabhṛtivyutpādanaṃ niṣphalameva; iti cet ? atrocyate, gaustiṣṭhati devadattaḥ pacatītyādayaḥ śṛṅgagrāhikayā tāvajjanmasahasraṇāpi bodhayituṃ boddhuṃ cāśakyāḥ, ānantyāt| ataḥ prakṛtipratyayavibhāgaklapanārūpo laghubhūta upāyaḥ samāśrīyate lipivat| āropita eva ca tatra sambandhaḥ| prasiddho hi sthūlārundhatīśākhācandrādinyāyo loke, pañcakośāvataraṇanyāyaścottaramīmāṃsāyām| tātparyaviṣayābādhācca prāmāṇyam| eṣaiva hyarthavādeṣvapi gatiḥ| ātmavapotkhedanaprabhṛtīnāṃ bādhe'pi tātparyaviṣayībhūtasya prāśastyasyābādhitatvāt| uktaṃ ca hariṇā---
upāyāḥ śikṣamāṇānāṃ bālānāmupūlālanāḥ|
astye vartmani sthitvā tataḥ satyaṃ samīhate || iti ||
upeyapratipattyarthā upāyā avyavasthitāḥ| iti ca|
ata eva hi kecitsupratyayaṃ vidadhati, apare sim| tathā sūtrarītyā `pāṭhitam' ityatra itapratyayaḥ, bhāṣyarītyā tapratyayaḥ, sūtrarītyā tāvāniti vatup ``ḍāvatāvarthavaiśeṣyāt iti vārttikoktarītyā ḍāvaturiti dik|
etena `pacati' ityādau ādeśaiḥ smārthamāṇā laḍādayo bodhakā iti vadantaḥ parāstāḥ| tathā hi, vṛddhavyavahārācchaktigraha iti nirvivādam| tataśca prayogasamavāyināmeva tiprabhṛtīnāṃ śaktiḥ sidhyati, na tvalaukikānāṃ lādīnām| evaṃ ḍupacaṣ ḍukṛñ ityādiprakṛtayo vicakvibādipratyayāśca na śaktāḥ kintu apākṣīt papāca pāpacyate karoti carkarīti ityādiprayogasamavāyinaḥ apāk papāc ityādaya eva|
śrūyamāṇena ḍupacaṣprabhṛtīnāṃ smaraṇaṃ tenārthabodha iti cet ? na, lāghavalādvyavasthitatvācca śrūyamāṇānāmevārthasambandhakalpanāt, autprekṣikasya smaraṇakalpane gauravāt, avyavasthāpatteśca| `pacati(1)devadattaḥ', `pacantaṃ taṃ paśya' iti tipśakṛbhyāṃ smāritasya laṭa eva bodhakatve ekatra ādhāradheyabhāvena saṃsargeṇa devadatte ākhyātārtho yatno viśeṣaṇamitaratra tu abhedena saṃ sargeṇa kṛdarthaḥ karttā viśeṣaṇāmiti tvātsiddhāntabhaṅgāpatteśca| etena kartradhikaraṇe ākhyātārthatvaṃ karturnirasya jañjabhyamānādhikaraṇe śānarjthatvaṃ svīkurvanto mīmāṃsakā api parāstāḥ|
yattu tairuktaṃ śānajaṃśe `` karttari kṛt iti vyākaraṇaṃ śaktigrāhakamastīti; tadapyāpātataḥ, kṛdvākyaśeṣo'yamanirddiṣṭārtheṣu ṇvulādiṣūpatiṣṭhate na tu śatrādiṣu sthānyarthena nirākāṅkṣatvāditi vakṣyamāṇatvāt| ākāṅkṣitavidhānaṃ jyāya iti nyāyāt| anyathā kriymāṇa iti karmmaṇi śānaco daurlabhyāpatteśca| kiñca ``karttari kṛt iti catkartṛgrahaṇaṃ tadeva ``laḥ karmaṇi ityatrāpyanuvṛttaṃ, tatkathaṃ kṛtāṃ tiṅāṃ ca vailakṣaṇayam ? anyalabhyatvāderubhayatra sāmyāt|
yattu nāmārthayorabheda eva saṃsarga iti hi śānajādau karttā vācya ityuktam, tattu pacatikalpaṃ pacatirupaṃ devadatta ityādyanurodhāttiṅkṣvapi tulyam| tasmātpararītyā na kāścicchatrantāttiṅante vaiṣamyahetuḥ| asmadrītyā tu ``bhāvapravānamākhyātaṃ, sattvapradhānāni nāmāni iti niruktakārokteḥ pratyayārthaprādhānyamautsargikaṃ tiṅṣu tyajyate, `pradhānapratyayārthavacanamarthasyānyapramāṇatvāt iti sūtrācca| śatṛśānajvidhau rūpavidhau ca bhāṣye'pi sphuṭamatet| `pācako vrajati' itivat `pacativrajati' iti prayoge'pyata eva nopapadyate, pacatorūpaṃ pacantirūpamityādau rūpabādyante dvivacanādikañca na bhavati| tasmāttiṅṣu kṛtsu ca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavyatyāsamātramastīti vakṣyate|
yattu bhaṭṭai--karttari yadekatvaṃ tatraikavacanaṃ tibiti lādividheḥ ``dvyekayoḥ ityādeścaikavākyatayā vyākhyānānna karturvācyatā sūtrādāyātīti, tadapyāpātataḥ| dvivacanādisaṃjñā hyādeśaniṣṭhā, tataśca tadvidinā ``dvyekayoḥ ityasya ekavākyatā, na ca tatra karttarītyasti, yad dvitvādiviśeṣaṇatayā kathañcidyojyeta| lavidhitibādividhyorapyekavākyatāstīti cet ? satyam, vākyaikavākyatā sā, na tu padaikavākyatā ādeśavidherlavidhilabhyalakārānuvādena pravṛtteḥ| lavidhau kartṛgrahaṇam| sa ca dvivacanādisaṃjñāvinirmukta eva| ata eva ādeśasmāritā lakārā bodhakā iti pakṣe ekatvādibhānāyā''deśā eva śaraṇīkartavyāḥ| evaṃ ṇalādau tibādīdvārakaṃ liḍādismaraṇaṃ kalpyamiti mahadeva gauravam| na ca paramparāsambandhena ṇaleva bodhakaḥ, vṛttiśūnyatvāt| ata evāpabhraṃśānāṃ sādhusmārakatābhyupagamastavāpīti dik|
tasmāt ``pūrvatrāsiddham ityādau yathā āhāryāropeṇaiva vyākhyānaṃ sarvasaṃmataṃ tathā sāstrīyaprakriyāyāṃ sarvatra|
vastutastu vācakatā sphoṭaikaniṣṭhā| tatra cāṣṭau pakṣāḥ--varṇasphoṭaḥ 1, padasphoṭaḥ 2 , vākyasphoṭāḥ 3, akhaṇḍapadasphoṭaḥ 4, tādṛgvākyasphoṭaḥ 5, itthaṃ pañca vyaktisphoṭāḥ, varṇapadavākyabhedena trividho jātisphoṭa iti| tathā hi, kiñcidvarṇavyatyāsādinā śaktatāvacchedakānupūrvībhaṅgasya pratipadamaitsargikatvāttatra ca kenacitkvacitprathamaṃ śaktigrahātkena kasya smāraṇamityatra vinigamanāvirahādṛṣabho vṛṣabho vṛṣa ityādāviva kar kār kur cakar ityādīnāṃ prayogasamavāyināṃ sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ tattadānupūrvyavacchainnānāṃ vācakateti varṇasphoṭapakṣaḥ| karprabhṛtayo vācakā na veti ceha vipratipattiśarīram || 1 || `rāmaṃ rāmeṇa rāmāya haraye harau harīn' ityādau pariniṣṭhite rūpe kiyānāṃśo dravyādivācakaḥ kiyāṃśca karmatvāderityasya vinigantumaśakyatayā rāmamityādipariniṣṭhataṃ padameva vācakaṃ karmatvādiviśiṣṭhasyeti padasphoṭapakṣaḥ || 2 || dadhādaṃ, hareva, viṣṇova, ityādāvapi vinigamanāvirahataulyādvākyameva viśiṣṭārthe śaktamiti vākyasphoṭaḥ || 3 || ekaḥ paṭa iti vadekaṃ padaṃ vākyaṃ vetyabādhitapratītervarṇātiriktameva padaṃ vākyaṃ vā akhṇḍaṃ varṇavyaṅgyam| ekatvapratītiraupādhikīti cet ? paṭepi tathātvāpatteḥ || kaḥ padārthosāviti cat ? bhāvaḥ| bhāvaviśeṣeṣu kvāntarbhavatīti cet ? tvatparibhāṣiteṣu dravyādiṣu māntarbhūt| nahyetāvatā pramāṇasiddhaṃ pratyākhyātuṃ śakyate| āniyatapadārthavāde gauravamiti cet ? vyaktīyattā tavāpi nāsti| upādhīyattā tu sarvaiḥ suvacā| bhāvatvābhāvatvābhyāṃ nityatvānityatvādinā vā vibhajanāt| bhāvavibhājakopādhayastu ghaṭavibhājakopādhivadevā'nāvaśyakāḥ| asmiṃśca pakṣadvaye varṇā apyanāvaśyakāḥ| nanvanubhavasiddhāste iti cet ? vyañjakaghvaniviśeṣopahitasphoṭa eva kakārādyātmanā vyavahiyate ityabhyupagamāt| bhāṭṭamate tāro mando gakāra itivat advaitasiddhānte viṣayasaṃbandhajanyavṛttivaicitryeṇa vyaṅgye svarūpasukhe vaicitryavacca| ataeva vācaspatimiśrāstatatvabindau ``vastutaḥ kakārādatiricyamānamūrttergakārasyābhāvāt iti sphoṭavādimatamupanyāsthat| yathā vā akhaṇkaḍeṣvapi ṛkārādiṣu varṇeṣu varṇāntarasamānākāraikadeśāvabhāsaḥ, tathā'tra pakṣe varṇāvabhāso'pi bhaviṣyati| uktaṃ ca bopadevena----

aupādhiko vā bhedo'stu varṇānāṃ tāramandavat || iti ||

vākyātpadānāmatyantaṃ praviveko na kaścana || iti ||
tasmādakhaṇḍaṃ padaṃ vākyaṃ veti || 5 || pañcāpi vyaktisphoṭāvāntarabhedāḥ|
jātisphoṭavādinastu ghottaraṭatvādikaṃ śaktatāvacchedakatayā ādyapakṣatraye'pi yathāyayaṃ vācyam| anyathā saro rasa ityādāvarthaviśeṣapratītyanāpatteḥ| tacca upādhirūpam| upādhiśca paramparāsaṃbaddhā jātireva| sā ca sarvādhiṣṭānabrahmasvarūpātmikā| tathā ca śakyāṃśa iva śaktāṃśe'pi nyāyasāmyenākṛtyādhikaraṇarītyā brahmatattvameva tattadupahitaṃ vācyaṃ vācakaṃ ca| avidyavidyakadharmaviśeṣo vā jātiriti pakṣe tu saiva vācikā'stvityāhuḥ || 6 ||
aṣṭāvapyete pakṣāḥ siddhāntagrantheṣu tatratatropanibaddhāḥ| tathā hi, sthānivatsūtre ``sarve sarvapadādeśāḥ itibhāṣyagranthaḥ| padyate'rtho'neneti arthavadihīpadaṃ na tu suptiṅantameva| tathāca ``eru ityasyatesturityartha iti ṭīkāgranthaśca varṇasphoṭe'nukūlaḥ| tathā sthānyarthābhidhānasamarthasyaivādeśatvamiti sthānentaratamaparibhāṣayaiva ``tastha sthamipām ityādiṣu nirvāhāttadarthaṃ yathāsaṃkhyasūtraṃ nārabdhavyamiti bhāṣyamapi| padasphoṭavākyasphoṭau tu ihaiva praghaṭṭake ``yenoccāritena iti bhāṣyapratīkamupādāya kaiyaṭena bhāṣyarthatayā varṇitau| varṇavyatiriktasya padasya vākyasya veti vadatā tayorakhaṇḍatāpyuktā| ``nityeṣu śabdeṣu kūṭasthairavicālibhirvarṇairbhavitavyam iti tatratatra bhāṣye sakhaṇḍatoktā|
māyāniścalayantreṣu kaitavānṛtarāśiṣu|
ayoghane śailaśṛṅge sīrāṅge kūṭamastriyām ||
ityamaraḥ| paspaśāyāmeva praghaṭṭakāntare ``kiṃpunaḥ ityādi bhāṣyamupādāya `kecidvarṇasphoṭamapare padasphoṭaṃ vākyasphoṭaṃ cāhuḥ' iti vadatā kaiyaṭena `` aiuṇ ityatra vyaktisphoṭajātispoṭayorbalābalaṃ cintayatā pratyāhārānhikānte ``akṣaraṃ na kṣaraṃ vidyāt iti bhāṣyavyākhyāvasare vyavahāranityatā tu varṇapadavākyasphoṭānāṃ, nityatvaṃ tu jātisphoṭasyeti pratipādayatā, anupadameva brahmatattvameva hi śabdarūpatayā pratibhatītyartha iti vyācakṣāṇena sarve pakṣāḥ sucitā eva| yadā tu avidyaiva jātiriti pakṣastadabhiprāyeṇa jātisphoṭasyāpi vyavahāranityateti ``akṣaraṃ na kṣaraṃ vidyāt ityasya kaiyaṭīye pāṭhāntaram| ``ādyantau ṭakitau itisūtre ca bhāṣya eva varṇasphoṭapadasphoṭāvuktau| asatyameva prakṛtipratyayavibhāgaṃ tadarthaṃ cāśritya rekāgavayanyāyena satyasya padasphoṭasya vyutpādanamabhipretamiti tatraiva kaiyaṭaḥ| ``arthavadadhātuḥ ``svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasya ``taparastatkālasya ityādisūtreṣvapi spaṣṭamidaṃ bhāṣyakaiyaṭādāvityalaṃ bahunā| jāteśca brahmātmakatvamuktaṃ hariṇā----
sambandhibedātsattaiva bhidyamānā gavādiṣu|
jātirityucyate tasyāṃ sarve śabdā vyavasthitāḥ ||
tāṃ prātipadikārthaṃ ca dhātvarthaṃ ca pracakṣate|
sā nityā sā mahānātmā tāmāhustvatalādayaḥ || iti ||
jāteḥ sphoṭatvamapi praghaṭṭakāntare sa evāha----
anekavyattyabhivyaṅgyā jātiḥ sphoṭe iti smṛtā|
kaiścidvyaktaya evāsyā dhvanitvena prakalpitaḥ || iti ||
yadyapīhāṣṭau pakṣā uktāstathāpi vākyasphoṭapakṣe tātparyaṃ granthakṛtām| tatrāpi jātisphoṭe ityavadheyam, pṛrvapūrvopamarddenaivottarottaropanyāsāt| tathāca prathamavyutpattervyavahārādhīnatayā saṃpūrṇasya vākyasya viśiṣṭe prāthamikaḥ śaktigraha iti nirvivādam| sa cāvāpodvāpābhyāmavayavānāṃ śaktiriti nyāyopaṣṭambhena tyajyata iti darśanā ntarāṇāṃ panthāḥ| ekādeśādisthale uktarītyā vinigamanāviraheṇa kaiścitpararūpādisthale pūrvalopādyabhyupagamena ca vyākaraṇānāṃ kalahe sati avayavaśakterdurupapādatayā prāthamikaśaktigraha eva pramārupa iti tu saiddhāntikaḥ panthāḥ| uktaṃ ca hariṇā---
tatra yanmukhyamekeṣāṃ tatraiteṣāṃ viparyayaḥ || iti||
brāhmaṇārtho yathā nāsti kaścid brāhmaṇakambale|
devadattādayo vākye tathaiva syuranarthakāḥ || iti ca ||
evaṃsthite nipātā dyotakā vikaraṇā anarthakā ityādivicāro'pi prakriyādaśāyāmeva| āha ca---
akaḍādīnāṃ vyavasthārthaṃ pṛthaktvena prakalpanam|
dhātūpasargayoḥ sāstre dhātureva tu tādṛśaḥ || iti ||
tādṛśo'khaṇkaḍa ityarthaḥ| evañca `nāmārthayorabheda eva saṃsargaḥ' `pratyayārthaḥ pradhānam' ityādivyutpattayo'pi prakriyāśrayā eva| uktaṃ ca----
kiṃgarbhajanye kiṃgarbha kīdṛgbhātīti no mate|
vicāraḥ phalitaḥ sarvaḥ prakṛtipratyayāśrayaḥ || iti ||
āropitasyāpi pāramārthike upāyatā na viruddhā| lipisthūlārundhatīśākhācandrādīnāṃ laukikadṛṣṭāntānāmarthavādavākyāpañcakośāvataraṇādīnāṃ tantrāntarasiddhānāṃ pūrvatrāsiddhādīnāṃ caitacchāstrasiddhānāṃ prāgeva darśitatvāt| tadevaṃ pakṣabhedena avidyaiva brahmaiva vā sphuṭatyartho'smāditi vyutpattyā sphoṭa iti sthitam| āha ca----
śāstreṣu prakriyābhedairavidyaivopavarṇyate| iti|
samārambhastu bāvānāmanādi brahma śāśvatam| iti ca|
tadevaṃ varāṭikānveṣaṇāya pravṛttaścintāmaṇiṃ labdhavāniti vāsiṣṭharāmāyaṇoktābhāṇakanyāyena śabdavicārāya pravṛttaḥ san prasaṅgādadvaite aupaniṣade brahmaṇyapi vyutpadyatāmityabhiprāyeṇa bhagavānbhartṛharirvivarttavādādikamapi prasaṅgād vyudapādayat, tattu tantrāntare sphuṭaṃ prakṛte nātīvalopayuktaṃ ceti neha tanyate |
iti sphoṭasvarūpavyutpādanm ||
syādetat, caṃ likha cakārastruṭita ityādivyavahārāllipāveva śabdabhramavatāṃ tatraiva vācakatvābhimānajuṣāṃ bālānāṃ pustakamupayujyate yathā, tathaiva bhedagrahavatāmapīti vastusthitiḥ| evamihāpi prakṛtyādivibhāgepāramārthikatvābhimānavatāmapi upayujyate eva sāstraṃ tatkimarthaṃ kalpanāvyutpādanakleśaḥ| ata eva hi bhāṣyakāro'pi śabdo nityo'nityo veti vikalpya ubhayathāpi vyākaraṇārambhasya niṣpratyūhatvādyathātathāstvityudāsiṣyateti cet ? satyaṃ, vyutpattyarthaṃ vastusthaitiḥ kathitā| pakṣabhedeṣu hi gauṇamukhyeṣu vyutpāditeṣu tatra parasparaviruddhatayā bhāsmānā api siddhāntagranthā vyavasthāpayituṃ śakyante| svārthadravyādīnāṃ pañcanāṃ krameṇa bhānamityādivakṣyamāṇamapi kalpanayaivopapādayituṃ śakṣyate iti dik|
nanvastu sādhuśabdo viṣayaḥ, astu ca prakṛtipratyayādikalpanayā tadvyutpādanopapattiḥ, tathāpi vyākaraṇādhyayanasyānuṣṭhāpakaṃ kimiti cet ? nityādhyayanavidhairiti gṛhāṇa| śruyate hi ``brāhmṇena niṣkāraṇo dharmaḥ ṣaḍaṅgo vedo'dhyeyo jñeyaśca iti| niṣkāraṇo dṛṣṭakāraṇanirapekṣo nitya iti yāvat| kāryate'nuṣṭhāpyate'neneti kāraṇaṃ phalam| brāhmaṇena ṣaḍaṅgo vedo'dyeyo jñeyaścetyanvayaḥ| tathāca sāṅgavedādhyayanatadarthajñānarupo'yaṃ dharmo nityaḥ sandhyopāsanādivadityarthaḥ| śrutireṣeti haradattādayaḥ| smṛtiriti tu bhaṭṭācāryāḥ| tatra yadi smatireveti prāmāṇikaṃ tarhi ``āgamaḥ khalvapi iti bhāṣyepyāgamamūlakatvādāgamaḥ smṛtireviti vyākhyeyam| aṅgatvaṃ cāṅgatvena saṃstavāt| uktaṃ hi śikṣāyām---
mukhaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ tasya jyotiṣaṃ netramucyate|
niruktaṃ śrotramuddiṣṭaṃ chandasāṃ vicitiḥ pade ||
śikṣā ghrāṇaṃ tu vedasya hastau kalpānpracakṣate || iti ||
upakārakatayā'pyaṅgatvam| vyākaraṇaṃ hi arthaviśeṣamāśritya svaraviśeṣādīn vidadhat padārthaviśeṣanirṇaye upayujyate| jyotiṣamapi svādhyāyopayoginamanuṣṭhānopayoginaṃ ca kālaviśeṣaṃ pratipādayati| niruktaṃ tu vyākaraṇasyaiva pariśiṣṭaprāyaṃ bāhulakādisādhyānāṃ lopāgamavikārādīnāṃ prāyaśastatra saṅgrahāt| chandovicitirapi gāyatryādilakṣaṇadvārā gāyatryā yajatītyādividhyarthanirṇaye upayujyate| śikṣāpi varṇoccāraṇaprakāraṃ darśayati| kalpasūtrāṇyapi prakaraṇāntarapaṭhitasya nyāyalabhyasya śākhāntarādhītasya cāṅgajātasyopasaṃhāreṇa prayogaṃ darśayanti| tasmātṣaḍaṅgāni| teṣvapi pradhānaṃ vyākaraṇam, padapadārthāvagamasya vyākaraṇādhīnatvāt; vākyārthajñānasya tanmūlakatvāt| ata eva tasya śikṣāyāṃ mukatvena nirūpaṇaṃ kṛtam| manvādismṛtiṣvapi aṅgādhyayanavidhayaḥ prasiddhā eva| tathā cādhyayanavidhirvyākaraṇādhyayanasyānuṣṭhāpaka iti sthitam| tathāca sandhaayopāsanāderabhāve pratyavāyo'nuṣṭhāne ca pāpakṣaya iti yathābhyupeyate tathā vyākaraṇādhyayanasyāpyananuṣṭhāne anuṣṭāne ca bodhyam |
rakṣāprabhṛtīni phalāntarāṇyapi santi| tathā ca bāṣyam--``kāni punaraspa prayojanāni| rakṣohāgamalaghvasandehāḥ prayojanam iti| atra prayujyate pravartyate'neneti karaṇalyuḍantaḥ prayojayatīti kartṛvyutpattyā bāhulakātkartṛlyuḍanto vā, ubhayathāpi pravarttakavidhiparaḥ pulliṅgaḥ prayojanaśabda ekaḥ| phalaparaḥ klībo'paraḥ| ubhayoḥ ``napuṃsakam iti napuṃsakaikaśeṣe ekavadbhāvasya vaikalpikatayā praśne bahuvacanamuttare ekavacanaṃ ca bodhyam| tatra āgamaḥ pravarttakaḥ, rakṣohalāghavāsandehāstu phalānīti vivekaḥ| tatra pravarttaka āgamo vyākhyātaḥ| phalāni vyākhyāyante |
tatra rakṣā vedasaṃrakṣaṇam| tathāhi, bhāṣāyamadṛṣṭā lopagamavarṇavikārāśchandasi dṛśyante| te kevalaprayogaśaraṇaiḥ prāmādikāḥ sambhāvyeran| vaiyākaraṇastu lakṣaṇadarśī tadeva rūpaṃ sthāpayati|
tatra lopodāharaṇam--tmanā deveṣu vivide mitadruḥ| tmanā ātmanetyarthaḥ| ``mantreṣvāṅ‌yāderātmanaḥ ityākāralopaḥ|
āgamo yathā--devāsaḥ, brāhṇaṇāsaḥ| ``ājjaserasuk ityasugāgamaḥ|
lopāgamau yathā--devā aduha| aduhatetyarthaḥ| duherlaṅo jhasyādādeśe kṛte `` lopasta ātmanedeṣu iti talopaḥ, ``bahulaṃ chandasi iti ruḍāgamaḥ| etena `nāśiraṃ druhe' `viśvā itte' `chenavo duhre' ityādilaḍantamapi vyākhyātam|
varṇavikāro yathā--gṛbhṇāmi te saubagatvāya| ``hṛgrahorbhaśrchandasi ``hasyeti vaktavyam iti bhakāraḥ|
pratyayo'pi chāndasosti| yathā--udgrābhaṃ ca nigrābhaṃ ceti| ``udigraha itisūtre ``udgrābhanigrābhau ca cchandasi srugudyamananipātanayoḥ iti vacanādunnipūrvādgraherghañ| tatra utpūrvātsūtreṇa loke'pi siddho ghañ| nipūrvāttu vārtikoktaśchandasyeva| sanniveśaviśeṣayuktāḥ pātraviśeṣāḥ srucaḥ| iha tu juhūpabhṛtoreva grahaṇam ``udgābhaṃ ceti juhūmudyacchati, nigrābhañcetyupabhṛtaṃ niyacchati iti vacanāt| bhakārādeśaḥ prāgvat|
ūho'pi prayojanam| tathāhi, yatrāhghajātaṃ sampūrṇamupadiṣṭaṃ sā prakṛtiḥ|yathā--darśapūrṇamāsau| yatra nopadiṣṭaṃ sā vikṛtiḥ yathā--``sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvaped brahmavarcasakāmaḥ iti vihito yāgaḥ| atra vaikṛtasya vidherviśayabhūtāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ karaṇībhūte yāge upakārakākāṅkṣāyāṃ tanmukhena prākṛtamaṅgajātaṃ prāpyate| vaidike karaṇe tādṛśānāmevāṅgānāmapekṣitatvāt| teṣāmeva prakṛtau klṛptasāmarthyāt| tadviśeṣasy caikadevatātvādinā śakyajñānatvāt| tasmāt ``prakṛtivadvikṛtiḥ karttavyā iti pūrvamīmāṃsāyāṃ sthitam| tatra yasyāṅgasya prakṛtau ya upakāraḥ klṛptastasya vikṛtāvasaṃbhave nivṛttiḥ| yathā prakṛtāvavaghātasya vaituṣyamupakāratayā kalṛptaṃ tasya kṛṣṇaleṣvasaṃbhavādavaghātasya nivṛttiḥ| mantrā apyaṅgam| teṣāṃ cānuṣṭheyārthaprakāśanaṃ kāryam| tatra prakṛtau yasya mantrasya yadabhidheyaṃ taccedvikṛtau sākalyena nāsti tadā kṛtsnasya mantrasya nivṛttiḥ| yathā-- ``avarakṣo divaḥ sapatnaṃ vadhyāsam ityavaghātamanatrasya kṛṣṇaleṣu| yasya tvekadeśasyābhideyaṃ nāsti tasya tāvanmātraṃ nivartate| yathā--``agnaye tvā juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi ityasya mantrasyāvayavabhūtaṃ devatābhidhāyi padamauṣadhadravyakatvena ekadevatākatvena cāgraneyavikārabhūte devatābhidhāyi padamauṣadhadravyakatvena ekadevatākatvena cāgneyavikārabhūte saurye nivarttate agniśabde ca luptadvārakatayā nivartamāne ekāro'pi nivarttate| akārāntetaraprakṛtisannidhānenaiva hi ekārasya sampadānaṃ vācyam, akārāntāttu yaśabdasya| tataścaturthyantasūryāyetyādyudāttamagnaya ityasya madhyodāttasya sthāne ūhyam| so'yaṃ prakṛtyūhaḥ|
liṅgasya kvacidūhaḥ| yathā--``devīrāpaḥ śuddhāḥ stha ityapsu viniyukto mantraḥ| tasyājye ūhaḥ devājyaśuddhamasīti|
pratyayamātrasya kvacidūhaḥ| yathā--``mā bhermā saṃvikthāḥ iti puroḍāśe'vadānamantraḥ| tasya dhānāsūhaḥ--``mābhaiṣṭa mā saṃvijidhvam ityādiriti haradattādayaḥ| yājñikāstu saṃvigdhvamityūhamāhuḥ| yuktaṃ caitat, prakṛtāvaniṭkatayā ``vijir pṛthagbhāve ityasya prayogo na tu ``ovijī bhayacalanayoḥ ityasyetyavadhāraṇāt|
lāghavamapi prayojanam| tatāhi, adhyāpanaṃ brāhmaṇasyavṛttiḥ| tannirvāhaśca vaiduṣyādhīnaḥ| vaiduṣyaṃ ca sādhvasādhuvivekaḥ| sa ca na pratipadapāṭhādinā sambhavati, śabdānāmānantyāt| tasmādutsargāpavādarūpalakṣaṇadvārā tadbodhane lāghavam| anyathā tu gauravam|
asandeho'pi prayojanam| tathāhi, ``sthūlapṛṣatīmanaḍvāhāmālabheta iti śrūyate| tatra sandehaḥ--karmadhārayo'yaṃ bahuvrīhirveti| tatra karmadhārayapakṣe pṛṣatīśabdena matvarthalakṣaṇayā pṛṣatattavatī bindumatī gaurevābhidhīyate, sthūlāpi saiva, bindūnāṃ sthaulyaṃ tānavaṃ vā yathā tathā'stu| bahuvrīhau tu sthaulyaṃ pṛṣtsveveti| gaustu sthūlā kṛsā vetyatrānādaraḥ| tatra lakārākāre udāttatvaṃ dṛṣṭā pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇa bahuvrīhiṃ vaiyākaraṇo niścinoti| tataśca niścayena pratibandhātsaṃśayānutpādaḥ| sa evāsandehaḥ| arthābhāve'vyayībhāvādasandehamiti syāditi cet ? na, paryāyeṇāvyayībhāvatatpuruṣasaṃjñādvayamapīha bhavatīti dvitīye upapādayiṣyamāṇatvāt| ata evobhayathā muniprayogaḥ--adrutāyāmasaṃhitamiti, athāsaṃhitayeti ca| evaṃ ``indrapītasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi ityādāvapi svareṇaiva bahuvrīhinirṇaye handrapītādhikaraṇamavaiyākaraṇānprati sārthakam| kṛtvācintānyāyena vā neyamiti dik |
tadevaṃ rakṣohalāghavāsandehākhyāni catvāri phalāni vyākhyātāni| āgamastu pravartaka ityuktam| bhāṣye tu sandarbhasuddhyarthaṃ phalacatuṣṭayasya prāk paścādvā pravarttake vaktavye madhye taduktyā phalasandaṃśena nityānāmapi phalaparyavasānamastīti sūcitam| phalaṃ tu pāpakṣayaḥ pratyavāyānutpattirvā, ``dharmeṇa pāpamapanudati ----
vihitasyānanuṣṭhānānninditasya ca sevanāt|
anigrahāccendriyāṇāṃ naraḥ patanamṛvchati ||
ityādivacanānīha sādhakānīti dik|
``imāni ca bhūyaḥ ityādibhāṣyeṇa pravarttakavacanāntarāṇi udāhṛtya vyākhyātāni| tadyathā--``te'surā helayo helaya iti kurvantaḥ parābabhūvustasmād brāhmaṇena na mlecchitavai nāpabhāṣitavai mleccho ha vā eṣa yadapaśabdaḥ iti brāhmaṇam| atra na mlocchitavai etasya vivaraṇaṃ nāpabhāṣitavai iti| ubhayatrāpi ``kṛtyārthe tavaikenkenyatvanaḥ iti tavaipratyayaḥ| thātūnāmanekārthatayā nindāvacanānmlecchadātoḥ karmaṇi ghañ| tenāpaśabdasāmānādhikāraṇyaṃ na virudhyate| atra `na mlechitavyam' iti niṣedhasya ``te'surāḥ ityarthavādaḥ| na ceha rātrisatranyāyena ārthavādikaṃ phalamāstviti vācyaṃ, ``dravyasaṃskārakarmasu parārthatvātphalaśrutirarthavādaḥ syāt iti nyāyena apāpaślokaśravaṇavatprāśastyamātraparatvāt| prakaraṇātkratvaṅgo hyayaṃ niṣadha iti ``yarvāṇastarvāṇo nāma ityādāvuttaragranthe bhāṣyakāraireva sphuṭīkariṣyate| ata eva ihāpi parābhūtā mā bhūmetyadhyeyaṃ vyākaraṇamiti nopasaṃhṛtaṃ, kintu mlecchā mābhūmetyeva| mlecchā nindyāḥ, śāstraboditaviparītānuṣṭhānāditi bhāvaḥ| atra ``haiheprayoge haihayoḥ iti plute plutatvaprayukte prakṛtibhāve ca karttavye tadakaraṇaṃ mlecchanamittyeke| nanu ``sarvaḥ plutaḥ sāhasamanicchatā vibhāṣā karttavyaḥ iti bhāṣyakṛtā vakṣyamāṇatvānnaiṣa doṣa iti cet ? satyam, ata evāparitoṣād `vākyadvirvacanaṃ mlecchanam ' ityaparairvyākhyātam| ``sarvasya dve ityatra padagrahaṇasya coditatvāditi teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ|
nanu nedaṃ śāstrīyaṃ dvirvacanaṃ kintu tātparyadyotanārthamaicchikaḥ punaḥ prayogaḥ `anāvṛttiḥ śabdādanāvṛttiḥ śabdāt ' itivaditi cet ? tarhyāmreḍitasvarānupapattiḥ| yadi tu tatrāmreḍitasvaravinirmakta eva pāṭhastarhi ariśabde rephasya latvamapaśabda ityavardhayam| idaṃ ca bhāṣyādiṣu prasiddhaṃ śrutipāṭhamusṛtya vyākhyātam| ayaṃ ca pāṭhaḥ kvacicchākhāyāmanveṣaṇīyaḥ| mādhyandinānāṃ śatapathabrāhmaṇe tu ``helavo helava iti vadataḥ iti paṭhitvā ``tasmād brāhmaaṇo na mlecchet iti paṭhyate| tatra yakārasthāne vakāro'paśabda iti spaṣṭameva|
mantro hīnaḥ svarato varṇato vā mithyāprayukto na tamarthamāha|
sa vāgvajro yajamānaṃ hinastiyathendrasatruḥ svaratoparādhāt || iti ||
svareṇa svarataḥ ``hīyamānapāpayogācca iti tasiḥ| mithyāprayuktaḥ yadarthapratipādanāya prayuktastato'rthāntaraṃ svaravarṇadoṣātpratipādayan ata eva tamarthaṃ nāhetyarthaḥ| vāgeva vajraḥ hiṃsakatvāt| yajamānaṃ hinastīti| yathādhvaryukṛtāddhomādyajamāne dharmotpattiḥ evamadhvaryukṛtādapaśabdaprayogādyajamāne pratyavāya ityarthaḥ| yathetyudāharaṇe| indraśatruḥ indra śatruśabdaḥ| purā kila viśvarūpākhye tvaṣṭuḥ putre indreṇa hate sati kupitastvaṣṭā indrasya hantāraṃ vṛtrākhyaṃ putrāntaramutpipādayiṣurābhicārikaṃ yāgaṃ kṛtavān| tatra ca indrasya śātayitā śatruḥ hiṃsaka iti yāvat tathābhūtaḥ san vardhasveti pratipādituṃ `indraśatrurvardhasva' iti prayuktam| ṇyantācchaderauṇādikaḥ krunpratyayaḥ| prajñādigaṇe nipātanād hrasvaḥ| indraśatrutvasya vidheyatvānna sambodhanavibhaktiḥ tasyā anuvādyaviṣayakatvāt| ata eva rājan yudhyasva rājā bhava yudhyasvetyanayorvyavasthayaiva prayogaḥ| rājatvasya siddhatve sambodhanavibhaktirna tu vidheyatve'pīti| evaṃ sthite indraśatruśabde tatpuruṣasamāsaprayukte'ntodātte vaktavye pramādādādyudāttaḥ kiloktaḥ| tathāca pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇa bahuvrīhyartho labdhaḥ| inderhi dhātorauṇādike ``ṛjrendra ityādinā ranpratyaye kṛte indraśabda ādyudātto vyutpāditaḥ| tenendra evāsya hisakaḥ sampanna iti śrutītihāsapurāṇādiṣu prasiddham| tadihodāharaṇatayoktam |
syādetat, ``yajñakarmaṇi ityekaśrutyeha bhavitavyam| sā ca tatpuruṣabahuvrīhyoraviśiṣṭeti| atrāhuḥ--japādiparyudāsena mantreṣveva ekaśrutirvidhīyate| svecchayā prayujyamānaśca mantro na bhavati| taduktaṃ bhedalakṣaṇe jaimininā--``anāmnāteṣvamantratvam iti| apastambaścāhaanāmnātā amantrā yathā pravarohanāmadheyagrahaṇāni iti| ata eva ``mantro hīnaḥ iti pāṭhasya śikṣāyāṃ prasiddhatve'pi ūhyamānasyāmantra tayā yathenadraśatruriti vākyaśeṣo'saṅgataḥ syādato mantraśabdaḥ śabdamātrapara ityāśayena bhāṣye ``duṣṭaḥ śabdaḥ iti paṭhitam| nanu svāhendraśatrurvarddhasveti vede paṭhyata eveti ? satyam, ūhitaṃ yadamantrabhūtam anukāryaṃ tadanukaraṇasya pāṭhe'pi arthaparasyānukāryasya laukikatvānapāyāt| nanvindraśatruśabdasya laukikatve kathaṃ svaraprayuktayorguṇadoṣayoḥ prasaktiḥ svarasya vedamātraviṣayakatvāditi cet ? na, svaravidhau chandodhikārābhāvāt| etāvāneva hi bhedaḥ--yacchandasi traisvaryamekaśrutiśca vyavasthāyā''śrīyate, loke tvaicchiko vikalpaḥ| ata eva ekaśrutyāsūtrapāṭhastraisvaryeṇa veti pakṣadvayamapi tatratatropanyastamiti vakṣyāmaḥ|
nanvevaṃ ``uccaisaltarāṃvā itisūtrādvikalpānuvṛttyaiva siddhau ``vibhāṣāchandasi ityatra vibhāṣāgraho vyarthaḥ syāt| prasajyapratiṣedhe tu nāyaṃ doṣaḥ| yajñakarmaṇītyasya nivṛttaye punarvibhāṣāgrahaṇāt| na ca paryudāsa pakṣe'pyevemavāstviti vācyaṃ, nityāvikalpavidhyorviṣayabhedasyāvasya katayā ārambhasāmarthyādeva tannivṛttisiddheḥ| prasajyapratiṣedhe tu nārambhasāmarthyaṃ, ūhādiṣvamantreṣu caritārthasya pūrvavidheruttareṇa chandomātraviṣayakeṇa bādhasambhavāt| na hyūhādīnāṃ chandastvamasti, mantrabrāhmaṇetaratvāt| tasmādasamarthasamāsamāśrityāpi prasajyapratiṣedha evāgatyā svīkarttumucita iti cet ? na, paryudāsapakṣe'pi mantre nityaṃ brāhmaṇe veti viṣayavibhāgasaṃbhavena yajñakarmanivṛttaye vibhāṣāgrahaṇasambhavāt| uktāparitoṣādeva tu kecijjapādiṣu prasajyapratiṣedhamāśritya ihāpyekaśruteḥ prāptau satyāṃ tadakaraṇaṃ bahuvrīhisvarakaraṇaṃ ca svarato'parādhādityasyārtha ityāhuḥ|
śrūyate ca-----
yadadhītamavijñātaṃ nigadenaiva śabdyate|
anagranāviva śuṣkaidho na cajjvalati karhi cit ||
nigadena pāṭhamātreṇa| śuṣkaidha iti sāntena klībena edhasśabdena akārāntena vā pulliṅgena nirvāhyam| na jvalati na prakāśate niṣphalaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| nirukte tu--``athāpi jñānapraśaṃsā bhavatyajñānanindā ca ityupakramya---
``sthāṇurayaṃ bhārahāraḥ kilābhūdadhītya vedaṃ na vijānāti yo'rtham|
yorthajña itsakalaṃ bhadramaśnute nākameti jñānavidhūtapāpmā ||
iti mantramudāhṛtya ``yadgṛhītamavijñātam ityādi paṭhitam| tatrāpi gṛhītaṃ śabdataḥ, avijñātaṃ tu arthataḥ prakṛtipratyayādivibhāgena vetyādi; śeṣaṃ prāgvat|
anyatrāpi śrūyate--``ekaḥ śabdaḥ samthak jñātaḥ suṣṭhu prayuktaḥ svarge loke kāmadhugbhavati iti| etacca ``ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ iti sūtre bhāṣyakṛdvakṣyati| ekanmūlakameva kātyāyanapraṇīteṣu bhrājākhyeṣu ślokeṣu smaryate----
yastu prayuṅkte kuśalo viṣeṣe śabdān yatāvadvyavahārakāle|
so'nantamāpnoti jayaṃ paratra vāgyogavid duṣyati cāpaśabdaiḥ || iti ||
duṣyatati cāpaśabdairityatra avaiyākaraṇaḥ karttā sāmarthyād bodhyaḥ|
tathāḥ---
avidvāsaḥ pratyabhivāde nāmno ye na pluniṃ viduḥ|
kāmaṃ teṣu tu viproṣya strīṣvivāyamahaṃ vadet ||
athamahamityasya ``anukaraṇaṃ cānitiparam itika gatisaṃjñā| tato gatisamāse'pi `asyavāmīyam' ityādāvivānukaraṇatvādeva vibhakterluṅ na |
yājñikāḥ paṭhanti prayājāḥ savibhaktikāḥ kāryā iti || yadyapi prakṛtau prayājamantrāḥ savibhaktikā eva paṭhyante, tathāpi yadi ādhā nādanantaraṃ yajamāna udaravyathāvān syādyadi vā saṃvatsaramadhye tasya mahatī vipatsyāttadā naimittikīṃ punarādheyeṣṭiṃ vidhāya tatredamāmnātaṃ--``prayājāḥ savibhaktikāḥ iti| tatra kevalavibhakteḥ prayogānarhatvātprakṛtirākṣipyate| sā cāgniśabdarūpā na tu yā kācit| nirukte devatākāṇḍe-``atha kiṃdevatāḥ prayājānuyājāḥ itika praśnamavatārya mantravarṇādīnudāhṛtya ``āgneyā iti tu sthitiḥ ityupasaṃhārāt| tasmādāditaścaturṣu prayājeṣu catasro vibhaktayo'gniśabdaprakṛtikāḥ paṭhyante ityādiśrautagrantheṣu draṣṭavyam|
tathānyatrāpi ``yo vā hamā padaśaḥ svaraśo'kṣaraśo vācaṃ vidadhāti sa ārtvijīnaḥ iti| padaṃpadamiti ``saṃkhyaikavacanācca vīpsāyām iti śas| svara udāttādiḥ| akṣaraṃ vyañjanasahito'c| ṛtvijamarhatītyārtvijīno yajamānaḥ, ṛtvikkarmārhatītyārtvijīno yājakaḥ, ``yajñartvigbhyāṃ ghaśañau itisūtreṇa ``yajñartvigbhvāṃ tatkarmārhatīti copasaṃkhyānam itivārttikena ca khañ| yajane yājane ca viduṣa evādhikāra iti bhāvaḥ|
ṛgvede'pi baharavo mantravarṇāḥ--catvāriśṛṅgā, catvārivāk, utatvaḥ paśyan, saktumiva, ityādayaḥ| ``titau paripavanaṃ bhavati iti bhāṣyam| ``cālanī titauḥ pumān iti tu amarasya pramāda ityeke| vastutastūktabhāṣyānurodhādamaragranthe pusatvāyogamātraṃ vyavacchedyaṃ na tvanyayogo'pi| tathā ca puṃnapuṃsakavarge--``syādvāstu hiṃgu titau iti trikāṇḍaśeṣaḥ| ata eva `titaumācaṣṭe titāpayati' ityabhiyuktagranthā api saṃgacchante iti dik|
yājñikāḥ paṭhanti--``āhitāgnirapaśabdaṃ prayujya prāyaścittīyā sārasvatīmiṣṭiṃ nirvapet iti|
tathā--daśamyuttarakālaṃ putrasya jātasya nāma vidadhyāddhoṣavadādyantarantasthamavṛddhaṃ tripuruṣānūkamanāriprātiṣṭhitaṃ taddhi pratiṣṭhitatamaṃ bhavati dvyakṣaraṃ caturakṣaraṃ vā nāma kṛtaṃ kuryānna taddhitamiti| nāmakaraṇe adhikāriṇaḥ piturye trayaḥ puruṣāstānanu kāyati abhidhatte iti tripuruṣānūkm| ``anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate iti dīrghaḥ| tripuruṣetyatra pātrāditvātstrītvābhāvaḥ, mūlavibhūjāditvātkaḥ| yattu upapadāvipakṣayā ``ātaścepasarge iti kaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ ṣaṣṭhītatpūruṣa iti, tattu ``karmaṇyaṇ iti sūtre ``akārādanupapadātkarmopapado vipratiṣedhena iti vārttikasya nadīsūtre strayākhyāvitimūlavibhujāditvātka iti bhāṣyasya ca ananuguṇam| ata eva gaṅgādharādiśabdānāṃ saṃjñāśabdatvamiti prāñcaḥ| vastutastu prathamaṃ karmāvivakṣāyāmanūkapadaṃ vyutpādya paścātkarmasambandhe'pyadoṣaḥ| vārttikādikaṃ tu prathamameda karmavivakṣāmabhipretya| anyathā kṛtapūrvyādiṣu kā gatiḥ ? ata eva ``śakyaṃ ca kṣudupahantum iti bhāṣyavyākhyāyāṃ bahiraṅgastrītvapratītyā antaraṅgaḥ padasaṃskāro na vihanyate iti kaiyaṭopi vakṣyati| vivakṣā ca lokaprasiddhyanusāriṇī na tu svāyatteti ``viparābhyāṃjeḥ ityādāvapi pūrvaṃ dhātuḥ sādhanena yujyata iti pakṣamupaṣṭabhya vijayatītyādi nāpādanīyamiti dik|
tathā ca ṛgvede eva paṭhyate--``sudevo asi varuṇa yasya te saptasindhavaḥ| anukṣaranti kākudaṃ sūrmyaṃ suṣirāmiva iti| asyārthaḥ--he varueṇa! satyadatevo'si| yasya te kākudaṃ tālu kākurjihvā sā udyate utkṣipyate'sminniti kākudam| vaderutkṣepaṇamartho dhātūnāmanekārthatvāt| tato ghañarthe kāvidānamityādhikarame kaḥ, samprasāraṇaṃ, ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣe śakandhvāditvātpararūpam| nuda preraṇe ityasmādadhikaraṇe kaḥ pṛṣodarāditvānnuśabdasya lopa ityanye| niruktasvaraso'pyevam| saptāsindhava iva sindhavo vibhaktayaḥ| anukṣaranti tālu prāpya prakāśante ityarthaḥ| atra dṛṣṭāntaḥ--yatā sacchidrāṃ lohamayīṃ pratimāṃ praviśayāgniḥ prakāśatetatheti| agnirhi tatratyaṃ malaṃ bhasmīkṛtya pratimāṃ śuddhāṃ karoti tathā vibhaktayo'pi śārīraṃ pāpamapākurvantīti bhāvaḥ| sūrmī sthūṇā'yaḥpratimetyamaraḥ| smaryate ca---
sūrmīṃ jvalantīmāliṅgenmṛtyave gurutalpagaḥ| iti|
``ami pūrvaḥ ityatra ``vā chandāsi ityanuvṛtteryaṇādeśaḥ| suṣirāmityatrārśaādyac abhedopacāro vetyāhuḥ| vastutastu ``ūṣasuṣimuṣkamadhoraḥ iti matvarthīyo rapratyayaḥ| ``randhraṃ śvabhraṃ vapāsuṣiḥ ityamaraḥ ``saradhresuṣiraṃ triṣu iti ca| suṣṭu syatīti suṣiriti kṣīrasvāmī|
gartte garttānvite vādye viśeṣe suṣiraṃ triṣu|
iti śāśvataḥ ||
iti prayojanaprapañcaḥ ||
ityevaṃ viṣayaprayojanayoruktayoḥ sambandhādhikāriṇāvuktaprāyāveveti pṛthaṅnoktau|
iha yena prayojanaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ tato'nya eva taṭastha itthaṃ pratyavatiṣṭhate| nanu yathā `adhīṣva' ityācāryeṇokte prayojanapraśnamakṛtvaiva vedamadhīyate, tadvadaṅgabhūtaṃ vyākaraṇamapyadhyeṣyante tatkiṃ prayojanavarṇanakleśeneti ? atredamuttaram, prāyeṇedānīntanānāmalpāyuṣkatvādvighnabahulatvācca pradhānabhūto vedastāvatpāṭhyate| tadadhyayanakāle ca bālyātprayojanādikaṃ praṣṭumasamarthāḥ śiṣyā guruṇā upadiśryamānaṃ vedaṃ gṛhṇantīti yuktam| tato gṛhītavedāḥ prauḍhimāpannā vivāhārthaṃ tvaramāṇā vyākaraṇādhyayanāya guruṇā preryamāṇā api na sahasā pravarttante| ``vedānno vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ siddhālokācca laukikāḥ, anarthakaṃ vyākaraṇam iti pratyavatiṣṭhante| tānpratiyuktameva prayojanādivarṇanam| pūrvakalpeṣu vyākaraṇaśikṣādīni lakṣaṇāni prathamaṃ pāṭhayitvā tattallakṣaṇānusandhāpanapūrvakaṃ lakṣyabhūtaṃ vedaṃ grāhayantaḥsthitāḥ| tadā paraṃ bālyāvasthāyāṃ vyākaraṇapāṭhātprayojanapraśnavirahe tatpratipādanamapi na karttavyameveti| yadyapi---
śrāvaṇyāṃ prauṣṭhapadyāṃ vā'pyupākṛtya yathāvidhi|
yuktaśchandāṃsyadhīyīta ṇāsānvipro'rddhapañcamān ||
tataḥ paraṃ tu chandāṃsi śukleṣu niyataḥ paṭhet|
vedāṅgani rahasyaṃ ca kṛṣṇapakṣeṣu sampaṭhet ||
iti manuvacanasya ``ita ūrdhvamanadhyāyeṣvaṅgānyadhīyīta ityādismṛtyantarāṇāṃ ca paryālocanayā vedavedāṅgādhyayanasamakālatā labhyate, tathāpi ṛṣivacanatvāviśeṣādbhāṣyakāroktermānavādeśca vrīhiyavavadvikalpa eveti tattvam| tadevamanubandhacatuṣṭayasya susthātvātsādhuśabdavyutpādanaṃ karttavyamiti sthitam |
nanu kimidaṃ sādhutvam? sādhayati bodhayatīti sādhuriti vyutpattyā bodhakatvaṃ taditi cet? gāvyādāvapi tatsattvāt| śaktatvaṃ taditi cet ? na, `pacati' ityādau vikaraṇānāmasādhutāpatteḥ, teṣāmanarthakatvāt; ḍupacaṣ laṭ ityādīnāṃsādhutāpatteśca, lākṣaṇikeṣvavyāpteśca teṣāmapi lakṣye'rthe 'śakteḥ| kvacicchaktatāyāstu aśrvāsvādiṣvatiprasakteḥ| vṛttimattvaṃ taditi cet ? na, dyotakeṣu nipāteṣvavyāpteḥ | aupasaṃdānikī śaktireva dyotaneti cet ? na, prottarajitvaghottaraṭatvayoraviśeṣeṇa vinigamanāvirahācchaktatāpattau vyāsajyavṛttiśaktau viśrānteḥ| tataśca aṭdvivacanādyavyavasthāpattiḥ| na ca jātiviśeṣe eva sādhuteti vācyaṃ, katvādinā saṅkarāpatteriti|
atrāhuḥ----
anapabhraṣṭatā'nādiryadvā'bhyudayayogyatā|
vyākriyā vyañjanāyā vā jātiḥ kā'pīha sādhutā || iti ||
asyārthaḥ---śaktivaikalyādiprayuktamanyathoccāraṇamapabhraṣṭatā, tadviraho'napabhraṣṭatā, saiva sādhutā| sā cārthaviśeṣāntarbhāveṇaiva| tathāhi, yamarthaṃ śaktayā lakṣamayāvā bodhayituṃ dyotayituṃ vā yādṛkśabdo'nādiḥ prayuktastasminnarthe doṣādanyathātvaṃ prāptaḥ so'sādhuḥ, anyathā tu sādhuriti| ye'pi gāvyādiṣveva prathamaṃ vyutpannāḥ santastānprayuñjate teṣāmapyanyathoccāraṇamastveva| tatra ca doṣaprayojyatāstyeva, mūlaprayokturbhramādyanyatamatvāt|
yadvā, anāditā sādhutā| anādariti tu śloke bhāvapradhāno nirddeśaḥ| āderabhāvo'nādiriti vā| asandeha itivattatpuruṣaḥ|
abhyudayayogyatā vā'stu sādhutā|
ratnatattvavacchāstrāpariśīlanaśālibhirgamyo jātiviśeṣo veti| yattu jātisaṅkara ityuktam| tanna; guṇagatajātau tasyādoṣatvāt| tathāhi, yasya devadattāderanoṣṭhyā varṇā eva pūrvaṃ śrutāstasya kuḍyadivyavahitasya oṣṭhyavarṇeṣu śruteṣu yadanumānaṃ jāyate tadoṣṭhyānoṣṭhyasādhāraṇatadanumāpakajātyaṅgīkāre satyeva ghaṭate na tu tattadvyāpyanānājātisvīkāre, oṣṭhyavarṇavṛttyasādhāraṇajāteḥ prāgagṛhītatvenānumitisāmagrīvaikalyāt| vastutastu upādhisaṅgaravadeva jātisaṅgaro'pi sarvatrāstu,dūṣakatābījānirukteḥ, vinigamakābhāvena bhūtatvamūrttatvayoriva śarīratvapṛthivītvayordvayorapi jātitvabhaṅgāpatteśca| tasmāccaturvidhamapi sādhutvaṃ nirdoṣaṃ vyākaraṇaikagamyaṃ ca|
evamasādhutvamapi caturddhā--apabhraṣṭatā, sāditā, pratyavāyayogyatā, tadavacchedakajātiviśeṣo veti| ṭighubhādisaṃjñāsu yadyapi puṇyapāpajanakatārūpe sādhutvāsādhutve nastastathāpi anapabhraṣṭatvarūpaṃ sādhutvamastyeva| tadevānuśāsanapravṛttāvupayogi, ``bhaya ityādisautrānirddeśāt ``kutvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ityādibhāṣyāccetyāhuḥ| evaṃ cānāditvamabhyudayayogyatvaṃ vā anapabhraṣṭatāmātreṇa na sidhyati, kintu pauruṣeyasaṅketavirahaviśiṣṭenetyavadheyam| tadetaduktam---
yāstvetāḥ svecchayā saṃjñāḥ kriyante ṭighubhādayaḥ|
kathaṃ nu tāsāṃ sādhutvaṃ naiva tāḥ sādhavo matāḥ ||
anapabhraṃśarūpatvānnāpyāsāmapaśabdatā|
hastaceṣṭā yathāloke tathā saṅketitā imāḥ ||
tataśca----
nāsāṃ prayoge'bhyudayaḥ pratyavāyo'pi vā bhavet|
lāghavenārthabodhārthaṃ prayujyante tu kevalam || iti||
tadayaṃ nirgalito'rthaḥ---
yāstvetāḥ svecchayā saṃjñā kriyanta iti pakṣe
anidaṃprathamāḥ śabdāḥ sādhavaḥ parikīrttitāḥ|
ta eva śaktivaikalyapramādālasatādibhiḥ|
anyathoccāritāḥ pumbhirapaśabdā itīritāḥ ||
iti ca sādhvasādhulakṣaṇe āśrīyamāṇe ṭighubhādīnāṃ sādhvasādhubahirbhāvaḥ spaṣṭa eva| teṣāmapyanāditeti pakṣe tu caturvidhā'pi prāguktā sādhutā'styeva| uktañca---
vyavahārāya niyamaḥ saṃjñāyāḥ saṃjñini kvacit|
nitya eva tu sambandho ḍityathādiṣu gavādivat ||
vṛdvyādīnāṃ ca śāstre'smiñchaktyavacchedalakṣaṇaḥ|
akṛtrimo'bhisambandho viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyavat ||
pakṣadvaye'pyanuśāsanaviṣayatā nirvivādeti| nāmakaraṇe tvayaṃ viseṣaḥ--kṛtaṃ kuryānna taddhitamityādigṛhyasūtrāvirodhināmeva sādhutā| tadvirodhināṃ tu deśabhāṣānusāreṇa kriyamāṇānāṃ kūcīmañcītyādināmadheyānāmasādhutaiva| tadetad ṛlṛksūtre vārtikavayākhyāvasare sphuṭīkariṣyate ||
iti sādhutvanirvacanam ||
vyutpādanaṃ ca prakṛtipratyayādikalpanayā utsargāpavādarūpalakṣaṇaireva, na tu sādhvasādhvorvā anyatarasya vā pratipadapāṭhena, śabdānāmānantyena tadasambhavādityuktam| syādetat, lakṣaṇapraṇayanamapi kiṃ jātipakṣamāśritya uta vyaktipakṣam ? ādye sakṛdgatau yadbādhitaṃ tadvādhitameveti na siddhyet| tathāhi, jātau padārthe dvayorvidhyoḥ parasparaparihāreṇa tattajjātyākrāntavyaktiviśeṣe caritārthayoḥ kvacidekatra prasaṅge parasparapratibandhādapratipattireva syāt satpratipakṣavat| tathā ca vakṣyati--``apratipattirvobhayostulyabalatvāt iti| tatra ca vipratiṣedhasūtraṃ vidhyarthaṃ---paraṃ tāvadbhavatīti| tasmiṃśca kṛte yadi pūrvasya nimittamasti tarhi bhavatyeva tat| yathā `bhindhāki' ityatra bhinad hi iti sthite paratvāddhibhāve kṛte punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānādakajbhavati| tadevaṃ jātipakṣe punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānaṃ yadyapi siddhyati tathāpi sakṛdgatāviti na sidhyati| tathā ca`juhutāt tvam' ityatra juhu hi iti sthite dhibhāvaṃ bādhitvā paratvāttātaṅi kṛte sthānivadbhāvena syādeva dhiḥ| vyaktipakṣe tu sakalavyaktyuddeśyakasya śāstrasya vyaktyantare carakitārthatvāsmbhavādvikalpagrasaṅge niyamārthaṃ sūtraṃ parameva bhavati na tu pūrvamiti| tathā caitatsūtrabalena tatra pūrvalakṣaṇasya vyaktyantaramātraviṣayakatvaṃ kalpyata iti etadvyaktiviṣayakalakṣaṇābhāva eva paryavasyati| tathā ca juhutāttvamityādeḥ siddhāvapi bhindhakītyādi vyaktipakṣe na sidhyati| tasmādaśakyamanyatarapakṣāśrayaṇena lakṣaṇapraṇayanamiti cet? satyam, ata eva lakṣyānurodhātpakṣadvayamapyāśrīyate| kva citkaścitpadārtha iti| tatra jātivādināmayaṃ bhāvaḥ--lāghavājjātirvācyā| vyaktīnāmānantyena tāsāṃ vācyatve gauravam| vāhadohādyanvayastu lakṣitāyāṃ vyaktāviti|
vyaktivādinastāvāhuḥ--anupapattiṃ vināpi vyaktipratīteranubhavasiddhatayā vyaktireva vācyā| tvapratyayādikaṃ vinā jāteḥ prādhānyenāpratīteśca| vāhādyanvayo'pyevaṃ samañjasaḥ| yattūktaṃ vyaktīnāmānantyamiti, naitadvādhakaṃ, śakyatāvacchedikāyā jāteraikyāt| nanvevaṃ jāterapi vācyatvamāyātamiti cet ? na, akāryatve'pi kāryatāvacchedakatvavadaśakyatve'pi śakyatāvacchedakatvasambhavāt| ata eva lakṣyatāvacchedake lakṣaṇā neti naiyāyikābhyupagamaḥ| tasmājjātirupalakṣaṇaṃ vyaktimātraṃ tu vācyamiti|
yattu sarupasutre bhāṣye vakṣyate--``nahyākṛtipadārthakasya dravyaṃ na padārthaḥ ityādi, tattu jātivyaktyoranyatareṇa viśiṣṭasyāparasya vācyatetyevaṃ rūpaṃ matāntaram| tathā cākṛtyadhikaraṇe bhaṭṭairuktam---
niyogena vikalpena dve vā saha samuccite|
sambandhaḥ samudāyo vā viśiṣṭā vaikayetarā || iti||
tatra jātireva vyaktireva vā vācyeti ihatyaṃ matadvayaṃ niyogenetyanenopanibaddham| caturthacaraṇena tu sarupasūtroktaṃ matadvayamupanibaddhamiti vivekaḥ| yadyapi jātivyakitpakṣayoranyatarasya nyāyena bādha āvaśyakastathāpīha śāstre saṃjñāparibhāṣādivallakṣyasiddhyupāyatayā ubhayāśrayaṇe kimapi bādhakaṃ nāstītyavadheyam| vastutastu bhaṭṭoktāṣṭhapakṣīmadhye vikalpeneti tṛtīyaḥ pakṣo'tra prakriyādaśāyāṃ sthitaḥ| vikalpaśca lakṣyānurodhādvyavasthito natvaicchika ityanyadetat| samuccayapakṣaṃ caturtha māśrityāpi kvacitkasya cidvivakṣā aparasya tvavivakṣeti gṛhītvā prakriyānirvāhaḥ sukara iti dik| yadi hi vyaktirevetyetatsārvatrikamābhimataṃ syāttarhi``jātyākhyāyāmiti sūtraṃ nārabheta| yadi ca jātireveti, tarhi sarūpasutraṃ nārabheteti bhāṣyam|
nanu yasminvena eka evāmravṛkṣastatrāpilakṣaṇaryā jātiparatve iha āmrāḥ santīti prayogaṃ sādhayituṃ ``jātyākhyāyām iti sūtramastu| tathā jātipakṣe'pi nānārthānurodhātsarūpasūtramastu| vakṣyati hi vārttikakṛt-vyartheṣu ca muktasaṃśayamiti| satyam, lakṣayānurodha eva pakṣadvayāśraye śaraṇam| ata evodāhṛtasūtrayorbhāṣyakṛtā pratyāravyāsyamānatvepyadoṣaḥ|
idānīṃ vārtikakāraḥ śāstrasya niyamavidhirupatayā sārthakyamāhasiddhe śabdārthasambanade lokato'rthaprayukte śabdaprayoge śāstreṇa dharmaniyamo yathā laukikavaidikeṣu| lokādeva hi prathamavyutpāttiḥ avyutpannaṃ prati vyākaraṇādīnāmapravṛttiḥ| ``arthavadadhātuḥ ityādi hi vyākaraṇaṃ śaktigrahopajīvakam| tathā ca samarthasūtre'pi vārttikam--``arthānādeśanāt iti| ``anekamanyapadārthe ityādikaṃ hi lokasiddhamarthamanūdya sādhutvānvākhyānaparam| tataśca lokādeva śabde arthe tayoḥ sambandhe ca siddhe arthabodhanāya śabdaprayoge'pi prasakte gavādaya eva prayoktavyā na tu gāvyādaya iti niyamārthaṃ śāstram| niyamaphalaṃ tu dharmaḥ| tatra smārtto dṛṣṭāntaḥ--``prāṅmuko'nnāni bhuñjīta ityādirlaukikaśabdenaiktaḥ| ``vrīhīnavahanti ityādiśca vaidikaśabdenoktaḥ| dharmaniyama iti ca ṣaṣṭhītatpuṣo'śvaghāsādivapat, na tu caturthītatpuruṣaḥ prakṛtivikṛtibhāvavirahāt| nanu yadi prayuktānāmidamanvākhyānaṃ tarhi kimarthamaprayuktā api ūṣa tera cakra pecetyādayo vyutpādyante iti cet ? na, ārṣajñānaṃ vinā aprayuktatāyā duravadhāraṇatvāt| mahānhi prayogaviṣayaḥ| tathā ca bhāṣyam--``saptadvīpā vasumatī, trayo lokāścatvāro vedāḥ sāṅgāḥ sarahasyābahudhā bhinnā ekaśatamadhvaryuśākhāḥ sahasravartmā sāmaveda ekaviṃśatidhābāhvṛcyaṃ navadhātharvaṇo vedaḥ vākovākyamitihāsaḥ purāṇaṃ vaidyakamityetāvān prayogasya viṣayaḥ iti| bahvṛcānāmāmnāyo bāhvacyam| ``chandogaukthikayāśikabahvacanaṭāññyaḥ iti ñyapratyayaḥ| ``caraṇāddharmāmnāyayoḥ ityuktatvādāmnāye| atharvaṇā prokto vedo atharvā| upacārātprayoga ityeke| vasantādiṣu atharvan ātharvaṇa ityubhayoḥ pāṭhasāmarthyātproktapratyayasva vaikalpiko lugiti tu tattvam| ata eva bhāṣye vakyate-tena proktamiti prakṛtya ṛṣibhyo lugvaktavyaḥ| vasiṣṭho'nuvākaḥ| tato vaktavyamatharvaṇo veti| tamadhīte ātharvaṇikaḥ vasantāditvāṭhṭhak| dāṇḍināyanādisūtre nipātanāṭṭilopābhāvaḥ| ātharvaṇikasyāmnāya ātharvaṇaḥ ``ātharvaṇikasyekalopaśca iti ātharvaṇikādaṇ tatsanniyoge nekalopaśca|
prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ| etāvantaṃ prayogaviṣayaṃ paryālocayitumaśaktairapyasmadādibhirlakṣaṇānugatānāṃ prayayogestītyanumeyam| asti ca tvayodāhṛtānāmapi vede prayogaḥ--saptāsye revatī reva dūṣa| yanme naraḥ śrutyaṃ brahma cakra| yatrānaścakrājarasaṃ tanūnāmiti| nanu yadi lakṣaṇenānāditāsiddhistarhi vacantyādīnāmapi syāditi cet? na, ``nahi vacirantiparaḥ prayujya te ityabhiryuktānāmavigītavyavahāreṇa sāmānyaśāstrasya saṅkocāt| abhyupagato viśeṣaviṣayiṇyā patitasya karmānadhikārasmṛtyā agnihotrādiśrutīnāṃ saṅkocaḥ, viśeṣaviṣayeṇa śiṣṭācāreṇa sāmānyasmṛteḥ saṅkocaśca| taduktam--ānarthakyapratihatānāṃ viparītaṃ balābalamiti| yatra tu aprayogaḥ sandigdhaḥ sāstrānugamaśca tatra niṣpratyūhamanumānam| taduktam--- ``yathālakṣaṇamaprayukte iti| aprayukte aniścitaprayoge ityarthaḥ| niścitāprayoge tu lakṣaṇaṃ na pravarttate eveti niṣkarṣaḥ| na caivaṃ `brāvovaciḥ ityādīnāṃ saṅkocāpāttiḥ| triśaṅkvādyayājyayājanenāpi smṛtisaṅkocāpattestulyatvāt| tatra dharmabuddhyānuṣṭhānaṃ nāstīti cet ? ihāpi sādhutvabuddhyā prayogo nāstīti tulyam| yarvāṇastarvāṇa itivadabhaiyuktānāmapi asādhuprayogasya kratorbahirupapatteśca| ata evetihāsapurāṇādiṣvapaśabdā api santīti haradattaḥ| nadīsaṃjñāsūtre bhāṣye'pi spaṣṭametat| kecittu ārṣagrantheṣvapi chandaṃsi vihitasya vyatyayasya pravṛttyā sādhutāṃ samarthayanti| na ca gauṇamukhyanyāyena mukhye chandasyeva tatpavṛttiḥ, svaritatvapratijñayā tadbādhāt| vakṣyati hi ``svaritenādhikāraḥ iti sūtre'viśeṣāyādhikaṃ kāryamiti| gauṇamukhyanyāyo hi svaritatvapratijñāsthale na pravarttate ityarthaḥ| upapādayiṣyate cedam| ata evārṣatvātsādhuteti tatra tatroddhoṣaḥ saṅgacchate iti dik|
yadyapi aprāptāṃśapūraṇaphalako niyamavidhiḥ, itaravyāvṛttiphalakastu nityaprāptiviṣayakaḥ parisaṃkhyāvidhiriti pūrvottaramīmāṃsayorvyavahārastathāpīha śāstre parisaṃkhyā'pi niyamaśabdena vyavahiyata| tena ``pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyāḥ ityasya niyamodāharaṇatayā upanyāso na viruddhaḥ| na cāsau mīmāṃsakarītyā'pi niyamo bhavatviti vācyaṃ, pañcātiriktabhakṣaṇe prāyaścittavidherasaṅgatatvāpatteḥ, pañcānāmabhakṣaṇe prāyāścittāpattau
gṛhe'pi nivasan vipro munirmāṃsavivarjanāt|
ityādismṛtivyākopācca ata eva tridoṣā'pi parisaṃkhyaiva tatrāśriteti dik |
atredamavardhayam, niyamātikrame kṛte apūrvaṃ paraṃ na bhavati, dṛṣṭastvarthāvabodho bhavatyeva avahananātikrame kṛte'pi vaituṣyavat digantarābhimukhabhojane tṛptivacca| na cāpabhraṃśānāmavācakatayā kathamarthāvabodha iti vācyaṃ, śaktibhramavatāṃ bādhakābhāvāt| viśeṣadarśinastu dvividhāḥ--tattadvācakasaṃskṛtaviśeṣajñānavantastadvikalāśca| tatra ādyānāṃ sādhusmaraṇadvārā arthabodhaḥ, dvitīyānāṃ bodhyārthasaṃbaddhārthāntaravācakasya smṛtau satyāṃ tato lakṣaṇayā bodhaḥ, sarvanāmasmṛtervā, tadarthajñāpakatvena rūpeṇa sādhusmṛtervā, arthādhyāhārapakṣāśrayaṇādveti yathāyathaṃ bodhyam|
apare tvāhuḥ--apabhraṃśā api vācakā eva| tathāhi, asmātpadādayamartho bodhdhavya itīśvarechcā śaktīriti mate bhagavadicchāyāḥ sanmātraviṣayakatvādapabhraṃśaistu bodhadajananasya śaktibhraṃmadaśāyāṃ tenāpyabhyupagamād durvārā śaktiḥ| padārthāntaraṃ taditi mate'pi kalpakaṃ sādhyavasādhvostulyameva| asādhusmaraṇadvārā sādhurbodhaka iti vaiparītyasyāpatteśca| svīkṛtaṃ hi pareṇa tibādismāritānāṃ lādīnāmasādhūnāmapi bodhakatvam| nanu sādhūnāmalpatvāttatraiva lāghavācchaktiḥ kalpyate iti cet ? na vayamapūrvaṃ kiñcitkalpayāmaḥ, kintu yathā ghaṭajananasamirthyameva daṇḍādeḥ śaktiḥ, tathā ghaṭabodhajananasāmarthyameva ghaṭādipadānāṃ śaktiḥ| sā ca kāraṇatvāparaparyāyā śaktibhramād bodhaṃ vadatā tvayā'pyabhyupetaiva| śaktigrahasya bhramatvaṃ paraṃ tyajyatāṃ viṣayābādhāditi brūmaḥ| nanvevaṃ gauṇamukhyavibhāgocchedaḥ `` sarve sarvasya vācakāḥ iti paryavasānāditi cet ? tvatpakṣe'pīśvarecchāyā gauṇādāvatiprasaṅgasya tulyatvāt| suhṛdbhāvena pṛcchāmīticet ? pracurataraprayogatadvirahābhyāṃ gauṇamukhyavibhāga iti gṛhāṇa| nanu janakatvenāgṛhītādapi tarhi kāraṇātkāryodayaḥ syādeveti cet ? padārthasmṛtirāpādyate vākyārthabodho vā ? nādyaḥ, sambandhagrahaṃ vinā tadayogāt| nāntyaḥ, dvārābhāvāt| padārthasmāraṇaṃ hi dvāram| evañca mahadeva lāghavamaa| sādhusmāraṇakalpanākleśaśca na bhavatīti| sādhutvaṃ tu jātiviśeṣātmakamityuktameva| samānāthāmarthāvagatau śabdauścāpaśabdaiśceti bhāṣyamapyetatpakṣapātīti dik ||
iti apaśabdānāṃ vācakatvāvācakatvavicāraḥ|
prayogaśabdamupādadāno vārttikakāraḥ prayogāddharmo na tu jñānamātrāditi sūcayati| yuktaṃ caitat, ekaḥ śabdaḥ samyagjñātaḥ suprayukta ityatra jñānaprayogayorupādānasyāviśeṣe'pi pratipadādhikaraṇanyāyena yadaikasmādapūrvaṃ tadetarattadarthamiti prayogātphalaṃ, jñānaṃ tu tadaṅgamityabhyupagamāt prayogasya phalamprati sannihitatvācca| jñānasya tu vyavahitatvāt jñānasyaprayogāṅgatāyāṃ dṛṣṭārthatālābhācca| uktaṃ ca bhaṭṭaiḥ---
sarvatraiva hi vijñānaṃ saṃskāratvena gamyate|
parāṅgaṃ cātmavijñānādanyatretyavadhāryatām || iti||
ata eva ``tarati brahmahatyāṃ yo'śvamedhena yajate ya u cainamevaṃ veda ityādiṣvapi jñānapūrvakānuṣṭhānātphalamityeva siddhāntaḥ| taduktaṃ vārtikakṛtā--`tattulyaṃ vedaśabdena iti| vedaḥ śabdo vidhāyako yasyārthasya aśvamedhādestenedaṃ tulyamityarthaḥ| tena vaidikaśabdānāmapi pakṣakoṭiparaviṣṭatayā dṛṣṭāntāsaṅgatiriti nāśaṅkanīyam| ``te'surāḥ iti pūrvodāhṛtaśrutirapi apaśabdaprayogātpratyavāyaṃ bodhayantī sādhuprayogāddharmaṃ gamayati| vājasaneyināṃ brāhmaṇe--``tasmādeṣā vyākṛtā vāgudyate iti śrutirapyevam| bhāṣye tu abhyupetyavādena sādhujñānātphalamityayamapi pakṣaḥ samarthitaḥ| na caivamapaśabdajñānādadharmo'pi syāditi vācyaṃ, `yāvadvacanaṃ vācanikam' ityabhyupagamāt ``na mlecchitavai ityādinā asādhuprayogasyaiva niṣedhācca| na ca vyākaraṇādhyayane pravṛttasya pariniṣṭhitapacatyādibodhārthaṃ ḍupacaṣprabhṛtīnāṃ prayogo'pyāvaśyaka eveti vācyaṃ, tadīyajñānamātreṇa nirvāhāt| ata evālaukikamprakriyāvākyamūhamātrasya gocara iti nitsasamāseṣvasvapadavigrahābhyupagamaḥ| atha vyutpādanārthaṃ tatprayoga āvaśyaka ityāgrahastathāpi na kṣatiḥ, anapabhraṣṭatvena teṣāṃ pratyavāyājanakatvāt| nahyete śaktivaikalyādiprayuktāḥ, yena gāvyādisāmyaṃ bhajeran| atha sāditvādasādhutetyāgrahastathāpi na kṣatiḥ śabdasvarūpaparatvāt| anukaraṇānāṃ sarvatra sādhutābyupagamāt| nahi ``helayo helayaḥ iti śrutipāṭho'pi pratyavāyajanakaḥ| syādatat, sarvā ajvyaktayo halvyaktayaśca śāstrānte śuddhāḥ paṭhiṣyante ``a a itivat| nacaivaṃ gauravaṃ, tadbalena sarveṣāmanubandhanāṃ pratyākhyānāt| itsaṃjñālopayorapi tyāgāt| tathāhi, śīṅ dhātorṅakāraṃ parityakṣyāmaḥ| īkāraṃ ca kalaṃ paṭhiṣyāmaḥ| ṅita ātmanepadamityasya sthāne kalādātmanepadamiti paṭhiṣyāmaḥ| kalaśca prakriyādaśāyāmeva yathā ṅakāraḥ| prayoge tu śuddha eva| pratyāpatteḥ śāstrānte karaṇamapi śāstrīyasakalakāryaṃ pratyasiddhatālābhāya| evañca prakriyāyāṃ doṣasya kalāderāśrayaṇaṃ'pi pariniṣṭhitarūpe na kaściddoṣaḥ| yathā yatānyāsapakṣe'pi akārasya vivṛtatā prakriyāmātraviṣayā na tu prayogasamavāyinī tadvadiha pakṣe kalādayopīti na kaścidviśeṣaḥ| dharmikalpanāta iti nyāyaśceha bodhyaḥ| ṅakārādayo hi dharmiṇa eva tyayā pāṭhyāḥ| mayā tu ubhayapaṭhanīyasya īkārasya kalatvamātraṃ kalpyamiti| nanvasminpakṣe ``svaritañitaḥ ityatra kathaṃ kāryamiti cet? ``dhmātātkartrabhiprāye iti| evam ``ādyantau ṭakitau ityatra ``ādyantau kaladhmātau iti| iḍādyāgamāśca niranubandhāḥ kalāḥ pāṭhyāḥ, ānugādayo dhmātāḥ| ḍukṛñityasya sthāne kṛ iti dvidoṣaṃ pāṭhyam| ``ādirantyena ityatrāpi ``ādikalau saha ityuktvā `a u' ityādikāḥ saṃjñāḥ kariṣyante| kaleneti tṛtīyānirddeśe sati tu aprādhānyātsiddhānta eva caramavarṇasya saṃjñā na syāt| ``ḍhralope ityādau aṇa ityapanīya a oriti kariṣyate svarasandhistvasandehāya kariṣyate| tasmātsarvamanubandhakāryādikaṅkalādibhireva sidhyatīti cet ? satyam, sidtyevam| apāṇinīyaṃ cu bhavatīti cet ? atrocyate, iṣṭasiddhyartho varṇopadeśaḥ| evañcākṛtyupadeśādeva udāttādisiddhimaṅgīkṛtya kalādiṣvatiprasaṅga itthaṃ parihāryaḥ|
āgamāśca vikārāśca pratyayāḥ saha dhātubhiḥ|

saṃjñāsutramidam ``ādirantyena sahetā ityanena sahaikavākyatvāt| aiuṇityeṣāmādirakāraḥ antyena ṇakārādinā sahitaḥ san ādyantābhyāmākṣiptānāṃ madhyagānāṃ svasya ca saṃjñeti hi vākyārthaḥ| atra akārādīnāṃ svarūpeṇa anukāryeṇa vā satopyarthavattvasyāvivakṣitatvātprātipadikatvaṃ neti `gavityayamāha' ityādāviva vibhakteranutpāttiḥ ``supāṃsulug iti lugvā ``chandovatsūtrāṇi iti bāṣyakāreṣṭyā chandogeṣu vyākaraṇasūtreṣvapi chāndasakāryātideśāt ``yūstryākhyau itisūtre chandaḥpradeśeṣu gauṇukhyanyāyo na pravarttate iti vakṣyamāṇatvādvā|

tasmādaiuṇityādau svarasandhiḥ prāpnotyeveti cet? satyam, saṃhitāvirahānna yaṇodayaḥ| anityā hi vākye saṃhitā| uktañca---

yathā sandhīyamānānāmanekībhavatāṃ svaraḥ|
upadiṣṭastathā vidyādakṣarāṇāmavagrahe || iti ||

``laṇ [māosūo 6] ityatratyo ṇakāro'pi tribhyaḥ ``aṇuditsavarṇa sya [pāosūo1-1-69] ityeka evāṇ, ``iṇaḥ ṣīdhvam [pāosūo 8-3-78] ityādayaḥ sarve iṇaḥ, ``iko yaṇ [pāosūo 6-1-77] ityādau yaṇ ca| catra yaṇ tāvatpūrveṇa na sambhavatyeva | iṇtu sambhavannapi jñāpakāttyaktaḥ| aṇastu ubhābhyāṃ grahaṇe sthite kva pūrveṇa kva vā pareṇeti vi vakṣāyāṃ grahaṇakaśāstre pareṇaivānyatra tu pūrveṇaiveti siddhāntaḥ| uktaṃ hi ``vyākhyānato viśeṣapratipattiḥ [paobhāo1] iti| na hi ``pareśca ghāṅkayoḥ [pāosūo 8-2-22] ityādau vyākhyānādanyanniyāmakamasti| kiñca, aṇ grahaṇāni tāvatpañca--``uraṇ raparaḥ [pāosūo 1-1-51] ``aṇuditsavarṇasya [pāosūo1-1-69] ``ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrghoṇaḥ [pāosūo 6-3-111] ``ke'ṇaḥ [pāosūo7-4-13] ``aṇo'pragṛhyasya [pāosūo8-4-57] iti| tatra ``uraṇ raparaḥ [pāosūo 1-1-51] iti tāvatpūrveṇa ``ṛta iddhātoḥ [pāosūo7-1-100] iti dhātugrahaṇājjñāpakāt| taddhi `mātṝṇām' ityādivyāvṛttyarthaṃ kriyate| pareṇa ca grahaṇe ``nāmi [pāosūo 6-4-3] iti dīrghasyāpi raparatvāpattyā vyāvartyāprasiddhiḥ| nanu `cikīrṣati' ityatra ``ajjñanagamām [pāosūo6-4-16] iti dīrghe rapararatve ca sati ``upadhāyāśca [pāosūo 7-1-1] itītvameṣitavyam| tadvat `mātṝṇām' ityatrāpi prasaṅge tadvyavartakatayottarārthaṃ dhātugrahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti cet ? na, evaṃ hi satyuttaratraiva kuryāt| iha karaṇaṃ jñāpakameva| tathā ca vakṣyati--``nuḍvācya uttarārthaṃ tu, iha kiñcit trapo iti iti| kiñca aṇgraharaṇasāmarthyādapi pūrvaivāyam| yadi hi pareṇa syād `urac' ityajgrahaṇameva kuryāt `kṛttiḥ' `kṛtaṃ' `prakṛtaṃ' `nṛḥpāhi' mātṝṇām' ityādāvādyudāttānudāttasvaritānunāsikadīrghāṇāṃ raparatāyāḥ pareṇāmgraheṇopapādayitavyāyāstāvatāpi lābhāt| `karttā' `kārakaḥ' ityādau guṇavṛddhiprasaṅge ecāmavarṇasya cāviseṣādraparatvasya vikalpena prasaṅga ityapyajgrahaṇena sidhyatyeva|
syādetat, `kartrarthaṇ' ityatra iko yaṇi raparatve rephadvayaśravaṇārthamaṇgrahaṇaṃ syāt| nahyetadajgrahaṇena sidhyati| ``halo yamām [pāosūo8-4-64] iti lopastu vaikalpikaḥ ``jhayo ho'nyatarasyām [pāosūo 8-4-62] ityatonyatarasyāṃgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| atra ca jhāpakaṃ grahaṇakaśāstre'ṇgrahaṇam| taddhi `sayyam̐ntā' savvam̐tsaraḥ | yalam̐lokam ityādau parasavarṇasya sānunāsikasya ********** grahaṇādka ``anaci ca (pāosūo 8-4-47) iti dvitve kṛte pakṣe yavalānāṃtrikasya śravaṇārthaṃ kriyate| ``haloyamām[pā.sū.8-4-64] ityasya nityatve tu vyarthameva tatsyāt| yadyapi guṇānāmabedakatvenaiva sānunāsikayavalānāṃ dvitvasiddhergrahaṇakaśāstre'jgrahaṇamevocitaṃ cana tvaṇgrahaṇaṃ, tathāpi `guṇā bedakāḥ' [pāobhāo] ityapi pakṣaṃ jhāpayitumaṇgrahaṇam| bedakābhedakapakṣayośca jātivyaktipakṣayoriva lakṣyānurodādvyavasthā| ata eva ``catasaryādyudāttanipātanam [bhāoio] ityādi saṅgacchate| ata eva ca ``aṣṭana ā vibhaktau [pāosūo 7-2-84] ityādāvidamastyadādyatve cānunāsikoneti vakṣyāmaḥ|
yattu vikalpānuvṛttau jhāpakāntaravarṇanam-anuvarttate vibāṣā śaro'ci yadvārayatyayaṃ dvitvaṃ, nitye hi tasya lope pratiṣedārtho na kaścitsyād iti, tattu bhāṣye dūṣitam| tathāhi, lopasya nityatve ``aco rahābhyām [pāosūo8-4-46] iti dvitvenārambhasāmarthyāttadvādhaḥ. dvividhā eva hi yaraḥ yamo jharaśceti| tatra ``halo yamām [pāosūo 8-4-64] iti ``jharo jhari [pāosūo 8-2-39] iti ca lope kṛte dvitvaṃ vṛthā syāt| kiṃ tarhi tayoryogayorudāharaṇamiti cet? yatrāntareṇa dvitvaṃ vyañjanatrayaṃ labhyate, yathā ādityo devatā'sya ādityaḥ, prattam, avattamiti| evaṃ sthaite `caturṣu' ityatrāpi yadi dvitvaṃ syāttarhi lopo na syādeva| tataśca sārtakaḥ ``śaro'ci [pāosūo8-4-49] iti niṣedhaḥ kathaṃ vibhāṣānuvṛttiṃ jñāpayedityāstāṃ tāvat| sarvathāpi vikalpānuvṛtteḥ sthitatvātpākṣikarephadvayaśravaṇārthamaṇgrahaṇamastviti|
atrocyate, `kartrartham' ityādau satyapi raparatve rephadvayaśravaṇaṃ durlalbham‌ro ri [pāosūo8-3-14] iti lopāt| na ca tatra `padāntasya' iti vyākhyātuṃ yuktaṃ, jargṛdherlaṅ `ajarghāḥ' pāsparddherlaṅ `apāspāḥ' ityāderasiddhiprasaṅgāt| na cāṇgrahaṇasāmarthyāttadvādhaḥ, pūrveṇāpi grahaṇe 'bādhenaivopapatteriti dik| tasmāddhātugrahaṇasāmarthyādaṇgrahaṇasāmarthyādvā ``uraṇ raparaḥ iti pūrveṇa graharaṇamiti sthitam| vastutastu dhātugrahaṇameva jñāpakam, aṇgrahaṇasya `lākṛtiḥ' ityādau laparatāphalamityapi vaktuṃ śakyatvāt| ``aṇuditsavarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ [pāosūo1-1-69] iti tu pareṇaiva ``ūrṛt [pāosūo7-4-7] iti liṅgāt| tatra hi ``kṝtasaṃśabdene [cuouo] ityasmāccurādiṇyantālluṅi caṅi `acīkṛtat' ityatra ṛkārasya dīrghasyāpi sthāne hasva evayathā syādityevamarthaṃ taparakaraṇaṃ kṛtam| grahaṇakaśāstre pūrvaṇa grahaṇe taparatvaṃ syāt| nanu satyapi pareṇa grahaṇe ``urṛt [pāosūo7-4-7] ityatra taparatvaṃ vṛthaiva| bhāvyamānena savarṇagrahamāprasakteriti cet? na, vakṣyati hi tatra vṛttikāraḥ--na cāyambhāvyamāno'ṇ kintu ādeśāntaranivṛttyarthaṃ svarūpeṇābhyanujñāyate iti| kṛte tu taparatve tadvalādeva dīrghasthāne bhāvyamānatā'pi labhyate ityanyadetat| tasmād grahamakaśāstreṇa `ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrghī'maḥ (pāosūo 6-3-111) ityatrāpi halāmaṇāmasambhavādecāntu viśeṣābhāvādanarthakamavāṇgrahaṇaṃ syāt| tataśca ``acaśca (pāosūo 1-1-28) ityeva siddhamityaṇgrahaṇasāmarthyātpūrveṇa nanu ``vṛhū udyamane [tuopao] asmāttṛci ūditvādiḍabhāve guṇe ḍhatvadhatvaṣṭutvaḍhalopeṣu rephasya dīrghe sthānasāmyādṛkāre ḍhalopasyāsiddhatvam ``upadhāyāśca (pāosūo 7-1-1-101) itītve pūrvavad guṇe ``vṛhū udyamane [tuopao] asmānniṣṭhāyāṃ ḍhatvadhatvaṣṭutvaḍhalopeṣu kṛteṣu `vṛḍhaḥ' iti rupam| dantyoṣṭhyādiścāyam| ``udvṛharakṣaḥ saha mūlamindra iti darśanāt| ``mūlamasyābarhi [pāosūo4-4-88] iti abādhenopapattau hi bādho na nyāyyaḥ| ``aṇo'pragṛhyasya (pāosūo 8-44-57) ityatra pareṇa sati--`kartṛ' `agne' `vāyo' `matyai' `papau' `mālāmāckṣāṇo māl' `vṛkṣavayaterapratyayaḥ vṛkṣav' atrāpi prāpnoti| rephavarjitā antarathāḥ sānunāsikaniranunāsikabhedena dvidhetyuktatvāt| atra laṇsūtre stitvā vṛkṣavśabdamityaṃ kaiyaṭo vyudapādayat--vṛkṣaṃ vṛśca tītī kviti kṛte, vṛkṣavśabdamittham̐ kaiyaṭo ``hali sarveṣām [pāosūo8-3-23] iti kaprāpnoti| na ca sthānivadbhāvaḥ pūrvatrāsiddhe tanniṣedhāditi cet? iti prāpnoti | na ca stānivadbhāvaḥ pūrvatrāsiddhe tanniṣedhāditi cet? na, ``bho bhago [pāosūo8-3-17] ityato'sītyanuvartyāśi hali tadvidhānāditi| na ca vicpakṣe'pi ṇicaḥ prāgbhāvinaṃ kviṇamevāśrityoṭh prasañjāditi| na ca vicpakṣe'pi ṇicaḥ prāgbhāvin kvipamevāśrītyoṣ prasañjanīyaḥ, arntabhūtakvibāśrayatayā'ntaraṅge rarttavye bahirbūtaṇijapekṣatayā vahiraṅgasya ṭilopasyāsiddhatvāt| idaṃ tviha vaktavyam| vicpakṣe'pyekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvena vraścatigrahaṇena grahaṇam ``vraśca[pāo sūo 8-2-36] iti ṣatvaṃ durvāram| na ca ṇilopasya sthānivattvam `pa(1)dāntavidhau na' iti niṣedhāt ``pūrvatrāsiddhe na [bhāoio] iti niṣedhācca| tasmānnāyaṃ vṛścatirapi tu vetirvātirvā, vṛkṣaṃ vetīti vṛkṣavīḥ vṛkṣaṃ vātīti vṛkṣavyaṃ vṛkṣavāṃ vā''caṣṭe vṛkṣav, vic, na tu kvip ūṭhprasaṅgāt, kvau vidhiṃ prati sthānivatvaniṣedhāt| tathā ca devayateḥ `dayuḥ' iti siddhāntitam| na caivamapi ``lopo vyoḥ [pāosūo6-1-76] ityasya prasaṅgaḥ sthānivattvāt| cānavayavatvāt| vibhāvitaṃ cedaṃ ``bho bhago [pāosūo8-2-17] iti sūtre kaiyaṭeneti dik|
yattu ``hali sarveṣām (pāosūo8-3-22) iti sūtre haradattenoktam--``vṛkṣav karotītyevaṃ rūpaḥ prayoge nāstyeva, anabhidhānāt| laṇsūtre ``na padāntā haloṇaḥ santi (bhāoio) iti bhāṣyakārokteścānabhidhānaṃ niscīyate iti, taccintyam laṇsūtrabhāṣye ``na padāntāḥ pare'ṇaḥ santi iti pāṭhāt apragṛhyasyeti paryudāsāśrayaṇenācāmeva kāryabhāktvāditare kāryabhājo na santītyevaṃparatayā kaiyaṭena tadvivaraṇācca, ``nanu cāyamasti kartṛ ityuttarabhāṣyeṇāsya dūṣitatvācca, tvadudāhṛtapāṭhe uttarabhāṣyasyoktisambhavālābhācca| ata eva ``bho bhago (pāosūo8-2-17) itisūtre bhāṣyakāravṛttikārādibhiḥ sarvairapi `vṛkṣav' ityudāhṛtam| svayamapīha tathaivodāhṛtamiti pūrvāparasvagranthavirodho bhāṣyavṛttikaiyaṭādisakalamahāgranthavirodho mūlayuktyabhāvaśceti tiṣṭhatu tāvat|

ācārādapradhānatvāllopaśca balavattaraḥ ||
pratyāhāro'kṣarasamāmnāyaḥ| tatra yenubandhāsteṣāmajgrahaṇeṣvityupalakṣaṇam| ajādipratyāhāragrahaṇeṣu| kathaṃ neti| `grahaṇam' iti śeṣaḥ| ``ādirantyena (pāosūo1-1-71) iti sūtreṇa hi akārmārabhyā''cakārādvarṇānāṃ bhavantyacsaṃjñā madhyasthātvāviśeṣādikārādīnāmiva ṇakārakakāraṅkārāṇāmapi syāt| tataśca `ṇakāraḥ'`dadhi-kakāraḥ' `dadhi-ṅakāraḥ' ityādau yaṇ syāt| evamaḍgrahaṇe cakārasyāpi grahaṇād `rucīnām' ityādau ``aḍvyavāye iti ṇatvaṃ syāt| evamiṇgrahaṇena cakāragrahaṇād `rucidhve' ityādau ``vibhāṣeṭaḥ (pāosūo8-3-79) iti ḍhaḥ syāditi pūrvapakṣaḥ pūrvārddhasyārthaḥ|
uttaramāha--ācārāditi| ācāro'tra sūtrakṛto nirddeśaḥ| ``uṇādayo bahulam (pāosūo3-3-1) ``tṛṣimṛṣikṛśeḥ (pāosūo1-2-25) ``ṅasiṅasośca (pāosūo 6-1-110) ityādau yaṇo'kṛtatvānmadhyasthānāmapyanubandhānāṃ saṃjñitvaṃ neti jñāpyate ityarthaḥ| samādhānāntaramāhaapradhānatvāditi| aṇinyādisaṃjñāḥ praṇetuṃ tadrūpapratipādanāyānubandhā uccāryante| tataśca parārthamupādīyamānatayā teṣāmaprādhānyam| itareṣāṃ tu svārthamupādīyamānatvātprādhānyam| tena teṣāmeva saṃjñā na tvanubandhānām| ``pradhānāpradānayoḥ pradhāne kāryasampratyayaḥ (paobhāo105) iti nyāyāt| nanvevamakārasyācsaṃjñā na syāt, saṃjñāpratipādane cakārasyeva tasyāpyaṅgatvāviseṣāditi ceti? na, ``svaṃ rūpam (pāosūo 1-1-68) ityanuvṛttyā''derapi saṃjñitvāt| svaṃ rūpaṃ cādereva gṛhyate nāntyasya, sarvanāmnāṃ pradhānaparāmarśakatāyā autsargikatvāt| iteti tṛtīyayā ito'prādhānyalābhāt| tadevaṃ saṃjñāpravṛttikāle'nubandhānāṃ saṃnidhānamabhyupetya dvedā samāhitam| vastutastu tadeva nāstīttayādda-lopaśceti| balavāneva balavattaraḥ svārthe tarap| ``alpāctaram (pāosūo 2-2-34) iti yathā| ``halantyam (pāosūo1-3-3) itītsaṃjñāyāṃ hi kṛtāyāṃ ṇakārādīnāmacsaṃjñā prāpnoti lopaśca| tatra paratvānnityatvādantaraṅgatvācca lope kṛte saṃjñāpravṛttikāle makārādīnāmasattvādeva teṣāmajādisaṃjñā neti bhāvaḥ| yasmistu pratyāhāre yo'nubandho'kapokṣitastasya vacanasāmarthyāttatpravṛtteḥ prāg lopābhāvaḥ| lupte'pi vā tasmin bhūtapūrveṇa tena sahita ādiḥ saṃjñā bhaviṣyati| antaḥ pātināṃ tu luptānāṃ na saṃjñā śrūyamāṇeṣvikārādiṣu sāvakāśatvāditi| nanu halpratyāhāre'kārasya praveśo durvāraḥ| na hi tatra lopo labhyate| tataḥ prāgacsaṃjñāviraheṇa ``upadeśe'j (pāosūo 1-3-2) itītsaṃjñāyā apravṛtteḥ| evañcādyasamādhānamapi durupapādam| udāhṛtasyācārasya ``lopaśca balavattaraḥ ityanenaiva gatārthatvāditi cet? na, ``so'syādiḥ (pāosūo4-2-55) itinirddeśena prathamasya guṇānāṃ bhedakatvena caramasya ca samādhānasya sūpapādatvāditi dik ||
iti śrīśabdakaustubhe prathamasyādhyāyasya prathame
pāde dvitīyamānhikam || 2 ||
śabdakaustubha-I
vṛddhirādaica (pāosūo1-1-1)
ākāra aikāra aukāraśca vṛddhisaṃjñaḥ syāt| saṃjñāpradeśā ``vṛddhireci (pāosūo6-1-88) ityādayaḥ| tadudāharaṇamevāsyāpyudāharaṇaṃ bodhyam| ihācca aiccetītaretarayogadvandvaḥ ``supāṃ suluk (pāosūo7-1-39) iti sulugvā| athavā samāhāre dvandvaḥ| nacaivaṃ ``dvandvāccudaṣahāntāt (pāosūo 5-4-106) iti ṭac syāditi vācyaṃ, samāsāntavidheranityatvāt| atra jñāpakaṃ tu dvitribhyāṃ ṣa mūrdhnaḥ (pāosūo5-4-115) iti ṣavidhānam| naddhai ``bahuvrīhau sakathyakṣaṇoḥ (pāosūo 5-4-113) iti ṣaci prakṛte'pi kriyate| ṣacaścittvasāmarthyājjāyamānamantodāttatvaṃ bahuvrīhitvaprayuktaṃ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraṃ yathā bādhate tathā ``dvitribhyāṃ pāddanmūrdhasu bahuvrīhau (pāosūo 6-2-197) iti vidhīyamānamantodāttatvavikalpaṃ mā bādhiṣṭetyevamartham| tacṭaca ``dvitribhyām (pāosūo6-2-43) ityasya kvacillabdhāvakāśatve satyeva saṅgacchate, na tvanyathā| avakāśaśca samāsāntānāmanityatāyāṃ satyāmeva labhyate| `trimūrddhānaṃ saptaraśmiṃ gṛṇīṣe' iti yathā| tasmātṣapratyayavidhānaṃ jñāpakamiti sthitam| tathā ``dvitribhyām (pāosūo 6-2-197) iti sūtre bahuvrīhigrahaṇamapīha jñāpakam| anyathā `pāddanmūrddheṣu' ityeva nirddiśet| evaṃ hi sati kṛtasamāsāntapāddatprakramo'pi na virotsyate| bahuvrīhibhinnaṃ ca samāsāntavirahādeva vārayiṣyate|
nanu ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣādivāraṇāya bahuvrīhigrahaṇamastu| tathāhi, dvayordantā iti vigṛhya `dvidataḥ paśya' iti prayoge ``paddan (pāosūo 6-1-63) iti datādeśaḥ| sa eveha niranubandhakatvādvā gṛhyeta| na ca ``paddan (pāosūo 6-1-63) iti sūtre tadanatavidhidaurlabhyātkathametaditi vācyam (pāosūo6-1-63) iti sūtre tadantavidhidaurlabhyātkathametaditi vācyam ``ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇm (pāosūo 6-1-13) iti sūtrasthapūrvapakṣanyāye na ``siddhaṃ tvavayavānanyatvāt (bhāoio) ityāṣṭamikabhāṣyavārttikanyāyena cāvayavasya kāryalābhāt| anyathā `hāstiśīrṣyā upaiṣi' ityādāvagateriti vakṣyate| tasmātkathaṃ bahuvrīhigrahaṇaṃ jñāpakamiti cet? na, pūrvottarasāhacaryabalenāpi bahuvrīhyapraviṣṭasya vāraṇasambhavāt datṛ iti sānuvandhasyāpi supaṭhatvācca
| ``sphigapūtavīṇāñje'dhvakukṣisīranāmanām ca (pāosūo 6-2-187) iti sūtre ``apācca (pāosūo 6-2-186) ityanuvṛttyā `apasphigam' ityādāvuttarapadāntodāttavidāyake'dhvaśabdagrahaṇamapīha liṅgam| ``upasargādadhvanaḥ (pāosūo 5-4-85) ityacpratyayasya nityatve hi cittvādeva siddhaṃ syāt| tathā ``prateraṃsvādayastatpuruṣe (pāosūo6-2-113) iti sūtraṃ'śvādigaṇe rājanśabdasya pāṭho'pīha liṅgam| anyathā ``rājāhaḥ sakhibhyaṣṭac (pāosūo 5-4-91) iti ṭacaiva siddhe kintena ? yattu ``ṛkprabdhūḥ pathām (pāosūo 54-74) ityatra ṭilopasyeva ``prakṛtivadanukaraṇam (paobhāo 36) ityatideśena pratyayasyāpi prāptau tadakaraṇaṃ jñāpakamiti| tanna, atideśo'yamanitya iti ṛlṛksūtre prapañcitatvāditi dik| ``kṛtamanayoḥ sādhutvam ityādibhāṣyagranthāścāsminpakṣenukūlāḥ| anayoḥ padayoriti svarasāt| athavā `āt' ityasamastameva ``paspaśāyāṃ śabdāpratacipattiḥ' iti vārttike bhāṣyakāraireva vṛddhiḥ ādaijiti padavibhāgapradarśanāt| asmiṃśca pakṣe anayoḥka sūtrakhaṇḍayoriti neyam| pakṣāntarābhiprāyakameva vā tat| vṛddhiśabdastu tantreṇāvṛttyā vā yojanīyaḥ| ``dvirvacane'ci (pāosūo 1-1-59) ``igyaṇaḥ samprasāraṇam (pāosūo1-1-45) ityādāvivobhayathā'pyadoṣāt| āditi taparakaraṇamaijarthaṃ, tena trimākṣatracaturmātrāṇāmaicāṃ saṃjñā na bhavatītyādi ``eoṅ ``aiauc sūtrayoḥ prapañcitam| nacaivaṃ takārasyottaraśeṣataiva syāditi padāntatāvirahājjaśtvaṃ na syāditi vācyam, asandehārthatayā''kāraśeṣatvasyāpi sambhavāt| astu vā''daijiti padam, ``ṛta iddhātoḥ (pāosūo7-1-100) ityādau daparatvamevāśritya taparasūtre dakāropi praśliṣyate iti ``titsvaritam (pāosūo 6-1-185) iti sūtre bhāṣyakārairvakṣyamāṇatvād dātparasyāpi tatkālagrāhakatvāt| vastutastu dakārapraśleṣapakṣo'bhyuccayamātram| iha tu taparakaraṇaṃ spaṣṭārthamevetyādi prāgevoktaṃ na vismarttavyam|
nanu ``coḥ kuḥ (pāosūo 8-2-30) iti kutvamaicchabde prāpnoti catuṣṭayī śabdānāṃ pravṛttiriti pakṣe'sya saṃjñāśabdatayā laukikatvenānuśāsanaviṣayatvāt| trayīpakṣe'pi jātiśabdatvalasambhavāt| vaiśeṣikaparibhāṣayā dravyatvaguṇatvādijātisvīkāre vaiyākaraṇaparibhāṣayāpi tatsvīkārasya durvāratvāt| vastutastu siddhānte vyaktiviśeṣopahitasattāyā eva jātitvasvīkāradihāpi sā'stu| vyaktiviśeṣāśca svarūpasattā atadbhedenānugatīkṛtāssattopadāyakāḥ| taduktam---``tasyāṃ sarve śabdā vyavasthitāḥ iti| ādyantāvayavadvārā samudāyānukaraṇaṃ aic vā śabdaḥ| anukaraṇaśabdāśca jātiśabdā eva tatrānukāryaniṣṭhajāteḥ pravṛttinimittatvāt| na cādyapakṣe sūtravaiyarthyam, ṇadīyaśāstre vṛddhiśabdenādaica eva grāhyā iti niyamārthaṃ sūtrārambhāt| taduktaṃ kaiyaṭena --``anekaśakteḥ śabdasya śattyavacchedena saṃjñini viniyogānnityatvācca sarvasaṃjñānāṃ laukikatvāt iti| anekasminnanekā vā śaktirasyeti vigrahaḥ| avacchedakabede'pi lāghavācchaktirekaiva| aupādhiko bheda iti pravādastu upādhibhinna ityatra paryavasanna iti matenā''dyaḥ pakṣaḥ| upādhisthityadhīnasthitko jīvabrahmabedavadupadeye'pi bhedo'stīti matena dvitīyaḥ kalpaḥ. ``na kopadhāyāḥ (pāosūo 6-3-37) iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt| avacchedaḥ saṃkocaḥ.ka sa ca yadyapi śakterniravayavatayā na sambhavati tathāpi taditarasmistātparyaviraha eva śaktisaṅkoco'trābhimataḥ| ``sarve sarvārthavācakāḥ ityabhyupagame'pi tātparyaṃ kvacidevetyasya nirvivādatvāt| śaktiḥ paraṃ kāraṇatāparaṇaryāyā sarvatra durvāretyuktam| na caivam ``anyāyaścānekārthatvam ityasya nirviṣayatā, ṇairuṣayasaṅketanirapekṣasya prasiddhatarasambandhasya vinā pramāṇaṃ bahuṣu na kalpanamiti tadarthāt| gauṇamukhyavibhāgo'pi prasiddhyaprasiddhinibandhana eva| gāvyādīnāmasādhutāpi saṅketavirahe satyeva| ataeva prasiddhe'pi pakṣe goṇyādīnāṃ goṇyāṃ sādhutvamastyevetyanyatra vistaraḥ| uktaṃ ca---
vyavahārāya niyamaḥ saṃjñāyāḥ saṃjñini kvacit|
nitya eva tu sambandho ḍitthādiṣu gavādivat ||
vṛddhyādīnāṃ ca śāstre'smin śattyavaccedalakṣaṇaḥ|
akṛtrimo'bhisambandho viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyavat || iti ||
vastatastu sādhvasādhubahirbhāvapakṣe'pyeṣāmanuśāsanaviṣayatā'styeveti paspaśāyāṃ sādhutvanirvacanaprasaṅgenopapāditam| tasmātsarvathāpikutvaṃ prāpnotyeveti cet? satyam, ``ayasmayādīni chandasi (pāosūo 1-4-20) iti bhatvapravṛttyākutvopayoginī padasaṃjñā pratibadhyate| jaśtvāvidhyekavākyatāpannā tu padasaṃjñā'styeva| `sasuṣṭubhā sa ṛkvatā gaṇena' ityatra tu viparītam--kutve padatvamasti jaśtve tu neti| viṣayabedena saṃjñādvayamastītyaṃśe paraṃ dṛṣṭāntatā boddhyā| tena ``upadeśejanunāsika it (pāosūo1-3-2) ityādau kutvābāvo jaśtvaṃ ca siddhyati| ``chandasi vihitasya sūtre kathaṃ pravṛttiḥ ityāśaṅkya, `chandovatsūtrāṇibhavanti iti bhāṣyam iṣṭiriyaṃ bhāṣyayakṛtaḥ| yadvā, chandaḥśabdaḥ svaryate| ``svaritenādhikāraḥ (pāosūo 1-3-11) adhikaṃ kāryaṃ gauṇasyāpi grahaṇamityarthaḥ| tena chandoṅgeṣvapi vaktavyam iti vārttikavacanāt ``ṣaṣṭhīyuktaḥ (pāosūo1-4-9) iti sūtre `chandasi vā' iti vibhajya ekāsaṃjñeti niyamasya chandāsi vikalpanādvā| yadvā, ``ayasmayādīni (pāosūo1-4-20) ityanenobhayasaṃjñāprayuktakāryabhājaḥ samudāyā nipātyante, na tu prakṛtā bhasaṃjñaiva vidhīyate| ata eva kāryaviśeṣapuraskārasambhava iti bodhyam| tasmātkutvaṃ neti sthitam| kuśabdasya ``aṇudit (pāosūo 1-1-69) ityanena saṃjñātvena viniyogāttatra ca prāguktarītyamatabedasatvājjātiviśeṣaḥ pravṛttinimittam, vyaktiviśeṣopahitā sattaiva vā, śabdasvarūpaṃ vā, tasyāpi grāhyatvaṃ grāhakatvaṃ ceti paspaśoktarītyā vyaktiviśeṣaṇatayā bhānābhyupagamāt| tathācoktatritayānyatamamiha tvapratyayārthaḥ, prakṛtijanyabodhe prakārībhūtatvaṃ,prayogopādhimāśritya tathābhūtadharmasya tvatalarthatāyā vakṣyamāṇatvāt| yadvā, prakṛtiḥ śabdasvarūpaparā, tatpravṛttinimittattve tu tvatalādīnāṃ śaktireveti matāntaramapi vakṣyate| ubhayathā'pīha tvapratyayena svārthāśrayaḥ kakāro lakṣyate| tena kutvam netyasya kakārādeśo neti paryavasito'rthaḥ| āha ca---
sāmānyānyabhidhīyante sattā vā tairviśeṣitā|
saṃjñāśabdasvarūpaṃ vā pratyayaistvatalādibhiḥ || iti ||
ityaṃ padavibhāgaḥ padasādhutvaṃ coktam| vākyārthastu saṃjñāsaṃjñibhāvaḥ| tathāhi, samānavibhaktikanāmārthayorabhedānvayasya vyutpannatayā''kārādayo vṛddiṃ pratyabhedena saṃsargeṇa viśeṣyāḥ| virupopasthitistu viśeṣaṇībhūtaṃ śabdasvarūpamādāya bodhyā| etena ``indro marutvānmadhavā (aokoo1-1-44) ityādi vyākhyātam| na tu tatrāpi marutvadādiśabdānāṃ tattadvācye lakṣaṇeti grāhyam, uktarītyā lakṣaṇāṃ vinaivopapatteḥ. ata evodbhidadhikaraṇe viśiṣṭavidhipakṣaṃ matvarthalakṣaṇāprasaṅgena dūṣayitvā nāmadeyatvaṃ siddhāntitam| anyathā nāmadheyatve'pi lakṣaṇāyāstulyatayā'dhikaraṇasyāsambhavaduktikatāpatteriti dik|
syādetat| kimādaijmātrasya vṛddhisaṃjñā āhosvid vṛddhiśabdamāvarttya vṛddiriti ye ādaicaste vṛddhisaṃjñā iti vyākhyānāllukślulupsaṃjñāvattadbhāvitānāmeveti ? nādyaḥ, `sarvabhāsaḥ `sarvakākaḥ' ityādau ``uttarapadavṛddau sarvaṃ ca (pāosūo6-2-105) iti sūtreṇa pūrvapadāntodāttatvaprasahgāt| iṣyate tu ``samāsasya (pāosūo6-1-223) ityantodāttaḥ. na ca ``sarvasya supi (pāosūo6-1-191) ityādyudāttatā śaṅkyā satiśiṣṭena samāsasvareṇa bādhāt| ``sarvastomaḥ ityādau tu ``bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadam (pāosūo6-2-1) ityanena samāsāntodāttatve bādhite ``sarvasya supi' (pāosūo6-1-191) iti bhavatyeva| iha tu karmadhārayatvātsamāsāntodāttatvameveti bodhyam| kiñca tāvatī bhāryā yasyeti bahuvrīhau ``tāvadbhāryaḥ' na siddhyet| ``vṛddhinimittasya ca taddhitasya' (pāosūo 6-3-39) iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaprasaṅgāt|
na dvitīyaḥ, `śālīyaḥ' ityādau vṛddhalakṣaṇasya cchapratyayasyāsiddhiprasaṅgāt| kiñcaivam `āmramayaṃ' `śālamayam' ityādau ``nityaṃ vṛddhiśarādibhyaḥ (pāosūo4-3-144) iti nityo mayaṭ na syāt| kiñca `āmraguptāyaniḥ' `śālaguptāyaniḥ' ``udīcāṃ vṛddādagotrāt (pāosūo4-1-157) iti vṛddhalakṣaṇaḥ phiñna syāt| nanu ``prācāmavṛddhātphin bahulam (pāosūo 4-1-160) iti phinā'pyetatsiddham| nahyatra phiñphinoḥ svare rupe vā viśeṣo'sti ``ñnityādirnityam (pāosūo6-1-197) ityādyudāttasyobhayatrāviśiṣṭatvāt| na ca `āmraguptāyanībhāryaḥ' ityatra ``vṛddhinimittasya ca taddhitasyaraktavikāre (pāosūo 6-3-39) iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhasiddhye phiñeva karttavya iti vācyam ``jāteśca (pāosūo 6-3-41) ityanenapi pratiṣedhasiddheḥ| na cāmraguptāyaneśchātrā iti vṛddhācche vivakṣite ``phakphiñoranyatarasyām (pāosūo4-1-91) iti lugvikalpena `āmraguptīyāḥ' `āmraguptāyanīyāḥ' iti dvairupyamiṣṭaṃ, tacca phiñaṃ vinā na sidhyatīti vācyam ``phakphiñoḥ (pāo sūo4-1-91) ityatra yūnītyanuvṛtyā tvadudāhṛtarūpadvayasya siddhānte'pyasammatatvāt| ata eva tatra yūnyevodāhṛtam| yaskasyāpatyam ``śivādibhyo'm (pāosūo 4-1-112) yāskaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ yuvā ``aṇo dvyacaḥ (pāosūo4-1-156) itika phiñ yāskāyaniḥ, tasya chātrāḥ `yāskīyāḥ' `yāskāyanīyāḥ, iti tasmātphinā'pi siddhau kimarthaṃ phiñeveṣyate iti cet? tadayaṃ nirgalitaḥ sūtrārthaḥ--kṛtānāmakṛtānāṃ cādaicāṃ pratyekaṃ vṛddhisaṃjñā syāt| āśvalāyanaḥ, aitikāyanaḥ| aśvaletikaśabdābhyāṃ naḍāditvātphakyādivṛddhiḥ| upagorapatyamaupagavaḥ ||
adeṅ guṇaḥ (pāosūo 1-1-2)||
