vyañjanānāṃ guṇaḥ syāditi paramavaśiṣyate| tataśca `īhitā' ityatra hakārasya kaṇṭhyatvādakāraḥ syāt `umbhitā' ityatra bhakārasyauṣṭhyatvādokāraḥ; tataśca `yetā' `unavitā' iti syāt| īkārasya yaṇi kṛte'kārasyeṭā sahādguṇo na tvallopaḥ, ārddhadhātukopadeśe yadakārāntaṃ tasya lopa iti vyākhyātatvāt|umbhescānusvāraparasavarṇayorguṇe karttavye'siddhatvāditi| naiṣadoṣaḥ ``saptamyāṃ janerḍaḥ (pāosūo 3-2-97) ityatra ḍapratyayasya ḍitkaraṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ na vyañjanasya guṇo bavatīti| yadi hi syāttarhi nakārasyārddhamātrikasya mātrike akāre guṇe kṛte trayāṇāmakārāṇām ``ato guṇe (pāosūo6-1-97) iti pararūpe ca siddhaṃ rūpam `upasarajāḥ' `mandurajaḥ' iti, tatkiṃ ṭilopārthena ḍitkaraṇena? strīgavīṣu puṃgavānāṃ garbhādhānāya prathamamupasaraṇamupasaraḥ| ``prajanesartteḥ (pāosūo3-3-71) ityappratyayo ghaño'pavādaḥ| prajanaḥ syādupasaraḥ (aokoo 3-2-25) iti saṅkīrṇavarge'maraḥ. prajāyate'sminprajanaḥ paśūnāṃ garbhagrahamakāla iti kṣīrasvāmī| apasare jāta upasarajaḥ, mandurāyāṃ jāto mandurajaḥ ``ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñāchandasorbahulam (pāosūo6-3-63) iti hrasvaḥ| ``vājiśālā tu mandurā (aokoo2-2-7) ityamaraḥ. na ca ḍakāraḥ śravaṇārtho'stviti vācyam ``prāvṛṭśaratkāladivāṃ je (pāosūo6-3-15) itika kṛtaṭilopanirddesālliṅgāt| nanu nedaṃ liṅgaṃ ``jai kṣaye (bhvāopao) ityasya kapratyayāntasya `ja' iti nirddesopapatteḥ| kathaṃ tarhi karmaṇyupapade vihita ātaḥ kaḥ `prāvṛṣijaḥ' ityādau syāditi cet? `dvipaḥ' `pādapaḥ' ityādisiddhaye ``supi syaḥ (pāosūo3-2-4) ityatra supīti yogavibhāgābhyupagamāt| satyam, ḍakārasya śravaṇārthatve itsaṃjñāsāskṣatraṃ bādhyeta| na ca prayojanābhāvaḥ, ṭilopārthatvāt| na ca guṇenānyathāsiddhiḥ, tadabhāvasyāpi jñāpyatvāt| niṣādasthapatyadhikaraṇanyāyena (jaionyāo6-1-13) phalamukhagauravasyādoṣatvāt, ḍakārasya śravaṇārthatābhyupagame ``siddhaṃ tu nityaśabdatvātkimarthaṃ śāstramiti cennivarttakatvātsiddham iti vṛddhisūtrasthavārtikavirodhācca| nanvasati ḍittve rūpaṃ na sidhyati, nakārastāne guṇasyāpi sānunāsikasya prasaṅgāt| na ca niranunāsikena pratyayākāreṇa saha pararūpācchuddho bhaviṣyatīti vācyam, pararūpavidhāne'pi guṇānāmabhedakatayā paryāyeṇa sānunāsi kaprasakterdurvāratvāditi| maivam, ``maivam, ``eṅi paraḥ itīyatā siddherūpagrahaṇādadhikādyannād guṇavivakṣopapatteḥ| tasya hyotadevaphalam--yādṛśaṃ parasya rūpaṃ niranunāsitatvādyupetaṃ tādṛgeva yathā syāditi| tasmājjanerḍavacanaṃ jñāpakaṃ na vyañjanasya guṇo bhavatīti| evañca ``iggrahaṇamātsandhyakṣaravyañjananivṛttyartham iti vārttikamasaṅgatamiti prāpte bhagavān bāṣyakāra itthaṃ siddāntamāha--uktarītyā jñāpakenaivātsandhyakṣarāṇāṃ nirāse'pi vyañjananivṛtyarthaṃ sūtraṃ karttavyameva| yattuktaṃ janerkaḍavacanaṃ jñāpakamiti| tanna, gamerapi hyayaṃ ḍo vaktavyaḥ| gameśca guṇe kriyamāṇe āntaryata okāraḥ syāt| tataśca `nagāḥ' `agaḥ' `abyudgaḥ' `samudgaḥ' ityādi na sidhyet| tataśca tatra caritārthaṃ ḍittvaṃ kathaṃ vyañjanasya guṇābhāvaṃ jñāpayediti| nanu ``janarḍaḥ (pāosūo3-2-97) ityeva ḍapratyayo gamerna vidhīyate kiṃ tu ``gamaśca (pāosūo 3-2-47) ``antātyantādhvadūrapāra (pāosūo3-2-48) iti prakāraṇe paṭhitena ``anyatrāpi dṛśyate (kāovāo) iti vārttikena kaḍapratyayāntarameva| tathāca kathaṃ bāṣyakṛtoktaṃ ``gamerapyayaṃ ḍaḥ iti? satyam, ``saptamyāṃ janerḍa (pāosūo3-2-97) iti prakaraṇe tāvad ``anyeṣvapi dṛśyate (pāosūo3-2-101) iti sūtreṇa ḍo vidhīyate iti nirvivādam| tatra cānyeṣvapyupapadeṣu janerḍo dṛśyate ityakṣarārthaḥ| tena `ajaḥ' `dvijaḥ' `anujaḥ' ityādi siddham| evamapi dhātvantarāḍḍavidāyakābhāvāt `paritaḥ khātā parikhā' ityādi na siddhyedityāśaṅkya tatra vārttikakṛtoktam ``anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate(kāovāo) iti| ayaṃ ca sautradṛśyapigrahaṇasūcita evārtho vārttikena vivṛto na tvapūrvaḥ saṃgṛhītaḥ| tathāca tatra vṛttikāra āha--``āpiśabdaḥ sarvopādhivyabhicārārthaḥ. tena dhātvantarādapi bhavati---paritaḥ khātā parikheti| dṛśigrahaṇātkārakāntare kālāntare ca ityādi tatraiva spaṣṭam| evaṃ sthite sautreṇaivānena `parikhā' ityāderiva `nagaḥ' `aga' ityāderapi siddhau iti vārttikaṃ na karttavyameva| kriyamāṇaṃ vā etasūttrasiddhārthaṃvivaraṇaparatayā neyamityāśayena bhagavatoktam--``gamerapi hyayaṃ ḍo vaktavyaḥ iti| nanvevamapi ḍittvaṃ vyarthaseva, gamervivaiva siddhe ``gamerḍoḥ iti ḍopratyayāvidhānena makārasya guṇa okāro na bhavatīti jñāpitatvāt| tasmāḍḍupratyayasya ḍittvaṃ pūrvoktarītyā jñāpakameva| kiñca, ḍopratyayavidhānameva vyañjanasyaguṇa iti jñāpayati| anyathā vicaiva siddhau kiṃ teneti cet? na, vicihi sati guṇaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ sānunāsika okāraḥ syāditi niranunāsikasiddhaye ḍopratyayavidhānāditi dik|
atra vadanti--``tenoterḍauḥ sanvacca iti ḍitkaraṇānna vyañjanasya guṇo bhaviṣyati| yattu sāstrātideso'yaṃ kāryātideśo vā? ādye `ūrṇunaviṣati' ityatreva ``dvirvacane 'ci (pāosūo 1-1-59) iti sthānivadbhāvena `tam̐tam̐ au' iti sthite ``sanyataḥ (pāosūo7-4-79) itikāraḥ sānunāsikaḥ syāt| dvitīye tvabhyāsakāryaṃ durlabhāmiti| tanna, ādye guṇānāṃ bedakatvād `imau' `ime' iti vadupapatteḥ. dvitīye'pi `babhruḥ' `juhūḥ' ityādyarthaṃ dātvadhikārīyadvitve 'bhyāsasaṃjñāsvīkārāt| ata eva ``liṭidhātoḥ(pāosūo6-1-8) iti sūtre ``dhātugrahaṇaṃ tiṣṭhatutāvatsāṃnyāsikam iti bhāṣyam| ``ādeca (pāosūo6-1-45) iti sūtre dhātugrahaṇānuvṛtterāpātato bhāṣye pradarśitatve'pi ṣyaṅvidhibhāṣye'nanuvṛttereva siddhāntitatayā bhāṣyāśayasyetthameva varṇanīyatvāditi dik|
kiñca, yathā stānentaratamaparibāṣāsaṃskṛtāvanunāsikaparasavarṇavidhī sthānaprayatnābyāmantaratama `etanmurāriḥ' `tvaṃ karoṣi' ityādikaṃ viṣayaṃ labdhvā caritārthau `caturmukhaḥ' `kuṇḍaṃ rathena' ityādau na pravarttete iti hayavaraṭsūtre siddāntitam, tathehāpi sārvadhātuke jusi guṇaḥ sici vṛddhyādayaḥ `netā' `abibhayuḥ' `anaiṣīt' ityādau caritārthāḥ `umbhitā' `anenijuḥ' `abhaitsīt' ityādiṣu na bhaviṣyanti| na caivaṃ `netā' `anaiṣīt' ityādāveva sthānaguṇapramāṇaistribhirāntaryalābhāt `cetā' `acaiṣīt' ityādau pramāṇāntaryaviraheṇa guṇavṛddhī na syātāmiti vācyam ``sṛghasyadaḥ kmarac (pāosūo3-2-160) iti kmaracaḥ knośca kitkaraṇena pramāṇata āntaryasyāvivakṣāyā jñāpanāt| nacaivamapi `īhitā' `īśitā' ityatra kaṇṭhyatālavyayorvivṛtayośca hakāraśakārayostādṛśāvevādetau syātāmiti vācyam, ``nājjhalau (pāosūo1-1-10) iti sūtrasya pratyākhyānāvasare ūṣmaṇāmīṣadvivṛtatāyāḥ siddhāntayiṣyamāṇatvāt| na caivaṃ vivṛtakaraṇāḥka svarāstebhya eo vivṛtatarāvityādi śikṣā'nurodhāt `cetā' `netā' ityādāvapi guṇāpravṛttiḥ syādvivṛtavivṛtataratvakṛtavailakṣarāyasattvāditi vācyam, tathāsati vidhernirviṣayatāpatteḥ,``jayaḥ karaṇam(pāosūo6-1-202) ityādinirdeśaiḥ knasunkmaracprabhṛtīnāṃ kittvena cekārādiṣu guṇapravṛttyanumānācca| ātsandhyakṣaravyañjaneṣu tu guṇādyapravṛttirevocitā| tathāca nirdeśāḥ ``yātivātidrātipsāti (pāosūoeo8-4-17) ``dhyāyateḥ samprasāraṇaṃ ca(kāovāo) ``vahaticinotidegdhiṣu ca (pāosūoeo 8-4-17) ityādi| atha knoḥ kittvenāpiguṇavṛddhividhāvantaratamaparibhāṣā'nupasthitireva jñāpyatāmiti cet? na, satyāmapīkparibhāṣāyāmīkārasyākārādinivṛttaye'ntaratamaparibhāṣāyā āvaśyakatvāditi| tadevaṃ ḍaorḍittvādanāntaryānnirdeśācca nirākṛtaṃ vyañjanaṃ bhāṣya evaica ākāraśca nirākṛtaḥ. tasmādvyarthaṃ sūtramidam|
atha yadyuttarārthatā, vibhajya yogaṃ kimiti paribhāṣātvamiṣyate?
atrocyate, ``kṅiti ca (pāosūo1-1-5) iti sūtre cakārasya itiśabdaparyāyatāmāśrityeka iti ye guṇavṛddhī tayorniṣedha iti tāvadvakṣyate| anyathā `laugavāyanaḥ' ityatra orguṇopi niṣidhyate| aupagavādistu tasyāvakāśaḥ. tathā `paurohityam' ityatrādivṛddhiśca na syāt| evaṃ sthite yadīyaṃ paribhāṣā pratyākhyāyate tadā kathañcittatratatra guṇavṛddhividāvikāmeva stānitvaparyavasāne'pīka iti padānuccāraṇeneglakṣaṇatvavirahānniṣedho na pravartteta| tataśca `kṛtaḥ' `kṛtavān' `kurutaḥ'`chinnaṃ' `chinnavān' ityādi na sidhyet| niṣedhasūtraṃ ca nirviṣayaṃ syāt paribāṣāparityāgapakṣe iglakṣaṇayorguṇavṛddhyoraprasiddhatvāt| tadetatsphuṭīkṛtaṃ bhāṣyakṛtā--``uttarārthameva tarhi sijarthaṃ vṛddigrahaṇam iti| tasya hyayamāśayaḥ--yadyapi ``sici vṛddhiḥ (pāosūo7-2-1) iti vidhau vakṣyamāṇarītyā pariśeṣādikāmeva sthānitvaṃ labhyate| tathāpīglakṣamatvaṃ vinā niṣedho na pravartteta| tasmāduttarārthaṃ niṣedhapravṛtyarthaṃ ca vṛddigrahaṇamiti| evañca vadatā nyāyasāmyād guṇagrahamasyāpyetadeva prayojanaṃ sūcitam| kathaṃ punarguṇavṛddhividhau sarvatra paribāṣāvyatirekeṇekaḥ sthānitvaparyavasānaṃ yena niṣedārthatā varṇyate iti cet? śṛṇu, ``sārvadhātukārddhadhātukayoḥ(pāosūo7-3-84) ``jusi ca (pāosūo7-3-83) iti guṇau tāvadalontyaparibhāṣayāṅgāntye'li prāptau prāguktajñāpakādibhirātsandhyakṣaravyañaajanebhyo vyāvarttitāvikṣveva viśrāmyataḥ| midi pugantalaghūpadādiguṇeṣu tu sthānī nirdiṣṭa eva| tathāhi, ``midegurṇaḥ (pāosūo7-3-82) ityatra mida irmidistasya miderityarthaḥ, pukyantaḥ pagantaḥ laghvī upadhā ladūpadā pugantaśca ************************samāhāradvandvāt ṣaṣṭhī na caivaṃ `yāpayati' ityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ, sannipātalakṣamaparibhāṣayā''dantalakṣamasya puko guṇāpravarttakatvāt| ``ṛcchatyṝtām (pāosūo7-4-11) ityatrāpi dvayorṛtordīrghasya ceti trayāṇāṃ praśliṣṭanirddeśaḥ| tadyathā--ā ca ṛcca ṛtaḥ ṛcchaterā ṛcchatyā, sa ca ṛtaśca teṣā miti ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣadvandvobhayagarbho dvandvaḥ ṛcchatyā ca ā ca ṛtaśceti tripadadvandvo vā| tena ṛcchatyṛkārasya stānitvaṃ labhyate| vastutastu caturṇāmiha praśleṣā bodhyāḥ tena `ārivān sarvabharuṇānyāruṣi' ityādāvartteḥ kvasau guṇaḥ siddhaḥ punarvidhātasāmarthyāt| anyathā kvasoḥ kitkaraṇasāmarthyāt `titīrvān' ityatreva guṇo niṣidhyeta| etacca ``kvasuśca (pāosūo7-4-16) ityatrāpyuraṅi guṇa iti yogo vibhajyate| tato dṛśaḥ| urityādyanuvarttate| ``sthūladūra (pāosūo6-4-156) iti sūtre'pi yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ `sthūladūrayuvahasvānāṃ yaṇādiparam' ityeko yogaḥ, `kṣiprakṣudrayoḥ pūrvasyaca guṇaḥ' iti yogāntaram| tatra `sthavīyān' ityādāvorguṇena siddham| ābhīyasyāsiddhatvasya ``śnasorallopaḥ (pāosūo6-4-111) iti taparakaraṇenānityatājñāpanāt bhāṣyakṛtā pratyākyānācca| yaṇa ādiryaṇādiḥ tataḥ paramiti samāsaḥ| tathāca kṣiprakṣudrayoryaṇa ādī pakāradakārau tataḥ parasya raśabdasya lopastābhyāmeva ca pūrvasyekārasyokārasya ca guṇa ityarthaḥ| taditthaṃ guṇāḥ sarve iki viśrāntāḥ| mṛjervṛddhāvapyaca ityapakṛṣyate| mṛjervṛddhiracaḥ, tato ñṇiti, aca ityeva| na caivam `amārṭ' ityatrāṭopi vṛddhiḥ syāditi vācyam lādeseṣu kṛteṣvāḍiti pakṣe paratvād vṛddhau satyāmaṭ| tatra kate punarvṛddhirna bhavati sakṛtpravṛttyā caritārthatvāt|
yadā tvasiddhavatsūtrapratyākyānāya ``lluṅ iti dvilakārakanirdeśamāśrityopadeśe ārddhadātuka ityanayoranyataradanuvarttya vā lāvastāyāmevāṭ kriyate, ``eranekācaḥ (pāosūo6-4-82) iti vibhajya `iṇoyam' ityanurvarttyānekācaścettarhīṇa eveti niyamamāśritya `addhyaiyātām' ityādau yaṇ vāryate, tadā lāvasthāyāṃ yadyapi vṛddhirna bhavati lakārāṇāṃ ṅittvena `mṛṣṭaḥ' ityādāviva tanniṣedhāt| tataścāntaraṅgatvādaḍāgama eva, tathāpi `antyābāve'ntyasadeśasya' (paobhāo104) iti paribhāṣāmāśrityāṭo vṛddhirnivartanīyā| paribhāṣāpratyākhyānapakṣe tvaṅgākṣiptena pratyayenājviśeṣyate yena nāvyavadhānanyāyācca siddham `amārṭ' ityādi rūpam| sici vṛddhāvapi vidheyāyāṃ nāstīkparibhāṣāyā upayogaḥ vyāvartyābhāvāt| na ca `acikīrṣīt' ityakāro vyāvartyaḥ ``ṇyallopāviyaṅyaṇguṇavṛddhidīrghabyaḥ pūrvavipratiṣiddham (kāovāo) iti vacanādallopenaiva siddhatvāt| anyatā `cikīrṣakaḥ' iti na syāt `cikīrṣāyaka' iti ca prasajyeta| ākārasya tu nāsti viśeṣaḥ sagiḍbhyāṃ bādhaścetyuktam| ejantamapi na sambhavati, ātvavidhānāt| `udavoḍhām' ityādau tu ḍhalopasyāsiddhatā| rainaiglauśabdānāmācārakvibantānāṃ satyāmasatyāṃ vā vṛddhau na kaścidviśeṣaḥ| gośabdātkvipi `agavīt' ityatrāpi nātiprasaṅgaḥ| ``ṛtaiddhātoḥ (pāosūo7-1-100) ityāto'nuvṛttena dhātugrahaṇena sijākṣiptasya dhātorviśeṣaṇe sati dhātureva yo dhāturna tu kathaṃcitprātipadikamiti vyākhyānāditi kaiyaṭādayaḥ|
nanvevaṃ kaveḥ akavāyīt, vidhoḥ avidhāvīt, pituḥ apitārīt, antaraṅgamapi guṇaṃ sici vṛddhirbādhata iti vadanmādhavo virudhyeta| satyam,
yadyavirodhaḥ sampādanīya ityāgrahastarhītthaṃ varṇanīyam--dhātoritivadota ityapyanuvarttete| tacca vākyabhedena sambadhyamānaṃ niyamārthaṃ sampadyate--odantasya dhātośced vṛddhistārhi dhātoreva dhātorna tu nāmadhātoriti| yadvā, ``neṭi (pāosūo7-2-4) ityatra neti yogaṃ vibhajya maṇḍūkaplutyā sambandhānuvṛttyā vā `gotaḥ' ittyanuvarttyaukārāntasya dhātorvṛddhirniṣidhyate| athavā ``bahulaṃ chandasi (pāosūo7-1-103) ityato bahulamityanuvarttya sici vṛddirnāmadhātāvigantasya bhavati na tvodantasyoti kathaṃ citsamādheyam|
vyañjaneṣvantaratamaparibālenaivānunāsikaparasavarṇayorivātiprasaṅga uddhṛta eva| abhyupetya tu brūmaḥ, nāprāptāyāṃ sici vṛddhāvārabhyamāṇā halantalakṣaṇā vṛddhirbādhikā bhaviṣyati| ``neṭi (pāosūo7-1-4) iti niṣedhastu halantasya yāvatī vṛddhiḥ prāptā ``sici vṛddhiḥ (pāosūo 7-2-1) iti vā ``halantasya (pāosūoeo7-2-3) iti vā tasyāḥ sarvasyā-, na tu sūtraviśeṣaprāpitatve āgrahaḥ| tena `akoṣīt' `amoṣīt' ityādau dvividā'pi vṛddhirniṣidhyate iti sustham| tasmānniṣedhasidvyarthamiglakṣaṇatāṃ sampādayituṃ sūtramiti sthitam|
syādetat `kṛtaḥ kṛtavān' `chinnaśchinnāvān' ityādau niṣedhasiddhaye guṇagrahaṇamastu| vṛddhigrahaṇaṃ tu vyartham| na ca `mṛṣṭo mṛṣṭavān' ityādau niṣedhasiddhistatphalaṃ, yogavibhāgena siddhatvāt| tathāhi, mṛjervūddhirityasyānantaram `ajādau kṅiti vā' ityevaṃ rūpaṃ vacanamavaśyaṃ karttavyam--`mṛjanti' ityādisiddhyartham| evaṃ sthite ajādau kṅitīti yoge vibhajyate| niyamārthaṃ cedam--kṅiti cedbhavatyajādāveveti| tena `mṛṣṭo mṛṣṭavān' ityādi siddham| tato'jādāvapi vikalpenetyetadarthaṃ `vā' iti dvitīyo yoga iti| tasmādvṛddhigrahaṇasya phalaṃ durupapādamiti| atrāhuḥ| ``ṇū stutau ``dhū vidhūnane kuṭādiṣu paṭhyete| tābhyāṃ luṅi anuvīt `adhuvīt' itīṣyate| tatra sici vṛddheḥ kṅitīti niṣedhāyeglakṣaṇatāṃ sampādayitumiha vṛddhigrahaṇamiti| nanvihāntarbhūtasijmātrāpekṣatvādantaraṅge uvaṅi kṛte halantatvāt ``neṭi (pāosūo7-1-4) iti niṣedhaḥ siddha iti cet? na, sicyantaraṅgaṃ nāstīti siddhāntāduvaṅaḥ prāgeva vṛddhiprasaṅgāt|
syādetat| ``antaraṅgaṃ balīyaḥ (pāobhāo5o) iti tāvad ``acaḥ parasmin (pāosūo1-1-57) itisūtre sthāpayiṣyate| tadaviśeṣātsicyapyastu| na caivam `ahaiṣīt' ityādau guṇaḥ syāditi vācyam, tasyaiva vṛddhisambhaveneṣṭāpatteḥ | nahīdānīṃ vidhāviggrahaṇamasti yenaikārasya vṛddhirna labhyeta| na caivamapi `astauṣīt' ityādāvantaraṅgatvād guṇe kṛte oto neti vyākhyānapakṣe vṛddhyasambhavaḥ, bahulagrahaṇādanigantānāṃ neti pakṣe tu `acaiṣīt' ityādāvapi doṣa eveti vācyam, oto dātoreva dhātorna tu nāmadhātoriti tṛtīyapakṣāśrayaṇena sarvasamādhānāt| `akārṣīt' ityādau halantalakṣaṇā vṛddhirastu| `atārīt' ityādau tvantaraṅgatvād guṇe halantalakṣaṇāyāṃ vṛddhau ``neṭi (pāosūo7-1-4) iti pratiṣiddāyām ``ato halādeḥ (pāosūo7-2-7) iti vikalpaṃ bādhitvā ``ato lrāntasya (pāosūo 7-2-2) iti nityā vṛddhiḥ| `alāvīt' ityādāvapyantaraṅgatvādguṇāvādeśayoḥ kṛtayoḥ ``ato lrāntasya (pāosūo7-2-2) ityatra ``lopo vyoḥ (pāosūo6-1-76) iti lopena vakārasyāpi vyākhyānānnityā vṛddhirbhaviṣyati-mā bhavānavīt| `amavīt' ityatrāpi tarhi nityā vṛddhiḥ syāditi cet? na, ṇiśvigrahaṇamapanīya tatsthāne avimavyoḥ prakṣepeṇa vṛddhiniṣedhāt| na hyasminpakṣe ṇiśvigrahaṇamupayujyate| `aunayīt' aśvayīt ityatrāntaraṅgatvād guṇāyādeśayoḥ kṛtayoryāntānāṃ netyeva niṣedhasiddheḥ| nanvevamaveriva maverapi nityaṃ niṣedha eva syāt, iṣyate tu vikalpaḥ| naiṣa doṣaḥ ``ato lrāntasya (pāosūo7-2-2) ityatra vakārapraśleṣeṇa yā nityā vṛddhiḥ prāptā saivehāvimavyornetyanena maverniṣidhyate na tu ``atohalādeḥ (pāosūo 7-2-7) ityeṣā'pi| ``madhyepavādāḥ pūrvānvidhīnbādhante nottarān(paobhāo6o) iti nyāyāt| na caivaṃ jāgartterapi tathā prasaṅgaḥ, tatra bādhyasāmānyacintāmāśritya svaviṣaye prāptaṃ sarvaṃ bādhyate iti svīkārāt| yadvā, apavāde niṣiddhe utsargo na pravarttate iti jāgarttāvāśrayaṇīyaṃ mavatau tu pravarttate iti bādhyasāmānyaviśeṣacintayorbādhake niṣiddhe bādhyasya pravṛttyapravṛtyośca lakṣyānurodhena vyavasthāyā anupadameva vakṣyamāṇatvāt| na caivam`agavīt' ityatrāpi nityā vṛddhiḥ syādvakārapraśle,āditi vācyam, sici vṛddherivāsyā api dhātugrahaṇena vāraṇāt| tasmātsicyantaraṅgāśrayaṇenaiva `anuvīt' `adhuvīt' ityādeḥ siddhau ``kṅiti ca (pāosūo1-1-5) iti pratiṣedhasyānapekṣaṇādvṛddhigrahaṇaṃ vyarthameveti|
ātrocyate-vakārapraśleṣe sati ``śavatirgatikarmā kambojeṣu vikāraevainamāryā bhāṣnte iti paspaśāyāṃ bhāṣyakārairabhyupagatasya śabdhātora pi nityavṛddhiprasaṅgaḥ, tasyāpi pratiṣedhe vā kathaṃka ṇiśvibhyāṃ nimānam? gauravaprasaṅgāt| kiñca, na vayaṃ vyasanitayā sicyantaraṅgaṃ nstīti brūmaḥ, kintu nyāyabalājjñāpakabalātphalānurodhācca| tathāhi, yenanāpraptinyā yenāntaraṅgaṃ vṛddhyā bādhyate `satyapi sambhave bādhanaṃ bhavati' ityabhyupagamāt| anyathā takreṇa dadhi na bādhyeta, śnamakajādibhiśica śappratyayakapratyayādayo na bādhyeran, deśabhedenobhayasambhavāt| na ca madhyepavādanyāyenovaṅeva vṛddhyā bādyate na tu guṇo'pīti vācyam| bādhyasya bhedena vivakṣāyāṃ hyetadevaṃ syāt| bādhyasya sāmānyacintāyāṃ tu svaviṣaye prāptaṃ svānapavādabhūtaṃ sarvaṃ bādhyate, yathā ``acira (pāosūo7-2-100) ityetena guṇadīrghotvāni| anyathā tatrāpi madhyepavādanyāyena repho dīrghotve eva bādhyeta na tu guṇam, tasya paratvāt bādhyasya ca kvacidbhedena cintā kvicitsāmānyarūpeṇetyubhayamapi lakṣyānurodhāttatratatrāśrīyate| ṇiśvigrahaṇaṃ cātra liṅgam| anyathāntaraṅgatvād guṇāyādeśayoḥ kṛtayoryāntanāṃ neti niṣedhādeva `aunayīt `aśvayīt' ityādeḥ siddhau kiṃ ṇiśvigrahaṇena? jñāpakāntaramapyuktaṃ bhāṣye--yañca karotyakāragrahaṇaṃ laghoriti kṛte'pīti| asyāyamāśayaḥ--``ato halādeḥ (pāosūo7-2-7) iti sūtre'dgrahaṇasya na tāvatsandhyakṣarādikaṃ vyāvartyam, laghugrahaṇenaiva vyudāsāt| idudṛtaḥ paramavaśiṣyante `acetīt ' `akoṣīt' `anartīt' iti| te'pyantaraṅgeṇa guṇenāpahṛtāścettarhi vyarthamadgrahaṇaṃ syāt| na ca `akuṭīt' `apuṭīt' ityādāvukāravyudāsāya taditi vācyam, tatrāpyantaraṅgeṇa guṇena vṛddhibādhe sati guṇe ṅittvānniṣiddhe'pi vṛddherapravṛtteḥ, na hi devadattasya hantari hate devadattasya punarunmajjanaṃ bhavatīti nyāyāt| ata eva ``nāntaḥ pādam iti pāṭhe pūrvarūpaniṣedhesatyayādayo'pi na pravarttante| tena `sujāte aśvasūnṛte, ityādi ca sidhyatīti svīkṛtaṃ bhāṣye| na caivamapavādābhāve punarutsargasya sthitiriti nirviṣayaṃ syād `vṛkṣau' ityādau ``nādici (pāosūo6-104) iti pūrvasavarṇe niṣiddhe vṛddhiśca na pravartteteti vācyam ``bhidyoddhyau nade(pāosūo3-1-115) ``tau sat (pāosūo 3-2-127) ityādi liṅgenāpavāde niṣiddhe utsargo'pi na pravarttate ityasyāsārvatrikatvābhyupagamāt| tadetattatratatrocyate---``notsahate pratiṣiddhā satī bādhitam iti| tathāca pakṣabhedāśra yeṇa ``ato halādeḥ (pāosūo7-2-7) ityadgrahaṇamapi jñāpakamiti sthitam|
phalamapyasti| yadi hi sicyantaraṅgaṃ syāttarhi cinīprabhṛtibhyo yaṅlugantebhyaḥ ciriṇotijiriṇotibhyāṃ ca luṅi sici `acecāyīt' anenāyīt' `acirāyīt' `ajirāyīt' iti na syāt, guṇāyādeśayoḥ kṛtayoryāntānāṃ neti pratiṣedhaprasaṅgāt| yadi tu bādhyaviśeṣacintāyāṃ madhyepavādanyāyamāśritya uvaṅeva bādhyate na tu guṇa ityāśrīyate tadāpyetanna siddhyedeva| tasmātsici sarvamapyaṃtaraṅgaṃ nāstyeveti siddhāntaṃ sādhayituṃ bādhyasāmānyacintaivāśrayaṇīyā| etadarthameva hi bhāṣye jñāpakopanyāsaḥ kṛtaḥ| anyathā nyāyenaiva siddhe'ntaraṅgasyāpi bādhe kiṃ jñāpakavarṇanena? evaṃ sthite `nyanuvīt' `nyadhuvīt' ityatra ``kṅitica (pāosūo 1-1-5) iti niṣedha evāśrayaṇīyastathā ceglakṣaṇatvasiddhaye vṛddhigrahaṇamapīha karttavyameveti sthitam| evañca satyasambhavādapi vṛddhyā sicyantaraṅgaṃ sarvaṃ bādhyate| yadi hisyāttarhi kvāpi sicīgantamaṅgaṃ na labhyete tyavadheyam| tathā ceglakṣaṇatvasya niṣedhapravṛttyarthamāvaśyakatve sthite tatra tatrātsandhyakṣaravyañjanādivyāvṛttirapīkparibhāṣayaiva sidhyatīti jñāpakavarṇanādikleśo'pi nāśrayaṇīyaḥ| na caivaṃ `dyauḥ' `panthāḥ' `imam' itāyādāvapīkpadopasthitivaśādikāmevautvamātvamatvaṃ ca syāditi vācyam, guṇavṛddiśabdayoranuvṛttau punarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇasāmarthyāddhi śabdavyāpāro'pyāśrīyate, guṇavṛddhī ye guṇavṛddhī na tu śabdāntareṇa vihite ityanuvṛttābhyāṃ viśeṣaṇādvā| nanu ``acaśca (pāosūo1-2-28) ``iti sūtre hrasvādigrahaṇānuvṛttyā saṃjñayā vidhāne padopasthitiriti sthāsyati tatsāmarthyād ``diva aut (pāosūo7-1-84) ``pathimadhyṛbhukṣāmāt (pāosūo7-1-85) ``tyadādīnāmaḥ (pāosū7-2-1-2) ityatrekpadopa syānaṃ na bhaviṣyati| yadi hi syāttarhi ``acaśca (pāosūo 1-2-27) ityatra saṃjñayā vidhāne'ti yatnāśrayaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ syāditi cet? na, ``divaut (pāosūo 6-1-131) ityādiṣvaguṇavṛddhisaṃjñakeṣvacparībhāṣānivarttanena caritārthatvāt ``aṣṭana ā vibhaktau (pāosūo7-2-84) ityādāviko'sambhavena tatra caritārthatvācca| tasmāt `dyauḥ' `panthāḥ' `imam' ityādisiddhaye ihāpi saṃjñāvidhāne niyamaṃ saṃpādayituṃ punarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇamiti prāñcaḥ| nanu `panthāḥ' ityanudāharaṇam ``ito't(pāosūo7-2-84) ityādāviko'sambhavena tatra caritārthatvācca| tasmāt `dyauḥ' `panthāḥ' `imam' ityādisiddhaye ihāpi saṃjñāvidhāne niyamaṃ saṃpādayituṃ punarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇamiti prāñjaḥ| nanu `panthāḥ' ityanudāharaṇam ``ito't (pāosūo7-1-86) iti siddhe ādvidhisāmarthyādevekpadasyānupasthiteriti cet? na, ṛbukṣiṛkārokārayorarthe ādvidhisambhavāt| na cekaḥ soścānantaryavivakṣaṇādyenanāvyavadhānāśrayaṇācca naivamiti vācyam, tathāpi sambuddhyarthatayā sāmarthyopakṣayāt| na caivam `ita āt' ityeva brūyāditi vācyam, ṛbhukṣaṇamindramityasyāsiddhyapatteḥ| ādvidhau hi ``vā ṣapūrvasya (pāosūo6-4-9) iti tatsiddhiriti dik|
yattu bhāṣye `saḥ' `imam' ityudāhṛtaṃ, tatra ``sa imaṃ mantramapaśyat iti bāhmaṇa vākyaikadeśānukaraṇamātram| udāharaṇaṃ tu `imam' ityeva na tu `suḥ' ityapi, tacchadve iko'sambhavena ``ikaḥ (pāosūo 1-1-3) iti niyamasyāpravṛtterityāhuḥ.
vastutastu sa ityapyudāharaṇaṃ sādhveva| ``tyadādīnāmaḥ (pāosūo7-21-2) iti vidhivākyam| tatra ceka ityasyopasthitau dvīdamorevātvaṃ syānna tvanyeṣām| gaṇaena nirddeśastu saṃjñopasarjanavyāvṛttyarthamuttarārtha ca syāt| ``tadoḥ saḥ sau (pāosūo 7-2-106) iti satvaṃhi tyadādīnāmeva tadorvidhīyate|
atredamavadheyam, śabdavyāpārāśrayaṇānurodhenāpi guṇavṛddhigrahaṇaṃ māstu, ikastāvityetāvataiva siddhaḥ| vastutastu tāvityapi vyartham| ika ityeva sūtryatām| sampūrṇaṃ pūrvasūtradvayamanuvartya vṛddhirityādataicau yatra vidhīyete, guṇa iti cādeṅau, tatreka ityupatiṣṭhate iti vyākhyānāt| vyākhyāne liṅgaṃ tu ``ito't (pāosūo7-1-86) itīdgrahaṇam| anyathā tatrāpīkpadopasthitāvuktarītyā yenanāvyavadhānanyāyādṛkārokāravyāvṛttau ca satyāṃ kiṃ teneti| tadetad ``iggrahaṇaṃ kimartham iti bhāṣyeṇa ``igghahaṇamātsandhyakṣara ityādivārttikena ca sūcyate| anyathā hi sūtraṃ kimarthamityādyeva brūyāt| yattūttarārthaṃ guṇavṛddhigrahaṇaṃ karttavyamevetyāśayeneggrahaṇamityuktamiti bhāṣyābhiprāyavarṇanam, tanna, pūrvasūtrānuvṛttyaiva siddhāvuttarārthatvasyāpi durupapādatvāt, samudāyāpekṣāyāṃ maṇḍūkapluteḥ sambandhānuvṛttervātvayāpi vācyatvāt, iggrahaṇasyāpyuttarārthatayā tadaṃśe'pi śaṅkānuttānācca| ika iti yogaḥ kimarthaṃ vibhajyate iti praśnabījamiti cettarhi guṇavṛddhyaṃśe'pi tasyāviśiṣṭatayā sūtraṃ kimarthamityeva brūyāditi dik|
yattu pradhānāvayavadvārā samudāyākṣepo'yamiti, tadapi nātīva śabdasvarasānuguṇam| tasmādukta evāśayaḥ sādhuḥ| na caivaṃ ``guṇavṛddhyadhikāre punarguṇavṛddigrahaṇasāmarthyād ityuttaragranthāsaṅgatiḥ, tasya yathāśrutābhiprāyakatvāt| grahaṇapadasyānuvṛttiparatayā sampūrṇasūtradvayānuvṛttiparatayāsampūrṇasūtradvayāvṛttisāmarthyaparatvādveti dik| evaṃ ceka iti yogavibāga eva pūrvapakṣasiddāntābhyāṃ samarthyate itīha paryavāsito'rthaḥ| tataścānenaikena yogavibhāgena sakaleṣṭasiddhau `mṛjervṛddhiracaḥ' `uraṅi guṇaḥ' ityādi bahutarayogavibhāgādyāśrayaṇenānyathāsiddhivarṇanaṃ nādarttavyamiti sthitam|
iyaṃ ca paribhāṣā'lontyaparibhāṣayāḥ śeṣo vā śeṣibhṛtā vā tayā saha samuccitā vā vaikalpikī vā tadapavādo vā pūrvavipratiṣedhāttadvādhikā vā padopasthāpikā veti saptadapakṣāḥ sambhavyante yadyapi, tathāpyādyānāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ duṣṭatvātsaptama eva siddhāntitaḥ| tathāhi, ``sārvadhātukārddhgadātukayoḥ (pāosūo7-3-84) ityatra svasvanimittavasātparibhāṣādvayaṃ sannihitam| tatrāṅgasyeti ṣaṣṭhī yadi pūrvamevāntyamalaṃ nītā aṅgāntyasya guṇa iti, paścādikā'ntyo viśeṣyate, tadekparibhāṣā śeṣabhūtā| yadi tu pūrvamikā'ṅgasya viśeṣaṇāttadantavidhirigantasyāṅgasyeti, tataḥ sa ca bhavannalontyasyeti, tadā dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ| tadidaṃ pakṣadvayamapi ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaṃ bahuvrīhiṃ cāśritya `taccheṣapakṣa' iti bhāṣye vyavahṛtam| iha pakṣadveye'pi ``miderguṇaḥ (pāosūo7-3-82) ityādau doṣaḥ| yo hi miderantyaḥ nāsāvik, yaścek nāsāvantyaḥ| tathā cāvaśyamparibhāṣāyāṃ tyaktāyāṃ satyāṃ vinigamakābhāvādubhayatyāge sarvādeśo guṇaḥ syāt| taduktaṃ vārttikakṛtā--``vṛddhiguṇāvalontyasyeti cenmidimṛjipugantalaghūpadharcchidṛśikṣiprakṣudreṣviggrahaṇaṃ sarvādeśaprasaṅgaścānigantasya iti| cakāro hetvarthaḥ| tataśca sarvādeśaprasaṅgo hīti phalitam|
atha mida irmidiḥ tasya miderityādipūrvoktarītyā kathaṃ cidiha sarvatreka eva sthānitvaṃ labhyeta, tathāpi `bhinnam' ityādāvaniglakṣaṇatvād guṇaniṣedho na syāt| atha knoḥ kittvājjñāpakādaniglakṣaṇatve|़pi niṣedhastarhi `laigavāyanaḥ' `paurohityam' ityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ
atha lakṣyānurodhāllaghūpadhaguṇamātrāviṣayakaṃ jñāpakaṃ tarhi padopasthitipakṣa eva lakṣyasiddhaye samāśrīyatām| evaṃ hi jñāpakāśrayaṇakleśo'pi na bhavati| kittavenāpi padopasthitireva jñāpyatām| evaṃ hi jñāpakamūlakaṃ vākyāntaraṃ na kalpyamiti lāghavam|
astu tarhi tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ--miderantyasyekaśca dvayorapi guṇa iti| maivam, sthāneyogāvayavasambandharūpasyārthadvayasya yugapaduccāritayā ṣaṣṭhyā durlabhatvāt| sthāneyogaṃ ca vinā'lontyavidhyalābhāt| syānaṣaṣṭhī hi tadupasthitau lihgamiti vakṣyate| ika ityanena sahāvayavaṣaṣṭhīṃ vinā'nvayāyogāt āvṛttyādau pramāṇābhāvācca|
etena miderantyasya veko veti caturthapakṣopi pratyuktaḥ, vikalpasyāṣṭhadoṣagrastattvācca|
astu tarhi tadapavāda iti pañcamaḥ pakṣaḥ| tathāhi, guṇavidāvaṅgasyeti na sthānaṣaṣṭhī| kintu igapekṣayā'vayavaṣaṣṭhī| tataśca liṅgābhāvādalontyaparibhāṣāyā anupasthitiḥ| ayameva ca bādapadārthaḥ| yadīkparibhāṣā na bhavettarhi sthānaṣaṣṭhītvaṃ tanmūlakālontyaparibhāṣopasthitiśca syāt| satyāntvikparibhāṣāyāṃ tadubhayaṃ netyetāvataivāpavādatvavyavahāraḥ| na hi vastuto vacanena prāpitasya bādhaḥ sambhavati śāstrāprāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt| ata eva śāstratātparyasaṅkoco bādha ityāhuḥ| etena dvandvāpavāda ekaśeṣa ityapi vyākhyātam| natdyanutpannāyāṃ vibhaktau dvandvasya prasaṅgaḥ, kintu yadyekaśeṣo na bhavettarhi pratyekaṃ vibhaktirdvandvaśca syātsati tvekaśeṣe tannetyeva tattvam| asmiṃśca pakṣe jusi guṇo `ajuhavuḥ' ityatreva `anenijuḥ' `paryaveviṣuḥ' ityādāvapi syāt| ``sārvadhātukārddhadhātukayoḥ (pāosūo7-3-84) iti guṇo `bhavati' ityādāviva `ihitā' ityatrāpi syāt| tathā ca vārttikam--``iṅmātrasyeti cejjusi sārvadātukārdhadhātukahrasvādyorguṇeṣvanantyapratiṣedhaḥ (kāovāo) iti| atra hrasvādīti ``hrasvasya guṇaḥ (pāosūo7-3-108) ``jusi ca (pāosūo 7-3-109) ``ṛto'ṅi sarvanāmastānayoḥ (pāosūo7-3-110) ``gherṅiti (pāosūo7-3-111) iti guṇacatuṣṭayaṃ gṛhyate| tataśca `he agne' `agnayaḥ' `karttari' `agnaye' `bābhravyaḥ' ityatra yathā orguṇāntaṃ guṇapañcakaṃ bhavati, evaṃ `he agnicit' `agnicitaḥ santi' `sukṛti' `agnicite' `sauśrutaḥ' ityatrāpi syāditi vārttikārtaḥ| yadyapīha nirddiṣṭasthānikatvātparibhāṣā durlabhā| agnicicchabdasya ghisaṃjñābhāvācca ``gherṅiti (pāosūo7-3-111) ityetanna prāpnoti, tathāpi vārttikasyoktisambhavamitthaṃ varṇayanti--``hasvasya guṇaḥ (pāosūo7-3-108)``jasi ca (pāosūo 7-6-109) iti sū6yostāvaddhrasvenegvaliśeṣyate| dīrghavyāvṛttiśca phalam| athāniyame niyamakāriṇī paribhāṣā kathamihopatiṣṭhatāma? na hi isvasya sthānitve'tiprasaṅgo'sti, akārasya hyakāra eva guṇo bhaviṣyatīti brūyāt| takṣatredaṃ vaktavyam| hrasvāntasyāṅgasyeko guṇa iti sūtrārthaḥ syāt| tataśca `he upago' ityādāvanantyasyāpi syāt, `agnicit' ityādikaṃ tu viśeṣaṇavyavacchedyaṃ syāt| tathā ca hrasvasyeka ityanayorna parasparaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ| kintvanayorekamaṅgasya viśeṣaṇamaparamaṅgasya viśeṣyamiti| yadvā, hrasvasyetyetadaṅgasya viśeṣaṇaṃ mā bhūdityaṅgasya stānaṣaṣṭhītvaṃ bādhitumanantyasyāpi guṇaṃ sampādayitumikparibhāṣopatiṣṭheta| evam ``ṛtaḥ (pāosūo7-3-110) ``auḥ (pāosūo6-4-146) ityubhayatrāpyanantyasya guṇavidhānārthaṃ paribhāṣā syādeva| ghisaṃjñā tu varṇayoreva na tu tadantasyeti pakṣaṃ gṛhītvā ``gherṅiti (pāosūo7-3-111) ityasya ``agnicitaḥ ityādāvatiprasaṅgo yojyaḥ| nahyasminpakṣe ṛta orityābhyāṃ gheḥ kiñaacidvailakṣaṇayamastīti dik|
nanvasminpakṣe ``puganta (pāosūo7-3-86) iti sūtrasyu niyamārthatvād `īhitā' ityādau na doṣa iti cet? na, yadi hi sārvadātukārddhadhātukayorlaghūpadhasyaiveti niyamastarhi hrasvādyorguṇe doṣastadavasthaḥ| yadi tu laghūpadhasya sārvadhātukārddhadhātukayoreveti niyamastathāpi `īhitā' ityādau doṣa eva| athāvṛttyā dvividho'pi niyamastarhi `anenijuḥ' ityatra doṣaḥ| na hyetanniyamadvayenāpi vārayituṃ śakyaṃ, laghūpadhatvātsārvadātukaparatvācca| `he buddhe' `buddhayaḥ' `picave hitaḥ picavyaḥ' ``ugavādibhyo yat (pāosūo5-1-2) `buddhaye' `vṛddhaye' ityādāvanupadhābhūteṣvatiprasahgastu durvāra eveti tāvadvārttikahṛdayam|
vastutastvaṅgākṣiptena pratyayena śrūyamāṇena ca jusādinā iko viśeṣaṇātsakaladoṣanirāse sati tadapavādapakṣo'pi samarthayituṃ śakyate eva| aṅgameva pratyayena viśeṣyate iti gṛhītvā paraṃ bhāṣyavarttikagranthapravṛttirityavadheyam|
astu tarhi pūrvavipratiṣedha iti kroṣṭrīyasammataḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ pakṣa iti cet? na, ikparibhāṣāyā niravakāśatvāt| na hi parasparaparihāreṇāvakāśalābhe'sati vipratiṣedhaḥ| tasmādyadi `satyapi sambhaṣe bādhanaṃ bhavati' ityāśrīyate tarhi yenanāprāptinyāyādapavādatvamastyeva| yadi tu ``asambhave bādhyabādhakabhāva asti ceha sambhavo yadubhayaṃ syādityāśrīyate tarhi taccheṣādiṣvanyatamaparyavasānaṃ na tu kroṣṭrīyamatasyāvakāśa iti sthitam|
tasmātpadopasthāpanamiti saptamaḥ pakṣaḥ siddhāntasammataḥ| tathāhi, ika iti ṣaṣṭhyantānukaraṇam, na tu saṃjñiparam, ``svarūṃpam (pāosūo 1-1-68) iti vacanāt| na ca ``aśabdasaṃjñā (pāosūoeo1-1-68) iti niṣedhaḥ, ṣaṣṭhyantasyāsaṃjñātvāt| tadayamartha--yatra brūyādguṇo bhavati vṛddhirbhavatīti, tatreka iti ṣaṣṭhyantamupatiṣṭhate iti| tasya ca padaikavākyatayā'nvayo'nvayo'ntaraṅgo'lontyaparibhāṣā tu vidhivākyeṣvavāntaravākyārthaṃ budhvā tadekavākyatayā sambadhyate iti tadanvayo bahiraṅgaḥ| tataśca ``jusica (pāosūo 7-3-83) ityādāviko'ṅgasyeti sambhavati sāmānādhikaraṇye vaiyadhikaraṇyasyānyāyyattvādikā'ṅge viśeṣite sthā naṣaṣṭhī na vihiteti bhavatyevā'lontyaparibhāṣopasthitiḥ| ``miderguṇaḥ (pāosūo7-3-82) ityādau tu sāmānādhikaraṇyānvayasyāsambhavānmiderika iti vaiyadhikaraṇyenānvaye sati sthānaṣaṣṭhīvirahādalontyaparibhāṣānopatiṣṭhate| na ca mideraṅgasyetyanayoravayavaṣaṣṭhītvepīka iti sthānaṣa ṣṭhyastyeveti vācyam, na hyeṣā'lontyaparibhāṣopasthitāvupayujyate, alsamudāyātmakasthāninaḥ parabhūtāyā eva ṣaṣṭhyāstadupastāpakatvāt, ikaścālrupatvāt| tathā cālontyaparibhāṣā ikparibhāṣānantaropasthitikā na tu tayā saha yugapadupatiṣṭhate yenāviseṣādubhayornivṛttiḥ syāditi sakaleṣṭasiddhiḥ| taccheṣatadapavādapakṣayorapi dūṣaṇamuddharttuṃ śakyamityuktameva|
tadiha saptapakṣīmadhye pakṣatrayaṃ duṣṭameva| pakṣacatuṣṭayantu sādhviti sthitam|
nanvetatsūtram ``aṅgasya (pāosūo6-4-1) ityādivadadhikārārthameva kiṃ na syāditi cet? evaṃ hi satīkoguṇavṛddhī neti natrā saṃyujyaiva paṭhet| ``sarvasya dve (pāosūo8-1-1) ``pūrvatrāsiddham (pāosūo8-2-1) ityādivat| na ddyuttarasūtropasthitikatvāviśeṣe kiṃcitsaṃyujya kiṃcittu vibhajya paṭhitumucitam, vairūpye hetvabhāvāt| ``pratyayaḥ (pāosūo3-1-1) ``paraśca (pāosūo3-1-2) ityādau tu pārārthyāviśeṣe'pyasaṃyujya nirddeśo vidheyabhedānna virudhyate| nāpīdaṃ vidhisūtram, punarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇasāmarthyāt, tatpratyākhyānapakṣe'pi viśiṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyāditi dik|
|| iti śrīśabdakaustubhe prathamasyādhyāyasya prathame pāde
tṛtacīyamāhnikam ||
na dhātulopa ārddhadhātuke (pāosūo1-1-4)|
dhātvaṃśalopanimitte ārddhadhātuke pare tannimittike guṇavṛddhī iko na staḥ| `loluvaḥ' `popuvaḥ' `marīmṛkajaḥ'| lolūyādibyo yaṅantebhyaḥ pacādyaci kṛte ``yaṅo'ci ca(pāosūo2-4-74) iti yaṅluki luṅnimittabhūtamacamevāśritya prāpte guṇavṛddhī niṣidhyate| yadyapi kṛtsnasya dhātorapi kvacillopo'sti| tadyathā, ``durīṇo lopaśca(pāosūo 1-2-187) duḥśabde upapade iṇo dhāto rak pratyayo bhavati dhātośca lopaḥ, duḥkhena īyate prāpyate dūrāmiti; tathāpyevaṃvidhe viṣaye guṇavṛddhyoḥka prāptivirahānniṣedhavaiyarthyam| ato'tra dātuśabdena tadekadeśo lakṣyate|
dhātulopa iti ca yadi ṣaṣṭhītatpūruṣaḥ syāttadārddhadhātukagrahaṇaṃ lopaviśeṣaṇaṃ vā guṇavṛddhyorviśeṣaṇaṃ vā tantrāvṛttyādibhirubhayaviśeṣaṇaṃ vetitrayaḥ kalpāḥ| tatrādye pakṣe ārddhadhātukanimittake dhātulope sati yatkiñcinnittike guṇavṛddhī na bhavata iti sūtrārthaḥ syāt| tataśca prapūrvādindheḥ ktapratyaye tannimittake nalope ca sati `preddhaḥ' ityatra prāpnuvannādguṇo'pi niṣidhyeta| yo hi dvayoḥ ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭayoḥ sthāne bhavati, labhate 'sāvanyatarato vyapadeśamitīksthānikatvasyāpi sattvāt| na caivamapīglakṣaṇatvavirahānna niṣedhaḥ laigavāyane orguṇasyeveti vācyam| nahyasminsūtre ika ityasya svarūpaparatāyāṃ pramāṇamastyutta(1) rasūtre tu cakāra itiśabdārthakaḥ pramāṇamityāhuḥ|
astu vā'rthādhikārāśrayaṇabalenehāpīka iti svarūpaparaṃ tathāpi `bhedyate' ityādau guṇo na syāditi tṛtīyapakṣe vakṣyamāṇo doṣa ādyapakṣadvaye'pyastyeveti bodhyam| nanu `upeddhaḥ' `preddhaḥ' ityudāharaṇasyehoktisambhava eva nāsti| tathāhi, ``pūrvaṃ dhātuḥ sādhanena yujyate iti mate `iddham' ityatra nalopo'ntaraṅgaḥ prathamopanataktapratyayāpekṣatvāt| ``pūrvaṃ dhāturupasargeṇa iti darśane tu guṇo'ntaraṅga, ubhayathā'pi guṇo bhaviṣyati bahiraṅgasya guṇasyāsiddhatayā niṣedhāyogāt bahiraṅgasya niṣedhasyāsiddhau guṇapravṛtternirbātvācca| satyam, ``asiddhaṃ bāheraṅgamantaraṅge (pāobhāo50) iti paribhāṣā neha pravarttate ``nājānantarye bahiṣṭvapraklṛptiḥ (paobhāo51) iti niṣedhāt| yatrāntaraṅge bahiraṅge vā'corānantaryamāśrīyate tatreṣā paribhāṣā neti vyākhyānāditi haradattānuyāyinaḥ| kintvasminpakṣe ``eta ai (pāosūo3-4-93) iti sūtre `pacāvedaṃ' `pacāmedam' ityādau eta aitvaṃ kuto netyāśaṅkya bahiraṅgatvena guṇasyāsiddhatvāditi haradattena vakṣyamāṇaṃ virudhyate, tathāca bahiraṅgasyāsiddhatābalena `preddham' ityādisiddhiriti pratipādanaparamihatyaṃ bhāṣyamapi virudhyeta| tasmādyatrottarakālapravṛttike aca ānantaryaṃ tatra bahiraṅgaparibhāṣā na syāditi kaiyaṭasammata eva ``nājānanatarye(pāobhāo51) ityasyārthaḥ sādhuḥ| `pacāvedam' ityādau hi pūrvaṃ guṇapravṛttiḥ| tatra cājānantaryāśrayaṇe'pi guṇottarapravṛttike aca ``nājānntarye (pāobhāo51) ityasyārthaḥ sādhuḥ| `pacāvedam' ityādau hi pūrvaṃ guṇapravṛttiḥ| tatra cājānantaryāśrayaṇe'pi guṇottarapravṛttike ``eta ai (pāosūo3-4-93) ityatra tadanāśrayaṇādyukta eva bahiraṅgatayoddhāraḥ| `upeddhaḥ' `preddhaḥ' ityādau tu guṇaṃ prāpayya niṣedhaḥ kārya ityuttarakālapravṛttiko niṣedhaḥ| tatrājānantaryāśrayaṇābhāvādbahiraṅgaparibhāṣayā siddhamevaitat| ato'tratyaṃ bhāṣyamapi saṅgacchate|
nanu ``ṣatavatukorasiddhaḥ (pāosūo6-1-96) iti sūtre eṣā paribhāṣā jñāpayiṣyate| tatra ca `ko'sicat' `ko'sya' ityādauprathamapravṛttike ``eṅaḥ padāntād (pāosūo6-1-109) ityasminnajānantaryaṃ na tūttarakālapravṛtte ṣatve'pīti kathaṃ kaiyaṭamataṃ samarthanīyam| tasmādyatrāntaraṅge bahiraṅge vā acorānantaryamiti haradattoktarītireva śaraṇīkarttavyeti cet? na, kaiyaṭamate acoriti dvitvasyāvivakṣayā sarvasāmañaajasyāt| asti hyuttarakālapravṛttike ṣatve aca ānantaryāśrayaṇam, iṇaḥ parasya sasyetyukteḥ| evañaaca prathamapakṣe `preddhaḥ' ityādau doṣābhāve'pi `(1)bhedyate' ityādyāsiddhireva dūṣaṇamiti dik|
dvitīyapakṣe tu yatkiñcinimittake dhātulope satyārddhadhātukanimitte guṇavṛddhī na sta iti sūtrārthaḥ syāt| tataśca ``knūyī śabde ityasmāṇṇici puki yalope kṛte pugantalakṣamo guṇo niṣidhyeta| tathāca `knopayati' iti na sidhyet| yadi tu ``cele kropeḥ (pāosūo3-4-33) iti nirddeśād guṇastarhīhāpi `bhedyate' ityasyāsiddhireva doṣaḥ|
tṛtīyapakṣe tvārddhadhātukanimittake dhātulope satyārddhadhātukanimitte guṇavṛddhī na sta iti sūtrārthaḥ syāt| tatra tantrāvṛttyādyāśrayaṇaprayuktaṃ gauravaṃ tāvatspaṣṭameva lopena saha guṇavṛddhyeraikanimittakatvaṃ ca na labhyeta| tataśca `bhedyate' ityatra bhiderṇyantātkarmāṇi yaki bhid iya iti sthite nityatvāṇṇilope kṛte pratyayalakṣaṇena ṇicamāśritya kriyamāṇo'pi guṇo niṣidhyeta| na ca ṇilopātpragevāntarahgatvād guṇo'stviti vācyam, vibhajyānvākhyānapakṣe tadasambhavāt ``upasaṃjaniṣyamāṇanimittopyapavāda upasaṃjātanimittamapyutsargaṃ bādhate (pāobhāo65) iti nyāyācca| anyatā `dadhati' ityādāvantaraṅgatvāt ``jhontaḥ (pāosūo 7-1-3) ityantādeśaḥ pravartteta| na ca ślau dvitve caivaṃkṛte antādeśasya sthānivadbhāvena ``adabyastāt(pāosūo 7-1-4) ityasya pravṛttirastviti vācyam, alvidhau sthānivadbhāvāsambhavāt| kiñca, ``samarthānāṃ prathamādvā (pāosūo4-1-82) iti sūtre ``akṛtavyūhāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ (pāobhāo56) ``kṛtamapi śāstraṃ nivarttayanti iti jñāpayituṃ samarthagrahaṇamiti vakṣyate| dve ete paribhāṣe samānaphale iti ca tatraiva sphuṭīkariṣyate| tathā cehāpi pūrvaṃ guṇo na kriyeta, kṛto'pi vā nivartteta `jagmuṣaḥ' ityādāviḍādivat| tasmāddhātorlopo yasminniti bahuvrīhireva sādhuḥ| evaṃ hi sati lopasya guṇavṛddhoścaikanimittakatvaṃ labhyate iti na kaścitpūrvoktadoṣaḥ|
syādetat, ārabhyamāṇe'pyasminsūtre `loluvaḥ' ityādau guṇo durvāraḥ| tathāhi, iha sūtre ``ṅkitica (pāosūo1-1-5) iti sūtre ca niṣedhyaṃ kimityākāṅkṣāyāṃ pūrvatra nirṇitā ikpadopasthitireva sambadhyeta--dhātvaṃśalopanimitte ārddhadātuke ikpadaṃ nopatiṣṭhate| tataśca `bebhidaḥ' `marīmṛjaḥ' `bhinnaḥ' `mṛṣṭaḥ' ityādau vyañjanasya guṇavṛddiprāptiḥ parametasya praghaṭṭakasya phalaṃ syāt| loluvādau tu syādeva guṇaḥ| na ca paribhāṣāṃ pratiśeṣibhūtatayā'rthataḥ pradhānayorguṇavṛddhyoreva niṣedho'stviti vācyam, śābdabodhe śābdaprādhānyasyaivānvayaniyāmakatāyā ucitatvāt| nahi `rājapuruṣamānaya' ityādāvarthataḥ pradhānabhūto'pi rājā ānayanenā'nveti, api tu puruṣa eva| prakṛte ca śābdaṃ prādhānyaṃ vākyārthabhūtāyāḥ padopasthitereva, kārakaviśiṣṭā kriyā vākyārtha iti siddhāntāta| āha ca---
sākāṅkṣāvayavaṃ bhedaṃ parānākāṅkṣaśabdakam|
karmapradhānaṃ guṇavadekārthaṃ vākyamucyate || iti ||
kiñca siddhānte prasajyapratiṣedhe sarvatra kriyayaiva saha naño'nvayo na tu nāmārthena| taduktam--
prasajyapratiṣedho'yaṃ kriyayā saha yatra nañ| iti|
ata eva puruṣavacanayorasaṅkaraḥ| anyathā hi `ghaṭo nāsti' `tvaṃ nāsi' `ahaṃ nāsmi' iti puruṣavyavastā na syāt| ghakaṭābhāvastvadabhāvo madabhāvaścāstītivatsarvatra prathamapuruṣāptteḥ. na hi paramate `tvaṃ nāsi' `tvadabhāvo'sti' ityanayorarthe kaścidviśeṣaḥ, nañarthaṃ prati prathamāntapadopasthāpitasyānvayitāvacchedakāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvena saṃsargeṇa prakāratābhyupagame'pi yuṣmatsāmānādhikaraṇyavirahasyāviśiṣṭatvāt| evaṃ vāyau rūpāṇāmabāvo'stītivadrapāṇi na santītyatrāpyastītyekavacanaṃ syādityanyatra vistaraḥ|
evaṃ kārakavibhakterapi kriyāyoge satyeva sādhutvaṃ na tvanyathā'pīti ``kārake (pāosūo1-4-23) iti sūtre vakṣyamāṇatvād `bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti' ityādāvadhikaraṇatvaṃ kriyānvayyeva na tu nañarthānvayi| tathācasakalakārakaviśiṣṭakriyāyāṃ nañarthānvayaḥ| naño dyotakateti niṣkṛṣṭapakṣe tu kriyāpadasyaiva tadvirahaparateti siddhāntaḥ| ubhayatā'pīha guṇavṛddhyoḥ pratiṣegho durlabha eveti|
atrāhaḥ--kriyayaiva saha vidheriva niṣedhasyānvayaḥ śābda iti satyameva, kintu kriyaiva keti saṃśaye tvaduktarītyā sannihitāpīkpadopasthitiriha na sambadhyate| tathāhi sati ``dīdhīvevīṭām (pāosūo1-1-6) iti sūtrasya vyarthatāpatteḥ| na hi tatrekparibhāṣā'lontyaparibhāṣayoḥ phale viśeṣo'sti| evaṃ sthite ``astirbhavantīparo'prayujyamāno'pyasti iti prātipadikārthasūtre vakṣyamāṇarītyā `bhavataḥ' ityasyopasthitasyaguṇavṛddhī ityādibhiranvitasya niṣedhānvaye sati guṇavṛddhyorabhāvaḥ phali to bhavatītyetāvatā guṇavṛddhyorniṣedha ityucyate| yathā''ghārāgnihotrā dhikaraṇe (jaionyāo2-2-5) sarvo'pi viśiṣṭavidhireva, tātparyatastu kaścid guṇavidhiriti siddhāntitaṃ, tadvanniṣedhe'pi bodhyaṃ nyāyasāmyāt| ata eva hi vidhiniṣedhayorvākyārthagocaratetyabhiyuktāḥ| tasmāt `loluvaḥ' `popuvaḥ' `marīmṛjaḥ' ityudāharaṇaṃ siddham| pratyudāharaṇaṃ tūcyate--dhātulopa iti kim? ārddhadātuke vidhiniṣedhābhyāṃ ṣoḍaśigrahaṇāgrahaṇayoriva guṇavṛddhyorvikalpo mā bhūt| ārddhadhātuka iti kim? ``turvī thurvī durvī dhurvī hiṃsāyā (dhāosūo 572|572|573|574|) ``murchā mohasamucchrāyayoḥ (dhāosūo 212) ebhyo yaṅlugantebyastibādau sārvadhātuke piti pare `totortti' `momortti' ityādau niṣedho mā bhūt ``rāllopaḥ (pāosūo6-4-21) iti cchvorlopasya guṇasya caikanimittakatvāt| idaṃ ca rāllope k‌ṅidgrahaṇānanuvṛttipakṣamāśrityoktam| tadanuvṛttipakṣe tu `totīrmi' ityādyuttamapuruṣaikavacanaudāharaṇaṃ bodhyam| anunāsikādipratyayatvena tatra rāllopapravṛtteḥ| nanu `toterti' ityādi prāguktamapyudāharaṇamastu| rāllopasyāpravṛttāvapi ``lopo vyoḥ (pāosūo6-1-66) iti lopāditi cet? na, tasya varṇamātranimittakatayā guṇena sahaikanimittakatvābhāvāt| na hi tatra pratyayagrahaṇaṃ tadākṣepakaṃ vā kiñcidasti| ata eva gaudherādiṣu pratyayaparatāṃ vinā'pi yalopa iti dik|
ika iti kim? `abhāji' `rāgāḥ'| ``bhañjeśca ciṇi (pāosūo6-4-33) ``ghañi ca bhāvakaraṇayoḥ (pāosūo6-4-27) ityupadhālope kṛte vṛddhiryathā syāt| kathaṃ tarhi `pāpacakaḥ' ityatra vṛddhipratiṣedha iti cet? śṛṇu, pāpacyaterṇvuli ``yasya halaḥ (kapāosūo 6-4-49) ityatra `aharyāt' `amavyīt' ityādivāraṇāya yasyeti saṃdātagrahaṇe'kapi ``ādeḥparasya (pāosūo1-1-54) iti halmātralope kṛte ``ato lopaḥ (pāosūo6-4-48) iti pṛthagallope tasya sthānivadbhāvena pāpacakādau na vṛddhiḥ| na tviha ``na dhātulope (pāosūo1-1-4) iti sūtrasya kaścidapi vyāpāraḥ| yaṅlugantāṇṇvuli `pāpācakaḥ' iti bhavatyeva vṛddiḥ `nonāva' itivat| etena ``na dātulopa (pāosūo1-1-4) ityatreka ityanuvṛtteḥ `pāpācakaḥ' itivannadhātusūtre `bebhiditā' `marīmṛjitā' ityudāharaṃśca kaumudīkāraḥ parāstaḥ, pṛthagallopasya nyāyyatve bhāṣyādisammatatve ca sati vṛddherasambhavāt| ata eva vṛttikārādayo'pyatra sūtre 'c‌pratyayāntānyeva loluvādīnyudājarhuḥ| bhidimṛjyostu yadi yaṅluk tarhi tasyānaimittikatvād guṇavṛddhī sta eva, `bebheditā' `marīmārjitā' iti yathā| yadi tu ``yasya halaḥ (pāosūo 3-4-49) ityavayavalopastarhi sthānivadbhāvādeva guṇādyaprasaṅga ityubhayathāpi naitatsūtrodāharaṇattvamityavadheyam| bhāṣyakārastu ``yasya (pāosūo6-4-148) iti lopa ivāci lukyapi pṛthagallopamāśrityaitatsūtraṃ pratyācakhyau| na ca yenanāprāptinyāyenāci yaṅo lugatolopaṃ bādheteti vācyam, ``yasya halaḥ (pāosūo6-4-49) ityatra yasyeti yogaṃ vibhajyāto lopa iti cānuvarttya yaśabdasyāto lopavidhānena lugbādhanāt| avaśiṣṭaṃ vyañkajanamātraṃ luko'vakāśaḥ| tataścāllopasya sthānivattvādeva `bebhiditā' `marīmṛjitā' `pāpacakaḥ' ityādāvapi pṛthagallopāpattiḥ, cakārānukṛṣṭabahulagrahaṇājjāyamānasyānaimittakasya luko'ntaraṅgatayā lakārotpatteḥ prāgeva samudāye pravṛtteḥ| nanvevaṃ `cekriyaḥ' `loluvaḥ' `toṣṭuvaḥ' ityādāvallopasya sthānivattvādyathā guṇo na, evamiyaṅuvaṅāvapi na syātāmiti cet? satyam acamāśritya na bhavata eva, uktayukteḥ; kintu sthānivadbhāvalabdhamakāramāśritya bhaviṣyataḥ| sa hi yakāre lupte pratyayasaṃjñakaḥ|
syādetatū, loluvādiṣvakāre lupte yalugiti kramaḥ| tatra yakārāvastānakāle akāreṇa pratyayatvaṃ na labdhameva| lupte'pi tasminnakāro nāstyeva tataḥ prāgeva lopāt| soyamasatkayaṃ pratyayatāṃ labheta? tallopasya sthānivadbhāvena pratyayatvamiti cet? sthānini dṛṣṭaṃ hi kāryaṃ tadvada tideśena labhyate, na tu tatrādṛṣṭamapi|
atrāhuḥ--tatra sambhāvitamātramatidiśyate| yadi hi lopasya sthānibhūto 'kāra iha lupte'pi yakāre tiṣṭhettarhi pratyayatāṃ labhetovalaṅādikaṃ ca pravarttayediti kathaṃ nātideśaḥ| varoniṣedhaśceha liṅgam| sa hi yāteryaṅantādvaracyallopayalopayoḥ kṛtayoḥ sthānivadbhāvena ``āto lopa iṭi ca (pāosūo 6-4-64) ityālopo mā bhūdityetadarthaṃ kriyate| sthāninidṛṣṭasyaivātideśe tu kintena? na hi `yā--yā--ya' ityasyāmavastāyāmāto lopasya prāptiḥ anajāditvāditi dik|
nanvevaṃ `cekṣiyaḥ' `toṣṭuvaḥ' ityatra ``antarahgānapi (pāobhāo52) iti nyāyenākṛte eva ``akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ (pāosūo7-4-25) iti dīrghe yaṅo luk| tato'llopasya sthānivadbhāve satyapi cekṣi a a toṣṭuṃ a a iti stānyakāreṇa saha laghūpadhamaṅgamacpratyayaparaṃ jātamiti laghūpadhaguṇaḥ syādeva| satyam, antaraṅgīviyaṅuvaṅau bhaviṣyataḥ| yathāha vārttikakāraḥ--``śacaṅantasyāntaraṅgalakṣaṇatvāt (kāovāo) iti| tatāca ``ripi gatau (dhāosūo124|125)``dhi dhāraṇe (dhāosūo 126) ityeṣāṃ tudāditvācche kṛte `riyati' `piyati' `dhiyati' iti bhavati| `aśiśriyat' `prādudruvat' iti ca ``ṇiśri (pāosūo 3-1-48) iti caṅīyaṅuvaṅo bhavataḥ| tasmātpṛthagallopenaiva sakalanirvāhāt ``na dhātulope (pāosūo1-1-4) iti sūtrannārambhaṇīyam| na caivaṃ `marimṛjaḥ' ityatra ``majerajādau saṃkramaḥ (kāovāo) iti pākṣikavṛddhiprasaṅgaḥ, haradattādimate mukhyājādāveva tatpravṛtteḥ, niṣkarṣe tu ``yathottaraṃ munīnāmprāmāṇyāt iṣṭāpatteḥ| vyavastitavibāṣā vā'stu| atra vadantiguṇopadālopayuṭāṃ na lopāllopayorapi prasaṅgātpṛtagallopo luki vaktuṃ na śakyate| tathāhi, sarvakṣatra dīrghānteṣu hrasvānteṣu ceyaṅuvaṅoḥ kṛtayorlagūpadhalakṣaṇo guṇaḥ prāpnoti| na ceha sthānivadbhāvaḥ ādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāt| kiñaaca `jaṅgamaḥ' ityatra ``gamahana (pāosūo6-4-97) ityupadhālopaḥ syāt| athātrānaṅīti pratiṣedhastarhi `darīdṛśaḥ' ityatra ``ṛdṛśo'ṅi (pāosūo6-4-63) iti yuṭ syāt| kiñca `sanīsraṃsaḥ' `danīdhvaṃsaḥ' ``aniditām (pāosū06-4-24) ityupadhālopaḥ syāt| api ca `yāyāḥ' `vāvāḥ' ityādiṣvākā***** syāt| tasmātsamudāyalugevaiṣṭavyo loluvādisiddhaye ca sūtramārambaṇīyamiti| atrocyate, loluvādiṣu guṇastāvanna bhavati sthānidvārakasyānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvasya sattvena sthānivadbāvāt| ata eva hi ``na padānta (pāosūo1-1-58) iti sūtre savarṇagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| `śiṇḍhi' ityādāvanusvārasya sthānidvārakamanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvamāśritya tasya savarṇe karttavye śnasorallopasya sthānivadbhāvo mama bhūditi| nanvanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvasya śāstrīyakāryatvābhāvātkathamatidesa iti cet? anādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāpekṣe ``acaḥ parasmin (pāosūo 1-1-57) ityatideśe karttavye ``sthānivadādeśa (pāosūo1-1-56) ityasya pravattisambhavāt savarṇagrahaṇavyākhyāvasare sarvairitthamevopapāditatvācca| nanu yotrādeśa uvaṅsonādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatāṃ sthānidvārā kathañcillabhatāṃ na tu tasyeha kiñcitkāryaṃ vidhīyate yenāllopaḥ sthānivatsyāt| yasya ca kāryaṃ vidhīyate ukārasya nāsāvādeśaḥ yena sthānidvārā'pi pūrvatāṃ labheta| satyam, `sarve sarvapadādeśāḥ' ityāśrayaṇātsthānyādeśibhāvastāvadarthavati viśrāmyati| ata eva ``eru (pāosūo3-4-86) ityasya testuriti paryavasitārthamāśritya sthānivatsūtreṇaiva siddhatvādekadeśavikṛtasyopasaṅkhyānaṃ nārabdhavyamiti vakṣyate| ata eva ca sthānivadityuktau sambandhiśabdatvādevādeśa ityasya lābhe siddhe punarādeśagrahaṇamānumānikasyāpyādeśasya parigrahārthamiti vakṣyate| evañcehāpi lolū ityasya lolugh ityādeśaḥ, sa cānādiṣṭādacaḥka pūrvaḥ sthānivadbhāvāt| tasya ca lolova ityādeśe kārye'llopaḥ sthānivaditi yuktameva| kiñca, ``jñājanorjā (pāo sūo 7-3-79) iti ``rīṅ ṛtaḥ (pāosūo7-4-27) iti ca sūtre dīrghoccāraṇena ``aṅgavṛtte punarvattāvavidhirniṣṭhitasya (paobhāo93) iti paribhāṣā jñāpayiṣyate| tenovaṅi kṛte guṇo na bhaviṣyati| `darīdṛśaḥ' ityatra guṇo na bhavati pratipadoktasyāṅo grahaṇāt| `adarśat' iti yatā| yaṅastvakāra upadeśavelāyāṃ na prattyayaḥ kintu tadavayavaḥ, yakāre lupte tu nāsau ṅakāraviśiṣṭo na vāśrūyate| kintu tarkaikagocaratvāllākṣaṇikavadvilambitopasthitikaḥ| nanvevamanaṅīti paryudāse'kapyasyāgrahaṇāt `jaṅgamaḥ' ityatrāllopaḥ syāditi cet? na, anaṅīti paryudāsenāṅsadṛśe aupadeśike ajādau śrūyamāṇājādau vopadhālopavidhānāt| arthavānevāṅguṇavidhau gṛhyate iti tu na samyak vikaraṇānāmanarthakatvāt| yattu `dedyaḥ' ityatra yuṭ syāditi| tanna, anubandhanirddeśāt| taduktam---
śtipā śapānubandhena nirddiṣṭaṃ yad gaṇena ca|
yatraikākajgrahaṇaṃ caiva pañcaitāni na yaṅluki || (pāobhāo131) iti|
``dīṅo yuḍaci (pāosūo6-4-63) iti sūtre dīṅa ityanubandhanirdeśo yaṅluṅnivṛttyartha iti tvayaivoktatvācca| atra ca jñāpakam ``ekāca upadeśe (pāosūo1-3-2) iti sūtre yaṅluṅnivṛttimuddiśya kriyamāṇamekājgrahaṇam| na hi tasminkṛte'pyuktaparibhāṣāṃ vinā `bebheditā' ityādi siddhyati| `bibhetsati' ityādisiddhaye tantrāvṛttyādyāśrayamenopadeśagrahaṇasyobhayaviśeṣaṇatāyāḥ siddhāntayiṣyamāṇatvāt| na caivama piśtipāśapetyādyaṃśāntare kathaṃ jñāpakamiti vācyam, ekadeśānumatidvārā pūrvācāryapaṭhitaparibhāṣājñāpanasya ``gatikārakopapadānām (pāobhāo76) ityādau bahuśo dṛṣṭatvāt| na caivamekāca iti vidhīyamānaṃ dvitvamapi yaṅluki na syāditi vācyam ``guṇo yaṅlukoḥ (pāosūo7-4-82) iti jñāpakena tatpravṛtteḥ| yaṅluki `bebheditā' ityādāviḍāgame tūdāhṛtaparibhāṣaiva śaramam| ``dviḥprayogo dvirvacanaṃ ṣāṣṭham(bhāoio) iti vakṣyamāṇatayā dhāttvantaratvasya vaktumaśakyatvāt `bebheditā' iti yaṅnte tu pṛthagallopābhyupagamāttasya ca sthānivadbhāvānneṇniṣedhaḥ pūrvasmādapi vidhau sthānivadbhāvasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt| kiñca, ``yasya (pāosūo 6-4-148) iti lopasya tvayā'pyavayavalopatvaṃ svīkṛtam| tatra yadyapi `dedyakaḥ' ityatra yuṭ syāditi nāpādanārham, halaḥ paratvābhāveneha yalopāpravṛttyā `dedīyakaḥ ' iti rūpābhyupagamāt| `sanīsrasakaḥ' ityādaunalopopi sarvasammatatvādeva nāpādyaḥ, `yāyāyakaḥ' `vāvāyakaḥ' ityādāvāllopo'pyanāpādyaḥ, yalopaviraheṇājādikṅidārddhadhātukaparatvābhāvā t; tathāpi gamaryaṅantāṇṇvuli `jaṅgamakaḥ' ityātrāllopasya sthānivadbhāvād vṛddhyabhāva ivopadhālopaḥ syāt| athātrānaṅīti pratiṣedhastarhi `darīdṛśakaḥ' ityatra ``ṛdṛśo'ṅi (pāosūo7-4-16) iti guṇaḥ syāt| atha yadīhāṅgavṛttaparibhāṣayā ``saṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ(pāobhāo94) iti vā samādhīyate tarhi yaṅlukyapi `sanīsraṃsaḥ' ityatra nalopo `yāyāḥ' `vāvāḥ' ityālopaśca na śaṅkyaḥ, samādhānasya tulyatvāditi dik|
kṅiti ca (pāosūo1-1-5)| ika iti śabdamuccārya vihite guṇavṛddhī| gitaṃ kitaṃ ṅitañca nimittanayā''śritya ye prāpnutaste na staḥ| git jiṣṇuḥ, ``glājisthaśca gsnuḥ (pāosūo3-2-139) cāyaṃ kidevāstviti vācyam, `sthāsnuḥ' ityatra `ghumāsthā (pāosūo6-4-63) itītvaprasaṅgāt| na caivaṃ `bhūṣṇuḥ' ityatreṭprasaṅgaḥ ``śrūyukaḥ kiti (pāosūo7-4-11) ityatrāpi carttvena gakārapraśleṣamāśritya tanniṣedhāt| na caivaṃ cartvasyāsiddhatayā visarjanīyo na syādrorutvañca pravartteteti vācyam, ``na mune (pāosūo8-2-3) ityatra neti yogavibhāgātsautratvādvā| tathāca ``glājistha (pāosūo3-2-139) iti sūtre ślokavārttikam----
ksnorgittvānna stha īkāraḥ kinṅitorītvaśāsanāt|
guṇābhāvastriṣu smāryaḥ śruyako 'niṭtvaṃ kagoritoḥ || iti| jayādityo'pyevam| vāmanastu ``glājisthaśca (pāosūo3-2-139) ityatra sthā ā ityākāraṃ praśliṣya kasnupratyayāntasya tiṣṭhaterākāra eva na tvītvamiti vyākhyānādeva sthāsnoḥ siddhau na kvāpi gakārapraśleṣaḥ kārya ityāha| nanvetena tanmate ``daṃśecchandasyupasaṃkhyānam(kāovāo) iti ksnau `daṃkṣṇavaḥ paśavaḥ' ityatra ``aniditām (pāosūo 6-4-24) iti nalopaḥ syāt| satyam, chāndasatvātsamādheyaḥ. kit--`cita' `stutaṃ' `mṛṣṭam'| ṅit--`cinutaḥ' `sunutaḥ' `mṛṣṭāt'| nimittasaptamyāśrayaṇaṃ kim? vyavahite'pi yathā syāt--`chinnaṃ' `bhinnam'| ika iti kim? kāmayate| śabdavyāpārāśrayaṇaṃ kim? laigavāyanaḥ| orguṇo hīka eva pravarttate na tatrekpadopasthitiḥ oritinirddiṣṭasthānikatvāt| taduktam--``taddhitakāmyorikprakaraṇāt iti| nanu kṅitīti saptamīnirddeśāt``tasminnitinirddiṣṭe pūrvasya (pāosūo1-1-66) iti paribhāṣopatiṣṭheta, tatra niḥ śabdasya nairantaryaparatvāddiśeścoccāraṇakriyatvādavyavahitoccāritasya niṣedhaḥ syānna tu `chinnaṃ' `bhinnam' ityāderapīte cet? bhavedevaṃ, yadi kṅitītyetanniṣedhyayā kriyayā sākṣātsambadhyeta| iha tu guṇavṛddhibhyāṃ sambadhyate| ``yasya ca bhāvena (pāosūo2-3-37) iti saptamī, kriyāntarāśrayaṇādautsargikasattākṣepaḥ. tataśca kṅiti sati prāpteya ye guṇavṛddhī iti sambandhe kṛte siddhasādhyasamabhivyāhāranyāyenopalakṣaṇībhūtasattāśrayaṇasya nimittatvamutsargataḥ phalati na tviha viśiṣyanimittatāyāṃ saptamīvidhānamasti| na cātra nirddiṣṭaparibhāṣā sambhavati, vidhyaṅgabhūtānāṃ paribhāṣāṇāṃ sākṣādvidheyaniṣedhyakriyānvayinyeva pravṛtteḥ| idantu kriyānvayino viśeṣaṇaṃ na tu kriyāyāḥ| ato'tra na paribhāṣāpravṛttiḥ| anyathā ``vṛddhiryasyācāmādiḥ (pāosūo1-1-73) ityatrekparibhāṣopasthāne śālīyādirna sidhyet| na hyatrekaḥ stāne vṛddhiḥ| ata eva ``udīcāmātaḥ sthāne (pāosūo7-3-46) iti sūtre sthāne grahaṇaṃ kṛtam| ātaḥ sthāne yo'kāra ityanūdyamānasya viśeṣaṇe āta ityasmin ``ṣaṣṭhī sthāne yogā (pāosūo1-1-49) iti paribhāṣāyā apravṛtteḥ| ``guṇānāñca parārthatvādasambandhaḥ samatvātsyāt (jaiosūo3|1|22) iti nyāyopyatrānusandheyaḥ| nanu tarhyanenaiva nyāyena kṅitītyetatpradhānabhūtakriyayā sambadhyatāṃ na tu taccheṣabūtābhyāṃ guṇavṛddhibhyāṃ, pradhānānvayasya sambhavatastyāgāyogāditi cet? na , yatra hi guṇaḥ kṛtātmasaṃskāraḥ pradhānopakārāya mahate prabhavati tatrātmano'pi saṃskāramanubhūya pradhānena sambadhyate| yathā pānīyamelādisaṃskṛtaṃ puruṣeṇa| uktañca----
guṇaḥ kṛtatmasaskāraḥ pradhānaṃ pratipadyate|
pradhānasyopakāre hi tathā bhūyasi vartate || iti ||
iha guṇavṛddhyoḥ kṅidgrahaṇena viśeṣitayoḥ pradhānasya mahānupakāro bhavati vyavahitasyāpi pratiṣedhasiddheḥ| knoḥ kitkaraṇañcātra jñāpakam| anyathā pradhānenaivānvaye nirddiṣṭaparibhāṣāyāścopasthitau satyāṃ vyavahite niṣedhasyāpravṛttau vyarthameva knoḥ kittvaṃ syāt| tasmādyathāvyākhyānameva sādhu| nanu na yadīyaṃ parasaptamī tarhi śacaṅnte doṣaḥ laghūpadhalakṣaṇaguṇaprāpteriti cet? na, antaraṅgatvādiyaṅuvaṅpravṛtteḥ| `` dhi dhāraṇa (dhāosūo126) `ri pi gatau (dhāosūo124|125) tudādayaḥ, dhiyati riyati piyati| ``ṇiśra(idrusru bhyaḥ karttaricaṅ (pāosūo 3-1-48) aśiśriyat, adudruvat asusruvat iha tipamāśritya prāpto guṇobahiraṅgaḥ śacaṅāśrayāviyaṅuvaḍāvantaraṅgau| taduktam-``śacaṅantasyāntaraṅgalakṣaṇatvāt iti| (kāovāo) ``mṛjerajādau saṃkrame vṛddhirveṣyate iti kāśikāyām| idañca ``iko guṇavṛddhī (pāosūo1-1-3) iti sūtraprasaṅgādvaiyākaraṇāntaramatatvenoktaṃ bhāṣye| asyārthaḥ-saṃkrāmato guṇavṛddhī asmāditi vyutpatyā guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhanimittabhūtaḥ kṅitpratyayo'tra saṃkramaśabdenocyate, yogarūḍheḥ| tena `marīmṛjaḥ' ityatra dhātvaṃśalopanimittatayā vṛddhipratiṣedhahetāvapyacpratyaye nāsau viklapaḥ pravarttata ityavadheyam| ata eva ``kṅityaci vā iti vacanaṃ tatra bhāṣye kṛtam| mṛjanti, mārjanti| atra haradattaḥ--acītyucyamāne'pi ``yasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe(paobhāo33) iti siddhe ādigrahaṇaṃ mukhyājādigrahaṇārtham| vyapadeśivadbhāvenājādau `yūyaṃ mamṛja' `tvayā mamṛje' ityādau na bhavatīti| taccintyam, mukhyājādiparigrahe pramāṇābhāvāt| na hi bhāṣye ādigrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ yena tyaduktārtho labhyeta, kintu ``kṅityaci vā iti vacanaṃ paṭhitam| yattu tataḥ prāguktaṃ bhāṣye``ihānye vaiyākaraṇā mṛjerajādau saṃkrame vibhāṣā vṛddhimārabhante iti, tattu tadādiparibhāṣābalalabdhavākyārthānuvādamātraṃ na tu parakīyavidhivākyaśarīramidaṃ, yena tvaduktamarthaṃ jñāpayet| ata evātreyo `mṛjā' iti bhidādipāṭhādaṅ gaṇapāṭhādeva vṛdhyabhāva ityāha| ata eva rakṣitenāpi dhātupradīpe `tundapari mṛjaḥ' tundaparimārjaḥ' ityubhayaṃ darśitam| durghaṭavṛttau tu `tundaparimṛjaḥ' ityatra vyavasthitavibhāṣayā vṛddirnetyuktam| ata eva dhātuvṛttiṣu `yūyaṃ mamṛja, mamārja' iti rūpadvayamudāhṛtam| yattu mukhyājādigrahaṇavādino'pi mate 'tra vṛddhiviklapo durvāra eva| tatāhi, madhyamapuruṣabahuvacanasya thasya ``parasmaipadānām(pāosūo3-4-82) iti sūtreṇa vidhīyamāno'kārādeso'lontyasya prāpnoti| na caivaṃ vidhivaiyarthyam, ṇalādīnāṃ yathāsaṃkhyasampādanena caritārtatvādityāśaṅkya bhāṣyaeva dvedhā samādhāsyati--kāradvayātmako'yamanekāltvātsarvādeśaḥ| yadvā ``dātoḥ (pāosūo 3-1-91) ityadhikārad ``ādeḥ parasya (pāosūo1-1-54) iti thakāramātrasyākāra iti| tatra pakṣadvayepi ``ato guṇe (pāosūo6-1-97) iti pararūpasya ``acaḥ parasmin (pāosūo1-1-57) iti sthānivadbhāvānmukhyājāditvamapyastyeveti kaiściddharadattamiśramate dūṣaṇamuktam| tanna, ``ādyantavad (pāosūo1-1-21) ityatideśa iva sthānivadbhāve'pi mukhyatvābhāvasya suvacatvāditi dik|
syādetat, `acinot' `amārṭ' ityādau stānivadbhāvena tipo ṅittvāt ``kṅiti ca (pāosūo 1-1-5) iti guṇavṛddiniṣedhaḥ syāt| na cālvidhitvātsthānivadbāvāsambhavaḥ anubandhakāryeṣvanalvidāviti niṣedhasyāpravṛtteḥ| anyathā `acinavam' `amārjam' ityādāvapittvena ``sārvadātukamapit (pāosūo1-2-4) iti ṅittvāpatteḥ| iha ca jñāpakaṃ ``na lyapi (pāosūo 6-4-69) iti sūtram| anyathā lyapaḥ kittvābhāvādevetvāprāptau kintanniṣedārthena sūtreṇa? yattu ``serhyaṣicca (pāosūo 3-4-27) ityapidvacanaṃ jñāpakamiti| tanna, ``śṛṇīhi viśvataḥ prati ityādau sthānentaratamaparibhāṣayā pittavādanudāttasya sipaḥ sthāne'nudāttasyaiva heḥ prāptavudāttasampādanena caritārthatvāt| apittvasāmarthyāddhi tatrāntaratamaparibhāṣā bādhyate| pratipattilāghavārthamudātta iti vaktavye 'pidvacanaṃ jñāpakamiti vā'stu| nyāyasiddho'pyayamarthaḥ, anubandhānāmanekāntatvena sthānikoṭāvapraviṣṭatayā stānyalāśrayavidhivi,yakasya ``analvidhau(pāosūoeo1-1-56) iti niṣedhasyāpravṛtteḥ,| ``anubandhā ekāntāḥ (pāobhāo5)iti **te'pi sthānitvapratīteḥ prāgevātaraṅgeṇa lopena teṣāmapahārāt| tasmāllaḍādyādeśānāṃ tibādīnāṃ sthānivadbhāvena ṅittvaṃ durvāramiti|
atrāhuḥ--``yāsuṭ parasmaipadeṣu (pāosūo 304-103) iti sūtre ṅidvacanaṃ jñāpakaṃ-lādeśānāṃ sthānivadbhāvena ṅittvanna bhavatīti| tathācavārttikam--``lakārasya ṅittvādādeśeṣu sthānivadbhāvaprasaṅga iti cedyāsuṭo ṅidvacanātsiddham iti| nanu `stuyāt' ityādāvaniglakṣaṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthaṃ `cinuyuḥ' ityādau ``jusica (pāosūo7-2-83) ityasya pratiṣedhārthañca yāsuṭo ṅittvamastu| ``uto vṛddhirluki hali (pāosūo 7-3-89) ityatra tdyuta iti nirddiṣṭasthānikatayekparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate| ``jusi ca (pāosūo7-2-83) iti tu ``kṅiti ca (pāosūo1-1-5) ityasyāpavāda eva| tatāca sthānivadbhāvalabdhaṃ ṅitvaṃ `stuyāt' `cinuyuḥ' ityatra vṛddhiguṇau niṣeddhuṃ nālam| punarṅittvasāmarthyāttu tadubhayaniṣedho bhaviṣyati| tathāca vṛddhiguṇaniṣedhe caritārtaṃ yāsuṭo ṅittvaṅkathaṃ lādeśeṣu lāśrayaṅittvasya virahaṃ jñāpayediti cet? ucyate, ``ata aut?? iti vaktavye vṛddhigrahaṇaṃ saṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityo yatā syādityeva martham| tena `stuyāt' ityatra na vṛddhiḥ, tathā `cinuyuḥ' ityatra na guṇaḥ ``ksasyāci (pāosūo7-3-82) ityato'cītyanuvartyājādau jusi guṇavidhānāt| ``miderguṇo'kajusi ca ityakāraṃ praśliṣyāccāsāvus ceti karmadhārayāśrayaṇenājādāvusi guṇapidhānāśrayaṇe tu `cakruḥ' `jarhuḥ' ityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ|
guṇeti luptavibhaktikamujusīti ca cchedaḥ| ukārādau jusīti cārthaḥ| ``jusi guṇe yāsuṭpratiṣedhaḥ (kāovāo) iti vārttikamapyuktarītyā siddhārthakathanaparamiti tāvadvārttikakārasya hṛdayam|
bhāṣyakāramate tu ``sārvadhātukamapit(pāosūo1-2-4) iti sūtre'piditi yogaṃ vibhajya ṅiditi cānuvartyāvṛttiñcāśritya ṅicca pinna picca ṅinna bhavatīti vākyārthadvayaṃ varṇyate| idañca ``halaḥ śnaḥ (pāosūo3-1-73) iti sūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭam| tena `brūtāt' ityatra bruva īṇna tātaṅ aupadeśikaṅitvenāntaraṅgeṇātideśikasya bahirahgasya pitvasya bādhāt, `ātidiṣṭādupadiṣṭaṃ balīyaḥ' iti nyāyāt| `acinot' ityādau tvaupadeśikena tibādīnāṃ pittvena lāśrayamātideśikaṃ ṅitvambādhyate| tena guṇādisiddhiḥ| asmiṃśca pakṣe yāsuṭo ṅitvavacanaṃ na jñāpakaṃ kintu `mṛjyāt' ityādāvaprāptaṅitvavidhāyakam| tena ca pittvasya `cinoti' ityādau sāvakāśasya vādhaḥ| ataḥ `stuyāt' ityādau piti halīti vidhīyamānā vṛddhirna pravarttate| `cinuyuḥ' iti tu prāgvadeva samarthanīyam| pūrvodāhṛtavārttikamate tu `brūtāt' ityatreṭ prāpnoti| ``āgamaśāsanamanityam iti tu kathaṃ citsamādheyaḥ| vastutastu ``halaḥ śnaḥ sānajjñau (pāosūo3-1-83) iti śānacaḥ śitkaraṇena ``kvacidanubandhakāryepyanalvidhāviti niṣedhaḥ pravarttate iti jñāpyate| tena `brūtāt' ityādau na kaściddoṣa iti| ata eva bhāṣyamate `bhaviṣīṣṭa' ityatra ṅitvanna `kariṣyamāṇā' ityatrogillakṣaṇāṭillakṣaṇaśca ṅībneti dik|
dīdhīvevīṭām (pāosūo1-1-6)
dīdhīvevyoriṭaśva guṇvṛddhī na staḥ| ādīdhyanam, ādīdhyakaḥ| āvevyanam āvevyakaḥ| akaṇiṣam| araṇiṣam| kaṇitā śvo raṇitā śvaḥ| ihāmaṃ prati sijantamaṅgam| tipo ḍādeśaṃ prati tu `kaṇit' `raṇit' iti tāntamaṅgaṃ, tasyāmaṃ ḍādeśaṃ ca sārvadhātukaṃ nimittīkṛtya laghadhūpadhaguṇaḥ prāpto'nena niṣidhyate| vṛddhistviṭo na sambhavatyeva| luḍantatāṃ sphoṭayituṃ śva ityasya prayogaḥ| na hi tṛjante tṛnnante veṭo gueṇaprāptiḥ pratyayāvayavatvāttasya| atha ``dīṅ kṣeye (dhāosūo28) ``dhīṅ anādare (dhāosūo 30) ``veñ tantusantāne (dhāosūo38) teṣāmiha grahaṇaṃ kuto neti cet? na, avayavaprasiddhyapekṣayā samudāyaprasiddherbalavattvāt| kiñca caturṇāṃ grahaṇe'bhiprete'sandehārthaṃ ``dīvedhīvīṭām' ityeva brūyāt| iṭ cātrāgama eva gṛhyate na ``iṭ gatau (dhāosūo 319) iti dhātuḥ| nanu dātusāhacaryāddhātureva gṛhyatām| maivam, sāhacaryasya sarvatrāniyāmakatvāt| anyathā ``dvistriścaturiti kṛtvorthe (pāosūo7|3|43) iti sūtre kṛtvorthagrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt, dvistririti sujantābhyāṃ sāhacaryeṇa caturityasyāpi sujantasya grahamasambhavāt|ata evāgamāpekṣayā prakṛterabhyarhitatvāddīdhīṅaḥ pūrvānipātaḥ sūtre kṛtaḥ| iṭo'pi dhātutve tu prakṛtitvāviśeṣe'pyalpāctaratvāttasyaiva pūrvanipātaḥ syāt|
atredamavadheyam, `dīdhyakaḥ' `vevyakaḥ' iti yadudāhṛtaṃ taddīdhīvevībyāṃ śuddhābhyameva ṇvuli rūpaṃ na tu ṇyantābhyāmapi| yattu ``yīvarṇayoḥ (pāosūo7-4-53) iti sūtre haradattenoktam--varṇaśabdo ``varṇa vistāre (dhāosūo406) itidhātoḥ pacādyajantaḥ, śrūyamāṇa eva varṇe yatā sthānivattvopi śrūyamāṇatvābāvāllopābhāve yaṇi kṛte `dīdhyakaḥ' `vevyakaḥ' ityeva śuddhena samānākāraṃ rūpaṃ bhavatīti, tadetat, ``nāglopiśāsvṛditām (pāosūo 7-4-2) ityetasminsūtre bhāṣyakāraireva ṇyantasya `dīdhakaḥ' iti rūpaṃ śuddhasya tu `dīdhyakaḥ' iti vyutpāditatvātsiddhāntavirodhādupekṣyam| tatra hi varṇagrahaṇaṃ lupte'pi varṇe yathā syādityevamarthamityāśaṅkya sthānivadbhāvena siddherantaraṅgatvāṇṇilopātprāg ``yīvarṇayoḥ(pāosūo7-4-53) iti lopasiddhesva varṇagrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyātam| nanu varṇagrahaṇaṃ kurvataḥ sūtrakārasyāśayaṃ bhāṣyakāroktādanyamevānusṛtyabrūma iti cet? satyam, tathāpi ``yathottaraṃ munīnāṃ prāmāṇyādrūpāśuddhistadavasthaiveti dik|
syādetat, dīdhīvevyorṅitvāt ``ṅkiti ca(pāosūo1-1-5) iti sūtreṇaiva niṣedho'stu kimiha dīrghīvevīgrahaṇena ? maivam, iglakṣaṇayorhi sa niṣedha ityuktamaa| na ca ``aco ñṇiti (pāosūo 7-2-115) iti vṛddhiriglakṣaṇā| kiñca kāryiṇo nimittatve pūrveṇa siddhiḥ sambhavedapi| na ca kāryī nimittatayā''śrīyate `cyavate' `plavate' ityādāvapi guṇaniṣedhāpatteḥ| atra ca liṅgaṃ kuṭādimadhye ``kūṅ śabde (dhāosūo121) ityasya pāṭhaḥ ``sthāṇḍilācchayitari (pāosūo4-2-15) iti nirddeśaśca| yattu prakṛtasūtre dīdhīvevyorgrahaṇamevaitatparibhāṣājñāpakamiti| tanna, aniglakṣaṇavṛddhiniṣedhena caritārthatvāt bhāṣyamate etatsūtrasya pratyakyā syamānanayoktaparibhāṣāyāṃ liṅgāntarasyaivānusarttavyatvācca|
syādetat, yadi kāryī nimittatvena nāśrīyate kathaṃ tarhi `ūrṇunaviṣati' ityatra ``dvirvacane'ci (pāosūo1-1-59) iti nuśabdasya dvitvam, iṣa ityasya ajāditve'pi dvitvaṃ prati kāryimadhye praviṣṭatayā nimittatvāsambhavāt ``sanyaho (pāosūo 6-1-9) iti ṣaṣṭhīmāśritya sannantasya dvitvavidhānāt| anyathā `pratīṣiṣati' iti sano dvitvaṃ na syāt| yattu ``sanyaṅoḥ (pāosūo6-1-9) iti saptamyāśrayaṇo'pisanyaṅorakāroccāraṇasāmarthyād dvitvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti, tanna ditsadhitsādibhyo yaṅutpattipratibandhena ``aco yad (pāosūo3-1-97) iti yatpratyayotpādanena cākāroccāraṇasya caritārthatvāt| anyatha `aririṣati' ityādyasiddheśca| yadi hi tatrāpi sthānivatsyādi so dvirvacane kṛte `ariṣati' iti syāt|
atrocyate---kāryamanubhavanneva kāryī nimittatayā nāśrīyata iti paribhāṣārthaḥ| `aririṣati' ityatra hi ``ajāderdvitīyasya (pāosūo6-1-2) itī risśabde dvittvapravṛttiḥ| tadantargataścesūśabda iti nāsau dvitvaṃ prati nimittaṃ kāryabhāktvāt| `ūrṇunaviṣati' ityatra tu nav‌śabdasya dvitvaṃ prāptaṃ tadanantargataścesśabda iti bhavatyeva nimittaṃ tadbhāvabhāvitāmātreṇeha nimittateti ``sanyaṅoḥ (pāosūo6-1-9) iti sūtre bhāṣyakāraireva sphuṭīkṛtatvāt| tathā ca ``dvirvacane'ci (pāosūo1-1-59) iti sthānivadbhāvānnuśabdasya dvittvamucitameva| yattu ``dvirvacane'ci (pāosūo1-159) iti sūtre `aci kiṃ'? jeghrīyate `dedhmīyate' iti prācāṃ pratyudāharaṇaṃ, tadāpātataḥ, ghrīy dhmīy ityasya dvitatvabhāktayā ``ī ghrādhyamoḥ (pāosūo7-4-31) itītvaṃ prati nimittabhūtasya yaṅo dvittvampratyanimittatvāt| tasmāttatrācītyasya `adhijage' ityetadeva vyāvarttyaṃ bodhyam, ``gāṅliṭi (pāosūo 2-4-49) iti dvilakārakanirddeśamāśrityalāvastāyāmeva gāṅādeśavidhānāt| ajgrahaṇantu jñāpakaṃ rūpasthānivadbhāvasyeti tatratyavārttikamapi `adhijage' ityetasminnudāharaṇe kāryātideśāśrayaṇe'jgrahaṇavaiyarthyaṃ syādityeva yojyamiti dik‌|
yattvasiddhavtsūtre vakṣyate--`atra grahaṇaṃ samānāśrayapratipattyartham' tanna, āśrayatvaṃ sthānitayā nimittatayā vā kathañcidāśrayaṇamātreṇa na tu nimittatayaivetyāgrahaḥ| tena ``śā hau (pāosūo6-4-35) iti śābhāvo herdhitve karttavye 'siddho bhavati| anyathā dhitve heḥ kāryitayā nimittatvābhāvādasiddhatvaṃ na syāt| ata eva samānāśrayamābhīyamābhīye'siddhamityevāhurna tu samānanimittamiti|
idañca sūtraṃ bhāṣyavārttikayoḥ pratyākhyātam| tathāhi, dīdhīvevyauchāndasau dhāt na tu loke prayogārhau| chandasi cānayorguṇodṛśyate--`hotrāya vṛtaḥ kṛpayannadīdhet' `adīdhayurddīśarajñe vṛtāsaḥ' ityādau| na cā yambāhulakena samādheyaḥ, tathā sati niṣedhasūtrānārambhasyaiva lāghavenocitatvāt| tatheṭo|़pi grahaṇaṃ vyartham ``ārddhadātukasyeṭ (pāosūo7-2-35) ityatra hi ``neḍ vaśai kṛti(pāosūo7-2-8) iti sūtrādiḍgrahaṇamanuvarttate| tacceṭo vikārabhāvārtham iṭ iḍeva na tu vikṛta iti vyākyānāt| tato laghūpadhaguṇābāvātsiddhaṃ `kaṇitā śvaḥ' `raṇitā śvaḥ' ityādi| na caivaṃ `pipaṭhīḥ' ityatra dīrgho na syāditi vācyam, tasya ni yamaṃ pratyasiddhatvāt| `apāṭhīt' ityatra savarṇadīrghastu na vāryate ``sijlopa ekādeśe siddho vaktavyaḥ (kāovāo) iti jñāpakāt| yadvā, aṅgādhikāre kriyamāṇo niyama āṅgameva vikāraṃ vyāvarttayati| tena ``rvoḥ (pāosūo8-2-76) iti ``akaḥ savarṇe (pāosūo6-1-101) iti ca dīrgho bhavatyeva| `grahītā' ityatratu ``graho'liṭi (pāosūo 7-2-37) ityārambhasāmarthyāddīrgho bhavatyeva|
idaṃ ntvavaśiṣyate--`pipaṭhīṃṣi brāhmaṇakulāni' ityatraṃ ``sāntamahataḥ saṃyogasya (pāosūo6-4-10) iti dīrghatvaṃ na syāt| siddhatvādāṅgatvāt `tejāṃsi' ityādau caritārthatvācca `piṭhaṭhīḥ' `apāṭhīt' `grahītā' ityādipūrvodāhṛtebhyo'sya vailakṣaṇyāditi| atrāhuḥ--`pipaṭhīṃṣi' iti prayogo'sādhureva| na hyatra numāgamo labhyate allopasya sthānivadbhāvenājhalantatvāt| na caivamajantatvaprayukto num syodevite vācyam, tasya sakārāduttaratra prasaktyā dīrghasya tathāpyapravṛtteḥ, sāntasaṃyogābhāvāt| vastutastvajantatvaprayukto numatra na bhavatyeva sthānivadbāvāsaṃbhavāt| anādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvasya vidhau hisaḥ| na cājantamanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvaṃ, yena tasya numi karttavye'llopaḥ sthānivatsyāt| nanu jhalantatvaprayukto num durvāraḥ| na ca tasminkarttavye sthānivadbhāvaḥ śaṅkyaḥ, ``kvau luptaṃ na stānivit (kāovāo) iti niṣedhāt| antathā sakhīyateḥ kvipi sakhīḥ sutīyateḥ sutīrityādi na syāt, allopasya sthānivadbhāvena yaṇādeśaprasaṅgāt|
atrocyate, ``kvilugupadhātvacaṅparanirhrāsakutveṣūpasaṃkhyānam(kāovāo) iti tāvadvārttikaśariram| tatrakvītyaṃśo yadyapi dvedhā vyākhyāsyatekvau luptaṃ na sthānivaditi, `kvau vidhimprati na sthānivaditi ca| devayateḥ kvipi `dayūḥ' ityāderanyataravyākhyānāśrayaṇena siddhāvapi sakhīyateḥ sakhīrityasyādyavyākhyānaṃ vinā asiddheḥ, lavamācakṣāṇo `lauḥ' ityasya dvitīyavyākhyānaṃ vinā'siddheśca, tatāpi `kvau vidhiṃ prati' iti dvitīyavyākhyānameva sārvatrikam| ``kvauluptam iti tukvācitkaṃ ``khyatyāt(pāosūo6-1-112) ityatra ``maparyantasya(pāosūo7-2-91) ityatra ca bhāṣyādāvāśritaṃ na tu sārvatrikam| atra ceḍgrahaṇapratyākhyānaparamatratyabhāṣyameva pramāṇam| kathamanyathā `pipaṭhīṃṣi' ityādau dīrghasyeṣṭatve sūtrarītyā ca tallābhe iḍgrahaṇaṃ pratyācakṣīta| tasmāt `pipaṭhiṣi brāhmaṇakulāni' ityeva rūpaṃ bhavatīti sthitam|
7lonantarāḥ saṃyogaḥ (pāosūo1-1-7)
ajbhiravyavahitā halaḥ saṃyogasaṃjñā syuḥ| saṃjñāpradeśāḥ ``saṃyogāntasya (pāosūo8-2-23) ityevamādayaḥ| ihāntaraśabdena chidravācinā bahuvrīhau niśchidrā ityarthalābhādavagrahe saṃjñayā na bhāvyam| ādheyapradhānenāntaretyavyayena saha bahuvrīhau ttvādeyaniṣedhapratīteravagrahe'pi bhāvyameva saṃjñāyā| na hi tatrāntarā madhye kiñcidasti kintu madhyamātraṃ varttate `` mātrā hasvastāvadavagrahantaram (ṛoprāo 1-6) iti prātiśākhyabalena tatra mātrākālāvasānābhyupagamāt| yattu prātiśākhyāntaram--``addharmatrau'vagraha iti, tattu sarvatra saṃhitāyāmarddhamātrākālasya sattvāttato'tiriko'rddhabātrākālo'vagrahe'stītyevaṃparam| ataḥ prātiśākyayoravirodhaḥ| tadiha kataraḥ pakṣo grāhya iti cet? ubhayathā'pyadoṣa iti bhāṣyakārāḥ| nanu `apsu' ityādau satyāṃ saṃyogasaṃjñāyāṃ ``saṃyoge guru (pāosūo 1-4-10) iti gurutvād ``guroranṛtaḥ (pāosūo8-2-86) iti plutena bhāvyaṃ na tvanyatheti mahānphale viśeṣaḥ| tatkayaṃ pakṣadvayābhyupagama iti cet? na, `apsu' ityasyādhikaraṇavṛrtterdūrāddhūtasambandhābhāvāt| ``vicāryamāṇānām (pāosūo8-2-97) ityādau tu ``vākyasya ṭe (pāosūo 8-2-82) ityanuvarttate na tu ``guroranṛtaḥ (pāo sūo8-2-86) iti| nanu `apsu bhavo'psavyaḥ', digādiṣu pāṭhādyat pāṭhādyat ``apo yoniyanmatuṣu ca (kāovāo) ita saptamyā aluk| tataḥ sambuddhau sambuddhau `he apsavya' ityatra syādeva phalabheda iti cet?
atrāhuḥ naivaṃ vidhe viṣaye'vagrahaṃ padakārāḥ kurvantīti| atra ca sampradāya eva śaraṇamiti bodhyam| uktañcaitat--`gobhyo gātuṃ' `gobhirmadāya' `citraidrājā rājakā idanyake' ityādau gobhyo gobhiḥ rājakā ityādīnāṃ satyapi padanve'vagrahākarṇāt| ``īyivāṃsamatisridhaḥ ityādāvīyivāṃsamiti vināpi padasaṃjñāṃ kvasoḥ pūrvamiḍāgamānte'vagra hakarāṇācca| etena `sisāsan' `ukthaśasaḥ' `ririṣaḥ' ityādau padakāle sattvahrasvatvādayopi vyākhyātāḥ| yattu ``māno mahāntam(ṛosaṃo) iti mantre vedabhāṣyakārairuktam--``chāndasaḥ padakālīno hrasvaḥ iti, tadapi saṃpradāyamātraparatayā kathaṃ cinneyam| `na lakṣaṇena padakārāḥ' iti bhāṣye, ``padavibhāgaḥ pauruṣeyaḥ iti kaiyaṭādibhiruktatvāditi dik|
kathaṃ tarhi tatratatrāvagrahe viśeṣa ityucyate iti cet? avāntarapadatve satyavagrahaḥ kriyate ityutsargamabhipretyeti gṛhāṇa| ``apsuyonirvā aśvaḥ ityādāvapi suśabdātpūrvaṃ nāstyavagrahaḥ, avāntarapadasaṃjñānekatve uttarakālapravṛttikayā'vagraha iti vaidikasampradāyāt| ata eva `mayūraromabhiḥ' ityatra bhisaḥ pūrvamavagrahaḥ| `namauktibhiḥ' ityatrāpyevam| ``indraprāṇaḥ puraeteva ityatra cevaśabdātprāgiti dik|

jātau cedaṃ bahuvacanaṃ hala iti ``jātyākhyāyāmekasmin(pāosūo 1-2-58) iti vacanāt| tena dvayorapi saṃyogasaṃjñā bhavati| ataḥ `śikṣā' ityādau ``gurośca halaḥ (pāosūo3-3-103) ityapratyayaḥ sidhyati| yatra tu bahavo halaḥ saṃśliṣṭāstatra dvayorbahūnāṃ vā viśeṣeṇasaṃjñā| na caikājdvirvacananyāyena samudāyasyaiva syāditi vācyam, vaiṣamyāt| tathāhi, dvirvacanaṃ samudāyāvayavaikācoryugapatkarttumaśakyam| saṃjñā tu śakyā| tathā samudāye dvirukte'vayavā api dviruktā bhavanti ``vṛkṣaḥ pracalansahāvayavaiḥ pracalati iti nyāyāt| iha tu samudāye pravṛttayā sayogasaṃjñayā nāvayavānāṃ tatkāryasiddhiḥ| ato'viśeṣeṇa dvayorbahūnāṃ ca saṃjñeti sthitam| yadi tu bahūnāmeva syāttarhi `saṃsvaryate' ityatra ``guṇorti (pāosūo7-4-29) iti guṇo na syāt| `gomānkaroti' ityatra saṃyogāntalopo na syāt| `nirglānaḥ' ityādau niṣṭhānatvaṃ na syāditi dik|

mukhanāsikāvacano'nunāsikaḥ (pāosūo1-1-8)|

bhāṣyakaiyaṭayostu ucyate'neneti vacanam| karaṇe lyuṭ, sāmānye napuṃsakam `śakyaṃca kṣudapahantum' itivat, ``tena tulyaṃ kriyā cet (pāosūo5-1-115) ``saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ (pāosūo4-2-16) itivacca| idañca ``viśeṣaṇānāñcājāteḥ (pāosūo1-2-16) ityatra vakṣyamāṇena padasaṃskārapakṣe guṇavacanānāmityādi vācanikamityanena saha yathā na virudhyate, tathā tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ| tato mukhanāsikā vacanaṃ yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| mukheti kim? yamānusvārāṇāmevamā bhūditi bhāṣyam| tatra vargeṣvāditaścaturṇāṃ pañcame pare tanmadhye pūrvavarṇasamānākāraṃ varṇāntaraṃ prātiśākhyeṣvāgamatvena vihitaṃ tadyamasaṃjñam| yama iva yamaḥ, yamau hi loke prāyeṇa samānākārau bhavataḥ| yathā`palikrakrīḥ' `cakhkhanatuḥ' `agragniḥ' `aghraghnan' ityatra kakhagagha ityebhyaḥ parabhāge tattatsadṛśo yamāgamaḥ| yaktuktaṃ vivaraṇe ``vargapañcamayuktāḥ prathamādayo yamāḥ iti| taccintyam, ayogavāhatvapratipādakena hayavaraṭsūtrasthabhāṣyeṇa saha virodhāt, kevalanāsikyatvapareṇa yamānusvārāṇāmeveti bhāṣyeṇa saha virodhācca| yathedaṃ bhāṣyaṃ na kevalanāsikyatvaparaṃ kintu ām̐ ityādīnāṃ bhāgamātraṃ nāsikyaṃ, yamānusvārāṇāṃ tu mukhanāsikyatve'pi prāsādavāsinyāyena nāsikyatvamapyasti, na tu tadīyaṃ bhāgamātraṃ tathetyevaṃparaṃ; tathāpyāditaścaturṇāṃ tadasambhava eva| kiñcaivaṃ ``naiva doṣo naiva prayojanam iti ta duttarabhāṣyagranthavirodhaḥ `yad ghnanti' ityādau ``yaronunāsike (pāosūo8-4-45) ityasya pravṛttyāpattyā tvatpakṣe doṣasyodbhaṭatvāt| ata eva prātiśākhye ``sparśā yamānananunāsikāḥ svānpareṣu svarśeṣvanunāsikeṣu (ṛoprāo6-29) ityupakrambha `pradodhuvacchmaśruṣu' ityatra yamaṃ niṣeddhumārabdhe ``na sparśasyoṣmaprakṛteḥ pa(1)rastādyamāpattim (ṛoprāo 6-30) iti sūtre parastācchabdaḥ prayuktaḥ| ``yamaḥ prakṛtyaiva sadṛk ``śrutirvā ya mena mukhyāsti samānakāle (ṛoprāo 6-33) ityādisūtrāntareṣvapi spaṣṭhameva yamasya varṇāntaratvam| tathā nāradiyaśikṣāyāmapi---
