atra hi yamānāṃ pṛthaggaṇanātspaṣṭameva varṇāntaratvam| gaṇanā tvittham--aiuṛ iti caturṇāṃ hrasvadīrghaplutabhedāttraividhye dvādaśa, lṛkāra ekaḥ ecāṃ dīrghapsutabhedādaṣṭau, itthaṃ svarā ekaviṃśatiḥ| sparśāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ| yaralavaśaṣasahetyaṣṭau| yamāścatvāraḥ prathamayamadvitīyayamādibhedena vibhajanāt| ata eva kuṃ khuṃ guṃ ghuṃ iti yamacatuṣṭayaṃ nyāsādāvudāhṛtam| `kacaṭatapāḥ kaḥ' `khachaṭhathaphāḥ khuḥ' ityādiparibhāṣāmāśritya tattaduttarasyāśarīrasyāpi kathañcitpradarśanatātpararyakaṃ cedamiti dhyeyam| anusvāravisarga* ka* pāścātvāraḥ, duspṛṣṭaśca bahvṛcānāṃ prasiddhaḥ īle voleheti| itthaṃ triṣaṣṭiḥ| lṛkārasya plutasambhavāttena saha catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ| tadetaduktaṃ `sambhavataḥ' iti|
hayavaraṭsūtre kṣīrodakāro'pyāha--``vargāntyenantyātpare tayormadhyavarttī nāsikāsthāno yama iti| yattu kaścidāha--yamā ādeśāḥ| na ca teṣāmānunāsikyapakṣe `tajjñaḥ' `tad ghnanti' ityādau ``yaro'nunāsike(pāosūo8-4-45) ityanunāsikādeśāpattyā ``naiva doṣo naiva prayojanam iti bhāṣyaṃ virudhyeteti vācyam, vyavasthitavibhāṣāśrayaṇāditi| tattuccham, prāguktaprātiśākhyanāradīyaśikṣādisakalagranthavirodhena ādeśapakṣasya garbhasrāveṇaiva gatatvāt, vyavastitavibhāṣākalpanasya nirmūlatvācca| etena etadīyalekhanaprāmāṇyabhrameṇa ``anupasargāt jñaḥ (pāosūo1-3-76) ityādau cavargābhāva dṛḍhīkṛtya ścutvābhāvaṃ sādhayantastadanugāmino'pi parastā, nāradena `yajñaḥ' ityatra jakāradvayasya sphuṭamabhidānāt ``nasyaitasya trayasyāsthnāmajñāṃ parvaṇāmiti ityāraṇyakaprayoga iva sajātīyasamabhivyāhārānna spaṣṭo bheda iti tu prasiddhaṃ śāstra| ata eva ``na vyañjanaparasyaikasyānekasya vā viśeṣosti iti bhāṣyam| vyañjanātparasya vyañjanaṃ paraṃ yasyetyevambhūtasya ca durlakṣo bhedābhedavibhāga ityevamparatayā tatratatra kaiyaṭena vyākhyātam| ata eva ca bahuṣu pustakeṣu ``tajjñāpayatyācāryaḥ iti bhāṣyagranthaḥ| ``anupasargāt (pāosūo1-3-76) iti sūtre'pi keṣāñcit ścutvapāṭhaḥ sammata eva| pāṭhāntaraṃ tu ``alpāctaram(pāosūo2-2-34) `āluc' `tadasahane' itivatsautratvādasaṃhitayā vā samādheyāmiti dik|
tadetatsakalamabhidhāya prakriyāprakāśe gurucaraṇairuktam--``tajjñānamityādau tu śyutvaṃ bhavatyeva| yamaśca mukhanāsikyaḥ kevalanāsikāsthāno veti matadvayam ``nāsikyā nāsikāsthānāḥ mukhanāsikyā vā iti taittirīyaprātiśākhyāt| anunāsikaviṣaye tu darśanatrayam--kṛtsno varṇo mukhena nāsikayā coccāryata ityekam, pūrvo bhāgo mukhena paronāsikayeti dvitīyaṃ, tadvaiparītyāttṛtīyam| dvitīyatṛtīyayorbhāgamātrasya nāsikyatve'pi taduparāgādbhāgāntaramapi tadvadavabhāsate| tatā ca nāsikānvayasya bhāgamātraviṣayatayā nāsikāvacanagrahaṇena mukhanāsikyo varṇau na gṛtdyeta| kintu bhataviśeṣe kevalanāsikāstānatayā yamādaya eva gṛhyeran| tataśca vidhipradeśe ``aṅo'nunāsikaḥ (pāosūo6-1-126) ityādau yamānusvārā eva vidhīyeran| ``viḍvanoranunāsikasyāt (pāosūo6-4-42) ityādau tvanuvāde apratipattireva syādityudāhṛtabhāṣyaśayaḥ| tasmāddarśanadvaye mukhapadopādānaṃ sārthakamiti sthitam| prathachamadarśane tu prāsādavasinyāyāśrayaṇeno bhayavacanānāmapi sthitam| prathamadarśane tu prāsādavāsinyāyāśrayaṇenobhayavacanānāmapi siddhāsaṃjñā| āntaratamyācca vidhipradeśeṣu yamānusvārāṇāmapravṛttiḥ| tathāca mukhaśabdopādānaṃ cana karttavyamiti bhāṣye sthitam| mukhavacana ityevokte tu kacaṭatapādīnāmapi syāt| tataśca `śaktaḥ' ityatra kalopaḥ syāt| `pakkaḥ' ityatra cakāralopaḥ syāt| `taptam' ityatra palopaḥ syāt| `odanapag' ityādau ``anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ (pāosūo6-4-15) iti dīrghaḥ syāt| anu paścānnāsikā vyāpriyate yasminnāsikāyāḥ paścānmukhaṃ vyāpriyate yasminnati vā'nvarthasaṃjñeyam| tena nāsikāvyā pārastha bhāgaviṣayakatvasūcanātprāsādavāsinyāyasyāviṣayo'yamiti dhvanitam| etacca sūtraṃ pratyākhyātuṃ śakyam| pradeśavākyeṣveva prāguktasya nāsikāmanugata ityasya vā yogasyāśrayaṇena sakaleṣṭasiddiriti dik|
lulyāsyaprayatnaṃ savarṇam (pāosūo1-1-9)| tālvādisthānamābhyantaraprayatnaścatyubhayaṃ yasya varṇasya yena varṇena saha samānaṃ sa tasya savarṇo bodhyaḥ| saṃjñāpradeśāḥ ``akaḥ savraṇe dīrghaḥ (pāosūo6-1-101) ityādayaḥ| yadyapi tulayā samminaṃ tulyamityavayavārthaḥ ``nauvayodharmaviṣamūlamūlasītātulābhyastāryatulyaprāpyavadhyānāmyasamasamitasammiteṣa (pāosūo4-4-7) iti sūtreṇa tulāśabdātsammite yadvidhānāt, tathāpyayaṃ sadṛśamātre rūḍhaḥ śabdaḥ| asyanti uccārayanti anena varṇānityāsyam| ``asu kṣepaṇe (dio pāo1210) bāhulakātkaraṇaṃ ṇyat| yadvā, āsyandate annaṃ prāpya dravībhavatītyāsyam| ``anyeṣvapi(pāosūo3-2-101) iti ḍapratyayaḥ| athavā `annena dravīkriyate ityāsyam' antarbāvitaṇyartātkarmaṇi ḍaḥ `paritaḥ khātā parikhā' itivat| tatra bhavamāsyaṃ tālvādistānam| ``śarīrāvayavādyat (pāosūo5-1-6)| ``yasya (pāosūo 6-4-148) itilope ``halo yamām (pāosūo8-4-6) iti yalopaḥ na cāllopasya sthānivadbhāvaḥ śaṅkyaḥ, yalope karttavye tanniṣedhāt| prakṛṣṭo yatnaḥ prayatnaḥ| prakarṣaścābhyantaratvam| prārambhe yatno vā prayatnaḥ| ābhyantaraprayatnā hi varṇaprārambhakāla eva vyāpriyante| tatā ca tulyau sthānaprayatnau yasyeti dvandvagarbhau bahuvrīhiḥ| yadvā, tulyaḥ āsye prayatno yeṣāmiti tripado bahuvrīhiḥ| āsye iti viśeṣaṇādbāhyaprayatnavyudāsaḥ| āsya ityekatvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ, tadvitāntāsyaśabdopādānasāmarthyāt| tena bhinnasthānānāmarthād vyudāsaḥ| yadvā, tulyaḥ āsye tulyāsyaḥ, mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsādhuḥ. tulyāsyaḥ prayatnā yasyeti vigrahaḥ|yadvā, āsye prayatnaḥ āsyaprayatnaḥ, sa tulyo yasyeti| ekatvavivakṣādikaṃ prāgvat| tadevaṃ samāsacatuṣṭayamapi bhāṣye sthaitam--``dvandvagarbho bahuvrīhiḥ, tripado vā, pūrvabhāge tatpuruṣagarbhaḥ taduttarabhāge vā iti|
tulyaśabdasya sambandhaiśabdatvācca yena saha tulyasthānaprayatnaṃ tena saha savarṇamiti labhyate| nahi mātā pūjyetyuktaṃ svasutamātā bhāryā pūjyate kintu pūjakasyaiva māteti dik|
tulyasthānamiti kim? tulyaprayatnānāmapi kacaṭatapānāṃ mā bhūta|
tena `tarptā' ityatra ``jharo jhari (pāosūo8-4-65) iti pakāralopo na bhavati| yatnagrahaṇaṃ kim? cakāraśakārayormā bhūt| sati hi sāvarṇye `vāk ścyotati' ityatra cakāraśakārayormā bhūt| sati hi sāvarṇye `vāk ścyotati' ityatra śakāralopaḥ syāt| ābhyantaratvaviśeṣaṇamapyetadarthameva| asti hi śvāsāghoṣavivārākhyabāhyaprayatnasāmyaṃ caśayorapi| nanu alpaprāṇatvamahāprāṇatvakṛto bhedo'stīti cet? kiṃ tataḥ| nahi sarvaprayatnasāmyaṃ vivakṣituṃ śakyam `aṅkitaḥ' ityādyasiddhaiprasaṅgāt, kaṅayorapi bāhyaprayatnabhedāt| sarvaprayatnasāmyaṃ hisvasya svenaivāyāti na tu pareṇa| tathā ca savarṇasaṃjñāpraṇayanamapi vyarthaṃ syāt, ``aṇudittulyāsyaprayatnasya ityuktau sarvasāmañjasyāt| ``jharo jhari (pāosūo 8-4-65) ityuktaṃ ``halo yamāṃ yami (pāosūo8-4-64) ityatreva yathāsaṃkhyapravṛttyā `māhātmyam' ityādau makārasyeva `śiṇḍhi' ityādau ḍhakārasyāpi lopo na syāditi hi siddhānte savarṇagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| sa cāvyāptidoṣo yāvatprayatnasāmyavivakṣāyāṃ tadavastha eva syāt| atha yāvadbāhyasāmyaṃ yāvadābhyantarasāmyaṃ vāvivakṣyeta evamapi `madhuliṭstānam' ityatra ``jharojhari (pāosūo8-4-65) iti salopaḥ syāt, sakārathakārayoḥ śvāsāghoṣavivāramahāprāṇatvarūpabāhyaprayatnacatuṣṭayenāpi sāmyāt|
atha sthānaprayatnavivekaḥ--akuhavisarjanīyāḥ kaṇṭhyāḥ| icuvaśāstālavyāḥ| ṛṭuraṣā sūrddhanyāḥ| lṛtulasā dantyāḥ| upūṣadhmānīyā oṣṭhyāḥ| eai kaṇṭhyatālavyau| oau kaṇṭhyoṣṭhyau| vakāro dantyoṣṭhya| jivhāmūlīyo jivhāmūlasthānaḥ| anusvāro nāsikyaḥ|
yatno dvidhā---ābhyantaro vavāhyaśca| tatrābhyantaraścaturddhā--spṛṣṭāta īṣatspṛṣṭatā vivṛtatā saṃvṛtatā ceti| tatra spapṛtī sparśānām| īṣatspṛṣṭatā antasthānām| hrasvasyāvarṇasya prayoge saṃvṛtatā| śāstrīye kārye tu vivṛtatā pratijñāyate iti aiuṇsūtre pratipāditam| ``yvṛtaḥ saṃvṛtāḥ ititu prātiśākhyoktatvānna sarvasādhāraṇam| ūṣmaṇāṃ svarāṇāñca vivṛtatā| eṣāṃ caturṇāmapyābhyantaratvaṃ varṇotpattiprāgbhāvitvāt| tathā hi nābhipradeśātprayatnapreritāṃ vāyuḥ prāṇo nāma ūrdhvamākrāmannuraḥ prabhṛtīni sthānānyāhā**| tato varṇasya tadabhivyañjakadhvanarvā utpattiḥ| tatretpatteḥ prāgyadā jivhāgropāgramadhyamūlāni tattadvarṇotpāttistānaṃ tālvādi samyak spṛśanti tadā spṛṣṭatā| īṣadyadā spūśanti tadā īṣatspṛṣṭatā| samīpāvastānamātre saṃvṛtatā| dūratve vivṛtatā| ata eva icuyaśānāṃ tālavyatvāviśeṣe'pi tālusthānena sahajivhāgrādīnāṃ cavargauccāraṇe karttavye samyak sparśaḥ, yakāre īṣat svarśaḥ, śakārekārayostu dūrevasthitirityādyanubhavaṃ śikṣākāroktiṃ cānusṛtya vivecanīyam|
bhāṣyakārāstu ``nājjñalau (pāosūo1-1-20) ityasya pratyākyānāvasare ūṣmaṇāṃ svarāṇāṃ ca īṣadvivṛtatvaṃ vivṛtatvaṃ ceti vailakṣaṇyaṃ vakṣyanti| tadapyanubhavānusāryeveti sahṛdayairākalanīyam|
bāhyāḥ prayatnāḥ punarekādaśa--vivāraḥ saṃvāraḥ śvāso nādo ghoṣo'ghoṣo'lpaprāṇo mahāprāṇa udātto'nudāttaḥ svaritaśceti| ete na varṇotpatteḥ paścānmūrdhni pratihate nivṛtte prāṇākhye vāyau utpadyante| ata ekabāhya ityucyante| galabilasya saṅkocātsaṃvāraḥ| tasyaiva vikāsādvivāraḥ| etau ca saṃvṛtavivṛtattvarūpābhyāmābhyantarābhyāṃ bhinnāveva| tayoḥ samīpadurāvastānātmakatvādittyavadheyam| tatra ``vargāṇāṃ prathamadvitīyāḥ śaṣasavisarjanīyajivhāmūlīyopadhmānīyā yamau ca prathamadvitīyau vivṛtakaṇṭha
āḥ śvāsānupradānāṃ aghoṣāḥ, varṇayamānāṃ prathame alpaprāṇāḥ, itare sarve mahāprāṇāḥ, vargāṇāṃ tṛtīyacaturthā antasthā hakārānusvārau yamau ca tṛtīyacaturthau saṃvṛtakaṇṭhānādānupradānā dhoṣavanto vargāṇāṃ tṛtīyā antasthāścālpaprāṇāḥ, yathātṛtīyāstathā pañcamā ānunāsikyameṣāmaparo guṇaḥ iti śikṣāsu sthitm| saṃgrahaśva---
khayāṃ yamāḥ śaya*ka* visargaḥ śara eva ca|
ete śvāsānupradānā aghoṣāśca vivṛṇvate ||
kaṇṭhamanye tu ghoṣāḥ syuḥ saṃvṛtā nādabhāginaḥ|
ayugmā vargayamagā yaṇaścālpāsavaḥ smṛtāḥ ||
yadyapyete bāhyāḥ prayatnāḥ savarṇasaṃjñāyāpranupayuktāstathāpyantaratamatvaparīkṣāyāmupayokṣyante itīha ābhyantaratvaviśeṣaṇavyāvarttyatayā vyutpāditāḥ|
nanviha sūtre payatnagrahaṇaṃ vyartha, taddhitāntāsyaśabdabalādeva tālvādisthānasya prayatnasya ca lābhāditi cet? na, pratyekaṃ vyāpāranirāsārthamubhayorūpādānāt| tena sthānapparayatnobhayasāmye satyeva saṃjñā na tvanyatarasāmye'pi| evaṃ sthite yatphalitaṃ tatspaṣṭatvārthamupanyasyate| aṣṭādaśa avarṇāḥ parasparaṃ savarṇāḥ, evamivarṇovarṇau| ṛkārā aṣṭādaśa, lṛvarṇāstu dvādaśeti triśanmithaḥ savarṇāḥ, lṛvarṇasya dīrghī na santītyuktatvāt ṛlṛvarṇayormithaḥ sāvarṇyasyopasaṃkhyānācca| ecastu dvādaśa mithaḥ savarṇāḥ, na tu ekāraikārau okāraukārau vā mithaḥsavarṇau| yathā caitattathā``aiuṇ (māosūo1) ityatraiva pratipāditam| akāreṇāpyecāṃ na sāvarṇyaṃ prayatnabhedāditi ihaiva sūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭam| ataeva edaitorapi śakāreṇa na sāvarṇyamititeṣāṃ``nājjñalau (pāosūo1-1-110) iti sūtre udāharaṇatvaṃ nāsti| na cātra sthānabhedena nirvāhaḥ ecāmakāreṇa saha kaṇṭhasthānasāmyāt, edaitauḥ śakāreṇa saha tālusthānasāmyāt| nahi yātatsthānasāmyaṃ vivakṣitam, ñamaṅapānānaṃ svavargyaiḥ saha asāvarṇyāpatteḥ yavalānāṃ sānunāsikaniranunāsikānāmasāvarṇyāpatteśca| nahi niranunāsikānāmapi nāsikāsthānam, yena sarvasāmayaṃ syāt| nanu taddhitāntāsyaśabdabalāttālvādisāmyamātraṃ labhyate| oṣṭhātprabhṛti prākkākalakāddhi āsyamaa| kākalakaṃ ca grīvāyā unnatatapradeśaḥ yaṃ kaṇṭhamaṇirityācakṣate| tatkathaṃ nāsikāstānabhedenāsavarṇatvamāpādyate iti cet? nāsikā hi na bāhāyā varṇotpattau nimittam, tatra jihvāgrādivyāpāravirahāt kintu antarāsye vitataṃ carmāsti paṇavacarmavat, tatsaṃbaddhorekhāviśeṣo nāsikā, savai varṇotpattau nimittamiti siddhāntāt| tasyāśca oṣṭhādibhyo'viśeṣāt vargyovargyoṇa savarṇaḥ tulyāsyaprayatnatvāt| rephasya repha eva savarṇaḥ, evamūṣmaṇāmapi ūṣmāṇa eva savarṇā na tvanye, tulyāsyaprayatnatvābhāvāt| śaṣasahānāṃyathākramam ikāraṛkāralṛkārākārāḥ sūtrakāramate yadyapi tulyāsyaprayatnāstathāpi na savarṇāḥ ``nājjñalau' (pāosūo1-1-110) iti niṣedhāt| bhāṣyakāramate tu prayatnabheda eveti vakṣyate| iha sthānabhedādaprāptāṃ savarṇasaṃjñāṃ vidhātuṃ vārttikmārabhyate---``ṛkāralṛkārayoḥ savarṇavidhiḥ(kāovāo)iti| hotṛlṛkāraḥ hotṝkāraḥ| ubhayāntaratamaśca dīrgho na sambhavatīti pariśeṣādṛkāraḥ|
syādetat, ``akaḥ savarṇedīrghaḥ (pāosūo6-1-101) ityatra ``ṛti ṛvā vacanaṃ ``lṛti lṛ vā vacanamiti vakṣyati| tasyāyamarthaḥ--akaḥ savarṇe ṛti pare pūrvaparayoṛḥ sthāne vā ṛ kaayamādeśo bhavati| dvimātro'yam| madhye dvau rephau, tayorakā mātrā, abhito'jbhaktaṃraparā| īṣatspṛṣṭaścāyam| tatra prayatnabhedādṛkāreṇāgrahaṇādanactvāddīrghasaṃjñāyā abhāvādaprāpto'yaṃ vidhīyate ``lṛti lṛ vā (kāovāo) iti| ayamapi dvimātraḥ, īṣatspṛṣṭaśca| madhye dvau lakārau tayorekā mātrā, abhitojbhakteraparā| pūrvavadaprāpto vidhīyate| tatra vāvacanamiti vāśabdo dīrghasamuccayārtho bhaviṣyati|
vā syādvikalpopamayorevārthe'vi samuccaye|
ityabhidhānāt tenāprāptaeva dīrgho bhaviṣyati| tatkiṃ savarṇasaṃjñayā? nanu``lṛti lṛvā ityatra savarṇe ityanuvarttate na vā? ādye `hotṛlṛkāra' ityatra ṛlṛvarṇayoḥ savarṇasaṃjñāvidhānāṃ vinā neṣṭasiddhiḥ, antye`dadhlṛkāro' `madhlṛkāra' ityādāvatiprasaṅga iti cet? na , prathamavārttike ``ṛti ityapanīya `ṛtaḥ' iti pañcamyantapāṭhenaiva sarvasāmañjasyāt| savarṇa iti ca pūrvavārttike'nuvarttate| tena `dhāttraṃśaḥ' ityādau nātiprasaṅgaḥ| dvitīyavārttike tu savarṇa iti nivṛttam| ṛta ityanuvarttate| tasmād ``akaḥ savarṇe (pāosūo6-1-101) ityatrāvaśyakarttavyena vacanadvayenaiva sakalanirvāhādṛkāralṛkārayoḥ savarṇavidhairitīhatyaṃ vārtikaṃ vyarthamiti|
maivam, ihatyamekaṃ vārttikamāśritya ṣāṣṭhavacanadvayapratyākhyānasyaiva nyāyyatvāt| tathāhi, tadvacanadvayaṃ kurvatā'pi rephadvayalakāradvayagarbhayo stadvideyayoractvaṃ tāvadeṣṭavyam| tannirvāhārthaṃ varṇasamāmnāye tau paṭhanīyau| anyathā hi vidhānamātramanayoḥ syānna tvackāryaṃ plutaḥ| tadvidhāne hi ``acaśca (pāosūo1-2-28) iti paribhāṣayā `acaḥ' ityupatiṣṭhate| nanu īṣatspṛṣṭasyānactvānmā bhūt plutaḥ vivṛtasya tu ṛkārasyāctvena plutaḥ siddha eveti cet? satyam| vivṛtaḥplutaḥ siddhaḥ, īṣatspṛṣṭau tu plutau rephadvayalakāradvayagarbhau na sidhyataḥ| ata evācsaṃjñāmātreṇāpi na nistāraḥ, grahaṇakaśāstrapravṛttestāvanmātreṇānirvāhāt kinttvaṇsu pāṭha eva karttavya ityuktam| sati tvaṇsu pāṭhaṃ nābhyāṃ trimātrayorapi grahaṇatplutasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ pakṣe īṣatspṛṣṭau plutau bhavataḥ| evaṃ stite ṣāṣṭhaṃ vacanadvayaṃ mā'stu, tadvidheyayorapi dīrghatayā ``akaḥ savarṇe (pāosūo 6-1-101) ityanenaiva siddheḥ| nanu `sthānentaratamaparibhāṣayā vivṛtasya sthāninovivṛtāveva dīrghau syātāṃ na tvīṣatspṛṣṭāviti cet? na, rephadvayayukta evādeśaḥ `susaddaśaḥ' ityapi hi sambhavati| tathā ca kiṃ rephadvayayuktatvamādarttavyaṃ, kiṃ vā vivṛtatvamityatra vinigamakābhāvena paryāyeṇābhayapravṛttau siṣādhayiṣitasya rūpadvayasya nirvāhāt| lṛkāre'pi kadācidṛkārāntaratamo vivṛtadīrghaḥ kadācid lṛkārāntaratamo lakāradvayagarbha īṣatspṛṣṭa iti sakaleṣṭasiddheḥ| tadevaṃ ṣāṣṭhaṃ vacanadvayaṃ na karttavyamiti sthitam|
nanu tadevāstu saṃjñāvidhānaṃ tu māstviti cet? na, vacanadvayārambe goravasya spaṣṭatvāt| kiñca, saṃjñābhāve ``ṛtyakaḥ (pāosūo6-2-128) ``upasargādṛti (pāosūo6-1-92) ``uraṇraparaḥ (pāosūo1-1-51) ityādiṣu ṛkāreṇa lṛkāragrahaṇaṃ na syāt| na caivaṃ siddhānte'pi `tavalkāraḥ' ityādau raparatvaprasaṅgaḥ rapratyāhāraparatvasya vakṣyamāṇatayā laparatvasiddheḥ| ṛditāmlṛditāṃ ca dhātūnāmanubandhakāryeṣu saṅkarastu na bhavati dhātūpadeśe pṛthaganubandhakaraṇasāmarthyāt, vidhivākyoṣvapi pṛthaganuvādasāmarthyāt| anyathā hi sarvān ṛdita eva lṛdita eva vā paṭhitvā vidāvapi tenaiva rūpeṇānuvadat| sambhavatyaikarūpye verūpyāśrayaṇāyogāt|
nājjñalau (pāosūo1-1-10)| ajjñalau mithaḥ savarṇau na staḥ. akārahakārayorikāraśakārayo ṛkāraṣakārayorlṛkārasakārayośceti sthalacatuṣṭaye pūrvasūtreṇa prāptaṃ sāvarṇyamanena niṣidyate| tena `ānaḍuhaṃ carma' `vaipāśo matsyaḥ' ityatra ``anyathā hi `yasya' ityanena dīrghāṇāmiva ikāraśakārayorapi grahaṇaṃ syāt| tathā `daṇḍahastaḥ' `dadhiśītaṃ' `kartṛṣaṭkam' ityādau savarṇadīrghaḥ syāt| tathā `daṇḍahastaḥ' `daṇḍahastaḥ' `kartṛṣaṭkam' ityādau savarṇadīrghaḥ syāt| `dadhisāndram' ityaudau yaṇādeśaśca syāt| ihājjhalau kasyāpi na savarṇau sta iti vākyārtho na grāhyaḥ saṃjñārambhavaiyarthyāpatteḥ| vihitapratiṣiddhatvena viklape tu lāghavāt ``tulyāsyaprayatnaṃ vā ityeva sūtrayet| nāpyacāmajbhirhalāṃ halbhiḥ sāvarṇyaṃ niṣidhyate| ``nājjñalau (pāosūo2-2-20) ityatraiva sūtre savarṇadīrghasya ``jhayo haḥ (pāosūo8-4-62) iti pūrvasavarṇādeśasya ca nirddeśāt| nanu jhalavātra nirddiṣṭo na tu hal, tāvataiveṣṭasiddhoriti cettarhi dīrgārnirddeśa eva jñāpako'stu| tena hyacāmajbhiḥ sāvarṇyamaniṣiddhamiti jñāpite pariśeṣādajjñalormitho niṣedha eva paryavasyati,| ``jharo jhari savarṇo (pāosūo8-4-65) iti jñāpakācca| yattu nāṇśalāvityeva kuto na sūtritamiti| tanna, `kartṛṣaṭkaṃ' `dadhisāndram' ityādyasiddhyāpatteḥ, ṛlṛkā*********; grahaṇakasūtrātirikte pūrva evāṇityuktatvāt| astu ********, tathāpyajapekṣayā vyaktigauravameva syādityajgrahaṇamapanīyāṇgrahaṇaṃ kriyatāmiti śaṅkāyā garbhāyā garbhasrāveṇaiva gatārthatvāt| śalaṃśe tu vyaktilāghave satyapi varṇoccāraṇe viśeṣo nāstītyevottaram| vastutastu ``nākśalau ityeva sūtrayitumucitam|
syādetat śārāṃ śarbhirapi sāvarṇyaṃ niṣiddhyeta| te hīkārādibhirgṛhītatvādacsaṃjñakāḥ halpūpadeśāddhalaśca| na cāsmādeva niṣedhādikārādayo na savarṇā iti vācyam, etadbākyārthabodhātprāk padārthopastiterāvaśyakatayā tasyāmavasthāyāmikārādibhiḥ śarāmupasthāpanasya durvāratvāt| tataśca `paraśśatāḥ' `rāmaṣṣaṣṭhaḥ' `yaśassāram' ityādau ``jharo jhari (pāosūo8-4-65) ityasya pravṛttirna syāt| tataścaikekatra śartrayaṃ śrūyeta| iṣyate tu dvayam| tathā ca pūrvapakṣavārttikam--``ajjhaloḥ pratiṣedhe ṣakārapratiṣedho'jjhaltvāt iti| atra śakāragrahaṇaṃ śarāmupalakṣaṇm| kiñcāvarṇasyāṣṭādaśadhā bhinnasya parasparaṃ sāvarṇyaṃ na syāt| tataśca `daṇkaḍāgram' ityādau dīrgho na syāt| tathāhi, hakāreṇa grahaṇādakāro hal akṣu pāṭhāccāc| na cāsminneva sūtre etasya pravṛttiḥ yena grahaṇakaśāstramasāvarṇyānna pravartteteti| atra siddhāntaṃ vārttikakāra evāha---``siddhamanactvādvākyāparisamāptervā iti| tatra sūtrapratyākhyānenottaraṃ prathamavārttike'bhipretam| tathāhi, śikṣāvākye vivṛtamūṣmaṇāmiti yogo vibhajyate| tatra ceṣadityanuvarttate| svarāṇāñceti vivṛtamityanuvarttate| īṣaditi nivṛttam| tathāca prayatnabhedādūṣmasvarayoḥ sāvarṇyāprāptau kiṃ sūtreṇa? tathāca śarāmanactvādeva siddhamityarthaḥ| upalakṣaṇañcedamakārasyāhaltvādityapi bodhyam| sūtrārambhamabhyupetyedam| vastutastūktarītyā sūtrameva nārambhaṇīyamityarthaḥ|
īṣadityasyānanuvṛttiṃ samānaprayatnatāñca svīkṛtya sūtrārambhapakṣe'pyāha--vākyāparisamāpterveti| ayamāśayaḥ--iha pūrvaṃ varṇānāmupadeśaḥ| tata itsaṃjñā| tata ``ādirantyena sahetā(pāosūo1-1-71) iti pratyāhārasiddhiḥ| tato ``nājjhalau (pāosūo1-1-10) ityetadvākyārthabodhaḥ| tato'pavādaviṣayaparihāreṇa savarṇasaṃjñāniścaye sati grahaṇakaśāstrapravṛttiḥ, natvetatsūtraniṣpattisamaye| anyathā tatsūtreṇaivekāraśakārādīnāṃ sāvarṇyaniṣedhādikāreṇa śakārāgrahaṇe satyajjhaltvāditi hetorasiddhyā tvadīyaḥ pūrvapakṣo'sambhavaduktik eva syāt| atha padarthajñānasya vākyārthabodhahetunayaitadvākyasthāpadārthabodhakālaṃ etadvākyarthagrahābhāvādiha sūtre ikāreṇa śakāragrahaḥ syādevetaḥ pūrvaṃ sāvarṇyaniṣedhāgrahāditi brūṣe tarhītaḥ pūrvaṃ grahaṇakaśāstrameva na niṣpannamiti kathaṃ na paryālocayeḥ? nanvevaṃ ``tulyāsyaprayatnaṃ (pāosūo1-1-9) ``nājjñalau (pāosū01-1-10) ityādau ``akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ (pāosūo6-1-101) iti dīrgho'pi na pravartteteti cet? na, savarṇasaṃjñādyuttarakāle pravarttamānasya dīrghaśāstrasya daṇḍāḍhakādāvivehāpyapratibaddhapravṛttikatvāt, uddeśyatāvacchedakarūpākrāntatvāviśeṣāt| na ca savarṇadīrghavidānātprāgetatsūtrārthabodhānupapattiriti vācyam, padārthopasthitiprabhṛtisāmagrīsampattau satyāṃ sādhutvabodhakavakyārthajñānavilambena śābdabodhe vilambādarśanāt| anyathā vyākaraṇaśāstrapariśīlanavikalānāṃ kvāpi śābdabodho na syāt| tathā vaiyākaraṇānāmapi vyākaraṇasūtraghaṭakaśabdeṣu vyākaraṇādeva sādhutvabodhe taduttarakāle ca vākyārthāvagatāvātmāśrayānyonyāśrayacakrakāṇāṃ durvāratvāditi dik|
sādhutvajñānaṃ tu na śābdabodhahetuḥ| astu vābhiyuktavākyatvena sādhutvānumitiḥ, tataḥ śabdabodhe jāte lakṣyāntareṣviva lakṣaṇavākyāntargateṣvapi lakṣaṇapravṛttiriti dik|
vastutastu śarāṃ parasparaṃ sāvarṇyaniṣedhe satyapi na kṣatiḥ| paraḥ śatādiṣu hi rūpadvayaṃ siddhānte'piṣyate| śatātparāṇīti vigrahe ``kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam (pāosūo2-1-32) iti bahulavacanādvā ``supsupā (pāosūo2-1-4) iti vā samāse kṛte pāraskarāditvātsuṭi sakārasya ścutvam| tataḥ ``anaci ca (pāosūo7-4-47) iti dvirvacanam| nanu ``śaro'ci (pāosūo7-4-49) iti ``anaci (pāosūo7-4-47) iti vā dvitvaniṣedho'stviti cet? na, tatra ``nājjhalau (pāosūo1-1-10) iti niṣedhādikāreṇa śakārāgrahaṇāt| tato ``jharo jhari (pāosūo 7-4-65) iti lopavikalpād dviśakāraṃ triśakāraṃ vā rūpamiti sāvarṇyaniṣedhe'pi siddhyatyevedaṃ rūpadvayam, ``anaci ca (pāosūo8-4-47) iti dvitvasyāpi vaikalpikatvāt| tatra dvitvasya vaikalpikatvaṃ ``yaronunāsike'nunāsiko vā (pāosūo8-4-45) ityato vetyanuvartanāt ``sarvatra śākalyasya (pāosūo8-4-51) iti pākṣikaniṣedhādvā| lopasya vaikalpikatvaṃ tu ``jhayo ho'nyatarasyām (pāosūo8-4-62) ityato'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇānuvṛtterityavadheyam| tasmātsāvarṇye satyasati vā `paraśśatāḥ' iti dviśakārakatriśakārakarūpayoraviśeṣaḥ.
paraśaśatādyāste yeṣāṃ parā saṃkhyā śatādikāt| (aokoo3-1-64)
ityamaraḥ| evaṃ `rāmaṣṣaṣṭhaḥ' `yaśassāram' ityādāvapi| ata eva bhāṣye--``apara āha ityupakramya vārttikadvayamapyekahetutayā vyākhyāya ``astu vā grahaṇamikārādibhiḥ śakārādīnām iti vākyaśeṣādhyāhāreṇa pratijñavikalpārtho vāśabda iti vyākhyātam| tatra apara āhetyaparitoṣodbhāvanam| tadbījantūktarītyā śarṣu sāvarṇyaniṣedhāniṣedhayoḥ phalāviśeṣe'pi prāguktarītyā `daṇḍāgram' ityādi na siddhyet| tadarthaṃ ca sūtrapratyākhyānasya vākyāparisamāptinyāyasya vā''śrayaṇe āvaśyake śarāṃ śarbhiḥ sāvarṇyābhāvābhyupagamo nirmūla eveti|
syādetat, agṛhītasavarṇānāmeva ``nājjñalau (pāosūo1-1-10) iti niṣedha iti tāvatsthitam| tathā cekārādīnāṃ śakarādibhiḥ sāvarṇyāniṣedhāt `kumārī śete' ityādau savarṇadīrghaḥ syādityāśaṅkyācītyanuvṛttyā samāhitam| evaṃ sthite `mālāsu' ityādau ṣatvaṃ syāt| hakāreṇākāragrahaṇe sati `gorīṣu' ityādivadiṇaḥ paratvānapāyāt| kiñca `viśvapābhiḥ' ityatra ``ho ḍhaḥ' (pāosūo7-2-31) iti ḍhatvaṃ syāt, `vāgāśīḥ' ityatra ``jhayo honyatarasyām (pāosūo7-4-62) ityākārasya ghakāraḥ syāt, `gāsīdhvam' ityatra ``iṇaḥ ṣīdhvam (pāosūo8-3-78) iti mūrddhanyādeśaḥ syāt, `dāsīṣṭa' ityādau ``dāderdhātorghaḥ (pāosūo8-2-32) iti ghatvaṃ syāt, `rāma āyāti' ityādau ``hasica (pāosūo6-1-114) ityutvaṃ syāt, `devā āyānti' ityādau ``hali sarveṣām (pāosūo8-3-22) iti nityo yalopaḥ syāt, `cākhāyitā' ityādau ``yasya halaḥ (pāosūo6-4-49) iti yalopaḥ syāt, `śyenā yitā' ityādau ``kyasya vibhāṣā(pāosūo6-4-50) iti lopaḥ syāt, `nicāyya' ityādau ``halo yamām(pāosūo8-4-64) iti yalopaśca bhyāditi bahūpaplavaprasaṅgaḥ|
atrocyate, ākāro na hakārasya savarmaḥ ``tato'pyākāraḥ iti aiuṇsutrodāhṛtaśikṣārītyā bhinnaprayatnatvāt| ``savarṇeṇagrahaṇamaparibhāṣyamākṛtigrahaṇāt iti vārttikamate tu hakārākārayorekajātyanākrāntatvādeva nātiprasaṅgaḥ| yadvā, ākārasahito'c āc sa ca halca ājjñalāviti sūtre ākārapraśleṣo vyākyeyaḥ| tenākārasyācāṃ ca halbhiḥ saha sāvarṇyaṃ niṣidhyate| ākārapraśleṣe liṅgaṃ tu ``kālasamayavelāsu tumun (pāosūo3-3-164) ityādinirddeśāḥ| atra pakṣe āśca āśceti dvandvena savarṇadīrghaṇa ca ``nājjhalau (pāosūo1-1-10) iti sūtre dīrghāt paraḥ pluto'pi nirddiṣṭa iti vyākhyeyam| tena `yiyāso' ityādau ``guroranṛtaḥ(pāosūo8-2-83) iti plutādākārātparasya sanaḥ sasya ṣatvaṃ netyavadheyam| bhāṣyamate tūṣmaṇārmīṣadvivṛtatābhyupagamena sāvarṇyaprasaktireva nāstīti sūtrapratyākhyānātsakalamanāvilam||
iti śabdakaustubhe prathamasyādhyāyasya prathame pāde caturthamānhikam || 4 ||
īdūdede dvivacanaṃ pragṛhyam (pāosūo1-1-11)
īdūdedantaṃ dvivacanaṃ pragṛhyasaṃjñaṃ syāt| `harī etau' `viṣṇū imau' `gaṅge amū'| ``taparakaraṇamasandehārtham' iti vṛttikārāḥ| anyathā hi yaṇādeśe kṛte hrasvasyāyaṃ nirddeśa ityapi sambhāvyeta| tataśca `akurvahyatra' ityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ| bhāṣye tu vyaktiḥ padārtho, bhedakāśca guṇā iti pakṣamāśritya gueṇāntarayuktānāṃ dīrghāṇāṃ saṅgrahārthaṃ taparakaraṇamityuktam| idañca `id' iti prathamatakārasyaiva phalamityavadheyam,tāvataiva ūkāre'pi siddheḥ tātpara iti pañcamīsamāsapakṣasyāpi sthitatvāt| ekārasyatvaṇtvādevāṇuditsūtreṇa savarṇagrāhakatāsiddheḥ| īdūtoḥ paramanaṇtvād guṇāntarayuktasaṅgrahāya yukto yatnaḥ| tasmādbhāṣyamate'pi ūdetostaparakaraṇamasandehārthameva guṇānāmabhedakatve tvīdityapi tathetyabhipretyaikarupyaṃ vṛttikṛdbhiruktam| iha ``taparaḥ (pāosūo1-1-70) iti sūtre pañcamīsamāsomā'stvityabhipretya ūditi, tathā'tapara evaikāro nirddiṣṭa ityapi suvacam|
syādetat, asandehāyāpi kriyamāṇaṃ taparatvaṃ plutaṃ vyāvarttayedeva `ghaṭāyonmīlitaṃ cakṣuḥ paṭaṃ na hi na paśyati' iti nyāyāt| athāyaṃ dakāraḥ ``ṛdorap (pāosūo3-3-57) itivaditi cet? evamapyekāro gṛhyaṇāt plutam, aṇatvāt; na tvīdūtau vākyāparisamāptinyāyenānaṇtvāt| jātiparo nirdeśa iti cet? tarhi hrasve'pyatiprasaktiḥ. dīrghavyaktirapi viśeṣaṇībhūtā vivakṣiteti cet? kathaṃ tarhi plutasaṅgrahaḥ? na ca plutavyāvṛttiriṣṭaiveti vācyam `agrī 3 iti' ityatra ``aplutavadupasthite (pāosūo6-1-29) iti sūtreṇa plutatvaprayukte prakṛtibhāve niṣiddhe'pi pragṛhyatvaprayuktasyatasyeṣyamāṇatvāt| ``aplutavat (pāosūo 6-1-129) ityasyatu `devadatteti' ityādau caritārthatvādvaiyarthyaṃ na śaṅkyam| tathā ca ṣāṣṭha vārttikam--``vadvacanaṃ plutakāryapratiṣedhārthaṃ plutapratiṣedhe hi pragṛhyaplutapratiṣedhaprasaṅgo'nyena vihitatvāt iti| atrāha bhāṣyakāraḥ--``yathoddeśaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam (pāobhāo2) ityāśrayaṇāt pragṛhyasaṃjñāṃ prati pluto'siddhaḥ| tathāca dvimātratvabuddherapratighātāt siddhāsaṃjñā| kāryakālapakṣe paraṃ pragṛhyasaṃjñāyā api``aṇo'pragṛhyasya (pāosūo8-4-57) ityetaddeśatayā tāṃ prati plutasya siddhatvenā'nunāsikaḥ pravarttetaiveti syādevadoṣaḥ| etena `agnī 3 iti' ityādau prakṛtibhāvo'pi vyākhyātaḥ, ``plutapragṛhyā āci (pāosūo6-1-125) iti jñāpakātsvarasandhaiṣu plutasya siddhatve'pi saṃjñāṃ pratyasiddhatvānapāyāt, yathoddeśapakṣa evehāśrīyate ityuktatvāt| vastutastvanunāsikapravṛttibhayenaiveha yathoddeśapakṣāśrayaṇam| prakṛtibhāvastu kāryyakālapakṣaṃ'pi sūpapādaḥ| na ca pragṛhyaḥ prakṛtyetyanenaikavākyatāpannāṃ saṃjñāṃ prati plutasya siddhatayā trimātrasya saṃjñā durupapādeti vācyam, plutasya siddhatāyāṃ bījābhāvāt| yattūktaṃ plutaḥ prakṛtyetyetadeva jñāpakamiti| tanna, plutaśabdena tatsthānino lakṣaṇayā sarvasāmañjasyāt| na caivaṃ lakṣaṇaiva doṣa iti vācyam, śrutārthāpattimūlakavākyāntarakalpanāpekṣayā lakṣaṇāyā evābhyarhitatvāt|astu vā viśeṣāpekṣaṃ jñāpakam| siddhaḥ plutaḥ plutatvaprayuktaṃ prakṛtibhāva iti, na tu pragṛhyatvaprayukte'pi| tasmātkāryyakālapakṣamāśritya prakṛtibhāvasya samarthayitu śakyatve'pyanunāsikapravṛttivāraṇāyaiveha yathoddeśapakṣāśrayaṇamiti sthitam|
atra haradattaḥ--yadyapi saṃjñāyāmasiddhaḥ plutastathāpyanunāsikaparyudāse siddhaeva| tataśca yasyānena sañjñākṛtā dvimātrasya na so'nunāsikavidhau sthānī kintu trimātraḥ| na ca sthānivadbhāvāttasyāpi pragṛhyatvam, alvidhitvāt| kiñcāvaśyaṃ ``siddhaḥ plutaḥ svarasandhiṣu ityāśrayaṇīyam| `daṇḍa āḍhakam' iti plutasya dārgheṇa nivṛttiryathā syāt| ata eva `suślokā 3 iti, suśloketi' ityatra guṇo bhavan plutameva nivarttayati na tu sthāninam| anyathā hyadeśarūpe plutaḥ śrūyeta tadiha yathoddeśe'pi saṃjñāparibhāṣe kathamiveṣṭasiddhiḥ, kathaṃ vā grantheṣu na pūrvāparavirodha iti vipaścitaḥ praṣṭavyā iti?
atrāhuḥ---yadyapi dvimātrastrimātreṇāpahṛtastathāpi ``pūrvatrāsiddham (pāosūo8-2-1) iti śāstrāsiddhatvabodhanāttrimātre'pi dvimātra evāyamiti buddhyā pragṛhyasaṃjñā kriyate| ata eva `amunā' ityatra mutve kṛte nadupajīvanena nābhāve ca kṛte ``supi ca (pāosūo7-3-102) iti dīrgho muśabda eva daśabdo'yamiti buddhyā prāpnoti tatparihārāya tantrāvṛttyādyāśraṇena nābhāve karttavye kṛte ca sati mubhāvo nāsiddha ityaṣṭame vyākhyātam| kṛnmejantasūtre ca sannipātaparibhāṣā samāhitam| na tviha dvimātre kṛtāṃ saṃjñāṃ sthānivadbhāvena trimātre ānayāmaḥ, yena ``analvidhau (pāosūoeo1-1-56) iti niṣedhaḥ śaṅkyeta| nahi rajatabhramaprayuktā pravṛttiḥ śuktiṃ na gocarayatīti yuktam| etāvāneva para viśeṣaḥ--rajatabhramo'nāhāryyaḥ pravarttakaḥ, ihatu śāstrāprāmāṇyādāhāryāropo'pi tattacchāstrapravṛttāvapravṛttau ca niyāmaka iti| tadetatkaiyyaṭenaiva sphuṭīkṛtam| yadāha śāstrāsiddhatvāśrayaṇācca plutabuddhāvasatyāṃ pragṛhyatve vidhīyamāne dvimātratvabuddhiḥ pravarttate| tathā ca vakṣyati ``asiddhavacanamutsargalakṣamabhāvārthamādeśalakṣaṇapratiṣedhārthaṃ ca iti| ``ṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ (pāosūo6-1-86) ityetatsūtrasthaṃ vārttikamidam| utsṛjyate nivartyate ādeśenetyutsargaḥ sthānī, sa lakṣaṇaṃ nimittaṃ yasya kāryasya tugādestasya pravṛttyarthamityarthaḥ| tathā caikarūpyārtham̐ sarvatra śāstrāsiddhatvameveti bhāvaḥ| etena yasyānena sajñā kṛtā na so'nunāsikavidhau sthānīti prathamadūṣaṇamuddhṛtam| yadapi `daṇḍāḍhakaṃ' ``suśloketi ityādāvādeśaḥ plutaḥ śrūyeteti| tadapi na, uktarītyā tatrāpyādeśena plutasyaiva nivṛtteḥ| pluto mayā'pahriyate iti buddhiḥ paraṃ tasya nāstītyanyadetat|
yattu ṣaṣṭhe bāṣyakāro vakṣyati---``siddhaḥ plutaḥsvarasandhiṣu iti, tattvihānunāsikaparyyudāsānurodhādyathoddeśapakṣa evāśrayaṇīya iti sthite svarasandhisāmānyāpekṣajñāpakāśrayaṇe'pi na doṣa ityāśayena na tu sāmānyāpekṣatāyāmeva kiñcidāgrahe bījamastīti dik|
nanūdāharaṇeṣvīdādikameva dvivacanaṃ na tu tadantamiti cet?, vyapadeśivadbhāvena tadantatvāt| nanvīdūdantaṃ dvivacanāntamityeva kathaṃ na vyākhyātam? evaṃ hi sati vyapadeśivadbhāvo nāśrayaṇīya iti cet? na, `kumāryoragāraṃ kumāryagāraṃ' `vadhvoragāraṃ vadhvoragāraṃ vadhvagāram' ityatra pratyayalakṣaṇena dvivacanānte'tivyāpteḥ``saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahame tadantagrahaṇaṃ nāsti (pāobhāo27) iti ``suptiṅntaṃ padam (pāosūo1-4-14) ityatrāntagrahaṇena jñāpitatvātca| etenedādyantaṃ yad dvivacanaṃ tadantaṃ pragṛhyaṃ, kumāryyagārādau tu sakārāntaṃ dvivacanaṃna tvīdādyantamiti parastam, saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantāgrahaṇāt| yattvasminpakṣe dūṣaṇāntaramuktam--`aśukle śukle samāpadyetāṃśuklyāstāṃ vasre' ityatra śabdāntaraprāptyā 'nityaṃ lukaṃ bādhitvā paratvācchībhāve kṛte tasyaluki pratyayalakṣaṇena śuklītyasya pragṛhyatā syāditi | tanna, ``antaraṅgānapi vidhīn bahiraṅgo lugbādhate (pāobhāo52) iti paribhāṣayaukārasyaiva lopāt, tasya cedādyantatvavirahāt| astu tarhi īdādi viśeṣyaṃ, tathā ca dvivacanasaṃjñaṃ īdādi gapragṛhyamityartha iti cet? na, `gaṅge' ityādeḥ siddhāvapi `dṛśyete' ityādyasiddheḥ| dvivacanāvayavo hyayamekāro na tu dvivacanam| kiñca pragṛhyamityasya sannihitatvād dvivacanameva sajñiṃ na tvīdādiḥ, viprakṛṣṭatvāt| tasmādyathāvyākhyānameva manoramam|
atra vṛttikārāḥ--``mamīvādīnāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ iti paṭhitvā `maṇīva' `rodasīva' `dampatīva' `jampatīva' ityudājarhuḥ| munitrayānuktatvādapramāṇamidamiti kaiyaṭādayaḥ| vadadbhiḥ samānanyāyatayā'nyeṣāṃ munitrayānuktānāṃ vṛttikṛnmātroktānāṃ turīyasyeṣṭiḥ, śaṃsiduhiguhibhyo vā, krameke chandasi, bhāṣāyāṃ ca aṅgagātrakaṇṭhebhyastviṣyata ityādīnāmanādarttavyatoktā| marṇāvoṣṭrasya lambete iti tu ivārthakena vāśabdena nirvāhyamityāhuḥ. nyāsakārastu ``sambuddhau śāklyasyetau(pāosūo1-1-16) iti śākalyagrahamasya siṃhāvalokitanyāyeneha sambandhādvyavasthitavibhāṣāśrayaṇāccedaṃ labhyate ityāha|kecittvivārtheyaṃ vaśabdaḥ prayukto bhīmo bhīmasena itivat| `kādambakhaṇḍitadalāniva paṅkajāni' ityādivaccetyāhuḥ| vastutastu ``vadvāyatātathevaivaṃ sāmye (aokoo3-4-9) iti kālidākasaprayogasya tadvyākhyātṛbhirudāharamātsarvaṃ sustham| yuktaṃścāyameva pāṭhaḥ prātipadikaprakrame taddhitasya vaterananuguṇatvāt| etena---
