adaso māt (pāosūo1-1-12)
asmātparāvīdūtau pragṛhyau staḥ| amī īśāḥ| rāmakṛṣṇāvamū āsāte| na cāmū ityudāharamaṃ pūrvasūtreṇa gatārthamiti vācyam, tasmin karttavye mutvasyāsiddhatvāt| ``adasomāt (pāosūo1-1-12) iti sūtraṃ prati tu nāsiddhatvam, ārambhasāmarthyāt| tathā ca vārttikam--``āśrayātsiddhatvaṃ ca yathā rorutve iti| puṃvadvacanamevodāharaṇaṃ strīnapuṃsakayordvivacane tu mutvasyāsiddhatve'pyekārāntatvātpūrveṇaiva siddhā saṃjñā| tataśca prakṛtibāvo'nunāsikaparyyudāsaśca siddha evetyavadheyam|
yattu haradattenoktam ``aṇo'pragṛhyasya(pāosūo8-4-57) ityatraupasthitena pūrvasūtreṇa saṃjñāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ mutvasya siddhatvālliṅgatrayepi dvivacane'nunāsikaparyudāsaḥ pūrveṇaiva siddhaḥ| etatsūtrārambhastvadvivacanārthaḥ, puṃsi dvivacane prakṛtibhāvārthaśceti| taccintyam, plutasaṃgrahānurodhana pūrvasūtre yathoddeśapakṣasyaiva sthāpitatvāt| tasmāt puṃsi dvivacane'nunāsikaparyudāso'pyetatsūtrasya phalaṃ na tu prakṛtibhāvamātramityavadheyam|
athāpi kathañciddharadattoktissamarthayitavyetyāgrahastarhi itthaṃ samarthanīyā--pūrvasūtre kāryakālapakṣa evāstu| na caivaṃ plutasyānunāsikaparyyudāso na syāditi vācyam `ī ī 3 t' `ū ū 3 t' iti dīrghātparabhāgeplutasyāpi praśliṣṭanirdeśāt| ekārastvaṇtvādeva plutaṃ grahīṣyati| na ca tādapi parastapara iti tatkālagrahaṇāpattiḥ ``ṛdorap (pāosūo3-3-57) itivaddakāra evāyamityāśayāt| yuktañcaitat,yathoddeśapakṣe plutāt prāgeva saṃjñāpravṛttau satyāṃ tataḥ plute kṛte tameva dvimātratvena paścantyā api saṃjñāyāḥ punaḥ pravṛttau bījābhāvāt| nābhāvastu mubhāvātprāgaprāptastato mutvanimittakaṃ nābhāvamāśritya mubhāve daśabdo'yamiti buddhyā prāpnuvan dīrghaḥ pratividhīyate ityucitam| natdyasau plutāt prāk pragṛhyasaṃjñāvanmubhāvāt prāgeva pravṛtto yena punarna pravarttata| etena pūrvasūtrasthaharadattagrantho'pyujjīvita iti yāvaddhādhaṃ sādhu| bhāṣyakaiyaṭayostvayaṃ bhāvaḥ--plutāt prāk prāptā'pi pragṛhyasaṃjñā phalābhāvānna kriyate| na ca plute'nunāsikapravṛttireva phalamastviti vācyam, saṃjñāyā apravṛttāvapi tallābhāt, pragṛhyatvaprayuktaparyyudāsasyaiva vidhispṛṣṭasya tatphalatvaucityācceti| `suśloketi' ityādāvapyantaraṅgatvāt plutaḥ `antaraṅgambalīyaḥ' (pāobhāo38) iti nyāyāt|
prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ--nanvārabhyamāṇe'pyasminsūtre pūrvasūtreṇaikarūpyārthaṃ yatoddeśapakṣa evāśrayaṇīyaḥ| tathāca rutvasyotvaṃ pratīva pragṛhyasaṃjñāṃ pratyeva muttvamītvayoḥ siddhatvaṃ syāt, na tvayādīn pratyapi| tataśca `amī āsate' ityatrāyādeśaprasaṅga, `amū āsāte' ityatra puṃsyāvādeśaḥ, `amī atra' ityatra ``eṅaḥ padāntādapi(pāosūo6-1-109) ityekādeśaprasaṅgaśca| na ca saṃjñāṃ pratyeva siddhatve vacanānarthakyaṃ syāditi vācyam, anunāsikaparyudāsena caritārthatvāt|
atraucyate--yadyanunāsikaparyyudāsamātraṃ prayojanaṃ syāttarhi saṃjñāsūtraṃ na praṇayet| ``aṇo'pragṛhyasyānunāsikaḥ ``adsona ityeva brūyāt| ``asau `amuke' `amukābhyām' ityādau tu siddhānte'pi na bhavatyanunāsikaḥ, anaṇtvādanavasānatvācca| atastatra mādgrahaṇamīdūdadgrahaṇaṃ vā na karttavyam| na caivaṃ `he amuka' ityatrāpi niṣedhāpattiḥ, tyadādīnāṃ sambodhanavibhaktivirahasyautsargikatvāt| ataḥ saṃjñārambhasāmarthyātprakṛkatibhāvārthatvamapyasya vijñāyate| tadbalāccāyādiviraho'pi siddhyati, prakṛtibhāvasyāpadādarūpatayā ``upasañjātanimitto'pyutsarga upajaniṣyamāṇanimittenāpyapavādena bādhyate(paobhāo65) iti paribhāṣāvatārācca| yattu saṃjñārambhasāmarthyādayādīnsaṃjñāṃ ca prati mutvamītvayoḥ siddhatvajñāpanādayādīn bādhitvā paratvānmutvamītve iti tanna, ayādyabhāvasya jñāpane lāghavāt| arthāpatterhi sākṣādupapādakaviśayatautsargikī| kiñca mutvamītvayorekapadāśrayatvena balīyastvam, `antaraṅgambalīyaḥ' (pāobhāo38) iti nyāyāt| tatkathaṃ vipratiṣedopanyāsaḥ? ``nājānantaryye(pāobhāo51) iti niṣedhastu, ``asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgam(paobhāo50) ityasyaiva na tūdātadṛtaparibhāṣāyāḥ| yadyapi ``asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge(paobhāo50) ityanayaiva gatārthatvādantaraṅgambalavaditi pṛthak paribhāṣā na karttavyeti ``vipratiṣedhe param (pāosūo1-4-2) iti sūtre bhāṣyakṛdvakṣyati| `vṛkṣa iha' ityatra hi saptamyekavacanena saha suṇo'ntaraṅgaḥ| savarṇadīrghatvaṃ tu bahiraṅgam| na cehāsiddhaparibhāṣayā guṇo labhyate ``nājānantaryye (paobhāo51) iti niṣedhāt| ata eva ``acaḥ parasmin (pāosūo1-1-57) iti sūtre bhāṣyakṛdvakṣyati--
ārabhyamāṇe nityosau paraścāsau vyavasthayā|
yugapat sambhavo nāsti bahiraṅgeṇa siddhyati || iti ||
etacca tatreva sphuṭīkaraṣyate| ata evoktaṃ vārttikakṛtā,--``śacaṅantasyāntaraṅgalakṣaṇatvāt iti `dhiyati' `adudruvat' ityādi ca tatrodātdṛtam| jñāpakaṃ cātra ``omāṅosca (pāosūo6-1-95) ityāṅgrahaṇam| taddhi `khaṭvā-ā-ūḍhā' ityatra paramapi savarṇadīrgha bāditvā dhātūpasargayoḥ kāryamantaraṅgamityantaraṅgatvād guṇe kṛte vṛddhiprāptau satyāṃ pararūpaṃ yathā syāditi kriyate| etacca ``samprasāraṇācca(pāosūo6-1-108) iti sūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭam| kathaṃ tarhi vārtikakṛtoktaṃvipratiṣedhādveti? satyam, ata evāparitoṣādbhāṣyakāreṇāthaveti pakṣāntaramāśritamiti dik|
māt kim? amuke'tra| nanvihasūtre īdūtāvevānuvarttitau na tvekāraḥ. satyam, sati mādgrahaṇe ekāro nānuvarttate adaso māt parasya tasyāsambhavāt| anyathā tvanuvartteta| ekadeśānuvṛttistu durjñānā| tasmādekārānanuvṛttitātparyagrāhakaphalakaṃ mādgrahaṇamiti sthitam| atredaṃ cintyam| ``īdūtau saptamyarthe pragṛhyau,udasaḥ, ecca dvivacanam ityeva kuto na sūtritam? evaṃ hi pūrvasūtrasthāmīdgrahaṇaṃ prakṛtasūtre mādgrahaṇaṃ ca na karttavyamiti mahallāghavam| ekadeśānuvṛttiśca nāśrayaṇīyā bhavatīti ||
śe (pāosūo1-1-13)|
ayaṃ pragṛhyāḥ syāt| asme indrābṛhaspatī| caturthībahuvacanasya sthāne ``supāṃ suluk (pāosūo 7-1-39) iti sūtreṇa śe ādeśaḥ| śittvāt sarvādeśaḥ| ``śeṣe lopaḥ (pāosūo7-2-90) na yuṣme vājabandhavaḥ| yuṣmāsvityarthaḥ| atra padapāṭhakāle `yuṣme' ityudāharaṇaṃ bodhyam| saṃhitāyāntvacparatvābhāvena satyasati vā pragṛtdyatve viśeṣālābhāt| evaṃ `tve rāyaḥ sudughāste hyaśvāḥ' ityādīnāmapi padapāṭhakāle udārahaṇatvaṃ bodhyam| ``lakṣaṇapratipadoktayoḥ pratipadoktasyaiva grahaṇam (pāobhāo114)| teneha na---`kāśe' `kuśe' `vaṃśe' `hariśe' `babhruśe'| hari babhru ābhyāṃ lomādittvācchapratyayaḥ. tataḥ saptamyekavacanam ||
nipāta ekājanāṅ(pāosūo1-1-14)| eko'j nipāta āṅbhinnaḥ pragṛhyaḥ syāt| a niṣedhādhikṣepayoḥ, `a avadyam'| i vismaye, `i handraḥ' u jugupsāsaṃtāpānvarthāpyartheṣu `u umeśaḥ'| ekājiti karmadhārayaḥ vartipadārthaprādānyenāntaraṅgatvāt ``vyāharati mṛgaḥ (pāosūo1-3-83) ityādinirdeśācca| teneha--`predaṃ brahmavṛtratūrye,vāvitha' `preddhaḥ' ityādi|
syādetat, yadyayaṃ karmadhārayastarhi ekagrahaṇaṃ vyartham| nipāto yo'c ityetāvataivābhimatasiddheḥ| na ca viparītaviseṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvenājanto yo nipāta ityarthaḥ syādviśeṣaṇena tadantavidheriti vācyam, tathāsati vyāvartyālābena viśeṣaṇavaiyarthyāpatteḥ. na ca halantaṃ vyāvartyam, tasya sañjñāyāṃ satyāmapi bādhakābhāvāt| na ca halantaṃ vyāvartyam, tasya sañjñāyāṃ satyāmapi bādhakābhāvāt| na ca `puro'sti' ityādau halantasya saṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ prakṛtibhāvādro rutvaṃ na syāditi vācyama, pragṛhyasañjñāṃ prati rutvasyāsiddhatayā doṣābhāvāt| na ca sāntasya kṛtā pragṛhyasañjñā ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatayā rephāntasyāpi syādeveti prakṛtibhāvaprasaṅgastadavastha eveti vācayam, pragṛhyasañjñāṃ pratīva prakṛtibhāvaṃ pratyapi rutvasyāsiddhatvāt| sakārāntasya tu na kiñcidapi siddhakāṇkaḍasthaṃ prāpnoti yatprakṛtibhāvena vyāvartyeta| tasmādacā nipātasya viśeṣaṇe ajgrahaṇaṃ vyarthameva syādikati suṣṭhūktam| nanvajantasyaiva yathā syādajmātrasya mā bhūdityevamartham̐ viśeṣaṇaṃ kinna syāditi cet? na, vyapadeśivadbhāvena tasyāpyajantatvānapāyāt| viśeṣaṇasāmararthyādvyapadeśivadbhāvo na pravarttate iti cet? na, tadantavidhiparityāgenāpi tatsārthakyasya suvacātvāt| tathāpyanyataraparityāge āvaśyakaṃ vinigamakaṃ kimiti cedāṅgrahaṇamevetyavehi| taddhi vyapadeśivadbhāvamātrabādhe vyarthaṃ syāt' tasmādaco viśeṣaṇatvenāṅgrahaṇājjñāpakāttadantavidhirna| aco viśeṣyatve tu sutarāṃ tadantavidhiriti| ubhayathā'pyekagrahaṇaṃ vyarthameveti sthitam| nanvacsamudāyanivṛttyarthamekagrahaṇamastu| `aiu apehi' iti samudāyasyaiva saṃjñā syānnāvayavānābekājdvirvacananyāyāditi caramasyaiva prakṛtibhāvaḥ syānna tu pūrvayoriti| maivam, ajityekatvasya vivakṣayaiva samudāyanirāsasambhavāt| atrāha bhāṣyakāraḥ--acsamudāyagrahaṇaśaṅkānirāsārthamekargrahaṃ kurvan jñāpayati varṇagrahaṇeṣu vyaktisaṅkhyā na vivakṣyate kintu jātireva nirdiśyate iti| tena ``damberhalgrahaṇasyajātivācakatvātsiddham iti vārttikakṛtā vakṣyamāṇaṃ sūtreṇaiva jñāpitaṃ bhavati| dambheḥ siddhamityanvayaḥ| atra heturhalgrahaṇasya jātivācakatvāditi| tena dambheḥ sani kṛte ``sanīvanta (pāosūo7-2-49) iti vikalpādiḍabhāve ``dambha icca (pāosūo7-4-56) itīdītoḥ kṛtayoḥ ``atra lopo'bhyāsasya(pāosūo7-4-58) ityabhyāsalope `` halantācca (pāosūo1-2-10) iti sanaḥ kittvānnalope bhaṣbhāve ca kṛte `dhipsati' `dhīpsati' iti rūpadvayaṃ siddhyati| halgrahaṇasya vyaktiparatve tu yo'trekaḥ samīpo hal nakāro na tataḥ paraḥ san, yasmācca paraḥ san bhakārānnāsāvikaḥ samīpa iti kitvaṃ na syāt| tathā ``tṛṃhū hiṃsāyāṃ(tuopao1215) tudādiḥ,ūditvādiḍ vā titṛṃhiṣati titṛkṣatīti syāditi dik|
syādetat, `aiu apehi' ityatra ekājdvirvacananyāyopanyāso na yuktaḥ samudāyasajñaṃyā'vayavānāmananugrahāt| ata eva hi `nirglāyāt' `nirgleyāt' hatyādau bahūnāṃ sannipāte dvayoḥ saṃjñā svīkṛtā| nāpi nipātagrahaṇena grahaṇamekaikasminnipāte saṃjñāvidhānasambhavāt| satyam ekājsamudāyagrahaṇaśaṅkāmātraṃ tu syādeva| tannirāsāyaiva kriyamāṇamekagrahaṇaṃ prāguktamarthaṃ jñāpayati| vastutastvapṛktasaṃjñāyāmekagrahaṇamuktārthe jñāpakamityāśritya prakṛtasūtre ekagrahaṇasya parityāga eva jyāyān| nipāta iti kim? cakārātra| tacathā ataterḍaḥ aḥ, `he a āgaccha' ityapi pratyudāharaṇam| āṅanāṅorvyavasthāmāha bhāṣyakāraḥ--
īṣadarthe kriyāyoge maryādā'bhividhau ca yaḥ|
etamātaṃ ṅitaṃ vidyādvākyasmaraṇayoraṅit || iti ||
iha etacchabdena pūrvamanirdiṣṭatvādetamityasyainādeśo na kṛta iti kaścit| tanna,---anvādeśaśca kathitānukathanamātraṃ na tvidameva kathitasyedamā'nukathanamiti bhāṣyakṛtā vakṣyamāṇatvāt| tasmādyat kiñcidvidhāya vākyāntareṇānyadupadiśyate so'nvādeśaḥ| iha tu īṣadarthādau yo varttate iti vṛttirna vidheyā, kintu paricāyakatāmātreṇopāttāḥ| ato nainādeśaḥ| etena---
naktaṃ bhīrurayaṃ tvameva tadimaṃ rādhe gṛhaṃ prāpaya|
ityapi vyākhyātam| bhīrutvasya vidheyatvāvivakṣaṇāt siddhasyaiva hetutvenānuvādāditi dik|
īṣadarthe--ā uṣṇam oṣṇam| āṅīṣadarthe iti ``kugati(pāosūo2-2-18) iti sūtre vārttikakṛtā ṅidvyavahṛtaḥ| kriyāyoge--ā itaḥ etaḥ| prādiṣu ṅitpaṭhitaḥ| maryādā'bhividhau ceti samāhāradvandve āgamaśāsānasyānityatvānnumabhāvaḥ| maryādayā sahite abhividhāviti madhyamapadalopī vā samāsaḥ| maryādāyām--ā udakāntāt odakāntāt| abhividhau--aahicchatrāt āhicchatrāt| vinā teneti maryādā, saha tenetyābhividhiḥ ``āṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ(pāosūo2-1-13) iti ca ṅinnirdiṣṭaḥ pūrvaprakāntasya vākyārthasyānyathātvadyotanāya ākāraḥ prayujyate--`ā evaṃ nu manyase'| naivaṃ pūrvamamaṃsthāḥ, saṃpratyevaṃ manyase ityarthaḥ| vākyārambhasūcanāya ākāra ityapare| tathā smṛteḥ sūcaka ākāraḥ prayujyate| tataḥ smṛto'rtho nirdiśyate--ā evaṅkila taditi|
atra ca vākyasmaramayoraṅidityatraiva tātparyam| ato vākyasmaraṇābhyāmanyatreṣadarthādyabhāve'pi ṅittvaṃ bodhyam| tena ``āmenyasya rajasoyadabhraām̐ apo vṛpānā ityatra saptamyarthavṛtterapyākārasya ṅittvena ``āṅo'nunāsikaschandasī (pāosūo6-1-126) iti pravarttate iti ṣaṣṭheharadattādayaḥ|
yuktañcaitat| ṅidaṅidoranyataralakṣaṇamātreṇārthādubhayavivekalābhe tatrāpi lāghavādaṅillakṣaṇe tātparyyamāśritya bhāgāntarasyāvayutyānuvādarūpatvāt|
ot (pāosūo1-1-15)|
odanto nipātaḥ pragṛhyasaṃjñaḥ syāt| āhoiti, utāho iti| nipāta iti kim? devo'si| vaṣaṭ te viṣṇavāsa ā| vāyavāyāhi| viṣṇova| yattu `gavityayamāha' ityetadeva nipātagrahaṇasya vyāvartyamiti| tanna, pragṛhyasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāmapi kṣatyabhāvāt| na caivaṃ prakṛtibhāvāpattiḥ, prakṛtibhāvavidhau padāntādhikārāt| na cāyaṃ padānto bhavatyeveti bhramitavyam, anukāryānukaraṇayorabhedavivakṣayā'rthavatvābhāvenāprātipadikatvādvibhakteranutpattāvetraitadūpābhyupagamāt| anyathāvibhaktiśravaṇāpatteḥ| na caivamapadasya prayogāsaṅgatiriti vācyam, ``apadaṃ na prayuñjīta ityudghoṣasya apariniṣṭhitaṃ na prayuñjītetyevaṃ paratvāt, tasya ca suptiṅādiviśayakatattadvidhiśāstra mūlakatvāt, iha takarītyā subvibhakterapyaprāptyā go iti svarūpasyaiva pariniṣṭhitatvāt| ata eveha ``lopaḥ śākalyasya(pāosūo8-3-19) ityapi na pravarttate| kathaṃ tarhi pūrvasūtre ``śe'rthavat grahaṇāt iti vārttike ``eṅaḥ padāntāt(pāosūo6-1-109) iti pūrvarupaṃkṛtamiti cet? natrānukāryānukaraṇayorbhedaṃ vivakṣitvā vibhaktiṃ cakṛtvā śeṣvarthavān śe'rthavāniti samāsena supo lukaṃ kṛtvāvyākhyānāt| etenottarasūtre `sambuddāviti kim? `gavityayamāha' ityudāharanto vṛttikārā api pratyuktāḥ| tasmādiha `devo'si' ityādikameva pratyudāharaṇaṃ bodhyam| na ca ``eṅaḥ padāntāt (pāosūo6-1-109) ityārambhasāmarthyādeva tatsiddhiḥ, `hare'va gaccha' ityādau caritārthatvāt| na caiṅgrahaṇasāmarthyam| ``ṅasiṅasośca (pāosūo 6-1-110) ityuttarārthatvāt| uttarasūtre tu sambuddhigrahaṇābhāve `āho iti' ityādāvapi paratvādvikalpāpattiḥ, pūrvasūtrasya `aho īśāḥ' ityādāvuttarasya tu `viṣṇo iti' ityādau labdhāvakāśatayā vipratiṣedhasambhavāt| na ceha odantasya āryitayā bhinnaviṣayakatve kathaṃ vipratiṣedha iti vācyam| `trapūṇām' ityādau prakṛtipratyayāvayavayornumnuṭorivehāpi phalavirodhena viṣayabhede'pi vipratiṣedhasambhavāt, arthādhikārapakṣe uttarasūtre'pyokārāntasya saṃjhitvācca, śabdādhikārapakṣe'pi ``iko jhal (pāosūo1-2-9) ityatra sanākṣitvācca, śabdādhikārapakṣe'pi ``iko jhal (pāosuo1-2-9) ityatra sanākṣiptasya dhātorikā viśeṣaṇavadihāpi sanbudhyākṣiptāyāḥ prakṛterokāreṇa viśeṣaṇe tadantavidhisambhavācca| tasmātsūtradvaye'pi `gavityayamāha' iti pratyudāharaṇaṃ neti sthitam| prakṛtibhāve padāntagrahaṇaṃ na sambadhyate ityāśayena tu vṛttigrantho yojyaḥ asmiśca pakṣe maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena ``iko'savarṇe (pāosūo6-1-127) ityatra padāntagrahaṇaṃ sambandhanīyameva| anyathā `gauryau' `gauryyaḥ' ityādāvatiprasakteriti dik|
syādetat, nipātasamudāyā ete| āha u āho, uta āho utāho ityādi| tataścādivadbhāvāt ``nipāta ekāj(pāosūo1-1-14) ityanenaiva siddhā saṃjñā| na caivam `āho iti' ityādiṣu ``ūm̐(pāosūo 1-1-17) ityasya prasaṅgaḥ, niranubandhako'yamukāraḥ na tūñ iti samādhānāt| ata eva ``uñaḥ (pāosūo1-1-17) iti sūtre ñakāroccāraṇa mapi sārthakam| ata eva ca ``uñaḥ (pāosūo1-1-17) ``ūm̐(pāosūo1-1-18) ityatra bhāṣyakṛtoktam---``dvāvukārāvimau| eko'nanubandhakaḥ, aparaḥ sānubandhakaḥ iti| caivamapi ā u o ityatrā''ṅanāṅorekādeśasyānāṅiti pratiṣedhe prāpte pratiprasavāyedamiti vācyam, anāṅityasya paryyudāsāśrayaṇenā''ṅanāṅorekādeśasyādivadbhāvādanāṅgrahaṇena grahaṇāt| prasajyapratiṣedhe hyasamarthasamāso vākyabhedaśca syāt| bhāṣye'pi pratiṣiddhārthametadityuktirabhyuccayamātram| kathamanyathā'nupadameva `adobhavat' ityatrātiprasaṅgamāśaṅkya pratipadoktasyaivaukārasya grahaṇamiti samādadhīta| tasmādidaṃ sūtraṃ vinā'pi sarvaṃ lakṣyaṃ nirvyūḍhameveti cet ?
atrocyate---āho utāho ityādayo na nipātasamudāyāḥ, kinttavakhaṇḍā eva| etacca etatsūyatrabalātpratipadoktasyaukārasya grahaṇamiti bhāṣyabalāccādhyavasīyate| tena `ām āho devadatta' ityatra ``āma ekāntaramāmantritam(pāosūo8-1-55) iti nighātapratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ| ata eva padakārairapi ``oṣuvarttamaruta ityādau `o' ityādyaikapadyenaiva paṭhyate| tadevaṃ sūtrakārabhāṣyakārapadakārāṇāṃ samvāda eveti sthite nipātasamudāya evāyamityāśrityaitatsūtraṃ pratyācakṣāṇāḥ parastāḥ|
syādetat, anado'daḥ samabhavadityatrātiprasaṅgaḥ, cvyantasya nipātatvalāt ``ūryādicviḍācaścaḥ(pāosūo1-4-61) iti gatisaṃjñāvidhāne'pi ``prāgrīśvarānnipātāḥ (pāosūo1-4-56) ityasyādhikārāt| na ca lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā lākṣaṇika okāro vyāvartyata iti vācyam, varṇagraṇeṣūktaparibhāṣayā apravṛtteḥ| anyathā ``eco'yavāyāvaḥ (pāosūo6-1-78) ityapi `haraye' ityādau na pravartteta, `cakre' `cakrire' ityādau pratipadaukte cāritārthyāt| varṇasya prādhānye mā'stu paribhāṣā, viśeṣeṇatve tu syādeveti cet! na, aviśeṣeṇāpyapravṛtteḥ sūpapādatvāt| tathā ca ṣaṣṭhe vakṣayāmaḥ--``abhyupetyāpi brūmaḥ--agorgauḥ samabhavadgo'bhavadityādau ``gamerḍo(uosūo1-2-235) ityokārasya pratipadoktatayā'tiprasaṅgaḥ syādeva| nanviha gauṇamukhayanyāyena samādhānamastu| tathāhi, `saṃghībhavanti brāhmaṇāḥ' `tvadbhavati devadattaḥ' `madbhavasi tvaṃ' `tvadbhavāmya ham' ityādau vacanapuruṣavyavasthānurodhena cvipratyayasthale sarvatra prakṛtereva kartṛtvamiti siddhāntasthitiḥ. tathāca prakṛtāvāropeṇa varttamānāṃdvikṛtivācakācchabdāccverutpattau cvipratyayaṃ prati prakṛtibhūtasya vāhīkādivṛttergośabdasya gauṇārthatā spaṣṭaiva| ata eva `amahān mahān bhūto mahadvūtaścandramāḥ' ityādau ``ānmahata(pāosūo6-3-46) ityātvaṃ na pravarttate iti cet? na, dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayorvaiṣamyāt| tathāhi, viśiṣṭarupopādāne gauṇasukhyanyāyaḥ| tasya ``arthavadgrahaṇe nānarthakasya (pāobhāo14) ityetatpāribhāmūlakatvāt, arthopastiteśca rūpaviśeṣagraha sāpekṣatvāt|?tathā ca `` ānmahataḥ (pāosūo 6-3-46) iti viśiṣṭarūpagrahaṇena vidhīyamānamātvaṃ gauṇe na bhavatīti yuktam| iha tu ``ot (pāosūo1-1-15) iti varṇapuraskāreṇa vidhīyamānā pragṛhyasaṃjñā kathaṃ gauṇārthavṛtterna bhavet| nipātasaṃjñā tu tasyāpi mukhyaiva| ata eva saṃjñāśvaśurasyāpatyaṃ--`śvāśuriḥ' ityatra ``rājaśvaśurādyat (pāosūo4-1-136) na pravarttate| ``ata iñ (pāosūo4-1-95) tu pravarttate eva| anyathā iño yataśca tulyayogakṣemataiva syāt| ata eva `gaurvāhīko brūte' `gāṃ vāhīkaṃ pāṭhaya' ityādau vṛddhyātve sta eva tayorapa varṇāśrayatvāt, ``gotaḥ (pāosūo7-1-90) iti taparatvabhokārāntopalakṣaṇārthamiti vakṣyamāṇatvāt| tathā ca ``auto'm (pāosūo6-1-93) iti sūtre bhāṣyakṛdvakṣyati--``gāmityatra parā'pi vṛddhirniravakāśenā''tvena bādhyate iti| tatraiva kaiyaṭo'pi vakṣyati--ota iti sūtraṃ pāṭhyam| okārāntopalakṣaṇatayā vā ``gota(pāosūo7-1-90) ityetadvyākhyeyam iti| vṛcyādigrantheṣvapyevameva sthitam|
yattu vadanti--mukhyaeva svārthe sāsnādimati gośabdo vṛddhyātve labhate| tato vāhīkādiśabdāntarasannidhānādgauṇatāpratītiḥ| `gobhavat' ityatra tu gauṇārthatāṃ vinā cvireva durlabha iti vaiṣamyam| tasmāt padakāryeṣvayaṃ nyāyo na prātipadikakāryoṣviti sthitamiti| taccintyam, vākyasaṃskārapakṣe vṛddhyātvapravṛttitaḥ prāgeva gauṇārthāvagateḥ| yattu kārakāṇāṃ kriyayaiva śrautaḥsambandhastata ekakriyāvaśīkṛtānāmaruṇaikahāyanīnyāyena pārṣṇikaḥ parasparāvacchedaḥ| tathāca `gāmānaya' ityanvayavelāyāṃ na gauṇārthatā, kintu vāhīkena saha pārṣṇikāvacchedavelāyām| na cāntaraṅgatvena pravṛttaḥ padasaṃskāro bahiraṅgauṇatvalapratītāvapi nivarttate iti| tadapi na, tāvatā'pi `brūte' `pāṭhaya' iti kriyānvayāyaiva gauṇatāyā āśrayaṇīyatvāt, kaṭopi karma, bhī,mādayo'pīti pakṣe kathañciduktisambhave'pi sāmānādhikaraṇyādbhīṣmāderdvitīyetyevaṃ rūpe bhāṣyokta pakṣāntare tvaduktanyānavatārācca, `śvāśuriḥ' ityatreñopyabhāvāpa tteśca, śabdaprayoktrā vāhīkaniṣṭhasyaiva karmatvādervivakṣitatvācca| tasmādvarṇāśrayatvād vṛddhyātve ityeva tattvaṃ, na tu prātipadikakāryyatvāditi| ata eva ca ``ekācca prācām (pāosūo5-3-94) ityādau prātipadi kakāryatve'pi na smāyādayaḥ, viśiṣṭarūpapuraskāreṇaiva sarvanāmasaṃjñāvidhānāt| ``abhivyaktapadārthā ye ityapi gauṇamukhyanyāyasiddhārthakathanaparaṃ, prasiddhāprasiddhatve eva hi mukhyatvagauṇatve ityanyatra vistaraḥ| ata eva sarvādisūtre ``saṃjñopasarjanapratiṣedhaḥ iti vārttikaṃ pratyācakṣāṇo haradatta āha--``saṃjñāpratiṣedhastāvanna vaktavyaḥ abhivyaktapadārthā ye ityeva siddhatvāt iti| yattu tatra kaiyaṭo vakṣyati -- ``prasiddhyaprasiddhivaśātsambhavannapi gauṇamukhyanyāyo nehoktaḥ| padakāryeṣvayaṃ na tu prātipadikakāryeṣvityotsūtre uktatvāt iti| tadabyuccayamātram, yuṣmadasmadoḥ svarūpamātrāśrayāṇāṃ kāryāṇāmupasarjanatāyāmiva saṃjñāyāṃ pravṛttyāpatteḥ, ``yuṣmadyupapade (pāosūo1-4-105) ``asmadyuttamaḥ (pāosūo1-4-107) ityādāvapi tadāpatteśceti dik|
tadevam `adobhavat' `gobhavat' ityādau ``ot (pāosūo1-1-15) iti pragṛhyasaṃjñā'vyayatvādivad durvāreti pūrvapakṣaḥ paryyavasannaḥ|
atraucyate, pūrvasūtre'nāṅiti paryudāsādāhsadṛśāḥ pratipadaghaṭitā eva nipātā gṛhyante| ihāpyarthādhikāreṇānāṅgrahaṇānuvṛttyā vā tathaiveti sarvaṃ sustham| tathāca sarvādisūtre ``akārātkārau anupasarjanatve satyeva bhavataḥ iti praghaṭṭake ``tadoḥ saḥ sau (pāosūo7-2-103) iti satvaṃ tarhyaviśeṣitatvādgauṇatāyāmapi syādityāśaṅkya ``tyadādīnāmaḥ (pāosūo7-2-102) ityatra ``anupasarjanāt(pāosūo4-1-14) satvavidhāvanuvarttanānna kaściddoṣa iti samādhatta kaiṃyaṭaḥ|
sambuddhau śākalyasyetāvanārṣe (pāosūo1-1-16)|
ṛṣirvedaḥ ``taduktamṛṣiṇā ityādau tathā darśanāt| saṃmbuddhinimittaka okāro'vaidike itau pare pragṛhyo vā syāt| `viṣṇo iti' `viṣṇaviti'| saṃmbuddhāviti kim? gavityayamāheti vṛttikāraḥ| etanniṣkarṣaśca pūrvasūtre ukta eva| anārṣe kim? brahmabandhavityabravīt| itāviti kim? paṭo'tra|
añaḥ (pāosūo1-1-17)|
uña itau prahagṛhyasaṃjñā vā syāt| `uiti' `viti'|
ūm̐ (pāosūo1-1-17)| uña ityanuvarttate, śākalyasyeti, pragṛhyamiti ca| pragṛhyasya utra itau pare ūm̐ ādeśo vā syāt| dīrgho'nunāsikaśca ūm̐ iti| iha yadyeko yogaḥ syāt uña ūm̐ iti, tadādeśe vikalpite rūpadvayameva syāt--`um̐ iti' `u iti'| ato yogaṃ vibajya pragṛhyasaṃjñā'pi vikalpitā| evamapi ``ūm̐ (pāosūo1-1-18) iti dvitīyasūtre yadi pragṛhyagrahaṇaṃ śākalyagrahaṇaṃ cetyubhayamapi nānuvartteta, tadā uñamātrasya nityamūm̐bhāvavidānātpragṛhyasyevāpragṛhyasyāpyādeśaḥ syāt| tatra pragṛhyasyādeśe kṛte sthānivadbhāvena pragṛhyātvāt `ūm̐ iti' iti rūpaṃ siddham| na ca `` analvidhau (pāosūo9-1-56) (pāosūo7-2-28) iti sūtre iṭa iti samudāyarūpāśrayaṇād `agrahīt' ityatra ca ``graho'liṭi [pāo sūo 7-2-37] iti dīrghasya sthānivadbhāvamāśritya sijlopaḥ siddhtīti sthānivatsūtre vakṣyate| apragṛhyasya tvādeśe'nunāsiko yaṇ syāt| tathā ceṣṭarūpatritayamadhye `ūm̐ iti' ityekameva siddhaṃ na tvaparaṃ dvayamityavyāptiḥ| ativyāptiśca sānunāsikavakārayuktasyāniṣṭasyāpi prasaṅgāt| atha pragṛhyagrahaṇamātramanuvartteta tadā pragṛhyasyoño nityamādeśaḥ syāttataśca `viti' `ūm̐ iti' iti dve eva rūpe syātāṃ, na tu `u iti' iti tṛtīyam| atha śākalyagrahaṇamātramanuvartteta tata uñamātrasayādeśavikalpānād `ūm̐ iti' `u iti' iti dvayaṃ pragṛhyasya, `viti' `viti ' iti dvayamapragṛhyasyeti saṃkalanayā rūpacatuṣṭayaṃ syāt| tatra tritayasyeṣṭatve'pi sānunāsikavakārayuktamaniṣṭamāpatati| tasmācchākalyagrahaṇaṃ pragṛhyagrahaṇaṃ cetyubhayamanuvarttata ityuktam| iha vibhaktivipariṇāmena pragṛhyasyoña cetyubhayamanuvarttata ityuktam| iha vibhaktivipariṇāmena pragṛhyasyoña iti vyākhyātam| ādeśasāmānādhikaraṇyena pragṛhyaṃ ūm̐ ityetadādeśo bhavatīti vyākhyāne'pi na kaścidviśeṣa ityavadheyam|
nanu pariniṣṭhitameva prayogārhaṃ, pariniṣṭhitatvaṃ ca apravṛttanityavidhyuddeśyatāvacchedakānākrāntatvam| nihate tiṅantādāvavyāptivāraṇāyāpravṛtteti| vaikalpikeḍāgamoddeśyatāvacchedakākrānte `seddhā' ityādāvavyāptivāraṇāyoktaṃ nityeti| ata eva `pac' `laṭ' ityādīnāmalaukikateti siddhāntaḥ| tathāca `u iti' ityetadrūpaṃ na syādeva| atra hi śākalyamate ūm̐odeśena bhāvyameva| itareṣāṃ mate tu pragṛhyatvameva nāstīti cet? bhavedevaṃ yadi śākalyagrahaṇaṃ yathāśrutaṃ syāt, tattu vikalpamātratātparyakam| tathāca bhāṣyam--``sākalyasya vibhāṣā yathā syāt iti``ūṃ vā śākalyasya iti ca| tathāca tatra kaiyyaṭaḥ- ``śākalyaśrutereva phalaṃ vāgrahaṇena pratipādayati iti, ``smṛtyantarānusandhānadvāreṇa vibhāṣā sampadyate iti ca| yadvā, astu śākalyagrahaṇaṃ yathāśrutam| tathāpi ``nipāta ekāj (pāosūo1-1-14) ityanenaiva siddhe ``uñaḥ(pāosūo1-1-17) iti tāvanniyamārtham| tathā ca śākalyabinnamate na pragṛhyateti prathamasūtrārthaḥ| uttarasūtre ca pragṛhyasyoña ityetāvataiva śākalye labdhe punaḥ śākalyānuvṛttyetareṣāmapi mate pākṣikaḥ pragṛhyo'stītyanumīyate| tena `u iti' rūpaṃ siddham| atha vottarasūtre punaḥ śākalyā nuvṛttisāmarthyācchabdādhikārāśrayaṇena śakalasyaiva ṛṣerapatyāntaraṃ gṛhyate| asmiścaṃ pakṣe pragṛhyasyoña ityanuvādasāmarthyādeva pragṛhyatā'pi labhyate yathā ``ḍhaki lopaḥ (pāosūo4-1-133) ityanuvādasāmarthyāḍhḍhagiti dik|
ādeśaścāyamanunāsika iti nirdeśādeva vyaktam| tathā ca bavhṛcaprātiśākhyām-``ukāraśceti karaṇena yukto rakto pṛkto drāghitaḥ śākalena (ṛoprāo1-18) iti| raktasaṃjño'nunāsika iti ca| ata eva `yadetanūm̐ iti padakārāḥ paṭhanti' ityanukaraṇe ``yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā (pāosūo8-4-45) ityeṣa vidhiḥ pravarttate|
īdūtau ca saptamyarthe (pāosūo1-1-19)
śākalyasya itāviti nivṛttam| īdantamūdantaṃ ca śabdarūpaṃ saptamyarthe vartamānaṃ pragṛhyaṃ syāt| `adhyasyāṃ māmakītan'| māmakyāṃ tanvāmiti prāpte ``supāṃ suluk (pāosūo7-1-39) iti luptasaptamīkāvetau| māmakī iti, tanū itīti padakāle kāryodāharaṇe bodhye| `somo gaurī adhiśritaḥ' iti saṃhitāyāmapyudāharaṇam| īdūtāviti kim? priyaḥ sūryye priyo agnā bhavāti| agniśabdātparasyāḥ saptamyā ḍāādeśaḥ| padakāraiḥ pragṛhyoṣvitiśabdaprayogasya niyamitatvenehāpi padakāle itiśabdaprayogaprasaṅga iti pratyudārahaṇamidam| saptamīgrahaṇaṃ kim| dhītī, matī, suṣṭutī| dhītyā, matyā, suṣṭutyeti prāpte tṛtīyaikavacanasya pūrvasavarṇa īkāraḥ| tataḥ ``akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ (pāosūo6-1-109) ityekādeśaḥ| na tviha supo luk hrasvaśravaṇāpatteḥ| arthagrahaṇaṃ kim? vāpyāmaśvo vāpyaśvaḥ| nadyāmātirnadyātiḥ ``saṃjñāyām (pāosūo2-1-44) iti saptamīsamāsaḥ| nanu saptamyarthopahihāstyeva tatkathamarthagrahaṇe kṛte'pīṣṭasiddhiriti cet? ittham, jahatsvārthāvṛttiriti pakṣe pade varṇavaṭvṛttau varttipadānāmānarthakyādīdantamihānarthakaṃ, na tu saptamyarthavṛttīti spaṣṭameva| ajahatsvārthāvṛttiriti pakṣe'pi upasarjanapadaṃ na svārthamātre paryavasyati kintu tatsaṃsṛṣṭe pradhānārthe| arthagrahaṇasāmarthācca yāvānarthaḥ saptamyā'bhidhīyate ādheyāsaṃsṛṣṭo niṣkṛṣṭādhikaraṇarupastāvanmātrasyeha grahaṇamiti vṛttipraviṣṭena bhaviṣyati| yadyapi vākyavatsamāse'pi luptasaptamībalenādhikaraṇamātrabodhaḥ paścādvākyārthatayā saṃsṛṣṭabodha iti vaktuṃ śakyate, tathāpi siddhānte tāvat ``samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ (pāosūo2-1-1) iti paribhāṣānurodāt samāsasthale ekārthībhāva eva sāmarthya, na tu vyapekṣā| ata eva ``upasarjane viśeṣaṇānvayo na bhavati śakyaikadeśatvāt iti dvitīye vakṣyete| mīmāṃsakādīnāmapi niṣādasthapatinyāyena pūrvapadārthasambandhini lakṣaṇā'bhyupagamādyuktaivārthagrahaṇena vāpyaśvanadyātiprabhṛtervyāvṛttiḥ| ātiḥ balākā|
śarārirātirāṭiśca balākā bisakaṇṭikā| (aokoo 2-4-27) ityamaraḥ| ādyāstrayo'pi strīliṅgaḥ balākāsāhacaryāditi kecit| vastutastu śarāryādayastrayaḥ pakṣiviśeṣavācakā na tu balākāparyāyāḥ| ato balākāsāhacaryamakiñcitkaraṃ strītvaṃ paramastyeva| ratnakośe strīliṅgakāṇḍe---``āṭiḥ śarārirvaraṭī ityukteḥ| āterapi tatsāhacaryāt|
taparakaraṇamasandehārthamiti vṛttiḥ| atra vārttikam----
īdūtau saptamītyeva lupte'rthagrahaṇādbhavet|
pūrvasya cetsavarṇo'sāvāḍāmbhāvaḥ prasajyate ||
vacanādyatra dīrghatvaṃ tatrāpi sarasī yadi|
jhāpakaṃ syāttadantatve mā vā pūrvapadasya bhūt ||
asyārthaḥ---īdūtau saptamītyevāstu nārtho'rthagrahaṇena| atrottaramāha---lupta iti| saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidherabhāvāt| saptamyā eva saṃjñā syāt| lupte'pi supi prakṛtibhāgasya saṃjñāsiddhaye tu karttavyamevārthagrahaṇamityarthaḥ| nanu `somo gaurī' ityādau vibhaktirna lupyate kintu `dhītī' `matī' ityādāviva pūrvasavarṇe kṛte ``akaḥ savarṇe iti dīrghekādeśe tasyādivadbhāvātsaptamīgrahaṇādastyeva saptamītyāśaṅkayāha--pūrvasyeti| āḍāmbhāva iti| ekādeśaṃ vādhitvā paratvādāṅgatvāccā''ḍāmau syātāmityarthaḥ| tasmāllugeveti sthite'rthagrahaṇaṃ karttavyameveti bhāvaḥ| nanvarthagrahaṇaṃ mā'stu vacanasāmarthyācca saṃjñāvidhāvapi tadantavidhirbhaviṣyatītyāśaṅkyāha--vacanāditi| yatra dīrghatvaṃ tatraiva vacanātsyāt ``dṛtiṃ na suṣkaṃ sarasī śayānm iti yathā| atra hi saraśśabdātparasya saptamyekavacanasya ``iyāḍiyājīkārāṇāmupasaṃkhyānam (kāovāo) itīkārādeśe saptamī śrūyate| tathāca `somo gaurī' ityādau na syāde vetyarthaḥ| etad dūṣayati-tatrāpīti| tatrāpi saptamyā lugeva na tvīkāraḥ| yadi sarasīśabdo'pi varttate| asandigdhe sandigdhavacanametacchāstrāṇi cetpramāṇaṃ syuriti yathā| asti hi sarasīśabdo ``dakṣiṇāptathe hi mahānti sarāṃsi sarasya ityuccante iti bhagavadukteḥ ``kāsāraḥ sarasīsaraḥ (aokoo 1-10-28) ityamarakośācca| tathā ca ``sarasīḥ pariśīlituṃ mayā ityādi prayogo'pi dṛśyate| evañca sarasīśabdo'pi luptavibhaktika eveti vacanāttadantavidhiriti sthitam| nanūktarītyā'stu sarasīśabdaḥ, saras‌śabdo'pi sānto nirvivāda eva| tathāca sāntādevekārādeśo'yamastu| evaṃ hi sati saṃjñāvidhau jñāpakācyaktasya tadantagrahaṇasya punarāśrayaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavatīti cet? na, tathā satīkārasya suptvenānudāttatayā saraḥ śabdasya ca sṛdhātorasuni vyutpāditasya nitsvareṇa sarasīti padamādyudāttaṃ prasajyeta| gaurādiṣu ``pippalyādayaśca (kāovāo) iti pāṭhātpippalyādyantaḥpātinaḥ saraḥ- śabdānṅīṣā tvantodāttamiṣyate| tathaiva vede pāṭhāt| evantarhi pragṛhyasaṃjñāprakaraṇe pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ nāstīti jñāpanāyedamarthagrahaṇamastu| evañca ``idūded dvivacanam (pāosūo1-1-11) iti sūtre īdūdedantaṃ dvivacanāntamiti pakṣe īdūdedantaṃ yadvivacanaṃ tadantamiti pakṣaśca samarthito bhavati| tatra hi kumāryyoragāraṃ kumāryyagāram, aśukle śukle sampadyetāṃ śuklayāstāṃ vastraṃ ityatrātivyāptiriti doṣaḥ| sa ca pratyayalakṣaṇavirahādevoddhūta ityāha---jñāpakamiti| pragṛhyasaṃjñāprakaraṇe pratyayalakṣaṇābhāvasyeti śeṣaḥ| kvedaṃ jñāpanamupayujyate, tadāha-tadantatva iti| tadantagarbhe pakṣadvaye'pītyarthaḥ| nanu saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidherabhāvādeva tadantapakṣastatra śthita ityaparitoṣādāha-mā veti `vāpyaśvaḥ' ityādau bhā bhūdityarthaḥ|
atredamavadeyam, ``avitṝstṛtanvibha īḥ (uosūo3-446) iti sūtrādīrityanuvarttamāne ``yāpoḥ kidve ca (uosūo3-447) ``vātapramīḥ (uosūo4-449) iti sūtrābhyāṃ śabdatrayaṃ vyutpāditam| yāntyaneneti yayīrmuktimārgaḥ| pibati rasānpāti vā lokamiti papīḥ sūryyaḥ vātaṃ pramimīte sammukhadhāvanāditi vātapramīḥ niḥśṛṅgo mṛgākṛtirvātamṛganāmā paśuviśeṣaḥ| emyastribhyo'pi ṅau savarṇadīrghāt `papī' `yayī' `vātapramī' iti rūpaṃ nirvivādam| tayāceha śrūyamāṇasyokārasya saptamītvāt `tatrāpi sarasī yadi' ityasaṅgatam, īkārasya śrūyamāṇasyekārasya saptamītvāt `tatrāpi sarasī yadi' ityasaṅgatam, īkārasya śrūyamāṇasyekārasya saptamītvāt `tatrāpi sarasī yadi' ityasaṅgatam, īkārasya śrūyamāṇasyāsambhavāt| sāmarthyāttadantavidhirbhaviṣyatītyasyārthaḥ| tasmādūkārāṃśe sāmarthyāttadantavidhau labdhe `somo gaurī' ityādāvapi bhāveṣyatītyāśayaḥ| `yayīāsaktaḥ' ityādau tu bhāvyameva prakṛtibhāvena| na cāyaṃ yogaśchāndasastathāvidhānāmevodāharaṇānāṃ dattatvāditi vācyam, munitrayoktiṃ vinā'smadicchayā chāndasatvakalpane'tiprasaṅgāt, loke pragṛhyatvaṃ na bhavatītyasminnarthe pramāṇānupalambhācca, `apratiṣiddhamanumanaṃ bhavati' itinyāyena loke `yayī' `vātapramī' ityeteṣāṃ pragṛhyatvarayaiva nyāyyatvācca| ata eva ``dṛgdṛśvatuṣu (pāosūo6-3-79) iti sūtre ``dṛkṣe ca (kāovāo) iti vārtikamupādāya ksapratyayaḥ sādeśaśca chandasyeva, bhāṣye `sadṛkṣāsaḥ' ityudāhṛtatvāditi keciditi vyācakṣāṇā haradattādayaśchāndasatvaṃ vadatāṃ mate svasyāparitoṣamāviścakruriti dik|
dādhāghvadāpa (pāosūo1-1-20)|
dārūpā dhārūpāśca dhātavo ghusaṃjñāḥ syurdāpdaipau varjayitvā| tatra dārūpāścatvāraḥ--``ḍudāñ (juouo1091) praṇidadāti, ``dāṇ (bhvāoāo3o) praṇiyacchati, ``do (diopao1148) praṇidyati, ``deṅ (bhvāoāo962) praṇidayate| dhārupau dvau-``ḍudhāñ (juouo1092) praṇidadhāti, ``dheṭ(bhvāopao902) praṇidhayati vatso mātaram| adābiti kim? ``dāp lavane (aopao1059) dātaṃ barhiḥ| lūnamityarthaḥ| ghutvābhāvād ``dodaddhoḥ (pāosūo7-4-46) iti na pravarttate| ``daip śodhane (bhvāopao924) avadātaṃ mukham| iha ghutvābhāvād ``aca upasargāttaḥ (pāosūo7-4-47) ityetanna| ghupradeśā ``nergadanada (pāosūo8-4-17) ityādayaḥ| iha dodeṅdheṭāmanukaraṇāni vyavasthāpya tatra ``prakṛtivadanukaraṇam(paobhāo) ityatideśād ``ādecaupadeśe'śiti (pāosūo6-1-45) ityātvaṃ kriyate, anaimittikamātvaṃ śiti tu pratiṣedha iti siddhāntāt| na caivaṃ vibhakterutpattirna syādadhāturiti tu pratiṣedha iti siddhāntāt| na caivaṃ vibhakterutpattirna syādadhāturiti prātipadikasaṃjñāniṣedhāditi vācyam, adhāturiti paryyudāso'yaṃna tu prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ| asti ceha svāśrayamadhātutvam| yadvā, ``yattadetebhyaḥ (pāosūo5-1-39) ityādāvivehāpi kāryaviśeṣapuraskāreṇaivātideśapravṛttyapravṛttī bhaviṣyataḥ| tataścaturṇāṃ dārūpāṇāṃ dvayośca dhārūpayorekaśeṣaṃ kṛtvā dvandvaḥ karttavyaḥ| `praṇidātā' ityādau kṛtātvanāṃ dodeṅdheṭāṃ tu sthānivadbhāvātsiddhaṃ ghutvaṃ lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣāyā ``niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya (paobhāo82) ityasyāśca neha pravṛttiḥ, sarveṣāṃ svarūpeṇaivānukṛtatvāt| ata eca dārayatidhārayatyornātiprasaṅgaḥ, tayoranukaraṇe ātvāsambhaveneha dṛ dhṛ ityanayoranupāttatvāt| nanu kṛtātvasya sūtre nirdeśāt `praṇidyati' `praṇidhayati' ityādau cātvavirahātkayaṃ ghutvamiti cet? bhrānto'si| na hi vayaṃ kṛtātvamanukurmo yenoktadoṣaḥ syāt, api tu dedodhe ityeṅanteṣvevānukriyamāṇeṣu lakṣaṇavaśaniṣpannamātvamityuktam| na ca lakṣaṇena svarūpānyatve'pyanukaraṇatā hīyate ``sakhyurasambuddhau (pāosūo7-1-92) ityatrāpi sakhirupapnatīteḥ, `gavityayamāha' ityatra gośabdapratīteśca| dīṅastu nehagrahaṇaṃ, tadanukaraṇe ātvāsambhavāt| vārtikamate ejantānāṃ dīṅādīnāmātvavidhānāt| bhāṣyamate tvejnimitte paratastadvidhānāt| tena dīṅastṛjādāvātve kṛte'pi ghusaṃjñāvirahāt `pranitātā' ityatra ``nergada (pāosūo8-4-17) iti nityaṃ ṇatvaṃ na bhavati ``śeṣe vibhāṣā (pāosūo1-2-27) iti vaikalpikaṃ tu syādeva| tathā `upādāstāsya svaraḥ śikṣakasya' ityatra ``sthāghvoricca (pāosūo1-2-17) itītvaṃ na bhavatīti sūtrakārasya matam| nanvāsminpakṣe dāpdaipāvanukṛtau na vā? ādye'nukaraṇaparyudāsobhayasāmarthyāttayorghusaṃjñāvikalpaḥ syāt, antye adābiti vyarthaṃ syāt ananukṛtatvādeva dāpdaiporghusaṃjñāprāptivirahāditi cet? na, adābityasminnasati tayorapyanukaraṇaṃ sambhāvyeta| na hi lakṣaṇaikacakṣuṣā dodeṅādīnāṃ dāpdaipośca vailakṣaṇyaṃ kiñcidanubhūyate yadbalād grahaṇāgrahaṇe vyavasthāpyeyātām| ``vyākhyānato viśeṣapratipattiḥ (pāobhāo1) iti paramavaśiṣyate| kintvagatikagatireṣā'nabhidhānavat| na ca tadbalena siddhasya pratyākhyānaṃ śobhate|
vārtikakāramate tu prayogasthānāmeva dādhārūpāṇāmidamanukaraṇam| na caivaṃ `praṇidyati' `praṇidayate' ityādau śiti na syāt, ātvābhāvāt| tathā ``deṅ rakṣaṇe (bhvāoāo962) ādita ``dheṭ (bhvāopao 902) vyatyadhita, `praṇidātā' `praṇidhātā' ityādāvapi na syādātvasya lākṣaṇikatvāt ``lakṣaṇapratipadoktayoḥ pratipadoktasya grahaṇam (paobhāo114) iti nyāyāditi vācyam, vacanabalenaiva tatsamādhānāt| tathāca kātyācanavārtikam---``ghusaṃjñāthāṃ prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ śidartham iti| bhāradvājīyāstu paṭhanti ---``śidvikṛtārtham iti| tathāca dādhāprakṛtayo ghu iti paṭhitvā dāśca dhāśca prakṛtayaśceti dvandvaṃ kṛtvā sannidhānāddādhāmeva prakṛtaya iti vyākhyeyam|
bhāṣyakārāstu vārtikaṃ pratyācakhyuḥ| tathāhi, ``nergada(pāosūo8-4-17) iti sūtre tāvadavaśyaṃ prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ karttavyaṃ `praṇimayate' `praṇyamayata' ityatrāpi ṇatvaṃ yathā syāt| tadeva purastādapakṛṣya ghuprakṛtimā iti paṭhiṣyāmaḥ| ghuśca prakṛtiśca māśceti dvandva| śannidhānācca pūrvottarayoḥ prakṛtirgrahaṣyite| na caivaṃ mīnātiminotyorapi māprakṛtitvādgrahaṇāpattiḥ, māṅo ṅakārānubandhasyaiva tatrāvaśyaṃ paṭhanīyatvāt| anyathā `māmānaḥ' ityatrātiprasaṅgāt| tasmād ghuprakṛtimāṅiti pāṭhena `praṇidyati' `praṇidayate' ityādeḥ siddhatvācchidarthaṃ tāvad ghusaṃjñāyāṃ prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ na karttavyamiti sthitam| bhāradvājīyoktarītyā `vikṛtārthaṃ karttavyam' iti punaravaśiṣyate| tadapina, ``gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ (pao bhāo 115) iti paribhāṣayaiva lākṣaṇikasyāpi dārupasya ghusaṃjñāsiddheḥ| asyāṃ ca paribhāṣāyāṃ daipaḥ pittvaṃ liṅgam| taddhyadābiti sāmānyagrahaṇārthaṃ kriyate lākṣaṇikatvādeva ghusaṃjñāyāṃ depragrahaṇābhāve tukiṃ niṣedhe sāmānyagrahaṇārthena pittvena ? na caivamapi dheṭo ghusaṃjñā na syādeveti vācyam ``do dad ghoḥ (pāosūo 7-4-46) ityatra dheṭo nivṛttyarthaṃ kriyamāṇena daityanena dheṭo'pi ghusaṃjñājñāpanāt| na ca dadhātinivṛttyarthaṃ kriyamāṇena daityanena dheṭo'pi dhusaṃjñājñāpanāt| na ca dadhātinivṛttyarthaṃ da ityuktamiti vācyam, tatra dadhāterhiḥ(pāosūo7-4-42) iti hyādeśavidhānādeva dadbhāvāprasahgāt| nanvevamapi ``gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ (paobhāo82) iti paribhāṣāyāśca yathā bādhastathārthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣāyā api bādhaḥ syāt| tathāca `pranidārayati'`pranidhārayati' ityatrāpyatiprasaṅga iti cet? na, gadādīnāṃ ya upasargastatsthānnimittāduttarasya tāneva gadādīn pratyupasargasya neriti vyākhyānāt| dārayatidhārayatyavayavayostu dādhārupayoranarthakatvānna taṃ pratyupasargatvam, yatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ pratyeva gatyupasargasaṃjñā iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt| na caivaṃ `praṇidāpayati' `praṇidhāpayati' ityatrāpi ṇatvaṃ na syāditi vācyam, tatra pugāgamātpūrvaṃ dā dhā ityavasthāyāṃ ghusaṃjñāpravṛttau pugviśiṣṭasyāpi ghugrahaṇena grahaṇāt| `anāgamakānāṃ sāgamakā ādeśāḥ' iti pakṣe tu sthānivadbhāvena ghusaṃjñāpravṛtteḥ| nanvanāntaryamevaitayorāntaryyaṃ samprayogo vā naṣṭāśvadagdharathavaditi sthānentaratamasūtrasthabhāṣyarītyā dārayatyāderapi dāpayatyādisāmyameva, niṣpannasyāṇo raparatvābhyupagamena rephapukoraviśeṣāditi cet? satyam, ``siddhantu prasaṅge raparatvāt ityuraṇraparasūtrasthavārttikarītyā samādhānaṃ kṛtam| uktabhāṣyarītyā tu prasakto doṣaḥ prāguktasūtrakāramatamāśrityoddharttavyaḥ| na hi dṛdhṛ ityanayoranukaraṇe ātvaṃ labhyate iti dik|
idaṃ tvavadheyam, `praṇidāpayati' ityatrāpyupasargayoḥ prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇatve satyeva ``nergada (pāosūo8-4-17) iti nityaṃ ṇatvaṃ, ṇyarthaviśeṣaṇatve satyeva ``nergada (pāosūo8-4-17) iti nityaṃ ṇatvaṃ, ṇyarthaviśeṣakatve tu ghusaṃjñakaṃ pratyanupasargatvāt ``śeṣe vibhāṣā iti vikalpa eva na tu nityaṃ ṇatvamiti|
syādetat, `upadidīṣate' ityatra ``sani mīmā(pāosūo7-4-54) itīsūbhāvaḥ syāt, vārttikakṛtā ghusaṃjñāyāṃ prakṛtigrahaṇāt| sūtrakārabhāṣyakārayostu nāsau doṣaḥ, sūtrakṛtā dīṅonanukṛtatvāt, bhāṣyamate ṇatve prakṛtigrahaṇepi ghusaṃjñāyāntadvirahāditi cet ? satyam, vārtika mate'pi neyaṃ dāprakṛtiḥ, ejantānāmātvavidānābhyupagamāt| na caivamādantatvanibandhanayucpratyayāsiddhiḥsa, tatrākārāntalakṣaṇapratyayavidhiriti daccanenaiva tatsiddheḥ| bhāṣye tvetadvacanapratyākhyānāyaijviṣaye ātvaṃ siddhāntitamityanyadetat|
idaṃ tvavaśiṣyate, bhāṣyavārttikobhayamate'pi ``upādāstāsya svaraḥ śikṣakasya' ityatra ``sthāghvoḥ (pāosūo1-2-27) itītvaṃ prāptaṃ, tacca bhāṣye sannipātaparibhāṣayā parihṛtam| upa dī s ta iti sthite ejviṣaye pravarttamānamātvaṃ sico'kiccvamupajīvati| yadi cātra ghusaṃjñā syāttarhi ``sthādhvoricca(pāosūo1-2-27) iti sicaḥ kittvaṃ syādato'kittavamupajīvya pravṛtta ākāraḥ kitvapravarttikāṃ ghusaṃjñāṃ na pravarttayatyeveti|
vārttikakṛtā tu ``dīṅaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ sthāghvoritve(kāovāo) iti vacanameva kṛtam| ubhayamate'pi dīṅstṛjādāvātve kṛte `praṇidātā' ityādau ``nergada [pāosūo8-4-17) iti ṇatvaṃ bhavati| ata eva vārttikakṛtā ``dīṅaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ ityeva noktaṃ kintu ``sthāghvoritve viṣayaviśeṣo nirdiṣṭaḥ|
sūtramate tu na bhāvyaṃ ṇatveneti spaṣṭameva| kiñca bhāṣyavārttikāyorna kevavalaṃ sūtrakṛtā saha virodhaḥ kintu paraspareṇāpi| tathāhi, bhāṣyamate `praṇidīyate' `praṇidīnaḥ' ityādāvapi nityaṃ ṇatvaṃ ṇatvavidhau prakṛtigrahaṇāt| vārttikamate tu vaikalpikam, ejantānāmeva prakṛtitvābhyupagamenedantasyāprakṛtitvāt| anyathā `upadidīṣate' ityatresbhāvāpatteḥ| tadevaṃ `praṇidātā' ityādau sūtrakṛtā saha dvayorvirodhaḥ| `praṇidīnaḥ' ityādau tu bhāṣyakṛtā sahetarayorvirodho duṣparihara iti|
atredaṃ vaṃktavyam, `yathottaraṃ munīnāṃ prāmāṇyam' iti siddhāntādbhāṣyoktarītyā sarvatra dīṅi pare nernityaṃ ṇatvamiti sthite sūtravārttikamate'pi ``śeṣa vibhāṣā (pāosūo8-4-18) iti vyavasthitāvibhāṣāmāśritya bhāṣyāvirodhaḥ sampādanīyaḥ, ekavākyatayaiva sarvanirvāhasambhave matabhedakalpanasyānāśrayaṇayitvāditi| nanvadābiti pratiṣedhe ``dāpalavene (aopao1059) ityasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam, na tu daipaḥ| pakāre śrūyamāṇe ātvāyogāditi cet? na, ``anubandhā anekāntāḥ (paobhāo4) iti pakṣe śrūyamāṇasyāpi pakārasya kākādivadanavayavatvena dhātorejantatvānapāye ātvapravṛtteḥ| ``ekāntā anubandhāḥ (paobhāo4) iti pakṣe'pi bhavatyevātvam ``nānubandhakṛtamanejanātvam (paobhāo7) iti siddhāntāt| atra ca ``udīcāṃ māṅo vyatīkṣare (pāosūo3-4-19) iti kṛtātvasya meṅo nirdeśo jñāpakaḥ| na ca ``māṅbhāne (juoāo 1077) ityasyaivāyaṃ nirdeśo `vyatimimīte' ityādau tasyāpi kadacidvyatīhāre vṛttisambhavāditi vācyam, apūrvakālārthasya ktvāpratyayasya ``māṅmāne ityasmādanabhidhānāt| atra ca bhāṣyoktereva pramāṇatvādityāhuḥ| evañca meṅa ityeva paṭhanīye ``māṅo vyatīhāre iti gurukaraṇaṃ ``nānuvandhakṛtamanejantattvam (paobhāo7) iti jñāpanārthameva|
bhāṣyakārāstu nāyaṃ daip kintu divādiṣu ``dāp śodhane ityeva paṭhiṣyataityāhuḥ| na ca svare bhedaḥ `dāyati' ityāderubhayathāpyādyudāttatvāt| nanu tācchīlike cānaśi `dāyamānaḥ' ityatra svare bhedaḥ| śyanidhātorādyudāttatvaṃ śapi tu cānaśo'ntodāttatvamiti cet? na, ubhayathā'pyantodāttatvānapāyāt| na ca śyansvarasya satiśiṣṭatvena prābalyamiti vācyam ``anyatra vikaraṇebhyaḥ (paobhāoeo) iti paryudāsāt, ``ātmamāne khaśca (pāosūo3-2-43) ityatratyabhāṣyakaiyaṭabalena khaśīvacānaśyapyantodāttatayā nirṇayāt| sthānivatsūtrīyaḥ kaiyaṭagranthastu śarasūtrasthabhāṣyasvoktibhyāṃ virodhātprāmādika iti vakṣyate| dhyāyatyādayastu divādiṣvevādantatvena na paṭhitāḥ `` na viśvasedaviśvasta ``pathikavanitāḥ pratyayādāśvasantyaḥ' (meodūo) ityādi siddham| yattu bhāṣye ekāntatvapakṣe'pi na doṣa ityupakramya pakāralope kṛte bhaviṣyati, dāptvaṃ tu bhūtapūrvamanubandhamāśritya vyutpādanīyamiti siddhāntitam| tatretthaṃ pratyavatiṣṭhante-satyapyejantatve upadeśe ejantatvaṃ kathamiti? atrocyate--pitkaraṇasāmarthyādupadeśe ejantatvābhāve'pyātvapravṛttiḥ| vastutastūpadeśagrahaṇaṃ bhāṣyakāro na manyate| tathāca tatra vakṣyati-upadeśagrahaṇaṃ na kariṣyate| yadyupadeśagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate `cetā' `stotā' ityatrāpi prāpnoti| atrāpyācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati na paranimittasyaica ātvaṃ bhavatīti| yadayaṃ krīṅjīnāṃ ṇāveca ātvaṃ śāsti| naitadasti jñāpakaṃ niyamārthametatsyāt krīṅjīnāṃ ṇāveveti| yattarhi ``mīnātiminotidīṅāṃ lyapi ca (pāosūo 6-1-50) ityatraijgrahaṇamanuvarttayatīti| nanu `praṇidāpayati' ityatrāpyadābiti pratiṣedhaḥ syāditi cet? na, yathoddeśapakṣe'ntaraṅgatvāddāvasthāyāmeva ghusaṃjñāyā nirvṛtatvāt| kāryakālapakṣe tu ghusaṃjñāyā ṇatvasamānadeśatayā pukaṃ prati ṇatvaghusaṃjñayorasiddhatvena prāgeva puk tato ghusaṃjñā na syāditi doṣaḥ prasajjatyeva| ata eva bhāṣye dvedhā samāhitam-dādhāgvapiditi vakṣyāmi| yadvā, bāntāvetau dhātū satramapi bāntam| cartvena sarvatra pakāro nirdiṣṭaḥ| ato `dāpayati' ityatra nāsau niṣedhaḥ tasyāpi ttvādabāntatvācceti|
ādyantavadekasmin (aṣṭāosūo1-1-21)|
asahāye ādāvivānta iva kāryāṇisyuḥ| aupagavaḥ| yathā tavyādīnāṃ pratyayādyudāttatvaṃ pravarttate, evamihāṇopi| ābhyām| yathā `vṛkṣābhyām' ityādau ``supi ca (pāosūo7-3-102) iti dīrghatvaṃ bhavati evamihāpi| ``īṅgatau divādiḥ--eyam| ``acoyat (pāosūo3-3-57) iti ajantāddhātordhiyimāno yatpratyaye yathā `ceya' `jeyam' ityādau bhavati tathehāpi| iṇastu ``etistu (pāosūo3-1-109) iti kyapi `ityam' ityādau bhavati tathehāpi| iṇastu ``etistu (pāosūo3-1-109) iti kyapi `yatyam' ityevarūpaṃ na tu `eyam' iti| ekasminniti kim? sabhāsannayane bhavaḥ sābhāsannayanaḥ| atra hyākārasyādittve sati tamevāśritya sabhāsannayanaśabdasya vṛddhatvaṃ syāt| tataścāṇaṃ bādhitvā ``vṛddhācchaḥ (pāosūo4-2-114) iti chaḥ prasajyeta| nanu ``vṛddhiryasyācāmādiḥ (pāosūo1-1-73) iti sūtre ādigrahaṇasyāpīdameva vyāvarttyam| tatsāmarthyādeva sabhāsannayanaśabde vṛddhasaṃjñā na bhaviṣyatīti cet? na, yadi hi vṛddhasaṃjñāsūtre ādigrahaṇasāmarthyādanātideśakasya mukhyasyaivādergrahaṇaṃ tarhi jānātīti jñā brāhmaṇītyādirasahāyo'pi vṛddho na syāt| tataśca jñāyā ayaṃ `jñayaḥ' ityādi na siddhyet| asati hi prakṛtasūtrasthaikagrahaṇe yatrādivyapadeśo mukhyo nāsti asahāye madhye ante ca sa sarvo'pyaviśeṣādatideśasya viṣayaḥ syāt| yadi vṛddhasaṃjñāyāmādigrahaṇaṃ tarhi vyarthameveti cet? hantaivamatideśa syādigrahaṇasya ca sāmarthyātsarvatra vikalpāpattiḥ| ihaikagrahaṇe kṛte tvantyamadhyayorvyāvṛttyā vṛddhasaṃjñāyāmādigrahaṇaṃ sārthakamiti dik|
yattu nyāsakṛtoktam---atideśasūtre ekagrahaṇābhāve vṛddhasaṃjñāsūtrasthamādigrahaṇamanātideśekapratipattyarthaṃ sadasahāyānāṃ jñādīnāmeva vṛddhasajñāṃ vārayenna tu sabhāsannayanasya, sannayanetyetadantargatāṃścaturo'co'pekṣyānātideśikasyāditvasya tatra satvāditi| taccintyam, parasminsati yasmātpūrvo nāsti sa ādiriti siddāntarīyatyā madhyasthe'pyāditvavirahāt| iyāneva hi viśeṣaḥ-asahāye satyantaviśeṣaṇavirahādviśiṣṭābhāvaḥ, madhyasthe tu viśeṣyābhāvādviśiṣṭābhāva iti|
vārtikakārastu lāghavādapūrvatvamātramādiśabdasya pravṛttinimittamanuttaratvamātraṃ ccāntaśabdasya na tu satyanyasminnityapi viśeṣaṇaṃ, gauravāt| tathā cāsahāye'pi mukhyayorevādyantayoḥ sambhava iti manvānaḥ sūtrametatpratyācakhyau| āha ca--``apūrvānuttaralakṣaṇatvādādyantayoḥ siddhamekasmin iti|
bhāṣyakārastu naitanmene, satyanyāsminniti viśeṣaṇaprakṣepaprayuktasyagauravasya prāmāṇikatvāt| loke hyayamādiranto vetyukte'vaśiṣṭamapi kiñcidastīti niyamena pratīyanti| padānniyatopasthitiśca śaktisādhyā| anubhavamapalapyaikadeśamātre śaktikalpane tu śvasurādipadānāmapi lāghavādbhāryātvamātraṃ pitṛtvamātraṃ taddhaṭakapuṃstvamātraṃ vā śakyatāvacchedakaṃ syāditi viśiṣṭaviṣayakaśaktyucchedena sakalaśiṣṭavyavahāravyākopaḥ syāditi| nanvevamapi vyapadeśivadvacanaṃ karttavyameva, `iyāya' `āra' ityādau dhātvavayavatvaṃ prāthamyamekāctvaṃ cāśritya dvitvaṃ yathā syāt| ekāca iti hi bahuvrīhiriti vakṣyate| na ceṇo vṛddhyāyādeśayorartteśca vṛddhau raparatve ca kṛte āyū ār ityanayorekāctvaṃ pacāderiva mukhyamevāstīti vācyam, ``dvirvacane'ci (pāosūo1-1-59) iti rūpātideśena i ṛ anayoreva dvirukteḥ| kiñca yajeḥ pañcamalakāre `sa devān yakṣadiṣito yajīyāni' ityādau ``sibbahulaṃ leṭi (pāosūo3-2-34) iti sip| tasya ṣattvaṃ vyapadeśivadbhāvenaiva sādyaṃ, pratyayasya yaḥ sakārastasya ṣatvamiti siddhāntāt| tasmād ``vyapadeśivadekasmin (paobhāo32) ityeva sūtryatāṃ kiṃ prakṛtasūtreṇa? vyapadeśo nāma viśiṣṭo mukhyo'padeśo vyavahāra ekāca ityādiḥ so'syāstīti vyapadeśī, paciprabhṛtistasminnivāsahāye'pi kāryyaṃ syādityarthaḥ| atrāha bhāṣyakāraḥ ``avacanāllokavijñānātsiddham iti| vacananirapekṣāllokavyavahārādeva vyapadeśivadbhāvasiddherādyantavaditi vyapadeśivaditi cobhayamapi na sūtrayitavyamityarthaḥ| asti hi loke nirūḍho'yaṃ vyavahāro'yameva me jyeṣṭhaḥ putro'yameva madhyamo'yameva kaniṣṭha iti| tathā asūtāyāmasoṣyamāṇāyāṃ ca prathamagarbheṇa hateti vyavaharanti| tathā pūrvamanāgato'gre'nājigamiṣuścāhaṃ idaṃ me prathamamāgamanāmiti| nanu sarve ime gauṇā vyavahārā statkathaṃ mukhye caritārthaṃ śāstraṃ gauṇe pravartteteti cet? na, nirūḍhataratayā gauṇasyāpyasya mukhyasamakakṣatvāt, jñāpakācca| yadayam ``iṭaīṭi(pāosūo7-2-27iti) sico lopaṃ śāsti cajjñāpayati vyapadeśivadekasminniti| na hyanyatheṭ labhyate| valrūpatve'pi valāditvavirahāt| tathā ``dīrgha iṇaḥ kiti (pāosūo7-4-67) ityādīnyapi jñāpakāni| na hi vyapadeśivadbhāvaṃ vinā iṇobhyāso labhyate iti dik|
yattuktaṃ kaiyaṭena-arthavatā vyapadośivadbhāvātkuruta ityādau taśabdākārasyānarthakatvena tatra ṭisaṃjñāsiddhaye ādivadbhāvo vacanenaiva sādhanīya iti| atredaṃ vaktavyam, arthavatā vyapadeśivadbhāva iti tāvanneyaṃ paribhāṣā tasyā vidhyaṅgatvāt| vyapadeśivadbhāvastu laukika ityuktatayā taṃ pratyaṅgatvāyogāt| kintu śāstre vyapadeśivadbhāvayojanāya śabdārthasamudāyamāśritya tasyaikadeśaḥ śabda iti vyutpādayitumarthavattā'pekṣiteti paraṃ tasyāśayaḥ| ata eva ṣaṣṭhe ``nijau catvāra ekācaḥ ityeteṣu vyutpādanāvasare bāṣyakaiyaṭayoranarthakenāpi vyapadeśivadbhāvaḥ svīkṛto loka ivaṃ śāstre'pyanarthakasya vyapadeśivadbhāvasambhavat| tasmādarthavateti prāyovādamātraṃ, sūtrapratyākhyānaṃ tu samyageveti dik ||
taraptamapau ghaḥ (pāosūo1-1-22)|
etau ghasaṃjñau staḥ| kumāritarā| kumāritamā| ``gharupa (pāosūo6-3-47) iti hrasvaḥ| nidyāstaro nadītara ityatra tu na bhavati, tamapā sāhacaryeṇa pratyayasyaiva tarapo grahaṇāt| yadvā, tarabili rūpaṃ saṃjñāpravṛttāvāśritaṃ tacca pariniṣṭhite prayoge kvāpi nāstītyaupadośikaṃ gṛhyate| tacca tarappratyayasyaivāsti| āpicapratipadoktatvamapīha sulabham| tenāvayavaśo vyutpādite nadītare nātiprasaṅgaḥ| kiñca samānādhikaraṇe strīliṅege pare hasvatvaṃ vidhīyate| anyathā `mahiṣīva rūpaṃ mahiṣīrūpam' ityatrāpi syāt| ``sup supā iti samāsaḥ. rūpamākṛtiḥ, mahīṣīveyamākṛtirityarthaḥ| sāmānādhikaraṇyastrītve ca svārthikatvādātiśāyanikasya sto na tu nadītare, ato noktadoṣaḥ| nanvātiśāyanikaprakaraṇa eva tādī gha iti, pitau gha iti vā kriyatāṃ lāghavāditi cet? na, prakaraṇotkarṣeṇeha saṃjñāprakaraṇāsyānyo'pi tarabastīti jñāpanārthatvāt| sa cānirdiṣṭārthatvātsvārthe bhavati| tena ``alpāctaram ``lopaśca balavattaraḥ ityādi siddham| keci ttu sāmānyāpekṣaṃ jñāpakamāśritya īyasuno'pi svārthikatāmāhuḥ| tenāho mahīyastava sāhasikyamityādi prayogāḥ samarthitā bhavanti|
bahugaṇavatuḍati saṅkhyā (pāosūo1-1-23)|
ete saṅkhyāsaṃjñāḥ syuḥ| bahukṛtvaḥ ``saṃkhyāyāḥ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasuc (pāosūo5-4-17)| bahudhā ``saṃkhyāyā vidhārthe dhā (pāosūo5-3-42)| bahubhiḥ krīto bahukaḥ ``saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan (pāosūo5-1-22) bahuśaḥ ``bavhalpārthācchaskārakāt (pāosūo5-4-42) ityanuvarttamāne ``saṃkhyaikavacanācca vīpsāyām (pāosūo5-4-43) iti śas| gaṇakṛtvaḥ, gaṇadhā, gaṇakaḥ, gaṇaśaḥ, tāvatkṛtvaḥ, tāvaddhā, tāvatkaḥ, tāvacchaḥ| ``yattadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup (pāosūo5-1-32)| ``ā sarvanāmnaḥ (pāosūo6-3-91) seṣaṃ prāgvat| katikṛtvaḥ katikaḥ, katidhā katiśaḥ ``kimaḥ saṃkhyāparimāṇe ḍati ca (pāosūo5-2-41) śeṣaṃ prāgvat|
syādetat, vaipulyeṣa'pi bahuśabdo varttate, vahurhimavāniti| saṅghe ca gaṇaśabdaḥ, bhikṣukāṇāṃ gaṇa hati| ``samavāyaścayo gaṇaḥ (aokoo2-5-40) hatyamaraḥ| tathāca saṅghavaipulyavācinorapyanayoḥ saṃkhyā saṃjñā syāditi cet? na, saṃkhyāyate'nayetyanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānāt| tasmātsaṃkhyāvācinoreva bahugaṇaśabdayoriha grahaṇam| tacca niyamārtham--aniyatabahutvavācināṃ madhye'nayoreva saṃkhyā saṃjñā na tu bhūryādīnāmiti| tena bahuvaliṣayayordvyekayorniyatabahutvavācināṃ tryādīnāṃ ca na vyāvṛttiḥ| nanu niyamārthatve siddhe sajātīyāpekṣatvānniyamasya tvaduktavyavasthā sidhdyet| niyamārthatvameva tu durupapādam, vidhyarthatāyā evaucityāt| tathāhi, asti tāvat ``kṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kṛtrime kāryyasampratyayaḥ (paobhāoavao9) iti paribhāṣā| sā ca nyāyamūlā| saṃjñāsūtreṇa saṃjñiviśeṣe niyamyamāno hi saṃjñāśabdaḥ kathaṃ taditaraṃ bodhayet| evaṃ sthite bahugaṇayoriha grahaṇābhāve saṃkhyāpradeśeṣu grahaṇameva na syāt, akṛtrimatvāt| tasmātsvasaṅgrahārthameva bahugaṇagrahaṇaṃ na tu bhūryādinivṛttyarthamiti| atrāhuḥ--- saṃjñiviśeṣe kriymāṇaḥ saṃjñāniyamo yadi sāmānyāpekṣastadā yuktā'kṛtrimasya vyāvṛttiḥ| viśeṣaparatve tu sajātīyaṃ kṛtrimāntarameva niyamena vyāvarttyeta na tvakṛtrimamapi| tadetadutyate--``ubhayagatiriha śāstre bhavati (paobhāo9) iti kṛtrimākṛtrimayorubhayorapi grahaṇamityarthaḥ| asti ca saṃkhyāpradeśeṣūbhayagrahaṇe liṅgaṃ ``saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan (pāosūo5-1-22) iti sūtre śadantaparyudāsaḥ| na hi kṛtrimā saṃkhyā śadantā'stīti dik| tena `pañcadhā' `pañcakṛtvaḥ' ityādi siddhaṃ bhavati| yadyapi saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantagrahaṇaṃ nāsti, tathāpi vatuḍatyoḥ kevalayoḥ saṃjñāyāḥ prayojanābhāvātsāmarthyāttadantagrahaṇam| taddhitavidhau hi ``ṅyapprātipadikāt (pāosūo4-1-1) ityādhikṛtaṃ, na ca kevalasya pratyayasya prātipadikatvamastīti bodhyam| etacca sūtraṃ bhāṣye pratyākhyātam| ``bahupūgagaṇasaṅghasya tithuk (pāosūo5-2-21) ``vatorithuk (pāosūo5-2-53) ``ṣaṭkatikatipayacaturāṃ thuk (pāosūo5-2-21) iti sūtrairḍaṭi pare āgamā vidhīyamānā bahuprabhṛtīnāṃ ḍaṭo nirvāhakaṃ saṃkhyātvaṃ jñāpayantīti kimanena sūtreṇa? nanu ``bahupūgagaṇasaṅgha(pāosūo 5-2-52) itvā dau viśeṣāśrayaṇātsaṃghavaipulyavācinorapi bahugaṇaśabdayoḥ saṃkhyākāryaṃ syāditi cet? na, aniyatasaṃkhyāvācinorapyetayoḥ saṃkhyākāryaṃ bavatītyetāvanmātrajñāpanena caritārthatve sati sarvathā saṃkhyāmapratipādayatorapi saṃkhyākāryakalpanasya gauravaparāstatvāt| bhūryādīnāṃ tvāniyatasaṃkyāvācināṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, niyatasaṃkhyāvācināṃ pañcādīnāmeva loke saṃkhyāśabdatvena prasiddhataratvāt; prasiddhāprasiddhayoḥ prasiddhagrahaṇasya nyāyyatvāt| nanvevamapi bahugaṇayoriva pūgasaṃghādīnāmapi dhāśas-khṛtvasujādisaṃkhyākāryaprasaṅgaḥ| na ca bahugaṇayoḥ sāmānyāpekṣaṃ jñāpakaṃ pūgādīnāṃ tu ḍadviṣayamameveti vācyam, anupapatte| samānatvena ekasūtropāttatvena ca vaiṣamye vījābhāvāditi cet? maivam, lakṣyānurodhena kvacitsāmānyāpekṣaṃ kvacidviśeṣāpekṣaṃ jñāpakamityāśrayaṇāttadanurodhena vairupyasya soḍhavyatvāditi dik| imāṃ kusṛṣṭimasahamānenaiva sūtrakṛtā sūtrāmidaṃ praṇītamiti tu paramārthaḥ|
atra vārtikāni--adyarddhagrahaṇaṃ samāsakanvidhyartham| arddhenādhikamadhyardham| ekadeśavācako'yamarddhaśabdaḥ| tasyādhiśabdena samāse kṛte yaugikārthaḥ pratīyate na saṃkhyeti vārttikārambhaḥ| adyarddhena śūrpeṇa krītamaddhayarddhaśūrppaṃ ``diksaṃkhye (pāosūo2-1-50) ityanuvarttamāne ``taddhitārtha (pāosūo2-1-51) iti samāsaḥ, tataḥ ``sūrpādañanyatarasyām [pāosūo 5-2-26] ityañaṣṭhaño vā ``adyarddhapūrva (pāosūo 5-1-27) iti luk| adyarddhena krītamadhyarddhakam ``saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan (pāosūo 5-1-26) iti kan| iha samāsavidhyarthamiti sambandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhī| samāse vidhīyamāne samāsānimitte vā'nyasminkārye vidhīyamāne ityarthaḥ| tena dvigunimitto lugapi labhyate| tathāca ``adhyarddhapūrva (pāosūo5-1-27) iti sūtre'dhyarddhagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati| taduktaṃ, luki cā grahaṇamiti| adhyarddhapūrvapadaśca pūraṇapratyayāntaḥ| saṃkhyetyanuvarttate| pūraṇa pratyayānta ityasya pūraṇapratyayāntottarapada ityarthaḥ| samāsakanvidhyarthamityeva| arddhaṃ pañcamaṃ yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| arddhepañcamairarddhādhikaiśca turmiḥ śūrpaiḥ krītamarddhapañcamaśūrppaṃ, pūrvavadañaṣṭaño vā luk| arddhapañcamena krītamarddhapañcamakam|
adhikagrahaṇaṃ cāluki samāsottarapadavṛddhyartham| adhikayā ṣaṣṭhayā krīto'dhikaṣāṣṭhikaḥ, adhikasāptatikaḥ, ``taddhitārtha (pāosūo2-1-51) iti samāsaḥ| ``prāgvateṣṭhañ (pāosūo5-1-18) | alukīti vacanāt lūki karttavye saṃkyāsajñā nāstīti dvigutvamapi na, tena ``adhyarddhapūrva dvigoḥ (pāosūo5-1-28) iti luṅ na| tataḥ ``saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃvatsarasaṃ khyasya ca (pāosūo7-3-15) ityuttarapadavṛddhiḥ| nanvalukīti vyartham, uttarapadavṛddhyarthamiti vacanādeva lugabhāvasyākṣeptuṃ śakyatvāditi cet? na, arhatyarthātparetpareṣvartheṣu ye pratyayāsteṣāṃ lugaprāptyā tatraivottarapadavṛddheḥ sāvakāśatvāt|
ṣṇāntā ṣaṭ (pāosūo1-1-24)|
ṣāntā nāntā ca saṃkhyā ṣaṭsaṃjñā syāt| `ṣaṭ tiṣṭhanti' `ṣaṭ paśya' `pañca' `sapta' ityādi| saṃkhyeti kim? vipruṣaḥ, pāmānaḥ| nanu `śatāni' `sahasrāṇi' ityatra numi kṛte tasya pūrvabhaktatayā nāntā saṃkhyeti ṣaṭsaṃjñā syāditi cet? astu| na caivaṃ ``ṣaḍbhyo luk (pāosūo7-1-22) iti luk syāditi vācyam, sarvanāmasthānasannipātena kṛtasya numastadavighātakatvāt| nanvevamapi `aṣṭānām' iti na siddhyati| tathāhi, `aṣṭan ām' iti sthite paratvānnityatvācca ``aṣṭana ā vibhaktau (pāosūo7-2-84) ityātve kṛte'nāntatvāt saṃjñāyāmasatyāṃ ``ṣaṭcaturbhyaśca (pāosūo7-2-55) iti nuṇna prāpnotīti cet? na, yathoddeśapakṣe ātvātprāgeva ṣaṭsaṃjñā, antaraṅgatvāt| tataḥ kṛtepyātve ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatayā ṣaṭsejñakatvena nuṭaḥ siddhatvāt| kāryakālapakṣe tarhyuktadoṣastadavastha eva| kiñca yathoddese'pyalvidhitvādatideśo durlabhaḥ| ata eva `vavraśca' iti ``acaḥ parasmin (pāosūo1-1-57) ityasya phalamiti kaiyaṭa iti cet? na, ``aṣṭano dīrghāt (pāosūo7-2-84) iti dīrghagrahaṇena kṛtātvasyāpi ṣaṭsaṃjñājñāpanāt| tathāhi, ``nraḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ (pāosūo7-3-15) ityādyudāttatvaṃ bādhetvā ghṛtādipāṭhādantodātto'ṣṭanśabdaḥ sādhitaḥ| tasmādbhisi `aṣṭabhiḥ' `aṣṭābhiḥ' iti rūpadvayam| tatrātvābhāve madhyodāttamātvapakṣe tvantodāttamiti siddhāntaḥ| tatra ``ṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ (pāosūo6-1-179) iti sūtreṇa `ṣaṇṇāṃ' `ṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ (pāosūo6-1-179) iti sūtreṇa `ṣaṇṇāṃ `ṣaḍbhiḥ' ityādāviva vibhakterudāttatvaṃ prāptaṃ tadvādhitvā ``jhalyupottamam (pāosūo6-1-180) iti prāptam| ṣaṭtricaturbhyo yā jhalādirvibhaktistadante pade upottamamudāttaṃ bhavatīti hi tasyārthaḥ| tadvādhanāya ``aṣṭano dīrghāt (pāosūo6-1-172) ityārabhyate| dīrghāntādaṣṭanaḥ parā'sarvanāmasthānavibhaktirudāttā bhavatīti sūtrārthaḥ| tatra yadyātvapakṣe ṣaṭsaṃjñā na syāttarhi na syāttarhi sāvakāśoṣṭanaḥ svaraḥ paratvādātvābhāvapakṣe ``jñalyupottamam (pāosūo6-1-180) iti ṣaṭsvareṇa bādhiṣyate iti kiṃ dīrdhagrahaṇena? kṛtātvasyāpi ṣaṭ saṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ tu ṣaṭsvarasyāṣṭanaḥ svaro'pavādaḥ sampadyate| na cāṣṭanaḥ svaraḥ śasi sāvakāśa iti vācyam, tatra ``ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ (pāosūo8-2-5) iti sūtreṇaiva gatārthatvāt; `aṣṭanśabdo'ntodāttaḥ' iti samanantaramevoktatvāt| tena dīrdhapakṣa iva tadabhāvapakṣe'pi vibhakterudāttatā syāditi tadvyāvṛttyarthaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ dīrghagrahaṇaṃ sārthakameva| tasmāddīrghagrahaṇenātvapakṣe'pi ṣaṭsaṃjñā jñāpyate iti sthitam| na caivaṃ dīrghagrahaṇasyātvavikalpajñāpakatvaṃ na syāditi vācyam, ubhayajñāpakatvasambhavāt| na hyeke naikameva jñāpyate iti niyamaḥ, yāvatā vinā'nupapattistāvato jñāpyatvāt| taccaikamanekaṃ vetyanyadetat| prakṛte cobhayaṃ vinā dīrghagrahaṇavaiyarthyānuddhārāditi dik|
yadi tu ṣṇāḥ ṣakāranakārākārā ante yasyāḥ sā ṣṇānteti prakṛtasūtre evākāro'pi praśliṣyeta tadā ``dvābyām ityatra ``ṣaṭtricaturbhyohalādiḥ (pāosūo6-1-179) iti vibhakterudāttatvaṃ syāt| ``ā dvābhyāṃ haribyāmindra yāhi ityādāvādyudāttameva dvābhyāmiti padaṃ paṭhyate tasmādihākārapraśleṣo na varṇanīyaḥ, kintūktaprakāra evādarttavya iti sthitam| tathā saptame yogavibhāgaṃ kṛtvā tadvalenāpi dvedhā bhāṣye samāhitam| tathāhi, ``ṣaḍbhyo luk (pāosūo7-1-22) ityatra ṣaḍbhya iti vibhajyate| ``aṣṭābya auś (pāosūo7-1-22) iti sūtrādaṣṭābhya ityanuvarttate| tena ṣaḍbhyo yaduktaṃ kṛtākārādaṣṭano'pi tatsyāditi sūtrārthaḥ na caivaṃ jaśśasorlugapyatidiśyeteti vācyam, auśtvavidhivaiyarthyāpatteḥ| athavā ``aṣṭana vā vibhaktau (pāosūo7-2-84) ityasmādanantaraṃ ``rāyaḥ (pāosūo7-2-85) iti yogaṃ vibhajya halītyubhayoryogayoḥ śeṣo vyākhyeyaḥ| tena `aṣṭānām' ityatra nuṭaḥ paścādevātvaṃ na tu tataḥ prāk| na caivaṃ jaśśasorātvaṃ na syāditi vācyam, lāghavārthamaṣṭabhya iti nirdeṣṭhavye ``aṣṭābhya auś' (pāosūo7-1-21) iti kṛtacātvanirdeśena jaśśasorviṣaye ātvānumānāt| yatrātvaṃ tatraivauśtvaṃ yathā syādityetadarthaṃ hi tatra dīrghocyāraṇaṃ kṛtamiti|
syādetat, halīti yadyubhayoḥ śeṣastarhi priyāṣṭanśabde aujasamauṭśasṭāṅeṅasiṅasosāmṅyossu vaikalpikatayeṣyamāṇamātvaṃ na siddhyet| na ca tatrātvaṃ neṣyata eveti vācyam, itaḥprācīnapakṣāṇāmatiḥ vyāptiprasaṅgāt| teṣu hyātvaṃ prāpyate eva vibhaktimātre tadvidhānāt| na ca ``ṣaḍbhyo luk (pāosūo7-1-22) ``ṣaṭcaturbhyaśca (pāosūo7-1-55) iti sūtrābhyāṃ vidhiyamānau lugnuṭau yathā gauṇatāyāṃ na stastathātvamapi na syādeveti vācyam, vaiṣamyāt| lugnuṭirvidhau hi `ṣaḍbhyaḥ' iti `ṣaṭcaturbhyaḥ' iti bahuvacananirdeśāt ṣaḍarthaprādhānya eva tau pravarttete| ātvavidhau tu `aṣṭanaḥ' ityekavacananirdeśād gauṇe'pipriyāṣṭābhyām' ityātvaṃ pravarttete eva ``padāṅgādhikāre tasya taduttapadasya ca (pāobhāo29)iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt| na ca jaśśasoraṣṭābhya auśiti kṛtātvanirdeśanānumīyamānamātvekevale prādhānye ca `aṣṭau' `paramāṣṭau' ityatra yathā bhavatyevaṃ gauṇatve'pi bhaviṣyatīti tadaṃśe nānupapattiriti vācyam, auśtvaṃ hi lugnuṭāviva gauṇatve na bhavati `aṣṭābhyaḥ' iti bahuvacananirdeśāt| anyathā hi kṛtātvānukaraṇe'pyekavacanenaiva nirdiśet--aṣṭā auśiti aṣṭa iti vā| spaṣṭe caitadihaiva sūtre bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ| tathā cauśtvavidhau kṛtātvanirdeśabalenānumīyamānamātvamapi prādhānye eva syānna tu gauṇatāyāmiti tadaṃśepyanupapattisāmyāt| tasmād----
halītyubhayaśeṣaścenna syādātvaṃ priyāṣṭanaḥ|
ṭāṅeṅasiṅasosāmsu tathaivaujasamauṭchasi ||
prāgukteṣu tu pakṣeṣu bhavedātvamamīṣvapi|

ityapītyāśaṅkya ``yathālakṣaṇamaprayukte' ityabhihitatvācca| ata eva yathālakṣaṇamiti pratīkamupādāya na bhavatyevātrātvamityartha iti kaiyaṭo 'vyakhyat| evaṃ sthite prācīnāḥ pakṣā aparitoṣagrastā eva vyavasthitavibhāṣayā gauṇatāyāmajādiṣvātvaṃ na bhavatītyāśayena vā yojyāḥ, udāhṛtabhāṣyakaiyaṭaprāmāṇyāt| tasmātpriyāṣṭnaḥ sarveṣu vacaneṣu rājanśabdasādhāraṇaṃ rūpaṃ, halapādau tu eva ``aṣṭābhya auśu (pāosūo7-1-21) iti sūtre ``tadantagrahaṇamatre,yate paramāṣṭau ityuktvā ``priyāṣṭāna hatyatrātvasyābhāvādauśna bhavati iti kāśikā saṃgacchate| ata eva ca ``aṣṭana ā vibhaktau (pāosūo7-2-84) iti sūtre tadantavidhiścātreṣyate| priyā aṣṭau yasya priyāṣṭāvityapi yathā syāditi kāśikāgrantho'pi saṅgacchate, halādāvātvasya nirbādhatvāt| haradattastu ``aṣṭābyaauś (pāosūo7-1-21) iti sūtre priyāṣṭāna hatvatreti vṛttigranthamupādāya yathā punargauṇatāyāmātvaṃ na bhavati tathā tadvidhāveva vakṣyata iti pratijñāya ``aṣṭana ā vibhaktau (pāosūo7-4-84) iti sūtre lopamicchanti `priyāṣṭaḥ paśya' ityādyātvābhāvapakṣe'pyallope ṣṭutvaṃ `priyāṣṭa' iti bhavatītyantena granthena pūrvapratijñātārthaviparītaṃ bhāṣyavṛcyādiviruddhaṃ ca kathmabhihitavāniti tasyāśayaṃ sa eva praṣṭavyaḥ| allope ṣṭutvamityapi taduktiścintyaiva, pūrvasmādapi na sthānivat (bhāoio) iti niṣedhaḥ ``tasya doṣaḥ saṃyogādilopalatvaṇatveṣu (bhāoio) iti sāpavādatvāt| nanu ``raṣābyāṃ no ṇaḥ munīnāṃ prāmāṇyāt| na ca mūrddhanyaśabdena ṣṭuśabdena vā nirvartyamāne ṇakāre vaiṣamyamasti sūtrakārarītyā kathaṃcitsaṃbhavannapi nyāyo'tra bāṣyānurodhāttyājya eva| tathāca ``śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ (pāosūo7-4-61) iti sūtre kharpūrvagrahaṇaṃ karttavyamiti vārttikaṃ pratyācakṣāṇo bhagavānāha-abhyāsajaśtvacartvaṃ siddhamityeva etvatuggrahaṇaṃ na karttavyamiti| tathāca halādiḥ śeṣe karttavye
