iti ca (pāosūo 1-1-25)|
ḍatyantā saṃkhyā ṣaṭsaṃjñā syāt| kati santi, katyadrākṣīḥ| ṣaṭtvājjaśśasorluk| saṃkhyeti kim? pāterḍatiḥ, patayaḥ| na cāsya saṃkhyāsaṃjñā'pi syāditi vācyam, vatusāhacaryeṇa tatra taddhitasyaiva grahaṇāt| idaṃ sūtraṃ pratyākhyātaṃ bhāṣye| vahugaṇavatusaṃkhyāṃ ``ḍati saṃkhyetyanuvarttate| tataḥ ``ṣṇāntā ṣaṭ saṃkhyā ḍatītyubhayamapyanuvarttate| pūrvasūtrepyanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānāt saṃkhyāpraśnaviṣyasyaiva ḍatergrahaṇaṃ na tvauṇādikasyeti|
ktaktavatū niṣṭhā (pāosūo1-1-23)|
etau niṣṭhāsaṃjñau staḥ| kṛtaḥ| kṛtavān| nanu vihitayoḥ pratyayayoranena saṃjñā| saṃjñayā ca vidhānam| vakṣyati hi tṛtīye - niṣṭheti| tathācānyonyāśraya iti cet? na, sūtraśāṭakavadbhāvisaṃjñāvijñānāt| tau bhūte kāle bhavato yayorvihitayorniṣṭhetyeṣā saṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti|
syādetat, anubandhāḥ kāryārthamupādīyante na tu śravaṇārthaṃ, teṣāṃ lopavidhānāt| tathāca luptānubandhasya pariniṣṭhitasya yatra sārupyaṃ tatra kkānubandhakāryyaṃ bhavatu kka vā neti tu niścetumaśakyam| na ca kākādivadupalakṣaṇasyāpi vyāvarttakatā bhaviṣyatīti vācyam, kākādinā'pi hi vedikāpuṇḍarīkādikaṃ sthiraṃ kiñcitparicāyyate tadvalāccoḍḍīne'pi kāke vyavahāro na saṅkīryyate| na ceha pariceyāntaramupalabhyate ktapratyayatanpratyayoḥ kākādikalpau hi kakāranakārau tadapagame saṃvṛtte - `ta' ityatra pariceyasya parasparavyāvṛttasya durvacatvāditi|
atrāhuḥ--kālakārakaviśeṣādayo arthā evātra vedikāpuṇḍarīkādisthānāpannāstaddarśanāccānubandhasmṛtau satyāṃ tattatprayuktaṃ kāryyaṃ sādhutayā jñāyate| tathā `lūnaḥ śāliḥ' iti kenacitprayukte lakṣaṇajñena karmabhūtakālabalātktapratyayo'yamiti nirṇīyate| ``lotamālabheta iti prayukte tu meṣavācī locaśabdastanpratyayāntaḥ prayukta iti nirṇīyate ``hasimṛgriṇvāmidamilūpūdhūrvibyastan (uosūo3-373) ityuṇādisūtrāt| ``lotaḥ syādaśvameṣayoḥ iti tu pañcapādīvṛttau sthitam| tathā `prābhitta ghaṭaṃ devadattaḥ' iti prayoge kartrekatvādyavagamālluṅantasyāyaṃ prayoge na tu niṣṭhāntasyeti nirṇīyate|
syādetat, ``añcighṛsibhyaḥ ktaḥ (uosūo3.376) iti ktapratyaye `aktaṃ' `ghṛtaṃ' `sitam' iti vyutpāditam| tatrāpi niṣṭhā saṃjñā syāt| tataśca ``niṣṭhā ca dvyajanāt (pāosūo6-1-205) iti svaraḥ syāt| niṣṭhāntaṃ dvyackaṃ saṃjñāyāmādyudāttaṃ syātsa cedādirākāro neti sūtrārthaḥ| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ ``ghṛtaṃ mimikṣe ityādāvantodāttasyaiva paṭhyabhamānatvāditi|
atrāhuḥ--``ataḥ kṛkami (pāosūo8-6-46) iti sūtre kamigrahaṇenaiva siddhe kaṃsagrahaṇena jñāpitamuṇādayaḥ kkacid vyutpattikāryaṃ na labhante iti| ato nātra niṣṭhā saṃjñeti| yadvā ``ghṛtādīnāṃ ca (phiosūo1-21) iti phiṭsūtreṇa siddham|
|| iti śrīśabdakaustubhe prathamādhyāyasya prathame pāde pañcamānhikam ||
sarvādīni sarvanāmāni (pāosūo1-1-27)| etāni sarvanāmasaṃjñāni syuḥ| tadguṇasaṃvijñāno'yaṃ bahuvrīhiḥ| tasyānyapadārthasya guṇānāṃ varttipadārtharūpāṇāṃ viśeṣaṇānāṃ kāryānvayitayā saṃvijñānaṃ yatra sa tadguṇasaṃvijñāna| tatra sarva ādiryeṣāṃ tānīti vigrahaḥ| tacchabdaprayogeṇānyapadārthaprādhānyaṃ labhyate| evaṃ citrā gāvo yasya sa ityādāvapi| anyathā hi yasya gāvaścitrā iti gośabdārthaprādhānyaṃ syāt| na caivaṃvidhe'rthe bahuvrīhiriṣyate| yattu vṛttivākyayorviśeṣyaikyasampattaye citrāṇāṃ gavāmayamityādi vigrahavarṇanaṃ mīmāṃsāvārttike kṛtam, tattu na munivacasāmanukūlam, aprathamāvibhaktyarthe bahuvrīhiriti vārttikakṛtā vakṣyamāṇatvāt| bhāṣyakṛtā ca ``śeṣo bahuvrīhiḥ (pāosūo2-2-23) iti sūtre trikataḥ śeṣamāśritya sūtrākṣarairevoktasyārthasya sādhitatvāt| dvitīyā śritātītādibhistṛtīyā tatkṛtārthenetyādi krameṇa hi ṣaṇṇāṃ trikāṇāṃ samāsa uktastadapekṣayā śeṣaḥ prathamārūpaḥ trikastasyaiva bahuvrīhisaṃjñeti `vṛṣṭe deve gataḥ' ityāderiva citrāṇāṃ gavāmityasyāpi dūrāpāstaṃ bahuvrīhitvam| kiñca ``matvarthe bahuvrīhīḥ (kāovāo) iti kātyāyanavacanātkayaṃ citrāṇāṃ gavāmityatra tatprasaktiḥ? nanu `daṇḍī' ityādāvapi daṇḍasyāyamiti vigrahābhyupagamādasmadrītyā'yameva matvartha iti cetarhi sutarāṃ munivacanavirodhaḥ ``tadasyāstyasmin (pāosūo5-2-94) iti sūtreṇa prathamāntādastyupādhikātsabandhini matubvidhānāt ``samarthānāṃ prathamādvā (pāosūo4-1-82) iti sūtreṇa prathamanirdiṣṭasyaiva prakṛtitvāvadhāraṇācca| nanvetānyapi sūtravārttikabhāṣyavacāṃsi kathañcidbhaṅktvā neṣyāma iti cet? ``samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ (pāosūo2-1-1) ityādīni ``vrīhibhiryajata ityādiṣu padavidhibhinneṣvapi yojayitvā sāmarthya ca bāṣyādisammatādviparītameva varṇayan bhavādṛśo niraṅkuśaḥ kiṃ kiṃ na kuryāt? kintu vyākaraṇādhikaraṇe siddhāntitaṃ vyākaraṇaprāmāṇyaṃ kathaṃ svecchayā vyākulayasīti paraṃ paryyanuyoge samādhānaṃ vibhāvaya| tasmāccitrā gāvo yasyetyeva vigrahaḥ sakalaśiṣṭasampradāyasiddho munitrayavacasāmanukūlaśceti dik|
ādiśabdasyāvayavavācitvādudbhūtāvāyavabhedaḥsamudāyaḥ samāsāryastasya ca samudāyasya yugapallakṣye prayogābhāvādānarthakyāttadaṅgeṣviti nyāyena tadavayaveṣu pravarttamānā saṃjñā'viśeṣātsarvaśabde'pi pravarttate iti yuktaṃ tadguṇasaṃvijñānatvam| ``hali sarveṣām (pāosūo8-3-22) ityādinirdeśāśceha liṅgam| ``jakṣityādayaḥ ṣaṭa (pāosūo6-1-1) iti sūtre tu jakṣiti yogaṃ vibhajya jakṣeḥ saṃjñāvidhānasāmarthyādeva ityādaya ityatadguṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrīhiḥ| etena `katantebhyaḥ' `kaṇvādibhyaḥ' ityubhayatrāpabi śakalaśabdasaṅgrahārthaṃ yathā tatpuruṣabahuvrīhyerekaśeṣa iti caturthe vakṣyate, tathehāpi ``napuṃsakamanapuṃsakena (pāosū 1-2-69) iti vā `svarabhinnānāṃ yasyottaraḥ svaravidhiḥ saśiṣyate iti vā tatpuruṣabahuvrīhyoḥ saha vivakṣāyāṃ bahuvrahīheḥ śeṣa iti parāstam, tadguṇasaṃvijñānabahuvrīhiṇaiva sarvaśabdasyāpi saṃgrahe siddhe ekaśeṣāśrayamasya gauravaparāhatatvāt|
mahāsaṃjñākaraṇamanvarthasaṃjñānārthaṃ sarveṣāṃ nāmānīti| tatsāmarthyācca sarvārthābhidhānasāmarthyaviśiṣṭanāmeva saṃjñitvamanumīyate| tathā ca tathābhūtānāṃ gaṇe pāṭhasyāvaśyakatayā prakarāntarajuṣāṃ ca pāṭhe pramāṇābhāvadeva viśeṣe'vasthitānāṃ saṃjñānāmupasarjanānāṃ ca sarvāditvameva nāsti| tena teṣāṃ gaṇaṃkārthaṃ saṃjñāprayuktakāryyaṃ cetyubhayamapi na bhavati| gaṇakāryaṃ yathā-- ``tyadādīnāmaḥ (pāosūo7-2-102) | tad nāma kaścit, atikrāntastamatitat| yathā -- ``aḍḍutarādibhyaḥ (pāosūo7-1-25)| anyamatikrāntamatyanyam| atikataram| saṃjñāprayuktaṃ yathā--``sarvanāmnaḥ smai (pāosūo7-1-14)| atisarvāya| tadetadabhipretyoktaṃ vārtikakṛtā -- ``saṃjñopasarjanapratiṣedhaḥ pāṭhātparyudāsaḥ paṭhitānāṃ saṃjñākaraṇam iti| tasmātprasiddhena pravṛttinimittena prayukta itaraṃ pratyanupasarjanībhūta eveha saṃjñīti sthitam|
yattu svarūpamātrāśrayaṃ kāryyaṃ na tu gaṇapāṭhaṃ saṃjñāṃ vāpekṣate| yathā ``yuṣmadasmadbhayāṃ ṅaso'ś (pāosūo7-2-27) ityādi, tadupasarjanatve'pi bhavatyevetyavadheyam| na caivaṃ ``yuṣmadyupapade (pāosūo1-4-105) ityādāvapi tvamādiprasaṅgaḥ, lokaprasiddhārthaparatāyāmeva tatpravṛtteḥ| ``abhivyaktapadārthā ye iti nyāyāt| tadantagrahaṇamatra boddhavyaṃ ``dvandve ca (pāosūo1-1-31) iti jñāpakāt| tacca tatraiva vakṣyate, ``prayojanaṃ sarvanāmāvyayasaṃjñāyām iti vārtikavacanācca| tena ` paramasarvataḥ' `paramasarvatra' `paramasarvakaṃ' ityatra samastāttasil tral akacca siddhyati| na ca tasilādividhau prātipadikādityanuvṛtteḥ sarvanāmnā ca tadviśeṣaṇe tadantavidhirbhaviṣyatīti vācyam ``samāsapratyayavidhau na tadantavidhiḥ (kāovāo) iti niṣedhāt| na caivam `atisarvāya' ityādāvatiprasaṅga upasarjanaparyudāsasyoktatvāt| ata eva `paramasarvasmai' ityādau smāyādayo bhavantyeva|
syādetat, `asaḥ' `atasmin' `aneṣaḥ' ityādāvapyatvasatvasminnādīni na syuḥ `atisarva' ityatrevopasarjanatvāt| tathā cābrāhmaṇa ityāderbrāhmaṇabhinna ityādikrameṇa pūrvapadārthaprādhānyena vivaraṇaṃ kurvanti| satyam, vaiyākaraṇamate nañsamāsasyottarapadārthaprādhānyameva| nañsūtre bhāṣyakāreṇa tathaiva siddhāntitatvāt| tathāhi, āropitatvaṃ nañarthaḥ| tathāca māyāmanuṣyamāyāmṛgavyājaniśākarakapaṭabrāhmaṇādiśabdebhya iva āropito mityābhūto'yaṃ brāhmaṇa ityevaṃ śābdabodhaparyavasāne brāhmaṇabhinna ityādikamārthikārthavivaraṇaṃ na tu śābdo'yamarthaḥ| ata eva ``etattadoḥ (pāosūo6-1-1-132) iti sūtre'nañsamāsa iti sārthakam| ata eva cautsargikī tatpuruṣasyottarapadārthapradhānatā'pi nirvahatīti dik|
nanu yadīha tadantavidhiriṣṭastarhi bhāṣyayavirodhaḥ| tatra hi ``saṃjñopasarjanapratiṣedhaḥ iti vārtikasya pratyākhyānamupakramyārthadvārakaṃ vibhaktiviśeṣaṇamāśrityātiprasaṅga uddhṛtaḥ| sarvanāmārthasamavetasaṃkhyākārakādyabhidhāyino ṅeḥ smai syādityādinoktarītyā tadantavidau sati tu `ātisarvāya' ityādau samudāyasya sarvanāmatayā'rthadvārakavibaktiyāgeśrayaṇe'pi smāyādiprasaṅgastadavastha eva syāditi cet? satyam, ata evāparitoṣādbhaṣye ``athavā mahatīyaṃ saṃjñā kriyate iti pakṣāntaramupanyastāmiti gṛhāṇa| nanu yadīyamanvarthasaṃjñā tarhi ``pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāmagaḥ (pāosūo7-4-3) iti ṇatvaṃ syāditi cet? satyam, ata eva nipātanāṇṇatvābhāvaḥ| saṇatvaṃ tu rūpamasādhveva nipātanena ṇatvaśāstrasya bādhitatvāt| ata eva `śāśvatkaḥ' ityādyapyasādhveva| ``yeṣāṃ ca virodhaḥ śāsvatikaḥ (pāosūo2-4-9) iti nipātanena ``isusuktāntāt (pāosūo7-3-51) ityasya bādhitatvāt| nanvevam ``aparasparāḥ kriyāsātatye (pāosūo6-1-144) iti nipātanena santataśabdo bādhyeteti cet? na, tatra `sātatye' ityanenaikadeśānumatidvārā ``lumpedavakṣyamaḥ kṛtye iti pūrvācāryyapaṭhitasya ślokasyaiva jñāpanāt| nanvevamapi ``purāṇaprokteṣu brāhmaṇakalpeṣu (pāosūo4-3-105) iti purāṇaśabdena purātanaśabdasya bādhaḥ prāpnoti| satyam, pṛṣodarādiṣu purātanaśabdasya pāṭho boddhavyaḥ| āgamaśāstrasyāvyayaṭilopasya cānityatāmātraṃ purāṇeti nirdeśena jñāpyate iti tu tattvam| tadeva bādhakānyeva nipātanānīti bhāṣye sthitam|
yadvā, nedaṃ saṃjñāsūtram, kintu gaṇaśuddhimātraphalakam, yāni sarvanāmāni tānyeva sarvādīni na tvitarāṇyapīti vyākhyānāt| yathā ``tiṅo gotrādīni kutsanābhīkṣṇayayoḥ (pāosūo8-1-27) iti sūtre kutsanābhīkṣṇyayoriti yogaṃ vibhajya gotrādīnītyanuvartyaitayorarthayoryāni varttante tānyeva gotrādīni iti gaṇaśuddhiparatayā vyākhyāsyate tena ``canacidiva gotrāditaddhitāmreḍiteṣvagateḥ (pāosūo8-1-57) ``kutsane ca supyagotrādau (pāosūo8-1-69) iti sūtrayorapi viśiṣṭārthānāmeva gotrādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ tathehāpi| nanuktarītyā ``tyadādīnāmaḥ (pāosūo7-2-102) ityādyantargaṇakāryaṃ siddhyatu ``sarvanāmnaḥ smai (pāosūo7-1-14) ityādikaṃ tu kṛtsnasakalādiśabdeṣvativyāptaṃ syāditi cet? na, gaṇapāṭhasāmarthyāttatra paṭhitānāmeva grahaṇāt| etāvāneva hi bhedaḥ| yatpūrvokte pakṣe saṃjñā vidheyā gaṇaśuddhistvārthikī asmiṃstu pakṣe gaṇaśuddhiḥśābdī kṛtsnādivyāvṛttistvarthāditi| athavobhayamanena kriyate pāṭhaśuddhiḥ saṃjñā ca, tantrāvṛttyekaśeṣāṇāmanyatamāśrayaṇāt| tatra saha vivakṣāṃ vinā'pi vācanika ekaśeṣaḥ| ākṛtipakṣe hi pratyākhyātaṃ sarūpasūtram ``iko guṇavṛddhī (pāosūo1-1-3) ityādi yaṃcchāstraprakriyārthaṃ satsahavivakṣāṃ vinā'pyekaśeṣaṃ vidhatte| taditthaṃ pañcāpi pakṣāḥ sthitāḥ| saṃjñābhūtānāṃ vyāvṛttistu gauṇamukhyanyāyenāpi siddhyati| na cāsau padakāryeṣveveti vācyam, viśiṣṭarūpopādāne sarvatra tatpravṛtterityupapaditamotsūtre| vārttikarītyā tvekasaṃjñādhikāre sarvanāmasaṃjñānantaramekadravyaniveśini saṃjñeti saṃjñāsaṃjñayā sarvanāmasaṃjñā bādhyate ityapi samādhānāntaraṃ boddhavyam| yadbā ``pūrvaparāvara iti gaṇasūtre'saṃjñāyāmiti yogaṃ vibhajya pūrvottarayoḥ śeṣo vyākhyeyaḥ| uktāḥ sarvādayo vakṣyamāṇāḥ svādayaścāsaṃjñāyāmiti| tasmādupasarjanavyāvṛttirevānvarthasaṃjñāśrayaṇasya mukhyaṃ phalam| nanu ``anupasarjanāt (pāosūo4-1-14) iti yogaṃ prakārāntareṇa vyākhyāya tadbalenaivāntargaṇakāryaṃ vāritaṃ bhāṣye| tadyathā-- `anupasarjana' iti luptaṣaṣṭhīkaṃ padam| aḥ āditi ca cchedaḥ| aśca acca tayoḥ samāhāraḥ āt| akārātparau a at ityādeśau yatra kriyete tatrānupasarjanasya grahaṇamiti paribhāṣārthaḥ| tena tyadādyatvam ``aḍḍatarādibhyaḥ (pāosūo7-1-25) ityadaḍbhāvaśca gauṇatāyāṃ na bhavati| akārātparatvena viśeṣaṇatvaṃ kim? ``pañcamyā at (pāosūo7-1-32) yuṣmānatikrāntebhyo'tiyuṣmat| ``ekavacanasya ca (pāosūo7-1-32) yuṣmānatikrāntādatiyuṣmat| na hyayamakārātparo vidhīyate iti| tathā copasarjanavyāvṛtterapyanyathāsiddhau kiṃ mahāsaṃjñayeti cet?
na, `atisarvāya' ityādivārṇasya tadekasādhyatvāt| na hīdam ``anupasarjanāt (pāosūo4-1-14) ityanena sādhayituṃ śakyate| etadaparitopādeva hi bhāṣye pakṣāntarāśrayaṇamiti dik| evañca ``anupasarjanāt (pāosūo4-1-14) iti sūtraṃ paribhāṣātvenāpi nopayujyate ityarthātpratyākhyānameva bhavatītyavadheyam|
syādetat, kaumbhakāreyasiddhaye sūtramārambhaṇīyam tatra hi kumbhakārīśabdādeva ḍhagutpādayitavyaḥ| anyathā kumbhetyukārasya vṛddhirna syāt| tathāca viśiṣṭasya strīpratyayāntatāpyeṣṭavyā| sā ca tadaiva nirvahati| yadi ``ṭiḍḍhāṇañ (pāosūo4-1-15) iti sūtre pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā'ṇityanenāṇantagrahaṇe tena ca prātipadikaviśeṣaṇādaṇṇantāntaṃ prakṛtiḥ syāt| tacca ``samāsapratyayavidhau pratiṣedhaḥ (kāovāo) itika ``grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirna (pāosūo4-1-14) ityupasarjananiṣedhasāmarthyāttu pradhānena tadantavidhau jñāpite kaumbhakāreyaḥ siddhyatīti spaṣṭamava| naṃ ca ``kṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi (pāobhāo28) iti paribhāṣayā kumbhakāraśabdādeva strīpratyayo'stviti vācyam, aṇiti hi taddhito'pi gṛhyate| aupagavīti yathā| ``kṛdgrahaṇe (pāobhāo28) iti paribhāṣā tu kṛnmātragrahaṇe pravarttate na tu kṛdakṛdgrahaṇe'pi evamarthamevedaṃ sūtramiti bhāṣyakṛtaiva caturthe sthāpayiṣyate| tatkathamihoktam ``anupasarjanāt (pāosūo4-1-14) ityayaṃ yogaḥ pratyākhyāyate iti?
atrocyate, caturthe sūtrakārābhiprāyavarṇanamātraṃ kariṣyate| niṣkarṣe tu kriyamāṇe sūtravaiyarthyamevāyātītyāśayeneha bhagavatoktaṃ pratyākhyāyate iti| tathāhi, kāraśabdānṅībutpattāvapi kaumbhakāreyaḥ sidhyatyeva ``ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇam ``strīpratyaye cānupasarjanena (paobhāo26) iti paribhāṣayā'nupasarjane strīpratyaye tadādiniyamaniṣedhena kumbhakārīśabdāddagutpatteḥ| ata eva hi `paramakārīṣagandhīputraḥ ityatra ṣyaṅantasyocyamānaṃ samprasāraṇaṃ paramakārīṣagandhyāśabdasyāpi bhavatyeva| na caivam `atikārīṣagandhyaputraḥ' ittyādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ| ``anupasarjana ityuktatvenopasarjane tadādiniyamasattvāt| na caivam `adhīpippalī' ityādau halṅyādilopo na syāditi vācyam, halṅyādisūtre dīrghagrahaṇasāmarthyena tatropasarjanenāpi tadādiniyamo nāstīti jñāpitatvāt| vastutastu niṣkauśāmbyādau samudāyasyāṅyābantatve'pyavayavasya ṅayābantatayā tataḥ parasya sorlopaprāpternaitajjñāpakam| arddhapippalyādāvapyavayavasya ṅyantatavaiva nirvāhaḥ| na ca vihitaviśeṣaṇatā vaktuṃ śakyā `yā' `sā' ityādāvavyāpteḥ| na ca tatra halantād vihitatvena nirvāhaḥ `karttā' `hartā' ityādāvalopāpatteḥ, `yaḥ' `saḥ' ityādau lopāpatteśca| yadvā, sutisītipratyayaiḥ prakṛtirākṣipyate halantyasūtre kaiyaṭagranthanirvāhāya vivaraṇe tathaiva varṇanāt| evañca jñāpakaṃ susthamekadeśasyāprakṛtitvāt| ata eva pañcamasamāptau ``gostriyorupasarjanasya (pāosūo1-2-48) iti sūtre ca kaiyaṭena jñāpakatvapakṣa evoktaḥ| nanubayathāpi `mā lā hṛṣṭā' ityādau samudāyādābantatvaprayuktaḥ suḥ syāttataścaikapadyaikasvaryayorāpattiḥ| ekavākyatayā vidhiriti pakṣe'pi `pacatikalpam' ityādisiddhaye ekavacanamutsarga ityasyāvaśyāśrayaṇīyatvāditi cet na, ṅyabgrahaṇasyānyārthatayā yathākathañcitprātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭagrahaṇena ṅyābantatvātsubutpatteśca vakṣyamāṇatvāt| iha ca samudāyasyāprātipadikatvāt| arthavatsamudāyānāṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthamiti hi sthāsyati| na caivamapi kadācitkārīśabdāḍ ḍhak syādeveti vācyam ekāj‌dvirvacananyāyena samudāyādevotpatteḥ, kumbhenaikārthībhūtasya niṣkṛṣyāpatyena yoga iti vaktumaśakyatvācca| kiñca sūtramārabhamāṇasyāpyeṣaiva gatiḥ| `aupagavī' ityādāviva kevalātkāraśabdādapi kadācinṅīpprasaṅgena kaumbhakāreye pākṣikadoṣasya tvatpakṣe'pi tulyatvāt|
syādetat, akriyamāṇe'smin sūtre `kumbhakārī' ityatra ṅīveva na syāt| kumbhenaikārthībhūtasyāṇṇantasya strītvenāyogāt| yasya ca strītvena yogo viśiṣṭasya, na tadaṇṇantam| tasmādamahatpūrvāditi niṣedhena jñapyamānastadantavidhiruttaratrāpyabhyupagantavyaḥ| sa ca yathā pūrvatropasarjanenāpi bhavati ``na ṣaṭsvastrādibhyaḥ (pāosūo4-1-10) priyapañcā draupadī, ``vano ra ca (pāosūo4-1-7) atidhīvarī iti, tathā ṭidādāvapi syāt| tataśca `bahakurucarā' ityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ| ato niṣedhasūtramidaṃ sārthakam| nanu pūrvatropāttaṃ tadantaṃ ca striyāmityanena viśeṣyate ``ṭiḍhḍhāṇañ (pāosūo4-1-15) ityādau tūpāttaṃ ṭidādikameva tena `bahukurucarā' ityādau ṭidāderastrītvānna ṅīp| `kumbhakārī' ityādau tvaṇṇantasya striyāṃ vṛttestadantādapi ṅīp bhaviṣyatīti cet? na, etadviṣayavibhāgasya duruhatayā tajjñānārthameva sūtrārambhasyocitatvāt| naitadevam, ārabdhe'pyasminsūtre vyākhyānasyaiva śaraṇīyatvāt|
anyathā `pañcājī' ityatrājānāmastrītve'pi tadantasya sriyāṃ vṛttyā ṭāpprasaṅgāt| ato viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaṃ prati kāmacārād ``ajādyataṣṭāp (pāosūo4-1-4) ityatra ``ṭiḍhḍhāṇañ (pāosūo4-1-15) ityādau copāttaṃ strītvena viśeṣyate ``vano ra ca (pāosūo4-1-7) ityādau tūpāttaṃ tadantaṃ ceti sakaleṣṭāsiddheḥ sūtraṃ vyarthameva|
syādetat, tadantavidhijñāpanārthamevedaṃ sūtramārambhaṇīyam| na ca `amahatpūrvā' (kāovāoeo) ityanenaiva tatsiddhiriti vācyam, tasya jñāpakatvāyogāt| `pañcājī' ityādisiddhyarthamajādibhiḥ strītvaṃ viśeṣyate iti hi vakṣyate| tathāca `mahāsūśūdrī' ityatra samudāyasya striyāṃ vṛttāvapyavayavasyātathātvena satyapi tadantavidhau ṭāp na prāpnotīti kathaṃ tadantavidhiṃ jñāpayitvā niṣedhaḥ paryavasyet? maivam, itarairajādibhiḥ strītvaviśeṣaṇe'pi śūdraśabdenāviśeṣaṇāt| evañca spaṣṭameva jñāpakaparyavasānam| na caivaṃ `pañcaśūdrī' ityatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ jītirityanena śūdrasya viśeṣaṇāt|
syādetat, ``pūrvasūtranirdeśo vāpiśalamadhīta iti iti kātyāyanoktarītyā sūtraṃ sārthakam| tathāhi, apradhānamupasarjanam, tathaiva pūrvācāryasūtreṣu loke ca vyavahārāt| tataścā''piśalinā proktam ``iñasca (pāosūo4-2-112) ityaṇ| tatodhyetryāṃ ``tadadhīte (pāosūo 4-1-59) ityaṇ| tasya ``proktālluk (pāosūo4-2-64) iti luk| āpiśalā brāhmaṇī| atra proktārthasyāṇo'pradhānatvāttadantānna ṅīp| aṇ yaḥ aḥ anupasarjanamapradhānamiti viśeṣaṇāt| na caivamapyadhyetryāmutpannasyāṇo'nupasarjanatayā tadāśryo ṅīp syādeveti vācyam, tasyaluptatvāt| na ca pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ śaṅkyam, varṇāśraye tanniṣedhāt| ``ṭiḍhḍhāṇañ (pāosūo4-1-15) ityatra hyata ityanuvartate| aṇā ca akāro viśeṣyate| aṇyo'kāra iti na tu viparīto viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ| varṇasyāprādhānye pratyayalakṣaṇāpatteḥ `atṛṇeḍ' ityatra tṛṇahaim vat| nanu striyāmityanenāṇo viśeṣaṇānnoktadoṣa iti cet? na, kāśakṛtsninā proktā mīmāṃsā kāśakṛtsnī, tāmadhīte kāśakṛtsnā brāhmaṇī| atra dvitīye'ṇi ``proktālkuk (pāosūo4-2-64) iti lupte prathamo'pyaṇ striyāmevotpanna iti tadantād brāhmaṇyāṃ varttamānāt ṅīp syāt| tasmātpradhānādyathā syādapradhānānmā bhūdityetadarthamārambhaṇīyaṃ sūtramiti|
atrocyate, adhyetryāmabhidheyāyāmaṇa īkāreṇa bhavitavyam| yaśce hādhyetryāmaṇutpannaḥ sa lupta eva| yaśca śrūyate tasmādīkāra utpanno luptaśceti punarna bhavati sakṛtpravṛttyā lakṣaṇasya caritārthatvāt| tasmād ``anupasarjanāt (pāosūo4-1-14) ityayaṃ yogaḥ pratyākhyāta iti bhayavaduktirnirbādhaiveti dik|
sarvādayaśca pañcatriṃśat---sarva, viśva, ubha, ubhaya, ḍatara, ḍatama, anya, anyatara, itara, tvat, tva, nemaṃ, sama, sima, pūrvaparāvaradakṣiṇottarāparādharāṇi vyavasthāyāmasaṃjñāyām| svamajñātidhanākhyāyām| antaraṃ bahiryogopasaṃvyānayoḥ| tyad, tad, etad, idam, adas, eka, dvi, yuṣmad, asmad, bhavatu, kim, iti| tatra sarvaviśvaśabdau kṛtsnaparyāyau sarvaśabdasya ``svāṅgaśiṭām (phiosūo2-27) ityādyudāttatve prāpte'ntodāttatvaṃ gaṇe nipātyate| tena sarveṣāṃ vikāra ityatra ``anudāttāderañ (pāosūo4-2-44) siddhaḥ| sa hyanudāttādiprakṛtikādvidhīyate iti ṅyāpsūtre bhāṣye sthitam| prayoge tu ``sarvasya supi (pāosūo6-1-191) ityādyudātta eva|
ubhaśabdo dvitvaviśiṣṭasya vācakaḥ| ata eva nityaṃ dvivacanāntaḥ| yadyevaṃ tarhi kimarthamasau sarvādiṣu paṭhyate ? na hyatra smāyādayaḥ sambhavanti| kākacostu nāsti rūpe svare vā viśeṣaḥ| avagrahastu kapratyaye'pi padakārairna kriyate ``citra idrājā rājakāḥ ``idanyake ityādau tathaiva nirṇītatvāt| na ca `ubhābhyāṃ hetubhyām' `ubhayorhetvoḥ' ityatra ``sarvanāmnastṛtīyā ca (pāosūo2-3-27) iti pākṣikatṛtīyāsiddhyartha iha pāṭha iti vācyam, ``nimittakāraṇahetuṣu sarvāsāṃ prāyadarśanam‌ (kāovāo) iti vārtikena gatārthatvāt| na ca vṛttikṛtā ``sarvanāmnastṛtīyā ca (pāosūo2-3-27) iti sūtre paṭhitatvādidaṃ vārttikamapi sarvanāmasaṃjñāsāpekṣameveti vācyam, bhāṣye ``hetau (pāosūo2-3-23) iti sūtre tasya paṭhitatvāt| ata eva `annena kāraṇena vasati' `annasya kāraṇasya ' ityudāhṛtaṃ haradattena|
atrocyate, ubhaśabdastāvad dvivacanamātraviṣayaḥ| vṛttau tu dvivacanalopānnāsau prayujyate, ubhābhyāṃ pakṣābhyāṃ vinītanidrā iti vigrahe `ubhayapakṣa' (raovāo5-72) ityādiprayogadarśanāt| kathaṃ tarhi ubhasthāne ubhayaśabdasiddhiriti cet? ittham, ``ubhādudātto nityam (pāosūo5-2-44) ityatrobhāditi yoge vibhajyate| avayavavṛtteḥ saṃkhyāvācina ubhaśabdādavayavinyarthe ayac syāt| ubhayo maṇi| tato ``nityam ubhaśabdād vṛttiviṣaye nityamayac syāt| anirdiṣṭārthatvātsvārthe| tadetaduktaṃ vārttikakṛtā - ``ubhayo'nyatra iti| evaṃ sthite `ubhayataḥ' `ubhayatra' ityādāviva kapratyaye'pyubhaya eva prāpteḥ| akaci tu `ubhakau' ityādi sidhyati| na cehāpi `ubhaye' iti syādeveti vākhyam, akajarthaṃ sarvādiṣu pāṭhenāyaco bādhāt| anyathā pāṭhavaiyarthyā patteriti dik| ``svāṅgaśiṭāmadantānām (phiosūo2-29) ityādyudā ttārthaṃ pāṭha iti tu na yuktam, gaṇe evāntodāttasya nipātyamānatvāt| anyathā ``ubhe bhadre joṣayete `ubhāu nūnam' `ubhābhyāṃ deva savitaḥ' `sapatyata ubhayornṛmṇamayoḥ' ityādāvādyudāttaprasaṅgāt| ubhayaśabdastvavayavadvayārabdhe'vayavini varttate `ubhayo maṇiḥ' iti yathā| śyāmalohitābhyāmavayavābhyāmārabdha ityarthaḥ| tirohitāvayavabhedatvādekavacanam| `ubhayameva vadanti manīṣiṇaḥ' ityādau tu samudāyadvayaghaṭitaḥ samudāyo'rthaḥ| tirohitāvayavabhedatvaṃ tu tulyameva| yadā tu vargadvayārabdhe mahāsamudāye varttate tadāvargyabhinnena vargyadvayena mahābhedavivakṣayodbhūtāvayavabhedatvādbahuvacanānta eva, ubhaye devamanuṣyāḥ| tasya mitrāṇyamitrāste ye ca ye cobhaye nṛpāḥ|
iti yathā| yadā tu prāguktarītyā `ubhayo maṇiḥ' iti vyutpādya tādṛśameva maṇidvayaṃ saha vivakṣyate, tadaikaśeṣeṇa dvivacanaṃ prāpnoti| bhanabhidhānāttu na bhavati| tathāca ``taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ (pāosūo1-1-37) iti sūtre ``kṛttaddhitānāṃ grahaṇaṃ ca pāṭha iti bhāṣyamavatārayankaiyaṭa āha--``ubhayaśabdasya dvivacanānutpādādasarvavibhaktitvam iti haradattastu tasminneva sūtre ubhayaśabdād dvivacanamaṅgīkṛtya pāṭhāśrayaṇaṃ tu `pacatikalpaṃ' `pacatirupam' ityādāvatiprasaṅgaṃ vārayitumityāha| ihāyajādeśasya sthānivadbhāvena tayap‌pratyayāntatayā ``prathamacarama (pāosūo1-1-33) iti sūtreṇa jasi vibhāṣā prāpnoti vyavasthitavibhāṣāyā pūrvavipratiṣedhena vā nityameva jasi sarvanāmateti kecit| vibhaktinirapekṣatvenāntaraṅgayā nityasaṃjñayā bahiraṅgā vaikalpikī bādhyate iti tu siddhāntaḥ| ``na veti vibhāṣā (pāosūo1-1-44) iti sūtre bhāṣyakārastvāha --ayat pratyayāntarameva na tvasau tayasyādeśaḥ ``ubhādudāttaḥ (pāosūo5-2-44) iti sūtre tayapo'nanuvṛtteḥ| na caivam `ubhayī' ityatra ``ṭiḍḍhāṇañ (pāosūo 4-1-15) iti sūtreṇa tayabantatvaprayukto ṅīp na syāditi vācyam, tatra mātrājiti mātraśabdātprabhṛtyayacaścakāreṇa pratyāhāragrahaṇāt| evañca tayabgrahaṇamapi na tatra kāryam| yadvā, dvayasajiti pratyāhāraḥ| tathāca daghnañmātracorapi grahaṇaṃ na karttavyamiti mahadeva lāghavam| vastutastu ``pramāṇe mātracdvayasacdaghnacaḥ iti pāṭhyamiti bhāṣyāśayaḥ| tathā ca tato'pi lāghavam| na caivaṃ `kati striyaḥ' ityatrātiprasaṅgaḥ| ata ityanuvṛtteḥ, ``na ṣaṭsvasrādibhyaḥ (pāosūo6-4-137) iti niṣedhādvā| na caivaṃ `tailamātrā' ityādāvatiprasaṅgāḥ, sadṛśasyāpyasya pratyāhāre'sanniviṣṭatvāditi|
atra kaścit, ubhayetyarthaparo nirdeśaḥ| tena ``vyarthā dvayeṣāmapi medinībhṛtām (māokāo ) iti māghaprahayogaḥ samarthito bhavatītyāha| tanna, arthaparatāyāṃ vṛttikārādyabhiyuktavacanānupalambhāt| mahākaviprayogabalādeva kalpyate iti cet? na, mahākavibhireva tadviparītasya bahuśaḥ prayogāt| tathāca māghaḥ ``gurudvayāya guruṇoḥ (māokāo 2-6) iti| kālidāso'pi-- ``asmin dvaye rūpavidhānayatna iti| śrīharṣaśca----
aye mamodāstameva jivhayā dvayeti tasminna natiprayojane| iti|
tasmād dvayaṃ dvaidhamiṣyanti gachantīti dvayeśasteṣāṃ dvayeṣāmitīṣeḥ kkibantasya rūpaṃ bodhyam|
yattu kaścidāha-cākravarmaṇavyākaraṇe dvayaśabdasyāpi sarvanāmatā'bhyupagamāttadrītyā'yaṃ prayoga iti tadapi na, munitrayamatenedānīṃ sādhvasādhuvibāgastasyaivedānīṃtanaśiṣṭairvedhāṅgatayā parigṛhītatvāt| dṛśyante hi niyatakālāḥ smṛtayaḥ| yathā kalau pārāśarasmṛtirityādīti ``śatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate (pāosūo5-1-22) iti sūtre sarvaikavākyatayā siddhāntitatvāt|
ḍataraḍatau pratyayau yadyapi ``saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantagrahaṇaṃ nāsti (paobhāo-27) tathāpīha ``prayojanaṃ sarvanāmāvyayasaṃjñāyām (kāovāo) iti vācanikastadantavidhiḥ, kevalayoḥ saṃjñāyāḥ prayojanābhāvādvā| anyo bhinnaḥ| anyatarānyatamaśabdāvavyutpannau svabhāvād dvibahuviṣaye nirdhāraṇe varttete iti paspaśāyāṃ kaiyaṭaḥ| tatrānyatamaśabdasya gaṇe pāṭhābhāvānna sarva nāmakāryam| nāpi ``aḍḍatarādibhyaḥ (pāosūo7-1-25) ityādyantargaṇakāryyam| tathāca prayujyate ``na tāvatsāmānyādiṣvanyatamaṃ tamaḥ iti| śākaṭāyanastvacanyatarānyatamau ḍataraḍatamāntau vyutpāditavān| tanmate'pyanyataraśabdapāṭhasya niyamārthatvādanyatamaśbdo'ntargaṇakāryaṃ sarvanāmasaṃjñākāryaṃ ca na labhyate iti tadvyakhyātāraḥ ``itarastvanyanīcayoḥ (aokoo3-3-200) ityamaraḥ| tvatva iti dvāvapyadantāvanyaparyāyau tatraika udāttaḥ, paro'nudāttaḥ| ``etaṃ tvaṃ manye daśa putramutsam ityudāttasya prayoga| ``utatvaḥ paśyan ityādiranudāttasyeti vivekaḥ| kecittu tvaditi tāntamekaṃ paṭhanti| tathāca jayadevaḥ prāyuṅkta-``tvadadharamadhuramadhūni pibantam iti|tvatto'nyasyā adhara iti ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo na tu tavādharastvadadhara iti, ``paśyati diśidiśi rahasi bhavantam iti pūrvavākyena sahānanvayāpatteḥ| anudāttaścāyam ``tvatvasamasimetyanucyāni (phiosūo4-78) iti phiṭsūtrāt| tathāca prayujyate ``starīrutvadbhavati sūta utvat iti| tvaditi sarvanāmasu paṭhito'nudātto'yamanyaparyāya iti tadvyāśyāyāṃ vedabhāṣyakārāḥ| iha prāguktarītyodāttānudāttayorakārāntayoranudāttasya takārāntasya ca prāmāṇikatvaṃ nirvivādameva| gaṇapāṭhe paraṃ vipratipattiḥ| tatrāpyanudāttasyākārāntasya gaṇapāṭhe na saṃśayaḥ ``uto tvasmai tanvam ityādiprayogāt| avaśiṣṭayormadhye katarasya gaṇe pāṭha iti tu saṃśayodāhṛtaprayogāṇāṃ tatraudāsīnyāt| tasmāttāntasyākajādikamudāttasya vā smāyādikaṃ kvacicchākhāyāṃ prayujyate naveti vibhāvya tatvaṃ nirṇeyaṃ bahuśrutairiti dik|
vastutastvādyasya tāntaccheda eva yuktaḥ| anyathā aikṣvākaśabda iva svarasarvanāmnā ekaśrutyobhayasaṅ‌grahasambhavāttvaśabdamekamevāpaṭhiṣyaditi dhyeyam| `tve vasūni' `tve rāyaḥ' ityādayastu śepratyayāntasya yu ṣmadaḥ prayogo na tu tvaśabdasya| padakāraiḥ pragṛhyatvaprayuktasyotiśabdasya prayogāditi sthitaṃ vedabhāṣye|
nema ityardve| prayogaśca ``pranemasmindadṛśe soma iti| samaḥ sarvaparyāyaḥ| ``nabhantāmanyake same| ``mānovṛkāya vṛkye samasmai| ``uruṣyāṇe aghāyataḥ samasmāt| ``uto samāsmin| tulyaparyāyasya tu samāśabdasya na sarvanāmatā ``yathāsaṃkhyamanudeśaḥ samānām (pāosūo1-3-10) iti jñāpakāt| ``kṛnmejantaḥ (pāosūo1-1-39) iti sūtre ``ete doṣāḥ samā bhūyāṃso vā iti bhāṣyakāraprayogācca| etena ``same yajeta iti prayogo vyākhyātaḥ|
simaḥ kṛtsne ca śakte ca syānmaryādāvabaddhayoḥ|
iti nighaṇṭuḥ| ``ādrātrīvāsastanute simasmai| ``ucchukramatkamajate simasmāt| yadyapīha ``tvattvasamasimetyanuccāni (phiosūo4-78) iti prāptaṃ tathāpi ``simasyātharvaṇe'nta udāttaḥ (phiosūo4-78) ityu dāttatā| atharvavedapraviṣṭe mantre ṛgvedādigate'pītyabhiyuktairvyākhyātatvādityavadheyam|
pūrvaparāvarottarāparāḥ pañca dikkālayostadavacchinne ca| pūrvasyāṃ diśi pūrvasminkāle pūrvasyāṃ vāpyām pūrvasmingurāvityādi| dakṣiṇādharaśabdau diśi tadavacchinne ca| arthaniyamaścāyaṃ vyavasthāyāmityuktergamyate| svābhideyenāpekṣyamāṇasyāvadherniyamo hi vyavasthā| pūrvādiśabdānāmuktortho hi niyamena kañcidavadhimapekṣate| ``sthāgāpāpaco bhāve (pāosūo3-3-25) iti ktini prāpte 'ta eva nipātanādaṅ| vyavasthāyāṃ kim? ikṣiṇā gāthakāḥ| pravīṇā ityarthaḥ| `adhare tāmbūlarāgaḥ' `uttare pratyuttare vā śaktaḥ'| kathaṃ tarhi ``tathā pareṣāṃ yudhi ca (raovaṃ 3-21) iti kālidāsaḥ? ``apare pratyavatiṣṭhante ityādi ca? atrāhuḥ, deśavācitayā vyavasthāviṣayayoreva parāparaśabdayorupacārācśatrau prativādini ca prayogaḥ| na caivamupasarjanatā| na hi lākṣiṇikatvamupasarjanatvaṃ, kintu svārthaviśiṣṭārthāntarasaṃkramaḥ| sa tu na vṛttipraviṣṭasyāpi pradhānasya na vā lākṣaṇisasyāpi vṛttimapraviṣṭasya| ata eva `tasmādvahnimān' ityādau jñānalakṣaṇāpakṣe'pi sarvanāmakāryam| tadyo'haṃ so'sau, yo'sau so'hamityatra bhāgatyāgalakṣaṇāyāmapi sarva nāmakāryapravṛttiriti bhūvādisūtre `etānyapītyetatpratipādyāni vastūnītyarthaḥ'| iti kaiyaṭaśca| vastutastvatra śatrutvādiprakārakobodho'naśvādiśabdebhyo bhinnatvāderivārthikaḥ śabdāttudeśāntaraniṣṭhatvādiprakāraka eveti tattvam|
asaṃjñāyāṅkim? uttarāḥ kuravaḥ| sumerumavadhimapekṣya kuruṣūttaraśabdo varttate ityastīha vyavasthā| prasiddhatvāttu nāvadheḥ prayogaḥ| `megho varṣati' ityatra jalasya yathā evaṃ `diśaḥ sapatnī bhava dakṣiṇasyāḥ' ityādāvapi vastuto vyavasthā'stīti sarvanāmakāryaṃ sambhavatyeva| na ca sejñātvānniṣedhaḥ ādhunikasaṅketo hi saṃjñā| na ca dikṣu sā'stīti pañcame'stāti prakaraṇe kaiyaṭaharadattādayaḥ| atra dikṣu cirantanaḥ kuruṣu tvādhunikaḥ saṅketa ityatra vyākhyātṛvacanameva pramāṇam|
svaśabdasya catvāro'rthāḥ ātmā ātmīyo jñātirdhanaṃ ceti|
svo jñātāvātmani svaṃ triṣvātmīye svo'striyāṃ dhane| (aokoo3-3-219)
ityamaraḥ| yadyapi ``svāminnaisvarye (pāosūo5-2-126) iti sūtre īsvaratvavācyapi svaśabdaḥ svīkṛtadastatāpyasau mattvarthīyemanicpratyayamātraviṣayo na tu kevalaḥ-prayogārhaḥ| tatra jñātidhanayorniṣedhādāttmātmīyayoreva saṃjñā| ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kim? ātmīyatvaṃ puraskṛtya jñātidhanayorapi pravṛttau sarvanāmatā yathā syāt| ātmātmīyayorityeva tu vaktumihocitam| svasmai ityādi| jasi vibhāṣāvidhāyake'ṣṭādhyāyīsthe sūtre'pyevam| yattuṃ tatra svamātmīyaityeva vaktumucitamātmavācino napuṃsakatayā jasi vibhāṣāyāmupayogābhāvāditi kecit| taccintyam, sūtrasāmarthyādevātmanyapi puṃstvalābhāt| ata evāmarakośe'pyātmanīti pūrvānvayi, svamiti tūttarānvayi| tathā ca hemacandraḥ-
dyauḥ svarganabhasoḥ svo jñātyātmanoḥ svaṃ nije dhane| iti| medinīkāro'pi--
vastutastu ``pūrvapara ityāditrisūtryāmarthanirddeśaḥ pāṭhaviśeṣaṇam| tenetareṣāṃ pāṭhādeva paryyudāsaḥ| tathāca ``vibhāṣā jasi (pāosūo1-1-32) ``iti prakaraṇe ``pūrvādīni nava ityeva lāghavātkarttavyam| trisūtrī tu na paṭhanīyaiveti niṣkarṣaḥ| athavā gaṇapāṭha eva pūrvādinavakapāṭhānantaraṃ ``vibhāṣā jasi (pāosūo1-1-32) iti karttavyaṃ, pūrvādīni cārthaviśiṣṭānyanuvarttanīyāni| na ca sarvādīnāmapyanuvṛttiḥ śaṅkyā, nemasya jasi vibhāṣārambhāt| yadvā, `jasṅasiṅīnāṃ śismātsminaḥ ``pūrvādibhyo navabhyo vā ``auṅa āpaḥ śī ``napuṃsakācca iti saptame nyāsaḥ karttavyaḥ| paramārthastu saptame yathānyāsamevāstu| ``pūrvādibhyo navabhyo vā (pāosūo7-1-16) ityetattu ``jasaḥ śī (pāosūo7-1-17) ityatrānuvartya vākyabhedena sambhantsyate ``vā chandasi (pāosūo6-1-203) ityetad ``ami pūrvaḥ (pāosūo 6-1-107) ityatra yathā tathā ceyaṃ trisūtrī aṣṭādhyāyyāṃ na pāṭhyeti sthitam| asaṃjñāyāmiti tu na kāryamanvarthasaṃjñayā `abhivyaktapadārthā ye' iti nyāyena vā saṃjñāyā vyudastatvāt| antaraśabdastu nānārthaḥ| tathā cāmaraḥ---
antaramavakāśāvadhiparidhānāntarddhibhedatādarthye| chidrātmīyavinābahiravasaparamadhyentarātmani ca || (aokoo3-3-94) iti|
atra bahiryogopasaṃvyānayorevārthayoḥ saṃjñā| bahirityanāvṛtto deśo bāhyaṃ cocyate| tatrādye antare antarā vā gṛhāḥ| nagarabāhyāścāṇḍālādigṛhā ityarthaḥ| dvitīye nagarābhyantaragṛhā ityarthaḥ| upasaṃvyānaśabdo'pi karaṇavyutpatyottarīyaparaḥ| karmavyutpattyā tvantarīyaparaḥ| ubhayathāpi bahiryogeṇa gatārthatvāt upasaṃvyānagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyamiti bhāṣye sthitam| kecittu śāṭakānāṃ traye śarīrasaṃyuktasya tṛtīyasya, catuṣṭaye tu caturthasya tatsaṃyacuktasva vā, tṛtīyasya bahiryogābhāvādupasaṃvyānagrahaṇaṃ karttavyaṃ śāṭakayugadyarthamiti padato vārttikakārasyāpyayamevāśya ādiśabdavalādavagamyate| bhāṣyamate tu bahiryogagrahaṇaṃ svaryate tena ``śītoṣṇābhyāṃ kāriṇi (pāosūo5-2-72) ityādāviva gauṇagrahaṇātparamparayā bāhyasambaddhasyāpi bhaviṣyatītyāhuḥ| satyapi bahiryoge purīviṣayatāyāṃ na sarvanāmatā ``apurīti ca vaktavyam iti vārttikāt| taddhi gaṇasūtrasya śeṣo na tu jasi vibhāṣāvidhāyakasya, ata ityadhikṛtya jasaḥ śīvidhānādābantātprāpatyabhāvāt| antarāyāṃ puri| prākārādbāhyāyāṃ tadantarvarttinyāṃ vetyarthaḥ| liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayaikādeśasya pūrvāntagrahaṇena grahaṇādvā prāptirbodhyā|
tyad, tad, etau pūrvoktaparāmarśakau| tatrādyaśchāndasaḥ| `eṣa syabhānu' iti gaṇaratnakārastanna, tathā sati ``śyaśchandasi bahulam (pāosūo6-1-133) iti sūtre chandograhaṇavaiyarthyāpatteḥ| yad uddeśyasamarpakaḥ| etadidamau pratyakṣopasthita| adas vyavahite| ekonyārthe pradhāne ca prathame kevale tathā|
sādhāraṇe samāne ca saṃkhyāyāṃ ca prayujyate ||
dviśabdo dvitvāviśiṣṭe'liṅgaḥ| sambodhanaikaviṣayaśca yuṣmadarthaḥ| asmacchabdastūccārayitrarthaḥ| saliṅga saṃbodhanavyabhicārī ca bhavatvarthaḥ| ``bhāterḍavatuḥ (uosūo166) iti vyutpādito'yam| yadyapyasmātsmāyādayo na sambhavanti, ``sarvanāmnastṛtīyā ca (pāosūo2-3-27) iti ``nimittakāraṇahetuṣu sarvāsāṃ prāyadarśanam (kāovāo) ityanenaiva gatārtha, tathāpi
phiñadrimayaṭaḥ pūrvanipātaṣṭakchasau tathā| ātvaikaśeṣaṣyañvirahā akacca bhavataḥ phalam ||
phiñ - bhāvatāyaniḥ, tyadāditvena vṛddhatvād ``udīcaṃ vṛddhād (pāosūo4-1-157) iti phiñ| bhavantamañcatīti bhavadryaṅ, ``viṣvagdevacośca (pāosūo6-3-91) iti cakāreṇa sarvanāmnonukarṣaṇādadryādeśaḥ| bhavanmayaḥ, ``nityaṃ vṛddhaśarādibhyaḥ (pāosūo4-3-14) iti mayaṭ| bhavanmitra, ``sarvanāmasaṃkhyayoḥ (kāovāo) iti prāṅnipātaḥ| bhāvatkaḥ, bhavadīyaḥ, ``bhavataṣṭhakchasau (pāosūo4-2-115) ityatra hi śatrantanivṛttaye vṛddhādityanuvartyate| ātvam--bhavādṛk, ``ā sarvanāmnaḥ (pāosūo1-2-72) ityekaśeṣaḥ| `bhavato bhāvo bhavattā' ityatra sarvanāmasaṃjñayā guṇavacanasaṃjñāvādhāt ṣyañviraho'pi phalam| anyathā hi bhāvatyamiti syāt| akacca-bhavakān, ``sarvanāmno vṛttimātre (bhāoio) iti kapuṃvadbhāvo'pi phalam--bhavattyāḥ putro bhavatputraḥ| kiṃśabdaḥ praśne ākṣepe ceti dik|
vṛt sarvādigaṇo vṛttaḥ samāpta ityarthaḥ| ``yadindrāgnī avamasyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ madhyamasyāṃ paramasyāmutasthe ityatra tvavamamadhyamaparamaśabdeṣu chandasi sakalavidhivyatyayāt syāḍāgamaḥ| na tvetadanurodhena sarvādeśakṛtigaṇatvamiti mantavyam| ata eva chandasyapi sarvanāmakārvameṣāṃ na niyatam| ``ye madhyamāḥ pitaraḥ ``viṣṇoḥ pade parame ityādau tadabhāvāt| ``vyūhāvubhau tāvitaretarasmāt, ``anyonyeṣāṃ puṣkarairāmṛśanta ityādi tu dviḥ- prayogo dvirvacanamiti pakṣe tadantavidhīnā siddham| sthāne dvirvacanapakṣe tu sthānivadbhāvenetyavadheyam|
nanu vasnasādāviva prakṛtipratyayavibhāgasya saṃmohātsthānivadbhāvenāpi padatvamātraṃ syāt, natu sarvanāmatā, sub‌viśiṣṭe sthānini tadvirahāditi cet? na, sanniyogaśiṣṭatvenāntaraṅgamapi dvitvaṃ bādhitvā ``samāsavacca bahulam (kāovāoeo) iti samāsavadbāvaprayuktasya lukaḥ prathamaṃ pravṛtteḥ, ``antaraṅgānapi vidhīn bahiraṅgo lug bādhate (paobhāo52) iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt, tataḥ pratyayalakṣaṇena padatvamāśritya dvittvapravṛtteḥ| etena `tattattāmasabhūtabhītaya' ityādi vyākhyātam| nanvastūktarītyā `itaretarasmāt' ityasya siddhiḥ, `anyonyeṣām' iti tu katham? na hyatra samāsavadbhāvo'stīti cet? tatra prathamaikavacanāntatvaṃ pūrvapadasya dvitīyādayastu parapada iti vacanabalenaiva prakṛtipratyayavibhāgasya siddheriti dik|
``vanyetarā jānapadopadābhiḥ (raovaṃo41) iti tu vanyā itare yebhya iti bahuvrīhiṇā samādheyam| ``taparaḥ (pāosūo1-1-70) iti jñāpakātsarvanāmnaḥ pūrvanipāto'nityaḥ| ``putrodakātparājayaḥ iti tu prādhānyādinā ākhyātādityayeṃ ākhyātaṇijantād ghañrthe kapratyaye lākṣaṇikasya sarvanāmatāvirahātsamādheyam|
vibhāṣā diksamāse bahuvrīhau (pāosūo1-1-28)| atra sarvanāmasaṃjñā vā syāt| uttarapūrvasyai| uttarapūrvāyai| ``diṅnāmānyantarāle (pāosūo2-2-26) iti pratipadokto diksmāso gṛhyate| teneha na-yā pūrvā saivottarā yasyā bhrāntasya tasmai pūrvottarāya| evaṃ ca bahuvrīhigrahaṇa na karttavyam, dakṣiṇotetarapūrvāṇāmiti dvadvasya lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayaiva vāraṇāt| nanūttarārthaṃ tat| tathāhi, ``ekaṃ bahuvrīhivat (pāosūo8-1-9) ``ābādhe ca (pāosūo8-1-10) iti dvirbhāve `ekaikasmai dehi' `dakṣiṇadakṣiṇasyai' ityādīṣyate| tatrottarasūtreṇa niṣedho mā bhūt| bahuvrīhireva yo bahuvrīhirna tvatidiṣṭabahuvrīhistatraiva yatā syāditi| maivam, samāsagrahaṇānuvṛttyāpyuktārthalābhāt uttarasutrasya pratyākhyānācca|
na bahuvrīhau (pāosūo1-1-29)| bahuvrīhau karttavye sati sarvanāmasaṃjñā na syāt| tvakaṃ pitā yasya tvatkapitṛkaḥ| ahakaṃ pitā yasya matkapitṛkaḥ| dvakau putrau yasya dvikaputraḥ| iha hi samāsapravṛtteḥ prāgantaraṅgatayā'kac pravartteta, sa ca samāse satyapi śrūyeta, `atikrānto bhavakantamatibhavakān' itivat| na hi vṛtteḥ prāgapyupasarjanatā'sti| nanu yadi prāgeva prāpnuvannakac nivarttitastarhi `tvakampitā' ityādi kathaṃ vigṛhyate? tvatkaḥ pitetyādi kapratyayadarśanaucityāditi cet? bhrānto'si| na hi yasminprakriyāvākye utprekṣāmātragocare bahuvrīhisaṃjñāpravṛttā sarvanāmasaṃjñā ca niṣiddhā tatprayujyate, apariniṣṭhitatvāt; kintu tatsadṛśaṃ bahuvrīhisaṃjñāśūnyaṃ vākyāntarameva| yadāha kaiyaṭaḥ| ``aprayogasamavāyi yatprakriyāvākyaṃ tatrāyaṃ niṣedho na tu laukike, tasya pṛthageva prayogāttādarthyābhāvāt iti| ata eva dṛṣṭāḥ sarve yenetyeva vigraho na tu sarvā iti| rājñaḥ puruṣa ityādivigrahepi hyeṣaiva gatiḥ, alaukike vākye ``allopo'naḥ (pāosū 6-4-134) ityāderapravṛtteḥ ``antaraṅgānapi vidhīn (paobhāo52) iti siddhāntāt| ata eva `gomatpriyaḥ' ityādau sorlugeva na tu ilṅyādilopaḥ| tena numdīrghādayo na pravarttante| bhāṣye `tvakatpitṛkaḥ' ityādyeva rūpaṃ svīkṛtyedaṃ sūtraṃ pratyākhyātam| yadāha---- akacsvarau tu karttavyau pratyaṅgaṃ muktasaṃśayau iti|
aṅgampratīti pratyaṅgam| anakārānteṣu tvakatpitṛko dvikaputra ityādiṣvakac| viśvapriya ityādiṣvadantaṣu tu ``svāṅgaśiṭāmadanatānām (phiosūo1-29) ityādyudāttateti viṣayaviveko bodhya ityarthaḥ| yathotaraṃ munīnāṃ prāmāṇyāt bhāṣyottyaiva vyavasthetyavadheyam|
tṛtīyāsamāse (pāosūo1-1-30)| atra sarvanāmatā na syāt| māsapūrvāya| lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā ``pūrvasadṛśa (pāosūo2-1-31) iti samāso gṛhyate, na tu ``kartṛkaraṇekṛtā (pāosūo2-1-32) ityādirapi| tena `tvayakā kṛtaṃ tvakatkṛtam' ityādau niṣedho na| samāsa ityanuvarttamāne punaḥ samāsagrahaṇaṃ gauṇārthasyāpi saṅgrahārtham| tena samāsārthavākye'pi niṣedhaḥ| māsena pūrvāya| ayaṃ ca laukike vākye niṣedho na tu ``na bahuvrīhau (pāosūo 1-1-29) itivadalaukike, akārānte kālacoraviśeṣeṇānakārāntānāṃ pratipadoktatṛtīyāsamāsaviraheṇa cālaukike ni,edhasya vaiyarthyāpatteḥ|
dvandve ca (pāosūo1-1-31)| ihoktasaṃjñā na syāt| pūrvāparādharāṇām| samudāyasyāyaṃ niṣedho na tvavayavānām| tathāhi, tyadādīnāṃ tāvad dvandva eva nāsti ``tyadādīni sarvairnityam (pāosūo1-2-72) ityekaśeṣeṇa bādhitatvāt| na ca dvandve kṛte ekaśeṣa iti bhramitavyam, ekavadbhāvasvarasamāsāntaprasaṅgena dvandvāpavādatvapakṣasyaiva sthāpayiṣyamāṇatvāt| anyathā `teṣām' ityādāvapi ``dvandve ca (pāosūo1-1-31) iti niṣedhāpatteśca| tyadādibhyaḥ prācīnāstvadantāḥ tatra kākacoraviśeṣaḥ| ``sarvanāmno vṛttimātre (bhāoio) iti puṃvadbhāvastviṣyate evadakṣiṇottarapūrvāṇāmiti| kiñca sarvanāmasaṃjñāniṣedhenāpyasau durvāraḥ| tatra hi mātragrahaṇaṃ kvacitsarvanāmatvena dṛṣṭānāṃ sampatyasarvanāmatve'pi puṃvadbhāvaḥ| nanvavayave sañjñā cenna niṣiddhī tarhi `aṅgadhikāre tasya ca taduttarapadasya ca' (pāobhāoeo29) iti vacanād `dakṣiṇottarapūrvāṇām' ityādau suḍāgamādiprasaṅgaḥ| na ca niṣedhavaiyarthyam anāṅgasya tralādervyāvṛttyā caritārthatvāṃditi cet? na, aṅgakāryeṣu sarvanāmno vihitasyāmo ṅerṅasiṅayorityādikrameṇa vyākhyānāt| vihitaviśeṣaṇatvasyāśrayaṇe pramāṇaṃ tu `dakṣiṇottarapūrvāṇām' iti bhāṣyaprayoga eva| tasmātsamudāyasyaivāyaṃ pratiṣedho nāvayavānāmiti sthitam| ata eva sarvanāmasañjñāyāṃ tadantavidhisadbhāve ``dvandve ca (pāosūo 1-1-31) iti jñāpakamityuktam|
vibhāṣā jasi (pāosūo1-1-32)| jasīti kāryāpekṣayā'dhikaraṇasaptamī| jasādhāraṃ yatkāryyaṃ śībhāvākhyaṃ tatra kartavye dvandve uktā saṃjñā vā syāt| varṇāśrametare| varṇāśrametarāḥ| śībhāvaṃ pratyeveyaṃ vibhāṣeti vyākhyātam| tenākac na bhavati tasminkarttavye ``dvandve ca (pāosūo1-1-31) iti nityaṃ niṣedhāt| atastatra kapratyaya eva bhavati| varṇāśrametarakāḥ| kena vyavadhānānneha śībhāvaḥ akaci kṛte tu tanmadhyapatitanyātena śībhāvaḥ syādeva|
prathamagharamatayālpārddhakatipayanemāśca (pāosūo1-1-33)| ete jasaḥ kāryaṃprati sarvanāmasañjñā vā syuḥ| prathame, pathamāḥ, ityādi| śeṣaṃ rāmavat| neme, nemāḥ śeṣaṃ sarvavat| ihāpi prāgvacchībhāvaṃ pratyeva sañjñāvikalpaḥ| tena `prathamakāḥ' ityādāvakaj na| anyathā `prathamake' iti syāt| ubhayaśabdasya tu neyaṃ vibhāṣā kintu nityā saṃjñeti gaṇavyākhyāprasaṅgenopapāditam|
pūrvaparāvaradakṣiṇottarāparadharāṇi vyavasthāyāmasaṃjñāyām (pāosūo1-1-34)|
svamajñātaghanākhyāyām (pāosūo1-1-35)| antaraṃ bahiryogopasaṃvyānayoḥ (pāosūo1-1-36)| eṣā trisūtrī gaṇamadhye'pi paṭhyate| sā ca vyākhyātā| tayā yasminnevopādhau nityā saṃjñā prāptā tatraiva jasi vibhāṣā'nayā vidhīyate| pūrve, pūrvāḥ, ityādi| sve, svāḥ, ātmīyā ityatheḥ, ātmāna iti vā| iha trisūtryāṃ yadvaktavyaṃ tatsarvaṃ gaṇavyākhyāvasara evoktam| ``vibhāṣāprakaraṇe tīyasya ṅitsūpasaṃkhyānam (kāovāo)| dvitīyasmai, dvitīyāya, ityādi| ekādeśasya pūrvāntagrahaṇena grahamālliṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā vā dvitīyasyai, dvitīyāyai, ityādyapi siddham| evañca ``vibhāṣā dvitīyātṛtīyābhyām (pāosūo7-3-105) iti sūtraṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati, arthavatvāt, prātepadoktatvāccā ``dvestīyaḥ (pāosūo5-2-54) ``treḥ samprasāraṇaṃ ca (pāosūo5-2-55) it‌yayameva gṛhyate| teneha na-``prakāravacane jātīyar (pāosūo5-3-69) paṭujātīyāya| ``jātyantāccha bandhuni (pāosūo5-4-9) brāhmaṇajātīyāya| mukhapārśvaśabdābhyāṃ tasantābhyāṃ ``gahādibhyasca (pāosūo4-2-137) iti chaḥ, mukhatīyāya| pārśvatīyāya| tathā `dvitīyāya bhāgāya' ityatrāpi na bhavati ``pūraṇādbhāge tīyādan (pāosūo5-3-48) ityani kṛte ``yasyeti ca (pāosūo6-4-148) ityavākalope ca sati tīyasya lākṣaṇikatvāditi dik || iti sarvanāmasaṃjñāprakaraṇam ||

atrocyate-prāptavibāṣātve tāvat samanantaroktaroktarītyaivoktisambhavaḥ| ubhayatravibhāṣātve tvittham - ``antaraṅgānapi (pāobhāo52) iti nyāyena latvāt pūrvaṃ luk| na ca luṅnimittamajeva durlabhaḥ, tasyārthāpekṣatvena bahiraṅgatayā'siddhatvāt pūrvābhāvena ``pūrvatrāsiddham (pāosūo8-2-1) ityasyāpravṛtteḥ| tathācācaḥ pūrvameva latvaṃ syāditi vācyam, kṛtitug‌vidhigrahaṇena hi bahiraṅgaparibhāṣāyā anityatvajñāpanāt dharmigrāhakapramāṇena luka iva tadupajīvyānāṃ samāsādīnāmapi prābalyasiddeśca| nanu kṛte'ci tannimitte luki ca sati nijegir ac iti sthite ``gro yaṅi (pāosūo 8-2-20) iti na prāpnoti, yaṅparatvābhāvāt| pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ tu ``na lumatā (pāosūo2-3-69) iti niṣiddham| tatra hyaṅgasyetyanenāṅgādhikāro na nirdiśyate iti vakṣyate| na ca sthānivadbhāvaḥ lukā luptaṃ na sthānivaditi niṣedhāt ajjñalādeśaḥ tvācca| tathā ca kathamubhayatra vibhāṣeti cet? na, nadātulopasūtra pratyākhyānapakṣe pṛthagallopāśrayaṇeva sthānivadbhāvasambhavāt| na ca ``pūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivat (bhāoio) iti niṣedhaḥ ``tasya doṣaḥ saṃyogādilopalatvaṇatveṣu (bhāoio) iti sāpavādatvāt| yadyapi ``acivibhāṣā (pāosūo8-2-21) ityasya ``pūrvatrāsiddham (pāosūo8-2-1) iti ``gro yaṅi (pāosūo8-2-20) iti pratyasiddhatvādvipratiṣedhāsambhavaḥ| tataśca satyāmapi yaṅītyasya nivṛttāvubhayatravibāṣātvaṃ na sambhavati| tathāpi `adhunā' ityādivallādhavārthaṃ `amunā' iteyeva vaktavye ``na mune (pāosūo8-2-3) ityukteryogavibāgārthatayā na yoge yogo'siddhaḥ kintu prakaraṇe prakaraṇamiti cāsiddhatvaṃ na bhavatītyāśayenobhayatravibāṣātve uktisambhavo boddhavyaḥ| siddhānte tu vibhāṣāyā asiddhatvādeva nityaṃ latvaṃ samudāyalopavādināṃ tu mate ajapekṣayāntaraṅgatvānnityaṃ latvamiti vyavasthitavibhāṣeti vā samarthayitavyam|
iti śrīśabdakaustubhe prathamasyādhyāsya prathame pāde ṣaṣṭhamānhikam ||
igyaṇaḥ samprasāraṇam (pāosūo 1-1-45)|
yaṇaḥ sthāne ik bhavatītyevaṃrūpo vākyārthaḥ, yaṇsthānika ig‌rūpo varṇaścetyubhayamapi samprasāraṇasañjñaṃ syāt| tatra ``ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇam (pāosūo6-1-13) ityādiṣu vidhipradeśeṣu vākyārthasya grahaṇaṃ ``samprasāraṇācca (pāosūo6-1-108) ityādyanuvādapradeśeṣu varṇasyeti vivekaḥ| pūrvasūtrāditiśabdānuvṛttervākyārthasya saṃjñitvamiti labhyate| tatpratyākhyānapakṣe tu vākyameva saṃjñi| na caivaṃ tadeva vidheyaṃ syāditi vācyam, ``vāha ūṭh samprasāraṇamitisāmānādhikaraṇyabalena tadupasthāpitārthasyaiva vidheyatvanirṇayāt| na caivamapi ``ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇam (pāosūo6-1-13) ityādau doṣatādavasthyam, sāmānyāpekṣajñāpakāśrayaṇāt| nanu tathāpi vākyatadarthayoranyatarasya saṃjñitvamastu varṇasya tu kathamiti cet? tantrāvṛttyekaśeṣāṇāmanyatamāśrayaṇenārthadvayābhyupagamādityavehi| atra ca vidheyānuvādyasamarpakavibhattyā sūtre nirdeśa eva liṅgam| āha ca- vibhaktiviśeṣanirdeśastu jñāpaka ubhayasaṃjñātvasyeti| ubhayoḥ saṃjñeti ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaḥ| bhartṛhariścāha----
samprasārṇasaṃjñāyāṃ liṅgābhyāṃ varṇavākyayoḥ|
pravibhāgastathā sūtra ekasminneva jāyate ||
tathā dvirvacanecīti tantropāyādilakṣaṇaḥ|
ekaśeṣeṇa nirdeśo bhāṣya eva samarthitaḥ || iti ||
tantraṃ ca śabdatantramarthatantraṃ veti matabedena vyavasthā boddhavvā| arthabhedācchabdabhede ādyaḥ pakṣaḥ| śabdaikye dvitīyaḥ| ādye'pi vyañjakadhvanimātrabhede vyaṅgyaikye āvṛttirevetyādi bodhyam| evañca---
tantrakṣatvamaikarūpyeṇa bhavettulyopakārataḥ|
upakārānyathātve tu bhavedāvṛttilakṣaṇam ||
iti mīmāṃsakamarthādānurodho vaiyākaraṇairna karttavyaḥ, tasya bhāṣyādisakalavaiyākaraṇagranthaviruddhatvāt, mūlayuktiśūnyatayā durupapādatvācceti dik| yadvā, vākyārtha eva saṃjñī anuvāde tu tannirvṛtto varṇo lakṣyate| samprasāraṇājjātaṃ samprasāraṇamiti| atha vā varṇā eva saṃjñī| vidhipradeśeṣu tu sūtraśāṭakavadbhāvisaṃjñāśrayaṇīyeti| sarvepyete pakṣā bhāṣye sthitāḥ|
syādetat, `aduhitarām' ityatra lakārasya yaṇaḥ sthāne uttamapuruṣaikavacanamiṭ| tasya ca samprasāraṇasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ ``halaḥ (pāosūo6-4-2) iti dīrghaḥ syāt tarapaṃ prati laṅantasyāṅgatvāditi| atrāhuḥ--saṃkhyātānudeśādyakārasthānikasyaiva ikārasya saṃjñā na tu lakārasthānikasyeti|
atredamavadheyam-vākyārthaḥ saṃjñīti pakṣe tasyoddeśyavidheyasaṃsargarūpatayā tatra yathāsaṃkhyāparibhāṣopasthitau yaṇaḥ sthāne iksyādyathāsaṃkhyamityavāntaravākyārthaḥ| so'yaṃ samprasāraṇasaṃjñaḥ syāditi mahāvākyārthaḥ| nacāvāntaravākyārthaṃ gṛhītvā ``yātivātidrāti(pāosūo eo8-4-17) ityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ, tasya saṃjñāsambandhamātraphalakatvāt| anyathā ``ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇam (pāosūo6-1-13) ityādervaiyarthyāpatterato noktadoṣaḥ, aduhītyādestajjatvābhāvācca| ubhayasaṃjñātvapakṣe'pi upasthitatvādyathāsaṃkhyapravṛtta eva varṇaḥ saṃjñīti| ataḥ `aduhitarām' ityatra nātiprasaṅgaḥ| idaṃ ca karmakarttari rūpamiti haradattaḥ| upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat, kevale kartaryapi sambhavāt| varṇa eva saṃjñīti pakṣe tu yathāsaṃkhyaṃ durlabham, anuvāde paribhāṣāṇāmanupasthānasyopapāditatvāt| na caivaṃ sthāneyogo'pyasminpakṣe na labhyeteti vācyam ``ṣaṣṭhī sthāne yogā (pāosūo1-1-49) ityātrānuvartya etatsūtrasya vyākhyeyatvāt| uktaṃ hi ``iko guṇavṛddhī (pāosūo1-1-3) iti sūtre- ``siddhaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhyadhikāre vacanād iti| ihaiva vā siṃhāvalokananyāyena sthānagrahaṇāpakarṣostu, yathāsaṃkhyaṃ tu durlabhamityuktam| kathaṃ tarhi `aduhitarām' ityatra nātiprasaṅga iti cet? tantrāvṛttyādyāśrayaṇena saṃprasāraṇasyetyatra tadbhāvitagrahaṇāt| yadvā, kāryakālapakṣe yaṇaḥ sthāne saṃprasāraṇamigbhavatīti vākyārthādanuvādataiva nāsti tatra paribhāṣopasthitau satyāṃyathāsaṃkhyāpravṛtta eva saṃjñī| sa eva samprasāraṇasyetyādau upatiṣṭhate| athavā sthānakrameṇa sambandho laukikanyāyasiddhatvādanuvāde'pi sulabhaḥ| yathāsaṃkhyasūtraṃ paraṃ na pravarttatāmiti dik|
`dyubhyām' itvatra ``halaḥ (pāosūo6-4-2) iti dīrgho na ``diva utta (pāosūo6-1-131) iti taparakaraṇāt| ata eva `dyulokaḥ' ityatra ``saṃprasāraṇasya (pāosūo6-3-139) iti dīrgho na| nanvevaṃ ``bhāvyamāno'pyukāraḥ savarṇāngṛhṇāti (paobhāo20) ityarthe jñāpakatayā kathamasyopanyāsa iti cet? na, tasya vākyārthaḥ saṃjñīti pakṣeṇoktatvāt ``saṃprasāraṇasya (pāosūo6-3-139) ityatra tadbāvitagrahaṇādvā| pakṣāntare tu ``ṛta ut (pāosūo66-1-111) iti jñāpakaṃ boddhavyam| nanvevam `akṣadyuvau' `akṣadyuva' ityādau ūṭhaḥ samprasāraṇasaṃjñāyāṃ ``saṃprasāraṇācca (pāosūo6-1-107) iti pūrvarūpaṃ syāditi cet? na, saṃprasāraṇapūrvatve samānāṅgahaṇasya vārtikakṛtā kṛtatvāt| tatpratyākhyānapakṣe tu ``vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ (paobhāo55) ityuvaṅ bhaviṣyati| vākyārthaḥ saṃjñītyādipakṣāntare tu pūrvarūpaprāptireva nāsti| `hūtaḥ' `jīnaḥ' ityādau tu ``halaḥ (pāosūo6-4-2) iti sūtrasāmarthyātsamprasāraṇanirvṛttasyādeśe'pi dīrghapravṛttiḥ| varṇasaṃjñāpakṣepi alvidhau sthānivadbhāvāsambhavena ``halaḥ (pāosūo6-4-2) itisūtrārambhasāmarthyātsamprasāraṇasyādeśe kāryapravṛttervācyatvāditi dik ||
ādyantau ṭakitau (pāosūo1-1-46)|
ṭitkitau yasyoktau tasya kramādādyantāvayavau staḥ| bhavitā| yāpayati| ``purastādapavādāḥ (pāobhāo60) iti nyāyena sthāneyogatvasyāyamapavādaḥ| ``pratyayaḥ (pāosūo3-1-1) ``paraśca (pāosūo3-1-2) ityanena tu paratvādvādhyate| tena ``careṣṭaḥ (pāosūo3-2-8) ``gāpoṣṭak (pāosūo3-2-16) ``vrīhiśālyorḍhak (pāosūo5-2-2) parā eva bhavanti| pareṇa paribhāṣāprakaraṇena sāhacaryātparibhāṣeyam| bhāṣye tu saṃjñāpakṣo'pi sthāpitaḥ| tathāhi, ṭakitāviti karmadhārayaḥ| itsaṃjñakau ṭakārakakārau ādyantayoḥ saṃjñe staḥ| tathā ca iṭ itika bahuvrīhiḥ iḥ ṭ ādiryasyeti vigrahaḥ| tathā ca sthānentaratamaparibāṣayā tavyasya itavyādeśe siddhamiṣṭam| evaṃ `yāpayati' ityatra yāteryāp ādeśaḥ, puḥ k yasyeti vyākhyānāt| na caivamādyantau ṭakau ityevāstviti vācyam ``ālajāṭacau (pāosūo5-2-125) ``ṭhasyekaḥ (pāosūo7-3-50) ityādāvapi ṭakayorādyantasaṃjñātvaprasaṅgāt| hatadsaṃjñakatvena tu deśaviśeṣo lakṣyate| tena itsaṃjñakasya yo deśastatrāvasthitau ṭakau saṃjñe| cāṭacaṣṭakāra ikādeśasya kakāraśca tatheti noktadoṣaḥ| nanvasminpakṣe ``luṅlaṅlṛṅkṣu (pāosūo6-4-71) ityādinā bhū ityasyābhū ityādeśaḥ syātsa codātta ityanto dāttaḥ prasajyeta| naiṣa doṣaḥ| aḥ ṭ udāttaśca yasyeti tripadabahuvrīhyāśrayaṇāt| viśeṣaṇasyāpi udāttasya sautraḥ paranipātaḥ| tenodāttākārādirādeśa iti siddham| na caivamapi ``āḍajādīnām (pāosṛo6-4-72) ityatra doṣatādavasthyam| anuvṛttenodāttaśabdena saha śrūyamāṇasya bahuvrīhyasambhavāditi vācyam, ``āḍajādīnām (pāosūo6-4-72) ityatra doṣatādavasthyam| anuvṛttonodāttaśabdena saha śrūyamāṇasya bahuvrīhyasambhavāditi vācyam, ``āḍajādīnām (pāosūo6-4-72) iti sūtrasya pratyākhyāsyamānatvāt| vakṣyati hi-``ajādīnāmaṭā siddham ityādi|
midaco'ntyātparaḥ (pāosūo1-1-47)|
sanniviṣṭānāmacāṃ madhye antyo yo'c tasmātparo mitsyāt sa ca pūrvāntaḥ| sthāneyogasya paraśceti paratvasya cāpavādaḥ| vanāni| yaśāṃsi| rūṇaddhi| nanu pūrvayogavadayamapi purastādapavādanyāyena sthāneyogamātrasyāpavādo'stu na tu ``pratyayaḥ (pāosūo3-1-1-) ``paraśca (pāosūo3-1-2) ityasyāpīti cet? na, bādhyasāmānyacintāmāśritya svaviṣaye prāptaṃ sarvaṃ bādhyate itīhābhyupagamāt| anyathā śnamo mitkaraṇaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt| naca śravaṇārtha eva śnamo makāra iti vācyam, ``tṛṇaha (pāosūo 7-3-92) iti nirdeśāt| aca iti jātyabhiprāyeṇaikavacanam| nirddhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī| na cāntyādityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyādaca iti pañcamyevāstāmiti vācyam ``śe mucādīnām (pāosūo7-1-59) ityādāvantyasyāco'sambhavenaitatparibhāṣāyā apravṛttāvalontyaparibhāṣāprasaṅgāt| tathāca tatra mitkaraṇavaiyarthyāpatteḥ| pūrvasūtre ādyantāvitisamāsanirdeśe'pīhāntagrahaṇamātramanuvarttate ekadeśa eva svaritatvapratijñānāt| tena mitpūrvāntaḥ| yadi tvabhaktaḥ syāttadā `tātā piṇḍānām' ityādau ``śeśchandasi bahulam (pāosūo6-1-70) iti śerlope kṛte nalopona syāt, prātipadikāntatvābhāvāt| tathā `vahaṃlihaḥ' ityatra ``vahābhre lihaḥ (pāosūo3-2-32) iti khaśi ``arurdviṣadajantasya (pāosūo6-3-67) iti mumi ``mo'nusvāraḥ (pāosūo8-3-23) ityanusvāro na syāt, apadāntatvāt| yadi tvādigrahaṇamanuvartya parādiḥ kriyeta, tadā `vāriṇe' ityādau `gherṅiti' (pāosūo7-3-111) iti guṇaḥ syāt, `vahaṃlihaḥ' ityatrānusvāro na syāt, `atiśayitaḥ sakhā yeṣāṃ tānyatisakhīni brāhmaṇakulāni' ityatra ``sakhyurasambuddhau' (pāosūo7-1-92) iti ṇittvaprayuktā vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti| sā hi gauṇatve'pīṣyate asthādyanaṅvat| etacceha sūtre bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ sphuṭam| tasmātpūrvāntapakṣa evātra sthitaḥ|
atra vārttikam-antyātpūrvo masjeranuṣaṅgasaṃyogādilopārtham| magnaḥ| magnavān| ``oditaśca (pāosūo 8-2-45) iti niṣṭhānatvam| tasyāsiddhatvātkutvam| ``masjinaśorjhali' (pāosūo7-1-60) iti num| sa ca yadyantādacaḥ paraḥ syāttadā ``aniditām (pāosūo6-4-24) ityanuṣaṅgalopo na syāt| upadhābhūtasya nakārasyānuṣaṅga iti prācāṃ saṃjñā| atha ``skoḥ (pāosūo8-2-29) iti salope kṛte nakāra upadhātvāllupyatāmiti cet? na, lanopaṃ prati ``skoḥ (pāosūo8-2-29) itilopasyāsiddhatvāt, bahūnāṃ samavāye samudāyasyaiva saṃyogasaṃjñeti pakṣe salopasyāprāpteśca| tathāca `maṅktā' `maṅktavyam' ityādyapi prayojanaṃ bodhyam|
bharjimarcyośca| antyātpūrvo mit ityanuvarttate| ``bhṛjī bharjane (bhvāoāo178) asmādauṇādike aci kṛte ūmāgamaḥ bharujā| ``marca śabdārthe (cuopāo1650) curādikaḥ, asmād, ``acaiḥ (uosūo4-588) ityauṇādika ipratyaya īmāgamaḥ| nipātanātsiddham| bharujāśabdo hyaṅgulyādiṣu paṭhyate marīciśabdo bāvhādiṣu| uṇādiṣu tu ``mṛkaṇibhyāmīciḥ (uosūo4-519) iti īcipratyayaṃ kṛtvā marīciśabdo vyutpāditaḥ| tadupāyāntaraṃ bodhyam|
eca igghrasvādeśe (pāosūo1-1-48)|
ādiśyamāneṣu hrasveṣu madhye eca igeva syāt| heśabdamatikrāntaṃ kulamatihi kulam| citraguḥ| atiriḥ| atinu| yadatra vaktavyaṃ tadeoṅsutre evoktam|
ṣaṣṭhī sthāne yogā (pāosūo1-1-49)| anekasambandhaparatayā sambhāvyamānā ṣaṣṭhī sthānaprayuktasambandhapareti bodhyam| ``asterbhūḥ (pāosūo2-4-52) asteḥ samīpo'nantaro veti saṃśaye tatsthāne uccāraṇīya ityarthaḥ| sthānaṃ ca prasaṅgaḥ| darbhāṇāṃ sthāne śaraiḥ prastaritavyamitivat| tathā ca iguccāraṇe prasakte yaṇuccāraṇīya ityādyarthaparyavasāne sāmīpyādayaḥ sambandhā arthādvyāvṛttāḥ| yogaḥ sambandhaḥ, sa bahuvidho'styasyā iti yogā| arśaāditvānmatvarthīyo'c| sa ca bhūmni, anyathā viśeṣaṇavaiyarthyāpatteḥ| tenānekasambandhaparatayā sambhāvyamānetyartho labhyate| ayoge'ti vā chedaḥ| aniścitayogaviśeṣetyarthaḥ| yogetyayogeti vā kim? ``udupadhāyā gohaḥ (pāosūo6-4-89) ``śāsa idaṅhaloḥ (pāosūo6-4-34) ityādau śāsa ityatra mā bhūt| sati hi tatrāpi sthāneyogatve gohiśāsoḥ sthāne dhātumātrasyopadhāyāśca ūditau syātāmiti dik|
yadvā, sthāne yogo yasyā iti bahuvrīhiḥ| ata eva nipātanātsaptamyā aluk| yadvā, sthānena yoge'syā iti vigrahaḥ| nipātanādetvam| na cānayoḥ pakṣayorgohaḥ śāsa ityādāvatiprasaṅga, paribāṣāṇāmaniyate niyantuṃ pravṛtteḥ| yuktaṃ caitat| ākāṅkṣāpūrvakatvātsambandhasya, iha copadhāsannidhānenāvayavaṣaṣṭhītve nirṇīte ākāṅkṣāvicchedāt| loke'pi hi panthānaṃ pṛcchantaṃ pratyamuṣminnavakāśe dakṣiṇo grahītavyo'muṣṇinnuttara ityādāvupadiṣṭa sati yatra mārgadvaidhātsaṃśayastatraiva tadupatiṣṭhate na tvasaṃdigdhe tiryakpathepīti dik|
bhāṣyakārāstvāhuḥ--``asterbhūḥ(pāosūo2-4-52)|
ityādāvanekasambandhaprasaṅge'pi lakṣyānurodādantaraṅgatvāt ``sthānivadādeśaḥ (pāosūo1-1-56) iti jñāpakācca sthāneyogataiva vyākhyāsyate| tasmānnāyametasya sūtrasya sūtrārthaḥ, kintu ṣaṣṭhyantamuccāryamāṇameva sthānena yujyate na tu pratīyamānamiti sutrārthaḥ| tadetaducyate ``nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti (paobhāo12) iti| tena ``pādaḥ pat (pāosūo6-4-130) ityasyāyamarthaḥ--pācchabdāntaṃ yadaṅgaṃ tadavayavasya pācchabdasya sarvasya padādeśa iti| ``alo'ntyasya (pāosūo1-1-52) ``ādeḥ parasya (pāosūo1-1-54) iti tu yogau ārambhasāmarthyādasya bādhakau| ``anekālśitsarvasya (pāosūo1-1-55) ityanena tu sahāvapirodhādasya samuccayena pravṛttiriti| evaṃ sthite tantrādyāśrayaṇena prāgukto'pi sūtrārthaḥ su vacaḥ| phalaṃ tu sphuṭapratipattiriti dik|
sthāne'ntaratamaḥ (pāosūo1-1-50)|
prāpyamāṇānāṃ madhye sadṛśatama ādeśaḥ syāt| sādṛśyaṃ ca caturdhā| sthānato'rthato guṇataḥ pramāṇataśceti| sthānato yathā--sudhyupāsyaḥ| madhvariḥ| dhātraṃśaḥ| lākṛtiḥ| yattu yathāsaṃkhyasūtreṇaivehānyathāsiddhirityuktaṃ bhāṣyādau, tadabhyuccayamātram, arthataḥ sāmyavivakṣāyāṃ yathāsaṃkhyālābhāt| iko hi ṣaṭṣaṣṭiḥ yaṇastu sapteti vaiṣamyāt| athekśabdādyaṇśabdācca prathamaṃ caturṇāṃ caturṇāmupasthiterastyeva sāmyamiti cettārhi sudhyupāsyeti dīrghasya kataṃ yaṇādeśaḥ| ikāreṇa grahaṇāditi cettarhi sudhyupāsyeti dīrghasya kathaṃ yaṇādeśaḥ| ikāreṇa grahaṇāditi cettarhi tṛtīyena ṛkāreṇa caturthena lṛkāreṇa ca parasparasya grahaṇāllākṛtau rephaprasaṅga dhātraṃśe ca lakāraprasaṅgaḥ, yavau ca sānunāsikaniranunāsikau na vyavatiṣṭheyātāmiti dik|
daityāriḥ, śrīśaḥ, ityādyapīhodāharaṇam,

iha bhāṣye antaratama iti saptamyantapāṭho'pyupanyasya dūṣitaḥ| tathāhi, ``antaratamauraṇ raparaḥ iti saṃhitayā tāvatsūtrakṛdapāṭhīt| padakārāstu vyākhyātāraḥ| tatra saptamyantamapi śakyaṃ chettum| ṣaṣṭhīti cānuvarttate| antaratame sthānini ṣaṣṭhī upasaṃharttavye****sūtrārthaḥ| evaṃ ca ``aka savarṇe dīrghaḥ (pāosūo6-1-101) ityatra ******** dīrghasyāntaratame sthāninyaka iti ṣaṣṭhyā upasaṃhāratsiddhamiṣṭam| tathā ``vānto yi pratyaye (pāosūo6-1-79) ityatra eca ityanuvṛttāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyā vāntā deśasyāntaratamayorodautorupasaṃhārātsiddham| anyathā ejmātrasya vantādeśaḥ syāt|
atredaṃ dūṣaṇam--``iko yaṇaci (pāosūo6-1-77) iti yaṇ hasvānāmeva syānna tu dīrghāṇām| arddhamātrasya hi mātrikaḥ sannikṛṣṭa iti tatraivekiti ṣaṣṭhyā upasaṃhārāt| tathā ``iko guṇavṛddhī (pāosūo1-1-3) ``acoñṇiti (pāosūo7-2-225) iti ṣaṣṭhyorguṇavṛddhyorantaratameṣveva ikṣvakṣu copasaṃhārāt `netā' `lavitā' `nāyakaḥ' `lāvakaḥ' ityādāvevasyāt| `cetā' `stotā' `cāyakaḥ' `stāvakaḥ' ityādau tu na syāditidika| tadevaṃ saptamyantapakṣasya duṣṭatvātprathamāntapakṣa eva yukta iti sthitam|

atrāhuḥ--naraśabdapāṭhasya pratyākhyānameva bhāṣyakṛto'bhipretaṃ saptamyantapakṣanirākaraṇabhāṣyeṇa tathaivānumānāt| na caivaṃnaraśabdājjātilakṣaṇaṅīṣi sati `nari' iti rūpaṃ syāditi vācyam, iṣṭāpatteḥ| tathāca prayujyate ``kinnarīṇāṃ nāgīṇām iti| yadvā,naraśabdasya niyatapulliṃgatvamevāstu| tathāca kvātiprasaṅgaḥ? uktaprayogasartu puṃyogalakṣaṇe ṅīṣi bhaviṣyati, yathānyāse'pi tasya durvāratvāt| athavā ``nṛnarayoḥ (gaosūo125) ityatrāta iti varttate ``ajādyataṣṭāp (pāosūo4-1-4) iti sūtrāt| taccānuvṛttisāmarthyātṣaṣṭhyā vipariṇataṃ naraśabdena saha vaiyadhikaraṇyena sambadhyate, na tu nṛśabdena, asambhavāt| tasmātsiddhaṃ `nārī' iti|
atredaṃ vaktavyam| pratyākhyāyatāṃ nāma naraśabdaḥ ``nṛnarayoḥ (gaosūo125) iti paṭhataḥ sūtrakṛto mate tu kathamuktisambhavaḥ? na ca `narī' ityeveṣṭamiti vācyam, vṛddhividāyakasūtramadhye naraśabdapāṭhasya vaiphalyāpatteḥ| ata ityanuvṛttyā samarthanamapi kliṣṭam, ekadeśānuvṛttivibhaktivipariṇāmādyāśrayaṇāt| kiñca `nṛnarayoḥ' (gaosūo125) iti gaṇapāṭhe paṭhyate, na tvaṣṭādyāyyām| gaṇe cāta iti na prakṛtam| tathā `śārṅaravādyañaḥ (pāosūo4-1-73) ityādiśabdena gaṇasūtramapi hṛdayamāgamayya tatrāta ityasyānvayo vācyaḥ, casa kliṣṭatara iti spaṣṭameva| tasmāditthaṃ samādheyam-nara iti rāntaṃ luptākāranukaraṇaṃ tasya aḥ naraḥ| nuśca narasyeveti dvandvaḥ| cādgaṇe pāṭhācca ṅīn| yadvā, ``sthāne'ntaratamaḥ (pāosūo1-1-50) ityatra tantreṇa dvedhā chedaḥ sutrakṛtaḥ sammataḥ, bhāṣyoktarītyā laukikanyāyāśrayaṇena sūtrapratyākhyānapakṣe'pi hi prakṛtita ādeśataścetyubhayathāpyantaratamanivṛttirastyeva| sūtrakṛto mate vācanikī sā| bhāṣyakṛtastu nyāyasiddhetyanyadetat| tathā ca ``vānto yi (pāosūo6-1-79) ``nṛnarayoḥ (gaosūo125) ityādi sarvaṃ susthameva| ata eva caturthe sthānito'ntaratamanivṛttimāśritya `nārī' iti rūpaṃ sādhayanharadattopi na virudhyate | ``iko yaṇaci' (pāosūo6-1-77) ityādāvatiprasahgaḥ paramavaśiṣyate| sa ca ``lvādibhyaḥ (pāosūo8-2-44) ``pvādīnāṃ hasvaḥ (pāosūo7-3-80) ityādijñāpakena vācanikyā nyāyamūlikāyā vā sthānitontaratamanivṛtteranityatāmāśrityapariharttavya hati dik|

syādetat| as s iti sakāradvayanirdeśe dhātutvābhāvāt śtivevānupapannaḥ, padamadhyapraviṣṭana sakāreṇa sico viśeṣaṇāsambhave sijāśrayasya īṭaḥ prasaṅgaśca| na cāsteḥka sāntatvena viśeṣaṇasāmarthyātsicprayukto'pīṇ neti vācyam, tathāpi svatantrasya bhavataratiprasaṅgasya durvāratvāt| tathācārthabhedābhāve'pi svatantrāsvatantrābhyāṃ bhūbhyām `abhūvīt' `abhūt' iti rūpadvayāpattiḥ| yattvetaddoṣopanyāsapūrvakaṃ mādhavācāryairuktam--``sicolpāckattvādbahuviṣayatvenābhyarhitatvācca pūrvanipāte karttavye ``astisicaḥ (pāosūo7-3-96) itika vacanāttantrādinā vidyamānātsica ityartho labhyate| ata eva śtipprayogo'pi sārthakaḥ| anyathā `sijasbhyām' ityeva brūyāt| na caivamasatāvasyatau cātiprasaṅgaḥ, vikaraṇavyavadhānena tābhyāṃ parasyāpṛktasārvadhātukasyāsambhavāt iti| taccintyam, evamapi śtippratyayāsamādhānena dvisakārakonirdeśaka iti bhāṣyasyānirvāhāt| etena sicca as ca sicas| samāhāradvandve luptapañcamīkaṃ padam| ayasmayāditvena bhatvānna kutvajaśtve| asti ca tatsijas ceti karmadhārayaḥ| tena luptātsico bhūbhāvenāpahṛtādasteśca parasya neti kalpanāpi pratyuktā, uktarītyā rūpasiddhāvapi bhāṣyānirvāhāt| tasmādiha bhagavato'bhiprāyāntarameva vaktavyamiti|

satyaṃ paṭhitam, kintu bahutamaprayojanānanipaṭhitvā asiddhaparibhāṣayaiva gatārthatvānneyaṃ karttavyetyupasaṃhṛtam| etena prakṛtasūtre `paṭvyā' `mṛdvyā' ityudāharaṇadūṣaṇaprastāve 'siddhaparibhāṣāṃ bhāṣyakārairudāhṛtāmantaraṅgambalīya ityetadupalakṣaṇatayā vyācakṣāṇo'pi kaiyaṭaḥ pratyuktaḥ, vipratiṣedhasutrasthabhāṣyavirodhāt| tasmādiha siddhāntatattvamanyadeva vaktavyamiti| ucyate, antaraṅgaparibhāṣāyā nirapavādatvādasiddhaparibhāṣāyāstu ``nājānantarye (paobhāo51) iti sāpavādatvādubhayorāvaśyakatā| vipratiṣedhasūtrasyathaṃ bhāṣyaṃ tvabhyuccayaparameveti bhāgavṛttikārāḥ| kaiyaṭaladhuvivaraṇādayo'pyevam| bṛhadvivaraṇakārāstu ``nājānantarye (paobhāo51) iti paribhāṣā māstu| tajjñāpakatayā yatsammataṃ tenāsiddhaparibhāṣāyā anityatvameva jñāpyate ityāhuḥ| asmiṃśca pakṣe vipratiṣedhasūtrasthaṃ ``nājāntarye iti bāṣyamapyanityatvaparatayā bhaṅktvā neyam| anyathā hi tatraiva ``antaraṅgaṃ balīyaḥ ityasya pratyākhyānaṃ virudhyeta| ata eva vṛttau ``nalopaḥ sup‌svara (pāosūo8-2-2) ityatra nalopasyāsiddhatvāt ``hasvasya (pāosūo6-1-71) iti tuk netyupakramya sannipātabahiraṅgaparibhāṣābhyāṃ gatārthatāmāśaṅkya paribhāṣādvayasyāpyanityatāṃ jñāpayituṃ tug‌grahaṇamityuktam| ata eva tatra mikṣairapyuktam--bahiraṅgaparibhāṣāyā anityatvāt `yā' `sā' ityatra bahiraṅgamapi tyadādyatvamantaraṅge ṭāpi nāsiddhamiti| tathā `pratidīvnaḥ' ityādisiddhayepyasiddhaparibhāṣāyā anityatvaṃ svīkṛtam| ata eva ca `akṣadyūḥ' ityatra yalope kārye ūṭh nāsiddha iti dik|
etadapavādaśca ``akṛtavyūhā (pāobhāo56) ityādiḥ| utsargāpavādayordvayorapyanityatve sthite lakṣyānurodha eva vyavasthāheturiti sarvaṃ sustham|

nanvevaṃ `samādya' ityatra jagdhayādeśaprasaṅga ``ṇyallopau (kāovāo) iti pūrvavipratiṣedhena ṇilope kṛte tataḥ pratyayalakṣaṇena vṛddhau satyāmekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatayā'digrahaṇena grahaṇāt| evaṃ `ghātyāt' ityatra vadhādeśaprasaṅga iti cet? na, ādighātyorapi sthānidvārā'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāt| nanu sthāninaḥ pūrvatve'pi ādeśasy kimāyātam? nahyanādiṣṭadacaḥ pūrvatvaṃ nāma śāstrīyaṃ kāryaṃ, yat ``sthānivadādeśaḥ (pāosūo1-1-56) iti pūrvasūtreṇātidiśyeteti cet? na, anādiṣṭādacaḥka pūrvatvamupajīvya ``acaḥ parasmin (pāosūo1-1-57) iti śāstre pravartayitavye ``sthānivadādeśaḥ (pāosūo1-1-56) ityasya pravṛttisambhavāt| tathāca ``acaḥ parasmin (pāosūo1-1-56) ityatideśa eva śāstrīyaṃ kāryaṃ, tacca pūrvasūtreṇātidiśyate iti phalito'rthaḥ| ata eva napadāntasūtre savarṇagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| anyathā śnasorallope kṛte paścādbhavannanusvāronānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrva iti tasya vidhau sthānivadbhāvavirahātsavarṇagrahaṇaṃ vyarthameva syāt| nanvevaṃ `kṣatriyakaṇḍūtiḥ' iti na siddhyati| tathāhi, kaṇḍūyateḥka ktici allopayalopayoḥ kṛtayorallopasya sthānivattvenovaṅi kṛte ūkārasyānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvasya sthāne jātasyovaṅaḥ ``sthānivadādeśaḥ (pāosūo1-1-56) iti sthānivadbhāvenānādiṣṭadacaḥka pūrvatvād ``acaḥ parasmin (pāosūo1-1-57) itisthānivattvenākāreṇa vyavāyādūṭho'māvena sthānivattvādeva ``lopo vyorvali (pāosūo6-1-33) iti valopābhāvena ``hali ca (pāosūo8-2-77) iti dīrghe kṛte `kaṇḍūv‌ti' iti prāpnoti| yattu yaḥ sthānidvārā pūrva uvaṅ na tasyoṭh, kasya tarhi? vakārasya | yasya coṭh vakārasya, na sa sthānidvārā pūrva iti| tanna, testuritivatkaṇḍū ityasy kaṇḍuv iti ādeśāt, tasya ca kaṇḍuū ityādeśe karttavye sthānivadbhāvāvaśyambhāvāt| uktaṃ hi ---``sarve sarvapadādeśāḥ iti| anyathā `nirādya' `ghātvāt' ityādāvapi sthānivadbhāvānāpattyā mūlaśaithilyāpatteriti|
atrocyate| anādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatāyāḥ sthānidvārakatvamanityaṃ, napadāntasūtre `kaṇaaḍūtiḥ' itaci bhāṣyodāharaṇājjñāpakāt| ``āto'nupasarge kaḥ (pāosūo3-2-3) iti sūtre ``kavidhau sarvatra prasāraṇibhyo ḍaḥ iti vārttikasya tatpraghaṭṭakabhāṣyasya ca paryālocanayāpyevameva labhyate| tathā ca tatra bhāṣyam--yo'nādiṣṭadacaḥ pūrvastakttkārye sthānivattvaṃ hīti| sthānidvārake tu pūrvatve gṛhyamāṇe sampūrṇaḥka praghaṭṭakata evāsaṅgataḥ syāditi tatraiva sphuṭīkariṣyate| tatratyaḥ kaiyaṭastvāpātataḥ |

atra kecit-- `titāpayati' ityasādhveva| tathāhi, titau ṇic iti sthite ṭilopaśca prāpnoti ``ata upadhāyāḥ (pāosūo7-2-166) iti vṛddhiśca| ubhayornityayoḥ paratvād vṛddhiḥ| tataṣṭilope kṛte svata evānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvamādantaṃ na tu sthānidvāreti puṅ na prāpnoti| tasmācchapi ṇico guṇe kṛte ecivṛddhāvāyādeśe `titāyati' itibhavati| na ca titā ṇic iti sthite antaraṅgatvādād‌guṇe śapyayādeśe `titayati' iti syāditi vācyam, śapi hi guṇe sati ``vṛddhireci (pāosūo6-1-88) iti bādhenād‌guṇasya nimittavighātasyotpatsyamānatayā'kṛtavyūhaparibhāṣayā pṛrvamantaraṅgasyāpyād‌guṇasyāpravṛtteḥ| akṛtavyūhaparibhāṣā hyantaraṅgaparibhāṣāyā apavād ityuktam| na ca śapi guṇasya ``acaḥ parasmin (pāosūo1-1-57) iti sthānivattvādād‌guṇasya na nimittavikhāta iti vācyam, pūrvasyaiva vidhau sthānivadbhāvo na tu pūrvaparayorvighāvatyuktatvāt| tasmāt `titāyati' ityeva ****, na tu `titayati' `titāpayati' iti vā| caṅi tu titā ṇic caṅ tip iti sthite ``tanoterḍauḥ sa nvacca (uosūo541) iti vyutpattipakṣe ``anabhyāsasya iti dvitvaniṣedhe ṭilopasya caṅparanirhrāse sthānivattvaniṣedhād hrasvābhāve ṇilope tasya sthānivattavādasiddhatvādvā''tolopābhāve dīrghavidhiṃ prati sthānivattvaniṣedhātsavarṇadīrghe `atitāt' iti bhavati na `atitāpat' iti|

tasya doṣa ityāderayamarthaḥ--tasya ``pūrvatrāsiddheca (bhāoio) ityasva sthalatraye doṣaḥ atiprasaktiḥ, tasmāttatra sthānivadbhāvasya pratiprasavaḥ karttavya ityarthaḥ| tena `vākyarthaṃ' `vāsyartham' ityatra ``skoḥ (pāosūo8-2-26) iti lopo na nigāryate, nigālyate| ``aci vibhāṣā (pāosūo8-2-21) iti latvaṃ siddhati| tathā `māṣavapanī' ityatra ṇatvaṃ na bhavati, allopasya sthānivattvena nakārasya samāsāntatvābhāvāt| na cāsatyapi sthānivadbāve ṅībeva samāsānto na tu nakāra iti vācyam, ṅībutpatteḥ samāsa iti dvitīye vakṣyamāṇatvāt| evaṃ sthite takṣayateḥ kvipi `tak' rakṣayatestu `rak' ityādibodhyam| atra hi saṃyogādilope karttavye ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāvānna tatpravṛttiḥ| saṃyogāntalope tu sthānivadbhāvaniṣedhādbhavatyevāsau| `goraṭ' iti tu śu(1) dvātkvipi bodhyam| yattu ``acaḥ parasmin (pāosūo1-1-57) iti sūtre `dadhvatra' iti kabāṣyamupādāya kaiyaṭenoktam-- ``pūrvatrāsiddhe cetyetadatra nāsti, tasya doṣa ityeva saṃyogādilopasya saṃyogopalakṣitalopopalakṣaṇatvāt iti| tanna bāstavam| kintu tatratyapūrvapakṣiṇo'bhiprāyavarṇanamātram| ata eva ``napadātanta"" (pāosūo1-1-58) iti sūtraśeṣe tenaivoktam--``skandayatoḥ `skan' takṣayateḥ tak iti| yattu ``siddhakāṇḍe ścutvaṃ dhuṭtve iti vārttikavyākhyāvasare kaiyaṭenoktam--``madhugitīṣyate, madhuḍiti prāpnoti iti| tattu sakāropadeśasāmarthyāditi bodhyam| `san ścotati' ityatra ``śi tuk (pāosūo8-3-32) ityasyāpravṛtyā sakāraścaritārtha iti cettarihi ``kauluptam iti samādheyam| ``kusmanāmnovā (gaosuo) ityatra `kūḥ' iti mādhavodātdṛtaṃ samyageva tatra sāmarthyaviraheṇa saṃyogādilopāpravṛtteriti dik|
syādetat| iha saṃyogādigrahaṇaṃ māstu| na caivaṃ `vākyartham' ityādau ``skoḥ (pāosūo8-2-29) iti lopāpattiḥ| ``skoḥ saṃyoga (pāosūo8-2-29) iti lopāpattiḥ| ``skoḥ saṃyoga (pāosūo8-2-29) ityatra ``jhalo jhali (pāosūo8-2-26) ityato jhala ityanuvartate| taccopasarjanasyāpi saṃyogetyasya viśeṣaṇam, na tu pradhānayorapi skoḥ, avyabhicārāt| tataśca jhalanto yaḥ saṃyogastadādyoḥ skorlopaḥ syāditi sūtrārthāt, bahiraṅgatayā yaeṇo'siddhatvādvā| ata eva hi `dadhyatra' ityādau saṃyogāntalopo na pravartate| tathā cāṣṭame vārtikam--na vā jhalo lopādvahirahgalakṣaṇatvādveti| na caivamapi `kāṣṭatak' `rāṣṭrarak'ityādi na sidhyedeveti vācyam, anabhidhānāttatra kvipa eva durlabhatvāt| anabhidhānaṃ ca ``kāṣṭaśageva nāsti ityāṣṭamikabhāṣyabalena nyāyasāmyānnirṇīyate iti|
atrocyate| kusmayateḥ `kūḥ' ityādisiddhaye saṃyogādīti vācyameva| kiñca `tak' `rak' ityādyarthamapi vaktavyam| na cānabhidhānam, pramāṇābhāvāt kaiyaṭādibhirudāhṛtatvācca| na ca kāṣṭhaśageva nāstīti bhāṣyaṃ tatra pramāṇam, nyāyavaiṣamyāt| tathāhi, `kāṣṭhaśak sthātā' ityatra jhalparo yaḥ saṃyogastadādeḥ kakārasya lopamāśaṅkya taduktam| tena yatra kalopaprasaktistadabhiprāyakamanabhidhānam| ata eva kāntebhyaḥ kvip netyevamparatayā tadvākhyātam| na ca ṇijantebhyaḥ kvipi kalopaprasaktirasti, ṇilopasya sthānivadbāvāt| na ca ``pūrvatrāsiddhe ca iti tanniṣedhaḥsaṃyogādilope pratiprasavasya jāgarūkatvāt| tasmātsaṃyogodilopagrahaṇaṃ karttavyameveti sthitam|
idaṃ tvavadheyam| ``saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ (pāosūo8-2-23) ityatra na vā jhalo lopādvahiraṅgalakṣaṇatvādvā iti dvidhā siddhāntavyavasthāpanāt `kū' iti saṃyogāntalopo'pi durlabhaḥ| tena `kusm' ityevabhavatiprathamapakṣe| dvalitīyapakṣābhiprāyeṇa tu mādhavaḥ|
nanvevamapi latvagrahaṇaṃ vyartham, `nigālyate' ityatra satyapi ṇilope pratyayalakṣaṇena latvasiddheḥ| na ca varṇāśrayatvam, dhātoḥ svarūpe tatpratyaye kāryavijñānāt| idaṃ ca dāṇḍināyanādisūtre `bhrauṇaityā' iti tatvanipātena jñāpayiṣyate| kiñcāntaraṅgatvādapi latvaṃ suvacamiti|
atrocyate, ``tṛṇaha im (pāosūo7-3-92) ityatrāci netyanuvartate| halīti nivṛttam| tatā ca `atṛṇeṭ' ityādisiddhaye pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ nārambhaṇīyam, kintu niyamārthaṃ tadārambha iti bhāṣye sthitam| itakhyāvṛttimātraphalakaṃ pratyayalakṣaṇasūtram| tattatkāryāṇi tu sthānivatsūtreṇa nirvāhyāṇi| tatra ca `pradīvya' itīṇnivṛttaye aprādhānyonāpyalāśrayaṇe niṣedhaḥ stitaḥ| tathācāci pratyaye vidhīyamānaṃ latvaṃ sthānivadbāvaṃ vinā durlabhameva| yadapyantaraṅgatvāllatvamityuktaṃ, tadapi na; akṛtabyūhaparibāṣayā latvāpravṛtteḥ| kiñca ``upasargasyāyatau (pāosūo8-2-19) iti sūtre pakṣadvayaṃ vakṣyate-ayatiparatvamupasargasya viśeṣaṇaṃ repha sya veti| tatrādye pakṣe `palyayate' iti sidyati, `plāyate' iti tu na sidhyet ekādeśe kṛte vyapavargābhāvāt, ubhayata āśraye antādivadbāvāyogācca| tasmāttatra sthānivadbāvenaiva vyapavargo varaktavyaḥ| sa ca ``pūrvatrāsiddhe ca iti niṣidda iti latve pratiprasavaḥ sārthaka eva| dvitīyapakṣe tu `palyayate' iti na syāt, yakāreṇa vyavadhānāt| `plāyate' ityatraiva paraṃ latvaṃ syāt, ``pūrvatrāsiddhe ca iti sthānivatatvaniṣedhena tatra rephasyāyatiparatvāvidhātāt| kṛte tviha latvagrahaṇe yena nāvyavadānanyāyena `palyayate' ityatrāpi latvaṃ sidhyati| sphuṭaṃ cedamaṣṭame bhāṣye eva| tasmādiha latvagrahaṇaṃ karttavyameveti sthitam|
ṇatvagrahaṇaṃ tu vyartham| tathāhi, `māṣavapanī' iti tāvadbahiraṅgaparibhāṣayā'pi siddham| na ca `prahiṇoti' `pramīṇīte' ityādisiddhaye taditi vācyam ``acaḥ parasmin (pāosūo1-1-57) iti sūtrasya pravṛtti vināpyekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatayā ``hinumīnā (pāosūo8-4-15) ityasya pravṛttisambhavāt| na ca ``ṣṇāntā ṣaṭ (pāosūoi1-1-24) iti sūtre varṇitarītyā `priyāṣṭnaḥ' ityādisiddhaye ṇatvagrahaṇamiti vācyam, kāryakālapakṣe bahiraṅgaparibhāṣayaiva tasyāpi siddheḥ| yathoddeśapakṣastu na grahīṣyate pratyākhyeyena ṇatvena saha phalasāmyārtham| etena `priyāṣṭṇaḥ' iti ṇatvābhyupagamaparaḥ padamañjarīgranto'pyapāstaḥ| bahiraṅgaparibhāṣāyā anityatvepīha tadapravṛttau pramāṇābhāvāt| tasmādihaṇatvagrahaṇaṃ vṛtheti sthitam| pratyuta ṇatve sthānivattvābhyupagame bādhakamapyasti| tathāhi--``aniterantaḥ (pāosūo8-4-19) iti sūtre ``antaḥ (pāosūo8-4-20) iti yogaṃ vibhajya `he prāṇ' iti rūpasiddhaye``pdāntasya (pāosūo8-4-37) iti pratiṣedhaṃ bādhitum ``antaḥ (pāosūo8-4-20)iti sūtreṇa padāntasyāniterṇatvaṃ vidhīyate ityekā vyākhyā| antaśabda samīpaparyāyamāśritya nimittasamīpastho yo'niternakārastasya ṇatvaṃ, nimittasamīpasthasyāniteryo nakārastasya ṇatvamiti ca yogavibhāgaṃ vināpi vyākhyānadvayaṃ bhāṣye sthitam| tatra prathamapakṣe ``prāṇiti ityādāvekenā''kāreṇa vyavadhāne'pi vacanasāmathyārṇṇatvaṃ pravarttate| dvitīyapakṣe tvekādeśasyādivadbāvādrephādavyavahitasyāniteḥ sambhavātpravarttate| `paryaniti' ityatra tu varṇadbayenaikena ca vyavāyātpakṣadvaye'pi ṇatvaṃ na pravarttate iti spaṣṭamaṣṭame| yadi ceha ṇatvagrahaṇaṃ kriyate tarhi `paryaniti' itivat `prāṇiti' ityatrāpi dvayenaikena vā varṇena yathāsambhavaṃ vyavadhānāṇṇatvaṃ na syāt| na ca vacanasāmarthyātsthānivadbhāvakṛtaṃ vyavadhānamāśrayiṣyate `vṛtraghnaḥ' iti kutva iveti vācyam `niraṇiti' `duraṇiti' ityatra caritārthatvāt| na caivaṃ ``nirduroraniteḥ ityeva brūyāt, na tu ``aniterantaḥ iti sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ praṇayediti vācyam, āvṛttimāśritya `he prāṇ' ityatra ṇatvasya pratiprasavārthaṃ nirdurorityapekṣayā `antaḥ' ityuktāvakṣaralāghavānurodhācca sāmānyalakṣaṇapraṇayanasambhavāt| tasmādāṣṭamikabhāṣyaparyālocaneneha ṇatvagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyamiti nirṇīyate| ata eva `vyūḍhoraskena' ityatra ṇatvaṃ na| anyathā visargasyāṭ‌tvena tadādeśasya sasya sthānivadbhāvāṇṇatvaṃ syāt| iha ṇatvagrahaṇasya prayojanābhāvastūkta eva| tataśca ``tasya doṣaḥ saṃyogadilopalatvayoḥ iteyeva vācyam|
vastutastu tadapi na vācyam ``pūrvatrāsiddhe ca iti hyasiddhatvādeva nyāyasiddhamityuktam| taccāsiddhatvamanityam, ``adhunā (pāosūo5-3-17) itivad ``amunā iti vācye ``namune (pāosūo8-2-3) ityukterneti yogavibāgāt, nuṭīti vācye ``nāmi (pāosūo6-4-3) itiliṅgācca| `anaśvaḥ' ityāderaṅgasyetyanena vyāvṛttau satyāmapi `a(1)kṣaṇvantaḥ' ityādau hi dīrghaṃ vārayituṃ hi ``nāmi (pāosūo 6-4-3) ityuktam| ``rudhādibhyaḥ śnam (pāosūo3-1-78) ``śnānnalopaḥ (pāosūo6-4-23) iti sūtradvaye bhāṣyakaiyaṭādyālocanenārambhasāmarthyātsannipātparibhā,āyā ivāsidadhatvasyāpyaviśeṣādbādhe prāpte ``nāmi ityuktirit cet? na, kṛtituggrahaṇādinā sannipātaparibhāṣāyā anityatvajñāpanātsāmarthyādbādha iti pakṣe'pyakṣaṇvanta ityādāvubhayabāde gauravācca| tasmādanityatājñāpanārthameva tat| tena siddhakāṇḍamapi saṃgṛhītaṃ bhavati| etena `rāmaḥ' `rāmebhyaḥ' ityādau rutvasyāsiddhatvādrorukārasyetsaṃjñālopau kathaṃ syātāmityetadapi samāhitam| ``pratyayaḥ (pāosūo3-1-1) ``paraśca (pāosūo3-12) ityādiliṅgācca| yattvanunāsikanirdeśasāmarthyāditsaṃjñālaupau pratyasiddhatvaṃ neti| tanna, `tarumūlam' ityādau ``haśi ca (pāosūo6-1-114) ityasya vyāvṛttaye ``atoroḥ (pāosūo6-1-1) ityatra sānunāsikasyaiva nirdesābyupagamena cāritārthyāt| `rāmaḥ' ityādāvapi sānunāsikaśravaṇasyāpādyamāna tayā cāritārthyasya spaṣṭatvāditi dik| tena saṃyogādilopalatvayorasiddhatāvirahātsthānivattvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti sakaleṣṭasiddhiḥ|
dvirvacane'ci (pāosūo1-1-59) | rūpātideśo'yam| dvitvānimitte'cci yo'jādeśaḥ sa sthānivadrūpaṃ labhate dvitve karttavye| cakratuḥ, cakruḥ| dvitvanimittatvenājviseṣaṇādiha na--dudyūṣati, susyūṣati| na hayūṭh dvitvanimittam| nanvevaṃ `cakratuḥ' iti yaṇo'pi sthānivadbhāvo na syāt, atuso dvitvanimittatve'pyakārasyātathātvāt| sūtraṃ tu cakre ityādau sāvakāśamiti? satyam, iha nimittaśabdena sākṣādvā samudāyaghaṭakatayā vā dvitvaprayojakatvamāśrīyate na tu sākṣādevetyāgrahaḥ, lakṣyānurodhāt| kiñca sūtre nimittaśabdo nāstyeva| kintu lakṣaṇayā vā dviruvyote'sminniti dvirvacanamiti vyutpattyā vā dvirvacanamastyasminniti arśaādyacā vā dvirvacananimittaṃ labdhavyam| tacca prakāratrayaṃ sākṣātparamparamparāsādhāraṇe prayojake'pi suvacam| etacca ``ṭhasyekaḥ (pāosūo7-3-50) iti sūtre kaiyaṭe spaṣṭam| ata eva ūrṇoteḥ sani ``sanīvanta (pāosūo7-2-49) itīṭpakṣe ``vibhāṣorṇoḥ (pāosūo1-2-3)iti ṅittvavirahe `ūrṇunaviṣati' iti sid‌dham, sannantasya dvitvavidhāne'pi sano dvitvaprayojakatvena tasmin guṇāvadeśayordvitve karttavye sthānivadbhāvāt| taduktam--tadbhāvabhāvitāmātreṇeha nimittatvamiti| vastutastudvirvacanākṣiptaḥ pratyayo'cītyanena viśeṣyate| parasminnityanuvarttate| `amīṣāṃ madhye devadattātparamānaya' ityukte yathā sajātīyena manuṣyāntareṇāvyavahitaḥ para ānīyate, tathehāpi pratyayāntareṇāvyavahitaḥ parogṛhyate| tena dvitvanimitte ajādau pratyaye pratyayāntareṇāvyavahite pare sati yo'jādeśaḥ sa sthānivatsyāditi sūtrārthaḥ| evañca `cakratuḥ, ityādau na kā'pyanupapattiḥ| vakṣyamāṇajñāpakabalena ṇici vyavahite pravṛttāvapi `didevanīyiṣati' ityādāvanekapratyayavyavadhānādapravṛttiḥ| `apīpyat' ityatra varṇavyavadhāne'pipratyayāntarābhāvātpravṛttiḥ| anuvāde paribhāṣānupasthāne'pi nirdiṣṭaparibhāṣākarttavyasya nirvāhaśceti bodhyam| ata eveha parasminnityanuvartate iti nyāsakāraḥ| tathā dvirvacaneneha pratyayākṣepaṃ vadan ṇijbhinnena vyavahite jñāpakasyāpravṛttiṃ bruvankaiyaṭopyetadabhipraiti| `ūrṇunaviṣati' ityādisiddhaye tu tadbhāvabhāvitāmātreṇa nimittateti svīkriyate evetyavadheyam|
nanvevam `aririṣati' iti na siddhyet, ṛdhātoḥ sani ``smipūṅrañjavaśāṃ sani (pāosūo7-2-74) itīṭi kṛteka isśabdanimittakasya guṇasya sthānivadbhāve ``ajāderdvitīyasya (pāosūo6-1-2) itī so dvitvaprasaṅgāt| iṣyate tu ris‌śabdasya dvitvam| atrocyate| na hi kāryā nimittatayā''śrīyate iti ``dīdhīvevīṭām (pāosūo1-1-6) ityatropapāditatvānneha is śabdo nimittam| ato na sthānivadbhāvaḥ| na caivaṃ sannantasya kāryitvād `ūrṇunaviṣati' ityapi na syāditi vācyam, matvarthīyeneninā kāryamanubhavat eva kāryitvalābhāt| tatra tu dvitīya ekāc dvitvarūpaṃ kāryamanubhavati na tu san| `aririṣati' ityatra tu ris‌śabdasyaiva kāryabhāk‌tvamiti vaiṣamyāt| nanvevamacītyasya `jeghrīyate, dedhmīyate' iti vyāvartyaṃ na saṅgacchate, ghrīy dhmīy iti dvitīyājavadhikasyaikācaḥ kāryitayā yaṅo'pi dvinvanimittatvābhāvāditi cet? satyam, `adhijage' ityevājgrahaṇavyāvarttyamastu| tatra hi ``gāṅ liṭi (pāosūo2-4-49)
iti dvilakārakanirdeśamāśritya lāvasthāyāmeva gāṅādeśaka iti bhāṣte eva spaṣṭam| idañca vārtti kamatamanusṛtyoktam, tatra liṭi liṅītyādīnāṃ parasaptamītvābhyupagamāt| bhāṣyamate tvārddhadhātukīyāḥ sāmānyena bhavantītyabhyupagamālliṭītyādayopi viṣyasaptamyevetyuktaṃ sthānivatsūtre| tanmate tvacītyasya `jagle' ityādi vyāvarttyaṃ bodhyam| tathāhi, ``ādeca (pāosūo6-1-45) iti sūtre'śitīti parasptamīti pakṣe śa(1) it iti karmadhārayāśrayaṇād ``yasmimanvidhistadādāval‌grahaṇe (pāobhāo) ityasya pravṛttyā ādiśito'nyasminpare vidhīyamānamātvaṃ lāvasthāyāṃ kriyate| ato na sthānivat| na cāntaraṅgatvāttibādiṣveśi ca kṛte ātvaṃ syāttathā ca sthānivat| na cāntaraṅgatvāttibādiṣveśi ca kṛte ātvaṃ syāttathā ca sthānivat| na cāntaraṅgatvāttibādiṣveśi ca kṛte ātvaṃ sthāttathā ca sthānivattvaṃ durvāramiti vācyam, ``na samprasāraṇe samprasāraṇaṃlliṭi vayo yaḥ (pāosūo6-1-3738) iti dvilakārakanirdeśamāśritya taṃ ca tatrānupayuktatvādihānuvartya lliṭi tu lāvasthāyāmevetyātvavidhau vyākhyānāt| kathaṃ tarhi `jeghrīyate' `dedhmīyate' iti bhāṣyavṛttyādiṣu pratyudātdṛtamiti cet? prātiśākhyarītyetyavehi| tathāhi, ``anusvāro vyañjanaṃ cākṣarāṅgam (ṛoprāo1-5) ityuktvā ``svarāntare vyañjanānyuttarasya (ṛoprāo1-5) iti sūtritam| evañca `nenijati' `anenijuḥ' ityādāvekac‌kasya ghātoḥ sampūrṇasya dvirvacanādabhyastāśrayam adbhāvajusādi sidhyat| dvyacke tu madhyavartināṃ halāmuttarāṅgatvātprathamājantameva dvirucyatām| yathā daridrātau da iti, jāgartau jā iti| na caitāvatā kvacidrūpe'niṣṭamāpadyate, yena pratiśākhyaparibhāṣāmupekṣya `naṭabāryāvadvyañjanāni' iti cāśritya `dar' `jāg' ityādi dvirucyate| ata eva `caturaśchayatāvādyakṣaralopaśca(kāovāo) iti saṅgacchate iti dik| yadā tu ṣāṣṭhabhāṣyavārttikarītyā dvitīyājavadhika ekāc gṛhyate, ``gāṅ liṭi (pāosūo2-4-49) iti ca viṣayasaptamyāśrīyate, anaimittikamātvaṃ, śiti tu pratiṣedha iti vā, aśitīti viṣayasaptamī vā āśrayite, tadā `jeghrīyate' `adhijage' `jagle' iti trividhasyāpivyāvartyasyāsambhavādacītyasya phalaṃ kimiti vibhavanīyaṃ sūribhiḥ|

tadevaṃ `jeghrīyate' `adhijage' `jagle' ityetatsiddhaye kriyamāṇamajgrahaṇameveha rūpātideśatve pramāṇam| kāryātideśapakṣe hi ghrīgāglāityeṣāmeva bhāvyaṃ dvitveneti kiṃ tena? tathā ca vārttikam-ajgrahaṇa tu jñāpakaṃ rūpasthānivadbhāvasyeti| `dedhmīyate' `śāśayyate' ityapi `jeghrīyate' ityanena samānayogakṣemamudāharaṇam| ``ī ghrādhmoḥ (pāosūo7-4-31) iti īkāraḥ, ``ayaṅ yi k‌ṅiti (pāosūo7-4-22) iti śīṅo'yaṅādeśaḥ| acītyasya pratyākhyānapakṣe tu lakṣyānurodhādeva śabdādhikāramāśrityeha rūpātideśo vyākhyeyaḥ| pūrvasūkṣatrādaca iti ṣaṣṭhyantasyānuvṛttiriha kimartheti cet? nanvevamapi ``ṇau sthānivadvacanaṃ karttavyam `nunāvayiṣati' `cukṣāvayiṣati' `tuṣṭāvayiṣati' ityādyartham| atrāhuḥ--oḥ puyaṇjiṣu vacanaṃ jñāpakaṃ ṇau sthānivadbhāvasyeti| asyārthaḥ--yauteḥ pūṅaśca ``sanīvanta (pāosūo7-2-49)ka iti ``smipūṅaraṃjvaśām (pāosūo7-2-74)ka itika sūtrābhyāmiṭi kṛte `yiyaviṣati' `pipaviṣate' ityatra ``dvirvacane'ci (pāo1-1-59) iti sthānivadbhāvādyakārapakārayoravarṇaparayoḥ parato yadyapyabhyāse ukāro labhyate| tasya cekāradeśavidhānena oḥ puyaṇsūtre pakārayakāragrahaṇaṃ caritārtham| tathā'pi vargagrahaṇaṃ pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ jagrahaṇaṃ ca jñāpakaṃ dvitvanimittasyāco ṇicā vyavadhāne'pi sthānivadbhāvaḥ pravarttate iti| taṃ vinā avarṇapareṣu puyaṇjiṣu pareṣu uvarṇāntasyābhyāsasya durlabhatvāt| yena nāvyavadhānācca ṇicaivaikena dvitvanimittasyāco vyavadānamāśrīyate| tena `ninavanīyiṣati' ityādau na sthānivat lyuṭkvajbhyāṃ vyavadhānāt| evaṃ ṇijantāllyuṭkyacsansvapi na sthānivat, `nināvanīyiṣati' ityādi| na hi ṇau kṛtaṃ sthānivaditi vacanamasti kintu jñāpyamānaḥ sthānivadbhāvo lāghavādekenaiva vyavadhāne ityuktam| iha tvanekena vyavadhānaṃ spaṣṭamava| yadyapyanūdyamānādeśaviśe,ṇatvānnirdiṣṭaparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhata, tathāpyacītyaupaśleṣikasaptamībalādeva tadarthaḥ paryavasyati| īṣadviprakṛṣṭalābhe ca nātyantaviprakṛṣṭasya grahaṇamiti bodhyam| vastutastu `parasmin' ityunu(1) vartate iti sūtropakrame; tadubhavaṃ bhāṣyaviruddhatvādupekṣyam| `acikīrttat' ityasya siddhaye'varṇaparadhātvakṣaraviṣayakameva jñāpakamiti spaṣṭaṃ bhāṣye| prakṛtasūtrapratyākhyānapare vārttike avyaptirūpadoṣodbhāvanapareṇa ``odaudādeśasya cuṭutuśarādeḥ ityādibhāṣyeṇāpyayamartho labhyate ityanupadameva sphuṭīkariṣyate| ata eva---
