etacca sūtraṃ vārttikakāraḥ pratyācakhyau| tathāhi, ṣaṣṭhī dvitvaprakaraṇānte vipratiṣedhaḥka paṭhyate--``dvirvacanaṃ yaṇayavāyāvādeśā'llopopadhālopaṇilopakikinorutvebhyaḥ iti| tathāca `dadhyatra' ityādau sāvakāśo yaṇ `cayanaṃ' cāyakaḥ' `lavanaṃ'`lāvaka' ityādau| cāyavāyāvaḥ, `godaḥ' `kambaladaḥ' ityādāvāllopaḥ, `śleṣmaghnaḥ' ityādāvupadhālopaḥ, `kāraṇā' `hāraṇā' ityādau ṇilopaḥ, `nipūrttā' ityādāvupadhālopaḥ, `kāraṇā' `hāraṇā' ityātadau ṇilopaḥ, `nipūrttā'ityādāvutvaṃ cetyetāni nava `bibhidatuḥ' ityādau sāvakāśena dvitvena pūrvavipratiṣedhādvādhyante| tena `cakratuḥ' `cicāya' `lulāva' `cicayitha' `lulavitha' `papatuḥ' `tasthatuḥ' `jagmatuḥ, `jaghnatuḥ' `āṭiṭat' `taturiḥ, `jaguriḥ' ityādi siddham| nanvevaṃ `ninyatuḥ' iti na syāt, iyaṅa ihāparigaṇitatvāditi cet? na, ``eranekācaḥ (pāosūo6-4-82) iti yaṇeha bhāvyamiti prāgapīyaṅo'pravṛtteḥ ``prakalpya ca iti nyāyāt| tasmād ``dvirvacane'ci (pāosūo1-3-59) iti sūtraṃ vinā'pi sarvaṃ siddhamiti|
bhāṣyakārāstu sūtraṃ samarthayante| tathāhi, vipratiṣedhastāvadayuktaḥ, āllāpādīnāṃ nityatvāt dvitvasyānityatvenātulyabalatvāt| kiṃ ca pūrvavipratiṣedhe sarvatra vacanasyārambhaṇīyatvādiha tu sutarāṃ tatheti kva lāghavam? apica, kriyamāṇamapi vacanaṃ yadyantaraṅgāṇāmapi bādhakaṃ tarhi `ninvanīyiṣati' `didavanīyiṣati' ityādāvapyabhyāse ukāraḥ śrūyeta| athātrāntaraṅgatvādavādeśaḥ, vacanaṃ tu nāntaraṅgāṇāṃ bādhakaṃ kintu nityānāmeveti brūyāḥ, evamapi `cukṣāvayiṣati' ityādau vṛddhyāvādeśayoḥ pravartanādabyāsaṃ itvaṃ syāt| tatāca tadbādhanāya utvaṃ vidheyam| tathāca tvayā itthaṃ nyāsaḥ karttavyaḥ ``utparasyātaḥ (pāosūo7-4-88) ``tica (pāosūo7-4-89) ``odaudādeśasya cuṭutuśarādeḥ iti| abyāsasyeti gharttate| odotorādeśo yāsminnaṅge tasya yo'bhyāsaścuṭutuśarādistasy yo'kārastasya utsyādityarthaḥ| yathā--cukṣāvayiṣati, uḍuḍāvayiṣati, tutāvayiṣati, ūrṇunāvayiṣati, śuśāvayiṣati, pusphārayiṣa tīti| atra ``cisphurorṇau (pāosūo6-1-54) ityātvam| yadyapīha khayaḥ śeṣaṃ kṛte śarāditvaṃ nāsti tathāpyabhyāsasaṃjñāpravṛttikāle'styevetyavadheyam| odaudādeśasyeti kim? ``cāyṛ pūjāyāṃ (bhvāouo905) cicāyiṣati| ``khada sthairye (bhvāopao50) cikhadiṣati| cuṭutuśarādeḥ kim? bibhāvayiṣati| ata iti kim? ṛjum aṇm ṛtum aṃśu cākhyat ārjijat, āṇiṇat, ārttitat, āṃśiśat' ityatra paratvād vṛddhau satyāṃ ṭilope saṇickasya dvitve kṛte mā bhūt| ubhayathāpi doṣaḥ--śītaṃ lunāti śīlaluḥ sūryaḥ, tamākhyātumicchati `śiśītalayiṣati' ityatra takārāduttarasyāta utprasaṅgāt| nanvevamapi ``aujaḍhat``āñcakat ityādāvabhyāse'kāraśravaṇārthaṃ yatnāntaramāstheyameveti gauravāntaraṃ vārttikakāraṃ prati kuto nāpāditamiti cet? na, tatrekāra eveṣṭa ityuktatvāt| sajātīyāpekṣaṃ hi siddhānte'pi jñāpakam| anyathā `acikīrttat ityatrābhyāse'kāraśravaṇāpatteḥ| tasmādvārttikakṛtāvacanadvayamapi karttavyaṃ syāditi stitam| tathā `jaglau' ityādisiddhaye vipratiṣedhavārttike vṛddhirapi pāṭhyā| tathā ``oḥ puyaṇji (pāosūo 7-4-80)iti tṛtīyamapi karttavyameva| `pipaviṣate' `yiyaviṣati' jijāvayiṣati' ityatra itvaṃ yathā syāt| tathāhi| pu yu ityanayoḥ sani iṭi paratvād guṇe kṛte pūrvavipratiṣedhenāvādeśātpūrvaṃ dvitvamitītvaṃ vaktavyameva| tathā ``jucaṅkramya (pāosūo3-2-250) ityatra nirdiṣṭātsautrājjudhātorṇyantātsani jijāvayiṣatītyatra `cuṭutuśarādeḥ ityutve prāpto tadvādhanāyetvaṃ vaktavyam| na ca tatra cakārameva paṭhiṣyāmi na tu cuśabdamiti vācyam ``guṅ ghuṅ ghvanau (bhvāoāo979) ābhyāṃ ṇijantābhyāṃ caṅi sati ca ajūgavat, ajūghavat, jugāvayiṣati, jughāvayi ṣati ityādyasiddhiprasaṅgāt| kiñca, `didavanīyiṣīta' `ninavanīyiṣati ityatra ``cuṭutuśarādeḥ ityutvaṃ syāditi tadvāraṇāya vacanāntaramāsteyam| atha vā ``sanyataḥ (pāosūo7-4-79) iti sūtrād guṇo yaṅlukoḥ' (pāosūo7-4-82) ityādyaṣṭasūtryā vicchannmapi san‌grahaṇaṃ maṇḍūkaplutyā(1) nuvartya sūtramatoktarotyā `yena nāvyavadhāna' nyāyena ṇij‌bhinnairvyavadhāne utvaṃ neti samādheyam| evamapi tanuśabdādācārakvibantāddhetumaṇṇau satyasati vā yadā san tatra `titanaviṣati' `titanāvayiṣati' ityatrāpyutvaṃ syāt' idvāraṇāya odaudādeśasyeti vārtikamanyataiva vyākhyeyam, tadyathā, abhyāsasyetyavayavaṣaṣṭhī| środaudityādistu sambandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhī| abhyāsasyetyavayavaṣaṣṭhī| odaudityādistu sambandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhī| ubhayamapyato viśeṣaṇam| tadayamarthaḥ--abhyāsasyāvayavabhūtasyathā odaudādeśasya yathāyathamavayava ādeśo vā yo'ttasyodbhavati| `cukṣāvayiṣati' ityavayavaḥ| `pusphārayiṣati' ityādeśaḥ| tathācād‌grahaṇamapi sārthakam| anyathā `āṭiṭat' ityādiśiddhaye caṅ‌pare ṇau yadaṅgaṃ tadavayave laghau sanvadatideśād `ārjijat' ityādāvatiprasaṅgavirahādata iti vyarthaṃ syāditi dik| tathāca sūtramatāpekṣayā vārtikamate mahadeva gauravamiti|
syādetat| mā'stu prakṛtasūtraṃ mā ca vārttikam| ``oḥ puyaṇ (pāosūo7-4-80) ityetadeva jñāpayiṣyati antaraṅgaṃ nityaṃ ca bādhitvā dvirvacanaṃ syāditi| tato dvitve kṛtaṃ yathāprāptaṃ yaṇādi kariṣyate| maivam, `ninavanīyiṣati' `didavanīyiṣati' ityādyasiddheḥ| kiñca sāmānyāpekṣaṃ jñāpakaṃ viśeṣāpekṣaṃ vā? ādye `acikīrttat' iti na sidhyet| antye `cakratuḥ' ityādi na sidhyet| tasmātsūtraṃ karttavyameva| `cukṣāvayiṣati' ityādisiddhaye tu ``oḥ puyaṇ (pāosūo7-4-80) iti jñapakamāśrayaṇīyam| tacca tulyajātīyāpekṣamiti sthitam| ata eva vāmanodāhṛtam `ojaḍhat' ityetadbhāṣyaviruddhamiti bopadevopaṣṭambhena prapañcitaṃ prāk| vastutastu vāmanoktaṃ samyageva| yataḥ---
bopadevamahāgrāhagrasto vāmanādiggajaḥ|
kīrttereva prasaṅgena mādhavena bimocitaḥ ||
tathāhi, kiṃ vāmanoktau vārtikadūṣaṇaparabhāṣyavirodhaḥ, kiṃ vā sajātīyāvaṣaṇaparabhāṣyavirodhaḥ, kiṃ vā sajātīyāvaṣayajñāpakatāvarṇanabhāṣyavirodhaḥ? nādyaḥ, nityānityayorvipratiṣedhānupapattiriti, `didavanīyiṣati, ityādyasiddhiriti ca dūṣaṇayorbhāṣye'nuktatayā bhāṣyaṃ dūṣaṇāntarāṇāmapyupalakṣaṇamiti sthite `aujaḍhat' ityabhyāse'kāradeśopi vidheyaḥ syāditi vārttike dūṣaṇāntarasyāpi deyatvāt| tadevaṃ vārtikaṃ racanīyam--vārttike dūṣaṇāntarasthāpi deyatvāt| tadevaṃ vārttikaṃ racanīyam--odaudādaśesya kacuṭutuśarāderabhyāsasyautsani| tato'llopavato ṇico'tu| allopavato'ṅgasyābhyāsasya ṇico'tsyāt| aujaḍhat āñcakaditi| na dvitīyaḥ, yatra dvi ruktāvabhyāsasyottarakhaṇḍasyādyo'javarṇastatra sthānivaditi hi bhāṣyasya phalito'rthaḥ| asti ca hataśabdasya dviruktau prakriyādaśāyāmuttaratrāvarṇaḥ| nanu punaḥ pravṛttena ṭilopenāpahārānnāsau prayoge samavaitīti cet? kiṃ tataḥ? nahi prayogasamavāyitvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ bhāṣye dattm| evañca `nunāvayiṣati' ityādau dvitvapravṛttivelāyāmavarṇābhāve'pi paścādbhāvinaṃ tamāśritya yathā sthānivadbāvastathā hataśabdasya paścāttadvarahe'pi `adhyajīgapat' ityatra tu sthānivadbhāve satyajāditayā ṇica eva dvitvaṃ syāt tathāca na dvitvapravṛttivelāyāṃ nāpi paścādavarṇaparateti `acikīrttat' ityādāviva na sthānivadbhāvaḥ| evañcovarṇasthānikasyaiva sthānivadbhāva iti durāgraho nirmūla eva| ata eva ``lopaḥ pibateḥ (pāosūo7-4-4) iti sūtre `apīpyat' ityeva sādhu, natu, `añcikat' iti| `aṅgapayati' `āñcakipat' ityādi tu durāpāstam, allopasya durvāratvāt| akāroccāraṇaṃ tvabhyāse'kāraśrutyādinā caritārtham| yadapyaglopitvaṃ sthānivartvaṃ cetyādyuktam| tadapi na, cinteriditkaraṇena ``ghuṣiraviśabdene (pāosūo7-2-23) ityetatsūtrasthabhāṣyeṇa ca ṇijvikalpasya susthatayā allopavikalpasya nirmalalatvāt| ṇijabhāvapakṣe hi ``anekācaḥ (bhāoio) ityāmpravṛrtyā dhātorantodāttapravṛttyā cākāraḥ kṛtārthaḥ| `aṅkyāt' ityādau nalopapratibandho'pi phalamiti dik|
na caivamapi `aujaḍhat ' ityabyāse ikāraḥ śrūyeta' `pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacane (paobhāo126) ityukteriti vācyam ``ubho sābhyāsasya (pāosūo8-4-21) iti tadanityatājñāpanāt| yattu padadvirvacanaviṣayaṃ taditi bopadevaḥ| tanna, ``suvinirdurbhya (pāosūo8-3-88) iti sūtre ``sūpibhūto dvirucyate iti vārttikena tadbhāṣyeṇa ca saha viredhāt| ata evābhyāse ḍakāraṃ durgaguptādaya āhuḥ| evañca vaiyāghrapadyavārttike `aujaḍhat' iti pāṭhasya prāmādikatvakalpanameva prāmādikam| jiśabdapāṭhastu ktinā nirvāhyaḥ| yattvadantepaṣūnadātau `mā bhavānūninat' ityabhyāse ikāraśravaṇaṃ, tadapi lipipramādaprayuktam, anyathā ``kṝta saṃśabdane (cuouo120) ityatra subdhātau sāmpradāyikaḥ pāṭhaḥ| ``nonayatidhvanayati (pāosūo3-1-51) iti sūtre kāśikāpadamañjaryorapyevamevetyavadheyam| evañceda bhāṣyakāśikayoravirodha eveti sthite sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇādigranthā api nirbādhā evetyavadheyam| yattu ``stautiṇyoḥ (pāosūo8-3-61) iti sūtre `siṣecayiṣati' ityatra sicerhetumaṇṇau guṇe sani iṭi guṇāyādeśayoḥ kṛtayorguṇasya sthānivadbāvātsicchabdasya dvitvamiti nyāsakāreṇoktam| tattūttarakhaṇḍa'kārābhāvādbhāṣyaviruddhaṃ, sthānivadbhāvaṃ vinā'pyabhimatarūpasiddherniṣpalaṃ cetyupekṣyam| etena `aujaḍhat' `āpīpyat' ityādisiddhayesāmānyāpekṣatāṃ vadan `acikīrttat' ityādisiddhaye cānityatāṃ śaraṇīkṛrvan śīradevo'pyapāstaḥ ||
iti śrīśabdakaustubhe prathamasyādhyāyasya prathamepāde aṣṭamānhikaṃ samāptam ||
adarśanaṃ lopaḥ (pāosūo1-1-60) ||
sthāne ityanuvarttate| tadarthaśca prasaṅge, iti| prasaktasyānuccāraṇaṃ lopasaṃjñaṃ syāt| saṃjñāpradeśā ``lopo vyorvali (pāosūo6-1-66) ityādayaḥ arthasyaiṣā saṃjñā na tu śabdasya mahāsaṃjñākaraṇasāmarthyāt| nanvevaṃ pradeśeṣveva lopa iti laukiko'rtho grahīṣyate, paśurapatyaṃ devatetivat| tatkiṃ saṃjñayeti cet? na, prasaktasyetyevaṃrūpaviśeṣalābhāya sūtrārambhāt| anyathā `dadhi, madhu' ityādau tugāgamaprasaṅgāt| asti hi tatra kvipo'darśanam, tacca lopa iti pratyayalakṣaṇāpatteḥ| nanvevaṃ vārtikamate, bhāṣyamate tu pratyayalakṣaṇasūtraṃ niyamārtham| tatkathaṃ dadhyādau tuk‌prasaṅgaḥ? sthānivatsūtraṃ tu na tukaṃ prati pravartayati, ṣaṣṭhīgrahaṇasya tatrānuvarttitatvāt| ata eva `grāmaṇīḥ' ityādāvaṇkāryaṃ na bhavati| tathāca bhāśyarītyā `sīhitāvasānayorlekasiddhatvāt' iti vakṣyamāṇanyāyenedaṃ sūtre māstviti cet? na, `ghaṭaṅkaroti' `grāme tiṣṭhati' ityādau ``lyablope (kāovāo) iti pañcamyāpatteḥ' ``agnimīle (ṛosao1-1-1) ityādau ``cādilope iti nigātapratiṣedāpatteśca| ārabdhe tu sūtre tatra śāstrato lokato vā jyapaścādīnāṃ cāprasaktatvānnoktadoṣaḥ| nanu vārttikamate prasaktasyetyukte'pi `grāmaṇīḥ' ityatra vṛddhiḥ syāt, karmaṇyaṇaḥ prasaṅgasattvāditi cet? na, vāsarūpanyāyena pakṣe'ṇaḥsambhave'pi kvippakṣe tenāṇprasaṅgasya bādhitatvāt| vaikalpikayorekānuṣṭhāne tasminprayoge itarānuṣṭhāpakaśāstrāprāmāṇyasya śāstrasiddhatvāt|
pratyayasya luk‌ślulupaḥ (pāosūo1-1-61)||
anekasaṃjñākaraṇasāmarthyāttantrāvṛttyādyāśritya tadbhāvitasaṃjñā iha vijñāyante| luk‌ślulupśabdauḥ kṛtaṃ pratyayādarśanaṃ kramādetatsaṃjñaṃ syāt| saṃjñāpradeśā ``lukkataddhitaluki (pāosūo1-2-49) ``juhotyādibyaḥ śluḥ (pāosūo2-4-75) ``janapade lup (pāosūo4-2-89) iti| vidhipradeśeṣu bhāvisaṃjñāvijñanānnānyonyāśrayaḥ| viśeṣavihitā apyetāḥ saṃjñā lopasaṃjñāṃ na bādhante| ekasaṃjñāṃdhikārādanyatra sajñānāṃ bādhyabādhakabhāvo nāstīti `ākaḍāra' sūtre vakṣyamāṇatvāt| pratyayasyeti śakyamakarttum| na caivaṃ ``luk taddhitaluki (pāosūo1-2-49) iti vidhīyamānamadarśanaṃ ``gostriyoḥ (pāosūo1-2-46) ityanuvṛttergeśabdasyāpi syāditi vācyam, ``gorupasarjjanasya iti yogaṃ vibhajya ``striyā ``luk taddhitaluki (pāosūo1-2-49) iti sūtre strīgrahaṇasyaivānuvartanasaṃbhavāt| anyathā pratyayagrahaṇe kṛte'pi gamerḍorluk syāt| ``kaṃsīyaparaśavyayoryaññau luk ca (pāosūo4-3-168) iti lugapi prakṛterna bhaviṣyati ``ṅyāpprātipadikāt (pāosūo4-1-1) ityadhikārātprātadipadikātparasya lugvidhānāt| kṛte'pi hi prayyayagrahaṇe kameḥ saḥ kaṃsaḥ, parān śṛṇāti paraśuriti ukārasakārayorluk prāpta evameva parihāryaḥ| na caiyaṃ yañañoreva lugastu vidhānasāmarthyācca yañañlukāṃ vikalpaḥ| vatyanuktistu yañañbhyāṃ mukta autsargikasya śravaṇaṃ mābhūdityevamarthamiti vācyam, yaññlukāmekakālapratītānāmuddeśyavidheyabhāvāsamvāt| ``ṭ‌yuṭ‌yulau tuṭ‌ca (pāosūoeo4-3-23) ityatra tu ``ghakālakaneṣu (pāosūo6-3-17) iti ``anadyatanelaṅ (pāosūo3-2-111) iti ca jñāpakādvākyabedamāśritya ṭ‌yuṭ‌yulostuḍ‌vidhīyate| tasmādapratyayanivṛttaye tāvat pratyayagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam|

syādetat| sarvādeśārthaṃ pratyayagrahaṇam| tena ``yaññośca (pāosūo2-4-64) ``supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ (pāosūo2-4-71) ityādiṣu yatrānekāl pratyayasyatra ``alo'ntyasya (pāosūo2-4-71) ityādiṣu yatrānekāl pratyayastatra ``alo'ntyasya (pāosūo1-1-52) iti na bhavati| tathā ``lavaṇālluk (pāosūo4-4-24) ityādau ``ādeḥ parasya (pāosūo1-1-54) iti na bhavatīti| maivam, jñāpakādeva sarvādeśatvasiddheḥ| ``ghorlopo leṭi vā (pāosūo7-2-7) iti hi lope prakṛte ``lugvā duha (pāosūo7-3-73) iti lugghaṇaṃ jñāpayati lugādayaḥka sarvādeśā iti| alo'ntyasy hyadarśanaṃ prakṛtena lopenāpi siddham| na ca vaiparītyāpattiḥ, asañjātavirodhitvena lope'lontyaparibhāṣāyāḥ pravṛtteḥ| sāmānyena lumadviṣayaṃ jñāpakaṃ na tu luṅmātraviṣayamiti sarvaṃ siddham|
syādetat| ``āgastyakauṇḍinyayoḥ (pāosūo2-4-70) ityatra ``lugaṇiñoḥ (pāosūoeo2-4-58) ityato luggrahaṇamanuvarttate na vā? ādye sthāninau dvau ādeśāstu lukā saha trayaḥ, iti vaiṣamyādyathāsaṅkhyā bhāve ekaikasya traya ādaśāḥ paryāyeṇa syuḥ| tataścāgastayo'pi kuṇḍināḥ syuḥ, kuṇḍināścāgastayassyuḥ| lukca kriyamāṇo jñāpakātsarvādeśa iti ubhayatrāpi vibhaktimātraṃ kṣūyeta| atha kriyamāṇo jñāpakātsarvādeśa iti ubhayatrāpi vibhaktimātraṃ śrūyeta| atha nivṛttaṃ tato'gastayaḥ kuṇḍinā ityatra na kaściddoṣaḥ| kintu agastīnāṃ chātrāḥ `āgastīyāḥ' ityatra prāgdīvyatīye, ajādau pratyaye vivakṣite'pyagastyādeśasya niṣedhābāvādanivṛttāvavṛddhatvāccho na syāt| pratyayagrahaṇe sati tu luggrahaṇānuvṛttyā āgastyakauṇḍinyayoḥ pratyayāṃśasya lugbhavati, avaśiṣṭabhāgayoryathāsaṃkhyamagastikuṇkaḍinacau| tena `agastayaḥ' `kuṇḍināḥ' iti siddham| prāgdīvyatīye vivakṣite tu ``gotre lugaci (pāo sūo4-1-89) iti luki pratiṣiddhe tatsanniyogaśiṣṭatvādagastyādeśa'pi nivṛtte āgastyaśabdādvṛddhācce kṛte ``sūryatiṣya (pāosūo6-4-149) iti yalope ca āgastīyāḥ' iti siddhyati| kauṇḍinye tu nāsti viśeṣaḥ| nivṛtte'pi, kuṇḍinajādeśe kauṇḍinyaśabdādapi ``kaṇvādibhyo gotre (pāosūo4-2-111) ityaṇi kṛte, ``āpatyasya (pāosūo6-4-151) iti yalopa `kauṇḍināḥ' ityeva bhavitavyam| tasmād ``āgastyakauṇḍinyayoḥ (pāosūo2-4-70) ityatrāvaśyamanuvartyaṃ luggrahaṇam| tataśceha pratyayagrahaṇamapi karttavyameveti| maivam, ``āgastyakauṇḍinyayoḥ (pāosūo2-4-70) ityatra ``yaskādibhyo gotre (pāosūo2-4-63) iti gotragrahaṇamanuvarttya gotre yo vihitastasya lugiti vyākhyānenāpīṣṭasiddheḥ| tasmādatra pratyayagrahaṇaṃ mā'stviti sthitam|
syādetat| evaṃ sati lopasaṃjñayā saha lugādisaṃjñānāṃ tulyavyaktikatvaṃ syāt| tadbhāvitasya saṃjñeti cet? aviśeṣāllope'pi tathā syāt| ucyate| asañjātavirodhitvāllopasaṃjñā tāvadadarśanamātrasya bhavati| ucyate| asañcātavirodhitvāllopasaṃjñā tāvadadarśanamātrasya bhavati| lugādiśaṃjñāsu paramanekasaṃjñāpraṇayanasāmarthyāttadbhāvitagrahaḥ| tatena saṃjñāsaṅkaro netyuktam| sati tu saṅkare `hanti' iti śabluki ``ślau (pāosūo6-1-10) iti dvitvaṃ syāt| `juhoti' ityatra ślau sati ``uto vṛddhirluki hali (pāosūo7-3-89)ka iti vṛddhiḥ syāt| na ca tatrābhyastasya na(1) ityanuvṛtteḥ`yoyoti' `nonoti' ityādāviva vṛddhirna bhaviṣyatīti vācyam, saṃjñāsaṃkarapakṣe tadanuvṛttyasambhavāt| anyathā sūtrasya nirviṣayatāpatteḥ| na yautirautītyādiravakāśaḥ| saṃjñāsaṅkare tatrāpi dvitvasya durvāratvāt| lopasaṃjñā tu lugādisaṃjñānāṃ vyāpiketyuktam| tena `pañca' ityādau pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ sidhyatīti dik|
bhāṣyamate tu yadyapi sthānivatsūtreṇa `pañca' ityādi siddham, tathāpi `sudṛṣad brāhmaṇaḥ' ityatra vakṣyamāṇarītyottarapadādyudāttatvasyopadhādīrgasya ca vāraṇāya lope sati pratyayalakṣaṇameveti niyamo'vaśyaṃ pravarttanīyaḥ| tathāca tatra lukaḥ pratyayasaṃjñā'pyādarttavyetyavadheyam|
pratyayalope pratyayalakṣaṇam (pāosūo1-1-62)||
pratyaye lupte'pi tadāśrayaṃ kāryaṃ syāt| ``alvidyarthamidam iti vārttikamatam| tathāhi, `atṛṇeṭ' ityatra tipo halṅyādilope kṛte ``tṛṇaha im (pāosūo 7-3-92) iti sūtreṇa vidhīyamāno halādipitsārvadhātukanimitta imāgamo'smādvacanādbhavati| sthānivatsūkṣatreṇa tu na sidhyati, alvidhitvāt| nanvevaṃ pratyayalakṣaṇamapi na syāt, ``varṇāśraye nāsti gratyayalakṣaṇam (pāobhāo21) iti niṣedāditi cet? na, nahyevaṃrūpaṃ vacanamasti, kintu prakṛtasūtre pratyayalope tallakṣaṇamityevāstu, yadvā tallakṣaṇamityapi māstu, stānivadityanuvṛttyaiveṣṭasiddheḥ| evaṃ sati pratyayalakṣaṇāmityukteḥ phalaṃ tatpaṭhyate| punaḥ pratyayagrahaṇasāmarthyāddhi yatkāryaṃ prati pratyayasyāsādhāraṇaṃ rūpaṃ nimittatayā''śrīyate supttvatiṅ‌tvādi, tadeva bhavatīti labyate| tena `gave hitaṃ gohitam' ityavādeśo na bhavati, tadvidhāvactvamātrāśrayaṇāt, tasya ca pratyayāpratyayasādhāraṇyāt| athātra ``na lupatā (pāosūo1-1-63) iti niṣedhaḥ| tarhi `suyaśāḥ' ityatra ``visarjanīyasya saḥ (pāo sūo8-3-34) syāt, `suvṛḍ' ityādau ``khari ca (pāo sūo8-4-54) iti carttavaṃ syāditi dik|
imāgame tu halādau sarvadhātuke iti pratyaya eva prādhānyenāśrīyate iti vaiṣamyam| tasmādvarṇaprādhānye pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ nāsti pratyayaprādhānye tvastīti vivekaḥ| anenaiva nyāyena ``na dhātulope (pāosūo1-1-4) ityatra dhātulopa iti bahuvrīhiṇaiva siddhe ārddhadhātukagrahaṇasāmarthyāttattvena nimittatā labhyate| tena `dhinvikṛṇvyorvici' ``lopo vyoḥ (pāosūo6-1-66) iti valopasya valnimittatvāttatrārddhadhātukatayā vico nimittatvābhāvād guṇo bhavatyeva| tena, sudhe, śudhenau, sudhenaḥ' `sukaḥ, sukarṇau, sukarṇaḥ'ka ityādi bhaviti| paṭhanti ca---
sudhe sudhevārivadhātsurāṇāṃ sukāraṇe lāghavataśca rāma|
viśeṣaṇe dve ya ihādikartturvadedadhītī sa hi kaiyaṭīyaḥ || iti |
na ca `totortti' ityādivyāvṛttyā ārddhadhātukagrahaṇasya sārthakyātkathaṃ sāmartyamiti vācyam, yaṅlukaścāndasatvāt| bhāṣāviṣayatvapakṣe tvārddhadhātukagrahaṇamāvartya sāmarthyamupapādanīyam| nanvetat ``ṅkiti ca (pāosūo1-1-5) ityetatsūtrasthabhāṣyeṇa saha viruddham| pūrvasminyoge yadārddhadhātukagrahaṇaṃ tadanavakāśamiti tatroktatvāditi cet? na, anāsthāyā tathoktatvādityāhuḥ|
tadupaṣṭambhenātra vijevānabhimata ityeva kiṃ na syāditi cintyam|
kvipi tu ūṭh| tena `dhinūḥ' `dhinvau' `dhinvaḥ' `kṛṇūḥ' `kṛṇvau' `kṛṣvaḥ' iti bhavati| `sudhī' `sudhinau, sudhinaḥ' `sukīḥ, sukṛṇau, sukṛṇaḥ' ityādi tu na bhavatyevetyāhuḥ|
yaṅluko bhāṣāviṣayatve ārddhadhātukagrahamasya `totorti' ityatra cāritārthyādāvṛttau ca mānābhāvād guṇaniṣedhapravṛttyā `sudhī, `sudhinau' ityevāstu| kṛṇotestu dīrgha `sukīḥ, sukīrṇau, sukīrṇaḥ' ityādi bhavatvityapi cintyam|
nanvevaṃ `parivīḥ' ityatra tugdīrghau paryāyeṇa syātām| anenaivobhayavidhāne paurvāparyābhāvena ``vipratiṣedhe param (pāosūo1-4-2) ityasyāpravṛtteḥ| satyam, śāstrātideśasya vyapadeśātideśasya vāśrayaṇādadoṣaḥ| yadvā, sati pratyaye yatkāryaṃ bhavitumarhati tadevātidiśyate iti `parivīya' ityādāviva `parivīḥ' ityātrāpi dīrgha eva bhavati na tu tugiti kāryātideśe'pyadoṣaḥ|
bhāṣyakārāstvāhuḥ--tṛṇahaimarthaṃ tāvannedaṃ sūtram, sthānivatsūtreṇaiva gatārthatvāt| na cālvidhirayam, halītyasya nivarttanāt| na caivaṃ `tṛṇahāni' ityātrāpīm syāditi vācyam ``nābhyastsyāci(pāosūo7-3-87) ityato'ci netyanuvattanāt| nāpi `āśīḥ' ityatra ``sāsaidaṅhaloḥ (pāosūo6-4-34) itītvārthamidam, āsāsaḥ kvāvupasaṃkhyānenaiva siddheḥ| taddhi tvayā'pi vācyam| ``śāsa idaṅhaloḥ (pāosūo6-4-34) ityatra śāsimātragrahaṇamiti pakṣe niyamārtham--āśāsaḥ kvāveva yathā syāt `āśāste' ityādau mā bhūditi| yasmācchāseraṅ vihitastasyaivāṅ‌sāhacaryāditvavidhau grahaṇamiti pakṣe yathā `āśāste' ityādau na bhavati, tatā kvipyapi na syāditi vidhyartham| tasmātpratyayalope sati pratyayalakṣaṇameveti niyamārthamidaṃ sūtram| pratyayāpratyayasādhāraṇaṃ rūpamāśritya yatkaryaṃ vidhīyate tannivṛttiḥ phalam| tena śobhanā dṛṣado'sya prāsādasya sudṛśaṣat| atra ``sormanasīalomoṣasī (pāosūo6-1-117)iti sūtreṇa suśabdātparasya mannantasyāsantasya cottarapadasya bahuvrīhau vidhīyamānamādyudāttatvaṃ na bhavati| atra hi lupte'pi jasi stānivadbhāvenāsantamuttarapadamastyeva| kintvas iti rūpaṃ pratyayāpratyayasādhāraṇam, ``aninasman‌grahaṇānyarthavatā cānarthakena ca tadantavidhiṃ prayojayanti (paobhāo16) iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt| ato niyamenādyudāttavyāvṛttiḥ siddhā| tathāca ``nañsubyām (pāosūo6-2-172) ityantodāttaṃ padaṃ bhavati|
idantvavadheyam| na kevalaṃ svarārthamevedaṃ sūtram| kintūktodāharaṇe eva prāpnuvan ``atvasantasya (pāosūo6-4-14) ityupadādīrghā'pi uktaniyamenaivavyāvartyaḥ| vārttikamate tu uktasvarasya dīrghavyāvṛtteśca siddhaye upāyāntaramanveṣaṇīyamiti|
nanu yadi niyamārthaṃ sūtraṃ tarhi `pañca' ityatra pratyayalakṣaṇena padatvamitivṛttiḥ kathaṃ yojyā? evaṃ ``samāsatvātprātipadikatvam ``snukramoḥ (pāosūo7-2-36) itīṭ' ``ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi (pāosūo2-3-66) itikarmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī ityādayo'pi tatratatrā'bhiyuktagranthāḥ kathaṃka yojyā iti? atrocyate,yo'smākaṃ niyamavidhiḥ sa mīmāṃsakarītyāparisaṅkhyāvidhiriti tāvatsapaṣṭaṃ vivaraṇādau| tatra doṣatrayaṃ--svārthahāniḥ, parārthaparikalpanā, prāptabādhaśceti| tacca yadyagatyā sahyate, iti pakṣastadā niyamavidherniṣedha evārthaḥ| pratyayalakṣaṇaśabdena tadbhinnaṃ lakṣyate, bhavatītyanena tu na bhavatīti| tathāca sthāne'ntaratamasūtre bhāṣyam-- ``nānenāntaratamā nivartyante `api tu' `anantaratamā nivarttyante iti| ata eva vārttikakāropi vakṣyati--``ubhayaprāptau karmaṇīti pratiṣedhe'kādiprayoge'pratiṣedhaḥ (kāovāo) iti| asminpakṣe ``ubhayaprāptau (pāosūo203-66) iti pariśetitā ṣaṣṭhītyādikrameṇa vyākhyeyaṃ, natu vihiteti| yadi tu doṣatrayagauravaparihārārthaṃ pratyayalakṣaṇasūtraṃ yathāśrutaṃ vyākhyāya ataeva jñāpakāt sthānivatsūtrasya pratyayalopetaraviṣayakatā kalpyate sāmānyapuraskārapravalṛttasya śāstrasya viseṣatātparyaṃ hi tvayā'pi kalpyameva| anyathā vikalpāpatteḥ| bhāṭṭamate ``na tau paśau karoti ityatra yathā| ``pade juhoti ityādaibirāhavanīyavidheriva viśeṣa vidhinā sāmānyavidheḥ saṅkocasambhavācca| na caivaṃ sāmānyasya viśeṣe upasaṃhārāpattiḥ, sāmānyaśāstrapraṇayanavaiyyarthyāpatteḥ| vede tu na kaścitpraṇetā yenaivaṃ paryanuyujyeteti caturddhākaraṇasyāgneye upasaṃhāro mīmāṃsāyāmabhyupetaḥ| kalpasūtrakārāstu taatrāpi vyutthā eva| tathāca bhagavatā kātyāyanena sutritam ``aviśeṣādubhau vā (kāośrauosūo) iti| evañca sāmānyaśāstrasya viśeṣalakṣaṇāyāka ubhayavācyatvāttathai vopapattau doṣatrayaṃ na soḍhavyamiti pakṣastadodāhṛtagranthāḥka samyageva| naiyāyikamate tu tātparyasaṅkocasthale lakṣaṇā nāstyeveti nirvivādam, valiśeṣadharmaprakārakabodhasyoddeśyatāyāmeva tadabhyupagamāt| sāmānyaprakārakasya viśeṣaviśeṣyasyāpi lakṣaṇāṃ vinā nirvāhāditi sudhībhirākalanīyam|
na lumatāṅgasya (pāosūo1-1-63)||

svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasyāśabdasaṃjñā (pāosūo1-1-68)|
śabdasya svaṃ rūpaṃ saṃjñi śabdaśāstre yā sejñā, tāṃ vinā, ``agnerḍhak (pāosūo4-2-33) āgneyam| ``āṅo yamahanaḥ (pāosūo1-3-28) āyacchate, āhate| iha āgni āṅ yam han eṣāmetatsūtropāttānāṃ prayogasamavāyinasta eva saṃjñinaḥ| aśabdasaṃjñeti kim? ``upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ (pāosūo3--392) dādhābhyo yathā syāt, ghudhātoḥ śabdārthānmā bhūt| śabdaḥ śabdaśāstraṃ, tatra saṃjñeti saptamīsamāsaḥ, na tu śabdasya saṃjñeti; `karma' `karaṇam' ityādiṣvartasaṃjñāsu svaparūpagrahaṇāpatteḥ|
syādetat| rūpagrahaṇaṃ vināpi svaśabdena tadeva grahīṣyate, pratītāvupadeśānapekṣatvādasādhāraṇattvādantaraṅgatvānniyatopasthitikatvācca| artho hi pratītau sambandhagrahamamapekṣate, sādhāraṇaśca, paryāyairapi pratyāvanāt| bahiraṅgaśca padajñānajanyabodhaviṣayatvāt| aniyatopastitikaścānukaraṇadaśāyāmapratīte| tatkiṃ rūpagrahaṇeneti cet?
atrāhuḥ| iha śāstre artho'pi vivakṣito rūpavaditi jñāpanārthaṃ rūpagrahaṇam| tena ``arthavad‌grahaṇe nānarthakasya (paobhāo) ityupapannaṃ bhavati| tatroktajñāpakādartho grahyaḥ, `svaṃ rūpam' iti vacanādrūpaṃ ceti sāmarthyādarthavato rūpasya grahaṇam| tena `kāśe, kuśe' ityatra ``śe (pāosūo1-1-13) iti pragṛhyasaṃjñā na bhavati|
etatsūtraṃ bhāṣye pratyākhyātam| tathāhi| ārabhyamāṇe'pi sūtre paśuḥ, apatyaṃ, devatā, prāñcaḥ, udañcaḥ, bharatāḥ, hatyādayastāvallokavadarthā eva gṛhyante| ``agnerḍhak (pāosūo4-2-33) ityādau tu śabda eva grahīṣyate, arthasya pratyayena paurvāparyāsambhavāt ``ṅyāpprātipadikāt (pāosūo4-1-1) ityadikārācca| ``upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ (pāosūo3-3-92) ityādau tu ghudhāturna grahīṣyate ``dādhā ghu (pāosūo1-1-20) ityārambhāt| uktaṃ hi----
vyavahārāyaṃ niyamaḥ saṃjñāyāḥ saṃjñini kva cit| iti|
arthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣā'pi vraścādiśutre rājiṃ paṭhitvā punarbhājipāṭhātsiddhā, nyāyasiddhā ca| ``agnerḍhak (pāosūo4-2-33) ityādau hi śabdaviśiṣṭasyārthasyotsargata upasthitau viśeṣye kāryabādhādviśeṣaṇībhūte śabde pravartamānaṃ kāryamupasthitārthopahite eva, tvanarthake'pi, arthasya viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabāvavyatyāsamātreṇopapattau sarvātmanā tvāgāyogāt| gauṇamukhyanyāyo'pyetanmūlaḥ, gauṇasya prathamato'nupasthiteḥ| etena ``abhivyaktapadārthā ye ityapi vyākhyātam| tasmānn‌yāyata eva sakalanirvāhe sūtraṃ nārambhaṇīyamiti| nanūttaratra catuḥsūtryāmanuvṛttaye ``svaṃ rūpam (pāosūo1-1-68) ityavaśyaṃ vācyameveti cet? na, anuvṛtteranāvaśyakatvāt| tathāhi, aṇuditsūtre tāvatsvasyāpi svasāvarṇyādeva siddham, kathamanyathā ``avāttām ityatna ``jharo jharo (pāosūo8-4-65) iti lopaḥ| tatra vyaktibhedātsāvarṇyamiti cet? ihāpi bodhyabodhakavyaktyorbhedāt| tathā ``taparastatkālasya (pāosūo1-1-70) ityatrāpi| ``ādirantyena (pāosūo1-1-71) ityatrāpyādigrahamaṃ vṛttyā siddham| āvṛttau liṅgaṃ tu ``nādici (pāosūo6-1-104) ityādi| ``yena vidhiḥ (pāosūo1-1-71) ityatra tu vārttikakāra ``tasya ca iti vakṣyatyeva| vastutastu tadapi na vācyam, vyapadeśivadbhābenaiva siddheḥ| ``aprātipadikena iti tu tatreva pratyākhyāsyāmaḥ| ata eva ``yenavidhistadādyantatve prayojanam ityādyantavatsūtrasthaṃ vārttikaṃ saṅgacchate' iti dik|
sittadviśeṣāṇāṃ vṛkṣādyartham| atra sidityupalakṣaṇaṃ kiñcilliṅgamāsajya itthaṃ liṅgā viśeṣāṇāṃ saṃjñeti vaktavyam| tacca liṅgaṃ vṛkṣādāvāsañjanīyamityarthaḥ| evamagre'pi| tena ``vibhāṣā vṛkṣamṛga (pāosūo2-4-12) iti sūtre viśeṣāṇāmeva grahaṇāt `plakṣanyagrodhaṃ, plakṣanyagrodhāḥ' iti siddhyati|
pitparyāyavacanasya ca svādyartham| cakārādviśeṣāṇāṃ svarūpasya ca grahaṇam| ``sve puṣaḥ (pāo8sūo 2-4-40) raipoṣaṃ puṣṭaḥ, aśvapoṣam, svapoṣam|
jitparyāyavacanasyaiva rājādyartham| ``sabhā rājāmanuṣyapūrvā (pāosūo2-4-23) inasabham, īśvarasabham| neha rājasabhā, hariścandrasabhā| paryāyeṇa yo vakti sa hi paryāyavacanaḥ| na ca svasya svena sahavikalpaḥ, nāpi viśeṣeṇa, sāmānyaviśeṣayorbhinnaprakārakabodhajanakatayā tulyārthatvābhāvāt| tulyārthastu vikalperanniti nyāthāt| inaśabdo rājaśabdaparyāya ityādivyavahārāstu `bhīmo bhīmasenaḥ' itivat|
jhit tasya tadviśeṣāṇāṃ ca matsyādyartham| ``pakṣimatsyamṛgān hanti (pāosūo8 4-4-35) mātsikaḥ, śāpharikaḥ| paryāyavacanānāṃ na animiṣān hanti| ``mīnasyeṣyate iti bhāṣyam| mainikaḥ|

iha vṛkṣādau rājādau ca nyāyenaivābhimataṃ sidhyatīti tatraiva vakṣyate| itasttu sarvaṃ vācanikamevetyavadheyam||
aṇuditsavarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ (pāosūo1-1-69)|
atrāṇ pareṇa ṇakāreṇetyuktam| aṇudicca savarṇasya saṃjñā syāt vidhīyamānaṃ vinā| cakārāt svarūpasya| ``asya cvau (pāosūo7-4-32) śuklī syāt, mālī svāt| ``eranekāco'saṃyogapūrvasya (pāosūo6-4-82) cicyatuḥ, ninyatuḥ| ``ṛdorap (pāosūo3-3-56) yavaḥ, stavaḥ, lavaḥ, pavaḥ| ``uraṇ raparaḥ (pāosūo1-1-51) karttā, kirati| na caivam ṛdorap hrasvāntebhyaḥ kṛñādibhyo'pi syāditi vācyam, dīrghoccārapāvaiyarthyāpatteḥ| nanvevamapi ``aṣṭana ā vibhaktau (pāosūo7-2-84) ityatra savarṇagraho durvāraḥ| na hi tatrāpi sāmarthyam, hrasvoccāraṇe hyardhamātrikasya mātrika eva yathā syāditi dīrghagrahaṇasyobhyārthatopapatteriti cet! na, ``apratyayaḥ (pāosūoeo6-1-69) iti niṣedhāt, dīrghāṇāmanaṇtvena savarṇagrāhakatā nāstīti prāgevoktatvācca| nanu dīrghāścedanaṇastarhi `kārakaḥ' `hārakaḥ' ityādau raparatvaṃ na labhyeteti cet? bhrānto'si| na hi dīrghāḥ kvāpyaṇgrahaṇena nopasthāpyante iti brūmaḥ kintu grahaṇakaśāstre tadupajīvyeṣu varṇopadeśādiṣu ca hataratra tu vākyāparisamāptinyāyānavatārādastyevāṇ‌grahaṇena dīrghagrahaṇamiti tattvam|
udit-- ``kuhoścuḥ (pāosūo7-4-62) cakāra, jagāda| apratyaya iti niṣedhastu ugitsu na pravarttate, ugitkaraṇasāmarthyāt| ata evāhuḥ--``bhāvyamānoṇ savarṇānna gṛṇhāti (pāobhāo) iti| tuk-luknuk tuḍādayastu noditaḥ, ``pratijñānunāsikyāḥpāṇinīyāḥ (bhāoio) ityabhyupagamāt| apratyaya iti kim? vidhāyamānānāṃ pratyayāgamādeśānāṃ savarṇagrāhakatvaṃ mā bhūta| ``ata iñ (pāosūo4-1-95) ``idama iś (pāosūo5-3-3) ``ārddhadātukasyeṅ (pāosūo7-2-35) ``bhuvo vuk (pāosūo6-4-88) ``am sambuddhau (pāosūo8-1-99) iha hi sarvatropadeśa iti vacanātsūtrāntargateṣveva iñādiśabdeṣvitsaṃjñā pravarttate| lopastu tatrānupūrvyādvādhito'pi padasvarūpaparyālāṃcanāyāṃ pravṛttaḥ| tataḥ ``svaṃ rūpam (pāosūo1-1-68) iti saṃjñābalāt jñāyamānā padārthopasthitiranubandhavinirmuktasyaiva bhavati| tathācopasthāpakasyāṇtvātsavarṇagrahaṇaṃ prāptaṃ niṣidyate ityucitam| ata eva caturdaśasūtryā muccāraṇārdhasyākārasyevetsaṃjñakānāmapi ṇakārādīnāṃ laṇmadhyākārasya ca padaparyālocanāyāmeva `lopaśca balavattaraḥ' iti nyāyenāpahārāditarāntarbhāveṇaiva saṃjñā pravarttate iti siddhāntaḥ| idaṃ ca ``alo'ntyātpūrva upadhā (pāosūo1-1-65) iti sūtre ``tasminnati nirdiṣṭe (pāosūo1-1-66) ityatra ca kaiyaṭagranthe spaṣṭam| iṭ aka ikocītyādau sānubandādvibhaktistu prāthamikabodhe viśiṣṭasya vipayatayā tasyaivārthavatvamādāya| anyo hi paścādupatiṣṭhate na tu prayujyate iti kathaṃ tato vibhaktiḥ kriyatām? itsaṃjñākāryaṃ tu ānarthakyāttadaṅgeṣviti nyāyena pratyāyye pravarttate| vibhattyarthānvayo'pyevam| dṛṣṭaṃ hi ṅamuḍādāvupasthāpake kṛtasya liṅgasya tadvodhye phalapravarttakatvamiti dik|
syādetat| uktarītyā ``udoṣṭhyapūrvasya (pāosūo7-1-102) iti sūtre ucchabde pravṛttā itsaṃjñā lakṣye titsvaraṃ pravarttayediti cet? satyam, ata evaitatsamādhānāya pūrvācāryaiḥ parākrāntāmiti gṛhaṇa| kathaṃ tarhi `eoṅ' sūtre tad‌dūṣaṇāya pravṛttamiti cet? tatkālāvadhāraṇena kṛtārthasya takārasayānubandhāntaravaiṣamyāditi gṛhāṇa| ata eva `vaiyākaraṇaḥ' ityatra aicaścitsvaro na bhavati| `pacasva' iti śapo'pyevam| ``na yvābhyām (pāosūo7-3-3) iti sūtre `acaḥ parasya dve' ityatra ca aicoścakārasya prayāhāre upakṣayāt| yadvā, iñiśādiṣvapi mā'stu sūtrāntargateṣvitsaṃjñā, kintu phalapratyāsatteḥka padārtheṣveva sā'stu| naite upadiṣṭā iti cet? na te phalabhāja iti tulyam| sāmarthyātparaṃparāśambandhe lamiti cet? saṃjñāpi takṣatraivāstu sāmarthyāditi tulyam| upadeśe'ntyatvaṃ hi prāyogikeṣvasambhavāttatpratyāyakaniṣṭhamānupūrvīsājātyādāśrīyate| na caitattapareṣvasti, pratyāyye takārābhāvāditi dik|
prakatamanusarāmaḥ| bhāvyamāno'pyukārādeśaḥ savarṇān gṛhṇāti ``ṛtaut (pāosūo6-1-111) iti tapakaraṇālliṅgāt| tena `amunā' `ambhyām' ityatra hasvasya hrasvo dīrghasya dīrghaḥ siddhyati| na caivaṃ ``sanāśaṃsa (pāosūo3-2-168) ityupratyayo'pi savarṇaṃ gṛhṇātviti vācyam ādeśaviṣayakaṃ jñāpakamityuktatvāt| yadvā, ``adaso'seḥ (pāosūo8-2-80) iti sūtre eva uśca ūścoti samāhāradvandvo'stu| ata eva sorlukā nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| ata eva ca ``ūdupadhāyāḥ (pāosūo6-4-89) iti sūtre goha iti vikṛtanirdeśaṃ pratyākhyātuṃ bhāṣyakārairūkārāntarapraśleṣa uktaḥ|
nanvevamapi ``akaḥ savarṇe (pāosūo6-1-101) ityatra akāro'ṣṭādaśānāṃ grāhako'stu, amtvāt| astu ca sa eva ikārādīnāmapi grāhakaḥ, ``ādirantyena (pāosūo1-1-171) ityukte, īkārādayastu kathaṃ grāhyāḥ? na hi tadvācakaḥka śabdastasminsūtre upātto'sti| nanvak‌śabdena ikārādayo'pyupasthitā iti cettarhi vākyārthe te nayantu nāma, padārthasaṃsargasya vākyārthatvāt| na tu te'pi svārthopasthāpakāḥ, anuccāritatvādityuktam| ata eva `ṛcaṃ vetti' ityādau śabdaviśeṣaṃ vettītyevārtho na tu tadarthaṃ vettīti| taduktaṃ vārttikakṛtā--``tatra pratyāhāragrahaṇe savarṇāgrahaṇamanupadeśāt| isvasampratyayāditi ceduccāryamāṇasampratyāyakatvācchabdasyāvacanam iti| śabdasya pratīyamānasya avacanam arthāpratipādakatvamityarthaḥ| atrocyate| pratyāhāragrahaṇe sarvatra svavācyavācye nirūḍhā lakṣaṇā ``dīrghājjasica (pāosūo6-1-105) iti jñāpakāt| ``prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ (pāosūo6-1-102) ityatra hi aka ityanuvarttate| na cāk‌śabdavācyo dīrgho'sti, yo'sya niṣedhasya viṣayaḥ syāt| nanvākāro'stīti cet? na, ``nādici (pāosūo6-1-104) ityanevaiva tatra niṣedhasiddheḥ| ``pvādīnām (pāosū07-3-90) ityādinirdeśā apīha liṅgam| nanvevam ``iko yaṇaci (pāosūo6-1-77) iti sūtre īdātorgahaṇaṃ na syāt, yugapadvṛttidvayavirodhāt| tathā ca `sudhyupāsyaḥ' `dadhyānaya' ityādi na siddhyediti cet? na, sati tātparye yugapadvṛttidvayasya svīkāre bādhakābhāvāt| iha ca ``āṇnadyāḥ (pāosūo7-3-112) ityādinirdeśānāṃ tātparyagrāhakatvāt| yadi tu prācāṃ mate śraddhāvaśādyugapadvṛttidvayaṃ nābhyupaiṣi, tarhīṃha īdātorapi igacchabdayorlakṣaṇaivāstu| svavācyahasvavācya tvāviśeṣāt| svavācyatāpi paramastītyanyadetat|

vāhikā nāma te deśā na tatra divasaṃ vaset || iti|
etena dharmabahirbhūtatvādvāhīkā ityukaṃ bhavati| śatadrūrvipāśā irāvatī vitastā candrabhāgeti pañca nadyaḥ, sindhunadastu ṣaṣṭhaḥ, tanmadhyadeśo vāhīka iti tadvayākhyātāraḥ| vyutpattyantaraṃ tu tatraiva darśitam|
vahikaśya vahīkaśca vipāśāyāṃ piśācakau|
tayorapatyaṃ vāhīkā naiṣā sṛṣṭiḥ prajāpateḥ || iti|
etacca vivecanaṃ ``vāhīkagramebhyaśca (pāosūo4-3-117) ityādāvupayokṣyata iti sarvaṃ sustham ||
iti śrīvidbanmukuṭaratnasya lakṣmīdharasūreḥ sūnunā bhaṭṭojibhaṭṭena kṛte
śabdakaustubhe prathamādhyāyasya prathame pāde navamamānhikam ||
pādaścāyaṃ prathamaḥ samāptaḥ ||

iko jhal (aṣṭāosūo1-2-9)| ikaḥ paro jhalādiḥ san kitsyāt| cicīṣati, tuṣṭūṣati, cikīrṣati| nanu vistukṛñbhyaḥ sani kṛte guṇaṃ bādhitvā "ajjhana"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-16)itidīrgho'stu kiṃ kittvena?na ca `pipaviṣati'ityādāvapi tathā syāditi vācyam "anunāsikasya kvi" (aṣṭāosūo6-4-15) iti sūtrājjhalanuvṛttyā ḍhalādau sani dīrghavidhānāt| nacehaguṇamiva `jñīpsati' ityatra ṇilopamapyaviśeṣād dīrgho bādheta| kittve tu sati `cicīṣati' ityādau kṛtārtho dīrgho `jñīpsati' ityatra paratvāt ṇilopena bādhyata iti vācyam, yenanāprāptinyāyena dīrghasya guṇāpavādatvāt| na ca purastādapavādanyāyena ṇilopa eva bādhya iti bhramitavyam, ubhayāpavādatāsaṃbhāvanāyāmeva tadavatārāt| iha tu ṇilopena saha yenanāprāptivirahāt| na ca bīdhyasāmānyacintāyāṃ ṇilopabādho durvāra iti vācyam, "sthāśapāṃ jñīpsyamānaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-34)iti nirdeśāt‌lakṣyānurodācceha bādhyaviśeṣacintāyā eva yuktatvāt| na ca kuṭādau "gu purīṣotsarge"(tuopāo14000), `dhrugatisthairyayoḥ"(tuopao1401)iti pāṭhāt `jugūṣati'`dūdhūṣiti'ityatra kṛtārtho dīrghaḥ pareṇa guṇena bādhyaṃteti vācyam, uhaneti vaktavye "ajjhana" iti pratyāhāragrahaṇasya niravakāśatvāt| naca `gameriṅādeśasya'(kāovāo)iti vārtikaṃ pratyākhyātuṃ tantrādinā sambhavavyabhicārābhyāṃ gameracā viśeṣayiṣyamāṇatvādajgrahaṇasārthakyaṃ śaṅkyam| evaṃ hi `uto dīrghaḥ ityuttvā `iṅhanoḥ' iti sūtrayet| iṇiko deśasyāpi grahaṇamiti pakṣe'pi `ihanoḥ' iti brūyāt| hanā sāhavaryācca `i'dhātureva grahīpyate na tvivarṇāntaḥ| yathānyāsapāṭhepi hanisāhacaryāllugvikaraṇasyādeśagamergrahaṇasambhavācca| tasmāddīrghavidhinā guṇavādhātkiṃ kittveneti? ucyate, uttarārthamavaśyam "iko il"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-9)iti kartavyam| yogavibhāgaḥ kimartha iti paramavaśiṣyate| tatrājprahaṇasāmarthyasya "jñīpsyamānaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-34)ityāderjñāpakasya ca paryālocanākleśaparihārārthaṃ lakṣaṇaikacakṣuṣo bādhyasāmānyacintābhramaṃ vārayituṃ yogavibhāga iti niṣkarṣaḥ| vārttikaṃ tu yathāśrutābhiprāyakam| tadyathā-
ika kittvaṃ guṇo mā bhūhīrghārambhātkṛte bhavet|
anarthakaṃ tu hrasvavārthaṃ dīrghāṇāṃ tu prasajyate||
sāmarthyāddhi punarbhāvyamṛdittvaṃ dīrghasaṃśrayam|
dīrghāṇāṃ nakṛte dīrghe ṇilopastu prayojanam||
asyārthaḥ-ika uttarasya sanaḥ kittvaṃ vidhīyate guṇo mā bhūdityevamartham| dūṣayati-dīrghārambhāditi| guṇo na bhaviṣyatīti śeṣaḥ| ārambhavādyāha-kṛte bhavediti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-"sanimīmā"(aṣṭāosūo7-4-54)ityatra mīgrahaṇena minotimapi grāhayitvā dīrghaḥ kṛtārtha iti `cicīṣati' ityādau kṛtepi dīrghe guṇaḥ syāt| dūṣayati-anarthakaṃ tviti "mīnātiminoti"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-50)ityātve kṛte gāmādagrahaṇeṣviśeṣānmāgrahaṇenaiva minotimīnātyorapi siddhe mīgrahaṇaṃ tatra māstu| tathā ca dīrghavidhānaṃ na kṛtārthamiti bhāvaḥ| hrasvārthamiti| hrasveṣu dīrghaḥ pravarttatām, na tu dīrgheṣu; aprāpte śāstramarthavaditi nyāyāt| tataśca `babhūṣati' ityādauguṇaḥ prasajyata evetyarthaḥ| dūṣayāte-sāmarthyāditi| guṇanivṛttirūpaprayojanasadbhāvāddīrghāṇāṃ dīrghairbhāvyameva| "morāji"(aṣṭāosūo8-3-25)itivaditi bhāvaḥ| na caivaṃ dīrgheṇa guṇasyeva ṛditvasyāpi bādhaḥ syāttathā ca cikīrṣati' iti na sidhyedana āha-ṛdittvamiti| "yaṃ vidhiṃ prati" iti nyāyād guṇa eva bādhyedata āha-ṛdittvamiti| nanu `titīryati' ityādau tarhi itvaṃ bādhyatām, tatrāha-dīrghāṇāmiti| itvotvayorhi guṇa vṛddhī paratvād bādhike| tataśca "ajjhana"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-16)iti dīrgheṇa guṇabādhe satyevetyaṃ labhyaṃ na tu tataḥ prāk| evaṃ ca yasya tu vidherityaṃśo hrasva iva dīrgheṣvaviśiṣṭa iti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ prāpte siddhāntamāha-ṇilopastviti|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-10)

(aṣṭāosūo1-2-15)

(aṣṭāosūo1-2-17)
sthāghvoricca(aṣṭāosūo1-2-17)| anayauridādeśaḥ syātsicca kitsyāt| upāsthita, upāsthiṣātām, upāsthiṣata| "upānmantrakaraṇe"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-25)"akarmakācca"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-26)iti taṅ| ghoḥ-adita, adhitaḥ ghusthoritīha vaktuṃ yuktam| yadyapi jayādityena "vā gamaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo13)ityārabhya pañcasūtryāmā tmanepadeṣvityanuvarttitaṃ tathāpi niṣphalatvādurekṣyam| tathāhi-gameḥ parasmaipade sijnāsti, aṅā bādhāt| liṅ tu na jhalādiḥ| na cātmanepadamevānuvartya jhalgrahaṇaṃ tyājyamiti vāñyam, uttasūtrasya `aghānipātām' iti ciṇvadiṭi ativyāptyāpatteḥ| hantestu parasmaipade vadhādeśo nityaḥ| yamestu "yamarama"(aṣṭāosūo7-2-73-) itī ṭsakoḥ satorjhalādiḥ sic parasmaipade nāsti| upayame tu nityamātmanepadam| sthāghvoḥ parasmaipade sico luk| evaṃ sthite "hanaḥ sic"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-14)iti sūtre yaduktaṃ vṛttikṛtā ātmanepadagrahaṇamuttarārthamanuvarttataṃ iti| tadapyāpātaramaṇīyameva| tasmādyathāvyākhyānameva sādhu| syādetat-bhāvyamānasya savarṇāgrāhakatvāditi taparakaṇaṃ vyarthama satyam| iścetyuktepi lāghave viśeṣābhāvādiccetyuktamiti tattvam bhāvyamāno'pi kvacitsavarṇān gṛh‌ṇātīti kṛśakāśāvalamvena vārttikam|
icca kasya takāretvaṃ dīrghau bhūdṛte'pi saḥ|
anantare pluto bhūt plutaśca vipaye smṛtaḥ|| iti ||
asyārthaḥ-icceti nakāretvaṃ kasya cit siddhaye iti praśnaḥ| hetorapi samānyataḥ sambandhitvenaiva vivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhī, anyathā "hetā"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-23)iti tṛtīyo syāt| atra takārasyetvoktirāpātata ityuktam "eoṅ"(māosūo3)sūtre| yadvā takārametīti takāret| tapara iti vyākhyeyam| tathā ca bhāṣyam-"kasya hetīrikārastaparaḥ kriyate" iti| `amūbhyām' ityādāviva bhāvyamānopyāntaratamyāddīrgho mā bhūdityuttaram| kṛte'pīti| iccetyaṃśādṛtepi "sthāghvoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-17)iti kittve sati "ghumāsthā"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-66)itītvena siddhe vidhānasāmarthyādanantaramo'pi hrasvaḥ siddhastatkiṃ tapareṇoti punaḥ praśnaḥ| anantare iti| asadṛśe ādeśe kriyamāṇe hrasva iva plutopi syātsa mā bhūdityarthaḥ| plutaśceti| viṣayaviśeṣe vākyasya ṭerityadhikṛtya hi pluto vakṣyate| ata eva "kurūnagamanna" ityādau smṛtaḥ, na tu "asthitam" ityādau, aṭitvāt| tathā ceṣṭāpattirna kāryeti tatparatvaṃ samarthitam| prāñcastu anantare'vidyamānepi viśeṣe "ghumāsthā"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-66)itītvena siddhepīti yāvat| pluto mā bhūdityetadarthaṃ dīrghaḥ syāt "morāji"(aṣṭāosūo8-3-25)itivat| astevavamiti cet, na, praśnākhyānādirūpe viṣaye plutasyeṣyamāṇatvāt| tadevaṃ sthalāntare bhinnakālanivṛttyarthamapi taparatvamiha dīrghanivṛttidvārā plutasiddhyarthaṃ paryavasyatīti vyācakhyuḥ| apare tu yadyanena pluto vidhīyate tarhi yatrāṣṭhamikasya viṣayastatrāpyanenaiva syāt tasyāsiddhatvāt| tataśca pakṣe'nuvādadoṣaḥ syāt| atau hrasva eva bhaviṣyatīti taparakaraṇapratyākhyānaparaścaturthavaraṇa iti vyācakhyuḥ| etacca matadvayamatyayuktam| anantyasyāpītyādīnāṃ ṭisaṃjñā virahādihāprabṛtteḥ| kaiyaṭo'pi matadvayakhaṇḍanaparatayaiva neyaḥ| nyāsaharadattādayastu āṣṭamikagranthairvattyādibhiśca virodhādupekṣyaḥ| bhāṣyaṃ tvasmaduktavyākhyānuguṇameva| yadā viṣayastadaiva plutena bhavitavyamiti yojanayā neha plutasya viṣayo'stīti dhvanitatvāditi dik||
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-18)
na ktvā seṭ(aṣṭāosūo1-2-18)seṭ ktvā kinna syāt| devitvā| seṭ kim? kṛtvā| ktvā kim? nigṛhītiḥ| atra vārtikam-

asyārthaḥ-pūrvārddhameko ganthaḥ| tatrottarārdhānnetyapakṛpyate| ktvāgrahaṇaṃ tyaktvā naseḍityetāvatāpi yogenākittve kṛte `gudhitaḥ' ityādau niṣṭhāyāṃ nākitvam| kutaḥ?| avadhāraṇāt| "niṣṭhāśīṃṅ"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-19)ityanena, śīṅādibhya eva niṣṭhā na kiditi niyamādityarthaḥ| viparītaniyamastu lakṣyānurodhānna vyākhyāsyate| na caivaṃ liṭi pratiṣedhāt `jāgmiva' ityādāvupadhālopo na syādata āha-jñāpakāditi| kiṃ tat? tatrāha-sanīti| `śiśayiṣate' ityatra kitvaṃ vārayituṃ kriyamāṇam "iko jhal"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-9)iti jhalgrahaṇaṃ jñāpayati--"ātideśikasya rkitvasya nāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ" iti| nanūttarārthaṃ jhalgrahaṇaṃ syāt netyāha-itvamiti| `upasthāyiṣatāṃ hariharau bhaktena' ityatra asthā sa ātām iti sthite itvamprāptañciṇvadbhāvaśca| paratvācciṇvadbhāve kṛte yuk ca prāpta idvidhiśca| apavādatvādyuki kṛte yakārasyetprasaṅgaḥ| taṃ vārayituṃ jhalgrahaṇamiti jñāpakabhaṅgavādino matm, tanna, na seḍiti sicopi kittve niṣiddhe tatsanniyogaśiṣṭatayā ittvasyāpravṛtteḥ| atra dṛṣṭāntamāha-reṇeti| śobhanā dhīvānosyāṃ `sudhīva' ityatra "ano bahuvrīheḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-12)iti ṅīpo niṣedhe "vanoraca"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-7)iti rephopi na bhavati tathetyarthaḥ| bhāṣye tvabhyupetyāpi dūṣayatikidatideśāditi| auṣadeśikasya niṣedhepyātideśikena siddham| tadaniṣedhasya jñāpitattvāditi bhāvaḥ| syādetat-saṃyogānteṣvātideśikakittvābhāvādaupadeśikameva śaraṇam| añjeḥ `ājivān'iti yathā| atrāhuḥ-ānupūrvyātsiddham| nalope kṛte dvirvacane ekādeśe ca "vasvekāj"(aṣṭāosūo7-2-67)itīṭ| kṛtadvirvacanānāmekācāmiti siddhāntāt| na cedānīṃ kittvapratiṣedhaḥ, upajīvyavirodhāt| kittve hi pratiṣiddhe nalopanivṛttau dvihal‌tvānnuṭi ekāc‌tvābhāvādiḍeva nāvatiṣṭheta| kiñca kvasośchāndasatvātsārvadhātukatve "sārvadhātukamapit"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-4)iti ṅitvātsiddham| evaṃ sthite siddhāntamāha-gṛhītiriti| kinnivṛttyarthaṃ ktvāgrahaṇamityarthaḥ| titutreṣvagrahādīnāmitīṭ| kittvāsaṃprasāraṇam| evaṃ "kruñca kauṭilyālpībhāvayo-"(bhvāopao186)nikucitiḥ, kittvannalopaḥ| upasnihitiḥ, kittvānna guṇaḥ| idānīṃ ktvāgrahaṇaṃ pratyācaṣṭe-ktvāceti| vigrahāditi| yogavibhāgādityarthaḥ| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-na seṇniṣṭhāśīṅityāditrisatrīṃ paṭhitvā "pūḍaḥ ktvāca"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-22)ityatra yogo vibhajyate| pūḍaḥ parā seṇniṣṭhā kinna syāt| tataḥ tkvā ca seṭ kinnetyanuvartate pūṅa iti nivṛttam| evaṃ caikaṃ ktvāgrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyātam| yogavibhāgastu pūrvamekasūtreṇa saha nirmātavyaḥ|

uccaistarāṃ vā vaṣaṭkāraḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-2-35)| yajñakarmaṇi vaṣaṭkāra uccaistarāṃ vā syādekaśrutirvā| vaṣaṭśabdenātra vauṣaṭśabdo lakṣyate| tulyārthatvāt| dvāvapi hi devatāsampradānasya dānasya dyotakau| vauṣaḍityeva tu noktam| pratipattilāghave'pi mātrāgauravāt| kāragrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ samudāyādapi kārapratyayo bhavatīti tena evakāra ityādi siddham| uccaiḥśabdo'dhikaraṇapradhāno'pi tadviśiṣṭabhavanakriyāyāṃ varttate| tena kriyāprakarṣādāmupratyayaḥ| udāttataro bhavatīti phalitorthaḥ| brūhipreṣyaśrauṣaḍ‌vauṣaḍāvahānāmādeḥ"(aṣṭāosūo8-2-91)iti sūtreṇa vauṣaṭ‌śabdasyādeḥ pluta udātto vihitastadapekṣayā ayamudāttatarontyasya vidhīyate| dvayorapyayamudāttatara ityeke| tadā yājyāntāpekṣaḥ prakarṣaḥ| anye tu svārthikastarabityāhuḥ| tatrodāttamātraṃ prathamasya siddhiṃ dvitīyasyānena vidhīyate| atra prakarṣāvivakṣāpakṣa eva prabalaḥ| vaṣaṭ‌kārontyaḥ| "sarvatroccaistarāmbalīyān yājyāyāḥ" iti sūtritattvāt| somasyāgne vihī vauṣaṭ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-36)
vibhāṣā chandasi(aṣṭāosūo1-2-36)| chandasi ekaśrutirvā syāt| pakṣe traisvaryam| sampradāyāvyavasthito vikalpastena bahṛcānāṃ svādhyāyakāle saṃhitāyāntraisvaryameva| brāhṇe tvekaśrutiḥ| śākhāntareṣvapi yathāsampradāyaṃ vyavasthā| atra tantrāvṛttyādinā achandasīti nañ‌praśleṣādbhāṣāyāmapi aicchiko vikalpo bodhyaḥ| tathā ca "dāṇḍināyana"(aṣṭāo sūo6-4-174)ādisūtre bhāṣyam-"ekaśrutirhi svarasarvanāmetyādi"| ata evābhiyuktānāṃ ca viruddhasvarakatatpuruṣabahuvrīhyādyāśrayaṇena śliṣṭakāvyādinirmāṇaṃ saṅgacchate| "alaṃ busānāṃ yāta" iti "śveto dhāvati" iti ca dvyarthavākyam iti paspaśānte bhāṣyamapi| kāvyaprakāśe'pi veda iva loke svaro na viśeṣādhyavasāyaheturiti| kiṃmarthaṃ tarhi "jhalyupottamam"(aṣṭāosūo 6-1-180)"vibhāṣā bhāṣāyām"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-181)iti sūtramiti cet, traisvaryeṇa prakrame pākṣikānudāttalābhāyeti gṛhāṇa| veti prakṛte vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ kurvan sūtrakāro'pi tantrādikamabhipraiti| yattu vṛttikṛnmataṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ"yajñakarmaṇi"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-34)ityasya nivṛttyarthamiti, taccintyam| "chandasi" ityukte'pi tannivṛttisiddheḥ| anyathā pūrvasūtrasya nirviṣayatvāpatteḥ| na ca japādiṣu sāvakāśasya parasya pūrvo'pavāda iti vācyam| evaṃ hi sati paratraiva japādigrahaṇaṃ kuryāt kiṃ nañā kiñca chandograhaṇena| etena ūhitānāmacchandastvāttatra sāvakāśasya mantreṣu pareṇa bādhaḥ syāditi haradattoktaṃ pratyuktam| siddhānte'pi anūhiteṣu paratvādasya prāptimāśaṅkya yajñakarmaṇīti karmagrahaṇasāmarthyātpūrvasyaiva pravṛttiriti svoktivirodhāt| yadapi haradattenoktam, japādiparyudāsena mantrāṇāmeva grahaṇamiti pakṣe vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ syāditi| tadapi indraśatruprastāve dūṣitamasmābhiḥ| yadapīha vṛttikṛtā `agnimīle' ityādyapyekaśrutāvudāhṛtaṃ tatsakalādhyāpakasampradāyaviruddham| chandograhaṇavaiyarthyāpādakañca| chandasi vyavasthito'nyatraicchika iti vikalpayorvaiṣamyaṃ sūcayituṃ hi tat| na ca loke vikalpasya vṛttikṛtānuktatvādasāmpradāyikatvaṃ vācyam| bhāṣyādisammateruktatvāt "śvetaḥ" ityādervṛttikṛtāpi tatra tatrodāhṛtatvācca| ita ityasya hi "uḍidam"(aṣṭāo sūo6-1-171)ityantodāttatā `śvetaḥ' iti tu ekodāttamiti kathaṃ svarānusaraṇe tantraṃ syāditi dik|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-37)
na subrahmaṇyāyāṃ svaritasya tūdāttaḥ(aṣṭāosū01-2-37)| subrahmaṇyākhye nigade "yajñakarmaṇi"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-34)iti "vibhāṣā chandasi"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-36)iti ca prāptā etaśrutirna syātsvaritasyo dāttaśca syāt| nitarāṅgadyata iti nigadaḥ| parapratyāyanārthamuccaiḥ paṭhyamānaḥ pādabandharahito yajurmantnaviśeṣaḥ| apādabandhe hi gadirvarttate yathā gadyamiti "naugadanada"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-64)iti karmaṇyap| subrahmaṇyāśabdo parityaktasvaliṅga eva tadvati nigade nirūḍhaḥ| subrahmaṇyom 3indrāgaccha hariva āgaccha medhātithemerṣa vṛṣaṇaśvasya mene gaurāvaskandinnahalyāyai jāra kauśika brāhmaṇa gautamabruvāṇa śvaḥ sutyāmāgaccha maghavan subrahyaṇi sādhuriti yat| tittvāt svaritaḥ tasya ṭāpā sahaikādeśaḥ svaritānudāttayorāntaryātsvaritaḥ| tato nipātena oṃśabdena "omāṅośca"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-95)ityudāttamvaritayorekādeśaḥ svariti eva| "ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo8-2-5)ityudāttavidhistu neha pravarttate anudāttasyetyanuvṛtteḥ| tataḥ "svaritasya tūdāttaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-37)iti prakṛtasūtreṇaivodāttaḥ iti vṛttikārakaiyaṭaharadattādayaḥ| vastutastu nedaṃ yuktam| "ekādeśa udāttena"(aṣṭāosūo8-2-5)ityatrānudāttānuvṛttau pramāṇābhāvāt| `kvāvarammarutaḥ" ityatrodāttapāṭhācca| ata eva prātiśākhye "udāttavatyekībhāve udāttaṃ sandhyamakṣaramanudāttodaye punaḥ svaritaṃ svaritopadhe" ityuktam| iha hi pūrvārddhe anudāttagrahaṇamakurvata uttaratra ca kurvataḥ punaḥśabdena pūrvānvayabhramaṃ vārayataḥ spaṣṭa evokta āśayaḥ| yattu "tasyādita"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-32)iti sūtre "svaritodāttārthañca"(kāovāo)iti vārttike "yaḥ siddhaḥ svaritaḥ subrahmaṇyom"iti bhāṣyam, tatprauḍhivādamātraṃ niṣkarṣe tu "devabrahmaṇoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-38)itivat "svaritasya tūdātta"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-37)ityapi navasūtryutkarṣajñāpakamevetyavadheyam| `indra' ityāmantritamādyudāttam| āṣṭamiko nighātastu bhinnavākyatvānna bhavati| dvitīyo varṇo'nudāttaḥ| "udāttādanudāttasya svaritaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo8-4-66)tasyānenodāttaḥ| na cāsmin karttavye svaritasyāsiddhatvam, "etatkāṇḍamutkṛṣyate" ityuktvāt| ata evāsminnudātte kṛte śeṣaneghātopi na| yathod‌deśapakṣepyanudāttaparibhāṣāyāṃ kartavyāyāmasiddhatvena varjyamānābhāvāt| tena dvāvapyudāttau| āṅudāttaḥ tataḥ parasya "udāttādanudāttasya svaritaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo8-4-66)iti svaritasyānenodāttaḥ| chakārākāro'nudāttaḥ| na ca tasya "udāttādanudāttasya"(aṣṭāosūo8-4-66)iti svaritaḥ śaṅkyaḥ| prakaraṇotkarṣeṇāsyāsiddhatvāt| `hariva āgaccha' ityatroktaprakriyayā catvāra udāttaḥ| vakāracchakārāvanudāttau| medhātitheriti paṣṭhyantasya parāṅgavadbhāvaḥ| āmantritādyudāttaḥ| dhāśabdasya "udāttāt"(aṣṭāosūo8-4-66)iti svaritatve'nenodāttaḥ| tataścatvāro'nudāttāḥ| vṛṣeti pūrvavad‌ dvāvudāttau pañcānudāttāḥ| "ityādhīvatam"(ṛoveo)iti "adadā arbhām"(ṛoveo)iti ca ṛṅmantrāvatrānusandheyau| tena parāṅgavadbhāve ujīvyaṃ sāmarthyaṃ sphuṭībhavati| `gaurā' ityatra gauravadavaskandatīti vigrahaḥ| "saro gauro yathā piba" iti mantravarṇāt| pūrvavada dvāvudāttau tatastrayonudāttāḥ| ahetyudāttau| catvāro'nudāttāḥ| kauśītyudāttau| catvāro'nudāttāḥ| gautetyudāttau| catvāro'nudāttāḥ| śva ityudāttam| sutyāmityantodāttam| "saṃjñāyāṃ samaja"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-99)iti kyapo vidhāne udātta ityanuvṛtteḥ| āgeti dvāvudāttau catvāro'nudāttāḥ|
asāvityantaḥ(kāovāo)| tasminneva nigade prathamāntasyānta udāttaḥ syāt| gārgyo yajate| ñitsvareṇa prāpta ādyudātto'nena bādhyate|
amuṣyetyantaḥ(kāovāo)| ṣaṣṭhyantasyāpi prāgvat| dākṣeḥ pitā yajate|

(aṣṭāosūo1-2-38)
devabrahmaṇoranudāttaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-2-38)| "svaritasya tūdāttaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-37)iti pūrvasūtraśeṣasyāyamapavādaḥ| devabrahmaṇoḥ svaritasyānudāttaḥ syāt subrahmaṇyāyām| devā brahmāṇa āgacchata| dvayorapyāmantritādyudāttatve śeṣanighāte ca "udāttādanudāttasya svaritaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo8-4-66)tasyānenānudāttaḥ| dvitīyasya āṣṭamiko nighātastu na bhavati "āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat"(aṣṭāosūo8-1-72)iti padātparatvābhāvāt| tataḥ prācīnapadasya tu bhinnavākyasthatvāt| ye tu devā brahmāṇa iti sāmānādhikaraṇyena vyācakṣate| tanmate "vibhāṣitaṃ viśeṣavacane"(aṣṭāosūo8-1-74)bahuvacanamiti pakṣe vidyamānatayā dvitīyasya nighātaḥ| prakṛtasūtreṇa svaritanighātastu vakārasyaiva| tathā ca bhāṣyam-"devabrahmaṇoranudāttatvameke icchanti| devā brahmāṇaḥ iti dviḥ pāṭhaḥ| udāttau dvāveko veti vikalpābhibrāyeṇa| tatra dvitīyapakṣe prakṛtasūtre brahmagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam"|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-39)
svaritātsaṃhitāyāmanudāttānām(aṣṭāosūo1-2-39)| svaritātpareṣāmanudāttānāmekaśrutiḥ syātsaṃhitāyām| imaṃ me gaṅge yamune sarasvati| anudāttānāmiti jātau bahuvacanam| tenaikasya dvayośca bhavatyeva| saṃhitāgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakakam-"anyatra pañcamīnirddaśe kālo na vyavadhāyakaḥ" iti tena "tiṅṅatiṅaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo8-1-28)iti nighātaḥ padapāṭhe'pi bhaṣati| agnimīle, purohitamityādau tvavagrahe'pi bhavatyekaśrutiḥ| yathā sandhīyamānānāmityatideśāt| iti śabdātparasya tu "puruhūta iti puruhūtaḥ" ityādau na bhavati parigrahe tvanārṣāntāditi pratiśākhye viśeṣavacanāt| evamanvetavā ityādāvapi| "padyādīṃstu d‌vyudāttānām"(ṛomāo)itiniṣedhāditi dik|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-40)
udāttasvaritaparasya sannataraḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-2-40)| udāttasvaritau parau yasmāttathābhūtasyānudāttasya anudāttataraḥ syāt| agnim| kanyā| syādetat| "imaṃ me' iti mantre śutudriśabdasya pādāditvena nighātābhāvādādyuttatayā tasminpare sarasvatītīkārasya sannatara iṣyate ekaśrutireva tu prāpnoti| navasūtryā utkarṣeṇāsiddhatayā sannatarāyogāt| uktaṃ hi-"pūrvatrāsiddhe nāsti vipratiṣedho'bhāvāduttarasya" iti| satyam| "namune"(aṣṭaosūo8-2-3)ityatra neti yogavibhāgānna doṣaḥ| `devadattanyaṅ' ityatra tu "nyadhica"(aṣṭāosūo8-2-53)iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvare "udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo8-2-4)ityañcatyakārasya svaritaḥ pūrvasya sannataraṃ prati nāsiddhaḥ| prakaraṇe utkarṣāt|

prathamānirddiṣṭaṃ samāsa upasarjanam|(aṣṭāosūo1-2-43)| samāsavidhāyakaṃ śāstraṃ samāsaḥ, tādarthyāt| samasyate'neneti vyutpattyā vā| tatra prathamayā yannirddiśyate tadupasarjanaṃ syāt| dvitīyā śritādibhiḥ-kṛṣṇaśritaḥ| mahāsaṃjñākaraṇanvarthasaṃjñārtham| loke hyapradhānamupasarjanamāhuḥ| tena rājñaḥ kumāryā rājakumāryā ityatrobhayoḥ "ṣaṣṭhī"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-8)iti sūtre prathamānirddiṣṭatvāviśeṣe'pi rājaivopasarjanaṃ na tu kumārī| tena kumārīśabdasya na pūrvanipāto na vā "gostriyoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-48)iti hasvaḥ| na ca rājñaḥ kumārīti prathamāntenaiva vigraha iti bhramitavyam| mūlābhāvāt tathā ca "tatpuruṣe tulyārthatṛtīyāsaptamī"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-2)iti sūtre parame kārake parameṇa kārakeṇetyādāvatiprasaṅgamāśaṅkya lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣābalena samāhitaṃ bhāṣye| "anekamanyapadārthe"(aṣṭāosūo 2-2-24)iti sūtre'pi bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ spaṣṭametat| prathabhāntenaiva vigraha iti niyamo nāstīti pariniṣṭhitavibhaktyeva vigrahasyocitattvācca| ata eva "pūraṇaguma"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-11)iti samānādhikaraṇena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaniṣedho'pi saṅgacchate| ata eva ca "ekavibhakticāpūrvanipāte"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-44)ityasya viṣayalābhaḥ| syādetat-uktarītyā sūtrabhāṣyadisvarasānnyāyācca dvitīyādyantatayā pariniṣṭhitasya prathamāntena vigraho nāstītyevocyatām, tatkimucyate niyamo nāstīti? satyam| asti tatrāpyālambanam, tatkimucyate niyamo nāstīti? satyam| asti tatrāpyālambanam, tathāhi-rājakumāryā ityādeḥ pariniṣṭhitasyārthapradarśanapare laukike vigaaihavākye prakṛtibāgamātraṃ vyākhyeyaṃ na tu samāsottaravibhaktirapi| naha ṣaṣṭhī ṣaṣṭhyā vyākhyeyā kintvanuvādamātraṃ tat| tatra prātipadikārthamātravyācikhyāsāyāṃ prathamayā vigrahaḥ kena vāryate| ata eva-
"harītakīṃ bhuṅkṣva rājan māteva hitakāriṇīm"|
ityādiprayogāḥ saṅgacchante| māteti prathamāntena samāse bādhakābhāvāt| ata eva pacatīti pākacakastaṃ pācakamityādyapi samyageveti dik| tasmād dvitīyādyantasya pariniṣṭhitasya prathamayā pariniṣṭhitayā vā vigraho na tu tadubhayabhinnayeti niṣkarṣaḥ| syādetat-yadyanvarthasaṃjñeyaṃ `yācakavṛntārakaḥ' `gogarbhiṇī'ityādiṣu viśeṣyasya pūrvanipāto na syāditi cet| "vṛndārakanāgakuñjaraiḥ pūjmamānam" (aṣṭāosūo2-1-62) "catuṣpādo garbhiṇyā"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-71)ityādau vidhivākye prathamānirddeśasyānanyārthatvādadoṣaḥ| tasmātsati sambhave vyavasthāpakamanvarthatvamiti sthitam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-44)
ekavibhakti cāpūrvanipāte(aṣṭāosūo1-2-44)| arthādhikārādihasamāsārthamalaukikaṃ vigrahavākyaṃ samāsaḥ| tatra viśeṣyasamarpake pade prayogabhedādanekavibhaktiyukte'pi yanniyatavibhaktikaṃ tadupasarjansaṃjñaṃ syātpūrvanipātetarasminkārye| atikrānto mālāmatimālaḥ| ihātikrāntamatikrāntenetyādikrameṇa sakalavibhaktiyogepi mālāśabdasya dvitīyāniyamāt saṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ "gostriyoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-48)iti hrasvaḥ| evaṃ niṣkauśāmbirityādi| ekavibhaktāvaṣaṣṭhyantavacanam(kāovāo)neha-arddhaṃ pippalyāḥ arddhapippalī| nanvevaṃ `pañcakhaṭvī' na sidhyet| satyam| ata eva saṃjñāpūrvakatayā vyavasthitavibhāṣāśrayaṇena vārddhapippalīṃ sādhayitvā "ṣaṣṭhyanta'(kāovāo)iti vārttikaṃ nārabdhavyamiti prāmāṇikāḥ| vastutasyatu ekadeśisamāsaviṣayako'yaṃ niṣedhaḥ| na cātra pramāṇābhāvaḥ| `pañcakhaṭvī' iti dvitīyabhāṣyasya pramāṇatvāt|

||dvitīyamānhikam||
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-45)
arthavadadhāturapratyayaḥ prātipadikam(aṣṭāosūo1-2-45)| ḍitthādīnyavyutpannānyudāharaṇam| avyutpattipakṣasya cedameva jñāpakam| yattu vyutpattipakṣe'pi nipātārthamanukaraṇārthaṃ cedamiti haradattenoktam, tanna| tatrā'pi prakṛtyādikalpanasambhavāditi bodhyam| vastutastu `bahupaṭavaḥ' ityādyarthamidam| na ca taddhitagrahaṇe matvarthalakṣaṇayā nirvāhaḥ| `pacataki' ityādāvativyāpteḥ| avyutpattipakṣastu kamigrahaṇena siddhe kaṃsagrahaṇenaiva jñāpyaḥ| jñāpite ca tatrāpyanenaiva saṃjñā sidhyati| nanvetadeva jñāpakam| bahucpūrve kṛtārthatvādityavadheyam| arthavatkim? ghanaṃ vanamityādau prativarṇaṃ saṃjñā mā bhūt| syādetat-viśiṣṭarūpopādānaviṣayatayā arthavatparibhāṣāyā ihāpravṛttāvapi adhāturapratyaya iti paryudāsādeva siddham| na ca "adhīte" `yāvakaḥ' ityādau iṅkanau nirarthakāvapi dhātupratyayau sta iti vācyam| aḍādivyavasthāyai iṅa evārthavattvasvīkārāt| svārthikānāñca prakṛtyarthevattvāt| na cedaṃ kalpanāmātramiti vācyam| ḍitthādāvapi tathātvāt| uktaṃ hi-"arthavattā nopapadyate kevalenāvacanāt siddhaṃ tvanvayavyatirekābhyām"iti| kalpitābhyāmiti hi tadarthaḥ| vastutaḥ padasphoṭavākyasphoṭayorevārthavattvāt| satyam| uttarārthamarthavad‌grahaṇaṃ iha tu spaṣṭārtham| adhātuḥ kim? ahan| nalopo mā bhūt| na ca "supodhātu"(aṣṭāosūo2-4-71)iti dhātugrahaṇāt dhotaurneyaṃ saṃjñeti vācyam| 'śpenāyate' ityādau pratyayānte dhātugrahaṇasya caritārthatvāt| apratyayaḥ kim? `pacati'iti tipo mābhūt| supopyevam| na caivantadanteṣu ativyāptitādavasthyam| uttarasūtre taddhitagrahaṇasya niyamārthatvāt| taddhitāntānāmeva natvanyayāntānāmiti| na ca tatrāpi saṃjñāvidhitvena tadantagrahaṇaṃ durlabhamiti vācyam| arthavadityanuvṛttisāmarthyāttatsiddheḥ| praśaṃsāyāṃ hi matup| ekārpībhāvena laukikaprayoge prasiddhatvañca praśesārthaḥ| adhātupratyayāviti siddhe nañ‌dvayopādānaṃ spaṣṭārtham| mahāsaṃjñākaraṇaṃ prācāmanurodhāt|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-46)
kṛttaddhitasamāsādya(aṣṭāosūo1-2-46)| arthavanta ete prātipadikaṃsajñāḥ syuḥ| viśeṣamasāmarthyāttadantavidhiḥ| na hi jahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttau kṛtāntaddhitānāṃ cārtho'sti| bhūtapūrvagatilabhyastu na praśastaḥ saḥ| bhit, chit| atrādhāturiti paryudāse prāpte karttā, harttā, atra taddhitāntānāmeveti niyamena nirāse prāpte| sannihitattvācca kṛdgahaṇena prāguktameva bādhyate na tu samāsagrahaṇakṛto niyamo'pi| tena kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣānupasthānāt `mūlakenopadaṃśam'iti vākyasya na bhavati| nanu bādhyasāmānyacintāyāṃ samāsaniyamo'pi bādhyeteti cet, satyam| ādye eveha pakṣaḥ| na ca vākye'tiprasaṅgaḥ| śabdādhikāramāśrityehārthavacchabdenaikārthībhāvavivakṣaṇāt| atiśaye matup‌smaraṇāt| bakṣyamāṇarītyā "apratyaya" iti| niṣedhaḥ pratyayāntapara iti pakṣe tu madhyepavādanyāyāt sarveṣṭasiddhiḥ| apratyaya ityasya pratyākhyānapakṣepi purastādapavādanyāyādiṣṭasiddhiriti dik| taddhitaḥ-aupagavaḥ| atrā'nena pūrveṇa vā saṃjñā niyamavidhīnāṃ vidhirūpeṇa niṣedharūpeṇa vā pravṛttiriti matabhedasyoktatvāt| evaṃ samāse'pi| na cāsamarthasamāseṣu vidhyarthaṃ samāsagrahaṇamiti vācyam| arthavadgrahaṇanuvṛtteruktatvāt| asamarthānāṃ tarhi kathaṃ saṃjñeti cet, dharmigrāhakamānādeveti gṛhāṇa| "asūryalalāṭayoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo3-2-36)ityādinā hi samāsa upapade kṛdvidhīyate| upapadañca mahāsaṃjñākaraṇabalādvibhaktyantameva| na caivamapi strīpratyaye tadādiniyamābhāvāt `rājakumārī'ityādau pratyayānte vidhyarthaṃ taditi vācyam| antaraṅgasyā'pi halṅyādilopasya lug‌viṣaye pravṛttyā śrūyamāṇa eva supi samāsapravṛtteḥ| ata eva `gomatpriyaḥ' ityādau numādayo neti vakṣyate| tasmātprakṛte samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ sadvākyasya sajñāṃ nivartayatīti sthitam| niyamaśca sajātīyā'pekṣaḥ| yatra pūrvo bhāgaḥ padamuttaraśca pratyayabhinnaḥ tādṛśasya samudāyasya cetsyāttarhi samāsasyaiveti| ṣaḍ‌vidhe'pi samāse pūrvabhāgasya padatvāvyabhicārāt| tena bahuc‌pūrvasyāstyeva saṃjñeti `bahupaṭavaḥ' iti ṭakārasyodāttatā labhyate| prathamasya jaso luki "citaḥ saprakṛterbavhakajartham"(kāovāo)iti citsvare kṛte punarvibhaktyutpatteḥ| anyathā tu jasevodāttaḥ syāt| uttaraścetyādi kim? `hariṣu' ityāderanena vyāvṛttirmā bhūt| evamastu, ko doṣa iti cet? śṛṇu| tathāsati `janmavān'ityādau taddhitānte vidhyarthaṃ taddhitagrahaṇaṃ syāt `rājānau' ityādestu prātipadikatvaṃ kena vāryatām| na tāvadanena niyamena, pūrvabhāgasyāpadatvāt| nāpi taddhitagrahaṇena, tasyoktarītyā niyamārthatvāyogāt| na ca "supodhātuprātipadikayoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-4-71)iti dhātugrahaṇe pratyayāntānāṃ prātipadikasaṃjñā neti jñāpakamiti vācyam| tasya `prāsādīyati'ityādau `hariṣu'itivadaprātipadike caritārthatvāta| nāpi ṅyāb‌grahaṇaṃ jñāpakam| liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā siddhau tasyānyārthatāyā eva siddhāntayiṣyamāṇatvāt| tasmāduktameva sādhu| yadyapi prakṛtipratyayabhāvānāpannasaṃghātāviṣayako niyama ityapi tpattiriti granthaṃ yojayitumidaṃ gauravamāvṛtam| niṣkarṣe tu tathaivāstu| tathā ca taddhitagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthameva| bhedasaṃsargadvārakamarthavattvamiti kaiyaṭasyāpyayameva bhāvaḥ| bhede parasparaparihāreṇa prayoge sati yaḥ saṃsargastad‌dvārakamityarthāt na tu bhedaḥ saṃsargo vā dvayaṃ vā vākyārtha ityāśayena tadgranthaḥ| bahuc‌samāsayorvairūpyālābhāt| yadvā-"sātpadādyoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo8-3-111)itisātigrahaṇātpratyayo na prātipadikamiti siddhe pūrvasūtrasthaṃ pratyayagrahaṇaṃ sāmarthyāttadantaparam| taddhitagrahaṇantu vidhyarthameva| syādetat-pakṣatraye'pi `rājapuruṣau' ityādau `puruṣau'ityādeḥ saṃjñā durvāreti prātipadikāvayavatvāsupo luk syāditi cenmaivam| jahatsvārthāyāmānarthakyāt| ajahatsvārthāyāmapi pūrvapadavinirmuktasya viśiṣṭārthaviraheṇa tatsahitasyaiva viśiṣṭārthagamakatvāt| praśaṃsāyāṃ hi matubityuktam| evaṃ `ghaṭapaṭau' ityādāvapi militayoreva padayoḥ sahabhūtārthatā| pratyayānāṃ prakṛtyarthānvitasvārthabodhakatvācca| "ghaṭau'ityaṃśo nārthavāniti| etenāsamarthasamāse daśadāḍimādivadanarthake vidhyarthaṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ kiṃ na syāditi coktaṃ pratyuktam| arthavadgrahaṇasyehārthatāyā evoktatvāditi dik| yadi tu naiyāyikarītyā arthavattvaṃ vṛttimattvaṃ tacca samāsasya nāstītyāśritya samāsagrahaṇaṃ vidhyartham| taddhitagrahaṇamapi tathā| apratyaya iti tu pratyayavāraṇārthamityāśrīyate tathāpi na kṣatiḥ| taddhitagrahaṇasya tadviśiṣṭaparatāmāśritya `bahupaṭavaḥ' ityasya susādhatvāt| kintvasminpakṣe siddhāntavirodhaḥ `mūlakenopadaṃśaṃ' `pacataki' ityatrātiprasaṅgaśceti yathāsthitamevāstu| iha prakaraṇe yathāśrutāḥ prācāṃ granthā duṣṭā evetyavadhayem| nipātasyārthakasya prātipadikasaṃjñā vaktavyā yeṣāṃ dyotyopyartho nāsti tadarthamidam| `avadyati'| anuktasamuccayārthāccakārātsiddhamidam| anukaraṇeṣu tu anukaraṇena sahābhedavivakṣāyāmarthavattvābhāvānna prātipadikatā, "bhū sattāyām(bhvāopāo1) iti yathā| bhedavivakṣāyāṃ tu saṃjñā syādeva| "bhuvo vug"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-88)iti yathā| na cādhāturiti paryudāsā'pattiḥ| prakṛtivadanukaraṇamityātideśasyānityatayovaṅaṃśe pravṛttāvapi saṃjñāṃśe apravṛttisambhavāt| etacca "ṛlṛk"(māosūo2)sūtre upapāditam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-47)
hasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya(aṣṭāosūo1-2-47)| klībe prātipadikasyājantasya hrasvaḥ syāt| śrīpaṃ kulam| prātipadikagrahaṇasāmarthyānneha-kāṇḍe, kuḍye| iha tu "antādivacca"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-85)ityatideśenā'sti prāptiḥ| na ca dvikapakṣe `vāriṇī' iti vyāvarttya kṛtārthateti vācyam| tatrāpi prātipadikamityasyānuvṛttyā siddhe sāmarthyasya suvacatvāt| lakṣyānurodhena pakṣāntarasyaiva sugraḍatvācca| yadvākāryakālapakṣaṃ pratyayāntasya neti prasajyapratiṣedhaṃ cāśritya samādeyam| na caivaṃ `brahmabandhuḥ' ityatra svādayo na syuriti vācyam| liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā `śvaśrūḥ'ityatreva tatsiddheḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-48)
gostriyorupasarjanasya(aṣṭāosūo1-2-48)| upasarjanaṃ yo gośabdastādṛgeva ca yatstrīpratyayāntantadantasya prātipadikasya hrasvāḥ syāt| citraguḥ, niṣkauśāmbiḥ| upasarjanasya kim? sugauḥ, rājakumārī, strīśabdaḥ svaryate| tena stryadhikāroktapratyayagrahaṇānneha-atilakṣmīḥ, atiśrīḥ| kathaṃ `gokulaṃ' `rājakumārīputraḥ' iti cet, śṛṇu| upasarjanasya sasabandhikatayā yasya prātipadikasya hrasvo vidhīyate tadarthaṃ prati yadyuttarapadabhūtayorgostriyorguṇībhāvastadedaṃ hrasvatvam| na ceha tadasti| goḥ kulaṃ prati guṇabhāve'pi gāṃ pratyatathātvāt| kumāryāśca putraṃ prati guṇībhāve'pi rājānaṃ pratyatathātvāt| śāstrīyaṃ cehopasarjanaṃ gṛhyate| kṛtrimatvāt| ata eva pratyayamātrasya tathātvāsambhavāttadantalābhaḥ| yadi tu laukikamupasarjanatvaṃ gṛhītvā pratyaya eva viśeṣyeta tadā harītakyāḥ phalāni `harītakyaḥ' ityatrātivyāptiḥ syāt| spaṣṭañcedaṃ "upamānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-55)iti sūtre bhāṣye| atha kathaṃ rājakumārīmatikrāntaḥ `atirājakumārīśabdasya strīpratyayāntatvādityavehi| atikrāntamprati hyasāvupasarjanaṃ na tu rājānampratīti vivekaḥ| atratyaḥ kaiyaṭastvāpātata ityavadheyam| atra vārttikam-"īyaso bahuvrīhau puṃvadvacanam"(kāovāo)iti| īyasantādyaḥ strīpratyayastadantānto yo brahuvrīhistatra hasvo netyarthaḥ| "gaustriyoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-48)iti hrasvo vihitaḥ| tatra puṃsi yathā strīpratyayāntatā nāsti tatheha bodhyamityevaṃ vacanavyaktyā hrasvābhāvaḥ paryavasyati| javhyaḥ śreyasyo yasya sa bahuśreyasī| "īyasaśca"(aṣṭāosūo5-4-156)iti kabniṣedhaḥ| bahuvrīhau kim? atiśreyasi|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-49)
luktaddhitaluki(aṣṭāosūo1-2-49)| taddhitaluki sati upasarjanastrīpratyasya luk syāt| luk tāvatpratyayasyaiva sambhavati, na tu tadantasya| ata evopasarjanamiha laukikam na tu pūrvavacchāstrīyam, asambhavāt| nahi pratyayamātraṃ śāstrīyamupasarjanam| āmalakyāḥ phalamāmalakam| "nityaṃ vṛddhaśarādibhyaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-3-14)iti mayaṭaḥ phale luk| tato'nena gaurādiṅīṣo luk| iha pūrvasūtrasyāvakāśo `niṣkauśāmbiḥ'| asyāvakāśaḥ `āmalakam'| pañca indrāṇyo devatā asya `pañcendraḥ' ityatra tu paratvāllugeva|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-50)
idgoṇyāḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-2-51)| goṇyā ityasyāttaddhitaluki| luko'pavādaḥ| pañcabhirgoṇībhiḥ krītaḥ paṭaḥ pañcagoṇiḥ| daśagoṇiḥ| goṇīśabdaḥ parimāṇavacana āvapanavacanaśca| tatrādyāt "prāgvateṣṭhañ(aṣṭāosūo5-1-18)dvitīyādārhīyaṣṭhak| tayoradhyardheti luk|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-51)
lupi yuktavadyaktivacane(aṣṭāosūo1-2-51)| prācāmidaṃ sūtraṃ dūṣaṇārthaṃ pāṇiniranuvadati| lupi sati prakṛtivalliṅgavacane staḥ| pañcālāḥ, kṣatriyāḥ, pulliṅgabahuvacanaviṣayāḥ| teṣāṃ nivāso janapadaḥ pañcālāḥ| pañcālasyāpatyāni bahūni| "janapadaśabdāt kṣatriyādñ"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-168)"te tadrājāḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-174)"tadrājasya bahuṣu"(aṣṭāosūo2-4-62)tataḥ "tasya nivāsaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-2-69)ityaṇo "janapade lup"(aṣṭāosūo4-2-81)lupi kim? lavaṇassūpaḥ| "saṃsṛṣṭe"(aṣṭaosūo4-4-22)"lavaṇālluk"(aṣṭāosūo4-4-24) vyaktivacane kim? harītakī pañcālā ityādiṣu ṣaṣṭhyā atideśo mā bhūt| samāse uttarapadasya bahuvacanasya lupaḥ niyamārthamidam| mathurā pañcālāḥ| uttarapadasyaiveti niyamānneha| pañcālamathure| bahuvacanasya kim? godau| grāmo mathurā ca godamathurāḥ| pūrvapadasya dvitvātideśaḥ syādeva|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-52)
viśeṣaṇānāñcājāteḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-2-52)| lubarthasya viśeṣaṇānāmapi tadvalliṅgavacane sto jārti varjayitvā| pañcālā ramaṇīyāḥ| godau ramaṇīyau| ajāteḥ kim? pañcālā janapadaḥ| gaudau grāmaḥ| kathaṃ tarhipañcālā janapadau ramaṇīya iti| jātiviśeṣaṇatvāditi gṛhāṇa| pañcālaviśeṣakatve tu ramaṇīyā iti bhavatyeva| syādetat-luponyatrā'pīdaṃ tulyam, "badarīvṛśraḥ" ityatra sūkṣmakaṇṭakā sūkṣmakaṇṭaka iti prayogayorviśeṣyabhedena vyavasthāsvīkārātā| tatkiṃ sūtreṇa? satyam| guṇavacanānāmāśrayato liṅgavacanānīti sūtrārthaḥ| tathāhi-jātibhinnāni yāni viśeṣaṇāni teṣāṃ yuktavat, viśeṣyavadityarthaḥ| guṇavacanānāmityuddhoṣe'pi jātibhinnaṃ guṇaśabdārthaḥ| taduktamamareṇa-
strīdārādyairyadviśeṣyaṃ yādṛśaiḥ prastutaṃ padaiḥ|
guṇadravyākriyāśabdāstathā syustasya bhedakāḥ"(aokoo3-1-2)iti|
sāmānye napuṃsakasya nyāyaprāptasyāpavādo'yam| tena śuklaṃ paṭā iti na bhavati| anityaścāyamatideśaḥ| "saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-2-16)ityādiliṅgāt| lakṣyānurodhādvyavasthā| harītakyādiṣu vyaktiḥ| niyamārthamidam| tena vacanaṃ na yuktavat| haritakyāḥ phalāni harītakyaḥ| gaurādiṅīṣantāt "anudāttādeśca"(aṣṭāosūo4-3-140)iti lup| khalatikādiṣu vacanam| ayamapi niyama eva| khalatikasya parvatasasyādūrabhavāni vānāni khalatikaṃ vanāni| khalatiko varaṇādiḥ| manuṣyalupi pratiṣedhaḥ(kāovāo)manuṣyalakṣaṇe lubarthe viśeṣaṇānāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| lubantasya tu bhavatyeva| cañcā tṛṇamayaḥ pumān| sa iva cañcā'bhirūpaḥ| "saṃjñāyām"(aṣṭāosūo5-3-98)iti lup| carmavikāraviśeṣo vardhrikā| sa iva vardhrikā darśanīyaḥ| tadiha dve vārttike ādyasya tṛtīyantu dvitīyasyāpavāda iti sthitam| idaṃ tvavadheyam| ihābhirūpadarśanīyapadayorviśeṣyaliṅge pratiṣiddhe napuṃsakatvaṃ prāpnoti| bhāṣyakārīyodāharaṇasāmarthyānna bhavatīti|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-53)
tadaśiṣyaṃ saṃjñāpramāṇatvāt(aṣṭāosūo1-2-53)| tat-yuktavadvacanam| aśiṣyam-akartavyam| kutaḥ? saṃjñānāṃ pramāṇatvāt| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-pañcālā varaṇā ityādayo na yaugikāḥ| tannivāse'pi deśāntare aprayogāt| "deśe tannāmni"(aṣṭāosūoeo 4-2-67)ityadhikṛtyādūrabhave pratyayavidhānācca| kintu saṃjñāśabdā ete| te ca yalliṅgasakhyatayā loke prasiddhāstatra pramāṇabhūtā eva| tadarthapramāṇakā ityarthaḥ| yathā āpo dārā vanaṃ gṛhāḥ sikatā varṣā ityādau| neha śāstrenuśāsanamāracyaṃ tadarthamapi māstu| kiñca-
(aṣṭāosūo 1-2-54)
lubyogāprakhyānāt(aṣṭāosūo 1-2-54) lubapyaśiṣyaḥ| "janapade lup"(aṣṭāosūo4-2-81)"varaṇādibhyaśca"(aṣṭāosūo4-2-82)iti| kutaḥ? yogasyāvayavārthasyeha aprakhyānāt apratīteḥ| tathā cātra "tasya nivāsaḥ" (aṣṭāosūo4-2-69) "adūrabhavaśca"(aṣṭāosūo4-2-70)iti taddhito naivotpadyate kiṃ lupo vidhānenetyarthaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-55)
yogapramāṇe ca tadabhāve'darśanaṃ syāt(aṣṭāosūo1-2-55)| cakāro hyarthe| yadi hi yogasyāvayavārthasyedaṃ pramāṇaṃ bodhakaṃ syāttadā tadabhāve na dṛśyeta| dṛsyate ca samprati| vinaiva kṣatriyayogaṃ janapade pañcālaśabdaḥ| na ca bhūtapūrvagatiḥ| kṣatriyayogāddeśe deśayogādvā kṣatriye śabda ityatra vinigamakābhāvena vaiparityasyāpi suvacatvāpatteriti bhāvaḥ| ato'kṣādivannānārthā evaite iti tattvam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-56)
pradhānapratyayārthavacanamarthasyānyapramāṇatvāt(aṣṭāosūo1-2-56)| pratyayārthaḥ pradhānamityevaṃrūpaṃ vacanamapi aśiṣyaṃ kutaḥ? arthasya lokata eva siddheḥ| ākhyātasya kriyāpradhānatayā vyabhicārāccetyarthaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-57)
kālopasarjane ca tulyam(aṣṭāosūo1-2-57)| atītāyā rātreḥ paścārddhena āgāminyāḥ pūrvārddhena ca sahito divaso'dyatanaḥ| viśeṣaṇamupasarjanamityādikrameṇa kāla upasarjanaṃ ca pūrvācāryaiḥ paribhāṣitaṃ tatrāpi tulyam| aśiṣyatvaṃ samānamityarthaḥ| lokaprasiddhatvādeveti bhāvaḥ|
(aṣṭā'sūo1-2-58)
jātyākhyāyāmekasminbahuvacanamanyatarasyām(aṣṭā'sūo 1-2-58)brāhmaṇāḥ pūjyāḥ| brāhmaṇaḥ pūjyaḥ| eko'pyartho vā bahuvadimatyatideśādviśeṣaṇādapi siddham| bahūnāṃ vacanaṃ bahuvacanaṃ pratipadanamiti vyākhyānāccātideśaḥ phalitaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-59)
asmado dvayośca(aṣṭāosūo1-2-59)| ekatve dvitve ca vivakṣite'smado bahuvacanaṃ vā syāt| vayaṃ būmaḥ| pakṣe ahaṃ bravīmi| āvāṃ brūva iti vā| sabiśeṣaṇasya pratiṣedhaḥ|(kāovāo)| paṭurahaṃ bravīmi| kathaṃ tarhi "tvaṃ rājā vayamapyupāsitaguruprajñābhimānonnatāḥ"(vaiośao23) iti bhartṛhariḥ| atronnatvasya vidheyatvādbhavatyeva| anuvādyaviśeṣaṇaparatvātpratiṣedhasyeti haradattaḥ| bhāṣye tvetatsūtra pratyākhyātam| tathāhi-ahaṅkārāvacchinnedhyastānāñcakṣurādīndriyāṇāṃ tattādātmyādahamullekhagocaratā bhedābhedapratītiśca| ahaṃ śṛṇomīti vanmama śrotraṃ śṛṇotītyapi vyavahārāt tatra cakṣurādīnāṃ bahutvādbhedasvātantryayorvivakṣāyāṃ `vayaṃ brūmaḥ' iti siddham| abhedamātravivakṣāyāṃ tu ekavacanam| na ca gauṇatā| `gauro'ham' ityādīnāṃ yāvadvyavahāraṃ bādhābhāvāt| etena "puṣyādigurāvekeṣām" iti vṛttikāreṇa paṭhitamapi gatārtham| tvaṃ gururyūyaṃ gurava ityasyoktarītyā siddheḥ| ata eva "ācāryāḥ kathayanti" ityādilaukikaprayogo'pi saṅgacchate|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-60)
phalgunīproṣṭhapadānāñca nakṣatre(aṣṭāosūo1-2-60)| dvayorityanukarṣād| dvitvaṃ bahutvaprayuktaṃ kāryaṃ vā vidhīyate| tena viśeṣaṇe'pi siddham| pūrve phalgunyau pūrvāḥ phalgunyaḥ| pūrve proṣṭhapade pūrvāḥ proṣṭhapadāḥ| nakṣatre kim‌? phalgunyau māṇavike| phalgunyorjāte ityarthaḥ| "phalgunyaṣāḍhābhyāṃ ṭānau"(kāovāo)iti ṭaḥ| ṭittvān ṅīp| ekasyāntu tārāyāṃ nemau śabdau prayujyete| ud‌bhūtāvayavabhede samudāya eva nirūḍhatvāt| sūtre tu nakṣatre iti prathamādvivacanaṃ nakṣatre yadyabhidhīyete ityarthāt|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-61)
chandasi punarvasvorekavacanam(aṣṭāosūo1-2-61)| dvayorekavacanaṃ vā syāt| punarvasurnakṣatramaditirdevatā| punarvasu vā| loke tūd‌bhūtāvayavasamudāye| nirūḍhatvād dvivacanameva| gāṅgatāviva divaḥ punarvasu|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-62)
viśākhayośca(aṣṭāosūo1-2-62)| prāgvat| viśākhā nakṣatramindrāgnī devatā| pakṣe viśākhe| chandasītyanuvṛtterloke| `viśākhe' ityeva| amarastu-"rādhāviśākhā"(aoko1-3-22)iti prayuñjāno dvivacananiyamaṃ necchati| sutre tṛdāsīnam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-63)
tiṣyapunarvasvornakṣatradvandve bahuvacanasya dvivacanaṃ nityam(aṣṭāosūo1-2-63)| chandasīti na sambhadhyate pūrvatra cakāreṇānukṛṣṭatvāt| etadartha eva hi pūrvatra yogavibhāgaḥ| tiṣya ekaḥ| punarvasū dvau| teṣāṃ dvandvo bavharthaḥ| tatra bahutvaṃ dvitvavadbhavatītyatideśo'yam| tiṣyapunarvasū uditau| tiṣyapunarvasū iti kim? viśākhānurādhāḥ| nakṣatreti kim? tiṣyapunarvasavo māṇavakāḥ| tiṣyapunarvasuśabdābhyāṃ "nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-2-3)ityaṇ "lubaviśeṣe"(aṣṭāosūo4-2-4)tato jātārthe "sandhivelādi"(aṣṭāosūo4-3-16) sūtreṇāṇ| tasya "śraviṣṭhāphalgunyanurādhā"(aṣṭāosūo4-2-34)ityādinā luk māṇavakavṛttirayaṃ dvandvo na tu nakṣatravṛttiḥ| na cāyaṃ gauṇaḥ| yaugikatvāt| nanu nakṣatre ityanuvṛttyā siddhametat| kiṃ punarnakṣatragrahaṇena| atra bhāṣyam-"paryāyāṇāmapi yathā syāt" iti| tasyā'yaṃ bhāvaḥ-tiṣyapunarvasvoḥ śabdayorabhidheye nakṣatre varttamāno yo nakṣatraśabdānāṃ dvandva iti vyākhyānāt| puṣyapunarvasū sidhyapunarvasū ityapi sidhyatīti| syādetat-yathā "bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo3-4-69)ityakarmakaśrutyāntaraṅgaṃ dravyakarma niṣidhyate na tu bahiraṅgaṃ kālādi karma tathāntaraṅgasya kālasya vyāvṛttyā bahavastiṣyapunarvasavo'tikrāntā ityādeḥ siddhāvapi māṇavakasya bahiraṅgasya vyāvṛttaye punarnakṣatragrahaṇamastu| yadvā-tiṣyapunarvasvoriti yogaṃ vibhajya deśāntarasthamapi tiṣyasva kāryaṃ nakṣatra eveti vyākhyāsyate| tena "tiṣyapuṣyayornakṣatrāṇi yalopaḥ"(kāvāo)iti siddham| tasmādvahiraṅgavyāvṛttyā yogavibhāgena vā kṛtārthaṃ nakṣatragrahaṇaṃ kathaṃ paryāyagrahaṇārthaṃ syāt| ucyate-akarmakaśabdaḥ śrutyaiva karma vyāvarttayan mukhyamantaraṅgameva vyāvarttayatīti yuktam| nakṣatraśabdastu svārthārpaṇapranāḍyā arthāntaraṃ vyāvarttayannaviśeṣādubhau vyāvarttayatīti nādyaṃ phalam| nāpi dvitīyam| puṣyārthavacanasyāvaśyakattvāt| ata eva pakṣadvaye'pyaparitoṣādbhāṣye pakṣāntaramuktam| dvandva iti kim? yastiṣyastau punarvasū yeṣānte tiṣyapunarvasavaḥ| tiṣyādaya eva viparyaviṣayā iha bahuvrīhiṇocyante| ato bhavatyayaṃ nakṣatrasamāsaḥ na tu dvandvaḥ| bahuvacanasya kim? idaṃ tiṣyapunarvasu| sarvo dvandvo vibhāṣayaikavat| nyāyasiddhaṃ cedam| prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāra eveti hi niyamaḥ| na tu viparītaḥ| "cārthe dvandvaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-29)iti pṛthagvidhānāt| prakṛtasūtre bahuvacanagrahaṇācceti dik|
|| iti śīśabdakaustubhe prathamasyādhyāyasya dvitīye pāde dvitīyamānhikam ||
dvitīye pāde tṛtīyamānhikam
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-64)
sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣa ekavibhaktau(aṣṭāosūo1-2-64)| samānāyāṃ vibhaktau yāni sarūpāṇyeva dṛṣṭāni teṣāṃ eka eva śiṣyate| anaimittikattvenāntaraṅgo'yamekaśeṣaḥ subuttpatteḥ prāgeva ṅyantābantaprātipadikānāṃ pravarttate| hariṇī mṛgī haritavarṇā ca, tayoḥ saha vivakṣāyāṃ hariṇyau hariṇyaḥ| kṣitikṣānttyoḥ kṣamā| "vāsona samyak kṣamayośca tasmin" iti śrīharṣaḥ, "śriyau narendrasya nirīkṣya tasya" iti ca| "sakṛcchrutātsakṛdarthaḥ pratyayaḥ" iti mate śabdasārūpye'pi dvandvaḥ syāt| athā'pi tantreṇānekārthatābhyupagamyate evamapi sarvatra tantreṇaiva bodhanīyamiti niyamābhāvāt pākṣiko dvandvo durvāraḥ| ārabdhe ttvekaśeṣe subantadvayavirahāt dvandvasyāprāptireva phalitā bhavati| ata eva ekaśeṣasya dvandvāpavādakatetyuddhoṣaḥ| "iko guṇavṛddhī"(aṣṭāosūo1-1-3) ityasya "alontya"(aṣṭāo sūo1-1-52) apavādakateti paśre'pavādaśabdasyetthameva vyākhyātattvāt| ata eva `ghaṭau' `ghaṭāḥ' ityādinyapīhodāharaṇāni| tatrāpi aicchikasyānekavyaktibodhoddeśyakasyānekaviśakalitaśabdaprayogasya ghaṭo'yaṃ ghaṭo'yamiti bahuśo darśanena tadvadeva sahavivakṣāyāṃ `ghaṭau' ityādidvandvasya durvārattvāt| etena "vyartheṣu ca muktasaṃśayam"(kāovāo)iti vārttikaṃ dṛṣṭvā nānārthā evehodāharaṇamiti bhrāmyantaḥ parāstāḥ| na ca padārthatāvacchedakabhedābhāvād `ghaṭau' ityādau dvandvaprasākterneti vācyam| "cārthe dvandvaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-29)iti sūtreṇa sāhityamātre tadvidhānāt| tasya cetaretarayogadvandve ekaśeṣe ca viśeṣaṇatvaṃ prayogopādhitvaṃ vā| samāhāradvandve tu prādhānyena bhānamityanyadetat| na caivamapi `ghaṭakalaśau' ityādidvandvāpattiḥ| "virūpāṇāmapi samānārthānām"(kāovāo)iti vārttikena ekaśeṣāt| vastutastu sautra evāyamarthaḥ| rūpyate bodhyate iti rūpam, arthaḥ samānaṃ rūpaṃ yeṣāmiti sarūpāḥ| "jyotirjanapada"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-85)iti samānasya sabhāvaḥ| sarūpāśca sarūpāśca teṣāmiti ekaśeṣaṇa vyākhyānāt| na ca svāṅge svavyāpārāyogaḥ vākyāparisamāptinyāyāditi vācyam| uddeśyatāvacchedakarūpākrāntatayā "tulyāsyaprayatnam"(aṣṭāosūo1-1-9)itivatsvasminnapi pravṛtteḥ| etadviṣayavivecanaṃ tu "aiuṇ"(māosūo1)ityatraiva kṛtam| ata eva jananīvācino mātṛśabdasya dhānyamāpavācinastṛjantasya ca ekaśeṣaṃ niṣed‌dhuṃ pravṛtte "mātṛmātroḥ pratiṣedhaḥ sarūpatvāt"(kāovāo)iti vārttike svāntargate mātṛmātrorityatrāpi niṣedhapravṛttiḥ| nanvarthaviśeṣopahitayoreva tatrā'nuvādaḥ| anyathā jananīvācinorapi niṣedhāpatteḥ| tatkathaṃ śabdarūpapare svāntargate niṣedhapravṛttiriti cet, "prakṛtivadanukaraṇam" ityatideśāditi gṛhāṇa| sūtramatetūttarasūtrādevakāro'trā'nukṛṣyate| tena ekavibhaktau yāni sarūpāṇyeveti vyākhyānātparicchetṛvācinaśca "aptṛn"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-11)iti sarvanāmasthāne dīrghavidhānādasārūpyādekaśeṣābhāvaḥ| na ca vācinikaikaśeṣavirahe'pi śliṣṭarūpakasthala iva tantranyāyāśrayeṇa pākṣika ekaśeṣo mātṛmātroḥ syādeveti vācyam| yānyekavibhaktau sarūpāṇyeva teṣāmevaikaśeṣa iti niyamāt| na caivaṃ 'ghaṭaghaṭau' iti pākṣikaṃ durvāramiti vācyam| tantrāvṛttyādyāśrayaṇena sarūpāmāmekaseṣa evetyaparaniyamāśrayaṇāt| tasmāt 'ghaṭakumbhau' `kumbhakumbhau' `mātṛbhyāṃ' ceti pākṣikamaniṣṭatritayaṃ prāptaṃ sūtreṇā'nena vāryate| `ghaṭau' ityādisiddhistu syādevaitadvināpi hi| jātipakṣe vyaktipakṣe'pīti niṣkarṣasaṃgrahaḥ| syādetat-devadeva ityādāvapi tarhyekaśeṣaḥ prāpnoti| na ca `ekavibhaktau' ityanena tadvāraṇam| tasya sārūpyopalakṣaṇatvādekaśeṣasya cānaimittikattvāt| atha vakṣyamāṇarītyā ekaśeṣaviśeṣaṇatāṃ brūṣe, tathāpyanistāraḥ| devadeva ityatrāpi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsādupari ekavibhakteḥ satvāt| antarvartinyostu lukā luptatvena pratyayalakṣaṇābhāvāt| atrāhuḥ--sahavivakṣāyāmeva ekaśeṣaḥ| itaretarayogadvandvasya viṣaye iti yāvat| atra hyanekasyārthasya militasye tarānvayaḥ sa tathābhūto viṣayaḥ| uktañca-
"anusyūteva bhinnānāmekā prakhyopajāyate|
yadā sahavivakṣāntāmāhurdvandvaikaśeṣayoḥ" iti|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-65)
ayañca viṣayaniyamo'bhidhānabalāllabhyate "vṛddhoyūnā"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-65)ityādisūtreṣu sahayoge tṛtīyāyāḥ prayogācca| yadvā--pūrvasūtrāt `dvandve' ityanuvarttate| arthādhikārāccetaretarayogadvandvāvagamaḥ| tena dvandve prasakte satīti vyākhyānāduktaviṣayaniyamasiddhiḥ| na ca dvandve kṛte ityeva vyākhyāyatāmiti vācyam| svarasamāsāntādidoṣaprasaṅgena "kṛtadvandvānāmekaśeṣaḥ" iti pakṣasya dūṣayiṣyamāṇattvāt| etena "sāravasāravormijaḥ" iti śrīharṣaprayogo'pi vyākhyātaḥ| saravyāṃ bhavāḥ sāravāḥ| te ca te āravasahitāśceti karmadhāraye sahavivakṣāvirahāt| " vidvanmānasarājahaṃsa" ityādiśliṣṭarūpake tu mānasameva mānasamiti tantreṇa prayogo na tu sautra cet, pakṣe evameva| tāvatā'pi ubhayaprayogasya nirvāhyatvāt| na caivaṃ samāhāradvandvaviṣaye ekaśeṣānuśāsanātpākṣikaṃ `ghaṭaghaṭam' ityādi durvārameveti vācyam| tatrā'nabhidhānasyaiva śaraṇīkaraṇīyatvāt| astu vā tatrāpyekaseṣapravṛttiḥ| na caivaṃ napuṃsakatāpattiḥ| samāhāradvandva eva tadanuśāsanāt| tathā ca pratyarthaṃ śabdaniveśa iti pakṣe "na brāhmaṇaṃ hanyāt" ityādau sakalavyaktisaṅgraho bhaviṣyatīti prativyaktilakṣaṇaṃ nāvartanīyam| "ekavaccāsyānyatarasyām'(aṣṭāosūo1-2-69)iti jñāpakādekaśeṣe kṛte ekavadbhāvo neti tu tattvam| ekaśca ekaśca dvau ca dvau cetyādau tu dvandvaikaśeṣau ubhāvapi anabhidhānenaiva vāraṇīyau| utsargataḥ saṃkhyāśabde'pyevameveti bodhyam| `viṃśati' ityādau tvekaśeṣa iṣṭa eveti dik| evaṃ sthite sūtrāraṃbhapakṣe'pi bahuśo'nabhadhānasyaivāśrayaṇād `ghaṭaghaṭau' ityādāvapi tataivāstu kiṃ tannirāsārthaṃ sūtrārambheṇetyāśayena bhagavatā ekaśeṣaprakaraṇaṃ pratyākhyātam| na caivaṃ `pitarau' ityatra mātuḥ, `śvaśurau' ityādau śvaśvrādeśca pratītiḥ kathaṃ syāditi vācyam| ekaśeṣārambhe'pi taulyāt| yaḥ śiṣyate sa lupyamānārthādhāyīti cet tarhi dvivacanādyupādhiviśeṣapuraskāreṇa pitrādiśabdānāmeva mātrādau saktirnirūḍhalakṣaṇā ceti phalito'rthaḥ| tathā ca lokavyavahārādeva tadgrahasambhave na kiñcidanupapannam| na caivaṃ `agnicit' ityādau kvibādayo'pi pratyākhyāyatāmiti vācyam| pratyayalakṣaṇena tugāgamaprātipadikasaṃjñādyarthaṃ tadārambhāt| tadevaṃ sarūpāṇāṃ virūpāṇāṃ ca sarvamekaśeṣaṃ pratyācakṣāṇenāpi bhagavatā sarūpasūtramātraṃ tu śāstrīye vyavahāre saṃjñāparibhāṣādivadvināpi sahavivakṣāmekaśeṣaṃ vidhātuṃ bhaviṣyatītyāśayena "dvirvacanoci'(aṣṭāosūo1-1-59)ityatra ekaśeṣa iti bhāṣye'bhihitamiti dik| ārabhyamāṇe tu sūtre yadyapi ṣaṭ pakṣāḥ sambhavanti tathāpi tatra trayo duṣṭā eva trayastu nirdoṣā ityavadheyam| tathāhi-"pṛthak sarvebhyo vibhaktau parata ekaśeṣaḥ"| "ekavacanāntānāṃ" ca "akṛtadvandvānāṃ vā" "samudāyādekavibhaktau vā" "yugapadadhikaraṇavacane vā" "anaimittiko vā" iti ṣaṭ pakṣāḥ| tatrādye ekaśabdaḥ samānaparyāyastathā ca vṛkṣa s‌ vṛkṣa s‌ iti sthite ādyayornivṛttau s‌ s‌ vṛkṣa s‌ iti sthite saṃyogāntasya padāntasya lopa iti vyākhyāne madhyamasya sorlopaḥ| saṃyogāntaṃ yatpadaṃ tadantasyeti vyākhyāne tu halṅyādilopaḥ tatrāpi sutisīti pratyayaiḥ prakṛterākṣepa iti pakṣe tu na kasya cillopaḥ| sarvathā'pīṣṭarūpaṃ na sidhyatyeva| ādyantayornivṛttau tu s vṛkṣa s s iti syāt| parayornivṛttau tu vṛkṣa s s iti syāt| tathā vṛkṣā anityā ityādāvantasupratyayaśravaṇaṃ syāditi duṣṭa eva prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ| dvitīye tu vṛkṣa s iti savibhaktikasyāvasthānāt, dvivacanabahuvacanayoranutpattirekavacanaśravaṇañca syāt| tṛtīye tu dvandve iti anuvartya abhimatavākyārtho yadyapi labdhuṃ śakyate tathāpi aśva aśva au iti sthite vibhaktyapekṣāccheṣātpūrvamantaraṅgatvātsamāsāntodātte kṛte yadi pūrvaśeṣastarhi sarvānudāttaṃ padaṃ syāt| paraśeṣe tvantodāttaṃ syāt| iṣyate tvādyudāttam| aśeḥ kvanibvyutpādanāt| "yo aśvebhirvahate vibhavohyaśvāḥ" ityādau tathaiva prayogācca| kiñca ṛkca ṛkca ṛcāvityatrāntaraṅgatvāt "ṛkpūḥ"(aṣṭāosūo5-4-74) iti samāsānte kṛte vibhakterakāreṇa vyavadhānādekaśeṣo na syāt| samāsānto hi samāsabhaktastameva na vyavadadhyāt| svarūpaṃ tu vyavadadhātyeva| "samāsārthottarapadasyāvayavaḥ" iti bhāṣyamate'pi ekavibhaktāvityasyāvṛttyā evakārasya cānukarṣaṇena ekavibhaktau yāni sarūpāṇyeveti vyākhyānānna bhavati| yadvā-yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatāyāṃ dvivacanabahuvacanāntānāmekaśeṣaḥ| dvandvo'pyevam| ajahatasvārthāyāṃ hi vṛttau "rāmakṛṣṇau" ityādau pūrvapadamapyubhāvabhidhatte tāvevottarapadamapi| na cānyataravaiyarthyam| parasparasamabhivyāhāreṇaivobhayārthādhyavasāyāt| tathā ca dvandvavṛtteḥ prāgekaikārthatāvagame'pi parārthābhidhānaṃ vṛttiriti siddhāntāt| tathā ca rāmaśca kṛṣṇaśceti laukikavākyasyādūraviprakarṣeṇa vigrahatayā pradarśane'pi alaukikadvandaikaśeṣayoḥ prakriyāvākye rāma au kṛṣṇa au iti praviśati| tathā ca vibhaktyantānāmekaśeṣo'pi nirbādha eva| atha vā upakrama eva yathā vyākhyātaṃ tadrītyā anaimittika evaikaśeṣaḥ| tathā ca pakṣatrayaṃ sthitaṃ siddhānte| atredamavadeyam-uktapakṣatrayamadhye'pi samudāyādekavibhaktāviti pakṣastāvat duṣṭaeva mātṛmātarāvityatrātiprasaṅgaṃ vārayituṃ ekavibhaktāvityasya sarūpāṇyevetyetadviśeṣaṇatayā āvaśyakattve sthite ubhayathā yañantaṃ yadvahuṣviti luk| nacaivaṃ kāśyapasya pratikṛtiḥ kāśyapaḥ| tataḥ pratikṛtīnāṃ sahavivakṣāyāṃ `kāśyapāḥ' ityatrā'pi ajantaṃ bahuṣu varttata iti luk syāditi vācyam| "yaskādibhyo
