ityudāhṛtya
"kiṃ tvayaṃ taddhitāntānāmekaśeṣaḥ kṛto bhavet|
kiṃ vā kṛtaikaśeṣāṇāṃ paścāttaddhitasaṅgatiḥ|| "
ici vadatāṃ bhaṭṭānāṃ grantho'pi vyākhyātaḥ| ṇyapratyayāntānāmekaseṣaḥ| ṇyapratyayāntānāmeva veti tadāśayāt| kṛtaikaśeṣāṇāṃ prajāpatirdevatā yeṣāmiti kṛtaikaśeṣayacchabdenopasthāpitānāṃ taddhitasaṅgatistaddhitavācyatā| tathā ca militānāṃ devatāsambandhaṃ bodhayituṃ laukikavigrahe yeṣāmiti nirddeśaḥ| vṛttau tu devatāvadvācakasya taddhitasyaikaśeṣa iti militeṣu paśuṣu devatānvayādeko yāgaḥ| agnīṣomīya ityādau militayordevatāyāmabhedānvaye yathetyudātdṛtavārttikasyottarārdhe'rthodhyavaseyaḥ| yuktaṃ caitat| pratyayārthabahutvaṃ hi pratyakṣamupalabhyate| tatkṛtaṃ caikaśeṣatvamiti na prakṛtau bhavedityuttaravārttikasyānuguṇyāt| syādetat-pratyayārthasyaikadeśe prakṛtyartho viśeṣaṇam| abhedaśceha sambandha āgneyādāviyaṃ sthitiriti pakṣe devatāvatāṃ sāhityaṃ labhyate na tu sahitānāṃ devatāktve devatāyāṃ pradeye ca khaṇḍaśaḥ śaktiriṣyata iti pakṣe'pi ekapratyayopāttadevatānvayasyāntaraṅgatvādevameveti cet, satyam| pradeye eva śaktiḥ prakṛtestu pratyayasamabhivyāhārāddevatāyāṃ nirūḍhalakṣaṇetyāśayenā'yaṃ grantho neyaḥ| kevalāddevatāvācī taddhito'gneḥ samuccarannityādigranthāstu matāntarābhiprāyeṇa neyāḥ| na caivamapi virūpaikaśeṣapakṣe samānārthatālābhārthaṃ prakṛtyarthānvayasya prāthamikatvaṃ svīkāryameveti vācyam| yayaya ityeṣābhekavibhaktiṃ prati prakṛtitvābhāve'pi vibhaktau parataḥ sārūpyasambhavena sarūpaikaśeṣa evetyāśayāt| prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ| svarabhinnānāṃ yasyottaraḥ svaravidhiḥ sa śiṣyata iti vaktavyam| tena pūrvodātdṛte `hariṇyau' ityatra ṅībantasya pittvādanudāttapratyayakasya śeṣaḥ| na tu jātau puṃyoge vā yo ṅīṣ tadantasya pratyayasveraṇāntodāttasya| nanu " varṇādanudāttāt"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-39)iti ṅīṣantasyāpi udāttanivṛttisvareṇāntodāttatā syādeveti cet, bhrāntosi| udāttanivṛtterevābhāvāt| "kramādibhyo vun"(aṣṭāosūo4-2-61)| nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| ubhayoḥ sahavivakṣāyāmādyudāttaḥ| ubhayoḥ sahavivakṣāyāmādyudāttaḥ śiṣyate nitsvarasya paratvāt| akṣau akṣāḥ| "akṣasyādevanasya"(phiosūo35)iti kintu pāribhāṣikameva liṅgatrayam| tacca kevalānvayi| ayamarthaḥ iyaṃ vyaktiridaṃ vastvitiśabdānāṃ sarvatrāpratibaddhaprasaratvāt| tatra kaścicchabdaḥ ekasminneva liṅge śaktaḥ kaścittu dvayoḥ kaścit "tisro jātaya evaitāḥ keṣāṃ citsamavasthitāḥ|

ubhayorantaraṃ yacca tadabhāve napuṃsakam||" iti|
ayamarthaḥ-saṃstyānaṃ-strī| satvarajastamolakṣaṇānāṃ guṇānāmapacayaḥ| prasavo guṇānāmupacayaḥ| sa eva pumān| sūterdhātoḥ sapsakārasya pakārādeśa ityarthaḥ| sūṅo ḍumasunniti mādhavaḥ| yattu ujjvaladattena yāterdamasunnittyuktam| yacca "puṃso'suṅa"(aṣṭāosūo7-1-89)iti sūtre nyāsarakṣitābhyāṃ "punātermakāsun hrasvaśca" iti sūtraṃ paṭhitaṃ tadubhayamapi bhāṣyānanuguṇantayorupacayāpacayayorabhāve sati yadubhayorantarasadṛśaṃ tannapuṃsakam| "nabhrāṇnapāt"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-75)iti nipātanāditi bhāvaḥ| tathā ca sthitimātraṃ napuṃsakam| ata evāvirbhāvatirobhāvayorapi sthitisāmānyavivakṣāsambhavānnapuṃsakaliṅgasarvanāmeti siddhāntaḥ| strīpumānnapuṃsakamitiśabdāśca śuktyādiśabdavaddharme dharmiṇi varttanta ityavadheyam| svakṛtānta iti| "kṛtāntau yamasiddhāntau"(aokoo3-3-64)ityamaraḥ| vaiyyākaraṇasiddhānte ityarthaḥ|

pumān striyā(aṣṭāosūo1-2-67)| sarūpāṇāṃ madhye striyā sahoktau pumān śiṣyate sa ca puṃvadeva syāttallakṣaṇa eva viśeṣaścet| sampṛktā ca saṃpṛktaṃ ca sampṛktau| "yaḥ śiṣyate sa lupyamānārthābhidhāyi" ityatra "vṛddoyūnā"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-65)iti syāt| iha hi kutsāsauvīratvābhyāṃ prayukte'pi ṭhaki yuvaprayuktatāstyeveti viśiṣṭā'bhāvo nirbādhaḥ| evamindrendrāṇyāvityatra prakṛtasūtraṃ pravartteta| `himahimānyau' ityādau cottarasūtramiti dik| nanvevaṃ gārgyavātsyāya nayoratiprasaṅga iti cet, yosau viśeṣaḥ sa tallakṣaṇaścediti vacanavyakatyā pāṭhāduddeśyavidheyānvayalābhāt| evañca kṛtsnasya viśeṣasya tanmātraprayuktatvaṃ phalitam| tena padāntaraparyantānusāraṇaṃ kaiyaṭādīnāṃ yuktameveti dik| taditaraprayuktaviśeṣaviraharūpaviśiṣṭābhāvavivakṣāyāntu sarvaṃ sustham| etena sā ca sa ca tāvitivyākhyātam| anaimittikasyaikaśeṣasya tad tad‌ ityavasthāyāṃ pravṛttāvapi puṃstvaniyamasyaitena labhyatvāt| brāhmaṇavatsaśca brāhmaṇīvatsā cetyatra tu na bhavati| strīpuṃsayoḥ sahavivakṣāyāmekaśeṣaḥ| sahavivakṣā ca pradhānayoreva| tena yatra pradhānayoreva strīpuṃsayorviśeṣaprayojakatā tatraiva ekaśeṣapravṛtteḥ iha vā pradhānakṛtasyā'pi viśeṣasya sattvāt| evakārānuvṛtterneha-"indrendrāṇyau'| iha hi puṃyogakṛto'pi viśeṣaḥ| `āraṇyāraṇyānyau'| iha mahatvakṛto'pi viśeṣaḥ| pumāniti kim? prāk ca pratīcī ca prākpratīcyau staḥ| prapūrvādañceḥ kvinnantādastāteraṃceligiti "taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-1-38)ityavyayattvādaliṅgaḥ prāk‌śabdaḥ|

bhātṛputrau svasṛduhitṛbhyām(aṣṭāosūo1-2-68)| yathāsaṃkhyaṃ śiṣyete| bhrātā ca svasā ca bhrātarau| putraśca duhitā ca putrau|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-69)
napuṃsakamanapuṃsakenaikavaccāsyānyatarasyām(aṣṭāosūo1-2-69)| aklībena sahoktau klībaṃ śiṣyate tacca vā ekavat syāt| tallakṣaṇa eva cedviśeṣaḥ| śuklaḥ kambalāḥ, śuklā, bṛhatīkā, śuklaṃ vastraṃ, tadidaṃ śuklam| tānīmāni śuklāni| anapuṃsakeneti kim? śuklaṃ śuklaṃñca śukle| ekavacceti na bhavati| asyeti kim? uttarasūtre ekavadbhāvānuvṛttirmā bhūt|
pitā mātrā(aṣṭāosūo1-2-70)| mātrā sahoktau pitā vā śiṣyate| pitarau| mātāpitarau| ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'karttum| tathāhi-"yaḥ śiṣyate sa lupyamānārthābhidhāyi" itinyāyenāsmin viṣaye pitṛśabda eva mātaramapi vaktīti nirvivādam| tatra ca nirūḍhalakṣaṇā vā śaktireva vetyanyadetat| na ca dvandvanivṛttyarthaṃ sūtram| tasyā'pi pakṣe iṣṭatvāt| evaṃ "śvaśuraḥ śvaśrvā"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-71)ityatrāpi bodhyam| etena "patnī duhitaraścaiva pitarau bhrātarastathā'(yāosmṛo135)|
ityasya vyākhyāvasare vigrahe kramapratīteḥ "prathamaṃ mātā dhanabhāk tadabhāve tu pitā" iti vijñāneśvaragranthaścintyaḥ| ekapadajanye bodhe kramābhāvāt| sūtrārambhe'pyevameva| pratyuta mukhyārthasya prathamapratītirucitā| na tu lakṣyāyā mātuḥ| yattu vigrahe kramapratītiriti, tanna| vṛttivigrahayoḥ sahāprayogāt| vṛttereveha vyākhyeyaśloke prayogāt| kiṃ ca vṛttāvapiprayuktāyāṃ vigraho'pi smaryatāṃ kathañcit| na tu tatrāpi pūrvāparibhāve kiñcinniyāmakamasti tasmātkramanirṇaye pramāṇāntaraṃ mṛgyam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-71)
śvaśuraḥ śvaśrvā(aṣṭāosūo1-2-71)śvaśrvā sahoktau śvaśuro vā śiṣyate| śvaśurau| śvaśrūśvaśurau| śvaśvreti sautranirddeśādeva pratyayāntasyā'pi prātipadikatvam| anyathā hi "prakṛtividanukaraṇam" iti ūḍantatṛtīyā na syāt|
(pāosūo1-2-72)
tyādīni sarvairnityam(pāosūo1-2-72)| sarvaistyadādibhiranyaiśca sahoktau tyadādīni nityaṃ śiṣyante| pratyāsattestyadādibhireva sahoktāvityartho mā bhūditi sarvagrahaṇam| sa ca devadattaśca tau| dvandvanivṛttyarthaṃ vacanam| `tau'iti tu `sarūpa'(aṣṭāosūo1-2-64)sūtreṇaiva siddhaṃ devadattasyāpi tacchabdenaiva rnirdeṣṭuṃśakyatvāt| tyadādīnāṃ mithaḥ sahoktau yatparaṃ tacchiṣyate śabdaparavipratiṣedhāt| sa ca yaśca yau| "pūrvaśeṣo'pi dṛśyate" iti bhāṣyam| sa ca yaśca tau| ahaṃ ca bhāvaṃścāvām| tyadāditaḥ śeṣe puṃnapuṃsakato liṅgavacanāni(kāovāo)| ādyādittvāttasiḥ| tyadādīnāṃ śeṣe sahavivakṣito yorthaḥ pumān yaśca napuṃsakaṃ tadvaśena liṅgavacanāni bhavantītyarthaḥ| sā ca devadattaśca tau| tacca devadattā ca yajñadattā ca tāni| puṃnapuṃsakayostu sahavivakṣāyāṃ napuṃsakavaśena vyavasthāparatvāt| tacca devadattaśca te| advandvatatpuruṣaviśeṣaṇānāmiti vaktavyam(kāovāo)| kukkuṭamayūryāvime| mayūrīkukkuṭāvimau| arddhaṃ pippalyāstat| ardhapippalī ca sā ardhapiplyau te| iha "paravalliṅgam"(aṣṭāosūo2-4-26)iti samāsārthasya liṅgā'tideśe kṛte tadviśeṣaṇasya sarvanāmnastadeva liṅgam| bhāṣye tu etatsūtraṃ pratyākhyātam| yadāha-sāmānyaviśeṣavācinośca dvandvābhāvātsiddhamiti| viśeṣasannidhau hi prayuktaḥ sāmānyaśabdau viśeṣāntare varttate| brāhmaṇā āgatā vasiṣṭhaśceti yathā| tathāvidhe viṣaye vācaniko'yaṃ dvandvaniṣedhaḥ| tenaiva taddevadattāvityādinivṛtteḥ siddhatvādayamekaśeṣo na vaktavya ityartha iti kaiyyaṭaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi `śūdrābhīraṃ ' `gobalīvardaṃ' `tṛṇopalam' iti, atrāhuḥ-ābhīrī jātyantarāṇi|
"brāhmaṇādugrakanyāyāmābhīro nāma jāyate|
māhiṣyograu prajāyete viṭ‌śūdrāṅganayornṛpāt"|| iti smṛteḥ ||
gośabdastu strīgaviparo'yaṃ strīliṅgaḥ| apāmulapa iti nāmadheyamiti| anityoyaṃ niṣedhaḥ| "prācyabharateṣu(aṣṭāosūoeo2-4-66)itisūtranirdeśālliṅgāt| tena "pramāṇaprameya" ityādiṣu dvandvaḥ siddhaḥ| etena-
"avidyā taccito yogaḥ ṣaḍasmākamanādayaḥ|
matsyādau tadviśeṣayoḥ" ityādiprayogā vyākhyātāḥ| sūtrārambhe tvetena siddhyeyureveti sahṛdayairākalanaryim|
(aṣṭāosūo1-2-73)
grāmyapaśusaṅgheṣvataruṇeṣu strī(aṣṭāosūo1-2-73)| eṣu sahavivakṣāyāṃ strīśiṣyate| "pumān striyā"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-67)ityasyāpavādaḥ| gāva imāḥ| grāmyagrahaṇaṃ kim? rurava ime| paśugrahaṇaṃ kim? brāhmaṇāḥ| saṅgheṣu kim? etau gāvau carataḥ| ekaśeṣasyānekaviṣayatve labdhe saṅghagrahaṇasāmarthyād bahūnāṃ saṅgho gṛhyate| ataruṇeṣu kim? vatsā ime| barkarā ime| anekaśapheṣviti vaktavyam(kāovāo)aśvā ime| gardabhā ime| ekaśaphattvātpuṃśeṣa eva| "śaphaṃ klībe khuraḥ pumān"(aokoo2-8-49)ityamaraḥ| haradattastu "śaphāḥ khurāḥ" iti prayuṅkta| tatra śaphaśabdasya puṃstve mūlāntaraṃ mṛgyam| uṣṭrāṇāṃ tvāraṇyatvāt strīśeṣābhāvaḥ|
|| iti śrīśabdakaustubhe prathamādhyāyasya dvitīye pāde tṛtīyamānhikaṃ pādaśca samāptaḥ ||
<1.3>
|| tṛtīyapāde prathamānhikam ||
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-1)
bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-1)| kriyāvācino gaṇapaṭhitā dhātusaṃjñāḥ syuḥ| dhātutvāllaḍādayaḥ| bhavati, edhate| kriyāvācinaḥ kim? `yā paśya' ityādau dhātutvaṃ mā bhūta| sati hi tasmin "ātodhātoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-140)ityālopaḥ syāt| na ca "yā prāpaṇe"(dhāosūo1049)ityādyarthanirddeśo niyāmakaḥ| tasyāpāṇinīyatvāt| bhīmasenādayo hyarthaṃ nirdidiśuriti smaryate| pāṇinistu "bhvedha" ityādyapāṭhīditi bhāṣyavārttikayoḥ spaṣṭam| kiñca abhiyuktairapi kṛtorthanirdeśo nārthāntaranivṛttiparaḥ sukhamanubhavatītyādāvadhātutpaprasaṅgāt| uktañca--
"kriyāvācitvamākhyātumekaikorthaḥ pradarśitaḥ|
prayogato'nusarttavyā anekārthā hi dhātavaḥ"|| iti |
ata eva "kurda khurda gurda guda krīḍāyāmeva"(dhāosūo21-22-23-24)ityevakāraḥ paṭhyate "śliṣa āliṅgane"(aṣṭāosūo3-1-46)ityādisūtrāṇyapīha jñāpakāni| tasmāt `yāḥ paśya'ityādivyāvṛttaye kriyāvācina iti viśeṣaṇaṃ sthitam| gaṇapaṭhitā iti kim? hiruk‌, pṛthak, ṛte, ityādyavyayānāṃ `śiśye' iti bhāvārthatiṅantasya cā mā bhūt| na caivaṃ sautreṣvavyāptiḥ| stambhavādīnāmuditkaraṇena dhātvadhikārīyakāryavidhānena ca dhātutvānumānāt| na caivamapi laukikānāṃ culumpādīnāmasaṅgrahāpattiḥ| bhvādyante yajādisamāptyarthaṃ vṛtkaraṇe'pi bhvādīnāmasamāpteḥ| dhātuvṛttiṣu tathaiva vyākhyātatvāt| "kāsyanekāj‌grahaṇaṃ culumpādyartham"(kāovāo)iti kātyāyanavacanenāpyetallabhyate| evaṃ bhvādyante vṛtkaraṇasya puṣādisamāptyarthatayā divādīnāmaparisamāpteḥ `mṛgyati'ityādisiddhiḥ| vastutastu curādīnāmante "bahulametannidarśanam" iti gaṇasūtreṇa sakaleṣṭasiddhiḥ| taddhi dhātuvṛttiṣu dvedhā vyākhāyātam| bhvādigaṇapaṭhitebhyo'pi ṇic prayogānusārājjapa iti| daśagaṇīpāṭho diṅmātrapradarśanārthastenānye'pi śiṣṭaprayuktā dhātavaḥ saṅgrāhyā iti ca| syādetam-bhūrādiryeṣāmiti vigrahe yaṇi sati bhvādaya iti syāt| kriyāvācitvañca sūtrānārūḍhameveti| ucyate-"bhavanaṃ bhūḥ kriyāsāmānyam| vadantīti vādayaḥ vaderauṇādika iñ" iti bhāṣyam| yadyapi "vasi vapi yaji rāji vraji sahi hani vāsi vādi vāribhya iñ"(uosūo574)ityauṇādikasūtreṇa vaderṇyantādiñ vihitastathāpi bahulagrahaṇāt kevalādapi bhaviṣyatīti nyāsakārādayaḥ| vastutastu "vadantīti vādayaḥ" iti bhāṣyamarthakathanaparam| ṇyantādeva tviñ| na ceha ṇyarthānanvayaḥ| pacatipācayatyostulyārthatvāt| bhuvo vādaya iti vigrahaḥ| tathāca kriyāvācitvaṃ tāvatsūtrārūḍham| niranubandhānāṃ śabvikaraṇānāṃ bhūprabhṛtīnāṃ pāṭhasāmarthyātpaṭhitānāmeva saṃjñetyanumīyate| "sanādyantā dhātavaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo3-1-32)iti sūtrārambhācca| atha vā bhūrādiryeṣāmiti vigrahaḥ| nipātanād vugāgamaḥ mahāsaṃjñākaraṇaṃ tu "dadhati kriyām" iti dhātavaḥ ityanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānārtham| yadvā-bhūśca vāśceti dvandvaḥ| ādiśabdayostu vyavasthāprakāravācinorekaśeṣaḥ| tato bhūvau ādī yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| bhūprabhṛtayo vāsadṛśāḥ kriyāvācina iti yāvat| atha vā vāityayamādiryeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ vāityasyādaya iti tatpuruṣaḥ| tayorekaśeṣe svarabhinnānāmiti bahavrīhiśeṣaḥ| bhuvo vādaya iti ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaḥ| vācyavācakabhāvaśca ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ| "dvirvacaneci"(aṣṭāosūo1-1-59)iti vattantrāvṛttyādinā vā ubhayalābhaḥ| sarvathāpi kriyāvācino bhvādaya eva dhātava iti sthitam| kā punaḥ kriyā? ucyate, karotyarthabhūtā utpādanāparaparyāyā utpattyanukūlavyāpārarūṇa bhāvanaiva kriyā| tathāhi-abhavato gaganāderakriyamāṇatayā bhavataśca ghaṭādeḥ kriyamāṇatayā bhavatyarthakarttuḥ karotikarmatvam| tathā ca karotyarthakartturbhavitṛprayojakatayā| bhavaterutpattyarthāprayojakavyāpāre ṇijutpadyamānaḥ karotyarthamavalambate| uktañca-
"karotikriyamāṇena na kaścitkarmaṇā vinā|
bhavatyarthasya karttā ca karoteḥ karma jāyate||
karotyarthasya yaḥ kartā bhavituḥ sa prayojakaḥ|
bhavitā tamapekṣyātha prayojyattvaṃ prapadyate||
prayojyakartṛkaikāntavyāpārapratipādakāḥ|
ṇyantā eva prayujyante tatprayojakakarmasu||
tena bhūtiṣu kartṛttvaṃ pratipannasya vastunaḥ|
prayojakakriyāmāhurbhāvināṃ bhāvanāvidaḥ||" iti ||
sā ca sakaladhātūnāṃ vāttyā| ata eva `kiṃ karoti'? iti praśne `pacati' `paṭhati' ityādyuttaraṃ saṅgacchate| na cāsau mīmāṃsakoktarītyā pratyayavācyai2vāstāmiti vācyam| bhoktavyamityādāvākhyātaṃ vināpi tatpratīteḥ| tathā ca tatrāpi kārakāpekṣā dṛśyate| asti ca tatrāpi pakotisāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ, kiṃ karttavyaṃ, bhoktavyam, kiṃ kṛtavānbhuktavāniti| kiñca, `bhāvayati ghaṭam' iti vat tvanmate `bhavati ghaṭam' ityapi syāt `tulyārthattvāt| dṛṣṭānte karttuḥ kumbhakārasya vyāpāraṃ ṇijācaṣṭe, dārṣṭāntike ttvākhyātapratyayaḥ| nanu prayojakavyāpāro ṇijarthaḥ, kartṛvyāpārastvākhyātārthaḥ| iti vaiṣamyamiti cet, kārakacakraprayoktuḥ kartṛtve ghaṭasyātathāttvāt| yadi tu-
"dhātunoktakriye nityaṃ kārake kartṛteṣyate"
iti bhartṛharipratipāditarītyā prādhānyena dhātūpāttavyāpārattvarūpaṃ kartṛtvaṃ tavāpi sammataṃ kastarhīdānīmākhyātārthaḥ| vyāpārasya dhātunaivābhihitatvāt| api ca, dhātoḥ sakarmakākarmakatvavibhāga ucchidyeta| `akarmakācca'(aṣṭāosūo1-3-26)ityādisūtrāṇi ca virudhyeran| nanū siddhānte'pi kriyāyāḥ karmāpekṣāniyamātkathamakarmakateti cet, na, phalavyāpārayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyavaiyadhikaraṇyābhyāṃ sakarmakākarmakavibhāgasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt| kiñca, `jyotiṣṭomayājī' ityādau "karaṇe yajaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo3-2-85)iti ṇinirasmatpakṣe saṅgacchate| dhātutvena dhātupāttāṃ bhāvanāṃ prati yajitvena tadupāttasyāṃśāntarasya karaṇatvāt| pacyādayo hi dhātutvena bhāvanāmāhuḥ| viklityādyaṃśāntare tu pācatvādinā prātisvikarūpeṇāhuḥ| taccāṃśāntarabhāvatāṃ prati prāyeṇa bhāvyatayā sambadhyate| `jyotiṣṭomayājī' ityādau tu karaṇatayā `jyotiṣṭhomākhyena yāgena svargaṃ bhāvitavān" ityarthapratīteḥ| spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ ṇinividhau haradattagranthe| etena "dvyarthaḥ paciḥ" iti bhāṣyaṃ vyākhyātam| bhaṭṭiścāha-
vibhajyasenāṃ paramārthakarmā senāpatīṃścāpi purandaro'tha|
niyojayāmāsa sa śatrusainye karotirartheṣviva sarvadhātūn" iti|
nanu kriyāyā dhātvarthatve `pacati' ityādau ekakartṛkā vartṛmānā pacikriyeti kriyāviśeṣyako bodho na syāt| pratyayārthaṃ prati prakṛtyarthasya viśeṣaṇatāyā aupagavādau klṛptatvāditi cenna, "pratyayārthaḥ pradhānam' iti hyutsargaḥ sa ceha tyajyate| "kriyāpradhānamākhyātam" iti smaraṇāt| "pācikā" ityādau strītvasya viśeṣaṇatvābhyupagamācca| pratyuta tavaiva `pacati' ityādāvanupapattiḥ| `pacantaṃ taṃ paśya' ityādau śatṛśānacoḥ kartṛpradhānyasya sarvasammatatayā tiṅkṣvapi tathātvāpatteḥ, śatrādīnāṃ tiṅāśca lādeśatvasyāviśiṣṭatvāt, ādeśānāñca sthānismārakatve sthānyarthābhidhāyitve vārthaikyadhrauṣṭatvāt| ata eva hi yuṣmadi samānādhikaraṇe madhyabhaḥ, asmadyuttamaḥ, ityādipuruṣavyavasthā saṅgacchate| abhihite kartari prathamā, ityādi ca| na `samānādhikaraṇe' ityanena svābhidheyasaṃkhyānvayitvam, abhihitaśabdena cābhihitasaṅkhyākatvaṃ vivakṣitamiti vācyam| sūtrānanuguṇattvāt| kṛttāddhitasamāsaiḥ saṃkhyāyā anabhidhānāttadabhihite'pi tṛtīyāprasaṅgācca| na ca kṛtyanabhidhānameva kartturanabhidhānamiti vācyam| bhāvārthalakāre'pi karttari prathamāpatteriti dik| syādetat--astibhavatividyatiṣu kriyāvācitvamavyāptam| na hi tatrotpādaḥ pratīyate| evantiṣṭhatāvapi tathā jāyata utpadyate ityatrāpyavyāptiḥ utpattirhi ādyakṣaṇasambandhaḥ| tadanukūlavyāpāraścotpādanā| tadanubhavaścāstyādibhyo nāstyevaḥ| ata eva `kiṃ karoti' iti praśne `pacati' ityādivat `asti' iti na pratibruvate iti cet, ucyate, `asti' ityādeḥ svarūpadhāraṇaṃ `karoti' ityarthaḥ| dhāraṇañcottarakālasambandhaḥ| tathā satyapi karotyarthe dhāttvarthāntargatena dhāraṇenaiva bhāvyākāṅkṣāyāḥ pūraṇāt `jīvati' `nṛtyati' ādivadakarmakatā kriyā hi vyāpāravyadhikaraṇaivotpattirucyate| ata eva tatra ghaṭādīnāṃ karmatā| parasamavetavyāpāraphalībhūtotpattiśālitvāt| janiprabhṛtibhistu vyāpārasamānādhikaraṇaivocyate| ata evākarmakatā teṣām| sotpattyanukūlavyāpārabhājamapi sūkṣmarūpāpannaghaṭādīnāṃ parasamavetattvaghaṭitakarmatāvirahāt| uktañca hariṇā-
"ātmānamātmanā bibhradastīti vyapadiśyate|" iti|
anyepyāhuḥ-
"astyādāvapi dharmyaṃśe bhāvye'styeva hi bhāvanā|
anyatrāśeṣabhāvāttu sā tathā na prakāśate" iti||
tathā pacau viklidau ca viklittiryadyapi sādhāraṇī tathā'pi pacau vyāpāravyadhikaraṇā viklidau tu tatsamānādhikaraṇā seti sakarmakākarmakavibhāgaḥ| na hi dhātvarthabhūtaphalaśālittvamātraṃ karmatvaṃ kintu vyāpāravaiyadhikaraṇyamapi phale'pekṣyate| yattūktaṃ `kiṃ karoti' iti praśne ityādi| tadasiddham| āsannavināśaṃ kañciduddiśya `kiṃ karoti' iti praśne `asti' ityuttarasya sarvasammatatvāt| itaratra tu susthatayā niścite `kiṃ karoti' iti praśnaḥ pākādiviśeṣagocara evetyavadhāraṇāt `asti' iti nottaram| etena-
"yāvatsiddhamasiddhe vā sādhyatvenābhidhīyate|
āśritakramarūpattvātsā kriyetyabhidhīyate"||
ityapi vyākhyātam| pūrvāparībhāvāpannānekakṣaṇaviśiṣṭasyotpattiḥ "ātmāsti" ityādāvapi sulabhaiveti bhāvaḥ| pacatyādāvapi hi adhiśrayaṇādiradhaḥśrayaṇānto vyāpārakalāpaḥ kriyā| ata eva tasya yugapadasannikarṣānna pratyakṣatā| kintu ekaikasyādhiśrayaṇādivyāpārasya krameṇānubhave sati manasā saṅkalanā kriyate| taduktaṃ bhāṣye-"kriyā nāmeyamatyantāparidṛṣṭā aśakyā piṇḍībhūtā nidarśayitum" iti| aikyamapi pāribhāṣikam| ekaphalāvacchinnatvāt| uktaṃ ca--
"guṇabhūtairavayavaiḥ samūhaḥ kramajanmanām|
buddhyā prakalpitābhedaḥ kriyeti vyapadiśyate||" iti ||
tadeva bhavatyādau kriyāvācakattvaṃ suvacam| ata eva `abhūt' `asti' `bhaviṣyati' iti kālayogaḥ| na hi kriyātvaṃ vinā'sau sambhavati| taduktam-
"kriyābhedāya kālastu saṅkhyā sarvasya bhedikā"| iti|
"kālānupāti yadrūpantadastīti pratīyate|" iti ca|
āṣye tūktārthasādhanāya niruktakāravacanamudāhṛtam-"ṣaḍ‌bhāvavikārā iti ha smāha bhagavānvārthāpaṇiriti| bhāvasya kriyāyāḥ ṣaṭ prakārā ityarthaḥ| teṣu ca jāyate'stīti pāṭhātsarvakriyānvayaḥ siddha itvarthaḥ| kaiyaṭastu prakārāntareṇāpi vyācakhyau| bhāvasya sattāyā ete prakārāḥ saptaivānekakriyātmikā sādhanasambandhādavasīyamānasādhyasvarūpā janmādirūpatathāvabhāsate" iti| tathā ca-"jātisamuddeśe'pi sambandhibhedātsattaivetyupakramyoktam--
"prāptakramaviśeṣeṣu kriyā saivābhidhīyate|
kramarūpasya saṃhāre tatsatvamiti kathyate"|| iti ||
vyāpāraviśeṣāṇāṃ sādhyatvāt kramikattvācca tadupahitāyāste bhavata ityarthaḥ| `pākaḥ' ityādau tu prakṛtyā sādhyāvasthāyā asatvarūpāyā upasthitiḥ| ghañā tu siddharūpāyāḥ| uktañca--
"kriyāyāḥ siddhatāvasthā sādhyāvasthā ca kīrtitā|
siddhatāṃ dravyamicchanti tatraivecchanti ghañ‌vidhim||
ākhyātaśabde bhāgābhyāṃ sādhyasādhanavartitā|
prakalpitā yathā śāstre sa ghañādiṣvapi kramaḥ||
sādhyattvena kriyā tatra dhāturūpanibandhanā|
satvabhāvastu yastasyāḥ sa ghañādi nibandhane"|| iti |
liṅgasaṅkhyākārakādyanvayayogyenāvasthāviśeṣeṇa ghañādibhya upasthitirityarthaḥ| etena "kṛdabhihito bhāvo dravyavatprakāśate" iti tṛtīyādhyāye bhāṣyamapi dhyākhyātam| prakalpitetyanena padasphoṭasyaiva vāstavatāṃ dhyanayati-sādhyettveneti| ata eva tampratikārakatayā odanāderanvaya iti bhāvaḥ| ata eva `bhoktuṃ pākaḥ' `bhuktvā gamanam' ityādau tumunādayaḥ siddhāḥ| kṛttvorthāstvanabhidhānānnetyeva śaraṇam| ata eva kvacidṛśyatepi dvirvacanam| `dviraṇavidhiḥ' iti sūtravārttikayoḥ prayogāt| sattvabhāvastviti| ata eva `pākaṃ karoti' ityādau kārakatvena sā'nvetītyarthaḥ| nanvevaṃ "paśya mṛgo dhāvati" ityādau mṛgakartṛkaśīghragaterdaśanampratikarmatā na syāt| na ca saṃsargamaryādayeha karmatābhāne'pi prakāratvenābhānānnoktadoṣa iti vācyam| evamapi `pacati' bhavati' ityādāvasaṅgateḥ| ekakartṛkā varttamānā pacikriyā ekakartṛkā vartagānā bhavanakriyateti hi tatra vākyārthaḥ| tatra ca `bhavati' iti lakārārthatya karturdedhadattakartṛkapacikriyāṃ pratyabhedena saṃsargeṇa viśeṣyatvasyāvātyakatvāt| tathā ca devadattavatpacikriyāyaḥ satvadharmo durvāraḥ| atrāhuḥ-"kartṛtvakarmatvayoranubhavabalādbhānaṃ svīkriyate| kārakāntarābhāvamātre tu tātparyam" iti| "ākhyātaśabde bhāgābhyām" ityudāhṛtaślokopyetadabhiprāyaka eva| tatra "yaṃ prati" ityuttaraślokānurodhāditi tṛtīye sphuṭīkariṣyāmaḥ| etena `apākṣīt' `apākṣīḥ' `apākṣīḥ' `pacataḥ' pacanti' `pakṣyati' `pakṣyataḥ' ityādāvapi `bhavati' ityanena kartṛtvenānvayo vyākhyātaḥ| `bhāvī varttate' `dhvastosti' ityādāviva sūkṣmāvasthasya varttamānasattāsambhavāt|

yathāsaṅkhyamanudeśaḥ samānām(aṣṭāosūo1-3-10)| samasaṅkhyānāṃ sambandho yathākramaṃ syāt| "nandigrahipacādibhyo lyuṇinyacaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo3-1-134)nandanaḥ, grāhī, pacaḥ| "samūlākṛtajīveṣu hankṛñ‌grahaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo3-4-36)`samūlaghātaṃ hanti' ityādi| atrānuvādyayorapi dhātūpapadayoryathākramaṃ bodhyam| syādetat-`vidibhidichideḥ kurac"(aṣṭāosūo3-2-162)ityādau tacchīlādyarthatrayeṇa yathāsaṅkhyaṃ prāptoti| evaṃ "khyatyāt"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-112)ṅasiṅasoḥ ityādāvapīti cet| atrabhāṣyam-"svaritenetyapakṛṣyate| tena svaritatvābhāvānneha yathāsaṅkhyam"iti| pratijñāsvaritāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ| svaritatvā bhāvādeva "kartṛkamaṃṇośca bhūkṛñoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-127)iti sūtre na yathāsaṃkhyaṃ "nāḍīmuṣṭyośca"(aṣṭāosūo3-2-30)iti sūtre yathāsaṃkhyaṃ ca bhavatyeveti bhāṣyam| vṛttikārastu "kartṛkarmaṇośca"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-127)"nāḍīmuṣṭyośca"(aṣṭāosūo3-2-30)iti sūtradvaya|pi bhāṣya viparītaṃ vadannupekṣyaḥ| "nāḍīmuṣṭyośca"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-30)iti sūtre yathā saṅkhyābhāvaparaṃ bhāṣyamapi pūrvāparavirodhāccintyam| etadeva vā matāntaraparaṃ sattatratyavṛtterālambanamastu| "karttṛkarmaṇo-"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-127)ityatra tu vṛttiścintyaiva| "vaiśoyaśaāderbhagādyal‌khau"(aṣṭāosūo4-4-131)ityatrāpyasvaritātvādeva na yathāsaṅkhyam| iha bhāṣye vṛttau cetthaṃ sthitam| caturthe tu vṛttikāroyoge vyabhajat| "bhagādyal" iti "khaca" iti ca|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-11)
svaritonādhikāraḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-11)| "itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇe"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-21)tṛtīyā| adhikāraviniyogaḥ svaritatvayuktaśabdasvarūpamadhikṛtaṃ bodhyam| "pratyayaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo3-1-1)"paraśca"(aṣṭāosūo3-1-2)ityādi| yathā prāyeṇottaratropasthitiḥ| kva cittu pūrvatrāpi| taduktam-"atiṅityubhayoryogāyoḥ śeṣaḥ" iti| kiyad‌dūramadhikāra ityatra vyākhyānaṃ śaraṇam| yathā ātṛtīyādhyāyāntaṃ dhātvadhikāro na tu prāglādeśebhya eva| tathā āsaptamādhyāyaparisamāpteraṅgādhikāro na tu prāgabhyāsavikārebhya evetyādi| yadvā-`svarite' iti saptamyantam| tena tasmindṛṣṭe adhikāro nivarttaya ityarthaḥ| kaḥ svaritādhikārārthaḥ kaśca tannivṛttyartha ityatra tu vyākhyānameva śaraṇam| nanvevaṃ vyākhyānādevānuvṛttyananuvṛttī stāṃ kimanena sūtreṇa, satyam, arthāntarāṇi saṅga-hītuṃ sūtraṃ kṛtam| tathāhi-svaritenādhikārarūportho grāhyaḥ| "gostriyoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-48)ityatra ca strīśabdaḥ svaryate| tena goṭāṅgrahaṇaṃ kṛnnivṛttyarthamiti na vaktavyam| kiñca adhikaṃ kāryamadhikāraḥ| gauṇe'pi śāstrāpravṛttirityarthaḥ| tathā ca gauṇamukhyanyāyo yatra neṣyate(apādānādhikaraṇādau)tatra svaritaḥ pāṭhyaḥ| api ca adhikaḥ kāraḥ kṛtiriyam| yatpūrvaḥ san paraṃ bādhate| tathā ca pūrvavipratiṣedhā saṃgṛhītā bhavanti| tatra tatra svaritāpāṭhenaiva gatārthatvāditi dik|
|| iti śrīśabdakaustubhe prathamasyādhyāyasya tṛtīye pāde prathamānhikam ||
prathamasyādhyāyasya tṛtīyapāde dvitīyamānhikam||
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-12)
anudāttaṅita ātmanepadam(aṣṭāosūo1-3-12)| anudāttetka upadeśe yo ṅittadantāddhātorlasthāne ātmanepadameva syāt| edhate, spardhate, bobhūyate, ṛtīyate, kathaṃ tarhi `śete' ityādi, ṅideva tvayamiti cet, satyam| vyapadeśivadbhāvo bodhyaḥ| upadeśe kim? `cukuṭiṣati-"gāṅkuṭādibhyaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-1)iti sana ātideśikaṃ ṅittvam| dhātoriti kim? atyutat adudruvat, iti ṅidabhyāmaṅcaṅbhyāṃ mā bhūt| kathaṃ punaḥ "dhātoḥ" iti labhyate iti cet, "bhūvādi"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-1)sūtrānmaṇḍūkaplutyā'nuvṛttsya "dhātavaḥ" ityasya vibhaktivipariṇāmāt| "sādṛśyamātreṇa pariṇāmavyavahāro vastugatyā tu yogyaśabdāntarameva sannihite bhavati" iti kaiyaṭaḥ| yadvā-ātmanepadenaiva lakārasya dhātoścākṣepaḥ| "iko jhal"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-9)ityatra sanā dhātorākṣepavat| ata eva ṅitā tasya viśeṣaṇāttadantavidhīrvyākhyātaḥ| `citrīyate' ityādau tu avayave'caritārthena ṅakāreṇa kyajantasya viśeṣaṇaṃ tato vyapadeśivadbhāvānṅintateti dik| etena `cinutaḥ' `sunutaḥ' iti vyākhyātam| yattu tatra ṅitīva ṅidvaditi vyākhyānāmāśritya samādhānaṃ, tadāpātataḥ| `pacete' ityādau "ātoṅitaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo7-2-81)iti iyādeśābhāvaprasaṅgāt| nanu "vṛdbhyaḥ tyasanoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-92)iti sūtre syagrahaṇena `vikaraṇebhyo niyamo balīyān" iti jñāpitattvāccaṅaṅoḥ `cinutaḥ' ityādau cānupapattireva nāstīti cet, upajaniṣyamāṇenāpi ṅitā upasañjātanimittasyā'pi parasmaipadasya bādhāpatteḥ| "niyamo balīyān" ityasyāpi pākṣikāttvācca| "vṛdbhyaḥ syasanoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-92)ityasya vikaraṇavyavadhāne'pi niyamapravṛttiriti jñāpakatāyā api suvacattvāt| "śadeḥ śitaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-60)iti sūtre bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoridaṃ spaṣṭam| tasmādyathāvyākhyānameva manoramam| haradattastu ṅita ityeva vyākhyat| "dhātoḥ" iti nāpekṣyate| "niyamo balīyān" ityāśrayaṇāccaṅādau na doṣaḥ| na ca bhāvinā ṅitā bādhaḥ| paratvātparasmaipadasyaivocitatvāt" iti tasyāśayaḥ| ubhayathāpi yaṅīyaṅorṅitvasya guṇaniṣedhe caritārthatāmāśaṅkyaḥ yaṅaḥ prāganudāttamakāraṃ praśliṣya "jucaṅkramyadandramya"(aṣṭāosūo3-2-150)iti jñāpakādyujabhāvaṃ vadantaḥ īyaṅaḥ prāgikāramīkāraṃ vā praśliṣya ādye antedittvābhāvānna num, dvitīye ekāca ityanuvṛtteḥ "śvīdito niṣṭhāyām"(aṣṭāosūo7-2-14)iti neṇniṣedha iti kalpayantaḥ parāstāḥ| syādet-yaṅlukyapi sarvatrātivyāptiḥ, pratyayalakṣaṇena ṅidantatvāt| satyam, ṅittvasya patyayāpratyayasādhāraṇatayā `sudṛṣat' ityatra "sormanasi"(aṣṭāosūo7-2-17)itisvarasyevaṃ "atvasantasya"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-14) iti dīrghasyeva cehātmanepadasyāpravṛtteriti niṣkarṣaḥ| prāñcastu `bobhūtu tetikte' ityatra tijeryaṅlugantādātmanepadavidhānaṃ jñāpakaṃ yaṅlugantātpratyayalakṣaṇenātmanepadaṃ neti| ata eva "carkarītaṃ ca" ityādādau paṭhitasya cakārātparasmaipadamiti vyākhyānaṃ jñāpakasiddhārthānuvāda iti siddhāntaḥ| nanvevamapi `pāspardhīti' ityādāvātmanepadaṃ durvāram, svarddheranudāttettvāt| na cedaṃ prakṛtyantaramiti vācyam, dviḥprayogo dvirvacanaṃ ṣāṣṭhamiti vakṣyamāṇattvāt| satyam, "śtipā śapā"(kāovāo)ityādinā niṣedho bodhyaḥ| anubandhena nirdeśo hi dvidhā| kva citsākṣāt-"śīhaḥ sārvadhātuke guṇaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo7-4-21)| "dīṅo yuṭ"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-63)iti yathā| "anunādāttetaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo3-2-149)ityādau ttvanubandhatvenaḥ| yatra tu nobhayathāpi nirdeśastadbhavatyeva| "āṅo yamahanaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-28)"bhāvakarmaṇoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-13)ityādi yathā| nanu "āṅaḥ" iti kathaṃ nānubandhanirddeśa iti cet, na| prakṛtigrahaṇe yaṅ lugantasya grahaṇamityasya hyayamapavādaḥ| tena prakṛteryatrānubandhena nirdeśaḥ sa evāsya viṣayaḥ| ata e `cecitaḥ' `marīmṛṣṭe' ityādau `kṅiti ca"(aṣṭāosūo1-1-5)iti pravartata eveti dik| atha kathaṃ "sa evāyaṃ nāgaḥ sahati kalabhebhyaḥ paribhāvam" iti| atrāhuḥ| "ādhṛṣādvā"(gaosūo)iti vikalpitaṇicaḥ saheridaṃ rūpam| yadvā-cakṣiṅo ṅittkaraṇamanudāttettvalakṣaṇasyātmanepadasyānityatāṃ jñāpayati| sa hi anudāttet| "vicakṣaṇaḥ prathayan" ityādau "anudāttetaśca halādeḥ"(aṣṭāosūo3-2-149)itiyuco darśanāt| na cāyaṃ lyuṭ| litsvarāpatteḥ| antodāttasya ca pāṭhyamānatvāditi| etena "sphāyannirmokasandhi" iti murāriprayogo vyākhyātaḥ| syādetat-lasya tibādayaḥ| laṭaḥ śatṛśānacau| liṭaḥ kānajvā| kvasuśca| "lṛṭaḥ sadvā"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-14)ityātmanepadaparasmaipadayorvihitattvādita ārabhyāpādaparisamāpteḥ prakaraṇaṃ kimarthamiti cet, niyamārthamityavehi| ata evānudāttaṅita ātmanepadameveti vyākhyātam| soyaṃ prakṛtiniyamaḥ| uttarasūtre ca bhāvakarmaṇorātmanepadameveti arthaniyamaḥ| yatraivakārastatonyatrāvadhāraṇamiti siddhāntāt| tathāhi-
"tadasambandhayasambandho vyāptiḥ saivāvadhāraṇam|
vyāpakattavadyotakaiva śabdasambaddhabhinnajam||
na cāsminpakṣe anudāttetprabhṛtibhyaḥ parasmaipadaṃ mā bhūt ātmanepadaṃ tvaniyatattvāt `atti' ityādāvapi syāditi vācyam| śeṣātparasmaipadameveti niyamāt| nanu tatra karttarātyukteḥ karttari parasmaipadamevāstu| bhāvakarmaṇostu| `jāgaryate' `adyate' ityādau parasmaipadaṃ durvārameveti cenna| bhāvakarmaṇorātmanepadameveti niyatattvāt| astu vā pratyayaniyamaḥ| ātmanepadamanudāttaṅita eveti| bhāvakarmaṇoreveti| na caivamanudāttetprabhṛtibhyaḥ parasmaipadaprasaṅgaḥ| parasmaipadasyāpi "śeṣātkarttari"(aṣṭāosūo1-6-781)iti niyatatvāt| nanu kīdṛśastatra niyamaḥ karttari yadi parasmaipadaṃ bhavati śeṣādeveti, śeṣādyadi bhavati karttaryeveti vā, ādye aśeṣātkarttarimā bhūta| bhāvakarmaṇostu śeṣādaśeṣācca parasmaipadaṃ durvāram| antye śeṣādbhāvakarmaṇormā bhūt aśeṣāttu bhāvakarmakartṛṣu triṣvapi prāpnoti| satyam, yogavibhāgena niyamadvayaṃ bodhyam| śeṣāde tatrāpi karttaryeveti| tasmādiha prakaraṇe prakṛtyarthaniyamaḥ pratyayaniyamo veti pakṣadvayamapi sthitam| syādetat-vikaraṇavyavadhāne niyamo na prāpnoti| tathāhi-vikaraṇānāmavakāśo lādeśabhinnāḥ| "ik‌śtipau dhātunirdeśe"(kāovāo)iti śtip| "pāghrādhmādeṭ‌dṛśaḥ śaḥ(aṣṭāosūo3-1-137)| tācchīlyādiṣu cānaś| niyamasyāvakāśaḥ liṭ‌liṅo luk‌śluśnamaśca| paspardhe, spardhiṣīṣṭa, āste, śete, atti, juhoti, bhinatti, bhūyāt, ityādi| edhate, spardhate, kurute, niviśate, ityādāvubhayaprasaṅge paratvānnityatvācca vanikaraṇeṣu tairvyavadhānānniyamo na syāt| tataśca prakṛtiniyamapakṣe vikaraṇāntādubhayaprasaṅgaḥ| pratyayaniyame'pi tulyajātīyasyaiva niyamena vyāvṛttiḥ dhātoranantarasya lasya yadyātmanepadam "anudāttaṅita eva" yadi tu parasmaipadaṃ, "śeṣādeva" ityādi| tathā ca dhātvantarāttadvyāvṛttāvapi vikaraṇavyavadhāne niyamāpravṛtteḥ padadvayamapi syādeva| satyam, vikaraṇebhyo niyamo baliyān" iti "vṛdbhyaḥ syasanoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-92)itisyagrahaṇena jñāpyate| ato niyamadvayepyadoṣaḥ| tatrāpi prakṛtyarthaniyamapakṣo balīyānityavadheyam| tatra hi śeṣātkarttarīti na vācyam, kintu parasmaipadamityeva yatra taccānyacca prāptaṃ tatra parasmaipadameva syāt| pratyayaniyamapakṣe tu śeṣāditi karttarīti vācyam, yogaśca vibhajanīya iti doṣatrayamadhikaṃ syāt| tibādivākyena saha vākyabhedaḥ parisaṅkhyāprayuktatridoṣatā ceti doṣacatuṣkantu pakṣadvaye'pyastyeva| yadi tu tadapi kimarthaṃ soḍhavyamiti buddhistarhi lasya tibādaya ityanena sahedaṃ prakaraṇamekavākyatayā vidhāyakamiti vyākhyeyam| asminpakṣe śeṣātkarttarīti karttavyameva| parasmaipadamātmanepadamiti ca sūtraśāṭakavadbhāvinī saṃjñāśrayaṇīyā| anyatā vihitānāṃ saṃjñā saṃjñayā ca vidhānamityanyonyāśrayaḥ syāt| asmiṃśca pakṣe vikaraṇeṣu na kaściddoṣaḥ| lādeśeṣu kṛteṣu sārvadhātukamāśritya vikaraṇapravṛtteḥ| na ca syādiṣu doṣastadavastha eveti vācyam, labhātrāpekṣayāntaraṅgeṣu tibādiṣu kṛteṣu lakāraviśeṣāpekṣatayā bahiraṅgāṇāṃ syādīnāṃ pravṛtteḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-13)
bhāvakarmaṇoḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-13)| anayorvihitasya lasyātmanepadaṃ syāt| supyate, kriyate| prāgvedakavākyatayā vidhiḥ bhinnavākyatayā niyamo veti bodhyam| niyamo'pi dvidhā, pratyayaniyamo'rthaniyamaśceti| na cāntyapakṣe karmaṇi ghañ na syāt `ko bhavatā lābho labdhaḥ' iti, "akarttari ca"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-19)ityasya tvapādānādiravakāśa iti vācyam| tulyajātīyasya parasmaipadasyaiva niyamena vyāvarttanāt| syādetat-"lūyate kedāraḥ svayameva" ityatra parasmaipadaṃ prāpnoti| "karmavatkarmaṇā"(aṣṭāosūo3-1-87)ityanena hi śāstraṃ vyapadeśo vā'tidiśyate| tathā ca tena tena śāstreṇa tattatkāryaṃ karttavyam| tatra karmaṇyātmanepadamityasyāvakāśaḥ śuddhaṃ karma, karttari parasmaipadamityasya śuddhaḥ karttā| karmakarttaryubhayaprasaṅge parattvātparasmaipadamiti| satyam, prādhānyātkāryātideśa evetyātmanepadameva paraṃ bodhyam| pakṣāntare tu "śeṣātkarttari"(aṣṭāosūo1-6-78)ityatra "karttari karma"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-14)ityataḥ karttarītyanuvarttya karttaiva yaḥ karttā tatra parasmaipadaṃ na tu karmakartarīti vyākhyātam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-14)
karttari karmavyatihāre(aṣṭāosūo1-3-14)| vinimayaviṣayībhūtāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ varttamānāddhātoḥ kartaryātmanepadaṃ syāt| vyatilunīte| anyasya yogyaṃ lavanaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| parasparakaraṇamapi karmavyatihāraḥ| sampraharante rājānaḥ| "vyātyukṣīmabhisaraṇaglahāmadīvyan" karttṛgrahaṇamuttarārtham|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-15)
na gatihiṃsārthebhyaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-15)| ebhyaḥ karmavyatihāre ātmanepadaṃ na syāt| vyatigacchanti, vyatisarpanti, vyatighnanti| pratiṣedhe hasādīnāmupasaṅkhyānam(kāovāo)| hasādayo hasaprakārāḥ śabdakriyāḥ| vyatihasanti, vyatijalpanti| haraterapratiṣedhaḥ(kāovāo)sampraharante rājānaḥ| arthagrahaṇasāmarthyādye śabdāntaranirapekṣā gatihiṃsayorvartante ta iha gṛhyante| haratistūpasargavaśāddhiṃsāyāṃ varttata iti na tasyāyampratiṣedha ityāhuḥ|
"tataḥ samprahariṣyantau dṛṣṭvā karṇadhanañjayau"
ityatra tu `yotsyamānau' iti vivakṣitaṃ na tu karmavyatihāraḥ| vahestunāyaṃ pratipedaḥ| agatyarthattvāt| prāpaṇaṃ hi vaherarthaḥ| gatipratītistvākṣepāt|
(aṣṭāosūo16)
itaretarānyonyopapadācca(aṣṭāosūo1-3-16)| ātmanepadaṃ na syāt| parasparopapadācceti vaktavyam(kāovāo)| itaretarasyānyonyasya parasparasya vā `vyatilunanti'| laukike śabdavyavahāre lāghavaṃ pratyanādarāditaretarādiśabdā vyatītyupasargau ca karmavyatihāradyotanāya samuccīyante| tathātmanepadamapi samuccīyeteti niṣedho'yamārabhyate| nanvevaṃyante| tathātmanepadamapi samuccīyeteti niṣedho'yamārabhyate| nanvevaṃ-
"sampadvinimayenobhau dadhaturbhuvanadvayam"|
ityatra taṅ kathaṃ neti cet? karaṇavinimaye satyapi kriyāvinimayasyāvivakṣitatvāt|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-17)
nerviśaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-17)| nipūrvādviśa ātmanepadaṃ syāt| niviśakte| neḥ kim? praviśati| kathaṃ tarhi `nyaviśate' nyavikṣate' iti, aṭā vyavadhānāt| na ca svāṅgamavyavadhāyakamiti vācyam| aṅgabhaktasyāṭo vikaraṇānāṃ pratyavayavatvepi dhātumpratyanavayavatvena vyavadhāyakatvāditi| atrāhuḥtibādividheḥ prāglāvasthāyāṃ dhātorevāḍāgamaḥ| "luṅlaṅ"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-71)ityatra dvilakārakanirddeśasya bhāṣyakṛtā "asiddhavat"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-22)sūtrapratyākhyānāvasare vakṣyamāṇatvāt| matāntare'pi lakāraviśeṣāpekṣatvādbahiraṅgamaḍāgamaṃ bādhitvā lamātrāpekṣatvādantaraṅgeṣu tibādiṣu kṛteṣu niyamo bhaviṣyati| "vikaraṇebhyo niyamo balīyān" iti siddhāntāt| atra ca "vṛdbhyaḥ syasanoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-92)iti syagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakamiti bodhyam| athedaṃ jñāpakaṃ vikaraṇavyavadhānepi niyamaḥ pravarttate ityevaṃparatayānīyeta tathāpyadoṣaḥ, antaraṅgatvāttibādiṣu satsu śabdāntaraprāptyā'nityayoraḍ‌vikaraṇayormadhye paratvādaṭpravṛtteḥ| nanu vikaraṇaḥ śabdāntarātprāpto na tu śabdāntarasyeti cet, kintataḥ? na hi "śabdāntarasya" iti vācanikam, kintu nyāyo'yam| tathā ca ca śabdāntarasya prāpnuvata iva tasmātprāpnuvatoṣyanityatvam| yadvyaktisambadhitayā pūrvaṃ prāpnoti tadvyaktisambandhitayā punaraprāptestulyattvāt| ata evopasarganiyame "aḍvyavāya upasaṅkhyānam"(kāovāo)iti vārttikaṃ pratyākhyātam "śadeḥ śitaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-60)iti sūtre bhagavatā bhāṣyakāreṇeti dik| arthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā nerupasārgasya grahaṇaṃ teneha na-madhūni viśanti bhramarāḥ| kathaṃ tarhi-
"ityuktvā maithilīṃ bhartturaṅke nivisatīṃ bhayāt"| (rao12-38)iti kālidāsa iti cet, aṅgāni viśatīmiti pāṭha iti apavādaviśayaparihāreṇotsargapravṛtteḥ| anyathā'tiprasaṅgāt| "vā lipsāyām"(kāovāo)ityādervaiyarthyāpatteśceti dik|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-18)
parivyavebhyaḥ kriyaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-18)| ebhyaḥ krīṇāterātmanepadaṃ syāt| ñittvādeva siddhe satyakartrabhiprāyārthoyamārambhaḥ| parikrīṇīte, vikrīṇīte, avakrīṇīte| paryādaya upasargā iha gṛhyante| tantrāvṛttyādyāśrayaṇena krīṇāterye paryādayastebhyaḥ kriya iti vyākhyānāt| parasparasāhacaryādvā| teneha na-`vikrīṇāsi' iti| atra tvekadeśavikṛtasyānnayatvātprapnoti| na cāyaṃ vibhaktiviśiṣṭasya virityasya vikāro na tu viśabdasyetyuttarasūtrasthakaiyaṭavākyād bhramitavyam, vibhakterlopāt| prakṛtibhāgasyaiva vikārāt| kaiyaṭasyāpyayamaparitoṣostyeva| ata eva vakṣyati-"pakṣivācino viśabdasya sambhave tu sāhacaryādupasargagrahaṇaṃ vyākhyeyam"iti|
(aṣṭāo1-3-19)
viparābhyāñjeḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-19)| spaṣṭorthaḥ| vijayate, parājayate| prāgvadupasargagrahānneha-vijayati, parājayati, senā| parā utkṛṣṭā| nanu `jeḥ' iti kathaṃ nirdeśaḥ| "prakṛtivadanukaraṇam" ityatideśena dhātutayā iyaṅi `jiyaḥ' iti vaktavyatvāt| na ca `niyaḥ' kriyaḥ' iti dīrghe sā vakāśamiyaṅaṃ paratvād "gherṅiti"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-111)iti guṇo bādhata iti yuktam| hasveṣvapi pūrvavipratiṣedheneyaṅ iṣṭatvāt| ata eva `kṣiyaḥ' iti nirdiśyate| kiñca "kṣiyo dīrghāt"(aṣṭāosūo8-2-46)iti sūtre dīrghagrahaṇamapīha jñāpakam| anyathā "kṣiyaḥ" iti nirdeśādeva dīrghasya nirṇaye kiṃ tena? ucyata-anityoyamatideśaḥ| ato neyaṅ| anityatāyāṃ pramāṇantu "ṛlṛk"(māosūo2)sūtra evoktam| avivakṣitārtharūpamātrānukaraṇādvā| yattu "parājerasoḍhaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-26) iti sūtre iyaṅa parattvād "gheḥ"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-111)iti guṇa iti haradattanoktam, taccintyam| "kṣiyo dīrghāt"(aṣṭāosūo8-2-46)ityetatsūtrasthabhāṣyakaiyaṭavṛttigranthaistatratyehatyasvagranthābhyāñca saha virodhāt|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-20)
āṅo donāsyaviharaṇe(aṣṭāosūo1-3-20)| āṅpūrvāddadātermukha vikasanādanyatrārthe varttamānādātmanepadaṃ syāt| vidyāmādatte| anāsyaviharaṇe kim? mukhaṃ `vyādadāti'| āsyagrahaṇamavivakṣitam| "upeyivānanāśvān"(aṣṭāosūo3-2-109)ityatropaśabdavat| tenehāpana-`vipādikāṃ vyādadāti'| pādasphoṭo vipādikā| nadīkūlaṃ vyādadāti| parāṅgakarmakādanāsyaiti niṣedho neṣyate| tathā ca vārttikam-svāṅgakarmakācceti(kāovāo)svamaṅgamiha na tu "adravaṃ mūrttimat" iti paribhāṣitam| vyādadate pipīlikāḥ pataṅgasya mukham| kathantarhi-"vyādatte vihagapatirmukhaṃ svakīyam"| kartrabhiprāye bhaviṣyati| akartrabhiprāyārtho hyayamārambhaḥ| etena `mukhaṃ vyādāya svapiti'ityatra `suptvā vyādatte' iti vyatyāsena prayoga iti pretya bhāvaparīkṣāyāṃ vācaspatigranthopi vyākhyātaḥ| āṅo ṅidviśiṣṭasya grahaṇānneha,-`bhikṣāmādadāti'| atra smṛtāvākāra iti haradttaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-21)
krīḍo'nusamparibhyaśca(aṣṭāosūo1-3-21)| "krīḍṛ vihāre"(bhvāopao350)asmādātmanepadaṃ syāt anusamparibhyaḥ| cakārādāḍaḥ| anukrīḍate, saṅkrīḍate, parikrīḍate, ākrīḍate| upasargeṇa samā sāhacaryādanoḥ karmapravacanīyānna| māṇavakamanukrīḍati| māṇavakena sahetyarthaḥ| "tṛtīyārtheḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-85)ityanoḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā| samo'kūjane(kāovāo)saṅkrīḍati śakaṭam| "mayāsya saṅkrīḍati cakricakraḥ" iti śrīharṣaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi-"krīḍate nāgarājaḥ" iti| apaprayoga evāyamityāhuḥ| āgameḥ kṣamāyām(kāovāo)ṇyantasyedaṃ grahaṇam| āgamayasva tāvat sahasva kañcitkālam, mā tvariṣṭhā ityarthaḥ| etena "yāvadāgamayate'tha narendrān" iti śrīharṣaprayogo vyākhyātaḥ| yāvatpratīkṣate ityarthāt| śikṣerjijñāsāyām(kāovāo)dhanuṣi śikṣate| "śikṣa vidyopādāne"(bhvāoāo506)ityasya neha grahaṇaṇ| anudāttettvādeva siddhatvāt kintu śakeḥ sannantasya| "sanimīma"(aṣṭāosūo7-4-54)itīs| dhanurviṣaye jñāne śakto bhavitumicchatītyarthaḥ| kriyaiva hiśakerthaṃ prati viṣayatayaivānveti| bhokktuṃ śaknotītyādidarśanāt| bhojanaviṣayakaśaktimāniti hi tadarthaḥ| "śakadhṛvajñāglāghaṭarabha"(aṣṭāosūo3-4-65)iti tumun| iha tu jñānaṃ viṣayaḥ| jñātumiti tu na prayujyate ātmanepadenaiva jñānaviṣayakatāyā gamitattvāt| na caivaṃ `jijñāsāyām' ityasaṅgatam| jñānecchā hi tadarthaḥ| lakṣye tu jñānaṃ śakto viṣayaḥ| śaktistu sanarthabhūtāyāmicchāyāmiti vyākhyānāt, satyam, jñānaviśiṣṭāyāḥ śaktericchāviṣayatayā jñātasyāpi viṣayatānapāyāt| etāvāneva parambhedaḥ| icchā sanvācyā śaktistu prakṛtyarthaḥ| tasyāstu jñānaviṣayakatvamātmanepadena dyotyataiti| āśiṣi nāthaḥ(kāovāo)anudāttettvādeva siddhe niyamārthaṃ vārtikam-"aśiṣyeva" iti| na caivamanudāttetvaṃ vyarthamiti vācyam| tasya `nāthane' iti yujarthatvāt| `sarpiṣo nāthate'| "āśiṣi nāthaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-55)iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| `sarpirme bhūyādityāśāste' ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi-"nāthase kimu patiṃ na bhūbhṛtām"(kio13-59)iti bhāraviḥ| ucyate-nādhase iti pāṭhaḥ| tavargacaturthasthāne lipipramādād dvitīyaḥ paṭhyate| ata eva kāvyaprakāśe cyutasaṃskṛterudāharaṇam--
"tatpallī patiputri kuñjarakulaṃ kumbhābhayābhyarthanā-
dīnaṃ tvāmanunāthate kucyugaṃ patrāvṛtaṃ mā kṛthāḥ'|
(kāoprao7-5)iti|
"anunāthati stanayugam" iti tu paṭhanīyamiti tatraivoktam| atrāpi dhakāro vā pāṭhyaḥ| haratergatatācchalye(kāovāo)gataṃ prakāraḥ| paitṛkamaśvā anuharante| mātṛkaṃ gāvo'nuharante| piturmātuścāgataṃ prakāraṃ satataṃ pariśīlayanatītyarthaḥ| "ṛtaṣṭhañ"(aṣṭāosūo4-3-78)"isusuktāntātkaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-51)| gatatācchīlye kim? māturanuharati| sādṛśyamātramiha vivakṣitaṃ na tu prakāratācchīlyam| kiraterharṣajīvikākulāyakaraṇeṣu(kāovāo)vikṣepārthaḥ kiratiḥ| harṣādayastu viṣayatvenopāttāḥ| tatra harṣo vikṣepasya kāraṇaṃ jīvikākulāyakaraṇe tu phalam| eṣvevārtheṣu "apāccatuṣpāt"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-142)iti suḍvidhīyate| apaskirate vṛṣo vṛṣṭaḥ, kukkuṭo bhakṣārthī, śvā āśrayārthī ca| harṣādiṣviti kim?`apākirati kusumam'| ihātmanepadasuḍāgamau na bhavataḥ| harṣādimātrasatve tu yadyapi taṅ prāpnoti, tadvidhau catuṣpācchakunikartṛkatvasya nimittatvenānupādānāt, tathāpi śabdaśaktisvābhāvyātsuṭā saha samānaviṣayo'yaṃ taṅ| tena gajo'pakirati ityeva bhavatītyāhuḥ| āṅi nuprach‌vyoḥ(kāovāo)ānute| utkaṇṭhāpūrvaṃ śabdaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| "ṇu stutau"(bhvāopao1035)adādiḥ| āpṛcchate| "praccha jñīpsāyām"(tuopao1414)tudādiḥ| "grahijyā"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-16)iti samprasāraṇam| "śapa upālambhane" "śapa ākrośe"(bhvāouo1000)iti svaritet| tasmādātmanepadamakartṛge'pi phale vaktvayaṃ śapatharūperthe| `devadattāya śapate' tvatpādau spṛśāmi naitanmayā kṛtamityekaṃ rūpaṃ śapathaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| "ślāghanhūṅsthāśapām'(aṣṭāosūo1-4-34)iti sampradānasaṃjñā| jñīpsyamāne-vivadante| tadyathā-"yasmai ākhyāyate sa sampradānam" ityeke| "ya ākhyāyate saḥ" ityanye| kathaṃ tarhi-
"nīvīmprati praṇihite tu kare priyeṇa
sakhyaḥ śāpāmi yadi kiñcidapi smarāmi"| iti||
atrādduḥ-`svāśayaṃ prakāśayāmi' ityetāvadiha vivakṣitaṃ na tu śapatha iti|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-22)
samavapravibhyaḥ sthaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-22)| ebhyastiṣṭhateḥ pragvat| santiṣṭhate, avatiṣṭhate, pratiṣṭhate, vitiṣṭhate| āṅaḥ pratijñāyāmupasaṃkhyānam(kāovāo)`śabdaṃ nityamātiṣṭhate' nityatvena pratijātīte ityarthaḥ| vṛttau tu `asti sakāramātiṣṭhate' `guṇavṛddhī āgamā vā tiṣṭhave, ityudāhṛtam| asyārthaḥ-āpiśalirhi "asa bhuva"
(aopao1065)iti na paṭhati kiṃ tu sakāramātram| staḥ santītyudāharaṇam| `asti' `āsīt' ityādisiddhaye tu aḍāṭāvāgamau pratijānīte| tāveva guṇavṛddhīti|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-23)
prakāśanasthekhyayośca(aṣṭāosūo1-3-23)| tiṣṭhateretayorarthayorātmanepadaṃ syāt| gopī kṛṣṇāya tiṣṭhate| svābhiprāyaṃ makāśayatītyarthaḥ| "ślāghah‌nūṅa"(aṣṭāosūo34)iti sampradānatvam| "saṃśacya karṇādiṣu tiṣṭhate yaḥ"(kio3-14)karṇādīnnirṇetṛttvenāśrayatītyarthaḥ| stheyo vivādapadanirṇetā tiṣṭhatesminniti vyutpatteḥ| vṛttau tu `tiṣṭhantyasmin' iti prayuktam| tatra prakaraṇāccidinā vivādapadanīrṇetuḥ pratītirna tu śābdītyabhiprāyeṇa parasmaipadaṃ bodhyam| "kṛtyalyuṭobahulam"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-113)iti adhikaraṇe "aco yat"(aṣṭoosūo3-1-17)|

udonūrdhvakarmaṇi(aṣṭāosūo1-3-24)| utpūrvāttiṣṭhateranurdhvattvaviśiṣṭe parispande varttamānādātmanepadaṃ syāt|
"uttiṣṭhamānastu paro nopekṣyaḥ pathyamicchatā"|(śio2-10)
anūrdhveti kim? "javena pīṭhādudatiṣṭhadacyuta-"(śio1-12)| iha kriyāyā anūrdhvatvaṃ nāma uparideśasaṃyogaphalakattvābhāvaḥ| yadyapi "udo'nūrdhva" ityukteranūrdhvatāviśiṣṭakriyāvācakatvaṃ labhyata eva dhātoḥ kriyāvācitvāvyabhicārāttathāpi lokaprasiddhaparispandātmakakarmaparigrahārthaṃ karmapadam| teneha na-`asmād grāmācchatamuttiṣṭhati'| utpadyata ityarthaḥ| tathā ca "uda īhāyām"(kāovāo)iti vārttikaṃ sautrakarmapadasiddhārthakathanaparam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-25)
upānmanūkaraṇe(aṣṭāosūo1-3-25)| mantrakaraṇaṃ kārakaviśeyatra tasminnarthe varttamānādupapūrvakāttiṣṭhaterātmanepadaṃ syāt| āgneya'gnīdhramupatiṣṭhate, aindryā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate| mantrakaraṇe kim? bhartāramupatiṣṭhati yauvanena| upāddevapūjāsaṅgatikaraṇamitrakaraṇapathiṣviti vācyam|(kāovā)devapūjāyāṃ ādityamupatiṣṭhate| kathaṃ tarhi-

devatāttvāropādbhaviṣyati| mahīpatedevatāṃśattvādvā| saṅgatakaraṇerathikānupatiṣṭhate| upaśliṣyatītyarthaḥ| evaṃ gaṅgā yamunāmupatiṣṭhate iti| mitrakaraṇantūpaśleṣaṃ vinā'pi bhavati| rathikānupatiṣṭhate| ayaṃ panthāḥ srughnamupatiṣṭhate| prāpnotītyarthaḥ| vā lipsāyāmiti vaktavyam| (kāovāo)bhikṣuko brāhmaṇamupatiṣṭhate, upatiṣṭhati vā, lipsayā hetubhūtayā upagacchatītyarthaḥ|

akarmakācca(aṣṭāosūo1-3-26)| upapūrvakāttiṣṭhaterakarmakādātmanepadaṃ syāt| bhojanakāle upatiṣṭhate| sannidhatte ityarthaḥ|

udvibhyāṃ tapaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-26)| ābhyāṃ tapaterakarmakādātmanepadaṃ syāt| uttapate, vitapate| dīpyata ityarthaḥ| svāṅgakarmakācceti vaktavyam(kāovāo)| svamaṅgaṃ svāṅgam| natu "adravam" iti paribhāṣitam| uttapade, vitapate pāṇim| akarmakātsvāṅgakarmakādityukteḥ svamaṅgaṃ svāṅgamiti vyākhyānācca neha-`devadatto yajñadattasya pāṇimuttapati'| santāpayatītyarthaḥ| suvarmamuttapati| santāpayati vilāpayati vetyarthaḥ| uddhibhyāṃ kim? niṣṭapati| "nisastapatāvanāsevane"(aṣṭāosūo8-3-102)iti mūrdhanyaḥ|

āṅo yamahanaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-28)| āṅpūrvābyāmakarmakābhyāṃ svāṅgakarmakābhyāñca yamihanibhyāmātmanepadaṃ syāt| āyacchate, āhate| āyacchate pāṇim| āhate śiraḥ| neha-parasya śira āhanti| kathaṃ tarhi "ājaghne viṣamavilocanasya vakṣaḥ"(kio170-63)iti bhāraviḥ| atra kecit-`āja' iti padaṃ chitvā `ghne' iti bhāve kvipi caturthyekavacanāntamuktvā ghne hantuṃ āja jagāmeti vyācakhyuḥ, tanna| arjerliṭi vibhāvena `vivāya' iti siddhāntāt| anye tu viṣamavilocanasya samipametya svaṃ vakṣamāsphālitavānityarthaḥ| mallo hyutsāhāviṣkaraṇāya svaṃ vakṣamāsphālayatītyāhuḥ| bhāgavṛttau tu pramāda evāyamityuktam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-29)
samogamyṛcchibhyām(aṣṭāosūo1-3-29)| sampūrvābhyāmakarmakābhyāṃ gamyṛcchibhyāmātmanepadaṃ syāt| saṅgacchate, samṛcchiṣyate| akarmakābhyāṃ kim? grāmaṃ saṅgacchati| kathantarhi "taccaikyaṃ samagacchata" iti ārpatvāt| yadvā-cāturvarṇyāditvātsvārthe ṣyañ| ekaṃ samapadyatetyarthaḥ| vidipṛcchisvaratīnāmupasaṅkhyānam(kāovāo) viderjñānārthasyeha grahaṇam| parasmaipadibhyāṃ sāhacaryāt na lābhārthasya| sa hi svaritettvādubhayapadī| sattāvicāraṇārthayostvanudāttetvādātmanepadaṃ siddhameva| saṃvitte, saṃvidāte, saṃvidate| sampṛcchate, saṃsvarate| arttiśrudṛśibhyaśceti vaktavyam(kāovāo)| `artti' itibhvādijuhotyādī dvāvapi gṛhyete| "sarttiśāsti"(aṣṭāosūo3-1-56) ityaṅ‌vidhau tu śāstinā luptavikaraṇena sāhacaryājjuhotyādereva grahaṇam| parasmaipadeṣu iti tūttarārthamanuvartamānamapi yogavibhāgasāmarthyādaṅ‌vidhau na sambadhyate| tena `māsamṛta' `māsamṛṣātāṃ' `māsamṛṣata' iti bhāṣyaṃ-bhvādyabhiprāyeṇa| `samārata' `samāretāṃ'`samāranta' iti vṛttistu juhotyādyabhiprāyeṇa yojyā| saṃśṛṇute sampaśyate| "rakṣāṃsīti purā'pi saṃśṛṇumahe" iti murāriprayogastu cintyaḥ| akarmakādityanuvṛtteḥ| vṛttikārastu "samo gamyṛcchipracchisvaratyarttiśruvidibhyaḥ" iti paṭhitvā "dṛśeśca" iti vaktavyarūpeṇa papāṭha| tatra vārttikānupūrvībhaṅge keṣāñcideva sūtre prekṣepe dṛśeśca tadvahiṣkāre bījaṃ na paśyāmaḥ| athāsminnakarmakādhikāre ye sakarmakā hanigamiprabhṛtayasteṣāṃ kathamakarmakatā| ucyate-
"dhātorarthāntare vṛtterdhātvarthenopasaṅgrahāt|
prasiddheravivakṣātaḥ karmaṇokarmikā kriyā"||
`vahati bhāram' iti prāpaṇe sakarmako vahiḥ| spandane tvakarmakaḥ| `vahanti nadyaḥ' iti| prāṇaviṃśiṣṭaṃ dhāraṇaṃ jīvatirāha| gātraviśiṣṭaṃ vikṣepañca nṛtyatiḥ| ato dvāvapyakarmakau| prasiddhoryathā-`megho varṣati' iti| karmaṇo'vivakṣāto yathā-"hitānna yaḥ saṃśṛṇute sa kiṃ prabhuḥ"(kiṃo1-5)| "upasargādasyatyūhyorvā" (kāovāo)iti vaktavyam| iti ārabhyākarmakāditi na sambadhyate| nirasyati, nirasyate| samūhati, samūhate| upasargātkim? asyati, ūhate| anudāttettvādātmanepadī| kathantarhi "anuktamapyūhati paṇḍito janaḥ "ityādi| cakṣiṅo ṅitkaraṇenānudāttettvalakṣaṇasyātmanepadasyānityatājñāpanātsamādheyam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-30)
nisamupavibhyo hvaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-30)| spaṣṭorthaḥ| nihvayate| akartrabhiprāyārthaṃ sūtram| syādetat--`nihvāsyate' itāyādyudāharaṇamastu na tu `nihvayate' iti| ākārāntasya sūtre upādānāt| ekārāntasya grahaṇābhāvāt| nahi vikṛtiḥ prakṛtiṃ gṛhṇātīti cet? ucyate-ākārāntādapi kathamabhyupaiṣi| nahi `hvaḥ' iti sūtre ākāraviśiṣṭaḥ paṭhitaḥ| prayogasamavāyināṃ vācakateti siddhāntarītyā `hvā' iti vāntasya ākārāntamarthaḥ| `dadhnā' ityatra nāntasya dadhī veti yadi tarhi vāntasyaiva ekārāntanartha ityapi tulyam| prakiyādaśāyāṃ hi ekārāntānukaraṇe lakṣamavaśādātvaṃ na tu ākārānta ihānukāryaḥ| tasmānna kiñcidihānupapannam| yattu nyāsakṛtoktaṃ "navyo liṭi"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-46)ityātvaniṣedhake sūtre kṛtātvasya `vya' ityasya nirdeśājjñāpakādvikṛtirapi prakṛtiṃ gṛhvātīti| soyamasthāne saṃrabhbhaḥ| uktarītyā pūrvapakṣasya śithilatvāt| "eranekācaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-82) "oḥ supi"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-83)ityādāvapi vikṛtigrahaṇe `śiśayiṣata' ityādāvapi yaṇāpatteḥ| vikṛteḥ prakṛtigrāhakatve `viśvarājau' ityatrāpi "viśvasya vasurāṭoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-128)iti dīrghaprasaṅgāt| `turāsāham' ityādau mūrdhanyaprasaṅgācceti dik|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-31)
kṣpardhāyāmāṅaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-31)| āṅpūrvāt hvayaterātmanepadaṃ syātspardhāyā viṣaye| mallamāhvayate| spardhamānastasyāvhānaṅkarotītyarthaḥ| spardhāyāṃ kim? putramāvhayati| yadyapi spardhāyāmapyayaṃ dhātuḥ paṭhyate tathāpi āṅpūrvakastatra na varttate kiṃ tu śabdane| ata eva svardhāyāṃ viṣaye ayaṃ vidhiriti vyākhyātam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-32)
gandhanāvakṣepaṇasevanasāhasikyapratiyatnaprakathanopayogeṣu kṛñaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-32)| saptasvartheṣu kṛña ātmanepadaṃ syādakartṛgepi phale| gandhanamiha sūcanam| tathāhi-"gandha ardane"(cuoāo1685) ardahiṃsāyām"(cuouo1829)iti ca curādau pāṭhādgandhanaṃ hiṃsā| sūcanamapi vadhabandhādikaraṇatvāddhiṃseti sa eveha gandhanaśabdārthaḥ| utkurute sūcayatītyarthaḥ| avakṣepaṇaṃ bhartsanam| śvayeno vartikāmudākurute bhartsayate ityarthaḥ| harimupakurute sevata ityarthaḥ| sahasā varttate sāhasikaḥ| "ojaḥ sahombhasā varttate(aṣṭāosūo4-4-27)iti ṭhak| tasya karma sāhasikyam| ṣyañ| paradārānprakurute teṣu sahasā pravarttata ityarthaḥ| pratiyatne-edho dakasyopaskurute| "avodaidhaudhma"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-29)iti nipātaḥ| samāhāradvandvaḥ| kṛñaḥ pratiyatne"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-53)iti ṣaṣṭhī| "upātpratiyatna"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-139)ityādinā suṭ| tasya guṇāntarādhānaṃ karotyarthaḥ| gāthāḥ prakurute| prakarṣeṇa kathayatītyarthaḥ| upayogaḥ samīcīno viniyogaḥ| śataṃ prakurute| dharmārthaṃ viniyuṅkta ityarthaḥ| eṣu kim? kaṭaṃ karoti|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-33)
adheḥ prasahane(aṣṭāosūo1-3-33)| adhipūrvātkṛñaḥ prāgvadabhibhavekṣamāyāñca| "ṣaha marṣaṇe"(bhvāoāo852)abhibhave ceti pāṭhāt| ye tu "abhibhave chandasi" iti paṭhanti teṣāmapi chandasīti prāyovāda iti haradattaḥ tamadhicakre| abhibhūtavān soḍhavānvetyarthaḥ| etena "bha-1--1."bhavādṛśāścedadhikurvate ratiṃ"(kio1-43)iti pāṭhaḥ| sa ca mallināthena ratiṃ santoṣaṃ adhikurvate svīkurvate cet iti vyākhyātaḥ| tenaiva ca "atra prasahanasyāsaṅgateradhipūrvāt karoteḥ "adheḥ prasahane"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-33)ityātmanepadaṃ na bhavati| prasahanaṃ paribhavaḥ iti kāśikā| tathā'pyasyāḥ kartrabhiprāyavivakṣāyāmava prayojakatvāt| kartrabhiprāye "svaritañitaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-72)ityātmanepadaṃ prasiddham" ityuktam|- vādṛśāścedadhikurvate parān'(kio1-43)iti bhāraviprayogo'pi vyākhyātaḥ| kṣamante ityarthāt|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-34)
ve) śabdakarmaṇaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-34)| vipūrvātkṛña ātmanepadaṃ syāt śabdaścetkarma kārakaṃ bhavati| svarānvikurute| uccārayatītyarthaḥ| śabdakarmaṇaḥ kim? cittaṃ vikaroti kāmaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-35)
akarmakācca(aṣṭāosūo1-3-35)| veḥ kṛñokarmakātprāgvat|
"hīnānyanupakartṝṇi pravṛddhāni vikurvate"|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-36)
sammānanotsañjanācāryakaraṇajñānabhṛtivigaṇanavyayeṣu niyaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-36)| eṣu bodhanīyeṣu nayaterātmanepadaṃ syāt| tatrotsañjanajñānavigaṇanavyayā nayatervācyāḥ| itare prayogopādhayaḥ| tathāhi ācāryaḥ śāstre nayate| śāstrīyasiddhāntānupapattibhiḥ sthirīkṛtya śiṣyebhyaḥ prāpayatītyarthaḥ| te ca śiṣyā yuktibhirniścāyyamānāḥ sammānitā bhavanti tadīyābhilāṣitārthasampādanāt| tathā cātra nayateḥ prāpaṇamevārthaḥ| śiṣyasammānanantu tadīyaṃ phalaṃ satprayogopādhiḥ| utsañjanedaṇḍamunnayate| utkṣipatītyarthaḥ| ācāryakaraṇe-māṇavakamupanayate| vidhinā ātmasamīpaprāpaṇamiha nayaterarthaḥ| tatphalaṃ māṇavakasaṃskāraḥ| tasya kartṛgāmitvābhāvādaprāptamātmanepadaṃ ācāryakaraṇe vidhīyate upanayanapūrvakeṇādhyāpanena hi kaścidatiśayodhyāpake janyate| sa evācāryaśabdapravṛttinimittam|
"upanīya dadadvedamācāryaḥ sa udādṛtaḥ"(yāosmṛo1-34)
ityapi atiśayaviśeṣaparicāyakaparam| tathā cācāryakaraṇaṃ phalībhūtaṃ prayogaupādhiḥ| na ca tasya kartṛgāmittvādātmanepadaṃ siddhameveti vācyam| nahi tadupanayanakriyāyāḥ sākṣātphalaṃ kintūpanayanapūrvikāyā adhyāpanakriyāyāḥ| prayogopādhittvaṃ tu paramparayā phalībhūtasyāpyastīti dik| "vininyurenaṃ guravo gurupriyam" ityatra tu ācāryakaraṇasyāvivakṣitatvānna taṅ| vivakṣā hi svāyatteti "upajñepakramaṃ tadādyācikhyāsāyām"(aṣṭāosūo2-4-21)itīcchāsanā jñāpitam| jñānetattvaṃ nayate| niścinotītyarthaḥ| bhṛtirvetanam| karmakarānupanayate| bhṛtidānenātmasamīpaṃ prāpayatītyarthaḥ| vigaṇanamṛṇāderniryātanam| karaṃ vinayate| rājadeyaṃ bhāgaṃ śodhayati| niryātayatītyarthaḥ| vyayo dharmādau viniyogaḥ| śataṃ vinayate| dharmārthaṃ viniyuṅkta ityarthaḥ| eṣu kim? ghaṭaṃ nayati|
kartṛsthe cāśarīre karmaṇi(aṣṭāosūo1-3-23)| niyaḥ kartṛsthekarmaṇi yadātmanepadaṃ prāptaṃ taccharīrāvayavabhinne eva syāt| śarīraśadbena tadavayavo lakṣyate| śarīratādātmyāpannasya kartṛtayā śarīrasya tatsthattvāsambhavāt| avayavānāntu sambandhaviśeṣeṇa tatsthattvasyānubhavāt| ata eva hi "karādi puruṣattvavyāpyam" ityuddhoṣaḥ| krodhaṃ vinayate| svakīyaṃ krodhamapagamayatītyarthaḥ| krodhāpanayanaphalasya cittaprasādādeḥ kartṛgatatvāt "svaritañitaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-72)iti sūtreṇa siddhe niyamārthamidam| teneha na-gaḍuṃ vinayati| kathantarhi "vigaṇayya nayanti pauruṣaṃ vijitakrodharayā jigīṣavaḥ"(kio2-35)iti bhāraviḥ| kartrabhiprāyattvāvivakṣāyāṃ bhaviṣyati| kecittu apanayane varttamānādanenātmanepadaṃ vidhīyate| iha tu karotyarthe prāptyarthe vā varttate| dhātūnāmanekārthattvādityāhuḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-38)
vṛttisargatāyaneṣukramaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-38)| krama ātmanepadaṃ syādapratibandhotsāhasphītatāsu| vṛttau-ṛcyasya kramate buddhiḥ| na pratihanyata ityarthaḥ| sarge-vyākaraṇādhyayanāya kramate| utsahata ityarthaḥ| "sṛjaterutsāhārthatā yenendralokāvajayāya sṛṣṭaḥ" ityādau prasiddhā| tāyane kramantesmin śāstrāṇi| sphītībhavantītyarthaḥ| "tāyṛsantānapālanayoḥ"(bhvāoāo489)ityasmālyuṭi `tāyanam'iti rūpam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-39)
upaparābhyām(aṣṭāosūo1-3-39)| vṛttyadiṣūpaparābhyāmeva kramerātmanepadaṃ syānna tṛpasargāntarapūrvāt| upakramate| ābhyāmeveti niyamānneha-saṅkrāmati| vṛttyādiṣvityeva| neha-upakrāmati parākrāmati|

āṅa udgamane(aṣṭāosūo1-3-40)| āṅpūrvatkramerudgamane varttamānādātmanepadaṃ syāt| ākramate ādityaḥ| udayata ityarthaḥ| jyotirudgamana iti vācyam(kāovā)| neha-ākrāmati dhūmo harmyatalāt| bhāṣye tu `harmyatalam' iti paṭhyate| tatrodgamanapūrvikāyāṃ vyāptau kramirdraṣṭavyaḥ na tṛdgamanamātre akarmakatāpatteḥ| kathantarhi "nabhaḥ samākrāmati candramāḥ kramāt" iti| ucyate-vyaptiviha kramirvarttate na tūdgamane|

veḥ pādaviharaṇe(aṣṭāosūo1-3-41)| vipūrvātkrameḥ pādaviharaṇe varttamānādātmanepadaṃ syāt| sādhu vikramate vājī| pādaviharaṇaṃ padavikṣepaḥ| yadyapi kramistatraivārthe paṭhyate tathāpi dhātunāmanekāryattvātsūtrerthopādānam| teneha na-vikrāmatyajinasandhiḥ dvidhābhāvati sphuṭatītyarthaḥ|

propābhyāṃ samarthābhyām(aṣṭāosūo1-3-42)| tulyārthābhyāṃ propābhyāṃ kramerātmanepadaṃ syāt| samastulyo'rtho yayoriti vigrahe śakandhvādittvātpararūpaṃ saśabda eva vā tulyortho bodhyaḥ| prārambe'nayostulyārthatā| prakramate, upakramate| ārabhate ityarthaḥ| samarthābhyāṃ kim? prakāmati gacchatītyarthaḥ| upakrāmati| āgacchatītyarthaḥ| "upaparābhyām"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-39)iti tu neha pravarttate| tatra vṛttyādigrahaṇānuvṛtteruktatvāt| iha ca vṛttyāderavivakṣaṇāt|

akarmakācca(aṣṭāosūo1-3-45)| akarmakājjānāterātmanepadaṃ syāt| sarpiṣo jānīte| sarpiṣā upāyena pravarttata ityarthaḥ| "jñovidarthasya"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-51)iti karaṇe ṣaṣṭhī| `akarmakāt' ityasya sthāne `sakaraṇāt' ityeva tu noktam| 'svareṇa putraṃjānāti" ityatrātivyāpteḥ|

sampratibhyāmanādhyāne(aṣṭāosūo1-3-46)| ābhyāṃ jānāterātmanepadaṃ syādanādhyāne| śataṃ sañjānīto| avekṣata ityarthaḥ| śatampratijānīte| aṅgīkarotītyarthaḥ| anādhyāne kim? mātuḥ sañjānāti| utkaṇṭhāpūrvaṃ smaratītyarthaḥ| "adhīgartha"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-52)iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| nanu tatra "śeṣe" ityanuvarttate tenātra karmaṇaḥ śeṣatvena vivakṣitattvāt "akarmakācca"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-45)iti pūrveṇa prāpnoti, atrāhuḥ-`anādhyāne' iti vibhajyate| sa cobhayoryogayoḥ śeṣaḥ tenādhyāne pūrveṇāpi na bhavatīti|

bhāsanopasambhāṣājñānayatnavimatyupamantraṇeṣu vadaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-47)| eṣvartheṣau vaderātmanepadaṃ syāt| atropasambhāṣopamantraṇe dhātorvācye| itare prayogopādhayaḥ| bhāsanandīptiḥ| śāstre vadate| bhāsamāno bravītītyarthaḥ| bhāsanaṃ hetubhūtaṃ saddhiśeṣaṇaṃ śiṣyaiḥ stūyamāno hi bhāsate| tathā coparyupari śāstrārthapratibhāsātsuṣṭhūktirnirvahati| tejobhaṅge tu na śaknuyādvaditumiti bhāvaḥ| upasambhāṣo upasāntvanam| karmmakarānupavadate| upasāntvayatītyarthaḥ| jñāne-sāstre vadate| uktiviṣayakajñānavāniti phalitorthaḥ| yatnaḥ utsāhaḥ| kṣetre vadate| tadviṣayakamutsāhamāviṣkarotītyarthaḥ| atrāviṣkraraṇarūpasva vadattyarthasya yatnaḥ karmetyāhuḥ| viśiṣṭo'tra vadaterthaṃ ityapi suvacam| vimatau-kṣetre vivadante| vimatyā hetubhūtayā nānāvidhaṃ bhāṣanta ityarthaḥ| upamantraṇam upacchandanam| kulabhāryāmupavadate| svābhilaṣite pravarttayituṃ prārthayata ityarthaḥ| eṣviti kim? yatkiñcidvadati|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-48)
vyaktavācāṃ samuccāraṇe(aṣṭāosūo1-3-48)| manuṣyādīnāṃ sambhūyoccāraṇe vaderātmanepadaṃ syāt| sampravadante brāhmaṇāḥ devā vā| yadyapi vada dhāturvyaktāyāmeva paṭhyate, tathāpi "vyaktavācām" ityupādānasāmarthyādyeṣāṃ prasiddhataraṃ vyaktavākyantadeveha gṛhyate| tena śukasārikādīnāṃ samuccāraṇe na bhavati| "varatanu sampravadanti kukkuṭāḥ"| nanvihatanuśabdasya hrasvāntatve sambuddhau ceti guṇena bhāvyaṃ dīrghāntatve nadīlakṣaṇaḥ kap prāpnoti? satyam, tanuśabdaḥ strījātau kavibhiḥ prayujyate| tasmāt "ūṅutaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-66)ityūṅi kṛte karmadhārayo'yamiti haradattaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-49)

dāṇaśca sā ceccaturthyarthe(aṣṭāosūo1-3-55)| sampūrvāddāṇastṛtīyāntena yuktādātmanepadaṃ syātsā cettṛtīyā caturthyarthe| dāsyā saṃyacchate| kāmukaḥ saṃstayai dadātītyarthaḥ| aśiṣṭavyavahāre caturthyarthe tṛtīyā vaktavyā(kāovāo)| etaccānenaiva jñāpyate| yadvā-iha sūtre cecchabdaścaśabdārthe| nipātānāmanekārthatvāt| sā ca caturthyarthe bhavatītyarthaḥ| "aśiṣṭavyavahāra" iti tu vaktavyameva| bhāṣye tvidaṃ sūtramapi pratyākhyātam| tathāhi-"yo dāsyā saha bhūñjānastayā dattaṃ svayaṃ bhuṅkte svayañca tasyai dadāti tadviṣaye'yaṃ prayoga iṣyate| tatra "sahayukte"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-19)ityeva tṛtīyā| karmavyatihāre ca taṅ| dānapūrvake bhoge dāṇdhāturbodhyaḥ" iti| nanvārabhyamāṇe sūtre `samprayacchata' ityatra kathaṃ taṅ `samaḥ' iti pañcamyā ānantaryalābhāt| atrāhuḥ-`samaḥ' iti viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhī tena pūrvasūtramapi `aśvena samudācarate' ityādau pravarttata iti dāsyā samprayacchate ityudāhṛtya śiṣṭavyavahāre tu `brāhmaṇībhyaḥ samprayacchati' iti pratyudāharan bhāṣyakāraśceha vyākhyāne pramāṇam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-56)
upādyamaḥ svakaraṇe(aṣṭāosūo1-3-56)| upapūrvādyameḥ prāgvat svīkāre'rthe| bhāryāmupayacchate| yatsvasya sato rūpāntareṇa karaṇaṃ tadiha na gṛhyate ki ntvasvasya sato yatsvatvasampādanaṃ tadeva| cvipratyayastu sūtre na kṛtaḥ "samarthānāṃ prathamādvā"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-82)iti vikalpitatvāt| teneha na-svaṃ śāṭakamupayacchatīti| atra vṛttikāraḥ pāṇigrahaṇa eveṣyate| teneha na-devadatto yajñadattasya bhāryāmupayacchati| dāsītvena rūpeṇa svīkarotītyartha iti| etacca bhāṣyaviruddham| tatra svīkāramātre ātmanepadasyoktatvāt| tathā ca bhaṭṭiḥ prāyuṅkta--
"upāyaṃsta mahāstrāṇi śastrāṇyapāyaṃsata jitvarāṇi"|
"nopāyaṃsta daśānanaḥ"| "upāyaṃsata nāsavam" ityādi|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-57)
jñāśrusmṛdṛśāṃ sanaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-57)| sannantānāmeṣāmātmanepadaṃ syāt| "apanhave jñaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-44)ityādibhiḥ sūtrairjānāterātmanepadaṃ vihitaṃ śrudṛśorapi "samogamyṛcchibhyām"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-29)ityatropasaṅkhyānam| tasmiṃśca viṣaye "pūrvavatsanaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-62)ityeva siddham| viṣayāntare'nena vidhīyate smaratestu aprāpta eva vidhānam| dharmaṃ jijñāsate, śuśrūṣate, susmūrṣate, didṛkṣate|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-58)
nānorjñaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-58)| anupūrvājjānāteḥ sannantādātmanepadaṃ na syāt| putramanujijñāsati| anoḥ kim? dharmaṃ jijñāsate| pūrvasūtreṇa prāptasyāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ| "anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā" iti nyāyāt| tathā ca sakarmakasyaiva pratiṣedha iti phalitam| pūrvasūtrasya sakarmakaviṣayatvādakarmakāttu "pūrvavatsanaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-62)ityātmanepade bhavatyeva| "akarmakācca"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-45)iti sūtreṇa kevalādvidhānāt| -1--1."jñovidarthasyakaraṇe'(aṣṭāosūo2-3-41)ityanena ṣaṣṭhī|-auṣadhasyānujijñāsate auṣadhena pravarttitumicchatītyarthaḥ|
