(aṣṭāosūo1-3-60)
śadeḥ śitaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-60)| śitaḥ prakṛtibhūto yaḥ śadistasmādātmanepadaṃ syāt| śīyate, śīyante| śitaḥ kim? śatsyati, aśatsyat| "śeṣātkarttari'(aṣṭāosūo1-3-78)iti parasmaipadam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-61)
mriyaterluṅliṅośca(aṣṭāosūo1-3-61)| śito luṅliṅośca prakṛtibhūto yo mriyatistata evātmanepadaṃ syānnānyasmāt| tatra śitprakṛtitvaṃ pūrvavacchidutpatteḥ prāgeva yogyatayā bodhyam| luṅliṅostu satyāmevoṃtpattau bodhyam| mriyate, mriyatām, amriyata, amṛta, mṛṣīṣṭa| niyamaḥ kim? mamāra, marttāsi, mariṣyati, amariṣyat| ṅitvaṃ tu svarārtham| mā hi mṛta| luṅi "tāsyanudāttet"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-186)iti ṅillakṣaṇaḥ sārvadhātukamighātaḥ| "hi ca"(aṣṭāosūo8-1-34)iti tiṅi nighātapratiṣedhaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-62)
pūrvavatsanaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-62)| sanaḥ pūrvo yo dhātustena tulyaṃ sannantādapyātmanepade syāt| yena nimittena sanaḥ prakṛterātmanepadaṃ vidhīyate tadeva nimittaṃ sanā vyavahitaṃ sadapyātmanepadaṃ pravarttayatītyarthaḥ| iha sūtre "tena tulyam'(aṣṭāosūo5-1-115)iti tṛtīyāntādvatirna tu pañcamyantāt, lakṣaṇābhāvāt| yathā ca `brāhmaṇena tulyaṃ vaiśyādadhīte' ityatra brāhmaṇādiveti gamyate tathehāpi pūrvasmādiveti gamyate| brāhmaṇāpādānakedhyayane brāhmaṇaśabdasya lakṣaṇayā brāhmaṇāpādānakādhyayanasādṛśyaṃ vaiśyāpādānakādhyāpanamiti kriyāsāmyaṃ dṛṣṭānte nirvāhyam| anyathā vatipratyayāyogāt| yadāha-"tena tulyaṃ kriyā cet"(aṣṭāosūo5-1-115)iti| evañca prakṛte'pi ātmanepadabāvanasya tulyatvaṃ bodhyam| tadapi nimittasya tulyatvāttaddvārakamiti phalitorthaḥ| etena `śabdo'nityaḥ, kṛtakatvāt| ghaṭavat' ityādi vyākhyātam| tatrāpi bhavanakriyāyāḥ sāmyāt| anyathā vatpratyayāsādhutāpatteḥ| ata evānityo bhavitumarhatīti prāñcaḥ prayuñjate| sādhyapadasya jñāne lakṣaṇayā jñānayoḥ sāmyaṃ vākyārtha iti vāstu| sarvathāpi śabdaghaṭayoḥ sāmyārthaṃ na tu śābdamiti dik| āsisiṣate, śiśayiṣate, nivivikṣate, bubhukṣate, ityādi| iha tu na bhavati-śiśatsati, mumūrṣati| na hyoṣā śadimriyativyaktiḥ śitaḥ prakṛtiḥ ato nātmanepadanimittam| kṛte hi sani sannantameva śitaḥ prakṛti| `śiśayiṣate' ityādau tu prakṛtau ṅittvānapāyānnimittātideśaḥ sambhavatyeveti vaiṣamyāt| nanvevaṃ `anucikīrṣati' ityatrātiprasaṅgaḥ| gandhanāderarthasya ñitvasya cātmanepadanimittasyātideśāpatteriti cenna| "anuparābhyāṃ kṛñaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-79)iti vacanaparyālocanayā anupūrvakatvābhāvaviśiṣṭasyaivātmanepadanimittatādhyavasāyāt| astu vā prādhānyātkāryasyaivātideśaḥ prāksano yebhya ātmanepadaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tebhyaḥ sannantebhyopi bhavatīti| na caivaṃ `śiśatsati' `mumūrṣati' ityatrātiprasaṅgaḥ "śadeḥśitaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-60)"mriyaterluṅ liṅośca"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-61)iti sūtradvaye'pi sano netyanuvartya vākyabhedena sannantānniṣedhāt| `jugupsate' ityādau tu yadyapyayamatideśo na prāpnoti| nityasannantatatayā prāk sana ātmanepadādarśanāt| tathāpi "anudāttaṅitaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-12)ityanenaivātmanepadam| avayave hyacāritārthaṃ liṅgaṃ samudāyaṃ viśinaṣṭi sāmarthyāt| na caivaṃ `jugupsati' ityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ| sanūparyantaviśeṣaṇena cāritārthye sati tato'pyadikaviśeṣaṇe pramāṇābhāvāt| nanvevaṃ `gopayati' `tejayati' ityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ| san‌ṇicormadhye kataradviśeṣaṇīyaṃ katarannetyatra viniyāmakābhāvāditi| atrāhuḥ-yatra nindādau sanniṣyate tadarthakā evānudāttetaḥ nityasannantāścaite| arthāntare tvananubandhakā eva curādau pāṭhyāḥ| anyathā nindākṣamādibhyonyatra yathā ṇij bhavati tatā laḍādirapi syāt|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-63)
ām‌pratyayavatkṛñonuprayogasya|(aṣṭāosūo1-3-63)| ām‌pratyayo yasmādityatad‌guṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrīhiḥ| ām‌prakṛtibhūtasya dhātorivānuprayujyamānātkaroterāmanepadaṃ syāt| ñittvādeva siddhe'kartrabhiprāyārthaṃ sūtram| īhāñcakre| nanvasya vidhyarthattvāt `indāñcakāra' ityādāvapi kartrabhiprāye taṅ prāpnoti, satyam, pūrvavadityanuvarttate, tatsāmarthyādvākyabhedena niyamo'pi kriyate pūrvavadevātmanepadaṃ na tu pūrvaviparītamapīti| kṛñaḥ kim? īhāmāsa, īhāmbabhūva| iha kṛñ‌grahaṇasāmarthyānna pratyāhāragrahaṇam| ataeva ca jñāpakādanuprayogavidhau pratyāhāragrahaṇam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-64)
propābhyāṃ yujerayajñapātreṣu(aṣṭāosūo1-3-64)| propābhyāṃyujerayoga ityasmādātmanepadaṃ syādayajñapātreṣu| prayuṅkte, upayuṅkte| yujiraḥ svariteto rudhāderakartrabhiprāyārtho'yaṃ vidhiḥ| "yuja samādhau(ruouo1445)iti divādestu neha grahaṇam| anudāttettvādeva siddheḥ| sūtre yujaritīkārasya vivakṣitatvācca| yajñapātraviṣayatāyāstatrāsambhavācca| svarādyanto pasṛṣṭāditi vaktavyam(kāovāo)svaroc‌ādiranto vāyasya tādṛśenopasargeṇa sambaddhādityarthaḥ| sam nis nir dus dur etadbhinnāḥ sarvepyupasargāḥ saṅ‌gṛhītāḥ| udyuṅkte, niyuṅkte| ayajñapātreṣu kim? dvandvaṃ nyañcipātrāṇi prayunakti|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-65)
samaḥ kṣṇuvaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-65)| sampūrvātkṣṇudhātoḥ prāgvat| "samogamyṛcchibhyām'(aṣṭāosūo1-3-29)ityato vicchidya pāṭhaḥ sakarmakādapi vidhānārthaḥ| saṃkṣṇute śastram|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-66)
bhujo'navane(aṣṭāosūo1-3-66)| rakṣaṇātirikte'rthe varttamānād bhujeḥ prāgvat| "bhujo'bhakṣaṇe' iti vaktavye'navana iti vacanamarthāntareṣvapi yathā syāt| bhujerhi pālanābhyavahārādivopabhoga ātmasāt‌karaṇaṃ cārthaḥ| odanambhuṅkte abhyavaharatītyarthaḥ|
'babhuje pṛthivīpālaḥ pṛthivīmeva kevalām'|
"di-1--1.`bhuvam' iti pāṭhaḥ mallināthakṛtasañjīvinyām|-vaṃ marutvāniva bhokṣyate mahīm"|(rao3-4)|
neha pālanamarthaḥ kintūpabhoga ātmasātkaraṇaṃ vā| etena "vṛddho jano duḥkhaśatāni bhuṅkte" iti vyākhyātam| anavane kim? mahīṃ bhūnakti| rudhādereveha grahaṇam| avanapratiṣedhāt| paṭhanti hi-"sayogo viprayogaśca" ityupakramya "viśeṣasmṛtihetavaḥ" iti| yathā dogdhrīparyāyo dhenuśabdaḥ saṃsargibhirviśeṣe'vasthāpyate| `savatsā dhenurānīyatāṃ' `sakiśorāḥ' `savarkarā' iti, tathā'vatsā'kiśorā'barkareti gaurdhenurvaḍavā ajāca krameṇānīyate nānyā tathehāpi| tena "bhuja kauṭilye'(ruoāo1455)ityasya tudāderagrahaṇānneha-vibhujati pāṇimiti|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-67)
ṇeraṇau yatkarma ṇau cetsa kartta'nādhyāne(aṣṭāosūo1-3-67)| ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ syādanādhyāne| aṇau yatkarma ṇau cediti dvitīyaṃ vākyam| karmeha kriyā ṇicprakṛtyupāttā yā saiva ceṇṇyantenocyetetyarthaḥ| sakarteti tṛtīyaṃ vākyam| aṇāvityādyanuvartate karmeha kārakaṃ śabdādhikārāśrayaṇāt| ṇicprakṛterarthaṃ prati yatkarma kārakaṃ sa ceṇṇyante karttetyarthaḥ| "ṇicaśca"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-74)ityātmanepadaṃ siddhe'pi akartrabhiprāyārthamidaṃ sūtram| kartrabhiprāye'pi "vibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-77)iti vikalpabādhanārthañca| "aṇāvakarmakāt"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-88)iti parasmaipadabādhanārthañca| na cākartrabhiprāye caritārthasyāsya vikalpaparasmaipadābhyāṃ parābhyāṃ bādhaḥ syāditi vācyam| pūrvavipratiṣedhāśrayaṇāt| atra ca pramāṇaṃ `darśayate rājā' iti bhāṣyodāharaṇamiti dik| udāharaṇantu kartṛsthabhāvakāḥ kartṛsthakriyāśca| tatra hi karmavadbhāvo nāstīti vakṣyate| prakṛtasūtreṇaiva tvātmanepadam| tathā hi-viṣayattvāpattyupasarjanaviṣayatvāpādānavacano dṛśiḥ sakarmakāṇāmaśabdābhidhāyitāniyamāt| tatra dhātūpāttavyāpārāśrayaḥ karttā dhātvarthabhūtavyāpāravyadhikaraṇaphalaśālikarma tatha ca `paśyanti bhavaṃ bhaktāḥ' iti prayogaḥ cākṣuṣajñānena viṣayīkurvantītyarthaḥ| yadā tu saukaryātiśayavivakṣayā preraṇāṃśastyajyate tadā `paśyati bhavaḥ' iti prayogaḥ viṣayībhavatītyarthaḥ| uktañca--
"nivṛttapreṣaṇaṃ karma svakriyāvayavaiḥ sthitam|
nivarttamāne karmatve svekartṛtvevatiṣṭhate" iti||
tataḥ paśyantaṃ prerayantīti ṇici `darśayanti bhavaṃ bhaktāḥ' iti prayogaḥ| paśyantītyarthaḥ| uktañca--
"nivṛttapreṣaṇāddhātoḥ prākṛte'rthe ṇijucyate" iti|
tataḥ punarṇyarthasya saukaryadyotanārthamavivakṣāyāṃ `darśayate bhavaḥ' viṣayībhavatītyarthaḥ| tadiha paśyatidarśayatyoḥ samānārthatayā kartṛsthabhāvakattvācca karmavadbhāvavirahe prakṛtasūtreṇātmanepadam| iha hi ṇicprakṛtibhūtena dṛśinā ya evārtho dvitīyakakṣāyāmupāttaḥ sa evaṃ caturthyāmiti sāmānakriyatvamasti aṇau yatkarma prathamakakṣāyāṃ tadeva kartṛ| evaṃ `ārohayate hastī' ityapyudāharaṇam| "ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ'| nyagbhāvayantītyarthaḥ| `ārohati hastī' nyagbhavatatyirthaḥ| tato nivṛttapreṣaṇāṇṇici `ārohayanti' ārohantītyarthaḥ| tataḥ punarṇyarthatyāge `ārohayate' nyagbhavatītyarthaḥ| ihāpi prāgvatprathamatṛtīyayordvitīyacaturthyoścārthasāmyāccaturthī kakṣā udāharaṇam| soyaṃ nivṛttapreṣaṇapakṣaḥ| āha ca--
"nyagbhāvanaṃ nyagbhavanaṃ ruhau śuddhe pratīyate|
nyagbhāvanaṃ nyagbhavanaṃ ṇyantepi pratipdayate"||
avasthāṃ pañcamīmāha ṇyantatatkarmakarttari|
nivṛttapreṣaṇāddhātoḥ prākṛte'rthe ṇijucyate" iti||
iha viśiṣṭavācakayoḥ śruddhaṇyantayorvācyāvaṃśau vācakabhedāt dvedhā gaṇayittvā pūrvoktaprathamatṛtīyakakṣāyāmavasthācatuṣṭayañcaturthakakṣāyāntu pañcamī hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ' iti prāgvadeva prathamakakṣā| tataḥ saukaryadyotanārthaṃ karmaṇā eva preṣaṇamadhaayāropya ṇic kriyate| `darśayati bhavaḥ' `ārohayati hastī' iti paśyata ārohataśca prerayatītyarthaḥ| tato ṇicprakṛtibhyāṃ ṇij‌bhyāñcopāttayordvayorapi preṣaṇayoryugapattyāge `darśayate' `ārohayate' ityudāharaṇam| viṣayībhavati nyagbhavatīti ca pūrvavadevārthaḥ| soyamadhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣa ihādhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣe `darśayati bhavaḥ' `ārohayati hastī' iti dvitīyakakṣāyāmativyāptiṃ vārayituṃ samānakriyatvaparaṃ dvitīyaṃ vākyam| tena preṣaṇādhikyānnātivyāptiḥ| nivṛttapraṣeṇapakṣe `darśayanti bhavam' `ārohayanti hastinam' ityevaṃrūpaṃ tṛtīyaṃ vākyam| iha tu aṇau karmaṇorbhavahastinoḥ karmatvameva na tu kartṛteti nātivyāptiḥ atra prāñcaḥ-aṇau yatkarmeti vākyaṃ karmāntaranivṛttiparam| tathā hi-yattadornityasambandhādiha yacchabdena tacchabda ākṣipyate| dharmāntarasya cānirddeśāduddeśyatayāpi śrutaṃ karmatvameva vidhīyate| tacca vidhīyamānaṃ sāmarthyāṇṇerityasya sannihitattvācca ṇyantāvasthāyāmeva vidhīyate| na hyaṇau tadvidhānaṃ sambhavati aṇau yatkarmetyanuvādasāmarthyādeva tatsiddheḥ| tadevamaṇau yatkarmetyetāvata evāṇau yatkarma ṇau cettatkarmetyarthaḥ phalitaḥ| anena ca karmāntaranivṛttiḥ kriyate| na ttvaṇau karmaṇo ṇau karmatvaṃ pratipādyate| sa karmetyuttaravākyena tasya kartṛttvapratipādanāt| ekasya yugapadekasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ karmakartṛttvayorasambhavāttasmāt,
"uddeśapratinirdeśāllabdhe yatsaṅgrahe punaḥ|
dadbraho vākyabhedena karmāntaranivṛttaye"|
tato ṇau cediti vākyāntaram| aṇau yadityeva aṇau yatprātepādyaṃ vastu tadeva ṇau pratipādyañcedityarthaḥ iti vyācakhyuḥ| atredaṃ cintyam-karmāntaranivṛttiparaṃ vyākhyānaṃ yadyapi karttuṃ śakyaṃ tathāpi tasya phalaṃ durllabham| `ārohayamāṇo hastī' `sthalamārohayati manuṣyan' ityasya vyāvṛttiḥ phalamiti cenna, tatra samānakriyatvābhāvāt| "ṇau cet" iti vākyaṃ hi pratipādyasāmyārthamiti vṛttipadamañjaryoḥ sthitam| na ceha tadasti| na cāstu vṛtyādimate doṣo'yaṃ bhāṣyakaiyaṭayostu samānakriyatvasyānuktatvātkarmāntaravyāvṛttiphalakaṃ vākyaṃ sārthakameveti cet, na, bhāṣyamatepi samānakriyatvasya vyākhyeyatvāt| tasyānuktatvepyapratyākhyātatayā sammatatvāt| anyathā adhyāropitapreṣaṇe dvitīyakakṣāyāmatiprasaṅgāt| bhāṣyavārttikayoḥ karmaśabdasya kriyāparatayaiva vyākhyātuṃ śakyatvācca| abhyupetyāpi brūmaḥ-māstu bhāṣyamate samānakriyatvaṃ tathāpi `darśayate bhṛtyān rājā' ityudāharaṇaṃ vyācakṣāṇena kaiyaṭena aṇau ye kartṛkarmaṇī tadbhinnaṃ karma vyāvartyate iti tāvatspaṣṭīkṛtam| tathā ca `manuṣyān' ityasyāṇau kartṛtayā gatyarthād drūherṇau karmatve'pi durvāramātmanepadam| manuṣyasthalayoraṇau kartṛkarmaṇoreveha karmatayā taditarakarmābhāvāt| api ca, sakarttetyaṃśo'pīha nāsti| hastina eva kartṛttvāt| syādatet-`ārohayamāṇaḥ' ityatrāṇau karmaṇo hastina eva kartṛttvaṃ sa eva ca `sthalamārohayati' ityatrāpi kartteti, tadapi na| pratyāsattibalenaivātiprasaṅgabhaṅgāt| tathā hi-ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ syādaṇau yatkarma sa cetkarttetyukte pratyāsatteretadgamyate| "yena ṇicāṇyantādātmanepadaṃ vidhitsitaṃ tatprakṛtau yatkarma sa cetkarttā" iti| iha tu yatrāyamupādhiḥ kṛtameva tatrātmanepadam| `ārohayamāṇaḥ' iti yatra tu na kṛtaṃ `sthalamārohayati' iti na tatrāyamupādhirasti, yenātivyāptiḥ syāt| yattu haradattenoktam-"hastipakānārohayati hastī ityatra mā bhūt" iti| tatredaṃ vaktavyam-kimidamadhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣe dvitīyakakṣāyāmudāharaṇaṃ kiṃ vā nivṛttapreṣaṇapakṣa iti? nādyaḥ, ṇijvācyavyāpārabhedena samānakriyattvābhāvāt| na dvitīyaḥ, tatrādyayoḥ kakṣayoraṇyantattvāt| tṛtīyasyāntu hastinaḥ kartṛtvāyogāt| hastipakānāṃ karmattvāsambhavācca| tasmāccaturthī pariśiṣyate| tatrāpi nyagbhavatītyarthāparyavasānena karmaṇo nānvayaḥ spaṣṭa eva| svādetat-`darśayate bhṛtyān rājā' iti tāvadbhāṣye svīkṛtaṃ tatsamarthanāya aṇau ye kartṛkarmaṇī taditarakarmavyavacchedo'bhipreta ityāha kaiyaṭaḥ| tasyāpyayamāśayaḥ-aṇau yatkarmetyatra "karttari karma"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-14) ityatonuvṛttaṃ `karttari' ityetatprathamayā vipariṇamyate| yaśca yacca yaditi "napuṃsakamanapuṃsakena"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-69)ityekaśeṣaḥ| tena karmakartrorṇau karmattvepyadoṣaḥ| evañca "kareṇurārohayate niṣādinam" iti māghaprayogaupyupapadyata iti| evaṃ sthite nivṛttapreṣaṇādhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣayordvayorapi caramakakṣāyāmakarmakatayā bhāṣyakaiyaṭādigranthāḥ sarvaevānanvitāḥ syustatkiṃ haradattaṃ pratyeva paryanuyogena| etāvāneva hi bhedaḥ bhāṣyamate'ṇau ye kartṛkarmaṇoriti vyākhyānādudāharaṇamidaṃ vṛttikāraharadattādimate tu pratyudāharaṇam| aṇau yatkarmetyeva vyākhyānāditi| atrocyate-anananvayastāvaduruddharaḥ| bādhe dṛḍhe'nyasāmyātkiṃ dṛḍhenyadapi bādhyatāmiti nyāyāt| `gambhīrāyāṃ nadyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' ityatra gambhīranadīpadārthayorebhedabodānantaraṃ tīralakṣaṇāyāmapi prāthamikabodhamādāya gambhīrapadasārthakyavadihāpyadhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣe dvitīyakakṣāyāṃ karmaṣyanvite tato ṇijaryasyeva karmaṇo'pi tyāge ṇicaḥ karmapadasya ca prāthamikabodhamādāya kathaṃ citsārthakyam| svajñāpyasambandho lakṣaṇetyabhyupagamāt| eṣaiva "arthavādaiḥ prāśastyalakṣaṇāyāṃ gatiḥ" iti kaiyaṭasyoktisambhavo bodhyaḥ| niṣkarṣastu karmavyavacchedavākyārtho bhāṣyavārttikayoranabhimata eva, uktarītyā prayojanābhāvāt| granthastu karmapadasya kriyāparatāyāṃ sustha eva| udāharaṇeṣu tu bhṛtyānityāderavivakṣāyāṃ karmavyāpāramātre vivakṣite siddhaṃ bhavatītyevāśayo bodhyaḥ| "smarayatyenaṃ vanagulmaḥ svayameva" iti bhāṣyavṛttyorvyākhyāvasare enamiti karmaṇo vivakṣāyāḥ keyaṭaharadattābhyāmubhābhyāmapi śaraṇīkṛtattvācca| yattu sūtraśeṣe kaiyaṭenainamityasya vivakṣeti pugaḥ pratipāditaṃ tadeva tvāpātata iti dik| tasmāt--
"bhṛtyādīnāṃ parityāgācchabdabhedātparigrahāt|
karmavākye ca tādarthyavarmanātsarvamujjvalam"||
syādetat-sakarmakāṇāṃ sarveṣāmaṃśadvayābhidhāyitayā karmakarttari karmavadbhāvātideśādeva siddhānīha mūlodāharaṇāni| nacādhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣe `ārohayatau hastinaḥ' karmatvābhāvātsamānadhātau ca karmatvābhāvena `pacatyodanaṃ devadattaḥ' `rādhyatyodanaḥ svayameva' itivātkarmavadbhāvo na prāpnotīti vācyam| nivṛttapreṣaṇaprakriyayaiva sakalalakṣyasaṅgrahāt| adhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣaparityāge'pi kṣatyabhāvāt| na ca dṛśeḥ kartusthabhāvakatayā ruheśca kartṛsthakriyatayā karmavadbhāvo na prāpnotīti vācyam| pacibhidyādibhyo vailakṣaṇyasya durupapādatvāt| vikledanādvidhābhāvanayorapi kartṛsthatāpattau karmavadbhāvātideśasya nirviṣayatāpatteḥ| tatra vyāpārāṃśasya kartṛsthatve'pi viklittidvidhābhavanarūpaṃ phale karmasthe iti| yadi tarhi dṛśiruhyorapi viṣayatvanyagbhāvau karmasthāviti tulyam| tasmādiha vaiṣamye bījaṃ vaktavyamiti cet, atrāhurbhartṛhariḥ-
"viśeṣadarśanaṃ yatra kriyā tatra vyavasthitā|
kriyāvyavasthātvanyeṣāṃ śabdaireva prakalpitā" iti||
asyārthaḥ-yatra kriyāprayukto viśeṣo dṛśyate yathā-pakveṣu taṇḍuleṣu yathā vā| chinneṣu kāṣṭheṣu tatra kriyā sthitā| tena `pacyate odanaḥ "chidyate kāṣṭham' iti karmmavadbhāvaḥ siddhaḥ| anyeṣāṃ mate-anyoṣāṃ dhātūnāṃ vāśabdaireva kriyāvyavasthā| śabdena kartṛvyāpārasyaiva prādhānyenāvagamātkartṛsthatetyarthaḥ| uddeśatāpi kvacitkarmasthāṃśasya kvacittu vyāpārāṃśasyeti autsargikaṃ niyāmakaṃ bodhyaṃ tadiha darśanarohaṇābhyāṃ viṣaye nyagbhūte ca viśeṣānupalambhātkartṛstha eveha bhāvaḥ kriyā ca| uddeśānurodhācca| `ahaṃ paśyeyam' iti hyuddeśaḥ na tu ayaṃ viṣayo bhavatvityevam `ahamuparigaccheyam' ityuddeśo na tu `hastino nyagbhāvo bhavatu' iti| uparigamanarūpa eva ca vyāpāraviśeṣo ruherartho na tu nyagbāvanamātram| bhūmiṣṭhe vṛkṣasya śākhāṃ hastābhyāmavanamayatyapi ārohatītyaprayogāt| ata eva "yaddhituparaṃ chandasi"(aṣṭāosūo8-1-56)ityatra bhāṣyaṃ-"ruhirgatyarthaḥ" iti| "ata eva cāṇau kartturṇau karmatvam| pacicchidyostu viklittidvidhābhavanarūpo viśeṣaḥ karmaṇi dṛṣṭaḥ taduddeśenaiva ca kārakavyāpāra iti mahadvaiṣamyam| evañca `āruhyate hastī' iti karmavadbhāvaṃ pradarśayanto bhāṣyanyāyavirodhādupekṣyāḥ" iti kaiyaṭaḥ| etena--
"adhigacchati śāstrārthaḥ smarati śraddadhāti ca|
yatkṛpāvaśatastasmai namostu gurave sadā"||
iti prayogo vyākhyātaḥ| na caivaṃ kriyata iti na syāditi vācyam| yatnārthatāvādināmetaddoṣaprasaṅge'pi bhūvādisūtrasthabāṣyānusāreṇa karoterabhūtaprādurbhāvārthatāmabhyupagacchatāmasmākaṃ sarvasāmañjasyāta| evañca kartṛsthabhāvakriyeṣu karmavadbhāvāprāptervidhyarthamidaṃ sūtramiti sthitaṃ bhāṣye| `lāvayate sveyameva' ityādau tu kāryātideśapakṣe paratvāt "karmavatkarmaṇā"(aṣṭāosūo3-1-87)ityevātmanepadam| śāstrātideśetu "bhāvakarmaṇoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-13)ityetadapekṣayā paratvāt ṇeraṇādisutreṇetyavadheyam| yadi tvaṇau ye kartṛkarmaṇī tadbhinnakarmanivṛttirbhāṣyakṛtobhipretā syāttarhi sakarmakāṇāṃ madhye tatsūtrodāharaṇatāpattau karmasthakriyā apyudāharaṇaṃ syuḥ| na hi tatrātideśaḥ sulabhaḥ| "karmavadakarmakāṇām" iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt| tathā niyamārthatvaparāṇāṃ yakciṇoḥ pratiṣedhārthaṃ tvityādi bhāṣyavārttikagranthānāmapyasāmañjasyaṃ syāditi dik| tasmādihāsmaduktameva vākyārthatrayaṃ munitrayasammatam| jayādityanyāsakāraharahattakaiyaṭādisakalagranthakārāṇāmiha mahāneva pūrvāparavirodho vipaścidbhiruddharttavyaḥ| asmaduktistu mātsaryamutsārya paribhāvanīyetyalaṃ bahunā| yattu "kareṇurārohayate niṣādinam" iti māghe prayuktaṃ taṇṇicaśceti siddham| etena--
"sa santataṃ darśayate gatasmayaḥ|
kṛtādhipatyāmiva sādhu bandhutām"||(kio1-10)
iti vyākhyātam| bandhutā taṃ paśyati, tāṃ darśayate| yadvā-bandhutāṃ kṛtādhipatyāmivalokeḥ paśvayati tāṃ darśayate ityarthaḥ| ādye bandhutā aṇau kartrī| dvitīye tvaṇau sā karma| ubhayathāpi ṇau karmatvaṃ nirvavādameveti dik| ṇeriti kim? ārohatīti nivṛttapreṣaṇānmā bhūt| na ca "ṇaucet" iti vākyaśeṣe śrutatvāṇṇereva bhaviṣyatīti vācyam| aṇāvityasyāpi śrutattvāt| kiṃ cottarārthamavaśyaṃ ṇeriti vācyameva| tadihaiva spaṣṭārthamuktam| hetumaṇṇijgrahaṇārthaṃca| bhīsmyostasyaiva sambhavāt| tena gaṇayate gaṇaḥ svayameveti siddham| gaṇayatirhi vibhajya bhāgaśo'vasthāpane varttate| tathā ca karmasthabhāvakādasmānnivṛttapreṣaṇāddhetumaṇṇau punaḥ preṣaṇāṃśatyāge satyātmanepadamiṣṭam| ṇeriti hetumaṇṇicā sannidhānā daṇāvityatrāpi tasyaiva grahaṇāccurādi ṇau yatkarma tatkartṛkāddhetumaṇṇyantādapi sidhyatīti| yattu vṛttikṛtā gaṇayatītyeva rūpamavasthācatuṣṭaye'pyudāhriyate| tatra saṅkhyānimittasya paricchedasya jñānaviśeṣātmakatayā kartṛsthasya dātuvācyatāmāśritya karmavadbhāvāpravṛttyā dvitīyāvasthāyāṃ parasmaipadamupapādanīyam| caturthāvasthāyāṃ tu parasmaipadamaśuddhameva| ṇeraṇāvityatrāpi "aṇāvakarmakāt"(aṣaaṭāosūo1-3-88)ityatreṣa hetumaṇṇica eva grahaṇasya nyāyyatvāt| tathaiva bhāṣye sthitatvācca| bhāgaśo'vasthāpanaparatve tu dvitīyāvasthāyāmapyātmanepadamiti viśeṣaḥ| karmavadbhāvāvasya durvāratvāt| yakciṇau tu "ṇiśranthi"(kāovāo)ityādiniṣedhānna sta iti dik| ṇau cediti kim? nivṛttapreṣaṇāṇṇau `ārohayanti hastipakāḥ' iti tṛtīyapakṣāyāṃ mā bhūt| asati hi ṇau cedgrahaṇe śrutatvādaṇāveva karmatvaṃ kartṛtvañca labhyeta| na caikasyobhayarūpatā badhiteti vācyam| prathamāvasthāyāṃ karmaṇo dvitīyāvasthāyāṃ kartṛtvasya nirvivādattvāt| anādhyāne kim? smarati vanagulmaṅkokilaḥ| tataścaturthāvasthāyāṃ smarayati vanagulmaḥ| utkaṇṭhāpūrvakasmṛtau viṣayo bhavatītyarthaḥ| "smṛ ādhyāne,"(bhvāopao809)ghaṭādiḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-68)
bhīsmyorhetubhaye(aṣṭāosūo1-3-68)| ābhyāṃ ṇyantābhyāmātmanepadaṃ syātprayojakādeva cedbhayavismayau sta| sūtra bhayagrahaṇaṃ vismayasyāpyupalakṣaṇam| muṇḍo bhīṣayate| "bhiyo hetubhaye ṣuk"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-40)iti ṣuk| "vibheterhetubhaye"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-56)iti vaikalpikātvapakṣetu `bhāpayate' atra ṣuṅna| tadvidhāvīkārapraśleṣāt| jaṭilo vismāpayate| "nityaṃ smayateḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-57)ityātvam| "arttihrī"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-36)iti puk| hetubhaye kim? kuñcikayā bāyayati| rūpeṇa vismāyayati| iha karaṇādbhayavismayau na tu hetoḥ| yadyapi hetorvyāpāre ṇijvidhānātprayojakañceditītyarthaḥ| viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyāt| ata eva `mauṃḍyena bāpayati' ityatra na mauṃḍyākhyadharmasya bhedena vivakṣaṇāt| udāharaṇe tu tādātmyasya vivakṣaṇāddhetoreva bhayam| etena--
"manuṣyavācā manuvaṃśaketuṃ-vismāyayan"|(rao2-33)
iti vyākhyātam| iha hi na siṃhādvismayaḥ kintu manuṣyavāceti karaṇāt| ata evātra "nityaṃ smayateḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-57)ityātvaṃ na| tadvidhāne "bibheterhetubhaye"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-56)ityato hetubhayānuvṛttyā bhayagrahaṇasya ca smayopalakṣaṇatayā vyākhyānāt| kvacittu `vismāpayan' iti pugāgamapāṭhaḥ prāmādikaḥ| yadvā-vāk vismāpayate siṃhastu vismāpayamānāṃ vācaṃ prayuṅkte vismāpayati| vyantāṇṇicū| vāceti tu prayojye karttari tṛtīyā na tu karaṇe iti samādheyam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-69)
gṛdhivañcyoḥ pralambhane(aṣṭāosūo1-3-69)| pratāraṇārthābhyāmābhyāṃ ṇyantābhyāmātmanepadaṃ syāt| māṇavakaṃ gardhayate vañcayate vā| pralambhane kim? śvānaṅgardhayati| abhikāṃkṣāmasyotpādayatītyarthaḥ| ahiṃ vañcayati| varjayatītyarthaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-70)
liyaḥ sammānaśalinīkaraṇayośca(aṣṭāosūo1-3-70)| sammānanaśalinīkaraṇayoścakārātpralambhane ca varttamānāṇṇyantāllīdhātorātmanepadaṃ syāt| "līṅ śleṣaṇe"(dioāo1139)divādiḥ, "lī śleṣaṇe"(kryāo1502)kryadiḥ, ubhayorapi grahaṇam| nignubandhakaparibhāṣā tu pratyayaviṣayiṇī| "vāmadevāḍḍhyaḍyau"(aṣṭāosūo4-2-9)iti ḍitkaraṇena jñāpitā hi sā| jñāpakañca sajātīyaviṣayakamevetyutsarga-| sammānane--jaṭāmirālāpayate| pūjāṃ samadhigacchatītyartha| akarmakaścāyam| dhātvarthena kroḍīkṛtakarmatvāt `putrīyati' ityādivat| śālinīkaraṇe-śyeno varttikāmullāpayate| nyakkarotītyarthaḥ| pralambhana--bālamullāpayate| "vibhāṣā līyateḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-51)iti ṇāvātvaṃ vidhīyate| tadasminviṣaye nityam| anyatra tu vikalpaḥ| vyavasthitavibhāṣā hi sā| na ca "līyateḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-51)iti vihitamātvaṃ kathaṃ līnāteḥ syāditi vācyam| līnātilīyatyoryakā nirdeśoyamiti siddhāntāt| sammānanādiṣviti kim? bālakamullāpayati| āśleṣayatītyarthaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-71)

svaritañitaḥ kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale(aṣṭāosūo1-3-72)| svariteto ñitaśca dhātorātmanepadaṃ syātkriyāphale kartṛgāmini sati| yajate, sunute| kartrabhiprāye kim? yajanti yājakāḥ, sunvanti dakṣiṇādi tu na phalam| uktaṃ hi hariṇā--
"yasyārthasya prasiddhyarthamārabhyante pacādayaḥ|
tatpradhānaphalaṃ teṣāṃ na lābhādi prayojanam"|| iti |
pacā pākaḥ| ṣittvādaṅ| kecittu prayojakavyāpāravṛttibhyo dhātubhyastad‌dyotakamātmanepadamanena vidhīyate| kurute| kārayatītyarthaḥ| `kārayate' ityatra tu prayojakavyāpāradvayamartha-| ṇijantāṇṇici yathā "kartrabhiprāye" iti sūtrāṃśopi kartṛpadasyāhetukartṛparatvāduktārthatātparyaka evetyāhuḥ| uktañca hariṇā--
kriyāpravṛttāvākhyātā kaiścitsvārthaparārthatā|
asatī vā satī vāpi vivakṣitanibandhanā||
yeṣāñcitkartrabhiprāye ṇicā saha vikalpyate|
ātmanepadamanyeṣāṃ tadarthā prakṛtiryathā||
krīṇīṣva, pacate, dhatte, cinoti, cinute'pi ca|
āptaprayogā dṛśyante yeṣu ṇyartho'bhidhīyate"|| iti|
asatī cetyanena "kamalavanoddhāṭanaṃ kurvate ye" ityādayaḥ prayogāḥ samarthitāḥ| tatrāpi svārthatāvivakṣāyāḥ sambhavāt| ṇyarthasya vācakaṃ dyotakaṃ vā ātmanepadamiti matadvayaṃ saṅgṛhītaṃ keṣāṃ cidityādinā ślokena| cinoti cinuta iti, cinoti cāpayati ceti krameṇārthaḥ|

nigaraṇacalanārthebhyaśca(aṣṭāosūo1-3-87)| abhyavahārārthebhyaḥ kampanārthebhyaśca ṇyantebhyaḥ parasmaipadaṃ syāt| nigārayati, āśayati, bhojayati, calayati, copayati, kampayati| sakarmakārtho'cittavatkartṛkārthaścāyamārambha-| "ādeḥ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ" iti kāśikā| bhāṣyakārastu "gatibuddhi"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-52)ityādinā ṇaukarttuḥ karmasaṃjñā prāptā "ādikhādyoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ"(kāovāo)iti vacanānna bhavati| kathaṃ tarhi "ādayatvannaṃ baṭunā" iti| akartrabhiprāye bhaviṣyati| kartrabhiprāye prāptasya "nigaraṇacalana"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-87)ityasya hyayaṃ niṣedho na tu "śeṣātkarttari"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-75)ityasya| kathaṃ

pūrvārdhānurodhena pānārthatvāditi vācyam| pānasyāpi bhakṣaṇaviśeṣātmakattvāt| sāmānyagraheṇa viśeṣasyāpi grāhyattvāt| anyathehaiva sūtre `copayati'ityudāharaṇāsaṅgateḥ| cupermandagatyarthakatvāt| imāmityasyākarmakattvāsaṅgātiprasaṅgācca| gatyādisūtreṇa hyasya karmasaṃjñā sā ca pratyavasānārthatāṃ vinā durupapādeti| ata eva "napādami"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-89)iti sūtre pāgrahaṇaṃ dheṭa upasaṅkhyānañca saṅgacchate| anyathā pādheṭorapyācamivatpānārthattvena niṣedho vyarthaḥ syāt| na caivaṃ budhayudhāditsūtre dravatigrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ calanaviśeṣavācakasyāpi calanavācakatānapāyāditi vācyam| calanatvavyāpyāyā akhaṇḍāyā eva jāteḥ pravṛttinimittatāyā uktatvāt| pānantu dravadravyasya galādadhaḥ karaṇam| tatra dravadravyāṃśasyādhaḥkaraṇe karmībhūtasyādhikasya bhāne'pi bhakṣayaterarthasya bhānaṃ nirvivādam| yathā mandagatau bhāsamānāyāṃ gaterbhānam| adhikaṃ praviṣṭaṃ na tu taddhāniriti nyāyāt| na ca pānatvamapyakhaṇḍasyandanatvavaditi vācyam| tatsādhakānirukteḥ| dṛṣṭānte tu kāryatāvacchedakatayā tatsiddheriti| ucyate-`ācāmaya' iti loḍantaṃ chitvā "kiṃ nācāmayeḥ" iti vyākhyeyam| `se' iti tu sambodhanaṃ damayantyaḥ| tathā hi-asya strī ī-lakṣmīḥ tayā saha varttamānā seḥ tasyāḥ sambodhanaṃ se| salakṣmīke ityarthaḥ|

aṇāvakarmakāccittavatkartṛkāt(aṣṭāosūo1-3-88)| ṇeḥ pūrvamakarmakāccittavatkartṛkāṇṇyantātparasmaipadaṃ syāt| śete kṛṣṇastaṃ śāyayati gopī| aṇaukim! ārohayamāṇaṃ prayuṅkte ārohayate| "ṇeraṇau"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-67)iti sūtre udāharaṇatvena yo'karmako nirṇītastasmād dvitīye ṇau mā bhūt| sa hi ṇāvakarmakaḥ nivṛttapreṣaṇādhyāropitapreṣaṇayorubhayorapi nyagbhavatītyarthe paryavasānasyoktatvāt| akarmakātkim! kaṭaṃ kurvāṇaṃ prayuṅkte kārayate| cittavatkartṛkātkim? vrīhīn śoṣayate| atra kecit| curādiṇyantāddhetumaṇṇau "aṇau"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-88)ityasya pratyudāharaṇamāhuḥ| tattu bhāṣyādiviruddham| tathā hi-vudhādisatrādiha ṇerityanuvartate| budhādibhyaśca hetumaṇṇireva sambhavatīti niṣedho'pi pratyāsattestasyaiva nyāyyaḥ| tena curādiṇyantādapi hetumaṇṇau bhavatyevedaṃ parasmaipadamiti bhāṣye sthitam| yattu rūpayantaṃ prayojayati `rūpayate' iti kena citpratyudāhṛtaṃ taccurādiṇyantāddhetumaṇṇicaṃ vidhāya tasya ca saukaryātiśayātprayojakavyāpārāvivakṣāyāṃ prayojyavyāpāramātravṛttyā akarmakatāmāśritya tato dvitīye hetumaṇṇici boddhavyam| ata eva `prayojayati' ityāha| iha hi yujinā ṇicā ca prayuktidvayaṃ vadatā hetumaṇṇidvayaṃ sūcyate| anyathā `prayuṅkte' ityevādarśayiṣyat| evañca cetayamānaṃ prayuṅkte `cetayate' iti keṣāṃ citpratyudāharaṇaṃ yadvṛttikṛtā dūṣitaṃ tatsamarthitaṃ bhavati| svārthaṇyantādekasminneva hetumaṇṇau tu `rūpayati' `vetayati' ityeva bodhyam|

(aṣṭāosūo1-3-90)
vā kyaṣaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-90)| kyaṣantāt parasmaipadaṃ vā syāt| lohitāyati, lohitāyate| nanviha parasmaipadābāvapakṣe lakāra evāśrayeta na tvātmanepadam| tasya prakṛtiviśeṣe'rthaviśeṣe ca niyatatvāt| satyam| pūrvasūtre tāvadapavādamapanayatā pratiṣedhenātmanepadaṃ pravartyata iti nirvivādam| sa eva ca pratiṣedha ihānuvartyate| tadanuvṛtisāmarthyāccehātmanepadavikalpaḥ sidhyati| ātmanepadapravṛttyavinābhūtena niṣedhenātmanepadasya lakṣaṇayā upasthitau tasyaiva vikalpanāt| tena mukte "śeṣātkarttari parasmaipadam'(aṣṭāosūo1-3-78)bhaviṣyati| prakṛtyarthaniyamapakṣe ekavākyatāvidhiśceti pakṣe ca parasmaipadavikalpepi na kaściddoṣa ityavadheyam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-91)| dyutādibhyaḥ parasmaipadaṃ vā syālluṅi| adyutat, adyotiṣṭa| aluṭhat, aloṭhiṣṭa| luṅi kim? dyotate, loṭhate| anudāttettvānnityaṃ taṅ| nanviha vikalpānuvṛttirvyarthā| "anudāttetaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-12)ityanena pratiṣiddhasya parasmaipadasyānena pratiprasave kṛte "lasya"(aṣṭāosūo3-4-77)ityutsargeṇeva pākṣikasyātmanepadasya siddheḥ| satyam| parasmaipade pratiprasūte ātmanepadaṃ na bhavatīti jñāpayituṃ vānuvṛttiḥ| tena "anukaroti" ityādau pākṣikamātmanepadaṃ na bhavati| yadā tu "anudāttaṅitaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-12)ityādiprakaraṇenātmanepadameva vidhīyate "śeṣāt"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-78)ityādinā ca parasmaipadam| tadā `anukaroti' ityādau parasmaipadenātmanepadaṃ bādhyate yena nāprāptinyāyāt| pakṣe ātmanepadapravṛttyarthaṃ ceha vāgrahaṇamityavadheyam| pakṣadvayamapīdaṃ "anuparābhyām"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-79)iti sūtre niyamasūtrāṇāṃ vidhirūpeṇa niṣedharūpeṇa vā pravṛttiriti pakṣadvayasyāpi tattvaṃ nirūpitamasmābhiḥ| tadapyetasmādbhāṣyādutthitamityavadheyam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-92)
vṛbhdyaḥ syasanoḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-92)| vṛtuvṛdhuśṛdhusyandūbhyaḥ parasmaipadaṃ vā syātsye sani ca| vartsyati, avartsyat| vivṛtsati, "na vṛdbhyaścaturbhyaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo7-2-59)itīṇinaṣedhaḥ| pakṣe varttiṣyate, avartiṣyata| vivarttiṣate| syasanoḥ kim? varttate| nanu dyutādiṣveva vṛtādayaḥ paṭhyante| tathā ca takrakauṇḍinyanyāyeneyaṃ prāptirvṛdbhayaḥ pūrvāṃ prāptiṃ bādheta| tataśca `avṛtat, avartiṣṭa'iti luṅi pūrvema vikalpo na sidhyet| tathācottarasūtre cakāraḥ kriyate| luṭīti viśeṣavidhinā syasanoriyaṃ prāptirmā bādhīti1-1--1.apādānasaṃjñāṃ bādhate ityarthaḥ|-| anyathā kṛperapi vṛtādyantarbhāvādanenaiva siddhe kiñcakāreṇeti cet? satyam, dyutādipāṭhasāmathyāṃdvṛtādibhyo luṅi bhaviṣyati| yadvā luṅīti svarayiṣyate|
(aṣṭāosūo1-3-93)
luṭi ca klṛpaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-3-93)| luṭi syasanośca kṛpeḥ parasmaipadaṃ vā syāt| kalptāsi, kalpsyati, akalpsyat| ciklṛpsati| "tāsi ca klṛpaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo7-2-30) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| pakṣe kalpitāse| kalpiṣyate, akalpiṣyata| cikalpiṣate| iheṇinaṣedho nāsti| tatra hi "gameriṭ parasmaipadeṣu"(aṣṭāosūo7-2-58)ityataḥ parasmaipadeṣvityanuvarttate| ūditvātpākṣika iḍabhāvastvastyeva| syādetat, syasanorityasya svaritatvamevāstu "vā kyaṣaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-90)iti vāśabdasya yathā| tathā ca "svaritenādhikāraḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-11)hatyeva siddhe kiñcakāreṇa? satyam, spaṣṭārthaścakāraḥ| atha evānukarṣaṇārthāḥ sarve cakārā bhāṣye pratyākhyātāḥ|
|| iti śrīśabdakaustubhe prathamasyādhyāyasya tṛtīye pāde dvitīyamānhikam|| pādaśca samāptaḥ ||
<1.4>
||caturthepāde prathamamānhikam||
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-1)
ākaḍārādekā saṃjñā(aṣṭāosūo1-4-1)| ita ūrdhvaṃ kaḍārāḥ karmadhāraye(aṣṭāosūo2-2-38)ityataḥ prāgekasya ekaiva saṃjñā syāt| tatrobhayoḥ sāvakāśatve "vipratiṣedhe param"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-2)iti paraiva| niravakāśatve tu saiveti vivekaḥ|
tatra parasyā udāharaṇaṃ-`dhanuṣā vidhyati' iti| śarāṇāmapāyaṃ pratyavadhibhūtasyaiva dhanuṣo vyadhanaṃ prati sādhakatvamityubhayaprasaṅge paratvātkaraṇasaṃjñā apādānasaṃjñāṃ bādhate| tathā `kāṃsyapātryāmbhuṅkte' ityadhikaraṇasaṃjñā `dhanurvidhyati'iti kartṛsaṃjñā-1--1.apādānasaṃjñāṃ bādhate ityarthaḥ|-ca| taduktam-"apādānamuttarāṇi" iti|
niravakāśāyāstūdāharaṇam-`atatakṣat' iti| atra hi "saṃyogeguru"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-11)iti gurusaṃjñā laghusaṃjñāṃ bādhate| tena "sanvallaghuni"(aṣṭāosūo7-4-93)ityetanna pravarttate|
syādetat| bhapadasaṃjñābhyāṃ tarhi aṅgasaṃjñā bādhyeta| tathā ca `gārgyaḥ' ityatra "yasyeti ca"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-148)iti lopo na syāt| `dhānuṣkaḥ' ityatrāṅgasyocyamānā vṛddhirna syāt| aṅgasaṃjñā tu `karttavyam' ityādau sāvakāśā| nahi dhātupratyaye pūrvasya bhavapadasaṃjñe staḥ|
atrāhuḥ-"supi ca"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-102) "bahuvacane jhalyet"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-103) "taddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ"(aṣṭāosūo7-2-117)ityādau svādiṣu taddhiteṣu cāṅgasya kāryavidhānaṃ samāveśasya jñāpakam| dvividhā hi svādayaḥ-yajādayo valādayaśca| tatra yathākramaṃ bhapadasaṃjñābhyāṃ bhāvyam| tābhyāṃ cāṅgasaṃjñābādhe nirviṣayā eva tattadvidhayaḥ syuḥ|
gurulaghusaṃjñe varṇamātrasya vidhīyete, nahīghisaṃjñe tu tadantasyeti tābhyāṃ samāviśataḥ| tena `vātsībandhuḥ' ityatra "nadī bandhuni"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-109)iti pūrvapadāntodāttatvaṃ, `he vātsībandhī'ityatra "guroranṛtaḥ"(aṣṭāosū8-2-86)iti plutaśca sidhyati| tathā viścanā ca vinarau "dvandve ghi"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-32)iti pūrvanipātaḥ| vinarāvācaṣṭe vinayati pravinayya gataḥ| "lyapi laghupūrvāt"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-56)iti ṇerayādeśaḥ| yathā cāyādeśe karttavye ṭilopo na sthānivattathā "acaḥ parasmin"(aṣṭāosūo1-1-57)ityatra vyutpāditam| yattūktaṃ vintrorbhāvo vaintram "igantācca laghupūrvāt"(aṣṭāosūo5-1-131)ityaṇiti, taccintyam;"dvandvamanojñādibhyaśca"(aṣṭāosūo5-1-133)iti vuñprasaṅgāditi kaiyaṭaḥ| puruṣasaṃjñā tu parasmaipadasaṃjñāṃ na bādhate "ṇaluttamo vā"(aṣṭāosūo7-1-91)iti jñāpakāt| anyatrāpi yatra samāveśa iṣṭastatra cakārādinā svasthāne sādhayiṣyate| bhāṣye tu pāṭhāntaramapyupanyastam-"prākkaḍārātparaṃ kāryam" iti| asyārthaḥ-prākkaḍārātsaṃjñākhyaṃ kāryaṃ paraṃ syāditi| saṃjñāprakaraṇāddhi saṃjñārūpameveha kāryam| parāsaṃjñetyeva tu na sūtritam| "vipratiṣedhe"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-2)ityattarasūtre paraṅkāryamityasyānuvṛttiryathā syāt| tatra yasyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ parasyāḥ pūrvayā'navakāśayā bādhaḥ prāptaḥ sā parā'nena vidhīyate| etadeva ca jñāpakamiha prakaraṇe saṃjñānāṃ bādhyabādhakabhāvasya| tena parayā'navakāśayā sāvakāśā pūrvā bādhyate| dvayostusāvakāśayorvipratiṣedhe parayā pūrvā bādhyate iti| asminpakṣe aṅgasaṃjñā parā karttavyā bhapadasaṃjñe tu pūrve, evaṃ yatra yatra samāveśa iṣṭastatra sarvatra boddhavyam| asminpakṣe ṛtviya iti na sidhyati| tathāhi, "ṛtoraṇ"(aṣṭāosūo5-1-105) "chandasi ghas"(aṣṭāosūo5-1-106) "siti ca"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-16)iti padasaṃjñaiveṣṭā| tena tatra paraṃ kāryamiti vacanādbhasañjñāpi syāt| tataśca "orguṇāḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-146)prasajyeta| padatvaprayuktenāvagraheṇa sitkaraṇaṃ sārthakaṃ syāt| "śeṣo bahuvrīhiḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-23)"śeṣo ghyasakhi"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-7)iti śeṣagrahaṇaṃ cāsminpakṣe karttavyaṃ syāt| anyathā hi `unmattagaṅgam' ityādau "anyapadārthe ca sañjñāyām"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-21)iti satyāmavyayībhāvasañjñāyāṃ paraṅkāryamiti vacanādbahuvrīhisañjñā'pi syāt| `matyai' ityatra nadīsañjñāparyāye ghisaṃjñā'pi syāt| tataśca guṇaprasaṅgaḥ| vastuto bahuvrīhau śeṣagrahaṇaṃ pāṭhadvaye'pi kartavyaṃ, ghisaṃjñāyāntu pāṭhadvaye'pi na kartavyamiti tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ|
idaṃ tvavadheyam| ekā saṃjñeti pāṭhe'pi saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam| eketyukte'pi sañjñādhikāradeva tallābhāt|
syādetat, "ādvandvāta" ityevocyatām| na hi "cārthe dvandvaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-29)ityataḥ paratredamupayujyate| satyam, tathā sati "dvandvaśca prāṇitūrya"(aṣṭāosūo2-4-2)ityasyāpyavadhitvaṃ sambhāvyeta| tataśca sambuddhisañjñāmantritasañjñayoḥ samāveśo na syāt| nanu "ākaḍārāt" ityukte'pi "prākkaḍārātsamāsaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-3)ityasyāvadhitvaṃ kuto na syāditi cet? vyāptinyāyālliṅgācca| yadayaṃ "tatpuruṣaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-22)"dviguśca"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-23)ityārabhate| samāveśārthaṃ hi ca tat| vastutastu "saṃkhyāpūrvo dviguḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-52)ityatraiva cakāraḥ pāṭhyaḥ tāvataiva "divaḥ karma ca"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-43)"tatprayojako hetuśca"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-23)iti sūtrāntaraṃ tu na kartavyameva| evaṃ samānādhikaraṇasamāsaprakaraṇaṃ samāpya "karmadhārayaśca" ityeva pāṭhyam| "tatpuruṣaḥ samānādhikaraṇaḥ karamadhārayaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-2-42)iti sutraṃ tu māstviti dik|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-2)
vipratiṣedhe paraṅkāryam(aṣṭāosūo1-4-2)| virodhe sati kṛtyarhaṃ yatparaṃ tat syāt| vipratipūrvātsedhaterghañ, "upasargātsunoti"(aṣṭāosūo8-3-65)iti ṣatvam| upasargavaśācca virodhārthakatvam| `kāryam' ityatra "arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-169)ityarhārthe kṛtyapratyayaḥ| tena tulyabalavirodha iti paryavasyati| nahyapavādādīnāṃ sannidhau utsargādīnāṃ kṛtyarhatvaṃ, tairbādhitatvāt| tatra nityamāvaśyakatvādvādhakam| antaraṅgantu lāghavāt| apavādastu vacanaprāmāṇyāt| tadbhinnastu prakṛtasūtrasya viṣayaḥ| taduktam-"paranityāntaraṅgāpavādānāmuttarottarasya balavattvam"(paobhāo38)iti| jātipakṣe vidhyarthaṃ sūtram| vṛkṣeṣu, vṛkṣābhyām ityatra hi labdhāvakāśayoretvadīrghatvaśāstrayorvṛkṣebhya ityatra yugapatprasaṅge sati gamakābhāvādapratipattireva syāt| taduktam-"apratipattirvobhayostulyabalatvāt" iti| tatrāsmādvacanātparasminkṛte yadi pūrvasyāpi nimittamasti tarhi tadapi bhavati| yathā `bhindhaki' ityatra paratvāddhibhāve kṛte'pyakac| taduktaṃ-"punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānātsiddham"(paobhāo39)iti| vyaktipakṣe tu tadvyaktiviṣayakayorlakṣaṇayoranyatra caritārthatvāsambhavāttavyānīyarāmiva paryāye prāpte niyamārthamidaṃ sūtram-vipratiṣedhe parameva na tu pūrvamiti| etallabhaṇārambhācca tatra pūrvasyānārambho'numīyate| tathāca juhutāttvamityatra paratvāttātaṅi kṛte sthānivadbhāvena dhitvaṃ na bhavati| taduktaṃ-"sakṛdgatau vipratiṣedhe yadbādhitaṃ tadbādhitameva"(paobhāo40)iti| jātivyaktipakṣayośca lakṣyānurodhādvyavasthetyuktaṃ paspaśāyām| nityādiṣu tu nāsya pravṛttirityuktam| tena radherṇici "ata upadhāyāḥ"(aṣṭāosūo7-1-61)iti vṛddhiṃ parāmapyanityāṃ bādhitvā "radhijabhoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo7-1-61)iti numeva| na ca so'pi śabdāntaraprāptyā'nitya eveti vācyam, kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvamātreṇāpi kvacinnityatābhyupagamāt| tena `randhayati' iti siddham| tathā `adudruvat' ityādāvantaraṅga uvaṅ paramapi laghūpadhaguṇaṃ bādhate| tathā `śunaḥ' ityatrāntaraṅgatvāt "samprasāraṇācca"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-108)iti pūrvatvam| allope tu sati tasya sthānivattvādyaṇ syāt| `bahuśvānagarī' ityatra "ana upadhālopinaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-28)iti ṅīp syāt| siddhānte gaurādilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ tu na, upasarjanatvāt| yattvihatyabhāṣyaṃ `bahuśunī' iti, tatsiddhāntena sthitam, allopābhyupagamapakṣe pravṛttatvāt| etaccehaiva kaiyaṭe ābhātsūtrīyabhāṣyakaiyaṭayośca spaṣṭaṃ nyāyasiddhañca| yattu "bahuśvetyeva bhavitavyam" iti ḍāpsūtre bhāṣyam, tadiha sādhakatayā na grāhyam| ḍāppakṣamevoprakamya `bahuśukā' iti rūpaṃ tiraskartuṃ tasya pravṛttatvāt| `vṛkṣa iha' ityādau tvantaraṅgeṇa guṇena dīrgho bādhyate| na cāsau apavādaḥ kathaṃ bādhyatāmiti vācyam, samānāśraye tasya caritārthatvāt| tathā ca vārttikam-"iṇ‌ṅiśīnāmād‌guṇaḥ savarṇadīrghatvāt"(kāovāo)iti| iha śīnāmiti nadītvānnuṭ, vibhaktiparatayā nityastrītvāt| ata eva "auṅaḥ śyām"(kaovāo)iti prayogaḥ| udāharaṇantu `ayaje indraṃ, vṛkṣe indraṃ, sarve iha' iti bodhyam| ihāntaraṅgaṃ balavaditi lāghavanyāyamūlakamiti kaiyaṭaḥ| "acaḥ parasmin'(aṣṭāosūo1-1-57)iti sūtre bhāṣyamapyevam| "asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgam"(paobhāo50)iti tu "vāha ūṭh"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-132)ityūṭhgrahaṇena jñāpitam| "ṣatvatukoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-86)ityanena tu tadapavādabhūtaṃ "nājānantarye"(paobhāo51)iti| tatra "asiddham"(paobhāo50)ityanayā `pacāvedam' ityādāvaitvābhāvārthamavaśyāśrayaṇīyayā gatārthatvād "antaraṅgaṃ balīyaḥ" iti na kartavyetīhatyaṃ bhāṣyaṃ viruddham| nyāyasiddhatāyā uktatvāt| kiñca sāpavādayā'siddhaparibhāṣayā kathaṃ nirapavādāyā gatārthatā? atha "ṣatvatukoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-86)ityanena "asiddhaṃ bahiraṅm"(paobhāo50)ityasyā anityataiva jñāpyate, lāghavāt; na tu "nājānantarye"(paobhāo51)iti, gauravāt| tarhi prabalamidaṃ bhāṣyam| sphuṭīkṛtaṃ cedam "acaḥ parasmin"(aṣṭāosūo1-1-57)iti sūtre'smābhiḥ| evañcācorānantaryamiti dvitvaṃ vivakṣitam| nacetyādayo'pi prācāṅkalahā mudhaiva| evañca "antaraṅgānapi vidhīn bahiraṅgo lugbādhate"(paobhāo52)ityapi gatārtham| "ṣatvatukoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-86)iti vā kṛtituggrahaṇena vā'nityatājñāpanāt "aśvimānaṇa"(aṣṭāosūo4-4-126) "śvayuva"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-132)ityādinirddeśācca| tena `gomatpriyaḥ' ityādi siddham| ācārakvipi tavamamādibādhe ca krameṇa pratyayottarapadagrahaṇasya kṛtārthatvāttadīyajñāpakatā pravādo'pi yathāśrutābhiprāyeṇaiveti dik||
|| iti śrīśabdakaustubhe prathamasyādhyāyasya caturthe pāde prathamamānhikam ||
|| caturthe pāde dvitīyamānhikam ||
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-3)
yūstryākhyau nahī(aṣṭāosūo1-4-3)| ivarṇovarṇāntau tinyastrīliṅgau nadīsaṃjño staḥ| dīrghāntayoreṣā saṃjñā vyatiṣṭhate, aṇtvena savarṇagrahaṇāt| hrasvāntayostu prāptāpyeṣā parayā ghisaṃjñayā bādhyate| tena `mate, dheno' ityādau "ambārthanadyoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-107)iti hrasvo na bhavati| nanu śeṣagrahaṇād dhisaṃjñā kathaṃ bhavediti cet? na, śeṣagrahamasya pratyākhyātatvāt| tathāhi, ekā saṃjñeti pāṭhe tāvaccheṣasya grahaṇaṃ vyarthamiti spaṣṭameva| aparaṅkāryamiti pāṭhe tu dīrghānte sāvakāśāṃ nadīsaṃjñāṃ punnapuṃsakayoḥ sāvakāśā ghisaṃjñā `he mate' ityādau paratvādvādhiṣyate| `matyai, dhenvai' ityādau tu niravakāśā'pi "ṅiti hrasvaśca'(aṣṭāosūo1-4-6)iti nadīsaṃjñā ghisaṃjñāṃ na bādheta| ataḥ śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| tadapi vastuto vyarthameva, nadīsaṃjñāvacanasāmarthyādeva ghisaṃjñābādhopapatteḥ| hrasvalakṣaṇā hi nadīsaṃjñā| sā ca pratyayāpekṣatvādvahiraṅgā| tatrāntaraṅgāyāṃ ghisaṃjñāyāṃ "gherṅiti"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-111)iti ca guṇe kṛte hrasvābhāvānnadīsaṃjñā nirviṣayā syāt| taduktam-"tatra vacanaprāmāṇyānnadīsaṃjñāyāṃ ghisaṃjñābhāvaḥ" iti| yadvā, īśca ūśca yū "vā chandasi"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-107)iti pūrvasavarṇaḥ| tena dīrghayoreveyaṃ nadīsaṃjñā| na caivaṃ "ṅiti hravasśca'(aṣṭāosūo1-4-6)iti sūtre hrasvāṃśe'nanvayaḥ syāditi vācyam, vibhaktivipariṇāmena yvoḥ savarṇo yo hrasva iti vyākhyānāt| udāharaṇantu `gauryai' `vadhvai' ityādi| yū iti kim? mātre, svasre| stryākhyau kim? vātapramye|
syādetat| striyamācakṣāte iti vigrahe stryākhyāyāviti prāpnoti| "ātaścopasarge"(aṣṭāosūo3-1-136)iti kapratyayasya `suglaḥ' ityādau sāvakāśasya pareṇa karmaṇyaṇā bādhitatvāt| satyam, mūlavibhujāditvātkaḥ| yadvā, vicpratyayo bhaviṣyati| etena "tatprakhyañcānyaśāstram"(jaiosūo1-4-4)iti jaiminisūtramapi vyākhyātam| nanvemapi striyāmityevāstu kimadhikena? maivam, āsamantāccakṣāte iti vyutpattyā nityastrītvalābhārthaṃ tadupādānāt| tena `grāmaṇye senānye striyai' ityatra na bhavati| grāmaṃ senāñca nayatīti hi kriyāśabdāvetau liṅgatrayasādhāraṇau| ata eva `ādhyai brāhmaṇyai' iti bhāṣyodāharaṇaṃ cintyamiti kaiyaṭaḥ, ādhyānakartṛtvasyāpi liṅgatrayasādhāraṇatvāt|
prādeśanaṃ nirvapaṇamapavarjanamaṃhatiḥ(aokoo2-7-30)
ityamarakośādibalāddāne rūḍhau tu pradveṣayuktamābhicārikādyaṅgabhūtameva tadiha grāhyam| uṇādīnāmavyutpattipakṣāśrayaṇādantodāttatā| "vahivasyartibhyaścit"(uosūo509)iti cidgrahaṇānuvṛtteriti tu tattvam| etena "māno garvaḥ" iti vyācakṣāṇā api pratyuktāḥ, padadvayatvasyādhyāpakasampradāyasiddhattvāt vākyaśeṣānuguṇyācca| tasmād `ādhyai brāhmaṇyai' iti bhāṣyodāharaṇaṃ cintyamiti| sthitam| prāksubutpatteryatra samāsastatraiva gatikārakapūrvasyeṣyata iti yaṇ pravarttata iti vadatāṃ śrīpatidattādīnāmapi mate kaiyaṭoktaṃ cintyaṃ dṛḍhameva| vastutastu ādhyānamādhīriti vyutpādyaguṇaguṇinorabhedavivakṣayaiva prayogo'yamiti cintyoddhāro'vadheyaḥ| haradattastvāha-nityastrītvaṃ nāma na liṅgāntarānabhidhāyakatvaṃ, kintu śabdāntarasamabhivyāhāraṃ vinaiva striyāṃ varttamānatvaṃ tat| vṛttisvaraso'pyevam| kathantarhi `grāmaṇye' `khalapve' ityādi pratyudāhriyate iti cet? śṛṇu| kriyāśabdatvopyanayoḥ puṃsi mukhyā vṛttiḥ| puṃsāmeva tvayamautsargiko dharmaḥ yadbhrāmanayanaṃ khalapavanaṃ vā| ādhyānaṃ tu strīpuṃsasādhāraṇameveti vaiṣamyam| tasmādyuktamevedaṃ bhāṣyamiti|
atra vārttikam-prathamaliṅgagrahaṇañca| prayojanaṃ kvibluksamāsāḥ| asyārthaḥ-yaḥ pūrvaṃ stryākhyaḥ paścādupasarjanatayā liṅgāntaraviśiṣṭaṃ dravyāntaramāha tasya nadīsaṃjñā vaktavyā| kvipi kumārīmicchati kumārīyati| tata; kvip, allopayalopau, kvau luptasya sthānivattvāniṣedhānnayaṇ| yadvā, kumārayatīti kumārī, ācārakvibantātkarttari kvip| kumārī brāhmaṇa-| ṅyantatvātsulopaḥ| tasmai kumār‌yai brāhmaṇāya|
syādetat| iha kyackvipoḥ prakṛtibhūtasya ṅībantasyāpi nityastrītvaṃ durlabhaṃ puṃliṅgātkyackvipoḥ nirvṛttena triliṅgena samānākāratvāditi cet? na, arthabhedena śabdabhedāśrayaṇāt| tatra prathamodāhṛtasyetthaṃ rūpāṇi-kumārīmicchan kumārīvācaran vā brāhmaṇaḥ kumārī, ṅyantatvātsulopaḥ| kumāryau| kumāryaḥ| na ceha "aniśnudhātu"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-77)itīyaṅprasaṅgaḥ| "eranekācaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-82)iti yaṇā bādhitatvāt| ata eva ami śasi ca kumāryaṃ, kumāryaḥ; pradhyaṃ, pradhya itivat| na ca "gatikārakapūrvasyaiva" iti niṣedhaḥ śaṅkyaḥ, taditarapūrvasya netyarthāt viśiṣṭābhāvasyāpūrvepi sattvāt| ṅayi kumāryai, kumāryāḥ, kumārīṇāṃ, kumāryāṃ brahmaṇe, he kumāri brāhmaṇe ityādi| patnyādestu saṃyogapūrvakatvādiyaṅ| patniyau, patniyaḥ ityādi| śeṣaṃ prāgvat| puṃliṅgātkyavackyaṅorniṣpannasya tu aṅyantatvātsulopona| kumārīḥ| hekumārīḥ| anadītvād‌dhrasvo na| kumāryaṃ, kumāryāḥ, kumāryaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ, kumāryi brāhmaṇe ityādi| kumāramātmanamicchantī brāhmaṇī kumārīrityatrāpi kaiyaṭamate nityastrītvābhāvātpuṃvadeva rūpam| haradattamate tu lakṣmīvat| ami śasi ca yaṇviśeṣaḥ|
prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ| "lummanuṣye"(aṣṭāosūo5-3-98)iti lup| kharakuṭyai brāhmaṇāya| yadyapyatra yuktavadbhāvātstrītvamasti tathāpi svāśrayasya puṃstvasyāpi sattvānnityastrītvaṃ nāstīti kaiyaṭaharadattādayaḥ| taccintyam, `cañcāḥ paśya' ityādau śaso natvāpatteḥ| tasmāllubantaiḥ kharakuṭīcañcādiśbdaiḥ śāstrīyastrītvaviśiṣṭa eva laukikaḥ pumānabhidhīyate ityeva tattvam| evañca lupaḥ prayojitatvena kathaṃ gaṇanetyapi cintyam| samāse atilakṣmīḥ, bahuśreyasī| "īyasaśca"(aṣṭāosūo5-4-156)iti kabniṣedhaḥ| "īyaso bahuvrīherna"(kāovāo)ityupasarjanahasvo na| ubhayatrāpi sambuddhau hasvaḥ ṅitsu āḍāgamādikañca nadīsaṃjñākāryaṃ bodhyam|| avayavastrīviṣayatvātsiddham|| samāse tāvadavayavo lakṣmyādiśabdaḥ striyāmeva varttate iti tadānīmeva sejñāḥ| tataśca varṇasaṃjñāpakṣe samudāyasya nadyantatvātkāryasiddhiḥ| tadantasya saṃjñeti pakṣe tu aṅgādhikāre tasya ca taduttarapadasya ceti vacanāt| vasturastūktavacanasya prāgeva dūṣitatvāttadantatvenaiva siddhirbodhyā| atitantrībandhurityatrāpi "nadī bandhuni"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-109)iti pūrvapadāntodāttatvaṃ sidhyati,-pūrvapadasya nadyā viśeṣaṇot| kvibluporapi antaraṅgatvātkvibādeḥ prāgeva pravṛttā saṃjñā bahiraṅgeṇa liṅgāntarayogeṇa na nivartate tvakatpitṛke'kajvat| "akṛtavyūhāḥ"(paobhāo56)ityasyānityatāyā "acaḥ parasmin'(aṣṭāosūo1-1-57)iti sūtre varṇitatvāt|
syādetat| iyaṅuvaṅsthānapratiṣedhe yaṇsthānapratiṣedhaprasaṅgo'vayavasyeyaṅuvaṅsthānatvāt| yathā hyavayavasya strīviṣayatvātsamudāyasya nadīsaṃjñetyuktam, tathāvayavasyeyaṅuvaṅsthānatvātsamudāyasya yaṇsthānasyāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| yathā striyai ādhyai pradhyai|
atrāhuḥ,-iṅuvaṅbhyāmaṅgamākṣipyate,-aṅgādhikāre tayorvidhānāt| tena yasyāṅgasyeyaṅuvaṅau nirvartete tasya nadīsaṃjñāniṣedhaḥ| `ādhyai' ityatra tu avayavasyāṅgatvaṃ nāsti aṅgasya tu "eranekācaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-82)iti yaṇvidhānādiyaṅuvaṅaḥ sthānatā nāstīti niṣedhābhāvaḥ| etadarthameva ca tatra sthānagrahaṇam, iyaṅuvaṅoryadā sthitistadā pratiṣedho yathā syāt, yadā tvapavādena bādhastadā mā bhūditi| evaṃ "ṅiti hrasvaśca"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-6)ityatrāpyaṅgasyākṣepātso'pi vidhiraṅgasyaiva strītve bhavati, nāvayavasya| śakaṭyai, atiśakaṭaye brāhmaṇāya| śriyai, atiśriye brāhmaṇāya| iha tu syādeva-atiśriye atiśriyai vā brāhmaṇyai iti sthitaṃ bhāṣye| na ceha nityastrītvaṃ nāstīti vācyam, haradattamate tatsattvāt| kaiyaṭamate tu "ṅiti hrasvaśca"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-6)ityatra strīgrahaṇamātramanuvarttate, na tvākhyāgrahaṇam| evañca sudhīśabde'pi rūpadvayaṃ nirvivādam| sudhyādayaḥ puṃvaditi prakriyā tu prāmādikyeva| atilakṣmyaticamvorvātapramīhūhūbhyāṃ sāmyoktirapyevam| tathā `svayaṃbhūḥ puṃvad' ityapi pramāda eva|
syādett, `niṣkauśāmbiḥ pumān' ityatrāpi antaraṅgatayā nadīsaṃjñā syādatilakṣmyādau yathā| satyam, satyāmapi tasyāṃ na kaścidrūpe doṣaḥ| na ca sambuddhihrasvādiprasaṅgaḥ, hrasvādeśena nadyā apahārāt| varṇasya nadītvāt| stryākhyatvaṃ tu tasya śaktyāśrayatāmātreṇa bodhyam| paryāptyadhikaraṇatāyā avivakṣitatvāt| tadantasya nadīsaṃjñeti pakṣe'pi ekadeśavikārānabhyupagamena sarvādeśasyaiva vaktavyatvāt| na ca sthānivadbhāvaḥ, alvidhitvāt| `prapaṭhya' ityatreḍabhāvārthaṃ viśeṣaṇatayā'pyalāśrayaṇe niṣedhasya siddhāntitatvāditi dik| niṣkauśāmbyai niṣkauśāmbaye brāhmaṇyai ityatra tu "ṅiti hrasvaśca"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-6)iti vikalpo bhavatyeveti dik|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-4)
neyaṅuvaṅsthānāvastrī(aṣṭāosūo1-4-4)| iyaṅuvaṅo sthitiḥ sthānaṃ nirapavādā prasaktiryatra tāvīhūtau nadīsaṃjñau staḥ strīśabdaṃ vinā| he śrīḥ| he bhūḥ| astrīti kim? he stri| kathaṃ tarhi "vimānanā subhru kutaḥ| piturgṛhe" iti kālidāsaḥ| "hāpitaḥ kvāsi he subhru" iti bhaṭṭiśca| "ekavaṃśaprabhavabhruva" iti śrīharṣaśca| pramāda evāyamiti haradattaḥ| "sāmānye napuṃsakam"(kaovāo)iti vā kathañaci tsamādheyam| kecittu tado dāvacanena "sakṛd‌dvandvamanityam" iti paribhāṣājñāpanamāśrityānityo'yaṃ pratiṣedha iti samādadhuḥ| kiṃntvetatsaka lapramādeṣu suvacam| tadodāvacanapratyākhyānaparabhāṣyādiviruddhañca| anye tu "vāmi"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-5)ityato vāgrahaṇasya siṃhāvalokitanyāyenānuvṛttasya vyavasthitavibhāṣāparatveneṣṭasiddhimāhuḥ| tadapi na, siṃhāvalokitanyāyasyehābhimatatve nañgrahaṇasya "vāmi"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-5)ityuttarasūtrasya ca vaiyarthyāpatteḥ| yattūktaṃ durghaṭavṛttau bhruśabdād "aprāṇijāteśca"(kāovāo)ityūṅi samāse upasarjanahrastvatve ca kṛte "ūṅutaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-66)ityūṅi tasya samudāyabhaktatvānnovaṅsthānatvamiti| tadatisthavīyaḥ, pratyayasya bhaktatāyā niṣpramāṇakatvāt| tatsthānikasyaikādeśasyāntavadbhāvena bhrūśabdāvayavatāyā anapāyāt, aṅgādhikāre taduttarapadagrahaṇasya nirvivādatayā samudāyabhakte'pyuvaṅpravṛtteśca| `subhruvau' ityādirūpāṇāṃ sarvasammatatvācceti dik|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-5)
vāmi(aṣṭāosūo1-4-5)| iyaṅuvaṅsthānau vā nadīsaṃjñau staḥ striyāmāmi| śrīṇām, śriyām, bhrūṇām, bhruvām| dvitīyaikavacanaṃ tu neha sūtre gṛhyate, tatra nadīkāryābhāvāt| astrītyeva| strīṇām| iha "vāci hrasvaśca" ityeva kuto na kṛtam| evaṃ hi ṅitīti na kartavyamiti cintyam| vastutastu sannipātaparibhāṣayā `bhrūṇām' iti nuṭ na syādata āmītyuktam| paribhāṣā ceyamananaiva jñāpyate iti dhyeyam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-6)
ṅiti hrasvaśca(aṣṭāosūo1-4-6)| iyaṅuvaṅsthānau hrasvau ca yū vā nadīsaṃjñau staḥ striyāṃ ṅiti pare| śriyai, śriye, bhruvai, bhruve, kṛtyai, kṛtaye, dhenvai, dhenave| astrītyeva| striyai| strīloṅgāviti kim? agnaye, vāyave| iha prathamaliṅgagrahaṇaṃ nāsti| tena niṣkausāmbirharivadityuktam| striyamatikrānto'tistrirityatra tu viśeṣaḥ| atistriyau, "striyāḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-79)itīyaṅ| ayaṃ hi gauṇatve'pi bhavati| kintu-
guṇanābāvautvanuṅbhiḥ paratvātpuṃsi bādhyate|
klībe numā ca strīśabdasyeyaṅityavadhāryatām||
"jasi ca"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-119)iti guṇaḥ-atistrayaḥ| "vāmaśasoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-80)atistriyam, atistrīm| atistriyau| atistriyaḥ, atistrīn| "āṅonā'striyam"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-120)atistriṇā| atistribhyām| "gherṅiti"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-111)iti guṇaḥ-atistraye, atistreḥ| atistriyoḥ| "hrasvanadyāpaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo7-1-54)iti nuṭ atistrīṇām| "acca gheḥ"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-119)atistrau| saṅgrahaśca-
aukāre osi nityaṃ syādam‌śasostu vibhāṣayā|
iyādeśo'ci nānyatra striyāḥ-1--1.`puṃsyupasarjane'kvacit-syādupasarjane||
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-6)
evaṃ klībe numā iyaṅ bādhyate| tena `atistri, atistriṇī' ityādi vārivat| striyāntu "ṅiti hrasvaśca"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-6)itihrasvāntatvaprayukto nadīsaṃjñāvikalpaḥ| astrīti tu iyaṅuvaṅsthānāvityasyaiva viśeṣaṇam, tatsambaddhasyaivānuvṛtteḥ| na cehāvṛttyomayaviśeṣaṇatā, pramāṇābhāvāt| tena atistriyai, atistriye| "aut"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-128)iti bādhitvā "idudbhyām"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-117)iti ṅerām-atistriyām| pakṣe "accagheḥ"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-119)atistrau|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-7)
śeṣo ghyasakhi(aṣṭāosūo1-4-7)| hrasvau yau yū tadantaṃ sakhibhinnamanadīsaṃjñaṃ ghisaṃjñaṃ syāt| haraye, bhānave| hrasvau kim? grāmaṇye, khalapve| yū kim? mātre| asakhi kim? sakhye| śeṣaḥ kim? matyai| śeṣagrahaṇaṃ vyarthamiti nadīsañjñāsūtre evoktam| samāse tu susakherāgacchatītyādau ghisañjñā bhavatyeva, samudāyasya sakhiśabdādbhinnatvāt| tadantagrahaṇaṃ tu nāsti, viśeṣeyasambandhābhāvāt| yattu "grahaṇavatā"(paobhāo31)ityādi haradattonopanyastaṃ khyatyātsūtre ca kaiyaṭena| tatpūrvāparaviruddhamiti "yena vidhiḥ"(aṣṭāosūo 1-1-72)iti sūtre vyutpāditam| na caivaṃ "yasyeti ca"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-148)iti sūtre ivarṇasya īti sakhītyudāharaṇaṃ na yujyate, sakhiśabdāt "sakhyāśaśvītibhāṣāyām"(kāovāo)iti ṅīṣi sati lope savarmadīrghe vā viśeṣābhāvāt| yattu tatra bhāṣye vṛttau coktam-asati lope'tisakherāgacchatītyatra savarṇadīrghasya pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvādasakhīti ghisaṃñjñāpratiṣedhaḥ syāditi, tadasakhīti prasajyapratiṣedhamāśrityeti kaiyaṭādau spaṣṭam| ata evāpātataḥ paryudāsasyaiveha sthitatvāt| anyatā vākyabhedādasamarthasamāsāt| `susakheḥ' ityādyasiddhyāpatteśca| tasmāditi lope phalaṃ durlabhamiti cet? atrocyate, sakhī, sakhyau, sakhyaḥ ityādāvanaṅ‌ṇitve mābhūtāmiti ilopa eṣitavyaḥ| na ca siddhānte'pi prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭagrahaṇāddoṣatādavasthyam, vibhaktau liṅgaviśiṣṭāgrahaṇāt| etena ikāralopasya taddhite evodāharaṇaṃ na tvīti parata iti vadan haradatto'pāstaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-8)
patiḥ samāsa eva(aṣṭāosūo1-4-8)| patiśabdaḥ samāsa eva ghisañjñaḥ syāt| bhūpataye| neha-patyā, patye| viparītaniyamaṃ vārayitumevakāraḥ dṛḍhamuṣṭinā|
syādetat, "śeṣoghyasakhipatī" ityevāstu| samastasya tu pūrvoktarītyā siddham| na cottarasūtre sakhyurapi sambandhāpattiḥ, bādhakābhāvāt| iṣṭarūpasya tāvatāpi siddheḥ| dvitīyasya tu sādhogpi chandasyapaṭhitasyānāpadyatvāt| na caivamuttarasūtre ṣaṣṭhīyuktagraho vyarthaḥ syāditi vācyam, iṣṭāpatteḥ| evameva hi "śrīgrāmaṇyocchandasi"(aṣṭāosūo7-1-56)iti śrīgrahaṇaṃ "nityaṃ mantre'(aṣṭāosūo6-1-210)ityādīni ca pratyākhyātāni| "sambuddhau śākalyasya"(aṣṭāosūo1-1-16)ityatrā nārṣagrahaṇamapyevam| satyam| yathā sakhigṛhe gṛhasakhāyāvityatra pūrvanipātāniyamastathā patigṛhe ityatra mā bhūt iha hi ghitvātpūrvanipātaeva| bahucpūrvasya tu susākhinyāyena ghitvād `bahupatinā' ityādi bodhyam| atha kathaṃ "sakhinā vānarendreṇa"
"patinā nīyamānāyāḥ puraḥ śukro na duṣyati"|
"naṣṭe mṛte pravrajite lkībe ca patite patau"|
ityādi? atra haradattaḥ, chandovadṛṣayaḥ kurvantīti| asyāyamāśayaḥ-asādhava evaite triśaṅkvādyayājyayājanādivattapomāhātmyaśālināṃ munīnāmasādhuprayogo'pi nātīva bādhate| asmadādīnprati tu smṛtipurāṇādyadhyayanavidhibalādeva tadantargatatatpāṭho na bādhakaḥ| tathāca svātantryeṇedṛśaṃ prayuñjānā asmadādayaḥ pratyavayanttyeveti nadīsaṃjñāsutre bhāṣyakaiyaṭayorapi sthitamidam| yadvā, sakhetyākhyātaḥ sakhiḥ, patirityākhyātaḥ patiḥ, tena sakhinā, patinā| ākhyātaṇyantātkarmaṇi "acaiḥ'(uosūo588)ityauṇādika ipratyayaḥ lākṣaṇikatvāccaitayoryisaṃjñāparyudāse grahaṇaṃ nāstīti dik| etena-
arjunasya sakhā kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇasya sakhirarjunaḥ|
ityapi vyākhyātam| kathaṃ "vaco vācaspaterapi" iti māgha-| na hyayaṃ samāsaḥ, alugvidhāyakādarsanāditi| satyam, "tatpuruṣe kṛti"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-14)iti bahulagrahaṇādaluk| etena divaspativāstoṣpatī vyākhyātau| "ṣaṣṭhyāḥ pati" (aṣṭāosūo1-4-8)ityādinā satvam| ye tu tatra chandasītyanuvartayanti "śriyaḥ pati-"(śi1-1)ityādisiddhaye tanmate pāraskarāditvātsuṭ| kecittu 'dyāvāpṛthivīśunāsīramarutvadagnīṣomavāstoṣpatigṛhamedhācchaca'(aṣṭāosūo4-2-32)iti sāmānyāpekṣajñāpakāt ṣaṣṭhyā aluk| kaskāditvātsatvam| iṇaḥ parasya tu ṣatvamityāhuḥ|
padakārāstu vācaspatiṃ viśvakarmāṇam, vāsteṣpate pratītyādau pṛthak padamadhīyate|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-9)
ṣaṣṭhīyuktaśchandasi vā(aṣṭāosūo1-4-9)| ṣaṣṭhyantena yuktaḥ patiśabdaśchandasi ghisaṃjño vā syāt| kṣetrasya patinā vayam| iha yogo vibhajyate| ṣaṣṭhīyuktaśchandasīti| tato vā| chandasītyeva| sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante ityarthaḥ| "bahulañchandasi" ityādikastvasyaiva prapañcaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-10)
hrasvaṃ laghu(aṣṭāosūo1-4-10)| hrasvaṃ laghusaṃjñaṃ syāt| laghūpadhaguṇaḥ-cetati| na ca hrasvapradeśeṣvapi laghusaṃjñayaiva vyavahāraḥ sukaraḥ `sarpiṣṭvam' ityāda au "hrasvāttādau taddhite"(aṣṭāosūo8-3-101)iti ṣatvāsiddhiprasaṅgāt| gurusaṃjñayā tatra laghusajñāyā bādhāt| tasmādekasaṃjñādhikārād‌bahirhrasvasaṃjñāpraṇayanaṃ samyageva kṛtam| yadyevantarhi dīrghaplutasaṃjñāyāḥ samāveśamāśaṅkya ekasaṃjñādhikāre'yaṃ yogaḥ kariṣyate iti bhāṣyaṃ virudhyate, gurusaṃjñāyā laghusaṃjñāyā iva gurulaghusaṃjñābhyāṃ hrasvasaṃjñāyā bādhaprasaṅgāt| na ca niravakāśatā, laghusaṃjñāpravṛttyupāyatāmātreṇa sārthakyāt| yathā padaṃ sadbhaṃ bhavatīti vyākhyāyāṃ padasaṃjñāyāḥ| satyam, cakārādinā samāveśaḥ kartavya ityāśayaḥ| etadaparitoṣādeva vā tatra pakṣāntarāṇyuktānīti dik|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-11)
saṃyoge guru(aṣṭāosūo1-4-11)| hrasvaṃ gurusaṃjñaṃ syātsaṃyoge pare| śikṣā, bhikṣā| "gurośca halaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-103)ityakārapratyayaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-12)
dīrghañca(aṣṭāosūo1-4-12)| dīrghaṃ gurusaṃjñaṃ syāt| īhāñcakre|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-13)
yasmātpratyayavidhistadādi pratyaye'ṅgam(aṣṭāosūo1-4-13)| pratyayo yasmādvihitastadādiśabdaḥ pratyaye pare'ṅgasaṃjñaṃ syāt| rāmeṇa| vidhiriti kim? strī īyatī| na ceha vatupaḥ strīśabdādavidāne'pi sa vidhirastyeveti vācyam, sannidhānabalena yasmādyaḥ pratyayo vihitastasmintso'ṅgamiti vyākhyānāt| tadādi kim? vadāmi, vadiṣyāmi| "ato dīrgho yañi"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-101)iti dīrghaḥ| na cāyamārambhasāmarthyādeva bhaviṣyatīti vācyam, "yaya gatau" "caya gatau(bhvāoāo478)ābhyāṃ yaṅluki yāyāmi, yāyāvaḥ, yāyāmaḥ, cācāmi, cācāvaḥ, cācāmaḥ ityādau caritārthatvāt| pratyaye kim! pratyayavaśiṣṭasya tatopyadhikasya vā mā bhūt| evaṃ hi `vavraśca' ityuradatvasya paranimittatvaṃ na labhyate| tathāca "avaḥparasmin"(aṣṭāosūo1-1-57)iti sthānivatvābhāvādvakārasya samprasāraṇaprasaṅgaḥ| na ca prathamasūtreṇa sthānivadbhāvaḥ, alvidhitvāt| ata eva hi satyapi prathamaliṅgrahaṇe niṣkauśāmbyādau nadīkāryaṃ netyuktam|
iha "prakṛtyādipratyaye'ṅgam" ityeva lāghavādvaktuṃ yuktam| prakṛtimātrasya tu vyapadeśivadbhāvātsiddham| yogavibhāgena paribhāṣārthalābhārthaṃ tathoktamiti tattvam| kartā, kārakaḥ| iha yogo vibhajyate| yasmātpratyayavidhistadādipratyaye iti| paribhāṣeyam| pratyaye gṛhyamāṇe yasmāttasya vidhistadādi gṛhyate ityarthaḥ| tena "ña
nityādiḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-197)ityādau yatra pratyayaḥ saptamyā nirddiśyate tatra tadādergrahaṇam| tena `devadatto gārgyaḥ' iti saṅghātasya ñitsvaro na bhavati| "supa ātmanaḥ kyac"(aṣṭāosūo3-1-8)ityatrāpyanena tadādiniyamaḥ| tatra supā karmaṇastadādervā viśeṣaṇāttadantavidhiḥ| tena `mahāntaṃ putram' ityādāvatiprasaṅgo na| sati hi vākyātkyaci `mahatputrīyati' iti syāt| tathā `devadattaścikīrṣati' iti saṅghātasya dhātusaṃjñā na, `devadatto gārgyaḥ' iti saṅghātasya prātipadikasaṃjñā na, `devadatto gārgyāyaṇa-' iti saṅghātātphaṅ neti dik|
asyāpavādaḥ "kṛd‌grahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇam"(pāobhāo28)iti| iha ca "gatiranantaraḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-49)ityanantaragrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam| taddhi abhyuddhataśabde ucchabdavyavahitasyābhiśabdasya prakṛtisvaranivṛttyartham| na ca paratvād "gatirgatau"(aṣṭāosūo8-1-70)iti nighāte kṛte udāttagrahaṇānuvṛttyā vidhīyamānaḥ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro na bhaviṣyatīti vācyam, apādādāvityadhikārātpādādau nighātāpravṛtteḥ| tadādiniyame tu hṛtaśabdasya ktāntatvepyud‌dhṛtaśabdasyāktāntatvātprāptireva neti kimanantaragrahaṇena? prayojanantu samāsataddhitasvarāḥ| tathāhi, `avataptenakulasthitam' ityatra "ktena" ityanuvarttamāne "kṣepe"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-47)iti samāsaḥ| 'ttapuruṣe kṛti"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-14)ityaluk| `sāṃkṛṭinam' ityatra "aṇinuṇaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo5-415)iti sopasargādaṇ| ata eva vādivṛddhirupasargāṃśe paryavasyati| `vyāvakrośī' ityatra "karmavyatihāre ṇac striyām"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-43) iti ṇac| tato "ṇacaḥ striyām"(aṣṭāosūo5-4-14)ityañ| "na karmavyatihāre"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-6)ityaijāgamaniṣedhaḥ| `durādāgataḥ' ityatra thāthādisvareṇāntodāttatvam| nanu paribhāṣāṃ vinā'pi "samāsasya"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-123)ityantodātto bhaviṣyatīti cet? maivam, āgamyate smeti hi karmaṇi ktaḥ| tathāca samāsasvaraṃ bādhitvā "gatiranantaraḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-49)iti madhyodāttaṃ syāt| satyāṃ tu paribhāṣāyāṃ "thāthaghañ"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-144)ityanena kṛtsvarāpavādagātisvaraṃ bādhitvā paratvādantodāttatvaṃ bhavati| nanu thāthādisvarasyāpyapavādo gatisvaraḥ| satyam, gateruttarasya ktāntasya yadantodāttatvaṃ tasyaivāsāvapavādaḥ| kārakāduttarasya tu thāthādisvara eva bhavatīti vakṣyate| nanvastu gatisvareṇādyudātta āgataśabdaḥ| tato dūvaraśabdasya "stokāntika"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-39)iti samāsaḥ| "pañcamyāḥ stokādibhyaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-2)ityaluk| tataḥ satiśiṣṭatvātsamāsāntodātta eva bhaviṣyati| satyam, anyārthaṃ kṛtayā paribhāṣayā kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyudātte āgataśabde prāpte sagaterapi ktāntatvātsthānāntaraprāptatvādgatisvarasya bādhakasyāpi bādhena thāthādisvaro bhavatītyevābhipretaṃ na tu svara evānanyathāsiddhaṃ paribhāṣodāharaṇam| tathāca paribhāṣā prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ na pravartate,-madhyepavādanyāyena kṛdgrahaṇasyāpratyaya iti niṣedhamātrabādhakatvāt| samāsetarapadasaṃjñakapūrvabhāgaghaṭitaḥ saṅghāto na prātipadikamiti niṣedhastu paratvābdādhaka eva| tena `mūlakenopadaṃśam' ityatra na supo luk| na ca samāsavikalpasamārthyam, "na samāsa"(kāovāo)iti śākalaniṣedhāpravṛttyā dadhyupadaṃśādau tatsārthakyasambhavāt| etacca "puṃyogādākhyāyām"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-48)iti sūtre bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ spaṣṭamiti dik| "ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇam"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-4)(aṣṭāosūo6-1-13)iti sūtre bhāṣye tadādiniyamasyāpavādāntaraṃ paṭhitam "strīpratyaye cānupasarjane tadādiniyamo na" iti| etacca vācanikameveti sarvādisūtre vyākhyātam| yadvā, iha "neyaṅuvaṅ‌sthānau"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-4)ityato'strītyanuvarttate| tacca yadyapi tatra svarūpapadārthakaṃ tathāpīhārthaparaṃ sampadyate| pratyayagrahaṇe tadādi grāhyaṃ, strī cennābhidhīyate ityarthaḥ| tena strīpratyaye tadādiniyamo nāstīti phalitam| na caivam `atikārīṣagandhyāputraḥ' ityatra samprasāraṇaprasaṅgaḥ, astrītyanena pradhānastriyāmeva pratiṣedhāt| "gauṇamukhyayoḥ" iti nyāyāt| tena yāvān śabdaḥ striyaṃ prādhānyenāha tāvān strīpratyayāntaḥ na tu tato'dhiko'pīti sthitam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-14)
suptiṅantaṃ padam(aṣṭāosūo1-4-14)| subantaṃ tiṅantañca padasaṃjñaṃ syāt| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ| antagrahaṇamanyatra "saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantagrahaṇaṃ nāsti"(paobhāo27)iti jñāpanārtham| gaurabrāhmaṇitarā| ghasaṃjñāyāṃ tarabantagrahaṇe sita gaurīśabdasya "puṃvatkarmadhāraya"(aṣṭāosūo8-3-42)iti puṃvadbhāvaṃ bādhitvā puṃvadbhāvād hrasvatvaṃ "khid ghādikeṣu" iti hrasvaḥ syāt paṭ‌vitarotivat| brāhmaṇīśabdasya hrasvo na syāt| kathaṃ tarhi prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ kṛttaddhitaśabdābhyāṃ tadantagrahaṇamiti cet? atra bhāṣyakārāḥ-arthavad‌grahaṇaṃ tatrānuvartate| tatsāmarthyāttadantagrahaṇamiti|
syādetat; yadyarthavattā pāramārthikī vivakṣyate, tarhi sā padasya vākyasya vā'sti, ta nu kṛttāddhitāntasya| tathācārthavatsūtre vārttikam-"arthavatā nopapadyate kevalenāvacanāditi| atha siddhaṃ tvanvayavyatirekābhyāmiti"| tatratyottaravārtikānurodhena prakriyādaśāyāṃ kalpitā sā vivakṣyate, tarhi kṛttaddhitayorapi sāstīti cet? satyam, ataevārthavadgrahaṇasāmarthyamuktam| pratyayāntena tvekārthībhūtena pratīyamāno'rtha iha gṛhyate, tasya laukikārthaṃ prati pratyāsannataratvāt| matupaḥ prāśastyaparatayā tasyaiva grahaṇāt| ata eva ca tadupādānaṃ sārthakam| pūrvasūtre'dhāturiti paryudāsabalenāpi tallābhasambhavāt|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-15)
naḥ kye(aṣṭāosūo1-4-15)| kyaci kyaṅi kyaṣi ca nāntameva padasaṃjñaṃ syāt| kyac-rājīyati| kyaṅ-rājāyate| kyaṣ-carmāyati, carmāyate| sāmānyagrahaṇārthaṃ kyaṣaḥ kakāra iti vadato vṛttikārasya matenedamudāhṛtam| bhāṣye tu kyaṣaḥ kakāra iti vadato vṛttikārasya matenedamudāhṛtam| bhāṣye tu kyaṣaḥ kakārasya pratyākhyānātkyackyaṅoreveha grahaṇam| carmāyatīti rūpaṃ cāsādhu, kyaṅantatayā nityamātmanepadābhyupagamāt| tathā ca vakṣyate-"lohitaḍājbhyaḥ kyaṣvacanaṃ bhṛśādiṣvitarāṇi"(kāovāo)iti| etacca tṛtīyaeva sphuṭīkariṣyāmaḥ nāntameveti kim? vācyati, srucyati, tapasyati| nanu kyaeva nāntamiti viparīto niyamaḥ kuto neti cet? na ṅisambuddhyoriti jñāpakāt nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasyeti jñāpakācca| anyathā hi "nalopaḥ kye" ityeva sūtrayet|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-16)
siti ca(aṣṭāosūo1-4-16)| siti pratyaye pare pūrvaṃ padasaṃjñaṃ syāt| bhasaṃjñāpavādaḥ| `bhavataṣṭhakchasau"(aṣṭāosūo4-2-115)bhavadīyaḥ "ṛtoraṇ"(aṣṭāosūo5-1-105)"chandasi ghas"(aṣṭāosūo5-1-106)ṛtuḥ prāpto'sya ṛtviyaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-17)
svādiṣvasarvanāmasthāne(aṣṭāosūo1-4-17)| kapratyayāvadhiṣu svādiṣvasarvanāmasthāneṣu pūrvaṃ padasaṃjñaṃ syāt| rājabhyāṃ, rājabhiḥ| rājatvaṃ, rājatā| sarvanāmasthāne tu rājānau, rājānaḥ| bhuvadvabhdyo, dhārayadvad‌bhyaḥ iti padasaṃjñāyā upasaṅkhyānam| "tasau matvarthe"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-19)iti bhasaṃjñāyā apavādaḥ| vyatyayena bhavateḥ śapo luk|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-18)
yaci bham(aṣṭāosūo1-4-18)| yakārādiṣvajādiṣu ca svādiṣvasarvanāmasthāneṣu parataḥ pūrvaṃ bhasañjñaṃ syāt| gārgyaḥ, rājñaḥ| vācikaṣaḍikayostu yathā bhatvābhatve nirvahatastathā pañcame vakṣyate| nabhoṅgiromanuṣāṃ vatyupasaṃkhyānam(kāovāo)| nabhasā tulyaṃ vartate| iti nabhasvat, bhatvādrutvābhāvaḥ| manuṣvadagne| "aṅgirasvadaṅgiraḥ"| "janerusiḥ"(uosūo280)ityatra bahulagrahaṇānuvṛttermanyaterupipratyayaḥ "ādeśapratyayoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo8-3-59)iti ṣatvam| "vṛṣaṇvasvaśvayo-"(kāovāo)vṛṣaṃ varṣukaṃ vasu yasya saḥ vṛṣaṇvasuḥ| evaṃ vṛṣaṇaśvaḥ| karmadhāraye ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣādirvā yathāsambhavaṃ bodhyaḥ| ihāntavartinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya padatve sati nalopaḥ prasajyeta| bhatvāttu na padatvam| ata eva "padāntasya"(aṣṭāosūda8-4-37)iti ṇatvaniṣedho na| "alloponaḥ"(aṣṭāosūda604-134)iti tu na bhavati aṅgasañjñāyā abhāvāt aṅgasyeti tatrādhikārāt| upasaṃkhyānānyetāni chandoviṣayāṇīti kaiyaṭaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-19)
tasau matvarthe(aṣṭāosūo1-4-19)| tāntasāntau bhasaṃjñau sto matvarthe pratyaye pare| vidyutvān| bhatvājjaśtvaṃ na| udakena śvayati vardhate udaśvit| kvip "udaśvito'nyatarasyām"(aṣṭāosūo4-2-19)iti nipā tanātsamprasāraṇābhāvaḥ| "udakasyodaḥ saṃjñāyām"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-57)| udaśvitvān ghoṣaḥ| yaśasvī| matvarthavṛttitvaṃ matupo viniprabhṛtīnāṃ cāviśiṣṭam| ata ubhayatra bhatvapravṛttiḥ| yathā devadattaśālāsthā ānīyantāmityukte devadatto'pyānīyate uddeśyatāvacchedakarūpākrāntatvāt|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-20)
ayasmayādīni chandasi(aṣṭāosūo1-4-20)| etāni chandasi sādhūni| bhapadasaṃñjñādhikārādyathāyogantadubhayadvāraiṣāṃ sādhutvaṃ vidhīyate| tathā ca vārttikam-ubhayasañjñānyapīti vaktavyamiti| ayasmayaṃ pātram| bhatvādutvanna| ayaso vikāra ityartheṃ "dvayacaśchandasi"(aṣṭāosūo4-3-150)iti mayaṭ| etena "mayaḍ‌vaitayorbhāṣāyām"(aṣṭāosūo4-3-143)ityukteḥ kathamiha mayaḍityāśaṅkyāta eva nipātanāditi vadan nyāsakṛtparāstaḥ| sasuṣṭubhā saṛkvatā gaṇena| iha ṛkvateti padatvātkutvam, bhatvājjaśtvābhāvaḥ| jaśtvavidhānārthāyāḥ padasañjñāyā bhatvena pratibandhāt|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-21)
bahuṣu bahuvacanam(aṣṭāosūo1-4-21)| bahutve etatsyāt| vṛkṣāḥ| kathantarhi dārā iti? avayavabahutvasyāvayavini āropādbhaviṣyati| na caivamekasminnapi vṛkṣe bahuvacanāpattiḥ, tatrārope pramāṇābhāvāt| dārādau tu nityabahuvacanāntatvagrahakakośādervṛddhavyavahārasya ca mānatvena vaiṣamyāt|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-22)
dvyekayordvivacanaikavacane(aṣṭāosūo1-4-22)| dvitvaikatvayoretesta-| vṛkṣau, vṛkṣaḥ| iha dvyekaśabdau saṅkhyāparauṣa na tu saṅkhyeyaparau| ata eva dvyekayoriti dvivacanam| anyatā bahuvacanaṃ syāt| pūrvasūtre'pi bahuṣviti saṅkhyāparameva| bahuvacanantu āśrayagataṃ bahutvaṃ dharme āropya kṛtam| tatpalantu bahuḥ parvata iti vaipulyavācino neha grahaṇamiti sūcanameva| vastuto vyarthaṃ tat| paratvādekavacanasambhavāt| yattu "āśataḥsaṅkhyā saṅkhyeya" iti, tatprāyovādamātram| atra ślokavārttikaṃ-
supāṅkarmādayopyarthāḥ saṅkhyā caiva tathā tiṅām|
prasiddho niyamastatra niyamaḥ prakṛteṣu vā|
"karmaṇi dvitīyā"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-2)ityādeḥ prakaraṇasya "bahuṣubahuvacanam"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-20)ityādeśca svādisūtreṇa sahaikavākyatayāvidhāyakatvam| tathā "bahuṣu bahuvacanam"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-20)ityādisūtrayostibādivākyenāpyekavākyateti pūrvārdhasyārtha-| tṛtīyacaraṇenārthaniyama uktaḥ| caturthena tu prakṛtārthāpekṣaḥ pratyayaniyama uktaḥ| eṣāṃ pakṣāṇāṃ balāvalacintā tu "taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-1-38)iti sūtra evasmābhiḥ kṛtā| iha "ekadvibahuṣvekavacanadvivacanabahuvacanāni" iti kartumucitam| bahuśabdaśca saṅkhyāvācyeva grahīṣyate, dviśabdasāhacaryāt| ata eva hi ekaśabdaḥ saṅkhyāvācyeva gṛhyate| vastutastu idaṃ sūtradvayaṃ māstu| ekavacanādisaṃjñānāmanvayarthatāśrayaṇena sakaleṣṭasiddheḥ|
|| iti śrīśabdakaustubhe prathamādhyāyasya caturthe pāde dvitīyamānhikam ||
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-23)
kārake(aṣṭāosūo1-4-23)| adhikāro'yam| vyatyayena prathamārthe saptamī| tathāca `dhruvam' ityādau pratisūtraṃ vākyaṃ bhittvā kārakasaṃjñā vidhayite| tathāhi, apāye dhruvaṃ kārakasaṃjñaṃ syāt| tata apādānam| uktaṃ kārakamapādānasaṃjñaṃ syāt| punaḥ kārakaśabdānuvṛttisāmarthyādviśeṣasaṃjñābhiḥ saha samāveśo na tu paryāyaḥ| anuvṛttiṃ vināpi prathamavākyamātrāttatsiddheḥ| tena 'stamberamaḥ' ityādau adhikaraṇatvātsaptamī, kārakatvād "gatikārakopapadātkṛt"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-139)iti prakṛtisvaraśca siddhaḥ| thāthādisvarastu na bhavati, apā sāhacaryāderaca eva tatra grahaṇāt| na copapadatvādeva kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaro'stviti vācyam, "stambakarmayoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo3-2-13)iti nirddeśātpratipadikayostathātve'pi saptamīviśiṣṭayoratathātvāt| na hi saptamīviśiṣṭaṃ saptamyā nirdiṣṭam, yenopapadasaṃjñāṃ labheteti dik|
anvarthā ceyaṃ saṃjñā karotīti kārakamiti| tena kriyānvayino na bhavati| brāhmaṇasya putraṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchatīti| iha hi brāhmaṇaḥ puṃtraviśeṣaṇaṃ na tu kriyānvayī| nanu putro'pi kathaṃ kārakam? praśno hi jijñāsā| tatra praṣṭuḥ kārakatve'pi yaṃ prati praśnastasya janakatvāyogāditi cet? satyam, māstu janakatā| kriyānvayamātramiha vivakṣitam| taccāstyeva| etena sampradānasya kārakatvaṃ vyākhyātam| yadvā, sampradānāderapi prathamaṃ buddhyārohātkārakatā| evaṃ jñāyate karotītyādau kartṛkarmaṇorapi bodhyam| kāryāvyavahitapūrvakṣaṇavṛttīnāṃ kathaṃ kāraṇateti cet? yathā yāgasyetyavehi| tatra vyāpāro'stīti cet? na, tāvatā'pi yāgasya pūrvavartitānupapādanāt| avyavahitapūrvavartisvasvavyāpārānyatarakatvaṃ kāraṇatvamiti cet? na, vyāpāratvasya kāraṇatvagarbhatayā ātmāśrayāpatteḥ, svavyāpārasyeva svajñānasyāpi praveśasambhavācca| ata eva jñāyamānaṃ liṅgaṃ padañcānumitiśabdajñānayoḥ kāraṇamiti jarannaiyāyikāḥ| jñāyamānāḥ padārthāḥ kāraṇamiti ca mīmāsakāḥ| ata eva ca rathantarasāmāderaindravāyvāgnatvādau nimittatetyud‌ghoṣo mīmāṃsakānām| athavā upasarjanasaṃjñā yathā rājñaḥ kumāryā rājakumāryā ityādau yathāsambhavamanvarthā'pi `ardhapippalī' ityādau vacanādbhavati, tathā kārakasaṃjñāpi pratisūtraṃ vidhīyamānā vacanātsampradānādau bhavati| pradeśeṣu tu saṃjñāprakāraka eva bodhaḥ| tattadrūpaprakārako vetyanyadetat|
syādetat| `vṛkṣasya parṇaṃ patati' ityādau parṇaviśeṣaṇasyāpi vṛkṣasya kārakatāpattiḥ, `vṛkṣātpatati, itiprayogānurodhāt| tarhi asmadīyaśabdaprayogavailakṣaṇyamātreṇa ekasyaiva janakatvājanakatve vyavatiṣṭhete iti cet? atredaṃ siddhāntarahasyam| kārakatvaṃ tadvyāpyakartṛtvādiṣaṭkañca vastuviśeṣe'navasthitatam| viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyavat tarhi gauḥ sarvaṃ prati gaureva na tu kañcitpratyagauritivadviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇameveti suvacam| tathāca kiṃ kārakaṃ kaḥ karttā kiṃ karmetyādipraśne sarvamityuttaram| vakṣyamāṇakartṛtvakarmatvāderacetaneṣu anādiṣu ca nirbādhatvāt kayā pacidhātuvyaktyā upasthāpite'rthe kiṃ kartrādikamiti praśne tu prakṛtapacivyaktyupāttavyāpārāśrayaḥ kartā| vyāpāravyadhikaraṇaphalāśrayaḥ karma| yadvyāpārottarabhāvitvaṃ kriyāyā vivakṣyate tatkaraṇam| kartṛkarmaṇorāśrayo'dhikaraṇamityādi krameṇottaram| viklittyanukūlavyāpāro hi pacyarthaḥ| vyāpāraścānekadhā| tatra paceradhiśrayaṇataṇḍulāvapanaidhopakarṣaṇāpakarṣaṇaphūtkārāditātparyakatve tadāśrayo devadattaḥ kartā| jvalanatātparyakatve tvedhāḥ kartāraḥ| taṇḍuladhāraṇādiparatve sthālī kartrī| avayavavibhāgādiparatve taṇḍulāḥ karttāraḥ| ata eva karmakartā karaṇakartetyādivyavahāraḥ| evaṃ `sthālyā pacati' ityatra tṛtīyopāttavyāpārāśrayo'pi sthālī karaṇameva, na tu tadā kartrī; devadattādivyāpārasyaiva tatra dhātūpāttatvāt| tathā ādikhādibhyāmupātterthe baṭuḥ karttā| tasminnevārthe bhakṣayatinopātte baṭuḥ karma| adhipūrvaiḥ śīṅsthāprabhṛtibhirupātte'rthe ādhāraḥ karma| tatraiva kevalairupātte'dhikaraṇamityādi| nanvevamananugama iti cet? satyam, kasya kaḥ pitā ko bhrāta ityatrevānanugatasyaiva lakṣyatvāt| ata eva prayogāṇāṃ sādhvasādhutā vyavatiṣṭhate| anyathā kvacitkartuḥ sarvatra kartṛtāpattau sakalaprayogāḥ saṅkīryeran| uktaṃ ca hariṇā-
vastutastadanirddeśyaṃ na hi vastu vyavasthitam|
sthālyā pacyata ityeṣā vyavasthā dṛśyate yataḥ|| iti ||
ata eva prayojakavyāpāravyāpyatvāviśeṣepi pacyādidhātuṣu prayojyo na karma gamyādiṣveva tu karma tathā `paurāṇikācchṛṇoti' naṭasya śṛṇoti' ityatra paurāṇikopādānaṃ kārakañca, naṭastu nobhayamityādi vakṣyamāṇaṃ saṅgacchate| nanvevaṃ "laḥ karmaṇi"(aṣṭāosūo3-4-69)ityādividhiṣu kiṃ karma grāhyamiti cet? vinigamakābhāvātsarvamityavehi| yathā bhasyetyatra sarvaṃ bhama| tarhi ṭighubhādivatpāribhāṣikameva kārakatvakarmatvādikaṃ syāditi cet? ko vā brūte neti| etāvāneva paraṃ bhedaḥ-ṭighubhādīnāṃ śabdasaṃjñātvamitareṣāntvarthasaṃjñātvamiti| evañca "karmaṇi dvitīyā"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-2)ityanena yathāyathāmādhārādāvapi dvitīyā vidhīyate iti phalitam| `rathena gamyate' `ratho gacchati' ityādāvapi kartṛvibhaktirutsargeṇaiva siddheti na tatra lakṣaṇā''śrayaṇīyetyavadheyam| vibhaktīnāṃ vācyāṃśāniṣkarṣastu kariṣyate| etena jñānasya svaprakāśatve kartṛkarmavirodhamudbhāvayantaḥ parāstāḥ, śabdaviśeṣopādhikasya kartṛtvādeḥ pratyakṣādāvuktisambhavāt| etena parasamavetakriyāphalaśālitvaṃ karmatvaṃ cedapādane'tivyāptirityāśaṅkya dhātvarthatāvacchedakaphalaśālitvaṃ taditi pariṣkurvanto'pi parāstāḥ| `grāmaṃ gamayati devadattam' ityādau gantari avyāpteḥ| tvanmate gamanasya prakṛtyarthatve'pi tathātvānavacchedakatvāt| tattve vā pācayatyādiprayojyakartaryativyāpteḥ| tatra pāribhāṣikamanuśāsanopayogikarmatvaṃ vacanabalādvyavasthitamiti cet? apādāne'pi tarhi tannāstītyavehi, ekasaṃjñādhikāre'navakāśayā bādhāt| ata eva `ātmānamātmā hanti' ityādau parayā kartṛsaṃjñayā karmasaṃjñābādhamāsaṅkyāhaṅkārādiviśiṣṭātmabhedamāśritya tatratatra bhāṣye samāhitamiti dik|
nanvevaṃ karaṇaṃ kārakamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ katham, asvātantryeṇa ṇvulpratyayāyogāt| anyathā kartṛsaṃjñāpattau karaṇasaṃjñāyāḥ paryāyāpatteriti cet? ucyate, adhikārasāmarthyātkārakaśabdopanītaṃ svātantryamavasthāntaragataṃ vijñāyate| avasthāntare yatsvatantraṃ tatsādhakatamaṅkaraṇamiti| yathā `kurukṣetrasthaḥ kāśyāṃ vasanti' ityādau| kartustu sāmpratikaṃ svātantryam| tacca kartṛsaṃjñāyāmupayujyate iti| yadvā, kārakaśabdaḥ kriyā paraḥ, karoti kartṛkarmādivyapadeśāniti vyutpatteḥ| tathāca apādānādisaṃjñāvidhau kriyāyāmityasyopasthityā kriyānvayināmeva ttatttsaṃjñāḥ syuḥ| "kārakāddataśrutayoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-148)ityādau tu kārakaśabdaḥ svaryate| tenaitadadhikāroktaṃ kartrādiṣaṭkameva gṛhyata iti|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-24)
dhruvamapāye'pādānam(aṣṭāosūo1-4-24)| apāyo viśleṣo vibhāgastaddhetutvopahito gativiśeṣaśceha vivikṣitastasminsādhye'vadhibhūtamapādānasaṃjñaṃ syāt| vṛkṣātpatati| `dhruvam' ityatra "dhru gatisthairyayoḥ"(tuopao14000)ityasmātkuṭādeḥ pacādyac| ye tu "dhruva sthairye" iti paṭhanti| taṣāmigupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kapratyayaḥ| dhruvatīti dhruvaṃ sthiram| ekarūpamiti yāvat| dhruvamasya śīlamiti yathā| tathā cāpāye sādhye yadekarūpamityukte prakṛtadhātūpāttagatyanāviṣṭatve sati tadupayogīti labhyate| taccārthādavadhibhūtameva paryavasyati| tena `dhāvato'śvātpatati' ityādau kriyāyā viśiṣṭasyāpyaśavsya prakṛtadhātūpāttakriyāṃ pratyavadhitvanna virudhyate| tathā `parasparasmānmeṣāvapasarataḥ, ityatra sṛdhātunā gatidvayasyāpyupādānādekameṣaniṣṭhāṅgatiṃ pratyaparasyāpādānatvaṃ sidhyati| uktañca hariṇā prakīrṇakāṇḍe-
apāye yadudāsīnaṃ calaṃ vā yadi vā'calam|
dhruvamevātadāveśāttadapādānamucyate||
patato dhruva evāśvo yasmādaśvātpatatyasau|
tasyāpyaśvasya patane kuḍyādi dhruvamiṣyate||
meṣāntarakriyāpekṣamavadhitvaṃ pṛthak pṛthak|
meṣayoḥ svakriyāpekṣaṃ kartṛtvañca pṛthak pṛthak|| iti ||
atadāveśāditi apāyānāveśādityarthaḥ|
gatirvinā tvavadhinā nāpāya iti kathyate|
iti tatraivokteravadhinirapekṣasya calanasyāpāyatvābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| `parvatātpatato'śvātpatati' ityatra tu parvatāvadhikapatanāśrayo yo'śvastadavadhikaṃ devadattāśrayaṃ patanamarthaḥ| pañcamī tvavadhau śaktā| tatrābhedena saṃsargeṇa prakṛtyartho viśeṣaṇam| pratyayārthastu kriyāyāṃ viśeṣaṇam| kārakāṇāṃ kriyayaiva sambandhāt| anyathā'sādhutvāt| kriyānvaye satyeva hi kārakasaṃjñā, tatpūrvikā viśeṣasaṃjñāśca sthitāḥ| ata evāhuḥ-
nāmno dvidhaiva sambandhaḥ sarvavākyeṣvavasthitaḥ|
sāmānādhikaraṇyena ṣaṣṭhyā vāpi kvacidbhavet|| iti |
sāmānādhikaramyeneti `nīlo ghaṭaḥ' ityādyabhiprāyam| `nīlaṃ ghaṭamānaya' ityādāvapyantaraṅgakriyānvayānantaramekakriyāvaśīkṛtānāṃ pārṣṇikyabodhābhiprāyañca| ṣaṣṭhyeti akārakavibhakterupalakṣaṇaṃ `haraye namaḥ' iti yathā| kvaciditi, akārakavibhakterapi, `naṭasya śṛṇoti' ityādau kriyānvayadarśanāditi bhāvaḥ| etena `bhūtale ghaṭo na' ityatra bhūtalādheyatvābhāvo ghaṭe bhūtalādheyatvaṃ vā ghaṭābhāve viśeṣaṇamiti| dvedhā vyācakṣāṇā naiyāyikāḥ parāstāḥ, ubhayathā'pi kriyānanvaye kārakavibhakterasādhutvāt, arthābāve'vyayībhāvāpatteśca| tasya nityasamāsatvāt| nanvasmadukto'pi bodho'smaddarśanavyatutpannānāmanubhavasākṣika iti cet? satyam, na hi vayaṃ bodha eva nodetīti brūmaḥ| sarve sarvārthabodhanasamarthā ityabhyupagamāt kintu tasminnarthe'sādhutām| tathāca "siddhe śabdārthasambandhe" iti vārtikaṃ vyācakṣāṇā bhāṣyakārā āhuḥ-"samānāyāmarthasambandhe" iti vārtikaṃ vyācakṣāṇā bhāṣyakārā āhuḥ-"samānāyāmarthāvagatau sādhubhiścāsādhubhiśca gamyāgamyetivanniyamaḥ kriyate" iti| uktañca-
bhedābhedakasambandhopādhibhedaniyantritam|
sādhutvaṃ tadabhāve'pi bodho neha nivāryate|| iti ||
evañca kasmādvākyātkīdṛg bodha iti praśne yo yathā vyuptannastasya tādṛgeveti sthitiḥ| kīdṛśe bodhe sādhutvaṃ kutra neti paraṃ vicāraviṣaya iti tattvam| etena `ghaṭaḥ karmatvamānayanaṃ kṛtiḥ' ityādināṃ svarūpāyogyateti parāstam, tathā vyutpannasya bodhānubhavāt| anyathā vyutpannasya vyutpattirūpasahakārivirahātkāryānudaye'pi svarūpayogyatānapāyāt| etena prakṛtyarthaprakārako bodho yatra viśeṣyatayā tatra viṣayatayā pratyayajanya ityādikāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ kalpayanto'pyapāstāḥ, viparītavyutpādite vyabhicārasyodbhavāt| siddhānte tu ghaṭaḥ karmatvamityādyasādhveva| tathāhi, "abhihite prathamā" iti vārttikaṃ, tatkathaṃ ghaṭaḥ karmatvamiti prathamā? ghaṭānayanayorānayanakṛtī prati karmatayā "kartṛkarmaṇoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-65)iti ṣaṣṭhīprasaṅgācceti dik|
nirdiṣṭaviṣayaṃ kiñcidupāttaviṣayaṃ tathā|
apokṣitakriyañceti tridhāpādānamucyate||
yatra sākṣāddhātunā gatirnirddhiśyate tannirhiṣṭaviṣayam| `aśvātpatati' yathā| yatra tu dhātvantarārthāṅgaṃ svārthaṃ dhāturāha tadupāttaviṣayam| yathā `balāhakādvidyotate' iti| niḥ saraṇāṅge vidyotane dyutirvartate| yathā vā `kusūlātpacati' iti| ādānāṅge pāke'tra pacirvartate| apekṣitakriyaṃ tu tat, yatra pratyakṣasiddhamāgamanaṃ manasi nidhāya pṛcchati kuto bhavāniti, pāṭaliputrāditi cottarayati; arthādhyāhārasya nyāyyatāyā uktatvāt| iha `sārthāddhīyate' ityapi nirddiṣṭaviṣayasyodāharaṇam|
syādetat| paratvātsārthasya karttṛsaṃjñā prāpnoti| uktaṃ hi "apādānamuttarāṇi" iti| kiñca sārthasya kartṛtvābhāve tyajyamānasya karmasaṃjñā na syāt kartṛvyāpāravyāpyatvābhāvāt| tataśca hīyate hīna iti karmaṇiṃ lakāro niṣṭhā ca na syāt| na ca karmakartaryayaṃ lakāra iti vācyam, jahāteḥ kartṛsthakriyatvātkarmaṇyevāyaṃ lakāra iti indunoktatvāt| yattu "apādāne cāhīyaruhoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo5-4-45)iti sūtre nyāsakareṇa sampradānasūtre kaiyaṭena coktaṃ karmasaṃjñāyāṃ kartṛgrahaṇaṃ svātantryopalakṣaṇam| ato hānakriyāyāṃ svatantreṇāpādānenepsyamānasyeha karmateti| taccintyam, `māṣeṣvaśvaṃ badhnāti' ityatra karmaṇo'pyaśvasya vastuto bhakṣaṇe yatsvātantryaṃ tadāśrayakarmasaṃjñāpatteḥ| ata eva karmasaṃjñāvidhāyakasūtraśeṣe kaiyaṭenoktam-prayojakavyāpārasyāśabdārthatvāttadapekṣaṃ karmatvamayuktamiti|
atrāhuḥ-`sārthāddhīyate' ityatra karmakarttari lakāraḥ| tathāhi, apagamanā jahāterarthaḥ| sā ca kṣudupaghātādinā devadattasyāpagamate tatsamarthācaraṇam| yadā tu kṣudupaghātādinā svayamevāpagacchati tadā karmakartṛtvam| sphuṭañcedaṃ haradattamādhavagranthayoḥ|
syādetat| dhruvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham? na ca `grāmādāgacchati śakaṭene' ityatraśakaṭe'tivyāptivāraṇāya taditi vācyam, paratvāttatra karaṇasaṃjñāpravṛtteḥ| yathā `dhanuṣā vidhyati' ityatra| iha hi śaraniḥsaraṇaṃ pratyavadhibhāvopagamenaiva vyadhane karaṇatetyubhayaprasaṅgaḥ| `vṛkṣasya parṇaṃ patati' ityādau tu vṛkṣaḥ parmaviśeṣaṇaṃ na tvapāyena yujyate| na ca saṃjñinirdeśārthaṃ dhruvagrahaṇam, apāye kriyāyāṃ yadanvetītyasyākṣiptasya saṃjñisamarthakatvāt| yadvā, kārake iti nirdhāraṇasaptamyāśrayaṇātkārakamiti labhyate| pūrvatrāpi prathamārthe saptamītyuktatvācca| tasmād dhruvagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam|
jugupsāvirāmapramādārthānāmupasaṅkhyānam(kāovāo)| adharmājjugupsate viramati pramādyati vā| saṃśleṣapūrvako viśleṣo vibhāgaḥ| sa ceha nāsti| buddhikalpitastu gauṇatvānna gṛhyate iti vārttikārambhaḥ| bhāṣyakārāstu jugupsādayo'tra jugupsādipūrvikāyāṃ nivṛttau| vartante ityupāttaviṣayametat| kārakapraraṇe ca gauṇasyāpi grahaṇam| "sādhakatamam"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-42)iti tamagrahaṇālliṅgāt| apāyādipadānāṃ svaritatvādvā "svaritenādhikāraḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-11)gauṇo'pyartho gṛhyate iti vyavasthāpanāt| tena buddhikalpitasyāpyapāyasya satvātsiddham| pūrvaṃ hi buddhyā'dharmaṃ samprāpya tato doṣadarśanānnivartate ityastyapāyaḥ| evamuttarasūtreṣvapi prapañcatvaṃ bodhyamiti dik|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-25)
bhītrārthānāṃ bhayahetuḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-25)| bhayaṃ bhīḥ, trāṇaṃ trāḥ, bhayārthānāṃ trāṇārthānāñca yoge bhayahetuḥ kārakamapādānaṃ syāt| corebhya udvijate bibheti, rakṣati vā trāyate| bhayahetugrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam| `araṇye bibheti' ityādau tu paratvādadhikaraṇasaṃjñā|
iti rāmāyaṇaślokastu kasya saṃyuge iti yojanayā vyākhyeyaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-26)
parājerasoḍhaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-26)| parāpūrvasya jayateḥ prayoge'soḍho hyortho'pādānaṃ syāt| `adhyayanātparājayate' glāyatītyarthaḥ| akarmakaścāyam| tatra ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam| asoḍhaḥ kim? śatrūnparājayate| abhibhavatītyarthaḥ| asoḍha iti ktārtho bhūtakālo'trāvivakṣitaḥ| tena `adhyayanātparājeṣyate' ityādi siddham| vastutastu asoḍhagrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ `śatrūnparājayate' ityatra paratvātkarmasaṃjñāsiddheḥ| iha sūtre parājeriti rūpaṃ "viparābhyāṭhjeḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-12)itivatsamarthanīyam| yattu paratvāt "gherṅiti"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-111)iti guṇa iti haradattenoktaṃ tatsutrabhāṣyādiviruddhamiti prāgeva praṇañcitam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-27)
vāraṇārthānāmīpsitaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-27)| vāraṇārthānāṃ prayoge kriyayā āptumiṣṭaṃ kārakamapādanaṃ syāt| yavebhyo gāṃ vārayati| "vṛñvaraṇe"(cuouo1814)curādiḥ| pravṛttividhāto vāraṇam| īpsita iti kim? yavebhyo gāṃ vārayati kṣetre| nanviha paratvādadhikaraṇasaṃjñābhaviṣyati yathā kṛte'pīpsitagrahaṇe goṣu ipsitatamatvaprayuktā karmasaṃjñā| satyam, cintyaprayojanamevepsitagrahaṇam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-28)
antardhau yenādarśanamicchati(aṣṭāosūo1-4-28)| antardhāviti saptamī| yeneti kartari kṛtīyā| na ca kṛdyoge ṣaṣṭhīprasaṅgaḥ| ubhayaprāptau karmaṇyeveti niyamāt| vyavadhāne sati yatkartṛkasyātmano darśanasyābhāvamicchati tatkārakamapādānaṃ syāt| māturnilīyate kṛṣṇaḥ| "līṅśloṣaṇe"(dioāo1139)daivādikaḥ| atrāntardhāviti cintyaprayojanam| na `didṛkṣate corān' ityatra hi paratvātkarmatā siddhā| icchatīti kim? icchāyāmasatyāṃ satyapi darśane yathā syāt|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-29)
ākhyātopayoge(aṣṭāosūo1-4-29)| upayogo niyamapūrvakaṃ vidyāsvītakaraṇam| tasminsādhye ya ākhyātā tatkārakamapādānaṃ syāt| upādhyāyādadhīte| upayoge kim? naṭasya śṛṇoti|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-30)
