janikartuḥ prakṛtiḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-30)| jāyamānasya heturapādānaṃ syāt| putrātpramodo jāyate| iha janirutpattiḥ| "janirutpattirudbhavaḥ" ityamaraḥ(aokoo1-4-30)| "iñajādibhyaḥ"(kāovāo)iti janerbhāve iñ "janighasibhyām"(uosūo579)ityuṇādisūtreṇeṇ vā| "janivadhyośca"(aṣṭāosūo7-3-35)iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ| tasyāḥ karteti ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaḥ| "kartarica"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-16)iti pratiṣedhastvanityaḥ, ata eva jñāpakāt| yadvā, śeṣaṣaṣṭhyā samāso'yam| niṣedhastu karmaṣaṣṭhīviṣaya iti "kārake"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-23)iti sūtre kaiyaṭaḥ| tathā cārthamātrasya grahaṇāddhātvantarayoge'pi bhavati `aṅgādaṅgātsambhavati' iti yathā| etena "ikśitapau dhātunirddeśe"(kāovāo)itīkā nirdeśo'yamityāśritya "gamahana"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-98)ityupadhālopamarthāsaṅgatiṃ codbhāvayanto mīmāṃsāvārtikakārāḥ samāhitaḥ| atra prakṛtigrahaṇamupādānamātraparamityeke| ata eva "prakṛtiśca pratijñā dṛṣṭāntānuparodhāt"(praosūo)ityadhikaraṇe brahmaṇo jagadupādānatāyāṃ "yato vā imāni bhūtāni jāyante" iti pañcamīmupaṣṭambhikāmāhuḥ| anye tu `putrātpramodo jāyate' iti vṛttisvarasātprakṛtiśabda iha kāraṇamātrapara ityāhuḥ| asmiṃśca pakṣe `yato vā' iti sāmānyaśabdo'pi upādānarūpaviśeṣaparaḥ "chāgo vā mantravarṇāt"(jaiosūo6-89-31)iti ṣāṣṭhanyāyāt| "ahameva bahu syām" iti hi sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ śrūyate| tacca caturdhā-bhrame, bādhāyām, abhede, tādātmye ca| prakṛte tādātmye, bhinnatve satyabhinnasattākatvam āvidyakaḥ sambandhaviśeṣo vā tādātmyamityādyuttaramīmāṃsāyāṃ spaṣṭam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-31)
bhuvaḥ prabhavaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-31)| bhūkartuḥ prabhavaḥ prāgvat| himavato gaṃṅgā prabhavati| kaśmīrebhyo vitaratā prabhavati| "tasu upakṣaye"(di.pa.1213)bhāvektaḥ| vigatastā vitastā| aśoṣyetyarthaḥ| atropalabhateḥ karmavyāpāre prabhavatirvartate| prakāśate ityarthaḥ| "bhītrārthānām"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-25)ityārabhyeyaṃ saptasūtrī bhāṣye pratyākhyātā| tathāhi corebhyo bibheti| bhayānnivartate ityarthaḥ| trāyate, rakṣaṇena corebhyo nivarttayatītyarthaḥ| parājayate, glānyā nivartate ityarthaḥ| vārayati, pravṛttimpratibadhnannivartayati| nilīyate, nilayanena nivartate ityarthaḥ| adhīte, upādhyāyānniḥsarantaṃ śabdaṃ gṛhṇātītyarthaḥ| brahmaṇaḥ prapañco jāyate ityatrāpi tato'pakrāmati| yathā vṛkṣātphalamiti lokaprasidhyāśrayeṇāpāyo bodhyaḥ| prabhavatītyatrāpi bhavanapūrvakaṃ niḥsaraṇamarthaḥ|
atredaṃ vaktavyaṃ, nivṛttiniḥsaraṇādidhātvantarārthaviśiṣṭe svārthe vṛttimāśritya yathākathañciduktaprayogāṇāṃ samarthane'pi mukhyārthapuraskāreṇa ṣaṣṭhīprayogo durvāraḥ| `naṭasya śṛṇoti' itivat| na hyupādhyāyanaṭayoḥ kriyānukūlavyāpārāṃśe viśeṣo vaktuṃ śakyaḥ| anabhidhānabrahmāstramāśritya pratyākhyānantu nātīva manoramam| evañca "jugupsāvirāma"(kāovāo)ityādivārtikamapyavaśyārambhaṇīyam| tathāca sūtravārtikamatameveha prabalamiti yāvadbādhaṃ sādhu| tathā dhruvaṃ bhayaheturasoḍha ityādisaṃjñinirddeśo'pi sārthakaḥ paratvāttattatsaṃjñāprāptāvapi śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ na māṣāṇāmaśnīyādityādāviva ṣaṣṭhyā iṣṭatayā tatrāpādānasaṃjñāyā vāraṇīyatvādityavadeyam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-32)
karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa sampradānam(aṣṭāosūo1-4-32)| karmaṇā karaṇabhūtena kartā yamabhipraiti sambadhnāti īpsati vā tatkārakaṃ sampradānaṃ syāt| na ca yugapatkarmatvaṃ karaṇatvañca kathamiti vācyam, kriyābedenāvirodhāt| dānakriyāyāṃ hi karma abhiprāpaṇakriyāyāṃ karaṇam| dīyamānayā gavā hi śiṣya upādhyāyamabhipraiti| upādhyāyāya gāṃ dadāti| atrābhipraitīti padatrayam| na tu samāsa-| "udāttavatā gatimatā ca tiṅā gateḥ samāso vaktavyaḥ" iti vārttikasya chandoviṣayatvāditi haradattaḥ| bhāṣāviṣayatve bādhakaṃ tu tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ|
atra vṛttikārāḥ-anvarthasaṃjñeyaṃ samyak pradīyate yasmai tatsampradānamiti| teneha na-rājakasya vastraṃ dadāti| ghnataḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ dadāti| iha hi dadātirgauṇaḥ na tu vāstavaṃ dānamastītyāhuḥ|
bhāṣye tu naitatsvīkṛtaṃ `khaṇḍikopādhyāyastasmai capeṭāṃ dadāti' `na śudrāya matiṃ dadhāyat' ityādiprayogāt| `rājakasya dadāti' iti tu śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ bodhyam| nanvevam `ajānnayati grāmam' iti nayatikriyākarmabhirajaiḥ sambadhyamānasya grāmasya sampradānatvaṃ syāditi cet? na, yamabhipraitītyuktyā hi yamiti nirddiṣṭasya gavādeḥ śeṣatvaṃ ca pratīyate| yathā kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale iti kartuḥ śeṣitvaṃ kriyāphalasya śeṣatvaṃ ca| na ceha grāmaṃ pratyajā śeṣabhūtā| tathā ca prayojakalakṣaṇe prāsanavanmaitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍapradānamityadhikaraṇe "krīte some maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍaṃ prayacchati" iti daṇḍadānaṃ na pratipattiḥ, kintu dvitīyāpekṣayā balīyasyā caturthīśrutyā'rthakarmetyuktam| atra vārttikaṃ-kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| patye śete| bhāṣyakārāstu sandarśanaprārthanādhyavasāyairāpyamānatvātkriyāpi kṛtrimaṃ karma| tathā ca sūtreṇaiva siddham| pratīyamānakriyāpekṣopi hi kārakabhāvo bhavatyeva| praviśapiṇḍīmiti vat| sūtrakāraścāha "kriyārthopapadasya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-14)iti| na caivamapyadadātikarmatvāt kriyāgrahaṇaṃ karttavyameveti vācyam, bhāṣye anvarthasaṃjñātvāsvīkārāt| nanvevaṃ `kaṭaṅkaroti' ityādāvapi sampradānatvaṃ syāt| vacanabalācca karmasampradānatvayoḥ paryāyaprasaṅgaḥ| atrāhuḥ-nedaṃ vārttikaṃ sārvatrikam, kintu prayogānusārānniyataviṣayaṃ, dhātūpāttaphalānādhāra eva pravṛtteḥ| bhāṣyamate tu yatra sampradānatvamiṣṭaṃ tatra sandarśanādīnāṃ kriyāyāśca bhedo vivakṣyate| tataśca tairāpyamānā kriyāpi kṛtrimaṃ karmeti siddhaṃ tayā'bhipreyamāṇasya sampradānatvam| yatra tanneṣṭaṃ tatra bhedo na vivakṣyate| tataścotpattiviklittyādyekaphalāvacchedenaikīkṛtayā kriyayā vyāpyamānasya karmatvameva bhaviṣyati| `kaṭaṅkaroti' `odanaṃ pacati' iti| gatyartheṣu tu bhedo'bhedaścetyubhayaṃ vivakṣyate| tatra bhedavivakṣāyāṃ `grāmāya gacchati' iti prayogaḥ| abhedavivakṣāyāntu `grāmaṃ gacchati' iti| tathāca "gatyarthakarmaṇi"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-12)iti sūtre pratyākhyāsyate| uktañca hariṇā-
bhedasya ca vivakṣāyāṃ pūrvāṃ kriyāṃ prati|
parasyāṅgasya karmatvāttatkriyāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam||
kriyāṇāṃ samudāye tu padaikatvaṃ vivakṣitam|
tadā karmakriyāyogātsvākhyayaivopacaryate||
bhedābhedavivakṣā ca svabhāvena vyavasthitā|
tasmādgatyarthakarmatve vyabhicāro na dṛśyate||
vikalpenaiva sarvatra saṃjñe syātāmubhe yadi|
ārambheṇa na yogasya pratyākhyānaṃ samaṃ bhavet|| iti ||
asyārthaḥ-karma svākhyayaiva kriyepsitatvaprayuktakarmasaṃjñayaivopacaryate, vyavahriyate| na tu sampradānasaṃjñayā gatyarthakarmaṇi tu bhedābhedau dvāvapi vivakṣyete iti rūpadvayasiddhiḥ| vyabhicāro'tiprasaṅgastu na dṛśyate| vivakṣāyā vyavasthitatvādeva| etadeva draḍhayati-vikalpeneti| samaṃ tulyaphalakam| tasmātsūtraṃ pratyācakṣāṇasya bhavato vivakṣāniyamo'bhimataḥ| gatyartheṣu vivakṣādvayam| `patye śete' ityādau tu bhedavivakṣaiva| `odanaṃ pacati' ityādāvabhedavivakṣaiva| ceṣṭāyāmanadhvanītyetatpratyudāharaṇayorapi abhedavivakṣaiva| `manasā hariṃ vrajati' adhvānaṃ gacchati' iti tridhā cedam| yadāha-
anirākaraṇātkartustyāgāṅgaṃ karmaṇepsitam|
preraṇānumatibhyāñca labhate sampradānatām|| iti |
anirākartṛ yathā-sūryāyārghyaṃ dadāti| nātra sūryaḥ prārthayate, na vānumanyate, na ca nirākaroti| prerakaṃ yathā-viprāya gāṃ dadāti| anumantṛ yathā-upādhyāyāya gāṃ dadāti| nanu dānasya tadarthatvāttādarthye caturtho siddhaiva tatkiṃ sampradānasaṃjñayā? maivam, dānakriyārthaṃ hi sampradānaṃ na tu dānakriyā tadarthā, kārakāṇāṃ kriyārthatvāt| sampradānārthaṃ tu dīyamānaṃ karmeti vākyārthabhūtāpādanakriyāyā atādarthyāttādarthyacaturthyā aprāptau saṃjñārambhāditi helārājaḥ| tadetatsūcitam-tyāgāṅgaṃ karmaṇopsitamiti| karmasampradānayoḥ karaṇakarmatve vācye| paśunā rudraṃ yajate| paśuṃ rudrāya dadātītyarthaḥ| etacca vacanaṃ uktodāharaṇamātraviṣayam| ata eva subvyatyayena siddhatvātprātyākhyāyate| loke tu yajeḥ pūjārthatvātpaśoḥ karaṇatvaṃ siddham|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-33)
rucyarthānāṃ prīyamāmaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-33)| sampradānaṃ syāt| devadattāya rocane svadatte modakaḥ| atrāha hariḥ-
hetutve karmasaṃjñāyāṃ śeṣatve vāpi kārakam|
rucyarthādiṣu śāstreṇa sampradānākhyamucyate||
asyārthaḥ-anyasamaveto'bhilāṣo rucyarthaḥ| rocate| abhilāṣaviṣayo bhavatītyavagamāt| viṣayībhavantaṃ modakaṃ devadattaḥ prayuṅkte| laulyāttadānuguṇyamācaratīti devadattasya hetusaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ sampradānasaṃjñā kathyate| tathāca hetusaṃjñāvirahe ṇijabhāvāddhetusamavāyinyā dvitīyasyāḥ kriyāyā apratītermodakaḥ svakriyāyāṃ dhātuvācyāyāṃ kartābhavati, na tu karma| yadā tu rocate prīṇayatītyarthaḥ, tadā karmasaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam| tathā ca prīyamāṇa iti viśeṣaṇam| "prīñ tarpaṇe"(cuouo1836)ityasmātsakarmakātkarmaṇi laṭ| daivādikastu ṅidakarmakaḥ| tarpyamāma ityarthaḥ| yattu samarthasūtre `rocayāmahe' iti haradattena prayuktaṃ, tadasminneva pakṣe'dhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣamāśrityetyavadheyam| yadā tu devadattasya yo'bhilāṣastadviṣayo bhavatītyarthastadā śeṣatvātṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanamiti| prīyamāṇaḥ kim? devadattāya rocate modakaḥ pathi| karmādāvivādhikaraṇe mā bhūt| ata eva `ādityo rocate' ityatra dīptyarthe saṃjñā na bhavati|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-34)
ślāghanhūṅsthāśapāṃ jñīpsyamānaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-34)| eṣāṃ prayoge bodhayitumiṣṭaḥ sampradānaṃ syāt| devadattāya ślāghate| ślāghā stutiḥ| devadattaṃ stautītyarthaḥ| evaṃ hi devadattaḥ śakyate jñāpayitum| stutiḥ| devadattaṃ stautītyarthaḥ| evaṃ hi devadattaḥ śakyate jñāpayitum|
anye tvāhuḥ-devadattāyātmānaṃ paraṃ vā ślāghyaṃ kathayatītyartha iti| tathā ca bhaṭṭikāvyam-
ślāghamānaḥ parastrībhyastatrāgādrākṣasādhipaḥ| iti|
ātmānaṃ ślāghyaṃ parastrībhyaḥ kathayannityarthaḥ| tatrādye pakṣe karmatve prāpte dvitīye tu kārakaśeṣatvāt ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam| hnautiprabhṛtayo'tra svārthopasarjanajñāpanāvacanatvātsakarmakāḥ| tathāca jñīpsyamāna iti saṃjñiviśeṣaṇamupāttamiti helārājaḥ| `devadattāya nhute' devadattaṃ nhuvānastameva nhutiṃ tameva bodhayati| sannihitamapi devadattaṃ dhanikāderapalapatītyarthaḥ| athavā nhotavyaṃ devadattaṃ bodhayatītyarthaḥ| `devadattāya tiṣṭhate' īdṛśohamityavasthānena bodhayatītyarthaḥ| `devadattāya śapate' śapathena kiñcitprakāśayatītyarthaḥ| jñīpsyamānagrahaṇād `devadattaḥ ślāghate' `gārgikayā ślāghate pathi'ityādau kartrādiviṣaye saṃjñā na bhavati| `jñīpsyamāne vivadante' iti "śapa upālambhe" iti vārttikodāharaṇavyākhyāyāṃ kaiyaṭaḥ| tatra yasmai ākhyāyate sa jñīpsyamāna iti mate tu yasmā ākhyāyamānaḥ pratyudāharaṇam| tasmād dvitīyā, `devadattaṃ ślāghate' iti| ākhyāyamāno jñīpsyamāna iti mate tu yasmā ākhyāyate sa pratyudāharaṇam| tasmācca ṣaṣṭhī, devadattāya ślāghate viṣṇumitro yajñadattasyeti| "jñapa micca"(cuouo1624)iti curādikātsani karmaṇi sānaci jñīpsyamāna iti rūpaṃ bodhyam| na nu jñādhātoḥ tasya bodhane mittvābhāvāt| `tajjñāpayati' ityādibhāṣyaprayogāt| ata eva "māraṇatoṣaṇa"(gaosūo)ityatra niśāneṣviti pāṭho na tu niśāmaneṣviti| niśānaṃ tanūkaraṇam| śyaterlyuṭ| `saṃjñapitaḥ paśuḥ' ityudāharaṇam| "āp‌jñapyṛdhāmīt"(aṣṭāosūo7-4-15)ityatra tūbhayorapi jñapyorgrahaṇamiti siddhāntaḥ| caurādikaśca māraṇatoṣaṇaniśābhaneṣu varttate iti mādhavaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-35)
dhāreruttamarṇaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-35)| ayamuktasaṃjñaḥ syāt| "dhṛṅavasthāne"(tuoāo1413)| ṇyantaḥ| uttamarṇo dhanasvāmī| utkṛṣṭārthavṛtterucchabdāttamapi dravyaprakarṣatvādāmabhāvaḥ| arteḥ ktaḥ| ṛṇam| "ṛṇamādhamarṇye"(aṣṭāosūo8-2-60)ityatra kālāntaradeyandravyavinimayopalakṣaṇārthamādhamarṇyagrahaṇam| tenottamarṇe'pi natvaṃ bhavati| asmādeva nipātanānniṣṭhāntasya paranipāto bahuvrīhau bodhyaḥ| devadattāya śataṃ dhārayati| dhriyamāṇaṃ svarūpeṇāvatiṣṭhamānaṃ svabāvādapracyavamānaṃ śataṃ prayuṅkte ityarthaḥ| kārakaśeṣe ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāmidaṃ vacanam| uttamarṇaḥ kim? devadattāya śataṃ dhārayati grāme| paratvādihādhikaraṇasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti cet? uttamarṇe'pi tarhi hetusaṃjñā syāt|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-36)
spṛherīpsitaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-36)| spṛha īpsāyāṃ curādāvadantaḥ| asya prayoge'bhipretaḥ sampradāne syāt| puṣpebhyaḥ spṛhayati| īpsitamātra iyaṃsaṃjñā| prakarṣavivakṣāyāntu paratvātkarmasaṃjñā| puṣpāṇi spṛhayati| yadā tvīpsitamīpsitatamaṃ vā śeṣatvena vivakṣitaṃ tadā ṣaṣṭhyeveti haradattādayaḥ| helārājastu "hetutve karmasaṃjñāyām'(vāopāo)iti prāguktaślokavyākhyāvasare spṛhayatiyoge karmasaṃjñāyāḥ seṣaṣaṣṭhyāśca bādhikeyaṃ sampradānasaṃjñetyāha| vākyapadīyasvaraso'pyevam| asminpakṣe "paraspareṇa spṛhaṇīyaśobham" iti karmaṇyanīyar durlabhaḥ| `dānīyo vipraḥ' itivatsampradāna e tu vyākhyeyaḥ| tathā-
kumārya iva kāntasya trasyanti spṛhayanti ca|
iti ṣaṣṭhyapyasaṅtā| vibhaktivipariṇāmena kāntāya spṛhayantīti tu vyākhyeyam| haradattamate tu yathāśrutāveva uktaprayogau nirbādhāviti|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-37)
krudhadruherṣyāsūyārthānāṃ yamprati kopaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-37)| krodhādyarthānāṃ dhātūnāṃ prayoge yaṃ prati kopastatkārakaṃ sampradānaṃ syāt| devadattāya krudhyati druhyati īrṣyati asūyati vā| vāk‌cakṣurādivikārānumeyaḥ prarūḍhaḥ kopo'tra krodhaḥ| apakāro drohaḥ| asahanamīrṣyā| guṇeṣu doṣāropaṇamasūyā| nanu cittadoṣārthānāmityevāstu kiṃ krodhādināṃ viśiṣyopādāneneti cet? na, dviṣādāvatiprasaṅgāt| "yo'smāndveṣṭi" ityādau hyanabhinandanaṃ dviṣerarthaḥ| ata evācetaneṣvapi prayujyate `auṣadhaṃ dveṣṭi' iti| yampratītyādi kim? bhāryāmīrṣyati-maināmanyodrākṣīditi| nātra bhāryāmprati kopaḥ kintu parairdṛśyamānāṃ tāṃ na kṣamate ityeva| krudhadruhorakarmakatayā kārakaśeṣatvāt `naṭasya śṛṇoti' itivat ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam| itarayostu sakarmakatvāt dvitīyāyāṃ prāptāyām|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-38)
krudhadruhorupasṛṣṭayoḥ karma(aṣṭāosūo1-4-38)| sopasargayoranayoryaṃ prati kopastatkārakaṃ karmasaṃjñaṃ syāt| pūrvasūtrāpavādaḥ| devadattamabhikrudhyati, abhidruhyati|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-39)
rādhīkṣyoryasya vipraśnaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-39)| etayoḥ kārakaṃ sampradānasaṃjñaṃ syāt| yadīyo vividhaḥ praśnaḥ kriyate| kṛṣṇāya rādhyati īkṣate vā| pṛṣṭo gargaḥ śubhāśubhaṃ paryālocayatītyarthaḥ| śubhāśubhaparyālocanamiha dhātvarthaḥ| śubhāśubharūpayoḥ karmaṇordhātvarthenopasaṅgrahādakarmakāvetau| ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam| ata eva rādhyatīti śyan, akarmakādeva tadvidhānāt| tathāca divādyantargaṇasūtraṃ "rādho'karmakādvṛddhāveva"(gaosūo)iti| asyārthaḥ-evakāro bhinnakramaḥ| rādho'karmakādeva| yathā vṛddhāviti| ata eva "karmavat karmaṇā"(aṣṭāosūo3-1-87)iti sūtre "rādhyatyodanaḥ svayameva" iti bhāṣyaṃ saṅgacchate| tatra hi sidhyatītyarthaḥ| etena-
na dūye sātvatīsunuryanmahyamaparādhyati|
kriyāsamabhihāreṇa virādhyante kṣameta kaḥ ||
iti māghaprayogau vyākhyātau| etenaitayoḥkarmakārakaṃ sampradānaṃ syāditi vyācakṣāṇāḥ parāstāḥ| yasyetyanarthakaṃ yampratītyanuvṛttyaiveṣṭasiddheḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-40)
pratyāṅbhyāṃ śruvaḥ pūrvasya kartā(aṣṭāosūo1-4-40)| pratipūrva āṅ‌pūrvaśca śṛṇotirabhyupagame varttate| tasya pūrvo vyāpāraḥ pravarttanakriyā, tasyāḥ karttā sampradānaṃ syāt| viprāya gāṃ pratisṛṇoti āśṛṇoti vā| vipreṇa mahyaṅgāṃ dehīti pravarttitaḥ pratijānīte ityarthaḥ| hetusaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ `devadattena pratiśṛṇoti' iti prayoganivṛttaye vacanam| vivakṣāntare tu `devadatto gāṃ pratiśrāvayati' iti bhavatyeveti haradattaḥ| atredaṃ cintyam-uktarītyā `devadatto rocayati modakam' ityapi prayogo durvāraḥ| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ| tatratyasvagranthena helārājagranthena ca virodhāt| tatra hetutvabādhānna ṇijiti yadi, tarhi prakṛte'pi tulyam| tasmādiha vaiṣamyaṃ durvacamiti|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-41)
anupratigṛṇaśca(aṣṭāosūo1-4-41)| anupūrvasya pratipūrvasya gṛṇāteḥ kārakaṃ pūrvasya kartṛbhūtaṃ sampradānaṃ syāt| anupratibhyāṃ gṛṇāḥ anupratigṛṇāḥ tasyeti vigrahaḥ| anupratipūrvaśca gṛṇātiḥ śaṃsituḥ protsāhane varttate| tatra pūrvo vyāpāraḥ śaṃsanam| hotre anugṛṇāti pratigṛṇāti vā hotā prathamaṃ saṃsati, tamadhvaryuḥ `othāmodeva' ityādibhiḥ śabdaiḥ protsāhayatītyarthaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-42)
sādhakatamaṃ karaṇam(aṣṭāosūo1-4-42)| kriyāyāṃ prakṛṣṭopakārakaṃ karaṇasaṃjñaṃ syāt| yadvyāpārānantaraṃ kriyāniṣpattiḥ tatprakṛṣṭam| uktañca-
kriyāyāḥ pariniṣpattiryadvyāpārādanantaram|
vivakṣyate yadā tatra karaṇaṃ tattadā smṛtam|| iti |
kāṣṭhaiḥ pacati| vivakṣyate ityanena sthālyādīnāmapi vaivakṣikaṃ karaṇatvamastītyuktam| āha ca-
vastutastadanirddeśyaṃ na hi vastuvyavasthitam|
sthālyā pacyata ityeṣā vivakṣā dṛśyate yataḥ|
nanu kārakādhikārādeva siddhe sādhakatve punaḥ śrutiḥ prakarṣārthā'stu kiṃ tamapā? satyam, asminprakaraṇe sāmarthyagamyaprakarṣo nāśrīyate iti jñāpayituṃ tamap| tena `gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' iti siddham| yadā ca tīradharma ādhāratvaṃ pravāhe upacaryate tadedaṃ prayojanam| yadā tu gaṅgāśabda eva tīre varttate tadā na prayojanam| tatrādye vibhaktirlākṣaṇikī| "subvibhaktau na lakṣaṇā" iti tu "yena vidhiḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-1-72)iti sūtra eva nirākṛtam| dvitīye tu prakṛtirlākṣaṇikī| nanu ubhayaṃ mukhyamastu| paramparāsambandhastu saṃsargaḥ| maivam, kārakavibhaktyarthānāṃ prakṛtyarthe sākṣātsambandhena viśeṣyatāyā vyutpannatvāt| apādānaprakaraṇoktāni ca bahūnyudāharaṇāni tamabgrahaṇasya prayojanānīti bodhyam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-43)
divaḥ karma ca(aṣṭāosūo1-4-43)| divaḥ sādhakatamaṃ karmasaṃjñaṃ syāt, cakārātkaraṇasaṃjñam| karaṇaśabdānuvṛttyā vakṣaayamāṇasyānyatarasyāṃ grahaṇasyākarṣaṇena vā saṃjñayo- paryāye labdhe samāveśārthaścakāraḥ| tena `manasā dīvyatīti manasādevaḥ' ityatra karmaṇyaṇ karaṇe tṛtīyā cetyubhayaṃ sidhyati| "manasaḥ saṃjñāyām"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-41)ityaluk| kiñca `akṣairddevayate yajñadattena'ityatra sakarmakatvādaṇi karturṇau karmatvaṃ na, "aṇāvakarmakāt"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-88)iti parasmaipadaṃ ca neti dik|
syādetat, yadi samāveśaḥ, tarhi `akṣān dīvyati' ityatra paratvāttṛtīyā syāt| tathāhi, karaṇasaṃjñāyā avakāśaḥ-`devanā akṣāḥ'| karaṇe lyuṭ| karmasaṃjñāyā avakāśaḥ-dīvyante akṣāḥ| "bhāvakarmaṇoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-13)iti yagātmanepade| `akṣān' ityatra tūbhayasaṃjñāprayuktakāryaprasaṅge paratvāttṛtīyaiva prāpnoti| atrāhuḥ, kāryakālapakṣe "karmaṇi dvitīyā"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-2)ityatra padasyopasthānaṃ tasyānavakāśatvāt dvitīyeti| nanu `dīvyante akṣāḥ' ityatra karmaṇyabhihite'pi karaṇatvasyānabhidhānāttṛtīyā syāt| tathā `devanā akṣāḥ' iti lyuṭā karaṇasyābhidhāne'pi karmaṇo'nabhidhāyanāt dvitīyā syāt| maivam, ekaiva hyatra śaktiḥ saṃjñādvayayoginī| tathācobhayatrāpyabhidhaānameva na tvanabhihitatvam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-44)
parikrayaṇe sampradānamanyatarasyām(aṣṭāosūo1-4-44)| niyatakālaṃ vetanādinā svīkaraṇaṃ parikrayaṇaṃ tasmin sādhakatamaṃ kārakaṃ sampradānasaṃjñaṃ vā syāt| śatāya śatena vā parikritaḥ| pariśabdaḥ samīpyaṃ dyotayati| krayo nāmātyantikaṃ svīkaraṇam| niyatakālantu tasya samīpamiti bhāvaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-45)
ādhāro'dhikaraṇam(aṣṭāosūo1-4-45)| ādhriyante'smin kriyā ityādhāraḥ| "adhyāyanyāyodyāva"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-122)ityādinā karaṇe ghañ| kriyāśrayayoḥ kartṛkarmaṇordhāraṇāt paramparayā kriyā prati ādhāraḥ tatkārakamadhikaraṇaṃ syāt| kaṭe āste, sthālyāṃ pacati|
syādetat| sākṣāt‌kriyādhārayoḥ kartṛkarmaṇoreva kuto neyaṃ saṃjñeti cet? na, parābhyāṃ kartṛkarmasaṃjñābhyāṃ bādhitatvāt| ata evāhuḥ-
kartṛkarmavyavahitāmasākṣāddhārayat‌kriyām|
upakurvatkriyāsiddho śāstre'dikaraṇaṃ viduḥ|| iti ||
ata eva `bhūtale ghaṭaḥ' ityādau astītyasyādhyāhāro niyataḥ| yathā `puṣpebhyaḥ' ityatra spṛhayateḥ| ata eva ca nañā saha kārakānvayaṃ vadantaḥ parāstāḥ| trividhaṃ caitadadhikaraṇamiti "saṃhitāyām"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-72) iti sūtre bhāṣyam-aupaśloṣikaṃ vaiṣayikamabhivyāpakañceti| kaṭe āste, gurau vasati, tileṣu tailamiti|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-46)
adhiśīṅsthāsāṃ karma(aṣṭāosūo1-4-46)| adhipūrvāṇāmeṣāṃ ādhāraḥ karma syāt| adhiśete adhitiṣṭhati adhyāste vā vaikuṇṭhaṃ hariḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-47)
abhiniviśaśca(aṣṭāosūo1-4-47)| etatpūrvasya viśaterādhāraḥ karma syāt| grāmamabhiniviśate| abhiniveśa āgrahaḥ, tadvān bhavatītyarthaḥ| akarmako'yaṃ, tatrādhikaraṇasya karmasaṃjñā vidhīyate| praveśanārthe tu siddhaiva| "parikrayaṇe sampradānam'(aṣṭāosūo1-4-44)iti sūtrādihānyatarasyāṃ grahaṇamanuvarttate maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena| vyavasthitavibhāṣā ceyam| "eṣvartheṣvabhiniviṣṭānām" iti samarthasūtrasthabhāṣyaprayogaśceha mānam| tena `pāpe'bhiniveśaḥ' ityādi siddham| iha sūtre neralpāc‌tarasya paranipātākaraṇamīdṛśānupūrvīkasamudāyavivakṣārtham| teneha na `niviśate yadi śūkaśikhāpade'iti| karmatvavivakṣāyāntu tatrāpi bhavitavyameva dvitīyayā|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-48)
upānvadhyāṅvasaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-48)| etatpūrvakasya vasaterādhāraḥ karma syāt| upavasati anuvasati adhivasatyāvasati vā grāmaṃ senā| vaseraśyarthasya pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ|| arthaśabdo nivṛttivacanaḥ| vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau| vācyavācakabhāvaḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ| bhojananivṛttervācakoyo vasistasya netyarthaḥ| grāme upavasati| katham `upoṣya rajanīmekām' iti? "kālādhvanoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-5)iti dvitīyā bhaviṣyati| katham`ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta' iti? upapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbhaviṣyati|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-49)
karturīpsitatamaṃ karma(aṣṭāosūo1-4-49)| kartrā yadāptumiṣyatetamāṃ tatkarmasaṃjñaṃ syāt| yadvyāpārāśrayatvādasau kartā tenaiva vyāpāreṇāptumiṣṭamiti sannidhānāllabhyate| tena kriyāphalaśālitvaṃ paryavasyati| kriyā hi phalecchāpūrvakecchāviṣayaḥ, phalameva tviṣṭatamam| tacca dhātunopāttamiti tadviśiṣṭatvenecchāviṣayo'tra saṃjñī| sa ca trividhaḥ| uktañca-
nirvartyañca vikāryañca prāpyañceti tridhā matam|
tatrepsitatamaṃ karma caturdhā'nyattu kalpitam||
audāsīnyena yatprāpyaṃ yacca karturanīpsitam|
saṃjñāntarairanākhyātaṃ yadyaccāpyanyapūrvakam||
tathā-
yadasajjāyate sadvā janmanā yatprakāśate|
tannirvartyaṃ vikāryantu karma dvedhā vyavasthitam||
prakṛtyucchedasaṃbhūtaṃ kiñcitkāṣṭhādibhasmavat|
kiñcid guṇāntarotpattyā suvarṇādivikāravat||
kriyākṛtaviśeṣāṇāṃ siddhiryatra na gamyate|
darśanādanumānādvā tatprāpyamiti kathyate|
`tatra nirvartyaṃ yathā-`ghaṭaṃ karoti' iti| ghaṭā hyasanneva jāyate vaiśeṣikādimate| saṅkhyādisatkāryavādimate tu sannevābhivyajyate ityasti viśeṣalakṣaṇam| sāmānyalakṣaṇantu kṛdhātūpāttotpattyākhyaphalaśālitvāt| etena karotiryatnārthakaṃ iti mataṃ pratyuktam, yatate itivadakarmakatāpatteḥ| na ca jānātivadviṣayatvāpādanaparyantārthābhyupagamenāpi nirvāhaḥ, lāghavenotpādanamātraparatvāt kartṛsthakriyatayā karmavadbhāvāsiddhiprasaṅgācca| prakṛteḥ prakṛtibhūtasyātmana ucchedaṃ sambhūtaṃ prāptam| tadyathā, `kāṣṭaṃ bhasma karoti'| guṇāntarotpattyā yathā-`suvarṇaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ karoti' iti| iha bhasmakuṇḍalayornirvartyatvameveti bodhyam| prāpyantu-`ādityaṃ paśyati'iti| tathāyuktamiti dvividham-dveṣyamitaracca| "akathitaṃ ca"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-51)ityaparam| saṃjñāntaraprasaṅge cānyat-"divaḥ karma ca"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-43)ityādi| taditthaṃ saptavidhaṃ karmeti sthitam| iha prāpye yadyapi viṣayatākhyaḥ kriyākṛtaviśeṣo'styeva| anyathā karmatvānupapatteḥ| tathāpi pratipattṛvyatiriktapuruṣāpekṣayā viśeṣo na gamyate ityuktam| vikārye tu kāṣṭhādau kathaṃ dhātūpāttaphalāśrayatetyavaśiṣyate| tatredaṃ tattvam| prakṛtivikṛtyorabhedavivakṣayā nirūḍhayā utpattyāśrayatā| yadvā, kāṣṭhāni vikurvan bhasmotpādayatītyarthaḥ| taṇḍulān vikledayannodanaṃ nirvarttayatītivat| etaccha "dvyarthaḥ paciḥ" iti prakramya bhāṣye vyutpāditam| tatra `taṇḍulānodanaṃ pacati' iti prayoga taṇḍulaniṣṭhaviklitterodanītpatteścānukūlo devadattaniṣṭhavyāpāra ityarthaḥ| `taṇḍulānpacati' ityatra tu vikledayatītyarthaḥ| `odanaṃ pacati' ityatra tu viklittvā nirvartayatītyarthaḥ| uktaṃvaca-
sambandhamātramuktañca śrutyā dhātvarthabāvayoḥ|
tadekāṃśaniveśe tu vyāpāro'syā na vidyate || iti |
tasmāddhātutvena dhātūpāttāṃ bhāvanāṃ prati pacitvena pacyupāttā| viklittiḥ karmatayā karaṇatayā vā yathāyathaṃ sambadhyate iti sthitam‌| ihaṃ tvavadheyam, kriyāyā dhātunā karturapi devadattādiśabdena lābhādyathā na dvitīyārthatā tatheṣṭatamatvāderapi, prayogopādhimātratvāt| adhiśīṅādivat| evañca tathāyuktasthala ivehāpi dhātūpāttaphalādhāramātramarthaḥ| ādheyameva vā| taccābhedena phale'nveti| "ananyalabhyaḥ śabdārthaḥ" iti nyāyāt| anyathā tathāyuktatvānīpsitatvayorapi vācyatāpattau sakalatāntrikavirodhācca| evantu phalāśrayaḥ karmetyevāstāṃ kiṃ dvisūtryetyavaśiṣyate| tatredamuttaram, agnermāṇavakaṃ vārayati' ityatra māṇavakasya apādānasaṃjñāṃ bādhitumīpsitatamamiti tāvadvaktavyam| tasmiṃścokte dveṣyodāsīnayoḥ saṅgrahārthaṃ "tathāyuktam'(aṣṭāosūo1-4-50)ityapi sītraṇīyam| anīpsitagrahaṇantu śakyaṃ pratyākhyātum| tathā ca kartṛkarmavibhaktyorubhayorapyādhāro vācyaḥ, ādeyaṃ vā| vyāpāreṇa phalena cānvaya iti tu vyavasthayā śabdabodhavaiṣamyamiti sthitam| `godohanī' `paktā' `pakkaḥ' itvādikṛdantānāṃ nāmārthe'bedānvayānurodhādādhāra evārthaḥ, phalabhāvanayostu viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo viparīta ityavadheyam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-50)
tathāyuktañcānīpsitam(aṣṭāosūo1-4-50)| īpsitatamavatkriyayā yuktamanīpsitamapi karmasaṃjñaṃ syāt| grāmaṃ gacchan vṛkṣamūlānyupasarpati| caurān paśyati|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-51)
akathitañca(aṣṭāosūo1-4-51)| apādānādiviśeṣairavivakṣitaṃ kārakaṃ karmasaṃjñaṃ syāt| `naṭasya śṛṇoti' ityādāvatiprasaṅgaṃ vārayituṃ parigaṇanaṃ kartavyam|
duhiyācirudhiprachibhikṣiciñāmupayoganimittamapūrvavidhau|
bruviśāsiguṇena ca yatsacate tadākīrtitamācaritaṃ kavinā||
nīvahyorharateścāpi gatyarthānāṃ tathaiva ca|
dvikarmakeṣu grahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti niścayaḥ||
iha prachītyatra "che ca"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-43)iti tuṅ na kṛtaḥ, āgamaśāsanasyānityatvāt "sanādyantā dhātavaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo3-1-32)"iko yaṇaci"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-77)itivat| upayujyate ityupayogo mukhyaṃ karma kṣīrādi tasya nimittaṃ gāvādi duhyādīnāṃ mukhyakarmaṇā sambadhyamānamiti yāvat| tathā bruviśākhyorguṇena kārakeṇa karmaṇeti vāvat; kārakāṇāṃ kriyāṃ prati| viśeṣaṇatvāt| tatrāpi karmaṇa eva prakṛtatvāt| yatsacate sambadhyate| "paca samavāye"(bhvāo uo997) svaritet| kecittu parasmaipadibhiḥ sahainaṃ dhātuṃ paṭhanti| "ṣaca samavāye, rapa lapa vyaktāyaṃ vāci" iti| tanmate "ṣaca sevane'(vāoāo163)ityasyānudātteto dhātūnāmanekāryatvātsamavāye vṛttirbodhyā| ubhayathāpi sambadhnāteḥ karmavyāpāre sacirvartate| ata eva kartṛpadasya karmapadenārthakathanaṃ na virudhyate| "rādhyatyodanaḥ" ityasya pacyate ityanena yathā| ubhayatrāpyodananiṣṭhaviklitterbhānāviśeṣāt| kavinā medhāvinā sūtrakāreṇa tadakīrtitamitvācaritaṃ vyavahṛtamityarthaḥ| apūrvavidhāviti| pūrvoktānāmapādānādisaṃjñānāṃ viṣayaścennāstītyarthaḥ| na caivaṃ vakṣyamāṇayorhetukartṛsaṃjñayorviṣaye'tiprasaṅgaḥ syāditi vācyam, ekasaṃjñādhikāreṇa parābhyāṃ hetukartṛsaṃjñābhyāṃ karmasaṃjñāyā bādhāt| prāñcastu pūrvagrahaṇamanyamātropalakṣaṇam| tena vakṣyamāṇayorhetukartṛsaṃjñayorviṣaye nātiprasahaṅgaḥ| sūtrepyakathitamiti kathananivṛttiparāyānnodanānāṃ bhūtakālo na vivakṣyate yathā "parājerasoḍhaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-26)ityavrāsahiṣyamāṇasyāpyapādānasaṃtrā bhavati `adhyayanātparājeṣyate' iti tathehāpītyāhuḥ| taccintyam, uktarītyā yathāśrune'pi sarvasāmañjasyāt| "nivahyoḥ" iti śloke gatyarthānāmityuttarasūtropāttānāmupalakṣaṇam cakāreṇa jayatyādayo gṛhyante iti kaiyaṭaḥ| mādhavopyāha-
jayateḥ karṣatermanthermuṣerddaṇḍayateḥ paceḥ|
tārergrahestathā mocestyārjedārpiśca saṅgrahaḥ||
kārikāyāñcaśabdena sudhākarasukhaiḥ kṛtaḥ|| iti |
etanniṣkarṣastu kariṣyate| krameṇodāharaṇāni-gāndogdhi payaḥ| avinītaṃ vinayaṃ yācate| gāmavaruṇaddhi vrajam| māṇavaktaṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchati| pauravaṃ gāṃ bhikṣate| vṛkṣmavacinoti phalāni| māṇavakaṃ dharmaṃ brūte śāsti vā| ajāṃ nayati grāmaṃ, vahati bhāraṃ grāmaṃ harati vā, gamayati grāmamityādi| jayateḥśataṃ jayati devadattam| karṣati śākhāṃ grāmam| kṣīranidhiṃ sudhāṃ mathnāti| muṣṇāti śataṃ devadattena| gargan śataṃ daṇḍayati| taṇḍulānodanaṃ pacati| tārayati kapīn samudram| grāhayati baṭunedam| mocayati tyājayati vā kopaṃ devadattam| dīpayati śāstrārthaṃ śiṣyān|
syādetat, duhādīnāmarthanibandhaneyaṃ saṃjñā na tu svarūpāśrayā, "ahamapīdamacodyaṃ codye" iti tadrājasūtrabhāṣye pṛcchiparyāyasya cuderapi dvikarmakatvadarśanāt| tathā ca bhaṭṭiḥ-
sthāsnuṃ raṇe smeramuco jagāda mārīcamuccairvacanaṃ mahārtham|
kālidāsopi-
śiloccayo'pi kṣitipālamuccaiḥ prītyā tamevārthamabhāṣateva| iti|
bhāraviśca-
udāracetā giramityudārāṃ dvaipāyanenābhidadhe narendraḥ| iti|
tathāca mikṣerarthaparatvādvyācerapi siddham, tulyārthatvāt| `pauravaṃ gāmarthayate' iti yathā| tankiṃ pāceḥ pṛthaggrahaṇeneti cet? atrāhuḥ, anunayārtho'tra yācatiḥ| vinayaṃ yācate| vinayāyāyānunayatītyarthāt| astu tarhi yācereva grahaṇam| tasyānekārthatvādbhikṣerapi siddhamiti cet? na, arthabhedena śabdabheda iti darśanamāśrityānunayārthasyaiva pāceriha grahaṇāt| ata eva hi nayatigrahaṇenānunayārthasyāpi na gatārthatā| spaṣṭārthaṃ bhikṣeḥ pṛthag‌grahaṇamityanye| cakāreṇa pacergraha iti yanmādhavādibhiruktaṃ tanmatabhedena| tathāca "karmavātkarmaṇā"(aṣṭāosūo3-1-87)iti sūtre "duhipacyorbahulaṃ sakarmakayoḥ" itivārtikavyākhyāvasare pacerdvikarmakatā kaiyaṭena sphuṭīkṛtā| yattu "karturīpsitatamam"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-49)iti sūtre `dvyarthaḥ paciḥ' ityādi bhāṣyaṃ tattu matāntareṇa| anyathā `taṇḍulānodanaṃ pacati' iti prayogasya yathāśrutasyopapattau kiṃ mudhā kleśena| ata eva akathitaśabdo yadyapradhānārtho gṛhyeta tadā `pāṇinā kāṃsyapātryāṃ dogdhi payaḥ' iti pāṇikāṃsyapātryoratiprasaṅgaḥ| karaṇādhikaraṇayostu pacatyādiravakāśaḥ| na hi tatrāsya prasaṅgo duhādiparigaṇanādityakathitasūtre kathayataḥ karmavatsūtra tu pacerdvikarmakatāṃ bruvato haradattasya na pūrvāparavirodhaḥ, matabhedaparatvāt| ata eva pacidhātunirūpaṇe `taṇḍulānodanaṃ pacati' iti prayogaṃ dvikarmakatayaiva mādhava udāhṛtavāniti dik| tathā grāherdvikarmakatvaṃ bahavo na manire| ata eva-
tamādau kulavidyānāmarthamarthavidāṃ varaḥ|
paścātpārthivakanyānāṃ pāṇimagrāhayatpitā||
iti kālidāsaśloke pūrvārdhe graherduhyarthatayā 'gatibuddhi"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-51)iti sūtreṇāṇau karturṇau karmatvāttamiti yojayitvā uttarārdhe teneti vibhaktivipariṇāmena vyācakhyuḥ| ata eva ca-
ajigrahattaṃ janako dhanustadyenārdidaddaityapuraṃ pinākī|
jijñāsamāno balamasya bāvhorhasannabhāṅkṣīdraghunandanastat||
iti bhaṭṭiprayogo jayamaṅgalāyāmitthaṃ vyākhyātaḥ| ajigrahat anena dhanuṣā bhagavatā tripuradāhaḥ kṛta iti bādhitavāniti| yuktañcaitat, śrīraghupatiṃ prati niyogakathanānaucityena svarūpopasthāpanasyaiva kartavyatvāt| etena-
ayācitāraṃ na hi devadevamadriḥ sutāṃ grāhayituṃ śaśāka|
itivyākhyātam, graherbuddhyarthatvāt| yadvā, iṣiśakyostumanunantasamabhivyāhṛtayordvikarmakatāyā "bhāṣye sthitatvātsiddhametaditi madhāvaḥ| grāherdvikarmatābhyupagamapakṣe tu "jāyāpratigrahitagandhāmālyām"(raovāo2-1-)iti na sidhyet| tatra hi "ṇyante karttuśca karmaṇaḥ" iti prayojye dhenurūpe karmaṇi ktaḥ syāt| tathāca jāyayā gandhamālye pratigrāhitā yeti vigrahe bahuvrīhireva na syāt, trikataḥ śeṣasya bhāṣye sthitatvāt| satyapi vā tasmin puvadbhāvo durlabhaḥ| siddhānte tu pratigrāhite gandhamālye yayeti vigrahaḥ| jāyāniṣṭhapreraṇaviṣayībhūtaṃ gandhamālyakarmakaṃ yatpratigrahaṇaṃ tatkartrīmityarthaḥ| anyapadārthāntarbhāveṇaiva viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyavaiparītyenaivaikārthībhāvakalpanāt| māsajātādivat| vyapekṣāpakṣe tu tu aṣaṣṭhīvibhaktyarthe bahuvrīhau sarvatra vyutpattyantarakalpanā'styeva| `prāptādekam' ityasya hi udakakartṛkaprāptikarmībhūtamarthaḥ| `ūḍharathaḥ' rathakarmakavahanakartā| `upahṛtapaśuḥ' paśukarmakopahārasampradānam| `uddhṛtaudanaḥ' odanakarmakoddharaṇāpādānam| `vīrapuruṣakaḥ' vīrapuruṣakartṛkasthityadhikaraṇamiti dik|
syādetat| apādānādyavivakṣāyāṃ dvikarmakatā'stu, tadvivakṣāyāntu "jāyāpratigrāhita" ityādi setsyati| maivam, "harateśca" iti cakāreṇa samuccitānāṃ jayatyādīnāmakathitasūtraviṣayatve'pi "tathaiva ca" iti samuccitānāmaṇau karturṇau karmatābhyupagamāt| gatyarthaiḥ sāhacaryāt| ata eva tāryādayaḥ pṛthageva saṅgṛhītāḥ| yuktañcaitat, grahaṇakartṛtvasyāvivakṣāyāṃ prayojakasya hetutvābhāve ṇico durlabhatvāt| na caivaṃ dīpigrahaṇavaiyarthyamakarmakatvādevāṇau karturṇau karmatvasiddheriti vācyam, ṇyantāṇṇici tatsārthakyāt| śiṣyāḥ tatvaṃ dīpayanti tānasau prerayatītyarthaḥ| nanvevaṃ tyājeḥ saṅgṛhītatvādyadyapi "tyājitaiḥ phalamutkhātaiḥ" "muktāhārañciraparicitaṃ tyājito daivagatyā" ityādi siddham| tathāpi gavā payastyājayatītyartha iti kaiyaṭaharadattādigrantho virudhyate iti, caitraviśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ karmatve'pi kartṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ tasya nirbādhatvāt|
syādetat, "karturīpsitatamaṃ karma"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-49) "tathāyuktañcānīpsitam"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-50)iti sūtrābhyāṃ sarvamidaṃ siddham| tathāhi yathā viklittyupasarjanaṃ vikledanaṃ pacerthaḥ, nyagbhāvanaṃ ruheḥ, dvidhābhāvanaṃ bhideḥ, tathā tyajanopasarjanaṃ tyājanaṃ duheḥ, dāpanaṃ yāceḥ bhikṣeśca; aṅgīkāraṇamapi yāceḥ, praveśopasarjanamavasthāpanaṃ rudheḥ, ākhyāpanaṃ pṛccheḥ, mocanaṃ ciñaḥ, prativādanaṃ brūñaḥ, tadviśeṣastu śāserityādi| evañca dhātūpāttavyāpāraviṣayāśrayatvaṃ gavādeḥ spaṣṭameveti| ata evākaḍārasūtre "apādānamuttarāṇi, gāndogdhītyatra paratvātkarmasaṃjñā" iti bhāṣye saṅgacchate| pañcakaṃ prātipadikārtha iti pakṣe'vadhitvaphalāśrayatvayoryugapadvivakṣāyāṃ cedam, avadhibhūtā yā gaustanniṣṭho yaḥ kṣaraṇānukūlavyāpārastadviṣayiṇī gopaniṣṭhā preraṇetyarthāt|
atrecyate, karmaṇaḥ śeṣatvena vivakṣāyāṃ `na māṣāṇāmaśnīyāt' iti vat ṣaṣṭhīṃ bādhituṃ sūtram| apādānatvamātravivakṣāyāṃ tu pañcamyeva, goḥ kṣīraviśeṣaṇatve tu ṣaṣṭhī bhavatyeveti na kaściddoṣaḥ| tathāceha ṣaṣṭhīsambandhamātraṃ dvitīyārtha iti sthitam|
athedaṃ vicāryate-karmaṇi vidhīyamānālakṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ kiṃ dvikarmakebhyo mukhye karmaṇi syurgauṇe veti| atra bhāṣyam-
pradhānakarmavyākhyeye lādīnāhurdvikarmaṇām|
apradhāne duhādīnāṃ ṇyante kartuśca karmaṇaḥ|| iti |
abhidhāne iti śeṣaḥ| atra dvikarmaṇāmityanena "nīvahyorharateśca" iti ca śabdasamuccitaḥ kṛṣirnayatyādayaścatraya ucyante, anyoṣāṃ viśeṣasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt| tathā duhyādīnāmityanena kārikopāttāḥ, caśabdasamucciteṣvahetumaṇṇyantā daṇḍyādayaścocyante| ṇyanta ityanena tu gatyādisūtropāttāścaśabdasamuccitāstāryādayaśca| tatra aṇau karmatasyābhidhāne lādaya ityarthaḥ| tatrāpi buddhipratyavasānārthaśabdakarmakeṣu guṇakarmaṇīti matāntaram| tathāca bhāṣyam--
kathite'bihitetvavidhistvamatirguṇakarmaṇi lādividhiḥ sapare|
dhruvaceṣṭitayuktiṣu cātha guṇe tadanalpamatervacanaṃ smarata|| iti |
atra pradhānakarmaṇi lādibhirabhihite guṇakarmaṇi ṣaṣṭhītyekīyamatadūṣaṇaparaḥ prathamaḥ pādaḥ| tvasyā ṣaṣṭhyāḥ vidhīritīyaṃ tvasya anyasya matirna tu mametyarthāt| sapare gatyādisūtropāttasahite duhyādau guṇakarmaṇi lādayaḥ| guṇakarmeti| puruṣapravṛtteḥ payaḥprabhṛtyarthatvād duhādāvapradhānaṃ gavādyucyate| ṇyante tu śabdataḥ prayojakavyāpārasya prādhānyam| prayojyavyāpārasya tvapradhānyamiti tadārthadharmādyucyate| dhruvayuktayo'karmakāśceṣṭitayuktayo gatyarthāḥ| eṣvaguṇe prayojye| na ca buddhipratyavasānārthaśabdakarmakeṣu guṇakarmaṇyeva syāt ṇyante kartuścetyasya sapara ityanena bādhāditi vācyam, apara āheti bhāṣyeṇa matāntaratādyavasāyāt-
atrāyaṃ saṅgrahaḥ-
gauṇe karmaṇi duhyadiḥ pradhāne nīhṛkṛṣvahām|
buddhipratyavasānārthaśabdakarmasu cecchayā||
prayojyakarmaṇyanyeṣāṃ ṇyantānāmiha niścitaḥ|
lakṛtyaktakhalarthānāṃ prayogo bhāṣyapāragaiḥ||
tatra nīprabhṛtīnāṃ pradhānakarmasambandho'ntaraṅgaḥ| duhyādīnāntu viparītam| tena tadaṃśe nyāyasiddho niyamaḥ| itarattu sarvaṃ vācanikam| krameṇodāharaṇāni-gaurduhyate payaḥ| dohyā dugdhā sudohā| ajā grāmaṃ nīyate| neyā nītāsunayā| bodhyate māṇavakaṃ dharmaḥ, māṇavako dharmamiti vā| devadatto grāmaṃ gamyate gamayitavyaḥ gamitaḥ sugama iti| yattu kaumudyāṃ duhyācyarthetyādinā duhyādīn nyādīṃśca dvairāśyena paṭhitvā nyādayo mukhye duhyādayo gauṇa ityuktam| tatra graheḥ pāṭhonirmūla eva| "jagrāha dyutaruṃ śakram" ityudāharaṇañcāyuktam| itareṣāntu dvikarmakatāmātratātparyakaḥ pāṭhaḥ| nyādayo duhyādayaścetyubhayatrāpyādiśabdaḥ prakāre iti siddhāntāvirodhena vyākhyeyam| yathāśrute hi daṇḍimuṣibhyāṃ mukhye syāt| tathāca `gargāḥ śataṃ daṇḍyantām' iti bhāṣyaṃ virudhyeta| śataṃ tvatra pradhānaṃ, gargāḥ arthinaśca rājāno hiraṇyena bhavantīti vākyaśeṣāt daṇḍiśceha grahaṇārtho na tu nigrahārthaḥ| ata eva hyatra samudāye vākyasamāptiḥ, guṇānurodhena pradhānāvṛtteḥ sambhavāt| tathā mantherapi pradhāne syāt| iṣyate tu gauṇe| tathā ca bhāraviḥ-
yenāpaviddhasalilaḥ sphuṭanāgasadmā devāsurairamṛtamambunidhirmamantha| iti |
amṛtaṃ hyatroddeśyatayā mukhyam| ambunidhistu gauṇaḥ| yadapi anye tu yathārucītyuktvā "gopīhāvamakāryata bhāṣaścaināmanantena" ityudāhṛtam| tadapi na, ṇyante kartuśca karmaṇa iti siddhāntāt| yadvā, "kṝvijñāne" iticurādāvātmanepadībopadevena paṭhitaḥ| tasyedamudāharaṇam, buddhyartheṣu pakṣadvayasyopapāditatvāt| yattu śrīharṣaḥ prayuṅkta-
svakrīḍāhaṃsamohagrahilaśiśubhṛśaprārthitonnidracandrā| iti,
taccintyam, śiśunā candraṃ prārthitetyapradhāne ktapratyaye bahuvrīhyayogāt| vakṣyati hi-aprathamāvibhaktyarthe cāyamiti| na ca candre ktaḥ, "apradhāne druhādīnām" ityukteḥ| ata eva "kākapakṣadharametya yācitaḥ" iti kālidāsaḥ|
kṛtṣaṣṭhī guṇamukhyābhyāṃ karmabhyāṃ prāpyate pṛthak|
aviśeṣād dvitīyāvannetā grāmasya goriti||
yatratyekena śabdena bhinnakakṣyadvayābhidhā|
na śakyate tatra yuktamekasyaivopajīvanam||
pradhāne niyatā ṣaṣṭhī guṇe hyubhayathā bhavet|
ityāha goṇikāputra iti bhāṣyād guṇadvayam||
netāśvasya strughnasya strughnaṃ vā| iha pradhāne karmaṇi nityā ṣaṣṭhībhāṣyakāravacanāttu guṇakarmaṇi vaikalpikīti sthitam| nanvakarmāṇāṃ prākṛtakarmābhāvātkathaṃ dvikarmakatā? tathāca ṇyarthakarmaṇi pratyayo'stu `āsyate māṇavakaḥ' iti| māsamiti tu prayogo'saṅgataḥ| "dhruvaceṣṭitayuktiṣu vāpyaguṇaḥ" iti śloke dhruvagrahaṇañca vyarthamiti cet? na, "kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ karmasaṃjñā hyakarmaṇāṃ, deśaścākarmakāṇām" iti bhāṣyādgantavyo'dhvā adya gantavyaḥ| asamādeva nipātanād gantavyaśabdasya paranipātaḥ| gantavyatayā loke prasiddhasya niyataparimāmasya krośayojanādereva grahaṇam| tena `adhaavānaṃ svapiti' iti na bhavati| māsamāste| godohamāste| yāvatā kālena gaurduhyate tāvantaṃ kālamāste ityarthaḥ| krośamāste| kurūn svapiti| janyamātraṃ kālopādhiriti pakṣe godohāderyadyapi kālatvātsiddhaṃ tathāpi loke māsādereva tathātvena prasiddhatvātpṛthagbhāvagrahaṇam| deśaśabdena ca grāmasamudāyaviśeṣāḥ kurupañcālādayo gṛhyante iti kaiyaṭaḥ| tena "adhiśīṅsthāsām'(aṣṭāosūo1-4-46)ityādervaiyyarthyaṃ neti dhyeyam| 'kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-5)iti tu guṇadravyayorthe ārambhaṇīyam| krośaṃ kuṭilā| māsaṅguḍadhānāḥ| sakarmakārthañca| māsaṃ vedamadhīte| yadvā, āsyādayastatpūrvake vyāpane varttante| tathācotsargeṇaiva siddham, māsamāsanena vyāpnotītyarthāt| tathāca dvitīye bhāṣyam-"prākṛtamevedaṃ karma" iti| na caivaṃ sakarmakeṣvapyatiprasaṅgaḥ, lakṣyānurodhenākarmakāṇāmeyoktaprakārābhyupagamāt| āha ca-
kālabhāvādhvadeśānāmantarbhūtakriyāntaraiḥ|
sarvairakarmakairyoge karmatvamupajāyate|| iti |
helārājastvāha| sakarmakeṣvapi māsamodanaṃ pacatīti bhavatyeva| ata evoktaṃ sarvairiti| akarmakairiti tvavivakṣitamiti| kaiyaṭo'pyevam| asminpakṣe `māsamāste kaṭe' iti kaṭāderapi dvitīyā prāptā tathāpi kālādereva vyāpanakarmatvaṃ na tu kaṭāderiti helārājaḥ| anabhidhānañceha śaraṇam| `adhiśīṅ'(aṣṭāosūo1-4-46)ityādijñāpakaṃ vā bodhyam| iha ca karmaṇi bhāve ca lakāre `davadettanāsyate māsau māsaṃ vā' iti rūpadvayamapīṣṭam|
syādetat, bhāvecākarmakebhya iti vacanānmāsādikarmakātkathaṃ bhavila iti cet? ucyate, akarmakebhya ityanenāntaraṅgaṃ dravyakarma vyudasyate na tu bahiraṅgaṃ kālādikarma| karmaṇītyatra tu vyaktipakṣāśrayaṇādantaraṅgāsannidhau bahiraṅge kālādikarmaṇyapi pratiraviruddhā, jātivyaktipakṣayorlakṣyānurodhena vyavastheti siddhāntāt| uktañca hariṇā-
śaktipramāmasaṃkhyāderdravyadharmādviśiṣyate kriyāsu kālayogo'taḥ prāgyogo dravyakarmaṇā|| iti |
atastaiḥ karmabhirdhāturyukto dravyairakarmakaḥ|
lasya karmaṇi bhāve ca nimittatvāya kalpate|| iti ca |
etena--
"sastemāghamaghābhidhāni yamunā gaṅgaughasaṅge yayā"
iti śrīharṣaprayogo vyākhyātaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-52)
gatibuddhipratyavasānārthaśabdakarmākarmakāṇāmaṇi kartā sa ṇau(aṣṭāosūo1-4-52)| gatyādyarthānāṃ śabdakarmakāṇāmakarmakāṇāṃ cāṇau yaḥ kartā sa ṇau karmasyāt| niyamārthamidam-ṇijarthenāpyamānasya yadi bhavati tarhi gatyarthādīnāmeveti| tena `pācayati devadatto yajñadattena' ityatra prayījye pūrvapravṛttakarttṛsañjñāyā eva nirapavādatvenāvasthānāttṛtīyā siddhyati|
āha ca--
guṇakriyāyāṃ svātantryātpreṣaṇe karmatāṅgataḥ|
niyamātkarmasaṃjñāyāḥ svadharmeṇābhidhīyate|| iti|
kartuḥ svadharmeṇa tṛtīyayetyarthaḥ| `gamayati māṇavakaṃ grāmaṃ' grāmakarmakaṃ yadramanaṃ tadanukūlavyāpārāśraya ityarthaḥ|
nīvahyoḥ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ|| yadyapyetayoḥ prāpaṇamartho na tu gatistathāpi viśeṣamatayā gatirapi vācyakoṭiniviṣṭetyetāvanmātreṇa prāptiṃ matvā pratiṣedha uktaḥ| nāyayati vāhayati vā bhāraṃ devadattena| vaheraniyantṛkartṛkasyaiva pratiṣedhaḥ|| niyantṛkartṛkasya prayojyaḥ karmeti vaktavyamiti phalito'rthaḥ| vahanti vāhāḥ vāhayati vāhān rathinaṃ sūtaḥ| "yā prāpaṇe"(aopao1-49)ityatra tu gatireva prāpaṇaśabdārthaḥ, yāti gacchatītyekārthapratīteḥ| tena `kālaṃ pācayati' ityādau prayojyasya karmatā bodhyā| budhyarthagrahaṇena jñānasāmānyavācina eva gṛhyante na tu tadviśeṣavācinaḥ smaratyādayaḥ| ata eva śrudṛśorupasaṅkhyānaṃ kariṣyate| bodhayati māṇavakaṃ dharmam| pratyavasānaṃ bhakṣaṇam| bhojayati āśayati māṇavakamodanam|
ādikhādyoḥ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ|| ādayati khādayatyannaṃ baṭunā|
bhakṣerahiṃsārthasya pratiṣedho vaktayaḥ|| hetumaṇṇijante vidhiriti pratiṣedho'vyaṇāvityayaṃ sannidhānāttadviṣayaḥ| tena curādiṇijante'pi bhakṣayatau prāptisattvātpratiṣedha upasaṅkhyātaḥ| bhakṣayatyannaṃ baṭunā| ahiṃsārthasyeti kim? bhakṣayanti balīvardāḥ sasyam| bhakṣayati balīvardān sasyam| kṣetrasthānāṃ yavānāṃ bhakṣyamāṇānāṃ hiṃsā draṣṭavyā, tasyā mavasthāyānteṣāṃ cetanatvābhyupagamāt| śabdaḥ karmakārakaṃ yeṣānte śabdakarmāṇaḥ, na tviha "kartari karmavyatihāre"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-14)ityatreva karmaśabdaḥ kriyāparaḥ, gatibuddhipratyavasānaśabdārtheti vaktavye'rthaśabdātkarmaśabdasya pṛthagupādānāt adhyāyayati pāṭhayati māṇavakaṃ vedam|
jalpatiprabhṛtīnāmupasaṅkhyānam|| jalpayati vilāpayati ābhāṣayati putraṃ devadattaḥ|
dṛśeścopasaṅkhyānam|| darśayati hariṃ bhaktān| yadyapi dṛśerjñānasāmānyaparatve budhyarthatvādeva siddhaṃ tathāpi jñānaviśeṣārthatāyāṃ na sidhyatītyupasaṅkhyānāmārabdham| `śrāvayati ślokaṃ devadattam' iti tu śabdakarmatvātsiddham| śabdakriyāṇāmiti vyākyāne tu śṛṇoterupasaṅkhyeyaṃ syāt| vhayatikrandatyośca pratiṣedhyaṃ syāt| vhāyayati krandayati vā devadattena| dṛśestūbhayathāpyupasaṅkhyeyaṃ syāt| śabdāyateścobhayathā pratiṣedhyam| akarmakatvādapi hyatra prasaṅgaḥ| śabdalakṣaṇasya karmaṇontarbhāvāt karmāntārayogācca| śabdāyayati devadattena| akarmakagrahaṇena tu yeṣāṃ kālādibhinnaṃ karma na sambhavati te gṛhyante, na tvavivakṣitakarmāṇo'pi| tena `māsamāsāyati devadattam' ityādau karmattvaṃ siddham| `devadattena pācayati' ityādau ca na bhavati| gatyarthākarmaketi sūtre'pyevam| ata evāvivakṣitakarmakebhyaḥ pacidadātiprabhṛtibhyaḥ kartari kto na| anyathā `pakvavān' `dattavān' ityarthe `pakvaḥ' `dattaḥ' iti syāt| "laḥ karmaṇi"(aṣṭāosūo3-4-69)iti sūtre tu avivakṣitakarmaṇāmasambhavatkarmaṇāṃ vā grahaṇam| ata evāvivakṣitakarmaṇāṃ na bhāve lādaya itīha sūtre vadato "ṇeraṇau'(aṣṭāosūo1-3-67)ityatra tu `neha pacyate' iti bhāve lakāra iti bruvato haradattasya matabhedaparatvānna pūrvāparavirodha iti dik|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-53)
hṛkroranyatarasyām(aṣṭāosūo1-4-53)|| hā ca krā ceti vigrahaḥ| huśca kruśceti vā | anayoraṇau karttā ṇau vā karma syāt| navetivibhāṣāsūtre ubhayatravibhāṣāsvidaṃ vārtikakṛtā paṭhitam| tathāhi, `abhyavahārayati māṇavakamodanaṃ māṇavakena vā' ityatra pratyavasānārthatvātprāpte `vikurvate chātrāḥ, vikārayati chātrān chātrairvā' ityatrākarmakatvātprāpte itaratra tvaprāpte vibhāṣeyam|
abhivādidṛśorātmanepade veti vaktavyam|| abhivādayateraprāpte vibhāṣā| dṛśestu buddhyādyarthatvādupasaṅkhyānādvā prapti| abhivādayati guruṃ devadattaḥ, abhivādayate guruṃ devadatte devadattena vā| "ṇicaśca"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-74)ityātmanepadam| parasmaipade tu `abhivādayati guruṃ devadattena'| darśayate rājānaṃ bhṛtyān bhṛtyairvā| karmasaṃjñābhāvapakṣe karmāntarasyābhāvāt| "ṇeraṇau"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-67)ityātmanepadamanyatra tu "ṇicśca"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-74)itīti prāñcaḥ| vastutastu "ṇicaśca" ityeva yuktam| "ṇeraṇau" ityasya tu nāyaṃ viṣayaḥ ṇijvācyaprayuktibhedāditi tatraivopapāditam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-54)
svatantraḥ karttā(aṣṭāosūo1-4-54)| kriyāyāṃ svātantryeṇa vivakṣito'rthaḥ kartā syāt| dhātūpāttavyāpārāśrayatvaṃ svātantryam| āha ca--
dhātunoktakriye nityaṃ kārake kartṛteṣyate| iti |
karmakartaryapyastīdam| phalavyāpārayorvaiyadhikaraṇyamātrasya pacāvautsargikasya paṃ tyāgaḥ| viśakalitaśaktipakṣe viśiṣṭaśaktipakṣe cedaṃ tulyam| nivṛttapreṣaṇaṃ karma svakriyāvayave sthitamiti pakṣe tu pradhānabhūtadhātvartha eveha kriyā, dhātutvaṃ tu bhūtapūrvabhāvanārthatvāt| etena kārakāṇāṃ kriyānvayaniyamo'pi dvedhā vyākhyātaḥ| devadattaḥ pacati| sthālī pacati| ananyalabhyasya śabdārthatvādāśrayo lakārārthaḥ| devadattena pacyate| devadattarūpo ya āśrayastadviśiṣṭo viklittyanukūlavyāpāra ityarthaḥ| vaiśiṣṭyaṃ cādheyatārūpaṃ saṃsargamaryādayā bhāsate|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-55)
tatprayojakohetuśca(aṣṭāosūo1-4-55)| tasya kartuḥ prayojako hetusañjñaḥ syāccātkartṛsañjñaḥ| saṃjñāsamāveśārthaścakāraḥ| kurvantaṃ prerayati kārayati hariḥ| hetutvāttadvyāpāre "hetumati ca"(aṣṭāosūo3-1-26)iti ṇic| kartṛtvātkartari lakāraḥ|
|| iti śrīśabdakaustubhe prathamasyādhyāyasya caturthe pāde tṛtīyamānhikam ||
||caturthe pāde caturthamānhikam||
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-56)
prāgrīśvarānnipātāḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-56)| "adhirīśvare"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-97)ityataḥ prāk prāṅ nipātā ityadhikriyate, tantrādyāśrayaṇāt| tena pūrvaṃ nipātasañjñāḥ santaḥ paścādratyādisañjñā ityarthātsaṃjñāsamāveśaḥ sidhyati| anyathā gatyupasargakarmapravacanīyasañjñānāṃ nipātasañjñāyāśca paryāyaḥ syāt| tantrādau pramāṇaṃ tu prāggrahaṇasāmarthyameva| anyathā rīśvarāditi pañcamyaiva dik‌śabdākṣepātkiṃ tena? na ca paraśabdakṣepaprasaṅga| "cādayo'sattve"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-57)| "prādayaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-58)ityetayorvidheyayorlābhenānanvayāpatteḥ| rephaviśaṣṭagrahaṇaṃ kim? "īśvare tosunkasunau"(aṣṭāosūo3-4-13)ityasya vyāptinyāyenāvadhitvaṃ mā bhūt| vastutastu māstu rephaḥ pratyāsattyā'bhimatasiddheḥ avyayībhāvasyāvyayasañjñārambhācca| na cāsau samāse'pyavyayībhāva eveti niyamārthaṃ syāditi vācyam, gauravagrastaṃ vyāptinyāyamāśritya niyamārthatvavarmanāpekṣayā pratyāsattervidhyarthatāyāśca nyāyyatvāt| ata eva "naloka"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-69)iti sūtre avyayātpṛthak lokādīnāṃ grahaṇamapyupapadyate iti dik|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-57)
cādayo'sattve(aṣṭāosūo1-4-57)| cādayo nipātasañjñāḥ syuḥ na tu dravye| nipātatvādatavyayatvam| ca vā ityādi|
vastūpalakṣaṇaṃ yatra sarvanāma prayujyate|
dravyamityucyate so'rtho bhedyatvena vivakṣitaḥ||
liṅgasaṃkhyānvayi dravyamiti vā| asattve kim? paśunā yajeta, paśuśabdaścādiḥ| `caḥ samuccaye' ityapi pratyudāharaṇam| na cātra "prakṛtivadanukaraṇam"(paobhāo36)ityapi pratyudāharaṇam| na cātra "prakṛtivadanukaraṇam"(pāobhāo36)ityatideśāt nipātatvaṃ durvāramiti vācyam, atideśasyānityatāyāḥ ṛlṛk‌sūtre evopapāditatvāt| prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ kim? vātīti vāḥ, viprātīti vipraḥ| iha kriyāviśiṣṭadravyavācakatayā kriyāyāścāsattvarūpatvānnipātatāsyāt| tataśca vepraśabdasyāpyavyayasañjñā syāt| "prayojanaṃ sarvanāmāvyayasañjñāyām"(maobhāo)ityuktatvāt|
atha cādayaḥ-va vā ha aha eva evaṃ nūnaṃ śaśvat yugapat bhūyas kūpat praśnavitarkapraśaṃsāsvayam| evaṃ sūpadapi| kuviditi bhūyo'rthe yogapraśaṃsāstibhāveṣu ca| nediti śaṅkāyām| "nejjihyāyanto narakaṃ patāma"| "nedevasāpunajannadevāḥ" ityādau tu na iditi padadvayaṃ paṭhyate| tasmānnipātasamudāyo'yaṃ bodhyaḥ "nipātairyadyadi"(aṣṭāosūo8-1-30)iti nighātaniṣedhaḥ| pratiṣedhavicārasamuccayeṣvayamiti tu śākaṭāyanaḥ| cet| caṇ| ayaṃ cedarthe ṇit, samuccayādau tvananubandhaḥ| idaṃ ca "nipātairyadyadi"(aṣṭāosūo8-1-30)ityatra sphuṭībhaviṣyati| kaccit| yatra| naha niścitaniṣedhe| hanta harṣe'nukampāya ca| mākiḥ mākīm etau niṣedhe| mākirneśanmākīṃ riṣanmākīṃ saṃśārike vaṭet kissambhāvitaniṣedhena kirindratvaduttaraḥ| nakirevāyathātvaṃhikaṃnukam| sukaṃākī nakī nakiḥ| mākīṃ mākiḥ| ākṛtamiti vedanighaṇṭuḥ| āmiśrāṇi navottarāṇīti tadvyākhyāyāṃ yāskaḥ| māṅ| "māṅi luṅ"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-175)itiviśeṣaṇārtho ṅakāraḥ| mā bhavatu mā bhaviṣyatītyatra niranubandho māśabdaḥ| nañ| ñakāro "nalopo nañaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo3-6-73)iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| nasyetyukte tu vā `pāmanaputra'ityatrāpi syāt| na ca siddhānte'pi straiṇaputre'tiprasaṅgaṃ vārayitum "aluguttarapade"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-1)ityuttarapadākṣiptena pūrvapadena naño'vaśyaṃ vaśeṣaṇīyatvāttenaiva pāmanaputrasyāpi siddheḥ kiṃ ñakāreṇeti vācyam, "naikadhāgamikarmīkṛtanaikanīvṛtta"ityādau niṣedhārthena naśabdena "sahasupā"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-4)iti samāse'tivyāptiṃ vārayituṃ ñitvasyāpyāvaśyakatvāt| naña| pūrvapadasya viśeṣaṇe'pi ananyārthañittvasya nipātasyaiva prahaṇaṃ na tu vṛddhyā caritārthañakārasya taddhitasyāpīti tu prācāṃ granthasyoktisambhavo bodhyaḥ| yāvat| tāvat| tvai nvai etau vitarke| śrauṣṭ| vauṣaṭ| svāhā| vaṣaṭ| svadhā oṃ| tathā| hiruk| khalu| kila| atha| suṣṭhu| ādaheti hi sopakramakutsaneṣu| `ādahasva dhāman' ityatra tu padakārā āditi pṛthak paṭhanti| upasargavibhaktisvarapratirūpakāśca|
avadattaṃ vidattaṃ ca pradattaṃ cādikarmaṇi|
sudattamanudattaṃ ca nidattamiti ceṣyate||
"aca upasargāttaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo7-4-47)iti ghoratatvaṃ na bhavati, upasargapratirūpakatvepyanupasargatvāt| vibhaktipratirūpako yathā-aham| śubham| ahaṃyuḥ śubhaṃyuḥ-"ahaṃśubhamoryus"(aṣṭāosūo5-2-40)cireṇa| antareṇa| cirāya| acirāt| akasmāt| cirasya mama| mamatvaṃ gatarājyasya| velāyāṃ mātrāyāmityādi| etena "geye kena vinītau vām" iti vyākhyātam| vāmityasyāvyayasya yuvāmityarthāt| āha āsetyādīni tu tiṅantapratirūpakāṇi| svarāstu sambodhanabhartsanānukampāpādapūraṇapratiṣedheṣu yathāsambhavaṃ bodhyāḥ| a apehi| ā evaṃ manyase| i indraṃ paśya| ī īśaḥ| ū ūpare bījaṃ vapati| e ito bhava| ośrāvaya| ṛ ṛ lṛ ai au ete mantrastomāḥ| paśviti samyagarthe| lodhaṃ nayatanti paśu manyamānāḥ| śukamiti śīghratve| yathā kathācetyanādare| pāṭ pyāṭ aṅga hai he bho aye ityādayaḥ sambodhane| gheti haṃsāprātilomyapādapūraṇeṣu| viṣu iti nānārthe| ekapade ityakasmādarthe| nihantyarīnekapade| puta iti kutsāyām| kutsitasavayavañchādayati iti puñchaḥ| ṅaḥ| puliti lāntamiti śākaṭāyanaḥ| kutsitaṃ kasati gacchatīti pulkasaḥ| asmītyahamarthe| tvāmasti vacmi viduṣāṃ samavāyotra tiṣṭhati| āta iti ito'pītyarthe| ityādi| ākṛtigaṇaścāyam|

prādayaḥ(aṣṭāosūda1-4-58)| prādayo gatisaṃjñāḥ syuḥ kriyāyoge| pulliṅgo'yaṃ gatiśabdaḥ, "gatiranantaraḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-49)iti liṅgāt| avyutpannaścāyaṃ ktijanto vā| "na ktici dīrghaśca"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-39)iti tu na pravartate, ata eva nirddeśāt| upasargasaṃjñayā saha samāveśārthaścakāraḥ| anyathā paryāyaḥ syāt| tena `praṇeyam' ityādau ṇatvaṃ kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaraśca sidhyati| nipātasaṃjñāyāstu samāveśaḥ prāggrahaṇena sādhita eva| iha yatkriyāyuktāḥ| prādayastaṃ pratyeva gatyupasarsasaṃjñāḥ, yogagrahaṇasāmarthyāt| tena pravṛddhaṃ kṛtaṃ prakṛtamityatra "gatiranantaraḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-49)iti svaro na, karmaṇi ktāntaṃ pratyagatitvāt| kṛñarthaviśeṣakatve tu syādeva| tathā `pravṛddho bhāvaḥ prabhāvaḥ' ityatra "śriṇībhuvonupasarge"(aṣṭāosūda3-3-24)iti ghañ siddhaḥ| evaṃ `praṇāyayati' `abhipācayati'ityādau prakṛtyarthagataprakarṣabhimukhyadyotakatāyāṃ ṇatvaṣatve staḥ| ṇyarthaviśeṣakatve tu neti bodhyam| nipātasaṃjñā tu kriyāyogaṃ vinā'pyasti| etadarthameva hi prādaya iti yogo vibhaktaḥ| tena `pragata ācāryaḥ prācāryaḥ' ityatrāvyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ sidhyati|
upasargasaṃjñāyāṃ marucchabdasyopasaṅkhyānam| maruttaḥ| upasargasaṃjñāvidhānasāmarthyādajantatvābhāvepi "aca upasargāttaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo7-4-47)iti tatvaṃ pravartate ityāhuḥ| evañca marunnayatītyatra ṇatvamapi prāpnoti| tasmāttatva eva saṃjñā vaktavyā| ata eva kividhiraṅ ca na bhavati| nipātasaṃjñā tu nāsyeṣṭā| tena "tṛtīyākarmaṇi"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-48)iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvare kṛte maruttaśabdo madhyodāttaḥ| nipātattve tvādyudāttaḥ syāt| na ca "upasargāścābhivarjam"(phiosūo81)iti phiṭsūtrāddoṣatādavasthyaṃ śaṅkyam| "nipātā ādyudāttāḥ"(phiosūo80)ityeva siddhe'bheḥ pratiṣedhamātrārthaṃ tatsūtrārambhāditi haradattādayaḥ| ata eva nābhirityeva sūtryatām| māstu vā tadapi, evādiṣu abheḥ supaṭhatvādityavocām| evañca "tapparvamarudbhyām" iti marutaśabdavyutpādane upāyāntaraṃ bodhyam| tatra ca tapaḥ pittvameva samyak| tanniti nittvapāṭhastu kvācitkaḥ prāmādikaḥ| anyathā maruttaśabdasyādyudāttatāpattau prakṛtasūtrasthakaiyaṭādivirodhāpatteḥ| matvarthīyaprakaraṇe tano nittvaṃ maruttaśabdasyādyudāttanāṃ cāvalambya pravṛtto haradattagranthastu cintyaḥ| "parvataścinmahi vṛddho vibhāṣā" ityādau paṭhyamānaṃ parvataśabdasyādyudāttatvaṃ tu dvedhāpi sidhyati| "nabviṣayasyānisantasya"(phiosūo26)iti parvataśabdasyādyudāttatvāt|
śracchabdasyāṅ‌vidhāvupasaṅkhyānam|| śraddhā| bhidādipāṭhātprajñāśraddhetinipātanādvā siddham|
antaḥśabdasyāṅkividhiṇatveṣūpasaṅkhyānam|| etacca "antaraparigrahe"(aṣṭāosūda1-4-65)ityatra bhāṣye sthitam| antardhā| antarddhiḥ| ñca "antaradeśe"(aṣṭāosūo8-4-24)iti na kartavyam| deśe tu kṣubhnāditvāṇṇatvābhāvaḥ| ayanaṃ cetyapi na kartavyaṃ "kṛtyacaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo8-4-29)iti siddheḥ| deśe tu kṣubhnādinā bodhyeti kaiyaṭaḥ| deśe niṣedhārthaṃ sūtradvayamiti tu haradattaḥ| pakṣadvaye'pi `antarṇayati' `antarbhavāṇi' ityādau yathāyathaṃ ṇatvaṃ bodhyam|

satyam, nedamupasargatvaprayuktaṃ kintu "upasargaprādurbhyām"(aṣṭāosūo8-3-87)ityatra pṛthaggrahaṇaprayuktam| etena `prāduṣyanti' iti paṭhitvā pra āṅ dus ityupasargatrikapūrvasya syateḥ "upasargātsunoti"(aṣṭāosūo8-3-65)ityādinā ṣatvamiti vyācakṣāṇāḥ parāstāḥ, dura upasargatāyāḥ ṣatvavidhau niṣedhāt, syaterthasya prakṛtāsambandhācca| ṇatvam| durnītam| durnayaḥ| etena "duraḥ parasya ṇatvaṃ na" iti keciditi paṭhitvā siddhānte ṇatvamiti bhrāmyantaḥ parāstāḥ|

(aṣṭāosūo1-4-71)

vibhāṣā kṛñi(aṣṭāosūo1-4-72)| prāptavibhāṣeyam "tirontardhau"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-71)ityanuvṛtteḥ| tiraḥkṛtteḥ| tiraḥkṛtya| tiraskṛtya| "tiraso'nyatarasyām"(aṣṭāosūo8-3-42)iti vā satvam| pratyudāharaṇe tu na satvam, tadvidhau gatigrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| tiraḥ kṛtvā kāṣṭham| kecittvihāpi satvamicchantaḥ parābhave tiraskāraśabdaprayogaṃ cānurundhānāḥ satvavidhau gatigrahaṇaṃ nivartayanatīti mādhavaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-73)
upāje'nvāje(aṣṭāosūo1-4-73)| etau kṛñi vā gatisaṃjñau staḥ| vibhaktipratirūpakau nipātāvimau durbalasya sāmarthyādhāne vartete| upājekṛtya| upājekṛtvā| anvājekṛtya| anvājekṛtvā| upaṣṭabhyetyarthaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-74)
sākṣātprabhṛtīni ca(aṣṭāosūo1-4-74)| etāni kṛñi vā gātisaṃjñāni syuḥ| cvyartha iti vaktavyam|| sākṣātkṛtya| sākṣātkṛtvā| asākṣād‌bhūtaṃ sākṣātkriyate cettadā'yaṃ prayogaḥ, na tu sākṣād‌bhūtasyaiva rūpāntarāpādāne| cvyanteṣu tu pūrvavipratiṣedhād "ūryādicvi"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-61)iti nityaiva saṃjñā| tena `lavaṇīkṛtya' ityatra māntatvaṃ na bhavati| tadvikalpasanniyogeneha gaṇe nipātyate| yadvā, lavaṇaśabdasya lavaṇamiti mānt ādeśaḥ| tathāca māstu pūrvavipratiṣedhaḥ| traiśabdyaṃ hi naḥ sādhyam-lavaṇaṃkṛtya lavaṇaṃkṛtvā lavaṇīkṛtyeti| tatra cvyantācavyantayoḥ pākṣike lavaṇamādeśe samaṃ rūpam| pareṇāpi vikalpena mukte tu cvyantasya nityā saṃjñeti na kaściddoṣaḥ| ihāgnau vaśeprabhṛtayo vibhaktipratirūpakā nipātāḥ| prādurāviḥśabdayorūryāditvātprāpte vibhāṣā| sākṣāt mithyā cinteti manovyāpāre| cintākṛtya| bhadrā ālocanāpraśaṃsāmaṅgaleṣvayam| rocanetītiśraddhotpāde praśaṃsāyāṃ ca| ameti rahaḥsāhityayoḥ| āsthā śraddhā| prājaryāvī jaryā jaraṇakriyāyām| prājaruhā bījaruheti ruhikriyāyām| lavaṇam| uṣṇam| śītam| udakam| ārdram| lavaṇādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ gatisaṃjñāsanniyogena māntatvaṃ nipātyate māntādeśo vetyuktam| agnau vaśe vikampane vikasane prahasate santapane| prādus namas āvis| ākṛtigaṇo'yam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-75)
anatyādhāna urasimanasī(aṣṭāosūo1-4-75)| etau nipātau kṛñi vā gatisañjñau sta-| urasikṛtya| urasikṛtvā| abhyupagamyetyarthaḥ| manasikṛtya| manasikṛtvā| niścityetyarthaḥ| atyādhānamupaśleṣaḥ| catra na| upasikṛtvā pāṇiṃ śete|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-76)
madhyepadenivacane ca(aṣṭāosūo1-4-76)| ete trayaḥ kṛñi gatisañjñā vā syuranatyādhāne| madhyekṛtya| madhyekṛtvā| padekṛtya| padekṛtvā| edantāvetau nipātau| nivacanaṃ vacanābhāvaḥ| asyāviśeṣeṇa edantatā nipātyate na tu sañjñāsanniyogena, vyākhyānāt| nivacanekṛtya| nivacanekṛtvā vācaṃ niyamyetyarthaḥ| anatyādhāne kim? hastinaḥ pade kṛtvā śiraḥ śete|

nityaṃ haste pāṇāvupayamane(aṣṭāosūo1-4-77)| etau nipātau kṛñi nityaṃ gatisañjñau sta upayamane| dārakarmaṇītyeke| svīkāramātra ityante| hastekṛtya pāṇaukṛtya kanyāṃ mahāstrīṇi vā| upayamane kim? hastekṛtvā suvarmaṃ gato bhṛtyaḥ|

prādhvambandhane(aṣṭāosūo1-4-78)| prādhvamiti cādiṣu pāṭhānmāntamavyayamānukūlye vartate| tatkṛñi nityaṃ gatisañjñaṃ syādbandhanahetukaṃ cedānukūlyam| prādhvaṃkṛtya| bandhane kim? bandhane kim? prādhvaṃkṛtvā| prārthanādinānukūlaṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ|

(aṣṭāosūo1-4-80)

chandasi parepi(aṣṭāosūo1-4-81)|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-82)
vyavahitāśca(aṣṭāosūo1-4-82)|spaṣṭam| haribhyāṃ yāhyoka ā| āmandrairindra haribhiryāhi| iha sañjñāniyamapakṣo'pi bhāṣye sthitaḥ, te ityanena prādīnupaniṣatparyantāt svarūpeṇa parāmṛśya dhātoḥ prāk prayuktānāmeṣāṃ pūrvasūtraikavākyatayā sañjñāvidhānāt| asmiṃśca pakṣe 'chandasi pare'pi" iti sūtradvayam anitiparagrahaṇaṃ ca na karttavyamiti sthitam| sukaṭaṅkarāṇīti bhāṣyaṃ ca saṅgacchate| prayoganiyamapakṣe tu 'kṛtyalyuṭaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-113)iti bahulagrahaṇena samarthanīyaṃ syāt| yattu khalaḥ khitkaraṇasāmarthyādanavyayasya prāk prayoge nirṇite soḥ pariśeṣādvyavadhānaṃ sidhyatīti| taccintyam, sāmarthyādvyavahite mumaḥ sambhavāt kṛdgrahaṇe gatipūrvasyāpi grahaṇācca īṣacchabdasyāgatisañjñakatayā `īṣadāḍhyambhavaḥ' ityatra khalaḥ khittvasyopakṣīṇatvācceti dik| dhātoḥ kim? prakartumaicchat prācikīrṣadityatra sanaḥ prāk prayogo mā bhūt|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-83)
karmapravacanīyāḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-83)| rīśvarātprāgidamadhikriyate| karma kriyāṃ proktavantaḥ karmapravacanīyāḥ bāhulakātkartaryanīyar, sa ca bhūte| tena samprati kriyāṃ na dyotayantīti labhyate| āha ca-
kriyāyā dyotako nāyaṃ sambandhasya na vācakaḥ|
nāpi kriyāpadākṣepī sambandhasya tu bhedakaḥ|| iti |
tathāhi, śākalyasya saṃhitāmanupravarṣadityatrānunā na kriyāviśeṣo dyotyate| anubhūyate sukhamityādau yathā| nāpi ṣaṣṭhyeva sambandha ucyate, dvitīyayaiva tasyoktatvāt| nāpi prādeśaṃ viparilikhati vimāya parilikhatītyatra viśabdena mānakriyeva kriyāntaramākṣipyate, kākaravibhaktiprasaṅgāt| kintu saṃhitāsambandhivarṣaṇamiti dvitīyāvagataḥ sambandho lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvarūpa evetyavagamātsambandha evānunā viśeṣa'vasthāpyate| kvacittu kriyāgataviśeṣadyotake'pīyaṃ sañjñā vacanātpravartate| "suḥ pūjāyām"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-94)"atiratikrameṇa ca"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-95)iti yathā|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-84)
anurlakṣaṇe(aṣṭāosūo1-4-84)| lakṣaṇe dyotye'nuḥ karmapravacanayisañjñaḥ syāt| "lakṣaṇetthambhūta"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-90)ityādinā siddhe hetau tṛtīyāṃ bādhitumidaṃ sūtram| tathāhi, lakṣaṇe karmapravacanīyasañjñāyā avakāśaḥ-yo na hetuḥ, `vṛkṣamanuvidyotate vidyut' iti| hetutṛtīyāyā avakāśaḥ-`dhanena kulam' iti| `saṃhitāmanuprāvarṣat' ityatra tu hetūbhūtasaṃhitopalakṣitaṃ varṣaṇamityarthāddhetubhūte lakṣaṇe paratvāttṛtīyā syāt| punaḥ sañjñāvidhānasāmarthyāttuṃ dvitīyaiva bhavati| āha ca-
hetuhetumatoryogaparicchede'nunā kṛte|
ārambhādvādhyate prāptā tṛtīyā hetulakṣaṇā|| iti|
na ca 'tṛtīyārthe'(aṣṭāosūo1-4-85)iti sūtreṇa gatārthatā śaṅkyā| tasya purastādapavādanyāyena "sahayukte'pradhāne"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-19)ityetanmātrabādhakatvāt|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-85)
tṛtīyārthe(aṣṭāosūo1-4-85)| asmin dyotye'nuruktasaṃjñaḥ syāt| nadīmanvavasitā senā| nadyā saha sambaddhetyarthaḥ| 'ṣiñ bandhane"(svāouo1248)asmātkartari ktaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-86)
hīne(aṣṭāosūo1-4-86)| hīne dyotye'nuḥ prāgvat| anu hariṃ surāḥ| haripratiyogikāpakarṣarūpasambandhavanta ityarthaḥ| utkṛṣṭādeva dvitīyā na tvapakṛṣṭāt, śaktisvabhāvāt|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-87)
upo'dhike ca(aṣṭāosūo1-4-87)| adhike hīne ca dyotye upaḥ praksaṃjñaḥ| upakhārthāṃ droṇaḥ| khārīto'dhiko droṇo'sti| ubhayamastīti phalito'rthaḥ| "yasmādadhikam"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-9)iti saptamī| hīne-upahariṃ surāḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-88)
apaparī varjane(aṣṭāosūo1-4-88)| etau varjane dyotye prāgvat| apaviṣṇoḥ pariviṣṇoḥ saṃsāraḥ| "pañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-10)iti pañcamī| 'parervarjane"(aṣṭāosūo8-1-5)iti dvirvacanam| taddhi pañcamīsahitena karmapravacanīyena dyotite'pi varjane bhavatyeva, ubhayorapi vidhānasāmarthyāt| varjane kim? pariṣiñcati| sarvata ityarthaḥ| atropasargatvātṣatvam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-89)
āṅ maryādāvacane(aṣṭāosūo1-4-89)| āṅ prāgvat maryādāśabdo yasminsūtre ucyate tatratyaścet| "āṅmaryādābhividhyoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-13)ityatropātto dvyartha ityarthaḥ| āmukteḥ saṃsāraḥ| ābālebhyo haribhaktiḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-90)
lakṣaṇetthambhūtākhyānabhāgavīpsāsu pratiparyanavaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-90)eṣavartheṣu viṣayabhūteṣu pratyādaya uktasaṃjñāḥ syuḥ| lakṣaṇe-va़kṣaṃ prati pari anu vā vidyotate vidyut| kañcitprakāraṃ prāpta itthaṃbhūtastadākhyāne yathā-sādhurdevadatto mātaraṃ prati paryanu vā| bhāge-yadatra māmprati syāt, parisyāt, anusyāt| yo'tra mama bhāgaḥ sa dīyatāmityarthaḥ| svasvāmibhāvo dvitīyā'rthaḥ| vīpsā pyāptumicchā sākalyapratipipādayiṣeti yāvat| bhūtaṃbhūtaṃ prati paryanu vā prabhuḥ| sakalabhūtānāmityarthaḥ| na ca "itthaṃbhūtākhyāne'(aṣṭāosūo1-4-9)ityeva siddham| idaṃ tarhyudāharaṇaṃ-vṛkṣaṃvṛkṣaṃ pratisiñcati, parisiñcati, anisiñcati| iha vīpsā dvirvacanenaiva dyotyate| pariśabdastu kriyayaiva sambadhyate| na caivantasya karmapravacanīyatvaṃ na syāditi vācyaṃ vīpsāyā viṣayatvānapāyāt| ata eva vīpsāyāṃ viṣayabhūtāyāmiti vṛttigranthamavatārayanharadatta āha-ete ca lakṣaṇādayo yathā vibhaktisamīpādayo'vyayārthāḥ, naivaṃ pratyādīnāmarthāḥ kintarhi saṃjñāyāṃ pratyādīnāṃ viṣayatvena nirddiṣṭā ityāheti| dvitīyā tu karmaṇi| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā tūpasargatvanivṛttyarthaḥ| tena "upasargātsunoti'(aṣṭāosūo8-3-65)iti ṣatvaṃ na| pariśabdayoge pañcamī tu na bhavati "pañcamyapāṅ"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-10)ityatra varjanārthenāpetyanena sāhacaryāt|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-91)
abhirabhāge(aṣṭāosūo1-4-91)| bhāgavarje lakṣaṇādāvabhiruktasaṃjñaḥ syāt| vṛkṣamabhividyotate| sādhurmātaramabhi| vṛkṣamabhisiñcati| abhāge kim? yadatra mamābhiṣyāttaddīyatām|

suḥ pūjāyām(aṣṭāosūo1-4-94)| susiktam| sustutam| anupasargatvānna ṣaḥ| pūjāyāṃ kim? suṣiktaṃ kintavātra| kṣepo'yaṃ, na pūjā| kathaṃ tarhi suṣṭutiriti? atiśayamātraṃ vivakṣitaṃ na tu pūjetyāhuḥ| paṭhanti ca-

atiratikramaṇe ca(aṣṭāosūo1-4-95)| atikramaṇe pūjāyāṃ cātiḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñaḥ syāt| atikramaṇamucitādadhikasyānuṣṭhānam| atisiktam| atistutam| bahutaraṃ samīcīnaṃ vā siktaṃ stutañcetyarthaḥ|

apiḥ padārthasmabhāvanānvavasargagarhāsamuccayeṣu(aṣṭāosūo1-4-96)| eṣu dyotyeṣvapiruktasaṃjñaḥ| sarpiṣo'pi syāt| prārthanāyāṃ liṅ| tasyā eva viṣayabhūte bhavane kartṛdaurlabhyaprayuktaṃ daurlabhyaṃ dyotayannapiśabdaḥ syādityanena sambadhyate| anupasargatvānna ṣaḥ| sarpiṣa iti ṣaṣṭhī tu apiśabdabalena gamyamānasya bindoravayavāvayavibhāvasambandhe| iyameva hyapiśabdasya padārthadyotakatā nāma| karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā tu neha pravartate, sarpiṣo bindunā yogo na tvapinetyuktatvāt| sambhāvanaṃ nāma śaktyutkarṣamāviṣkarttumatyuktiḥ| apisiñcenmūlasahasram| apistuyādviṣṇum| anvavasargaḥ kāmacārānujñā| apisiñca| apistuhi| garhāyām-dhigdevadattamapistuyādvṛṣalam| samuccayeḥapisiñca| apistuhi| siñca ca stuhi cetyarthaḥ| yathāyatham "upasargaprādurbhyām'(aṣṭāosūo8-3-87)iti "upasargātsunoti"(aṣṭāosūo8-3-65)iti ca prāptaṃ ṣatvaṃ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñayā upasargasaṃjñāyā bādhitatvānna bhavati|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-97)
adhirīśvare(aṣṭāosūo1-4-97)| svasvāmibhāve dyotye'dhiḥ karmapravacanīyaḥ syāt| iha svātsvāmino vā paryāyeṇa karbhapravacanīya vibhaktirna tu "hīne"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-86)"upo'dhike ca'(aṣṭāosūo1-4-87)ityatrevānyatarasmādeva| adhibhūvi rāmaḥ| adhirāme bhūḥ| etacca saṃjñāsūtraṃ nārambhaṇīyam| uttarārthatve tu yogo na vibhajanīya iti "yasmādadhikam"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-9)ityatra vakṣyāmaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-98)
vibhāṣā kṛñi(aṣṭāosūo1-4-98)| adhiḥ karotau prāksaṃjño vā syāt| īśvara ityanuṃvartate| prāptavibhāṣeyam| yadatra māmadhikariṣyati| viniyokṣyate ityarthaḥ| iha viniyokturīśvaratvaṃ gamyate| karmatvād dvitīyā| iha "tiṅi codāttavati"(aṣṭāosūo8-1-71)iti nighāto na, gatisaṃjñāyā bādhitatvāt| kiñca `māmadhikṛtvā' ityatra prādisamāso na, karmapravacanīyānāṃ pratiṣedha utyukte-| pakṣe `adhikṛtya' iti bodhyam|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-99)
