taṅānāvātmanepadam(aṣṭāosūo1-4-100)| taṅpratyāhāro lādesāvānau ca tatsaṃjñāḥ syuḥ| pūrvasaṃjñāpavādaḥ| āste| āsīnaḥ| cakrāṇaḥ| śānac‌kānacoreveha grahaṇaṃ lādeśatvātaḥ, na tu śānan‌cānaśoḥ| tena pūṅ‌yajoḥ śānan yajerakartṛgepi phale bhavati `rasamānasārasena' ityādau parasmaipadibhyo'pi cānaś‌ bhavati|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-101)
tiṅastrīṇitrīṇi prathamamadhyamottamāḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-101)| kṛtadvandvānāmekaśeṣāt prathametyādayaḥ ṣaṭ saṃjñāḥ tiṅaḥ ṣaṭ trikāḥ kramātprathamādisaṃjñāḥ syuḥ| śatṛkvasvoḥ sāvakāśā'pi parasmaipadasaṃjñā prathamādisaṃjñābhirna bādhyate "sicivṛddhiḥparasmaipadeṣu"(aṣṭāosūo7-2-1)iti liṅgāt| tathā parasmaipade labdhāvakāśā'pi prathamādisaṃjñā taṅkṣvātmanepadasaṃjñayā na bādhyate kṛtadvandvānāmekaśeṣeṇa taṅkṣu pratipadavidheruktatvāt| na caivamapi parasmaipadātmanepadasaṃjñābhyāṃ puruṣasaṃjñāyāḥ paryāyaḥ syāditi vācyam, "ṇaluttamovā"(aṣṭāosūo7-1-21)ityasya sāmānyāpekṣajñāpakatvāt| iha sūtratraye'pi mahāsaṃjñākaraṇaṃ pūrvācāryānuroghāt| iha trīṇitrīṇītyekaṃ padam| dve veti haradattaḥ| tatra satyāmapyavāntarapadasaṃjñāyāṃ mahāpadasaṃjñāmāśritya "saṃhitaikapade nityā" ityasya pravṛtteḥ| anyathā samāsādāvapi pṛthak chedāpatteḥ dviruktamadhye padāntaraprayogāpatteśca| ata eva `tātā piṇḍānām' ityādau vede'vagrahaḥ kriyate| yathā ca dvirukte mahāpadasaṃjñā'vāntarasaṃjñā ca tathā "nityavīpsayoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo8-1-4)ityatra vakṣyāmaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-102)
tānyekavacanadvivacanabahuvacanānyekaśaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-102)| tāni labdhapuruṣasaṃjñāni trīṇitrīṇi ekaśaḥ krameṇa ekavacanādisaṃjñāni syuḥ| tānītyuktiḥ samāveśārthā| anyathā puruṣavacanasaṃjñayoḥ paryāyaḥ syāt| tataśca "āḍuttamasya"(aṣṭāosūo3-4-92)ityādikāryaṃ pakṣe na pravarteta| ekaśa iti prathamāntādvīpsāyāṃ śas|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-103)
supaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-103)| supastrīṇitrīṇi kramādekaśa ukta saṃjñāni syuḥ| ihānvarthatāmāśritya "dvyekayordvivacanaikavacane"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-22) "bahuṣu bahuvacanam'(aṣṭāosūo1-4-23)iti śakyaṃ tyaktum, ekavacanasyautsargikatve'pi upasarjanakarmapravacanīyādisaṃjñāvadyathāsambhavamanvarthatāyāḥ suvacatvāt|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-104)
vibhaktiśca(aṣṭāosūo1-4-104)| supiṅau vibhaktisaṃjñau staḥ| cakāraḥ puruṣavacanasaṃjñābhyāṃ samāveśārtha-| tiṅāṃ vibhaktisaṃjñāyāḥ prayojanaṃ "na vibhaktau tusmāḥ'(aṣṭāosūo1-3-4)iti, supāṃ tu tyadādyatvādikamapi|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-105)
yuṣmadyupapade samānādhikaraṇe sthāninyapi madhyamaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-105)| lakāreṇa samānādhikaraṇe yuṣmadi prayukte'prayukte'pi madhyamaḥ syāt| tvaṃ pacasi dṛśyase ca| samānādhikaraṇe kim? tvāṃ paśyati| tvayā dṛśyate| iha yuṣmadi madhyamo'smadyuttama ityevāstu yuṣmadyammadi ca yo lakāra ityarthe sarvasāmañjamyāt| yathā tu na kṛtamityeva| atvaṃ tvaṃ bhavati tvadbhavatītyatra tu na, madhyamavikṛterakartṛtvāt| prakṛtireva hi vikārarupāpattau kartrī| tathā ca mantraḥ "yadagnesyāmahaṃ tvaṃ tvaṃbādhāsyāaham" iti| ahaṃ tvaṃ syām, tvaṃ vā ahaṃ syā iti prakṛtyāśraya eveha puruṣaḥ|
syādetat| `bhavān karoti' ityatrāpi sthāninyapīti madhyamaḥ syāt| atrāhuḥ| aliṅgaḥ sambodhanaikāviṣayaśca yuṣmadarthaḥ| saliṅgaḥ sambodhyāsambodhyasādhāraṇaśca bhavadartha iti| na ca yuṣmadaḥ sambodhanaikaviṣayatve tataḥ sambodhana eva prathamā syāt| tataśca āmantritādyudāttatvaṃ padātparatvena nighātaśca syāditi vācyam, sambodhanasya prātipadikārtha evāntarbhāvāt| "sambodhane ca"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-47)iti sūtraṃ hi sambodhanādhikyārthamiti vakṣyate| yattu kecidiṣṭāparttiṃ kurvāṇāḥ paṭhantisambodhanādhikyārthamiti vakṣyate| yattu kecidiṣṭāpattiṃ kurvāṇāḥ paṭhanti-
sambodhanārthaḥ sarvatra madhyame kaiścidiṣyate|
tathā sambodhane sarvāṃ prathamāṃ yuṣmado viduḥ||
yuṣmadarthasya siddhatvānniyatā cādyudāttatā|
yuṣmadaḥ prathamāntasya paraścenna padādasau|| iti ||
tanna, uktanyāyavirodhāt lakṣyavirodhācca| dṛśyate hi pādādāvapyantodāttatvaṃ padātparatve'pyanigātaśca| tadyathā-yuvaṃ ha garbhañjagatīṣu dhatthaḥ| yūyaṃ yātasvastibhiḥ| ha ye devā yūyamidāpayaḥ stha iti|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-106)
prahāse ca manyopapade manyateruttama ekavacca(aṣṭāosūo1-4-106)| manyadhāturupapadaṃ yasya dhātostasminprakṛtibhūte sati madhyamaḥ syāt parihāse gamyamāne manyatestūttamaḥ syātsa caikārthasya vācakaḥ syāt| dvayorbahuṣu ca mantuṣu ekavacanameva syāditi phalito'rthaḥ| ekavaccetyanvācaye cakāraḥ| tenaikavadbhāvābhāve'pi pradhānaśiṣṭo madyamottamau sta eva| satyapyodane parihāsaśīlaḥ śālakādiḥ pratārayanprayuṅkte--ehi manye odanaṃ bhokṣyadhve| odanaṃ bhokṣye bhokṣyāvahe ityādi, manyase manyethe ityādirarthaḥ| yuṣmadyupapade ityādyanuvartate| teneha na-etu bhavānmanyate odanaṃ bhokṣye iti| śyanā nirddeśānneha-ehi manuṣe rathena yāsyāmiti| prahāse kim? yathārthakathane mā bhūt-manyase odanaṃ bhokṣya iti bhuktaḥ so'tithibhiḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-107)
asmadyuttamaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-107)| lakārasamānādhikaraṇe'smadi sthite sthāninyapyuttamaḥ syāt| ahaṃ paśyāmi dṛśye vā| yuṣmadasmad‌bhyāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇye tu paratvāduttama eva| ahaṃ ca tvaṃ ca vṛtrahatsvayujyāvasanibhyaā|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-108)
śaṣe prathamaḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-4-108)| madhyamottamaviṣayādanyatra prathamapuruṣaḥ syāt| pacati, pacataḥ, pacanti|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-109)
paraḥ sannikarṣaḥ saṃhitā(aṣṭāosūo1-4-109)| atiśayitaḥ sannidharvarṇānāṃ yaḥ sa saṃhitāsaṃjñaḥ syāt| saṃjñāpradeśāḥ "saṃhitāyām"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-72)ityādayaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo1-4-110)
virāmo'vasānam(aṣṭāosūo1-4-110)| varṇānāmabhāvo'vasānasaṃjñaḥ syāt| saṃjñāpradeśā "vāvasāne"(aṣṭāosūo8-4-56)ityādayaḥ| abhāvasyāpi buddhikṛtaṃ paurvāparyamastyeva| yathoccaritapradhvaṃsināṃ nityavibhūnāṃ vā varṇānām| yadvā, viramyate'neneti karaṇe ghañ, caramavarṇaśca saṃjñī| asminmapakṣe "kharavasānayoḥ" ityekāpi saptamī viṣayabhedādbhidyate| khari pare rephasya visargaḥ, avasāne ca rephe sthāninīti| atra vārttikam-saṃhitāvasānayorlokaviditatvādatsiddhamiti| tathā ca sūtradūyaṃ mā'stvityarthaḥ|
|| iti śrīpadavākyapramāṇapārāvārapariṇisya lakṣmīdharasūreḥ sūnunā bhaṭṭojībhaṭṭena kṛte śabdakaustubhe prathamasyādhyāyasya caturthe pāde caturthamānhikam ||
<2.1>
||atha dvitīyādhyāya ārabhyate||
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-1)
samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-1)| padasambandhī yo vidhiḥ sa samarthāśrito bodhyaḥ| paribhāṣeyam| samarthaśabdasya tadāśrite lakṣaṇā| sāmarthye cehaikārthībhāvaḥ| prakiyādaśāyāṃ pṛthagarthatvena prathamagṛhītasya viśiṣṭhaikārthatvamiti yāvat| rājapuruṣaḥ| putrīyati| kumbhakāraḥ| aupagavaḥ| iha "guṇaḥ kṛtātmasaṃskāra"iti nyāyena mahāvibhāṣāyāḥ sāmarthyaviśeṣaṇatā| vikalpenaikārthībhūtaṃ ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ samasyate ityādyarthāt| viśeṣaṇabalādeva ca vyapekṣāpakṣo'pi sammataḥ| vṛttistu samāsādiniyatā| ata eva `ṛddhasya' iti viśeṣaṇaṃ tatra nānveti, śakyaikadeśatvāt| na hi śvaśuraśabdajanyapratītau pitṛviśeṣaṇatvenopasthitāyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ suśīlāya ityādiviśeṣaṇamanveti| na caivaṃ `devadattasya gurukulam' ityādāvananvayāpattiḥ, tatrāpi kulenaiva devadattaśabdottaraṣaṣṭhyarthasyānvayāt| sambandhastu upasthitagurudvāraka eva ṣaṣṭhyartho na tu taditaraḥ| uktañca-
samudāyena sambandho yeṣāṃ gurukulādinā|
saṃspṛśyāvayavāṃste tu yujyante tadvatā saha|| iti |
yadvā, sasambandhikapadārthasyaikadeśatve'pi bhavatyeva viśeṣaṇānvayaḥ `caitrasya naptā' ityādau tathā darśanāt, śvaśuraśabdopasthitāyāṃ bhāryāyāyaṃ tatpaterviseṣaṇatvācca| tadaṃśe utthitākāṅkṣatvāt| uktañca-
sambandhiśabdaḥ sāpekṣo nityaṃ sarvaḥ samasyate|
svārthavatsā vyapekṣā'sya vṛttāvapi na hīyate|| iti |
tasmātsamāsasubdhātukṛttaddhitaviśeṣaṇe|
na viśeṣaṇasambandhaḥ sāpekṣe tu bhavedayam||
syādetat vākye klṛptayā'vayavasaktyopapattau mā'stu śaktyantaram| na caivaṃ viśeṣaṇasambandhāpattiḥ `saviśeṣaṇānāṃ vṛttirna, vṛttasya vā viśeṣaṇayogo na' iti ni,edhasya sambhavāditi cet? satyam|
bahūnāṃ vṛttidharmāṇāṃ vacanaireva sādhane|
syānmahadrauravaṃ tasmādekārthībhāva āsthitaḥ||
cakārādiniṣedho'tha bahuvyutpattibhañjanam|
kartavyaṃ te nyāyasiddhaṃ tvasmākaṃ taditi sthitiḥ||
tathāhi, `dhavakhadirau' iti vṛttyaiva kroḍīkṛtārthatvāccakāro na prayujyate| tathā citragvādau yatpadam| tvayā tu vacanaṃ karttavyam| nirūḍhalakṣaṇā tu śaktito nātīva bhidyate, naiyāyikaiścakārārthe tadanabhyupagamācca| akathitasūtre vyutpāditarītyā nāmārthayorabhedaḥ "pratyayārthaḥ pradhaānam" ityādivyutpattityāgaśca, `prāptodakaḥ' ityādau udakakartṛkaprāptikarmetyādyarthābhyupagamāt| ekārthībhāve tu lāghavamiti| yadyapi siddhānte padaṃ vākyaṃ vā śaktaṃ tathāpi prakriyādaśāyāṃ lāghavādekārthībhāva ityāśayaḥ| yaiva hyasmākaṃ prakriyā sā paraiḥ pāramārthikatayā gṛhyate iti yuktastān prati gauravopanyāsa iti dik|
kvacittu sāpekṣatve'pi bhāṣyaprāmāṇyād vṛttiḥ| tadyathā-kimodanaḥ śālīnām| keṣāṃ śālīnāmodana ityarthaḥ| saktvāḍhakamāpaṇīyānām| āpaṇīyānāṃ saktūnāmāḍhakamityarthaḥ| kuto bhavānpāṭaliputrakaḥ| dve pāṭaliputre, tatra tasmātpāṭaliputrādbhavānāgata itvarthaḥ| "ropadhetoḥ prācām"(aṣṭāosūo4-2-123)iti vuñ| tathā nañsamāsā api kecitsādhavaḥ-aśrāddhabhojī brāhmaṇa iti yathā| kecittu na sādhavaḥ-akiñcitkurvāṇamiti yathā| kiñcidapyakurvāṇamityarthaḥ|
atredamavadheyam| vākye tredhā sāmarthyam-bhedaḥ saṃsargo bhedasaṃsargau ceti| ādye'tadvyāvṛttimātrasya śābdatvam| saṃsargastvārthaḥ| dvitīye viparītam| tṛtīye tūbhayaṃ śābdam| alaukake prakriyāvākye tu prathamamuktatritayānyatamāvagame'pi vṛttiḥ kalpyate| pariniṣṭhite viśeṣaṇasambandhādyabhāvadarśanāt| yathā śatrādau dvitīyāntādisāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ dṛṣṭvā lakāre tatkalpaneti| ata eva citratvāderanyapadārthaparatādarśanādalaukike prakriyāvākye'pi tatkalpanā, "anyapadārthe" ityādisautrānuvādanaiva devatāvigrahavattatsiddheśceti dik|
|| iti śabdakaustubhe dvitīyādhyāyasya prathame pāde prathamamānhikam ||
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-2)
subāmantrite parāṅgavatsvare(aṣṭāosūo2-1-2)|subantamāmantrite pare parāṅgavatsyātsvare karttavye| tannimittagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| tasyāmantritārthasya yannimittaṃ tatpratipādakaṃ yattadava parāṅgavattsyānnānyadityarthaḥ| yatte divo duhitarmartabhojanam| ita divaḥśabdamya parāṅgavadbhāvādāṣṭamiko nighātaḥ| tannimittagrahaṇānneha-etenāgne brahmaṇā vāvṛdhasva| ayamagne jaritā| anena mitrāvaruṇāvṛtāvṛdhāvṛtaspṛśākratuṃ bṛhantamāśāthe iti|
syādetat, ṛtaśabdastāvad ghṛtāditvādantodāttaḥ| tasya tannimittagrahaṇātparāṅgavadbhāvo mā bhūt| kintu mitrāvaruṇāvityasyāpi na syāt| ṛtasya varddhayitārāvittyarthe'ntarbhāvitavyarthādvṛdheḥ kvapi "anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-137)iti pūrvapadasya dīrghe sati hi ṛtāvṛdhāviti vyutpāditam| na ca tatra mitrāvaruṇau nirmittam| na ca mā bhūtparāṅgabadbhāva iti vācyam, ṛtāvṛdhāvityasya nighātānāpatteḥ| dvitīyapādādi tvenāpādādāviti niṣedhāt| ata eva hi "imaṃ me gaṅge" ityatra pūrvapūrvāmantritasyāvidyamānavadbhāvātsarveṣāṃ meśabdātparatāmupajīvya kriyamāṇo'pi nigāto `gaṅge' ityāditrayasyaiva kriyate na tu śutudrītyasyāpi| atrāhurvedabhāṣyakārāḥ tannimittagrahaṇaṃ māstu, sūtreṇaiva sakaleṣṭasiddheriti| yuktaṃ caitat| tathāhi, "vyapekṣāṃ sāmarthyameke" iti samarthasūtrasyabhāṣyarītyeha sāmarthyamupasthitam| ekārthībhāvapakṣe tu sāmarthasyehānuvṛttiḥ| śabdādhikāraśca bodhyaḥ| etadartha eva cāsminpradeśe etatsūtrārambhaḥ| tathāca "ṛtena mitrāvaruṇau" ityetayoḥ `ānaśāthe'ityarthakanāśāthe ityākhyātenānvayātparasparamasāmarthyana parāṅgavadbhāvābhāvānna ṣāṣṭha ādyudāttaḥ, kintvāṣṭamiko nighātaḥ| mitrāvaruṇāvityasya tu parāṅgavadbhāvadvṛtāvṛdhāviti na pādādirato nihanyate eva| naca sarpiḥkālakādisiddhaye "isusoḥsāmarthye"(aṣṭāosūo8-3-44)ityatra paṭhinaṃ "samānādhikaraṇamasramarthavadbhavati" ityetadihapravarttate `sarpiṣpīyate' ityādisiddhaye adhātvabhihitamiti viśeṣitatvāt| iha ca dhātvabhihitatvāt| nanvevaṃ śutudripadamapi nihanyeta pūrvasya sarasvatipadasya parāṅgavadbhāvenāpādāditvāditi cet? na, sacatetyanena sarveṣāmanvave'pi parasparamasāmarthyāt| uktaṃ hi-
sambodhanapadaṃ yacca tatkriyāyā viśeṣaṇam| iti|
naca geṅge ityādīnāmekavacanāntānāṃ sacateti bahuvacanāntena sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvātkathamekavākyatā? tathā ca kathaṃ nighāto'pi? tatra vārtikakṛtā samānavākyādhikārasya kṛtatvāditi vācyam "yuṣmadyupapade"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-105)iti trisūtryāṃ bhāṣyavārttikayoreva vacanabhede'pi sāmānādhikaraṇyasya samarthitatvāt pratyekaparyavasannaikatvaprakārakabodhāviśeṣyeṣvapi militeṣu saṃkhyāntarānvaye bādhakānirukteśca, ahaṃ ca tvaṃ ca vṛtrahan‌tsaṃyujyāvasanibhya ā, samau hi śiṣṭaurāmnātau vartsyantāvāmayaḥ saceti vedalokayoḥ pracuraprayogācca| etena "candre kalaṅkaḥ sujane daridratā" ityatra "yaśo vidhātuḥ kathayanti khaṇḍitam' ityasyānvayāya ete ityadhyāharantaḥ pratyuktāḥ| evañca satyadhyāhṛtena etacchabdenāpi samaṃ kalaṅkāderananvayāpatteḥ, `gaṅge' ityādau nighātānāpatteśaaceti dik| nanvevamapi mitrāvaruṇāvityasya kathaṃ parāṅgavadbhāvaḥ "āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat"(aṣṭāosūo8-1-72)ityavidyamānavadbhāvāditi cet? maivam, parasya hi kārye karttavye'sāvatideśo na tu svasya kārye'pi pūrvagrahaṇavaiyarthyāpatteḥ| na ca parāṅgavadbhāvaḥ parasya kāryaṃ kintu svasya| ata eva `vāyo yāhi' `agne naya' `indra dehyadhiratham' ityādau āmantritādyudāttatvaṃ bhavatyeva| "tiṅṅa'tiṅaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo8-1-28)iti nighātaḥ pare na bhavati| abhyupetyāpi brūmaḥ, prakṛte mitrāvaruṇāvityāmantritaṃ sāmānyavacanaṃ tadbiśeṣaṇatayā viśeṣavacanamṛtāvṛdhāviti| ato "nāmantrite samānādhikaraṇe sāmānyavacanam"(aṣṭāosūo8-1-73)iti avidyamānavadbhāvo niṣidhyate iti| nanvevamapi mitrāvaruṇapadasya parāṅgavadbhāvātpādāditvenāpādādāviti paryudāsaḥ syāditi cet? na, hyayaṃ kāryasyātideśaḥ kintu tādātmyasya tasmiṃścātidiṣṭe viśiṣṭamāmantritamiti buddhyā yadyatkarttu śakyaṃ tatkriyate| kiñca kāryātideśo'pyaśāstrīyasya daurlabhyaṃ kimuta tādātmyātideśe| subiti kim? pīḍyepīḍyamānā| nanviha ekārthībhāvavirahāt samarthaparibhāṣānupasthitāvapi samarthagrahaṇānuvṛttyā parāṅgavadbhāvona bhaviṣyati| evañcādupadeśātparatvenānudāttasyeṭā udāttenaikādeśe pīḍya ityantodāttaṃ siddham| maivam, sāmarthyasvehapi sattvāt| pīḍyamānasambodhyakā pīḍeti hi vākyārthaḥ| āha ca--
sambodhanapadaṃ yacca tatkriyāyā viśeṣaṇam|
vrajāni devadatteti nighāto'tra tathaā sati|| iti |
samānavākye nighātayuṣmadasmadādeśā-| "ākhyātaṃ saviśeṣaṇaṃ vākyam" iti vārtikakāravacanāditi bhāvaḥ| aṅgagrahaṇaṃ kim? ubhayoḥ pṛthagādyudāttatā mā bhūt| vadgrahaṇaṃ kim? svāśrayamapi yathā syāt| āmūkuṇḍenāṭan| "āma ekāntaramāmantritamanāntike"(aṣṭāosūo8-1-55)ityekāntaratā bhavati| svara iti kim? `kūpe siñcan' `varma naman' ṣatvaṇatve prati parāṅgavadbhāvo na bhavati| samānādhikaraṇasyopasaṃkhyānamananantaratvāt| tīkṣṇayā sūcyā sīvyan| na ca parasya parāṅgavadbhāve kṛte pūrvasyāpi sūtreṇaiva siddhamiti vācyam, svare ityavadhāraṇāt| parāṅgavadbhāve kartavye tasya durlabhatvāt| vastutastu svare iti na kartavyam| `kūpe siñcan' ityatra svāśrayapadādi sattvāt "sātpadādyoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo8-3-22)iti niṣedhasambhavāt| ṇatvaṃ tu pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāmeveti niyamānna bhaviṣyati| samāsābhāve'pi pūrvaṃ padamiti yaugikārthamātrasya lakṣyānurodhena grahītuṃ śakyatvāditi bhāṣyam| yadvā, āmantrite ityasyopasthitatvādāmantritatvayuktakāryaṃ pratyeva sannidhānāt parāṅgavadbhāvaḥ| tathaci parāṅgavadbhāve sāmānādhikaraṇyasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ, svaragrahaṇaṃ cetyubhayamapi na kartavyamiti sthitam|
paramapi chandasi pūrvasyāṅgavadbhavatīti vaktavyam| āte pitarmarutāṃ sumnametu| pratitvā duhitarddivaḥ| vṛṇīṣva duhitārddivaḥ|
avyayapratiṣedhaśca| uccairadhīyāna| avyayībhāvasya tu nāyaṃ niṣedha ityuktam|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-3)
prākkaḍārātsamāsaḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-3)| "kaḍārāḥ karmadhāraye"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-38)ityataḥ prāk samāsa ityadhikriyate prāggrahaṇaṃ cāvartate| tena pūrvaṃ samāsasaṃjñā tataḥ saṃjñāntaramapīti labhyate| tenāvyayī bhāvādisaṃjñābhiḥ samāveśaḥ sidhyati| anyathā paryāyaḥ syāt|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-4)
saha supā(aṣṭāosūo2-1-4)| iha sahati yogo vibhajyate| subantaṃ samarthena saha samasyate| katipayatiṅantamātraviṣayo'yaṃ yogaḥ, sup‌supeti punarārambhāt| ato'tiprasaṅgo nodbhāvanīyaḥ| yo jāta eva paryabhūṣat| yaḥ śambaraṃ anvavindat| yogavibhāgasiddhasyāsārvatrikatvānneha-samprayacchavṛṣṇyā indrāya bhāgam| ata eva "nityaṃ krīḍā"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-17)ityadhikāre "udāttavatā gatimatā ca tiḍhā gateḥ samāsaḥ"(kāovāo)iti vārtikakṛtā yaduktaṃ tadihaiva yogaṃ vibhajya sādhitaṃ bhāṣye| evam "ivena samāsaḥ"(kaovāo)ityapi supsupetyanena siddhamityuktam| yuktaṃ caitat| anyathā vārtikarītyā nityasamāsatāpattau `ya ānayat' `āyonayat samprayaccha' ityāderasaṅgatatvāpatteḥ `jīmūtasyeva' ityādau taittirīyāṇāṃ padadvayatvena pāṭhāsaṅgatiprasaṅgācca| ata eva `udvāhuriva' ityādau vyastavyavahitaprayogo'pi saṅgacchate, yathottaraṃ munīnāṃ prāmāṇyāt| tiṅasamāsastu chandasyena| ata eva "karmeṇā yamabhipraiti"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-32)ityatraikapadyaṃ neti haradattaḥ| etadapi asārvatrikatvādeva siddham| yuktaṃ cedam, chāndasatvenaiva tatra subluko vaktavyatvāt| anyathā "ekavacanamutsargataḥ kariṣyate" iti bhāṣyātsāmāsādutpannasya soḥ paryabhūṣadityādau hal‌ṅyādilopasambhave'pi yatprakarotītyādau śravaṇāpatteḥ| na ca napuṃsakatābhyupagamena nirvāhaḥ `yatprakṛrute' ityādau hrasvāpatteḥ, `prakurvīran' ityatra nalopāpatteśca| tasmātkāvyādau prabhavatītyādiprayogeṣūpasargaḥ pṛthak padameva| `vāgarthāviva' ityādāvivaśabdastu samastaḥ pṛthagvā| `udvāhuriva vāmanaḥ' `kacācitau viṣvagivāgajau gajau'(kiosao1śloo36)ityādau pṛthagevati tattvam| yattu kaścidivena samāsaśchandasa ityāha| tannirmūlam, taittirīyapṛthakpāṭhaviruddhaṃ ca| ivasamāse samāsāgāṃ śrautīmupamāmudāharatāmalaṅkārikāṇāṃ pratikūlaṃ ca| kiñca-
advaitamaṣyanubhavāmi karasya bilvatulyaṃ śarīramahinirlvayanīva vīkṣa|
ityādayaḥ samastaprayogāḥ `nahyasti prathamāntenaiva' ityanyapadārthasūtrasthabhāṣyasammatāḥ ata eva agniriva rājo vāyuriva pāśa ityādi pariśiṣṭodāharaṇamapi saṅgacchate| ityāstāṃ tāvat|
idaṃ tvavaśiṣyate-tiṅsamāse kṛte paramapi "tiṅhatiṅaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo8-1-28)iti nighātaṃ bādhitva satiśiṣṭatvātsamāsāntodāttatā prāpnoti| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ, `paryabhūṣat' `tadevānupraviśat' ityādau kvāpi antodāttapāṭhadarśanāt|
atredaṃ tattvam| "tiṅivodāttavati"(aṣṭāosūo8-1-71)iti gaternighātavidhānaṃ jñāpakaṃ tiṅsamāse'ntodāttābhāvasyeti| bhāṣyamate tu "gatikārakopapadātkṛt"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-139)iti sūtre kṛdgrahaṇasya pratyākhyātatvānna kaściddoṣa iti|
ihedamavadheyam| saheti tiṅsamāse suṣsupati vihite ca `vāgarthāviva' `pūrvaṃ bhūto bhūtapūrvaḥ' ityādau avyayībhāvādiviśeṣasaṃjñāḥ santyeva na, tattadadhikāreṣvasyāpāṭhāt| evaṃ `vispaṣṭapaṭuḥ' `kākatālīyaḥ' ityādāvapi, tatrāpi supsupetyasya pravṛtteḥ| "vispaṣṭapaṭuḥ' `kākatālīyaḥ' ityādāvapi, tatrāpi supsupetyasya pravṛtteḥ| "vispaṣṭādīni guṇavacaneṣu"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-24)"samāsāccatadviṣayāt"(aṣṭāsūo5-3-106)ityādayaḥ svarachapratyayārthamārabhyamāṇā api vṛddhakumārīvaranyāyena samāsasādhakā ityasminnapi pakṣe viśeṣasaṃjñāvirahastulya eva| samāsaścaturddheti tu prāyovādamātram| ata eva paṭhanti-
kaḥ samāsa iti praśne vispaṣṭapaṭugocare|
samāsamātraṃ ye brūyurvispaṣṭapaṭavo hi te ||
iha vispaṣṭamiti pāṭavasya viśeṣaṇam| ekadeśānvayasyāpyatra svīkāraḥ| evaṃ "pūrvapadārthapradhāno'vyayībhāvaḥ" ityādi pūrvācāryaparibhāṣitam| yadyapīha tadīyamahāsaṃjñāvyavahārasāmarthyātsvīkriyate, tathāpi tatsarvamautsargikameva, arddhapiplyādestatpuruṣasya pūrvapadārthaprādhānyāt `unmattagaṅgam' ityavyayībhāve'nyapadārthapradhānyācceti dik|
yadyapi jahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttau vartipadayorānarthakyam| ajahatsvārthāyāṃ tūbhayorapi viśiṣṭārthatā, tathāpi ekārthībhāvātpūrvasyāmavasthāyāṃ yau pṛthak padārthau tayorvṛttau prādhānyāprādhānyābhyāṃ praveśamāśrityoktānāmautsargikavyavahārāṇāṃ nirvāho bodhyaḥ| ṣoḍhā cāyaṃ samāsaḥ| tathāhi, mautsargikavyavahārāṇāṃ nirvāho bodhyaḥ| ṣoḍhā cāyaṃ samāsaḥ| tathāhi,
supāṃ supā tiṅā nāmnā dhātunā'tha tiṅāṃ tiṅā|
subanteneti ca proktaḥ samāsaḥ ṣaḍvidho budhaiḥ||
supāṃ supā-rājapuruṣaḥ| tiṅā-paryabhūṣat| nāmnā-kumbhakāraḥ| dhātunā-kaṭaprūḥ| ajasram| tiṅāntiṅā-pibatakhādatā| tiṅāṃ supājahijohaḥ| iha samāse pūrvapadottarapadapuraskāreṇāyaṃ vibhāgaḥ| tena madhyamānāmavyavasthitatve'pyadoṣaḥ ehi re yāhi re ityasya subantapūrvottarapadatvāt| sarveṣvamīṣu pūrvapadasya padatvamavyabhicāri| ata eva samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthamityayaṃ grantho yatra pūrvo bhāgaḥ padaṃ tadviṣayakaḥ| tena `bahupaṭavaḥ' ityatra ṭakārākārasyodāttatā sidhyatītyarthavatsūtre vyutpāditam|
ivena samāso vibhaktyalopaḥ|| pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ca|| iha uktayogābhyāṃ siddhaṃ samāsamanūdya vibhaktilopābhāvasvarau vidhīyate| tiṅantāpekṣayā ivaśabdasya paranipātastu rājadantāderākṛtigaṇatvāt| vāsayasīva vedhasaḥ| jīmūtasyeva bhavati| yeṣāṃ viśiṣya lakṣaṇaṃ nāsti te samāsāḥ "saha"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-5)| adhikāro'yam|
avyayaṃ vibhaktisamīpasamṛddhivyaddhyarthābhāvātyayāsampratiśabdaprādurbhāvapaścādyathānupūrvyayaugapadyasādṛśyasampattisākalyāntavacaneṣu(aṣṭāosūo2-1-6)| avyayamiti yogo vibhajyate iti "gambhīrāññyaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-3-58)"avyayībhāvācca"(aṣṭāosūo4-3-59)iti sūtre nyāsakāraḥ| tena `diśormadhyamapadiśam'iti siddham| śaradāditvāṭṭac| klībāvyayaṃ tvapadiśaṃ diśormadhye vidik striyam|(a.ko.3.1.5)ityamaraḥ|
vastutastu yogavibhāgaṃ vināpīṣṭasiddhiriti sūtraśeṣe vakṣyāmaḥ| vibhaktiriha kārakaśaktiḥ, vibhajyate'nayā prātipadikārtha iti vyutpatteḥ| vacanaśabdaḥ karmasādhanaḥ| sa ca pratyekaṃ vibhaktyādibhiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena sambadhyate| pūrvanipātābhāvaḥ sautraḥ| eṣvartheṣu dyotakatayā vartamānaṃ subantamavyayaṃ subantena saha ekārthabhūtaṃ sat samāsasaṃjñaṃ prāksyāttato'vyayībhāvasaṃjñamityarthaḥ| yadyapi supsupetyeva samāsaḥ siddhastathāpi tasyāsārvatrikatā punaḥ samāsavidhibhirjñāpyate| ata eva mahāvibhāṣātaḥ prākpāṭhe'pi avyayībhāvavanna tasya nityasamāsatā| tathāca svapadavigraha eva tatra bhavati| tathāca "bhūtapūrve caraṭ"(aṣṭāosūo5-3-53)iti sūtre vṛttiḥ-"pūrvaṃ bhūto bhūtapūrvaḥ| supsupeti samāsaḥ" iti| tathā śākalasūtre-"sinnityasamāsayoḥ śākalapratiṣedha iti nityagrahaṇena nārthaḥ| idamapi siddhaṃ bhavati| vāpyāmaśvo vāpyaśvaḥ nadyāmātirnadhyātiḥ" iti bhāṣyaṃ kaiyaṭo vyākhyat| supsupeti samāsaḥ| saṃjñāyāmiti hi samāsasya nityatvātsiddhaḥ pratiṣedha iti| tathā "anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-158)iti sūtre "asiddhavadatra"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-22)iti ca sūtre kaiyaṭena svapadavigraho darśitaḥ| nanūktarītyā saṃjñāyāmitivatpaṅkajādiṣvapi avigrahatvaṃ syāditi cet? satyam, yaugikārthamātreṇa sāmyamāśritya vigrahakathane'pi padmatvasya samāsaikagamyatayā vastutastasyeṣṭatvāt| etena kṛṣṇasarpalohitaśālyādayo vyākhyātāḥ|
prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ, vibhaktau-harau ityadhihari| yena subantena samāsastadghaṭakībhūtaiva vibhaktirgṛhyate sannidhānāt| tadarthadyotakaśceha adhiśabdaḥ| na caivamalaukike saptamyeva durlabhā, nipātenādhikaraṇasyābhihitatvāt, tiṅkṛttaddhitasamāsairiti parigaṇanasya pratyākhyāsyamānatvāditi vācyam, arthena caturthīsamāsasthale yathā vacanasāmarthyāduktārthasyāpi prayogaḥ tatheha vacanasāmarthyādabhihite'pi saptamītyabhyupagamāt, abbhakṣanyāyena vacanagrahaṇasāmarthyena ca vibhaktyarthamātravṛtteravyayasya grahaṇānneha| `gṛhasyopari' `grāmasya puraḥ'| uparyādayo hi digdeśakāleṣvapi varttante, na tu vibhaktyarthamātre| ata eva "kramādamuṃ nārada ityabodhi saḥ" ityādau nātiprasaṅgaḥ, itiśabdasya sarvanāmavat prakṛtaparāmarśakatvena karmatvamātrānabhidhāyakatvāt| evañca vibhaktiśabdaḥ saptamyāṃ paryavasyati| ata eva pariśiṣṭe "adhikaraṇe' ityeva sutritam| pāṇinistu mātrālāghavamabhipretya vibhaktiśabdaṃ prāyuṅkta| nipātenābhihitatvāt prathamāntenaivāyaṃ samāsaḥ ṣaṣṭhyantena vetyapi matadvayaṃ pariśiṣṭe sthitam| tadapi vibhaktigrahaṇe'dhikaraṇagrahaṇe cāviśiṣṭam|
samīpe-kṛṣṇasya samīpamupakṛṣṇam| śravyayībhāva ityanvarthasañjñāśrayaṇādasattvarūpāvyayārthaprādhānyaevāyaṃ samāsaḥ| samīpavartiprādhānye tu bahuvrīhiṃ vakṣyati "sakhyayā'vyayāsanna"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-25)iti| upadaśā iti yathā| nanu `samayā grāmaṃ' `nikaṣā laṅkām' `ārādvanāt' ityādāvatiprasaṅga iti cet? atrāha rakṣitaḥ-"abhitaḥ paritaḥ samayānikaṣānyārāditi dvitīyāpañcamyorvidhānasāmarthyānnāvyayībhāvaḥ" iti| yattūktaṃ durghaṭavṛttau-`citrasya grāmaṃ samayā' ityādau sāpekṣatvādasamāse cāritārthyādvibhaktividhānasya sāmarthya nāsti iti| tanna, samāsasya nityatayā "vṛttasya viśeṣaṇayogo na" ityasyaiva pravṛttyāpatteḥ| anyathā sthūlasya kumbhasya kāra ityādyapi syāt|
samṛddhau tu-madrāṇāṃ samṛddhiḥ sumadram| uttarapadārthaprādhānye tu "kugati"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-18)iti tatpuruṣaḥ samṛddhā madrāḥ sumadrā iti yathā|
vyṛddhau-duryavanam| na cārthābhāveneha siddhiḥ| yena samasyate tadīyārthābhāve hi samāsaḥ| iha tu yavanānāṃ nābhāvaḥ, kiṃ tu tadīyāyā vṛddheḥ|
arthābhāve-nirmakṣikam| avighnam| saṃsargābhāve'yaṃ samāsaḥ, na tvanyonyābhāve'pi arthagrahaṇasāmarthyena samasyamānapadajanyapratītiviśeṣyavirodhina evābhāvasya grahaṇāt| anyonyābhāvasya pratiyogitāvacchedakenaiva saha virodhāt| tasya ca prakāratve'pyaviśeṣyatvāt| ye tu vadanti-`ghaṭaḥ paṭo na' ityatrāpi paṭatvātyantābhāva evārthaḥ ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyena jāteḥ padārthatvāditi, teṣāmapi mate'rthagrahaṇasāmarthyādevākṣiptadharmyabhāve'yaṃ samāso na tu dharmābhāva iti phalaṃ tulyameva| eṣa evātratyaharadattagranthasyāpyāśayaḥ| etena `bhūtale ghaṭo na' ityatra ghaṭābhāvaṃ vyācakṣāṇāḥ parāstāḥ| nityasamāsaprasaktyā'sādhutāpatteḥ kārakavibhakterayogācca| ata eva siddhānte kriyādhyāhāreṇa kārakaviśiṣṭakriyāpratītau tasyā eva niṣedhaḥ śābdaḥ, bhūtalādhārakaghaṭādyabhāva evārthaḥ| gauravaṃ ca prāmāṇikaṃ vyadhikaraṇadharmāvacchinnapratiyogikābhāvaścāyam| ata eva `śaśaśṛṅgaṃ nāsti' ityatrāpi śabdasādhutā'rthasādhutā ceṣyate eva| śaśaśṛṅgāstitvañca śabdabalātpratītaṃ niṣidhyate|
atyantāsatyapi jñānamarthe śabdaḥ karoti hi|
ityabhyupagamāt| ayogyatāniścayastu na pratibandhakaḥ| anyathā vyutthamprati śabdo mūka eva syātprativādinaḥ śabdāddhākyārthāpratātātatkhaṇḍanakathāpyucchidyeta | āhāryaḥ śābdo bodha iti vāstu| etena-
nainaṃ chindanti śastrāṇi nainaṃ dahati pāvakaḥ|
na caivaṃ kledayantyāpo na śoṣayati mārutaḥ||(bhaogīoaośloo23)
ityādi vyākhyātam| anyathā ātmakarmakacchedadāhakledaśoṣāprasiddhyāpārthatāpatteriti dik|
atyayaḥ-himasyātyayaḥ atihimam| atyayo dhvaṃsaḥ| dhvaṃsatvaṃ cābhāvatvavyāpyamakhaṇḍamevetyarthābhāvātpṛthagupādānam|
`samprati'ityavyayamadhikaraṇaśaktipradhānam| tathācoktamamareṇa-
etarhisampratīdānīmadhunā sāmprataṃ tathā|(aokoo3-4-23)iti|
na jātu adhikaraṇakārakākṣiptā yujyate, ityeṣā kriyā niṣidhyate| nidrā idānīṃ na yujyate ityatinidram| vṛttau tu atitaisṛkamācchādanamityudāhṛtam| tisṛkā nāma grāmaḥ| tisṛbhavi saṃjñāyāṃ kanyupasaṃkhyānam| tatra bhavaṃ taisṛkāmacchādanam| tacca viśiṣṭakāle upabhogyam| uṣṇe śīte vā| tathāca naidanīmupabhogārthe taisṛkamācchādanamityarthaḥ| iha vūttāvupabhogakriyā antarbhūtā `dadhyupasikta odano dadhyo danaḥ' ityatropaseko yathā| ācchādanapekṣasyāpi taisṛkaśabdasya gamakatvātsamāsa iti haradattaḥ|
śabdaprādurbhāve-itihari| itiśabdaḥ svarūpaparaḥ| tasya prakāśa iti ṣaṣṭhyantena haradattaḥ|
śabdaprādurbhāve-itihari| itiśabdaḥ svarūpaparaḥ| tasya prakāśa iti ṣaṣṭhyantena vigrahaḥ|
paścādarthe-anurathyam| rathānāṃ paścādityarthaḥ| vyṛddhiśabdasyālpāctarasyāpūrvanipātenāsyānityatvajñāpanādiha vākyasya sādhutetyāhuḥ| samīpādivṛttibhirataddhitāntaiḥ sāhacaryāttathāvidhasyaiveha grahamam "tataḥ paścātsraṃsyate dhvaṃsyate ca" iti bhāṣyācca| "anekamanyapadārthe"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-24)iti sūtre `sarvapaścāt' iti bhāṣyaprayogācceti tu tattvam|
yogyatāvīpsāpadārthānativṛttisādṛśyāni yathārthāḥ| anurūpam| rūsya yogyamityarthaḥ| vīpsāyāṃ pratyartham| arthamarthaṃ pratītyarthaḥ| iha vākyamapi sādhu| na hyatrāvyayaṃ vīpsāvṛtti, kiṃtu karmapravacanīyatvātsambandhamavacchinatti| vīpsā tu dvirvacanena proktā| yadvā, pratiśabdasya vīpsārthe karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāvidhānasāmarthyāttadyoge dvitīyāgarbhaṃ vākyamapi bhaviṣyati| yathāśakti| śaktimanatikramyetyarthaḥ| hareḥ sādṛśyaṃ sahari|
anupūrvasyābhāva ānupūrvyam| brāhmaṇāditvāt ṣyañ| ṣyañaḥ ṣitkaraṇāt striyāmapi prayujyate| anujyeṣṭhaṃ jyeṣṭhānupūrvyeṇetyarthaḥ|
yaugapadye-sacakram| sahaśabdasya samāsaḥ| "avyayībhāve cākāle"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-81)iti sabhāvaḥ| evamagre'pi|
sādṛśye-sadṛśaḥ sakhyā sasakhi| vṛttau tu `sakakhī'ityudāhṛtam| apacitaparimāṇā śṛdṛśaḥ śṛgālī kikhī| yathārthatvenaiva siddhe punaḥ sādṛśyagrahaṇaṃ guṇabhūte'pi sādṛśye yathā syādityevamartham| `sadṛśaḥ sakhyā sasakhī'ityatra hi sādṛśyavataḥ prādhānyam| tenāvyayārthaprādhānyābhāvāt `samṛddhā madrāḥ sumadrāḥ' ityatrevāvyayībhāvo na syāt|
sampattiranurūpa ātmabhāvaḥ| sabrahmagargāṇāṃ teṣāmanurūpo brahmabhāva ityarthaḥ|
sākalye-satṛṇamabhyavaharati| na kiñcitparityajatītyarthaḥ| na tvatra tṛṇabhakṣaṇe tātparyam|
antavacane-sāgnyadhīte| agnyādayaḥ śabdāstadarthe granthe vartante tadānīṃ parigṛhītasya pradeśasyāgnyādiranto na tu tataḥ pareṇādhyayanaṃ nāstīti| ataḥ sākalyātpṛthagantagrahaṇam| agnerantatvamiti ṣaṣṭhyantenāsvapadavigrahaḥ| iha vacanaśabdo'tiricyate| tena dvandvasākalyātpṛthagantagrahaṇamāśritya yogavibhāgaphalībhūtam `apadiśam'ityādi susādhamiti tu niṣkarṣaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-7)
yathā'sādṛśye(aṣṭāosūo2-1-7)| pūrvema siddhe sādṛśyanirāsānām| yathetyetadasādṛśye eva samasyate na tu sādṛśye ityarthaḥ| teneha na| yathā haristathā haraḥ| harerupamānatvaṃ yathāśabdo dyotayati| tatra sādṛśya iti vā yathārtha iti vā pūrveṇa prāptaṃ niṣidhyate|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-8)
yāvadavadhāraṇe(aṣṭāosūo2-1-8)| iyatā paricchede vartamānaṃ yāvadityedavyayaṃ supā saha samasyate so'vyayībhāvaḥ| yāvadamatraṃ brāhmaṇānāmantrayasva| yāvadityavyayasya nityasamāse'pi taddhitāntenānavyayena svapadavigrahaḥ| yāvantyamatrāṇīti| avadhāraṇe kim? yāvaddattaṃ tādavadbhuktam| kiyad bhuktamiti nāvadhārayāmītyarthaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-9)
suppratinā mātrārthe(aṣṭāosūo2-1-9)| mātrā binduḥ stokamityalpaparyāyāḥ| mātrārthe varttamānena pratinā saha subantaṃ samasyate so'vyayībhāva-| śākasya leśaḥ śākaprati| sūpaprati| mātrārthe kim? vṛkṣaṃ pratividyotate vidyut| supgrahaṇamavyayādhikāranivṛttyartham| anyathā hi `doṣāmanyamahaḥ' `divāmanyā rātriḥ' iti vṛttiviṣaye sattvapradhaānatādarśanāttādṛśāvyayānyeva mātrārthe pratinā samasyeranniti bhāvaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-10)
akṣaśalākāsekhyāḥ pariṇā(aṣṭāosūo2-1-10)| etāḥ pariṇā samasyante so'vyayībhāvaḥ| dyūtakāravyavahāre cāyaṃ samāsa iṣyate| pañcikā nāma dyūtaṃ pañcabhirakṣaiḥ śalākābhirvā bhavati| tatra yadi sarve uttānāḥ patantyavāñco vā tadā pātayitā jayatyanyathā tu jīyate| tatra parājaya evāyaṃ samāsaḥ| akṣeṇa viparītaṃ vṛttaṃ akṣapari| śalākā pari| ekapari| dvipari| tripari| parameṇa catuḥ pari|
pañcasu tvekarūpeṣu jaya eva bhaviṣyati|
akṣādayastṛtīyāntāḥ pūrvoktasya yathā na tat||
kiṃ tava vyavahāre syādekatve'kṣaśalākayoḥ||
parameṇetyādervṛttigranthasyāyamarthaḥ| parameṇa atiśayenānyataḥ paraṃ pañcaparīti na bhavatīti yāvat| asyopapādanāya ślokaḥ-pañcasviti| ekarūpeṣviti| "pumān striyā"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-67)ityekaśeṣaḥ| tṛtīyāntā iti| kartṛtvāditi bhāvaḥ| pūrvaṃ paribhāṣitasya yathā ekarūpaṃ varttanaṃ samprati yadi tannetyarthaḥ| viparītavartane pariṇā dyotye samāsa iti yāvat| ekatve iti| anyathā `rājapuruṣaḥ' ityādāvivābhedaikatvamavagamyeta na tu śuddhamekatvam| prakaraṇādinā dvitvādyavagame ca prasajyet|
bhavadgirāmavasarapradānāya vacāṃsi naḥ|
ityādāviveti bhāvaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-11)
vibhāṣā(aṣṭāosūo2-1-11)| adhikāro'yam|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-12)
apaparibahirañcavaḥ pañcamyā(aṣṭāosūo2-1-12)| ete pañcamyā vā samasyante so'vyayībhāvaḥ| apahariṃ saṃsāraḥ, apahareḥ| parihari, parihareḥ| bahirgrāmam, bahirgrāmāt| prāggrāmam| prāggrāmāt| ihāpaparī parasparasāhacaryādvarjanārthau| tau ca karmapravacanīyau "apaparī varjane"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-88)iti| tadyoge pañcamyaiva bhāvyam-"pañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-10)iti| añcatirapyapaparisāhacaryādavyayameva gṛhyate tadyoge'pyañcūttarapadalakṣaṇayā pañcamyā bhāvyam| itthaṃsthite pañcamyeti jñāpanārthaṃ bahiryoge ṣaṣṭhyarthe pañcamī bhavatītyasya|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-13)
āṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-13)| etayorāṅa pañcamyantena vā samasyate so'vyayībhāvaḥ| āmukti āmuktervā saṃsāraḥ| ābālaṃ haribhakti, ābālebhyaḥ| iha maryādābhividhyoriti śakyamakartum| karmapravacanīyenaiva hyāṅā yoge pañcamī vihitā| karmapravacanīyatā ca etayorevārthayoḥ "āṅ maryādāvacane"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-89)iti| tatra hi vacanagrahaṇaṃ maryādoktimātre yathā syādityevamartham| astu vā tatraivābhividhigrahaṇam|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-14)
lakṣaṇenābhipratī ābhimukhye(aṣṭāosūo2-1-14)| abhimukhyadyotakāvabhipratī| cinhavācinā saha vā prāgvat| abhyagni śalabhāḥ patanti| pratyagni| agnimabhi| agniṃ pratīti vigrahaḥ| "abhirabhāge"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-91) "lakṣaṇetthaṃbhūta"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-92)iti cābhipratyoḥ karmapravacanīyatvād dvitīyā| ihābhipratī lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvamābhimukhyaṃ cetyubhayaṃ dyotayataḥ| lakṣaṇena kim? srughnaṃ pratigataḥ| srughnādāgatastabheva pratinivṛtta ityarthaḥ| atra srughnaḥ kamīṃbhūto na tu lakṣaṇam| abhipratī kim? yenāgnistena gataḥ| yena deśenāgnirgatastena gata iti pratīterbhavati gamanasyāgnirlakṣaṇam| ābhimukhyamapyastīti yenatenaśabdayoragniśabdena saha samāsaḥ syāt| ābhimukhyaiti kim? abhyaṅkāḥ gāvaḥ pratyaṅkāḥ| abhinavaḥ pratinavañcāṅka āsāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| aṅko'tra bhavati gavāṃ lakṣaṇam| ābhimukhyaṃ tu nāsti| nanvavyayārthaprādhānye'vyayībhāva ityutsarga ityuktam| tatkathamiha prasaṅga? satyam, iha prakaraṇe bahuvrīhiviṣaye'pyavyayībhāvo bhavatīti jñāpanārthamidam| tena "sakhyā vaṃśyena"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-19)`dvimunivyākaraṇam' ityādi siddham|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-15)
anuryatsamayā(aṣṭāosūo2-1-15)| yaṃ padārthaṃ samayā tena lakṣaṇabhūtenānuḥ samasyate so'vyayībhāvaḥ| sūtre tu yaditi samānye napuṃsakam| anuvanamaśanirgataḥ| vanasyānu| vanasya samīpaṃ gata ityarthaḥ| anuriti kima? vanaṃ samayā| yatsamayeti kim? vṛkṣamanu vidyotate vidyut| "avyayaṃ vibhakti"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-6)ityeva siddhe bibhāṣārthaṃ sūtram|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-16)
yasya cāyāmaḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-16)| yasyāyāmo'nunā dyotyastenalakṣaṇabhūtenānuḥ| samasyate so'vyayībhāvaḥ| āyāmo dairghyam| anugaṅgaṃ vārāṇasī| gaṅgāyā anu| ihāyāmolakṣaṇattvaṃcānunā dyotyate| lakṣyaṃ tu samāsārthaḥ| ata eva vārāmasyā sāmānādhikaraṇyam, gaṅgāyā yaddairghyaṃ tadupalakṣitetyarthāt| gaṅgā ca dairghyadvāropalakṣaṇam| tena gaṅgādairghyasadṛśaidarghyopalakṣitā kāśī udīryatīti phalito'rthaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-17)
tiṣṭhad‌guprabhṛtīni ca(aṣṭāosūo2-1-17)| etāni nipātyante| tiṣṭhanti gāvo yamin kālaviśeṣe sa tiṣṭhad‌gu dohanakālaḥ| cakāraevakārārthe| tenaiṣāṃ vṛtyantaraṃ na bhavati| `paramatiṣṭhad‌gu' ityādi na bhavatītyarthaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi-
ātiṣṭhad‌gu japan sandhyāṃ paścimāmāyatīgavam|
iti bhaṭṭiriti cet? avyayībhāvavilakṣaṇaṃ samāsāntaraṃ vyāvartyate| "āṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-13)itīhāvyayībhāvastu bhavatyeveti jayamaṅgalā| idaṃ ca `āyatīgavam' ityetadanurodhenāvaśyaṃ vācyam| `atiṣṭhad‌gu' ityatra tu pṛthak‌padatvaṃ pañcamyāśca lugityapi suvacam| `atiṣṭhad‌gu' ityatra tu pṛthak‌padatvaṃ pañcamyāśca lugityapi suvacam| "nāvyayībhāvādataḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-4-83)iti niṣedhādam‌tvapañcamyā ityukteścāyatīgavāditi kecitpeṭhuḥ| khalepvādini prathamāntāni| prātipadikārthamātre eṣāṃ prayogo nānyatretyarthaḥ| tiṣṭhad‌gu| vahad‌gu| śatrādeśo nipātanāt| "gostriyoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-48)iti hasvaḥ| āyatīgavam| iha śatrādeśaḥ puṃvadbhāvābhāvaḥ samāsāntaśca nipātyate| khaleyavam| khalebusam| saptamyā aluk| lūnaṃ yavam| lūnamānayavam| lūyamānabusam| saṃhriyamāṇabusam| ete kālaśabdāḥ| samabhūmi| samapadāti| samatvaṃ bhūmeriti pūrvapadārthaprādhānye'vyayībhāvaḥ| samambhūmi samampadātīti pāṭhāntaram| tatra pūrvapadasya mumāgamaḥ| sambhūmi sampadātītyaparaḥ| pāṭhaḥ| tatra samasyāntalopaḥ| saṃśabdena vā samāsaḥ| suṣamam| viṣamam| duḥṣamam| niḥṣamam| apasamam| āyatīsamā| āyatīsamam| śatrādeśaḥ pūrvavat| puṃvadbhāvābhāvaśca| samā saṃvatsaraḥ| evaṃ pāpasamam| puṇyasamam| prāhṇam| pramṛgam| prastham| pradakṣiṇam| eṣu caturṣu pragatatvamanha ityādivigrahaḥ| saṅgatatvaṃ prati gatasya samprati, viparītamasamprati| "ic karmavyatihāre"(aṣṭāosūo5-4-127)| daṇḍādaṇḍi| ayameva dvidaṇḍāṣvapi vidhīyate iti tatrāpyavyayībhāvatvaṃ bodhyam|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-18)
pāremadhye ṣaṣṭhyā vā(aṣṭāosūo2-1-18)| pāramadhyaśabdau ṣaṣṭhyantena saha vā samasyete so'vyayībhāvaḥ| edantatvaṃ cānayornipātyate| pakṣe ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaḥ| mahāvibhāṣayā hyekārthībhāvasya pākṣikatāmātraṃ labhyate| sati tvekārthībhāve'vyayībhāvastatpuruṣaṃ bādheta| ataḥ pākṣikaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ labdhumiha punarvāgrahaṇam `vyapekṣāṃ sāmarthyameke' iti pakṣe tu yatrotsargāpavādaṃ mahāvibhāṣayā vikalpyate tatrāpavādena mukte utsargo na pravartate iti jñāpanāyedam| evam "udaśvito'nyatarasyām'(aṣṭāosūo4-2-19)ityapi| tena pūrvaṃ kāryasyetyekadeśisamāsena yukte ṣaṣṭhīsamāso na bhavati| dakṣasyāpatyaṃ dākṣiritīñā yukte'ṇ na bhavati kiṃ tūbhayatra vākyameva| ekārāntatvanipātanaṃ tu yatra saptamyartho na sambhavati tadartham| pāregaṅgāt madhyegaṅgādānayeti yathā| saptamyarthasambhave tu "tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-14)iti bahulagrahaṇādalukyapi siddham|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-19)
saṃkhyā vaṃśyana(aṣṭāosūo2-1-19)| vaṃśo dvidhā-vidyayā-janmanā ca tatra bhavo vaṃśyaḥ| tadvācinā saha saṃkhyā vā samasyate so'vyayībhāvaḥ| dvau munī pāṇinikātyāyanau vaṃśyau dbimuni| vyākaraṇasya trimini| janmanā yathā-ekaviṃśati bhāradvājam| kathaṃ tarhiṃ trimuni vyakaraṇamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti cet? vidyayā saha tadvatāmabhedopacārāditi vṛttikārāḥ| "lakṣaṇenābhipravī'(aṣṭāosūo2-1-14)iti sūtre ābhimukhyagrahaṇādeva tatsiddhamiti tu prāgevoktam|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-20)
nadībhiśca(aṣṭāosūo2-1-20)| nadībhiḥ saṃkhyā prāgvat| samāhāre cāyamiṣyate| saptagaṅgam| dviyamunam| svarūpasya sāñjñā| nadyāśca neha grahaṇam, bahuvacananirddeśāt|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-21)
anyapadārthe ca sañjñāyām(aṣṭāosūo2-1-21)| anyapadārthe vidyamānaṃ subantaṃ nadībhiḥ saha nityaṃ samasyate sañjñāyāṃ so'vyayībhāvaḥ| vibhāṣādhikāre'pi vākyena sañjñānavagamādiha nityasamāsateti vṛttiḥ| śākalasūtre kaiyaṭasvaraso'pyevam| na caivaṃ nyāyasāmyādbahuvrīherapi nityatāpattiḥ, `citrā yaṣṭīḥ praveśa'ityatra vākye'pi yaṣṭidharapratīteriti dik| unmattagaṅgaṃ nāma deśaḥ| lohitagaṅgam| tūṣṇīṃgaṅgam| śanairgaṅgam| anyapadārthe kim? kṛṣṇaveṇī| sañjñāyāṃ kim? śīghragaṅge deśaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-22)
tatpuruṣaḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-22)| adhikāro'yaṃ prāgbahuvrīheḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-23)
dviguśca|(aṣṭāosūo2-1-23)| dvigurapi tatpuruṣasañjñaḥ syāt| saṃkhyāpūrvo dviguśceti cakārapāṭhamātreṇa sañjñāsamāveśasiddheridaṃ sutraṃ vyartham| dvigostatpuruṣatve ṭajacau prayojanam| pañcarājam| "rājāhaḥsakhibhyaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo5-4-91)iti ṭac| uttarapadasyānakārāntatvāt strītvābhāvaḥ| samāsārthottarapadāntāḥ samāsāntā iti pakṣe tu pātrāditvaṃ bodhyam| vṛttau tu `pañcarājī' iti kvācitko'papāṭhaḥ| dvyahaḥ| "ahnaṣṭakhoreva"(aṣṭāosūo6-4-145)iti ṭilopa-| "rātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsi"(aṣṭāosūo2-4-29)pañcagavam| "gorataddhitaluki"(aṣṭāosūo5-4-12)iti ṭac| prāgvat strītvābāvaḥ| "tatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ saṃkhyāvyayādeḥ"(aṣṭāosūo5-4-56)ityac|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-24)
dvitīyāśritātītapatitagatātyastaprāptāpannaiḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-24)| dvītīyāntaṃ śritādiprakṛtikaiḥ subantaiḥ saha samasyate sa tatpuruṣaḥ| kṛṣṇaṃ śritaḥ kṛṣṇaśritaḥ| duḥkhamatīto duḥkhātītaḥ| kūpapatitaḥ| ata eva nipānādiṭ| anyathā "tanipati"(kāovāo)iti vikalpateṭ katvād "yasya vibhāṣā"(aṣṭāosūo7-2-15)iti niṣedhaḥ syāt| yadvā, kṛtīprabhṛtīnāṃ "sesici"(aṣṭāosūo7-2-57)ityādineḍ‌vikalpānniṣṭhāyāmaniṭ‌katve siddhe iditkaraṇaṃ "yasya vibhāṣā"(aṣṭāosūo7-2-15)ityasyānityatāṃ jñāpayati| ata eva `dhāvitamibharājadhiyā' ityādi sidhyati| grāmagataḥ| tuhinātyastaḥ| sukhaprāptaḥ| sukhāpannaḥ| iha śritādiṣu gatyarthatvātkarttari ktaḥ| atyāso vyatikramo gativiśeṣa eva| prāptirapīha gatireva na tu phalam| evamāpattirapi| yadvā, śrita ityādāvādikarmaṇi ktaḥ|
syādetat| karmaṇi ktāntena saha tṛtīyārthe bahuvrīhiṇā'pi kṛṣṇaśritādirūpasiddhau kimanena sūtreṇa? kṛṣṇakarmakaśrayaṇakarteti bodhasyobhayatrāviśeṣāt| nanu "karmaṇi ktaḥ" iti pakṣe pratyayārthaḥ karma śrayaṇaṃ prativiśeṣyaṃ syāditi cet? na, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavyatyāsenaiva bahuvrīhisthale ekārthībhāvo'vaśyābhyupeya ityakathitasūtraevoktatvāt, etatsūtre bhāṣye tathaivoktatvācca| na ca svare bhedaḥ| tatpuruṣe'pi hi śritapatitagatebhyaḥ pūrvapadaṃ prakṛtisvaraṃ bhavati| "ahīne dvitīyā"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-47)iti vacanāt| atītādibhistu svarasiddhaye vidhīyatāṃ tatpuruṣaḥ| tathāhi, taistatpuruṣe thāthādisvarema bhāvyam, na tvahīnasvareṇa; atītātyastayorahīna iti niṣedhāt| prāptāpannayostvahīne dvitīyānupasarga iti vacanāt| bahubrīhau tu pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarema bhāvyamiti| tasmācchritapatitagataiḥ samāso na vidheyaḥ| evañca "ahīne dvitīyā"(aṣṭāosūo7-2-47)iti sūtramapi māstviti mahadeva lāghavam| nanvevaṃ jātyādibhyaḥ pareṣu śritādiṣu svare doṣaḥ syādeva "jātikālasukhādibhyonācchādanāt ktokṛtamitapratipannāḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-17)ityantodāttaprasaṅgāt| tatpuruṣārambhapakṣe hi bahuvrīherantodāttatā tatpuruṣasya pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraśceti dvaisvaryaṃ siddhyati| pratyākhyānapakṣe tvantodātta eveti vaiṣamyāditi cet? na, bahuvrīhāveva dvaisvaryasya susādhatvāt| tathāhi, "vā jāte"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-171)ityatra vājātaśritapatitagateṣviti vaktavyam| na caivaṃ lāghave viśeṣo neti vācyam "ahine dvitīyā"(aṣṭāosūo7-2-47)ityasyānārambheṇa lāghavasya spaṣṭatvāt|
etāvāṃstu viśeṣaḥ-tava samāsadvaye dvaisvaryaṃ mama tu bahuvrīhiṇaiva dvaisvaryamiti| atrāhuḥ| bahuvrīhiṇā `kṛṣṇaśritaḥ' ityādi na sidhyati 'niṣṭhā"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-36)iti pūrvanipātaprasaṅgāt| jātikālasukhādibhyo hi niṣṭhāyāḥ paranipāta upasaṃkhyāto na tu jātyādibhyo'nyatrāpi| kiñca jātyādāvapi rūpaṃ bhidyet, pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarapakṣe'pi pākṣikaśaiṣikakapprasaṅgāt| tvayā bahuvrīhāveva dvaisvaryasya sūtritatvāt| siddhānte tu tatpuruṣe "ahīne dvitīyā"(aṣṭāosūo7-2-47)iti svaro'sti na tu kap| bahuvrīhau tu kabasti na tu pūrvapadasvaraḥ| tathā coktasvarakapau na kvāpi samāviśataḥ| tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu| gauravaṃ ca prāmāṇikamiti sthitam|
gamigāmyādīnāmupasaṃkhyānam| grāmaṃ gamī grāmagamī| "gameriniḥ"(uosūo4-54)ityauṇādika iniḥ| sa ca bhaviṣyatkāle "bhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-3)ityukteḥ| yastu "āṅi ca ṇit"(uosūo4-55)itīniḥ, so'pi gamyādipāṭhādbhaviṣyati| ṇittvādvṛddhiḥ| āgāmī| bāhulakātkevalādapi| tena gāmīti mādhavaḥ| grāmaṃ gāmī grāmagāmī| "akenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-70)iti kṛdyogalakṣaṇaṣaṣṭhīniṣedhāt karmaṇi dvitīyā| kecittu āvaśyake ṇiniḥ| abhaviṣyadarthatve'pi "gatyarthakarmaṇi"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-12)ityatra dvitīyāgrahaṇamapavādaviṣaye'pi vidhānārthamiti kṛtprayoge'pi dvitīyaivetyāhuḥ| tattu bhāṣyaviruddham, bhāṣye gatyarthasūtrasya pratyākhyātatayā kṛdyoge ṣaṣṭhyā eva svīkārāt| etena-
tathāvidūrādriradūratāṅmī yathā sa gāmī tava koliśailatām|
iti śrīharṣaprayogo vyākhyātaḥ| annaṃ bubhukṣurannabubhukṣurityādi|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-25)
svayaṃ ktena(aṣṭāosūo2-1-25)| svayamityetatsubantaṃ ktāntaprakṛtikena subantena samasyate sa tatpuruṣaḥ| aikapadyaṃ samāsaprayojanam| tena- "āmaekāntaram"(aṣṭāosūo8-1-55)iti nighātaniṣedhaḥ svāyaṃkṛtiriti taddhitaśca sidhyati| dvitīyāgrahaṇaṃ tūttarārthatayā'nuvṛttamapi neha sambadhyate, svayamityasyātmanetyarthakasya kartrarthakatayā dvitīyāntatvānupapatteḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-26)
khaṭvā kṣepe(aṣṭāosūo2-1-26)| khaṭvāprakṛtikaṃ dvitīyāntaṃ ktāntaprakṛtikena subantena samasyate nindāyām| khaṭvārūḍho jālmaḥ| "jalmo'samīkṣyakārī syāt"(aokoo3-1-17)ityamaraḥ| vedaṃ vratāni ca samāpya samāvṛtenāhi khaṭvā''roñavyā| brahmacaryaeva bhūmiśayanārho'pi yaḥ khaṭvāmārohati sa jālmaḥ| ruḍhaścāyam| tena khaṭvāmārohatu mā vā niṣiddhānuṣṭhānaparaḥ sarvo'pi khaṭvārūḍha ucyate| ata eva vibhāṣāṃdhikāre'pi nityasamāso'yam| na hi vākyena nindā gamyate iti vṛttikṛtaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-27)
sāmi(aṣṭāosūo2-1-27)| sāmītyetadavyayamarddhaśabdaparyāyaḥ| tasyāsatvavācitvād dvitīyayā nāsti sambandhaḥ| tatsubantaṃ ktāntena vā samasyate sa tatpuruṣaḥ| sāmikṛtam|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-28)
kālāḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-28)| kālavācino dvitīyāntāḥ ktena saha prāgvat| anatyantasaṃyogārthaṃ vacanam| māsapramitaḥ pratipaccandraḥ| "māṅmāne"(dioāo1142)ādikarmaṇi| kartari ktaḥ| māsaṃ paricchetumārabdhavānityarthaḥ| iha pratipaccandreṇa nāstyatyantasaṃyogaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-29)
atyantasaṃyoge ca(aṣṭāosūo2-1-29)| aktāntārthaṃ vacanam| kālavācinaḥ śabdāḥ dvitīyāntāḥ atyantasaṃyoge supā saha prāgvat| muhūrtaṃ sukhaṃ muhūrtasukham| muhūrtavyāpītyarthaḥ| "kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-5)iti dvitīyā|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-30)
tṛtīyā tatkṛtārthena guṇavacanena(aṣṭāosūo2-1-30)| tatkṛteti pṛthak luptatṛtīyākam| tṛtīyāntaṃ tṛtīyāntārthakṛtaguṇavacanena arthaśabdena ca saha samasyate sa tatpuruṣaḥ| tacchabdena tṛtīyāntaparāmarśinā tadartho lakṣyate| tadarthakṛtvaṃ ca gumavacanasyārthadvārakaṃ viśeṣaṇam| tathāca tṛtīyāntārthakṛto yo gumastadvavacaneti phalito'rthaḥ| śaṅkulayā khaṇḍaḥ| śaṅkulākhaṇḍaḥ| kiriṇā kāṇaḥ kirikāṇaḥ| "khaḍi bhedane"(cuouo1581)"kaṇa nimīlane"(cuouo1715)ābhyāṃ ghañi vyutpāditāvetau kriyārūpāpanne guṇe vartitvā paścānmatublopādabedopacārādvā tadvati dravye varttete iti guṇavacanau bhavataḥ| dhānyenārtho dhānyārtha-| arthyate ityarthaḥ, prayojanam| arthanaṃ vā arthaḥ, prārthanā| abhilāṣaḥ| sarvatra karaṇetṛtīyāyāḥ samāsaḥ| tat kṛteneti kim? akṣṇā kāṇaḥ| kiñca yatra śaṅkulākhaṇḍādau pūrvottarapadārthayoḥ kriyākārakabhāvaḥ sambandhastatra caritārthaṃ vacanam| yathā `dadhnā bhuṅkte paṭuḥ' ityādau na bhavati, asāmarthyāt| tathehāpi na syāt-`dadhnāpaṭuḥ' `kuṅkumena lohitaṃ mukham' iti| iha hi gamyamānayā karotikriyayā karaṇasya sambandhaḥ| tasmādyatrottarapade kriyā na gamyate tatrāpi tatkṛtatve sati yathā syāt bhojanādidvārake sāmarthye mā bhūditi tatkṛtagrahaṇam| guṇavacaneneti kim? gobhirvapāvān| gosambandhidadhyādibhojanāddevadattasya vapāvattvaṃ paviratvamityasti tatkṛtatvaṃ na tvaso gumavacanaḥ| vacanagrahaṇaṃ kim? yāvatā arthena samāsāsambhavāttadvācī grahīṣyate| atrāhuḥ, guṇamuktavān guṇavacanaḥ| "kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-113)iti bhūte kartari lyuṭ| guṇamuktavatā samprati guṇopasarjanadravyavācinetyarthaḥ| tena `ghṛtena pāṭavam' iti guṇamātraniṣṭhena na bhavatīti| guṇaścātra "sattve niviśate'pauti" iti vakṣyamāṇo gṛhyate|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-31)
pūrvasadṛśasamonārthakalahanipuṇamiśraślakṣṇaiḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-31)| etaiḥ saha tṛtīyāntaṃ prāgvat| asmādeva vacanātpūrvādiyoge tṛtīyā hetau vā draṣṭavyā| māsena pūrvaḥ māsapūrvaḥ| mātrā sadṛśaḥ mātṛsadṛśaḥ| mātṛsamaḥ| iha samasadṛśābhyāṃ yoge "lulyārthaiḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-62)iti tṛtīyā|
syādetat| tulyārthayoge pakṣe ṣaṣṭhyapyasti| tataḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsenaiva siddhe kimiha sadṛśagrahaṇena| na ca "tatpuruṣe tulyārthatṛtīyā"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-2)iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarārthaṃ tat "sadṛśapratirūpayoḥ sādṛśye'(aṣṭāosūo6-2-11)iti, tat siddheḥ| na ca tatra sadṛśagrahaṇameva māstviti vācyam, ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapakṣe antodāttatvaṃ vārayituṃ tatsvīkārāvaśyambhāvāt| na cānabhidhānātṣaṣṭhīsamāsa eva māstviti vācyam, dāsyāḥ sadṛśa iti rūpāsiddhiprasaṅgāt| iha hi 'ṣaṣṭhyā ākrose"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-21)ityaluksamāsaḥ svīkṛto bhāṣye| nanvevamapi hetutṛtīyāntena samāsārthaṃ prakṛte sadṛśagrahaṇamastu-vidyayā hetunā sadṛśo vidyāsadṛśa iti| nahyatra "tulyārthaiḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-62)iti ṣaṣṭhī labhyate, pratiyoginyeva tadvidhānāditi cet? na, tatkṛtatvātpūrveṇaiva siddheḥ| yo hi vidyayā sadṛśaḥ tasya vidyākṛtaṃ sādṛśyamastīti| satyam, pratyākhyātamevedaṃ ṣaṣṭhe vārtikakṛtā| ūnārthe-māṣonaṃ kārṣāpaṇam| māṣavikalam| pūrvasūtre arthaśabdena samāsasya sādhitatvādiha arthagrahaṇamabhidheyanirddeśārtham| tacca ūnaśabdenaiva sambadhyate na tu pūrvādibhiḥ| ata eva samasadṛśau pṛthagupāttau| vākkalahaḥ| ācāranipuṇaḥ| guḍamiśriḥ| ācāraślakṣṇaḥ|
miśragrahaṇe sopasargasyāpi grahaṇam| guḍasaṃmi śrā dhānāḥ| "miśraṃ cānupasargamasandhau"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-154)ityatra anupasargagrahaṇājjñāpakādetat siddham|
avarasyopasaṃkhyānam| māsenāvaro māsāvaraḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-32)
kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam(aṣṭāosūo2-1-32)| kartari karaṇe ca tṛtīyā kṛdantena saha bahulaṃ prāgvat| hariṇā trāto haritrātaḥ| nakhairbhinno nakhabhinnaḥ| kṛdgrahaṇe gatipūrvasyāpi grahaṇānnakhanirminnaḥ| kartṛkaraṇe kim? bhikṣābhiruṣitaḥ| hetāviyaṃ tṛtīyā| bahulagrahaṇācchatṛśānac‌ktavatuprabhṛtibhirna| hastena-kurvan, bhuñjānaḥ, kṛtavānvā| kvacidvibhaktyantaramapi samasyate bahulagrahaṇādeva| pādahārakaḥ| hriyate iti hārakaḥ| bāhulakātkarmaṇi ṇvul| pādābhyāmityapādānapañcamyantasya samāsaḥ| galecopakaḥ "cupa mandāyāṃ gatau"(bhvāopao4-3)hetumaṇṇijantātkartari ṇvul| galecopakaḥ| "amūrdhamastakakāt"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-18)ityaluk| kṛteti kim? kāṣṭhaiḥ pacatitarām|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-33)
kṛtyairadhikārthavacane(aṣṭāosūo2-1-33)| stutinindāphalakamarthavādavacanamadhikārthavacanam| tatra kartari karaṇe ca tṛtīyā kṛtyaiḥ saha prāgvat| pūrvasutrasyaiva prapañco'yam| kākapeyā nadī| śakyārthe kṛtyaḥ| pūrṇatoyatvāttaṭasthairapi pātuṃ śakyeti stutiḥ| kākairapyeṣā pātuṃ śakyā| alpatoyatvāditi nindā vā|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-2-34)
annena vyañjanam(aṣṭāosūo2-1-34)| saṃskāradravyaṃ saṃskāryeṇa saha prāgvat| dadhnā upasikta odano dadhyodanaḥ| iha vṛttāvṛpasekakriyā'ntarbhavati svabhāvāt| ato nāsāmarthyam| na ca kārakāṇāṃ parasparamasambandhe'pi vacanasāmarthyādasamarthasamāsa evātrāstu iti vācyam `kindadhnā? odano bhujyatām' ityādāvatiprasaṅgāt|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-35)
bhakṣyeṇa miśrīkaraṇam(aṣṭāosūo2-1-35)| kharaviśadamabhyavahārthaṃ bhakṣyam| kharaṃ kaṭhinam| viśadaṃ vibhaktāvayavam| yatpratyayāntasya parajantasya ca bhakṣayatestatraiva prayogāt| `abbhakṣaḥ' ityādau tu noktapratyayāntaḥ kintu karmaṇyaṇantaḥ| tatra gauṇa evetyanye| bhakṣyeṇa saha miśrīkaraṇaṃ prāgvat| guḍena miśrā dhānā guḍadhānāḥ| iha vṛttau miśraṇakriyāntarbhāvo bodhyaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-36)
caturthī tadarthārthabalihitasukharakṣitaiḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-36)| caturthyantārthāya yattadvācinā arthaśabdādibhiśca caturtyantaṃ samasyate sa tatpuruṣaḥ| tadarthena prakṛtivikṛtibhāva eva samāsa iṣyate balirakṣitagrahaṇājjñāpakāt| hitasukhagrahaṇaṃ tu na jñāpakam| hitayoge caturthī vaktavyā| "caturthī cāśiṣi"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-73)iti adādarthye'pi caturthīsambhavāt| yūpāya dāru yupadāru| kuṇḍalahiraṇyam| neha-randhanāya sthālī| kathaṃ tarhi aśvaghāsaḥ, hastividhejibidhā? atra viśeṣaḥ atra bhāṣyam-aśvaghāsādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsā iti|
syādetat| caturthīsamāsa eva tarhyastu| na caivaṃ 'caturthī tadartha"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-36)iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraprasaṅgaḥ| prakṛtivikārabhāve etatpravṛtteḥ| anyathā `gorakṣitam' ityatra "caturthītadarthaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-36)ityeva siddhe "kte ca"(aṣṭāosūīo6-2-45)iti vyarthaṃ syāt| na ca hīnārthaṃ tat `gohitam' ityatra tādarthyābhāvāditi vācyam hite ceti vaktavye "kteca" iti sāmānyavacanasya jñāpakatvāt| ata eva `kuberabali' ityādau prakṛtivikṛtibhāvābhāvāt na pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ kintu samāsāntodāttatvameveti siddhāntaḥ| `randhanāya sthālī' ityādau tu yadi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa iṣṭaḥ tarhi caturthīsamāsa eveṣyatāṃ yathā gogrāsa-, līlāmbujaṃ, krīḍāsaraḥ, vāsabhavanaṃ, nāṭyaśāleti|
yadi tu randhanasthālyādau ṣaṣṭhīsamāsasyānabhidhānaṃ tarhi caturthīsamāsasyāpi tadastu| evañca balirakṣitagrahaṇamapi vyarthaṃ, jñāpyābhāvāt| kiñca yūpadārvādāvapi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsasambhavātsūtramevedaṃ māstu| "caturthī tadartha"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-36)ityetattu "ṣaṣṭhī tadartha" iti kriyatāṃ jñāpakācca svarasya vyavasthā bhaviṣyati|
atrāhuḥ| hitaśabdena tāvat ṣaṣṭhīsamāso na sambhavati, tadyoge caturthyā nityatvāditi caturthīsamāsa eva vaktavyaḥ| tataśca ktecetyatrāpi caturthīgrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ `gohitam' ityādyartham| evañca `gorakṣitam' ityatra na syāt, caturthyā asambhavāt| ṣaṣṭhītadartha ityasya cāprasaṅgaḥ, prakṛtivikṛtibhāvāt| ato rakṣitenāpi caturthīsamāsa eva vidheyaḥ| arthaśabdenāpi yoge tādarthyasambandhasya niyamena pratīyamānatvāccaturthyā bhavitavyamiti tenāpi caturthīsamāsa eva vaktavyaḥ| tathā balisukhagrahaṇamapi karttavyam| tādarthyasya samāsānniyatapratītiryathā syādityevamartham| tasmādārabdhavyamevedaṃ sūtram| prakṛtivikārabhāva evetyasya prayojanaṃ tu cintyamiti|
atredaṃ vaktavyam tādarthyasya bhānaṃ dvidhā-sambandhatvana tadvyāpyatādarthyatvākhyaviśeṣarūpeṇa ceti| taccāśvānāṃ ghāso'śvebhyo ghāsa iti vākye tāvadvayavasthitam| tatrādye samāsaḥ, dvitīye tu neṣyataiti bhāṣyavārtikādiprāmāṇyena nirṇīyate| yathā "na māṣāṇāmaśnīyāt" ityādau sambandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhī| karmatvarūpaviśeṣe tu dvitīyā yathā ka `pradīyatāndāśārathāya maithilī' ityatra sambandhisāmānye'ṇa| apatyarūpatadviśeṣe tu iñeva| yathā vā "abhūnnṛpo vibudhasakhaḥ" ityādau bhūtasāmānyavivakṣāyāṃ luṅ| anadyatanatvavivakṣāyāṃ tu laṅeveti| ata eva "āto'nupasarge kaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo3-2-3)iti sūtre jīvadvaṃśyatvarūpaviśeṣāvivakṣāyāṃ "provāca bhagavānkātyaḥ" iti prayuktaṃ bhāṣye| ata eta "kṛtalabdhakrītakuśalāḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-3-38)ityatra jātalabdhābhyāṃ kṛtakrītayorna gatārthatā prakārabhedāditi caturthe vṛttikāraḥ| tvayāpi tatra tathaivopapādayiṣyate| tatra bhava ityeva siddhe "prāyabhavaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-3-39)"so'sya nivāsaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-3-89)iti sūtrayorapyeṣaiva gatiḥ| tathāca prayojane spaṣṭe kathañcintyatāṃ brūṣe| nanu `aśvaghāsaḥ' ityādāvapi prakāraṇādviśeṣādhyavasāyo bhavatyeveti cet? satyam, na tu tatra viśeṣaprakārako bodhaḥ, luptaṃ smṛtaṃ bodhakamiti mate smṛtapaṣṭhyā sambandhatvaprakārako bodhaḥ, luptaṃ smṛtaṃ bodhakamiti mate smṛtaṣaṣṭhyā sambandhatvaprakārakabodhasyaiva jananāt| yaḥ śiṣyate sa lupyamānārthābhidhāyīti siddhāntarītyāpi caturthīlopābhāvena viśeṣaprakārakabodhe asāmarthyāt| ataevārthaprakaraṇādyabhijñasyāpi dāśarathaśabdānnāpatyatvaprakārikā dhīḥ kintu sambandhitvaprakārikaivetyādiśābdānyāyavidāṃ spaṣṭam| ata evāhuḥ-"bhedyabhedakasambandhopādhibhedaniyantritam| sādhutvam" iti| tasmādaśvāśvaśabdayoriva svaviśayādanyatrāsādhutā kvacitsādhutayā na virudhyate ityavadheyam| evaṃ sthite balirakṣitādigrahaṇaṃ jñāpakamityādi prāguktameva samyak| yattu tādarthyasya samāsānniyamena pratītyarthaṃ balisukhagrahaṇamityuktam| tadapina, tatrāpi pākṣikaṣaṣṭhīsamāsasya durvāratayā niyatapratītatādarthyena caturthīvibhaktirākṣipyate "tasmai hitam"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-5)ityato vā'nuvṛttya siddheḥ, pūrvapakṣāvasare tvayaiva tathoktatvācceti dik|
athena nityasamāso viśeṣyaliṅgatā ceti vaktavyam| dvijāyāyaṃ dvijārthaḥ sūpaḥ| dvijārthā yavāgūḥ| dvijārthaṃ payaḥ| tatra nityatvaṃ nyāsakiddham| caturthyā tādarthyasyoktatvādarthaśabdena vigraho na bhaviṣyati paravalliṅgatāṃ bādhituṃ viśeṣyaliṅgatāmātraṃ vācyam|
syādetat| "tadarthaṃ vikṛteḥ prakṛtau"(aṣṭāosūo5-1-12)ityatra tadarthasamarthamiti sūtraṃ kriyatām| tādarthyena caturthīvibhaktirākṣipyate| "tasmai hitam'(aṣṭāosūo2-1-5)ityato vānuvartate| caturthīsamarthāttadarthe'bhidheye sarthap‌syāt| "ādirñiṭuḍavaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-5)"ṣaḥ pratyayasya"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-6)iti dviṣakārakanirddeśātsakārasyetsaṃjñā| "siti ca"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-16)iti padatvam| pittvādanudāttaḥ| rājārthaḥ| gavārthaḥ| evaṃ cārthe iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro na vidheyaḥ| pratyayatvācca na tena vigrahaḥ| taddhitatvādabhidheyaliṅgatā ca siddheti| maivam, "ṣaḥ pratyayasya"(aṣṭāosūo1-3-6)ityatra sakārapraśleṣe mānābhāvāt| vuñ‌chaṇādisūtreṇa tṛṇādibhyaḥ sapratyaye `tṛṇasaḥ' ityādāvativyāpteśca| kiñca sarthapaḥ pratyayatve śacvyarthaṃ bhvarthamityatreyaṅuvaṅoḥ prasaṅgaḥ| syādetat| brāhmaṇo'rthaḥ sūpastasya brāhmaṇo'rthaḥ prayojaka iti yāvat| evañca caturthyantena vigrahābhāvaḥ| pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ viśeṣyaliṅgatā ceti sarvaṃ sidhyati| naitat| `mahadartham' ityatrātvakapoḥ prasaṅgāt| syādetat| "caturthītadartha" iti yogo vibhajyate| tataḥ "arthaḥ" ityanenāṃśena tadarthavācina uttarapadasyārthādeśo vidhīyate sa ca vaikalpikaḥ, mahāvibhāṣādhikārāt| tena yūpārthaṃ dāru, yūpadāruityubhayaṃ bhavati| na cārthādeśenoktārthatvāddāruśabdaprayogānupapattiḥ, arthādeśasya sakalaśabdasādharaṇatayā viśeṣasphuṭīkaraṇārthantatsambhavāt| tato balirakṣitayorapi vibhāṣārthaśabda ādeśo bhavati| kuverārtho baliḥ kuberabalirityādi pūrveṇa siddhe jñāpanāyedaṃ prakṛtivikṛtibhāvādanyatra nityo'rthādeśa iti| tena `randhanārthā sthālī' ityādi bhavāti| na tu `randhanasthālī' ityādi| aśvaghāsādayastu pūrvavat| tathācārthaśabdasyādeśatvāttena vigraho na bhaviṣyati| sthāniliṅgaṃ ca bhaviṣyati, sthānyarthābhidhānasamarthasyaivaideśatvāt, sthānivadbhāvācca| artha iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarastu vidheya eveti| naitadapi| `udakārtho vīvadhaḥ' ityatra vīvadhaśabdasyārthādeśa kṛte sthānivadbhāvena manthaudanādisūtreṇodādeśaprasaṅgāt|
iyuvau sarthapi syātāṃ bahuvrīhau kavācca hi|
arthādeśe tūdabhāvo yathānyāsaṃ varaṃ tataḥ||
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-37)
pañcamī bhayena(aṣṭāosūo2-1-37)| pañcamyantaṃ bhayaprakṛtikena subantena saha prāgvat| caurabhayam| bhayabhītabhītibhībhiriti vācyam| vṛkabhītaḥ| neha-vṛkebhyastrāsaḥ| pūrvasyaiva bahulagrahaṇasyāyamprapañca| tena grābhanirgato dharmajugupsurityādi siddham|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-38)
apetāpoḍhamuktapatitāpatrastairalpaśaḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-38)| etaiḥ saha alpaṃ pañcamyantaṃ samasyate sa tatpuruṣaḥ| alpaśa ityatra bavhalpārthāditi karmaṇi śas| yadyapi "bahvalpārthānmaṅgalāmaṅgalavacanam'(kāovāo)iti vakṣyati, tathāpyata eva nipātanācchasityāhuḥ| sukhāpetaḥ| kalpanāpoḍhaḥ| cakramuktaḥ| svargapatitaḥ| taraṅgāpatrastaḥ| alpaśabda ityukterneha-prāsādātpatitaḥ| bahulagrahaṇasyaivāyaṃ prapañcaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-39)
stokāntikadūrārthakṛcchāṇi ktena(aṣṭāosūo2-1-39)| etāni ktena saha prāgvat| stokānmuktaḥ| alpānmuktaḥ| antikādāgataḥ| abhyāśādāgataḥ| dūrādāgataḥ| kṛcchrānmuktaḥ| "pañcamyāḥ stokādibhyaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-2)ityaluk| paraḥśataśabdastu "nājjhalau"(aṣṭāosūo1-1-50)ityatra vyutpāditaḥ| evaṃ paraḥsahasro'pi|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-40)
saptamī śauṇḍaiḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-40)| saptamyantaṃ śauṇḍādibhissaha prāgvat| akṣaśauṇḍaḥ| bahuvacananirddeśādādyarthāvagatiḥ| nanu arthanirdeśārthaṃ bahuvacanam| tena samāsārthaṃ vā bahuvacanaṃ kinna syāditi cet? na, gaṇapāṭhavaiyarthyāpatteḥ| syādetat| kārakāṇāṃ kriyayaiva sambandha iti tāvatsthitam| tadiha `akṣaśauṇḍaḥ' ityādau saptamyarthaḥ kvānvetu, kriyāyā aśravaṇāt? satyam, prasaktirūpā kriyā vṛttāvihāntarbhavati tad‌dvārakameva ca sāmarthya yathā dadhyodanāguḍadhānādiṣu| antaḥśabdo'tra paṭhyate| tadyoge avayavina ādhāratvavivakṣāyāṃ saptamī| yathā vṛkṣeśākheti| vane'ntarvanāntaḥ| asya vaikalpikatvātpakṣevyayībhāvaḥ| antarvaṇam| "pranirantaḥ"(kāovāo)iti ṇatvāṃmati haradattaḥ| atredaṃ vaktavyaṃ, nāyaṃ vibhaktyarthe'vyayībhāvasya viṣayaḥ, vibhaktyarthamātravṛtteravyayasya sa ityuktatvāt| atra madhyasyāpi pratīteḥ| kathamanyathā'vayavāvayavibhāvamavocaḥ| kiñcā'vyayībhāvasya nityatvāttadupadarśito vane antariti vigraho'pi na saṅgaccheta| tasmādadhikaraṇatvamātravṛttinā antaḥśabdāntareṇāvyayībhāvo na tu madhyavācinetyavadheyam| adhiśabdo'tre paṭhyate| tasyādhikaraṇaprādhānye'vyayībhāvaḥ| `adhisrī' iti| ādheyaprādhānye tvanena tatpuruṣaḥ "brāhmaṇādhīnaḥ" iti "adhyuttarapadātkhaḥ"| brāhmaṇeṣvadhīti vigrahaḥ| śauṇḍa, dhūrtte, kitava, vyāḍa, pravīma, saṃvīta, antara, adhikaramapradhāna evāyamiha paṭhyate| adhi, paṭu, paṇḍita, kuśala, capala, nipuṇa| vṛt|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-41)
siddhaśuṣkapakvabandhaiśca(aṣṭāosūo2-1-41)| etaiḥsaptamī prāgvat| sāṅkāśyasiddhaḥ| kāmpilyasiddhaḥ| saṅkāśena nirvṛttaṃ vanaṃ sāṅkāśyam| kampilena kāmpilyam| cāturathikaḥ| saṅkāśādibhyo ṇyaḥ| tatra tapasā siddha ityarthaḥ| ātapaśuṣkaḥ| sthālīpakvaḥ| cakrabandhaḥ| "bandhe ca vibhāṣā"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-13)ityuluk|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-42)
dhvāṅkṣeṇa kṣepe(aṣṭāosūo2-1-42)| dhvāṅkṣavācinā saha saptamyantaṃ prāgvannindāyām| tīrthe dhvāṅkṣa iva tīrthadhvāṅkṣaḥ| tīrthakākaḥ| yathā dhvāṅghāstīrthe ciraṃ nāvatiṣṭhante tathānyo'pi kāryeṣvanavasthita eva mucyate| ivārthasya vṛttāntarbhāvānna pṛthak prayogaḥ| kṣepe kim? tīrthaṃ dhvāṅkṣastiṣṭhati|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-43)
kṛtyairṛṇe(aṣṭāosūo2-1-43)| saptamyanta kṛtyapratyayāntaiḥ saha prāgvadāvaśyake| ṛṇagrahaṇamāvaśyakopalakṣaṇārtham| yatpratyayāntenaiveṣyate, alpaśa ityanuvṛtteḥ| kṛtyairiti bahuvacanaṃ tu prakṛtibhedābhiprāyam| māse deyamṛṇam| pūrvāhṇe geyaṃ sāma| "tatpuruṣe kṛti"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-14)ityaluk|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-44)
saṃjñāyām(aṣṭāosūo2-1-44)| saptamyantaṃ supā prāgvatsaṃjñāyām| nityasamāso'yam, vākyena saṃjñānavagamāt| araṇyetilakāḥ| araṇyemāṣāḥ| vanekaserukāḥ| "haladantātsaptamyāḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-9)ityaluk|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-45)
ktenāhorātrāvayavāḥ|(aṣṭāosūo2-1-45)| anho rātreścāvayavāḥ saptamyantāḥ ktāntena saha prāgvat| pūrvāhṇakṛtam| aparāhṇakṛtam| pūrvarātrakṛtam| apararātrakṛtam| avayavagrahaṇaṃ kim? anhi dṛṣṭam| kathaṃ tarhi "rātrivṛttamanuyoktumudyatā" iti? "kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-38)iti bhaviṣyati|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-46)
tatra(aṣṭāosūo2-1-46)tatretyetatsaptamyantaṃ ktāntena saha prāgvat| tatrabhuktam| tatrakṛtam| yadyapi abhihitaḥ so'rtho'ntarbhūta iti tatraśabdadātprathamaiva yuktā, tathāpi `tatrabhāvan' ityādau vibhaktyantare'pi darśanādadhikaraṇapratipādane tatraśabdādapi saptamyevāpekṣyeti vṛttikṛto manyante| vastutastu "svayaṃ ktena"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-25)ityatra dvitīyādhikāraivehāpi saptamyadhikāro bādhyate, pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarasyāvyayatvenāpi siddheḥ, saptamyā api lukā vibhaktyantarasādhāraṇyānuddhārācceti dik|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-47)
kṣepe(aṣṭāosūo2-1-47)| saptamyantaṃ ktāntena prāgvat nindāyām| avataptenakulasthitaṃ ta etat| yathā tapte pradeśe nakulā ciramavatiṣṭhante evaṃ kāryāṇyārabhya yaścāpalena na ciraṃ tiṣṭati sa evamucyate| "kṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇam"(paobhāo28)iti nakulasthitaśabdana samāsaḥ| udakeviśīrṇam| pravāhesūtritam| bhasmanihutam| niṣphalamityarthaḥ| tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-14)ityaluk|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-48)
pātresamitādayaśca(aṣṭāosūo2-1-48)| ete nipātyante kṣepe| yecātra ktāntāsteṣāṃ pūrveṇa siddhe punaḥ pāṭho yuktārohyāditvasiddhyarthaḥ| yuktārohyādiṣu hi pātresamitādayaśceti paṭhyate| pātresamitāḥ| bhojanasamaya eva saṅgatā ityarthaḥ| pātrebahulāḥ| bhojane eva saṅghībhavanti na kārye ityarthaḥ| udumbaramaśakaḥ| yo'lpe tṛptaḥ nāsmātparamastīti manyate adṛṣṭavistāratvāt sa evamucyate| udumbarakṛmiḥ| kūpakacchapaḥ kūpamaṇḍūkaḥ| kumbhamaṇḍūkaḥ| udapānamaṇḍūkaḥ| nagarakākaḥ| mātaripuruṣaḥ| piṇḍīśūraḥ| piṇḍīśūraḥ| piṇḍīodanapiṇḍaḥ| tatraiva śūro nānyatretyarthaḥ| gehaśūraḥ| gehenardī| gehecheḍī| gehevijitī| gehevyāḍaḥ| gehedhṛṣṭaḥ| garbhetṛptaḥ| ākhanikabakaḥ| ākhaniko jalasrotaḥ khātaṃ tasmin baka iva yatkiñcidātmīye ākhanike labhate tadbhakṣayati tathā'nyepītyarthaḥ| goṣṭheśūraḥ| goṣṭhevijiti| karṇecurucurā| ākṛtigaṇo'yam| cakāro'vadhāraṇārthaḥ| tena `paramāḥ pātre samitāḥ' iti vākyameva bhavati na tu "san‌mahat"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-61)ityādinā samāsāntaram|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-49)
pūrvakālaikasarvajaratpurāṇanavakevalāssamānādhikaraṇena(aṣṭāosūo2-1-49)| ete sapta subantāḥ samānādhikaraṇena supā saha samasyante sa tatpuruṣaḥ| pūrvakālaityarthanirddeśaḥ| anyeṣāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ svarūpagrahaṇam| pūrvakālo'parakālena samasyate, pūrvatvasya sasambandhitvāt| "viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-57)iti siddhe pūrvakālādīnāṃ pūrvanipātaniyamārthaṃ vacanam| ekaśabdasya tu "diksaṃkhye saṃjñāyām"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-50)iti niyamātprāptyarthameva| pūrvaṃ snātaḥ paścādanuliptaḥ snātānuliptaḥ| atra kriyāśabdatvātpācakapāṭhakavatparyāyaḥ prāptaḥ| ekaśāṭī| śāṭaśabdājjātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ| sarvayājñikāḥ| jarattārkikāḥ| purāṇamīmāṃsakāḥ| navapāṭhakāḥ| kevalavaiyākaraṇāḥ| samānādhikaraṇe kim? ekasyāḥ śauklyam| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsastviha na bhavati "guṇena na" iti niṣedhāt|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-50)
diksaṃkhye saṃjñāyām(aṣṭāosūo2-1-50)| samānādhikaraṇenetyāpādaparisamāpteranuvarttate| "viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-57)iti siddhe niyamārthamidam| diksaṃkhyesaṃjñāyāmeva samānādhikaraṇena samasyete nānyatra| pūrveṣukāmaśamī| pañcāmraḥ| saptarṣayaḥ| neha-uttarā vṛkṣāḥ, pañca brāhmaṇāḥ| pūrvasūtramityādau tvadigvācitvātsamāsaḥ|
|| iti śrīśabdakaustubhe dvitīyasyādhyāyasya prathame pāde dvitīyamānhikam ||
|| tṛtīyamānhikam ||
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-51)
taddhitārthottarapadasamāhāre ca(aṣṭāosūo2-1-51)| taddhitārthe viṣaye uttarapade ca parataḥ samāhāre ca vācye diksaṃkhye samānādhikaraṇena saha samasyete sa tatpuruṣaḥ| pūrvasyāṃ śālāyāṃ bhavaḥ paurvaśālaḥ| samāse kṛte "dikpūrvapadādasaṃjñāyāṃ ñaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-2-107)evam-āparaśālaḥ|
uttarapade-pūrvaśālāpriyaḥ| iha tripade bahuvrīhau kṛte priyaśabde uttarapade pūrvayostatpuruṣe sati samāsāntodāttatvaṃ lakārākārasya bhavati| asati tvavāntaratatpuruṣe pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarema pūrvaśabdasyādyudāttatvaṃ syāt| dikṣu samāhāro nāsti, anabhidhānāt| saṃkhyāyāstaddhitārthe ṣāṇmāturaḥ| pāñcanāpitiḥ| anapatya ityuktatvānna luk| pañcakapālaḥ| "saṃskṛtambhakṣāḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-2-16)ityaṇ| "dvigorluganapatye"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-88)iti ṭac| nanu pākṣikaṃ pañcagodhana iti durvāram| mahāvibhāṣādhikāreṇa tatpuruṣasya vaikalpikatvāt| ata e nityatvamupasaṃkhyātaṃ vārtikakṛtā "dvandvatatpuruṣayoruttarapade nityasamāsavacanam"(kāovāo)iti| ata eva vāk ca dṛṣcca priye asya vāgdṛṣadapriyaḥ, chatropānahapriya iti tripade bahuvrīhau pūrvayornityaṃ dvandvaḥ| tena samāsānto'pi nityameva| syādetat| samudāyasyaikārthī bhāve sati avayavayorāvaśyaka ityupasaṃkhyānaṃ vyarthamiti cit? maivam, trāyāṇāṃ samāse kṛte'nyapadārthopasaṃkrameṇa parasparasambandhābhāvāt sati tūpasaṃkhyāne vacanasāmarthyādadvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ pravṛtteḥ| na caivaṃ tripade bahuvrīhau `citrājarad‌guḥ' ityatrāpi tatpuruṣe citrāśabdasya puṃvadbhāvāpattiḥ| upasaṃkhyānasya "taddhitārthottarapada"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-51)iti sūtroktatatpuruṣamātraviṣayatvāttasyaivottarapade pratipadoktatvāt| ata eva `khādiretaraśaāmyam' ityatra puṃvadbhāvasiddhaye karmadhārayottarapado bahuvrīhirnatu tripade iti samarthasūtraśeṣaṃ kaiyaṭaḥ| yattu pūrvatantre bādhakalakṣaṇe pṛṣṭasya yugapadvidherekāhavad‌dvisāmatvamityadhikaraṇe pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho bṛhadrathantarasāmākārya ityudāhṛtya dvandvaṃ kṛtvā bahuvrīhiḥ kārya iti kātyāyanavacanamupaṣṭambhakamaḥśritya pūrvapakṣitaṃ, yacca kātyāyanavacanaṃ samāsāntaviseṣamātraviṣayamityāśritya neha dvandva iti siddhāntitaṃ, tadubhayaṃcantyam, uttarapade ityuktedvandvaṃ kṛtvetyasyāsaṅgateḥ| svare viśeṣasya spaṣṭatayā samāsāntaparyantamāgrahe bījābhāvācceti dik|
samāhāre-pañcamūlī| pañcakumārī| iha pañcānāṃ mūlānāṃ kumārīṇāṃ ca samāhāra iti vigraha-| na tu pañcamūlāḥ samāhṛtā ityādi| bhāvasādhano hi samāhāraśabdo na tu karmasādhana-| tathā sati `pañcakumārī' ityatra kumāryarthasya prādhānyātsamāsaśāstre ca aprathamānīrddiṣṭatvādekavibhaktitvābhāvāccopasarjanatvābhāvena "gostriyoḥ(aṣṭāosūo1-2-48)iti hrasvo na syāt| athātra napuṃsakahrasvatvaṃ brūyāḥ, evamapi pañcakhaṭvī' na sidhyet| vā ṭābanta iti strīliṅgatvapakṣe hīdaṃ rūpam| tatra ca hrasvābhāvāt "dvigāretaḥ" iti ṅīp na syāt siddhānte tu samāsārthe samāhāre nānāvibhaktibhiryujyamāne'pi kumārīśabdasya nityaṣaṣṭhyaiva yoga ityekavibhaktikatvātsiddhamupasarjanatvam| na ca "ekavibhaktāvaṣaṣṭhyantavacanam"(kāovāo)iti vārtikena ardhapippalyādāviva upasarjanatvaniṣedhaḥ śaṅkyaḥ, tasyaikadeśisāmāsamātraviṣayakatvāt| atra caitatsūtrayibhāṣyameva pramāṇam| yadvā, "vibhāṣā chandasi"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-36)iti sūtrādvibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛttyā vyavasthitavibhāṣāśrayaṇācca "ekavibhaktica"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-44)ityupasarjanatā ekadeśisamāse na bhavati| pañcakhaṭvādau tu syādeva| spaṣṭaṃ caitannyāsagranthe| tasmādbhāvasādhana eveha samāhāra iti sthitam| "dvigurekavacanam"(aṣṭāosūo2-4-16)iti tu " sa napuṃsakam'(aṣṭāosūo2-4-17)iti vakṣyāmītyārabhyate|
syādetat| samāhāraḥ samūha iti paryāyau| samūhaśca taddhitārthaḥ, "tasya samūhaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-2-37)iti sūtrāt| tathāca taddhitārthaityeva siddhe kiṃ samāhāragrahaṇena?na caivaṃ taddhitaśravaṇaṃ syāditi vācyam "dvigorlug"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-88)iti luksambhavāt| nanvevaṃ lukkṛtāni syuḥ| tadyathā-`pañcapūlī' ityatra "aparimāṇabista"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-22)iti ṅīppratiṣedhaḥ syāt| pañcagavam| "gorataddhitaluki"(aṣṭāosūo5-4-92)iti ṭac na syāditi cet? maivam, na taddhitalukyataddhitalukītyetatsthāne samāhāraśabdapāṭhena sarvasāmañjasyāt| tathāhi, aparimāṇabistādibhyaḥ samāhāre niyamārthamidam-ebhyaḥ sāhāra eveti| paccānāmaśvānāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcāśvī| neha-pañcabhiraśvaiḥ krītā pañcāśvā| tathā-"gauḥ" gontāttatpuruṣāṭṭac syāt| puṅagavaḥ| tataḥ-samāhāre| gorityanuvartate| sajātīyāpekṣo niyamaḥ| gontād dvigossamāhāra eva ṭac syāt| pañcagavam| neha-pañcabhirgobhiḥ krītaḥ pañcaguḥ|
tadetatsakalamabhisandhāyoktaṃ vārtikakṛtā-samāhārasamūhayoraviśeṣātsamāhāragrahaṇānarthakyaṃ taddhitārthena kṛtatvāditi| samāhārasamūhayoriti śabdaparo nirddeśaḥ| ato naikaśeṣaḥ| aviśeṣāditi| arthāviśeṣādityarthaḥ|
atra bhāṣyakārāḥ| evaṃ sati `pañcakumārī' `daśakumārī' ityatra "luktaddhitaluki"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-49)iti strīpratyayasya luk syāt| tasmāttaddhitanivṛttyarthaṃ samāhāragrahaṇam| pṛthaksamāhāragrahaṇāddhi samāsasyaiva samāhāro vācyo na tu taddhitasyeti vyākhyānāttaddhito notpadyate iti siddhamiṣṭam| ata eva ca jñāpakāttaddhitārthe viṣaye iti vyākhyātaṃ na tu vācyeiti| ata eva `pāñcanāpitiḥ' ityādau taddhita utpadyate| samāsenaiva tadarthasyoktau tu taddhito notpadyeta| ata eva dvigorlugvacanamapi saṅgacchate iti dik|
nanu pañca gāvo'sya santi pañcaguḥ puruṣa ityatra matvarthasya taddhitārthatvādayaṃ samāsaḥ prāpnoti na tu bahuvrīhiḥ, aśeṣatvāt| tasya tu citragvādiravakāśaḥ, yatra diksaṃkhye na staḥ| sati cāsminsamāse matupaḥ śravaṇaṃ syāt| na ca dvigoriti luk, aprāgdīvyatīyatvāt|
atrocyate| paratvādbahuvrīhiḥ| trikataḥ śeṣasya bhāṣyasammatatvāt| vārtikakṛtā tu vacanamevārabdham-matvarthe pratiṣedhaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-52)
saṃkhyāpūrvo dviguḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-52)| "taddhitārthaḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-51)ityatroktaḥ saṃkhyāpūrvaḥ samāso dvigusaṃjñaḥ syāt| pañcakapālaḥ| "saṃskṛtambhakṣāḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-2-16)ityanenotpannasyāṇo "dvigorluganapatye"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-88)iti luk| pañcanāvapriyaḥ| "nāvodvigoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo5-4-99)iti samāsāntaṣṭac| pañcamūlī| "dvigoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-21)iti ṅīp| anantarasyeti nyāyātpūrvasūtraviṣaya eveyaṃ saṃjñā| etadarthameva tatra yogavibhāgaḥ| anyathā "diksaṃkhye saṃjñā taddhitārthottarapadasamāhāreṣu' ityeva brūyāt| tena `saptarṣayaḥ' ityatra 'igantakāla"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-29)iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro na bhavati| samāsāntodātta eva hi paṭhyate-"saptaṛṣayastapastepe niṣeduḥ" iti yathā| kathantarhi `ekāpūpī' itiḥ? atrāhuḥ| nāyaṃ "pūrvakālaika"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-49)iti samāsaḥ kintu pūrvasūtreṇa samāhāre| tathāhi, ekamaṣyapūpaṃ kaścitkṛpaṇo dadadanekaṃ manyate| tathā dāne śraddhātiśayādapūpamahattvādvā'nekasminniva yaḥ saṃbhramastamekasminnapi karoti| anena pratigrahītā kṛpaṇo vyākhyātaḥ| tatrāropitabahutvāśrayaḥ samāhāraḥ| tatra samāse kṛte dvigutve sati "akārāntottarapade dviguḥ striyām"(kāovāo)iti strītve "dvigoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-21)iti ṅīp sidhyati|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-53)
kutsitāni kutsanaiḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-53)| "kutsa avakṣepaṇe"(cuoāo1687)| matyādisūtre cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvādvartamāne ktaḥ| bahuvacananirddeśa ubhayatrāpi svarūpagrahaṇanirāsārthaḥ| kutsyamānavācīni| kutsanaiḥ saha prāgvat| śabdapravṛttinimittakutsāyāmevāyamiṣyate, sannidhānāt| viśeṣyasya pūrvanipātārtho'yamārambhaḥ| vaiyākaraṇakhasūciḥ| "sūcayatericca" itīkāraḥ| yaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ san praśnaṃ vismārayituṃ sūcayati nirīkṣate kathayati vā aho nirmalaṃ gaganamiti, sa evamucyate| atra vyākaraṇasya vedāṅgatvāttadadhyayanaṃ svarūpeṇa yadyapi praśastaṃ tathāpi pratibhānābhāvena niṣphalatvātkutsyate| yājñikakitavaḥ| kintavāstīti pṛcchan dhanamātroddeśena jātyādinirapekṣo dyūte pravartamānaḥ kitavaḥ| tathāca śrutiḥ "sabhāmeti kitavaḥ pṛcchamāno jeṣyāmi" ityādi| iha tu kitava iva kitavaḥ, yo yājñiko dakṣimāmātratatparaḥ sannayājyamapi yājayati sa evamucyate| mīmāṃsakadurdurūḍhaḥ| "dulautkṣepe"(cuouo16000)| dur‌pūrvaḥ| auṇādikaḥ kūḍhaḥ pratyayaḥ| "bahulamanyatrāpi" iti ṇiluk| ralayorekaviṣayatvasmaraṇād durdurūḍhaḥ| pravṛttinimittakutsāyāṃ kim?(vaiyākaraṇo daridraḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-54)
pāpāṇake kutsitaiḥ (aṣṭāosūo2-1-54)| ete subante kutsitaiḥ sahaprāgvat| pāpāmakaśabdau kutsanābhidhāyinau| tayoḥ pūrvasūtreṇa samāse paranipātaḥ syāt| tasmātpūrvanipātārthamidam| pāpanāpitaḥ| pāpakulālaḥ| aṇakanāpitaḥ aṇakakulālaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-55)
upamānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-55)| upamānepameyasādhāraṇadharmavacanaiḥ sahopamānāni prāgvat| ghanaśyāmaḥ| iha pūrvapadaṃ tatsadṛśe lākṣaṇikam| ata eva sāmānādhikaraṇyāt `mṛgīva capalā nṛgacapalā' ityādau puṃvadbhāvaḥ| sādṛśyaṃ cottarapadopasthitaśyāmatvacāpalādidvārakameva gṛhyate, tathaiva byutpatteḥ, śrutaṃ vihāyāśrutakalpane gauravāpatteśca| ata eva hi vyaste'pi `vāgarthāviva' ityādisthale samparkaprabhṛtisannihitadvārakameva sādṛśyaṃ pratīyate| pūrvanipātaniyamārthaṃ cedaṃ sūtram| "viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa'(aṣṭāosūo2-1-57)iti samāse hi pūrvanipātaḥ paryāyaṇobhayoḥ syātpācakapāṭhakādivat| "tatpuruṣe tulyārtha"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-2)iti sūtre pratipadoktasyāsyaivopamānagrahaṇena grahaṇārthamapīdaṃ sūtram| ata eva mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsamāse upamānasvaro na pravartate iti siddhāntaḥ| upamīyate'nenetyupamānam| upapūrvakānmāṅaḥ karaṇe lyuṭ| prādisamāsaḥ| upapūrvakaśca māṅ sādṛśyahetuke paricchede rūḍhaḥ| yena vastvantaraṃ sādṛśyena paricchidyate tadupamānam| tadvadgauriva gavaya iti| iha hi gauḥ karaṇaṃ puruṣaḥ paricchettā| sa hi gausādṛśyena gavayaṃ paricchinati| ghanaśyāmādau tu ghanādayaḥ śabdā yadyapi ghanādisadṛśe upameye saṃkrāntāstathāpi bhūtapūrvagatyā upamānavācitā draṣṭavyā| idameva darśayituṃ laukike vigrahavākye ivaśabdaḥ prayujyate na tvasau prakiyopayogītyavadheyam| sāmānyavacanatvamapi tadviśiṣṭopameyaparatvameva bodhyam|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-56)
upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ sāsānyāprayoge(aṣṭāosūo2-1-56)| upameyaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ saha prāgvat sādhāraṇadharmaprayoge'sati| viśeṣyasya pūrvanipātārtho'yamārambhaḥ| puruṣo vyāghra iva puruṣavyāghraḥ| vyāghrādirākṛtigaṇaḥ| sāmānyāprayoge kim? puruṣo'yaṃ vyāghra iva śūraḥ| kathaṃ tarhi "bhāṣyābdhiḥ kvātigambhīraḥ" iti kaiyaṭaḥ? atrāhuḥ-neha gambhīryaṃ sādhāraṇadharmatvena vivakṣite kintu vitataduravagāhatvādi| tasya cāprayogo'styeveti nirbādhaḥ samāsa iti|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-57)
viśeṣeṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa bahulam(aṣṭāosūo2-1-57)| bhedakaṃ samānādhikaraṇena bhedyena bahulaṃ prāgvat| nīlamutpalaṃ nilotpalam| bahulagrahaṇātkvacinnityasamāsaḥ| kṛṣṇasarpaḥ| lohitaśāliḥ| kvacinna, rāmo jāmadgnyaḥ| vyāsaḥ pārāśaryaḥ| viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ sasambandhikatayā'nyataropādānamātreṇetarākṣepasambhave ubhayopādānaṃ spaṣṭārthaṃ 'kutsitāni kutsanaiḥ"(aṣṭosūo2-1-53)ityādāviveti kaiyaṭamatam| haradattastvāha-viśeṣyeṇetyuktyā viśeṣaṇaṃ labdham| tasya punarviśeṣaṇatvoktirviśeṣyate iti vyatpattyā viśeṣyatvalābhārthaṃ, tathāca samasyamānapadadvayajanyabodhaprakārayoḥ parasparavyabhicāritve samāso'yaṃ yathā nīlotpalādau| takṣakaḥ sarpa ityādau tu na bhavati| nahi takṣakatvaṃ sarpatvavyabhicārīti| atredaṃ vaktavyam-`śabdaśāstrasahakārapādapād' iti prayuñjānena prakṛtasūtra eva śiṃśapāvṛkṣa iti samāso bhavatyeveti vadatā tvayā'pi śiṃśapāvṛkṣādibhyastakṣakaḥ sarpa ityādau viśeṣo vaktavyaḥ| nanūkta evāsau, "lubyogāprakhyānāt'(aṣṭāosūo1-2-54)itisūtrasvarasena śiṃśapādiśabdānāṃ phale'pi mukhyatayā śiṃśapātvasya vṛkṣatvavyabhicārādityupapāditatvāditi cet? na, "takṣako nāgavardhakyoḥ"(aokoo3-3-4)iti nānārthakośānurodhena takṣakaśabdasyāpi vardhakau rūḍhatayā takṣakatvasya sarpatvavyabhicāra ityaviśeṣāt| takṣakatvaṃ sarpatvavyāpyaṃ bhinnameva| tacca na vyabhicārīti cet? tatkiṃ śiṃśapātvaṃ vṛkṣatvaphalatvayorvyāpyaṃ nāneti na paryālocayeḥ| kiñca `rāmo jāmadagnyaḥ' `arjunaḥ kārtavīryaḥ' ityādi prakṛtasūtra eva vṛttau pratyudāhṛtam| tatra yadi rāmatvamarjunatvaṃ ca dāśarathidhanañjayādivyāvṛttaṃ bhinnameva tacca vyāpyamityāśayastarhi samaṃ śiṃśapātve| atha śiṃśapātvaṃ phalavṛkṣayorekaṃ tarhi nānārthocchedaḥ takṣakarāmārjunādāvatiprasaṅgaśca| ubhayasādhāraṇajātisādhakaṃ nāstītyādi tu tulyameva| tasmādiha kaiyaṭamatameva prāmāmikamityavadeyam| ata eva `kailāsādriḥ' `mandarādriḥ' `bhāvapadārthaḥ' `tarkavidyā' `vyākaraṇaśāstram' ityādayaḥ prayogāssaṅgacchante|
idaṃ tvavadheyam| viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve kāmacārātpācakapāṭhakādāviva nīlotpalādāvapyavyavasthitaḥ pūrvanipātaḥ prāptaḥ| tatrāyaṃ siddhāntaḥ| upasarjanamiti tāvadanvarthasaṃjñetyuktam `apradhānamupasarjanam' iti| tadiha jātiguṇaśabdayoḥ sannipāte guṇa eva viśeṣaṇaṃ tasya dravyāvacchedadvāraiva kriyānirvartakatvāt| śrautavyavahāro'pyevam| "śvetaṃ chāgamālabheta" iti hi codanāyāṃ śvetacchāgālābhe kṛṣṇacchāga ālabhyate na tu śvetamapi paśvantaram| kriyājātyorapyupanipāte evameva| tena `nīlotpalaṃ' `pācakabrāhmaṇaḥ' iti vyavasthita eva prayogaḥ| yatra tu guṇaśabdayoḥ kriyāśabdayoḥ guṇakriyāśabdayorvopanipātastatrāniyama eva| `khañjakubjaḥ, kubjakhañjaḥ'| `pācakapāṭhakaḥ, pāṭhakapācakaḥ'| `khañjapācakaḥ, pācakakhañjaḥ' iti| `śiṃśapāvṛkṣaḥ' ityatra tu śiṃśapātvasya vyāpyatvāt vṛkṣatvasya ca vyāpakatvāt viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavyavasthā spaṣṭaiveti dik|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-58)
pūrvāparapathamacaramajaghanyasamānamadhyamadhyamavīrāśca(aṣṭāosūo2-1-58)ete subantāḥ samānādhikaraṇena supā saha prāgvat| pūrveṇaiva siddhe pūrvanipātaniyamārthamidam| guṇakriyāśabdaiḥ saha samāse pūrvādīnāmeva pūrvanipāto yathā syāt| pūrvavaiyākaraṇaḥ| aparādhyāpakaḥ| ityādi| aparaścāsāvarddhaśca paścārddhaḥ| "paścāt"(aṣṭāosūo5-3-32)iti sūtre paṭhiṣyamāṇena "arddheca"(kāovāo)iti vārtikenāparasya paścabhāvaḥ|
paścārddhena praviṣṭaḥ śarapatanabhayād bhūyasā pūrvakāyam|
iti kālidāsaḥ| atha kathaṃ "dṛtaṃ sarājanyakamekavīraḥ" iti? iha hi "pūrvakālaika'(aṣṭāosūo2-1-49)iti bādhitvā paratvādanena samāse `vīraikaḥ' iti syāt| satyam, pūrvavipratiṣedho'tra vaktavya iti durghaṭavṛttikārādayaḥ| na tvatropaṣṭambhakaṃ munitrayavacaḥ paśyāmaḥ| bahulagrahaṇaṃ vā śaraṇīkarttavyam|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-59)
śreṇyādayaḥ kṛtādibhiḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-59)| arthaḥ prāgvat| śreṇyādiṣu cvyarthavacanam| aśreṇayaḥ śreṇayaḥ kṛtāḥ śreṇikṛtāḥ| ekena śilpena paṇyena vā yejīvanti teṣāṃ samūhaḥ śreṇi| śreṇyādayaḥ paṭhyante| kṛtādirākṛtigaṇaḥ| cvyantānāṃ tu "kugati"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-18)iti nityaṃ samāsaḥ paratvāt| śreṇi, eka, pūga, mukunda, rāśi, viṣaya, nicaya, nidhana, indra, deva, muṇḍa, bhūta, śravaṇa, vadānya, adhyāpaka, abhirūpaka, brāhmaṇa, kṣatriya, paṭu, paṇḍita, kuśala, capala, nipuṇa, kṛpama, iti śreṇyādiḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-60)
ktena nañ‌viśiṣṭenānañ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-60)| nañ‌mātrādhikena ktāntenānañ ktāntaṃ samasyate sa tatpuruṣaḥ| kṛtaṃ ca datakṛtaṃ ca kṛtākṛtam| ekameva vastu ekadeśakaraṇātkṛtamekadeśāntarasyākaraṇāccākṛtamityucyate| pītāpītam| uditānuditam| nuḍiḍādhikye'pīṣyate| aśitānaśitam| kliṣṭākliśitam| nuḍiḍ‌grahaṇamarthābhedakasya vikārasyāpyupalakṣaṇam| "śācchoranyatarasyām"(aṣṭāosūo7-4-41)chātācchitam| pūrvanipātaniyamārthaṃ sūtrārambhaḥ|
kṛtāpakṛtādīnāmupasaṃkhyānam(kāovāo)| kṛtāpakṛtam| bhuktavibhuktam| pītavipītam| gatapratyāgatam| bhāvektaḥ| tat kṣaṇabhuvā pratyāgamanena sahacaritaṃ gamanaṃ gatapratyāgatam| yātaṃ ca tadanuyātaṃ ca tadānīmeva punargamānta yātānuyātam| krayākrayikā| "alpe"(aṣṭāosūo5-3-85)iti kapratyayaḥ| tadantaśca svabhāvātstriyām| "anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-137)iti dīrghaḥ| mahān krayaḥ krayaśabdenocyate, gobalīvarddanyāyāt| evaṃ puṭāpuṭikā, phalāphalikā, mānonmāniketi|

sanmahatvaramottamotkṛṣṭāḥ pūjyamānaiḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-61)| ete pūjyamānaiḥ saha prāgvat| guṇakriyāśabdaiḥ saha samāse sadādīnāṃ pūrvanipātaniyamārthaṃ sūtram| satpāṭhakaḥ| mahāvaiyākaraṇaḥ| ityādi| pūjyamānaiḥ kim? utkṛṣṭo gauḥ| kardamāduddhūta ityarthaḥ| `mahājanaḥ' `mahodadhiḥ' `mahāpāpam' ityādau tu pūjābhāve'pi "viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-57)iti samāsaḥ|
