kiṃ kṣepe(aṣṭāosūo2-1-64)| etatsamānādhikaraṇena saha prāgvat| kiṃrājā, yo na rakṣati| kiṃsakhā, yo druhyati| kiṅgauḥ, yo na vahati| "kimaḥ kṣepe"(aṣṭāosūo5-4-70))iti samāsāntapratiṣedhaḥ| kṣepe kim? ko rājā pāṭaliputre|
poṭāyuvatistokakatipayagṛṣṭidhenuvaśāvehadvaṣkayaṇīprāvaktṛśrotriyādhyāpakadhūrttairjātiḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-65)| napuṃsakaṃ poṭā iti haradattaḥ| amarastu-"poṭā strīpuṃsalakṣaṇā'(aokoo2-6-15)iti napuṃsakaparyāyebhyaḥ pṛthagevāha| stanasmaśrvādiyuktā strī poṭeti tadvyākhyātāraḥ| ubhayathāpi śāstrīyastrītvaviśiṣṭe poṭāśabdo vartatate| yathā śāstrīyapuṃstvaviśiṣṭe dāraśabdaḥ| gṛṣṭirekavāraprasūtā| dhenuḥ pratyagraprasavā| vaśā vandhyā| vehad garbhaghātinī| vaṣkayaṇī taruṇavatsā| poṭādibhiḥ saha jātiḥ prāgvat| ibhapoṭā| ibhayuvatiḥ| agnistokaḥ| udiśvivatkatipayam| gogṛṣṭiḥ| godhenuḥ| govaśā| govehat| gobaṣkayaṇī| kaṭhapravaktā| kaṭhaśrotriyaḥ| kaṭhādhyāpakaḥ| kaṭhadhūrttaḥ| jātiḥ kim? devadattaḥ pravaktā| ` kaṭhadhūrttaḥ' ityatra yaḥ kaṭhaḥ sa dhūrta ityartho na tu kaṭhatvaṃ kutsyate| ataḥ "kutsitāni kutsanaiḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-53)ityanena gatārthatā na śaṅkyā, pravṛttinimittakutsāyāṃ tatpravṛtteḥ| kathaṃ tarhi "janayati kumudabhrāntiṃ dhūrtabako bālamatsyānām" iti| bakadhūrta iti hi yuktam? satyam, pramāda evāyamiti prāmāṇikā-|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-66)
praśaṃsāvacanaiśca(aṣṭāosūo2-1-66)| praśastavācibhiḥ samānādhikaraṇaiḥ saha jātiḥ prāgvat|
"matallikā macarcikā prakāṇḍamud‌ghatallajau
"praśastavācakānyamūni"(aokoo1-4-27)ityamaraḥ| niyataliṅgā ete na tu viśeṣyanighnāḥ| gomatāllikā| gomacarcikā| goprakāṇḍam| gavodghaḥ| golallajaḥ| praśastā gaurityarthaḥ| jāteḥ pūrvanipātārthaṃ sūtram| praśaṃsāvacanapoṭāyuvatītyekayogasambhave yogavibhāgasya prayojanaṃ cintyam| jātiḥ kim? kumārī matallikā| praśaṃsayeti vaktavye vacanagrahaṇaṃ rūḍhiśabdaparigrahārtham| tena ye yaugikāḥ praśastaśobhanaramaṇīyādayaḥ, ye ca viśeṣavacanāḥ śucimṛdvādayaḥ, ye ca jātiśabdāḥ santaḥ paratra prayogātpraśaṃsāṃ gamayanti, siṃho māṇavaka ita, te sarve vyudastāḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-67)
yuvākhalatipalitavalinajaratībhiḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-67)| jaradbhiriti pāṭhāntaram| tavādyapāṭhe yuvaśabdena jaratyāḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyāsambhavāttadanyathānupapattyā "prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭhasyāpi"(paobhāo73)iti paribhāṣā jñāpyate| tathāca yuvayuvatiśabdayordvayorapi khalatyādibhiścaturbhirubhayaliṅgaiḥ samānādhikaraṇaiḥ saha samāse aṣṭau udāharaṇāni paryavasyanti| tathāhi, yuvā khalatiḥ yuvakhalatiḥ| yuvatiḥ khalatī yuvakhalatī| "kṛdikārādaktinaḥ"(kāovāo) "sarvato'ktinnarthādityeke"(kāovāo)iti ṅīṣ| yuvapalitaḥ| yuvapalitā| yuvavalinaḥ| yuvavalinā| valiśabdaḥ pāmādiḥ| yuvajaran| yuvajaratī iti| jīryateratṛn| "ugitaśca'(aṣṭāosūo4-1-3)iti ṅīp| yuvatyāmeva jaratīdharmopalambhena tadrūpāropātsāmānādhikaraṇyam| yattu evaṃ sati puṃsyeva strītvāropeṇa jaratīsāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ sambhavatīti paribhāṣājñāpanaṃ kathamiti haradattenoktaṃ, tatredamuttaram| āropaṃ vinopapattau kiṃ tena? nahi ekamagatyā āropitamiti sarvamevāropaṇīyam, lakṣyānurodhena paribhāṣajñāpanasyaivaucityāt| "kumāraḥ śramaṇādibhiḥ'(aṣṭāosūo2-1-70)iti vā jñāpakamastu, śramaṇādiṣu strīliṅgānāmeva vahūnāṃ pāṭhāt| aśvādibhyaḥ phañvidhau "puṃsi jāte'(gaosūo)iti gaṇasūtre puṃsītyuktirjñāpiketi tu tattvam| yuvaśabdasya pūrvanipātaniyamārthaṃ vacanam| aniyamo hi prasaktaḥ, guṇaśabdatvāt|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-68)
kṛtyatulyākhyā ajātyā(aṣṭāosūo2-1-68)| kṛtyapratyayāntāstulyaparyāyāścājātivacanena saha prāgvat| bhojyoṣṇam| bhojyalavaṇam| tulyaśvetaḥ| sadṛśaśvetaḥ| pūrvanipātaniyamārthaṃ vacanam| ajātyeti kim? bhojya odanaḥ| pratiṣedhasāmarthyādviśeṣaṇamityapi na bhavati| `tulyamahān' ityādau tu paratvādanena "sanmahat"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-61) iti bādhyate| tasya tu akṛtyatulyākhyā avakāśaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi "tasya satkṛtyaśālinaḥ" iti bhaṭṭiḥ? "sanmahat"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-61)ityasmātparatvādanena samāse `kṛtyasat' iti syāt| satyam, satāṃ kṛtyamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso bodhyaḥ| evaṃ `paramapūjyaḥ' ityatra|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-69)
varṇo varṇena(aṣṭāosūo2-1-69)| samānādhikaraṇena saha prāgvat| kṛṣṇasāraṅgaḥ| sāraṅgaścitraḥ| sa cākṛṣṇo'pi sambhavati| ataḥ kṛṣṇo viśeṣaṇam| na cāsambhavaḥ, nānārūpasamāhāraścitramityabhyupagamāt| citratvaṃ rūpatvavyāpyaṃ nilatvādiviruddhaṃ jātyantarameveti pakṣe tu kṛṣṇāvayavake kṛṣṇaśabdasya lakṣaṇā bodhyā|
syādetat| "tṛtīyā tatkṛtā"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-30)itīha siddham, sāraṅgatvasya kṛṣṇādikṛtatvāt| evañca "varṇeṣu"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-3)iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro'pi na vidheyaḥ "tatpuruṣe tulyārthatṛtīyā"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-2)ityeva gatārthatvāt| maivam, `kṛṣṇaśuklaḥ' `haritaśuklā' ityādyarthaṃ samāsasyāvaśyaṃvidheyatvāt| na hīha tatkṛtatvamasti| tathā svarasutramapyubhābhyāṃ vaktavyam| iha mā bhūt kṛṣṇaitaḥ, lohitaitaḥ, iti| tathā cānena iti niṣedhārthaṃ vidhyarthaṃ veti paraṃ saṃśayaḥ| tatra kṛṣṇaśuklādau vidhyarthameveti sthitam| pratipadoktasya samāsasya grahaṇasambhavātsvarasūtre "varṇoneta" ityevāstu varṇoṣviti na kartavyamiti tuttvam| vastutastu "varṇo varṇeṣu"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-2)iti yathānyāsamastu| prakṛtasūtrameva tu na kartavyaṃ "viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-57)ityeva samāsasya siddhatvāditi dhyeyam|
matvarthīyacikīrṣāyāṃ na karmadhāraya iti vaktavyam|| vīrapuruṣavān grāma iti mā bhūt| tathāca prathamata eva matvarthavivakṣayā bahuvrīhireva bhavati| nyāyasiddhaṃ cedamiti bhāṣyam| bahuvrīhimātreṇa labhye'rthe matubādergauravaparāhatatvāt| kṛṣṇasarpavānvalmīkaḥ, lohitaśālimān grāmaḥ ityādi tu bhavatyeva, karmadhārayaṃ vinā jātiviśeṣasyāpratīteḥ| sarvaśabdasya tvakārāntaiḥ karmadhāraya iṣyate| tasmācca ṭhanaṃ bādhitvenireveti vaktavyam| sarvadhanī| sarvabījī| sarvakeśī|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-70)
kumāraḥ śramaṇādibhiḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-70)| pūrvanipātaniyamārthaṃ sūtram| ye'tra strīliṅgāḥ paṭhyante-śramaṇaḥ, pravrajitā, kulaṭā ityevamādastaiḥ saha strīliṅga eva kumāraśabdaḥ samasyate| ye tu puṃlliṅgā adhyāpakādayastairubhayathā, prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇāt| kumārī śramaṇā kumāraśramaṇā| śramaṇā| pravrajitā| kulaṭā| garbhiṇī| tāpasī| dāsī| bandhakī| adhyāpaka| abhirūpaka| paṇḍita| paṭu| mṛdu| kuśala| capala| nipuṇa|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-71)
catuṣpādo garbhiṇyā(aṣṭāosūo2-1-71)| jātiriti maṇḍūkaplutyānuvartate catuṣpājjātivācinaḥ subantā garbhiṇīśabdena saha prāgvat| gogarbhiṇī| ajagarbhiṇī| jātiḥ kim? kālākṣī garbhiṇī| catuṣpātkim? brāhmaṇī garbhiṇī| garbhiṇīśabdasya paranipātārthaṃ vacanam| pratyudāharaṇe tu "viśeṣaṇam"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-57)iti samāse pūrvanipāto bodhyaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-1-72)
mayūravyaṃsakādayaśca(aṣṭāosūo2-1-72)| ete samudāyā nipātyante| cakāro'vadhāraṇārthaḥ samāsāntaraṃ vyāvartayati| vyaṃsako dhūrtaḥ| mayūraścāsau byaṃsakaśceti vigrahaḥ| vyaṃsakaśabdasya guṇavacanatvātpūrvanipāte prāpte vacanam| evaṃ chātrāvyaṃsakādīnāṃ yavanamuṇḍaparyantānām|
anye tvāhuḥ-mayūra iva vyaṃsakaḥ| chātra iva vyaṃsakaḥ| kamboja iva muṇḍaḥ| yavana iva muṇḍaḥ| upamānasamāso'yam| tatra--"upamānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-55)ityeva siddhe punarvidhānaṃ "tatpuruṣe tulyārthatṛtīyā"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-2)iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro mā bhūditi| sa h‌yupamānasaṃśabdanena vihite samāse vidhīyate| mayūravyaṃsakaḥ| chātravyaṃsakaḥ| kambojamuṇḍaḥ| yavanamuṇḍaḥ| pādagṛhya, hastagṛhya, lāṅgūlagṛhya, punardāya, ete catvāraśca chandasi| yatprākṣimāḥ pitaraṃ pādagṛhya| agnirhotā hastagṛhyā nināya| punardāya brahmajāyām| punaśca nasau chandasīti gatisaṃjñā tu vārtikakāroktā na tu sūtrārūḍheti gaṇakāreṇedaṃ paṭhitam|
ehīḍādayo'nyapadārthe(gaosūo)| ehīḍeti yasminkarmaṇi tadehīḍam| evam ehiyavam| ehi vāṇijeti yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā ehivāṇijā| evam apehivāṇijā| prehivāṇijā| ehi svāgatamiti yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā ehisvāgatā| "ūha vitarke(bhvāoāo641)loṇmadhyamaikavacanam| prohakaraṭamiti yasyāṃ sā prohakaraṭā| nipātanātparasmaipadam| prohakaṭā| prohakardamā| uddharaṭūḍā| āharavasanā| āharavanitā| kṛntavicakṣaṇā| "kṛtī chedane"(tuopao1435)loṭ serhiḥ| mucāditvānnum| kṛnta vicakṣaṇa iti yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ setyarthaḥ| gaṇaratne tu kṛndhi vicakṣaṇeti pāṭhaḥ| tatra "kṛtī veṣṭane"(rūopao1447)iti rudhādirbodhyaḥ| uddharakoṣṭhāt utsṛja dehīti yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā uddharotsṛjā| "ākhyātamākhyātena"(gaosūo)iti siddhe asātatyārthaṃ vacanam| evam-uddhamavidhamā| utpaca nipacā| utpatanipatā| ihaiṣāṃsamāsānāmanyapadārthe strīliṅgatvāṭṭāp| evamagre'pi udak ca avāk ca uccāvacam| uccaiśca nīcaiścoccanīccam| ācitaṃ copacitaṃ ca ācopacam| ācapacam| niścitaṃ ca pracitaṃ ca niścapracam| ete sarve nipātyante| na vidyate kiñcana yasyāsāvakiñcanaḥ| sakiñcanaḥ| snātvākālakaḥ| iha samāsāntodāttatvaṃ lyaṣabhāvaśca nipātyate| samānakartṛkatvaṃ tu antarbhūtakriyāpekṣaṃ bodhyam, snātvākālakaḥ saṃpanna ityarthāvagamāt| pītvāsthirakaḥ| bhuktvāsuhitaḥ| proṣya pāyān utpatya yā kalā utpatanaṃ kṛtvā yā pāṇḍurbhavati socyate hastijvaraḥ pākalaḥ| tadviśeṣastu kūṭapākalaḥ "kalabhaṃ kaṭhora iva kūṭapākalaḥ" iti bhavabhūtiprayogāt hastiśāstre tathādarśanācyetyanye| nipatyarohiṇī| niṣadyaśyāmā| apehipraṇamā|
jahikarmaṇā bahulamābhīkṣṇye kartāraṃ cābhidadhāti(kāovāo)| jahīti loṇmadhyamaikavacanāntam| tatkarmaṇā bahulaṃ samasyate ābhīkṣṇye gamyamāne samāsena cetkartābhidhīyate| jahijoḍamityābhīkṣṇyena ya āha sa jahijoḍaḥ| jahastambaḥ| ujjahistambaḥ|
ākhyātamākhyātena kriyāsātye(gaosūo)| aśnītapibatetyevaṃ yatra satatamabhidhīyate sā'śnītapibatā| evaṃ pacatabhṛjjatā| khādatamodatā| khādatavasatā| aharanicayā| āharaniṣkaṣā| utpacanipacā| bhindhilavaṇā| bhindhi lavaṇamiti yasyāmabhidhīyate sā kriyā tathā| evaṃ pacalavaṇā| ākṛtigaṇo'yam| tenānyepi jñeyāḥ| tatra kecidgaṇaratnakṛtā saṃgṛhītāḥ| tadyathā-nāsti kutopi bhayaṃ yasya saḥ akutobhayaḥ| kāndiśaṃ gacchāmīti ya āha sa kāndiśīkaḥ| gaṇapāṭhasāmartyādīkaṇ dvītīyāyā alukca| "kāndiśīko bhayadrutaḥ"(aokoo3-2-42)ityamaraḥ| ahopuruṣo'hamiti yo tasya bhāva āhopuruṣikā| manojñāditvād‌vuñ| ahaṃ śakto'haṃ śakta iti yasyāṃ sāhamahamikā| yā icchā abhiprāya iti yadṛcchā| ehirepāhirā| ehi re pāhi re iti yasyāṃ sā tathetyarthaḥ| gaṇapāṭhādātvam|
ehirāṃ pāhire nītā yena niścapracā api|
tatkarma dagdhuṃ sevethā govindamakutobhayam||
unmṛḍ‌ḍhi avamṛḍ‌ḍhīti yasyāṃ sā unmṛjāvamṛjā| ata eva nipātanādanayorihaiva sādhutvam| anyad dravyaṃ dravyāntaram| antaraśabdo bhinnavācī| bhinnaścābhedena sambandhena pūrvapadārthe viśeṣaṇam| pūrvapadajanyabodhaprakārāśrayapratiyogitvaṃ bhede vyutpattisim| avaśyakāryam| tadeva tanmātram| "mātraṃ kārtsnye'vadhāraṇe"(aokoo3-3-177)ityādi|
|| iti śrīśabdakaustubhe dvitīyādhyāyasya prathame pāde tṛtīyamānhikam|| pādaścāyaṃ samāptaḥ||
<2.2>
||dvitīyepāde prathamamānhikam||
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-1)
pūrvāparādharottaramekadeśinaikādhikaraṇe(aṣṭāosūo2-2-1)| avayavinā saha pūrvādayaḥ samasyante sa tatpuruṣaḥ, ekatvasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭaścedavayavī bhavati| pūrvaṃ kāyasyeti pūrvakāyaḥ| aparakāyaḥ, ityādi| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāpavādo'yam| tathāca `kāyapūrvaḥ' iti prayogo'nena vyāvartyate| `pūrvakāyaḥ' iti prayogastu pūrvaścāsau kāyaśceti karmadhārayeṇāpi siddhaḥ| samudāyeṣu hi vṛttāḥ śabdā avayave'pi vartante iti nyāyāt, ūrdhvakāya itivat| nanu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsavyāvṛttaye'pi sūtraṃ na kāryaṃ, ṣaṣṭhyā eveha durlabhatvāt| pañcamyā hīha bhāvyam, diśi dṛṣṭaḥ śabdo dik‌śabda iti vyākhyānena sampratyadig‌vṛttinā'pi yoge pañcamīsvīkārāt? satyam| avayavavṛttibhiryoge ṣaṣṭhyeveṣyate "tasya paramāmreḍitam"(aṣṭāosūo8-1-2)iti liṅgāt| ekadeśiśabdo'yamavayeva rūḍhaḥ| ata eva tato matvarthīyaḥ `kṛṣṇasarpavānvalmīkaḥ' iti yathā| yadyapīha "ekagopūrvāt"(aṣṭāosūo5-2-118)iti ṭañ prāptastathāpyata eva nirdeśādinirboddhavyaḥ| ekadeśavācini tu ekadeśīyaśabda eva, bahuvrīhilabhye'rthe matubādayo netyuktvāt| ekadeśinā kim? pūrvaṃ nābheḥ kāyasya| nābheḥ pūrvo bhāgaḥ sa kāyasya sambandhītyarthaḥ| nābheriti digyogalakṣaṇapañcamī| atra pūrvasya bhāgasya nābhiravadhirna tvekadeśī, ato na nābhyā samāsaḥ| kāyena tu syādeva pūrvakāyo nābheriti, pūrvaśabdasya nityasāpekṣatvāt| ekādhikaraṇe kim? pūrvaṃ chātrāṇāmāmantrayasva neyaṃ nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī, kintu samudāyasamudāyisambandhe| bahuvacanaṃ tūd‌bhūtāvayavabhedasamudāyavivakṣayā yathā 'chātrāṇāṃ pañcamaḥ' iti| tataśca chātrāṇāmekadeśitvamastyeva, kintvekatvasaṃkhyāvaiśiṣṭyaṃ nāstīti samāsābhāvaḥ| kathantārhi `madhyāhnaḥ' iti? atrāhuḥ-sarvasyaikadeśavācino'hnā samāsaḥ, saṃkhyāvisāya"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-110)iti jñāpakāt| nahyanyathā sāyapūrvatvamahnasyopapadyate| kecittu nedaṃ viśeṣāpekṣaṃ jñāpakamahneti, kintu sāmānyāpekṣam| sarva ekadeśavācī kālena samasyate iti jñāpyaśarīram| tena `madhyarātraḥ' `upāratāḥ paścimarātragocarāḥ' ityādi siddham| na cordhvakāyavatsāmānādhikaraṇyena sāyāhnamadhyarātrādernirvāhaḥ śaṅkyaḥ, "ahaḥsarvaikadeśa"(aṣṭāosūo5-4-87)ityādinā vihitasyācaḥ "ahaḥsarvaikadeśa"(aṣṭāosūo5-4-88)ityahnādeśasya caikadeśisamāsaṃ vinā'nupapatteḥ| kathantarhi `dinamadhyaḥ' `rātrimadhyaḥ' iti jñāpakasiddhaṃ na sarvatretyadoṣaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-2)
ardhaṃ napuṃsakam(aṣṭāosūo2-2-2)| nityaklībo'rdhaśabda ekadravye vidyamānenāvayavivācinā saha prāgvat|
bhittaṃ śakalakhaṇḍe vā puṃsyardho'rdhaṃ sameṃ'śake|(aokoo1-3-16)tatra śakalakhaṇḍe iti napuṃsakatvasya rūpabhedānnirṇaye pūṃstvavikalpādastriyāmiti phalitam| na ca strīliṅgarūpameva kinna syāditi vācyam, bhinnaliṅgānāṃ na dvandva iti tena paribhāṣitatvāt| śakalaścāstrīti nirdeśenaiva nirṇayāt| `ardhaḥ' ityatra tu rūpabhedātpuṃstvāvagatau satyāṃ vāpuṃsīti tadvikalpenāviśeṣātstrīnapuṃsake labhyete| tathā cārdhaśabdastriṣviti phalito'rtheḥ| sameṃ'śake tu ardhaṃ nityanapuṃsakamityarthaḥ| ardhaṃ pippalyāḥ ardhapippalī| "ekavibhaktāvaṣaṣṭhyantavacanam"(kāovāo)iti pippalīśabdasyānupasarjanatvānna hrasvaḥ| ekādhikaraṇe kim? ardhaṃ pippalīnām| kathaṃ tarhyardhapippala iti? ardhaāni pippalīnāmiti vigrahe mā bhūt| khaṇḍasamuccaye tu bhaviṣyati, ardhapippalī ca ardhapippalī cetyādi vigrahāt| ekadeśineti kim? ardhaṃ paśordevadattasya| devadatto'tra svāmī na tvavayavīti na tena samāsaḥ| paśunā tu syādevaardhapaśurdevadattasyeti| devadattasvāmikaṃ paśorardhamityarthaḥ| napuṃsakaṃ kim? grāmārdhaḥ| nagarārdhaḥ| ardhamiti nirdeśādeva siddhe napuṃsakagrahaṇaṃ sūtre liṅganirdeśo na vivakṣita iti jñāpayitum| tena "tasyedam"(aṣṭāosūo4-3-120)iti liṅgatraye'pi bhavati| etatsūtraṃ "
paravalliṅgam"(aṣṭāosūo2-4-26)ityatra bhāṣye pratyākhyātam| tathāhi, `ardhapippalī' iti karmadhārayeṇa siddham, samudāye dṛṣṭāḥ śabdā avayave'pi varttante iti nyāyāt| samapravibhāgādanyatra hi tavāpyeṣaiva gatiḥ| ardhāhāraḥ, ardhahāraḥ, ardhajaratīyam, ardhavaiśasam, ardhoktam, ardhavilokitam, ityādidarśanāt| na ca samapravibhāge ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaṃ bādhitumidaṃ sūtramiti vācyam, ṣaṣṭhīsamāsasyāpīṣṭatvāditi| tathāca kālidāsaḥ prāyuṅkta-"premṇā śarīrārdhaharāṃ harasya' iti|
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-3)
dbitīyatṛtīyacaturthaturyāṇyanyatarasyām(aṣṭāosūo2-2-3)| etāni ekadeśinā saha vā prāgvatsyurekaṃ ced dravyam| dvitīyaṃ bhikṣāyāḥ dvitīyabhikṣā, bhikṣādbitīyam| tṛtīyabhikṣā| `bhikṣātṛtīyam' ityādi| ekadeśinā kim? dvitīyaṃ bhikṣāyā bhikṣukasya| ekādhikaraṇe kim? dvitīyaṃ bhikṣāṇām|
syādetat pūrvanasūtravadidamapi pratyākhyātam| tathāhi, samudāyaśabdasyāvayave vṛttau karmadhārayeṇa `dvitīyabhikṣā' ityādi siddham| `bhikṣādvitīyam' ityādi tu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsena siddham| maivam, "pūraṇa"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-11)itiṣaṣṭhīsamāsaniṣedhāt| siddhānte tvasmin sūtre'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasāmarthyātpakṣe ṣaṣṭhīsamāso labhyate, vākyasya mahāvibhāṣayaiva siddheḥ| nanvetatsūtraṃ vināpi pūraṇādbhāge"(aṣṭāosūo5-3-48)iti svārthe'n‌pratyayaṃ kṛtvā tadantena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaṃ kariṣyāma iti cet? na, tatrāpi pratiṣedhasāmyāt| "pūraṇa"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-11)ityatra hi arthagrahaṇaṃ na tu pūraṇādhikāravihitapratyayagrahaṇam, arthaśabdasya pratyekamabhisambandhāt| svārthitam| ata eva 'tānyuñcchaṣaṣṭhāṅkitasaikatāni"(raovao5-8)ityatra samāsaḥ prāmādika ityāhuḥ| vastutastu "paravalliṅgam"(aṣṭāosūo2-4-26)itisūtre tatpuruṣagrahaṇaṃ "dviguprāpta" ityādi vārttikaṃ "pūrvāpara"(aṣṭāosūo3-1-58)ityāditrisūtrī ca bhāṣye pratyākhyātā| tathāca bhikṣādvitīyādisiddhaye saṃjñāpramāṇatvādinirdeśānāṃ sāmānyāpekṣajñāpakatāśrayaṇīyā "pūraṇa"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-11)ityādiniṣedho'nitya iti| evañcocchaṣaṣṭhetyapi sādhviti dik| turīyasyāpīṣyate iti vṛttikārāḥ| etacca bhāṣyādau nāsti|
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-4)
prāptāpanne ca dvitīyā(aṣṭāosūo2-2-4)| etau dvitīyāntena sahaprāgvat| pakṣe "dvitīyāśrita"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-24)itisamāsaḥ| prāpto jīvikāṃ prāptajīvikaḥ| jīvikāprāpta iti vā| āpannajīvikaḥ| jīvikāpannaḥ| yadyapi prāptā jīvikā yeneti kṛtvā karmaṇi ktāntena bahuvrīhau `prāptajīvikaḥ' ityādi sidhyati, tathāpi samāsāntodāttārthaṃ vacanaṃ `prāptasukhaḥ' ityādyarthañca| iha hi bahuvrīhau "jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ"(kāovāo)iti niṣṭhāyāḥ paranipātaḥ syāt| liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā prāptaśabdasyāpyayaṃ samāsaḥ| prāptā jīvikā prāptajīviketi| nanu "ekavibhakti"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-24)ityupasarjanatayā jīvikāśabdasya hrasvo'stu nāma, prāptāśabdasya tu kutaḥ saḥ? atra bhāṣyam, "aca" iti pūrvapadasyākāro'pi sūtre'sminvidhīyate, cakāreṇa samuccayārthenākārapraśloṣasyānumānāditi| prāptāpanne samasyete, a ca, atvaṃ ca bhavati prāptāpannayoḥ| sautratvācca prakṛtibhāvo neti bhāva iti prāñcaḥ| vastutastu dvitīyetyasyānantaramakārapraśleṣo bodhyaḥ| evaṃ hi prakṛtibhāvaprasaṅga eva nāstīti bodhyam|
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-5)
kālāḥ parimāṇinā(aṣṭāosūo2-2-5)| parimīyate paricchidyate yena tatparimāṇaṃ tadvānparimāṇī| paricchedyavācinā subantena saha kālāḥ samasyante sa tatpuruṣaḥ| māso jātasya yasya sa māsajātaḥ| nanu jāto devadattaḥ tasya ca diṣṭyādi paricchedakaṃ na tu kālaḥ, tasya kriyāmātraparicchedakatvāditi cet? satyam, sākṣātkriyāṃ paricchindannapi kālastad‌dvārā devadattaṃ paricchinatti| yasya hi jananādūrdhvaṃ māso gataḥ sa māsajāta iti vyavahriyate| tatra vyavahārakālajananakṣaṇayorantarālabhāvī māso jananadvārā jātamapi paricchinattyeva| vigrahe ṣaṣṭhīnirddiṣṭasyāpi vṛttau prādhānyamiha bodhyam| `daṇḍī citraguḥ' ityādāviva viśeṣaṇaviseṣyabhāvavyatyāsenaiva ekārthībhāvābhyupagamāt| tathāca hariṇā-
kvacid guṇapradhānatvamarthānāmavivakṣitam|
ityupakramya-
ākhyātaṃ taddhitārthasya yatkiñcidupadarśakam|
guṇapradhānabhāvasya tatra dṛṣṭo vipayaryaḥ||
iti vadatā ākṣikavaiyākaraṇādyudāharaṇāni spaṣṭīkṛtāni| tathāca `māsajātaḥ' ityasya māsaprāgbhāvijananāśraya ityarthaḥ| atha eva māsa jāto dṛśyatāmityādikriyāyogo jātasyaiva bhavati na tu ardhapippalyādāviva pūrvapadārthasya| dvyahajātaḥ| dvayorahnoḥ samāhāraḥ| "rājāhaḥ sakhibhyaṣṭac"(aṣṭāosūo5-4-91)| "na saṃkhyādeḥ samāhāre"(aṣṭāosūo5-4-89)ityahnādeśapratiṣedhaḥ| kathantarhi `dvyahnajātaḥ' iti? ucyate, nāyaṃ samāhāre dviguḥ kintūttarapade dve ahanī jātasya yasyeti tripadatatpuruṣābhyupagamāt| nanu sup‌supetyekatvasya vivakṣitatvātkathametiditi cet? vacanādityavehi| uktaṃ hi vārttikakṛtā-"uttarapadena parimāṇinā dvigoḥ samāsavacanam" iti| asyārthaḥ-parimāṇivacanenottarapadena dvigoḥ siddhaye samāso vaktavyaḥ| arthād dvayoryugapaditi gamyate| tathāca vacanādbahūnāmapyayaṃ tatpuruṣo bhavati| evaṃ dvau māsau jātasya pūrvayostatpuruṣe sati "kālānte dvigau"(aṣṭāosūo5-1-86)iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro bhavati| dvayormāsayoḥ samāhāro dvimāsam| pātrādiḥ| dvimāsaṃ jātasyeti tu vigṛhya samāse kriyamāṇe satiśiṣṭatvātsamāsāntodāttatvaṃ syāt|
syādetat| yāvadvacanaṃ vācanikāmeti parimāmimātreṇa tripadatatpuruṣaḥ, anyatra tu dvipadaṃ eveti sthitam| tathāca "kathaṃ trilokanāthena satāṃ makhadviṣaḥ" iti kālidāsaḥ| "tavarasaruciram" iti ca kāvyaprakāśakāraḥ? iha hi trilokanavarasaśabdayorna tāvad "viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-87)iti samāsaḥ| "dik‌saṃkhye saṃjñāyām"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-50)iti niyamāt| nāpi samāhāre dviguḥ "dvigoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-21)iti ṅīp‌prasaṅgāt| na ca pātrāditvaṃ kalpyam `trilokī' iti prayogasyāsādhutāpatteḥ| tathā ca pariśeṣāttripadatvapakṣa evāvaśiṣyate| dvimāsajātaḥ| tripade tatpuruṣe jātaśabde uttarapade parataḥ sa coktarītyā duṣṭa eveti| atrocyate, lokaśabdo'tra samudāyaparaḥ| tathā ca tryavayavo loka iti madhyamapadalopī tatpuruṣaḥ| idañca, "dvigorluganapatye"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-88)ityatra bhāṣye eva spaṣṭam| trayāṇāṃ lokanātha iti vā| navarasā cāsau rucireti bahuvrīhigarbhaḥ karmadhārayo'pi suvacaḥ|
prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ| `rājapuruṣaḥ' ityādau yadyapyabhedaikatvasaṃkhyā bhāsate tathāpi māsajāte na tathā kintu śūrpeṇa krītaḥ śaurpika ityatra śūrpasyeva māsasya mukhyamevaikatvam| aktaparimāmasya vācake tathaiva vyutpatteriti dhyeyam|
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-6)
nañ(aṣṭāosūo2-2-6)| nañ supā saha prāgvat| abrāhmaṇaḥ| avṛṣalaḥ| uttarapadārthapradhāno'yam| tathāhi āropitatvaṃ nañā dyotyate| taccottarapadapravṛttiniṣṭham| tathā cāropitaṃ yad brāhmaṇatvaṃ tadviśiṣṭe samāsaḥ śaktaḥ| viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ saṃsargastvāropa eva| tena brāhmaṇābhinnatvabodha ārthaḥ| ata evānupasarjanatvādatasminnityādisarvanāmakāryanirvāhaḥ|
syādetat| vighnānāmabhāvo'pighnamityatrāpi paratvāttatpuruṣaḥ syāt| avyayībhāvastu `nirmakṣikam' ityādau sāvakāśaḥ| maivam, uttarapadārthaprādhānya evāsya pravṛtteḥ| uktaṃ hi prāk "avyayībhāvādimahāsaṃjñāvyavahāreṇa pūrvācāryoktārthaniyamo'pyutsargataḥ svīkriyate" iti| nanvevam, `anupalabdhiḥ' ityādau kā gatiḥ? śṛṇu| "rakṣohāgamalaghvasandehāḥ" iti bhāṣyaprayogātpakṣe tatpuruṣo'pīṣyate| ata eva bhūvādisūtre "athāsaṃhitayā" iti "virāmo'vasānam'(aṣṭāosūo1-4-110)iti sūtre tu "adrutāyāmasaṃhitam" iti dvidhāpi bhāṣyavārtikayoḥ prayuktam| yadvā, anupalabdhyasandehādāvapi lākṣaṇika ārtho vā tadabhāvabodhaḥ|
syādetata, anyapadārthaprādhānye'yaṃ samāsaḥ| bhāvapradhāno hyatranirddeśaḥ| na brāhmaṇatvaṃ yasminnityarthādunmattagaṅgādāvavyayībhāva iveha tatpuruṣo bahuvrīherbādhaka iti| phalantu `akartā' `abhoktā' ityādau "nadyṛtaśca"(aṣṭāosūo5-4-153)iti kababhāvaḥ syāt| maivam, `atasmin' ityādau sarvanāmakāryagaṇakāryayorasiddhiprasaṅgāt| `avarṣā hemantaḥ' ityatra hemantasyeva tadviśeṣaṇasyāpyekavacanāpatteśca| `adhano brāhmaṇaḥ' ityādāvapi nyāyasāmyāttatpuruṣaparavalliṅgatāpatteśceti dik|
matāntarantu-
tapaḥśrutañca yoniścotyetad brāhmaṇakāraṇam|
tapaḥśrutābhyāṃ yo hīno jātibrāhmaṇa eva saḥ||
ityādivacanaprāmāṇyātsarve samudāyaśabdāḥ tattadvyaktibhiriva tadīyagumasamudāyenāpyupahitāyāḥ sattāyā jātitvāt| tathāca `apūrṇo brāhmaṇo'brāhmaṇaḥ' iti sarvathāpyattarapadārthaprādhānyaṃ nirbādham| atra ca liṅgam-"etattadoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-102)iti sūtre'nañ‌samāsagrahaṇam| evañca "anekamanyapadārthe"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-4)ityādāvekavacanaṃ siddham| māghaśca-"sevyate'nekayā sannatāpāṅgayā" iti| kathantarhi "patantyaneke jaladherivormayaḥ" iti? atrāhuḥ| adhyāropitaikatvānāṃ prakṛtyarthatayā tatra vāstavabahutvābhiprāyaṃ bahuvacanaṃ na virudhyate iti| anekaścānekaścetyekaśe ṣo vā| yattu-
tatsādṛśyamabhāvaśca tadanyatvaṃ tadalpatā|
aprāśastyaṃ virodhaśca nañarthāḥ ṣaṭ prakīrttitāḥ||
yathā-abrāhmaṇaḥ, a paṃ. anaśvaḥ, anudarā kanyā, apacasi, adharmaḥ, iti| tattu yathāyathamadhikārthamabhipretyeti bodhyam| nirūḍhalakṣaṇāyāḥ śaktisamakakṣyatayā siddhānte tvatiriktaśakteruktatayā vṛttiviśeṣe tadarthāntarbhāva iti vā kathañcinneyam| iha na brāhmaṇasya bhāva iti yugapadeva bhāvenāropitatvena ca sambandhe vivakṣite samāsa eva prathamaṃ na tu parāvapi tvatalau, prakṛtyarthasya sāpekṣatvenāsāmarthyāt| nañ‌samāsastu pradhānasya sāpekṣatvānnirbādhaḥ| tataśca satiśiṣṭaḥ pratyayasvaro litsvaraśca bhavati na tu "tatpuruṣe tulyārtha"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-2)ityayam|
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-7)
īṣadakṛtā(aṣṭāosūo2-2-7)| spaṣṭo'rthaḥ īṣatpiṅgalaḥ| nanu `īṣadbhaktam' `īṣadunnatam' ityādāvavyāptiḥ| īṣadgārgyādāvativyāptiśca| satyam| ata eva vārtikakṛtoktam-"īṣad guṇavacanena" iti| akṛtetyapanīya tatsthāne guṇavacaneneti pūraṇīyamityarthaḥ| ato nāvyāptyativyāptī| yadyapi gargāpatyatve utkarṣāpakarṣau na stastathāpi tadekārthesamavāyināṃ kriyāguṇānāṃ tau bodhyau| tathāca prayujyate-`gārgyataraḥ' `gārgyakalpaḥ' ityādi|
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-8)
ṣaṣṭhī(aṣṭāosūo2-2-8)| ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ samarthena subantena saha prāgvat| rājapuruṣaḥ| kṛdyogā ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyata iti vācyam(kāovāo)| idhmavraścanaḥ| pratipadavidhānā ceti niṣedhasyāyamapavādaḥ| vastutastu sa niṣedho'yaṃ tadapavādaścetyubhayamapi na vaktavyamiti vakṣyate|
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-9)
yājakādibhiśca(aṣṭāosūo2-2-9)| ebhiḥ ṣaṣṭhī samasyate| "tṛjakābhyāṃ karttari"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-15)ityasya pratiprasavo'yam| brāhmaṇayājakaḥ| yājaka, pūjaka, paricāraka, pariveṣaka, snātaka, adhyāpaka, utsādaka, udvartaka, hotṛ, potṛ, bhartṛ, rathagaṇaka, patti, gaṇaka| vṛt|
guṇāttarema taralopaśceti vaktavyam(kāovāo)| idañca vārttikaṃ bhāṣye "sarva guṇakārtsnye"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-93)iti sūtre paṭhitam| tarabantaṃ yad guṇavāci tena samāsa ityarthaḥ| "na nirdhāraṇe"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-10)iti niṣedhasyāyamapavāda iti vṛttikārāḥ| "puraṇaguṇa"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-11)iti guṇaniṣedhasyeti bhāṣyakārāḥ| sarveṣāṃ śvetataraḥ sarvaśvetaḥ| sarveṣāṃ mahattaraḥ sarvamahān|
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-10)
na nirdhāraṇe(aṣṭāosūo2-2-10)nirdhāraṇe yā ṣaṣṭhī sā na samasyate| nṛṇāṃ dvijaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ| atra dvijaśabdena samāsaprasaṅgaḥ| tadapekṣā hi ṣaṣṭhī| kathaṃ `puruṣottamaḥ' iti? atra samādhānaṃ "dvivacanavibhajya"(aṣṭāosūo5-3-57)iti sūtre sthitvā kaiyaṭa āha yasmānnirdhāryate yaścaikadeśo nirdhāryate yaśca nirdhāraṇaheturetattritayasannidhāne nirdhāraṇe bhavatīti tatraivāyaṃ niṣedho na tu tritayasannidhānābhāve'pīti| yadvā, puruṣeṣūttama iti nirdhāraṇasaptamyāṃ "saṃjñāyām'(aṣṭāosūo2-1-44)iti samāsaḥ| yattvevaṃ sati "na nirdhāraṇe"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-10)iti sūtraṃ vyarthaṃ syāditi| tanna, svare bhedāt| saptamīsamāse hi "tatpuruṣe tulyārtha"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-2)iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāse tvantodāttatvaṃ syāt|
pratipadavidhānā ca ṣaṣṭhī na samasyate iti vācyam(kāovāo)| sarpiṣo jñānam| "jñovidarthasya"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-51)iti ṣaṣṭhī| sāca pratipadavidhānā "ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-50)iti vihāyānyasyāḥ sarvasyā api tathātvāt| na caivamanenaiva gatārthatvāt| "na nirdhāraṇe"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-10)iti vyarthamiti śaṅkyam| "yataśca nirdhāraṇam"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-41)iti sūtraṃ hi ṣaṣṭhīṃ na vidhatte kintu saptamīmeva| ṣaṣṭhī tu tayā mā bādhīti pratiprasūyate ityanyadetat| evaṃ "svāmīśvaraḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-3-39)ityādiṣvapi| tena `gṛhasvāmī' `sarveśvaraḥ' ityādi siddham| vastutastu "jño'vidarthasya"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-51)ityādicaturdaśasūkṣīmadhye "divastadarthasya"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-58)ityādiṣaṭ‌sūtrīṃ vihāyāvaśiṣṭasūtryāṃ śeṣa iti varttate| tathāca `namāṣāṇāmaśnīyāt' ityādāviva "ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-50)ityeva siddhe niyamārthaṃ prakaraṇam-ṣaṣṭhī bhavatyeva śrūyata eva, na tu lupyate| tathāca luk‌prayojikā samāsasaṃjñaiva na bhavatīti phalito'rthaḥ| tasmāt "pratipadavidhānā na" iti vacanaṃ na kartavyam| evaṃ sthite "kṛdyogā ca"(kāovāo)ityapi māstu| kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-65)ityatra hi śeṣe iti nivṛttam| tathāca ṣaṣṭhīvidhyarthameva-1--1."kartṛkarmaṇoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-65)iti sūtram|-taditi kutaḥ samāsanivṛttiprasaṅgaḥ| āha ca-
sādhanairvyapadiṣṭe ca śrūyamāṇakriye punaḥ|
proktā pratipadaṃ ṣaṣṭhī samāsasya nivṛttaye|| iti |
kathantarhi harismaraṇaṃ-"viśeṣasmṛtihetavaḥ" "padāt padārthasmaraṇam" ityādīti cet? karmaṇiṣaṣṭhyā samāsasyāniṣedhāditi gṛhāṇa| tathā ceha kārakaṣaṣṭhyā samāsātkṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaro bhavati| śeṣaṣaṣṭhīsamāse tvantodāttatā syāt| evañcāntodāttanivṛttaye prakaraṇaṃ `mātuḥsmṛtam' ityādau samāsābhāvārthaṃ ca| na hi tatra kārakaṣaṣṭhī labhyate "na loka"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-69)iti pratiṣedhāditi niṣkṛṣṭo'rthaḥ| āha ca-
niṣṭhāyāṃ karmaviṣayā ṣaṣṭhī ca pratiṣidhyate|
śeṣalakṣaṇayā ṣaṣṭhyā samāsastatra neṣyate|| iti |
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-11)
pūraṇaguṇasuhitārthasadavyayatavyasamānādhikaraṇena(aṣṭāosūo2-2-11)| pūraṇādyarthaistribhiḥ sadādibhiśca ṣaṣṭhī na samasyate| pūraṇe-satāṃ ṣaṣṭhaḥ| atra pūraṇārthāḥ pratyayā eva gṛhyante na tu pūraṇombhanādiśabdāapi| tena "kumbhapūraṇabhavaḥ paṭuruccaiḥ" ityādi siddham| atra ca jñāpakaṃ "lope cetpādapūraṇam"(aṣṭāosūo6-1-134)iti sūtraprayogaḥ| pūraṇādhikārastu na gṛhyate| bhāge'n‌pratyaye sati tadantenāpi niṣedhasya "dvitīyatṛtīya"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-33)iti sūtre bhāṣye eva spaṣṭatvāt| ataeva `bhikṣādvitīyam' ityādāvanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasāmartyātsamāsa ityuktam| ata eva ca "tānyuñchaṣaṣṭhāṅkitasaikatāni"(raovaṃo5-8)iti kālidāsasya pramāda ityāhuḥ| ṣaṣṭha ityākhyātaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ, ākhyātaṇyantād-"erac‌"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-56)iti vā samādheyam|
guṇaśceha "sattve niviśate'paiti" iti lakṣito gṛhyate kevalaguṇasya guṇopasarjanadravyasya ca pratipādakaḥ, vyāptinyāyāt| kākasya kārṣṇyam| brāhmaṇasya śuklāḥ| yadā'rthātprakaraṇādvā dantādi viśeṣyaṃ nirjñātaṃ tadedamudāharaṇam| kathaṃ tarhi "gosahasram" iti| atrāhuḥ| saṃśyayā nāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ "śatasahasrāntācca niṣkāt"(aṣṭāosūo5-2-119)"krośaśatajanaśatayorupasaṃkhyānam"(kāovāo)"khārīśatama'pi na dadāti"(bhāoio)ityādimunitrayaprayogāt| anityaścāyaṃ guṇena niṣedhaḥ| "saṃjñāpramāṇatvāt" "uttarapadārthaprādhānyam" ityādinirddeśāt| tena `karaṇapāṭavam' `arthagauravam' `buddhimāndyam' ityādi siddham| `candanagandhaḥ' ityādau tu nāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ "tatsthaiśca guṇaiḥ" iti samāsasya pratiprasavāt| gandhatvena pratīyamāno hi gandho na kadāpi guṇisamānādhikaraṇaḥ| kintu svapradhānaḥ| yastu "vahati jalamayaṃ pinaṣṭi gandhān" iti prayujyate sa candanatvādijātinimittako na tu guṇaśabdaḥ, mālatīkusumādiṣvadarśanāditi| evaṃ ghaṭarūpamityādi| surabhiśuklādiśabdāstu na tatsthaguṇapratipādakāḥ, tena rūpeṇa pratīyamānasya guṇisāmānādhikaraṇyadarśanāt| evaṃ "śauklyam" ityādāvapi bodhyam| śauklyasaurabhādiśabdairhi śuklatvasurabhitvādiprakāraka e guṇabodhaḥ| tadrūpāpannasya ca dravyasāmānādhikaraṇyamastyeva `śuklaḥ' `surabhiḥ' ityādāviti dik|
suhitārthāstṛptyarthaḥ| phalānāṃ suhitaḥ| karaṇasyaiva śeṣatvavivakṣayā ṣaṣṭhī| na ca "na loka"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-69)itiniṣedhaḥ śaṅkyaḥ, tasya kṛdyogalakṣaṇaṣaṣṭhīviṣayakatvāt| iha suhitārthayoge karaṇasya śeṣatvavivakṣaiva niyatetyāhuriti haradattaḥ| tatrāhurityaparitoṣodbhāvanam| tadvījantu niyame pramāṇābhāvaḥ,
nāgnistṛpyati kāṣṭhānāṃ nāpagānāṃ mahodadhiḥ|
nāntakaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ na puṃsāṃ vāmalocane||
ityādiprayogāṇāṃ pākṣikyāpi śe-1--1.`viśeṣa' ādarśe|-ṣatvavivakṣayā siddhatvāt| ata eva karaṇatvavivakṣayā tṛtīyāṃ bhaṭṭiḥ prāyuṅkta-
phalairnānāvidhaiścitraiḥ svāduśītaiśca vāribhiḥ|
tṛptāstāṃ bhrājathumantīṃ prapacchuḥ kasya pūriyam|| iti |
nanvevaṃ ṣaṣṭhīsamāse niṣiddhe'pi tṛtīyātatpuruṣeṇa `phalatṛptaḥ' iti syādeveti cet? iṣṭāpatteḥ| na caivaṃ niṣedhavaiyarthyam, svare viśeṣāt| tathāhi, ṣaṣṭhīsamāse'ntodāttatvaṃ syāt, tṛtīyāsamāse tu thāthādisvarāpavādaḥ "tṛtīyā karmaṇi"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-48)iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ| tṛpiśca sakarmako'pyasti, "pitṝnatārpsītsamasaṃsta banadhūn" iti bhaṭṭiprayogāt| tenāsmātkarmaṇi kto nāstīti na śaṅkanīyam| ` phalatarpaṇam' ityādau tu spaṣṭa eva svare bhedaḥ, kārakātparatvena kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvarāt|
sat--dvijasya kurvan kurvāṇo vā| kiṃkāra ityarthaḥ| śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī| corasya dviṣan| iha "dviṣaḥ śaturvā vacanam" iti pākṣikau karmaṇiṣaṣṭhī|
avyaya-brāhmaṇasya kṛtvā| tādarthyarūpasambandhasya sāmānyarūpeṇa vivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhī| brāhmaṇasambandhinī kriyetyartha-| `purā sūryasyodetoḥ' ityapyavyayodāharaṇam| iha karttari ṣaṣṭhī "-2--2."na lokāvyaya"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-69)iti sūtreṇetyādiḥ|-avyayapratiṣedhe tosunkasunorapratiṣedhaḥ"(kāovāo)iti vacanāt| atra sattavyābhyāṃ sāhacaryātkṛdavyayenaiva samāso niṣidhyate| tena `tadupari' ityādi siddhamiti rakṣitaḥ| tathā ca bhaṭṭiprabhṛtayaḥ prayuñjate-yatkṛte'rīnnigṛhṇīmaḥ,
ādeyāḥ kiṃkṛte bhogāḥ kumbhakarṇa tvayā vinā|
bhavatkṛte khañjanamañjulākṣīti, tatpāṇimātmopari pātukantu kimu tadantarubhau bhiṣajau divaḥ, ityādi ca| tathā "anekamanyapadārthe'(aṣṭāosūo2-2-24)iti sūtre `sarvapaścāt' iti bhāṣyaprayogo'pīhānukūlaḥ| kaiyaṭaharadattau tu avyayapratiṣedhe vṛkṣasyoparītyudāharantau-3--3.`kṛdavyayenāpi' ādarśe|-akṛdavyayenāpi niṣedhaṃ manyete| tattu bhaṭṭiśrīharṣādiprayogāṇāṃ pratikūlam| yadvā, asminpakṣe kṛ-1--1.uparinirdiṣṭaprayogatraye kṛte ityatreti yāvat|-cchabdaḥ sampadādikvibantaḥ kāryaparaḥ| tataścaturthī| ātmana upari pātuka iti vigrahaḥ| tasyāṃ yanmadhyaṃ tatretyarthe "saptamī śauṇḍaiḥ"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-4)iti sūtroktarītyā saptamītatpuruṣo'vyayībhāvo veti dik|
tavya-brāhmaṇasya kartavyam| niranubandhakasya sūtre grahamāttavyatā samāso bhavatyeva-svakartavyam| svare bhedaḥ| "gatikārakopapadāt"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-139)iti kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ| tatra tavyatastittvenāntasvaritatā| tavyasya tvādyudāttatvānmadhyodā-2--2.tavyapratyayāntena saha samāse tu kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa madhyodāttaṃ `svakartavyaṃ' syādityarthaḥ|-ttaṃ padamiti|
samānādhikaraṇena-takṣakasya sarpasya| viśeṣaṇasamāsastviha bahulagrahaṇānnetyuktam|
syādetat, iha ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ prāpnotyeva na| bāhyasambandhyapekṣā hīyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī| tathā ca kaṭo'pi karma, bhīṣmādayo'pīti nyāyena dvayorapi ṣaṣṭhyantayorviṣaprabhṛtinā'nvaye sati paścātprātipadikārthamātrayoḥ pārṣṇikaḥ sambandho vācyaḥ| tathāca takṣakasyeti sarpasyeti ca parasparamasamarthaṃ kathaṃ samasyatām? ata eva `nīlotpalasya' `merumahībhṛtaḥ' ityādāvapi prathamāntayorviśeṣaṇasamāse tataḥ ṣaṣṭhīti nyāyyaṃ na tu ṣaṣṭhyantayorviśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ, uktarītyā'sāmarthyāt| kiñca yathā `citraguḥ' ityādau sambandhasyābhihitatvātprathamā tathehāpi ṣaṣṭhyantayoḥ samāse tataḥ prathamaiva syānna tu ṣaṣṭhī| ucyate| kaṭa eva karma bhīṣmādayastu tatsāmānādhikaraṇyamātrādvibhaktiṃ labhante| iti pakṣe idaṃ bodhyam| samānādhikaraṇena niṣedha eva caitatpakṣajñāpakaḥ| ata eva viśeṣaṇavibhaktiḥ sādhutvārthetyud‌ghoṣo'pi saṅgacchate| na caivamapi samāsātṣaṣṭhī na syāditi vācyam, pañca-3--3.svārthadravyaliṅgasaṅkhyākārakāṇi pañca prātipadikasyaivārtho vibhaktyādi tu tadanuvādamātrakamiti pakṣe|-kapakṣe dvitīyāderivopapatteḥ| sakalavibhaktisādhāraṇena karmadhārayeṇānyatarasya sphuṭamanabhidhānāt| eṣaiva ca vaiyadhikaraṇyasthale sarveṣāṃ gatiḥ| tathāhi, `rājñaḥ kumāryā rājakumāryāḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhyantasya samāse pūrvanipātāniyamamāśaṅkyopasarjanasaṃjñāyā anvarthatāmāśritya samāhitamākare| na ca tatra tvaduktasyāsāmarthyasyoktisambhavo'pi, yena prathamāntameva samasyeta| tathāca rājñaḥ-kumārī, kumāryai, ityādaya eva vigrahā iti upasarjanasaṃjñāvidhāyakayoḥ sū-1--1."prathānirdiṣṭaṃ samāsa upasarjanam"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-43)"ekavibhakti cāpūrvanipāte"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-44)iti sūtrayorityarthaḥ-trayoḥ kāśikādauspaṣṭam| "anekamanyapadārthe"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-24)iti sūtre "tatpuruṣe tulyārtha"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-2)iti sūtre ca bhāṣyakaiyaṭayorapi spaṣṭamevedam| tathāca prathamāntena vigraha iti niyamābhāvātsarvatra ta-2--2.`tatpuruṣopari' ādarśe|-tpuruṣo'pi dvitīyādivibhaktayaḥ pañcakapakṣavadevopapādanīyā iti tattvam| rājapuruṣādau saṅkhyāyā ivottarapadārthapraviṣṭasambandhasyāpi vṛttāvapraveśācca| prayogārhe vigrahe paraṃ samāsottaravibhaktisajātīyāyāḥ prayogāt| pacantīti pācakā itivat| vākyasaṃskārapakṣe'laukike'pi bahuvacanavatṣaṣṭhyādikalpanāyā eva nyāyyatvāditi dik|
yattu vṛttāvudāhṛtaṃ śukasya mārāvikasya, rājñaḥ pāṭaliputrakasyeti| tatra mārāvītyāheti mārāvikaḥ| "tadāhetimāśabdādibhya upasaṃkhyānam"(kāovāo)iti ṭhak| śabdanakriyāyāḥ pratiṣedhako mārāvikaḥ mārāvidasyeti pāṭhe mārāviśabdaṃ dadātīti sa evārthaḥ| evaṃ pāṭaliputre bhavaḥ pāṭaliputrakaḥ| itthaṃ sthite yadīha samāso'niṣṭaḥ syāttadedaṃ samānādhikaraṇa ityasyodāharaṇaṃ saṅgaccheta| samāsa iṣṭa iti tu vadatā tenaiva nedamudāhartuṃ yuktam|
yattu tatraiva samarthitam-ṣaṣṭhīsamāse sati pūrvanipātāniyamaḥ syāt| viśeṣamasamāse tu viśeṣaṇasyaiva pūrvanipātaḥ sidhyatīti| tatredaṃ vaktavyam| viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasyāvyavasthitatvenātiprasaṅge prāpte `apradhānamupasarjanam, ārthaṃ cāprādhānyam' ityādikrameṇa dravyaguṇādiśabdeṣu vyavastheṣyate| tacca ṣaṣṭhīsamāse'pi suvacamiti kintanniṣedheneti! vastutastu godhenoḥ bhojyoṣṇasya kumāraśramaṇāyā go garbhiṇyā ityādīnīhodāhāryāṇi| poṭāyuvatītyādīnāṃ vibhaktyantare| viśeṣaṇasamāsaṃ bādhitvā caritārthānāṃ pareṇa ṣaṣṭhīsamāsena bādhāpatteḥ| tathāca viśeṣaṇasyaivopasarjanatayā pūrvanipāte'pyaniṣṭaṃ spaṣṭamevetyavadheyam|
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-12)
ktena ca pūjāyām(aṣṭāosūo2-2-12)| "matibuddhi"(aṣṭāosūo3-2-188)iti sūtreṇa vihito yaḥ ktastadantena ṣaṣṭhī na samasyate| sa hi pūjāyāṃ vartamānādvihita ityetāvanmātreṇa pūjāgrahaṇaṃ tasyopalakṣaṇaṃ gṛhatyeva kākaḥ| tena matibuddhyarthābhyāṃ ktasyāpyayaṃ niṣedhaḥ| rājñāṃ mato buddhaḥ pūjito vā| "ktasya ca varttamāne'(aṣṭāosūoi2-3-67)rājñāṃ mato buddhaḥ| pūjito vā| "ktasya ca varttamāne'(aṣṭāosūo2-3-67)iti ṣaṣṭhī| kathantarhi "kalahaṃsarāmamahitaḥ kṛtāvān" iti bhaṭṭiḥ? "maha pūjāyām"(bhvāopao30)rāmasya mahita ityartha-| tathā `rājapūjitaḥ' ityādi| atrāhuḥ| "ktena ca pūjāyām"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-12)ityādiṣukārakaṣaṣṭhyā eva samāso niṣidhyate| yadā tu kartrādereva śeṣatvavivakṣayā ṣaṣṭhī tadā bhāvatyeva samāsaḥ| svare ca viśeṣaḥ-kārakaṣaṣṭhyā samāse hi kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ, śeṣaṣaṣṭhyā tu samāsāntodāttatvamiti| anunyāsakārastvāha-yadā vartamāne ktastadā ṣaṣṭhī samāsaniṣedhaśca| yadā tu bhūte ktastadā kartari tṛtīyā| yathā "pūjito yaḥ surāsuraiḥ"iti| tasyāḥ "kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-32)iti samāsaḥ| na ca takrakauṇḍinyanyāyādvarttamāne kta iha bhūte ktaṃ bādhate iti vācyam-1--.1"tenaigadik"(aṣṭāosūo4-3-112)iti tṛtīyādhikāre "upajñāte"(aṣṭāosūo4-3-115)iti tṛtīyāntād upajñāte'rthe śauṣikapratyayavidhāyakena nirdeśenetyarthaḥ| anyathā bhūte ktasya bādhe ṣaṣṭhyā eva lābhāditi bhāvaḥ|-tenetyadhikāre upajñātaiti nirdeśenābādhajñāpanāt| na ca jñā-2--2.jñānārthakadhātubhya eva prāptasya bhūte ktasya vartamānaktenābādha iti yāvat|-nārthamātraviṣayakaṃ jñāpakam, udāhṛtaprayogānurodhena sāmānyaviṣayakatvasyaiva nyāyyatvāditi|
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-13)
adhikaraṇavācinā ca(aṣṭāosūo2-2-13)| ktena ṣaṣṭhī na samasyate idameṣāmāsitaṃ gataṃ bhuktaṃ vā| "kto'dhikaraṇeca"(aṣṭāosūo3-4-76)iti ktaḥ| "adhikaraṇavācinaśca"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-68)iti kartari ṣaṣṭhī| "adhikaraṇe ca" ityeva siddhe vācigrahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārtham| kathaṃ tarhi `kivṛttaṃ' `yadvṛttam' iti? atrāhuḥ-nāyamadhikaraṇe ktaḥ, kintu bhāve| kimo vṛtte yasminniti vyadhikaraṇapado bahuvrīhiḥ| yadvā, karttari ktaḥ| kimo vṛttaṃ niṣpannamiti ca vigrahaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-14)
karmaṇi ca(aṣṭāosūo2-2-14)| cakāra itiśabdārthaḥ| karmaṇītiśabdamuccārya vihitā pariśoṣitā vā yā ṣaṣṭhī sā na samasyate| citraṅgavāndoho'gopena| yadyanena`karmaṣaṣṭhīmātraṃ na samasyate'ityabhipretaṃ syāttarhi tṛjakābhyāṃ-3--3."tṛjakābhyāṃ kartari"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-15)iti yāvat|-niṣedhaṃ nārabheta| yatra hi kartari tṛjakau tatra karmaṇiṣaṣṭhyā bhāvyam| `śabdānuśāsanam' ityādau yathā na samāsaniṣedhastathoktaṃ paspaśāyām|
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-15)
tṛjakābhyāṃ karttari(aṣṭāosūo2-2-15)| kartrarthatṛjakābhyāṃ ṣaṣṭyā na samāsaḥ| kartarītyakasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ na tu tṛcopi, avyabhicārāt| apāṃ sraṣṭā| purāmbhettā| vajrasya bharttā| yadyapi bhartṛśabdo yājakādiṣu paṭhitastathāpi rūḍherbalīyastvātpatiparyāyasya tatra grahaṇam| yaugikasya tu niṣedha eva| odanasya pācakaḥ| kartari kim? ikṣūṇāṃ bhakṣaṇamikṣubhakṣikā| "paryāyāharṇotpattiṣu ṇvac"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-111)dhātvarthanirddeśe ṇvulvā-1--1."dhātvarthanirdeśe ṇvulvaktavyaḥ"(kāovāo)ityanenetyarthaḥ|-| kathaṃ tarhi ghaṭānāṃ nirmātustribhuvanavidhātuśca kalahaḥ? atra nyāsakāraḥ-tṛnnantametat| " na loka"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-69)iti ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhastvanityaḥ, tryakābhyāmiti vaktavye tṛcaḥ sānubandhakasyopādānājjñāpakāt| kaiyaṭastu śeṣaṣṭhyā samāsa ityāha| "janikartuḥ prakṛtiḥ"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-30)"tatprayojako hetuśca"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-54)iti jñāpakādanityo'yaṃ pratiṣedha iti tu bahavaḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-16)
kartari ca(aṣṭāosūo2-2-16)| kartṛṣaṣṭyā akena na samāsaḥ| bhavataḥ śāyikā| "paryāyārharṇa"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-111)iti ṇvuc| pūrvatra dvandvena nirddiṣṭo'pi tṛv nehānuvarttate, tadyoge karturabhihitatayā kartṛṣaṣṭhyā asambhavāt|
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-17)
nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-2-17)| etayorarthayorakena nityaṃ ṣaṣṭhī samasyate| uddālakapuṣpabhañjikā| krīḍāviśeṣasyeyaṃ saṃjñā| "saṃjñāyām'(aṣṭāosūo3-3-109)iti bhāve ṇvul| puṣpāṇāmiti karmaṇiṣaṣṭhī| jīvikāyām-dantalekhakaḥ| tatra krīḍāyāṃ vikalpe prāpte jīvikāyāṃ "karttari ca"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-16)iti niṣedhe prāpte vacanam| jayādityastu "tṛjakābhyāmṭha(aṣṭāosūo2-2-15)iti sūtre kartarītyetadanuvṛttāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyā viśeṣaṇam| tṛ-2--2.`tṛc‌pratyayena karturabhidhāne tadyoge kartṛṣaṣṭhyā asambhavāt' ityādiḥ|-juttarārtha ityuktvā "kartari ca"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-16)iti sūtre kartṛgrahaṇaṃ tṛjakayorviśeṣaṇatayā vyākhyāya "nityaṃ krīḍā"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-17)iti sūtre akapratyayamevodājahāra| tatredaṃ vaktavyam, prathamasūtre kartṛgrahaṇaṃ tṛjakayoreva viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktaṃ, tayoḥ śrutatvāt; na tu ṣaṣṭhyāḥ| evañca tṛjuttarārtha ityapi na kalpyam| akasyaiva cottaratrānuvṛttirna tu tṛcaḥ, asambhavāt| tathāca sūtradvayasya vyatyāsenārtha ucita iti| vāmanastu "ake jīvikārthe"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-73)iti sūtre ake iti kim? ramaṇīyakarteti jīvikāyāṃ tṛcaṃ pratyudājahāra| tasyāyamāśayaḥ-mā bhūtkrīḍāyāṃ tṛc, lakṣaṇābhāvāt| jīvikāyāntu "ṇvul‌tṛcau(aṣṭāosūo3-1-133)iti ṇvuli tṛjapi sulabha eveti| etanmate "nityaṃ krīḍā"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-17)ityatra tṛjagrahaṇāsambandhaśaṅkāvāraṇārthaṃ tṛjuttārtha ityādi kusṛṣṭyādaraṇamityāhuḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-18)
kugatiprādayaḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-2-18)| kuśabdo gatisaṃjñāḥ prādayaśca samarthena nityaṃ samasyante| kuḥ pāpārthe| kupuruṣaḥ| nityasamāsaviṣayasyāpyasya pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarārthamavyayatvamiṣyate| tathā ca vārttikam-"avyaye nañ‌kunipātānām'(kāovāo)iti| tasmādayaṃ svarādiṣu boddhavyaḥ| sa eva ceha gṛhyate, na tu pṛthivīvṛttiḥ ga-1--1.adravyārthaketyādiḥ-tyādisāhacaryāt| gatiḥ-ūrīkṛtya| prādigrahaṇamagatyartham| tadviṣayavibhāgārthāni tu bahūni vārttikāni| tathāhi, durnindāyām-duḥ puruṣaḥ| svatī pūjāyām-supuruṣaḥ, atipuruṣaḥ| āṅīṣadarthe-āpiṅgalaḥ| prāyikaṃ caitadupādhivacanam| anyathā "īṣadarthe ca"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-105)iti koḥ kādeśavidhānabhanupapannaṃ syāt| koṣṇam| duṣkṛtam| duratra kṛc‌chrārthe| anabhidhānāttu bhūte khal na bhavati| suṣṭutam| suśabdo'tiśaye, na tu pūjāyām| ata evopasarganibandhanaṃ ṣatvam| atistutam| "atiratikramaṇe ca"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-95)iti ka-2--2.`karmapravacanīyatvābhāvaḥ' iti pāṭhaḥ| tattvabodhinyām "atiratikramaṇe ca"(aṣṭāosūo1-4-95)iti sūtre anye tūdāharanti-"atisiktam atistutamiti"| ityukteḥ ṣatvābhāvācca karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā nirbādhā'treti cintyam|rmapravacanīyatvam|
prādayo gatādyarthe prathamayā| vṛttiviṣaye gatādyarthavṛttayaḥ prādayo gatitvābhāve'pi prādigrahaṇena samasyante ityarthaḥ| pragata ācāryaḥ prācāryaḥ| prāntevāsī|
atyādayaḥ krāntādyarthe dvitīyayā| atikrāntā mālāmatimālaḥ|
avādayaḥ kruṣṭādyarthe tṛtīyayā| avakruṣṭaḥ kokilayā avakokilaḥ|
paryādayo glānādyarthe caturthyā| pariglāno'dhyayanāya paryadhyayanaḥ| alaṃ kumāryai alaṃkumāri| nityasamāsatve'pi caturthīvidhānasāmarthyātpakṣe vākyamiti rakṣitaḥ| etena "ekavibhakti cāpūrvanipāte"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-144)iti sūtre `alaṃkumāriḥ' iti bhāṣyaṃ "paryādayoglānādyartha iti samāsaḥ" iti kaiyaṭavacanaṃ ca vyākhyātam| tadeva bhāṣyamanityatāyāṃ jñāpakamiti vāstu| vastutastu nehānena samāsaḥ, alamo'prāditvāt| prādisamāsasya tvayaṃ prapañca ityākaraḥ| kintu "dviguprāptāpannālampūrva"(kāovāo)ityanena jñāpyamāno'laṃpūrvastatpuruṣaḥ pṛthaggadigrahaṇātparyāptyarthenāpi bhavannabhidhānānurodhāccaturthyantenaiva bhavati| tasya cānityasamāsatvaṃ nirbādhamevetyavadheyam|
nirādayaḥ krāntādyarthe pañcamyā| niṣkrāntaḥ kauśāmbyā niṣkauśāmibiḥ| prādigrahaṇasya agatyarthatvādatiprasaṅge prāpte karmapravacanīyānāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| vṛkṣamprati vidyotate vidyut| kathantarhi adhītyeti? iha hi "adhiparī anarthako(aṣṭāosūo1-4-93)iti karmapravacanīyatvam| ucyate, "adhyāpakadhūrtaiḥ(aṣṭāosūo2-1-65)itinirddeśādanityaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ| ata eva `sustutam' `atistutam' iti ṣatvābhāve'pi samāsa udāhṛtaḥ| "svatī pūjāyām"(kāovāo)iti vacanādvātatsiddhiḥ|
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-19)
upapadamatiṅ(aṣṭāosūo2-2-19)| upapadaṃ subantaṃ samarthena nityaṃ samasyate| atiṅantaśca samāsaḥ| kumbhaṃ karotīti kumbhakāraḥ| iha kumbha as kāra ityalaukikaṃ prakriyāvākym| laḍarthādyādhikye'pyadūraviprakarṣeṇa tūktaṃ laukikaṃ vākyaṃ bodhyam| atiṅ kim? mā bhavān bhūt| "māṅi luṅ"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-175)iti saptamīnirddeśānmāṅupapadam| nanu supetyadhikārāttiṅantena na bhaviṣyati? satyam, tannivṛttiranena jñāpyate| tatphalaṃ tvanupadameva sphuṭīkariṣyāmaḥ| prathamāntaṃ tu sup‌grahaṇamihānuvartate eva| ata eva `rājadarśī' ityādau pūrvapade nalopādipadakāryaṃ sidhyati| supsupetīha nānuvarttate iti bhāṣyavṛttyādigranthāstu militaṃ nānuvartate ityeveparāḥ| atiṅiti nopapadasya viśeṣaṇaṃ kintu samāsasyeti yadyapīha bhāṣye na spaṣṭaṃ, tathāpi "anaṃvaklṛptyamarṣayoḥ"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-145)iti sūtre bhāṣye eva spaṣṭam| tatra hi kiṃvṛttasyānadhikārādakiṃvṛttagrahaṇānarthakyamityuktvā upapadasa़ñjñārthaṃ tarhītyāśaṅkyātiṅiti samāsapratiṣedhātsañjñānarthakyamiti siddhāntitam| evaṃ pūrvasūtrepi gatigrahaṇaṃ pṛthakkṛtya tenāpyatiṅgrahaṇaṃ sambandhanīyam| gatiḥ samasyate atiṅantaśca samāsaḥ syāditi| tena `prayavati' ityādau gateṅantena samāso na| atiṅgrahaṇācca supeti tṛtīyānivarttate| tathāca "gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpatteḥ"(paobhāo)iti prācāṃ paribhāṣā ekadeśānumatidvārā sāmānyāpekṣajñāpakabhūtena atiṅgrahaṇena labhyate| gatīnāṃ kārakāṇāmupapadānāṃ ca kṛdbhiḥ saha yaḥ samāsaḥ sa uttarapadātsubutpatteḥ prāgeva kārya ityarthaḥ| pūrvapadantu subantamevetyuktam|
gatīnāṃ tāvat-vyājighratīti vyāghrī| "ātaścopasarge"(aṣṭāosūo3-1-136)iti kaḥ| "pāghrādhmā"(aṣṭāosūo3-1-137)iti śapratyayastu na bhavati "jighrateḥ saṃjñāyāṃ pratiṣedhā vaktavyaḥ" ityukteḥ| vyāṅorghraśabdena gatiśamāsaḥ| sa ca yadi ghraśabdasya subantatāmapekṣeta tarhi subutpattaye saṃkhyākarmādiyogo vivakṣaṇīyaḥ| tadyogācca prāgeva liṅgayāgaḥ "svārthamabhidhāya" ityādinyāyāt| tataśca liṅganimittaḥ pratyayo bhavan ṭābeva syāt na tu ṅīṣ, ghraśabdamātrasya ajātivācitvāt| tataśca vyāṅoghrīśabdena samāsaḥ| tato vyāghrāśabdasya jātivācitve'pyanakārāntatvājjātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ na syāt| subutpatteḥ prāgevajāyamānastu samāso liṅgayogānapekṣatvena antaraṅgatvādbhavati| tato ṅīp pūrvapadasya tu subantatvātpadakāryāṇi syureva| `nigataḥ' iti rutvaṃ `sayyam̐ntā' iti parasaravarṇavikalpa ityādi|
kārakāṇām-aśvaiḥ krītā| alpairabhrairliptā| "kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-32)iti samāsaḥ| sa yadyuttarapadasya subantasya syāttarhi pūrvavaṭṭāp syāt| tataśca "krītātkaraṇapūrvāt"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-50)"ktādalpākhyāyām"(aṣṭāosūo4-1-51)iti ṅīṣ na syāt, ata ityadhikārāt| vacanasāmarthyātsyāditi cettarhi vākyāvasthāyāṃ syāt pūrvaśabdasya vyavasthāvacanatvasambhavāt| ata ityadhikāro vā vyavacchidyeta| tathāca-
sā hi tasya dhanakrītā prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī|
iti bhaṭṭiprayoge na sidhyet| siddhānte tu "kartṛkaraṇe "kṛtā"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-32)ityatra bahulagrahaṇātkvacitsubantena samāsaḥ ato na ṅīṣ|
upapadānām-kacchena pibatīti kacchapī| vyāghrīvat| su-1--1."supi sthaḥ"(aṣṭāosūo3-2-4)iti sūtre|-pīti yogavibhāgātka ityādi| yattvatiṅgrahaṇamupapadaviśeṣaṇamiti| tanna, tathā sati prathāmāntasub‌grahaṇasya nivṛttyāpattyā bahuviplavāpatteḥ| etenātiṅ kim? edhānāhārako vrajatīti pratyudāharaṇamapi pratyuktam| yadapi kaumu-1--1.prakiyākaumudyām|-dyāṃ "kugati"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-18)iti sūtre uktam-"atra supsupetyananuvṛttestiṅā'pi samāsaḥ, ūrīkaroti" ityādi| tadapyasat, tatra śeṣīkṛtenātiṅgrahaṇanaiva virodhāt| tiṅsamāsastu saheti yogavibhāgabalalabhyo vārttikoktaviśeṣaviṣayacchāndasaśceti prāgeva prapañcitam|
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-20)
amaivāvyavena(aṣṭāosūo2-2-20)| amaiva tulyavidhānaṃ yadupapadaṃ tadevāvyayena saha samasyate| svāduṅkāraṃ bhuṅkte| sampannaṅkāram| lavaṇaṅkāram| "svādumi ṇamul"(aṣṭāosūo3-4-26)| svādumītyata eva nipātanātpūrvapadasya māntatvam| svādumītyarthagrahaṇam| sampannalavalaśabdāvapi svāduparyāyau| yena vākyenāmeva kevalo vidhīyate na tu pratyayāntarasahitaḥ, tasmin, vākye saptamīnirddeśabalena yasyopapadasaṃjñā tada maiva tulyavidhānamityucyate| sūtre ca tulyavidhāyanamityadhyāhriyate| niyamāṅgabhūtastvevakāro niyamasvabhāvādeva labhyate na tu sūtrārūḍhaḥ| amaiva ca yattulyavidhānaṃ yasya pratyayāntaraṃ prati upapadatvameva nāstīti avyayāntareṇa sa samāso nāśaṅkanīyaḥ| sūtrasya prayojanantu "kālasamayavelāsu tumun"(aṣṭāosūo3-3-167)`kālaḥ samayo velā vā bho ktum' ityatra samāsanivṛttiḥ| amaiveti kim? agrebhojam, agrebhuktvā, "vibhāṣā'greprathamapūrveṣu"(aṣṭāosūo3-4-24)iti ktvāṇamulau| amācānyena ca tulyavidhānametam| avyayeneti kim? ku-2--2.atra samāso na syāditi bhāvaḥ|-mbhakāraḥ| asati hyavyayagrahaṇe amaiva yattulyavidhānaṃ tadeva samasyete| na ca pūrvasūtrasyānavakāśatvādavyayaviṣaya eva niyama iti vācyam, tathāsatyamaiva niyamāpatteḥ| amantenopapadasya yassamāsaḥ so'maivatulyavidhānasyati| tathā ca `agrebhojam' ityatra mā bhūt| `agrebhuktvā kālo bhoktum' ityatra tu syādeva|
(aṣṭāosūo2-2-21)

susūśrmajaṭakeśena sunatājinavāsasā|

ayaṃ ślokaḥ samarthasūtre bhāṣye paṭhitaḥ| suṣṭhu sūkṣmā jaṭāḥ keśā yasyeti caturṇāṃ bahuvrīhau "ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñāchandasorbahulam"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-63)iti bahulavacanamāddhrasvatvam| yadvā jaṭāvanto jaṭāḥ, arśaādyac; jaṭāḥ iti vā "tatkaroti"(gaosūo)iti ṇyantāderac| evaṃ suṣṭhu natam ajinaṃ vāsa ācchādanaṃ yasya tena, samantāni śitīni randhrabhyaḥ pūrva-4--4.pūrvaṃ trayāṇāṃ karnadhārayeṇapaścādbahuvrīhau samāse "bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadam" iti pūrvapadasya prakṛtisvara "samāsasya" iti sūtreṇa viśiṣṭasyaivāntodāttatayā keśavāsorandhrebhyaḥ pūrva evodāttaḥ syāt|-udāttaḥ syāt| ityate tususamantayoḥ prakṛtisvara iti bhā-5--5.sarveṣāṃ yugapadekasminneva bahuvrīhau samāse tu ādyayorudāharaṇayoḥ sorantye samantasya pūrvadatvena tayoreva svara iti bhāvaḥ| prakṛtisvaraḥ| na ca `citraguḥ' ityatra uttarapadasyāpyupasarjanasaṃjñārthamanekagrahaṇamiti vācyam, prathamānirddiṣṭatvaṃ vinā'pi "ekavibhakti"(aṣṭāosūo1-2-44)inyanena tatsiddheḥ, pradhānasyānyapadārthasya nānāvibhaktiyoge'pi vartipadayornityaṃ prathamāntatvāt| na caivaṃ `rājakumārīṃ paśya' ityādāvapyatiprasaṅgaḥ, tatra dvitīyādyantenāpi kumārīśabdena vigrahābhyupagamāt|
anyagrahaṇaṃ kim? bahuvrīhitatpuruṣayorviṣayavibhāgo yathā vijñāyeta| svapadārthe hi sāvakāśaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ paratvādanyapadārthe bahuvrīhirbādhate| asati tvanyagrahaṇe `kaṇṭhekālaḥ' ityādau vyadhikaraṇapade bahūnāṃ samudāye ca sāvakāśaṃ bahuvrīhiṃ svapadārtha ivānyapadārthe'pi `nīlotpalaṃ saraḥ' ityādau samānādhikaraṇe tatpuruṣo bādheta| padagrahaṇaṃ kim? grāhavatī nadī| iha hi `tatra mā snāsīt' iti vākyārtho gamyate| arthagrahaṇaṃ kim? yāvatā pade padāntarasya vṛttyasambhavādeva padārthe bhaviṣyati| satyam| kṛtsne padārthe yathā syāt| anyathā `citraguḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhyarthasambandhamātraparaṃ syāt| tathāca devadattādibhiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt|

diṅnāmānyatarāle(aṣṭāosūo2-2-26)| diśo nāmānyantarāle vācye samasyante sa bahuvrīhiḥ| dakṣiṇasyāḥ pūrvasyāśca diśorantarālaṃ dakṣiṇapūrvā| "sarvanāmno vṛttimātre puṃvadbhāvo vaktavyaḥ" iti bhāṣyam| ata eva "ṭhakchasośca"(kāovāo)iti vārtikasyoktisambhavaḥ| yadyapi tatra chasā sāhacaryādbhavataṣṭhageva gṛhyate iti "na kopadhāyāḥ"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-37)iti sūtre kaiyaṭaharadattābhyāmuktam| yuktaṃ caitat| gantryā carati dhāvantyā caratīti prāgvahatīye ṭhaki `gāntrikaḥ' `dhāvantikaḥ' iti yathā syād' gāntṛkaḥ' `dhāvatkaḥ' mābhūditi, tathāpi bhāṣyaṃ dṛṣṭvā vārtikakṛto'pravṛtteḥ| ata eva hiṃ "ekataddhite ca"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-62)iti sūtrasyāpyuktisambhavo labhyate iti dik| bhavanmayaḥ| sarvakāmyati| sarvakabhāryaḥ| sarvapriyaḥ "bhastrai-4--4."bhastraiṣājājñādvā" iti sūtre `eṣā' `dvā' ityanayoḥ samāsaghaṭakatve'pi pūrvabhāgatvena tadapraviṣṭatayā tadakaraṇena nirddeśāt|-ṣādvā" iti liṅgāt| tenākaci ekaśeṣavṛttau ca na sarvikā, sarvāḥ|

tatra tenedamiti sarūpe(aṣṭāosūo2-2-27)saptamyante grahaṇaviṣaye sarūpe pade tṛtīyānte ca praharaṇaviṣaye idaṃ yuddhamityarthe samasyate karmavyatihāre sa bahuvrīhiḥ| itikaraṇāllaukikavivakṣātātparyakāt grahaṇapraharaṇakarmavyatihārayuddhāni labhyante| gṛhyate'sminniti grahaṇaṃ keśādi, praharaṇaṃ daṇḍādi, karmavyatihāraḥ parasparagrahaṇaṃ parasparapraharaṇaṃ ca| keśeṣu keśeṣu gṛhītvā yuddhaṃ pravṛttaṃ keśākeśi| muṣṭīmuṣṭi| daṇḍaiśca daṇḍaiśca prahṛtya yuddhaṃ pravṛttaṃ daṇḍādaṇḍi| "ic karmavyatihāre"(aṣṭāosūo5-4-127)itīc‌samāsāntaḥ| tadantamavyayaṃ, tiṣṭhad‌guprabhṛtiṣvic‌pratyayasya pāṭhena avyayībhāvatvāt| "anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-137)iti pūrvapadasya dīrghaḥ| ata eva `muṣṭāmuṣṭi" iti prāmādikam| na ca sūtre idaṃ śabdāt prāk ākāraḥ praśliṣyatāmiti vācyam, bhāṣyakaiyaṭādyasammatatvāt `asyasi' ityādāvatiprasaṅgācca| pariśiṣṭe tu "ācca guṇinaḥ" iti sūtritam| guṇo'styasyeti guṇī amīti vyākhyāya `muṣṭāmuṣṭi' ityudāhṛtaṃ, tadapāṇinīyam|

tena saheti tulyayoge(aṣṭāosūo2-2-28)| sahetyetattulyayoge vartamānaṃ tṛtīyāntena saha vā samamyate sa bahuvrīhiḥ| saputra āgataḥ| saha putraḥ| "vopasarjanasya"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-82)iti sabhāvaḥ| nanvatra pitā pradhānamanyapadārthaḥ| satyam| vyadhikaraṇayoḥ prathamārthe ca yathā syāta, kap ca mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ vacanam| tulyayogeti kim?

cārthe dvandvaḥ| (aṣṭāosūo2-2-29)pāganuktasamāsamanekaṃ subantaṃ cārthe vartamānaṃ vā samasyate, sa dvandvaḥ| samuccayānvācayetaretarayogasamāhārāścārthāḥ|
parasparanirapekṣasyānekasyaikasminprati sambandhinyanvayaḥ samuccayaḥ| yathā "aharaharnayamāno gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ paśuṃ vaivasvato na tṛpyati surāyā iva durmadaḥ" iti, atra nayatikriyāyāmekasyāṃ gavādīnāṃ samuccayaḥ| gamyamānatvāttu caśabdasyāprayogaḥ|
yadā tu ekasya prādhānyamitarasyānuṣaṅgikatā tadā'nvācayaḥ| yathā bhikṣāmaṭa, gāṃ cānayeti| atra hi adarśanādgāmanānayannipi bhikṣāmaṭatyeva| anaṭastu bhikṣāṃ na gāmānayati| tathā aṭannipi nānviṣya gāmānayati|
militānāmanvaya itaretarayogaḥ|
samūhaḥ samāhāraḥ| tatra samuccayānvācayayorna samāsaḥ, asāmarthyāt| ekārthībhāve hi sati `puṣpavantau paśya' ityādāviva ekapadopāttau militāveva anviyātāṃ, na tu pratyekam| dha-2--2.itaretarayoge samāsaḥ|-vakhadirau vā-3--3.samūhaṛ samāsārthaḥ|-g‌dṛṣadam|
śeṣaḥ kim? nīlotpalam| iha hi ekasmindharmiṇi anekadharmasamuccayād dvandvaḥ syāt| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ, paṭuścāsau khañjaścetyādāvapi dvandve sati "dvandve ghi"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-32)ityādiniyamāpatteḥ| "viśeṣaṇam"(aṣṭāosūo2-1-57)ityādinā tatpuruṣe tu kāṇakhañjavadaniyamaḥ siddhyati| paraṃ kāryamiti pāṭhe cedam| ekasaṃjñādhikāre tu viśeṣavihitatvāttatpuruṣasaṃjñaiva bhavati| sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāve tu dvandva eva| yathā pramāṇaprameyetyādau, sādharmyavaidharmyābhyāmityatra ca| na hyatrābhedānvayo vivakṣitaḥ| yadyapi sāmānyaviśeṣayorvācaniko dvandvaniṣedhastathāpyanityaḥ sa iti tyadādyekaśeṣasūītre evopapāditam|
anekaṃ kim? hotṛpotṛneṣṭodgātāraḥ| na hyatra dvayordvayordvandvaṃ kṛtvā punardvandvaḥ kartuṃ śakyaḥ hotṛpotrorapyānaṅāpatteḥ| `vāktvak‌sragdṛṣadam' ityādau tvagāderapi ṭajāpatteśca| na cottarapade nityasamāsopasaṃkhyānāttathāpi tadāpattiḥ, sakṛtsamudāye pravṛttasya dvandvasya ekāj‌dvirvacananyāyenāvayeva punarapravṛtteḥ| upasaṃkhyānasyānyatropakṣayāt| na caivaṃ `vāktvacasragdṛṣadaḥ' `hotāpotāneṣṭodgātāraḥ' ityādi na syādeveti vācyam, dvayordvayoreva saddavivakṣayā dvandve samudāyayoḥ punaḥ sahavivakṣāyāṃ tadupapatteḥ| pūrvatrāpyanekagrahaṇaphalaṃ dattameva| tasyamādyathāyathaṃ samāsāntapuṃvadbhāvasvarā''naṅāṃ pravṛttirapravṛttiścānekagrahaṇaphalaṃ sthitam|
anekasya cārthe vṛttistu jahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttau militasyaiva| pakṣāntare tu pratyekam| tadetaducyate "yugapadadhikaramavacane dvandvaḥ" iti| adhikaraṇaṃ vartipadārthaḥ, tasya yugapadvacana ityarthaḥ| ata eva āṅgaśca vāṅgaśca kāliṅgaścetyatra sahavivakṣāyāṃ tenai-1--1."tadrājasya bahuṣu tenaivāstriyām" ityanenetyarthaḥ|-va vahuṣviti luki `aṅgavaṅgakaliṅgāḥ' iti sidhyatīti luk‌prakaraṇe bhāṣye eva spaṣṭam| yattvihasūtre "seyaṃ yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatā duḥkhā ca durupapādā ca" iti bhāṣye uktam| tasyāyamāśayaḥ-astu jahatsvārthatā, tathāpi dhavau ca khadirau cetyādivigraho'saṅgataḥ, prakriyādaśāyāmapi prathamrapṛttasyaikavacanasya tyāgāyogāt| anyathā ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣāderapi prathamayaiva rājā cāsau puruṣaścetyādivigrahāpattiḥ| "tatpuruṣe tulyārtha"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-2)ityādīnāṃ nirviṣayatāpattiśca|
syādetat| bhūtapūrvagatyā ta-2--2."tatpuruṣe" ityādīnāṃ nirvāhaḥ|-nnirvāhaḥ, uttarapadārthaprādhānyādivat| aluk‌samāse tu "ṣaṣṭhyā ākrośe"(aṣṭāosūo6-3-21)ityādya nuvādasāmarthyādeva nimittā pāyanyāyo nāśrayiṣyate| maivam, jñāpakasya sāmānyaviṣayatāyāṃ lāghavena dvandvāvayaveṣvapi dvivacanādyalābhāt nimittāpāyanyāyasyānityatvācca| na caivaṃ tadrā-1--1.`aṅgavaṅgakaliṅgāḥ' ityatra|-jalugasiddhiḥ| `tenaiva' iti sautramaṃmaśaṃ `bahuvacane pare' iti vyākhyāṃ ca pratyākhyāya bahuṣu vartamānasyetyarthasya sthāpayiṣyamāṇatvāt| ata eva jahatsvārthāyāmapi luk sidhyati| samprati pratīyamānaṃ yadbahutvaṃ tadāśrayasya tadrājena pragabhidhānāt bhūtapūrvagateśca tvayāpi vācyatvāt| na hi taddhitavṛttau ekaśeṣavṛttau ca tadrājo'rthavān| tadrājāttadrājadvandve tu vaikalpiko lugiti vakṣyate| evaṃ sthite dvandvaikaśeṣayoralaukikavākye'pi dvivacanādi durlabham| laukike vigrahe tu dūrāpāstaṃ taditi duḥkhetyanenoktam| etena rājā cāsau pūruṣaścetyeva vigṛhṇanto mīmāṃsakāḥ parāstā iti dik|
iha `ekaviṃśatiḥ' `dvāviṃśatiḥ' ityādau "rājanyabahuvacanadvandvendhakavṛṣṇiṣu"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-34)"saṃkhyā"(aṣṭāosūo6-2-35)iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara iṣṭastasmāt dvandva evāyam| sa ca samāhāre| netaretarayoge, anabhidhānāt| puṃstvantu lokāt| yadā tvekādhikā viṃśatiriti śākapārthivādisamāsaḥ kriyate, tadā samāsāntodāttatvamapīṣyate iti pāñcamikabhāṣye "bahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye ḍac"(aṣṭāosūo5-4-73)ityatra sthitam||
