<2.3>
|| tṛtīyapāde prathamamānhikam ||
(aṣṭāosūo2-3-1)
anabhihite(aṣṭāosūo2-3-1)| adhikāro'yam| tiṅkṛttaddhitasamāsairiti vaktavyam(kāovāo)| tena tiṅādyukte karmaṇi dvitīyā na| tiṅsevyate hariḥ| kṛta-kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ| taddhitaṃ-śatena krītaḥ-śatyaḥ, śatikaḥ| "śatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate"(aṣṭāosūo5-1-21)samāsaḥ-prāptamudakaṃ vaṃ prāptodako grāmaḥ| parigaṇanaṃ kim? kaṭaṃ karoti bhīṣmamudāram| iha viśeṣyātkaṭādutpannayā dvitīyayā gatārthatvādviśeṣaṇāt dvitīyā na syāt| parigaṇanasāmarthyāttu bhavati|
syādetat| kaṭopi karma bhīṣmādayo'pīti pakṣe sarvebhyo dvitīyā ucitaiva| aruṇaikahāyanīnyāyena hi pārṣṇikaḥ parasparāvacchedaḥ| ata eva hi `sakṛllavau' ityādau kārakapūrvatvaprayukto yaṇ sidhyati| "pūraṇaguṇa"(aṣṭāosūo2-2-11)ityatra samānādhikaraṇagrahaṇājjñāpakāt| abhedānvayasthale viśeṣyavibhaktirviśeṣaṇādapi bhavatīti pakṣe'pyevam| sakṛllvāviti tu kārakeṇābhedenānvayavato viśeṣaṇasyāpi kārakatvānapāyātsamādheyam| tasmānnārthaḥ parigaṇanena| kiñcānabhihitādhikāreṇāpi nārthaḥ| nahi `kaṭaḥ kṛtaḥ' ityādāvativyāptiḥ, ktapratyayenaiva karmatvasyoktatvāt uktārthānāmaprayogāt| tadyathā `bahupaṭuḥ' ityādau bahucoktārthatvānna kalpabādayaḥ| kiṃ ca `kaṭaṃ karoti' ityādau sāvakāśā dvitīyā `kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ' ityādiṣu prathamayā bādhiṣyaṭate, niravakāśatvāt| na ca `vṛkṣaḥ' `plakṣaḥ' ityādiravakāśaḥ, tatrāpi pratīyamānāstikriyāṃ prati kartṛtvena tṛtīyāprasaṅgāt| atha nīlamidaṃ na tu raktamityādau viśeṣaṇāntaranivṛttitātparyake'pyastikriyāyā anāvaśyakatvāt prathamāyā avakāśaṃ brūṣe; vipratiṣedhāt prathamā'stu| na ca tato'pi paratvāt ṣaṣṭhīprasaṅgaḥ, aśeṣatvāt|
ucyate, parigaṇanaṃ tāvatpratyākhyātameva bhāṣye| sūtraṃ tu `kartavyaḥ kaṭaḥ' ityādisiddhaye| iha hi prathamāṃ bādhitvā "kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti(aṣṭāosūo2-3-65)iti ṣaṣṭhī syāt| na ca kṛtyenoktārthatvānneha ṣaṣṭhīti vācyam, saṃkhyā vibhaktyartha iti pakṣe sūtrārambhāt| karmaṇi yadekatvaṃ tatra kṛdyoge ṣaṣṭhyekavacanamiti hi vākyārthaḥ| tathāca ṣaṣṭhīvācyasya karmaikatvādeḥ kṛtyenānuktatvād durvārā ṣaṣṭhī| kārakaṃ vibhaktyartha iti pakṣe tu māstu sūtramiti sthitam|
ārabdhe tu sūtre paryudāso'yaṃ, na tu prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ, asamarthasamāsāpatteḥ vākyabhedāpatteśca| `prāsāde āste' ityatra sadikriyāyā āsikriyāyāścaikamadhikaraṇaṃ prāsādākhyaṃ, tacca sadeḥ pareṇa ghañā abhihitamiti saptamīniṣedhāpatteśca| paryudāse tu āsikriyānirūpitamadhikaraṇaśaktimanabhihitābhāśritya saptamīvidhiḥ pravarttate| āsane āste śayaneśete ityādau tu laṭaḥ prakṛtibhyāṃ kriyopasthitau tadyogyam anud‌bhūtaśaktikaṃ pyakriyānirūpitaśaktyudbhavapratipādanāya saptamīti dik|
syādetat| yadyayaṃ paryudāsastarhi `paktvaudano bhujyate' iti na siddhyet| bhujipratyayenābhihitepyodane ktvāpratyayenānabhidhānamāśritya dvitīyāpatteḥ| bhāve hi ktveti vakṣyate| prasajyapratiṣedhe tu bhujipratyayenābhidhānamāśritya pa3sajyapratiṣedhaḥ suvacaḥ| kintu prāguūdoṣānistāraḥ|
atrocyate| pradhānanirūpitaśaktyabhidhāne prathamaiva, abhihite neti prasajyapratiṣedhāt| `āsane āste' `śayane śete' ityatra tu na pradhānaśakterabhidhānaṃ; yena prathamā syāt| etacca "svādumi ṇamul"(aṣṭāosūo3-4-26)iti sūtre kaiyaṭādau spaṣṭam| harirapyāha-
pradhānetarayoryatra dravyasya kriyayoḥ pṛthak|
śaktirguṇāśrayā tatra pradhānamanurudhaayate||
pradhānaviṣayā śaktiḥ pratyayenābhidhīyate|
yadā, guṇa tadā tadvadanuktāpi pratīyate|| iti|
paryudāsepyanabhihitāṃ pradhānaśaktimāśrityaiva vidhiḥ pravarttate| etena`pakvaṃ bhuṅkte' `dattaṃ gṛhṇāti' ityādi pakṣadvaye'pi samarthitaṃ bhavati| vastutastu `paktvā bhujyate' ityādau odanasya pacibhujibhyāṃ na yugapacchābdo'nvayabodhaḥ| kintvanyatareṇa śābdaḥ, apareṇārthaḥ| tatra ca prathamādvitīyayorvyavasthaiva| paktvā bhujyate odanaḥ| arthādodanameva praktveti| nahīṣṭakāḥ paktvetyādi sambhavati| na copasthitaparityāgo'nupasthitakalpanā ca nyāyyā| odanaṃ paktveti prayoge tu bhujyate ityatrārthī odanasya karmatā| ata eva `ghaṭaṃ kartuṃ śakyate' ityapi bhavatyeveti paspaśāyāṃ kaiyaṭaḥ| tasmātparyudāse ekavākyatvaṃ samāsasauṣṭhavaṃ cetyeva| guṇarūpantu pakṣadvaye'pi tulyāmiti sthitam| etena-
viṣavṛkṣo'pi saṃvardhya svayaṃ chettumasāmpratam|
iti vyākhyātam| sāmpratamiti nipātenābhihitatvāt| yuktamiti hi tadarthaḥ| parigaṇanaṃ tu pratyākhyātameva|
iha haradattena bhāṭṭamate kārakavaśiṣṭā saṃkhyā vibhaktyartha ityuktaṃ tattu kartradhikaraṇasthayathāśrutabhāṣyasvarasamanusṛtya kathañcinneyam| vastutastu bhāṭṭamate prakṛtyarthena saṃkhyayā ca karaṇatvādiśaktayo viśeṣyāḥ| ata evaikaśaktikroḍīkṛtānekāvidhistatratatra svīkṛta iti dik||
(aṣṭāosūo2-3-2)
karmaṇi dvitīyā(aṣṭāosūo2-3-2)| dvitīyādayaḥ śabdāḥ supāṃ trikeṣu varttante "samaṃ syādaśrutatvāt"(jaiosūo10-3-13-53)iti nyāyāt pūrvācāryavyavahārācca| iha svādisūtreṇaikavākyatayā vidhiḥ, bhinnavākyatayā niyamo vā| so'pi prakṛtānarthānapekṣya pratyayaniyamo vā'rthaniyamo veti sarve pakṣāḥ sādhavaḥ uktaṃ ca--
supāṃ karmādayo'pyarthāḥ saṃkhyā caiva tathā tiṅām|
prasiddho niyamastatra niyamaḥ prakṛteṣu ca|| iti |
vyākhyātaṃ cedaṃ prathame| iha ca tiṅāmiti svarasātsupsvapi karmādyeva vācyaṃ na tu karmatvam| na ca tiṅṣvapi karmatvamevārtha iti vācyaṃ, "tayoreva"(aṣṭāosūo3-4-70)ityuttarasūtre'pi tathātvāpattau `ghaṭaḥ kṛtaḥ' ityādāvabhedānvayānupapattiprasaṅgāt| tathā ca "laḥ karmaṇi"(aṣṭāosūo3-4-69)"karmāṇi dvitīyā"(aṣṭāosūo2-3-2)iti sūtrasvaraso'pi saṅgacchate| ghaṭamityatra ca ghaṭaḥ karmetyabhedānvaye ānayanādau karmatvena saṃsargeṇa viśeṣaṇatvam| tathāca prakāratayā saṃsargavidhayā veti dvidhā karmatvādibhānamityekaḥ pakṣaḥ| "śaktiḥ kārakam" iti bhāpyasvarasātsaiva vācyetyaparaḥ| ananyalabhyasya śabdārthatayā ādhāra ādheyaṃ vā dvitīyā'rthaḥ| `odanaṃ pacati' ityatra hi odanarūpo ya ādhārastādviśiṣṭā viklittirbhāsate| vaiśiṣṭyaṃ tvādheyatā| odanādheyā vā viklittirarthaḥ, ādheyarūpapratyayārthasya prakṛtyarthaṃ prati viśeṣyatvāt| ādheyatvameva ca saṃsarga iti pakṣāntaram| ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyenādhāratvādheyatve evārthe iti cāparam| saṃsargā evaite| tātparyagrāhikā eva paraṃ vibhaktaya iti matāntaram| sarvepyamī pakṣā helārājīyādau tatratatra sthitā bhāṣyādisammatāśceti dik| odanaṃ pacatītyādau|
ubhasarvatasoḥ kāryā dhiguparyādiṣu triṣu|
dvitīyāmreḍitānteṣu tatonyatrāpi dṛśyate||
asyārthaḥ-ubhayaśabdasarvaśabdayostasilantayoḥ prayoge dvitīyā kāryā| ubhaśabdena hyubhayaśabdo lakṣyate, anyathā tasilasambhavāt| ubhaśabdo hi dvivacanaṭābviṣaya ityuktam| dhigityatra saptamyā luk, "prakṛtivadanukaraṇam"(pāobhāo)ityatideśāt| na tvavibhaktikaḥ| `gavityayamāha' ityatra yathā padāntatvābhāvāt "lopaḥ śākalyasya"(pāosūo8-3-19)ityasyāpravṛttistatheha jaśtvāpravṛttiprasaṅgāt| na cāyaṃ gānta eveti vācyam, "kasya ca daḥ"(pāosūo5-3-72)ityasyāpravṛttau `dhakit' ityasyāsiddhiprasaṅgāt| āmreḍitānteṣviti| kṛtadvirvacanoṣvityarthaḥ| ubhayataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ gopāḥ| sarvataḥ kṛṣṇam| dhik kṛṣṇābhaktam| uparyupari lokaṃ hariḥ| adhyadhi lokam| adhodho lokam|-1--1.kathaṃ buddhīnāmiti ṣaṣṭhī upapadavibhakterdvitīyāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyapavādatvādityarthaḥ|-kathaṃ tarhi-
ucyate, uparibuddhīnāṃ uttānubuddhīnāmupari carantītyarthaḥ| evaṃ cāmroḍitāntatvābhāvānna dvitīyā| yadvā, pratipadoktasya "uparyadhyadhasaḥ sāmīpye"(pāosūo8-1-7)iti kṛtadvitvasyātra grahaṇam| tena vīpsādvirvacane sati nāsya pravṛttiḥ| tato'nyatrāpītyuktam, tānparigaṇayati vṛttikāraḥ-abhitaḥparitaḥsamayānikaṣāhāpratiyogepīti| abhitaḥ kṛṣṇam| ubhayata ityarthaḥ| paritaḥ kṛṣṇam| sarvata ityarthaḥ| "paryabhibhyāñca"(pāosūo5-3-9)iti tasil| ābhimukhyavṛttirapi vibhaktipratirūpako nipāto'bhitaḥśabdo'sti so'pīha gṛhyate| samayānikaṣāśabdau samīpaparyāyau| grāmaṃ samayā nikraṣā vā| hāśabdaḥ śokavṛttiḥ| hā kṛṣṇābhaktam, tasya śocyate ityarthaḥ| ṣaṣṭhyapavādo dvitīyā| sambodhane tvantaraṅgatvātprathamaiva| hā tāteti yathā| etena dhiṅmūrkheti prayogo vyākhyātaḥ| bubhukṣitaṃ na pratibhāti kiṃcit| eṣa pratiśabdaḥ kriyāviśeṣakatvādupasargo na tu karmapravacanīyaḥ| evamanye'pi dṛśigrahaṇātsādhanīyāḥ| tadyathā, caitraṃ yāvacchītamiti| paramapuruṣārādhanamṛte iti ca| tathā ca cāndrasūtram--"ṛte dvitīyāca" iti, cakārātpañcamī| sā cāsmacchāstre "anyārāt"(pāosūo2-3-29)ityanena vidhāsyate||
(aṣṭāosūo2-3-3)
tṛtīyā ca hośchandasi(pāosūo2-3-3)| juhoteḥ karmaṇi tṛtīyā syād dvitīyā ca chandasi| yavāgvāgnihotraṃ juhoti| agnihotraśabdo'tra haviṣi vartate| "yasyāgnihotramadhiśritam amedhyamāpadyate" ityādiprayogadarśanāt| agnaye hūyata iti vyutpatteśca| juhotiḥ prakṣepe| asminneva ca prayoge yavāgūśabdāttṛtīyā, agnihotraśabdācca dvitīyā| viruddhārthakavibhaktyanavaruddhatvānnāmārthayorabhedānvayaḥ| yavāgvākhyaṃ haviragnau devatoddeśena tyatkvā prakṣipatītyarthaḥ| etatsūtraṃ bhāṣye pratyākhyātam| agnihotraśabdo hi jyotiṣyapi vartate, agnihotraṃ prajvalitamiti darśanāt| hūyate'sminniti vyutpatteśca| juhotiśca prīṇane| tadyadā yavāgūśabdāttṛtīyā tadā yavāgvāgniṃ prīṇayatītyarthaḥ| yadā tu dvitīyā tadā yavāgvākhyamagnihotraṃ havirdravyaṃ prakṣipatītyartha iti|
māmāṃsakāstvāhuḥ-agnihotraśabdaḥ karmanāmadeyam, tatprakhyaṃ cānyaśāstramiti nyāyāt| dṛśyate ca sa eṣa yajñaḥ pañcavidho'gnihotraṃ darśapūrvamāsāvityādi| evaṃ sthite bhāvārthādhikaraṇanyāyena karaṇakoṭinikṣipte home sāmānādhikaraṇyāpannasyāgnihotrasya karaṇatvāttṛtīyāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ pakṣe dvitīyārthamidaṃ vacanamiti, tattu sūtrasandarbhaviruddham| karmaṇīti hyanuvartate||
(aṣṭāosūo2-3-4)
antarāntarema yukte(aṣṭāosūo2-3-4)| ābhyāṃ yoge dvitīyā syāt| antarāśabdaḥ saptamyantasya madhya ityetasyārthe vartate| antaremaśabdastu tatra ca vinārthe ca| antarā tvāṃ māṃ ca hariḥ|
mṛṇālasūtrāmalamantareṇa sthitaścalaccāmarayorddhayaṃ sa|
antareṇa hariṃ na sukham| nanu madhyasyāvadhyapekṣatayā yathāvadhibhūtābhyāṃ yuṣmadasmadarthābhyāṃ cāmaradvayena ca yogastathā ādheyenāpi saha| tasmādādheyādapi dvitīyā syāt| maivam, tatrāntaraṅgatayā prathamāyā evotpatteḥ| tasmādviśeṣaṇadiyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyapavādabhūtā dvitīyā na tu viśeṣyādapīti sthitam|
atha ṭābantenāntarāśabdena tṛtīyāntenāntareṇetyanena ca yogaṃ kuto neti cet? pratipadoktatayā tayoreveha grahaṇāt parasparasāhacaryācca| tadyathā-gurubhārgavāvityukte grahayoreva pratītirnatvācāryaparaśurāmayoḥ| tena kimanayorantareṇa gateneti siddham| kimanayorviśeṣeṇa jñātenetyarthaḥ| yuktagraha ṇānneha-antarā tvāṃ māṃ ca kṛṣṇasya mūrtiḥ| iha kṛṣṇānna dvitīyā| antaretyanenānanvayāt|
(aṣṭāosūo2-3-5)
kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoga(pāosūo2-3-5)| iha dvitīyā syāt| māsamāste| yadyapīha karmatvādeva siddham| kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ karmasaṃjñā hyakarmaṇāmityuktestathāpa sakarmakārthaṃ guṇadravyābhyāṃ yogārthaṃ cedam| māsamadhīte| māsaṃ kalyāṇī| māsaṃ guḍadhānāḥ| krośamadhīte| krośaṃ kuṭilā nadī| krośaṃ parvataḥ| atyantasaṃyogeṃ kim? māsasya dviradhīte| "kṛtvorthaprayoge kāledhikaraṇe" iti ṣaṣṭhī|
(pāosūo2-3-6)
apavarge tṛtīyā(pāosūo2-3-6)| apavargaḥ phalaprāptistasyāṃ dyotyāyaṃ kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge tṛtīyā syāt| ah‌nā krośena vā'nuvāko'dhītaḥ| apavarge kim?māsamadhīto nāyātaḥ|
(pāosūo2-3-7)
saptamīpañcamyau kārakamadhye(pāosūo2-3-7)| śaktidvayamadhye yau kālādhvānau tābhyāṃ saptamīpañcamyau staḥ| adya bhuktvāyaṃ dvyahe dvyahādvā bhoktā| kartṛśaktyormadhyeyaṃ kālaḥ| ihasthoyaṃ krośe krośādvā labhyaṃ vidhyet| kartṛkarmaṇormadhyeyaṃ deśaḥ| kālādhvabhyāṃ vibhaktyoryathāsaṃṅkhayaṃ na bhavati, asvaritatvāt|
(pāosūo2-3-8)
karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā(pāosāo2-3-8)| spaṣṭo'rthaḥ| hariṃ prati paryanu vā|
(pāosūo2-3-9)
yasmādadhikaṃ yasya ceśvaravacanaṃ tatra saptamī(pāosūo2-3-9)| karmapravacanīyayukte ityanuvartate| yasmādadhikaṃ tadasminnadhikamiti ca nirddeśādadhikaśabdayoge paryāyeṇa pañcamīsaptamyau staḥ| prakṛtasūtrārthastu yasmādadhikaṃ yasya ceśvaravacanaṃ karmapravacanīyayukte tatra saptamī syāt| upaparārddhe harerguṇāḥ, parārddhādadhikaḥ ityarthaḥ| aiśvarye tu svasvāminoḥ paryāyeṇa saptamī| tathāhi, īśvara ityucyate yena tadīśvaravacanaṃ aiśvaryam| athaveśvaraśabdo bhāvapradhānaḥ| yasya svāmina īśvaratvamucyate ityarthaḥ| adhavā yasyeti svaṃ nirddiśyate yasya svasya īśvara ucyate tataḥ svādityarthaḥ| paryāyeṇa ceyaṃ vibhaktiḥ śeṣaviṣayakarmapravacanīyavibhaktyārambhāt viśeṣaṇodevotpannayā saptamyā dviṣṭhasyāpi sambandhasyābhidhānāt| pratyayārthasya prakṛtyarthaṃ prati viśeṣyatayā viśeṣaṇādeva pratyayaucityācca| viśeṣyāttu prathamaiva| adhirāme bhūḥ| "saptamī śauṇḍaiḥ"(pāosūo2-1-40)iti samāsapakṣe tu rāmadhīneti bhavati| "aṣaḍakṣa"(pāosūo5-4-7)ityādinā khaḥ| vibhaktyarthavṛttitvaṃ tvavyayībhāvaḥ| adhirāmam| svadvibhaktau adhibhuvi rāmaḥ| iha sūtre yasyaceśvaravacanamityaṃśaḥ pratyā khyāto bhāṣye| tathāhi, svāminyādhāre bhūḥ sthitā tasyāṃ ca svāmī tatra yadā yadadhikaraṇatvena vivakṣyate tadā tatra saptamī bhaviṣyati| evaṃ cādhirīśvare iti saṃjñāsūtramapi na kartavyam| na cāgatyupasargatvabādhārthaṃ tat| aiśvaryaviṣayasya adheḥ kriyāyogābhāvenaiva tadaprāpteḥ| uttarārthamiti cettarhi yogavibhāgo na kāryaḥ|
(pāosūo2-3-10)
pañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ(pāosūo2-3-10)etaiḥ karmapravacanīyairyoge pañcamī syāt| apaviṣṇoḥ pariviṣṇoḥ saṃsāraḥ| apena sāhacaryātparervarjanārthasya grahaṇam| tena lakṣamādiṣu na bhavati| vṛkṣaṃ pari vidyotate vid‌yut| āṅmaryādāvacane| āpāṭaliputrādvṛṣṭo devaḥ|
(pāosūo2-3-11)
pratinidhipratidāne ca yasmāt(pāosūo2-3-11)| tatra karmapravacanīyayukte pañcamī syāt| pradyumnaḥ kṛṣṇātprati| tilebhyaḥ pratiyacchati māṣān| iha sūtre anenaiva yasmāditi pañcamī|
(pāosūo2-3-12)
gatyarthakarmaṇi dvitīyācaturthyau ceṣṭāyāmanadhvani(pāosūo2-3-12)aghvabhinne gatyarthānāṃ karmaṇi ete staśceṣṭāyāṃ satyām| grāmaṃ grāmāya vā gacchati| gatyartheti kim? odanaṃ pacati| karmaṇīti kim? aśvena vrajati| ceṣṭāyāṃ kim? manasā hariṃ vrajati| anadhvanīti kim? panthānaṃ gacchaṃti| āsthitapratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ(kāovāo)| āsthitaḥ| samprāptaḥ| gantrā adhiṣṭhita ityarthaḥ| tena yadā utpathātpanthā evākramitumiṣyate tadā bhavatveva caturthī| utpathena pathe gacchati| `ajānnayati grāmam' ityatra tu na caturthī, agatyarthatvāt| pratīyate hyatra gatiḥ, na tvasau nayaterarthaḥ, prāpaṇavācitvāt| evaṃ striyaṃ gacchatītyatrāpi na caturthī, asamprāptaprepsābhāvāt| anaghvanīti hyapanīya asamprāpta iti pūryate| dvitīyāgrahaṇamapavādaviṣaye'pi yathā syāt, tena kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati| anvayā caturthītyeva brūyāditi vadan vṛttikāro grāmaṃ ganteti tṛjantayoge udājahāra| idantu bhāṣyaviruddham| tathāhi, sandaśanādibhirāpyamānatvātkriyāpi kṛtrimaṃ karmeti kriyayābhipreyamāṇasya sampradānatvaṃ siddham| sandarśanādīnāṃ gamanasya ca bhedāvivakṣāyāṃ tu dvitīyāpi siddheti sūtramidaṃ pratyākhyātaṃ bhāṣye| evaṃ hi vadatā kṛdyoge ṣaṣṭhyeveṣyate| ata eva "akenoḥ(pāosūo2-3-70)iti `grāmaṃ gāmī' ityudāhṛtaṃ bhāṣye|
(pāosūo2-3-13)
caturthī sabhprādāne(pāosūo2-3-13)| spaṣṭam| viprāya gāṃ dadāti| tādarthya.e upasaṃṅkhyānam(kāovāo)| yūpāya dāru| iha dāruśabdāt "hetau"(pāosūo2-3-23)iti tṛtīyā tu na bhavati| ṣaṣṭhīviṣaye hi sā| prātipadikārthamātre prathamaiva| nanūpasaṃkhyānasyāvaśyakatve sutraṃ vyarthameveti cet? na, haraye rocate ityādyarthaṃ tasyāpyāvaśyakatvāt| klṛpi sampadyamāne ca(kāovāo)| vikāravācakāccurthītyarthaḥ| sa hi sampadyate prādurbhavati| bhaktirjñānāya kalpate| prakṛtivikārayorbhedavivakṣāyāṃ caturthī| abhedavivakṣāyāntu prathamaiva| bhaktirjñānaṃ kalpate iti kecit| anye tvabhedavivakṣāyāmapi caturthītyāhuḥ| janikarturityapādānatvavivakṣāyāntu pañcamī| bhakterjñānaṃ kalpate iti| kecittu tatrāpi caturthīmicchanti| utpātena jñāpite ca(kāovāo)| prāṇināṃ śubhāśubhayoḥ sūcako bhūtavikāra utpātaḥ| vātāya kapilā vidyut| hitayogeca(kāovāo)|caturthīsamāsavidhānājjñāpyate| brāhmaṇāya hitam|
(pāosūo2-3-14)
kriyārthopapadasya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ(pāosāo2-3-14)| upapadaṃ kṛtrimantacca kriyārthakriyārūpaṃ tumun‌ṇvuloreva sambhavatīti viśeṣaṇamahimnā viśeṣyantumun ṇvulantameva labhyate| aprayujyamānasya karmaṇi caturthī syāt| phalabhyo yāti, phalānyāhartumityarthaḥ| sthāniśabdo'prayujyamānaparatayā vaiyākaraṇagṛhe prasiddhaḥ|
(pāosūo2-3-15)
tumarthācca bhāvavacanāt(pāosūo2-3-15)| bhāvavacanāśceti sūtreṇa ye vihitāstadantāccaturthī syāt| yāgāya yāti| pākāpa pacanāya bhaktaye| bhāvavacanenaiva tādarthyasya dyotitatvāttādarthye caturthī na syāditi sūtrārambhaḥ|
(pāosūo2-3-16)
namaḥsvastisvāhāsvadhālaṃvaṣaḍyogācca(pāosūo2-3-16)| ebhiryoge caturthī syāt| haraye namaḥ| upapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī, pradhānabhūtākriyāsabandhasyāntaraṅgatvāt| namaskaroti devān| kathantarhi-"namaścakāra devebhyaḥ" iti, "rāvaṇāya namaskṛryāḥ" iti ca bhaṭṭiḥ? atra mādhavaḥ-sākṣātprabhṛtiṣu pāṭhādvaikalpikaṃ namaḥśabdasya gatitvam| tatra gati saṃjñāpakṣe upasargavad dyotakatayā kṛña eva pramatirarthaḥ| tatkarmaṇi dvitīyā namasyati devānitivat| agatitve tu karotikriyākarmabhāvāpannaṃ viśeṣyabhūtaṃ praṇāmamācaṣṭa iti devādāvakarmaṇi namaḥ svastīti caturthyeveti|
atredaṃ vaktavyam-uktarītyā caturthīsamarthane'pi namaso gatisaṃjñābhāvānnamaspurasorgatyoriti satvaṃ na syāt| tathā ca prayogānirvāhastadavasthaḥ| tasmāt kriyārthopapadasyaceti caturthī bodhyā, devān prasādayitumityarthāt| vardhamānastu-"śrāddhāya nigalbhata" itivatkriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti caturthītyāha| prajābhyaḥ svasti| agnaye svāhā| pitṛbhyo svadhā| alaṃ mallo mallāya| alamiti paryāptyarthagrahaṇam| tena daityebhyo hariralaṃ prabhuḥ samarthaḥ śakta ityādi| kathantarhi-"prabhurbubhūṣurbhuvanatrayasya"(mā.kā.1.49)iti māghaḥ| ucyate, paryāptyarthasyaivālamo grahaiṇaṃ, na tu `alaṃ rodanena ityādau vāraṇārthasyāpītivyākhyānāntaraṃ bhāṣye sthitam| evañca vyākhyābhedātprabhvādiyoge ṣaṣṭhyapi sādhuḥ| ata eva sūtrakāro dvedhā niradikṣat| tasmai prabhavati santāpādibhyaḥ(pāosūo4-1-101)saeṣāṃgrāmaṇīḥ(pāosūo5-2-78)iti ca| tathāca bhaṭṭiḥ-"nāprothīdasya kaścana puprothāsmau na kaścana"iti| prothṛ paryāptau(bhvāouo867)ityasya rūpam| `alaṃrodanena" ityatra tu karaṇe tṛtīyā, rodanena na kiṃcitsādhyamityarthāvagamāt| vaṣaḍindrāya| cakāraḥ punarvidhānārthaḥ| tenāśīrvivakṣāyāmapi ṣaṣṭhīṃ bādhitvā caturthyeva bhavati| svasti gobhyo bhūyāt| anyathā svastiyoge caturthyā avakāśaḥ| svasti jālmāyāstīti| tattvakathane kuśalārthairāśiṣītyasyāvakāśaḥ svastibhinnāḥ kuśalārthāḥ| ubhayaprasaṅge paratvāt pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī syāt|
(pāosūo2-3-17)
manyakarmaṇyanādare vibhāṣā'prāṇiṣu(pāosūo2-3-17)| prāṇivarje manyateḥ karmaṇi caturthī vā syāttiraskāre| na tvāṃ tṛṇaṃ manye tṛṇāya vo| manyatigrahaṇaṃ kim? na tvāṃ tṛṇaṃ cintayāmi| śyanā nirdeśānneha-natvāṃ tṛṇaṃ manvo manu avabodhane(taoāo1470)| tanāderuḥ| na ca manyotayakā nirddeśaḥ kiṃ nasyāditi vācyam, anabhihite ityadhikārāt| na hi yakā yoge anabhihitaṃ karma sambhavati| śyannapi daivādikadhātūpalakṣamamātraṃ na tu svayaṃ vivakṣitaḥ| tena-
tṛṇāya matvā raghunandano'pi bāṇena rakṣaḥ pradhanānnirāsthat|
iti bhaṭṭiprayogaḥ saṅgacchate| anādaraścātra nādarābhāvamātramapi tu tiraskāraḥ, kutseti yāvat| adharmānṛtādivannañaḥ pratipakṣavācitvāt| sa ca dvedhā-utkṛṣṭasyāpakṛṣṭenopamānāt| yathā tṛṇāya matveti| tṛṇamiva matvetyarthaḥ| kvacittu niṣedhayogenopamānāyogyatvapratīteḥ| yathā-na tvāṃ tṛṇaṃ manye iti| tṛṇatulyamapi tvāṃ na manye ityarthaḥ| iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ atrātyantamanādaraḥ pūrvatra tvanādaramātram! ubhayatrāpi sūtreṇa siddham|
vārttikakārastvāha-prakṛṣya kutsitagrahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti| yadvācinaścaturthī tato'pi yadi kutsā na tu sāmyamātraṃ tadā caturthītyarthaḥ| evañca pratiṣedhayuktāyāmeva kutsāyāṃ caturthīvidhānāt prāguktabhaṭṭiprayogo virudhyate sūtrarītyā tu saḥ| tathā cāpiśalirapi manyakarmaṇyanādara upamāne vibhāṣā, prāṇiṣvityasūtrayat| aprāṇiṣvityapanīya anāvādiṣviti pāṭhyamiti bhāṣyam| naukākānśukaśṛgālāḥ nāvādayaḥ|(kāovāo)te na tvāṃ śune manye ityatra tu prāṇitve'pi caturthī bhavatyeveti dik| anādareti karmaṇo viśeṣaṇam| anādaradyotakaṃ yatkarmeti| tena tṛṇādereva caturthī na tu yuṣmadaḥ, vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānādvā|
|| iti śrīśabdakaustubhe dvitīyasyādhyāyasya tṛtīyapāde prathamamānhikam ||
|| tṛtīyapāde dvitīyamānhikam ||
(pāosūo2-3-18)
kartṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā(pāosūo2-3-18)| rāmeṇa bāṇena hato vālī| prakṛtyādibhya upasaṅkhyānam(kāovāo)| prakṛtyābhirūpaḥ| kriyāyā aśravaṇāt kartṛkaraṇayorabhāvāt ṣaṣṭhīha prāptā| nanu gamyamānakarotikriyākaraṇatvāt siddham| karaṇāntaravyudāsāya hi prakṛtereva karaṇatvaṃ vivakṣitam| svabhāvenāyamabhirūpaḥ kṛto na tvalaṅkārādinetyarthāt| nanu yājñikaśabdābhidheyamadhyayanaṃ prati bāhulyaṃ karaṇam| saṅghībhūya yajñamadhīyate ityarthāt| yatrāpi viśiṣṭaveṣaṃ kañcid dṛṣṭvā prāyeṇāyaṃ yājñika ityadhyavasyati| tatrāpi gamyamānajñānakriyāṃ prati karaṇatvāt siddham| ācārādibāhulyena yājñiko'yamiti janairjñāpyate ityarthāt| kecittu prāyeṇaśabdo vibhaktipratirūpako nipāto nūnamityarthe varttate ityāhuḥ| dṛśyate ca prāyeṇa sāmagryavidhau guṇānāmita| prāyeṇa niṣkrāmati cakrapāṇāviti ca| idaṃ tarhi gotreṇa gārgyaḥ, prathamā ṣaṣṭhī vāprāpnoti| nanvihāpi anenāhaṃ jñāye ityarthātsiddham| idantarhi samena viṣameṇaiti, atra samaviṣamābhyāṃ dvitīyā prāptā| nanu patho'pi gamane karaṇatvāt samena pathetyartho'stu idaṃ tarhi dvidroṇena dhānyaṃ krīṇāti| pañcakena paśūn gṛṇhāti| dvayordroṇayoḥ samāhāra iti dvidroṇaṃ pānādiḥ| dvo droṇau kṛtvetyarthaḥ| iha dvitīyā ṣaṣṭhī vā prāptā| pañcaparimāṇamasya pañcakaḥ saṅghaḥ| tatra saṅghasaṅghinorabhedavivakṣāyāṃ paśūnityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt dvitīyā prāptā| etadapi pratyākhyātaṃ bhāṣye| dvidroṇādīnāṃ ca yanmūlyaṃ tena dvidroṇādyeva kriyate ityarthabhedo'pi nāstīti|
(pāosūo2-3-19)
sahayukte'pradhāne(pāosūo2-3-19)| sahārthena yukte'pradhāne tṛtīyā syāt| putreṇa sahāgataḥ pitā| pituratra kriyāsambandhaḥ śābdaḥ, putrasya tu ārtha iti tasyāprādhānyam| sahe'pradhāne ityeva vācye yuktagrahaṇādarthagrahaṇam| putreṇa sārdham| vināpi sahaśabdena tadarthāvagatau syādeva, tathā ca sautraprayogaḥ| "vṛddhoyūnā"(pāosūo1-2-65)iti| pradhānagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum| na caivaṃ piturapi tṛtīyāpattiḥ| tatraprātipadikamātrāpekṣatvādantaraṅgatvena prathamopapatteḥ|
(pāosūo2-3-20)
yenāṅgavikāraḥ(pāosūo2-3-20)| yena śarīravikāro lakṣyate tatastṛtīyā syāt| arśaādyajantaḥ sūtre aṅgaśabdaḥ| tadvikāralakṣakaśca prakṛtyarthabhūto'vayava eva gṛhyate, sannidhānāt| sa cārthādvikṛta eva na hyavikṛtenāvayavena śarīrasya vikāraḥ sambhavati| tadetadabhisandhāya vṛttāvuktam-yenāṅgena vikṛtenetyādi| akṣṇākāṇaḥ| pādenakhañjaḥ| pāṇinā kuṇiḥ| sāmānyopakrame vākye akṣṇetyukte bhavatyākāṅkṣā, nirūpayati vā kāṇo veti| tatra kāma ityādiprayogo na virudhyate| yadyapyakṣyeva kāṇaṃ tathāpi tadyogāccharīre'pi vyavahāro nirūḍhaḥ| ṣaṣṭhyapavādo yogaḥ| akṣisambandhikāṇatvavānityarthāt|
(pāosūo2-3-21)
itthambhūtalakṣaṇe(pāosūo2-3-21)| kañcit prakāraṃ prāpta itthambhūtastallakṣaṇe tṛtīyā syāt| jaṭābhistāpasaḥ| jaṭājñāpyatāpasatvavān|
(pāosūo2-3-22)
saṃjño'nyatarasyāṃ karmaṇi(pāosūo2-3-22)| sampūrvasya jānāteḥ karmaṇi tṛtīyā vā syāt| pitrā pitaraṃ vā sañjānīte| "sampratibyāmanādhyāne"(pāosūo1-3-46) iti taṅ| kṛdyoge tu paratvātṣaṣṭhī| pituḥ sañjñātā| yattu haradattenoktam, ādhyāne paratvāt "adhīgartha"(pāosūo2-3-52)iti ṣaṣṭhī mātuḥ sañjānātīti| tanna, tatra śeṣādhikārāt| karmatvavivakṣāyāṃ tṛtīyādvitīyayoravaśyābhyupeyatvāt| bhinnaviṣayayā ṣaṣṭhyā vipratiṣedhasyānyāyyatvācceti dik|
(pāosūo2-3-23)
hetau(pāosūo2-3-23)| hetvarthe tṛtīyā syāt| dhanena kulam| vidyayā yaśaḥ| heturiha laukikaḥ phasādhanībhūtaḥ, na tu tatprayojako hetuśceti kṛtrimaḥ| tasya cakāreṇa kartṛsaṃjñāvidhānātkartṛkaraṇayorityeva tṛtīyāyāḥ siddhatvāt| na ca laukikahetorapi nirvyāpārasādhāraṇyācca| karaṇasya tu kriyāmātraviṣayatvāt vyāpāraniyatvācca| āha ca-
dravyādiviṣayo hetuḥ kārakaṃ niyatakriyam| iti|
anāśrite tu vyāpāre nimittaṃ heturucyate| iti ca|
tathā phalamapīha hetuśabdena gṛhyate| adhyayanena vasati| idañca "pratyayaḥ"(pāosūo3-1-1)iti sūtre kaiyaṭe spaṣṭam|
(pāosūo2-3-24)
akartaryṛṇe pañcamī(pāosūo2-3-24)| kartṛvarjitaṃ yadyaṇaṃ hetubhūtaṃ tataḥ pañcamī syāt| tṛtīyāpavādaḥ| śatādbaddhaḥ| akartarīti kim? śatena bandhitaḥ| śatamiha uttamaṇāya dhāryamāṇatvādṛṇantatprayojako hetuśceti cakāreṇa kartṛsaṃjñañca| nanu pūrvasūtre laukikasya hetorgrahaṇamityuktam| ayantu śāstrīyaḥ| satyam, śāstrīyasyāpi laukikatvamastyeva| vyāpakaṃ hi laukikaṃ na tu viruddham| atha vā ihārthatayā pūrvasūtre'pi sāmānyagrahaṇamastu|
(pāosūo2-3-25)
vibhāṣā guṇe'striyām(pāosūo2-3-25)| guṇahetāvastrīliṅge pañcamī vā syāt| jāḍyājājāḍyena vā baddhaḥ| pāṇḍityātpāṇḍityena vā muktaḥ| guṇe iti kim? dhanena kulam| astriyāṃ kim? buddhyā muktaḥ| iha sattve niviśate'paitīti lakṣito guṇo gṛhyate| tadanurūpatvādudāharaṇapratyudāharaṇayoḥ| iha "vibhaṣā" iti yogo vibhajyate| tenāguṇe'pi kvacidbhavati, evaṃ striyāmapi| etacca "hatumanuṣyebhyaḥ"(pāosūo4-3-81)itisūtre haradattagranthe spaṣṭam| kecittu gumaśabdo'tra paratantramātraparaḥ| yasya dviguṇasya bhāvādityatra yathā| tena vanhimāndhūmādityādāvapi pañcamī siddhetyāhuḥ| kathantarhi nāstīha ghaṭonupalabdheriti| atrāhuḥ, striyāmapi kvacidbhavati vibhāṣāguṇe itiyogavibhāgāt| bāhulakaṃ prakṛtestanudṛṣṭeriti vārttikaprayogaśceha jñāpaka iti| (pāosūo2-3-26)
ṣaṣṭhī hetuprayoge(pāosūo2-3-26)| hetau dyotye ṣaṣṭhī syāt| annasya hetorvasati|
(pāosūo2-3-27)
sarvanāmnastṛtīyā ca(pāosūo2-3-27)| sarvanāmno hetuśabdasya ca prayoge hetau dyotye tṛtīyā syāt ṣaṣṭhī ca| kena hetunā vasati| kasya hetoḥ| nimittakāraṇahetuṣu sarvāsāṃ prāyadarśanam(kāovāo)| kinnimittaṃ vasati| kena nimittena| kasmai nimittāyetyādi| evaṃ kiṃ kāraṇam| ko hetuḥ| kiṃ prayojanamityādi| asarvanāmnopyetadbhavativṛttikāreṇe'va pāṭhe'pi bhāṣyakāreṇa "hetau"(pāosūo2-3-23)ityatra paṭitatvāt| prāyagrahaṇādasarvanāmnaḥ prathamadvitīye nastaḥ| annena kāraṇena vasati| annāya kāraṇāyetyādi| vārtike paryāyopādānaṃ prapañcārtham, prayojanādiśabdānurodhenārthaparatvasvīkārāt|
(pāosūo2-3-28)
apādāne pañcamī(pāosūo2-3-28)| spaṣṭam| grāmādāgacchati| lyablope karmaṇyadhikaraṇe copasaṅkhyānam(kāovāo)| prāsādātprekṣate| āsanātprekṣate, prāsādamāruhya āsane upaviśya prekṣata ityarthaḥ| gamyamānāpi kriyā kārakavibhaktinimittam, praviśa piṇḍītivat| tena kutobhavān, pāṭaliputrādityādi siddham| iha hi pratyakṣādisiddhamāgamanamupajīvyāvadhāveva praśnottare pravartate| etena "praśnākhyānayośca" iti vārtikaṃ pratyākhyātam, apekṣitakriyāyā dānatvenaiva siddhatvāt| anyathā kaścandra ityādāvativyāpteśca| yataścādhvakālanirmāṇaṃ tatra pañcamī|(kāovāo)tadyuktādadhvanaḥ prathamāsaptamyau(kāovāo)| kālātsaptamī ca vaktavya(kāovāo)| vanādgrāmo yojane yojanaṃ vā| kārttikyā āgrahāyaṇi māse| kṛttikābhiryuktā paurṇamāsī kārttikī| paurṇamāsyāṃ "lubaviśeṣe"(pāosāo4-2-4)iti luṅ na bhavati, "sāsminpaurṇamāsīti(pāosū o4-2-21)ityadhikāre "vibhāṣāphālgunīśravaṇākārttikīcaitrībhyaḥ"(pāosūo4-2-23)iti nirddeśāt| agre hāyanamasyā iti āgrahāyaṇī| prajñāderākṛtigaṇatvāt svārthiko'ṇ, āgrahāyaṇyaśvatthādinipātanāṇṇatvam| tadyuktāditi| tena pañcamyantena arthadvāreṇa yuktātkāle varttamānānmāsādiśabdādityarthaḥ| atra bhāṣye kārttikyāḥ prabhṛtīti prayogātprabhṛtiyoge pañcamīti kaiyaṭaḥ| prabhṛtītyarthagrahaṇam, tata ārabhyetyartha iti kaiyaṭāt| skandhātprabhṛtyeva sapallavānīti kumāraḥ|
(pāosūo2-3-29)
anyārāditararttedik‌śabdāñcūttarapadājāhiyukte(pāosūo2-3-29)| etairyoge pañcamī syāt| anya ityarthagrahaṇam| itaragrahaṇantu prapañcārtham| na ca itarastvanyanīcayoḥ(aokoo3-3-200)ityamarokternīcārthakasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti vācyam, "asmāttāromando vā" ityādāviva "pañcamīvibhakte"(pāosūo2-3-42)ityanenaiva siddhatvāt| devadattādanyo bhinno vilakṣaṇo'rthāntaraṃ vetyādi| na caivaṃ `ghaṭaḥ paṭo na' ityatrātiprasaṅgaḥ, naño'pyanyonyābāvārthakatvāt| ghaṭādbheda ityādyanurādhena dharmiparyantavivakṣāyā ayogāditi vācyam, naño dyotakatāyā uktatvāt| ārādevadattāt| iha "dūrāntikārthaiḥṣaṣṭhyanyatarasyām"(pāosūo2-3-34)iti prāptaḥ| "ārād‌dūrasamīpayoḥ"(aokoo3-3-25)"ṛtekṛśānorna hi mantrapūtam"| atra ṛteyoge pākṣikī dvitīyāpītyaktaṃ prāk| diśi dṛṣṭaḥ śabdo dikśabdaḥ| tena samprati deśakālavṛttinā'pi yoge bhavati| grāmātpūrvo deśaḥ| caitrātpūrvaḥ phālgunaḥ| kathantarhi pūrvaṃ kāyasyeti? ucyate, avayavavācibhiryoge na bhavati "tasya paramāmreḍitam"(pāosūo8-1-2)iti nirddeśāt| añcūttarapadasya dikśabdatve'pi "ṣaṣṭhyatasarthapratyayena"(pāosūo2-3-30)ityetadvādhanārthaṃ pṛthaggrahaṇam| prāk pratyagvā grāmāt| na ca tena sadhyraṅ‌ṅityādau pañcamyarthaṃ tatkinna syāditi vācyam, dikśabdasāhacaryeṇa prāgādīnāmeva grahaṇāt| āc-dakṣiṇā grāmāt uttarā vā| āhi-dakṣiṇāhi uttarāhi grāmāt| "dakṣiṇādāc"(pāosūo5-3-36)| "āhi cadūre(pāosūo5-3-37)"uttarācca"(pāosūo5-3-38)ityājāhī|
(pāosūo2-3-30)
enapā dvitīyā(pāosūo2-3-30)| enabantena yoge dvitīyā syāt| ṣaṣṭhyapīṣyate| sā tu `enapā' iti yogaṃ vibhajya sādhanīyā| dakṣiṇena grāmaṃ grāmasya vā| evamuttareṇa| "enabanyatarasyāmadūrepañcamyāḥ"(pāosūo5-3-35)ityenap| kathantarhi-
tatrāgāraṃ dhanapatigṛhāduttareṇāsmadīyam|
"stryadhikārātparema vāsarūpavidhirnāvaśyaṃ bhavatītyādi"| enabapi paraśabdātpākṣikaḥ| yadā taddhidhau "uttarādharadakṣiṇāt"(pāosūo5-3-34)iti nānuvartate| satyam, ata eva cintyamevedamiti haradattaḥ| uttareṇeti tṛtīyaikavacanāntaṃ toraṇenetyanena samānādhikaraṇamityanye| apare tu dhanapatigṛhāniti śasantaṃ paṭhanti|
(pāosūo2-3-32)
pṛthagvinānānābhistṛtīyānyatarasyām(pāosūo2-3-32)| anya tarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ samuccayārtham, nipātānāmanekārthatvāt| maṇḍūkaplutyā pañcamyanuvartate| ebhiryoge tṛtīyāpañcamyau staḥ| vṛttikārastvāhaḥ"pṛthagvinānānābhiḥ" iti yogavibhāgād dvitīyāpīṣyata iti| pṛthagrā meṇa rāmādrāmaṃ vā| evaṃ vinā nānā| "hiruṅ nānā ca varjane"(aokoo3-4-3)ityamaraḥ| "nānānārīrniṣphalā lokayātro"| iti prayogaḥ|
(pāosūo2-3-33)
karaṇe ca stokālpakṛchrakatipayasyāsattvavacanasya(pāosūo2-3-33)| adravyārthebhya ebhyaḥ karaṇe tṛtīyāpañcamyau staḥ| stokena stokādvā muktaḥ| asattveti kim? stokena viṣeṇa hataḥ|
(pāosūo2-3-34)
dūrāntikāryaiḥ ṣaṣṭhyanyatarasyām(pāosūo2-3-34)| etairyoge ṣaṣṭhī syātpañcamī ca| "pṛthagvinā"(pāosūo2-3-32)ityatra pañcamī samuccīyate ityuktam| ihāpyekapraghaṭṭakatvāttathaiveti draṣṭavyam| dūramantikaṃ vā grāmasya grāmādvā|
(pāosūo2-3-35)
dūrāntikārthebhyo dvitīyā ca(pāosūo2-3-35)| ebhyo dvitīyā syāccakārātpañcamītṛtīye| prātipadikārthe vidhirayam| grāmasya dūraṃ dūrād‌ dūrema vā| antikamantikādantikena vā| uttaratrāpyetadanuvṛttyā tattadviṣaye'pi dvitīyādayaḥ syuḥ| tathā cādhikaraṇe'pi prayujyate-dūrādāvasathānmūtramiti| āvasathasya dūre ityarthaḥ| asattvavacanagrahaṇamanuvartate| teneha na-dūraḥ panthāḥ| dūrāya pathe dehi| dūrasya pathaḥ svamiti|
(pāosūo2-3-36)
saptamyadhikaraṇe ca(pāosūo2-3-36)| cakārād dūrāntikārthebhyaḥ| kaṭe āste| dūrāntikārthebhyaḥ prāgvibhaktitrayamuktam| anena ca saptamīti tebhyaścatasro vibhaktayaḥ phalitāḥ| ktasyenviṣayasya karmaṇyupaśaṅkhyānam(kāovāo)| initi innantaḥ śabdaḥ| viṣayo vṛttibhūmiryasya ktāntasya tasyetyarthaḥ| adhītī vyākaraṇe| adhītamaneneti vigrahaḥ| "śrāddhamanena bhuktam'(pāosūo5-2-85)ityato'neneti varttamāne "iṣṭādibhyaśca"(pāosūo5-2-88)iti sūtreṇa karttarīnipratyayaḥ| tatastaddhitārthena sahaikārthībhūtasyādhītasya niṣkṛṣya vyākaraṇādinā sambandhābhāvāt| ktapratyayenānabhihitaṃ vyākaraṇam| tatra kṛtapūrvī kaṭamitivad dvitīyā prāptā| guṇabhūtayā'pi hi adhyayanakriyayā karmaṇaḥ sambandho na viruddhaḥ, "sahādhītavān vyākaraṇam" ityādau yathā| āha ca-
avigrahā gatādisthā yathā grāmādikarmabhiḥ|
kriyā sambadhyate tadvat kṛtapūrvyādiṣu sthitā|| iti|
na vivicya graho yasyāḥ sā avigrahā, guṇībhūtetyarthaḥ| nanu kālakarmaṇo'pi saptamī prāpnoti "māsamadhītī vyākaraṇe" ityādau| maivam, tasya bahiraṅgatvāt| na caivaṃ tatra dvitīyāpi na syāditi vācyam, tadvidhāne lakṣyānurodhena vyaktipakṣasyāśrayaṇāt| sādhvasādhuprayoge ca(kāovāo)| sādhuḥ kṛṣṇo mātari| asādhurmātule| atra sādhutvāsādhutvayormātrādiviṣayatve'pi kriyāyā abhāvenādhikaraṇatvābhāvādvacanam| `sādhunipuṇābhyām"(pāosūo2-3-43)ityeva siddhe anarcārthamatra sādhugrahaṇam| tena tattvakathane'pi bhavati| sūtre arcāgrahaṇantu nipuṇārtham| sādhugrahaṇantu tatra vārttikaṃ dṛṣṭvā sūtrasyāpravṛtteriti dhyeyam| arhāṇāṃ kartṛtve anarhāṇāmakartṛtve tadvaiparītye ca(kāovāo)| sassu taratsu asanta āsate ityādi| yadyapīdaṃ "yasya ca bhāvena"(pāosūo2-3-37)ityeva siddham| tathāpi lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvāvivakṣāyāmapi yathā syāditi vacanamityāhuḥ| nimittātkarmayoge(kāovāo)| nimittamihaphalam| tadvācinaḥ saptamī syāt| yadi tasya karmaṇā saha yogo yogaviśeṣaḥ saṃyogasamavāyātmakaḥ|
carmaṇi dvīpinaṃ hanti dantayorhanti kuñjaram|
keśeṣu camarīṃ hanti sīmnipuṣkalako hataḥ||
carmaphalakaṃ dvīpikarmakaṃ hananamityarthaḥ| atra hetutatṛtīyā prāptā| tatra hi phalamapi hetuśabdena gṛhyate| "adhyayanena vasati" ityādisiddhaye iti "pratyayaḥ"(pāosūo3-1-1)iti sūtre kaiyaṭe sthitam| atra dvīpicarmaṇoḥ samavāyaḥ sambandhaḥ| camaraśabdājjātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ| puṣkalakaḥ śaṅkuḥ| sasīṃmni sīmajñānārthaṃ hato nihataḥ nikhāta ityarthaḥ| nihanyamānena śaṅkunā saha sīmnaḥ saṃyogaḥ sambandha iti haradattādayaḥ| durgavākyaprabodhe tu kulacandrastvāha-sīmā aṇḍakośaḥ| puṣkalako gandhamṛgaḥ| uktaṃ ca medinīkeśe-
sīmā ghāṭasthitikṣetreṣvaṇḍakāśeṣu ca striyām| iti|
atha puṣkalako gandhamṛge kṣapaṇakīlayoḥ| iti ca|
karmayoge kim? vetanena dhānyaṃ lunāti|
(pāosūo2-3-37)
yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam(pāosūo2-3-37)| yasya kriya yā kriyāntaraṃ lakṣyate tataḥ saptamī syāt| nirjñātakālā kriyā anirjñātakālāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ kālaparicchedakatvāt lakṣaṇamityucyate| moṣu duhyamānāsu gataḥ| evaṃ deśaparicchedikā'pi sati guṇe dravyatvamasti|
(pāosūo2-3-38)
ṣaṣṭhīcānādare(pāosūo2-3-38)| anādarādhikye bhāvalakṣaṇe ṣaṣṭhīsamaptamyau staḥ| iha sūtre anādare iti pūrveṇa satsaptamī| anādare sati yo bhāvaṃ lakṣayatīti| tathāca tadādhikyaṃ phalitam| rudati rudato vā prāvājīt| rudantaṃ putrādikamanādṛtya sanyastavānityarthaḥ|
(pāosūo2-3-39)
svāmīśvarādhipatidāyādasākṣipratibhūprasūtaiśca(pāosūo2-3-39)| etaiḥ saptabhiryoge ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyau staḥ| ṣaṣṭhyāmeva prāptāyāṃ pākṣikasaptamyarthaṃ vacanam| gavāṃ goṣu vā svāmī, īśvaro vetyādi| dāyamādatte iti dāyādaḥ, sopasargādapyata eva nipātanātkaḥ| gāvāmityetattu yadyapi samudāyasya viśeṣaṇam, tathāpi dīyate iti dāya iti vyutpattyā avayavārthabhūtamaṃśaṃ spṛśatyeva| tena gavātmakasyāṃśasyādāteti phalito'rthaḥ| gavāṃ prasūtaḥ, gā evānubhavituṃ jāta ityarthaḥ|
(pāosūo2-3-40)
āyuktakuśalābhyāṃ cāsevāyām(pāosū2-3-40)| ābhyāṃ yoge ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyau sta āsevāyāṃ gamyamānāyām| āsevā tātparyam| āyukto vyāpāritaḥ| kuśalo nipuṇaḥ| āyuktaḥ kuśalo vā haribhajanasya haribhajane vā| āsevāyāṃ kim? āyukto gauḥ śakaṭe, īṣadyukta ityarthaḥ|
(pāosūo2-3-41)
yataśca nirddhāraṇam(pāosūo2-3-41)| jātiguṇakriyāsañjñābhiḥ samudāyādekadeśasya pṛthakkaraṇaṃ nirddhāraṇaṃ, yato nirddhāraṇaṃ tataḥ ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyau staḥ| nṛṇāṃ nṛṣu vā brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ| gavāṃ goṣu vā kṛṣṇā vahukṣīrā| gacchatāṃ gacchatsu vā dhāvan śīghraḥ| amīṣāṃ chātrāṇāṃ devadattaḥ paṭuḥ|
(pāosūo2-3-42)
pañcamī vibhakte(pāosūo2-3-42)| vibhāge vibhaktam| niddhāryamāṇasya yatra bheda eva na tu śabdopāttasāmānyarūpākrāntatā, tatra nirddhāraṇāśrayātpañcamī syāt| māthurāḥ pāṭaliputrakebhya āḍhyatarāḥ| na hyatra gavāṃ kṛṣṇā ityādiṣviva sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvaḥ, kintu śabdopāttadharmayorvirodha eva| idañca sūtraṃ buddhikalpitamapāyamāśrityāpādānaprakaraṇe pratyākhyātam| āha ca-
buddhyā samīhataikatvāt pañcālān kurubhiryadā|
punarvibhajate vaktā tadāpāyaḥ pratīyate|| iti|
(pāosūo2-3-43)
sādhunipuṇābhyāmarcāyāṃ saptamyaprateḥ(pāosūo2-3-43)| ābhyāṃ yoge saptamī syādarcāyāṃ gamyamānāyāṃ, na tu prateḥ prayoge| mātari sādhurnipuṇo vā| "puṇa karmaṇiśubhe"(tuopao1333)asmānnipūrvādigupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ| "arca pūjāyām"(bhvāopao204)asmādbhauvādikād "gurośca halaḥ"(pāosūo3-3-103)ityapratyayaḥ| caurādikāttu "ṇyāsaśrantha"(pāosūo3-3-107)iti yuc syāt| arcāyāṃ kim? nipuṇo rājño bhṛtyaḥ| iha tattvakathane tātparyam| sādhuśabdaprayoge tvanarcāyāmapi saptamī bhavatyeva| sādhvasādhuprayoge ca(kāovāo)iti vārttikāditi prāgevoktam| apratyādibhiriti vaktavyam(kāovāo)| neha-sādhurnipuṇo vā mātaramprati paryanu vā|
(pāosūo2-3-44)
prasitotsukābhyāṃ tṛtīyā ca(pāosūo2-3-44)| ābhyāṃ yoge tṛtīyā syāccātsaptamī| prasita utsuko vā harimā harau vā| "tatpare prasitāsaktau"(aokoo3-1-7)ityamaraḥ| utsukasāhacaryātprasito'pi tatpara eveha gṛhyate| tena prakarṣeṇa sitaḥ śukla ityarthe na bhavati|
(pāosūo2-3-45)
nakṣatre ca lupi(pāosūo2-3-45)| nakṣatre prakṛtyarthe sati yo lupsaṃjñayā lupyamānasya pratyayasyārthastatra vartamānāttṛtīyāsaptamyau sto'dhikaraṇe'rthe|
mūlenāvāhayeddevīṃ śravaṇena visarjayet|
mūle śravaṇe iti vā| "nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ"(pāosūo4-2-3)ityaṇo "lubaviśeṣe"(pāosūo4-2-4)iti lup| adhikaraṇe kim? puṣyaḥ| puṣya pratīkṣate| puṣyāya spṛhayati|
atra kecit-sūtre pañcamyarthe saptamyau| lubantānnakṣatravācina iti vyācakhyuḥ| teṣāṃ lubantaviśeṣaṇānna syāt| "uttarābhyāṃ phālgunībhyāṃ nottarābhyāṃ gacchet" iti yatheti haradattaḥ|
|| iti śrīśabdakaustubhe dvitīyasyādhyāyasya tṛtīyapāde dvitīyamānhikam ||
|| tṛtīye pāde tṛtīyamānhikam ||
(pāosūo2-3-46)
prātipadikārthaliṅgaparimāṇavacanamātre prathamā(pāosūo2-3-46)| prātipadikārthamātre liṅgamātrādiṣu ca prathamā syāt| dvandvānte śrutatvātpratyekaṃ mātraśabdaḥ sambadhyate| sa cāvadhāraṇe| "mātraṃ kātya'vadhāraṇe"(aokoo3-3-186) ityamaraḥ| prātipadikārthādīnyeva tanmātramityasvapadavigrahaḥ| "mayūravyaṃsakādayaśca"(pāosūo2-1-72)iti samāsaḥ| prātipadikārthaḥ sattā| uktaṃ hi-"tasyāṃ sarve śabdā vyavasthitāḥ" iti|
tāṃ prātipadikārthaṃ ca dhātvarthaṃ ca pracakṣate| iti ca|
uccaiḥ| nīcaiḥ| atra hi parimāṇaviśeṣopahitaṃ sattāmātraṃ pratīyate ityāhuḥ| anye tu niyatopasthitikaḥ prātipadikārtha ityāhuḥ| asminpakṣe `vṛkṣaḥ kuḍya bhittiḥ' ityādīnāṃ niyataliṅgānāṃ prātipadikārthamātre prathametyeva siddham| liṅgamātre iti tu taṭastaṭītaṭamityādyartham| na hyatra puṃstvādi niyatopasthitikam| ataḥ liṅgamātrādhikye'pi vidhīyate| parimāṇamātre droṇo vrīhiḥ| iha hi droṇalakṣaṇaṃ yatparimāṇantatparicchinno vrīhirityarthaḥ| prakṛtyarthasya droṇasya pratyayārthe parimāṇe'bhedena saṃsargeṇa viśeṣaṇatā, pratyayārthaśca| vrīhiṣu paricchedyaparicchedakabhāvena saṃsargeṇa viśeṣaṇamiti bodhyam| vacanamātre-ekaḥ dvai bahavaḥ| vacanaṃ saṅkhyā tathaiva prācāṃ vyavahārāt| tatra prakṛtyā uktāyāmapi saṅkhyāyāṃ yathā syādityetadarthamidaṃ vacanam|
iha sūtre `arthaliṅgayoḥ prathamā'ityetāvadevāśyakam, itarattu vyartham| tathāhi prātipadikagrahaṇaṃ tāvadvyartham| ṅyāp prātipadikāddhi svādayo vidhīyante| tatrārthe ityapekṣāyāṃ yasmātsvādividhistadartha iti labhyata eva| parimāṇamapyanarthakam, `gaurvāhīkaḥ' ityādāviva mukhyārthamātre prathamānāṃ satyāṃ padāntarasamabhivyāhāreṇa gauṇārthapratītyupapatteḥ, vāhīke gotvasyeva vrīhyādau droṇatvāderāropasambhavāt| evaṃ vacanagrahaṇamapi vyartham, "na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā" iti "pratyayaḥ"(pāosūo3-1-1)"paraśca"(pāosūo3-1-2)iti sūtre vabhyamāṇatayāpratyayasyāvaśyakatvāt| ananvitavacanaprayogāpekṣaṇā anuvādakaprayogasyaiva nyāyyatvāt| mātragrahaṇamapi vyartham, "sambodhana ca"(pāosūo2-3-47)iti jñāpakena karmādyādhikye prathamāyā apravṛtteḥ| nanu `vīraḥ puruṣaḥ' ityādau abedasaṃsargasyādhikasya bhānāt prathamā na syāditi cet? na, saṃsargasya vākyārthatvena bahiraṅgatvātprathamapravaॉttasaṃskārabādhānupapatteḥ|
vārttikakārastvāha--abhihite prathameti| `vṛkṣastiṣṭhati' `kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ' `śatyaḥ' `prāptodako grāmaḥ' ityādau tiṅādibhirabhihite kartrādau prathamā bhavatītyarthaḥ| evañca `vīraḥ puruṣaḥ' ityādau satyapyādhikye abhihitatvāt prathamā siddheti| na ca `vṛkṣaḥ' `plakṣaḥ' ityādāvyāptiḥ, astītyadhyāhārāt|
atra bhāṣyam-abhihitenābhihitetiprasaṅga iti| tathāhi, `prāsāda āste' ityatra sadikriyāyāścāsikriyāyāścaikamadhikaraṇaṃ prāsādākhyaṃ tacca saderutpannena ghañābhihitam| āserlaṭā tvanabhihitam| tatra saptamīṃ bādhittvā paratvātprathamā syāt| atiṅsamānādhikaraṇe prathametyucyeta| tadapi na, `devadattaḥ pacati'ityādiṣu tiṅāṃ daurlabhyāpatteḥ| tathāhi, devadattaḥ paca laṭ iti sthite yāvattiṅo na kṛtāstāvattiṅasāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvāt prathamaiveti niyamo na pravarteta| tathā ca devadattaśabdādaviśeṣotpannāḥ sarve svādayaḥ santyeveti śatṛśānacau syātām| tannimittabhūtasyāprathamāntena sāmānādhikaraṇyasya satvāt| tiṅ‌vidhestu liṅgādiṣvavakāśaḥ| sa eva prathamaiveti niyamasyāpi "vido laṭovā"(pāosūo3-4-83)ityādestu vidimātraprayoge caritārthatā| yathā "vettha veda" ityādi| sthāninyapi madhyamottamayorvidhānādarthātprakaraṇādvā nirjñātasya prayogānāvaśyakatvācca| pākṣikaścāyaṃ doṣaḥ| śatrādividhau hi `aprathamā' ityādiḥ paryudāsaḥ prasajyapratiṣedho veti dvaitam, tatra dvitīye uktadoṣasyāsaṅgateḥ prathamāyā api satvena śatrādiniṣedhasambhavāt|
yattu bhāṣye paryudāsapakṣe"vibhaktiniyame doṣo na"ityuktamātaccintyam, tatra hi dvitīyā karmaṇyevetyādi vacanavyaktyāśrayaṇāt| devadatte dvitīyā mā bhūt, ṣaṣṭhī tu syādeva| sā hi śeṣa eveti niyamyate| yatra ya vibhaktyantarasya niyamo na pravṛttaḥ sa śeṣaḥ| tataśca tiṅaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyāt prāk śeṣalakṣaṇaṣaṣṭhyāṃ satyāṃ durvārau śatṛśānacāviti|
(pāosūo2-3-47)
sambodhane ca(pāosūo2-3-47)| iha prathamā syāt| he rāma|
(pāosūo2-3-48)
sāmantritam(pāosūo2-3-48)| sambodhane yā prathamā tadantaṃ śabdarūpamāmantritasaṃjñaṃ syāt| yadyapi saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantagrahaṇaṃ durlabhaṃ, tathāpi mahāsaṃjñākaraṇāllabhyate āmantraṇamāmantritam| abhedopacārāttatsādhane śabde vṛttiḥ| vibhaktyantena cāmantryate na tu kevalayā vibhaktyeti| saṃjñāpradeśāḥ, āmantritasya cetyādayaḥ| soti kim? prātipadikārthasūtreṇā'pi yā sambodhane prathamā tadantasyāpīyaṃ saṃjñā yathā syāt| he pacan, he pacamāna| iha hi śatṛśānacoḥ sambodhane vidhānādabhihitaḥ so'rtho'ntarbhūta iti pūrveṇaiva prathamā| yadi tu vibhaktirahitayostayoḥ kartrādyabhidhāna eva sāmarthyam| yathā dvirvacanarahitasya loṭaḥ, tenehāpi "sambodhane ca"(pāosūo2-3-47)iti pakṣaḥ| tadā seti māstu, `anantarasya vidhirvā" iti pravṛtte'pi rūpaniṣpatteḥ|
(pāosūo2-3-49)
ekavacanaṃ sambuddhiḥ(pāosūo2-3-49)| āmantritaprathamāyā yadekavacanaṃ tatsaṃbuddhisaṃjñaṃ syāt| hepaṭo| "sambuddhau ca"(pāosūo7-3-106)iti vartamāne "hrasvasya guṇaḥ"(pāosūo7-3-108)| su sambuddhiriti vācye ekavacanagrahaṇameko'rtha ucyate, yena tāvanmātrasya pratyayasya saṃjñārtham| anyathā prakramābhedāya tadantasya syāt|
(pāosūo2-3-50)
ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe(pāosūo2-3-50)| kārakaprātipadikārthavyatiriktaḥ svasvāmibhāvādiḥ śeṣastatra ṣaṣṭhī syāt| rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ| nanu pratyayaniyamapakṣe śeṣa evetyavadhāraṇārthamastu nāma śeṣagrahaṇam| arthaniyamapakṣe tu ṣaṣṭhyāścānyasya ca prāptau ṣaṣṭhyeveti niyamasambhavātkinteneti cet? na, uttarārthamavaśyakartavyasya śeṣagrahaṇasya spaṣṭārthamihaiva grahaṇam| na cāpradhānārtha śeṣagrahaṇam| tena dvayoḥ paryāyeṇa vā na syāditi vācyam, pratyayārthasya prādhānyenāpradhānādeva ṣaṣṭhyā nyāyyatvāt| aprakṛtyarthaṃ puruṣaṃ tu `rājñaḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhyarthasya viśeṣaṇatvamucitameveti dik|
(pāosūo2-3-51)
jñovidarthasya karaṇe(pāosūo2-3-51)| jānāterajñānārthasya karaṇe śeṣatvena vivakṣite ṣaṣṭhī syāt| samāsanivṛttyarthamidaṃ prakaraṇamiti "nanirdhāraṇe"(pāosūo2-2-14)iti sūtre "pratipadavidhānā ca"(kāovāo)iti vārtikasya pratyākhyānāvasare evopapāditam| sarpiṣo jñānam| vastutaḥ karaṇībhūtaṃ yatsarpistatsambandhinī pravṛttirityarthaḥ| jñānapūrvikāyāṃ pravṛttau jānāterlakṣaṇā|
(pāosūo2-3-52)
adhīgarthadayeśāṃ karmaṇi(pāosūo2-3-52)| eṣāṃ karmaṇi śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī syāt| "ik‌smaraṇe"(aopao1-47)kakāra ihaiva viśeṣaṇārtha-| adhiśabdoccāraṇantu sāmānyāpekṣajñāpakaṃ "iṅikāvadhyupasargaṃ na vyabhicarate" iti| ata eva smṛtyarthadayeṣāmiti noktam| sūtrabhaṅgapakṣe'pi hi kitvaṃ karttavyameva "iṇvadika"(kāovāo)ityatra viśeṣaṇārtham| "eḥ" ityukteḥ "kaṭīgatau"(kāovāo)ityatra praśliṣṭasyāyatergrahaṇāpatteḥ| mātuḥ smaraṇam| sarpiṣodayanamīśanaṃ vetyādivṛttyādigrantheṣvihapakaraṇe mātuḥ smaraṇam| sarpiṣodayanamīśanaṃ vetyādivṛttyādigrantheṣviha pakaraṇe udāharaṇaṃ pratyudāharaṇañca| yadyapi tiṅantaṃ dṛśyate, tathāpi tasarpamupalakṣamatayā'bhiyuktairvyākhyātameva|
(pāosūo2-3-53)
kṛñaḥ pratiyatne(pāosūda2-3-53)| karoteḥ karmaṇi śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī syāt guṇādhāne| edho dakasyopaskaraṇam| edhāścodakañceti vigrahe "jātiraprāṇinām"(pāosūo2-4-6)ityekavadbhāvaḥ| "upātpratiyatna"(pāosūo6-1-139)ityādinā suṭ|
(pāosūo2-3-54)
rujārthānāṃ bhāvavacanānāmajvareḥ(pāosūo2-3-54)| bhāvakartṛkāṇāṃ jvarivarjitānāṃ rujārthānāṃ karmaṇi śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī syāt| caurasya rogasya rujā| rujo bhaṅge(tuopao1416)| bhidādipāṭhātprakṛtasūtraeva nipātanādvāṅ| rujāśabdo vyādhau rūḍhaḥ| sūtraṃ bhāvavacanānāmiti kartari lyuṭ| prakṛtyarthastu na vivakṣitaḥ| tarhi bhāvo vaktā sambhavati| tasmāt pratyayasya sādhutvanirvāhāya vacirbodhyaḥ| ajvarisantāpyoriti vācyam(kāovāo)| rogasya caurajvaraḥ, caurasantāpo vā| rogakartṛkañcaurasambandhi jvarādikamityarthaḥ| taperhetumaṇṇyantāderac| iha samāso bhavatyeva|
(pāosūo2-3-55)
āśiṣi nāthaḥ(pāosūo2-3-55)| āśīrarthasya nāthataḥ śeṣe karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī syāt| sarpiṣo nāthanam| āśiṣīti kim? māṇavakanāthanam, tatsambandhinī yāñcetyarthaḥ| yadyapi karmatvavivakṣāyāṃ "kartṛkarmaṇoḥ"(pāosūo2-3-65)iti yadā ṣaṣṭhī tadā samāso bhavatyeva, tathāpi tatra kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ| samāsāntodāttatvaṃ tu yāñcādāveva na tvāśiṣīti niṣkarṣaḥ|
(pāosūo2-3-56)
jāsiniprahaṇanāṭakrāthapiṣāṃ hiṃsāyām(pāosūo2-3-56)| hiṃsārthānāmeṣāṃ śeṣe karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī syāt| jasu tāḍane(cuopao1718)jasu hiṃsāyām(cuo uo1668)iti ca curādiḥ, tasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ na tu daivādikasya jasumokṣaṇe(diopao1211)ityasya| jāsīti nirddeśāt hiṃsāyāmiti vacanācca| caurasyojjāsanam| niprābhyāmupasṛṣṭo hano niprahaṇaḥ| "hanteratpūrvasya(pāosūo8-422)iti ṇatvam| niprau saṃhatau viparyastau vyastau ca| caurasya niprahaṇanaṃ praṇihananaṃ nihananaṃ prahaṇanaṃ vā| praṇītyatra "nergada"(pāosūo8-4-17)iti ṇatvam| naṭa avasyandane(cuouo1545)curādiḥ| naṭa nṛttau(bhvāopao781)ityasya tu ghaṭāderagrahaṇam, dīrghanirddeśāt| caurasyonnāṭanam| kratha hiṃsāyām(bhvāopao81)iti ghaṭādau paṭhyate tasyeha nipātanādvṛddhiriti vṛttikāraḥ| ata eva "kratha hiṃsāyām" iti yujādau svaritetaṃ vadan, devastatraivānudāttetaṃ paṭhan, śākaṭāyanaśca matāntaraparatayā nīto mādhavādibhiḥ| caurasya krāthanam| mitvantu "ciṇṇamuloḥ"(pāosūo6-4-93)iti dīrghavikalpārtham| akrathi akrāthi| krathaṃ kratham| krāthaṃ krātham| iha hi nipātanaṃ bādhitvā paratvāddīrghavikalpaḥ|
yattu nyāsakṛtoktaṃ krāthīti vikṛtanirddeśāt mitve'pi vṛddhiryatra tatraiva ṣaṣṭhī| caṅante tu vṛddhyabhāvāt coramacikrathaditi| tanmandam, samāsanivṛttaye prakaraṇamidamiti siddhāntāt tiṅantānāmanudāharaṇatvāt caṅante'pi śeṣaṣaṣṭhyā durapahnavatvāditi mādhavaḥ| na ca krāthereva śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī na tu hrasvasyeti vyākhyānātprakaraṇaṃ bhitvā prakṛte tiṅantamapyudāharaṇamastviti nyāsasyāśayo vācyaḥ, evamapi dvitīyāyā durlabhatvāt prakramabhede mānābhāvācca| yadyapi haradattenoktaṃ ghaṭādipāṭhaḥ "ghaṭādayaḥ ṣitaḥ"(gaosūo)iti ātideśikaṣitve aṅ yathā syādityetadartha iti| tadapi mandam, "ghaṭādayaḥ ṣitaḥ"(gaosūo)iti hi madhye sūtritam| tena pūrveṣāmeva ṣitvaṃ na tu pareṣāmapi, paraścāyamiti dik| vṛṣalasya peṣaṇam| hiṃsāyāṃ kim? dhānapeṣaṇam| antodāttaḥ| śeṣa ityanuvṛtteḥ karmatvavivakṣāyāṃ dvitīyaiva| tathā ca bhaṭṭiḥ-"admo dvijāndevayajīnnihanmaḥ" iti| "nijaujasojjāsayituṃ jagad‌drūhām|(māo kāo1-37)iti māghastu śeṣatve bodhyaḥ|
(pāosūo2-3-57)
vyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ(pāosūo2-3-57)| śeṣekarmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī syāt| dyūte krayavikrayavyavahāre cānayostulyārthatā bodhyā| śatasya vyavaharaṇaṃ paṇanaṃ vā| śatasambadhī krayavikrayarūpeṇa viniyogo devanaṃ vetyarthaḥ| samarthayoḥ kim? śalākāvyavahāraḥ, gaṇanetyarthaḥ| brāhmaṇapaṇanam, stutirityarthaḥ| "āyādayaārdhadhātuke vā"(pāosūo3-1-31)iti āyasya vikalpaḥ|
(pāosūo2-3-58)
divastadarthasya(pāosūo2-3-58)| iha śeṣe iti na sambadhyate, uttarasūtradvayārambhāt| pūrvasūtraeva diveḥ pāṭhe tadarthasyeti na kartavyamiti| yadyapi lāghavaṃ tathāpi yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ| śeṣāsambandhārthaśca| vyavahṛpaṇisamānārthasya divaḥ karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī syāt| iha trisūtryāṃ tiṅantamapyudāharaṇam| śatasya dīvyati| tadarthasya kim? brāhmaṇaṃ dīvyati|
(pāosūo2-3-59)
vibhāṣopasarge|(pāosūo2-3-59)| pūrvayogāpavādaḥ| śatasya śataṃvā pratidivyati|
(pāosūo2-3-60)
dvitīyā brāhmaṇe(pāosūo2-3-60)| brāhmaṇaviṣaye prayoge divastadarthasya karmaṇi dvitīyā vā syāt| ṣaṣṭhyapavādaḥ| gāmasya tadahaḥ sa bhāyāṃ dīvyeyuḥ| sopasargasya chanadasi vyavasthitavibhāṣāyāpi siddhe nirupasargārtha ārambhaḥ|
(pāosūo2-3-61)
preṣyabruvorhaviṣo devatāsampradāne)pāosūo2-3-61)| iṣyaterdaivādikasya gatyarthasya loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanaṃ preṣyeti tatsāhacaryād bruvirapi tathābhūto gṛhyate| devatāsampradānaṃ yasyārthasya tatra vartamānayoḥ preṣyabrūhītyetayoḥ karmaṇorhavirviśeṣasya vācakācchabdāt ṣaṣṭhī syāt| agnaye chāgasya haviṣo vapāyā medasaḥ preṣyānubrūhi vā| preṣyabruvoḥ kim? agnaye chāgaṃ havirvapāmedo juhudhi| haviṣaḥ kim? agnaye gomayāni preṣya| devatāsampradāne kim? māṇavakāya puroḍāśānpreṣya! haviṣaḥ prasthitatvena viśeṣaṇe pratiṣedhā vaktavyaḥ(kāovāo)| indrāgnibhyāṃ chāgaṃ havirvapāmmedaḥ prasthitaṃ preṣya iha sūtre śeṣagrahaṇaṃ na sambadhyate, tiṅantena samāsasyāprasaktatvāt| idañca bhāṣāyāmapi pravartate, uttaratra chandograhaṇāt|
(pāosūo2-3-62)
caturthyarthe bahulaṃ chandasi(pāosūo2-3-62)| ṣaṣṭhī syāt| puruṣa mṛgaścandramase godhākālakādārvāghāṭaste vanaspatīnām, vanaspatibhya ityarthaḥ|(kāovāo)| yā kharveṇa pibati tasyai kharvaḥ| vyatyayavacanātsiddham|
(pāosūo2-3-63)
yajeśca karaṇe(pāosūo2-3-63)| iha chandasi bahulaṃ ṣaṣṭhī syāt| ghṛtasya ghṛtena vā yajate|
(pāosūo2-3-64)
kṛttvorthaprayoge kāle'dhikaraṇe(pāosūo2-3-64)| iha ṣaṭ‌sūtryā vicchinnamapi śeṣagrahaṇamanuvarttate, uttarasūtre karmagrahaṇāt| "karttari ca"(pāosūo2-2-16)iti hi noktam| śeṣasambaddhaṃ karmagrahaṇaṃ mānuvṛtaditi prāñcaḥ| vastuto vyākhyānameva śaraṇam, sannihitasyādhikaraṇasya nivṛttaye vā karmagrahaṇasambhavāt| pañcakṛtvohno bhojanam| dviranho bhojanam| śeṣe kim? anyathā vidhirevāyaṃ syāt| tathāca dvirahanyadhīta iti saptamī na syāt| ṣaṣṭhyā bādhāt|
(pāosūo2-3-65)
kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti(pāosūo2-3-65)| śeṣe iti nivṛttam| kṛdyoge kartari karmaṇi ca ṣaṣṭhī syāt| bhavataḥ śāyikā| apāṃ sraṣṭā| kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kim? śastreṇa bhettā|
syādetat, iha kartṛkarmabhyāṃ kriyā ākṣipyate| tadvācīha dhātureva| dhātośca dvaye pratyayāḥ-kṛtastiṅśca| tatra tiṅaḥ prayoge "naloka"(pāosūo2-3-69)iti pratiṣedhena bhāvyam| tataśca pariśeṣāt kṛdyogaeva ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyati tat kiṃ kṛdgrahaṇena? maivam, taddhitāntasya vāraṇīyatvāt, yathā kṛtapūrvīkaṭamiti| nanu kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ pūrvamanenetyasminvigrahe ktasya karmaṇi vidhānāttenaiva karmaṇo'bhihatatvāt dvitīyayā na bhāvyam| evaṃ tadapavādabhūtayā ṣaṣṭhyāpi, ihāpyanabhihitādhikārāt| kiñca kṛtaśabdasya kaṭasāpekṣatayā samāso durlabhaḥ| evaṃ taddhato'pīti cet? atroktaṃ hariṇā--
viśeṣakarmasambandhe nirbhukte'pi kṛtādibhiḥ|
viśeṣanirapekṣo'nyaḥ kṛtaśabdaḥ pravarttate||
akarmakatve satyevaṃ ktānte bhāvābhidhāyini|
tataḥ kriyāvatā kartrā yogo bhavati karmaṇām||
avigrahā gatādisthā yathā grāmādikarmabhiḥ|
kriyā sambadhyate tadvat kṛtapūrvyādiṣu sthitā|| iti|
asyārthaḥ-kṛtādibhiḥ śabdaiḥ kaṭādisamabhivyāhārāt viśiṣṭakarmasambandhe niṣkṛṣya bhukte'pi anubhūte'pi kṛtaḥ pūrve kaṭo'nenetyavasthāyāmiti bhāvaḥ, tasyāmavasthāyāṃ vṛttivirahāt| karmasāmānyavacanonya eva kṛtaśabdaḥ pravartate vṛttiṃ labhate| avivakṣitakarmatāyāṃ neha pacyate ityādāvapi karmasāmānye pratyayābhyupagamāditi bhāvaḥ|
avivakṣitakarmaṇāṃ bhāve pratyaya iti matāntaramāha-akarmakatva iti| nanukarmasāmānye bhāve vā ktapratyaye kṛte sāpekṣatvābhāvāt "supsupā" iti samāse kṛte "pūrvādiniḥ"(pāosūo5-2-86)"sapūrvācca"(pāosūo5-2-87)iti karttari inipratyayo'stu nāma| kaṭasya tu prathamapakṣe ktenābhidhānaṃ durvāram| yathā śakyañca "kṣudupahantum" ityatra kṣudhaḥ kṛtyapratyayena| maivam, taddhitārthenaikārthībhūtasya kṛtaśabdārthasya niṣkṛṣya kaṭena sambandhābhāvāt|
tadetadāha-tataḥ kriyāvateti| nanvevaṃ kriyayāpi thogābhāve kathaṃ dvitīyetyāśaṅkyāha-avigraheti| viśiṣya graho grahaṇaṃ tadrahitāprādhānyenāgṛhyamāṇāpītyarthaḥ| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-guṇabhūtayāpi kriyayā kārakāṇāṃ sambandho dṛśyate, yathā kaṭaṃ kṛtavāniti| kṛtapūrvīśabdaścāyaṃ pūrvaṃ kṛtamanenetyasminnarthe vyutpāditaḥ| pūrvaṃ kṛtavānityanena samānārthaḥ sampadyate| tatra karotikriyāpekṣamasti kaṭasya karmatvam| anabhihitañca tat| ato'sati kṛdgrahaṇe ṣaṣṭhī syādeveti sthitam|
syādetat, odanaḥ yacyatetamāṃ, "gururdharitrī kriyatetarāntvayā"(māokāṃo)ityādāvapi odane dharitryādeḥ karmaṇaḥ kriyayaiva yogād dvitīyaiva syāt| kriyāviśeṣaṇībhūtena lakārārthena karmānvayaścet ktārthenāpyastu| kriyāyāḥ kārakeṣviva śakterapi śaktimatyutthitākāṅkṣakatvāviśeṣāt| kiñcāstu nāma kathañcit ktārthaparityāgena vṛttiḥ, rājapuruṣādau saṅkhyāviśeṣasya māsajātādau guṇapradhānabhāvādeśca bahuśastyāgadarśanāt| tathāpi kṛdgrahaṇaṃ vyarthameva, "naloka"(pāosūo2-3-69)iti niṣṭhāyoge niṣedhasiddheḥ| niṣṭhāntadhātūpāttikriyāyoge na bhavatīti hi tadarthaḥ| `grāmaṃ gatavān' ityādāvapi kārakāṇāṃ kriyayaivānvayāt| na ca `pācayati yajñadatto devadattena' ityatra ṇicprakṛtyarthaṃ prati kartuḥ prayojyātṣaṣṭhīṃ vārayituṃ kṛdgrahaṇam| ṇic tu na kṛditi bācyam, layoge netyeva niṣedhasiddheḥ| laprakṛtyā lāntapadena vā yā kriyopāttā tadyoge netyarthāt| sā ca kriyā guṇabhūtā pradhānabhūtā vetyatra nāgrahaḥ| gauṇamukhyanyāyakṣtu nāśrīyate, lakṣyānurodhāt svaritenādhikaḥ kāra iti vyākhyānācca| ata eva tatra tṛtīyā labhyate| `bhedikā devadattasya' `yajñadattasya kāṣṭhānām" ityatrebhābhyāṅkartṛbhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyapyata eva| tasmādvyarthaṃ kṛdgrahaṇamiti|
atrāhuḥ, kṛtyeva yathā syāttaddhitādhikye mā bhūditi kṛdgrahaṇam| vyākaraṇaṃ prājñaḥ| "prajñādibhyaśca"(pāosūo5-4-38)iti svārthe'ṇ| evañca vadatāṃ mate pācakatamaḥ' ityatrāpi ṣaṣṭhī neti labhyate| kṛtapūrvītivatkartavyapūrvītyāderabhyupagame tu tavyadādyantena samāsādinau kṛte kṛdgrahaṇavyāvartyatāpi sambhavati| bhāṣyaṃ tvihotādīnamevetyabhiyuktaprayogā anveṣaṇīyāḥ| "thantarhi dhayai rāmodamuttamam" iti bhaṭṭiḥ| ucyate, anityeyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī, tadarhamiti nirddeśāt| dvikarmakebhyastu kartari kṛti kṛte pradhāne niyatāṣaṣṭhī, guṇe tūbhayathā bhavedityakathita sūtre evoktam|
(pāosūo2-3-66)
ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi(pāosūo2-3-66)| ubhayoḥ prāptiryasminkṛti tatra karmaṇyeva ṣaṣṭhī syāt| āścaryo gavāṃ doho'gopena| akākārayoḥ prayoge pratiṣedho neti vaktavyam(kāovāo)| bhedikā bibhitsā vā rudrasya jagataḥ| kathantarhi ktinā bādhā na bhavatoti, "sthāgāpāpacobhāve"(pāosūo3-3-95)iti sūtre vṛttiḥ| tathā suṭā sīyuṭo bādhā na bhavatīti, "suṭtithoḥ"(pāosūo3-4-107)ityatra vṛttiḥ atra rakṣitaḥ-apratyayādityakārapratyayasyeha grahaṇam, prāthamyāt| bādhāśabde tu "gurośca halaḥ"(pāosūo3-3-103)ityakāra ityāha karaṇatvavivakṣāyāṃ tṛtīyeti vā bodhyam| śeṣe vibhāṣā(kāovāo)| strīpratyayaviṣayamevedamityeke| vicitrā sūtrasya kṛtiḥ pāṇineḥ pāṇininā vā| kecidaviśeṣeṇa vibhāṣāmicchanti| śabdānāmanuśāsanamācāryeṇācāryasya vā|
(pāosūo2-3-67)
ktasya ca vartamāne(pāosūo2-3-67)| vartamānārthaktasya yoge ṣaṣṭhī syāt| "naloka"(pāosūo2-3-69)iti niṣedhasyāpavādaḥ| rājñāṃ mato buddhaḥ pūjito vā| "matibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca"(pāosūo3-2-188)iti vartamāne ktaḥ| kathantarhi napuṃsake bhāve ktasya yoge ṣaṣṭhī, `chātrasya hasitam' iti śeṣavijñānātsiddham| kartṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ tṛtīyaiva, `chātreṇa hasitam' iti|
(pāosūo2-3-68)
adhikaraṇavācinaśca(pāosūo2-3-68)| ktasya yoge ṣaṣṭhī syāt| idameṣāṃ śayitam| iha kartari ṣaṣṭhī| sakarmakebhyastvadhikaraṇe kte kṛte kartūkarmaṇordvayorapi ṣaṣṭhī, anabhihitatvāviśeṣāt| idameṣāṃ bhuktamodanasya| "ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi" ityayaṃ tu niyamaḥ "kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti" ityasyā eva prāpteḥ| iha gatyartheṣu dhātuṣvayaṃ bhavati| idameṣāṃ gatimityadhikaraṇe| idamete gatā iti kartari| idamebhirgatamiti karmaṇi| ihaibhirgatamiti napuṃsake bhāve| kartṛvivakṣāyā idameṣāṃ gatamiti tatraiva śeṣavivakṣāyām|
(pāosūo2-3-69)
nalokāvyayaniṣṭhākhalarthatṛnām(pāosūo2-3-69)| jighṛkṣitarūpavināśaprasaṅgāt tṛnāmiti ṇatvaṃ na kṛtam| eṣāṃ prayoge ṣaṣṭhī na syāt "kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti"(pāosūo2-3-65)iti prāptā pratiṣidhyate| lādeśāḥ-odanaṃ pacan pacamānaḥ pecānaḥ pecivān| kathantarhi-"babhrirvajraṃ" "papiḥ somaṃ" "dadirgāḥ"iti| nahi kikinau lakārau nāpi tadādeśau| naiṣadoṣaḥ, "kikinau liṭca"(pāosūoeo3-2-171)ityanena liṭakāryātideśaḥ kriyate, na tu liṭsaṃjñā| "viśeṣātideśe ca sāmānyamapyatidiśyate" iti| u--kaṭaṃ cikīrṣuḥ| kanyāmalaṅkariṣṇuḥ| uka--vārāṇasīmāgāmukaḥ| kamerbhāṣāyāmaniṣedhaḥ(kāovāo)| purā sūryasyodetorādheyaḥ| purā krūpsya visṛpovirap‌śin| niṣṭhā-odanaṃ bhuktavān| devadattena kṛtam| khalartha-tvayā sukaram| īṣatpānaḥ somo bhavatā| tṛnniti pratyāhāḥra, "śatṛśānacau" ityārabhya tṛno nakārāt| tena śānprabhṛtīnāmapi grahaṇam| somaṃ pavamānaḥ| "pūṅ‌yajoḥ śānan"(pāosūo3-2-128)| naṭamāghnānaḥ| "tācchīlyādiṣu cānaśa" adhīyan pārāyaṇam| "iṅdhāryoḥ"(pāosūo3-2-130)iti śatā| tṛn, pātā sutamindro astu somam| dviṣaḥ śaturvā| murasya muraṃ vā dviṣan| sarvatra kārakaṣaṣṭhyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ| śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī tu syādeva| brāhmaṇasya kurvan| satyānuraktā narakasya jiṣṇavaḥ| chātrasya hasitam| janikarturityādi|
ikṣvākūṇāṃ durāpe'rthe tvadadhīnā hi siddhayaḥ|
api vāgadhipasya durvacaṃ vacanaṃ tadvidadhīta vismayam|(kiokāo2-2)ici ca|
yadvā, "ikṣvākūṇāṃ siddhayaḥ" ityanvayo na tu "ikṣvākūṇāṃ durāpe" iti| tathā "vāgadhipasya vismayam" ityanvayo na tu "vāgadhipasya durvacam" iti dik| iha uśca ukaśca ūkāviti vyutpādya laśca ūkau ceti vigrahītavyam| ūkāreṇa ca kṛto viśeṣaṇāttadantavidhiḥ| vyapadeśivadbhāvātkevalenāpi niṣedhaḥ|
(pāosūo2-3-70)
akenorbhaviṣaayadādhamarṇyayoḥ(pāosūo2-3-70)| bhaviṣyatyakasya bhaviṣyadādhamarṇyārthe naśca yoge ṣaṣṭhī na syāt| edhānāhārako vrajati| vrajaṅgāmī| dvitīyāsamāsaprasaṅge vyutpāditametat| ādhamarṇye-śataṃ dāyī| bhaviṣyaditi svaryate| tena bhaviṣyadadhikāravihitasya grahaṇānneha-varṣaśatasya pūrakaḥ| putrapautrāṇāṃ darśakaḥ| ayaṃ hi, "ṇvultṛcau"(pāosūo3-1-133)ityaviśeṣeṇa vihito na tu "tumuṇvulau"(pāosūo3-3-10)itivadbhavinaṣyadadhikārasthaḥ| iha yathāsaṃkhyaṃ vārayituṃ bhāṣyeyogo vibhaktaḥ| akasya bhaviṣyati, iti ādhamarṇye ceti|

atrāhuḥ, tolanaṃ tulā| asminneva sūtre "ṇilugaṅoḥ" nipātanātsādhuriti mādhavaḥ| upamitirupamā| tatra dhātvarthaṃ prati karaṇībhūtayoḥ dantavāsaḥśambhuśabdayostṛtīyā yuktaiva| yathā-upamīyate'nenetyādau| prakṛtasūtraṃ tu śeṣe ṣaṣṭhyapavādabhūtatṛtīyāvidhāyakam| neha pravarttate ityanyadetat|
