gavāśvaprabhṛtīni ca(pāosūo2-4-11)| etāni dvandvarūpāṇi kṛtaikavadbhāvāni sādhūni syuḥ| gavāśvakam| gavāvikam| gavaiḍakam| ajāvikam| ajaiḍakam| eṣāṃ paśudvandvavibhāṣāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam| kubjavāmanam| kubjakairātam| putrapautram| śvacāṇḍālam| strīkumāram| dāsīmāṇavakam| uṣṭrakharam| śāṭīpracchadam| ihāprāṇijātivācināmabahuprakṛtyarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| uṣṭraśaśam| mūtraśakṛt| mūtrapurīṣam| yakṛnmedaḥ| māṃsaśoṇitam| darbhapūtīkam| arjunapuruṣam| tṛṇolayam| dāsīdāsam| atra "pumān striyā"(pāosūo1-2-67)ityekaśeṣo na| kuṭīkuṭam| māṃsaśoṇitam| bhāgavatībhāgavatam| gavā śvaprabhṛtiṣu "yathoccāritaṃ dvandvattam" iti vārttikam| gaṇapāṭhe rūpameṣāṃ vivakṣitaṃ na tu pūrvottarapadanirddeśamātre tātparyamityarthaḥ| tena avaṅāde'śobhāvapakṣe na bhavati| apaśavo vā anye goaśvebhyaḥ paśavo goaśvāḥ|
vibhāṣā vṛkṣamṛgatṛṇadhānyavyañjanapaśuśakunyaśvavaḍavapūrvāparādharottarāṇām(pāosūo2-4-12)| vṛkṣādīnāṃ saptānāṃ dvandvaṃ aśvavaḍavetyādi dvandvatrayaṃ ca vibhāṣā ekavatsyāt| vṛkṣādau viśeṣāṇāṃ grahaṇam| tathāhi, vṛkṣādiśabdaiḥ pratyekaṃ dvandvo viśeṣyate| na caiko vṛkṣaśabdo dvandvaḥ| na ca dvayoḥ sahaprayogaḥ, ekaśeṣāt| evaṃ paryāyayorapi, virūpāṇāmapi samānārthanāmekaśeṣārambhāt| nāpi `vṛkṣaśca dhavaśca' ityādi, sāmānyaviśeṣayorvācanikadvandvaniṣedhasyoktatvāt| na ca prācyabharateṣviti nirddeśādanityaḥ sa iti vācyam, tathāpi `vṛkṣadhavam' ityādi, prayogādarśanena niṣedhasyaiva prakṛte pravṛtteḥ| tasmādviśeṣāṇāmeveha grahamaṃ sthitam| plakṣanyagrodham, plakṣanyagrodhāḥ| rurupṛṣatam, rurupṛṣatāḥ| kuśakāśam, kuśakāśāḥ| vrīhiyavam, vrīhiyavāḥ| dadhighṛtam, dadhighṛte| gomahiṣam, gomahiṣāḥ| tittirikapiñjalam, tittirikapiñjalāḥ| aśvabaḍavam, aśvavaḍavau| pūrvāparam, pūrvāpare| adharottaram, adharottare|
atra vārttikam-bahuprakṛtiḥ phalasenāvanaspatimṛgaśakunikṣudrajantudhānyatṛṇānāmiti(kāovāo)| eṣāṃ bahupraka-tireva dvandva ekavadityarthaḥ| neha-badarāmalakau, rathikāśvārohau, plakṣanyagrodhāvityādi| idaṃ vārttikaṃ vidhyantaraśeṣabhūtaṃ na tu svātantryoṇa vidhāyakam| vidhitve hi sa nityaścettarhi vanaspatyādīnāmetatsūtropāttānāmapi bahuprakṛtitve viklapaṃ bādhitvā nityaṃ syāt| abahuprakṛtikatve ca sautro vikalpaḥ syāt| vaikalpikatve tu phalādināmapi "nātiraprāṇinām"(pāosūo2-4-6)ityādilakṣaṇāntaraprāptaṃ nityamekavadbhāvaṃ bādhitvā bahuprakṛtikatve vikalpaḥ syāt| na ca "badarāmalakaṃ, badarāmalakāni" iti bhāṣyadarśanādiṣṭāpattiriti vācyam, tatra badarāmalakānīti kvācitkaḥ pāṭhaḥ, so'pi badarāmalakānītyevaṃ prāpte jātilakṣaṇo nitya ekavadbhāva iti vyākhyena iti kaiyaṭenoktatvāt| yattu nitye ekavadbhāve prāpte vikalpo'nena kriyate iti matāntaraṃ kaiyaṭenoktam| tadāpātataḥ, "badarāmalake tiṣṭhataḥ" iti taduttarabhāṣyavirodhāt| uktarītyā prakṛtavārttikasya bahuprakṛtike vikalpavidhiparatve hi anyatra nitya ekavadbhāvo durvāraḥ syāditi dik|
(pāosūo2-4-12)
tatrāpi yadi "vibhāṣā vṛkṣa"(pāosūo2-4-12)ityatra paṭhitatvādasyaiva śeṣaḥ syāt, tadā vanaspatyādiṣvabahuprakṛtitve vikalpābhāve'pi "jātiraprāṇinām"(pāosūo2-4-6)iti nityo vidhiḥ syāt| tasmātsarvaprakaraṇaśeṣo'yam| eṣāṃ phalādīnāṃ dvandvo'nena lakṣaṇāntareṇa vā ekavadbhavan bahuprakṛtireveti| tena "plakṣanyagrodhau" ityatra ayaṃ vikalpo "jātiraprāṇinām"(pāosūo2-4-6)iti nityaśca na bhavati| evaṃ vrīhiyavau kuśakāśāvityādi|
prakṛtasūtropāttānāntu ityaṃ viṣayavibhāgaḥ-ye'vāprāṇinasteṣāṃ "jātiraprāṇinām"(pāosūo2-4-6)iti nityaṃ prāpte vikalpo vidhīyate| sa ca teṣāṃ taireva| tathāca vṛkṣādīnāmanyaiḥ saha dvandve yathāprāptaṃ nityaṃ vikalpo vā| tadyathā-`vrīhikuśaplakṣam' ityatra "jātiraprāṇinām"(pāosūo2-4-6)iti nityaḥ| `plakṣaśabdasparśe, `plakṣaśabdasparśāḥ' ityatra tu "cārthe dvandvaḥ"(pāosūo2-2-29)ityubhayatra| na ceha "jātiraprāṇinām"(pāosūo2-4-6)ityasya pravṛttiḥ, adravyajātitvāt| aprāṇināmiti hi paryudāsa ityuktam| paśugrahaṇantu hastyaśvādiṣu senāṅgalakṣamasya nityavidherbādhanārtham| mṛgaśakunigrahaṇaṃ tvavaśiṣyate| tatretthaṃ vacanaṃ vyajyate-yo vibhāṣāprāpta ekavacano dvandvaḥ sa mṛgaviśeṣāṇāṃ taireva nānyairiti| tenaiṣāmanyaiḥ saha itaretarayoga eveti phalitam| evaṃ `pūrvāparam' `adharottaram' ityatrāpi| paśudvandvatvādeva siddhe aśvavaḍavagrahaṇaṃ pratipadavidhānārtham| tenaikavadbhāvapakṣe "pūrvavadaśvavaḍavau"(pāosūo2-4-27)ityetad‌bādhitvā "sa napuṃsakam"(pāosūo2-4-17)iti pravartate| tacchabdo hi ekavadbhāvabhājaṃ parāmṛśati| tena ekavadbhāvavannapuṃsakatvamapi pratipadavihitaṃ sampadyate| "pūrvavadaśvavaḍavau"(pāosūo2-4-27)iti tvekavadbhāvavirahapakṣe pravarttate| aśvavaḍavau| aśvavaḍavān||
(pāosūo2-4-13)
vipratitiṣiddhaṃ cānadhikaraṇavāci(pāosūo2-4-13)| viruddhārthānāmadravyavācināṃ dvandva ekavadvā syāt| atredaṃ niyamaśarīram-yaekavacano dvandvo vibhāṣā prāptaḥ, sa yadi vipratiṣiddhavācināṃ bhavati, tadā adravyavācināmeveti| tena dravyavācināmitaretarayoga eva| śītoṣṇo udake staḥ| vipratiṣiddhaṃ kim? nandakapāñcajanyam| iha dravyavācitve'pi pākṣikaḥ samāhāradvandvo bhavatyeva| yattu vṛttau `kāmakrodhau' iti pratyudāhṛtaṃ, tatrāpi `śītoṣṇaṃ' `sukhaduḥkham' ityādāviva pākṣikasyaikavadbhāvasya durvāratvāt| niyamārthaṃ hi prakṛtasūtramiti sthitam| na ca adravyavācināñcedbhavati tarhi vipratiṣiddhānāmeveti tadāśayaḥ kalpyaḥ, "śītoṣṇa udake" ityatra pākṣikaikavadbhāvāpattyā "anadhikaraṇavācīti kim? śītoṣṇe udake" ityevaṃrūpasvoktivirodhāpatteḥ, sautrānupūrvīsvarasabhaṅgaprasaṅgācceti dik|
(pāosūo2-4-14)
na dadhipayaādīni(pāosūo2-4-14)| etāni naikavatsyuḥ| dadhipayasī| madhusarpiī| sarpirmadhunī| iha triṣu vyañjanatvādvikalpaḥ prāptaḥ| brahmaprajāpatī| śivavaiśravaṇau| skandaviśākhau| na ceha virūpāṇāmapīti ekaśeṣaḥ śaṅkayaḥ,
"skandaścaiva viśākhaśca dvau sutau saṃbabhūvatuḥ|"
iti mahābhāratasvarasenāparyāyatvanirṇayāt| parivrāṭkauśikau| pravargyopasadau| śuklakṛṣṇe| idhmābarhiṣī, nipātanāddīrghaḥ| dīkṣāta pasī| śraddhātapasī| medhātapasī| adhyayanatapasī| ulūkhalamusale| ādyavasāne| śraddhāmedhe| ṛksāme| vāṅmanase| iha brahmaprajāpatyādiṣu samāhāradvandvaniṣedhamukhenetaretarayogadvandvo vyavasthāpyate| tatsāhacaryāt| `dadhipayasī' ityādāvapi tathaiva| tena tatra vyañjanatvaprayuktavikalpe niṣiddhe'pi jātilakṣaṇo nitya ekavadbhāvo'stviti na śaṅkanīyam| niṣiddhe'pi jātilakṣaṇo nitya ekavadbhāvo'stviti na śaṅkanīyam| kiñca ṣaṭsvasrādibhyaḥ"(pāosūo4-1-10)ityatra striyāṃ yaduktaṃ tanneti| sāmānyato niṣiddhyate| tathāca vakṣyati-doṣastvitve tasmānnobhāviti| nanu bhavedevaṃ yadi "jātiprāṇinām"(pāosūo2-4-6)iti vidhiḥ syāt, niṣedhastu saḥ| tathāca tenetaretarayoge prakṛtasūtreṇa samāhāre ca niṣedhāddadhipayaādīnāṃ dvandva eva na labhyeta|
atrocyate-niyamavākyānāṃ vidhirūpeṇa nivedharūpeṇa vā pravṛttiriti pakṣadvayaṃ tāvatpratyayalakṣaṇasutre upapāditam "d‌yudbhayo luṅi"(pāosūo1-3-91)ityādau bhāṣyārūḍhaṃ ca| tatra "jātiraprāṇinām"(pāosūo2-4-6)ityādau vidhimukhatāpakṣasyaiva labhyānurodhenāśrayaṇāttasya ca "na dadhi"(pāosūo2-4-14)ityādinā niṣedhātsarvaṃ sustham|
(pāosūo2-4-15)
adhikaraṇaitāvattve ca(pāosūo2-4-15)| dravyasaṅkhyāvagame naikavatsyāt| daśa dantoṣṭhāḥ| nanu varttipadārthasya saṅkhyāviśeṣe bodhanīye itaretarayogadvandva eveti nyāyasiddham| anyathā hi "daśapañcapūlyaḥ" iti dvigāviva pradhānabhūte samāhāra eva daśatvasaṅkhyā anviyāt na tu samudāyādiṣu tatkiṃ niṣedhena? satyam, nānena samāhāradvandvo niṣidhyate, kintu prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāra eveti yo'sau niyamaḥ sa eva niṣidhyate| asati hi niṣedhe
pañcasvihāsyāṅ‌ghrikareṣvabhikhyā bhikṣā'dhunā mādhukarīsadṛkṣā|
ityādīnāmasādhutvaṃ syāt, samāhāra eveti niyamenetaretarayoge dvandvasya durlabhatvāt| tathāca saṅkhyāvagatāvekavadeveti niyamo na syāditi sūtrārthaḥ phalitaḥ| tasmāditaretarayogadvandvasya pratiprasavārthamidam| etena "daśa dantoṣṭhāḥ" ityādau samāhāradvandvasyevetaretarayogadvandvasyāpi daurlabhyādvākyameva prayojyam| adhikaraṇaitāvattvecetyanena prāṇyaṅgānāṃ samāhāra evetyanena cobhayorniṣedhāditi pratyuktam| "daśa brāhmaṇa kṣatriyāḥ" ityādau prāguktanyāyabalenaiva samāhāradvandvo vāraṇīyaḥ|
(pāosūo2-4-16)
vibhāṣā samīpe(pāosūo2-4-16)| adhikaraṇaitāvattvasya sāmīpyena paricchittau samāhāra evetyevaṃrūpo niyamo vā syāt| upadaśaṃ dantoṣṭham| upadaśā dantoṣṭhāḥ| "avyayaṃ vibhakti"(pāosūo2-1-6)ityādinā subantasāmānyena vidhīyamāno'vyayībhāvaḥ saṅkhyayāpi bhavati| bahuvrīhistu "saṅkhyayāvyayāsannā"(pāosūo2-2-25)ityādinā viśiṣya vihitaḥ| tatraikavadbhāvapakṣe avyayībhāvo'nuprayujyate| ekārthasya tvekārtha evāntaraṅga| aikārthyeñca sāmīpyapradhānatvāt| yadyapyavyayībhāvo niḥsaṅkhyastathāpi bhedābhāvarūpamaikārthyaṃ bodhyam| sāmānādhikaraṇyantu sāmīpyatadvatorabhedavivakṣayā| adhikaraṇaitāvattvaṃ tu samāhārasamāhāriṇorabhedavivakṣayā| pakṣāntare tu bavharthasya bavhartho bahuvrīhirevānuprayujyate| bavharthatvañca tasya samīpiprādhānyāt| yadi tūbhayatrāvyayībhāva evānuprayujyate, tadā tasyāvyayatvād bahutvābhāvād‌bahuvacanaṃ na syāt| satyapi vā tasminnamabhāve kṛte `upadaśā' iti na syāt, bahuvrīherevānuprayoge tu upadaśasya pāṇipādasyeti ṣaṣṭhī syāt| upadaśaṃ pāṇipādasyeti ceṣyati| tasmādyathoktameva manoramam|
(pāosūo2-4-17)
sa napuṃsakam(pāosūo2-4-17)| samāhāre dvigurdvandvaścanapuṃsakaḥsyāt| paravalliṅgāpavādaḥ| pañcagavam| dantoṣṭham| prakaraṇādevānuvādyalābhe sagrahaṇametatprakaraṇānupāttasyāpi samāhāradvandvasya saṅgrahārtham| tathā ca "yuvoranākau"(pāosūo7-1-1)ityādāvucyate-yuvoriti samāhāradvandve "sanapuṃsakam"(pāosūo2-4-17)iti klībatvaṃ syāditi| ata eva prayujyate "kāryakālaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam" iti| akārāntottarapado dviguḥ striyāmiṣṭaḥ(kāovāo)| ata ityadhikāre "dvigo"(pāosūo4-1-21)iti ṅībvidhānamiha liṅgam| pañcamūlī| vābantaḥ(kāovāo)| pañcakhaṭ‌vī, pañcakhaṭvī, pañcakhaṭvam| strītvapakṣe upasarjanahrasvatvam| ano nalopaśca vā ca dviguḥ striyām(kāovāo)| pañcatakṣaṃ, pañcatakṣī| "uttarapadatve cāpadādividhau"(kāovāo)iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhāt padatvābhāvānnalopavacanam| pātrādyantasya pratiṣedhaḥ| pañcapātram| tribhuvanam| caturyugam| dvisamāsam| pātrādirākṛtigaṇaḥ|
(pāosūo2-4-18)
avyayībhāvaśca(pāosūo2-4-18)| ayaṃ napuṃsakaṃ syāt| adhistri| unmattagaṅgam| pūrvapadārthapradhānasya aliṅgatve'nyapadārthapradhānasya tu viśeṣyaliṅgatve prāpte idamucyate| anuktasamuccayārthaścakāraḥ| tatphalantu "puṇyasudinābhyāmanhaḥ"(kāovāo)puṇyāham| sudināham| karmadhāraye "rājāhassakhibyaṣṭac"(pāosūo5-4-91)| "rātrānhāhāḥ puṃsi"(pāosūo2-4-29)ityasyāpavādaḥ| sudinaśabdaḥ praśastavācī| tathā ca prayujyate-
sidināsu sabhāsukāryametat pravacinvīta viśeṣataḥ svayañca| iti|
teneha dināhaḥśabdayoḥ sahaprayogavirodho na śaṅkanīyaḥ| pathaḥ saṅkhyāvyayāde(kāovāo)trayāṇāṃ panthāḥ tripatham| virūpaḥ panthāḥ vipatham| prādisamāsaḥ kathantarhi-"atipanthāḥ supanthāśca"(aokoo2-1-16)ityamaraḥ? ucyate, patha iti kṛtasamāsāntātprathamā; saṃkhyāvyayarūpādeḥ paraḥ kṛtasamāsāntaḥ pathaśabdaḥ klībamityarthaḥ| pathaḥ klībateti pāṭhe'ti saṅkhyādipathaśabdasyāvyabhicaritasamāsāntatayā tatsāhacaryādavyayāderapi tathābhūtasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bodhyam| tathāca klībaliṅgakārikā-pathaḥ saṅkhyāvyayātpara iti| na ceha samāsāntosti, " na pūjanāt"(pāosūo5-4-59)iti niṣedhāt| kathantarhi "satpathaścārcite'dhvani" iti? svatibhyāmeveti parigaṇanāt| atha kathaṃ-
ityamaraḥ(aokoo2-1-16)? atra kṣīrasvāmidurghaṭādayo vipathaṃ kāpathamityeva pāṭhaḥ kartavyo liṅgakārikādyanurodhādityāhuḥ| evantu "vyadhyau vipathakāpathau" iti rabhasakośe'pi paṃstvaṃ prāmādikamiti labhyate| vastutastu pathe gatau ityasmātpacādyaci pathate vyāpnotīti pathaḥ, akārānto'yam| tathāca trikāṇḍaśeṣaḥ, "vāṭaḥ pathaśca mārgaḥ syāt" iti| tena samāse puṃstvanna| na caivaṃ `vipathaḥ' iti siddhāvapi `kāpatho' na syātkādeśasya durlabhatvāditi vācyam, īṣadarthe ceti tatsambhavāt, kutsāyamarthataḥ paryavasānāt| yattvakārāntasyābhyupāme "patho vibhāṣā"(pāosūo5-4-72)iti sūtraṃ vyarthaṃ syāditi mādhavenoktam| tatrāyaṃ samādhiḥ-"apathaṃ napuṃsakam"(pāosūo2-4-30)iti sūtre kṛtasamāsāntanirddeśasāmarthyāt "nañastatpuruṣāt"(pāosūo5-4-71)ityasya nityaṃ bādhaḥ prāptaḥ| na ca so'pyakārāntasya nirdeśaḥ, "pathaḥsaṅkhyāvyayādeḥ"(kāovāo)ityatrāpi tathātvāpattau satyāmapatho vipathaḥ kāpatha ityādyasiddhyāpatteḥ| kiñca "rātrānhāhāḥ"(pāosūo2-4-29)iti sūtrātparam "apathaṃ napuṃsakam"(pāosūo2-4-30)iti sūtre vārttikaṃ paṭhyate| tathāca prakramānurodhātkṛtasamāsāntanirddeśa eva nyāyyaḥ sampradāyasiddhaśca| ata e "apathaṃ napuṃsakam"(pāosūo2-4-30)iti sūtrasya vārttikena gatārthatāmāśaṅkaya sūtrasya prācyatvādadoṣa iti kaiyaṭaḥ| evaṃ sthite `apanthāḥ' ityetatsiddhaye "patho vibhāṣā"(pāosūo4-5-72)iti sūtram, amarasya ca na pūrvāparavirodha ityavadheyam|
prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ-idaṃ klībatvavidhānaṃ paravalliṅgatāyā apavādaḥ| tena "vipathā nagarī" iti bahuvrīhau na| panthānamatikrāntā'tipathetyatrāpi na| iha hi "dviguprāptāpannālaṃpūrvagatisamāseṣu na"(kāovāo)iti paravalliṅgatā pratiṣiddhā| yadyevamutpathamiti pratīkamupādāya "kugati"(pāosūo2-2-18)iti tatpuruṣa iti kaiyaṭo virudhyate| maivam, na hi tatra `patha udgataḥ' ityādivigrahaḥ, kintu utkṛṣṭaḥ panthā iti| tathā ca paravalliṅgameva prāptam| tasmāduttarapadārthaprādhānya evedaṃ liṅgavidhānamiti sthitam| spaṣṭañcedaṃ mādhavagranthe| yattu vṛttigranthe `supatham' ityudāhṛtam| tatra sukhabdasya| vaipulyamartho na tu pūjeti samāsāntaḥ kṛta iti mādhavaḥ| kriyāviśeṣaṇānāñca kriyāyā asattvarūpatvāttadviśeṣaṇānāṃ tadvadaliṅgatve prāpte vacanamidaṃ vārttikānārūḍhamapi vṛttikāreṇa kṛtamityāhuḥ| mṛdu pacati| prathamaṃ pacati| "sāmānye napuṃsakam"(kāovāo)iti vā siddham| ata e niyataliṅgeṣu nedaṃ pravarttate| ādiṃ pacati| ādibhūtā yā viklittistāṃ karotītyarthaḥ| dhātūpāttabhāvanāmprati karmatvāttatsāmānādhikaraṇyādvā dvitīyā| ata eva `sakṛllvau' ityādau kārakapūrvādyaṇityākaraḥ| na ca sakalakārakāṇāṃ kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāt klībatāpattiḥ śaṅkyā, kārakāṇāṃ vibhaktyarthatvarūpatvācca| śaktyādhārastu yadyapi dravyaṃ nāmārthaśca; tathāpi nāsau kriyāṃ prati viśeṣaṇaṃ, kintu kriyāviśeṣaṇībhūtakārakaviśeṣaṇamiti bodhyam| ata eva nāmārthasya bhedena dhātvarthānvayo neti siddhāntaḥ| `stokaṃ pacyate' ityādāvapi dhātvarthavyāpyasyaiva taṇḍulādernābhidhānaṃ na tu dhātukroḍīkṛtasyāpi "bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ"(pāosūo3-4-69)ityatra viśeṣaṇasāmarthyādbāhyakarmagrahaṇe "laḥ karmaṇi"(pāosūo3-4-69)ityatrāpi tathaiva nirṇayāt| ato dhātunā kroḍīkṛtasya viśeṣaṇaṃ dvitīyāntameva, na tu abhihitatvaprayuktaprathamāntam| na vā "stokamodanasya paktā" ityatra stokaśabdāttkṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī| yatra tu bhāvanāmprati karaṇatayā dhātvarthaviśeṣasyānvayastatra viśeṣaṇānāṃ tṛtīyāntataiva "jyotiṣṭomena yajeta" iti yathā| spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ "karaṇe yajaḥ"(pāosūo3-2-85)iti sūtre vṛttipadamañjaryoḥ| na caivaṃ "jyotiṣṭomena samīcīnaṃ yajet" iti na syāditi vācyam, bhāvanāviśeṣaṇatve tadupapatteḥ| tatra ca prathamāntataiva| sandarśanaprārthanādibhirvyāpyamānatvātkriyāyā api kṛtrimakarmatve tu tadviśeṣaṇatve'pi dvitīyaiva| tadiha kriyāviśeṣaṇānāṃ klībatetyuktatvāt| ekavacanamapyutsargaḥ| `hataśāyikāḥ śayyante' ityādau bahuvacanasyāpi "sārvadhātuke yak"(pāosūo3-1-67)iti sūtre vakṣyamāṇatvāditi dik| `prātaḥkamanīyam' ityādyavyayaviśeṣaṇe tu klībatvaṃ yadyapi tulyaṃ tathāpi prathamaikavacanameva na tu dvitīyaikavacanam, karmatābhāvanāt| prātarādiriti tu niyataliṅgameveti dik| yadyapyetāni vārttikāni bhāṣye "apathaṃ napuṃsakam"(pāosūo2-4-30)ityatra paṭhitāni tathāpi "avyayībhāvaśca"(pāosūo4-3-59)iti cakārasūcitārthakathanaparāṇītyāśayena vṛttyanurodhādihaiva vyākhyātāni|
(pāosūo2-4-19)
tatpuruṣo'nañkarmadhārayaḥ(pāosūo2-4-19)| adhikāro'yam| karmadhārayaśabdo bhāvapradhānaḥ| dvandvagarbho nañā bahuvrīhiḥ| na vidyete nañ ca karmadhārayatvaṃ cetyubhe yatra sa tatpuruṣa ityarthaḥ| vakṣyati "vibhāṣā senāsurā"(pāosūo2-4-25)ityādi| tatpuruṣaḥ kim? dṛḍhaseno rājā| nañ‌rahitaḥ kim? asenā| karmadhārayatvarahitaḥ kim? paramasenā| madhyamasūtreṣvayamadhikāro nātīvopayujyata iti tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ|
(pāosūo2-4-20)
saṃjñāyāṃ kanthośīnareṣu(pāosūo2-4-20)| kanthāntastatpuruṣaḥ klībaṃ syātsā ceduśīnaradeśotpannāyāḥ kanthāyāḥ saṃjñā| susamasyāpatyāni sauśamayaḥ, teṣāṃ kanthā sauśamikantham| saṃjñāyāṃ kim? vīraṇakanthā| ūśīnaradeśeṣu kim? dākṣikanthā| ihānādiḥ saṃjñā gṛhyate| sā cośīnareṣu tatpuruṣabhinnā nañsamāsarūpā karmadhārayaśca nāstevetīha mandamaghikārasya phalam|
(pāosūo2-4-21)
upajñopakramantadādyācikhyāsāyām(pāosūo2-4-21)| upajñāyate ityupajñā| "ātaścopasarge"(pāosūo3-1-136)iti karmaṇyaṅ pratyayaḥ| upakramyate ityupakramaḥ| karmaṇi ghañ| "nodāttapadeśasya"(pāosūo7-3-34)iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ| upajñānta upakramāntaśca tatpuruṣo napuṃsakaṃ syāt, tayorupajñopakramayorādiḥ prāthamyañcedākhyātumiṣyate| pāṇinerupajñā pāṇinyupajñaṃ granthaḥ| tvadupakramaṃ saujanyam| icchāsaneha vivakṣaiva śabdavyutpattau niyāmikā na tu vastusthitiriti jñāpyate| tena kriyāsambandhamātravivakṣāyāṃ na `devadattopajño rathaḥ' ityādi| iha ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣādvinā tadāditvāsampratyayādalabhyamadhikāraphalam|
(pāosūo2-4-22)
chāyā bāhulye(pāosūo2-4-22)| chāyāntastatpuruṣo napuṃsakaṃ syād bāhulye sati cecchāyām| yāni sambhūyopajīvyāṃ chāyāmārabhamāṇānyāvarakadravyāṇi tatsamarpakātpūrvapadātparaśchāyāśabdaścedityarthātphalati| ata eveha nādhikāraḥ phalavān| ikṣūṇāṃ chāyā ikṣucchāyam| "vibhāṣāsenā"(pāosūo2-4-25)ityādervikalpasyāpavādo'yam| kathantarhi `ikṣucchāyāniṣādinyaḥ'(raovaṃo4-20)iti? ucyate, āsamantānniṣādinya ityāṅpraśloṣo bodhyaḥ|
(pāosūo2-4-23)
sabhā rājā'manuṣyapūrvā(pāosūo2-4-23)| rājapūrvā amanuṣyapūrvāca yā sabhā tadantastatpuruṣo napuṃsakaṃ syāt| inasabham| īśvarasabham| paryāyasyaiveṣyate| tathāhi, arājeticchedaḥ| nañivayuktanyāyāccārājā rājasadṛśastatparyāyo gṛhyate| neha, rājasabhā| candraguptasabhā| kathaṃ "nṛpatisāmagamanna vepamānā"(maobhāo)iti kīcakavadhe? gajapativadrājaviśeṣavācitvāditi rakṣitaḥ| yadvā, nā patiryasyāṃ sabhāyāmiti bahuvrīhau kṛte paścātkarmadhārayaḥ| anañ‌karmadhāraya ityanuvṛtterna klībatvam| amanuṣyaśabdo rūḍhyā rakṣaḥpiśācādīnāha| rakṣaḥsabham| rūḍhyarthābhāvānneha-kāṣṭhasabhā|
(pāosūo2-4-24)
aśālā ca(pāosūo2-4-24)| śālāvācī saṅghātavācī ca sabhāśabdaḥ| tatra rājāmanuṣyapūrvatve pūrvasūtreṇa pūrvasya klībatvamuktam| saṅghātavācinastu anena vidhīyate| strīsabham, strīsaṅghāta ityarthaḥ| aśālā kim?anāthasabhā, anāthakuṭītyarthaḥ|
(pāosūo2-4-25)
vibhāṣā senāsurācchāyāśālāniśānām(pāosūo2-4-25)| etadantasya tatpuruṣasya klībatā vā syāt brāhmaṇasenam, brāhmaṇasenā| yavasuram, yavasurā| kuḍyacchāyam, kuḍyacchāyā| gośālam, gośālā| śvaniśam, śvaniśā kṛṣṇa caturdaśītyāhuḥ| tasyāṃ hi śvāna upavasantīti prasiddhiḥ| "śunaścaturdaśyāmuvasataḥ paśyāmaḥ" iti tiryagadhikaraṇe śābarabhāṣyam|
(pāosūo2-4-26)
paravalliṅgaṃ dvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ(pāosūo2-4-26)| etayoḥ parapadasyaiva liṅgaṃ syāt| kukkuṭamayūryāvimau, mayūrīkukkuṭāvimau| ardhaṃ pippalyā ardhapippalī|
syādetat yadi samāsārthasya paravalliṅgatvamanenātidiśyate, tarhi "pūrvavadaśvavaḍavau"(pāosūo2-4-27)iti sūtreṇāpi nyāyasāmyātsamāsasyaivātideṣṭavyam| tataśca ṭāp śrūyate samāsārthasya puṃstve'pi uttarapadārthasya strītvānapagamāt| yattu "gaustriyoḥ"(pāosūo1-2-48)iti hrasva iti| tanna, "cārthe dvandvaḥ"(pāosūo2-2-29)ityatrānekamityadhikārātsarveṣāṃ prathamānirdiṣṭatve'piṃ prādhānyādupasarjanasañjñāvirahāt| anvarthasaṃjñā hi sā| ata eva rājñaḥ kumāryāḥ rājakumāryā ityatra na hrasva ityuktam| ata eva ca `kukkuṭamayūryau' ityatra na hrasvaḥ| nanu māstvanvarthatā| tathāca `aśvavaḍavau' iti siddhyati| `rājakumāryāḥ' `kukkuṭamayūryau' ityatra tu hasve kṛte punaḥ strīpratyayāt| siddham| taduktam-`paravalliṅgamiti śabdaśabdārthau iti| tathāhi, liṅgaśabdena liṅgābhidhāyī pratyayo'rthaśca gṛhyate, tantrādyāśrayaṇāt| evañca dvandvārthasya tatpuruṣārthasya ca parasyeva liṅgaṃ syāt| tadabhidhāyī pratyayaśca parasyeveti sūtrārthaḥ| tathā ca yatra `dravyaguṇau' `guṇakarmaṇī' ityādau liṅgābhidhāyī pratyayo na sambhavati tatrārtha evātidiśyate| ubhayasambhave tūbhayam| yathā `kukkuṭamayūryau' ityādau| tataśca aupadeśikasya hrasvatve'pyātideśikasya śravaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati| na ca punarhrasvaḥ śaṅkyaḥ, anupasarjanatvāttadanyasyāprātipadikatvācca| na caivamapi `dattāgārgyāyaṇyau' `dattākārīṣagandhye' ityatra hrasvatve kṛte samāsātpunaḥ phak‌ṣyaṅau syātāmiti vācyam, "bhsāyaṭhaḍhe taddhite"(kāovāo)iti pūrvotpannayernivṛttisambhavādiṣṭāpatteriti| maivam, `dttā ca yuvatiśca dattāyuvatī' ityatra tipratyayadvayaśravamāpatteḥ| tatrābhatvena puṃvadbhāvāyogāt| tasmādupasarjanatvaṃ dvandve nāstyeva anvarthatvāditi sthitam| `aśvavaḍavau' ityatra strīpratyayanivṛttau upāyāntaraṃ vaktavyamiti|
atrocyate, "vibhāṣāvṛkṣamṛga"(pāosūo2-4-12)itisūtre'śvavaḍavetyatra ṭāpo nivṛttirnipātyate| taduktam-"samāsādanyalliṅgamiti cedaśvavaḍavayoṣṭābalugvacanaṃ nipātanāt siddham" iti| "dviguprāptāpannālaṃpūrvagatisamāseṣu pratiṣedho vaktavya"(kāovāo)| pañcasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtaḥ pañcakapālaḥ puroḍāśaḥ| prāpto jīvikāṃ prāptajīvikaḥ| āpannajīvikaḥ| alaṅkumāriḥ| niṣkauśāmbiḥ| bhāṣye tvetatpratyākhyātam| tathāhi, tatpuruṣagrahaṇaṃ na kariṣyate| paravalliṅgaṃ dvandvasyetyeva| kathaṃ `pūrvakāyaḥ' `arddhapiplī' iti? ekadeśisamāso'pi nārabhyate| karmadhāraya evāyaṃ-pūrvaścāsau kāyaśca, arddhañcāsau pippalī ceti| tataśca prādhānyādevottarapadārthasya liṅgaṃ bhavati| na ca ṣaṣṭhīsamāsabādhanārthamekadeśisamāso'vaśyārabdhavya iti vācyam, iṣṭatvādanabhidhānācca| tathāhi, "dvitīyatṛtīya"(pāosūo2-2-3)ityatrānyatarasyāṅgrahaṇātsūtrakārasyāpina ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa iṣṭaḥ, ardhaśabdenāpi ṣaṣṭhīsamāso bhāṣyakārāṇāmiṣṭa iti prāgevoktam| `pūrvāparam' ityatra tvanabhidhānātṣaṣṭhīsamāso na bhaviṣyatīti| idañca pratyākhyānaṃ durbalam, anabhidhānāśrayaṇamagatikagatiriti sanpratyayavidhau bhāṣya evoktatvāt|
(pāosūo2-4-27)
pūrvavadaśvavaḍavau(pāosūo2-4-27)| dvivacanamatantram| arthātideśaścāyam| paravalliṅgatāpavādaḥ| aśvavaḍavau, aśvavaḍavān, aśvavaḍavairjavanairityādi| "vibhāṣā vṛkṣa"(pāosūo2-4-12)ityādisūtreṇa samāhāradvandvapakṣe tu "sa napuṃsakam"(pāosūo2-4-17)inatyeva bhavati, tacchabdena viśiṣya parāmarśārthamevāsvavaḍavagrahaṇāt| anyathā paśugrahaṇenaiva siddhau| tadvaiyarthyāpatterityuktam|
(pāosūo2-4-28)
hemantaśiśirāvahorātre ca cachandasi(pāosūo2-4-28)| pūrvavadityanuvartate| hema ntaśca śiśire ca hemantaśiśirau| atredamavadheyam, śiśiraśabdaḥ punnapuṃsakayoḥ| tathāca cakravajrāndhakāreti sūtre timiraśiśirāṇi napuṃsake ceti bhagavānpāṇiniḥ| amaro'pi-"hemantaḥ śiśiro'striyāmā"(aokoo1-4-19)ityāha| tathā cātra sūtre "rātrānhāhāḥ"(pāosūo2-4-29)iti puṃstvaṃ prāptam| dvitvamantatram| ahorātrāṇi vidadhat| na cedaṃ samāhāradvandve satyekaśeṣātsiddhamiti vācyam, tatrāpi puṃstvasyottarasūtre vakṣyamāṇatvāt| chandasi liṅgavyatyayo vakṣyate tasyaivāyaṃ prapañcaḥ| loke tu duḥkhe hemantaśiśire| ahorātrau puṇyau|
(pāosūo2-4-29)
rātrānhāhāḥ puṃsi(pāosūo2-4-29)| etadantau dvandvatatpuruṣau puṃsyeva| rātreḥ pūrvo bhāgaḥ pūrvarātraḥ| ekadeśisamāsaḥ| "ahaḥ sarvaikadeśa"(pāosūo5-4-87)ityac samāsāntaḥ| pūrvāhṇaḥ| "rājāhaḥ sakhibhyaḥ"(pāosūo5-4-91)iti ṭac| "anho'nha etebhyaḥ"(pāosūo5-4-88)ityanhādeśaḥ| "anho'dantāt"(pāosūo8-4-7)iti ṇatvam| dvyahaḥ| "na saṃkhyāde) samāhāre"(pāosūo5-4-89)ityanhādeśābhāvaḥ| "anhaṣṭakhoreva"(pāosūo6-4-185)iti ṭilopaḥ| paravalliṅgāpavādo'yaṃ yogaḥ| vṛttau tu ete puṃsītyuktam| tatrāpyetadantā ityartho bodhyaḥ| yattu rātrādīnāmevānena puṃstve kṛte tadantasya "paravalliṅgam"(pāosūo2-4-26)ityeva siddhamiti| tanna, samāhāre napuṃsakatvāpatteḥ| eravalliṅgatvāpavādo hi "sa napuṃsakam"(pāosūo2-4-17)iti yogaḥ| na ca napuṃsakatve iṣṭāpattiḥ, `dvirātraḥ' `trirātraḥ' iti vṛttikārīyodāharaṇavirodhāt| taddhi samāhāre dviguriti sarvai rvyākhyātam| amaro'pi prāyuṅkta-"tena tu triṃśadahorātraḥ"(aokoo1-4-12)
iti, "māsena syādahorātraḥ"(aokoo1-4-22)iti ca| tasmāttadantasyaivāyaṃ puṃstvavidhiḥ| yadyapi sannidhānātparavalliṅgatāyā evāyamapavādastathāpi paratvānnapuṃsakatāṃ bādhate|
atredaṃ cintyam-uktarītyā `ahorātraḥ' ityatra puṃstvamastu| dvirātrādau tu vṛttikāraharadattādyuktaṃ puṃstvamasaṅgatam, tatra viśiṣṭaklībaṃtāvidheḥ| tathāca liṅgānuśāsanasūtram| "āpathapuṇyāde napuṃsake"(liosūo132)| "saṃkhyāpūrvā rātriḥ"(liosūo132)iti| amaro'pyāha-"rātraiḥ prāk saṃkhyayānvitam"(aokoo3-5-25)iti "gaṇarātraṃ niśābavhyaḥ"(aokoo1-4-6)iti ca| anuvākādayaḥ puṃsatī vaktavyam(kāovāo)| anuvākaḥ| śaṃyuvākaḥ| sūktavākaḥ| vākyaviśeṣasyaitāḥ sañjñāḥ| karmaṇi ghañantā iti napuṃsakatve prāpte vacanam|
(pāosūda2-4-30)
apathaṃ napuṃsakam(pāosūo2-4-30)| idaṃ napuṃsakaṃ syāttatpuruṣe| samāsāntare tu apatho deśaḥ| apathā nagarī| kṛtasamāsāntanirddeśānneha-apanthāḥ|
(pāosūo2-4-31)
ardharcāḥ puṃsi ca(pāosūo2-4-31)| ardharcādayaḥ śabdāḥ puṃsi klībe ca syuḥ| te ca gaṇaratne saṃgṛhītāḥ| tadyathā--

idamo'nvādeśe'śanudāttastṛtīyādau(pāosūo2-4-32)| anvādeśaviṣayasyedamo'nudātto'ś‌ādeśaḥ syāttṛtīyādau| prate babhrūvicakṣaṇaṃ śaṃsāmi, mābhyāṅgā anu| iha babhrūśabdenoktayoridamā parāmarśepyanvādeśo bhavatyeva "anvādeśaśca kathitānukathanamātram, na tu idamā kathitasyedamaivānukathanam iti bhāṣyokteḥ| na caivam "īṣadarthe" iti śloke yacchabdenoktasya punaḥ kathanāt `etam ātam' ityatrainādeśaḥ syāditi vācyam, kiñcidvidhāyānyadvidhātumanukathanasyaivānvādeśatvāt| īṣadarthādivṛttestvanuvāde'pyavidhānāt| aśādeśavacanaṃ sākackārtham| anyathā'nvādeśe'kṣātārthavivakṣāyām `imakābhyām' ityāpi prasajyeta| nanu tyadādyatvena siddhau vidhānasāmarthyātsarvādeśo'stu kiṃ śittvena? maivam, `ābhyām' `ebhiḥ' ityādau vikārābhāvārthatāpatteḥ, morājītivat| nanu `ābhyāmindrapakvam' ityādāvanvādeśatvavivakṣāvirahe yathā "ūḍidam"(pāosūo6-1-171)iti vibhakterudāttatā, tathā "mābhyāṃ gāḥ" ityatrāpi kuto neti cet? na, tatra prakṛteranudāttavidhānāt "ūḍidam" iti sūtre ca "antodāttāduttarapadāt"(pāosūo6-1-169)iti sūtrādantodāttādityasyānuvarttanāt| tathācānvādeśe `ābhyām' ityādeḥ sarvānudāttatā, itaratra tvantodāttateti vivekaḥ|
syādetat, "sāvekācaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-168)ityudātteneha bhāvyam, "suḥ saptamībahuvacanam" iti bhāṣye vṛttau coktatvāt| yattu "ūḍidam" iti sūtre haradattenoktam--iha "antodāttāt"(pāosūo6-1-129)ityanuvṛttisāmarthyāt `sāvekācaḥ'(pāosūo6-1-168)ityapi na pravarttate| na ca "yadīmenāuśataḥ" itiśaso vyāvṛttau sāmarthyopakṣayaḥ, ekājgrahaṇenaiva tadvyāvṛtteḥ| ekāca ityasya cāvaśyānuvarttyatvāt| anyathā "grīvāyāṃ baddho api kakṣa āsani" "matsyaṃ nadīna udani kṣipantam" ityatrātiprasaṅgāt| `āsan' ityādayo hyantodāttā evādeśāḥ sūtre paṭhitā iti|
atredaṃ vaktavyam--`ābhyām' ityatra "sāvekācaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-168)ityasya prāptireva nāsti saptamībahuvacaneṣu `eṣu' iti rūpaṃ na tādṛgihāsti| tathācātraivāntodāttagrahaṇasya caritārthatvātsāmarthyavirahaḥ| tathā ca "mābhyāṅgāḥ" "tadasya priyam" "tadasmai navyam" ityādeḥ siddhāvapi bhisādau doṣastadavastha eva| "ebhiragre" "sunvanti somānvacasi tvameṣām" "preṇā tadeṣāṃ nihitam" "eṣu dhāvīravat" ityādau hi e ityeva rūpamastyeva| tathāca tatra vibhakterudāttaprasaṅgaḥ| na ca "sāvekācaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-168)ityetatsūtrasthakaiyaṭaparyālocanayeṣṭāpattiriti vācyam, anyetviti vadatā kaiyaṭena tanmate'svarasāviṣkaraṇāt| tadbījantu bahutaravaidikaprayogavirodha eva|
athocceta--"sāvekācaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-168)iti sūtre haradattoktarītyā suḥ prathamaikavacanameva| na ca `tvayā' ityatrātiprasaṅgaḥ, sāvavarṇeti niṣedhāt| śeṣelopaṣṭilopa iti pakṣe tu sāvekāctvābhāvātprāptireva nāsti| rūpavivakṣāpi viphalā| evañca `ebhiḥ' ityādau prāptireva nāstīti| tadapi na, rūpavivakṣābhāve `doṣabhyām' ityatrāti prasaṅgāt| taittirīye hi "aṃsābhyāṃ svāhā doṣabhyāṃ svāhā" iti madhyodāttaṃ paṭhyate| evaṃ sthite suḥ saptamībahuvacanameva grāhyam| anyathā "indro yā to vasitasya rājā" ityatra yā ityantodāttaṃ na syāt| nahi prathamaikavacanaṃ yadrūpaṃ yāniti tadihāsti| ata eva gośunoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ sārthakaḥ| tadevamantodāttānuvṛttisāmarthyaṃ prathamaikavacanagrahaṇaṃ vā śaraṇamityevaṃrūpasya ṣāṣṭhaharadattagranthabalalabdhasya samādhānadvayasyāpi duṣṭāvāt `ebhiḥ' ityādi kathannirvāhyamiti phalitaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ|
atrocyate, "sāvekācaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-168)ityatrāpi "antodāttāt"(pāosūo6-1-169)ityasyāpakarṣānnoktadoṣaḥ| vṛttyādā vananuvarttitasyāpyanuvṛttistu bahudhā dṛṣṭaiva| ata eva "turustu"(pāosūo7-3-5)sūtre `stuvīta' ityādisiddhaye pitītyasya nivṛttyai sārvadhātukagrahaṇamiti sthite `śāmyati' iti śyanamiṭaṃ vārayituṃ tiṅītyasyānuvṛttirvakṣyate|

etadastratasostratasau cānudāttau(pāosūo2-4-33)| anvādeśaviṣaye etado'ś‌ syātsa cānudāttastratasoḥ parataḥ tau cānudāttau staḥ| etasmin grāme sukhaṃ vasāmaḥ, atho'trādhīmahe, ato na gantāsmaḥ| `atra ataḥ' iti pade sarvānudātte| nanu pañcame "etado'n"(pāosūo5-3-5)itibhāṣyasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ| nyāsarītyā vṛttipāṭho'pyevameva| padamañjarīrītyā tu "etado'ś" iti vṛttipāṭhaḥ| ubhayathāpi akāre siddhe kimaneneti cet? pāñcamikasyodāttatayā'nudāttārthamiha punarvacanamiti gṛhāṇa| `tratasoḥ' iti vacanaṃ nimittabhāvārtham| anyathā 'tratasau cānudāttau" ityanvācayo vijñāyet|
syādetat, tratasoḥ kṛtayoḥ prakṛterlitsvaraḥ| tataḥ śeṣanighātena tratasoranudāttatvaṃ siddham| aśmātrasya tvanudāttatvaṃ vidhīyatām| maivam, tratasorhi kṛtayoḥ "yenanāprāpti" nyāyenāpavādatvānnityatvāccānudātto'śādeśaḥ syāt| tatastadvidhānasāmarthyāllitsvarasyāpravṛttāvutsargaḥ pratyayasvara eva tratasoḥ syāt| yathā-`goṣpadam' ityatra ṇamullopena sahavidhānāllitsvarāpravṛttau pratyayādyudāttatve sati kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāntodāttaṃ padaṃ bhavati| tasmāt "trataso cānudāttau" iti kartavyameva|

(pāosūo2-4-62)
tadrājasya bahuṣu tenaivāstriyām| (pāosūo2-4-62)|| bahuṣvartheṣu vidyamānasya tadrājasya luk syāttenaiva lugbhāgjātīyenaiva kṛte cedvahutvaṃ, na tu striyām| aṅgāḥ| vaṅgāḥ| suhyāḥ| puṇḍrāḥ| magadhāḥ| "te tadrājāḥ"(pāosūo4-1-174)ityañādīnāmiha saṃjñā| lohadhvajāḥ| vrīhimatāḥ| iha tu "ñyādayastadrājāḥ"(pāosūo5-3-119)iti| tadrājasyeti kim? aupagavāḥ| rāghavāḥ| yādavāḥ| kathantarhi "raghūmāmanvayaṃ vakṣye" iti "nirudhyamānā yadubhiḥ kathaṃcit" iti ca?
ucyate, raghvapatye raghuśabdo lakṣamayā vartate| etacca "bahvaca iñaḥ"(pāosūo2-4-66)iti sūtre padamañjaryāṃ spaṣṭam| nanvevaṃ "paraśca"(pāosūo3-1-2)iti sūtre `babhrurmaṇḍurlamaka' ityādīnāmapaśabdatvaparaṃ bhāṣyaṃ virudhyeteti cet? na, bhāṣyasya śaktibhramaprayuktaparatvāt| iṣyete hi goṇīśabdasya goṇīsādṛśyaśaktibhramābhyāṃ gavi prayuktasya sādhutvāsādhutve| etena-
so'yamityabhisambandhāttaddhitena vinā yadi|
babhvādayaḥ prayujyerannapatyaniyamo bhavet||
iti hariśloko'pi vyākhyātaḥ| bahuṣu kim? āṅgaḥ| vāṅgaḥ| tenaiva kim? āṅgadevadattayajñadattāḥ| yadyapīha bahutvamāṅge'pyanveti tathāpi nedaṃ lugbhājo'rtha eva viśrāntam, devadattādigatatvāt| nanvevaṃ "bhārgavaśca vātsyaśca āgrāyaṇaśca bhṛguvatsāgrāyaṇāḥ" ityatra luṅ na syāt, uttarasūtreṣvapi tenaivetyadhikārāt| āgrāyaṇe ca naḍādiphako lugabhāvāt?
satyam, tenaivetyasya tajjādīyeneti vyākhyātatvādadoṣaḥ| apatyatayeha sājātyāt| yadyevaṃ `gārgyaśca kāśyapaśca gālavaśca' ityatra gālave ṛṣyaṇo lugabhāve'pi apatyatayā sājātyādyañañorlukprasaṅgaḥ|
atrāhuḥ, lopyalopibhirapatyapratyayaiḥ kṛte bahutve vikalpaḥ| "bhṛguvatsāgrāyaṇeṣu" "agārgyakāśyapagālavānām" ityumayathāpi sūtranirddeśāt| astriyāṃ kim? āṅagyaḥ striyaḥ|
syādetat, āṅgasyāpatyāni bahūni-"aṇo dvyacaḥ"(pāosūo4-1-156)iti phiñ| tasya "tadrājāccāṇaḥ" iti gaṇasūtreṇa "abrāhmaṇagotramātrāt"(kāovāo)iti vārttikena vā luk| aṅgāḥ| baidasyāpatyāni bahūni-"ata iñ"(pāosūo4-1-95)| "ṇyakṣatriya"(pāosūo2-4-58)iti luk| bidāḥ| atra yūni bahutvānvaye'pi gotrasya tadrājavācyasyaikyālluṅ na syāt| kiñca bidānāmapatyaṃ māṇavakaḥ baidaḥ, baidau| atra yuvabahutvābhāve'pi gotrabahutvādativyāptiḥ|
satyam, "gotrasya bahuṣu lopino bahuvacanāntasya pravṛttau dvyekayoraluk" "ekavacanadvivacanāntasya pravṛttau bahuṣu lopo yūni" iti vārttikadvayena siddham|
yadvā, avyāptyuddhāraḥ sūtreṇāpi sukaraḥ| tathāhi, tadrājāntaṃ yadvahuṣviti vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| na caiva pratikṛtibahutve'tiprasaṅgaḥ, tenaivetyasya `lopipratyayārthajātīyena' ityarthāt| gotrayūnorapatyatayā sajātīyatve'pi pratikṛtervijātīyatvāt| nāpi `baidau' ityatrātivyāptiḥ| "gotre'lugaci"(pāosūo4-1-89)iti sūtreṇa iñi vivakṣita evāluk‌pravṛtteḥ| na ca yūnyupasaṅ‌kramānantaraṃ punaryuvabahutva iva tadradvitvaikatvasthale lukaḥ prāptirasti yuvabahutve tu punarluk| na ca punaraluk śaṅkyaḥ, "samarthānāṃ prathamāt'(pāosūo4-1-82)ityadhikārāt| vibhaktivipariṇāmena hi gotrapratyayasya prathamasya alugityarthaḥ| prāthamyaṃ ca arthāntare'nupasaṅ‌krāntatvam| atha eva `ātribharadvājikā' iti siddhyati| atrerapatyāni "itaścāniñaḥ"(pāosūo4-1-122)iti ḍhak| bharadvājasyāpatyāni bidādyañ| tata ubhayatra yuvabahutve "ata iñ"(pāosūo4-1-95)tasya "ṇyakṣatriya"(pāosūo2-4-58)iti luk| ḍhako "atribhṛgu"(pāosūo2-4-65)iti, año "yañañośca"(pāosūo2-4-64)iti| tato atribharadvājānāṃ maithuniketi dvandvād vun, tasyākādeśaḥ| yadi dvitīyamarthamupasaṃkrāntasyāpi aluk syāttadā ihāpyañaḥ sa syāt| gopavanādigaṇe gargabhārgāvikāgrahaṇaṃ ceha jñāpakam| gargaśabdādyañ, tasya luk| bhṛguśabdādṛṣyaṇ, tadantādyūni "ata iñ"(pāosūo4-1-95), tasya luk| gargabhṛgūṇāṃ maithuniketi vun| atrātribhṛgviti prāptalukaṃ niṣed‌dhuṃ hi gopavanādiṣu pāṭhaḥ| sa ca dvitīyārthopasaṅkrame'pyalugiti pakṣe vyarthaḥ syāt|
idaṃ tvavadheyam, āṅgī ca vāṅgaśca sauhmaśceti dvandve āṅgīśabdena strītvayuktānāmarthānāmabhidhānāttadaṇo luk na bhavati| anyasya tu syādeva| āṅgīvaṅgasuhmā iti| iha bhāṣye tenaiveti pratyākhyātam| ato gārgyaśca caitraśca maitraścetyatrāpi lugbhavatīti pratīyate, tajjātīyatvasyānukteśca| tathāpi sūtraseṣe "atha yo lopyalopināṃ samāsa" iti bhāṣyaṃ vyācakṣāṇena kaiyaṭena tenaiveti vacanādalopisānnidikṛtaṃ bahutvamiti mākāri lugityuktyā tenaivetyaṃśasya bhāṣyābyupagatatvaṃ labhyate| ata evāñantaṃ yadbahuṣviti pakṣe "kāśyapasya pratikṛtayo bavhyaḥ kāśyapāḥ" ityatrāpatyabahutvābhāvānmā bhūt| āṅgasya pratikṛtayo bavhya ityatra tu syādeva| iha gotragrahaṇābāvādityāśaṅkya tenaiva grahamabalena samāhitaṃ haradatteneti dhyeyam| nanu `āṅgaśca'ityādivigrahe bhāṣyādisammato'pi luk durupapādaḥ, tadrājāntasya bahuṣvavṛtteriti cet? na, ajahatsvārthāyāṃbahuṣu vṛtteḥ spaṣṭatvāt| kathaṃ tarhi "seyaṃ duḥkhā ca" ityādi prāguktamiti cet? dvivacanabahuvacanāntairvigraho netyāśayeneti gṛhāṇa| tathāhi, laukike vigrahavākye svārthamātravṛttitā spaṣṭā| prakriyāvākye'pi vṛttipraveśātprāk pravṛttamekavacanaṃ durvārameva| rājapuruṣādau ṣaṣṭhyādivat| atha kathaṃ--
kauravyāḥ paśavaḥ kriyāparibhavakleśopaśāntiḥ phalam|
iti veṇīsaṃvaraṇam?
ucyate, "kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ"(pāosūo4-1-172)iti kauravyaśabdaṃ vyunpādya "tatra sādhuḥ'(pāosūo4-4-89)iti yat kāryaḥ| etena "tasyāmeva raghoḥ pāṇḍyāḥ"(raovaṃo4)iti vyākhyātam| "vṛddhetkosala"(pāosūo4-1-171)ityatra "pāṇḍorḍyaṇ"(kāovāo)ityupasaṅkhyānāt ḍyaṇastadrājatve'pi `pāṇḍye sādhavaḥ pāṇḍyāḥ' iti yatpratyayānatatvena sādhutvanirvāhāt|
(pāosūo2-4-63)
yaskādibhyo gotre(pāosūo2-4-63)| ebhyaḥ parasya gotrapratyayasya luk syāt| bahuṣu tenaivāstriyāmityanuvartate| "gotre kuñjādibhyaścaphañ"(pāosūo4-1-98)itigotrapratyayaprakaraṇaṃ, tato'nyatra laukikasya gotrasya grahaṇam| apatyādhikāre tu gotragrahaṇasāmarthyādeva pāribhāṣikasya grahaṇam| yadyapi kṛtrimasyaivā'nyatra grahaṇaṃ prāptaṃ tathāpi laukikasya jñāpakaṃ vakṣyate| tenāntarāpatye'pi luk| yaskāḥ| lahyāḥ| bahuṣviti kim? yāskaḥ| lāhyaḥ| striyāṃ tu yāskāḥ striyaḥ| gotre iti kim| yāskāḥ chātrāḥ| yaska, lahya, druhya, ayaḥsthūṇa, tṛṇakarṇa, ete pañca śivādiṣu paṭhyante| tataḥ parebhyaḥ ṣaḍbhya iñ| sadāmatta, kambala-1--1.`hāra' iti kaumudyām|-bhāra, a-2--2.`bahiryoga' `karṇāḍhaka' iti kaumudyām|-hiryoga, karṇāṭaka, piṇḍījaṅgha, bakasaktha| tataḥ parebhyaścaturbhyaḥ "śubhrādibhyaśca"(pāosūo4-1-123)iti ḍhak-3--3.`viśri' iti kaumudyām|-bisti, kudri, ajavasti, mitrayu| tataḥ parebhyo dvādaśabhya iñ| rakṣomukha, jaṅghāratha, ma-4.-4.`mathaka' iti kaumudyām|-nyaka, utkāsa, kaṭuka, puṣkarasat,-5--5.`viṣapuṭa' iti kaumudyām|-viṣapat, uparimekhala, kroṣṭumāna, kroṣṭupāda, kroṣṭumāya, śīrṣamāya| nanviha puṣkarasadaḥ pāṭho vyarthaḥ| sa hi bāvhāditvādiñantaḥ| "bavhaca iña prācyabharateṣu"(pāosūo2-4-66)ityeva siddham| na cāyaṃ prācyo neti bhramitavyam, taulvalyādiṣvetatpāṭhasya vauyarthyāpatteḥ| tasya hi "iñaḥ prācām"(pāosūo2-4-60)iti prāptasya lukaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ phalam|
atrāhuḥ, "na gopavanādibhyaḥ"(pāosūo2-4-67)iti pratiṣedhaṃ bādhitumihāsya pāṭhaḥ| gopavanādigaṇe hi taulvalyādaya iti kaiścitpaṭhyata eva| yairna paṭhyate tairapyata eva jñāpanāt taulvalyādiprakṛtibhāgānāṃ tulvalādīnāṃ gopavanādyantarbhāvonumeya iti| -6--6.`khalapa yadaka varṣuka bhalandana bhaḍila bhaṇḍila bhaḍita bhaṇḍita' iti kaumudyām|-kharapada, asya naḍāditvātphak| padaka| kramaka| ābhyāmataiñ| bhalandata| asmācchivādyam| bhaḍila| bhaḍika| bhaḍiva| bhaṇḍita| ebhyaścaturbhyaḥ "aśvādibhyaḥ phañ"(pāosūo4-1-110)
(pāosūo2-4-64)
yañañośca(pāosūo2-4-64)| gotre yau yañañau tadantaṃ yadvahuṣu tadavayavayoryañañorluk syānna tu striyām| gargāḥ| vatsāḥ| bidāḥ| urvāḥ| striyāṃ tu gārgyaḥ striyaḥ gotre kim? "dvīpādanusamudraṃ yañ"(pāosūo4-3-10)dvaipyāḥ| "utsādiśyo'ñ"(pāosūo4-1-16)autsāḥ| atha kathaṃ-`pautrāḥ' bidādyañantatvāt?
ucyate, apatyādhikārādanyatra laukikaṃ gotrantacce'ha pravarādhyāyaprasiddham| na ca pautrādistathā| idaṃ ca "strīpuṃsābhyām'(pāosūo4-1-87)iti sūtre kaiyaṭena sphuṭīkṛtam|
yañādīnāmekadvayorvā tatpuruṣe ṣaṣṭhyā upasaṃkhyānam(kāovāo)| ekadvayoriti bhāvapradhāno nirddeśaḥ| gārgyasya gārgyayorvā kulaṃ gargakulaṃ, gārgyakulaṃ vā| yañādīnāṃ kim? āṅgakulam| ekadvayoḥ kim? gargāṇāṃ kulaṃ gargakulam| tatpuruṣe kim? gārgyasya samīpamupagārgyam| ṣaṣṭhyāḥ kim? paramagārgyaḥ|
(pāosūo2-4-65)
atribhṛgukutsavasiṣṭhagotamāṅgirobhyasca(pāosūo2-4-65)|| ebhyo gotrapratyayasya luk syāt bahutve| atriśabdāt "itaścāniñaḥ"(pāosūo4-1-122)iti ḍhak| itarebhya ṛṣyaṇ| atrayaḥ bhṛgava ityādi|
(pāosūo2-4-66)
bavhaca iñaḥ prācyabharateṣu(pāosūo2-4-66)|| bavhacaḥ paro ya iñ prācyagotre bharatagotreca varttamānastasya luk syāt| pannāgārāḥ| mantharaiṣaṇā-| bharatāpatye tu yudhiṣṭhirāḥ| arjunāḥ| yudhiṣṭhirārjunaśabdābhyāṃ kurvādiṇyāpavādo bāvhādilakṣama iñ| bharatāpatye abhedopacārādbharataśabdaḥ| te ca bharatāḥ prācyā eva| dvandvastu gobalīvarddanyāyena| sāmānyaviśeṣavācinorvācanikadvandvaniṣedho yadyapyuktastathāpi tasyānityatā anenaiva jñāpyate| tatphalaṃ tūktameva| prāg‌grahaṇenaiva siddhe bhāratānāṃ pṛthagupādānamanyatra prāg‌grahaṇe eṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ neti jñāpanārtham| tena "iñaḥ prācām"(pāosāo2-4-60)iti luk bharatayuvapratyayasya na bhavati| ārjuniḥ pitā, ārjunāyanaḥ putraḥ|
(pāosūo2-4-67)
na gopavanādibhyaḥ(pāosūo2-4-67)|| ebhyo gotrapratyayasya luk na syāt| bidādyantargaṇo'yam| sa ca haritātprāgeva| tathā ca vārtikam-gopavanādipratiṣedhaḥ prāggharitādibhyaḥ(kāovāo)iti| āgaṇāntādgrahaṇe prāpte haritātprāk vṛtkaraṇaṃ karttavyamiti bhāvaḥ| gaupavanāḥ| śaigravāḥ| neha-haritāḥ|
(pāosūo2-4-68)
tikakitavādibhyo dvandve(pāosūo2-4-68)|| ebhyo gotrapratyayasya bahuṣu luk syād dvandve| yadyapi dvandvarūpāṇyeva gaṇe paṭhyante tikādīni pūrvapadāni kitavādinyuttarapadāni, tathāpi "tikādibhyaḥ"(pāosūo4-1-154)ityukteḥ pūrvapadeṣveva lugāśaṅ‌kyeta| iṣyate tūttarapadeṣvapi| ataḥ `tikakitavādibhyaḥ' ityuktam| taikāyanaśca kaitavāyanayaśca "tikādibhyaḥ phiñ"(pāosūo4-1-154)| tasya luk| tikakitavāḥ|
(pāosūo2-4-69)
upakādibhyo'nyatarasyāmadvandve(pāosūo2-4-69)|| ebhyo gotrapratyayasya bahutve luk vā syāt dvandve cādvandve ca| sūtraśeṣasya advandve ityasya tu dvandvagrahaṇamiha nānuvarttate ityarthaḥ| eṣāṃ madhye trayo dvandvāstikakitavādiṣu paṭhyante| aupakāyanāśca lāmakāyanāśca "naḍādibhyaḥ phak"(pāosūo4-1-99)| tasya luk| upakalamakāḥ| bhrāṣṭrakakapiṣṭhalāḥ| kṛṣṇājinayaḥ| kṛṣṇasundarāḥ| eṣāṃ pūrveṇa nityameva luk| advandve tvanena vikalpaḥ| upakāḥ| aupakāyanāḥ| lamakāḥ| lāmakāyanāḥ| bhrāṣṭrakāḥ| bhrāṣṭrakayaḥ| kāpiṣṭhalāḥ| kāpiṣṭhalayaḥ| kṛṣṇājināḥ| kārṣṇājinayaḥ| kṛṣṇasundarāḥ| kārṣṇasundarayaḥ| śeṣaṇāntu dvandve'pi vikalpa iti vṛttiḥ| bhāṣye tu `bhrāṣṭrakikāpiṣṭhalayaḥ' ityudāharaṇāttikakitavādiṣvasya pāṭho'nārṣa iti kaiyaṭaḥ|
(pāosūo2-4-70)
āgastyakauḍinyayoragastikuṇḍinac(pāosūo2-4-70)|| etayoravayavasya gotrapratyayasya aṇo yañaśca bahuṣu luk syāt avaśiṣṭasya prakṛtibhāgasya yathāsaṅkhyamagasti kuṇḍinac etāvādeśau staḥ| agastayaḥ| kuṇḍināḥ| kuṇḍinīśabdasya yañi "bhasyāḍha"(kāovāo)itipuṃvadbhāve "nastaddhite"(pāosūo6-4-144)iti ṭilope `kauṇḍyaḥ' iti prāptam| asmādeva tu nipātanānna puṃvat| īkārasya "yasya"(pāosūo6-4-148)iti lopaḥ| tasya sthānivattvādābhīyatvenāsiddhatvādvā ṭilopo na| cakāraḥ svarārthaḥ| madhyodātto hi kuṇḍinīśabdaḥ| `kuṇḍamastyasyāḥ' iti matvarthīyasya inerudāttatvāt| tadādeśo'pi āntaratamyāttathā syāt| kathaṃ tarhi-
vāsiṣṭhakuṇḍinau tadvadupamanyuparāśarāḥ|
caturṇāmekagotratvānna vivāhaḥ parasparam|| iti?
ucyate, nāyaṃ kuṇḍinajādeśaḥ, kintu "kuḍi dāhe"(bhvāoāo271)ityasmādauṇādike inac‌pratyaye ujjvaladattādibhirvyutpāditaḥ svatantra evāyaṃ śabdaḥ| ata eva "vāsiṣṭhamaitrāvaruṇakauṇḍinyeti hotā kuṇḍinavanmitrāvarumavadvasiṣṭhavadityadhvaryuḥ" iti baudhāyanasūtraṃ saṅgacchate| āpastambasūtramapyevam| etena-
vasiṣṭhamitrāvaruṇau kuṇḍinaśca mahātapā-|
iti matsyapurāṇapravarādhyāyaprayogo'pi vyākhyāta iti dik|
iha yadi lukaṃ nivartya viśiṣṭayorevādeśau kriyete, tadā `kauṇḍināḥ' ityasya siddhāvapi `āgastīyāḥ' iti na siddhyatī| tathāhi, agastya śabdādṛṣyaṇi āgastyaḥ| tato bahuvacanāntāddhṛddhācche vivakṣite "gotre'lugāca"(pāosūo4-1-89)iti luk‌pratiṣedhaḥ| pratyayaviśiṣṭasyāgastyādeśapakṣe tu tanniṣedhābhāvāddhṛddhatvāpagame śaiṣiko'ṇeva syāt| upapāditaṃ cedaṃ "pratyayasya luk‌ślu"(pāosūo1-1-61)sūtre|
(pāosūo2-4-71)
supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ(pāosūo2-4-71)|| etayoravayavasya supo luk syāt| putrīyati| rājapuruṣaḥ|
(pāosūo2-4-72)
adiprabhṛtibhyaḥ śapaḥ(pāosūo2-4-72)|| ebhyaḥ śapo luk syāt| atti| kathaṃ tarhi--
"vāsudevaṃ parityajya yo'nyaṃ devamupāsate" iti?
ucyate, `asa gatidīptyādāneṣu'(bhvāouo911)iti bhvāderubhayapadinorūpamidam, upādatte ityarthāt| atha katham "āśvaseyurniśācarāḥ" iti bhaṭṭiḥ "na viśvasetpūrvāvirodhitasya" iti ca pañcatantrama? pacādyajantādācārakvipi bhaviṣyati| "gaṇakāryamanityam" iti tu jayamaṅgalā| tatra jñāpakaṃ tu "ghaṭādayaḥ ṣitaḥ" ityata eva siddhe "kṣamūṣ sahane"(bhvāoāo443)iti ṣitkaraṇam||
(pāosīo2-4-73)
bahulaṃ chandasi(pāosūo2-4-73)|| chandasi bahulaṃ śapo luk syāt| vṛtraṃ hanati| ahiḥ śayate| anyebhyo'pi bhavati| trādhvaṃ no devāḥ||
(pāosūo2-4-74)
yaṅo'ci ca(pāosūo2-4-74)|| yaṅo'c‌pratyaye pare luk syāt cakārādvahulamanyatrāpi| loluvaḥ| popuvaḥ| pacādyac| idameva aci lugvidhānaṃ jñāpakaṃ "sarvadātubhyaḥ pacādyac" iti| bāhulakāt `bebhidīti' `cecchidīti' ityādi| iha ajiti pratyāhāro na gṛhyate| tathāhi sati "aṇi" ityevāvakṣyat, yaṅantādanyasyāco'sambhavāt iti haradattaḥ| na ca `pāpacye' ityevāvakṣyat, yaṅantādanyasyāco'sambhavāt iti haradattaḥ| na ca `pāpacye' `pāpacyai' ityatra sambhavaḥ, śapā vyavadhānāt, ekādeśasya sthānivadbhāvāt| "liṭastajhayoḥ"(pāosūo3-4-81)ityeśaḥ sambhavostīti cet? na, āmprasaṅgāt| yadi tu "amantre" iti niṣedhāt mantre kathaṃcittatsaṃbhavastarhi yaṅā sāhacaryāditi yuktyantaramanveṣaṇīyam|
(pāosūo2-4-75)
juhotyādibhyāṃ śluḥ(pāosūo2-4-75)|| ebhyaḥ śapaḥ śluḥ syāt| juhoti| maṇḍūkaplutyeha śabanuvartate| na tvanantaropi yaṅ, "ślo"(pāosūo6-1-10)iti sūtrārambhāt| anyathā yaṅo lukīva ślāvapi "sanyaṅoḥ"(pāosūo6-1-9)ityeva siddhe kiṃ tena?
(pāosūo2-4-76)
bahulaṃ chandasi(pāosūda2-4-76)|| dāti priyāṇi| anyebhyaśca bhavati-pūrṇāṃ vivaṣṭi| janimāsaṃviviktaḥ|
(pāosūo2-4-77)
gātisthāghupābhūbhyaḥ sicaḥ parasmaipadeṣu(pāosūo2-4-77)|| ebhyaḥ sico luk syātparasmaipadeṣu| iha maṇḍūkaplutyā luganuvartate na tvanantaro'pi śluḥ, vyākhyānāt| yadyapi gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣastathāpi `gāti' iti nirddeśādiha "iṇo gā luṅi"(pāosūo2-4-45)ityasya grahaṇam| gādeśasyaiva hyayaṃ śtipi śablukā nirddeśaḥ|
nanu nāyaṃ gādeśaḥ, luṅ‌yeva tadvidhānāt| satyam, tathāpi "prakṛti vadanukaraṇam' iti sthānivadbhāvātideśācchab‌luk| "bhavateraḥ"(pāosūo7-4-73)ityādau tu astyādeśānukaraṇe atideśātideśena prāpto'pi śab‌luk "prakṛtivat" ityasyānityatvānnetyavadeyam| haradattastu sthānivadbhāvāt| "prakṛtivadanukaraṇam" iti vā gātītyatra śabluginyāha| tatra śabdasyāsaṅgatiḥ spaṣṭaiva| vastutastu "gāporgrahaṇe iṇ‌pibatyoḥ"(kāovāo)iti vārtikamevātra śaraṇam| nirddeśādeva vyaktam| lugvikaraṇagrahaṇamiti tu bhāṣye prauḍhivādamātram, nirdeśasya sandigdhatvāt| gāyaterapi hi sici kṛtātvasyānukaraṇaṃ gātīti sambhavatyevetyavadheyam| agāt| asthāt| adāt| adhāt| pibatereveha grahaṇaṃ na tu pāteḥ, "ligvikaraṇālugvikaraṇayoralugvikaraṇasyaiva"(pāobhāo)iti paribhāṣayā| apāt| abhūt| bhūdhātoḥ stratantrasyāstyādeśasyacedaṃ rūpaṃ tulyam| na cādeśasya lugvikaraṇatvātpātivadagrahaḥ śaḍkya-| ārdhadhātukaikaviṣayatayā hetoḥ svarūpāsiddheḥ gāporgrahaṇena iṇādeśapibatyoreva grahamamityuktam| neha-`ke gai rai śabde'| agasīt| `pā rakṣaṇe'| apāsīt| "yaprarama"(pāosūo3-2-73)itīṭsakau| `pai śoṣaṇe' ityasyāpi lākṣaṇikatvādagrahaṇaṃ bodhyam| parasmaipadeṣu kim? agāsātāṃ grāmau devadattena| atra kaścit sūtre bhīdhātorṅasau nirddeśaḥ| "eranekācaḥ"(pāosūo6-4-82)iti yaṇ| tena `mā bhaiḥ śaśāṅka mama śīdhuni nāsti rāhuḥ" iti prayogaḥ saṅgacchata ityāha| evaṃ tu|
"mā sma baiṣīstvayā'dyaiva kṛtārthāṃ drakṣyate yatiḥ"
iti bhaṭṭirvirudhyeta| mā bhairiti tu prāmādikam| yadvā, āgamaśāsanānityatayā "astisicaḥ"(pāosūo7-3-96)itīṭo virahe sipo "hal‌ṅyā"(pāosūo6-1-68)iti lope sico visargaḥ|
(pāosūo2-4-78)
vibhāṣā ghrādheṭ‌śācchāsaḥ(pāosūo2-4-78)|| ebhyaḥ sico vā luk syātparasmaipadeṣu| dheṭaḥ pūrveṇa prāpte itareṣāmaprāpte vibhāṣeyam| aghrāta, adhāt, aśāt, acchāt, asāt| pakṣe'ghrāsīdityādi| parasmaipadeṣu kim? aghrāsanta sumanaso devadattena| karmaṇi taṅ|
(pāosūo2-4-79)
tanādibhyastathāsoḥ(pāosūo2-4-79)|| ebhyaḥ sico vā luk syāttathāsoḥ parataḥ| atata| atathāḥ| ataniṣṭa| ataniṣṭhāḥ| asatā| asaniṣṭhāḥ| yūyamataniṣṭetyatra tu na luk, ātmanepadenaikavacanena ca thāsā sāhacaryyāttathābhūtasyaiva taśabdasya grahaṇāt|
(pāosūo2-4-80)
mantre ghasavharaṇaśavṛdahādvṛc‌kṛgamijānibhyo leḥ(pāosūo2-4-80)|| ebhyo lerluk syānmantre| akṣannamīmadanta hi| "luṅ‌sanorghaslṛ"(pāosūo2-4-37)| "gamahana"(pāosūo6-4-98)ityupadhālopaḥ| "śāsivasi"(pāosūo8-3-6)iti ṣatvam| aṭ| "vibhāṣā chandasyamāṅyoge'pi"(kāovāo)ityaḍabhāve tu mā tvā vṛkāso aśivāsau kṣan| `vhṛkauṭilye' asya kṛtaguṇasyānukaraṇaṃ hvareti, akārastūccāraṇārthaḥ| mā vharmitrasya| dhūrtiḥ praṇaṅ martyasya| "naśervā"(pāosūo8-2-63)iti kutvam| pakṣe "vraśca"(pāosūo8-2-36)iti ṣatve naḍiti rūpaṃ bodhyam vṛ iti vṛṅavañoḥ sāmānyagrahaṇam| suruco vena āvaḥ| daha-mānaādhak| ādityākārāntagrahaṇam| suruco vena āvaḥ| āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣam| vṛj--parāvargbhārabhṛdyathā| akran karma karmakṛtaḥ| tverayiṃ jāgṛvāṃso anugman| ajñata vā asya dantāḥ| yadyapyaitareyabrāhmaṇe hariścandraṃ prati varuṇasyedaṃ vacanaṃ tathāpi mantragrahaṇamiha sūtre chandasa upalakṣaṇamiti brāhmaṇe'pi luk sidhyati| iha sūtre vibāṣetyanuvartate| tena-"na tā agṛbhṇannajaniṣṭa hiṣaḥ"ityādi siddham| etena iha sūtre `sica' ityanuvartya sic‌sthānibhūto yo liriti vyākhyānālliṅūliṭornati haradattagranthaḥ parāstaḥ| lopasya vaikalpikatayā chandasi rūpāntarasyānāpādyatayā ca sijanuvṛttervaiphalyāt| ata eva sici prakṛte ligrahaṇam "ādiḥ sico'nyatarasyām"(pāosūo6-1-187)ityetasyāpravṛttyarthamiti prakṛtasūtrasthaharadattagranthaḥ "cli luṅi"(pāosūo3-1-43)ityatratyakaiyaṭagranthaśca parāstaḥ|
(pāosūo2-4-81)
āmaḥ(pāosūo2-4-81)|| āmaḥ parasya luk syāt| īhāṃcakre| "lakṣaṇapratipadokta"(paobhāo)paribhāṣayā neha| "ama gatyādiṣu"-āma| āmatuḥ| tibādyapavādatvāllāvasthāyāmevāyaṃ luk| tenāmantasyātiṅantatvādanigātastataḥ parasya nighātaśca sidhyatīti "na lumatā"(pāosūo1-1-63)iti sūtre pratipāditam| na caivamāmantasya padatvaṃ na syāditi vācyam, subantatayā tatsiddheḥ| yathā ca supo na śravaṇaṃ tathā "kṛnmejantaḥ"(pāosūo1-1-39)iti sūtre pratipāditam|
(pāosūo2-4-82)
avyayādāp‌supaḥ(pāosūo2-4-82)|| avyayadvihitasyāpaḥ supaśca luk syāt| tatra śālāyām| atha| atra vārtikam-
"avyayādāpo lugvanānarthakyaṃ liṅgābhāvāt" iti| na ca "striyām"(pāosūo4-1-3)iti sūtre `strīsamānādikaraṇāt' iti pakṣaḥ sthitaḥ, `bhūtamiyaṃ brāhmaṇī' ityādāvativyāpteḥ| vihitaviśeṣaṇānneha-atyuccaisau||
(pāosūo2-4-83)
nāvyayībhāvādato'm tvapañcamyāḥ(pāosūo2-4-83)|| adantādavyayībhāvātsupo na luk pañcamībhinnasya tu supo'mādeśaḥ syāt| upakumbhaṃ tiṣṭhati| apañcamyāḥ kim? unmattagaṅgādāgataḥ| ataḥ kim? adhihari|
(pāosūo2-4-84)
tṛtīyāsaptamyorbahulam(pāosūo2-4-84)|| anayorbahulamam syāt| pūrveṇa nitye prāpte ārambhaḥ| upakumbhamupakumbhena vā kṛtam| upakumbhamupakumbhe sthitaḥ| ata vārtikam--
saptamyā ṛddhinadīsamāsasaṃkhyāvayavebhyo nityam|| ṛddiḥ-samudram| nadīsamāsa-unmattagaṅgam| saṃkhyāvayavaḥ-ekaviṃśaśatibhāradvājam| tripañcāśadgautamam| ekaviṃśatibharadvājā vaṃśyāstripañcāśadgautamā vaṃśyā iti vigrahaḥ| "saṃkhyā vaṃśyena'(pāosūo2-1-19)iti samāsaḥ| nanu bharadvājāt bidādyaño "yañañośca"(pāosūo2-4-64)iti luk prāpnoti, evaṃ gotamādṛṣyaṇaḥ "atribhṛgu"(pāosūo2-4-65)ityārambhāt| na ca "vartipadānāṃ svārthapasarjanaikatvaviśiṣṭārthāntaropasaṃkramāllugabhāvaḥ" iti kaiyaṭoktaṃ yuktam, vṛttipraveśātprāgeva prāpnuvato'ntaraṅgasya luko durvāratvāt| anyathā gargāṇāṃ kulaṃ gargakulamityapi na syāt|
atrāhuḥ, "bhāṣyakāraprayogādeva lugabhāvo'tra bodhya" iti| idaṃ ca vārttikaṃ bahulagrahaṇasiddhārthakathanaparam|
luṭaḥ prathamasya ḍāraurasaḥ(pāosūo85)|| luḍādeśasya prathamapuruṣasya ḍārairasaḥ kramātsyuḥ| attā| śayitā| nanu padadvaye dvau trikau prathamapuruṣau, tathā ca ṣaṭ sthāninaḥ traya ādeśāḥ tatkathaṃ vaiṣamye saṃkhyā tānudeśaḥ? atrāhuḥ ḍāraurasaśca ḍāraurasaśceti kṛtadvandvānāmekaśeṣāt ṣaḍevādeśāḥ| yadvā, arthata āntaryādvyavasthā ekārthasyaikārtho dvyarthasya dvyartha ityādi| ekārthatvādinirṇayastu vyavahārāt| yadyapi "nānubandhakṛtamanekāltvam"(paobhāo6)tathāpi ḍā ityasya sarvādeśatvamānupūrvyādbodhyam| pratipāditaṃ cedam "anekāl‌śit"(pāosūo1-1-55)iti sūtre| na cātmanepade adhyetā adhyetārau ityādau ḍāraurassu kṛteṣu ṭeretvaṃ syāditi cet? na, asminneva prayoge sakṛtpravṛttatayā caritārthatvāt| tathāhi, etvaṃ ḍādayaścetyubhayamapi śabdāntaraprāptyā'nityam, tatra paratvādetve kṛte punaḥprasaṅgavijñānāḍ‌ ḍādayaḥ| yadvā, tiṅa ādeśeṣu ṭeretvaṃ na bhavati, eśirecosthāsaḥ seśca ekāroccāraṇājjñāpakāt| syādetat, tiptayordvayorapi ḍādeśe'ntodāttampadamiṣyate| tatra tibādeśasyāntaratamyādanudāttatve satyudāttanivṛttisvareṇodāttatvaṃ siddhyatu, tādeśasya tu na sidhyati| tathāhi, tapratyayasya ḍādeśe kṛte lasārvadhātukasvarātparatvāṭṭilopaḥ| na cedānīmudāttanivṛttisvaro labhyaḥ, anudāttatvātprāgeva lopāt| nanu svarabhinnasya prāpnuvannanityo ḍādeśaḥ, śabdāntarasya prāpnuvannanudātto'pyanityaḥ, ubhayoranityayoḥ paratvādanudāttatve kṛte punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānāḍ‌ḍādeśe kṛte udāttanivṛttisvaraḥ sulabha iti cet? na, antaraṅgatvāḍḍādeśapravṛtteḥ|
atrāhuḥ, astūktarītyā paratvāṭṭilopaḥ, tathāpyasau anudātte avidyamānodātte para ityarthaḥ| "anudāttasyaca"(pāosūo6-1-161)iti sūtre hyanu dāttagrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyāsyate, tatsvīkāre'pi śāstrīyo'nudātto na gṛhyate, kintūdāttabhinnaḥ| na ca pratyayādyudāttapravṛtteridamapi durlabhamiti vācyam, parihṛtya cāpavādaviṣayamiti nyāyena lasārvadhātukānudāttaviṣaye pratyayasvarāpravṛtteḥ| na ca tāseḥ pratyayasvarātprāgeva paratvāṭṭilopaḥ śaṅkyaḥ, pratyayasvarasya pratyayasaṃniyogasiṣṭatvenāntaraṅgatvāt| tathāca bhāṣye saṃgrahaslokau--
pratyayasvarāpavādo lasārvadhātukānudāttattvam|
tena tatra na prasaktaḥ pratyayasvaraḥ kadācit||
pratyayasvaraśca tāservṛttisaṃniyogaśiṣṭaḥ|
tena cāpya sāvudātto lopsyate tathā na doṣaḥ||
vṛttiḥ pravṛttiḥ| yadaiva tāsiḥ pravartate tadaivāpavādābhāvādudāttatvayukta ityarthaḥ|
munitrayoktisadveṇīpariśīlanaśālinām|
mahatāmapi mānyo'sau dhāryate yena kaustubhaḥ||
|| iti śrīmatpadāvākyapramāṇapārāvārapārīṇasya lakṣmīdharasūreḥ sūnunā bhaṭṭojibhaṭṭena kṛte śrīśabdakaustubhe dvitīyasyādhyāyasya caturthe pāde dvitīyamānhikam| pādaśca samāpto'dhyāyaśca ||
<3.1>
|| tṛtīyasyādhyāyasya prathame pāde prathamamānhikam ||
(pāosūo3-1-1)
pratyayaḥ(pāosūo3-1-1)|| pratyayaśabdaḥ saṃjñātvenādhikriyate āpañcamasamāpteḥ| syādetat, prakṛtyupapadopādhivikārāgamānāmapi tarhi saṃjñā syāt| "haraterddatināthayoḥ paśau"(pāosūo3-2-25)| harateriti prakṛtiḥ| dṛtināthayorityupapadam| paśāvityupādhiḥ| "hanasta ca"(pāosūo3-1-108)ityādirvikāraḥ| "trapujatunoḥ ṣuk"(pāosūo4-3-138)ityāgamaḥ| nanveṣāṃ pratyayatve sati kiṃ syāditi cet? śṛṇu, prakṛtipratyayayoḥ parasparāpekṣaṃ paratvaṃ paryāyeṇa syāt, śabdāntarāpekṣaṃ vā prakṛte upapadasyāpi paratvaṃ syāt| "upasarjanaṃ pūrvam"(pāosūo2-2-30)iti tu rājapuruṣādiṣu sāvakāśaṃ paratvāt "paraśca"(pāosūo3-1-2)ityanena bādhyeta| nanu subvidhau prātipadikādhikārādrājapuruṣādau kathaṃ sāvakāśateti cet? satyam, evamapi samāsasaṃjñāvirahasthale upapadasya paratvaṃ syādeva| tathā ca bhoktuṃ vrajatītyeva syāt, na tu vrajati bhoktumiti| upādhestu sarthatvena paratvāsambhave'pi tadvācakaśabdasya paratvaṃ niyataṃ syāt| ādyudāttatvaṃ ca syāt| aṅgasaṃjñā tu vidhā nāyattā| na ca prakṛtyādayaḥ kutaścidvihitā ato na prakṛtyādiṣu pareṣu pūrvasya tatprāptiriti prāguktā eva doṣāḥ| vikārāgamayorapi yathāyathaṃ paratvamādyudāttatvaṃ tayoḥ parataḥ pūrvasyāṅgatvaṃ ca syāditi duṣṭo'yaṃ pratyayādhikāraḥ|
atrāhuḥ, prakṛtyādīnāṃ sanādyutpattau nimittatvenopādānāt pārārthyāt svasaṃskāraṃ prati na prayojakatvam| yathā `yo'śve sa devadattaḥ' ityukte nāśvasya devadattasaṃjñā| kiñca haraterddatināthayoḥ karmaṇorupapadayoḥ paśau karttari inpratyayo bhavatīti vākyārthaparyavasāne kathaṃ prakṛtyādināṃ saṃjñāprāptiḥ? ca āvṛttyā te ca haratyādayaḥ pratyayasaṃjñakā iti dvitīyaṃ vākyaṃ kalpyam, mānābhāvād gauravaparāhatatvācca| yattu sanādīnāmapyasatāṃ saṃjñānupapatteḥ vākyabhedenaiva saṃjñā vidheyā| tataśca yathā ekena sanādīnāṃ vidhirapareṇa saṃjñāvidhiḥ, evaṃ prakṛtyādīnāmapi syādeveti| tanna, vṛddhisūtraśeṣe varṇitayā rītyā sanpratyayo bhavatītyādikrameṇa saṃjñāviśiṣṭasya saṃjñina ekavākyenaiva vidhisambhavāt| nahi `udbhidā yajeta' ityādau nāmadheyasamvandhalābhāya vidhyāvṛttiṃ manvate nyāyavidaḥ| abhyupetya brūmaḥ, saṃjñāpare dvitīyaṃ vākyamapi `guptij‌kid‌bhyaḥ san pratyayaḥ' ityādirūpameva| tathāca viruddhavibhaktyavaruddhānāṃ prakṛtyādīnāṃ prathamāntena pratyaya ityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyamasambhāvyeva| na ca dvitīyavākye prakṛtyādīnāṃ vibhaktivipariṇāmena prathamā kalpyā, yogyavibhaktinirddiṣṭeṣu sanādiṣu saṃjñāyāścarirthatvāt| api ca ādyavākye sanādīnāmeva apūrvavidhānaviṣayatayā prādhānyam| evañca dvitīye'pi saṃjñinamapekṣamāṇā saṃjñā pūrvatra pradhānatayā klṛptameva gṛhṇīyāt na tvapradhānamapi| nanvevamapi vikārāgamānāṃ vidheyatayā prādhānyātsaṃjñā durvāreti cet? maivam, anvarthasaṃjñāvijñānāt| pratiyantyanenārthamiti hi pratyayaḥ| vikārāgamau tvanarthakau| na caivam "aveḥ kaḥ"(pāosūo5-4-28)ityādīnāṃ samāsāntānāṃ ca pratyayasaṃjñā na syāt, anarthakatvāditi vācyam, `svārthikā api prakaॉtyarthenārthavanta eva' iti siddhāntāt| yattu kalpanāmātrametaditi| tanna, prakṛtipratyayārthavibhāgasya sarvasyāpi kālpanikatvāviśeṣāt| naiṣā kalpanā śāstrakṛtsammateti cet? na, "dvitīya"(pāosūo2-2-3)iti sūtre pūraṇārthātsvārthe anpratyayasyāpi pūraṇārthatāyā bhagavataivokteḥ ihāpi pratyāyyanta iti vyutpattyantaramapyāśritya prakṛtya abhivyajyamānārthatvaṃ svārthikānāmastīti bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ svīkārācca| na caivaṃ vikārāgamayoḥ sambhavati, prakṛtyavayavatayā tadartha evopakṣayāt| api ca prayojanābhāvānnāmīṣāṃ saṃjñā| na ca paratvameva prayojanam, ṣaṣṭhyā vikārāṇāṃ sthānasambandhasya āgamānāmavayavatvena sambandhasya ca pratipādanāt| na cādyudāttatvaṃ prayojanam, āgamānāmanudātatvavidhānāt| yatra tu prayojanaṃ labhyate tatreṣyata evāgamasyāpi pratyayatvam| yathā śnamaḥ śakārasyetsaṃjñārthamiti|
idaṃ tvavaśiṣyate, "hanaśca vadhaḥ"(pāosūo3-3-76)"nābhinabhaṃ ca" (gaosūo)"virāga viraṅgañca"(gaosūo)ityādāvādeśānāṃ saṃjñā syāt arthavattvādvidhetvena prādhānyāt yogyavibhaktika tvācceti| saṃjñāprayojanaṃ tu sthānina ādeśena nivartitatvena śabdāntarāpekṣayā paratvamastīti| tasmātkarttavyo'tra yatna iti haradattaḥ|
atredaṃ vaktavyam, inaścetyādicakāro na pratyayasaṃjñāmātrasyānukarṣaṇārtha-, adhikārādeva tallābhāt| kintu saṃjñiviśiṣṭasya| evañca tenaiva nirākāṅkṣā saṃjñā kathaṃ vadādibhiḥ sambadhyeta? "kṣemapriyamadre'ṇca"(pāosūo3-2-44)ityādau tu ṇittvādisāmarthyādāvṛttyā saṃjñālābhaḥ| kiñca nabhaṃ viraṅgamiti dvitīyāntaṃ na tu prathamāntam, asāvamumādeśe labhate ityāśayena prācāṃ vyavahārāt| uktañca prātiśākhye-"asāvamumiti tadbhāvamuktam" iti|
"samānākṣaramantasthaṃ samakaṇṭhyaṃ svarodayam" iti ca|
"ikoyaṇaci"(pāosūo6-177)iti tadarthaḥ| evaṃ sthite nabhaviraṅgayoḥ saṃjñayā saha viruddhavibhaktyavarodho'pi spaṣṭa eveti dik|
atha sanaḥ saśabdādārabhya kapaḥ pakārema sapiti pratyāhāramāśritya sappratyaya ityeva kuto pakāreṇa sapiti pratyāhāramāśritya sipaḥ pakārema grahaṇāpatteḥ| vyāptyā tu "taptanaptanathanāśca"(pāosūo7-1-4)iti tanapaḥ| tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu| saṃjñāprayojanaṃ tu kartavya ityādau dhātorahgasaṃjñāpravṛttāvāṅgo guṇaḥ| yattu pratyayādyudāttatvaṃ phalamiti| tadāpātataḥ, "ādyudāttaśca"(pāosūo3-1-3)ityadhikāramāśritya tasya susādhatvāt|
(pāosūo3-1-2)
paraśca(pāosūo3-1-2)|| ayamadhikāraḥ paribhāṣā vā| liṅgavatī ceyam| liṅgaṃ tu pratyayasaṃjñā| "guptij‌kid‌bhyaḥ san"(pāosūo3-1-5)ityādau apādānatvāsambhavāddigyogalakṣaṇapañcamī, tatra paraḥ pūrvo vetyaniyamenādhyāhāre prasakte para eveti niyamārthamidam| "gāpoṣṭak"(pāosūo3-2-8)ityādau ṣaṣṭhīnirddeśe'pi ānantaryarūpaṣaṣṭhyarthasya pūrva parayoraviśeṣādaniyamastulya eva| syādetat, "vibhāṣā supobahucpurastāttu"(pāosūo5-3-68)ityetanniyamārthamastu bahujeva purastādbhavati nābhya iti| tataśca bahuci pūrvatvasya niyatatvādanyaḥ pratyayaḥ para eva bhaviṣyati| na caivamapi ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśeṣu madhyaśabdādhyāhārema madhye'pi prasaṅga eveti vācyam, "avyayasarvanāmnām'(pāosūo5-3-71)ityanena akajeva prakṛtimadhye nānya iti niyamāt| na ca bahujeva purastādakajeva madhye iti niyame bahujakacorniyamo na labhyeteti vācyam, deśaniyamārthayorapi vākyayoḥ bahujakacorddeśasambandhapratītyā nirākāṅkṣatayā tayordeśāntarasambandhe mānābhāvāt, vikalpasyānekadoṣaduṣṭatvācca| na cā kajeva prāk ṭeriti niyame pratyayāntaraṃ ṭiprāgbhāgarūpamadhyaviśeṣe mā bhūt, madhyāntare tu syādeveti vācyam, labhyasiddhaye madhyasāmānyāpekṣaniyamābhyupagame bādhakābhāvāt| kiñca "guptij‌kid‌bhyaḥ"(pāosūo3-1-5)ityādau bhyasādīnāṃ paratvadarśanena aṅgasaṃjñāsūtre pratyaye iti saptamībalena ca "ṅyāpprātipadikāt"(pāosūo4-1-1)ityādau paraśabdādhyāhāre niścite tadaikarūpyāya pratyayavidhiparāyāmaṣṭādhyāyyāṃ na pūrvādipadāntarādhyāhāro nyāyyaḥ, tatkiṃ paraśceti sūtreṇa? ucyate, prayoganiyamārthamidaṃ, para eva pratyayo na kevala iti| anyathā pratyayārthamātravivakṣāyāṃ kimasya dvayasamityādyapi prayujyeta| yadi tu prakṛtiviśeṣoddeśenaiva pratyayasya vidhānātkevalo na prayokṣyata iti brūṣe, evamapi prakṛtyarthamātravivakṣāyāṃ kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayujyetaiva| yathā pac paṭh iti| ataḥ pratyayaḥ paro bhavatyeveti niyamārthamidam| āpadatvanirvṛtteścāyaṃ niyamaḥ tadetattatratatrocyate-"na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā na kevalaḥ pratyayaḥ" iti "apadaṃ na prayuñjīta" iti ca| apariniṣṭhitaṃ na prayuñjīteti tasyārtha ityuktam| yattviha bhāṣye babhrurmaṇḍurlamaka ityādīnāmapaśabdatvamuktam, yacca padamañjaryāṃ tāratamyādiśabdānām, tatsarvaṃ lākṣaṇisādṛśyaśaktibhramābhyāṃ prayuktasya sādhvasādhutvavyavastha| ata eva "bavhaca iñaḥ"(pāosūo2-4-66)iti sūtre raghuśabdasya tadapatye lakṣaṇayā sādhutvaṃ haradattenoktam| prakṛtasūtre'pi `no khalvārabhyamāṇamapyetallakṣaṇayā prayogaṃ nivārayitumarhati' ityuktantenaiva| ata eva tāratamyamityasya śabdaparasyārthe lakṣaṇayā sādhutvaṃ kaiyaṭena "sādhakatamaṅkaraṇam"(pāosūo1-4-42)iti sūtre dhvanitamiti dik|
(pāosūo3-1-3)
ādyudāttaśca(pāosūo3-1-3)|| ayamapyadhikāraḥ paribhāṣā vā prāgvat| tittiriṇā proktamadhīte taittirīyaṃ brāhmaṇakulaṃ, 'tittirivaratantukhaṇḍikokhācchaṇ"(pāosūo4-6-102)"chandībrāhmaṇāni ca tadviṣayāṇi"(pāosūo3-2-66)"tadadhīte tadveda"(pāosūo4-2-59)| "proktalluk"(pāosūo4-2-64)| āyannādiṣūpadeśivadvacanaṃ svarasiddhyartham| iha rīśabda udāttaḥ| syādetat, asvarakasyāca uccāramāsambhavāt sarva eva svaravidhirniyamārthaḥ| tatra cita evāntodāttaḥ| rita eva madhyodāttaḥ| tideva svaritaḥ| suppitāvevānudāttau| dūrātsambuddhāvevaikaśrutyamiti svarāntarāmāmanyatra niyamātpāriśeṣyātpratya ya ādyudātta eva bhaviṣyati nāsvarakaḥ, nāpyanyasvarakaḥ, tātkimanena sūtremeti cet? maivam, uktarītyā ādyudāttatvamapi "ñnityādiḥ"(pāosūo6-1-117)ityādau niyamyate| kiñca tvaduktaniyame cidādīnāmaniyamaḥ syāt, ataścito'nta evetyādi vyākhyeyam| tataśca chaṇādīnāmaniyatasvaratvaṃ syāt| apica rityeveti niyame'nyatropottamarūpamadhyaviśeṣa udātto mā bhūt| madhyāntaraṃ tu syādeva| sāmānyāpekṣaniyame ca vyākhyānameva śaraṇīkaraṇīyaṃ syāt| tasmātsūtrārambha evo citaḥ syādetat, "ñnityādirnityam"(pāosūo6-1-197)"pratyayasya ca" "lasārvadhātukamanudāttam" "suptitauca" iti ṣaṣṭha eva sūtryatām| evaṃ svaraprakaraṇe pāṭhātsandarbhaśuddhiḥ, ādyudāttānudāttaśabdayostatratyayorevopajīvanāllāghavaṃ ca| nanvevaṃ pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantasya svaraḥ syāt| iha tu kriyamāṇe "ādyudāttaśca"(pāosūo3-1-3)ityasya pratiyogamupasthāne satyupadyamāna eva tavyādirudāttaḥ, evaṃ tibādiranudāttaḥ| ataḥ gratyayasañjñāsanniyogena svaro vidhīyata iti cet? maivam, ṣāṣṭhatve'pi jñāpakena tadantavidhinirāsasambhavāt| tathāhi, "pratyayasya ca" ityatra na tadantavidhiḥ ñnityādiḥ"(pāosūo6-1-197)ityārambhāt| "suptitau ca" ityatrāpi na, "dhātoḥ"(pāosūo6-1-162)ityādyārambhāt| yadi hi pratyayāntasyānudāttatvaṃ syāttarhi dhātuprātipadikayorantodāttavidhirnarviṣaya eva syāt| yatra hi pratyayo'nudātto `yāti' `vṛkṣān' ityādau, tatraiva prakṛtisvaraḥ śrūyate| yāto yānti vṛkṣatvaṃ vṛkṣatetyādau tu satiśiṣṭena pratyayasvareṇa bādhyate| tasmāt ṣaṣṭhe sūtrakaraṇamevocitāmiti cet? maivam, gopāyati dhūpāyatītyatra utpattisaṃniyogenādyudāttatve kṛte tataḥ "sanādyantāḥ"(pāosūo3-1-32)iti dhātutve "dhātoḥ"(pāosūo6-1-162)ityantodātto bhavati| tu "ñnityādirnityam" (pāosūo6-1-197)"pratyayasya ca" ityucyate| tadā paratvāddhātusvaraṃ pratyayasvaro bādheta| sūtrasya sūtrāntareṇa nimāne phalaṃ vācyam| "suppitau ca" ityasya ṣaṣṭhe nyāso'pyanucitaḥ, tathāsati tadantavidherdurvāratvāt| yattūktaṃ prakṛtisvaravidhānaṃ jñāpakamiti| tanna, `āste śete' ityādau lasārvadhātukamātrasyānudāttatve sati dhātusvarasya sāvakāśatvāt| prātipadikāntodāttasyāpi agnimān agnīnāmityādau "hrasvanuḍubhyāṃ matup"(pāosūo6-1-176) "nāmanyatarasyām"(pāosūo6-1-177)iti svarasiddhayarthatvāt| tatra hyantodāttādityanuvartate `tamaśyāmamadhumantam' ityādau mā bhūditi| bhittvā prakaraṇaṃ soḍhvā gauravaṃ ceha sūtraṇe phalaṃ dhātusvarastadvattadantāgrahaṇaṃ sthitam| na cāstu phalāntaramapi, tathāhi, bhavitavyamityādau pratyayotpattikāla evādyudāttatve kṛte paścādbhavanniṭ anudāttaḥ sidhyati| anyathā tu `bhū-tavya' iti sthite ādyudāttatvaṃ śabdāntaraprāptyā'nityam, iṭ tu svarabhinnasyetyubhayoranityayoḥ paratvādiṭi kṛte tasyaiva pratyayāvayavatvādudāttatvaṃ syāt| maivam, yāsuḍudāttavacanena `āgamā anudāttā' ityasyārthasya jñāpitatvāt| na ca cinuyādityādau pidbhakte yāsuṭi caritārthamudāttavacanaṃ kathaṃ jñāpakamiti vācyam, evaṃ hi udātto ṅiccetyapahāya apiccetyeva brūyāt| `apicca liṅ' ityuktyā hi "sārvadhātukamapit'(pāosūo1-2-4)iti ṅittvamapi sidhyatyeva| avaśyañcoktajñāpakaṃ tvayā'pyādartavyam| anyathā pratyayasaṃjñāsanniyogenādyudāttavidhāvapi bhaviṣīyetyādau svaro na sidhyet| tatra hi lāvasthāyāmanackatvātpratyayasvare asati paratvādviśeṣavihitatvācca sīyuṭi kṛte paścālladeśe pratyayādyudāttatvaṃ sīyuṭa eva syāt| jñāpakāśrayaṇe tu sīyuḍanudāttaḥ| "iṭo't'(pāosūo3-4-106)ityakāra udāttaḥ| na ca tittvātsvaritatvaṃ saṅkyam, takāra uccāraṇārtho na tvitsaṃjñakaḥ| itsaṃjñā'bhyupagamaparo vṛttigranthastu atratyabhāṣyādivirodhāt `bhakṣīyatavarādhasa' ityantodāttalakṣyavirodhācca prāmādika iti "navibhaktau tusmāḥ'(pāosūo1-3-4)ityatrāvocāma| nanvevamapi sīyuṭi kṛte akārasyāditvaṃ vicchinnaṃ tatkathamudāttatvamiti cet? yāsuṭa udāttavacanena pratyayādyudāttatve kartavye āgamā avidyamānavadbhavantīti jñāpitatvāt| tarhyavidyamānavadbhāvamātrajñāpanenopakṣīṇaṃ liṅgamāgamānāmanudāttattāṃ na jñāpayatīti cet? vācanikaṃ tarhi tadastu| tathā ca bhāṣyam-"yadyeve vacanādathāpi jñāpakādāgamā anudātta bhavanti" iti| avaśyaṃ ca tvayā'pīdaṃ bācyam, bhavitavyamityādau pūrvamudāttatve satyapi paścādbhavanniṭ jñāpakañca vacanaṃ vācanikamityanudātto bhavet śeṣanighāteneti cet? nāyaṃ śeṣanighātasya viṣayaḥ, svaravidhiśeṣatvāttasya| `yasminpade yasyāmavasthāyāṃ yasyāca udāttaḥ svarito vā vidhīyate tasminpade tasyāmavasthāyāṃ sannihitamajantaraṃ nihanyate' ityarthaḥ| na cāyaṃ prakāro'tra sambhavati| tasmādiṭo'nudāttatvaṃ nātra sūtrārambhasya phalamiti sthitam| idaṃ tarhi phalaṃ `srughne bhavā snaughnī' aṇa utpattivelāyāmevodāttatve sati udāttānivṛttisvarema ṅībudāttaḥ| anyathā `straughna ī' iti sthite "pratyayasya ca" ityādyudāttatvaṃ bādhitvā paratvāt "yasya"(pāosūo6-4-148)iti lope kṛte udāttanivṛttisvaro na labhyeteti cet? maivam, parasyāpi yasyeti lopasya ṅībutpattimapekṣamāṇasya antaraṅgeṇa bādhāt| tavāpi hi ātreyīśabde iyameva gatiḥ| tathāhi, atrerapatyam "itaścāniñaḥ"(pāosūo4-1-122)iti ḍhak| āyannādiṣu upadeśivadvacanaṃ svarasiddhyarthamiti pratyayasvarātpūrvameyādeśaḥ| "ṭiḍḍhā"(pāosūo6-1-15)iti ṅīp| ātreya ī iti sthite taddhitasya "kitaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-165)iti svaraṃ bādhitvā paratvāt "yasya"(pāosūo6-4-148)iti lope kṛte udāttanivṛttisvaro na syāt| tasmānnedaṃ phalamiti sthitam| astu tarhyanudāttasyātra pradeśe karaṇe phalāntaram| tathāhi,
pitsvarāttitsvaraṣṭāpi citsvaraścāpi pitsvarāt|
kāryaśabdāṭṭāpi svaritatvātprāgekādeśe kṛte tasya pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvāttitsvaraḥ prāpnoti paraṃ pratyādivadbhāvātpitsvaraśca paratvātsvarito bhavati| yadi tu "lasārvadhātukamanudāttam" "suppitau ca" ityucyate tarhi paratvādanudāttatvaṃ syāt| evam `āmbaṣṭhyā' ityatra yaṅaścāpyekādeśe kṛte pitsvarātparatvāccitsvaro jāyate| tadapi viparītaṃ syāditi cet? maivam, `kāryā' ityatra hi ṭābutpatteḥ prāgeva svarito bhavatyantaraṅgatvātsatyapi vā ṭāpi svaritaikādeśayorubhayoranityayoḥ paratvātsvarite kṛte āntaryataḥ svaritānudāttayorekādeśaḥ svarita eva bhavati| āmbaṣṭhyāyāmapi cāpaścitkaraṇasāmarthyādeva citsvaro bhaviṣyati| sāmānyagrahaṇe cittvamupakṣīṇamiti cet? na, evaṃ hi ṭāpprakarama eva "yaṅaḥ" iti sūtrayet|
(pāosūo3-1-4)
anudāttau suppitau(pāosūo3-1-4)|| pūrvasyāpavādaḥ| suppratyāhāraḥ picca anudāttaḥ syāt| pratyāhāraśca supaḥ pakārema na tu kapaḥ, ṭābādīnāṃ pitkaraṇāt, supaḥ pakārasyānanyārthatvācca| dṛṣadaḥ| paṭhati, pacati|
(pāosūo3-1-5)
guptij‌kid‌bhyaḥ san(pāosūo3-1-5)|| ebhyaḥ paraḥ sanpratyayaḥ syāt| "dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ"(pāosūo3-1-7)iti sūtre vāgrahaṇaṃ vibhajya trisūtrīśeṣatayā sambadhyate| sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena prathamasūtradvaye arthaviśeṣopahitebhya eva dhātubhyaḥ san| sa ca viśeṣo munitrayeṇa sākṣādanukto'pi vṛttikārādibhirupanibaddhaḥ|
tatra gupernindāyām(kāovāo)| jugupsate|
tijeḥ kṣamāyām(kāovāo)| titikṣate|
kitervyādhipratīkāre apanayane nāśane nigrahe ca(kāovāo)| cikitsati vaidyaḥ| "kṣetriyacparakṣetre cikitsyaḥ"(pāosūo5-2-12)iti sūtre vṛttigranthaḥ| kṣetriyāṇi tṛṇāni sasyārthaṃ kṣetre jātāni cikitsyāni apaneyāni vināśayitavyāni vā| tathā kṣetriyaḥ pāradārikaḥ| paradārāḥ parakṣetraṃ tatra cikitsyo nigrahītavyaḥ| vipūrvaḥ saṃśaye'pi-vicikitsati me manaḥ| "vicikitsā tu saṃśayaḥ"(aokoo1-5-4)ityamaraḥ| arthāntare tu gopayati| hetumaṇṇic| tejayati| saṃketayati| hetumaṇṇic curādiṇijvā| bhūvādau curādau cānayoḥ pāṭhādeti nyāsakāraḥ| vastutastu sarvatra curādiṇijeva na tu hetumaṇṇic ityanupadameva avayave hyacaritārthaṃ liṅgaṃ sāmarthyātsamudāyasya viśeṣakāmiti bhāṣye samarthitam| yuktaṃ caitat, bhvādau anudāttetsu `gupa gopane'tija niśāne'(bhvāoā995,996)ityanayoḥ pāṭhāt| maitreyastu tatraiva `gupa gopanakutsanayoḥ' iti papāṭha| eṣāṃ ca nityaṃ san| tathā ca bhāṣyam-"naitebhyaḥ prāksana ātmanepadaṃ nāpi parasmaipadaṃ paśyāmaḥ" iti| evaṃ ca `gopate' `tejate' iti svāmyuktaḥ kevalāttaṅaḥ prayogaḥ pratyuktaḥ| nanvevaṃ gopayati tejayatīti ṇijante'pi taṅprasaṅgaḥ| sannante taṅaṃ pravartya anudāttetvaṃ caritārthamiti cet? ṇici pravartyatāṃ na tu sanīti viparītaṃ kuto na; iti cet?
atrocyate, bhinnārthā dhātavo bhinnā eva| evaṃ ca nindākṣamādau yatrārthe sanniṣyate tadupahitāḥ sānubandhā bhvādayo bhinnā eva, yatra liṅgamiti bhāṣyasyāyamevāśayaḥ| spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ "pūrvavatsanaḥ"(pāosūo1-3-62)iti sūtre padamañjaryām| evañca bhvādibhyo hetumaṇṇijiti prāguktanyāsagrantho'saṅgata eva|
atrābharaṇakāraḥ-gupādisūtre guptij‌kinmānityupakramya gupādiṣvanubandhakaraṇamātmanepadārthamiti bhāṣye vārtike coktatvātkitiḥ parasmaipadiṣu paṭhito'pyātmanepadī bodhyaḥ| na ca gupādiṣviti bahuvacanaṃ vakṣyamāṇamān‌badhādyapekṣamiti vācyam, bhāṣye viśiṣya kiterapyupakramādityāha| etadanusārī vardhamāno'pi "svāśrayaṃ kaścikitsatu" iti khaṇḍanasya vyākhyāvasare "cikitsatāmiti tu yuktam" ityāha| mādhavastu naitanmene, anekamahāgranthaviruddhatvāt| tathāhi, dhātupāṭhe tāvadayamudāttetpaṭhitaḥ vṛttikāro'pīha parasmaipadamudājahāra| kaiyaṭo'pyāha-kramadarśanāya kitiḥ paṭhito na tvayamanudāttediti| haradatto'pyāha `kitistu parasmaipadī' iti| svāmī kāśyapa indraścetyādayo'pītthameva pratyapīpadan| tasmāt śrīharṣoktireva yuktā vardhamānoktirayukteti dik|
tathā ca prayujyate-tasya cikitsato bhrama evaṃ vidvānvicikitsatītyādi| sano nakāraḥ svarārthaḥ| dhātusvarastu na bhavati nitkaraṇasāmarthyāt| yaḥ stotāraṃ jighāṃsati sakhāyam| na cārdhadhātuke atolopena bhāvyam, sārvadhātuke tu śāpā sahaikādeśena, tathā ca sanokāro māstviti cet? na, ditsadhitsādibhya ekāc‌tve yaṅ‌prasaṅgāt `ditsyam' `dhitsyam' ityatra ṇyatprasaṅgācca| "kāsyanekāj‌grahaṇaṃ culumpādyartham" iti vārtikasya pratyayagrahaṇamapanīyānekāj‌grahaṇaṃ karttavyamityevaṃparatvena `ditsāñcakre' ityādyasiddhyāpatteśca| etena sanyaṅoriti saptamīṃ vyākhyāya `pratīṣiṣati'-`aṭāṭyate' ityādau tu sanyaṅorakāroccāraṇasāmarthyād‌dvitvamiti vadantaḥ prasādakārādayaḥ parāstāḥ, uktarītyā akāroccāraṇasya caritārthatvāt| nyāsaharadattādigranthāstu sanyaṅordvitvamapi phalamityevaṃparāḥ| te ca ṣaṣṭhīvyakhyānameva gṛhītvā yojyā iti dik|
(pāosūo3-1-6)
mān‌badhadān‌śān‌bhyo dīrghaścābhyāsasya(pāosūo3-1-6)|| ebhyaḥ sansyāt abhyāsasya ikārasya dīrghaśca| atrāpi pūrvavadarthaviśeṣopahitebhyaḥ sānubandhebhyo nityaḥ san| arthāntaropahitāni tu dhātvantarāṇi curādau boddhavyānīti niṣkarṣaḥ| tatra-
mānervicāre(kāovāo)| mīmāṃsate| nanu jñānārthānmāneruttarasūtreṇaiva sannastu, maivam, dīrghavidhānārthamiḍabhāvārthañcāsyāvaśyakatvāt| dhātorityavidhānāddhi sano'tra nārdhadhātukatvamato neṭ| yattūttaratantre vācaspatyādau mīmāṃsāśabdo `māṅ māne'(dioāo36)ityasmād‌vyutpanna ityuktam, tasyāyamāśayaḥ-iha sanprakṛtistāvadātmanepadārhāccurādikādbhinnaiveti sthitam| tatra "māna pūjāyām" ityādivṛttikāragrantho bhaṅktvā vyākhyeya eva| na hi tasmādayaṃ san| evaṃ sthite sanprakṛtiranudāttetkaivetyatra mānābhāvāt, ṅīdeva sāstu, nuk‌sūtre ca nipātyatāṃ muṇḍamiśrādi (pāosūo3-1-21)sūtre halikalyoradantatvavat| na ca vaiyākaraṇānāmupāyeṣvāgrahaḥ,
upeyapratipattyarthā upāyā avyavasthitāḥ| ityukteḥ|
na caivaṃ "sanimīmā"(pāosūo7-4-54)itīs‌prasaṅgaḥ, ghvādisāhacaryeṇecchāsanyeva tadvidhānāt iti|
badheścittavikāre(kāovāo)| bībhatsate|
dānerārjave(kāovāo)| dīdāṃsate|
śānerniśāne|(kāovāo)| niśānaṃ tīkṣṇīkaraṇam| śīśāṃsati, śīśāṃsate| curādīnāṃ tu-māna pūjāyām(cuopao311)mānayati| badhabandhane(cuopao74)bādhayati| dāna avaguṇṭhane(bhvāopao1019)dānayati| śāna tejane(bhvāopāo1020)śānayati| atra sanprakṛtibhūtau mānbadhī anudāttetau, śeṣau svaritetau| curādayastvananubandhāḥ| nanu trayāṇāmarthabhedādbhedo'stu śānestu ṇicsanorarthaikyātkathaṃ bheda iti cet? dhunāti dhunotyādīnāmiveti gṛhāṇa| syādetat, iha dīrghaśrutyā aca ityupasthitaṃ taccedabhyāsena viśeṣyate tadā abhyāsasyāco vidhīyamāno dīrgho halādiśeṣātprāk syāt| acā abhyāsaviśeṣaṇe tu ajantasyābhyāsasya vidhīyamāno halādiśeṣaṃ pratīkṣatāṃ tato'dhikasya pratīkṣāyāṃ kāraṇābhāvāt viśeṣavihitatvācca samantarameva bhavan badheritvasya śeṣāṇāṃ hrasvasya ca bādhakaḥ syāt| tataścābhyāse ākāraḥ śrūyeta natvīkāra iti cet? satyam| ata eva ābhyāsasyeti cchedaḥ kṛtaḥ| abhyāsasya vikāra ābhyāsaḥ, sa cetvameva| tathāhi lopastāvannavikāraḥ, lopāgamavarṇavikārajña iti paspaśāyāṃ dvau cāparau varṇavikāranāśāviti vārttike ca pṛthagupādānāt| abhāvasyādeśavidhānāyogācca, aca ityupasthiteśca| yadi tu hrasvasya syāttarhi taddhitanirddeśo vyarthaḥ syāt| tasmāditvameva taddhitena pratyāyyate| yadvā, sanyāhatya vihitasya vikārasya grahaṇamastu| tadetadābhisandhāya vyākhyātaṃ prāk `ābhyāsasya vikārasya'iti'| atha vā "dīrgho'kitaḥ"(pāosūo7-4-83)ityātrākidgrahaṇena abhyāsavikāreṣu bādhyabādhakabhāvo nāstīti jñāpyate| taddhi `yaṃyaṃmyate' `raṃraṃmyate' ityādau nuki kṛte mā bhūditi kṛtam| viśeṣavihitena nukā anajantatvādeva dīrgho na bhaviṣyatīti kiṃtena? ata eva `ḍoḍhaukyate' `totraukyate' ityādau hrasve kṛte guṇo bhavati| anyathā `babādhe' ityādau caritārthaṃ hrasvatvaṃ `pāpacyate' ityādau caritārtho dīrghaḥ paratvād bādheta|
(pāosūo3-1-7)
dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ samānakartṛkādicchāyāṃ vā(pāosūo3-1-7)|| iṣeḥ karma tenaiva ca samānakartṛko yo dhātuḥ tasmādicchāyāmarthe sanpratyayo vā syāt| dhātoḥ karmatvasamānakartṛkatve arthadvārake bodhye| arthasyāpi te iṣinirūpite eva na tu kriyāntaranirūpite, icchāyāmityasya sannidhānāt| kartumicchati cikīrṣati| dhātoḥ kim? sana ārddhadhātukatvaṃ yathā syāt| tena yathāyathāmiḍguṇau staḥ| anvathā `jugupsate' ityādāviva na syātām| karmaṇaḥ kim? gamanenecchatīttharthe `jigamiṣati' iti mā bhūt| samānakartṛkātkim? devadattakartṛkaṃ bhojanamicchati yajñadattaḥ| icchāyāṃ kim? kartuṃ jānāti| vāvacanādvākyamapi| na ca "samānakartṛkeṣu tumun"(pāosūo3-3-158)iti tumunvidhānasāmarthyādeva vākyaṃ siddhamiti vācyam, cikīrṣitumicchatītyatra caritārthatvāt| nahyatra sanaḥ prasaṅgaḥ, sannantānna sannitivakṣyamāṇatvāt|
āśaṅkāyāmupasaṃkhyānam(kāovāo)|| kūlaṃ pipatiṣati| śvā mumūrṣati| śaṅke patiṣyati kūlam| śaṅke mariṣyati cetyarthaḥ| āśaṅkā sambhāvanā tadviśiṣṭakriyāvacanātsvārthe sanniti kaiyaṭādayaḥ| śaṅkāviśiṣṭayoḥ patanamaraṇayorlaḍarthavarttamānatvānvaye `svargī dhvasta' ityādāviva viśeṣaṇībhūtaśaṅkāyāṃ vartamānatvaparyavasānaṃ bodhyam| pratyākhyānaṃ tu yo yadicchati sa tasya pūrvarūpāṇi karoti yathā-devadattaḥ kaṭaṃ cikīrṣuḥ pūlādīnyupādatte| evaṃ kūlasyāpi loṣṭaviśaraṇādīnyupalabhya patanecchā'dhyāropyate| yadvā, sanvidhāyake sūtre icchāśabdo gauṇamukhyasādhāraṇaḥ| gauṇamukhyanayāyastu lakṣyānurodhātsvaritatvācca nāśrayite| atra bhāṣyam--
śeṣikānmatubarthīyācchaiṣiko matubarthikaḥ|
sarūpaḥ pratyayo neṣṭaḥ sannantānna saniṣyate||
ayaṃ śloka iha sūtre matubvidhau ca bhāṣye paṭhitaḥ| asmābhistu caturthe "śeṣe"(pāosūo4-2-12)iti sūtre jñāpitoya'miti tatraiva vyākhyāsyate| etavdyākhyānaparāḥ prakṛtasūtrasthakaiyaṭaharadattādigranthāḥ pāñcamikabhāṣyaviruddhā iti tatraiva vakṣyate| iha sanprasaṅgādanyo'pyaniṣṭaḥ pratyayo vāritaḥ| prakṛtopayuktaṃ tu 'sannantānna saniṣyate" iti| sarūpa ityeva| sārūpyaṃ cātra sādṛśyam| svārthasannanttāttu syādeva| jugupsiṣate| mīmāṃsiṣate| etacca nyāyasiddham| tathāhi, lakṣyavasādiha jātiḥ padārthaḥ| tatra ca sakṛllakṣaṇaṃ pravarttate iti sanpravṛtteḥ prāk tadantaprakṛtyasambhavāttadantātpratyayasya prasaṅga eva nāstītyāhuḥ| evaṃ tu yaṅ san ṇyantātsani bo bhūyiṣayiṣatītyādi bahūnāṃ lekhanaṃ virudhyate| tasmādvācanikaḥ sannantāttadabhāva ityeva sāram| iha yo grāmaṃ gantumicchati tasya yadyapi grāmo na svarūpeṇeṣṭaḥ grāmo me syāditi, tathāpi gamyamānatārūpeṇeṣṭa eva| ata eva grāmo jigaṃsyate jigamiṣitavyaḥ jigamiṣitaḥ sujigamiṣa iti sannantādgrāme karmaṇi lādayo bhavanti| gamanaṃ prati karmatvamapyastyeva| ata eva grāmaṃ grāmāya vā jigamiṣatītyatra "gatyarthakarmaṇi"(pāosūo2-3-12)iti dvitīyācaturthyau bhavata iti bhāṣye sthitam| evaṃ ca grāmo gamanaṃ cetyubhayamiṣeḥ karma "śakyaṃ ca kṣudupahantum" iti paspaśāyāṃ bhāṣyasya tatratyakaiyaṭasya ca paryālocanayā kṣut upahananaṃ cetyubhayaṃ śakeḥ karmeti sthitam| evaṃ ca gantumiṣyate śakyate ceti prayoge grāmo grāmaṃ cetyubhayamapi vivakṣābhedena sādhu| prathamāntasya hi iṣi śakibhyāṃ karmatvena śābdo'nvayaḥ, gaminā tvārthaḥ| dvitīyāntasya tu gamiṃ prati karmatvaṃ śābdam, iṣaśakī prati tu viśiṣṭasya vaiśiṣṭyaṃ, viśeṣye viśeṣaṇaṃ tatra ca viśeṣaṇāntaramiti vā bodhyam| etena iṣiśakī ca dvikarmakau bhāṣye sthitāviti mādhavagrantho vyākhyātaḥ| kintu etadupaṣṭambhena "ayācitāraṃ nahi" iti śloke devadevasya śakikarmatvaṃ yadupapāditaṃ taccintyam| uktarītyā hi sutāṃ grāhayitumiti dvayaṃ karmāstu, gṛhṇādikartustu śakikarmatāyāṃ kaḥ prasaṅgaḥ?
|| iti śrīśabdakaustubhe tṛtīyasyādhyāyasya prathame pāde prathamamānhikam ||
|| tṛtīyasyādhyāyasya pradhamapāde dvitīyamānhikam ||
(pāosūo3-1-8)
supa ātmanaḥ kyac(pāosūo3-1-8)|| karmaṇa icchāyāṃ veti vartate| iṣikarmaṇa eṣitṛsambandhinaḥ subantādicchāyāmarthe kyac pratyayo vā syāt| ātmanaḥ putramicchati putrīyati| ātmaśabdo'tra paravyāvṛttiparaḥ svaśabdaparyāyo gṛhyate na tu cetanamātravacanaḥ| tathātve hi sa icchāṃ viśeṣayet subante vā? ādye'pi ātmana iti kartari ṣaṣṭhī cet? ātmā cedicchatīti tarhi paryavatsyet| tathā ca vyarthaviśeṣaṇatā, nahya nātmā icchati| karmaṣṭhyāṃ tu "aśvakṣīra"(pāosūo7-1-51)iti sūtraṃ na saṅgacchate, kṣīrādibhyaḥ kyaco durlabhatvāt| dvitīye'pi vyarthaviśeṣaṇataiva| parasyāpi hi iṣyamāmaḥ cetanasambandhī bhavatyeva| tasmādya thoktameva sādhu| svasya yatsubantamityatra tu kasya svasyetyapekṣāyāṃ icchayā eṣituḥ saṃnidhāpitatvāt tasyaiveti labhyate| na caivamapi ātmanaḥ putraṃ parasya svāminamicchatītyatra prasaṅgaḥ, subantasyātmasanvandhitvāditi vācyam, nahyatra yathākathaṃcidātmasambandhitvaṃ vivakṣitam, kiṃ tarhīṣyamāṇaṃ rūpamātmasambandhitvena yadeṣyatetadā pratyayaḥ| iha tvātmīyatvena necchā kintu parasvāmitveneti na doṣaḥ| suṣgrahaṇaṃ padavidhitvārtham| tena samarthaparibhāṣopasthānānmahāntaṃ putramicchatītyādau sāpekṣānna bhavati| anyathā mahāntaṃ putrīyatītisyāt| na ca sub‌grahaṇaṃ vinā'pi karmaṇa ityanenaiva padavidhitvaṃ labhyatāmiti vācyam, yatra hi padasyāsā dhāraṇaṃ rūpamāśrīyate sa padavidhiḥ karmatvaṃ tu apade'pi dṛśyate dhātoḥ karmaṇa iti yathā| kathaṃ tarhi "karmaṇyaṇ"(pāosūo6-2-1)ityādau padavidhitvamiti cet? upapadasañjñāyā anvarthatvabalāditi gṛhāṇa| mahāputrīyatīti tu mahāputrīmicchatīti vigrahe bodhyam| ātmanaḥ kim? rājñaḥ putramicchati purohitaḥ| nanvasāmarthyādevātra na bhaviṣyatīti cet? tarhyātmanaḥ putramicchatītyatrāpi na syāt| nanu laukikavigrahe ātmana iti prayoge'pi alaukike prakriyāvākye kevalātputraśabdāt kyajiti cet? tarhi tathaiva parakīyaputrecchāyāmapi syāditi gṛhāṇa| kiñca putraśabdasya nityasāpekṣatvānnāsāmartyam| apica yatrārthādeva parakīyatve gamyate tatra parasyeti prayogābhāvātspaṣṭaivātivyāptiḥ| aghamicchatīti yathā| na hi kaścidātmano'ghamicchati| kyacaḥ kakāro "naḥ kye"(pāosūo1-4-15)iti sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ| `ye' ityukte hi `sāmasu sādhuḥ sāmanyaḥ' atrāpi syāt| cakārastadavighātārthaḥ| svarastu pratyayasvarema dhātusvareṇā vā siddhaḥ| akārastu yadyapi na śravaṇārthaḥ, ārddhaniṣedhārthaḥ saḥ| tathāhi, samidhaṃ dṛṣadaṃ vecchati samidhyati, dṛṣadyati| tato ṇvul "ato lopaḥ"(pāosūo6-4-48)| " yasya halaḥ"(pāosūo6-4-41)| "kyasya vibhāṣā"(pāosūo6-4-50)| samidhakaḥ| dṛṣadakaḥ| atrāllopasya sthānivadbhāvāt "puganta"(pāosūo7-3-86)iti guṇaḥ "ata upadhāyāḥ"(pāosūo7-2-116)iti vṛddhiśca na bhavati| kiñca mṛdamicchati mṛdyati| mṛdyateḥ "aco yat"(pāosūo3-1-97)atolopādi pūrvat-mṛdyam| "yato'nāvaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-213)ityādyudāttatvam| apica `putrīyati' ityādau śapo'nudāttatā syāt| śapā sahaikādeśe tu sa udātto bhavati| apica mṛdyateranekāc‌tvādya ṅonutpattirāmpratyayaśca phalamiti dik|
kyaci māntīvyayācāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ(kāovāo)|| māntaścāvyayaṃ ceti dvandvaḥ, tena tatprakṛtika lakṣyate| māntaprakṛtikādavyayaprakṛtikācca subantānna kyajityartha-| yathāśrute tu putramicchatītyādau kyaj na syāt kāvicchati kānicchatītyādauca syāt| idamicchati svaricchati| gosamānākṣaranāntādityeke| gomicchati gavyati-"vānto yi pratyaye"(pāosūo6-1-79)| dadhīyati, madhūyati-"akṛtsārva"(pāosūo7-4-25)iti dīrghaḥ| kartrīyati-"rīṅṛta-"(pāosūo7-4-27)| rājīyati, takṣīyati-"naḥ kye"(pāosūo1-4-15)padatvānnalope "kyaci ca"(pāosūo7-4-33)itītvam| "nalopaḥ supsvara"(pāosūo8-2-2)iti niyamānnāsiddhatvam| asminpakṣe `vācyati' `mṛdyati' ityādi na siddhyediti nāyaṃ sthitaḥ pakṣa ityāhuḥ|
chandasi parecchāyāmapi(kāovāo)| jahi yo no aghāyati| mā tvā vṛkā aghāyavo vidan| jñāpakātsiddham| yadayaṃ kyaci prakṛterītvabādhanārtham `aśvāghasyā''t"(pāosūo7-4-37)ityākāraṃ śāsti| na hi kaścidātmano'ghamicchati| na cācārakyajarthaṃ tat, chandasi aghaśabdādācāre kyaco'darśanāt, udāhṛtasthale icchārthasyaiva pratīterityāhuḥ| kyajanteṣu prakṛtyartho yadyapi karma tathāpi tasya dātvarthāntarbhāvāt jīvatinṛtyatī tyādivadakarmaka evecchākyajantaḥ| ato'smādbhāve kartari ca lādayaḥ| ācārakyajante tu putrāderupamānakarmaṇo dhātvarthāntarbhāve'pi chātrāderupameyakarmaṇo'nantarbhāvāttasminkarmaṇi lādayo bhavantyeva| `putrayyite chātraḥ' `putrīyitavyaḥ' ityādi yathā, `śyenāyate kākaḥ' ityatra upamānakarturantarbhāve'pi upameyakartari lo bhavati tadvat| nanūktarītyā muṇḍaṃ karoti muṇḍayati māṇavakamiti na sidhyet, ṇijante mauṇḍyaguṇaviśiṣṭatvenaiva karmāntarbhūtaṃ na tu māṇavakatvādinā viśeṣeṇeti yadi, tarhi tathaiva muṇḍamicchati muṇḍīyati māṇavakamityapi syāt| tasmāt ṇickyacorviśeṣo vaktavya iti cet? ucyate, "tatkaroti'(gaosūo)iti ṇici siddhe "muṇḍamiśra"(pāosūo3-1-21)iti punarvidhānaṃ sāpekṣebhyo'pi yathā syādityevamarthameva| kyac tu nirapekṣeṣu caritārtha iti spaṣṭa eva viśeṣaḥ| yadvā, kaṇḍvādivat muṇḍādayo dvividhāḥ| dhātavaḥ prātipadikāni ca| tatra sautrā ete viśiṣṭakriyāvacanā dhātavaḥ| tebhyaścurādivatsvārthe ṇic| prātipadikānāṃ tu vigraha eva| māṇavakaṃ muṇḍaṃ karotīti| athavā muṇḍayatītyatra kamiti viśeṣākāṅkṣā anubhavasiddhā| muṇsyaiva vā śuddhena karotinā'nvayaḥ| mauṇḍyaviśiṣṭena tu māṇavakasya| yathā `gāṃ dogdhi paya' itiśuddhasya duheḥ pūrva gavā sambandhaḥ, paścāttu goduhinā payasaḥ| kyacpratyayastu anabhidhānānna bhavati| māmavakaṃ muṇḍīyatītyukte muṇḍamivācaratītyarthāntarameva gamyate| taduktaṃ hariṇā--
sadapīcchākyacaḥ karma tadācārakyacāhṛtam|
vākyavācyamato vyakteryathā'bhyāsaḥ kramādiṣu|| iti|
