asyārthaḥ-sadapi nyāyataḥ sambhavadapīcchākyacaḥ karma vākyavācyaṃ māṇavakaṃ muṇḍamicchatītyevaṃ rūpeṇa bodhanīyam, na tu kyajantena, yata ācārakyacā hṛtaṃ niravakāśīkṛtam, tadarthasyaiva nirūḍheḥ| ācārakyacā haraṇe vākyavācyatve vā hetumāha-ato vyakteriti| ato'smāt kyaco vyakterācārārthasyaiva pratīteḥ| ato vākyādicchākarmaṇaḥ pratīteriti vā| yathā kramādiṣu gatyartheṣu abhyāsaḥ paunaḥpunyaṃ vākyenaiva gamyate na tu yaṅā, kauṭilye nirūḍheḥ| uktaṃ ca prakīrṇakāṇḍe-
sadapīcchākyacaḥ karmma eva prayujyate|
prasiddhena hṛtaḥ śabdo bhāvagarhābhidhāyinā||
abhyāse tulyarūpatvānna yaṅantaḥ pravartate| iti||
etena yatheti kramādiṣu yathā vedādiviṣayo'bhyāso vyajyate tathā vākye icchākyacaḥ karmetyarthaḥ| athavā'bhyāsakramādiṣvityekaṃ padam, abhyāsena varmakramādiviṣayābhivyaktirbhavati tathā vākyena karmatvaviṣayābhivyaktirityartha iti vivaraṇaṃ pratyuktam| atra bhāṣye kyajantasya `iṣṭaḥ putraḥ' `iṣyate putraḥ' ityādayo vigrahā nirākṛtāḥ| tasyāyamāśayaḥ-yadyapi vṛttivākyayoratyantasamānārthakatā nāstītyadūraviprakarṣeṇaiva sarvatra vigrahaḥ, tathāpi susadṛśasambhave mandasadṛśopādānamanyāyyam| icchākyajantasya cākarmakatayā karmapratyayāntairvigraho'nucitaḥ, nirarthakādhikāvāpatteriti| ata eva bāhulakātkarmaṇi kvibantasya śrīśabdasya `śrīyate' ityeva vigraho nyāyyo na tu śrayantyetāmiti kartrarthatiṅanteneti mānyāḥ| yadi tu kartari kvip tarhi śrayatītyeva vigraha ityanyadetat| evaṃ ca śrayantyetāmityatra kiṃ śabdāśuddhirarthāśuddhirvetyādivalganamatratyabhāṣyāparyālocanamūla katvādupekṣyam|
atha nāmadhātuṣu pratisūtraṃ leśataḥ prakriyā vyutpādyate| putrīyatītyādau alaukike prakriyāvākye sandhikāryarahitātputra amityasyātkyaci supo luk "antaraṅgānapi"(paobhāo53)iti nyāyāt| tataḥ "kyaci ca"(pāosūo7-4-33)itītvam, aśvasyati| vṛṣasyati| kṣīrasyati| lavaṇasyati| "aśvakṣīravṛṣalavaṇānāmātmaprītau kyaci"(pāosūo7-1-51)ityasugāgamaḥ| atrātmapratāvityapanīya "aśvavṛṣayaurmaithunecchāyām" "kṣīralavaṇayorlālasāyām" iti vakṣyate| tenādyayorudāharaṇayoraśvavṛṣayormaithunāyecchatītyarthaḥ| anye tu parityaktaprakṛtyarthā maithunecchaivārtha ityāhuḥ| tathā ca kālidāsaḥ--
iti rāmo vṛṣasyantīṃ vṛṣaskandhaḥ śaśāsa tām| iti|
nighaṇṭuśca-`vṛṣasyantī tu kāmukī' iti| itarayorapi tṛṣṇātireko'bhyavajihīrṣātireko lālasā, tena kṣīralavaṇecchāyāṃ lālasārūpāyāmityarthalābhāt kṣīralavaṇe atiśayena abyavahartumicchatītyarthaḥ| atra prakṛtyasugakārayoḥ savarmadīrghaṃ bādhitvā "ato guṇe"(pāosūo6-1-97)iti pararūpam| akāroccāraṇaṃ tu pūrvasūtrodāharaṇe `brāhmaṇāsaḥ' ityādau kṛtārtham| tatha "sarvaprātipadikebhyo lālasāyamasug vaktavyaḥ" ityanakārāntādasaki dadhyasyatītyādau ca sugasukau ca daghimadhubhyāmeva staḥ, bhāṣye "dadhisyati madhustatītyevamartham" ityukterityeke| anye tu sarvaprātipadikebhya ityeke iti sarvagrahaṇād‌bahuvacananirdeśācca sarvatrastaḥ| evamarthamiti tūdāharaṇāntarāṇāmapyupalakṣaṇamiti vadanti|
aśanodakadhanebhyaḥ kyaci "aśanāyodanyadhanāyā bubhukṣāpipāsāgardheṣu"(pāosūo7-4-34)ityaśanadhanayorītvāpavāda ātvam udakasyodannādeśaśca| aśanāyati| sadyo bhoktumaśanamicchatītyarthaḥ| bubhukṣāyāṃ kim? aśanīyati| auttarakālikamaśanamicchatītyarthaḥ| udanyati| pātumudakamicchatītyarthaḥ| udakīyati| snānādyarthamudakamicchatītyarthaḥ| dhanāyati, satyapi dhane bhūyo'pīcchatītyarthaḥ| dhanīyati| daridraḥ san dhanamicchatītyarthaḥ| kecittu aśanādiprakṛtyarthamanapekṣya kevalaṃ bubhukṣādīneva kyajantasyārthān manyante| tathāca nighaṇṭuḥ-"udanyā tu pipāsā tṛṭ" iti| bhāraviśca-"kimu dhanaṃ dhanāyitum" iti| gārgyamicchati gārgīyati| atra "kyacvyośca"(pāosūo6-4-152)iti hala uttarasya āpatyayakārasya lopaḥ| upārṣabhīyati, uparṣabhīyati| upālkārīyati, upalkārīyati| atra "vā supyāpiśaleḥ"(pāosūo6-1-92)iti vṛddhivikalpaḥ| pakṣe guṇaḥ| na ca pakṣe guṇaḥ| na ca pakṣe "ṛtyakaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-128)iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ| vā supītyatra hi "upasargādṛti dhātau"(pāosūo6-1-91)iti sampūrṇamanuvarttate| tatra "yatkriyāyuktā" iti nyāyenopasargagrahaṇādeva dhātāviti labdhe punardhātu grahaṇaṃ yogavibhāgenādhikavidhānārthaṃ satprakṛtibhāvaṃ bādhata iti ṣaṣṭhe vakṣyamāṇatvāt|
upagatā ṛṣabhīyakā amuṃ deśam uparṣabhīyako deśaḥ| iha guṇaprakṛtibhāvau na tu vṛddhiḥ, gamimpratyupasargatve'pi subdhātuṃ pratyatathātvāt| na ca "upasargādadhvanaḥ"(pāosūo5-4-54)ityādāviva prādyupalakṣakatvam, tatrevātra mukhye bādhakābhāvāt| ṛṣabhasya samīpamuparṣabhaṃ tadicchati uparṣabhīyati| atrāpi guṇaprakṛtibhāvau na tu vṛddhiḥ, pūrvavat| syādetat "dhātusaṃjñānimitte pratyaye cikīrṣite upasargāḥ pṛthak kriyante" iti tāvadvakṣyate `udamanāyata' `unmanāyya gataḥ' `unmimanāyiṣate' iti aṭ‌lyap‌dvirvacanāni yathā syuriti| evaṃ cehāpi ṛṣabhaśabdādeva kyac| tena-upārṣabhīyat, uparṣabhīyya, upena prādisamāsaḥ| uparṣiṣabhīyiṣati ityādi sidhyatu, vṛddhistu kuto neti cet,? ṛṣabhīyateriha subdhātutvābhāvāt| "pratyayagrahaṇa"(paobhāo23)paribhāṣayā hi uparṣabhaśabdo'tra subantaḥ, na tu kevala ṛṣabhaśabdaḥ| tadiha yaḥ subanto nāsau dhātvavayavaḥ, yaśca dhātvavayavaḥ nāsau subantaḥ, kiñcopasargatvābhāvādapi na vṛddhiḥ| ata eva "lyabarthaṃ prādisamāsaḥ" ityuktaṃ na tu `gatisamāsaḥ' iti| na ca so'pi ktvāntenāsāmarthyātkathamiti vācyam, prakṛtyekadeśadvārakasya viśiṣṭena sāmarthyasya kṛtsu sarvatra vācyatvāt| na coktarītyā subdhātutvābhāve yatheṣṭadvirvacanaṃ na sidhyediti vācyam, nāmadātutvasyaiva tatra prayojakatvāt| ṛkāramicchati ṛkārīyati uparkārīyatītyatra "vāsupi"(pāosūo6-1-92)iti vṛddhiḥ śa kalaprakṛtibhāvascetyabhayaṃ na bhavati, ṛtīti taparakaraṇāt| usrāmaicchat ausrīyat| auṃkārīyat| ā ūḍhaḥ oḍhaḥ, auḍhīyat| atra "usyapadāntāt"(pāosūo6-1-96)"āmāṅośca"(pāosūo6-1-95)iti pararūpaṃ prāptam "āṭaśca"(pāosūo6-1-90)iti punarvṛddhividhānārthena caśabdena bādhyate| tathā ca ṣaṣṭhe vārtikam-"utsomāṅkṣvāṭaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ" iti| usi omāṅośca parayorāṭaḥ pararūpaṃ netyarthaḥ|
syādetat, uktavārtike āṅgrahaṇam auḍhīyaditi tadbhāṣyaṃ cāsaṅgatam, upasargāṇāṃ pṛthakkaraṇasya jñāpitatvāt| na ca sandhyabhāvaviṣayakameva taditi vācyam, uparṣabhīyatītyatra tadabhāvāpatteḥ| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ, mādhavādi granthavirodhāt|
atrāhuḥ-yatropasargasvarūpamavikalaṃ pṛthak pratīyate saṃ jñāpakasya viṣayaḥ| iha tuṃ āṅ ukāreṇa sahaikādeśe na tatheti aukārātpūrvamāṭ| tasya antavadbhāvalabdhāṅvyapadeśena okārema saha prāptaṃ pararūpaṃ vṛddhi mā bādhiṣṭeti vārtike āṅkhahaṇam| uktavārtikabhāṣyagrantha eva ca jñāpakasya viśeṣaviṣayatve pramāṇamiti| evaṃ sthite ā itaḥ etaḥ, aitīyat, etīyitvā, etitīyiṣatītyādi draṣṭavyam| praetīyatīti sthite "eṅi pararūpam"(pāosūo6-1-94)bādhitvā prāptām "etyedhati"(pāosūo6-1-89)iti vṛddhim "omāṅośca(pāosūo6-1-95)iti pararūpaṃ paratvādbādhate| pretīyati| āgata ṛśyaḥ ā īṣadṛśyo vā arśyaḥ, prādisamāsaḥ, ar guṇaḥ, arśyamicchati arśyīyati, ārśyīyat| atra gumasya antavadbhāvena āṅtvād "omāṅośca" iti pararūpaṃ prāptaṃ paratvāttadbādhitvā savarṇadīrghaḥ prāptaḥ so'pi "āṭaśca"(pāosūo6-1-90)iti punarvṛddhividhānārthena cakāreṇa bādhyata iti kecit| tanna, rūpe viśeṣābhāvāt, punarvidhānasya pararūpabādhenopakṣīṇatvācca| ata eva "usyomāṅkṣu" iti vārtikena pararūpemeva niṣiddhamiti dik|
arśyīyatītyasya prādipūrvatve prarśyīyati| atra "omāṅośca'(pāosūo601-9-7)iti bādhitvā paratvātprāptaḥ savarmadīrghaḥ cakārema punaḥ pararūpavidhānānneti mādhavaḥ| aramicchati arīyati, "rīṅ ṛtaḥ"(pāosūo7-4-27)alamicchatītyatrāpi idameva rūpaṃ, sāvarṇyāt| taparakaraṇāddīrghasya na rīṅ nāpi ṛta itvam, adhātutvāt| ṛyati| heśabdamicchati heyati| gāmicchati gavyati| gavyitā| ato lope "kyasya vibhāṣā"(pāosūo6-4-50)iti hala uttarasya kyapratyayakārasya prāpto lopaḥ "sannipāta"(paobhāo87)paribhāṣayā na bhavati| agavyīt| "vadavraja"(pāosūo7-2-3)ityatra halgrahaṇasya halsamudāyasya pratipattyarthatve'pi allopasya sthānivattvenāṅgasya halantatvābhāvānna vṛddhiḥ| raiyati| glāvyati glāvyitā| śvalihyati| śvalihyitā, śvalihitā| aśvalihīt| atra halantalakṣaṇā vṛddhirna, allopasya sthānivattvāt "neṭi"(pāosūo7-2-4)iti niṣedhācca| atra "ho ḍhaḥ"(pāosūo882--9)iti ḍhatvaṃ na, "naḥ kye" iti niyamenāpadāntatvāt| ata eva `goduhyati' ityatra "dādeḥ"(pāosūo842-32)iti ghatvaṃ `mitradruhyati' ityādau "vā druha"(pāosūo8-2-33)iti tadvikalpaḥ `upānahyati' ityādau "naho dhaḥ"(pāosūo2-34)iti dhatvam `anaḍuhyati' ityādau "vasusraṃ"(pāosūo8-2-72)iti datvaṃ ca na| puramicchati pūryati| "hali ca"(pāosūo8-2-77)iti dīrghaḥ| yattu adhātutvānna dīrgha iti mādhavenoktam| tanna, pipartteḥ kvipi "udoṣṭhyapūrvasya"(pāosūo7-9-92)ityutve raparatve ca niṣpannasya pur‌śabdasya dhātutvānapāyāt| kathamanyathā pūḥ pūrbhyāmityādau dīrghaḥ| kathaṃ ca "ṛkpūrabdhūḥ"(pāosūo5-4-78)"pūḥ sarvayoḥ"(pāosūo3-2-41)ityādinirddeśā iti dik|
evaṃ giramicchati gīryati| atrāpi girateḥ kvipi ṛta itve raparatve prāgvaddīrghaḥ| gīryitā, giritā| "kyasya vibhāṣā"(pāosūo6-4-50)iti yalopapakṣe halparatvābhāvānna dīrghaḥ| "rvoḥ"(pāosūo802-76)iti padasya vidhīyamāno'pina, "naḥ kye" iti niyamenāpadatvāt| svaricchatīti tu vākyameva na tu kyat, māntāvyayebhyaḥ pratiṣedhāt| yaturyati| divyati| anayoradhātutvāt "hali ca"(pāosūo7-2-77)iti dīrgho na| catur‌div‌śabdau hi "cateruran"(uosūo747)iti sūtrema "diverḍiviḥ" iti nyāsohitasūtreṇa ca vyutpannau avyutpannāveva vā| ubhayathā'pi dhātutvābhāvaḥ spaṣṭa eva| yattu prakriyāyāṃ "halica"(pāosūo8-2-77)iti dīrghaḥ divamicchati dīvyatītyuktam, tadaprāmāṇikameva| tathāca hali ceti sūtre kāśikā-"dhātorityeva divamicchati divyati' iti| yattu diverauṇādike kvapi divaśabdo dātureveti| vyutpattipakṣamāśritya prākriyāgranthaḥ, avyutpattipakṣamāśritya tu kāśiketyavirodha iti prasādakṛtokta; tattuccham, kvibantatve ūṭhaḥ prasaṅgād bhāṣyavirodhācca| "diva aut"(pāosūo7-1-70)iti sūtrādadhātugrahaṇānuvṛttyā veti dvedhā samāhitam| ubhayathā'pi tvatpakṣe asaṅgatiḥ spaṣṭaiveti dik|
tamicchati tadyati| yadyati| prāṇitīti prāṇ, prāṇyati| aharyati| "ro'supi"(pāosūo8-2-69)iti rutvāpavādo rephaḥ| sa ca nalope kartavye asiddho neti vakṣyate|
ujjheḥ kvip ut, tamicchati ujjhyati| kakubhyati| mṛḍaṃ pariva़ḍhaṃ vā''
cakṣāṇāmicchati mṛḍyati, parivraḍhyati| ṇāviṣṭhavadityatideśātparivṛḍherṛkārasya rephaḥ| budheḥ kvip, bhut, tamicchati budhyati| tvāṃ māmicchati tvadyati madyati| atitvāmatimāmicchati atitvadyati, atimadyati| "pratyayottarapadayośca"(pāosūo7-2-98)iti tvama au| yuvāmāvāṃ vetyādivigrahe yuṣmadyati, asmadyati| atiyuṣmadhyati, atyasmadyati| ukhāṃ panthānaṃ ca ācakṣaṇamicchati ukhyati, pathyati| marutyati| adasyati| payasyatītyādi|
(pāosūo3-1-9)
kāmyacca(pāosūo3-1-9)| uktaviṣaye kāmyac syāt| putramātmana icchati putrakāmyati| "supa ātmanaḥ kyackāmyacau" iti vaktavye uttaratra dvayoranuvṛttirmā bhūdityevamartho yogavibhāgaḥ| na caivamapi sannihitatvātkāmyajevottaratra sambadhyeteti vācyam, iha cakāreṇānukṛṣṭasya kyaca uttarārthatvāt| supa ātmanaḥ kāmyac kyacceti tu sūtrayituṃ yuktam| kāmyacaḥ kakārasya itsaṃjñā na, phalābhāvāt| na ca "kiti ca"(pāosūo7-2-118)iti niṣedhaḥ phalam, adhātuvihitatvena ārddhadātukatvābhāvādeva guṇāprāpteḥ| `vākkāmyati' ityatra sampa3sāraṇaṃ phalaṃ syāditi cet? na, ṣaṣṭhānte bhrauṇahatye tattvanipātanena "dhātoḥ svarūpagrahaṇe tatpratyaye kāryavijñānam" iti jñāpayiṣyamāṇatvāt| tatpratyayo dhātusaṃśabdanena vihitaḥ pratyaya iti prāñcaḥ|
svarūpagrahaṇaṃ ca neha śṛṅgagrāhikayopādānam, tathā sati `ghṛtaspṛgbhyām' ityādau "anudāttasya rcadupadhasya"(pāosūo6-1-59)ityamāgamaprasaṅgāt| kintu yatkāryaṃ dhātuṃ na vyabhicarati tatreyaṃ paribhāṣopatiṣṭhate| tathāca svarūpagrahaṇaṃ nāma dhātorevāśrayaṇam| tacca yathākathañcidityāstāṃ tāvat|
cakārastu bhāṣyavārtikayoḥ pratyākhyātaḥ| nyāsakāraharadattamādhavāstu 'putrakāmyiṣyati' ityādau satiśiṣṭamapi syasvaraṃ bādhitvā dhātusvaro yathā syādityetadarthaṃ citkaraṇamityāhuḥ| tattu prauḍhivāda mātraṃ munivacanavirodhena svotprekṣitasvārasyānādarttavyatvāditi suhṛdayairvibhāvyatām|
putrakāmyitā| putrakāmyiṣyati| iha "yasya halaḥ"(pāosūo6-4-49)iti na bhavati, anarthakatvāt| yasyeti hi saṅghātagrahaṇāt "arthavadgrahaṇe nānarthakasya"(paobhāo14)iti vabhyate| ata eva prayatau putrakāmyayeti sidhyati| ihāntarvartinyā vibhaktyā padatvādyathāyogaṃ padakāryāṇi| yaśaskāmyati, rutvaṃ visargaḥ, sopadādāviti satvam| svaḥkāmyati, sopadādāvanavyayasyeti vacanātsatvābhāvaḥ, adhikaraṇaśaktipradhānasyāpyasya vṛttiviṣaye śaktimatpradhānatvād iṣiṇā karmatvena yogaḥ| gīḥkāmyatītyādau `roḥ kāmye' iti roreva visarjanīyasya kāmye satvaniyamātsatvābhāvaḥ| sarpiṣkāmyati, satvaṃ bādhitvā "iṇaḥ ṣaḥ"(pāosūo8-3-39)iti ṣaḥ| ayaṃ ca satvāpavādatayā yatra tatprasaṅgastatraiva| tenoccaiḥkāmyati gīḥkāmyatītyādau na bhavati| puṃskāmyati| atra puṃsaḥ saṃyogāntalope "pumaḥ khayyam‌pare"(pāosūo8-3-6)iti rutvaṃ nirvartya "sampum‌kānāṃ so vaktavyaḥ"(kāovāo)iti satvavacanānnāsti visarjanīya iti na ṣatvam| māntāvyayebhyo'pyayaṃ bhavatyeva-kiṃkāmyati| anusvāraparasavaraṇamavikalpau|
(pāosūo3-1-10)
upamānādācāre(pāosūo3-1-10)|| upamānātkarmaṇaḥ subantādācāre'rthe kyac syāt| putramivācarati putrīyati cchātram| viṣṇūyati dvijam|
adhikaraṇācceti vaktavyam(kāovāo)| prāsādīyati kuṭyām| kuṭīyati prāsāde| ihopameye saptamīśravaṇādupamānamapi saptamyantameveti karmatvāvivakṣayā sūtreṇāsiddhe vārtikārambhaḥ| sūtravārtikayorubhayorapyudāharaṇe kyac‌pratyayasya ācāramātramarthaḥ| prakṛtestu vṛttiviṣaye ekatra svārthakarmakācaraṇasadṛśamarthaḥ, aparatra svārthādhikaraṇakācaraṇasadṛśam| tacca pratyayārthe'bhedena saṃsargeṇa viśeṣaṇam| pratyayārthe bhūtācaraṇakriyā tu upameyā| sā ca bāhyābhyāṃ karmādhikaraṇābhyāṃ sambadhyate|
(pāosūo3-1-11)
karttuḥ kyaṅa sa lopaśca(pāosūo3-1-11)|| upamānātkartuḥ subantādācāre kyaṅ vā syāt, sāntasya tu karturalontyasyeti lopo vā syāt| pratyayavikalpanātpakṣe vākyam| sāntasya lopavikalpastu vyavasthitaḥ ojo'psarasornityamanyeṣāṃ tu vikalpa eveti| kṛṣṇa ivācarati kṛṣmāyate| kathaṃ tarhi--
kṣīrodīyanti sadyaḥ sakalajaladhayo vāsukīyanti nāgāḥ| iti?
kṣīrodamiva ātmānamācarantītyartha "upamānādācāre'(pāosūo3-1-10)iti kyac| ojāyate| ojaḥśabdo'tra vṛttiviṣaye tadvati vartate| apsarasa ivācarati apsarāyate| yaśāyate, yaśasyate| vidvāyate,vidvasyate| iha sūtre cakāro'nvācaye| tena kartuḥ kyaṅ sarvatra bhavati, yatra tu sakāraḥ sambhavati tatra lopo'pi| seti ca pṛthakpadaṃ luptaṣaṣṭhīkam| tena kartturviśeṣaṇāttadantavidhiḥ| ato `haṃsāyate' ityādau salopo na| nānteṣvapi lopo vyavasthitaḥ| tathāca vārtikam--
"ojo'psarasornityam" iti| evaṃ sthite|
"ojaso'psaraso nityaṃ payasastu vibhāṣayā"
iti kāśikāyāṃ payograhamaṃ ojo'psarobhinnasakārāntasyopalakṣaṇārtham| etena yaśaḥprabhṛrnaiva bhavatīti bhrāmyantaḥ parāstaḥ| yattu prakriyāyāṃ supūrvasya manaso nityamiti, tadapāṇinīyam| yattu "vidvasyamānaḥ śāstre'dhikārī" iti vācaspatigranthavyākhyāvasare kalpatarukārairuktam-vidvasyamāna iti "lohitādiḍāj‌bhyaḥ kyaṣ"(pāosūo3-1-13)iti, tallohitāderākṛtigaṇatvena prauḍhivādamātram| vastutastu kyaṅevāyaṃ na tu kyaṣ, lohitādisūtre "nāyaṃ halantādvidhīyate" iti vadadbhirbhāṣyakārairhalantātkyaṣo'naṅgīkṛtatvāt| kathamanyathā "kyasya vibhāṣā"(pāosūo6-4-50)ityatra sāmānyagrahaṇārthaṃ kakāraṃ pratyācakṣīrannityavadheyam| arcirivācarati arciṣyate| "naḥ kye"(pāosūo1-4-15)iti niyamena padāntatvābhāvātṣatvam| tvadyate, madyate| anekārthatve tu yuṣmadyate, asmadyate| kumārīvācarati kumārāyate| harimīva gaurīva gurvīvācarati hariṇāyate, gaurāyate, gurūyate| "kyaṅmāninośca"(pāosūo6-3-36)iti puṃvat| sapatnīvācarati sapatnīyate| atra puṃvadbhāvo neti nyāsakāraḥ| yadāha-"nityaṃ sapatnyādiṣu"(pāosūo4-1-35)ityatra samudāyoccāraṇaṃ puṃvadbhāvabādhanārthamiti, tadetadyuktiviruddhaṃ bhāṣyaviruddhaṃ ca| tathāhi, samudāyanipātanaṃ rūḍhyarthaṃ samānasya sabhāvārthaṃ ceti na tvaduktārthajñāpakam| tathā 'tasilādiṣu"(pāosūo6-3-35)iti sūtre bhāṣyakāraḥ--sapatnīśabdācchivādyaṇi "bhasyāḍhe"(kāovāo)iti puṃvadbhāve `sāpataḥ' iti prāpayya aḍhagrahaṇamapanīya anapatya iti vivakṣayā parihṛtya gārgyāyaṇyā apatye tu kutsite "gotrastriyāḥ kutsane ṇa ca"(pāosūo4-1-140)iti ṇapratyaye gārgyāyaṇa iti syāt, gārgya iti ceṣyata iti doṣamudbhāvya "bhasyāḍhe"(kāovāo)iti yathānyāsaṃ sthāpayitvā "nityaṃ sapatnyādiṣu"(pāosūo4-1-35)iti samudāyanipātanaṃ parihāratvenānabhidhāya śatruparyāyātsapatnaśabdāt "śārṅgaravādi"(pāosūo4-1-73)ṅīnantāt śivādyaṇ iti sāpatnaśabdaṃ sādhitavān| śivādiṣu samānaḥ patiryasyā iti vyutpāditasya samānasvāmikābhidhāyino bhāṣitapuṃskasya kevalayaugikatvādgrahaṇaṃ neṣṭamiti tadāśayaḥ| evaṃ sthite tasmāt "liṅgaviśiṣṭa"(paobhāo73)paribhāṣāyā patyuttarapadalakṣaṇe ṇye sāpatya iti bhavati, bhāvakarmaṇoḥ patyantalakṣaṇe yaki sāpatyamiti subdhātuvṛttau mādhavaḥ| tasmātkyaṅyapi prakṛtibhedena `sapatnāyate' `sapatīyate' iti dvayamapi sādhu| yattu pā rakṣaṇe(aopao46)iti dhātau mādhavenoktam-bhāvakarmaṇoḥ patyantalakṣaṇe yaki sāpatnyam, abhāṣitapuṃskatvātpuṃvadbhāvo netyādi, itarattu svāmitvamātraparamityavirodhaḥ| evaṃ ca śivādau nityastrīliṅgasyāpi yogarūḍhasya grahaṇātsāpatnaśabādo dvyarthaḥ, `sapatnīyate iti ca tṛtīyamapi rūpaṃ mādhvityavadheyam| yuvatirivācarati yuvāyate| yattu "ṅyāp'(pāosūo4-1-1)sūtrabhāṣye `yuvatitarā' ityudāharaṇāt yauvanaṃ jātiḥ, anyathā "jāteśca' iti niṣedhābhāvāttasilādiṣvitiṃ puṃvadbhāvaḥ kriyeteti| tanna, vayaso'nityatvena ajātitvāt| kathamanyathā "acaḥ parasmin"(pāosūo1-1-57)iti sūtre yuvajāniriti bhāṣyaṃ saṅgaccheta| yuvatitareti tu bhāṣyanirddeśādeva na puṃvaditi kaiyaṭe spaṣṭam|
paṭvī ca mṛdvī ca paṭvīmṛdvyau| te ivācarati paṭvīmṛdūyate| pūrvapadasya kyaṅparatvābhāvānna puṃvat| pācikāyate, "na kopadhāyāḥ"(pāosūo6-3-37)| caturthīyate, pācikāyate, "na kopadhāyāḥ"(pāosūo6-3-38)| sraughnīyate, "vṛddhinimittasya ca taddhitasyāraktavikāre"(pāosūo6-3-39)| kāṣāyīyate kanthā| raktārthatvānneha puṃvadbhāvaniṣedhaḥ| khadirasya vikāraḥ khādirī| "palāśādibhyo vā"(pāosūo4-3-141)iti vikāre aṇañoranyatarasmin ṅīp| khādirāyate ityādi|
"ācāre'vagalbhklībahoḍebhyaḥ kvibvā"(kāovāo)|| kyḍpavādo'yam| pakṣe vāgrahaṇātkyaṅapi| gal‌bha dhāṣṭarye(bhvāoāo392)| klīvṛ adhāṣṭye(bhvāopāo381)| hoḍṛ anādare(bhvāoao286)| ete pacādyajantāḥ| aco'kārasya ihaiva vārtike anudāttatvānunāsikatve pratijñāyete| tena kvibantādātmanepadaṃ sidhyati| kvipsanniyogenānunāsikatvapratijñānātkyaṅpakṣe itsañjña| na bhavati| syādetat, uktadhātūnāmanudāttettvādavagal‌bhate, klībate, hoḍate, iti siddham| tebhya eva pacādyajantebhyaḥ kyaṅi avagal‌bāyata ityādi| na ca avagal‌bhate ityādīnāṃ dhārṣṭyādikamevārthaḥ syānna tvācāra iti vācyam, dhātūnāmanekārthatvenācārārthatāyā api lābhāt| tatkimanena vārtikeneti cet? satyam| `avagal‌bhāñcakre' `klībāñcakre' `hoḍāñcakre' ityatra pratyayāntatvādām yathā syādityevamarthamidaṃ vārtikam| avagal‌bheti kim? anupasargādupasargāntaraviśiṣṭācca kpaṅeva yathā syāt `gal‌bāyāñcakre' iti mādhavādayaḥ| prakriyāyāṃ tu avetyapahāya kevalasya pāṭhaḥ| tadanugāmiprasādādigranthaśca prāmādika eva| dhātuśya eva liṭi tu-jagalbhe, ciklībe, juhoḍe|
"sarvaprātipadikebhyaḥ"(kāovāo)|| na kevalamavagal‌bhādibhya eva kintu sarvebhya eva ācāre kvibvaktavya ityarthaḥ| pūrvavārtikantu anubandāsaṃgārthaṃ sthitameva| prātipadikagrahaṇādiha supa iti na sambadhyate|tena padatvābhāvādudāharaṇeṣu padakāryāṇi na| kṛṣṇa ivācarati kṛṣṇati| "ato guṇe"(pāosūo6-1-97)iti śapā saha pararūpam| etena `carmevācarati carmati' iti prakriyāgranthaḥ parāstaḥ, apadāntatvena nalopāyogāt| kathamanvathā| ihaiva śāmā saha pararūpa syāditi yatkiñcidetat| iha dvitīyavārtike vāgrahaṇaṃ nānuvartyam, prātipadikaviṣayakeṇānena kvipā suvantaviṣayasya kyaṅo bhinnaviṣayatvādeva bādhasyāprasaṅgādvacanadvayaprāṇāṇyādvikalpopapatteśca| pūrvavārtike'pi etsiddhakvibanuvādenānubandhāsaṅgamātre tātparyasya bhāṣye sthitatvena prātipadikaviṣayatā vāśabdavaiyarthyaṃ ceti tattvam| tasya subantaviṣayatve hi antarvarttivibhaktyā padatvāt gal‌bhateḥ saṃyogāntalopo durvāraḥ|
atha kvibanteṣu rūpāṇi leśata udāhriyante| aivācarati ati, ataḥ, anti| ṇali "aco'ñṇiti"(pāosūo7-2-115)iti vṛddhau "āta au ṇalaḥ"(pāosūo7-1-34), au| tathāca kaśabdasya cakāviti haradattaḥ| mādhavastu "ṇyallopau" iti vacanāṇṇali vṛddhimbādhitvā atolodvirvacane atolopādantaraṅgatvādatoguṇe pararūpatve tasyāṅgagrahaṇena prāptādatolopātparatvādabhyāsagrahaṇena grahaṇād "ata ādeḥ"(pāosūo7-4-70)iti dīrghaḥ| "āto lopa iṭi ca"(pāosūo6-4-64)ityālopaḥ kiti, ṇalastu au vṛddhiḥ| syādetat, iha pratyayāntatvādāmā bhāvyam| na ca "kāsyanekāj‌grahaṇam" iti vārtikena pratyayagrahaṇasthāne'nekāj‌grahaṇasya kṛtvātpratyayāntebhyo'pyekāj‌bhya āmneti vācyam, culumpādīnāmapratyayāntānāṃ saṃgrahārthamanekāj‌grahaṇamadhikaṃ kartavyamityetāvanmātraparatayā'pi vārtikasya kṛtārthatve sautrasya pratyayagrahamasyāpanayane kāraṇābhāvāt| ata eva "avagal‌bhāñcakre" ityādi bhāṣyādyudāhṛtaṃ saṅgacchate| na hi tatrānekāctvamasti, ātmanepadārthamanubandhāsaṅgasya nirvivādatvāt| ata eva svāmāsa svāñcakāreti prakriyākārodāhṛtaṃ nirbādhamiti cet? maivam, haradattādigrantheṣu kaśabdād aśabdādvāgādibhyaścācārakvibantebhya ekājbhyo'pi pratyayāntatvādām syāt, culumpādibhyaśca na syāt, ato'vyāptyativyāptiparihārāya pratyayagrahaṇamapanīya tatsthāne anekāj‌grahaṇaṃ karttavyamityarthakatayā vārtikasya vyākhyātatvāt mādhavādibhirapi tadanusāreṇaiva rūpāṇāmudāhṛtatvācca| yuktaṃ caitat, kāsyanekāj‌grahaṇamiti vārtikākṣarasvarasāt| anyathā hi anekāca upasaṃkhyānamityeva brūyāt, na tu pratyayaśabdāvaruddhakāsyuttarabāgamanekācaṃ niveśayet, āgantūnāmante niveśasya nyāyyatvāt| culumpādyarthamiti vārtikaśeṣasvaraso mamāpyanukūlo'stīti cet? na, tadapekṣayā upakramasya prābalyāt| na caiva galbhādāvām na syāditi vācyam, teṣāṃ kvip‌sanniyogena ekāctve'pi parvamanekāctvāt| kāsyanekāca ityatra bhūtapūrvagaterāśrayaṇāt| ācāre'vagalbhetyādivārtikasyaiva ca bhūtapūrvagatyāśrayaṇe pramāṇatvāt| taddhi āmpratyayo yathā syādityevamarthamiti bhāṣyādau spaṣṭam| iha jñāpakasya sāmānyaviṣayatve ghaṭapaṭaprabhṛtibhyastatkarotiṇyantebhyaḥ "kvip ca"(pāosūo3-2-76)iti kvau tata ācārakvau liṭi āmā bāvyam| galbhādiviśeṣamātraviṣayatve tu netyanyadetat|
idaṃ tvavaśiṣyate--"sarvaprātipadikebhyaḥ"(kāovāo)iti kvipi parasmaipade prāpte ātmanepadapravṛttyā caritārthaṃ vacanaṃ kathamām‌pravṛttiṃ sādhayediti|
atrottaram, vākyābyanujñānārthaṃ kṛtasyāpi icchāsani vāgrahaṇasya pūrvasūtradvaye vyavasthāpakatvamāśritya gupādernindākṣamādiṣveva sannānyatreti yathā siddhāntitaṃ,tathehāpi tadvalenaiva "sarpaprātipadikebhyaḥ"(kāovāo)iti kvip gal‌bāderna kariṣyate iti parasmaipadanivṛttistāvatsiddhā ātmanepadamapi svatantradhātubhyo'styeva| ācārārthatā'pyanekārthatvātsulabhā| tathāca vacanasya nānyatra caritārthateti jñāpakatvaṃ susthameva| evaṃ ca sakalamahāgranthaviruddhaṃ `svāmāsa' iti prakriyodāharaṇaṃ na śraddheyamiti sthitam| iṇaḥ ayatervā ṇijantāt "kvip ca"(pāosūo3-2-76)iti kvip āyayatītiḥ āḥ, āyamācakṣāṇa āḥ, sa ivācarati āti| "yamarama"(pāosūo7-2-73)itīṭsakau, āsīt, āsiṣṭām| ekādeśasya pūrvāntatvāt "liṅgaviśiṣṭa"(pāosūo73)paribhāṣayā ca mālevācarati mālāti| amālāsīt| amālāsiṣṭām| asmāllaṅi-amālāt, amālāḥ| atra hal‌ṅyādilopastu na bhavati, ṅīsāhacaryādāpo'pi soreva lopavidhānāt| kaviriva kavayati| kavayāñcakāra| āśīrliṅi kavīyāt| "sici vṛddhiḥ"(pāosūo7-2-1)ityatra "ṛta iddhātoḥ"(pāosūo7-1-100)ityato dhātorityanuvṛtterdhātureva yo dhāturiti vijñānānnāmadhātorna vṛddhiriti kaiyaṭaharadattau| tanmate guṇe akavayīt| vardhamāno'pyevam| mādhavastu ik‌paribhāṣārambhapakṣe dhātvanuvṛtteḥ kaiyaṭena pradarśitatvādigante nāmadhātāvapi vṛddhimicchati| tanmate akavāyīt| viriva vayati| vivāya, vivyatuḥ| avayīt, avāyīt| iriva ayati| iyāya, iyatuḥ, iyuḥ| iyayitha, iyathuḥ| iya| iyāya, iyami| atra kitsu savarmadīrghe kṛte iyaṅ| yadvādīrghātparatvenottarakhaṇḍe "eranekācaḥ"(pāosūo6-4-82)iti yaṇ| guṇavṛddhiviṣaye tu ayāyoḥ "dvirvacane'ci"(pāosūo1-1-59)iti sthānivattvād edaitordvitvam, abhyāsahnasvaḥ| "abhyāsasyāsavarme"(pāosūo6-4-78)itīyaṅ| edaitorapi sthānivattvādikārasya dvitvamiti pakṣe tu savarṇadīrghātparatvāduttarakhaṇḍasya punarguṇavṛddhī, tato'bhyāsasyeyaṅ| lakṣmīriva lakṣmayati| lakṣmayāñcakāra| śrīriva śrayati| śiśrāya, śiśriyatuḥ, siśriyuḥ| uriva avati| avāñcakāra| "ijādeśca"(pāosūo3-1-26)ityām| kuriva kavati| cukāva| bhrūriva bhravati| bubhrāva, bubhruvatuḥ| "aci śnudhā"(pāosūo6-4-77)ityuvaṅ| guṇavṛddhiviṣaye tu tābhyāṃ bādhyate| piteva pitarati| pitarāñcakāra| ārśīliṅi "riṅśayagliṅkṣu"(pāosūo7-4-28)iti riṅādeśaḥ| pitriyāt| neva narati| nanāra| evācarati arati| "pāghrā "(pāosūo7-3-78)ityādau nāyaṃ gṛhyate| "abhivyaktapadārthā ye" iti nyāyena dhātupāṭhasthasyaiva grahāt| evañcāsmādṛśabdālliṭi "ṛcchatyṝtām"(pāosūo7-4-11)iti na pravartate| tatra dhātvabhyāsayoḥ savarmadīrghe dhātugrahaṇena grahaṇād‌dṛkārāntalakṣaṇe guṇe `aratuḥ' ityādītyeke| anye tu abhyāsagrahaṇena grahaṇāt "urat"(pāosūo7-4-66)atvaṃ "halādiḥ śeṣaḥ"(pāosūo7-4-6'6)| "ata ādeḥ"(pāosūo7-4-70)iti dīrghaḥ| "āto lopa iṭi ca"(pāosūo3-1-48)iti caṅo'bhāvātsici-adrāvīt| bhūrivācarati bhavati| atra "gātisthā"(pāosūo7-3-78)iti "gātisthā"(pāosūo2-4-77)iti ca na pravarttate| pāti| apāsīt| evaṃ pratipadoktānāmanyeṣāmapi ihāpravṛtirunneyā| kathaṃ tarhi bubhruvaturiti prāguvaṅudāhṛta iti cet? dhātutvaprayukto'sau na tu bhrutvaprayukta ityavadhehi| pṝrivācarati parati| papāra, paparaturityādi| ayaṃ pṝśabdānukaraṇaṃ na punaḥ kryadau juhotyādau vā paṭhyamāna iti śnā śluśca na bhavati| kiti liṭi "ṛcchatyṝtām"(pāosūo7-4-11)iti ṛkārāntalakṣaṇo guṇaḥ| "śṝdṝprām"(pāosūo7-4-12)iti hrasvavikalpastu na bhavati, anabhivyaktapadārthatvāt| ṛrivācarati arati| arāñcakāra| "ijādeśca"(pāosūo3-1-36)ityām| lṛ ivācarati| alati| liṭi dvirvacanam| lṛrvaṇasya dīrghābhāvātsavarṇadīrghābhāvaḥ| uttarakhaṇḍasya yaṇi abhyāsasyoradatvādeva āla, ālaturityādīti mādhavaḥ| tatra yaṇīti kidviṣayaṃ, pitsu tu guṇavṛddhī bodhyo savarṇadīrghābhāva iti tu gumavṛddhisthale bhavatu nāma, avarmasya lṛkāraṃ pratyasavarmatvāt| guṇavṛddhyoḥ sthānivadbhāvena lṛkāradvirvacane'pi savarṇadīrghātparatvena punaruttarakhaṇḍe guṇādipravṛtteḥ| na cāntaraṅgatvātsavarṇadīrghaḥ, "abhyāsasyāsavarṇe"(pāosūo6-4-78)ityasya nirviṣayatāpatteḥ| na ca `iyarti' `iyṛtaḥ' ityādiravakāśaḥ, evaṃ hi "abhyāsasyarttau" tyeva brūyāt| na ca eṣeḥ iyeṣa, oṇeḥuvoṇetyavakāśaḥ, bāṣāyām "ijādeḥ"(pāosūo3-1-36)ityāmpratyayasyocitatvāt| chandasi tu tanvādīnāmupasaṃkhyānāt `triyambakaṃ suvarga' ityādivadiyaṅuvaṅorupapattestathāpi lṛvarṇasya dīrghābhāvāditi mādhavopanyasto heturasaṅgata eva, `hotṝkāraḥ' ityādiviva ṛkārasya durvāratvāt| tathā ca ṛśabdātkvipīva ekādeśasya dhātugrahaṇenābhyāsagrahaṇena vā grahaṇamiti matabhedena--aratuḥ, aruḥ, atuḥ, uḥ, iti rūpadvayamevocitam| "lṛti lṛ vāṃ" iti ṣāṣṭhavārtikavidheyasya varṇāntarasya pravṛttau tu lṛatuḥ lṛurityucitam| sarvathā'pi `alatuḥ' aluriti mādhavodāhṛtaṃ durupapādameveti vibhāvyatāṃ bhāṣyajñaiḥ|
herivācarati hayati| jihāya| ahayīt| yāntatvānna vṛddhiḥ'| erivācarati ayati| "ijādeḥ(pāosūo3-1-36)ityām| ayāñcakāra| "neṭi"(pāosūo7-2-4)iti vṛddhiniṣedhānmā bhavānayīt| gaurivācarati gavati| apadāntatvādavaṅ‌pūrvarūpe na staḥ| jugāva| `agavīt' agāvīt| "ato halādeḥ"(pāosūo7-2-7)iti vā vṛddhiḥ| okārāt-avati| avāñcakāra| mā bavānavīt| rai-rāyati| rirāya| nau-nāvati| nunāva| au-āvati| āvāñcakāra| godhugivācarati godohati| paya ivācarati payati| papāya| luṅi yāntatvādvṛddhyabhāvāt apayīditi mādhavaḥ|
atredaṃ vaktavyam| ayapayahayadhātuṣu "kvip ca"(pāosūo3-2-76)iti kvipi at pat hat iti tāvattvayaivodāhṛtam| ācārakvipi tu akṛttvāttugāgamo mā bhūt| yakārastu kathaṃ na lupyeta? tasmātkaśabdavadevātra rūpamucitam| dyaurivācarati `devati' iti-mādhavaḥ| atra ūṭhi `dyavati' ityucitam| phalerṇau "kvip ca"(pāosūo3-2-76)iti kvip| tata ācārakvip| phalati| yaṅluki pamphalyate| apamphālīt| ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt abhyāsasya nuk iti "caraphalośca" (pāosūo7-4-87)iti sūtre nyāsavistarau| yadyapi pratipadopātteṣvabhivyaktapadārthānāmeva grahaṇaṃ, tathāpi "utparasyātaḥ"(pāosūo7-4-88)iti sūtre ata iti taparanirdeśena dīrghanivṛttyarthaṃ kriyamāṇena ihāsyāpi grahaṇaṃ jñāpyata iti tadāśayaḥ| idamivācarati idāmati| yaṅiva yāṅati| aṇiva āṇati| rājeva rājānāti| "anunāsikasya kvi"(pāosūo6-4-15)iti dīrghaḥ| yattu kaścijjhalādiḥ k‌ṅit dhātoreva sambhavatīti tatsāhacaryāddhātuvihata eva kpip gṛhyata iti ācārakvau nānena dīrgha ityāha| tanna, asya kvipaḥ kakārasyātraiva sāmānyagrahaṇārthatvāt| pakārasya ca tadavighātārthatvātsāhacaryasya ca sarvatrāniyāmakatāyāḥ dvistriścaturitikṛtvo'rthagrahaṇena jñāpitatvāt| etena iha kvipi anubandhayoḥ phalaṃ cintyamiti vadannyāsakāraḥ pratyukta iti dik|
evaṃ ca pathimathyṛbhutakṣāṃ paramapyupadāguṇaṃ bādhitvā'ntaraṅgatvāddīrghe sati pathīnati mathīnati ṛbhukṣīmatītyādi bodhyam| idaṃ ca mādhavādimatamanusṛtyānunāsikāntānāṃ dīrghaḥ prapañcitaḥ| aparaṃ mataṃ kṛtyeva dīrgho na tvācārākvipi sāhacaryasya niyāmakatvenāpi kvacidāśrayaṇāt| na caivamanubandhavaiyarthyam, "verapṛktasya"(pāosūo6-1-67)ityatrāsyaiva grahaṇaṃ mā bhūditi kakārāsaṅgāt| pittvasāmarthyāttu prakṛtiḥ sarvānudātteti keṣāñcinmatasya nyāsagranthe spaṣṭatvāt| yuktaṃ caitat, kaumāravyākaraṇasaṃvādāt| tatra hi kyaṅa eva vaikalpiko lopo vihito na tu kvipaḥ, tatra ca kvibāśrayasya dīrghasyāprasaṅgāt| guṇe sati `pathenati' mathenatītyādyudāhṛdatam| nyāyasāmyena "cchvoḥśūṭh"(pāosūo1-4-19)ityatrāpi asya nirvahati, valopasya bhāṣye pratyākhyānāt| ata eva ca "na padānta"(pāosūo1-1-58)sūtre `pratidīvnaḥ' ityatra "upadhāyāṃ ca"(pāosūo8-2-78)iti dīrgha iti kāśikā'pi saṅgacchate, ācārakvibantādvic pratyaya iti tadāśayāt| carmevācarati carmatīti prakriyā tu atrāpi pakṣe aśuddhaiva| nalopapararūpayoḥ padāntāpadāntatva prayuktayoḥ samāveśasya durghaṭatvāditi dik|
aprasiddhā ye halantāsteṣāṃ kāritāṇau kṛte ṭilope ca ṇilopa ca taddhalantatvamuhyatām| maṭhaṃ makhaṃ kaphaṃ rathaṃ cācakṣāṇaḥ kurvan vā maṭ, mak, kap, rat| sa ivācarati maṭhati| makhati| kaphati| rathati ityādikrameṇa yathālakṣaṇamaprayukte'pyūhyamityarthaḥ|

bhṛśādibhyo bhuvyacverlopaśca halaḥ(pāosūo3-1-12)|| atrācverityekavacanaṃ bhṛśādyavayavāpekṣaṃ, sautro vā vacanavyatyayaḥ| paryudāsātsadṛśagrahaḥ| abhūtatadbhāvaviṣayebhyo bhṛśādibhyo bhavatyarthe kyaṅ syāt, halantānāṃ tveṣāṃ lopo'pi syāt| abhṛśo bhṛśo bhavati bhṛśāyate| caśabdo'nvācaye na tu sanniyoge, ajantānāṃ gaṇe pāṭhasya vaiyarthyāpatte-| acveriti yadi prasajpratiṣedhaḥ syāttarhi asamarthasamāso vākyabhedaśca spaṣṭa eva| kiṃca bhavatiyoge cvervidhānādanuprayujyamānena bhavatinaiva uktārthatvātkyaṅo'prasaktau niṣedhavaiyarthyam| ataḥ paryudāsa evocitaḥ| tathā nañivayuktanyāyena sādṛśyalābhādabhūtatadbhāvaviṣayebhya ityuktm| teneha na-kva divā bhṛśā bhavanti| ye rātrau bhṛśā nakṣatrādayaḥ te divā kva pradeśe bhavantītyarthaḥ| iha sumanas‌ unmanas‌ durmanas abhimanas iti paṭhyate| tatra śaṅkyate-samāsātkyaṅi viśiṣṭasya dhātutvādaṭ‌lyab‌dvirvacaneṣu doṣaḥ| tathāhi, svamanāyata, udamānayata ityādīṣyate| asumanāyata, aunmanāyata ityādi prāpnoti| tathā `sumanāyitvā' ityādau lyaviṣṭaḥ| su ud ityādīnaṃ ktvāntaśarīrapraveśe tu tad‌vyatiriktapadābhāvādasati samāse lyapo'bhāvāt `sumanāyitvā' ityādi prāpnoti| tathā kyaṅantātsani sannantasya prathamasyaikāco dvitve susumanāyiṣate ityādi prāpnoti| sumimanāyiṣate ityādīṣyate|
atrāhuḥ-curādiṣu "saṃgrāma yuddhe" iti paṭhyate sana na pāṭhyaḥ| saṃgrāmaśabdādyuddhavācinaḥ "tatkaroti'(gaosūo)ityeva ṇicaḥ siddheriti tatpāṭho niyamārthaḥ-dhātusaṃjñānimittaḥ pratyayaḥ sopasargāccedbhavati saṃgrāmayatereva nānyasmāditi, jñāpanārtho vāḥsopasargātsaṃghātāddhātusaṃjñānimitte pratyaye vidhitsite upasargāḥ pṛthak kriyante pariśiṣṭādeva tu pratya iti| saṃgrāmaśabdo hi curādau paṭhyamānaḥ sopasargaḥ saṃghāta eva na tūpasargasadṛśāvayavam `āplṛ' vyāptāvitivacchabdāntaram| tathāca "vā padāntasya"(pāosūo84-4-59)iti parasavarmavikalpo bhavati| saṃghātapāṭhaphalaṃ tu asaṃgrāmayata śūraḥ, saṃgrāmayitvā, sisaṃgrāmayiṣate ityādi| tataścoktarītyā niyamo jñāpanaṃ vā niṣkṛṣṭaṃ phalamiti|
atra haradattaḥ-anudāttedayaṃ saṃgrāmayatiriṣyate| tataśca ātmanepadārtha gal‌bhatyādīnāmivānubandhāsaṅgārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ syāditi kathaṃ niyamo jñāpakaṃ vā bhavediti| na cānubandhāsañjanārthe pāṭhe `grāma yuddhe' ityeva paṭhyena| saṃśabdastu dyotakaḥ prayogadarśanavaśādeva labyate| yathā iṅikoradhiḥ| tasmādviśiṣṭapāṭhaḥ prāguktaphalaka eveti vācyam, evaṃ hi yathā iṅikoradheḥ pūrvamāḍ na bhavati tathā'syāpi na syāditi|
atra mādhavaḥ-asyānudāttettvamapāṇinīyamiti pāṭhasyaitadarthatayā na jñāpakabhaṅga iti| etattu "saṃgrāmayatiranudāttedvoddhavyaḥ" iti kaiyaṭena virudhyate| yadapi haradattena siddhāntitaṃ-manaḥśabdasya svādibhirna samāsaḥ, kintvasamastā evaite pratyayārthāviśeṣaṇam, manaḥśabdasca vṛttiviṣaye tadvati varttate, manasvī suṣṭhu bhavatītyādirartha iti; tadapi "prabhau parivṛḍhaḥ"(pāosūo7-2-21)ityatra parivṛḍhamācaṣṭe iti ṇici ktvāpratyaye kaॉte `parivraḍhayya' iti lyav bhavatīti bhāṣyakārādibhirvakṣyamāṇena virodhātparāhatameva| nahyatreva tatrāpi pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ sambhavati| kathaṃ tarhīha iṣṭārthasiddhiriti cet?
atrocyate--curādau paṭhyamānaṃ `saṅgrāma' ityetatprātipadikam, "artistusu"(uosūo145)iti mannadhikāre "graserā ca"(uosūo148)iti vyutpādanāt; na tu dhātuḥ tasya ca "tatkaroti"(gaosūo)iti pūrvaprakrāntena gaṇasūtreṇa ṇici siddhe tatsanniyoge anubandhāsaṅga eva phalaṃ gal‌bhādivat| evaṃ sthite "yuddhe yo'yaṃ grāmaśabda" ityukte'pi kvalasya grāmaśabdasya yuddhe vṛttyabhāvātsāmarthyātsaṅgrāmaśabdo labhyata eva| tatra ca `saṅgrāmi iti visiṣṭasya dhātutvamapi sulabham, "sanādyantāḥ"(pāosūo3-1-32)iti sūtreṇa vidhīyamānāyāḥ sañjñāyāḥ prakṛtipratyayasaṅghāte viśrānteḥ| etena iṅikoḥ pratibandiḥ parāstaḥ, tatra hi pāṭhāpekṣā dhātusañjñā visiṣṭaṃ na spṛśatīti vaiṣamyāt| evaṃ ca "saṅgrāma" iti viśiṣṭapāṭho jñāpayati "upasargasamānākāraṃ pūrvapadaṃ dhātusaṃjñāprayojakībhūte pratyaye cakīrṣite pṛthak kriyate" iti| taccājahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttau svottarabhāgena dhātusaṃjñānimittapratyayaprakṛtibhūtena sāmānārthakamiti tad‌ghaṭitavisiṣṭārthenāpi ktvāntena saha samarthatvāt "kugiti"(pāosūo2-2-18)iti sūtreṇa prādigrahaṇātsamasyata iti `parivraḍhayya'ityādisiddhiḥ| avajigalbhiṣate, avāgalbhata, avagalbhya ityādāvapīyameva gatiḥ| na caivam "usyomāṅkṣvāṭaḥ"(kāovāo) iti ṣāṣṭhavārtikena `auḍhīyat' iti tadbhāṣyeṇa ca saha virodhaḥ, jñāpakasya sajātīyaviṣayatayā śrūyamāṇe pūrvapade pravṛttiḥ, na tvādeśenāpahṛte iti svīkārāt| atra ca bhāṣyavārtikadhātuvṛttyādigranthā anukūlā iti guṇagṛhyairvibhāvyatām| evaṃca `pramāṇayitvā' `vicārayitvā' ityādayaḥ keṣāṃcitprayogāḥ prāmādikā eva| ata eva praśasyamācaṣṭe `śrāpayati' `jyāpayati' iti śrajyāvudāharantaḥ sudhākarādayaḥ `śrapayati' `jyapayati' ityudāharantaḥ śākaṭāyanādayaśca prakrithārante nirākṛtāḥ, praśabdasya pṛthakkaraṇena śasyaśabdādeva ṇijutpattyā śrajyayoraprāpteḥ| ata eva mādhavādibhiḥ `praśasyayati' ityeva svīkṛtam| etena `prāvṛṣamākhyat apaprāvat' `vīrudhamākhyat avivīrat' ityādyudāharanto dhātucandrodayakārādayaḥ parāstāḥ| saṅgrāmayateḥ pāṭhena jñāpitasyārthasya "usyomāṅkṣvāṭaḥ"(kāovāo)iti ṣāṣṭhabhāṣyavārtikabalena anityatājñāpanamāśritya kathaṃcidvā samarthanīyā iti dik|
bhṛśādayastu ślokagaṇapāṭhānurodhena mādhavīye udāhṛtāḥ| tadyathā-bhṛśāyate| capalāyate| mandāyate| paṇḍitāyate| rehāyate| rehaśabdo rahasi nirghṛṇatve bhikṣābhilāṣasya ca nivṛttau varttata iti gaṇavṛttiḥ| tṛpāyate, tṛpaścandraḥ samudraśca| vehāyate, vehad garbhopaghātinī| adharāyate, `adharo mūrkhaḥ puṣkaraśca'iti gaṇavṛttiḥ| ojāyate, varcāyate, ojovarcaḥśabdau vṛttiviṣaye tadvati varttate| rephāyate, rephaḥ saroṣa iti gaṇavṛttau| durmanāyate| sumanāyate| unmanāyate| utsukāyate| śaśvāyate, bṛhāyate, tāntāvetau| "subāmantrite"(pāosūo2-1-2)ityatra manasyupasargasya parāṅgavadbhāva upasaṃkhyeyaḥ| tena `sumanāyate' ityādau "tiṅṅatiṅaḥ"(pāosūo8-1-28)iti nighāto na bhavati, `devadattaḥ sumanāyate' ityādau sopasargasya nighātaśca bhavatīti prakṛtasūtrasthabhāṣyaparyālocanayā labhyate| amī ślokā gaṇapāṭhasthā bhṛśādayaḥ| gaṇavṛttau tu bṛhacchabdo na paṭhyate| bhadraśabdastu paṭhyate| kandharaśabdaśca tvaco'bhyantare sthūlalantvābhā asaṃyuktā snāyuḥ kandharā, tadvān kandharaḥ| matvarthe arśaādibhyo'c(pāosūo5-2-127)|
(pāosūo3-1-13)
loditādiḍājbhayaḥ kyaṣ(pāosūo3-1-13)ṣaṣa lohitādibhyo ḍājantācca bhavatyarthe kyaṣ syāt| "vā kyaṣaḥ"(pāosūo1-3-90)lohitāyati, lohitāyate| atra `acveḥ' ityanuvṛttyā abhūtatadbhāvaviṣayatvaṃ labhyate| tacca ḍāco na viśeṣaṇam, asambhavāt| alohito lohito bhavatīti vigrahaḥ| paṭapaṭāyati, paṭapaṭāyate| kṛbhvastiyogaṃ vinā'pi kyaṣo ḍājantādvidhānasāmarthyādeveha ḍāc| bhavatyarthe vidhīyamānena kyaṣā uktārthasya bhavateriha prayogāyogāt| atra vārtikam-
lohitaḍājbhyaḥ kyaṣvacanaṃ bhṛśādiṣvitarāṇīti|| ādiśabdapratyākhyānaparametat| lohitaśabdātparatra paṭhyamānāni nīlaharitamandraphenadāsamanda ityetāni ṣaṭ bhṛśādiṣu draṣṭavyānītyarthaḥ| kyaṣaḥ kakāraṣakārāvapi pratyākhvātau| tathāhi, kakāro gumavṛddhiniṣedhārtho neti spaṣṭameva, aprasaktasya pratiṣedhāyogāt| nāpi "naḥ kye"(pāosūo1-4-15)iti sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ,nāntādāvidhānāt| nāpi "āpatyasya ca taddhitenāti" "kyacvyośca"(pāosūo6-4-151,152)iti, `yācchandasi' ityeva suvacatvāt| yuktaṃ caitat `śakunambhuraṇyum' iti, kaṇḍvādiyagantādapi darśanāt| nāpi lohitāyate ityatra "akṛtsārva"(pāosūo7-4-25)iti dīrghapravṛttyarthaḥ, tatra k‌ṅitītyasyānanuvṛtteḥ| nanvanuvṛttirāvaśyakī `uruyā' `dhṛṣṇuyā' ityevamarthamiti cet? na, iha hi tṛtīyāsthāne "supāṃ suluk"(pāosūo7-1-39)iti yādeśaḥ| sa ca chāndasaḥ| tatra ca hrasvo'pi chāndasa eva bhaviṣyati upagāyantu sāpatnayo garbhiṇaya itivat| nāpi "kyasya vibhāṣā"(pāosūo6-4-50)ityatra sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ, hala ityanuvṛtteḥ| nahyayaṃ halantādasti, na ca "vā kyaṣaḥ"(pāosūo1-3-90)iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ, "vā syāt" ityeva sūtraṇāt| na caivaṃ "pāśādibhyo yaḥ"(pāosūo4-2-49)pāśyā, atra prasaṅgaḥ, sāmānyavihitānāṃ tiṅāṃ niyamārthaṃ hi tatprakaraṇam| na ca pāśādiyāntāttiṅaḥ santi| nanvācārakvibantātsantīti cet? na, ṭāpā vyavadhānāt, pūrvasmādapi vidhau ekādeśasya sthānivadbhāvāt| na ca daṇḍyavadhyādiśabdebhya ācārakvibantebhyo'tiprasaṅgaḥ śaṅkyaḥ tatra "daṇḍādibhya"(pāosūo5-1-65)iti pūrvasūtrādyadanuvṛtteḥ na tu yapratyaya iti pañcame vakṣyamāṇatvāt| ata eva ṣakāro'pi vyarthaḥ| sa hi "vā kyaṣaḥ"(pāosūo3-2-170)"kyasya vibhāṣā"(pāosūo6-4-50)ityādau sāmānyagrahaṇāvidhātārtho veti phalaṃ sambhāvyate| tacca sarvaṃ dūṣitameva| tasmādādiśabdaṃ kaṣau ca hitvā "lohitaḍājbhyo yaḥ" iti bhāṣye sthāpitam| yadi tu "sabhāyāyaḥ"(pāosūo4-4-150)-sabhyaḥ, sa ivācaratītyāderācārakvibantasyābhidhānamasti, tarhi "vā yaṣaḥ" iti sūtryatām| ṣakāramātraṃ vā'stu, avaśiṣṭaṃ tu vyarthameva| vṛttikārastu vārtikasyārthamanyatā manyate| tadyathā-na kilānenādigrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyāyate, kintu yāni paṭhitāni nīlādīniṣaṭ teṣāmeva ito'pakṛṣya bhṛśādiṣu niveśa ucyate| apaṭhitānāṃ tu kyaṣeva| tāni cākṛtigaṇatvāllabhyante| ākṛtigaṇatve jñāpakaṃ tu "naḥ kye"(pāosūo1-4-15)iti sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ kyaṣaḥ kakāraḥ tadavivātārthaḥ ṣakāraśca, na hi paṭhyamāneṣu lohitādiṣu nāntaḥ kaścidasti| tāni cākṛtigaṇasiddhāni gaṇavṛttikāraḥ sañjagrāha|
lohitaśyāmaduḥkhāni harṣagarvasukhāni ca|
mūrchānidrākṛpādhūmāḥ karumāntiyacarmaṇīti||
nidrākarumādayo vṛttiviṣaye tadviti vartante|| nidrāyati nidrāyate ityādi| tadetatsarvaṃ bhāṣyaviruddhatvādupekṣvam| kiñca `lohitaḍājbhayaḥ' iti vadato vārtikakārasyāpi ādiśabdapratyākhyānamabhipretamiti spaṣṭaṃ labhyate| anyathā hi `lohitāt' ityeva brūyāt| ata eva "vidvasyamāna ityatra lohitādiḍājbhyaḥ kyaṣ" iti kalpatarugrantho vṛttikārarītyā sambhavannapi bhāṣyaviruddhatvātprauḍhivādamātramiti kyaṅvidhāvavocāma|
syādetat, "kyaṣ ca" iti sūtramastu, cātkyaṅ| tatra kyaṣpakṣe parasmaipadam, kyaṅpakṣe tvātmanepadamiti "vā kvaṣaḥ"(pāosūo1-3-90)iti sūtraṃ māstviti cet? maivam, "prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam"(paobhāo73)iti lohinīśabdāt kyaṣi `lohinīyati' `lohinīyate' iti rūpadvayamiṣyate| kyaṅi tu "kyaṅmāninośca"(pāosūo6-3-36)iti puṃvadbhāve sati `lohitāyate' iti syāditi phale bhedāt|
(pāosūo3-1-14)
kaṣṭāya kramaṇe(pāosūo3-2-14)|| kaṣṭe kṛcchram| "kṛcchragahanayoḥ kaṣaḥ" (pāosūo7-2-22)iti kṛcchre iḍabhāvaḥ| tena ca tatkaraṇaṃ pāpaṃ karma lakṣyate| kramaṇamutsāhaḥ, "vṛttisargatāyaneṣu'(pāosūo1-3-38)iti sūtre hi `sarga utsāha' ityuktam| tadayamarthaḥ-caturthyantātkaṣṭaśabdādutsāhe'rthe kyaṅ syāt| kaṣṭāya kramate kaṣṭhāyate| pāpaṃ karma kartumutsahata ityarthaḥ|
satrakakṣakaṣṭacchragahanebhyaḥ kaṇvacikīrṣāyāmiti vaktavyama(kāovāo)|| kaṇvaṃ pāpam| satrādayo vṛttiviṣaye pāpaparyāyāḥ| tebhyo dvitīyāntebhyaḥ cikīrṣāyāṃ kyaṅ| pāpaṃ cikīrṣatītyasvapadena vigrahaḥ| satrāyate| kakṣāyate| kaṣṭāyate| kṛcchrāyate| gahanāyate|
karmaṇo romanthatapobhyāṃ varticaroḥ(pāosūo3-1-15)|| karmaṇa iti pañcamī, romanthatapobhyāmityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt| pratyeka sambadhāttvekavacanam| vartīti ṇyantādvṛteḥ "ṇyāsaśranthoyuc"(pāosūo3-3-107)iti yuci prāpte ata eva nipātanāt ktin| carateḥ sampadāditvādbhāve kvip| romanthatapobhyāṃ karmabhyāṃ yatāsaṅkhyaṃ varticarorarthayoḥ kyaṅ syāt| romanthaṃ vartayati romanthāyate|
hanucalana iti vaktavyam(kāovāo)|| hanucalanenātra carvitasya mukhapradeśe ākṛṣya carvaṇaṃ lakṣyate| neha-kīṭo romanthaṃ vartayati| apānapradeśānniḥsṛtaṃ dravyaṃ kīṭo vartulaṃ karotītyartha iti nyāsakāraharadattau| apānapradeśānniḥsṛtamaśnātītyartha iti tu kaiyaṭo vyākhyat| tapasyati, iha taṅ prāptaḥ| tasmāt--
tapasaḥ parasmaipadaṃ ca(kāovāo)| iti vaktavyam| evaṃ ca "namovariva"(pāosūo3-1-19)ityādisūtra eva tapaḥśabdaḥ paṭhitumucitaḥ| tathā tu na kṛtamityeva|
(pāosūo3-1-16)
bāṣpoṣmabhyāmudvamane(pāosūo3-1-16)karmaṇaḥ|| kyaṅiti vartate| bāṣpamudvamati bāṣpāyate| ūṣmāṇamudvamati ūṣmāyate|
(pāosūo3-1-17)
śabdavairakalahābhrakaṇvameghebhyaḥ karaṇe(pāosūo3-1-17)|| ebhyaḥ karmabhyaḥ karotyarthe kyaṅ syāt| śabdaṃ karoti śabdāyate| evaṃ vairāyate| kalahāyate| abhrāyate| kaṇvāyate| meghāyate| "tatkaroti"(gaosūo)iti ṇici prāpte'yamārabhyaḥ| pakṣe ṇijapīṣyate-`śabdayati' iti| tadarthaṃ maṇḍūkaplutyā "bhṛśādibhyo bhuvi"(pāosūo3-1-12)iti sūtrāccakāro'trānuvartata iti nyāsakāraḥ| atra vārtikam-
sudunadurddinābhyāñca(kāovāo)|| sudināyate| durdināyate|
nīhārācca(kāovāo)|| nīhārāyate|
aṭṭṭāśīkākoṭāpoṭasoṭāpruṣṭāpluṣṭāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam(kāovāo)|| poṭā strīpuṃsalakṣaṇā| ato'nye kriyāvacanā iti subdhātuvṛttau mādhavaḥ| aṭa gatau(bhvāopao296)| aṭatītyaṭā aci ṭāp, tāṃ karoti aṭāyate| aṭṭa atikramahiṃsayoḥ(cuouo28)"gurośca halaḥ"(pāosūo3-3-103)ityakāraḥ-aṭṭā, tāṃ karoti aṭṭāyate| śīkṛ secane(bhvāoāo75)tālavyādiḥ| dantyādiriti tu dhanapālakāśyapau| guroścetyakāraḥ-śīkā, tāṃ karoti śīkāyate iti taddhātuvyākhyāyāṃ mādhavaḥ| kuṭa kauṭilye(tuopao86) tudādiḥ, hetumaṇṇic| kuṭa chedane(cuoāo165)ākusmīyaḥ| koṭayati koṭayate vā koṭā, tāṃ karoti koṭāyate| poṭoktā, poṭāyate| `soṭā' iti pāṭhe dhātvartho'nveṣaṇīyaḥ| `moṭā' iti pāṭhe tu muṭa sañcūrṇane(cuopao81)curādiḥ, pradarśane bhvādiḥ| pradarśanākṣepayostudādau(tuopao94)| moṭayatīti moṭā, moṭāyate| pruṣa pluṣa dāhe(bhyāopao55,56)| karmaṇi ktaḥ, pruṣṭā pluṣṭātāṃ karoti pruṣṭāyate| ujjvaladattastu "aśūprūṣilaṭikaṇikhaṭiviśibhyaḥ kvan"(uosūo157)iti sūtre `pruṣvaḥsyādṛtusūryayoḥ' `pruṣvā jalakaṇikā' iti ratnamatiḥ| pluṣa snehanādāviti dhātuḥ `pruṣvāyate' ityudāharan iha vārtike 'pruṣvā' iti pāṭhamupanyastavān|
(pāosūo3-1-18)
sukhādibhyaḥ kartṛvedanayām(pāosūo3-1-18)|| kartṛ iti pṛthakpadaṃ luptaṣaṣṭhīkam| vedanā jñānam| "vida cetanākhyānavivāseṣu"(cuoāo175)ityasmāccurādiṇyantād‌bhāve "ṇyāsaśrantho yuc"(pāosūo3-3-107)| "ghaṭṭivandividibhyaśca'(kāovāo)iti aupasaṅkhyāniko vā| kartṛtvaṃ ca śrutavedanakriyāpekṣam| tadayamarthaḥ-vedanakriyāyāḥ karturādheyabhāvena sambandhibhyaḥ sukhādibhyaḥ karmabhyo vedanāyāmarthe kyaṅsyāt| sukhaṃ vedayate sukhāyate| kartṛgrahaṇaṃ kim? sukhaṃ vedayate prasādhako rājñaḥ| ayaṃ vediḥ ākusmīyaḥ| evaṃ ca `vedayati' iti keṣāṃcitparasmaipadapāṭhaḥ prāmādikaḥ| atra ślokagaṇakāraḥ-
sukhaduḥkhagahanakṛchrāstṛprālīkapratīpakaruṇāśca|
kṛpaṇaḥ soḍha itīme sukhādayo daśa gaṇe paṭhitāḥ||
soḍhaṃ sahanamabhibhavo vā| gamaratnamahodadhau tu āsraśabdo'pīha paṭhyate|
(pāosūo3-1-19)
namovarivaścitraṅaḥ kyac(pāosūo3-1-19)|| karaṇagrahamamanuvṛttamabhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyādiha kriyāviśeṣaparam| tena namasaḥ pūjāyāṃ, varivasaḥ paricaryāyāṃ, citraṅa āścarye, kyac syāt| namasyati devān, namaskāreṇa pūjayatītyartha-| varivasyati gurūn| śuśrūṣata ityarthaḥ| citrīyate| `vismayate ityarthaḥ, `viśmāyayate' ityante| tathā ca māyāmṛgaṃ prakṛtya bhaṭṭirāha-"tataścitrīyamāṇo'sau" iti| atra citraṅo ṅitkaraṇādavayave kṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavatīti vācyam| tathā sati kyajantādātmanepadam| na caivaṃ śabdavairādisūtre citraśabdo'pi paṭhyatāṃ kyaṅaiva taṅ bhaviṣyatīti vācyam, tathā sati hi "kyaci ya"(pāosūo7-4-33) iti ītvaṃ na syāt| tasmātkyajeva kāryo ṅittvaṃ ca|
(pāosūo3-1-20)
pucchabhāṇḍacīvarāṇṇiṅ(pāosūo3-1-20)|| karaṇa ityanuvṛtteḥ kriyāviśeṣe pucchādudasane vyasane paryasane ca| udasanamutkṣepaṇam| vyasanaṃ-vividhaṃ viruddhaṃ vāut‌kṣepaṇam| paryasanaṃ-paritaḥ kṣepaṇam| utpucchayate| vipucchayate| paripucchayate|
bhāṇḍātsamācayane(kāovāo)|| samācayanaṃ rāśīkaraṇam| sambhāṇḍayate| bhāṇḍāni samācinotītyarthaḥ|
cīvarādarjane paridhāne vā(kāovāo)|| saṃcīvarayate bhikṣuḥ| cīvarāṇyarjayati paridhatte vetyarthaḥ| ṇiṅo ṇakāraḥ sāmānyagrahaṇārtho na tu vṛddhyarthaḥ| asambhavāt| ṅakārastadavighātārthaḥ ātmanepadārthaśca| ata eva pucchādaya uttarasūtre na niveśitāḥ|
muṇḍamiśraślakṣṇalavaṇava3tavastrahalakalakṛtatūstebhyo ṇic(pāosūo3-1-21)|| ebhyo daśabhyaḥ kṛñarthe ṇic syāt| muṇḍaṃ karoti muṇḍayati| miśrayati| ślakṣṇayati| lavamayati|
vratādbhojane tannivṛttau ca(kāovāo)|| payaḥ śūdrānnaṃ vā vraratayati|
vastrātsamācchādane(kāovā)|| saṃvastrayati| iha bhojanatannivṛttivrataśabdasyārthau| samācchādanaṃ tu vastraśabdasya| pratyayastu kṛñarthe| śrūyate ca bhojane vrataśabdaḥ-"yadasya payo vrataṃ bhavati| ātmānameva tadvardhayati| trivrato vai manurāsīt| dvivratā asurāḥ| ekavratā devāḥ" iti| paspaśāyāṃ ca-"śakyañcānena śvamāṃsādīnyapi vratayitum" iti| ayameva vrataśabdo darśādivadviparītalakṣamayā tannivṛttau vartate| `saṃvastrayati prāvāram' ityatra prāvāramācchādayatītyartha iti mādhavaḥ|
halādibhyastribhyo grahaṇe pratyayaḥ| haliṃ gṛhṇāti halayati| kaliṃ gṛhṇāti kalayati| kṛtaṃ gṛhṇāti kṛtayati|
tūstāni vihanti vitūstayati| `tūstaṃ keśaḥ' iti śrībhadraḥ| jaṭībhūtāḥ keśā iti nyāsaḥ| pāpamiti vaijayantī|
syādetat, "pratipadikāddhātvarthe"(gaosūo)ityeva sarvamidaṃ siddham| na ca "tatkaroti"(gaosūo)ityādinā tatra dhātvarthaniyamaḥ, rājānamatikrāntavān atyararājadityāderapīṣṭatvāt| tatkiṃ muṇḍādisūtremeti cet?
atrāhuḥ, muṇḍayati māṇavakaṃ, miśrayatyannaṃ, ślakṣṇayati vastraṃ, lavaṇayati vyañjanamiti sāpekṣebhyo'pi ṇijarthamidam| halikralvostvatvanipātārtham| tathā ca vārtikam-
halikalyoradantatvanipātanaṃ sanvadbhāvapratiṣedhārthamiti| tathāhi, `halii' `kalii' iti sthite "aco ñṇiti"(pāosūo7-2-115)iti vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, ṇāviṣṭhavaditi ṭilopaśca| tatra lopaḥ śabdāntaraprāptyā anityaḥ, vṛddhistu ṭilope satyaprāpteḥ| ubhayoranityayoḥ paratvād vṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ aikārasya āyādeśātpūrvameva paratvāt vārṇādāṅgasya balīyastvācca lope'naglopyayambhavatīti "sanvallaghuni"(pāosūo7-4-93)iti sanvadbhāvaḥ syād "dīrgho'(pāosūo7-4-94)itisthānivadbhāvāttena vyavadhānānna doṣa iti vācyam, caṅpare ṇau yadaṅgaṃ tasya yo'bhyāso laghuparaḥ tasya sanvat laghordīrghaśceti haradattādibhiḥ puraskṛte kaiyaṭenaikīyamatatayopanyaste vyākhyāne sthānivadbhāvasyākiñcitkaratvāt| caṅpare ṇau yallaghu tatra parato yo'bhyāsaḥ tasyeti bhāṣyakaiyaṭate'pi abhyāsasya ṭilopādyanantaraṃ jātatvena-1--1.ādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvena dṛṣṭasya vidhau kartavye vihitasya sthānivattvasyāprasaṅgādityarthaḥ|-ādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvena sthānivattvāprasaṅgāt| atvanipātane tu yadyapi paratvād vṛddhistathāpi ageva lupyata iti sanvadbhāvadīrghau na bhavataḥ| evaṃ ca balipaṭuprabhṛtibhyo ṇici abībalat apīpaṭat iti bhavati na tu ababalat apapaṭat iti|
syādetat, "ṇau caṅi"(pāosūo7-4-1)ityatratyabhāṣyeṇa sahaitadvirudhyate| tatra hi vṛddherlopo balīyāniti sthitam| yuktaṃ caitata, śabdāntaraprāptau satyāmapi kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvamātreṇa kvacinnityatvābhyupagamāt| yadāha-bhuvovukonityatvādityādīti, jñāpakaṃ cātra "nāglopiśās"(pāosūo7-4-2)iti sūtre agiti pratyāhāragrahaṇam| tathāhi, avarṇānteṣvavarṇopadheṣu ṛvarṇānteṣu ca vṛddhāvapyavarṇa eva lupyate| tatra alopināṃ netyeva vācyam| ivarṇovarṇāntayostu vṛddhau kṛtāyāmaukāro lupyate na tvak| na ca svāminamākhyat asasvāmat, gominamākhyat ajugomat, prādurākhyat apaprādat, yādṛśamākhyat ayayādat, tādṛśamākhyat atatādat ityādau yatra vṛddheraprasaṅgādiko lopastatra hrasvanivṛttaye aggrahaṇamiti vācyam, anabhidhānāttatra ṇica evānutpatteḥ| etacca bhāṣyakārema jñāpakatvasya samarthanādavasīyate| na caivamapi sragviṇamākhyad asasrajat ityatra vinmatorluki upadhāyā vṛddhau hrasvanivṛttyarthaṃ aglopagrahaṇaṃ syāt, asti hyatrābhidānam "ṭeḥ" ityatra bhāṣye `srajayati' ityudāhaṇāditi vācyam, evamapi srajayatītyatra vṛddhyabhāvasya siddhāntasammatatvenaṃ ṭerityatra bhāṣyakāreṇa srajayatīti nirddeśāt "āṅgavṛtte"(paobhāo94)iti paribhāṣayā vā vṛddheraprasaṅgena hrasvabhāvinyā upadhāyā eva abhāvāt| ataḥ pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ vṛddheḥ pūrvaṃ ṭilopa iti| tatkathamihocyate vṛddhau satyāṃ ṭilopa itīti cet?
atra mādhavaḥ-paratvād vṛddhiriti mukhyaḥ pakṣaḥ, vṛddherlopo balīyāniti tu prauḍhivādamātramityekaṃ matam| tadviparītaṃ matāntaram| bhāṣyadvayaprāmāṇyād vṛddheḥ pūrvaṃ paścādvā kāmacāreṇa ṭilopa iti apapaṭat apīpaṭaditi rūpadvayamapi sādhviti cāparaṃ matamiti matatrayamapi subdhātuvṛttāvupanibaddhavān| tatrādyaṃ mataṃ haradattasya, dvitīyaṃ kaiyaṭasya, tṛtīyaṃ tvanyeṣāmiti vivekaḥ| etadvalābalacintā tu karityate| ayaṃ ca bhedo ṇibhinnaviṣayaḥ, ṇerṇici tu ṇyallopāviti vipratiṣedhāt niṣkarṣarītyā'pavādatvādvā prāgeva ṇilopaḥ| upadhāhrasvatve sanvadbhāvadīrghayośca ṇerṇicītyupasaṃkhyānāṇṇyākṛtirddeśādvā avīvadadityeva rūpamiti saptame vakṣyāmaḥ|
prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ| muṇḍādisūtre keṣāṃcidgrahaṇaṃ prapañcārtham| muṇḍādayaḥ sarve'pi "satyāpapāśa"(pāosūda3-1-25)ityatraiva paṭhituṃ yuktāḥ| evaṃ hi ekavākyatā labhyate| dvirṇijgrahaṇaṃ ca na kartavyamiti lāghavam| tathā tu na kṛtamityeva|
(pāosūo3-1-22)
dhātorekāco halādeḥ kriyāsamabhihāre yaṅ(pāosūo3-1-22)|| ekāc halādiḥ samabhihriyamāṇakriyāvṛttiryo dhātuḥ tasmātsvārthe yaṅ syāt| samabhihāro'tra paunaḥpunyaṃ bhṛsārtho vā| yadyapi viprakīrṇānāmekatra rāśīkaraṇaṃ sabhabhihāraśabdasya mukhyo'rthaḥ, tathāpyasau dhānyādīnāmeva sambhavati, na tu dhātuvācyāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ, amūrtattvāt| ato gauṇo'rtho gṛhyate| sa ca na pratyayasya vācyaḥ, prakṛtyarthaṃ prati viśeṣyatāpatteḥ, kintu dyotyo'rthaḥ| ata eva ṭābādayastarabādayaśca svārthikā eveti nirūḍhaḥ panthāḥ| yadā tu prakṛtyarthaprādhānyamautsargikam ākhyāta iva ṭābādiṣvapi tyajyate tadā ṭābādayo vācakā ityapi pakṣaḥ sambhavatyeva| svīkṛtaścāyaṃ liṅgādividhau bhāṣye'pīti tatratatra sphuṭam| punaḥ punaratiśayena vā pacati pāpacyate| "dīrgho'kitaḥ"(pāosūo7-4-83)iti dīrghaḥ| dedīpyate| "guṇo yaṅlukoḥ'(pāosūo7-4-82)iti guṇaḥ| nanu "kriyāsamābhihāre ca'(kāovāo)iti vārtikena "nityavīpsayoḥ"(pāosūo8-1-4)iti vā padadvirvacanamiha kuto neti cet? yaṅaiva kriyāsamabhihārasya dyotitatvāt| na caivaṃ lunīhilunīhītyatrāpi na syāditi vācyam, kevalena loṭā tulyarūpo hiḥ kriyāsamabhihāraṃ dyotayituṃ sahāyatayā dvitvamapekṣate, anyathā saṃśayāpatteḥ; yaṅ tu na tathetivaiṣamyāt| dhātoriti kim? ārdhadātukatvaṃ yathā syāt| tena "bruvo vaciḥ" ityādi sidhyati| ekācaḥ kim? punaḥpunarjāgarti| halādeḥ kim? bhṛśamīkṣate| yaṅo ṅittvaṃ bobhūyate marīmṛjyate ityādau guṇavṛddhini,edhārtham| na caivamavayave caritārthasya samudāyaṃ pratyaviśeṣakatvāt yaṅantādātmanepadaṃ na syāditi vācyam, ṅidantāddhātostaditi "anudāttaṅita"(pāosūo1-3-12)iti sūtra eva prapañcitatvāt| `bhṛśaṃ śobhate' `bhṛśaṃ rocate' ityatrānabhidhānādyaṅ neti bhāṣyam| kathaṃ tarhi "ruca dīptau"(bhvāoāo746)"śubha śobhayām"|(tuopao41)iti dhātū vyācakṣāṇaiḥ dhātuvṛttikāraiḥ `rorucyate' `śośubhyate' ityudāhṛtamiti cet? bhāṣye bhṛśārthopādānāt paunaḥ punye bhavatyevetyāśayenetyāhuḥ| śobhata iti śabvikaraṇasyodāharaṇāttaudādikasya yaṅ bhavatyeveti dhātucandrodaye| "sūcisūtrimūtryaṭyartyaśūrṇugrahaṇam'(kāovāo)| sūca paiśūnye(cūopao341)sūtra avamocane(cuopao376)mūtra prasravaṇe'(cuopao161)| aśa bhojane(kryāopa051)aśū vyāptau(svāāo18)dvayorapi grahaṇam| atra ādyānāṃ trayāṇāmanekāltvāt tato'nyeṣāṃ ahalādittvāt, ūrṇotastu anekāltvādahalāditvāccāprāptau vacanam| atra ūrṇotervakṣyamāṇena ṇuvadbhāvenāpi siddham| sosūcyate| sosūtryate| sūcisūtrī adantau, curādiṇic, atolopaḥ, yaṅ, ṇilopaḥ, dvitvaṃ, "halādiḥ śeṣaḥ'(pāosūo7-4-60), abhyāsasya guṇaḥ| abhyāsātparasya ṣatvaṃ tu na bhavati, anādeśatvāt| na cemau ṣopadeśau, adantatvenānekāctvāt| ṣopadeśalakṣaṇe hi seksṛbādiparyudāsāt tatsādṛśyamekāctvaṃ vivakṣitāmiti niṣkarṣa-| `sosūcyate' `sosūtryate' iti bhāṣyodāharaṇaṃ cātra pramāṇam| ṣopadeśalakṣaṇe ekāctvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ deyamiti vadato mādhavasyāpyayamevāśaya-| sosūtryate| aṭāṭyate| "ajāderdvitīyasya"(pāosūo6-1-9)iti ṣaṣṭhīti vakṣyamāmatvāt| arāryate| "guṇo'rtisaṃyagādyoḥ" "yaṅi ca"(pāosūo7-4-129,130)iti guṇaḥ, ryaśabdasya dvitvam| na ca "nandrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-3)iti rephasya dvitvaniṣedhaḥ, "yakāraparasya nāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ" iti ṣaṣṭhe vṛttikārokteḥ|na caitadaprāmāṇikam, prakṛtasūtrasthasya arārthata iti bhāṣyasyaiva tatra pramāṇatvāt| aśāśyate| ūrṇonūyate| ūrmuñ ācchādane(aouo29)| nopadhoyam| tasyāṣṭamikaṃ ṇatvam| tasyāsiddhatvānnuśabdasya divatvam| "pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacane'(paobhāo128)ityanityam "ubhau sābhyāsasya"(pāosūo8-4-29)iti liṅgāt| syādetat, lunīhilunīhītyevāyaṃ lunāti| atra yaṅā loṭ bādhyeta| antaraṅgo hi yaṅ kriyāsamabhihāramātrāpekṣatvāt| loṭ tu bahiraṅgaḥ, kriyābhedāśraye dhātusambandhe bhāvakarmakartṛṣu vidhānāt| tathā loṭ sāvakāśo'pi kva? anekāci ajādau ca-jāgṛhijāgṛhītyevāyaṃ jāgarti, īkṣasvekṣasvetyevāyamīkṣate|
atrāhuḥ, vetyanuvartate| yadā na yaṅ tadā loṭ bhaviṣyati|
(pāosūo3-1-23)
nityaṃ kauṭilye gatau(pāosūo3-1-23)|| gatau vartamānāddhātoḥ kauṭilye eva dyotye yaṅ syāt na tu kriyāsamabhihāre| kramu pādavikṣepe(bhvāopao474)drama gatau(bhvāopao467)caṅkramyate| dandramyate| avadhāraṇārthānnityagrahaṇānneha-bhṛśaṃ krāmati| nanu yathā "vaḍavāyā vṛṣe vācye" ityanena apatye prāptastato'pakṛṣaaya vidhīyate, yathā vā ñītaḥ kto bhūta prāptaḥ tato'pakṛṣya varttamāne vidhīyate, evamatrāpi dhātumātrāt kriyāsamabhihāre yaṅ vihito gativacanāttu kauṭilya iti takrakauṇḍinyanyāyenaiva bādhaḥ siddhaḥ| satyam, ata eva nityagrahaṇaṃ bhāṣyavārtikayoḥ pratyākhyātam|
(pāosūo3-1-24)
lupasadacarajayajabhadahadaśagṝbhyo bhāvagarhāyām(pāosūo3-1-24)|| ebhyo yaṅ syāt dhātvarthagarhāyāṃ dyotyāyām| luplṛ cchedane(tuouo151)| ṣada viśaraṇādau(bhyāopao879)| yastu "āṅaḥ sadiḥ padyarthe"(cuopao299)iti caurādiko ṇyantaḥ sa iha na gṛhyate `ekāca' ityanuvṛtteriti haradattaḥ, taccintyam, prakṛtigrahaṇe ṇyadhikasyāprāpteḥ| anyathā lupāderapi hetumaṇṇyantasya vāraṇīyatayā saderevopanyāse bījābhāvācca| cara gatau(bhvāopao560)japa vyaktāyāṃ vāci(bhvāopao396)jabhī gātravināme(bhvāoāo388)daha bhasmīkaraṇe(bhvāopao1016)| ata eva daśeti nipātanāt yaṅluki nalopaḥ-dandaśīti| gṝ nigaraṇe(tuopao130)tudādiḥ| gṝ śabde(kryāopao26)krayādiḥ| tatra adantavikaraṇasāhacaryāttudādereva grahaṇamityeke| dvayorapītyanye| garhitaṃ lumpati lolupyate| sāsadyate| cañcūryate| "caraphalośca'(pāosūo7-4-87)iti nuk "utparasyātaḥ"(pāosūo8-4-88)"hali ca"(pāosūo9-2-77)iti dīrghaḥ| jañjapyate| jañjabhyate| dandahyate| dandaśyate| japādīnāṃ caturṇāmabhyāsasya "japajabhadahadaśabhañjapaśāñca'(pāosūo7-4-86)iti nuk| nijegilyate| "ṛta iddhātoḥ"(pāosūo7-1-100),raparatvaṃ, dvirvacanam, abhyāsasya guṇaḥ, jegir ya iti sthite "gro yaṅi"(pāosūo8-3-20)iti latvam| na ca paratvāt "hali ca" iti dīrghaḥ, tasyāsiddhatvāt| latve kṛte tu na vihatanimittatvāddīrghaḥ| bhāveti kim? sādhanagarhāyāṃ mā bhūt-mantraṃ japati vṛṣalaḥ| atra svaravarṇādibhraṃśābhāvād garhā nāsti| kartrākhyasādhanaṃ tu garhitaṃ śūdrasya vede anadhikṛtatvāt| nityagrahaṇamavadhāraṇārthamihānuvartate| tasya vyākhyānaṃ ca pūrvavat|
satyāpapāśarūpavīṇātūlaślokasenālomatvacavarmavarṇam̐cūrṇacurādibhyo ṇic(pāosūda3-1-25)|| ebhyo ṇic syāt| satyādibhyascūrṇāntebhyaḥ prātipadikāddhātvarthe ityeva siddhe satyasyāpugarthaṃ vacanam, anyeṣāṃ prapañcārtham, mālinyā upaślokayatītyādau sāpekṣādutpattyarthaṃ ca| dhātvarthe ityaviśeṣoktāvapi svabhāvalabhyo'rthaviśeṣo vṛttikārādibhirnirddiśyate| tadyathā-satyamācaṣṭe satyāpayati| satyaṃ karotīti tu bhāṣyam|
arthavedasatyānāmāpugvaktavyaḥ(kāovāo)|| āpugvacanasāmarthyāṭṭilopo na arthāpayati| pukaiva siddhe ākāroccāraṇamanyato vidhānārthaṃ tena likhāpayatītyādi siddhamiti kaścit| tanna, `pugeva kariṣyate' iti bhāṣyavirodhāt| tasmāllikhāpayatītyapaprayoga evetyāhuḥ|
pādau prakṣālāpayatīti gṛhyaprayogastu chandovadṛṣayaḥ kurvantīti samādheya iti haradattādayaḥ| pāśaṃ vimuñcati vipāśayati| rūpaṃ paśyati rūpayati| vīṇayopagāyati upavīṇayati| tūlenukuṣṇāti anutūlayati tṛṇāgram| anukuṣṇāti anughaṭṭayatītyartha iti haradattaḥ| ślokairupastauti upaślokayati| senayā abhiyāti abhiṣeṇayati, "upasargātsunoti"(pāosūo8-3-65)iti ṣatvam| abhyaṣeṇayat, "prāk sitādaḍvyavāye'pi"(pāosūo8-2-63)iti ṣatvam| tvaca saṃvaraṇe(tuopao21)"puṃsi sañjñāyām"(pāosūo3-3-118)iti ghaḥ| tvacaṃ gṛhṇāti tvacayati| ṭilopasya sthānivattvādupadhāvṛddhirna| uktādeva dhātoḥ halantāt "tatkaroti"(gaosūo)iti ṇai `tvācayati' ityupadhāvṛddhirbhavatyeva| "prakṛtyaikāc"(pāosūo6-4-163)iti ṭilopābhāvaḥ| tasmātsūtre tvacotyakāro vivakṣito na tu satyāpetivaduccāraṇārtha ityavadheyam| varmaṇā sannahyati saṃvarmayati| varṇaṃ gṛh‌ṇāti saṃvarmayati| cūrṇairavadhvaṃsayati avacūrṇayati| curādibhyaḥ svārthe, corayati| cintayati|
(pāosūo3-1-26)
hetumati ca(pāosūo3-1-26)|| hetuḥ kartuḥ prayojakaḥ, tadvayāpāraḥ pravartanārūpo hetumān, tasminvācye dhātorṇic syāt| pācayati devadatto yajñadattena| yajñadattaniṣṭhaklittvanukūlavyāpāraviṣayiṇī pravartanā devadattāśrayetyarthaḥ| pravartanā'nekadhā-preṣaṇamadhyeṣaṇaṃ tatsamarthācaraṇaṃ ceti| bhṛtyādernikṛṣṭasya pravartanā preṣaṇam, ājñetyarthaḥ| gurvāderārādhyasya pravartanā adhyeṣaṇam, prārthanetyarthaḥ| tatsamarthācaraṇamapi bahudhā anumatirupadeśo'nugraha iti| tatra yasyānumatiṃ vinā kriyā na niṣpadyate so'numatimātre prayojakaḥ| yathā rājādiḥ| vaidyādistu jvaritaḥ kaṣāyaṃ pibediti upadeśamātrema pravartakaḥ| yastu kenacid jighāṃsitaṃ palāyamānaṃ ruṇāddhi so'pi hanturanugrāhakatvāt prayojaka eva| tadiha arthaprakaraṇādigamyā amī viśeṣāḥ| sarvānugataṃ pravartanāsāmānyaṃ tu ṇico'rthaḥ| sa ca ṇicaḥ śakya iti mukhyaḥ pakṣaḥ| dyotya iti pakṣāntaramapyākare sthitam| yadyapi hetuśabdasya sasambandhikatvāt hetumā nityukte yaṃ prati prayojakatvaṃ sa eva labhyate, yathā pitṛmānityukte putraḥ, tādṛśaśceha kartā kārakādhikāre hetusaṃjñoktaḥ kriyā ca, tathāca paktuḥ pākasya vā hetumattvaṃ yuktam, tathāpi karaṇe ityadhikārāt neha kartāgṛhyate, prakṛtyaivoktatvācca na pākaḥ, kintu pākapaktrapekṣayā yo hetustadīyavyāpāra eva svabhāvato loke ṇijarthatayā prasiddho hetumacchabdenocyate iti siddhāntaḥ| evaṃ ca hetorityeva sūtraṃ yuktam| hetoḥ karaṇe vyāpāre ṇijityarthaḥ| tathā tu na kṛtamityeva| iha yadyapi phalavyāpārayordhātuvācyatvādviklittyanukūlavyāpāratvasya ca preṣaṇādāvapi sulabhatvāttasyāpi pacyarthatāmāśritya ṇico dyotakateti varṇitaṃ bhāṣyādau, tathāpi prauḍhivādamātrametat| tathāhi, adhiśrayaṇādireva vyāpāraviśeṣaḥ pacerarthaḥ| na tu tataḥ prācīno'pi krayaṇādyavasthāyāṃ pacatītyaprayogāt, anyathā'tiprasaṅgāt, kvācitkaprayogasya bhāktatvenāpyupapatteśca, pacatipācayatyorarthavailakṣaṇyasya anubhavasiddhatvācca, aṇau karturṇau karmatvamityādivyavasthābhyupagamācca, praṇāyayati' `abhiṣāvayati' ityādau upasargasya prakṛtyarthagataviśeṣadyotakatve ṇatvaṣatve staḥ, ṇicā sambandhe tu netyaṣṭame sphuṭatvācca| ato'tra pakṣe nātīvābhiniveṣṭavyam| syādetat, pravarttanāmātrasya ṇijarthatve ṇico loḍādīnāña
ca paryāyaprasaṅgaḥ| tataśca pṛcchatu māṃ bhavāniti vaktavye ṇijapi prayujyeteti cet? karttuḥ prayojako hi hetu; praiṣaviṣayastu nādyāpi kartṛtvenāvadhāritaḥ| tathāca prayojyapravṛttyupahitā pravṛttirṇijarthaḥ| kevalā tu loḍartha iti vivekaḥ| uktaṃ ca-
dravyamātrasya tu praiṣe pṛcchāderloṅ vidhīyate|
sakriyasya prayogastu yadā, sa viṣayo ṇicaḥ|| iti|
kiñca prayoktṛdharmaḥ prayuktirloḍarthaḥ| aniyatakartṛkā tu ṇijarthaḥ| paceti hi vaktureva preraṇā gamyate| pācayatītyatra tu vaktṛbhinnasya|
tatkarotītyupasaṃkhyānaṃ sūtrayatyādyarthe(kāovāo)|| gaṇapāṭhasiddha evāyamartha upasaṃkhyānenāpi pradarśitaḥ| iha karotītyatra prakṛtyarthamātraṃ vivakṣitaṃ na pratyayārthaḥ, tena ṇyantāt bhāvakarmaṇoḥ bhūtabhaviṣyatoḥ dvitvabahutvayośca laḥ sidhyati| ayaṃ ṇic prātipadikādeva na tu subantāditi mādhavaḥ| yuktañcaitat, supa ityadhikārasyeha vicchinnatvāt| kiñaaca curādiṣu hyevaṃ paṭhyate-"prātipadikāddhātvarthe bahulamiṣṭhavacca" (gaosūo) "tatkaroti tadācaṣṭe"(gaosūo) "tenātikrāmati"(gaosūo) "kartṛkaraṇāddhātvarthe"(gaosūo)iti| asyārthaḥ prātipadikāddhātorarthaviśeṣarūpe vācye ṇic syāt iṣṭhanīva cāsmin bahulaṃ kāryaṃ syāditi| kūlamullaṅghayati utkūlayati| asyaiva prapañcaḥ-tatkarotītyādiḥ| evañca prātipadikādityupakramānnedaṃ subantādvidhāyakam| tathā ca prakṛtavārttikamapi tatsamānārthakatvāttathaiva| "tenātikrāmati"(kāovāo)ityetattu kartṛkaraṇādityasyaiva prapañcaḥ| kartṛgrahaṇañca karaṇasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ karaṇatvena loke prasiddhānāṃ cakṣurādīnāmeva grahaṇamitiśaṅkāvyudasanāya| anyathā cakṣuṣā paśyati cakṣayatītyādāveva syānna tu karibhiravabadhnāti avakarayatītyādau| evañca, tattenetiśabdau karmakaraṇayorupalakṣakau| karaṇasya karmaṇaśca samarpakātprātipadikādityarthaḥ| subantādutpattau tu hastinā'tikrāmati atihastayatītyādau ṇau supo lope ṭilope ca kṛte antarvarttivibhaktyā padatvājjaś‌tvaṃ syāt| na ca ṭilopasya sthānivattvam, ajjhalādeśatvāt| haradattastu subantāṇṇicamabhipraiti| yadāha-taditi dvitīyāntopalakṣaṇamiti| na cāsminpakṣe padakāryaprasaṅgaḥ, iṣṭhavadityatidiṣṭayā bhasaṃjñayā padatvasya bādhāt| ata eva hi paṭiṣṭha ityādau subantādiṣṭhani jaśtvādipadakāryāpravṛttiḥ| kiñca sragviṇamācaṣṭe srajayatītyādau mādhavamate'pyeṣaiva gatiḥ| subantādutpannayorvin‌matorluki tatprakṛteḥ subantatvātpratyayalakṣaṇena padakāryaprasaṅgasya spaṣṭatvāt| tadiha matabhedena prātipadikātsubantādvā ṇijiti sthitam| ādyapakṣe'pi yatākathañcit prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭagrahaṇād ṅyābantādapi bhavati| ata eva ṇāviṣṭhavadityatra bhāṣye iṣṭhavadityatideśasya "puṃvadbhāvaṭilopayaṇādilopavinmatorlugartham" iti puṃvadbhāvo'pi prayojanatayoktaḥ| idañca diḍmātraṃ na tu parigaṇanamiti ṣaṣṭha evākare spaṣṭam| udāharaṇāni tu prapañcayāmaḥ-enīmācaṣṭe etayati| hariṇīmācaṣṭe haritayati| na cātra puṃvadbhāvasya iṣṭhani viśiṣyāvidhānātkathamatideśa iti vācyam, viśeṣātideśe sāmānyasyāpyatideśāt| vasiṣṭhavadatra varttitavyamityukte hi brāhmaṇatvaṃ sāmānyanibandhanamapyatidiśyata eva| tatheha bhasaṃjñānimittataddhitatvaprayuktaṃ puṃvadbhāvo'pītyadoṣaḥ| nanvetayatītyādau ṭilopena ṅīpi nivṛtte tatsanniyogaśiṣṭatvānnakāro'pi nivartyatām| tathā ca ṭilopenaiva gatārthatve kimarthaṃ puṃvadbhāvo'pi pṛthak prayojanatayā bhāṣye gaṇita iti cet?
atra kaiyaṭaḥ, "sanniyogaśiṣṭa"(paobhāo88)paribhāṣāyā anityatvajñāpanāyedam| tena `aineyaḥ' `śyaineyaḥ' ityatra "yasya"(pāosūo6-4-49)iti lope kṛte'pi nakāro na nivartate ityāha| haradattastu phalāntaramapi matāntaratvenāha-iḍabiḍamācaṣṭe aiḍabiḍayati| daradaṃ dāradayati| iḍabiḍaśabdo janapadasya kṣatriyajāteśca vācakaḥ| tasmāt "janapadaśabdāt kṣatriyādañ"(pāosūo4-1-168)daracchabdāt "dvyañma gadha"(pāosūo4-1-174)iti sūtreṇa| añādīnāmāpādaparisamāptestadvidhānāt "ataśca"(pāosūo4-1-177)iti luk| akārarūpasya tadrājapa3tyayasya striyāṃ lugiti hi sūtrārthaḥ| tataśca iḍabiṭ, darat strī| aiḍaviḍo dāradaśca pumān| puṃvadvacanena ca strīśabdasya puṃśabde'tidiṣṭe siddhamiṣṭam| na caivaṃ gotratvena jātitvāt "jāteśca'(pāosūo6-3-41)iti puṃvadbhāvaniṣedhaḥ śaṅkyaḥ, aupasaṃkhyānikasya nāyaṃ niṣedha iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt| na caivamapyajādī guṇavacanādevetyakteriṣṭhana evābhyāmasambhavena kathaṃ tadvadityatideśa iti vācyam, nahīṣṭhani dṛṣṭasyaivātideśaḥ kintu sambhāvitasya| anyathā atirājayatītyādau ṭilopo na syāt|
nanvasminpakṣe `aineyaḥ' `śyaineyaḥ' iti kathaṃ siddhyediti cet?
atra mādhavaḥ-ananyathāsiddhamapi aiḍabiḍayatītyādyudāhṛtya etayati śyetayatītyudāharan bhāṣyakāraḥ "sanniyogaśiṣṭa"(paobhāo88)paribhāṣāyā anityatvaṃ jñāpayatītyāha| vastutastu puṃvadbhāvasyaikākṣu ṭilopasyābhāṣitapuṃskeṣu ca cāritārthye'pi etayatītyādāvantaraṅgatvena puṃvadbhāva eva jñāpyaḥ "siddhaśca pratyayavidhau" ityuktatvena pratyayotpatteḥ pūrvameva pravṛttatvāt| ata eva nakārarahitaprayogasiddhiḥ| na cātra ṭilope'pi sanniyogaśiṣṭa nyāyena nakāranivṛttiḥ sulabheti vācyam, uktanyāyena nakāranivṛttau karttavyāyām "acaḥ parasmin"(pāosūo1-1-57)iti sthānivadbhāvasya durvāratvāt| ata eva `pañcendrāṇyo devatā asyeti pañcendraḥ' ityādau sthānivadbhāvenānugādiśravaṇe grāpte sthānivadbhāvaniṣedhārthe "kvilugupadhā" itivārttike luggrahaṇamiti bhāṣyavārttikādau spaṣṭam| ata evābhyāsekārasahitamaitaditi rūpaṃ siddham| ṭilope tu prakriyādaśāyāṃ pariniṣṭhite rūpe vā'varṇaparatvābhāvena sthānivadbhāvānatipattāvuktarūpāsiddhiḥ| nacāllopasyāpi sthānivadbhāvaḥ, tasya ṅīnimittatve'pi ṇijanimittatvāditi dhyeyam|
pṛthumācaṣṭe prathayati| caṅi vṛddheḥ pūrvaṃ ṭilopa iti pakṣe aglopitvāt| "sanvallaghuni"(pāosuo7-4-93)ityasyāpravṛtteḥ-apaprathat| paratvād vṛddhau āvādeśātpūrvaṃ ṭilope anaglopitvāt--apiprathat| pakṣadvayapīdaṃ "muṇḍamiśra"(pāosūo3-121)iti sūtre prapañcitam| evaṃ mṛdumācaṣṭe mradayati| amamradat, amimradta| bhraśayati, kraśayati, draḍhayati| eṣāṃ caṅi sarvathā'pyaglopitvāt--ababhraśat, acakraśat, adadraḍhat ityekameva rūpam| parivraḍhiyati| atropasargasya pṛthakkaraṇātparyavraḍhayata, paryavavraḍhat|
pṛthuṃ mṛduṃ bhṛśaṃ caiva kṛśaṃ ca dṛḍhameva ca|
paripūrve vṛḍhañcaiva ṣaḍetān ravidhau smaret||
kaviṃ paṭuṃ vā ācaṣṭe kavayati, paṭayati| acakavat, acīkavat| apapaṭhat, apapiṭhat| kumārīmākhyāt acukumārat| atra ekameva rūpam, "sanvallaghuni"(pāosūo7-4-93)iti "dīrgho laghoḥ"(pāosūo7-4-94)iti ca sūtre caṅpare ṇau pare acā avyavahitaṃ yallaghu tasminpare yo'bhyāsaḥ tasyeti kaiyaṭādisammate sūtrārthe yadatrābhyāsātparaṃ laghu na taccaṅparaṇiparamiti dīrghatvasyāprasaṅgāt, caṅpare ṇau yadaṅgantasya yo'bhyāso laghuparaḥ tasyeti haradattādipakṣe'pi kumārīśabdasya puṃvadbhāvena vṛddhāvapyaglopitvāt| nadīmākhyat ananadadityādi| nanu kaiyaṭamate "yenanāvyavadhānam" itinyāyena ekavyañjanavyavahite ajīharadityādau sanvadbhāvo'stu nāma, acikṣaṇadityādau tu kathamiti cet? asasmaradityādāvitvābhāvārtham "atsmṛdṛtvara"(pāosūo7-4-95)iti atvavidhānena saṃyogavyavadhāne'pi bhavatīti jñāpanāt| ūḍhamākhyat aujaḍhat| ūḍhimākhyat aujiḍht| kartāramācṣṭe karayati| bhartāraṃ bharayati| dogdhārandohayati| "tuśchandasi"(pāosūo5-3-59)iti tṛśabdalopo'pi ṇāvatidiśyata ityeke| anye tu chandasyupadiṣṭo'sau ṇāvapi chandasyevātidiśyatāṃ nāma| bhāṣāyāntu kathaṃ bhavet? tasmāṭṭilope karttayatītyādyeva rūpamityāhuḥ| tvāṃ māṃ vā ācaṣṭe tvāpayati, māpayati| iha "pratyayottarapadayośca"(pāosūo7-2-98)iti ekārthayoryuṣmadasmadormaparyantasya tvamau| "ato guṇe"(pāosūo6-1-97)iti pararūpātpūrvaṃ nityatvāṭṭilope vṛddhau pugityekaṃ matam| vastutastu parādapyantaraṅgasya balīyastvātpararūpatve "prakṛtyaikāc"(pāosūo6-4-163)iti cilopābhāvādupadhāvṛddhau tvādayati madāyatītyeva rūpamiti bahavaḥ| "prakṛtyaikāc"(pāosūo6-4-163)ityetatpratyākhyānabāṣyantūdāharaṇaviśeṣe'nyathāsiddhirityetāvanmātraparam| tadyathā-vṛttikārodāhṛteṣu madhye preṣṭhādaya ābhātsūtreṇa siddhāḥ| tasyāge'pi jyeṣṭhavadakāroccāraṇasāmarthyāt|
iṣṭhemeyaḥsvanekāco'pyavasiṣṭasya neṣyati|
ṭilopo bhāṣyakāreṇa pravṛtte vinmatorluki||
luko'pavādabhūtasya tasminpakṣe pravartanāt|
kaniṣṭhādāvidaṃ tulyaṃ tṛlopasya pravartanāt||
kaiyaṭamādhavādigranthāścehānukūlā iti vakṣyāmaḥ| "aṅgavṛtta"(pāobhāo94)paribhāṣayā vṛddhimakṛtvā tvadayati madayatītyanye pratipannāḥ| yuvāmāvāṃ vā ācaṣṭe yuṣmayati asmayati| "yuvāvau dvivacane"(pāosuo7-2-92)ityatra yadyapi dvivacane ityarthagrahaṇaṃ tathā'pīha yuvāvau na staḥ, vibhaktiparatvābhāvāt| prātipadikādeva hi ṇijiti mādhavādayaḥ| subantāditi haradattapakṣe'pi "antaraṅgānapi"(paobhāo52)iti nyāyena vibhakterlukāpahārāt| tvāmatikrāntamatikrāntau vā atitvām| atikrāntān atitvān| ācaṣṭe atitvayati, atimayati| yuṣmadasmadorekārthatvena "pratyayottarapadayośca"(pāosūo7-2-98)iti tvamau| antaraṅgatvātpūrvarūpaṃ, tataṣṭilopa iti mādhavaḥ| taccintyam, upasargasya pṛthakkaraṇena "prakṛtyaikāc"(pāosūo6-4-163)iti prakṛtibhāvāt| tasmādatitvādayati atimādayatītyeva bodhyam| atrāpi pararūpātpūrvaṃ nityatvāṭṭilope iti mate atitvāpayati atimāpayati| yuvāmāvāṃ yuṣmānasmānvā atikrāntamatikrāntāvatikrāntānvā ācaṣṭe atiyuṣmayati atyasmayati|
idānīṃ ṇyantātkvipi kaścidviśeṣa ucyate| tatra tvāṃ māṃ ācaṣṭa iti ākhyeyaikye tvāp māp, tvād mād, tvad mad iti prāguktamatabhedena tridhā prātipadikāni| yuvāmāvāṃ yuṣmānasmān vā ācaṣṭa iti ākhyeyasyānekatve tvamayorabhāvāṇṇau ṭilope, kvau, ṇilope, keścāpṛktalope yuṣma asya iti mānte prātipadike bhavataḥ| tataḥ svādayaḥ| tatra prātipadikāṣṭakādapi vibhaktīnāṃ yathāyathaṃ "ṅeprathamayoram"(pāosūo7-1-28)"śaso na"(pāosūo7-1-29)"bhyaso'bhyam"(pāosūo7-1-30)"pañcamyā at"(pāosūo7-1-31)"ekavacanasya ca"(pāosūo7-1-32)"yuṣmadasmad‌bhyāṃ ṅaso'ś"(pāosūo7-1-27)"sāma ākam"(pāosūo7-1-33)iti sūtrasaptakena vihitā ādeśā bhavanti| evaṃ "yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe"(pāosūo7-2-86)"dvitīyāyāñca"(pāosūo7-2-87)"pratamāyāśca dvivacane bhāṣāyām"(pāosūo7-2-88)iti trisūtryā vihitamātvaṃ "yo'ci"(pāosūo7-2-98)iti yatvaṃ ca bhavatyeva| "śeṣe lopaḥ"(pāosūoi7-2-90)tu ātvayatvanimittetaravibhaktau parato'ntyalopa iti vyākhyāne bhavatyeva| śeṣaśabdasya māntāccheṣaparatvamāśritya ṭilopa iti vyākhyāne tu na bhavatyevākhyeyasyānekatve| tatra hi śeṣelopenāpahāryaṃ māntātparaṃ ṇāviṣṭhavadityatitiṣṭena ṭilopenaivāpahṛtam| ākhyeyaikye tu bhavatyeva, prāk ṭilopābhāvāt| `ṭilopaṃ svīkṛtya pukā pāntatvam' iti mate tu na bhavatyeva| ajādau yatvavidhānādātvaṃ halādāveva paryavasyati| "tvāhau sau"(pāosūo7-2-94)"yuyavayau jasi"(pāosūo7-2-93)"tubhyamahyau ṅayi"(pāosūo7-2-95)"tavamamau ṅasi"(pāosūo7-2-96)iti catuḥsūtrīvihitāḥ prakṛtyādeśāstu ākhyeyaikye na bhavantyeva, maparyantābhāvāt| ākhyeyadvitvabahutvayostu vaikalpikāḥ| tathāhi-"maparyantasya"(pāosūo7-2-19)ityatra māntasyetyeva siddhe parigrahaṇasāmarthyādyuṣmadasmadormāntatvāvasthāyāṃ nādeśāḥ ityekaṃ matam| parigrahaṇābhāve māntasyaiva syāt, sati tu tasmin mānte tatodhike ca bhavati iti matāntaram| ubhayamidaṃ tasminneva sūtre vyutpādayiṣyate| matabhedācceha phalito vikalpaḥ| tatra ākhyeyadvitve sṛjasṅeṅassu paratvāt tvāhādipravṛttāvapi `au' `am' ityādiṣu vacanāntareṣu vibhaktiparatvādyuvāvau ekasminmate sta eva, matāntare tu na tvāhādayo nāpi yuvau iti vivekaḥ|
atha rūpāṇi-ākhyeyaikye sau tvāṃ, mām| `vṛddhirna' itivādināntu śeṣe lope tvam, mam| śeṣelopaṣṭilopaḥ, sa cācakṣāṇe na pravarttata iti pakṣe'pyākhyeyaikye'styeva dāntayorityuktam| pāntayostu pakṣe tvāpam, māpam,| itthaṃ saṅkalanayā trīṇi| auṅi `tvāṃ, mām' ityekameva| "prathamāyāśca dvivacane"(pāosūo7-2-88)ityāvam| jasi sāviva trīṇi, śeṣe lopasya pāntayoḥ pākṣikatvāt| am‌auṭoḥ-tvāṃ, mām| śasitvān, mān| "dvitīyāyāñca'(pāosūo7-2-77)ityātvam| āṅiḥtvāyā, māyā| avṛd‌dhau tu-tvāyā, mayā| tvābhyāṃ, mābhyām| tvābhiḥ, mābhiḥ| ṅayi am, śeṣe lopaḥ(pāosūo7-2-90)| vṛddhipakṣe "āto dhātoḥ"(pāosūo6-4-140)ityālopaḥ tvam, mam| pakṣe tvāpam, māpam| tvābhyām, mābhyām| tvābhyam, mābhyam| bhyami śeṣe lopaḥ| abhyamādeśapakṣe tu śeṣe lope āllope ca tvabhyam| mabhyam| avṛddhipakṣe'pyevam| pāntapakṣe tvāpabhyam, māpabhyam| tatra bhyami "aṅgavṛtta"(paobhāo94)paribhāṣāyā "bahuvacane jhalyet"(pāosūo7-3-103)ityetvaṃ na| tvat, mat| śeṣe lope vṛddhipakṣe āllopaḥ| tvāpat, māpat| tvābhyām, mābhyām| tvat, mat| tvāpat, māpat| tva, ma| tvāpa, māpa| tvāyoḥ, māyoḥ| avṛddhau tu-tvayoḥ, mayoḥ| tvākam, mākam| tvāpākam, māpākam, tvāyi, māyi| tvāyoḥ, māyoḥ| avṛddhau tu-tvayi mayi| tvayoḥ, mayoḥ| tvāsu, māsu| evañca-
ākhyeyaikye'tra sujasoścaturthyā bhyasi ca trayam|
ṭaus‌ṅidām‌bhyassu rūpe dve niścinuṣvaikamatyataḥ||
idaṃ tvavadheyam| kṛtaḥ karttaryasaṃjñāyāmitiviśeṣyanighnatokterācakṣāṇasya klībatve sujasorasarvanāmasthānatvena bhatvāta "āto dhātoḥ"(pāosūo6-4-140)ityālope tvam, mam ityeva rūpam| avṛddhivādināṃ sambodhane "eṅhrasvāt"(pāosūo6-1-69)iti hal‌mātralope he tvā, he ma| strītve tu ṭāp prāptaḥ "sannipāta"(paobhāo87)paribhāṣayā samādheyaḥ yattu kevale samādhānadvayam "aliṅgatvādaṭṭilopādvā" iti tadiha na bhavatīti dik|
athākhyeyadvitve rūpāṇi-sau tm, aham; prakṛtyādeśābhāve yuṣam, asam; śeṣe lopasyāpyabhāve yuṣmam, asmam| itthaṃ trīṇi| yuvām, āvām; yuṣām, asām| jasi-yūyaṃ, vayam; yuṣam, asam; yuṣmam, asmam| am‌auṭoḥ-yuvām, āvām; yuṣām, asām; yuvān, āvān; yuṣān, asān| yuvayā, āvayā; yuṣyā, asyā| yuvābhyām, āvābhyāṃ; yuṣābhyām, asābhyām| yuvābhiḥ, asmam| yuvābhyām, āvābhyām; yuṣābhyām, asābyām--yuvabhyam, āvabhyam; yuṣmabhyam, asmabhyam| bhyamādeśapakṣe tu-yuṣmbhyam| atra saṃyogāntalopo na, bhāṣye "jhala" ityanuvarttanāt| ananuvṛttipakṣe tuyuṅ‌bhyam| asmadastu "skoḥ"(pāosūo8-2-29)iti salope am‌bhyam| śeṣe lope tu-obhyam| yuvat, āvat; yuṣat, asat; yuṣmat, asmat| yuvābhyām, āvābhyām| yuṣābhyām, asābhyām| bhyasi ṅasivat trīṇi| tava mama; yuṣa, asa; yuṣma, asma| yuvayoḥ, āvayoḥ; yuṣyoḥ, asyoḥ| yuvākam, āvākam; yuṣākam, asākam; yuṣyākam, asmākam| yuvayi, āvayi; yuṣyi, asyi| yuvayoḥ, āvayoḥ; yuṣyoḥ, asyoḥ| yuvāsu, āvāsu; yuṣāsu, asāsu| evañca-
