iha sarvatra prakṛtyādeśayatvātvaśeṣelopeṣu kartavyeṣu ṇilopo na sthānivat, kvau luptatvāditi dik||
śvānamācaṣṭe śāvayati| `śvan i' iti sthite ṇāviṣṭhavadityatideśena dvau ṭilopau prāptau "ṭeḥ"(pāosūo6-4-143)ityekaḥ, "nastaddhite"(pāosūo6-4-144)ityaparaḥ| tatra "prakṛtyaikāc'(pāosūo6-4-163)iti prakṛtibhāvo yenanāprāptinyāyena "ṭeḥ"(pāosūo6-4-143)ityasyaiveti tasmānnivṛtte'pi "nastāddhite"(pāosūo 6-4-144)iti bhavatyeva| tata iṣṭhavadityatidiṣṭayā bhasaṃjñayaiva vakārasya samprasāraṇe vṛdvāvāvādeśaḥ| na ca `daviṣṭhaḥ' ityādau iṣṭhani "orguṇaḥ"(pāosūo6-4-146)pūrvasya dṛṣṭa iti ihāpyatidiśyeteti vācyam, tasminkartavye samprasāraṇaṭilopayoḥ "asiddhavadatra"(pāosūo6-4-22)ityasiddhatvāt| anye tu `brahmiṣṭhaḥ' ityādau nāntalakṣaṇāṭṭilopātparatvāt "ṭeḥ"(pāosūo6-4-155)ityeva pravarttate| tacceha prakaॉtibhāvena nivṛttam| "nastaddhite'(pāosūo6-4-144)iti tu iṣṭhani kvāpi na dṛṣṭamiti tasyehānatideśāt samprasāraṇapūrvatvayoḥ `śunayati' iti rūpamāhuḥ| na ca ṭilopayorābhīyatvena anyonyasyāsiddhatvātkathaṃ vipratiṣedha iti vācyam, vipratiṣedhe anyonyasyāsiddhatvātkathaṃ vipratiṣedha iti vācyam, vipratiṣedhe ābhīyaprasiddhatvaṃ nāstīti vakṣyamāmatvāt| vidvāṃsamācaṣṭa ityatra ṇau ṭilope vidvayatīti daurgāḥ| atra saṃprasāraṇābhāvaścintya ityātreyaḥ| "aṅgavṛtta"(paobhāo94)paribhāṣayā cintyoddhāro bodhyaḥ| saṃprasāraṇe vṛddhāvāvādeśe ca `vidāvayati' ityeke| anye tu `vidayati' ityāhuḥ| tathāhi, nityatvāṭṭilopātprāk saṃprasāraṇaṃ tato'ntaraṅgatvātpūrvarūpe paścāṭṭilopaḥ| na ca ṭilopasyāpi nityatvam, śabdāntaraprāptyā anityatvāt| nanu samprasāraṇamātreṇa na śabdāntaraprāptiḥ kintu pūrvarūpeṇa, "yasya ca lakṣamāntarema nimittaṃ vihanyate na tadanityam"(paobhāo48)iti cet? na, yasya cetyasya asārvatrikatāvā haradattādibhiruktatvāt| udañcamācaṣṭe udīcayati| atra upasargasya pṛthakkaraṇāt luptanakārādacchabdāṇṇic| "prakṛtyaikāc"(pāosūo6-4-163)iti ṭilopābhāve iṣṭhavadityatideśena bhatve "acaḥ"(pāosūo6-4-138) ityallope prāpte tadapavāda "uda īt"(pāosūo6-4-139)itītvam| caṅi tu udaicicat| atra ṇilopasya "dvirvacane'ci"(pāosūo1-1-59)iti sthānivattvāt "ajāderdvitīyasya"(pāosūo6-1-2)iti ciśabdasya dvitvam| aṅgasyā''ṭ vṛddhiḥ| lyapi laghupūrvatvābhāvena ayādeśābhāvāṇṇilope udīcya| pratyañcamācaṣṭe pratīcayati| atra "acaḥ"(pāosūo6-4-138)ityallopaḥ| "cau"(pāosūo6-3-138)iti pūrvapadasya dīrghaḥ| caṅi ciśabdātpūrvamaṭi yaṇādeśe pratyacicat| "iko'savarṇe"(pāosūo6-1-127)iti prakṛtibhāvapakṣe prati acicat| lyapi pratīcya| samyañcamācaṣṭe samīcayati| caṅi-samyacicat, sami acicat| samīcya| tiro'ñcatīti taryaṅ| "titasitaryalope"(pāosūo6-3-94)iti tiryādeśaḥ| tamācaṣṭe tirāyayati| iṣṭhavadbhāvena ṭilopenāñcaterapahīre vṛddhyāyau| na cātra añcerlopāt tirasastiriḥ kathamiti vācyam, alope iti hi "acaḥ"(pāosūo6-4-138)iti vidhīyamāne lope tiryādeśo vāryate, tasyaivānantaratvāt| iha tirerikārasya vṛddhyāyoḥ kṛtayorakṛtayorvā lopaḥ prāptaḥ "aṅgavṛtta"(paobhāo94)paribhāṣayā na bhavati| yadvā ciṇoluṅnyāyena prathamapravṛttaṭilopasya "asiddhavadatra"(pāosūo6-4-22)ityasiddhatvāt punaṣṭilopo na| ata eva tireḥ sthānivattvenāvyayatvāt "avyayānāṃ bhamātre"(kāovāo)iti prāpto'pi ṭilopo na bhavati| evaṃ "yasya"(pāosūo6-4-148)iti lopo'pi na bhavati, parayā vṛddhyā bādhādvā| caṅi aglo pitvena upadhāḍrasvo na, atitirāyat| saha añcatīti sadhraṅ, "sa hasya sadhriḥ"(pāosūo6-3-95)| sadhryañcamācaṣṭe sadhrāyayati| asasadhrāyat| pūrvavatpunaṣṭilopo na|
syādetat, yadi tirisadhryorikāre ṭilopasyāpa3vṛttau ciṇoluṅnyāyenāsiddhatvaṃ mūlam, tarhi kumārīmācaṣṭe `kumārayati' iti na sidhyet, tatrāpi iṣṭhavadbhāvena pravṛttasya puṃvattvasya tainaiva kumārākāralope asiddhatvāpatteriti cet? maivam, "atidiśyamānānāṅkāryāṇāmutpattideśa eva deśaḥ" ityabhyupagamāt puṃvattvasya ca "bhasyāḍhe taddhite"(kāovāo)iti ābhīyebhyaḥ prāgevotpatteḥ| ata eva bhāṣyakāreṇa `lohinīmācaṣṭe lohitayati' ityudāhṛtam| viṣvadryañcamācaṣṭe viṣvadrāyayati| devadryañcamācaṣṭe devadrāyayati| "viṣvagdevayośca"(pāosūo6-3-92)iti cakārāt sarvanāmna'dryādeśe sarvadrāyayati| adaso'dryādeśe amumuā yati, adamuāyayati, adadrāyayati| caṅi ajāditvāt dvitīyasya dvittvam| aglopitvānnopadhāhrasvaḥ| āmumumuāyat, ādadamuāyat, ādadadrāyat| ādye "pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacane"iti mutvasyāsiddhatvā bhāvaḥ| imācaṣṭe āyayati, "prakṛtyaikāc"(pāosūo6-4-163)iti prakṛtibhāvāṭṭilopābhāve vṛddhau āyādeśa-| caṅi upadhāhrasve dvitī yasya dvitve mābhavān ayiyat| na ca dvitve kartavye"ṇaukṛtaṃ sthānivat" iti vṛddhyādeḥ sthānivattvaṃ śaṅkyam, sthānirūpasya yatra dvirvacanaṃ labhyate tatra hi, tat, iha tu ṇereva dvirvacanamiti mādhavaḥ|
vastutastu acikīrttadityatra ativyāptiṃ vārayitum "oḥ puyaṇji"(pāosūo7-4-80)iti jñāpakasya sajātīyaviṣayatāmāśritya avarmavaduttarakhaṇḍa eva sthānivadbhāvapravṛttiriti "dvirvacane'ci"(pāosūo1-1-59)itisūtra evāvocāma| spaṣṭañcaitadevam "urat"(pāosūo7-4-66)iti sūtre rakṣitapadamañjaryādiṣvapi| uttarakhaṇḍasyāvarṇavattāpi na prayogaparyavasāyinyevetyāgrahaḥ kintu prakriyāvasthāgatā'pi| tena `aujiḍhat" `apītyat' ityatra dvirvacanottarakālaṃ ṭilopena "lopaḥ pivateḥ"(pāosūo7-4-4)ityanena ca uttarakhaṇḍe avarṇāpahāre'pi na kṣatiḥ| bhuvamācaṣṭe bhāvayati| caṅi-abībhavat| ṇau kṛtasya sthānivattvāt bhūśabdasya dvitvam| punaruttarakhaṇḍe vṛddhyāvau, hrasvaḥ| tataḥ sanvadbhāve "oḥ puyaṇ‌ji"(pāosūo7-4-80)itītvam| "dīrgho laghoḥ"(pāosūo7-4-94)iti dīrghaḥ| nanviha bhū ityasya dvitve satyuttarakhaṇḍe vṛddhyāvahrasvatvāni pravṛttāni, evañca abhyāsasyānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāt tasya sanvadbhāvena puyaṇ‌lakṣaṇe itve karttavye "ṇau caṅi'(pāosūo7-4-1)iti hrasvasya "acaḥ parasmin"(pāosūo1-1-57)iti sthānivattve alaghuparatvātkathamitvamiti cet? ucyate, "oḥ puyaṇji'(pāosūo7-4-80)itītvasya sanvadatideśasya ca ārambhasāmarthyāt sthānivadbhāvasyehāpravṛtteḥ| bhruvamākhyat abubhravat| atra yaḥ avarmaparo yaṇ, nāsāvabhyāsātparaḥ| yaśca paraḥ parvagaḥ, nāsāvavarmapara iti itvābhāvaḥ| aśiśrayat| ṇau kṛtasya sthānivattvena śriśabdasya dvitvam| heśabdamākhyat ajīhayat| gām ajūgavat| rāyam arīrayat| nāvam anūnavat| svaśvam svāśaśvat| svarāca,ṭesvayati| "avyayānāṃ bhamātre"(kāovāo)iti ṭilopaḥ| "prakṛtyaikāc"(pāosūo6-4-163)iti prakṛtibhāvastu "yenanāprāpti"(pāobhāo59)nyāyena ānantaryācca "ṭeḥ"(pāosūo6-4-155)ityasyaiva ṭilopasya nānyasyetyuktam| ṇau kṛtatvena ṭilopasya sthānivattvāt svar‌śabdasya dvitve asasvadityeke| ajādeśasyaiva sthānivattvam, ayaṃ tvajjhalādeśa iti sthānivattvābhāvāt sviśabdasya dvirvacane asisvadityanye| bahūnācaṣṭe bhāvayati| atra "iṣṭhasya yiṭ ca"(pāosūo6-4-159)iti iṣṭhanivihitāvād bahorbhūbhāvaḥ| yiḍāgamastu na bhavati `ṇau' ityupameye saptamīśrīvaṇena "iṣṭhavat" iti upamānādapi saptamyantādvatiḥ| tena iṣṭhani pare pūrvasya yatkāryaṃ tasyaivātideśo na tviṣṭhanaḥ kāryasyāpīti siddhāntāt `prātipadikasya' iti vacanasya pratyayakāryānatideśārthatvācca| "ṭeḥ"(pāosūo6-4-155)iti sūtre kaiyaṭena `bhāvayati' ityudāhṛtya yiṭ‌sanniyāgaśiṣṭaṣṭhatvād bhūbhāvasya yiḍabhāve asyāpyabhāvāt `bahayati' ityekīyamatatvenopanyastam| ----- tu sopapattikatvāttatraiva prābalyamiti manyamānena `bahayati' iti svapakṣatvenoktvā bhāvayatīsyekīyamatenoktam| ata eva puruṣakāye'pi bhāvayatīti cintyamityuktam|
vastutastu kaiyaṭapakṣa eva prakalaḥ| tathā ca iṣṭhavaditi kāryātideśaḥ, kāryasyaiva prādhānyāt| tathā ca iṣṭhavadvacanameva prakṛtau dṛṣṭānāmiha vidhāyakamiti tadeva bhūbhāvaṃ vidhatte| tathā ca sanniyogābhāvaḥ spaṣṭa eva| cāndrakaumāraśākaṭāyaneṣu tu iṣṭhani yugveti bahoreva yukaṃ vidhāya `bhūyayati' iti svīkṛtam| sthūlamācaṣṭe sthavayati| dūraṃ davayati| yuvānaṃ yavayati| hrasvayati| kṣepayati| kṣodayati| atrādyeṣu guṇasya "aco ñṇiti"(pāosūo7-2-115)iti vṛddhiḥ prāptā "aṅgavṛtta"(paobhāo94)iti vā "prātipadikāddhātvarthe bahulam"(gaosūo)iti bahulagrahaṇādvā na bhavati| yuvatiśabdādapi iṣṭhani "liṅgaviśiṣṭa"(paobhāo73)paribhāṣayā "sthūladūra"(pāosūo6-4-116)iti yaṇādiparalopādeḥ sattvāṇṇāvapitadatideśāt yavayatītyeva rūpam| yadvā puṃvadbhāve kṛte yaṇādiparalopāttadeva rūpam|
śīkaravyatikaramarīcibhirdūrayatyavanena vivasvati|
iti kālidāsaprayogastu cintya iti sudhākarādayaḥ| vastutastu dūramayate dūrāt taṃ karotīti samādheyam| sragviṇamācaṣṭe srajayati| atrātideśādvino luk| "prakyaikāc'(pāosūo6-4-163)iti ṭilopo na| "ata upadhāyāḥ"(pāosūo7-2-116)iti vṛddhistu "aṅgavṛttaḥ"(paobhāo94)iti na bhavatīti bhāṣye sthitam| gomantamācaṣṭe gāvayati, matub‌luki "aco ñṇiti"(pāosūo7-2-115)iti vṛddhiḥ| caṅi aglopitvāsanvaditvadīrghatvayorabhāve-asasrajat, ajugavat ityādi| yuvānamalpaṃ vā''caṣṭe kanayati, "yuvālpayoḥ kananyatarasyām"(pāosūo5-3-64)| pakṣe yavayati| yuvatimalpāṃ veti vigrahe'pyevam| antikamācaṣṭe nedayati| bāḍhamācaṣṭe sādhayati| "antikabāḍhayornedasādhau"(pāosūo5-3-63)| praśasyamācaṣṭe praśasyayati| iha "praśasyasya śraḥ" "jya ca"(pāosūo5-3-60,61)iti śrajyau na bhavataḥ, upasargasya pṛthakkaraṇāditi mādhavaḥ| yatta sudhākareṇa `śrāpayati' ityudātdṛtam, yacca śākaṭāyanena `śrayati' `jyayati' iti, tatsarvaṃ bhāṣyavirodhādupekṣyam| vṛddhamācaṣṭhe jyāpayati| ayañca jvādeśaḥ varṣādeśena saha vikalpate| "priyasthira"(pāosūo6-4-157)iti prādayaḥ| priyamācaṣṭe prāpayati, sthiraṃ sthāpayati, sphiraṃ sphāpayati, urum varayati iti subdātau mādhavaḥ| ūrṇudhātau tu vṛddhiṃ sa evodājahāra| bahulaṃ bahayati| guruṃ garayati| vṛddhaṃ varṣayati| tṛpraṃ duḥkhaṃ, tadācaṣṭe traṣayati| dīrghaṃ drāghayati| vṛndārakaṃ vṛndayati|
|| iti iṣṭhavadbhāvodāharaṇaprapañcaḥ ||
prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ-sutraṅkaroti sūtrayati| iha vyākaraṇasya sūtraṅkarotīti vākye dravyarūpaṃ sūtraṃ sūtraśabdenocyate| lakṣyalakṣaṇasamudāyaśca vyākaraṇaśabdārthaḥ| tayoraṃśāṃśibhāvāt ṣaṣṭhī| vṛttotu "sūtraśabdo'narthakaḥ karotyarthaparo vā" iti pakṣadvaye'pi sūtrasya padārthaikadeśatvāt na tena vyākaraṇaṃ sambadhyate, kintu karotyarthenaiva, iti `vyākaraṇaṃ sūtravati' iti dvitīyaiva bhavati| tatrāpi sambandhasāmānyavivakṣāyāṃ `mātuḥ smarati' itivat ṣaṣṭhī bhavatyeveti dik|
"ākhyānātkṛtastadācaṣṭe iti ṇic kṛlluk prakṛtipratyāpattiḥ prakṛtivacca kārakam"(kāovāo)|| ākhyāyata ityākhyānam, bāhulakātkarmaṇi lyuṭ| ākhyānaśabdena ca tadabhidhāyī śabdo gṛhyate, arthe kṛdantatvāsambhavāditi prāñcaḥ|
vastutastu karaṇe lyuṭ| kaṃsavadhamācaṣṭe kaṃsaṃ dhātayati| iha kṛd‌grahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇāt(paobhāo28)`kasavadha' iti kṛdanta ākhyānaśabdaḥ| tato dvitīyāntātprātipadikādvā ṇic| kṛto'p‌pratyayasya luk| tasyaiva yā prakṛtiḥ `han' iti, tasyāḥ vikāraparityāgena svenaiva rūpeṇāvasthānam| yadyapi kṛto luki kṛte tatsanniyogaśiṣṭasya vadhādeśasya nivṛttiḥ siddhaiva, "hanaśca vadhaḥ"(pāosūo3-3-76)iti sūtreṇa hi apratyayavadhādeśau sanniyogaśiṣṭau| tathāpi `sītāyogamācaṣṭe sītayā yojayati" ityatra kutvasyāsanniyogaśiṣṭatvena tannivṛttyarthaṃ prakṛtipratyāpattivacanamiti kaiyaṭaharadattamādhavādaya-|
vastutastu "nimittāpāya"(paobhāo57)nyāyenaiva tatsiddhestasyānityatvajñāpanārthamidam| "nahīdaṃ vacanaṃ, nāpi nyāyaḥ" iti vadadbhirapi "akṛtavyūha"(paobhāo57)paribhāṣāyāḥ tatsthānāpannāyāḥ puraskṛtatvāttasyā evānityatvamanena jñāpyata iti niṣkarṣaḥ| idañca "acaḥ parasmin"(pāosūo1-1-57)iti sūtra eva prapañcitamasmābhiḥ| evañca `kaṃsahan-i' iti sthite aṅgasaṃjñā dhātusaṃjñā ca kaṃsaviśiṣṭasyaiva prāptā, tataścāḍdvirvacanayordoṣaḥ syāt, ata uktaṃ "prakṛtivaccakārakam' iti| asyārthaḥ-prakṛtirhetumaṇṇicaḥ prakṛtiḥ, ṣaṣṭhyantādvatiḥ, badhādeḥ kṛdantasya yatkārakaṃ kaṃsādikaṃ tasya kṛt‌prakṛterhanyādeḥ hetumaṇṇau dhātāvanantarbhūtaṃ dvitīyāntaṃ yadrūpaṃ tadeva bhavatīti| ata eva `rājāgamanamācaṣṭe rājānamāgamayati' ityatra nakāraśravaṇamapyupapannam| anena cātideśena kārakasya dhātāvanantarbhāve labdhe tadvyatiriktādvadhādereva ṇic| etena `kaṃsamajīghatat' itya.ḍ‌dvarvacane yathābhimataṃ sidhyataḥ nanvevamapi "ho hanteḥ"(pāosūo7-3-54)iti "hanasto'ciṇṇaloḥ"(pāosūo7-3-32)iti ca kutvatatve na prāpnutaḥ, "ghātoḥ svarūpagrahaṇe tatpratyaye kāryavijñānāt"(paobhāo90)iti cet?
atra haradattamādhavādayaḥ-"prakṛtivacca" iti cakāro bhinnakramaḥ, `kārakam' ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| kāryaśabdaścādhyāhāryaḥ| hetumaṇṇic‌ptaṃkṛtau yādṛśaṅkārakaṃ tathehāpi, yādṛśañca tatra kāryaṃ aḍdvirvacanatatvakutvādi tadapīha tathaivetyarthaḥ| iha ca aḍ‌dvirvacane atideśadvayenāpi sidhyataḥ| asaṅkīrṇodāharaṇantu dvitīyādikaṃ kutvatatvādikañceti vivekaḥ| iha kaṃsavadhasubhadrāharaṇādiniruḍhopākhyāna eva ṇijiti nāgrahaḥ, kintu pratipādanamātre| tena rājāgamanamācaṣṭe rājānamāgamayati| yadyapīha kṛtprakṛtau `rājā' kartāsīt, tathāpi gamerhetumaṇṇau "gatibuddhi"(pāosūo1-4-52)iti karmībhūtaḥ; tadvaccehāpi| `rājānam' ityasya prakṛtibhāgo yadyapi antarvarttinyā ṣaṣṭhyā pratyavalakṣaṇena padam, tathāpi nakāraśravaṇaṃ bhavatyeva, rūpātideśabalāt| `devadattapākamācaṣṭe devadattena pācayati' iti tṛtīyaiva bhavati| "gatibuddhi"(pāosūo1-4-52)iti niyamena karmatvāpahāre kartṛtvasyaiva sthiteriti dik|
dṛśyarthāyāṃ ca pravṛttau(kāovāo)|| mṛgāṇāṃ ramaṇaṃ mṛgaramaṇam| kartṛṣaṣṭhyā samāsaḥ| tadācaṣṭe gṛgān ramayati| yadā pratipādyakartṛkadarśanārthamākyātaṃ tadaiva ṇijiṣyate nānyadetyetadarthaṃ vacanam| yeyamākhyātarūpā vṛttiḥ sā yadi dṛśyarthaḥ| tena `svayaṃ mṛgaramaṇamanubhavan anyasmai darśayitumācaṣṭe' ityasminviṣaye `mṛgān ramayati' itaki pravogaḥ| yadā tu araṇye dṛṣṭaṃ mṛgaramaṇaṃ grāmametyā'nyasmā ācaṣṭe-`evaṃ tatra mṛgā ramante' iti, tasminnākhyāte bodhanīye `mṛgaramaṇamācaṣṭe' iti vākyameva bhavati|
atra kaiyaṭādayaḥ-dṛśyarthāyāmeva' iti niyamo mṛgaramaṇadiviṣayaka eva, na tu sārvatrikaḥ| tena rājāgamanādau dṛśyarthapravṛttyabhāve'pi ṇij bhavatvevetyāhuḥ|
lopaśca kālātyantasaṃyoge maryādāyām(kāovāo)| iha ākhyānāditi na sambadhyate| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| sannihitayā ākhyānakriyayā saha kālasya sākalyena sambandhe bodhanīye ṇic, maryādāvacanasyāṅo lopaścetyarthaḥ| udāharaṇantu vivasanaṃ vivāsaḥ atikramaṇaṃ, ghañ, rātrervivāsa iti kartṛṣaṣṭhyā samāsaḥ| tataḥ "āṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ"(pāosūo2-1-13)ityāṅā sahāvyayībhāvaḥ| ārātrivivāsamācaṣṭe rātriṃ vivāsayati| yāvad‌rātreratikramaṇaṃ tāvatkathāḥ kathayatītyarthaḥ| vasikriyāyāṃ kartṛbhūtāyā rātrerhetumaṇṇau tāvatkarmatvaṃ vaserakarmakatvāttadvadatrāpi ṇau karmatvaṃ `rātrim' ityasya luptaṣaṣṭhyantatvena prakṛtibhāgasya padatve "iko'savarṇe"(pāosūo6-1-127)iti pākṣikaḥ prakṛtibhāvaḥ prāptaḥ pūrvavadrūpātidesānnivarttate| ihākhyeyaṃ ṇicprakṛtyā anupāttamapi arthādgamyate| tadvācakastu `bhārakakathām' ityādiḥ śabdo neha prayoktavyaḥ| tatsamabhivyāhāre hi sati ṇijeva notpadyate, anabhidhānāt| atra ca pramāṇaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ bhāṣyakārīyaṃ pratyākhyānameva| nahi phalabhede pratyākhyānaṃ pratyākhyānāvasara eva sphuṭībhaviṣyati| tathā `prakṛtivacca kārakam' ityasya pūrvokte viparītakramādhyāhāravyākhyāne'pi bhāṣyakārīyapratyākhyānaṃ pramāṇamiti dik|
citrīkaraṇe prāpi(kāovāo)|| ākhyānāditi vihāya śiṣṭaṃ sambadhyate| kṛdantāpāścaryakaraṇe gamyamāne prāpnotyarthe ṇic syāt, kṛllugādi pūrvavat| ujjayinyāḥ prasthito māhiṣmatyāṃ sūryodgamanaṃ prāpnoti sūryamudgamayati| iha ujjayinyā māhiṣmatī dūradeśastheti tāvato deśasya prāgudayādatikramaṇamāścaryakaraṇam| "prakṛtivacca kārakam" iti sūryasya pṛthagbhāvaḥ| saṅgrāmayatereva sopasargādityukterucchabdasyātipa pṛthakkaraṇam| sūryasya hetumaṇṇau karmatvāt ihāpi karmatve sūryamudagamayadityādi|
nakṣatrayoge jñi(kāovāo)|| nakṣatrayogavācinaḥ kṛdanatājjānātyarthe ṇic, śeṣaṃ prāgvat| puṣpeṇa yogaḥ kartṛkarmakaḥ yoga ityarthaḥ| puṣyohi candramasaṃ yunakti sambadhnāti| iha karmaṇo'pi gamyamānatvāt "ubhayaprāptau"(pāosūo2-3-66)iti niyamātkartari ṣaṣṭhyabhāve tṛtīyā "antarddhau yenādarśanamicchati"(pāosūo1-4-28)itivat| puṣyayogaṃ jānāti puṣyeṇa yojayati| yujeḥ kartuḥ puṣyasya gatyādikartṛṣvanantarbhāveṇa hetumaṇṇau na karmatā kintu kartṛtvameveti ihāpi tathā, tena tṛtīyaiyava| idañca "ākhyānātkṛtaḥ"(kāovāo)ityādi vārttikajātaṃ bhāṣyavārttikayoreva pratyākhyātam, tadīyalakṣyajātasya āropeṇāpi sūpapādatvāt| tathāhi, kaṃsaṃ ghātayatīti tāvadāropaḥ| ye hi kaṃsādyanukāriṇāṃ naṭānāṃ vyākhyānopādhyāyāḥ te kaṃsānukāriṇaṃ naṭaṃ sāmājikaiḥ kaṃsabuddhyā gṛhītaṃ tādṛśenaiva vāsudevena ghātayantīva| ye'pi citraṃ vyācakṣate iyaṃ mathurā, ayaṃ prāsādaḥ, ayaṃ bhagavān vāsudevaḥ praviṣṭaḥ ityādikrameṇa, tepi tathaiva| ye'pi granthaṃ vācayantaḥ kaṃsavadhamācakṣate granthikā nāma te'pi tattatpadārthaviṣayakaniścayotpādanāttāstāḥ kriyā nirvartayantīva| tathāca spaṣṭa āropaḥ| kiñca `gaccha hanyate kaṃsaḥ' `gaccha ghāniṣyate' kiṃ gateneha tena hataḥ kaṃsaḥ' ityādiṣu nirūḍheṣu vyavahāreṣu tavāpyeṣaiva gatiḥ| nahyatra ṇijvidhiḥ kiñcidupakaroti, uktodāharaṇeṣu ṇicpraveśābhāvāt| uktañca-
śabdopahitarūpāṃśca buddherviṣayatāhgatān|
pratyakṣamiva kaṃsādin sādhanatvena manyate|| iti|
evaṃ `rājānamāgamayati' ityādāvapi bodhyam| `rājānamānayati' ityādau hi ṇijabhāvāttavāpyeṣaiva gatiḥ| `rātriṃ vivāsayati' ityatrāpi vicitrakathā''khyānena rātriranenaiva gamiteti āropaḥ| `niśānnināya' ityādau ca tavāpyeṣaiva gatiḥ| `sūryamudgamayati' ityatrāpi prayojyaprayojakabhāvādhyāropaḥ, tadālambanantu `māhiṣmatyāṃ sūryodgamanaṃ labheya' ityevaṃrūpasya devadattābhipretārthasya nirvṛttireva| yo hi yasya pravartyaḥ sa tasyābhipretaṃ nirvarttayati| tatra svabhūtyarthaṃ pravartamānā api śiṣyādayo gurvabhipretamapi uddiśantyeva| sūryastu na devadattābhipretoddeśena pravartata iti vaiṣamyam| tathāpi abhipretārthasampattimātreṇa ārope na kācit kṣatiḥ| evaṃ "puṣyeṇa yojayati" ityatrāpi jyotiḥ śāstrapariśīlanena puṣyayogasya sarvānpratyāviṣkaraṇāt yojayatīvetyāropaḥ|
|| iti śabdakaustubhe tṛtīyasyādhyāyasya prathamapāde dvitīyamānhikam ||
|| tṛtīyādhyāyasya prathame pāde tṛtīyamānhikam ||
(pāosūo3-1-27)
kaṇḍvādibhyo yak(pāosūo3-1-27)|| ebhyo dhātubhyo yak syātsvārthe| kaṇḍūñ(kāouo1)kaṇḍūyati| kaṇḍūyate| na ca kaṇḍ‌vādīni prātipadikānyeveti vācyam, guṇaniṣedhārthena yakaḥ kittvena teṣāṃ dhātutvasiddheḥ| na caivaṃ dhātorityanuvṛttervaiyarthyamiti vācyam, prātipadikānāṃ vāraṇīyatvāt| na caite dhātava eveti vācyam, kaṇḍvādiṣu keṣāṃciddīrghapāṭhena prātipadikatvasiddheḥ| yadi hi dhātava eva te syustarhi vāgrahaṇaṃ nivartya nityo yagiti tāvadāstheyam, anyathā śabādau `kaṇḍavati' ityādyaniṣṭarūpaprasaṅgāt| evaṃ sthite hrasvāntādapi yaki `mantūyati' ityādivat "akṛtsārva"(pāosūo7-4-25)iti dīrghatve `kaṇḍūyati' ityādisiddheḥ kiṃ dīrghapāṭhena? tasmāt kittvadīrghābhyāṃ jñāpakābhyāṃ dhātavaḥ prātipadikāni ceti dvividhāḥ kaṇḍvādaya iti sthitam| uktañca bhāṣye-
dhātuprakaraṇāddhātuḥ kasya cāsañjanādapi|
āha cāyāmimaṃ dīrghaṃ manye dhāturvibhāṣitaḥ|| iti|
tatra dhātvadhikārāt dhātubhya eva pratyayaḥ| sa ca nitya iti siddhāntaḥ|
syādetat, eṣāṃ prātipadikatvamevāstu, tyajyatāṃ dīrghapāṭhaḥ pratyayasya kittvañca| nacaivam, "akṛtsārva"(pāosūo7-4-25)iti dīrghaḥ ṅkiti vidhīyamāna iha na syāditi vācyam, tatra "ṅkiti" ityasya nivṛtteḥ| na caivam `uruyā' `dhṛṣṇuyā' ityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ, tasya chāndasatvāt| na ca yako nityatve `kaṇḍūḥ' iti na siddhyediti vācyam, kaṇḍūyaśabdātsampadāditvādbhāve kvau allope 'lopo vyoḥ"(pāosūo6-1-66)iti yalope ca tatsiddheḥ| na ca yalope'llopasya sthānivattvaṃ śaṅkyam, " na padānta"(pāosūo1-1-58)iti niṣedhāt| na caivamallopasya sthānivattvāduvaṅ syāditi vācyam, sati sthānivattve akārāntasyaiva dhātuteti pūrvadale uvaṅo'prāpteḥ| tarhi yaṇ syāditi cet? astu, tasya ūṭh kariṣyate| na ca ūṭhi kartavye allopasya sthānivattvena kvipparatvaṃ nāstīti vācyam, vakārasya ādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāt| nanu sthānidvārakamanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvamastyeva| na ca tasyāsāstrīyatvānnātideśa iti mādhavoktaṃ yuktam, anādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvamāśritya kartavyasya "ataḥ parismin"(pāosūo1-1-57)ityatideśasya śāstrīyatayā "sthānivat'(pāosūo1-1-56)sūtreṇa atideśātideśasya durvāratvāt| anyathā "na padānta"(pāosūo58)iti sūtre savarṇamagrahaṇasya vaiyarthyāpatteriti cet?na, sthānidvārakasya anādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvasya asārvatrikatāyāḥ prāgeva nirṇītatvāt| ata eva ūṭhi kṛte punaruvaṅ na| yadvā, "kvau luptaṃ na sthānivat'(kāovāo)iti niṣedhādyaṇeva māstu| nanvevamapi `kaṇḍvau' ityādau sayogapūrvakatvena "oḥ supi"(pāosūo6-4-83)ityasyāpravṛttau uvaṅ syāditi cait? astu, kvipaḥ pratyayalakṣaṇenoṭhaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ| tasmāt prātipadikānyevaitāni dīrghakittve ca niṣphale iti cet? maivam, uvaṅo bahiraṅgatvenāsiddhatayā| ūṭho durbalatvāt| kiñcoktarītyā hi `kaṇḍūḥ' itivat `mantūḥ' ityādi syāt, `mantuḥ' ityādi ca na sidhyet| atha "dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ"(pāosūo3-1-7)ityato vāgrahaṇamanuvarteta, tarhi yadyapi `mantuḥ' ityādi hrasvaṃ siddhaṃ, tathāpi `kaṇḍūḥ' itivadallopayalopābhyāṃ `mantūḥ' ityapi svāt| tathā yaganutpattipakṣe `mantuḥ' ityādivat `kaṇḍuḥ' ityapi syāt| kiñca sukhādibhyo yapratyaye tasya anārddhadhātukatvādatolopābhāve "akṛtsārva"(pāosūo7-4-25)iti dīrghe `sukhāvati' ityādi syāt| `sukhyati' itvādi ceṣyate| atha halantameva paṭhyeta, tarhi `sukhaṃ' `duḥkham' ityakārāntaṃ na sidhvet| tasmādyathāvāsameva manoramam|
nanvevamapi prātipadikaiḥ `kaṇḍvau' `mantuḥ' ityādi yadyapi siddhaṃ, tathāpi yagantebhyaḥ kvau aniṣṭhaṃ syādeva| tadyathā-kaṇḍūyateḥ kaṇḍuvau, kaṇḍuvaḥ| mantūyateḥ mantūḥ| sukhādeḥ suk ityādi halantam| naiṣa doṣaḥ, yagantebhyaḥ kvipa evānutpatteḥ| uktaṃ hi bhāṣye-"naitebhyaḥ kvip drakṣyate" iti| kathantarhi kaṇḍūyaterapratvayaḥ? `kaṇḍūḥ' iti "napadānta"(pāosūo1-1-58)sūtre uktamiti cet? kyajantātkivapītyavehi| tatra ca `kaṇḍuvau' ityuvaṅiṣṭa eva| evaṃ prātipadikādācārakvibantātkyaṅantādadvā kvipvapi bodhyam|
syādetat, kaṇḍvādayaḥ prātipadikānyeva, yathānyāsaṃ dīrghaśca santu, kakārastu tyajyatāṃ, vāgrahaṇañcānuvartyatām, yagantātkvipo'nabhidhānañca āvayostulyaṃ, tatkiṃ kaṇḍvādīnāṃ dhātutveneti cet? uktarītyā `sukhyati' ityādyasiddheḥ| prātipadikātpratyaye tasyānārddhadhātukatvena `sukhāyati' iti syāditi hi spaṣṭa eva doṣaḥ| yattu kaumudyām-kṛñarthe yak syāt, dhātavaḥ prātipadikāni ceti kaṇḍvādayo dvividhāḥ, kaṇḍūṃ karoti kaṇḍūyate, nāmadhātutvādyateṣṭaṃ dvitve prāpte kaṇḍvādestṛtīyasya ityuktaṃ; tadetatsarvamākaraviruddhamanekadoṣagrastañca| tathāhi, kṛñartha itivyakhyānena `karaṇe' ityasyānuvṛttirlabhyate| tacca vyartham, dhātvarthamātrasyānuvṛttiṃ vinā'pi lābhāt| tato'tiriktasya cānanvayāt| evañca `kaṇḍūṃ karoti' iti vigrahapradarśanamapyayuktam| nāmadhātu tvāditi ca sutarāmaśuddham, dhātvadhikārāddhātubhya eva yagiti siddhāntāt| atha prātipadikādeva yakamabhyupaiṣi, tarhi laḍādau `kaṇḍavati' ityādi syāt| atha prātipadikānyeva kaṇḍvādīnītyabhipraiṣi, tarhi `sukhyati' ityādi na sidhyet "dvividhāḥ kaṇḍvādayaḥ" iti svoktivirodhaśca| ākaravirodhastu spaṣṭa evetyāstāṃ tāvat|
mānyāstu anekadoṣaduṣṭamapīmaṃ prakriyāpraghaṭṭakaṃ kathañcit samarathayante| tadyathā-prātipadikā kaṇḍvādayaḥ, tebhyaśca vaikalpiko yak iti pakṣeṇāyaṃ granthaḥ| ata evoktaṃ `kṛñarthe' iti| vigṛhītañca `kaṇḍūṃ karoti' iti ca| nahi dhātubhyo yaki prātipadikebhyo vā nitye yaki ayaṃ vigrahaḥ sambhavati| evañca nāmadhātutvādityādyapi samyageva| kathanta rhi dvaividhyamuktamiti cet? yagantāḥ santo dhātavaḥ| kevalāstu prātipadikānītyāśayāt| yadvā, yagantadhātvavayaveṣu teṣu dhātuśabdo gauṇaḥ| pratyayasadasadbhāvābhyām avasthābhedād dvaividhyam| na caivaṃ `sukhyati' ityādau "ato lopaḥ"(pāosūo6-4-64)na syāditi vācyam, yakaḥ kittvena āvaśyakatvāllāghavāccārddhadhātukatvasyaiva jñāpanāt| ata eva `dvividhā' ityevoktaṃ na tu dhātubhya eva yagiti| tadidaṃ bhāṣyādiviruddhamapi lakṣye visaṃvādābhāvādastu kathañcit|
athodāharaṇāni-1-kaṇḍūñ gātravigharṣaṇe| avayave kṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ samudāyaṃ viśinaṣṭi| evamagre'pi| kaṇḍūyati, kaṇḍūyate| 2-mantu aparādhe roṣa ityeke| mantūyati| candrastu ñitaṃ paṭhitvā mantūyate ityapyāha| 3-valgu pūjāpādhuryayoḥ| valgūyati| tadvalgunā yugapadunmiṣitena| 4-asu upatāpe| asūyati| asūyuḥ| "mṛgayvādayaśca"(uosūo39)ityupratyaya iti mādhavaḥ| etena-
santaḥ praṇayivākyāni gṛh‌ṇanti hyanasūyavaḥ|
iti bhaṭṭiprayogo vyākhyātaḥ| kecittu `as' 5-`asūñ' iti paṭhitvā ādyasya sāntasya `asyati' dvitīyasya dīrghāntasya `asūyati' `asūyate' ityāhuḥ| 6-leṭ 7-loṭ dhaurttye, pūrvabhāve, svapne ca| leṭyati, loṭyati| laṭitā, loṭitā| allopayalopau| kecit leṭloṭau dīptyarthāvāhugti mādhavaḥ pūrvabhāvaḥ pūrvatvam|
atra kecit pūrvaśabdaṃ prakṛtinirddeśārthamāśritya `pūrvyati' ityudāharanti| tathā cāntaḥkaraṇavṛttivarge bhaṭṭamallenoktam-
śete drāyati nidrāti sasti svapiti pūrvyati|
nidrāyate saṃviśati nidrāyāṃ saṃsti mandate|| iti|
asyārtho dhātucandrodaye uktaḥ| śetaprabhṛtīni daśākhyātāni nidrāyām| pasa svapne(aopao68)adādiḥ| `ṣasi śayane' ityeke peṭhuriti tatraiva kṣīrasvāmī| pūrvyatīti kaṇḍvādiyaganta ityādi| tathā devenāpyuktam-
pūrvyatīti tu yatsvapne tat kaṇḍavādiṣu darśanāt iti|
etacca amoghāyāṃ sākaṭāyanadhātuvṛttau arthanirddeśarahite gaṇapāṭhe pūrvasva pāṭhābhāvādayuktamiti puruṣakāraireva dūṣitam| yuktañcaitat, javādityenāpi `leṭ' `loṭ' ityeva pāṭhāt, haradattena ca ghaurtye pūrvabhāve svap‌ne ceti tadvivaraṇāt| etena buddhivarge-
manasāgocarīkāre namasvitve manasyati|
iti bhaṭṭamalloktirapi pratyuktā, nyāyasāmyāt| jayādityena hi `asu' ityeva nirddiṣṭam| haradattena tu atha kaṇḍvādīnāmarthanirddeśa ityupakramya kaṇḍvādīn vivṛṇvatā `asu' iti pratīkamupādāya `mānasa upatāpe' iti vivṛtam| ata eva `asu manasa utāpa' iti paṭhatāmapi `manasa' iti ṣaṣṭhyantamupatāpaviśeṣaṇam, na tu prakṛtinirddeśaḥ vṛttipadamañjaryādivirodhāt| dhātucandrodayakārasya tu `manasyati iti kaṇḍvādiyagantam' iti bhūyasā granthasandarbheṇa vyācakṣāṇasyāpi tatrāparitoṣo'styeva| ata eca `manasyate' iti pāṭhamāśritya manaḥśabdādvṛttiviṣaye tadviti varttamānāt kyaṅañcoktvā `idaṃ śobhatetarām' ityupasañjahāra|
8-lelā dīptau| "dhyāyatīva lelāyatīva" iti śrutiḥ| 9-iras 10-iraj11-irañ īrṣyāyām| irasyati| irajyati| īryati, īryate| "hali ca"(pāosūo8-2-77)iti dīrghaḥ| eṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ yathāyathamanye'pyarthāḥ santi| tathāhi-"irajyannagne prathayasva jantubhiḥ" iti mantre dīptyartho'yamiti bhaṭṭabhāskarādayaḥ| "irajyantāvasavyasya bhūreḥ" iti mantre aiśvaryārtha iti| īryatirmārgāvasthāne'pi uktañcāmareṇa-"caryā tvīryā pathisthitiḥ"(aokoo2-7-38)iti| 12-`iyas eśvarye' iti gaṇaratnamahodadhau| iyasyati| 13-uṣas prabhātībhāve| uṣasyati rātriḥ| 14-vedadhaurtye svapne ca| vedyati| 15-medhā āśugrahaṇe| medhāyati| (pāosūo3-1-28)
pagupūdhūpavicchipaṇipanibhya āyaḥ(pāosūo3-1-28)|| ebhya āyapratyayaḥ syāt svārthe| gupū rakṣaṇe(bhvāopao395)| gopāyati| dhūpasantāpe(bhvāopao396)| dhūpāyati| viccha gatau|(tuopao143)vicchāyati| vicchestudādipāṭhasāmarthyādāyapratyayāntādapi śo na tuśap| tena `vicchāyanatī' vicchāyatī iti| "ācchī"(pāosū-7-1-80)iti num‌vikalpaḥ| anye tu tudāpāṭhasāmarthyātsārvadhātuke'pyasya āyapratyayo vaikalpika ityāhuḥ|
paṇa vyaṇahāre stutau ca, pana ca(bhvāoāo440,441)| `paṇapana' iti paṭhanīye `pana ca' iti pṛthak‌pāṭhasāmarthyāt stutāvevāyam, tatsāhacaryātpaṇerapi stutāvevāyapratyayaḥ| anubandhasya kevale caritārthatvādāyapratyayāntānnātmanepadam| paṇāyati| panāyati| stautītyarthaḥ| vyavahāre tu-`śatasya paṇate' iti jayādityādayaḥ| anye tu vyavahārārthādapyāyamicchanti| tathā ca bhaṭṭiḥ-"na copalebhe vaṇijāṃ paṇāyām" iti| asminnapi pakṣe `paṇiṣyate' `paṇāyiṣyati' ityādau anubandhaḥ kevale caritārtha eva| ata eva panerapi āyapratyaye parasmaipadameva|
(pāosūo3-1-29)
ṛterīyaṅ(pāosūo3-1-29)|| ṛtiḥ sautraḥ tasmādīyaṅ syāt| ṛtīyate| īyaṅo ṅittvasya guṇaniṣedhena caritārthatve'pi dātorṅidantatvādyaṅantādivātmanepadam| yathā caitattathā "anudāttaṅitaḥ"(pāosūo1-3-12)iti sūtra evāvocām|
ṛteśchaṅiti siddhe īyaṅvacanaṃ dhātupratyayānāmāyannādayo neti jñāpanārtham| tena śameḥ khaḥ `śaṅkhaḥ' ityādi sidhyatīti vṛttikārādayaḥ| haradattastu "dvicavanavibhajyopapade tarap‌chasunau" iti vaktavye īyasun‌vacanamadhātupratyayeṣvapi āyannādyabhāvaṃ jñāpayediti pratibandinamāha| tatra īyasunvacanaṃ prakriyālāghavārthameva na tu jñāpanārtham, āyannādīnāṃ nirviṣayatāpatteḥ| na ca vinigamanāvirahaḥ, "ṇyakṣatriya"(pāosūo2-4-58)ityādisautranirdeśānāmeva vinigamakatvāditi samādhānaṃ bodhyam| ṛtiḥ sautro ghṛṇāyāṃ varttate iti vṛttiḥ| yadyapi ghṛṇāśabdo nānārthaḥ "ghṛṇā jugupsākṛpayoḥ" itivacanāt, tathāpīha jugupsārtha eva, ṛtīyāśabdasya bībhatsāparyāyatayā nighaṇṭuṣu pāṭhāditi haradattādayaḥ| bhaṭṭamallastu ākhyātacandrikrāyāṃ tṛtīyakāṇḍe nānārthavarge "ṛtīyate dhig‌ghṛṇayoḥ" iti paṭhan nānārthatāmiyeṣa|
iti vadannamaro'pyatrānukūlaḥ| yadi hi jugupsāmātrārthatvamicchettarhi "haṇīyā ca jugupsane" ityeva spaṣṭaṃ paṭet| nānārthe ghṛṇāśabdaṃ prayuñjānastu ṛterapi tathātvamabhipraitīti padacandrikāvyākhyāne dhātucandrodaye kṛṣṇaprabodhaḥ| ārdhadhātukavivakṣāyāntu īyaḍabhāvapakṣe śeṣatvātparasmaipadameva| ānarta| artitāsi| artiṣyati| ārtīt| ārtiṣyat| atrātmanepadaṃ samudāharan prasādakārastu bhrānta eva|
(pāosūo3-1-30)
kamerṇiṅa(pāosūo3-1-30)|| svārthe| kāmayate| nanviha "ata upadhāyāḥ"(pāosūo7-2-116)iti vṛddheḥ "ṅkiti ca"(pāosūo1-1-5)iti niṣedhaḥ prāpnoti| na ca ṇittvasāmarthyādvṛddhiḥ, "ṇeraniṭi"(pāosūo6-4-71)iti viśeṣaṇena caritārthatvāt| na ca ṅakāro'ṇyātmanepadena caritārtha iti vācyam, tāvatā pratiṣedhasya balīyastvānapāyāt| na ca kamermitsaṃjñāpratiṣedhārthaṃ "na kamyamicamām"(gaosūo)itivacanaṃ vṛddhyabhāve vyarthaṃ sat vṛddhimiha jñāpayatīti vācyam, ṇiḍantācciṇṇamuloḥ kṛtayoḥ "ciṇṇamulordīrgho'nyatarasyām"(pāosūo6-4-93)iti vaikalpike dīrghe prāpte tannivṛttyā mittvapratiṣedhasya sārthakyāt| na ca tatra dīrghagrahaṇaṃ parityajya prakṛto hrasva eva vikalpyatām, tathāca kamermitsaṃjñāpratiṣedho'pi māstviti vācyam, ṇijantādyaṅatādvā ṇici sati tataściṇṇamuloḥ-aśami, aśāmi; śamaṃ śamam, śāmama śāmam; aśaṃśami, aśaṃśāmi; śaṃśamaṃ śaṃśamam, śaṃśāmaṃ śaṃśāmam iti rūpadvayasya dīrghagrahaṇaṃ vinā anirvāhāt| dīrghavidhisprati hi ṇiyaṅorlopasya na sthānivattvaṃ, "na padānta"(pāosūo1-1-58)iti niṣedhāt| hrasvavidhimprati tu sthānivattve sati| ciṇṇamulparasya ṇicaḥ ṇiyaṅbhyāṃ vyavadhāne hrasvavikalpo na pravartteta| yathāśrutasūtrarītyā cedam| pūrvatrāsiddhīyenetyuktvā savarṇānusvārādigrahaṇaṃ na kartavyamiti pakṣe tu ṇijantāṇṇici ṇyākṛteraikyāt siddham| `śaṃśāmaṃ śaṃśāmam' iti tu yaṅlugantāṇṇamuliti "na padānta'(pāosūo1-1-58)sūtra evāvocām| asminniṣkṛṣṭapakṣe'pi "ciṇṇamuloḥ"(pāosūda6-4-93)iti sūtre dīrghagrahaṇaṃ kartavyameva| tathāhi, `heḍṛ anādare' ghaṭādiḥ|-1--1."mitā hrasvaḥ" ityanena|-eca ik, hiḍayati| atra ciṇṇamuloḥ kṛtayoḥ hrasve vikalpyamāne `ahiḍi, aheḍi' iti syāt| dīrghe tu `ahiḍi, ahīḍi'iti bhavati| evañca kamerapi ciṇṇamuloḥ dīrghavikalpe prāpte tadvyāvṛttyā kṛtārtho mittvaniṣedho vṛddhiṃ jñāpayituṃ nālam| kiñca-"āyādaya ārddhadhātuke vā'(pāosūo3-1-31)iti ṇiṅabhāve ṇici kṛte vṛddhau satyāṃ "mitāṃ hrasvaḥ"(pāosūo6-4-92)iti hrasve vārayituṃ mitsaṃjñāpratiṣedhaḥ sarvathā'pi nāyaṃ vṛddherjñāpakaḥ| tasmāt "ṅkiti ca"(pāosūo1-1-5)iti niṣedhaṃ vārayituṃ kaścidupāyo vaktavya iti cet? satyam, ukta evāsau taddhitakāmyorikprakaraṇāditi|
(pāosūo3-1-31)
āyādaya ārdhadātuke vā(pāosūo3-1-31)|| ārddhadhātukavivakṣāyāmāyādayo vā syuḥ| jugopa, gopāyāñcakāra| ānarta, ṛtīyāñcakre| kāmayāñcakre, cakame| iha `ārddhadhātuka' iti yadi parasaptamī syāt tadā pravṛttā āyādaya ārddhadhātuke pare pakṣe nivartanta ityarthaḥ syāt| tatra bahavo doṣāḥ| tathāhi-āyapratyayāntān strībhāvavivakṣāyām "a pratyayāt"(pāosūo3-3-102)ityakārapratyaye kṛte āyanivṛttipakṣe `gopā'ityaniṣṭe syāt `guptiḥ'iti ceṣṭaṃ na sidhyet| tathā ṛtīyaśabdālliṭi pratyayāntatvenāmi īyapratyayasya nivṛttau `ṛtāñcakāra' iti syāt, `ānarta' iti ca na syāt| tathā artitāsi, artiṣyati, ṛtyāt, ārtīt ityādau parasmaipadaṃ na syāt| tathā tāsyāderārddhedhātukasya īyaṅ‌nivṛttiṃ prati nimittatvena "na dhātulopa"(pāosūo1-1-4)iti niṣedhāt tannimitto guṇo na syāt|
athocyeta-`nānena nivṛttirvikalpyate kintu pravṛttireva' iti| tatrāpi āyādividhibhiḥ sahāsyaikavākyatā bhinnavākyatā vā? ādye gupādibhya ārddhadhātuke pare āyo vetyarthaḥ syāt| evamuttaratrāpi| tataśca ārddhadātuka eva vikalpenāyādayaḥ, sārvadhātuke tu naiva syuḥ|
athocyeta-gupādisūtra eva ārdhadhātuke veti vaktavye āyādaya iti na kartavyamiti lāghave spaṣṭe sati gauravaṃ soḍhavā "āyādaya ārdhadhātukevā" iti pṛthaksūtrakaraṇasāmarthyād vyāpārabhedenaikavākyatā| tataścāyamarthaḥ-gupādibhya āyādayo nityaṃ bhavantītyutsargaḥ, ārddhadhātuke pare tu vā bhavantīti| evañca vikaraṇavat pratyaye pare āyādayaḥ pravartern| tataśca gupeḥ ktini āyapakṣe allopayalopayoḥ `gopātiḥ' ityaniṣṭaṃ syāt `gopāyā' iti ceṣṭaṃ na sidhyet| tasmād duṣṭa evātra parasaptamīpakṣaḥ|
(pāosūo3-1-32)
sanādyantā dhātavaḥ(pāosūo3-1-32)|| sanādayo ṇiṅantāḥ pratyayā antāścaramāvayavā yoṣānte saṃghātā dhātusaṃjñāḥ syuḥ| jugupsate| kāmayate| "siptiṅantam"(pāosūo1-4-14)ityatra antagrahaṇena "saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣā na pravarttate"(paobhāo27)iti tatpratiprasavārthamihāntagrahaṇaṃ na tvayamapūrvavidhiḥ, gauravāt `devadattaścikīrṣati' ityādau devadattādeḥ samudāyasya saṃjñāprasaṅgācca| pratiprasave tu lāghavamuktadoṣābhāvaśceti spaṣṭameva| "bhūvādayaḥ"(pāosūo1-3-1)ityasyātantarameva "sanādyantāśca" iti na sūtritaṃ, sanādīnāmiyattānavagamāt| ṇiṅo ṅakārema pratyāhāramāśritya "saṅantāśca" iti kuto na sūtritamiti cet? caṅādiṣvapi ṅakārasattvena sandehāpatteḥ| ihaiva "sanādyantāḥ" ityasyānantaraṃ "bhūvādayaśca" iti sūtrayitumucitaṃ, tathā na kṛtamityeva|
etatsūtraṃ bhāṣye pratyākhyātam| tathāhi-jahat‌svārthāyāṃ vṛttau cikīrṣa jihīrṣa ityādisaṅghātā evārthavantaḥ tadavayavā anarthakāḥ, "sarve sarvapadādeśāḥ" ityatra ca arthavatyeva sthānyādeśabhāvaviśrānteḥ| "eruḥ"(pāosūo3-4-86)ityādau testuriti paryavasyatītyuktam| evañcehāpi karaṇaviśiṣṭeṣyarthasyeṣeḥ prasaṅge cikīrṣaśabdaḥ, tathā haraṇaviśiṣṭeṣyarthavṛtteḥ prasaṅge jihīrṣaśabdaḥ, gupeḥ prasaṅge gopāyaśabdaḥ, putraviśiṣṭecchāvṛtteriṣeḥ prasaṅge puvīyaśabda ityādiparyavasāne sthānivadbhāvenasiddha ghātutvam, jag‌dhyādivat `pacatu' ityatra tostiṅtvavacca|
syādetat, sthānivat‌sūtre ādeśaśabdena cikīrṣadayo grahītuṃ na śakyante, ādeśaśabdasya ṣaṣṭhīnirddiṣṭasthāninivarttakeṣveva rūḍhatvāditi cet? na, sthānivadityuktayaiva ādeśasya lābhe punastadgrahaṇasāmarthyena anumīyamānasya testurityāderiva `ādiśyate' iti yaugikārthapuraskāreṇa cikīrṣāderapi sugrahatvāt| na ca putrīyādirādeśaḥ subantasyaiva na tviṣeriti vācyam, "aṇurapi viśeṣaḥ"(pāosūo1-3-90)ityādiliṅgairapi dhātutvasyāvaśyakatve sthite tannirvāhāya icchāyāmācārebhuvītyādikriyāsamarpakāṇāmeva sthānitvanirṇayācceti dik|
(pāosūo3-1-33)
syatāsī lṛluṭoḥ(pāosūo3-1-33)|| lṛ iti lṛṅlṛṭoḥ sāmānyagrahaṇam| dhātoḥ lṛ ityasmin luṭi ca pare yathāsaṅkhyaṃ syatāsī pratyayau staḥ| akariṣyat, kariṣyati| śvaḥ karttā| tāserikāra itsaṃjñaka iti jayādityaḥ| tathāhi, `mantāhantā' ityatra `man tās ā' `han tās ā' iti sthite ṭilope kṛte ḍāpratyayamprati tāntamaṅgaṃ tasya upadhānakāraḥ, tasya "aniditām"(pāosūo6-4-24)iti lopaḥ prāptaḥ, taṃ vārayituṃ tāseridittvameṣitavyam| na cābhīyatvena ṭilopasyāsiddhatvāt nakāra upadhā neti vācyam, "ābhāt"(pāosūo6-4-22)sūtrasya bhāṣye pratyākhyānāt| sūtramate'pi ābhīyasya asiddhatvasya anityatvācca| tatra ca "śnasorallopaḥ"(pāosūo6-4-111)iti taparakaraṇaṃ liṅgam| taddhi `āstām' `āsan' ityādau mā bhūdityevamartham| tatrāṭo'siddhatvādeva lopāprasaktau taparatvaṃ vyarthaṃ sad‌ asiddhatvasyānityatāṃ jñāpayati| tena `debhatuḥ `debhuḥ' ityatra śranthigranthidambhisvañjīnāṃ liṭaḥ kittvānnalope tasyāsiddhatvābhāvād etvābhyāsalopau staḥ| evañcehāpi ṭilopasyāsiddhatāvirahe prāpto nalopa idittvana vāryate| na caivaṃ num‌vidhau dhātugrahaṇasya tāsivyāvṛttyā kṛtārthatvena dhātūpadeśāvasthāyāmeva num bhavatītyayamartho na sādhitaḥ syāditi vācyam, "num‌vidhāvupadeśivadvacanaṃ pratyayasidhyartham" iti vacanasyaiva śaraṇīkaraṇāt, "dhinvikṛṇvyoḥ"(pāosūo3-1-80)iti sanum‌kanirddeśāj jñāpakādvā| vāmanastu `tāserikāra uccāraṇārtha' ityāśayena "idito num dhātoḥ"| (pāosūo7-1-58)iti dhātugrahaṇaṃ dhātṛpadeśāvasthāyāmeva num yathā syādityevamarthaṃ manyate| tanmate `mantā' `hantā' ityatra ṭilopasyāsiddhatvānnalopo neti bodhyam|
idamidānīṃ vicāryate-lakāraṃ nimittatvenāśritya vidhīyamānāḥ syādayo vikaraṇāḥ kiṃ lāvasthāyāmeva, syuḥ, uta lādeśeṣu kṛteṣviti| ādye pakṣe lāvasthāyāṃ tāsau kṛte tasya pratyayādyudāttatve kṛte lādeśāḥ syuḥ, tataśca teṣāṃ svaraḥ satiśiṣṭaḥ| tataśca tāseḥ parasya lasārvadhātukasyānudāttavacanamaprāptavidhireva syāt| evañca `satiśiṣṭho'pi vikaraṇasvaro lasārvadhātukasvaraṃ na bādhate' ityasyārthasya jñāpakametaditi ṣāṣṭhaḥ siddhānto bhajyeta| tataśca-"yā dampatī samanasā sunute" ityatra satiśiṣṭasya vikaraṇasvarasya balīyastvāpattau madhyodāttaṃ tiṅantaṃ syāt| iṣyate tvantodāttam| evaṃ "prīṇītāśvān" "hinvanti sūram" ityādiṣvapi spaṣṭo doṣaḥ|
dvitīye tu pakṣe tāsisvaraḥ satiśiṣṭa iti śeṣanighātenaiva lasārvadhātukānudātttve siddhe tāsigrahaṇaṃ jñāpakamiti sidhyati| kintu gamiṣyati' `paṭhiṣyati' ityādi na siddhyati| tathā hi, " sārvadhātuke yak"(pāosūo3-1-67)utsargaḥ, tasyāpavādāḥ śabādayaḥ syādayaśca| tatra śabādīnāmavakāśaḥ-`gacchati' `paṭhati'| syādīnāntu `gaṃsyate' `paṭhiṣyate' iti| `gamiṣyati' `paṭhiṣyati' ityatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvācchap prāpnoti|
athocyeta-yakaḥ śabādīnāñca notsargāpavādabhāvaḥ, viviktaviṣayatvāt| yagvidhau hi bhāvakarmagrahaṇamanuvarttate| taccāvaśyamanuvartyam, `pacati' `paṭhati' ityādau śapi pare yaṅ mā bhūditi| evamapi `gamiṣyati' `paṭhiṣyati' ityādi sidyatu nāma, yak‌śaporutsargayoḥ syādibhirapavādaurbādhasambhavāt| kintu `deviṣyati' `seviṣyati' ityādi na sidhyedeva| tathāhi, vikaraṇānāṃ yak‌śapāvutsargau, tadapavādāḥ śyanādayaḥ syādayaśca| śyanādīnāmavakāśaḥ-`dīvyati' `sīvyati'| syādīnāntu `pakṣyate'| `deviṣyati' `seviṣyati' ityatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvāt śyanādayaḥ syuriti|
atra bahudhā samāhitaṃ bhāṣye| tathāhi, śabādeśāḥ śyanādayaḥ kariṣyante, "divādibhyaḥ"(pāosūo3-1-69)iti paṃñcamyā anuvṛttāyāḥ karttari śabiti prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīprakalpanāt| evañca divādibhyaḥ syādiviṣaye śabeva nāsti, syādibhirapavādairbādhāt| tadādeśāḥ syānnādayastu dūrāpāstā eva| athavā "divādibhyaḥ śyan"(pāosūo3-1-69)ityādiṣu syādayo'nuvartiṣyante| divādibhyaḥ śyan bhavati lṛluṭostu syatāsī bhavataḥ| divādibhya ityeva| evamagre'pi etena lāvasthāyāmeva prāpnuvantaḥ syādayaḥ sārvadhātukotparttti kimarthaṃ pratīkṣantām; tataśca kathaṃ tāserlasārvadhātukānudāttavacanasya uktārthajñāpakatvaṃ saṅgacchatāmiti dūṣaṇaṃ pratyuktam, 'sārvadhātuke yak"(pāosūo3-1-67)ityādau anuvṛttibalādeva sārcadhātukotpatteḥ pratīkṣaṇīyatvāt| athavā śyanādayaḥ śabādeśā mā bhūvan mā cānuvartantāmutaratra syādayaḥ| kintu `deviṣyati' ityādau syādīn bādhitvā paratvāttāvallādeśāḥ| na cānityāste, ātṛtīyādhyāyasamāpterdhātvadhikārāt syādibhirvyavadhāne dhātoḥ parasya lasyābhāvena ādeśāprāpteriti vācyam, dhātorvihitasya lasyeti vihitaviśeṣaṇāśrayaṇena lādeśānāṃ nityatvāt| evañca kṛteṣu lādeśeṣu ubhaye prasaktāḥ, syādayaḥ śyanādayaśca| tatrāntaraṅgatvātsyādaya eva bhaviṣyanti na tu syannādayaḥ, sārvadhātukatvaṃ karttarītyarthaviśeṣañca apekṣamāṇānteṣāṃ bahiraṅgatvāt|
(pāosūo3-1-34)
sibbahulaṃ leṭi(pāosūo3-1-34)|| dhātoḥ sippratyayo bahulaṃ syāt leṭi pare| joṣiṣat| juṣī prītisevanathoḥ (tuvaoāo8)| anudāttet| vyatyayena parasmaipadam| sip iṭ| "leṭo'ḍāṭau"(paosūo3-4-94)iti tipo'ṭ| 'itaśca lopaḥ"(pāosūo3-4-97)itīkāralopaḥ| bahulagrahaṇānneha-patāti didyut|
sibbahulañchandasi ṇidvaktavyaḥ(kāovāo)|| "praṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat" "ayāmivāṃ savitā sāviṣat" ṇittvāddvaddhiḥ| "devasya heḍo'vayāsisīṣṭhāḥ" iha yāteravapūrvālliṅga| bahulavacanāt sip thās sīyuṭ suṭ iṭ| "ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt"(pāosūo7-2-10)iti niṣedhastu na bhavati, sipā vyavadhānāt| sīyuṭaḥ sasya ṣatvābhāvaśchāndasaḥ| "tiṅṅatiṅaḥ"(pāosūo8-1-28)iti nighātaḥ| yacchabdayoge tu `yāsisīṣṭhāḥ' iti padamādyudāttameveṣyate| yadyapi pratyayasvareṇa thāsa udāttatvādantodāttaṃ padamprāptaṃ, tathāpi sūtrabhaṅgena sipantyaktvā sabayaṃ kartavya iti bhāṣyokteḥ sapi kṛte adupadeśāt paratvena "chandasyubhayathā"(pāosūo3-4-117)iti sārvadhātukatvena ca lasārvadhātukānudāttatvādiṣṭasiddhiḥ| sapaḥ pittvābhāve udāttanivṛttisvareṇa iṭa udāttatvaṃ syāt| tasmādiha sapaḥ pittvādantatve svarārthe iti sthitam| yathāśrutasūtrarītyā tu pitvaṃ vyarthameva| tathāca vārtikaṃ-"kitkaraṇānarthakyaṃ cānackatvāt| iṭo'nudāttārthamiti cet? āgamānudāttatvātsiddham" iti|

"kāspratyayādāmamantre liṭi"(pāosūo3-1-35)kās‌dhātoḥ pratyayāntemyaśca ām syālliṭi na tu mantre| kāsṛ śabdakutsāyām(bhvāoāo624)| kāsāñcake| lolūpāñcakre| amantre kim? kṛṣṇo nonāva| acchandasīti tu noktam, brāhmaṇe iṣṭatvāt| "putramāmantrayāmāsa"| "atha ha śunaḥ śeṣa īkṣāñcake"(aiobrā7-3)ityādi|

yadvā-uścāsau uśceti praśliṣṭanirdeśena udantasyaiva gurūmataḥ paryudāsaḥ| sa ca "ijādeḥ"ti sūtrasyaiva śeṣaḥ| tena valguphalguprabhṛtibhyaḥ kvibantebhyo'nekāc‌tvaprayukta ām bhavatyeveti sarvaṃ sustham| atra kāśikā-

atra ca pramāṇam-"āmpratyayavatkṛño'nuprayogasya'(pāosūo1-3-63)iti sūtre kṛñgrahaṇam| anuprayogasāmarthyādasterbhūbhāvo na| anyathā hi "kṛbhvanuprayujyate" ityeva brūyāt| yācayāṃcakāra| yācayāmbabhūva| yācayāmāsa| ihānuprayuktasyāsterbhāvakarmaṇostaṅa| tatra eśi iṭi ca rūpe vipratipadyante| tathāhi-ubhayatrāpi "ha eti"(pāosūo7-4-52)iti hādeśe kṛte `īkṣāmāhe' iti kecit| tāsisāhacaryādiṭyeva hatvamityanye| tatsāhacaryādeva sārvadhātuka eva eti hatvam| tenobhayatrāpi `īkṣāmāse' iti rūpamityapare|

atrocyate-kriyāmātravivakṣāyāṃ kārakatatsaṅkhyayoścāvivakṣāyāṃ pākapreraṇā jātetyādiprayogāstāvatsarvasammatāḥ| tatra tathaiva `pācayām' ityetāvanmātraprayoge prasakte taṃ vārayitumidam| kiñcastibhavatyoriva vidyaterapi prayoge nyāyataḥ prasakte tamapi vārayitumetat| kiñca nivṛttapreṣaṇāddhātoḥ prākṛte'rthe ṇici sāmānyavācakānuprayogārthaṃ sūtrametam| apica paścādeva prayogo yathā syāt na tu pūrvamiti| tena`cakre' `īkṣām' ityādi na bhavati| apica avyavahita eva paścādbhāvo mukhyaḥ| tathā ca vyavahitanivṛttyarthamapīdam| tena `īkṣāṃ rājā cakre' ityādi na bhavati| kathantarhi bavhṛcabrāhmaṇe-"tān ha rājā madayāmeva cakāra"(aiobrāo6)iti? chāndasatvādityavehi| kathantarhi bhaṭṭikāvye-"ukṣāmpracakrurnagarasya mārgān" "bibhayāmpracakārāsau" iti, kathañca raghukāvye-"taṃ pātayāṃ prathamamāsa papāta paścāt" "prabhraṃśayāṃ yo nahuṣañcakāra"iti? pramāda evāyam, "viparyāsanivṛttyarthaṃ, vyavahitanivṛttyarthañca" iti vārtikavirodhādityāhuḥ|
ihām‌prakṛteḥ kṛbhvastīnāñca sāmānyaviśeṣavacanatayā tadarthayorabhedānvayo bodhyaḥ| ata eva pratyāhāre'ntarbhūtasyāpi sampado'nuprayogo na bhavati, ananvitārthakatvāt| yattu "sanādyantā"(pāosūo3-1-32)ityato dhātvadhikārāt dhātūpasargasamudāyasya nānuprayoga iti| tanna, evamapi yo'tra dhātuḥ padiḥ tanmātrasya uktarītyaiva vāraṇīyatvāt| evañca sāmānyasya sannihite viśeṣe paryavasānāt tadgatasāghanādiviśeṣābhidhānam āmantagataviśeṣābhidhānameveti sampadyate| ata eva anuprayujyamānayorbhvastyorāmantavaśena sakarmakatvāt tābhyāṃ karmaṇi liṭ| tathāca māghaḥ-"tasyātapatraṃ bibharāṃbabhūve" iti| śrīharṣaśca-

cli luṅi(pāosūo3-1-43)|| dhātośclipratvayaḥ syāt luṅi pare| ikāro leriti sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ| cakāraḥ svarārtha ityuttarasūtre sphuṭībhaviṣyati| asyādeśāḥ sijādayo vakṣyante| nanvevaṃ kiṃ clipratyayena? sijevotsargaḥ pratyayo'stu, tadapavādāśca ksādayaḥ santu| na ca-"mantre ghasa"(pāosūo2-4-81)iti sūtre sarvadhātuṣu lerityekenaiva nirvāhe lāghavārthaṃ cliḥ karttavyaḥ| anyathā hi ghas‌naś‌gamarthamaṅo grahaṇam| ākārānteṣu dheṭo'ntarbhāvāttadarthaṃ caṅo grahaṇam| tasya hi "vibhāṣā dheṭśvyoḥ"(pāosūo3-1-49)iti caṅasti| dhātvantarārthaṃ sico prahaṇam| yadi tu janeḥ "dīpajana"(pāosūo3-1-61)iti vihitasya ciṇo luk chandasi dṛśyate tatastasyāpīti trīṇi catvāri vā grahaṇāni kartavyāni syuriti vācyam, clipakṣe'pi "cli luṅi" "cleḥ sic"(pāosūo3-1-43,44)"mantre ghasa"(pāosūo2-4-81)iti sūtreṣu militvā cliclerleriti trayāṇāṃ grahaṇasya tulyatvāt| na coktarītyā sāmye'pi clipakṣe lāghavāntaramasti, "gātisthā'(pāosūo2-4-77)iti sūtre `sica' ityapanīyatatsthāne `leḥ' ityabhiṣicya mantreghasādisūtre tasyevānuvartanāditi vācyam, evaṃ hi vadan akṛteṣveva sijādyādeśeṣu tadapavādo lereva lugityabhipraiṣi, kiṃ vā ādeśeṣu kṛteṣu sthānivadbhāvo neti?
nādyaḥ, `aguḥ' `asthuḥ' itvādau sicaḥ paratvābhāvena "sijabhyasta"(pāosūo3-4-109)iti juso'pravṛttiprasaṅgāt| na ca "ātaḥ"(pāosūo3-4-110)iti jus, tatrāpi `sica' ityasyānuvṛtteḥ|
athocyet, "ātaḥ" iti sūtre sij‌grahaṇaṃ nānuvarttate, tathāca `aguḥ' ityādau vidhyarthaṃ tat na tu niyamārtham, vyāvartyābhāvāt| na ca `abhūvan' iti vyāvartyam, tatra jusaḥ prāpterevābhāvāt| na ca "sijabhyasta"(pāosūo3-4-109)iti prāptiḥ, lāvasthāyāmeva lugiti pakṣasya idānīṃ parigṛhītatvāt| na caivam `avān' ityatrāpi "ātaḥ"(pāosūo3-4-110)iti nityo jus syāditi vācyam, "laṅaḥ śākaṭāyanasyaiva"(pāosūo3-4-111)iti niyamādvikalpopapatteriti| evamapi `mā hi gātāṃ' `mā hi syātām' ityādiṣu "ādiḥ sivo'nyatarasyām"(pāosūo6-1-178)ityeṣa svaro na siddhyet| tasmāllāvasthāyāṃ lopa iti prathamaḥ pakṣo duṣṭa eveti sthitam|
na dvitīyaḥ, evaṃ hi sati "vibhāṣā ghrādheṭ"(pāosūo2-4-78)iti sūtreṇāpi clyādeśānāmeva luk, iti dheṭaśṭaṅo'pi sa syāt| tatra yadā "vibhāṣā dheṭ‌śvayoḥ"(pāosūo3-1-49)iti caṅo vrikalpitatvena pakṣe sici kṛte tasya lugalukau, tadā adhāt, adhātām, adhuḥ| adhāsīt, adhāsiṣṭām, adhāsiṣuḥ iti siddhamiṣṭam| caṅo'pi lugabhāvapakṣe adadhat, adadhatām, adadhan| iti siddham| luk‌pakṣe tu "na lumatā"(pāosūo1-1-63)ityaṅgādhikāranirddeśa iti mate pratyayalakṣaṇena dvirvacane `adadhāt' ityapi caturthaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| "na lumatā"(pāosūo1-1-63)iti nāṅgādhikāranirddeśaḥ, kiṃ tvāṅgamanāṅgaṃ vā lumatā lupte pratyaye pare pūrvasya prāptaṃ sarvaṃ niṣidhyata iti mukhyapakṣe tu caṅo luki dvitvāpravṛttau sij‌lukā tulyameva rūpamiti `adhāt' ityādau yadyapi na doṣaḥ, tathāpi bahuvacane `adhān' ityaniṣṭamapi caturtha rūpaṃ syādeva, iṣyate tu traiśabdyam `adhuḥ, adhāsiṣuḥ, adadhan iti| na ca caṅo luki "ātaḥ'(pāosūo3-4-110)iti jus bhaviṣyatīti vācyam, tatra `sicaḥ' ityasyānuvṛtteḥ| anyathā tasya niyamārthatā'nupapattau `abhūvan' ityatra pratyayalakṣaṇena "sijabhyasta"(pāosūo3-4-109)iti jus‌prasaṅgāt| nanu "clyabhyastavidibhyaśca" iti vakṣyāmi| evañca caṅ‌lukyapi cleḥ paratvājjus bhaviṣyati| "ātaḥ"(pāosūo3-4-110)iti sūtre'pi ligrahaṇānuvṛttyaiva niyamāt `abhūvan' ityatra jus na bhaviṣyati| `mā hi gātām' ityādau "ādiḥ sicaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-187)iti svaro'pi siddhaḥ| evañca kṛteṣvādeśeṣu lugiti pakṣo nirbādha eveti cet? na, yadi "clyabhyasta" iti brūṣre tarhi ksāṅ‌caṅ‌kṣu doṣāpatteḥ| adhukṣan, avocan, adadhan, atrāpi hi jus prāpnoti| tasmātsijabhyastetyeva vaktavyam| "ātaḥ"(pāosūo3-4-110)ityatra ca sij‌grahaṇamanuvarttanīyam| evañca caṅ‌luki bahuvacane `adhān' iti prāpnotīti doṣaḥ sthita eva| tasmāt "gātisthā'(pāosūo2-4-77)ityatra sica ityeva vaktavyam| tataścaclipakṣe'pi cliclerleriti trayāṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ tulyameveti sthitam| pratyuta clerakaraṇe mahallādhavam| "mantre ghasa"(pāosūo2-4-81)ityādisūtre hi aṅa eva grahaṇaṃ kartavyam| sic tu "gātisthā"(pāosūo2-4-77)iti sūtrādanuvartyaḥ| dheṭo janeśca caṅ‌ciṇau vaikalpikau, tatra yāni lugudāharaṇāni tāni sica eva lukā siddhāni| na caivam "ādiḥ sico'nyatarasyām"(pāosūo6-1-187)iti svaraḥ syāditi vācyam, caṅ‌ciṇorgrahaṇe'pi pākṣikasya tasya durvāratvāt| tasmāt "cli luṅi" itisūtraṃ vyarthameveti cet?
atrāhuḥ, asati clau "mantre ghasa"(pāosūo2-4-81)ityatra yebhyaḥ sico luk teṣām "ādiḥ sicaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-187)itisvaraḥ syāt| sati tvasmin `leḥ' iti lāvasthāyāmeva luki sijabhāvādyathāyathaṃ svaraḥ| kiñca ākārāntebhyaḥ sico luki jusa prāpnoti lestu luki antibhāva eva bhavati| api ca, "śala igupadhāt"(pāosūo3-4-45)iti sūtre aniṭaḥ ityanena cliṃ viśeṣayitumapi clireṣṭavyaḥ| asati hi clau `aniṭaḥ' iti dhātoreva viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt| tataśca `aghukṣat' iti na siddhyet| nanūdittvādiḍ‌ṣikalpe pākṣikeṇeḍabhāvena aniḍevāyamiti cet? tarhi nityaṃ ksaḥ syāt| tataśca `aguhīt' iti na siddhyet| `aniṭaḥ' iti clerviśeṣaṇe tu yadā cliraniṭ tadā ksaḥ, yadā seṭ tadā sijiti siddhamiṣṭam| tasmāt yatāyathaṃ svaro'ntiścāguhīditi cleḥ phalamiti sthitam|
bhāṣye tu cliḥ pratyākhyātaḥ| yattūktam, "ādiḥ sicaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-187)iti syāditi, tanna, tasya vaikalpikatayā iṣṭasvarasya nirvādhatvāt, sarvavikalpānāṃ chandasi vyavasthitatvena aniṣṭasyānāpādyatvāt| yadapi ākārāntebhyo jus syāditi| tadapi, na mantre tādṛśasyodāharaṇasyābhāvāt| atra ca bhāṣyakāriyapratyākhyānameva pramāṇam| yadapi `aguhīt' iti na siddhyediti| tadapi na, guhādayo vikalpiteṭa iṭo bhāvā'bhāvābhyāṃ bhidyante| tatra ye seṭaḥ tebhyaḥ sic, aniṅbhyastu ksa iti bhagavadbhāṣyakārāśayasya kaiyaṭena varṇitatvāt|
(pāosūo3-1-44)
cleḥ sic(pāosūo3-1-44)|| cleḥ sijādeśaḥ syāt| ikāra uccāraṇārtha itsaṃjñako veti pakṣadvayamapi "hanaḥ sic(pāosūo1-2-14)ityatra pratipāditam| cakāraḥ svarārthaḥ| mā hi lāvīt| atra hi "āgamā anudāttā" iti iṭo'nudāttatvaṃ prāptaṃ sthāninyādeśe ca dviścitkaraṇādvādhyate| yattu kāṃcat-pratyayasvarasya dvāvapavādī āgamānudāttatvaṃ citsvaraśca| tatra ādyaṃ yāsuḍ‌vidhau jñāpitaṃ taddeśam, citsvarastu ṣāṣṭhaḥ| tatrāpavādavipratiṣedhe paratvāccitsvara eva siddhyati tatkiṃ sicaścittveneti| tanna, āgamānudāttatvaṃ hi ānugādiṣu prakṛtyāgameṣvapīṣyate| kuṇḍinajādīnāñca citsvaraḥ, tatkathamimau pratyayasvarasyāpavādau syātām? kiñca iha citsvarasya paratvamapi nāsti, sthānivadityasya kāryātideśatvāt| tasmādāgamānudāttatvena aviśeṣātsarvaḥ svaro bādhyata iti tadbādhanāya sicaścittvam| na ca cleścittvasāmarthyādeva tadbādhaḥ, "mantre vasa"(pāosūo2-481)iti sūtre `leḥ' iti sāmānyagrahaṇena tasya caritārthatvāt| anyathā hi niranubandhakatvādasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, na liṭaḥ| tataśca "āmaḥ"(pāosūo2-4-81)iti sūtre niranubandhakasya lerasambhavāt leriti nānuvartteta| tataśca paratvādantaraṅgatvācca tibādiṣu paścālluki `kārayām' ityasya pratyayalakṣaṇena tiṅantatvāt `devadattaḥ kārayāñcakāra, ityatra āmantasya nighātaḥ tataḥ parasya cānighātaḥ syāt| tasmāt "āmaḥ" ityatra `leḥ' ityanuvartyameva| tadarthañca pūrvatra sāmānyagrahaṇaṃ vācyam, tadavighātāya cleścakāraścaritārthaḥ| cleḥ pratyākhyānapakṣe tu sica eva cittvenānanyārthena āgamānudāttatvaṃ bādhyate|
spṛśamṛśakṛṣatṛpadṛpaḥ sijveti vaktavyam(kāovāo)|| spṛśa sparśane(tuopao142), mṛśa āmarśane(tuopao145), kṛṣa vilekhane(bhvāopao1015)ebhyaḥ kse prāpte tṛpa prīṇane, dṛpa harṣavimocanayoḥ(diopao89,90)ābhyāṃ puṣāditvādaṅi prāpte sijapi pakṣe abhyanujñāyate| asprākṣīt, aspārkṣīt, aspṛkṣat| amrākṣīt, amārkṣīt, amṛkṣat| akrākṣīt, akārkṣīta, akṛkṣat| atrāpsīt, atārpsīt, atṛpat| adrāpsīt, adārpsīt, adṛpat| prakriyākaumudyāntu prakṛtavārttike sṛpiṇapi prakṣīpya `asrāpsīt, `asārpsīt,' ityapi rūpadvayamudāhṛtam| tattu aprāṇāṇikatvādupekṣyam|
(pāosūo3-1-45)
śala igupadhādaniṭaḥ ksaḥ(pāosūo3-1-45)|| śalanta igupadho yo dhātuḥ tasmātparasya aniṭaścleḥ ksaḥ syāt| duh‌-adhukṣat| lih‌alikṣat| śalaḥ kim? abhaitsīt| igupadhātkima? abhaitsīt| igupadhātkim? adhākṣīt| aniṭaḥ kim? akoṣīt| cleḥ pratyākhyānapakṣe tu `aniṭaḥ' iti dhātoreva viśeṣaṇamiti prāgevoktam| yadyapi akṛta eva kse lāvasthāyāṃ guṇaḥ prāpnoti, tathāpi igupadhāditi viśeṣaṇasāmarthyānna bhavati| na ca kṛte'piguṇe bhūtapūrvagatyā vihitaviśeṣaṇāśrayaṇena vā kso'stviti vācyam, kitkaraṇavaiyarthyāpatteḥ| na ca "ksasyāci"(pāosūo7-3-72)ityatra viśeṣaṇārthaṃ tat, "sasyāci" ityeva siddheḥ| na caivaṃ vṝtṝvadihanikamikaṣibhyaḥ se `vatse' `vatsā' prasaṅga syāditi vācyam, "lugvā duha'(pāosūo7-3-73)ityatrāpi hi `sasyāci' ityataḥ `sasya' ityanuvartate| evañca duhādiṣu yasya sambhavaḥ tasyaiva purvasūtre'pi grahaṇamiti suvacatvāt| tasmātkitkaraṇasāmarthyād guṇo neti sthitam|
(pāosūo3-1-46)
śliṣa āliṅgane(pāosūo3-1-46)|| atra yogo vibhajyate-
āliṅgane|| śliṣaḥ parasyāniṭaścleryo'yaṃ ksādeśaḥ sa āliṅgane eva, na tvarthāntare| evaṃ cārthāntare sāvakāśo'ṅ āliṅgane ksena bādhyate| aślikṣat kanyāṃ devadattaḥ| pratyāsattau hyatra śliṣirvartate na tūpagūhanapariṣvaṅgāparaparyāye āliṅgane| upāślikṣātāṃ jatunā kāṣṭhe| nanviha "śala igupadhāt"(pāosūo3-1-45)iti kso durvāraḥ| āliṅgane eveti niyamena hi `anantarasya'(pāobhāo63)iti nyāyena śliṣa iti yā prāptiḥ aṅ‌bādhanārthā saiva niyamyate na tu tataḥ prācīnamapīti cet? na, yogavibhāgasāmarthyena sarvasyāḥ ksaprāpteḥ niyamanāt| ātmanepade ca aṅo'prāpteḥ sijeva paryavasyati| nanvevamapi āliṅganaeveti ādeśaniyamo'yamiti kutaḥ arthaniyama evāyaṃ kiṃ na syāt āliṅgane ksa eveti| tataścāliṅne aṅ mā nāma bhūt| ātmanepade tu anāliṅgane'pi pūrvema kso durvāra eveti cet? satyam, ubhayatheha niyamasambhave'pi pratyayaniyama evāśrīyate, lakṣyānurodhāt vidheyavibaktinirddeśena pradhānatvādvā bhāṣyakāroktavyākhyānādveti na kaściddoṣaḥ| śliṣa iti yoge aniṭaḥ kim? `śliṣa āliṅgane'(diopao80)ityasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt| `śliṣu pṛṣu pluṣu dāhe'(bhvāopao703)ityasya seṭo grahaṇaṃ mā bhūt| sānubandhakatvādeva tadagrahaṇe tu `aniṭaḥ' iti nāvaśyakamiti dik|
śliṣa iti yogavibhāgasiddhaśca ksaḥ "purastādapavāda"(pāobhāo61)nyāyena aṅameva bādhate na tu ciṇantena `samāśleṣi kanyā devadattena' iti ciṇeva bhavati|
(pāosūo3-1-47)
na dṛśaḥ(pāosūo3-1-47)|| dṛśaḥ kso na syāt| adarśat| adrākṣīt| "irito vā"(pāosūo3-1-47)ityaṅ‌pakṣe "ṛdṛśo'ṅi"(pāosūo7-4-16)iti guṇaḥ| sic‌pakṣe "sṛjidṛśorjhali"(pāosūo6-1-58)ityam|
(pāosūo3-1-48)
ṇiśrudrusrubhyaḥ karttari caṅ(pāosūo3-1-48)|| ebhyaścleścaṅ syāt kartṛvācini luṅi pare| `ṇi' iti ṇiṅ‌ṇicoḥ sāmānyagrahaṇam| acīkamata| acīkarat| aśiśriyat| adudruvat| asusruvat| karttari kim? akārayiṣātāṃ ghaṭau devadattena| caṅo ṅakāro gumaniṣedhārthaḥ| cakāraścaṅīti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| aṅītyucyamāne "asyativakti"(pāosūo3-1-52)ityaṅi "ṣidbhidādibhyaḥ"(pāosūo3-3-104)ici cāṅi atiprasaṅgaḥ| yadi tu "ṇiśri"(pāosūo3-1-48)ityādau ṅa eva kriyeta tadā śakyaṃ cittvamakartum|
kamerupasaṃkhyānam(kāovāo)|| "āyādaya ārddhadhātuke vā" iti yadāṇiṅ nāsti tadarthamidam| acakamata| atra bhāṣyam-
nākamiṣṭa sukhaṃ yānti suyuktairvaḍavārathaiḥ|
atha patkāṣiṇo yānti ye'cīkamata bhāṣiṇaḥ||
asyārthaḥ| acakamatācīkamateti śabdayoḥ sādhutve tulye'pi `acakamata' itiyasya viśeṣalakṣaṇasāpekṣatayā tatprayoge kleśādhikyātphalādhikyam| tena kamerluṅi kiṃ rūpamiti pṛṣṭe `acakamata' iti ye brūyuste suyuktaiḥ rathaiḥ svargaṃ yānti| yaistu `acīkamata' ityuktaṃ te pādau kaṣantīti patkāṣiṇo yānti| "himakāṣihatiṣu ca"(pāosūo6-3-54)iti pādasya padādeśaḥ|
anye tu vyācakṣate| akamiṣṭeti yairuktaṃ te evopacārādakamiṣṭaśabdenocyante| te'mī suyuktairvaḍavārathairgacchanto'pi sukhaṃ na prāpnuvanti, apaśabdoccāraṇāt| acīkamatabhāṣiṇastu patkāṣiṇo'pi sukhaṃ yānti|
(pāosūo3-1-49)
vibhāṣā dheṭ‌śvyoḥ(pāosūo3-1-49)|| ābhyāṃ cleścaṅ vā syāt| adadhat| sic‌pakṣe "vibhāṣā ghrādheṭ"(pāosūo2-4-78)iti vā luk| adhāt| adhāsīt| aśiśviyat| pakṣe "jṝstambhu"(pāosūo3-1-78)ityaṅ| "śvayateraḥ"(pāosūo7-4-78)aśvat| sici vṛddheḥ pratiṣedhe guṇaḥ| aśvayīt| kartarītyeva, adhiṣātāṃgāvau vatsena| karmaṇi dvivacanam| "sthāghvoricca'(pāosūo1-2-27)iti kittvetve|
(pāosūo3-1-50)
gupeśchandasi(pāosūo3-1-50)|| gupeḥ parasya cleścaṅ vā syāt chandasi| āyapratyayābhāvasthala evedam, sūtre kevalasyoccāra ṇāt| imānno mitrāvaruṇau gṛhānajūgupataṃ yuvam| gupū rakṣaṇe(bhvāopao395)luṅ thasastam| "tujādīnāṃ dīrgho'bhyāsasya"(pāosūo6-1-7)iti abhyāsadīrgha iti haradattaḥ| kalpasūtreṣu tu prāyeṇa hrasva eva paṭhyate| pakṣe agauptam, agopiṣṭam| ūditvādiḍabhāve "vadavraja"(pāosūo1-2-3)iti vṛddhiḥ| " jhalo jhali"(pāosūo8-2-26)iti sico lopaḥ| haṭ‌pakṣe "niṭi"(pāosūo7-2-4)iti vṛddhiniṣedhaḥ, guṇaḥ| āyapratyayapakṣe-agopāyiṣṭam| iti catvāri chandasi| bhāṣāyāntu caṅantaṃ varjayitvā trīṇi rūpāṇi|
(pāosūo3-1-51)
nonayatidhvayatyelayatyardayatibhyaḥ(pāosūo3-1-51)|| ebhyo ṇyantebhyaḥ cleścaṅ na syāt chandasi| "mā tvāyato jarituḥ kāmamūnayīḥ"| tvāyatastvāmicchato jarituḥ stotuḥ mama kāmamabhilāṣaṃ mā unayīḥ ūnaṃ mā kārṣīrityarthaḥ| `mā ūnanaḥ' iti bhāṣāyām| ūna parihāṇe(cuopao356)| curādāvadantaḥ ṇic sip caṅ ṇau kṛtasyāllopasya sthānivadbhāvāt "ajāderdvitīyasya"(pāosūo6-1-2)iti naśabdasya dvirvacanam| aglopitvānna sanvadbhāvadīrghopadāhrasvatvāni| iha vṛttipadamañjaryoḥ prāyeṇa auninat iti pāṭhaḥ| tatra abhyāse ikāraḥ prāmādikaḥ| idañca "dvirvacane'ci"(pāosūo1-1-51)iti sūtre sphuṭīkṛtamasmābhiḥ| "mā tvāgnirdhvanayīd dhūmagandhiḥ"| dhvana śabde(cuopao357)curādiradantaḥ| ghaṭādirnāntaśca| bhāṣāyāṃ tu aglopitvānna sanvat| adadhvanat| ghaṭādestu anaglopitvāt adidhvanat| ailayīt| aililat iti bhāṣāyām| ila preraṇe(cuopao127)curādiḥ| ārdayīt| ārdidat iti bhāṣāyām| arda gatau yācane ca(bhvāopao127)arda hiṃsāyām(cuouo296)hetumaṇṇyantau| iha sūtre `chandasi' ityasyānuvṛttirvṛttyādimahāgranthasaṃmatā| tathā ca bhaṭṭiḥ-

puṣādidyutādy‌lṛditaḥ parasmaipadeṣu(pāosūo3-1-55)|| śyanvikaraṇapuṣāderdyutāderlṛditaśca parasya cleraṅādeśaḥ syātparasmaipadeṣu| puṣa puṣṭau, śupa śoṣaṇe,(diopao76,77)ityevamādirādivādigaṇasamāpteḥ puṣādiḥ| yattu madhye `ṣṇiha prītau'(diopāo94)vṛt iti vṛtkaraṇaṃ tadradhādisamāptyartham| "asyativakti"(pāosūo3-1-52)iti sūtre "asyatigrahaṇamātmanepadārthaṃ puṣāditvāt" iti vārtikakāravacanaṃ cātra pramāṇam| apuṣat| aśuṣat| yastu bhūvādiḥ puṣa puṣṭau, śriṣu śliṣu pruṣu pluṣu dāhe(bhvāopao71,-75)ityevamādiḥ, so'tra na gṛṃhyate, dyutādīnāṃ pṛthakkaraṇājjñāpakāt| te hi tatra puṣeruttaratra paṭhyante| yo'pi puṣa puṣṭau, muṣa steye(kryāopao57,58)iti kryādiṣu paṭhitaḥ, so'pyatra na gṛhyate| tatra hi catvāra eva dhātavaḥ yadi ca te jighṛkṣitāḥ syurlṛdita eva te kriyeran| yattu svaritettvāderapi tenaiva siddhatvāditi haradattenoktam, tatra teṣāṃ niranubandhakatvāt graheḥ svaritettve'pyādiśabdārthālābhāt| aṅa ādiśabdārthatve tu apiśabdārthālābhāditi dik|
atha siddhānte'pi puṣādayo dyutādayaśca lṛdita eva kuto na paṭhitā iti cet? na, pratyekaṃ lṛkārapāṭhe viparītagauravāpatteḥ| na cānubandhāntareṇa lṛkāro nimātuṃ śakyaḥ, tattatkāryānirvāhaprasaṅgāt| āditāmīditāmuditāmūhitāñca tatra sattvāt| tadyathā-puṣādiṣu ñiṣvidā gātraprakṣaraṇe(diopao82), madī harṣe(diopao12)| śamu upaśame,(diopao95)ṣidhū saṃrāddhau(diopao86)iti paṭhyante| dyutādiṣvapi śvitā varṇe; ñimidā snehane, ñiṣvidāmnehanamocanayoḥ(bhvāoāo343,-345),sraṃsudhvaṃsu avasraṃsane(bhvāoāo355,356), syandū prasravaṇe, kṛpū sāmarthye(bhvāoāo762,763)iti paṭhyante| adyutat| aśvitat| "dyud‌bhyo luṅi"(pāosūo1-3-91)iti pākṣikaṃ parasmaipadam| gamlṛ(bhvāopao1--7)agamat| parammaipadeṣviti kim? adyotiṣṭa| iha "nandigrahipacādibhyaḥ"(pāosūo3-1-134)itivat puṣadyutādītyeka evādiśabdaḥ paṭhituṃ yuktaḥ| tathā tu na kṛtamityeva|

ciṇ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ(pāosūo3-1-66)|| dhātocleściṇ syāt bhāvakarmavācini taśabde| aśāpi bhavatā| akāri kaṭastvayā| ciṇgrahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārtham, 'ciṇ te padaḥ"(pāosūo3-1-60)ityataste ityasyeva ciṇ‌grahaṇasyāpyanuvṛtteḥ| yattu "dīpajana"(pāosūo3-1-60)ityatra anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ, tat "na rudhaḥ"(pāosūo3-1-64)ityatraiva nivṛttam| anyathā naño vaiyarthyāpatteḥ| na ca pratiṣedha eva ihānuvartteteti vācyam, tasya prāptipūrvakatvāt, bhāvakarmaṇośca kenāpi ciṇaḥ prāpterabhāvāt| na ca "śliṣaḥ" iti vibhaktena yogena vidhīyamānaḥ ksaḥ puṣādyaṅamiva imaṃ ciṇamapi bādheta, ato'tra ciṇeva yathā syāt kso mā bhūdityetadarthaṃ punaściṇgrahaṇamiti prakṛtasūtre bhāṣyārūḍhaṃ prayojanamastyeveti vācyam, tasyāpi pākṣikatvāt| samudāyāpekṣāyāṃ hyetaduktam| avayavāpekṣāyāṃ purastādapavādanyāyena śliṣeḥ kso'ṅameva bādhate na tu ciṇamiti prāgevoktam|
(pāosūo3-1-67)
sārvadhātu ke yak(pāosūo3-1-67)|| bhāvakarmavāciti sārvadhātuke pare dhātoryak syāt| āsyato śayyate tvayā| "ayaṅ yi ṅkiti"(pāosūo7-4-22)iti śīṅo'yādeśaḥ| kriyate kaṭaḥ|
iha karmaṇi yak bhavatītyasyāvakāśaḥ śuddhaṃ karma-pacyate odanaḥ| kartari śapo'vakāśaḥ śuddhaṃ kartā| karmakartaryubhayaprasaṅge-yag‌vidhāne karmakartaryupasaṃkhyānam tarhi kartavyam| na kartavyam| kāryātideśātsiddham| karmavatkartarītyanenaiva hi yagātmanepadādīni vidhīyante iti yageva paraḥ| śāstrātideśapakṣe'pi "na duhasnunamāṃ yak‌ciṇau"(pāosūo3-1-89)iti jñāpakāt karmakartari yageva bhaviṣyati|
atredamavadheyam, bhāvakarmakarttāro lakārārthāḥ| "laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ"(pāosūo3-4-69)iti sūtrāt| tatra hi cakāreṇa `kartari' ityanukṛṣyate| tacca vācyārthasamarpakamiti pūrvasūtre sthitam| uttaratrāpi "tayoreva kṛtya"(pāosūo3-4-70)ityatra tathaiveti sandaṃśātprāyapāṭhācca madhye'pi vācyasamarpakataivocitā pradhānabhūtadhātvarthāśrayaḥ kartā,phalāśrayaśca karma, phalavyāpārayośca dhātunaivopāttatvāt| āśrayamātraṃ lakārārthaḥ, ananyalabhyasyaiva śabdārthatvāt| tataśca tiṅāmapi saevārthaḥ, teṣāṃ lādeśatvāt sthānyarthābhidhānasamarthasyaiva cādeśatvāt| vikaraṇatāṃ dyotayanti, yak‌ciṇau tu phale| nanu viparītamevāstu, 'kartari śap"(pāosūo3-1-68)ityāderavyanuśāsanasya svarasena śabādaya eva vācakāḥ, lakārāstu dyotakā itīti cet? na, āśīlirṅi liṭi ca adādijuhotyādiṣu ca śabādyabhāve'pi tatpratīteḥ| yadyapi-
kvacittiṅāmabhāve'pi pratīyante trayo'pyamī|
aśāmyakārigaccheti ciṇ‌śap‌sannidhimātrataḥ||
adogabibharityādau ghātumātre'pi kartṛdhīḥ|
tathāpyāsata ityādau dhātvabhāve'pi kartṛdhīḥ||
tathāpi tatra paramate luptasmṛtaṃ bodhakam| asmākantu yaḥ śiṣyate sa lupyamānārthābhidhāyītyuktābhyupagamāt sarvaṃ sustham| tatra kartṛkarmaṇī vadan tiṅ tanniṣṭhāṃ saṅkhyāmapi pratipādayatīti kartṛkarmaṇordvitve bahutve ca dvivacanabahuvacane bhavataḥ| bhāve lastu asattvāvasthāpannāṃ dhātvarthabhūtāṃ kriyāmeva abhidhatte dyotayati veti tatra prathamapuruṣaikavacanameva bhavati, na madhyamottamau, yuṣmadasmatsāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvāt| nāpi dvivacanabahuvacane, dvitvabahutvayorapratīteḥ| ekavacanantu utsargaḥ kariṣyata iti bhāṣyādbhavati| atra bahuvacanetyapyutsargaḥ, `uṣṭrāsikā āsyante' `hataśāyikāḥ śayyante' ityatra bhāṣye tadabhyupagamāt| uṣṭrāṇāṃ hi āsikāḥ svarūpata eva vilakṣaṇāḥ, hatāśca nānāprakāraṃ śerate uttānā avatānā vikīraṇamakeśā visrastavastrā ityādi| tatsāmyādākhyātavācyasyāpi bhāvasya svarūpagatabhedāvabhāsādvahuvacanaṃ bhavatyeva| ivaśabdaprayogamantareṇāpi ivārthāvagatirbhavati, paratra paraśabdaḥ prayukta iti nyāyāt| tadayamarthaḥ-`yādṛśāni hatānāmanekaprakārāṇi śayanāni tādṛśāni devadattādibhiḥ kriyante' iti| evañceha `āsikāḥ' `śāyikāḥ' iti dvitīyābahuvacanāntaṃ, kriyāviśeṣaṇatvena karmatvāt| na caivaṃ klībatvamekavacanaṃ ca syāditi vācyam, "striyāṃ ktin"(pāosūo3-3-94)ityadhikārāt strītvāvadhāraṇena "sāmānye napuṃsakam"(kāovāo)ityasyāpravṛtteḥ, bahutvāvadhāraṇena ca ekavacanāpravṛtteriti dik|
ke cittu `karmaṇyayaṃ lakāraḥ' iti manvānā āsikāśāyikāśabdau prathamāntāvityāhuḥ| tathāhi, āsikāśāyikayorbhāvatayā kālabhāvādhvagantavya iti karmatve `godohaḥ supyate' itivat karmaṇi laḥ| uṣṭrāsikāhataśāyikayośca ākhyātaprakṛtyupasthite āsanaśayane prati paricchedakatvenānvayaḥ, godohasyeva svāpe| paricchedakatvaṃ ca āsikāśā yikayoḥ sādṛśyadvārakaṃ, godohasya tu kālopādhinetyanyadetat| etacca vivakṣāntare bhavatyeveti kaiyaṭādayaḥ|
bhāṣyakāraistu bhāve'pi lavidhāne bahutvaṃ svīkṛtamityuktam| na cevamākhyātavācyasya bhāvasya asattvāvasthāpannateti siddhānto bhajyeteti vācyam, liṅgāyogasya karaṇādikārakāyogasya ceha asattvāvasthātvena vivakṣitatvāt| ata eva `pacati bhavati, pacyate bhavati, paśya mṛgo dhāvati' ityādau vākyārthabhūtāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ kriyāntaraṃ prati kartṛtvakarmatvābhyāmanvaye'pi na kācit kṣatiḥ| na caitāvatā ghañādisāmyaṃ, ghañādivācyo hi bhāvaḥ saliṅgo yathāyathaṃ sakalakārakānvitaśceti vaiṣamyasya spaṣṭatvāt| atra vaiṣamye anubhavabalakalpyaḥ śabdaśaktisvabhāva eva niyāmakaḥ| tadetaduktam-"kṛdabhihito bhāvo dravyavatprakāśate" iti| kṛtsvapi tumunādau na sattvārthakatvam| etacca "avyayakṛto bhāve" iti vārttike sphuṭībhaviṣyati| anavyayakṛtsvapi `śayitavyaṃ bhavadbhiḥ' ityādau ekatvasaṃkhyāya evānvayaḥ, na tu dvitvāderityādi yathānubhavaṃ yathākarañca vivektavyam|
(pāosūo3-1-68)
karttari śap(pāosūo3-1-68)|| kartṛvācini sārvadhātuke pare dhātoḥ śap syāt| pakāraḥ svarārthaḥ ṅittvapratiṣedhārthaśca| śakāraḥ sārvadhātukārthaḥ 'śap‌śyanoḥ"(pāosūo7-1-81)ityādau viśeṣaṇārthaśca| pacati| paṭhati| kartṛgrahaṇaṃ "karmavatkarmaṇā"(pāosūo3-1-87)ityatropayokṣyate| iha tu sārvadhātuke śap bhavatīti sāmānyavidhāne'pi na kṣatiḥ, bhāvakarmaṇoryagāderapavādatvāt kartaryeva śapaḥ paryavasānāt| na ca yagvidhau bhāvakarmagrahaṇaṃ nānuvarttata iti vācyam, `pacati' ityādau śabādimeva nimittatvenāśritya yakaḥ prasaṅgāt|

rudhādibhyaḥ śnam(pāosūo3-1-78)|| ebhyaḥ śnam pratyayaḥ syāt| mittvādantyādacaḥ paraḥ| takrakauṇḍinyanyāyenāyaṃ śapaṃ bādhate| śakāraḥ "śnānnalopaḥ"(pāosūo6-4-23)iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| "nānnalopaḥ" ityucyamāne `yajñānāṃ' `yatnānām' ityatrāpi syāt| na ca "nāmi"(pāosūo6-4-3)iti dīrghatve kṛte "nāt" iti vyapadeśābhāvānna bhaviṣyatīti vācyam, ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvena satyapi dīrghe `nāt' iti vyapadeśasambhavāt| kiñca paratvāllopenaiva bhāvyam| na ca tato'pi paratvāt "supi ca"(pāosūo7-3-12)iti dīrgho'stviti vācyam, "sannipāta"(paobhāo87)paribhāṣayā tasya nāmyapravṛtteḥ na caivaṃ rāmāṇāmityādau "nāmi"(pāosūo6-4-3)iti dīrgho'pi na syādeveti vācyam, ārambhasāmarthyānnāmīti dīrghe kartavye sannipātaparibhāṣāyā apravṛtteḥ| "supi ca"(pāosūo7-3-102)iti dīrghastu "rāmābhyām" ityādau caritārthaḥ sannipātaparibhāṣāṃ bādhituṃ neṣṭe| yattu haradattenoktaṃ `kaṣṭāya' iti nirddeśātsāmānyapekṣajñāpakāddīrgho bhaviṣyati, evamapi tasya pūrvasmādvidhau sthānivattvānnaśabda evāyamiti nalopaḥ syādeveti| taccintyam, sāmānyāpekṣeṇa hi jñāpakena paribhāṣāyāḥ kvācitkī apravṛttiriti lakṣyānurodhātsidhyatu nāma, autsargikī tatpravṛttiḥ kimarthamiha tyājyā| `yatnānām' ityādilakṣyasiddhyarthameveti cet? satyapi dīrghe lakṣyaṃ na sidhyatīti samanantaramevoktatvāt svayamapi lakṣyāsiddhervakṣyamāṇatvācca| kiñca "pūrvasmādvidhau " iti atisthavīyaḥ, tasya hi pūrvasmānnimittatvenāśritādityarthaḥ sthitaḥ| yaccehānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvaṃ nakāravyañjanamātraṃ na tannimittatvenāśritam, yacca nimittaṃ nakārākārasaṃghātaḥ nāsāvanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrva iti yatkiñcidetat| tasmātprāguktavidhayā ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvātprāptiḥ| dīrghātprāgevaveti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ śakāraḥ| na caivamapi `viśnānāṃ' `praśnānām' ityatrātiprasaṅgaḥ, anarthakatvāt| na ca vikaraṇe'pyevameveti vācyam, ekadeśimate tasya vācakatvāt| mukhyamate'pi dyotyenārthenārthavatvāt| ata eva pratyayasaṃjñāyā anvarthatve'pi śnami tatpravṛttau "laśaku"(pāosūo1-3-8)iti śasyetsaṃjñā sidhyati| kiñca "lakṣaṇapratipadokta"(paobhāo115)paribhāṣayā'pi `viśnānām' ityādau nātiprasaṅgaḥ| tasmāt "śnānnalopaḥ"(pāosūo6-4-23)iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ śnamaḥ śakāra iti sthitam| na cārdhadhātukasaṃjñānivṛttyartho'pi so'stu, satyāṃ hi tasyāṃ anakti, bhanakti, ato lopaḥ syāt| ruṇaddhi, bhinatti, guṇaḥ syāt| hinasti, tṛṇoḍhi, iḍāgamaḥ syāt| 'neḍ vaśi"(pāosūo7-2-8)iti tu neha pravarttate, akṛttvāditi cet? na, satyapyārddhadhātukatve kṣatyabhāvāt| na ca lopo guṇa iḍ veti tritayaṃ syādityuktamiti cet? na, tritayasyāpyāgamatvāt, śnamaḥ pūrvabhāgasya cānaṅgatvāt| tathāhi, "yasmātpratyayavidhiḥ"(pāosūo1-4-13)ityasyāyamarthaḥ-pratyaye vidhīyamāne yatpañcamyā nirddiṣṭaṃ dhātoḥ prātipadikādityādi tadādi tasminparato'ṅgamiti| iha tu yatpañcamīnirddiṣṭaṃ rudhādibhyo dhātubhya iti, na tasmāt pratyayaḥ paraḥ, yasmācca pūrvabhāgātpratyayaḥ paraḥ, nāsau tasminvidhīyamāne pañcamyā nirddiṣṭa iti dik|
ruṇaddhi| bhinatti|

"kryādibhyaḥ śnā'(pāosūo3-1-83)| tasya śānac, cittvādantodāttaḥ| 'sannipāta"(paobhāo87)paribhāṣāyā anityatyāddherluk| halaḥ kim? krīmīhi| hau kim? puṣṇāti| `śnaḥ' iti sthāninirddeśa ādeśatvalābhāya| itarathā hi pratyayāntaramevedaṃ syāt| nanu tathaivāstu ko doṣa iti cet? na, `paca' `paṭha'ityādāvapi śapaṃ bādhitvā śānacprasaṅgāt| na ca "kryādibhiyaḥ"(pāosūo3-1-187)iti anuvarttata iti vācyam, `stabhāna' `stubhāna' ityādicaturṇāmasiddhyāpatteḥ| na ca stambhvādayo'pyanuvartayituṃ śakyāḥ, biśeṣavihitena śānacā śna iva śnorapi bādhe `stabhnuhi' ityāderasiddhiprasaṅgāt| na ca `śnuśca' ityapyanuvarttyam, kryāderapi śnuprasaṅgāt| na ca stam‌bhvādibhya eva śnuḥ, śānac tu tebhyaḥ kryādibhyaścetyatra pramāṇamasti| tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu| śānacaḥ śitkaraṇe prayojanaṃ cintyam, sthānivadbhāvenaiva siddheriti haradattaḥ|

vyatyayo bahulam(pāosūo3-1-85)|| vikaraṇāḥ prakrāntāḥ, teṣāṃ chandasi bahulaṃ vyatyayaḥ syāt| vyatigamanaṃ vyatyayaḥ| vyatipūrvādiṇo(aopao35)bhāve erac| kvacidanyonyaviṣayāvagāhanam| kvaṇḍāni bhedati| `bhinatti' iti prāpte| na hyasyā aparañcana jarasā marate patiḥ| `mriyate'iti prāpte|
jīvacāmaravāsādho vyādhamājīvamāmaraḥ|
ityapi purāṇādau chāndasardaśanātsamādheyam| indro vastena neṣatu| nayaterloṭi tipi śapsipau dvau vikaraṇau| indreṇa yujā taruṣema vṛtram| `tarema' ityartha-| taratervidhyādau liṅ, mas, uḥ, sip, śap, iti trayo vikaraṇāḥ| dhātorguṇaḥ| taruṣ mas iti sthite "nityaṅṅitaḥ"(pāosūo3-4-11)iti salopaḥ| yāsuṭ| "ato yeyaḥ"(pāosū7-2-80)| yalopaḥ| "ād guṇaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-87)| bahulagrahaṇaṃ sarvavidhivyabhicārārtham| tathā ca bhāṣyam-
