supāṃ vyatyayaḥ-yuktāmātāsīd dhuri dakṣiṇāyāḥ| dakṣiṇasyām iti prāpte| tiṅāṃ-caṣālaṃ ye aśvayūpāya takṣati| `takṣanti' iti prāpte| lādeśavyaṅgyaḥ kriyāsādhanaviśeṣarūpaḥ svārthaparārthatvādiścopagrahaśabdasya vācyaḥ| yathoktam-
ya ātmanepadādbhedaḥ kvacidarthasya gamyate|
anyataścāpi lādeśān manyante tamupagraham|| iti|
ātmanepadāditi lādeśāditi ca hetau pañacmī| iha tu tatpratītinimitte parasmaipade ātmanepade ca upagrahaśabdo lakṣaṇayā vartate| brahmacāriṇamicchate| `icchati' iti prāpte| pratīpamanya ūrmiryudhyati| `yudhyate' iti prāpte| madhostṛptā ivāsate| madhuna iti prāpte| bhāṣāyāntu yadyapyarddharcāditvādubhaliṅgo madhuśabdo'sti tathāpi arthaviśeṣa eva| tathā--
makarandasya madyasya mākṣikasyāpi vācakaḥ|
arddharcādigaṇe pāṭhāt punnapuṃsakayormadhuḥ||
iti śāśvatakeśāt| amṛte tu napuṃsaka eva| ata eva vyatyayodāharaṇaṃ dattam| māghastu--
sarasamakarandanirbharāsu prasavavibhūtiṣu virudhāṃ viraktaḥ|
dhruvamamṛtapanāmavāñchayāsāmadharamadhuṃ madhupastavājihīte||
ityatrāmṛtavācakamadhuśabdaṃ pulliṅgaṃ prayuñjānaścintyaḥ, śāśvatakośāt| naraḥ puruṣaḥ| adhāsavīrairdaśabhirviyūyāḥ| `viyūyāt' iti prāpte| yu miśraṇe(aopao23)vipūrvaḥ āśiṣi liṅ| kālavācī pratyayaḥ kālaḥ| śvo'gnīnādhāsyamānena| luṭo viṣaye lṛṭ| hal-triṣṭubhaujaḥ śuphitamugravīram| śubha śumbha śobhārthe(tuopao41,42)bhakārasya phakāraḥ āśvalāyanasūtre| taittirīye bhakāra eva paṭhyata iti haradattaḥ| vastutastu āśvalāyanasūtre'pi bhakāra eva paṭhyate| halvyatyayodāharaṇantu suhitamiti prāpta iti bhāṣyānurodhena spaṣṭam| ac-upagāyantu māṃ patnayo garbhiṇyaḥ| dīrghasya hrasvaḥ svaravyatyayaḥ "parādiśchandasi bahulam"(pāosūo6-21-99)ityatra vakṣyate| kartṛśabdaḥ kārakamātrasyopalakṣaṇaṃ tadvācinīnāṃ vibhaktīnāṃ vyatyaya iti haradattaḥ| evantu suptiṅ ityeva gatārthatā syāt, tasmātkārakavācināṃ kṛttiddhitādīnāmapi vyatyaya udāhāryaḥ| tathā ca "karmaṇyaṇ"(pāosūo3-2-1)sūtre bhāṣyamatrādāyeti ca kṛtāṃ vyatyayaśchandasīti| tacca tatraivasphuṭīkariṣyāmaḥ| yaṅiti pratyāhāraḥ yako yaśabdādāraśya "liṅyāśiṣyaṅ"(pāosūo3-1-86)iti ṅakāreṇa| teṣāṃ vyatyayaḥ prāgevodāhṛtaḥ| evaṃ suptiṅprabhṛtīnāṃ vyatyayaṃ śāstrakṛtpāṇiniricchati| sa ca bāhulakena siṣyati| bahūnarthān lātyādatta iti bahulaṃ tasya bhāvo bāhulakam| manojñāditvād vuñ|
(pāosūo3-1-86)
liṅyāśiṣyaṅ(pāosūo3-1-86)|| chandasi dhātoraṅ pratyayaḥ syāt āśiṣi liṅi pare| sthāgāgamavacividiśakiruhiṣvevāyamaṅ prāyema dṛśyate| upastheyaṃ vṛṣabhantugriyāṇām| upapūrvāttiṣṭhaterāśiṣi liṅ mipo'm, yāsuṭ, "chandasyubhayathā"(pāosūo6-4-86)iti sārvadhātukasaṃjñāyā api sattvāt "liṅa salopo'nantyasya"(pāosūo7-2-71)iti salopaḥ| aṅi "āto lopaḥ"(pāosūo6-4-64)"ato yeyaḥ"(kaosūo7-2-80)| satyamupageyam| gamema jānato gṛhān| mantraṃ vocemāgnaye| "vaca um"(pāosūo7-4-20)videyamenāṃ manasi praviṣṭām| vrataṃ cariṣyāmi tacchakeyam| asravantīmāruhemāsvastaye|
dṛśerag vaktavyaḥ(kāovāo)| pitarañca dṛśeyaṃ mātarañca| aṅi tu sati "ṛdṛśo'ṅi"(pāosūo7-4-16)iti gumaḥ syāt| atha kathaṃ `upastheyām śaraṇaṃ bṛhanta' iti? sthemeti hi prāpnoti|
atra bhāṣyam-sārvadhātukatvālliṅa salopa ārddhadhātukatvādetvamiti| "erliṅi"(pāosūo6-4-67)iti sūtreṇeti bhāvaḥ| aṅ cātra na kāryaḥ, bāhulakāt|
|| iti śrīśabdakaustubhe tṛtīyādhyāyasya prathame pāde caturthamānhikam ||
|| tṛtīyādhyāyasya prathame pāde pañcamamānhikam ||
(pāosūo3-1-87)
karmavatkarmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ(pāosūo3-1-87)|| karmaśabdena svaniṣṭhā kriyā lakṣyate| karmasthayā kriyayā tulyakriyo lakāravācyaḥ karttā karmavat syāt| "vyatyayo bahulaṃlliṅyāśiṣyaṅ"(pāosūo3-1-85,86)iti dvilakārako nirddeśaḥ| luptanirddiṣṭo vā lakāraḥ| lopastu "saṃyogāntasya"(pāosūo8-2-23)iti "halo yāmām"(pāosūo8-4-64)iti vā| tacca lagrahaṇamihānuvṛttaṃ ṣaṣṭhyā vipariṇamyeta, luptaṣaṣṭhīkaṃ vā, ṣaṣṭhyarthaśca vācyatvam| "karttari śap"(pāosūo3-1-68)iti sūtrātkartṛgrahaṇamanuvṛttaṃ prathamayā vipariṇamyate| tenābhimatārthalābhaḥ| yagātmanepadaciṇ‌ciṇvadbhāvāḥ prayojanam| bhidyate kāṣṭhaṃ svayameva| abhedi kāṣṭhaṃ svayameva| kāriṣyate kaṭaḥ svayameva| ātmanepadasya trīṇyapi imānyudāharaṇāni| yak‌ciṇ‌ciṇvadbhāvānāṃ tu krameṇeti vivekaḥ|
nivṛttapreṣaṇaṃ karma svakriyāvayave sthitam|
nivarttamāne karmatve sve kartṛtve'vatiṣṭhate||
asyāñcāvasthāyāmakarmakatvāt karttari bhāve ca lakārāḥ| tatra yadā kartari tadā śuddhe karttarīva rūpeṣu prāpteṣu pūrvāvasthāyāṃ bhideḥ karmībhūte kāṣṭhe yādṛśī kriyā dvidhābhavanarūpā, karoteḥ karmaṇi ca kaṭe utpattirūpā, tayā tulyakriyo'yaṃ bhidikṛñoḥ karttā lakāravācyaścetyatideśādyagādicatuṣṭayapravṛttiḥ| yathā nivṛttapreṣaṇasyākarmakatvaṃ, yathā ca kriyāyāḥ kvacitkarmasthatvaṃ, kvacinna, tathā "ṇeraṇau"(pāosūo1-3-67)iti sītre vyatpāditam| karmaṇeti kim? karaṇādhikaraṇābhyāṃ tulyakriye mā bhūt| sādhvasiśchinatti| sādhu sthālī pacati| nanviha karaṇādhikaraṇatvāvasthāyāmasisthālyorvyāpāro vastutaḥ sannapi dhātunā nopādīyata iti cet? kiṃ tataḥ? nahyasmin sūtre sādṛśyapratiyogibhūtāyāḥ kriyāyā dhātūpāttatvaṃ śabdenāśritaṃ, yena karmagrahaṇaṃ vinā'pyatiprasaṅgo na bhavet| kiñca kartṛsthakriyā apyasyaiva vyāvartyā| gacchati grāmaḥ svayameva, ārohati hastī svayameveti|
adhigacchati śāstrārthaḥ smarati śraddadhāti ca| ityādi|
nanvevaṃ karotyarthasya yatnasyāpi jñānecchādivatkartṛsthatvāt kāriṣyate kaṭaḥ svayameveti kathamudāhṛtamiti cet? na, karoterutpādanārthatvasya prāgeva varṇitatvāt| lakāravācyaḥ kim? bhāve lakārotpattau mā bhūt, bhidyate kusūlena| iha satyatideśe kusūlād dvitīyā syāt| kiñca lakāravācyatvaviśeṣaṇābhāve kṛtyāḥ khalarthāśca asmin kartari syuḥ-bhettavyaḥ kusūlaḥ svayameveti| īṣadbhedaḥ kusūlaḥ svayameveti| iṣyate tu bhāva eva-bhettavyaṃ kusūlena kusūlasya vā| "kṛtyānāṃ karttari vā"(pāosūo2-3-71)iti vā ṣaṣṭhī| īṣadbhedaṃ kusūlena| yattviha vārttike "kṛtyaktakhalartheṣu pratiṣedhaḥ" ityuktam, tanna ktagrahaṇamavivakṣitam, anyatra saha pāṭhāttviha paṭhitam| bhavatyeva hi ebhyo'karmakatvāt "gatyarthākarmaka"(pāosūo3-4-72)iti sūtreṇa karttari ktaḥ| tathā ca "sinotergrāsakarmakartṛkasya"(kāovāo)iti niṣṭhānatve "sino grāsaḥ svayameva" iti kartari kta udāhariṣyate!
anye tvāhuḥ-ktagrahaṇaṃ vivikṣitameva, `gavā dugdhaṃ paya' ityudāharaṇasambhavāt| atra hi goḥ karmakartṛtvāt tatra karmavadatideśe sati ktaḥ syāt| nahyatra siddhānte "gatyarthākarmaka"(pāosūo3-4-72)ityetatpravarttate, payorūpeṇa karmaṇā sakarmakatvāt| na caivaṃ sakarmakatvādeva karmavadityatideśo na bhaviṣyatīti vācyam, duhipacyorbahulaṃ sakarmakayoriti pratiprasavāt| na ca bahulagrahaṇādeva pravṛttiḥ, tasya bhāṣye pratyākhyātatvāditi dik|
vatigrahaṇantu śakyamakartum| tathāhi, lakāravācyasya kartuḥ karmasaṃjñaivāstu| na ca karmasaṃjñayā kartṛsaṃjñayā bādhaḥ, ekasaṃjñādhikārādanyatra saṃjñānāṃ samāveśāt| na caivaṃ sakarmakatvābhāve lo na syāditi vācyam, ānupūrvyā siddhatvāt| karmasaṃjñā hi lakārotpattiṃ pratīkṣate, lakāravācyasyaiva kartustadvidhānāt| tataḥ prāk cākarmakatvānapāyena "bhāve cākarmakebhya"(pāosūoeo3-4-61)iti bhāve kartari ca lavidherapratyūhatvāt| nanvevamapi yagātmanepade na syātāṃ, śuddhayoḥ karmakartroḥ sāvakāśayoryak‌śapoḥ paratvāt śapprasaṅgāt, "bhāvakarmaṇoḥ"(pāosūo1-3-13)ityātmanepadasya "śeṣātkartari"(pāosūo1-3-78)iti parasmaipadasya ca vipratiṣedhena paratvātparasmaipadaprasaṅgācceti cet? na, bhāvakarmaṇorvihitena yakā apavādabhūtena ākrāntaviṣayaṃ parihṛtya sārvadhātuke śabiti utsargasya pravṛttisambhavāt karttariśabiti sūtre kartṛgrahaṇamatiricyate| tasyaitatphalaṃ-"kartaiva yaḥ kartā tatra śabādayo yathā syuḥ karmakarttari mā bhūvan" iti| nanvasmin haradattapakṣe "na duha"(pāosūo3-1-89)ityādinā yaki niṣiddhe śap na syāt| tathā ca liṅliṭoriva nirvikaraṇaprayogāpattiriti cet? evaṃ tarhi karttarīti yogo vibhajyate, bhāvakarmaṇorityatrāpi bhāve, karmaṇi ceti| tataḥ karmaṇīttyanuvartya karmaṇi karttari yak bhavati śapo'pavādaḥ| na duhetyādau apavādābhāvātpunarutsargasya sthitiḥ| etacca vyākhyānaṃ yagvidhāveva bhāṣye sthitam| evantāvadyak siddhaḥ, na duhasnunamāmiti liṅgācca| tathā "karttari karma"(pāosūo1-3-14)ityataḥ "karttari" ityanuvarttya "kartaivaḥ yaḥ kartā tatra parasmaipadaṃ, na tu karmakarttari" iti vyākhyānādātmanepadam| tasmādvatkaraṇe tyakte'pi sarvamiṣṭaṃ siddhyatīti sthitam| kriyamāṇe tu vatkaraṇe atideśo'yamiti spaṣṭameva| sa ca ṣoḍhā-rūpanimittatādātmyavyapadeśaśāstrakāryātideśabhedāditi "sthānivat"(pāosūo1-1-56)sūtre vyutpāditam| iha tu āditastrayāṇāmasambhavaḥ| vyapadeśātideśastu saṃjñāpakṣānna bhidyate| tatra vatkaraṇaṃ vyarthama| ato dvāveva śiṣyete| tatrāpi śāstrātideśe yagātmanepadasiddhyarthaṃ pūrvoktayatna āstheya iti kliṣṭatā| pradhānaṃ ca kāryaṃ tadarthatvādatideśāntarāṇām| ataḥ kāryātideśa evāyam| na cāsminpakṣe dvitīyā'pyati diśyeta, tathā ca bhidyate kusūleneti bhāve lakāre kartari dvitīyā syāditi vācyam, "lavācyasyaiva kartuḥ karmavadatideśaḥ" ityuktatvāt| na caivamapi `bhidyate kusūlaḥ' ityatra doṣāpattiḥ, abhihitatvena dvitīyāyā apravṛtteḥ| nanviha anabhihitādhikāro nāstīti cet? satyam| tathāpi vatkaraṇasāmarthyāt yathā'nabhihite karmaṇi pratyayaḥ tathaivānabhihite kartaryapi labhyeta, tena abhidānamastītyuktameva| nanu nivṛttapreṣaṇā lunātibhinattyādayo'karmakāḥ dvidhā bhavatītivat, tatkathaṃ tatkartuḥ karmaṇā tulyākriyatvam iti cet? na, nahyasminprayoge yatkarma tena tulyakriyatāṃ brūmaḥ, kiṃ tarhi prayogāntare yatkarma tena| nanvevaṃ `pacatyodanaṃ devadattaḥ' `rādhyatyodanaḥ svayameva' ityādāvatiprasaṅga iti cet? atra vārtikam-
karmadṛṣṭaścetsamānadhātau(kāovāo)|| iti| nyāyasiddhaṃ cedaṃ, dhātoriti hyanuvartate kartṛkarmaṇī ca dhātoranyatra na sambhavata iti sāmarthyādeva siddhe tadanuvṛttirekatvavivakṣārthā| yasminneva dhātau yatkarma tena tulyakriyastasyaiva karteti| tena dhātubhede na bhavati|
syādetat, ekasyāpi rūpabhedena kartṛtvaṃ karmatvaṃ ca dṛśyate, `ātmānamātmanā vetsi' iti yathā| evaṃ ca `odanaḥ pacyate' ityādāvapi prākṛte karmaṇyeva lakāro'stu tatkiṃ nivṛttapreṣaṇatvāśrayaṇena, kiñca karmavadityatideśena? na caivaṃ `bhidyate kusūlena' iti bhāve lo na syāditi vācyam, iṣṭāpatteḥ| karmaṇyeva hi so'stu|
(pāosūo3-1-89)
atrāhuḥ, evaṃ satu "na duhasnunamām"(pāosūo3-1-89)|| ityādinā yakciṇoḥ pratiṣedhasya viṣayavibhāgo na labhyeta| api ca `namatedaṇḍaḥ" kārayate acīkarata vā kaṭaḥ' ityādau yakciṇoḥ pratiṣiddhayo'rapi śapcaṅau na syātām, akartṛtvāt| kiṃ ca `pacatyodanaḥ' ityapi prayogaḥ prasajyeta| tasmānnivṛttapreṣaṇatāmāśrityātideśasūtramārabdhavyameveti|
karaṇena tulyakriyaḥ karttā bahulaṃ karmavaditi vaktavyam(kāovāo)|| parivārayati kaṇṭakairvṛkṣam| parivārayante kaṇṭakā vṛkṣam| atrātmanepadaṃ sidhyati| na ca "ṇicaśca"(pāosūo1-3-74)ityanena tatsiddhiḥ, kriyāphalasya kartṛgāmitve satyeva tatpravṛtteḥ| iha tu tadabhāve'pyātmanepadasyeṣyamāṇatvāt| bahulagrahaṇānneha-`sādhvasiśchinatti'|
sakarmakāṇāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ(kāovāo)|| anyonyamāśliṣyataḥ| anyonyaṃ spṛśataḥ| etacca nyāyasiddham| tathāhi, karmasthayā kriyayā tulyā kriyā yasya karturityukte sannidhānādidaṃ gamyate-yatkriyāveśādasau kartā saiva cetkarmatvopayoginīti| na caitadihāsti, svayamanāśliṣyato'pi pareṇāśliṣyamāṇasya karmatvasambhavāt| parasamavetasaṃyogākhyaphalānukūlavyāpārayoścalanātmakayorekadhātūpāttayorapi svarūpemātra bhedāt| etena `bhidyamānaḥ kusūlaḥ pātrāṇi bhinatti' ityapi vyākhyātam| dvidhābhavanasya daivagatyā kusūlaniṣṭhatve'pi pātraniṣṭhakarmatāyāmaprayojakatvāt| svayamabhidyamāno'pi hi kusūlaḥ uparī patan pātrāṇi bhittyeva| nanvevamapi pacirūdhādīnāṃ dvikarmakāmāmekasya karmaṇaḥ kartṛtve'pyapareṇa sakarmakatvāvasthāyāṃ karmavadbhāvaḥ prāptaḥ, tanniṣed‌dhuṃ sakarmakāṇāṃ pratiṣedhavacanaṃ kartavyameveti cet? yogavibhāgātsiddham| tathāhi,
tapeḥ|| tapereva sakarmakasya na tvanyasya| tataḥ, tapaḥ karmakasyaiva| taperityanuvartate| yadvā vārtike yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate-
duhipacyorbahulaṃ sakarmakayoḥ(kāovāo)|| atra "duhipacyoḥ sakarmayoḥ" ityekaṃ vākyaṃ niyamārthaṃ-`duhipacyoreva na tvanyeṣām' iti| dugdhe gauḥ payaḥ| tasmādudumbaraḥ salohitaṃ phalaṃ pacyate|| gaurudumbaraścātra karmakarttā| "akathitaṃ ca"(pāosūo7-4-51)iti sūtre vārtikamupaṣṭambhakamityavadheyam|
odanaṃ pacatītyādāvatiprasaṅganivāraṇāya "bahulam" iti dvitīyaṃ vākyam| tacca pratyākhyātaṃ bhāṣye| duhipacyoriti hi karmakartṛviṣayakam, karmasthayā kriyayā tulyakriya eva vidhāyakaṃ niyāmakaṃ vā? ubhayathā'pi `odanaṃ pacati' ityādau prasaṅga eva nāstīti| na ca karmakartaryeva parasmaipadārthaṃ bahulavacanaṃ, tasyāniṣṭatvāditi dik|
sṛjiyujyoḥ śyaṃstu(kāovā)|| anayoḥ sakarmakayoḥ kartā bahulaṃ karmavadbhavatīti vaktavyam| yagapavādaśca śyan|
sṛje śraddhopapanne kartaryeveti vaktavyam(kāovāo)|| sṛjyate srajaṃ yujyate brahmacārī yogam| śyani sati praka-terādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| yaki tu lasārvadhātukānudāttatve yaka evodāttatvaṃ syāt| kaumudyāṃ tu "śraddhāvatkartṛkāt srajeryakciṇau kartari ke cit" ityuktam| tatra yagityaśuddham, ātmanepadānukteśca nyūnateti dik|
bhūṣākarmakirādisanāṃ cānyatrātmanepadāt(kāovāo)|| bhūṣāvācināṃ kirādīnāṃ sannantānāṃ ca yak‌ciṇau na bhavata iti vaktavyamityarthaḥ| alaṃ kurute kanyā svayameva| alamakṛta| bhūṣāphalasya śobhākhyasya karmaṇi darśanāt karmasthā bhūṣā| ṇyantānāṃ tu bhūṣārthānāṃ vakṣyamāṇenāpi yak ciṇoḥ pratiṣedhena siddhatvānneha mukhyodāharaṇatā-bhūṣayate kanyā svayameva| abubhūṣata kanyā svayameva| kirādi-avakirate hastī svayameva| avākīrṣṭa hastinaṃ kaścit| pāṃsvādinā'vakirati| tatra saukaryāt hastī kartṛtvena vivakṣyate| girate| agīrṣaṭa| kirādistudādyantargaṇaḥ| san--cikīrṣate kaṃṭaḥ svayameva| acikīrṣiṣṭa| ihecchāyāḥ kartṛsthatve'pi karotikriyāpekṣaṃ karmasthakriyatvam|
(pāosūo3-1-88)
tapastapaḥkarmakasyaiva(pāosūo3-1-88)|| tapa santāpe(bhvāopao1010)| asya karttā karmavatsyāt sa ca tapaḥkarmakasyaiva nānyakarmakasya| kriyābhedādvidhyarthametaditi vṛttiḥ| tathāhi, upavāsādīni tapāṃsi tāpasaṃ tapanti, duḥkhayantītyarthaḥ| tathā ca tāpasasya karmatve taperduḥkhanamarthaḥ| kartṛtve tu arjanamarthaḥ| tāpasastapyate, tapo'rjayatīti yāvat| nanvevamapi śarīrasantāpalakṣaṇakriyā avasthādvaye'pi tulyā, nahi śarīrasantāpādanyat arjanaṃ nāma tāpasasya vyāpāro'sti| tathā ca bhāṣyasammataṃ niyamārthatvameva vṛttikṛtā kuto nādṛtamiti cet?
atrāhuḥ, vastutaśśarīrasantāpasya sattve'pi śabdānna tattvena bhānaṃ kiṃ tvarjanatvenaiva| anyathā tapasaḥ karmatvānupapatteḥ| tathāca tulyakriyatvābhāvād vidhyarthataiveti| luṅi-atapta tapastāpasaḥ| "tapo'nutāpe ca"(pāosūo3-1-65)iti ciṇaḥ pratiṣedhātsic| tasya "jhalo jhali"(pāosūo8-2-26)iti lopaḥ| tapaḥkarmakasyeti kim? uttapati suvarṇaṃ suvarmakāraḥ| evakārastu vyartha eva| śrutasya tasya anvayo vaktavyaṃ iti cet?satyam, vākyaṃ bhittvā kathaṃcidanvayaḥ pradarśita eva|
(pāosūo3-1-89)
na duhasnunamāṃ yak‌ciṇau(pāosūo3-1-89)|| eṣāṃ yak‌ciṇau na staḥ| karmavadatideśena prāptayorayaṃ niṣedhaḥ, "anantarasya"(paobhāo63)iti nyātāt| tena śuddhe karmaṇi bhāve sta eva| duheranena yak‌niṣidhyate| ciṇ tu "duhaśca"(pāosūo3-1-63)iti sūtreṇa prāgeva vibhāṣitaḥ, dugdhe gauḥ svayameva| adugdha, adohi gauḥ svayameva| yakipratiṣiddhe śap, adāditvāttasya luk, "dādeḥ"(pāosūo8-2-32)iti ghaḥ, "jhaṣastathoḥ"(pāosūo8-2-40)iti dhatvam, jaś‌tvam| apradhāne duhādīnāmiti yasminkarmaṇi lakārastasya kartṛtvavivakṣā, pradhanaṃ karma tu karmaiva|
`svayaṃ pradugdhe'sya guṇairupasnutā vasūpamānasya vasūni medinī'|
itivat| ciṇabāve ksaḥ, lugvāduheti luk| prasnute| prāsnoṣṭa, ciṇi pratiṣiddhe sic| namate daṇḍaḥ svayameva| anaṃsta| antarbhāvitaṇyartho'tra namiḥ| tatra yathā `namayati daṇḍaṃ devadattaḥ' `namayate daṇḍaḥ svayameva' iti ṇyantasya karmasthakriyatvam, evamasyāpi draṣṭavyam|
yak‌ciṇoḥ pratiṣedhe hetumaṇṇiśribrūñāmupasaṃkhyānam(kāovāo)|| kārayate kaṭaḥ svayameva| acīkarata| ucchrayate daṇḍaḥ svayameva| udatvātkarmastham| bhāradvājīyāḥ paṭhanti-
ṇiśranthigranthibrūñātmanepadākarmakāṇāmupasaṃkhyānam|| iti ṇīti ṇiṅ‌ṇicoḥ sāmānyagrahaṇam| ṇijudāhṛtaḥ| ṇiḍaḥ-pucchamudasyati utpucchayate gauḥ| asyāntarbhāvitaṇyarthatāyām-utpucchayate gām| punaḥ saukaryātiśayena kartṛtvavivakṣāyām-utpucchayate gauḥ svayameva| udapupucchata| iha ṇyantāt yak‌ciṇoḥ pratiṣiddhayoḥ śapcaṅau bhavataḥ| kaumudyāṃ tu karmakartari caṅ netyāha| akārayiṣṭetyudāhṛtaṃ tadaśuddhameva| śrantha grantha sandarbhe(cuopao305,306)| curādāvādhṛṣīyau| tayorṇijabhāvapakṣe grahaṇam| granthati granthaṃ devadattaḥ| śranthati mekhalām| granthane granthaḥ svayameva| agranthiṣṭa| śranthate| aśranthiṣṭa| kryādāvapi imau paṭhyete, tayorapīha grahaṇam| śrathnīte grathnīte svayameva| ātmanepadavidhāvakarmakā ye dhātavo nirdiṣṭāste yadā'ntarbhāvitaṇyarthāḥ punaśca nivṛttapreṣaṇāsta ihodāharaṇam| tadyathā-"veḥ śabdakarmaṇaḥ" "akarmakācca"(pāosūo1-3-34,35)| vikurvate saindhavāḥ, valgantītyarthaḥ| tānvikaroti, valgayatītyarthaḥ| punaḥ saukaryātkartṛtve-vikurvate saindhavāḥ svayameva| vyakṛṣata| yattu vṛttau paṭhyate `āhanti māṇavakam, āhate māṇavakaḥ svayameva' iti, tadayuktam, `āhanti māṇavakam'| ityasya sakarmakatvādātmanepadābhāvācceti haradattaḥ|
anye tvāhuḥ-ātmanepadākarmaketi dhātūpalakṣaṇaṃ, hantiścāyam "āṅo yamahanaḥ"(pāosūo1-3-28)ityatra yadā karmāvivakṣayā akarmakaḥ, tadā ātmanepadasya nimittam| tasyātra sakarmakatve'pi aviruddhamudāharaṇamiti|
(pāosūo3-1-90)
kuṣirajoḥ prācāṃ śyan parasmaipadaṃ ca(pāosūo3-1-90)|| kuṣaniṣkarṣe(kryāpao46)| rañja rāge(bhvāouo1024)| anayordhātvoḥ karmakartari yak na syāt kintu śyan parasmaipadañca| ātmanepadāpavādaḥ| kuṣyati pādaḥ svayameva| rajyati vastraṃ svayameva| prācāṅgrahaṇaṃ vikalpārtham| kuṣyate| rajyate| "na duha"(pāosūo3-1-89)iti sūtrāt yak netyanuvarttya tasminneva sthale śyan vihitaḥ| tatsanniyogaśiṣṭaṃ ca parasmaipadam| tena āśīrliṅ‌liṭoḥ syādīnāṃ ca viṣaye śyan parasmaipade na bhavataḥ| koṣiṣīṣṭa pādaḥ svayameva| raṅkṣīṣṭa vastraṃ svayameva| cukuṣe| rarañje| koṣiṣyate| raṅ‌kṣyate| akoṣi| arañji ityādi| śyan‌yakoḥ svare numi ca viśeṣaḥ-kuṣyantī jaṅghā| śyani "śapśyanornityam"(pāosūo7-1-81)iti numāgamaḥ, nittvādādyudāttaśca| yaki tu "ācchīnadyoḥ"(pāosūo7-1-80)iti num‌vikalpaḥ lasārvadhātukānudāttatvena yaka evodāttatvaṃ ca syāt|
(pāosūo3-1-91)
dhātoḥ(pāosūo3-1-91)|| ātṛtīyasamāpteradhikāro'yam| yadyapi "dhātorekāco halādeḥ"(pāosūo3-1-22)iti sūtrāddhātugrahaṇamanuvartata eva, tathāpi ārddhadātukasaṃjñāyā āśritaśabdavyāpāratvalābhāya punardhātugrahaṇam| anyathā `lūbhyām' `pūbhyām' ityādau bhyāmāderiṭ prakṛterguṇaśca syāt| dhātorityevamavidhānāttu na bhavati| tathā kṛtsaṃjñā upapadasaṃjñā cāsminneva dātvadhikāre yathā syādityevamarthamapīdam| anyathā pūrvatrāpi syāt, tataśca `kariṣyati' ityatra syapratyayasya kṛtsaṃjñāyāṃ kṛdantasya prātipadikatve sorutpattiḥ syāt, ekavacanasyautsargikatvāt| "prātipadikārtha"(pāosūo2-3-46)iti sūtre vacanagrahaṇācca| tathā "cli luṅi"(pāosūo3-1-43)ityasya luṅante upapade clirityarthaḥ syāt| vāsarūpavidheśca pūrvatra pravṛttau ksādibhiḥ sicaḥ samāveśaḥ syāditi| tasmāt dhātoriti kartavyamiti sthitam| etacca śakyaṃ pratyākhyātum| tasmāt dhātoriti kartavyamiti sthitam| etacca śakyaṃ pratyākhyātum| tathāhi, "śami dhātoḥ"(pāosūo3-2-14) iti yaddhātugrahaṇaṃ tadeva dvitīyaṃ sārvadhātukārddhadhātukasaṃjñayoranuvartiṣyate| kṛdupapadasaṃjñe vāsarūpavidhiśca adhikāreṇaiva vyākhyāsyante| "pratyayaḥ" "paraśca"(pāosūo3-1-1,2)ityādivat| tena pūrvatra na tatprasaṅgaḥ|
(pāosūo3-1-92)
tatropapadaṃ saptamīstham(pāosūo3-1-92)|| saptamyante pade "karmaṇi" ityādau pratipādyatvena sthitaṃ kumbhādikaṃ saptamīsthaṃ tadvācakaṃ padamupapadasaṃjñaṃ syāt, tasmiṃśca satyeva vakṣyamāṇaḥ pratyayaḥ syāt, mahāsaṃjñākaraṇasāmarthyāt| padamatra saṃjñi| tena samarthaparibhāṣā vyāpriyate| saṃjñāpradeśā "upapadamatiṅ"(pāosūo2-2-19)ityādayaḥ|
(pāosūo3-1-93)
kṛdatiṅ(pāosūo3-1-93)| asmin dhātvadhikāre tiṅ‌bhinnaḥ pratyayaḥ kṛtsañjñaḥ syāt| kartavyam| karaṇīyam| atiṅa kim? cīyāt| sañjñāpradeśāḥ kṛttaddhitasamāsāścetyevamādayaḥ| "atiṅ" iti śakyamakartum| kathaṃ cīyāditi? jñāpakātsiddham| "akṛtsārvadātukayoḥ"(pāosūo7-4-25)iti sūtre akṛdityeva siddhe punaḥ sāvdātukagrahaṇaṃ jñāpayati `na tiṅāṃ kṛtsañjñā bhavati' iti| na ca śyannivṛttyarthaṃ sārvadhātukagrahaṇamiti vācyam, divādiṣu hrasvāntasya dīrghārhasyābhāvena vyāvarttyāprasiddheḥ| bhāṣye tu tiṅāṃ kṛtsañjñāyāmiṣṭāpattiḥ kṛtā| na caivaṃ tiṅantasya prātipadikatvātsvādyutpattiḥ syāditi vācyam, tiṅā ekatvāderuktatvāt| na ca vacanagrahaṇādukte'pi tadāpattiḥ, `ekaḥ' ityādau caritārthatvāt| "atiśāyane tamabiṣṭhanau" 'tiṅaśca'(pāosūo5-3-55,56)ityanena tiṅantānāmasubantatvajñāpanāt| na caivamapi `pacati' `paṭhati' ityatra "hrasvasya piti kṛti"(pāosūo6-1-71)iti tukprasaṅgaḥ, tugvidhau 'dhātvādeḥ"(pāosūo6-1-64)iti sūtrāt dhātugrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| evamapi `cikīrṣati' `jihīrṣati' ityādau syāditi cet? na, śapā vyavadhānāt| ekādeśe kṛte nāsti vyavadhānamiti cet? na, ekādeśasya pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhāvāt| na ca sthānivadbhāvaṃ bādhitvā paratvādantavadbhāvaḥ, tasya pratyākhyāsyamānatvāt| na caivamapi "atiṅ" iti pratyākhyāyamāne `paceran' ityatra prātipadikāntatvānnalopaḥ syāditi vācyam, 'jhasya ran"(pāosūo3-4-105)iti nakāroccāraṇasāmarthyādeva lopāprāvṛtteḥ| iha tarhi `cīyāt' iti kṛdyakāratvāddīrgho na syāditi cet? naiṣa doṣaḥ, sārvadātukapratiṣedho jñāpayati "akṛtīti pratiṣedhaḥ tiṅkṣu na pravartate" iti| na caivamapi tiṅsamāse kṛduttarapadasvaraḥ syāditi vācyam, iṣṭāpatteḥ, `yo jāta eva paryabhūṣāt' ityādau tathaiva pāṭhasya nirvivādatvāt gatikārakopapadātkṛt"(pāosūo6-2-139)iti sūtre kṛdgrahaṇasya pratyākhyāsyamānatvācceti dik|
|| iti śrīśabdakaustubhe tṛtīyādhyāyasya prathame pāde pañcamamānhikam ||
|| tṛtīyādhyāyasya prathame pāde ṣaṣṭhamānhikam ||
(pāosūo3-1-94)
vā'sarūpo'striyām(pāosūo3-1-94)|| paribhāṣeyam| asmindhātvadhikāre stryadhikāravyatirekeṇa yatrāsarūpo'pavādapratyayo vidhīyate tatra vetyupatiṣṭhate| evañca "dadātidadhātyorvibhāṣā"(pāosūo3-1-139)ityādivadvaikalpikatvenaiva apavāde śāstrātpramite tadvadeva pakṣe utsargaḥ pravartate| igupadhajñāprīkiraḥ ko'pavādaḥ tadviṣaye ṇvul‌tṛcāvapi bhavataḥ| vikṣepakaḥ vikṣeptā, vikṣipaḥ| nacaivam "āto'nupasarge kaḥ"(pāosūo3-2-3)iti kasya viṣaye "karmaṇyaṇ"(pāosūo3-2-1)ityapi pakṣe pravarteta| sarūpo'sāviti cet? kiṃ tataḥ? guṇavṛddhiśāstreṣvik‌padasyeva kavidhau veti padasya upasthitirhi jñātaiva| anyathā ṇvulāderapi durlabhatvāt| satyāñca vetyasyopasthitau kathaṃ sarūpasyāpi pakṣe pravṛttirnabhavediti cet? satyam, asarūpagrahaṇasāmarthyāt yampratyasarūpatā taṃ pratyevāsya pākṣikatā, anyaṃ tu prati bādhakataiveti na kaściddoṣaḥ| tataśca asarūpo'pavādapratyaya utsargasya vā bādhakaḥ syāditi phalito'rthaḥ| astriyāṃ kim? cikīrṣā| atra ktinna bhavati| strīgrahaṇaṃ svaryate| svaritenādhikāragatirbhavatīti "striyāṃ ktin"(pāosūo3-3-94)ityadhikāre vikalpo neti siddhāntaḥ| yadi tu striyāmabhidheyāyāṃ netyucyeta tadā `vikṣepikā' 'vikṣeptrī' iti kaviṣaye ṇvul‌tṛcau na syātām| athāpi `striyām' ityevaṃśabdamuccārya vihite niṣedhaḥ ityucyet, tarhi `vyāvakrośī' `vyāvakruṣṭiḥ' iti karmavyatihāre ṇaco viṣaye ktinna syāt| dvayorapi `striyām' ityuccārya vidānāt|
atra kecit-utsargāpavādayordvayorapi stryadhikāraniveśitatve sati pratiṣedho'yamityāhuḥ| anye tu apavādamātrasyāpīti| tatrārdya mate `āsanā' `āsyā' stryadhikāravihitenāpi yucā'pavādena saha ṛhalorṇyataḥ(pāosūo3-1-124)samāveśaḥ sidhyati| ghañastu ktinādinā'nabhidhānānna samāveśaḥ| dvitīyapakṣe tu ghañaḥ ktinnādibhirasamāveśaḥ sidhyati| `āsyā' ityatra tu "kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam"(pāosūo3-3-113)iti ṇyaditi viveka-| nanviha sārūpyaṃ prayoge upadeśe vā? nādyaḥ, `grāmaṇīḥ' `grāmarṇyaḥ' iti kvibādiviṣaye'ṇādīnāmapravṛttiprasaṅgāt| na hi kvibādayaḥ prayoge rūpavantaḥ, lopavidhānāt| nāntyaḥ, anubandhabhinneṣu kaṇaprabhṛtiṣvatiprasaṅgāditi cet? na, anubandhānāmanekāntatvena dvitīyapakṣe doṣābhāvāt| ekāntatve'pi "nānubandhakṛtamasārūpyam"(paobhāo8)"dadātidadhātyorvibhāṣā"(pāosūo3-1-139)iti liṅgāt| anyathā'nubandhakṛtādasārūpyādeva `dadaḥ' `dadhaḥ' iti śaviṣaye `dāyaḥ' `dhāyaḥ' ṇo'pi itibhaviṣyatīti kiṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇena? anityeyaṃ vāsarūpaparibhāṣā "arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca"(pāosūo3-3-169)ityatra kṛtyatṛj‌grahaṇālliṅgāt| tena "ktalyuṭatumun‌khalartheṣu vā'sarūpavidhirna bhavati"(paobhāo77)iti siddhāntaḥ| hasitaṃ hasanaṃ chātrasya| atra ktalyuḍ‌viṣaye ghañ na| tuman-icchati bhoktum| atra "icchārtheṣu liṅloṭau"(pāosūo3-3-157)iti loṇnabhavati| liṅ tu bhavatyeva, "liṅca"(pāosūo3-3-159)iti vacanāt| evaṃ cāsmādeva niyamādiha loṭ supariharaḥ| ato'tra tumun‌grahaṇamāpātataḥ| khalarthaḥ-ātoyuc īṣatpānaḥ atra khal na bhavati| nanu stryadikārādūrdhvaṃ 'vā'sarūpa"(pāosūo3-1-94)nyāyo nāstī tyevāśrīyatām| maivam, `āsitvā bhuṅkte' `āsyate bhoktum' ityādyasiddhiprasaṅgāt| iha hi bhojanārthatvādāsanasya pūrvakālatā gamyate| ktvāpratyayaśca tumarthādhikārādbhāve tatraiva ca lakāra iti samānaviṣayatvādbādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ syāt| "praiṣātisarga"(pāosūo3-3-163)iti sūtre "striyāṃ ktin"(pāosūo3-3-94)ityata ūrdhvaṃ vāsarūpavidherabhāvāditi kaumudīgranthastu ākaraviruddha iti dik|
(pāosūo3-1-95)
kṛtyāḥ(pāosūo3-1-95)| adhikāro'yam| avadhiviśeṣastu jñāpakātsiddhaḥ| 'arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca"(pāosūo3-3-169)iti sūtre `kṛtyāḥ' ityeva vaktavye ta़j‌grahaṇaṃ yogāpekṣaṃ jñāpakam-`ṇvul‌tṛcāvityetadyogātprāk kṛtyasaṃjñā'dikriyate' iti| saṃjñāpradeśāḥ-'kṛtyānāṃ kartari vā"(pāosūo2-3-31)ityādayaḥ bahuvacanamanuktasamuccayārtham| tena "kelimara upasaṃkhyānam"(kāovāo)ityādi sūtreṇaiva sūcitaṃ bhavati| atra sūtre vṛttikāraḥ "prāṅ ṇvulaḥ" iti pracikṣepa|
(pāosūo3-1-96)
tavyattavyānīyaraḥ(pāosūo3-1-36)|| dhātorevaite pratyayāḥ syuḥ| takārarephau svarārthau| karttavyam| karaṇīyam|
vasestavyatkartari ṇicca(kāovāo)|| vasa nivāse(bhvāopao1030)ityasya grahaṇam, na tu vasa ācchādane(aoāo13)ityasya lugvikaraṇasya| tayoreveti vacanāt karttari na prāpnotīti vacanam| vasatīti vāstavyaḥ| taddhitānto vā| vāstuni bhavo vāstavyaḥ| digāditvādyat| `avāstavyaḥ' ityatra svarabhedo'pi nāsti| tavyat‌pratyaye hi 'kṛtyokeṣṇuccārvādayaśca"(pāosūo6-2160)ityantodāttatvam| yatpratyaye tu "yayatoścātadarthe"(pāosūo6-2-156)ityaneneti|
kelimara upasaṃkhyānam(kāovāo)|| kṛtyā iti bahuvanenaitatsūcitamityuktam| kakāro guṇavṛddhiniṣedhārthaḥ| rephaḥ svarārthaḥ| pacelimā māṣāḥ| paktavyāḥ| bhidelimāḥ saralāḥ| bhettavyāḥ| śuddhe karmaṇi pratyayo bhāṣye sthitaḥ| vṛttikārastu karmakartari cāyamiṣyate ityāha| tadbhāṣya viruddham|
(pāosūo3-1-97)
aco yat(pāosūo3-1-97)|| ajantāddhātoryatsyāt| ceyam| jeyam| nanu pūrvasūtre eva yadapi nirdiśyatām, aj‌grahaṇaṃ ca māstu, halantāṇṇyataṃ vakṣyati, puriśeṣādajantebhya eva yad bhaviṣyati iti cet? ajantabhūtapūrvādapi yathā syādityevamarthamidam| ditsyaṃ, dhitsyam| iha hi dāño dhāñaśca sannantasya `ditsa' `dhitsa' iti sthite ārddhadātuke iti viṣayasaptamīmāśritya sano'to lope kṛte sāmpratikaṃ halanta tvamastīti ṇyatsyāt| aj‌grahaṇāttu bhutapūrvamajantatvamāśritya yadbhavati| tena "yato'nāva-"(pāosūo6-1-213)ityādyudāttatvam| ṇyati tu kṛte titsvaritatvaṃ syāt| `cikīrṣyam' ityādau tu ṇyadyatorviśeṣo nāsti| "yato'nāvaḥ" ityatra dvyaj‌grahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| 'ārddhadhātuke" ityasya parasaptamītve tu ihāj‌grahaṇaṃ na karttavyameva|
takiśasicatiyatijanīnāmupasaṃkhyānam(kāovāo)|| taka hasane(bhvāopao117)| śasu hiṃsāyām(bhvāopao728)| cate yācane(bhvāouo890)| yatī prayatne(bhvāoāo30)| janī prādurbhāve(dioāo43)| takyam| śasyam| catyam| yatyam| janyam| atra janeryadvidhānaṃ 'yato'nāvaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-213)iti svarārthaṃ "janivadhyośca"(pāosūo7-3-35)iti vṛddhiniṣedhena ṇyatyapi rūpe viśeṣābhāvāt| iha śaṃsimapi kocitpaṭhantīti haradattaḥ| tena "tadvānnarāśaṃsyaṃ rādhyaṃ ca" atrādyudāttaḥ sidhyati| apāṭhapakṣe tu ṇyantādaco yati sidhyatīti bodhyamiti| vadanti| tadetatsarvam "īḍavanda"(pāosūo6-1-214)ityādisūtravismaraṇamūlakatvādupekṣyam|
hano vā vadhaśca(kāovāo)|| hantervā yat, tatsanniyogena ca vadhādeśo vaktavya ityarthaḥ| vadhyaḥ| ghātyaḥ| yadabhāve ṇyat, "hanasto'cipaṇaloḥ"(pāosūo7-3-32)iti tatvam| "ho hanteḥ"(pāosūo7-3-54)iti kutvam| yadyapi `vadhamarhatīti vadhyaḥ' iti rūpaṃ yadityanuvartamāne "daṇḍādibhyaḥ"(pāosūo5-1-66)iti taddhitena yatā'pi sidhyati tathāpi `asivadhyaḥ' `musalavadhyaḥ' ityatra samāso na sidhyet| kṛti punaḥ "kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā"(pāosūo2-1-32)iti sidhyati| na ca asivadhamarhatīti vigrahe kṛtasamāsādeva taddhito'stviti vācyam, daṇḍādiṣu kevalasya vadhaśabdasya pāṭhāt| tadantavidheśca pratiṣedhāt svare bhedācca| asivadhaśabdādyati hi "titsvaritam"(pāosūo6-1-185)iti svaritaḥ prasajyeta| kṛdantena samāse tu kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvarema vadhyaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| ata eva vadhyaśabdena taddhitāntena saha "supsupā"(pāosūo2-1-4)iti samāsa ityapi na vācyam, antodāttaprasaṅgāt| vadhyaśabde kṛttaddhitānte prakārakṛtaviśeṣasya sattvācca| etena "girau ḍaśchandasi"(kāovāo)iti vārtikapratyākhyānaparaṃ bhāṣyamapyapāstam| ata eva "kṛtalabdhakrītakuśalāḥ"(pāosūo4-3-38)ityādīnāṃ cāritārthyamiti dik|
atratyabhāṣyādiparyālocanayā asamastavadhyaśabde viśeṣābhāva iti labhyate| tathā ca daṇḍādibhya ityeva sūtraṃ, yaccānuvartate| daṇḍādibhyo ya iti niranubandhapāṭhastu prāmādika iti mādhavo hantidhātau sphuṭīcakāra| haradattagranthaparyālocane tu idaṃ ca vacanaṃ yadvidhau bhāṣyādau paṭhitamapi kyabvidhau "mṛjervibhāṣā"(pāosūo3-1-113)ityasyāgre eva pāṭhyamityeva bhāṣyatātparyaṃ yuktam, vikalpākaraṇena laghutvāditi labhyate| tasminnapi pakṣe vadhyaśabdo dhātusvaremādyudāttaḥ, kyaptu pittvādanudāttaḥ| na ca nañsamāse "yayatoścātadarthe"kṛtyokaṣṇuccārvādayaśca"(pāosūo6-2-160)ityasya pravṛttyeṣṭasiddheḥ| asamaste eva viśeṣābhāvasya pratipādyatvācca|
(pāosūo3-1-98)
poradupadhāt(pāosūo3-1-98)|| pavargāntādakāropadhāt dhātoryat syāt| ṇyato'pavādaḥ| śapyam| labhyam| poḥ kim? vākyam| "cajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ"(pāosūo7-3-52)iti kutvam| adupadhātkim? kopyam| taparakaraṇaṃ kim? āpyam| kupa kopane(diopao127)āplṛ vyāptau(svāopao14)ābhyāṃ ṇyati titsvaraḥ| yati tu "yato'nāvaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-213)iti syāt|

gadamadacarayamaścānupasarge(pāosūo3-1-100)|| vyatyayena pañcamyarthe saptamī| ebhyo'nupasargebhyo yatsyāt| gadyam| madyam| caryam| yamyam| anupasarge kim? "na naiṣadhe kāryamidaṃ nigādyam"| pramādyam| pracāryam| yameḥ pūrveṇaiva siddhe niyamārthaṃ vacanam "anupasargādeva yathā syāt sopasargānmā bhūt" iti| kathaṃ tarhi 'tena na tatra bhavedviniyamyam" "aniyamyasya nāyuktiḥ" "tvayā niyamyā nanu divyacakṣuṣā" ityādi? pramādapāṭha evāyam| `viniyāmyam' ityādi dīrgha eva tu paṭhanīya iti haradattaḥ| niyame sāghurniyamya iti "tatra sādhuḥ"(pāosūo4-4-98)iti yadityanye| kevalādyataṃ kṛtvā niśabdena samāsa ityapare|
carerāṅi cāgurau(kāovāo)|| sopasargārthaṃ vārtikam| ācaryo deśaḥ| gantavya ityarthaḥ| agurau kim? ācāryo guruḥ|
(pāosūo3-1-101)
avadyapaṇyavaryā garhyapaṇitavyānirodheṣu(pāosūo3-1-101)|| avadyādayastrayo yathāsaṃkhyaṃ garhyādiṣvartheṣu nipātyante| tatra vadernañi upapade "vadaḥ supi kyapū ca"(pāosūo3-1-106)iti yatkyapoḥ prāptayoryadeva yathā syāt, so'pi garhāyāmeva yathā syādityubhayārthaṃ nipātanam| avadyaṃ pāpam| avacanārhatvāt| garhye kim? anudyaṃ gurunām| taddhi na garhyaṃ vacanārhaṃ tu na bhavati,
ātmanāma gurornāma nāmātikṛpaṇasya ca|
śreyaskāmo na gṛhṇīyāt jyeṣṭhāpatyakalatrayoḥ||
iti smṛteḥ| atra "vadaḥ supi"(pāosūo3-1-106)iti kyabeva bhavati| yajāditvāt samprasāraṇam| "nalopo naña" "tasmānnuḍaci"(pāosūo6-3-73,74)paṇervyavahārārthāt ṇyati prāpte yat vidhīyate| paṇyaḥ kambalaḥ| paṇyā gauḥ| pāṇyam anyat| stutyarham ityarthaḥ| `paṇitavya' śabdasya sādhāraṇatve'pi nipātanasya rūḍhyarthatvāt paṇyaśabdasya vyavahartavye eva rūḍhatvādarthaniyamo labhyate| uktañca-
dhātusādhanakālānāṃ prāptyarthaṃ niyamasya ca|
anubandhavikārāṇāṃ rūḍhyarthaṃ ca nipātanam|| iti|
vṛṅ‌sambhaktau(kryāoāo37)asmādyat aprativandhośatena sahasreṇa varyā kanyā| śatasahasraśabdāvaniyatavacanau, kanyāyā varaṇe varayitṝṇāṃ niyamo nāstītyarthaḥ| `vṛṅa' evedaṃ nipātanam, tatraiva anirodhasambhavāt| tena `vṛñ varaṇe'(svāouo8)ityasmāt "etistuśās"(pāosūo3-1-109)ityādinā kyabeva, vṛtyā| iha sūtre avadyādīni avibhaktikāni pṛthak padāni, na tu dvandvasya jasantasya nirddeśaḥ| tena `varyā' iti striyāmeva nipātyate| astriyāntu "ṛhaloḥ"(pāosūo3-3-124)iti ṇyadeva-vāryā ṛtvijaḥ, iti vṛttikāramatam| na cātra "etistu"(pāosūo3-1-109)iti kyap śaṅkyaḥ, tatra 'vṛña' eva grahaṇaṃ na tu `vṛṅa' iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt|
bhaṭṭistu dvandvājjasā nirddeśaṃ manvānaḥ pulliṅge'pi yataṃ prāyuṅkta-
sugrīvo mama varyo'sau bhavatā cāruvikramaḥ| iti|
puruṣottamādayo'pyevam|
(pāosūo3-1-102)
vahyaṃ karaṇam(pāosūo3-1-102)|| vahyaṃ nipātyate karaṇaṃ cedbhavati| vahantyaneneti vahyaṃ śakaṭam| karaṇe kim? vāhyam anyat, vahanakarmetyarthaḥ|
(pāosūo3-1-103)
aryaḥ svāmivaiśyayoḥ(pāosūo3-1-103)|| ṛ gatau(bhvāopao961)asmāt ṇyati prāpte yat nipātyate| aryaḥ svāmī vaiśyo vā| svāmi vaiśyayoḥ kim? āryo brāhmaṇaḥ| prāptavya ityarthaḥ| atra bhāṣye `svāminyantodāttatvañca' ityuktam| vaiśye tu "yato'nāvaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-213)iti ādyudāttameva| atha yo vaiśyaḥ svāmī ca tatra kathamiti cet? vaiśyatvavivakṣāyāmādyudāttam, svāmitvavivakṣāyāmantodāttam| ata eva `aryaḥ svāmyākhyā cet' iti phiṭ‌sūtre ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| tathā cedṛśe viṣaye yugapadarthadvayavivakṣā na kartavyaiveti phalito'rthaḥ|
(pāosūo3-1-104)
upasaryā kālyā prajane(pāosūo3-1-104)|| upapūrvātsṛdātorbhauvādikāt jauhotyādikācca yat nipātyate prathamagarbhagrahaṇe prāptakālā cet| upasaryā gauḥ, garbhādhānārthaṃ vṛṣabheṇopagantuṃ yogyā ityarthaḥ| kālyāprajane iti kim? upasāryā śaradi madhurā, prāptavyā ityarthaḥ| karmaṇiṃ ṇyat| `kālyā' ityatra `tadasyaprāptam' iti varttamāne "kālādyat"(pāosūo5-1-107)iti yat| prajananaṃ prajanaḥ, bhāve ghañ| "janivadhyośca"(pāosūo7-3-35)iti vṛddhiniṣedhaḥ|
(pāosūo3-1-105)
ajaryaṃ saṅgatam(pāosūo3-1-105)|| nañ‌pūrvājjīryateḥ karttari yannipātyate saṅgataṃ cet viśeṣyam| `saṅgatam' iti napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ| na jīryatītyajaryaṃ satāṃ saṅgatam| iha `ajaryam' iti samudāyasya saṅgataṃ vācyam ityartho na grāhyaḥ, udāharaṇe sahaprayogānupapatteḥ| na ca `ghaṭaḥ kalaśaḥ' itivat vyākhyānaparatayā sahaprayogaḥ,
tena saṅgatamāryeṇa rāmājaryaṃ kuru drutam|
iti bhaṭṭiprayogāt|
mṛgairajaryaṃ jarasopadiṣṭamadehabandhāya punarbabandha|
iti kālidāsaprayogastu `saṅgatam' ityadhyāhṛtya vyākhyeyaḥ| saṅgataṃ kim? ajaritā kambalaḥ| karttari nipātanam ityuktatvāt bhāve saṅgatakartṛke'pi ṇyadeva bhavati|`ajāryaṃ saṅgatena' iti|
(pāosūo3-1-106)
vadaḥ supi kyap ca(pāosūo3-1-106)|| `anupasarge iti vartate' iti vṛttikṛt| vaderdhātoranupasarge supyupapade kyap syāt cādyat| brahmodyam, brahmavadyam, bhāve kyap pūrvavatsamprasāraṇam| brahma vedaḥ, tasya vadanamityarthaḥ| nanu sakarmakādbhāve kṛt pratyayo durlabhaḥ, "bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ" "tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ"(pāosūo3-4-69,70)iti vakṣyamāṇatvāditi cet? satyam, uttarasūtrādiha bhāvagrahaṇasyāpakarṣaṇānnoktadoṣaḥ| iha sūtre anupasargagrahaṇasyānuvṛttiryadyapi vṛttibhāṣyādiṣu sthitā, tathāpi sā nāvaśyakī, "satsūdviṣa"(pāosūo3-2-61)iti sūtre upasargagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam-`anyatra subgrahaṇe upasargagrahaṇaṃ na' iti vakṣyamāṇena gatārthatvāt| `sarvathā'pyupasarge na' iti phalaṃ nirvivādam| teneha ṇyadeva-pravādyam, anuvādyam, apavādyam| yattu bhaṭṭavārttike `anūdyam' iti prayuktaṃ vyākaraṇādhikaraṇe, tatra niścayārthenuśabde upapade kyapaṃ vidhāya nañsamāse sati kathañcitsamādheyamiti nyāyasudhāyāmeva spaṣṭam|
(pāosūo3-1-107)
bhuvo bhāve(pāosūo3-1-3-1-107)|| bhavateranupasarge supyupapade kyap syāt bhāve| yattu nānuvarttate, pūrvasūtra cānukṛṣṭatvāt| brahmaṇo bhāvo brahmabhūyam| supi ityeva-bhavyam| anupasarge ityeva-prabhavyam| nanu anupasarge bhavatirakarmakaḥ, tasmādbhāve eva bhaviṣyati, tatkiṃ bhāvagrahaṇeneti cet? maivam, prāptyarthātkarmaṇi prasaṅgātsattārthakādapi kālādikarmaṇi prasaṅgāt uttarārthatvācca|
(pāosūo3-1-108)
hanasta ca(pāosūo3-1-1-8)|| hanterdhātoranupasarge subante upapade bhāve kyap syāt takāraścāntādeśaḥ| brahmahatyā| etatsūtravihitakyappratyayāntasya svabhāvāt strīliṅgatvameva loke| chandasi tu klībatāpīṣyate| sanādeva dasyuhatyāya jajñiṣe|
chandasi striyāṃ kyap cidvaktavyaḥ(kāovāo)|| tarati brahmahatyāṃ yo'śvamedhena yajate| supīti kim? ghāto varttate| ṇyattu na bhavati, sakarmakādbhāve vidhānābhāvāt| karmāvivakṣāyāmakarmakatve'pi na bhavati, anabhidānāt| anupasarge ityeva| praghāto varttate|
(pāosūo3-1-109)
etistuśāsvṛdṛjuṣaḥ kyap(pāosūo3-1-109)|| supyanupasarge bhāva iti nivṛttm| ebhyaḥ kyap syāt| `eti' iti iṇa eva grahaṇaṃ neṅikoḥ, tayoradhipūrvayoreva prayogāt `eti' iti nirddeśānupapatteḥ| tathā ca 'rakṣārthaṃ vedānāmadyevaṃ vyākaraṇam" iti bhāṣye yadeva prayuktaḥ| kecittu "iṇvadika iti vaktavyam"(kāovāo)iti vacanādadhītyamityudāharanti| ityaḥ| kathantarhi upeyamiti?īṅa gatau(dioāo37)iti daivādikādyat| stutyaḥ| śiṣyaḥ, "śāsa idaṅhaloḥ"(pāosūo6-4-34)iti itvam, "śāsivasi"(pāosūo8-3-60)iti ṣatvam| `āṅaḥ śāsu icchāyām"(aoāo12)ityasyāpi grahaṇam, aviśeṣāt| tena `āśāsyam' iti dhātusvareṇa madhyodāttaṃ padaṃ bhavati| ṇyati tu "gatikārakopapadātkṛt" iti antasvaritatvaṃ syāt| kecittu "śāsu anuśiṣṭau'(aopao65)ityasyaiva grahaṇamicchanti| `vṛ' iti vṛño grahaṇaṃ na vṛṅaḥ pūrvottarasāhacaryeṇobhayapadino grahaṇāj jñāpakāt| yadayaṃ "īḍavandavṛśaṃsaduhāṃ ṇyataḥ"(pāosūo6-1-21)iti vāryāśabdasyādyudāttatvaṃ śāsti| tatra hi īḍivandibhyām akāravadvikaraṇaprakṛtibhyāṃ sāhacaryāt ātmanepadino vṛṅo grahaṇam| vṛtyaḥ| dṛtyaḥ| juṣyaḥ| `kyap' iti vartamāne punaḥ kyabgrahaṇaṃ bādhakabādhanārtham| tena "orāvaśyake"(pāosūo3-1-125)iti ṇyataṃ bādhitvā kyabeva bhavati| tathāhi, iha sūtre stautergrahaṇasyāvakāśa āvaśyakāvivakṣāyāṃ stutya iti, "orāvaśyake" ityasyāvakāśo `avaśyalāvyam'| `avaśyastutyaḥ' ityatra ubhayaprasaṅge paratvāt ṇyat syāt, punaḥ kyabgrahaṇāt kyabeva bhavati|
śaṃsiduhiguhibhyo veti vaktavyam(kāovāo)|| śasyam, śaṃsyam| duhyam, dohyam| guhyam, gohyam| etacca vṛttāveva sthitam| bhāṣye tu nāsti tatra "praśasyasya śraḥ"(pāosūo5-3-60)"iḍavandavṛśaṃsaduhāṃ ṇyataḥ"(pāosūo6-1-214)iti sūtradvayaprāmāṇyāt śaṃseḥ siddham| itarayostu mūlaṃ mṛgyam|
āṅpūrvādañjeḥ saṃjñāyāmupasaṃkhyānam(kāovāo)|| añjū vyakti mrakṣaṇādiṣu(ruopao21)| asmāt bāhulakātkaraṇe kyap| 'aniditāṃ hala"(pāosūo6-4-24)iti nalopaḥ, ājyam| nanu ṇyatyeva nalopaḥ kasmānnokta iti cet? na, kutvaprasaṅgāt, titsvaraprasaṅgācca| tasmātkyabanta evāyam| nanvevamavagrahaḥ prāpnoti, na ceṣṭāpattiḥ, "ājyaṃ kimāsītparidhiḥ ka āsīt" ityādau padakārastaidakaraṇāt iti cet?
atra bhāṣyam-na lakṣaṇena padakārā anuvartyāḥ padakāraistu lakṣaṇamanuvarttyamiti| ayamāśayaḥ-saṃhitaiva nityā padavicchedastu pauruṣeyaḥ| ana evārthaviniścayābhāvānnāvagṛhṇanti| yathā `haridrava' iti| atra kiṃ hariśabda ikārāntaḥ, uta haricchabstakārānta iti sandehaḥ, kiñca "vanena vāyaḥ" iti mantre "veti caya iti ca cakāra śākalyaḥ" ityupanyasya "udāttaṃ tvevamākhyātamabhaviṣyat" iti adhāyiśabde aṭ‌svaraprasaṅgena dūṣayitvā verapatyaṃ `vāya' ityekapadyena siddhāntaṃ kurvan yāskaḥ padavibhāgasya pauruṣeyatvaṃ spaṣṭamevācaṣṭe| api ca sati padatve avagrahaḥ, asati tu na, iti dvayamapi prāyovādamātraṃ sampradāyānurodhāgātum" ityādau avagrahābhāvāt "īyivāṃsamatistridhaḥ" devayanto yathāmatim" ityādāvavagrahācceti dik|
prakriyākaumudyāntu `aja gatau kṣepaṇe ca' (bhvāopao230)ityasya `ājyam' ityuktaṃ, tattu bhāṣyaviruddham, arthānanuguṇañca, iti prāmāṇikairupekṣvameva|
(pāosūo3-1-110)
ṛdupadhāccāklṛpicṛteḥ(pāosūo3-1-110)|| ṛkāropadhāddhātoḥ kyap syāt klṛpicṛtī varjayitvā| vṛt-vṛtyam| vṛdh-va-dyam| aklṛpicṛteriti kim? kṛp sāmarthye(bhvāoāo763)kalpyam| kṛperlatvasyāsiddhatvāt ṛkāralṛkārayoḥ savarmasaṃjñāvidhānācca ṛdupadhatvam| cṛti hiṃsāgranthanayoḥ(tuopao44)cartyam| taparakaraṇaṃ kim? kṝta saṃśaṣdane(cuopao120), ṇijabhāve ṇayadeva bhavati| kīrtyam| idameva ca taparakaraṇaṃ liṅgam, "anityaṇyantāścurādayaḥ" ityatra| ṇijantāttu ṇilope kṛte cākṛte ca ditsyamitivadyadeva| tena "yato'nāvaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-213)ityādyudāttatā bhavati|
(pāosūo3-1-111)
ī ca khanaḥ(pāosūo3-1-111)|| khanaḥ kvap syāt īkāraścāntādeśaḥ| dīrghanirddeśaḥ praśleṣārthaḥ| tatra dvitīya ikāro "ye vibhāṣā"(pāosūo6-4-43)ityātvabādhanārthaḥ| anvathā "ye vibhāṣā" ityasyāvakāśaḥ-`khāyate' `khanyate'| itvasyāvakāśaḥ yasminpakṣe ātvaṃ nāsti| ātvapakṣe ubhayaprasaṅge paratvādantaraṅgatvāccātvaṃ syāt| "ye vibhāṣā" iti viṣayasaptamī| tathā ca yakārādau buddhisthe eva bhavadātvamantaraṅgam| ayaṃtvikāraḥ kyapā saha vidhānādvahiraṅgaḥ| tadittham-"ye vibhāṣā" iti viṣayasaptamīti pakṣamāśritya sūtrakṛtā dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kṛtam| bhāṣyakṛtā tu parasaptamīmāśritya pratyākhyātam| tathāhi, parasaptamīpakṣe itvamantaraṅgam, paranimittamanapekṣya vidhānāt| kyapsanniyogaśiṣṭaṃ hi tat| tathāca tadevātvasya bādhakam| nanu hrasvādeśe tasya pūrveṇa saha ād guṇe satyapi "ṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-86)iti ekādeśasyāsiddhatayā "hrasvasya piti kṛti tuk"(pāosūo6-1-71)iti tuk syāt ato dīrgha eva vidheyaḥ iti cet? na, padāntapadādyorekādeśastugvidāvasiddhaḥ, na, tvanyo'pi iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt| anyathā `vṛkṣe chatram' ityatra ṅau ād‌guṇasvāsiddhatvāt "che ca'(pāosūo6-1-73)iti hrasvāśrayo nityastuk syāt, iṣyate tu "dīrghāt" "padāntādvā'(pāosūo6-1-75,76)iti dik| kheyam|
(pāosūo3-1-112)
bhṛño'saṃjñāyām(pāosūo3-1-112)|| kyap syāt| bhṛtvāḥ karmakarāḥ, bharttavvā ityarthaḥ| tathā ca kriyāśabdo'yaṃ, na tu saṃjñā|
samaśca bahulam(kāovāo)|| asaṃjñāyāmeva| sūtreṇa nitvaṃ prāptasya kyapo vikalpārthamidaṃ vārttikam| sambhūtyāḥ, sambhāryāḥ| asaṃjñāyāṃ kimi? bhāryo nāma kṣatriyaḥ|
saṃjñāyāṃ puṃsi dṛṣṭatvānna te bhāryā prasidhyati|
striyāṃ bhāvādhikāro'sti tena bhāryā prasidhyati||
athavā bahulaṃ kṛtyāḥ saṃjñāyāmiti ca smṛtam|
yathā patyaṃ yathā janyaṃ yathā bhittistathaiva sā||
asyārthaḥ-te tava sūtrakārasya bhāryāśabdo na sidhyati, ṇayataṃ bādhitvā "saṃjñāyāṃ samajaniṣada"(pāosūo3-3-99)ityādinā kyapaḥ prasaṅgāt| nanu "nṛño'saṃjñāyām"(pāosūo3-1-112)iti prakṛtasūtre saṃjñāyāṃ niṣedhasāmarthyāt "saṃjñāyām"(pāosūo3-3-99)ityādisūtrāntaraprāpto'pi kyap bhṛñaḥ saṃjñāyāṃ na bhaviṣyati| na caiva tatra "saṃjñāyām" ityasya vaiyarthyaṃ, dhātvantareṣu caritārthatvāt, ityāśaṅkyāha-saṃjñāyāmityādi| pratiṣedhasyeti śeṣaḥ, `asaṃjñāyāma' itvasya pratiṣedhasya puṃsi `bhāryā nāma kṣatriyaḥ' ityatra dṛṣṭatvāt caritārthatvāt| tathā ca sāmarthyaṃ nāstīti bhāvaḥ| tasmāt bhāryāśabdo na siddhyatīti codyaṃ sustham|
uttaramāha-striyāṃ bhāvādhikāro'stīti| nanu "saṃjñāyāṃ samaja"(pāosūo3-3-99)iti sūtre vṛttikṛdvakṣvati bhāve iti na svaryate pūrvaevādhikāra iti| yuktaṃ caitat, `samajanti tasyāmiti samjvā' `niṣīdanti tasyāmiti niṣadyā' ityādidarśanāt| tatkathamucyate `striyāṃ bhāvādhikāro'stīti? satyam| striyāṃ-strīprakaraṇe "saṃjñāyāṃ samaja" itvādinā kyapi vidhīyamāne bhāvasyādhikāraḥ abhidheyatvopagamalakṣaṇo vyāpāro'sti| śabdaśaktisvābhāvyādbhāva eva kyap na tu karmaṇītvāśavaḥ|
etadaparitoṣādevāha-athaveti| na patantyanenetyapatyam| ajantāt bhāvakarmaṇorvidhīyamāno'pi yat halantātkaraṇe ca bhavati| `janyam' ityatrāpi halantādyat, `bhittiḥ' ityatra "ṣidbhidādibhyo'ṅ"(pāosūo3-3-104)ityaṅo viṣaye ktin| sarvamidaṃ yathā bāhulakādbhavati, evaṃ bhāryāśabde kyabviṣaye ṇyadbhavatītyarthaḥ| athavā itthaṃ samādheyam-kyabvidhau bhṛñ bharaṇe(bhvāouo923)iti bhvādireva gṛhyate na jauhotyādiko ḍubhṛñ bharaṇe(juouo5), dvyanubandhakatvāt| evañca vibhartervā `bhṝñbharaṇe'(kryāopao19)iti dīrghāntāt kryādervāṇvati bhāryāśabdo nirbādha eveti|
(pāosūo3-1-113)

ete sapta kyavantā nipātyante| abhiṣiktaḥ kṣatriyo rājā tena sotavyo'bhiṣavadvārema niṣpādayitavya ityarthe karmaṇi kyap| dīrghatvañca nipātvate rūḍhyartham| yadvā latātmakaḥ somo rājā, "rājānaṃ krīṇanti" ityādau darśanāt| sa sūyate kaṇḍ‌yate atra ityarthe adhikaraṇe kyap| nipātanaṃ rūḍhyartham| tena ādyapakṣe aśvamedhādau dvitīyapakṣe jyotiṣṭomādau ca nātiprasaṅgaḥ| rājasūyaśabdaśca punnapuṃsakaliṅgo'rdharcāditvāt| saratyākāśamārge iti sūryaḥ| `sṛ gatau'(bhvāopao960)| kartari kyap nipātanādutvaṃ, raparatvaṃ, "hali ca'(pāosūo8-2-77)iti dīrghaḥ| yadvā `ṣū preraṇe'(tuopao128)tudādiḥ| suvati-karmaṇi lokaṃ prerayati itvarthe kartari kyapi kṛte kyapo ruḍāgamaśca nipātyate| mṛṣopapadādvadeḥ karmaṇi kyap| pakṣe yati prāpte nityaṃ kyap nipātyate| viśeṣyanighno'yam|

chandasīti vaktavyam(kāovāo)|| loke tu-pratigrāhyam, apigrāhyam| gṛherdhātoḥ kyap syāt| pragṛhyampadam| vasya pragṛhyasaṃjñā vihiteti vṛttiḥ| yadyapi padāvayavasya dvivacanādeḥ pragṛhyasaṃjñā na tu padasya, tathāpi avayavadharmasya samudāye upacāro bodhyaḥ| yadvā yaugiko'yaṃ padaśabdaḥ paṭhyate, gamyate'nenārtha iti| asannikarṣaścātra gṛherarthaḥ, `agnī atra' ityādau hi prakṛtibhāvāt yaṇādyabhāve kiyatā'pi kālena vyavadhānāt parasparamacona sannikṛṣyante| tathā ca bavhṛcaprātiśākhyam-svarāntaraṃ tu vivṛttiḥ, sā vā svarabhaktikāleti| svarabhaktikālastu arddhamātrā pādamātrā vā, drāghīyasī sārddhamātreti tatraivoktatvāt| tathā cācorantarālasya vivṛttisaṃjñakasya varṇaśūnyakālasya kvacidarddhamātratvaṃ kvacitpādamātratvaṃ ceti phalito'rthaḥ| etadvyavasthā tu śikṣāsu boddhavyā| avagṛhyaṃ padam, yasyāvagrahaḥ kriyate iti vṛttiḥ| avagraho vicchedaḥ| atrāpi gṛhṇāterarthaḥ prāgvat, mātrā hrasvastāvadavagrahāntaramiti prātiśākhyāt| atra padakāle samāse pūrvapadamevagṛhyamiti haradattaḥ| upalakṣaṇañcaitat, `haribhiḥ' ityāderapi saṅgrāhyatvāt| tasmāt mahāpadasaṃjñākrānte ya ekadeśaḥ padakāle vicchidya paṭhyate, sa sarvo'pyavagṛhyamiti sthitiḥ| svenaiva īrituṃ śīlamasya svairī svatantraḥ| asvairī paratantraḥ| gṛhyakā ime, `gṛhītakā' ityarthaḥ| ubhayatrānukampāyāṃ kan| pañjarādibandhena paratantrīkṛtāḥ śukādaya ucyante|
gṛhāsaktāḥ pakṣimṛgāḥ chekāste gṛhyakāśca te|

yugyañca patre(pāosūo3-1-121)|| patantyanena patraṃ vāhanam| "dāmnīśasa"(pāosūo3-2-182)ityādinā karaṇe ṣṭran| tasminnarthe yujeḥ karmaṇi kyap kutvañca nipātyate| yugyo gauḥ| patre kim? `yogyam' anyat| ṇyati "cajoḥ"(pāosūo7-3-52)iti kutvam|
atra haradattaḥ-prāgghitīyena yatedaṃ siddham "tadvahatirathayugaprāsaṅgam"(pāosūo4-4-76)iti| svare'pi nāsti bhedaḥ| kyapi dhātusvaraḥ, yatyapi 'yato'nāvaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-213)ityādyudāttatvam| `ayugyam' ityatrāpi na svarabhedaḥ| "yayatoścātadarthe"(pāosūo6-2-156)"kṛtyokeṣṇuccārvādayaśca"(pāosūo6-2-160)ityubhayatrāpi antodāttatvavidhānāt| tasmādidaṃ sūtraṃ śakyamakartumiti|
atredaṃ vaktavyam| `yugyo gauḥ' ityādisiddhāvapi `yugyohastī' iti vṛttāvudāhṛtaṃ taddhitena na sidhyati, nahi hastī yugaṃ vahatīti| kṛtātu sidhyati yujyate sambandhaye hyasau kuthādineti| kiñca asatyasmisūtre ṇyat‌pratyayena `yogyo gauḥ' ityapi syāt| api ca svarabhedo'pi pākṣiko'styeva| "kraturbhavatyukthyaḥ" ityādau titmvaradarśanāt| "yato'nāvaḥ"(pāosūo6-1-213)iti sūtraṃ yadante dvyacke ekācprakṛtika eva pravartata iti vedabhāṣyakārapratipādite pakṣe svarabhedasya durvāratvāditi dik|

amāvasvadanyatarasyām(pāosūo3-1-122)|| amāśabdaḥ sahārthe varttate, `amātyaḥ' itvādau darśanāt| tasminnupapade vaserdhātorathikaraṇe ṇyat tannimittāyāṃ vṛddhau satyāṃ pākṣiko hrasvaśca nipātyate| nipātanādeva kālaviśeṣe rūḍhirlabhyate| amā saha sannikṛṣṭau vasato'syāṃ candrākrau ityamāvasyā, amāvāsyā| ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt "amāvāsyāyā vā"(pāosūo4-3-30)iti dīrghamadhyamanūdya vihitastāddhito hrasvamadhyādapi siddhyati| yadi tu yatpratyayāntasyedaṃ pākṣikaṃ nipātanamityāśrīyeta tadā yatā mukte `amāvāsyā' ityadhikaraṇe ṇyadeva tāvad durlabhaḥ| athāpi bāhukālāllabhyeta, evamapi "amāvāsyāyā vā"(pāosūo4-3-30)ityatra ṇyadantagrahaṇe yadantaṃ na gṛhyeta| kiñca ṇyatpakṣe upapadasamāso na syāt| mayūravyaṃsakāditvādbhaviṣyatīti cet? evamapi "gatikārakopapadāt"(pāosūo6-2-139)iti svaro na syāt, kiṃ tvantodāttaḥ syāt, iṣyate tu titsvara eva "amāvāsyāsubhagā suseva" `yadāgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'māvāsyāyām' itvādau svāśabde svaritatvasya śeṣāniyātasya ca paṭhyamānatvāt| tasmāt "ṇyadantasyaiva vṛddhau satyāṃ pakṣe hrasvo nipātyate" iti yathāvyākhyānamevādarttavyam| tathā ca bhāṣyam-
amāvasorahaṃ ṇyatornipātayāmyavṛddhitām|
tathaikavṛttitā tayoḥ svaraśca me prasidhyati||
iha vyaktibhedāśrayo dvivacanirddeśaḥ| ekasyoti śeṣaḥ| ṇyatoḥ-ṇyadantayoḥ| amāpūrvayorvasormadhye ekasya avṛddhitāṃ hrasvam ahaṃ nipātayāmi| sūtrakāreṇaikyamāpannasyeyamuktiḥ| tathā sati tayoḥ śabdayorekā taddhitavṛttiryayoḥ tattā sidhyati ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt| evaṃ nipātayato me svaro'pi sidh‌yati| sa ca vyākhyāta eva| na ca siddhānte'pi uttarapadaprakṛtisvaro durlabhaḥ, sūtre saptamyabhāvena upapadasaṃjñāyā apravṛttau upapadātparatvābhāvāditi vācyam, `amā' iti saptamyā lukā nirddeśāditi bhāvaḥ|
(pāosūo3-1-123)
chandasi niṣṭarkyadevahūyapraṇīyonnīyocchiṣyamaryastaryādhvaryakhanyakhānyadevayajyāpṛcchyapratiṣīvyabrahmavādyabhāvyastāvyopacāyyapṛḍāni(pāosūo3-1-123)|| etāni saptadaśa chandasi nipātyante| kṛtī chedane (tuopao154)asmāt nis‌pūrvātkyapi prāpte ṇvat, ādyantayorviparyāsaḥ, nisaḥ ṣatvaṃ ca nipātyate, niṣṭarkyaṃ cinvīta paśukāmaḥ| devaśabda upapade vhayaterjuhotervā kyap dīrghatvaṃ tugabhāvaśca, sparddhante vā udevahūye| atra prapūrvādutpurvācca nayateḥ kyap, praṇīyaḥ, unnīyaḥ| utpūrvācchiṣeḥ kyap, ucchiṣyam| mṛṅ prāṇatyāge(tuoāo123), stañ ācchādane(svāouo6), dhvṛ hūrchane(bhvāopao164)ebhyo yat, maryaḥ, staryā, striyāmevāsya nipātanam| dhvaryaḥ| khaneryatṇyato, khanyaḥ, khānyaḥ| devaśabda upapade yajeryapratyayaḥ, śundhadhvaṃ daivyāya karmaṇe devayajyāyai| pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatve kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ| strīliṅga evedaṃ nipātanam| āṅ‌pūrvātpṛccheḥ kyap, āpṛcchyaṃ dharuṇaṃ vājyarṣati| pratipūrvātsīvyateḥ kyap ṣatvañca, pratiṣīvyaḥ| brahmaṇyupapade vadervyat, "vadaḥ supi kyap ca"(pāosūo3-1-106)iti prāptayoḥ kvavyatorapavādaḥ, brahmavādyam| atha kathaṃ "brahmodyaṃ vadanti"(ṛośroosūo2-4)iti? chandasi viśeṣavihitena ṇyatā loke caritārthasya "vadaḥ supi" iti kyapo bādhaprasaṅgāt| na ca "vāsarūpa"(paobhāo8)ityuktatvāt| satyam, kṛdvyatyayo'tra bodhyaḥ| uktaṃ hi, "kālahalac‌svarakartṛyaṅāṃ ca" iti| tatra hi kartṛgrahamaṃ kṛtpratyayaparamityavocāma|
bhavateḥ stauteśca ṇyat, bhāvyaḥ, stāvyaḥ| upapūrvāccinoterṇyat āyādeśaśca nipātyate pṛḍe uttarapade| mṛḍa sukhane, pṛḍa ca(tuopao47,48)| ityetasmādigupadhalakṣaṇaḥkaḥ, upacāyyapṛḍam|
hiraṇya iti vaktavyam(kāovāo)|| upaceyapṛḍamevānyam| atra vāvarttikam-
niṣṭarkye vyatyayaṃ vidyāt nisaḥ ṣatvaṃ nipātanāt|
ṇyadāyādeśa ityetau upacāyye nipātitau||
ṇyadekasmāccaturbhyaḥ kyap caturbhvaśca yato vidhiḥ|
ṇyadekasmādyaśabdaśca dvau kyapau ṇyadvidhiścatuḥ||
ṇyatvayamiti, ādyantaviparyāsamatyarthaḥ| `caturbhyaḥ' iti devahūyādiṣu caturbhyo dhātubhyaḥ kyap, upasargabhedānnayaterbhedaḥ| dvau kyapāviti, dvābhyāṃ dhātubhvāṃ dvāviti bhāvaḥ| ṇyadvidhiścaturiti sujantam| `caturo vārān ṇyadvidhīyate' ityarthaḥ||

pāyyasānnāyyanikāyyadhāyyā mānahavirnivāsasāmidhenīṣu(pāosūo3-1-129)|| yathāsaṃkhyaṃ caturṣu catvāro nipātyante| pāyyaṃ mānam| mīyate'nena mānam| māṅo ṇyatpratyayaḥ karaṇe| "āto yuk ciṇ‌kṛtoḥ"(pāosūo7-3-33)|| iti yuk| dhātvādeḥ patvañca nipātanāt| meyamanyat| sānnāyyaṃ havirviśeṣaḥ| samyaṅ nīyate homārthamagniṃ pratīti| sampūrvānnayaterṇyadāyādeśau upasargadīrghatvañca nipātyate| aindrandadhyamāvāsyāyām, aindraṃ payo'māvāsyāyāmiti vihitayordādhipayasoḥ saṃjñoyam|
māghastu yathāśrutagrāhī havirmātre prāyuṅkta-
pratiśaraṇamaśīrṇajyotiragnyāhitānāṃ vidhivihitaviribdhaiḥ sāmidhenīradhītya|
kṛtaguruduritaughadhvaṃsamadhvayurmukhyairhutamayamavalīḍhe sādhusānnāyyamagniḥ|| iti|(māokāo11-41)
nanvidamapi dadhipayoviṣayakameva kiṃ na syāditi vācyam, candrodayāstamayavarṇanapūrvakaṃ sūryodayaṃ prakramya paṭhitasyāsya kṛṣṇapratipadviṣayatvena tatra dadhipayoyogasyāsambhavāt| havirviśeṣavācakasya sāmānye viśeṣantare vā lakṣaṇetyapi bodyam| nikāyyo nivāsaḥ| nipūrvāccinoteradhikaraṇe ṇyat, āyādeśaḥ, ādeḥ katvañca nipātyate| nicīyate'smindhānyādikamiti vigrahaḥ| niceyamanyat| atraivārthe nikāyaśabdo'pyasti| sa ca "nivāsacitiśarīropasamādhāneṣvādeśca kaḥ"(pāosūo3-3-41)ityatra vyutpādayiṣyate| dhāño ṇyat‌pratyayaḥ sāmidhenyām| samidhāmādhānī sāmidhenī| "samidhāmādhāne ṣeṇyaṇ"(kāovāo)| "pravovājāḥ" ityādikā ṛcaḥ sāmidhenyaḥ| atra ca na sarvā sāmidhenī dhāyyetyucyate, kintu samidhyamānavantīṃ samiddhavantīṃ cāntarema vikṛtiṣu prakṣipyamāṇā 'pṛthupājā amartyaḥ" ityādikaiva| sūtre sāmidhenīgrahaṇaṃ prayogaviṣayopalakṣaṇārtham| tathā cāsāmidhenyāmapi dṛśyate-dhāyyāḥ śaṃsati| "agnirnetā" "tvaṃ somakratubhiḥ" iti jyotiṣṭome marutvatīye śastravidhānametat| tatra `dhīyate anayā samit' iti karaṇe ṇyaditi haradattagranthaḥ "pṛthupājāḥ" ityādiviṣayaḥ, `dhīyata iti dhāyyā' iti karmaṇi ṇyaditi mādhavagranthastu "agnirnetā" ityādisādhāraṇa iti vivekaḥ| sarvaścāyaṃ viśeṣo nipātanasya rūḍhyarthatvāllabhyate|
(pāosūo3-1-130)

agnau paricāyyopacāyyasamūhyāḥ(pāosūo3-1-131)|| ete nipātyante agnāvabhidheye| agniśceha na jvalanaḥ, kintu taddhāraṇārthamiṣṭakācayananirmitasthalaviśeṣaḥ, tatraiva nirūḍhatvāt| paripūrvāduparpūrvācca cinoterṇyadāyādeśau nipātyete-paricāyyaḥ| upacāyyaḥ, sampūrvādvheḥ samprasāraṇaṃ dīrghatvañca nipātyate-samūhyaṃ cinvīta paśukāmaḥ| agnāviti kim? pariceyam| upaceyam| saṃvāhyam| iha sampūrvāt "ūhavitarke'(bhvāoāo649)ityasmādanekārthatvādvaherarthe vartamānāddhalantatvāṇṇyati `samūhyam' iti siddham| yuktaṃ caitat; "samūhyaṃ cinvīta paśukāmaḥ| paśavo vai puruṣaḥ| paśunevāsmai tatsamūhati" iti vahyarthena ūhinā brāhmaṇe samūhyaśabdasya niruktatvāt| uktañca vārtikakṛtā-

nandigrahipacādibhyo lyuṇinyacaḥ(pāosūo3-1-134)|| nandyāderlyuḥ, grahyāderṇiniḥ, pacāderac syāt| nandigrahipacādayaśca na dhātupāṭhe sanniviṣṭāḥ saṃgṛhyante| kintarhi nandana ramaṇa ityevamādiṣu prātipadikagaṇeṣu ye prakṛtibhāgāste iha buddhyā pṛthak kṛtya gṛhyante| nanvevaṃ kimanena sūtreṇa, gaṇapāṭhādeva nandanādiśabdānāṃ sādhutvopapatteriti cet?
atra haradattaḥ--asatyasminnaṣṭādhyāyyāṃ kvacidapyanupayogāt gaṇapāṭho nāpekṣaṣyate iti| tasyāyamāśayaḥ-eva eva sādhava iti svarūpaniyamaparaṃ hi vyākaraṇaśāstraṃ tacca "sūtreṣveva hi tatsarvam" iti nyāyena sūtrātmakam| tathā ca yatsūtraiḥ kathamapi na viṣayīkṛtaṃ, tasya gāvyādivadarthādasādhutvaṃ prasajyeteti|

ākṛtigaṇo'yam| tathā ca "śivaśamariṣṭasya kare"(pāosūo4-4-143)iti sūtre kṛño'c‌pratyayaḥ kṛtaḥ| "karmaṇi ghaṭo'ṭhac"(pāosūo5-2-35)iti sūtre ca ghaṭeḥ| tathā 'yaṅo'ci ca"(pāosūo2-4-74)iti sūtreṇa asminnac pratyaye pare yaṅo lugvihitaḥ| bhāṣye ca "ajapi sarvadhātubhyo vaktavyaḥ" ityuktam| kimarthaṃ tarhi pacādyanukramaṇamiti cet? nadaṭ ityādau anubandāsañjanārtham, karmopapadānāmigupadānāṃ ca bādhanārtham| anyeṣāntu prapañcārtham| tathāhi-nadaṭ, bhaṣaṭ, plavaṭ, caraṭ, garaṭ, taraṭ, coraṭ, devaṭ, sūdaṭ, ete ṭitaḥ| nada avyakte śabde(bhvāopao54), ṭo ṅībarthaḥ, nadaḥ| nadī| bhaṣa bhartsane(bhvāopao696)bhaṣī| pluṅ gatau(bhvāoāo983)plavī| cara gatau(bhvāopao560)carī| gṝ nigaraṇe(tuopao130)garī| tṝ plavanataraṇayoḥ(bhvāopao994)tarī| cura steye(cuopao1)corī| divu krīḍādau(diopao7)devī| sūdiruktārthaḥ| sūdī| miṣa sparddhāyām(tuopao72)meṣaḥ| kupa krodhe(diopao127)kopaḥ| sūplṛ gatau(bhvāopao1008)sarpaḥ| iha diviprabhṛtiṣu igupadhatvātkaḥ prāptaḥ| ḍubhṛñ(juouo5)jāraṃ bibhartīti jārabharā| śvānaṃ pacatīti śvapacā| anayoḥ karmaṇyaṇ prāptaḥ| nyaṅkvādiṣu śvapākaśabdasya pāṭhāt pakṣe 'karmaṇyaṇ"(pāosūo3-2-1)api bhavatīti kaiyaṭādayaḥ| jṝṣ‌mṛṅ‌prabhṛtīnāntu pāṭhaḥ prapañcārtha eveti vivekaḥ|
(pāosūo3-1-135)

pāghrādhmādheḍ‌dṛśaḥ śaḥ(pāosūo3-1-137)|| ebhyaḥ pañcabhyaḥ śapratyayaḥ syāt| pibatīti pibaḥ| jighraḥ| dhamaḥ| dhayaḥ| striyāntu ṭāp, dhayā| yadyapi dheṭiṣṭittvāt stanandhayītyatreva ihāpi ṅīp prāpnoti| tathāpi "khaśante eva ṅīp na tu śapratyayānte" iti sūtre `upasarge' iti kecidanuvartayanti, tattu bahūnāmasammatam| tathā ca prāyuṅkta śrīharṣaḥ- phalāni dhūmasya dhayānadhomukhāniti| śrūyate ca-yadā paśyaḥ paśyate rukmavarṇamiti| atra pibatereva grahaṇaṃ na tu `pā rakṣaṇe'(aopao46)ityasya, lugvikaraṇatvāt|

anupasargāllimpavindadhāripārivedyudejicetisātisāhibhyaśca(pāosūo3-1-138)|| anupasargebhyo limpādibhyaḥ śapratyayaḥ syāt| limpatīti limpaḥ| vindatīti vindaḥ| sūtre limpavindeti bhāvinā numā sanum‌kau nirdiṣṭau| tena vikaraṇetarāṇāmagrahaṇam| lābhārthasyaiva tu grahaṇam| dhṛñ dhāraṇe(bhvāouo925), dhṛṅ avasthāne(tuoāo132), ṇyantayordvayorapi grahaṇam| dhārayaḥ| atha kathaṃ 'na mahyamatrottaradārayasya te" iti śrīharṣaḥ? paratvāddhi sūtradhārādiṣviva karmaṇyaṇā bhāvyam| tathā ca vārttikam-akārādanupapadātkarmopapado vipratiṣedhena (kāovāo)iti| satyam, karmaṇaḥ śeṣatvavivakṣāyāmaṇo'prāptyā śe kṛte śeṣaṣaṣṭhyantena samāso bhaviṣyati| etena gaṅgādharabhūdharajaladharādayo vyākhyātāḥ| pāra karmasamāptau(cuopao379)pārayatīti pārayaḥ| vidacetanākhyānādiṣu(cuoāo175)curādiḥ| jñānādyarthānāmanyatamo vā hetumaṇṇyantaḥ| vedayatīti vedayaḥ| ejṛ kampane(bhvāoāo173)ṇyantaḥ| udejayatītyudejayaḥ| citi saṃjñāne(cuopao2)curādiḥ| cetayatīti cetayaḥ| sata sukhe curādiṇyanta iti bopadevaḥ| sātiḥ sautro hetumaṇṇyanta iti haradattaḥ| sātayaḥ| vāsarūpanyāyena kvipi sāt| sampadāditvādbhāve kvibvā| evañca eṣa evānandayatīti śrutibalādānandayitṛvijñānamānandamityādima śrutibalādānandarūpaṃ brahma sācchabdārthaḥ| tadastyeṣāmiti sātvanto bhaktāḥ| etena 'sātvatāṃ pataye namaḥ" ityādi vyākhyātam| sadeva sāt ityuktvā ārṣatvañca vadantaḥ pratyākhyātāḥ| `ṣada marṣaṇe'(bhvāoāo877)curādirhetumaṇṇnto vā, sāhayaḥ| udāharaṇeṣu limpivindibhyāṃ "tudādibhyaḥ śaḥ"(pāosūo3-1-77)"śe mucādinām"(pāosūo70-1-69)iti num| dārayādiṣu śab‌guṇāyādeśāḥ| anupasargāditi kim? pralipaḥ|
nau limperiti vaktavyam(kāovāo)|| nilimpā nāma devāḥ|

gahe kaḥ(pāosūo3-1-144)|| graheḥ kaḥ syāt gehe kartari| gṛhṇati dhānyādikamiti gṛham| tātsthyād gṛhā dārāḥ| gṛhaśabdo'rdharccādiḥ| tatra pulliṅkho bahuvacanānta eva| napuṃsakastu abhidheyavacanaḥ| dvividho'pi veśmani mukhyaḥ| dāreṣu gauṇaḥ| tathā ca-

śilpini ṣvun(pāosūo3-1-145)|| dhātoḥ ṣvun syāt śilpini kartari| kriyākauśalaṃ śilpaṃ, tadasyāstīti śilpī| pūrveṇa sāhacaryāt `śilpini' ityapi pratyayārthasya viśeṣaṇam| atra bhāṣye "nṛtikhani rañjibhyaḥ" iti parigaṇanaṃ kṛtam| nartakaḥ| nartakī| khanakaḥ| khanakī| "janījṝṣ‌knasurañjo'mantāśca"(gaosūo)iti mittvoktirjñāpayati-sañjerak‌ṅityapi kvacidanunāsikalopo bhavatīti nyāsakāraharadattādayaḥ| evañca "rañjerṇau mṛgaramaṇe"(kāovāo)iti "rajakarajanarajassūpasaṅkhyānam"(kāovāo)iti ca vārttikaṃ jñāpanasiddhārthānuvādakam| rajakaḥ| rajakī| ṣittvānṅīṣ|
bhāṣyamate tu ṅīṣ na bhavati| tathāhi-ṣaṣṭhe "rajakarajanarajaḥsūpasaṅkhyānam" iti vārttikaṃ pratyākhyātuṃ bhāṣyakṛtoktaṃ "kita ete auṇādikāḥ" iti,
